This amendment aims to reverse the budget cut for Slachtofferhulp for the year 2009.

Shifts justice budget funds to allow exit programmes for prostitutes to continue in 2009.

requests the government to make available a total of 1 million for the Literair Productiefonds, the sector institutes

qa: Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over de arrestatie van een kopstuk van de radicaal islamitische terreurbeweging Hamas (ingezonden 3 ju

MPs Voordewind and Anker asked ministers whether a Dutch citizen of Palestinian origin, released by Israel after arrest, is a Hamas leader and whether Dutch criminal or residence-law consequences follow. Minister Verhagen declined to discuss this individual case, stating the general rules on revoking Dutch nationality and that the answers could not be given in time.
I cannot provide any information on individual cases such as this one.
Over individuele zaken zoals de onderhavige kan ik geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Cramer en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vervanging van een (bijna) defecte OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why replacing a damaged or defective student OV-chipkaart requires a paper form and surrender of the old card, leaving students without travel rights for up to three weeks, and whether replacement at reasonable cost, or deactivation of the old card, can be arranged. The state secretary answered that card responsibility lies with transport operators, that verification and anti-misuse rules require the defective card to be returned, that temporary cards are issued when delays threaten, and that service levels are being agreed with operators.
I am making agreements with the OV companies about the service levels.
Ik maak afspraken met de OV-bedrijven over de niveaus van dienstverlening.

Vragen van het lid Anker (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de advertentie van de politie Drenthe, Fryslân en Groningen waarin kandidaten worden opgeroepen te solliciteren n

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether a police vacancy advertisement for a division chief in Drenthe, Fryslân and Groningen, which appeared to exclude candidates on the basis of origin or gender, conflicts with law and what measures will follow. The Minister agrees it conflicts with current legislation, says the regional corps will reopen the vacancy in line with the law, and states he knows of no other cases of exclusion by race or gender.
Yes, I share the view of the Equal Treatment Commission that it is in conflict with the applicable legislation.
Ja, ik deel de opvatting van de Commissie gelijke behandeling dat het in strijd is met de vigerende wetgeving.
Vragen van het lid Anker (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de legalisering van de bevoorrading van softdrugs in Utrecht (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Justice whether a planned Utrecht experiment with legal supply to coffee shops fits Dutch law and international drug treaties, and how the government will act. The Minister answered that the experiment would conflict with the Opiumwet and VN drug conventions, that no municipal experiment will take place this term, and that he will tell the Utrecht council it is undesirable.
As soon as the opportunity arises, I will inform the Utrecht municipal executive that it is undesirable for the plan in the Utrecht coalition agreement to be implemented during this cabinet term.

Zodra de gelegenheid zich voordoet zal ik het College van B&W aangeven dat het onwenselijk is dat het voornemen uit het Utrechtse coalitieakkoord in deze kabinetsperiode tot uitvoering wordt gebracht.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitsp

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about a Council of State ruling on noise nuisance from Leger des Heils church services in Zutphen, including whether the Activiteitenbesluit exemption for religious services distinguishes amplified from unamplified sound and whether the law should be amended. The minister answered that the ruling is a provisional measure, the legal procedure is not finished, so the cabinet cannot comment on the case, while confirming the exemption applies regardless of amplification.
The judgment of the chair of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State concerns a provisional measures ruling.
Het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State betreft een voorlopige voorzieningsuitspraak.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Anker (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Uitzetting Afghaanse christen geblokkeerd» (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

MPs Van der Staaij (SGP) and Anker (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Justice about an ECHR interim measure halting the deportation of an Afghan Christian asylum seeker and its implications for asylum policy toward Christian converts. The minister replied that the interim measure gives no reason to change Dutch policy, that individual asylum claims of converts are already tested for risks on return, and that no alternative verification method is planned.
I therefore attach no consequences to this for Dutch asylum policy toward Christians from Iran and Afghanistan.
Ik verbind hieraan dan ook geen gevolgen voor het Nederlandse asielbeleid ten aanzien van christenen uit Iran en Afghanistan.

Vragen van het lid Anker (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het weggooien van stempassen van gehandicapten door zorginstellingen (ingezonden 29 april 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the state secretary whether care institutions discarding disabled residents' postal voting passes is acceptable, whether institutions should organise assistance so residents can vote, and whether they will be informed before the 2010 elections. The state secretary agrees the passes should not be discarded, says she will write to care institutions reminding them of their duty to hand out passes and of ID requirements, but gives no binding rules.
I will point care institutions to this in a letter.
Ik zal zorginstellingen in een brief hierop wijzen.
qn: Vragen van de leden Ferrier (CDA), Kraneveldt-van der Veen (PvdA), Anker (ChristenUnie), Van der Vlies (SGP), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over

MPs from six parties asked the Minister of Education about the PO-Raad's claim that cuts to Passend Onderwijs would force school dismissals, the basis for harmonising the rugzak funding for special primary education, and how this fits earlier commitments and the cabinet's caretaker status. The minister confirmed the amounts, explained the harmonisation as a response to rising indications exceeding the 2010 budget, and said hardship cases would get tailored solutions.
The press release, however, concerns the current situation.
Het persbericht ziet echter op de huidige situatie.

m: Amendement van de leden Sneller en Tseggai over het stellen van democratische vereisten aan de interne organisatie van politieke partijen
Imposes democratic internal-organisation requirements on political parties, enforced through registration checks and reporting by the Autoriteit, before they can appear on ballots.
A political association that acts in breach of the obligations in this section will not have its designation placed above a candidate list.

Van de politieke vereniging die handelt in strijd met de in deze paragraaf genoemde verplichtingen wordt de aanduiding niet boven een kandidatenlijst als bedoeld in artikel H 1, eerste lid, van de Kieswet geplaatst.

Het wetsvoorstel bepaalt dat de statuten van een beursvennootschap kunnen bepalen dat een algemene vergadering tevens of uitsluitend digitaal kan plaatsvinden.

that boards of (listed) companies may also, without a statutory basis, determine that a general meeting is accessible only electronically
dat besturen van (beurs)vennootschappen ook zonder statutaire grondslag kunnen bepalen dat een algemene vergadering uitsluitend toegankelijk is langs elektronische weg

the accountability and deliberation function of a general meeting is best served when the annual meeting is held physically or hybrid

Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Sneller en Stultiens ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het faciliteren van digitale vergaderingen zonder statutaire grondslag in uitzonderlijke gevallen

Amendement van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Sneller over een evaluatie binnen 5 jaar

The minister answered that budget constraints under the caretaker cabinet limit funding, that the cabinet is exploring additional funds before the conferences, and that detailed programme allocations and results will only be shared after the conference.
No, I cannot commit to this, since the final distribution of ESA funds across the various programmes is only determined during the Ministerial Conference.
Nee, dit kan ik niet toezeggen aangezien de definitieve verdeling van de ESA-middelen over de verschillende programma’s pas tijdens de Ministeriële Conferentie wordt bepaald.

The minister said remote work resumed on 16 October, backlogs are being worked off without a timeline, ICT was heavily funded in recent years, and the OM has signalled a future financial gap that is still being assessed.
At this moment I cannot yet make statements about the period within which the backlogs will be cleared.
Op dit moment kan ik nog geen uitspraken doen over de termijn waarbinnen de achterstanden zijn weggewerkt.

I cannot give an estimate of the cost difference between private accountancy firms and municipal accountancy services.

I expect to submit the implementing law to your House for consideration before the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de uitvoeringswet voor het einde van dit jaar bij uw Kamer in te dienen voor behandeling.

It is correct that the disruption at the OM meant that information from the OM dated after 17 July was missing from the JDS.
Het klopt dat de verstoring bij het OM ertoe heeft geleid dat informatie van het OM van na 17 juli jl. ontbrak in het JDS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, Sneller en Koops over het bericht dat justitiepersoneel bekneld raakt door de doorgeslagen verzuimaanpak van Detentiecentrum Rotterdam

The State Secretary denied the policy is structural or that absenteeism there is significantly above the DJI average, acknowledged an incidental misapplication, and declined a separate investigation while noting ongoing verzuim monitoring.
However, this does not concern a structural practice or standing policy.
Het gaat hier echter niet om een structurele werkwijze of staand beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'De onwaarschijnlijke val van een burgemeester'

An MP asked why the mayor of Schuiling was allegedly offered honourable dismissal conditional on withdrawing his appeal against a criminal penalty order, and how this fits with the earlier claim that no pressure was applied. The Minister denied tying honourable dismissal to withdrawing the appeal, noted the dismissal was granted even though the appeal was maintained, and declined a broader reflection while the appeal is pending.
No. The granting of honourable dismissal is not linked by me, as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, to everyone's fundamental right of access to the courts.
Nee. De verlening van eervol ontslag wordt door mij als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet gekoppeld aan ieders fundamentele aanspraak op toegang tot de rechter.

Taken together, this means I do not currently arrive at a reasonable suspicion that a criminal offence has been committed.
Dat bij elkaar maakt dat ik nu niet kom tot een redelijk vermoeden dat er een strafbaar feit is gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het laptopverbod voor advocaten in gevangenissen

As long as there is no clarity on what the policy will look like exactly, I cannot make any statements about possible (implementation) consequences.
Zolang er nog geen duidelijkheid is over hoe het beleid er exact uit komt te zien, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over eventuele (uitvoerings-)consequenties.

The Minister said about 32% of reports on offences were rejected in 2024, with roughly 18% never approved, and outlined measures to reduce errors but gave no concrete figures on lost fines.
I cannot give an amount here because, as I indicated in my answer to question 3, we do not know what the prosecution decision would have been had these reports been approved.

Ik kan hier geen bedrag noemen omdat we, zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, niet weten hoe de vervolgbeslissing van het OM zou zijn uitgevallen als deze processen-verbaal wel waren goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de vermogensrechtelijke behandeling van cryptoactiva

MP Sneller asked the government about the property-law treatment of crypto-assets under MiCAR, including the lack of a Dutch legal basis for asset segregation, the difficulty of transferring, pledging and seizing digital goods, and preparation for a digital euro. The State Secretary answered that the AFM requires segregation via a foundation model without a statutory basis, that a wider legal framework is a matter for a new Cabinet, and that no plans currently exist to regulate digital goods under property law.
There are currently no plans to proceed to further property-law regulation of digital goods.
Er zijn op dit moment geen voornemens om over te gaan tot het nader vermogensrechtelijk reguleren van digitale goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de uitspraak van de rechter dat digitale platforms geen openbare plaats zijn in de zin van de APV

Sneller (D66) asked the government to respond to a Council of State ruling that digital platforms are not a public place under municipal bylaws, and asked whether the earlier cabinet position was wrong, why no national vision exists, and what alternatives exist for online incitement. Naturally, I am looking concretely at options to further strengthen the room for action.
Uiteraard kijk ik concreet naar mogelijkheden om het handelingsperspectief verder te verstevigen.

It is up to the supervisor to act if necessary.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om indien nodig op te treden.

Therefore it is not accepted that insufficient guidance is possible.
Daarom wordt niet gedeeld dat er onvoldoende begeleiding mogelijk is.

The minister answered that all preparatory meetings of council committees fall under openness rules, that closed meetings must follow the statutory procedure, and that he will not sanction municipalities via the municipal fund or seek advice from the Raad van State, leaving responsibility with the councils.
Closed meetings must therefore always be an exception and open meetings the rule.
Besloten vergaderingen dienen dan ook altijd een uitzondering te zijn en openbare vergaderingen de regel.

MPs Sneller (D66) asked whether membership of exclusive networks such as the Haagse Schouw by judges and senior officials should be registered as secondary positions and disclosed. Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de bezorgtijden van PostNL in relatie tot de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen

The minister replies that the 48-hour standard applies only to universal postal service mail, not election mail, which is governed by contracts with PostNL, and that the new rule does not take effect until July 2026; the government stresses timely delivery, asks municipalities to use alternative couriers for late replacement cards, and says the replacement-card deadlines will be examined in the candidate-nomination bill.
That is why I earlier indicated that I would examine the Electoral Act deadlines for delivering voting documents and include them in the bill on the candidate nomination procedure.
Daarom heb ik eerder aangegeven de termijnen in de Kieswet voor de bezorging van stembescheiden te onderzoeken en te betrekken bij het wetsvoorstel over de kandidaatstellingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over het artikel ‘Opnieuw grenscontroles door groep burgers, dit keer bij  Groningse Sellingen’

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether citizen groups stopping cars at the border and intimidating people is acceptable, what the government thinks of the chat messages with racist and violent content, and whether the government's initial response was too lax. The minister answered that border controls are reserved to authorities such as the Marechaussee, that taking the law into one's own hands is not allowed, that one suspect has been arrested, and that prosecution decisions rest with the prosecutor and judge.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have been committed.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Medische misstanden in Nederlandse gevangenissen. Ik kwam lopend binnen, en verliet de gevangenis in een rolstoel’

MPs Sneller and Van der Werf asked the Justice Minister about reports of medical failures in Dutch prisons, including delayed care, wrong medication, and reliance on untrained guards for medical matters. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems in principle, said the number of cases is unknown, and outlined existing procedures, on-call doctors, and planned reviews of women's detention, while disputing that cost considerations drive care decisions.
I take all signals, as described in the Misstandenboek, very seriously.
Ik neem alle signalen, zoals beschreven in het Misstandenboek, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the Health Minister about delays to the medicinal cannabis policy, supply continuity for patients, the closing of the procurement for a second grower, reimbursement and inspection capacity. The Minister said the policy rule and law change will proceed on schedule, supply will come from existing stock with a fallback import plan, and no new plans exist to change the current variety offer or reimbursement.
The Ministry of VWS will then proceed to import medicinal cannabis as a finished product.
Het Ministerie van VWS zal dan overgaan tot import van medicinale cannabis als «gereed product».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bevorderen van steward owned ondernemen in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether steward-ownership legislation and a model-articles approach would be pursued, and whether a survey should be commissioned in the Netherlands. The minister answered that consultations with experts are ongoing, that a decision on follow-up to the motion will come in autumn 2025, and deferred the substantive questions to that later letter.
You will be informed about this in the autumn of 2025.
Hierover zult u in het najaar van 2025 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de aflevering “Gaby overlijdt, maar familie kan niet rouwen door onze overheid”

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about delays in foreign death certificates for Dutch citizens dying abroad and municipalities refusing to register deaths without them. The government answered that municipalities may register deaths on lower-ranked source documents under the BRP Act, that case-by-case judgment is needed, and that guidance will be reiterated to municipalities, without new rules.
Following the broadcast and these parliamentary questions, the NVVB has already brought this to the attention of its members in its newsletter.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending en deze Kamervragen heeft de NVVB dit in haar nieuwsbrief al onder de aandacht gebracht van haar leden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Vijlbrief en Grinwis over de stijgende kosten voor huiseigenaren en bedrijven als gevolg van het ravijnjaar voor gemeenten

MPs asked the government about rising property tax (ozb) for homeowners and businesses caused by municipal deficits, and about whether this is reflected in purchasing-power, inflation and poverty forecasts. The minister answered that the government is in talks with local authorities, that ozb is excluded from forecasts with only small effects, and that setting local taxes is a matter for municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, the level of services and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport ‘Alpha Quick Scan: een zoektocht naar flakka’

MP Sneller asked the state secretary about the Alpha Quick Scan report on flakka, including market chaos after the alpha-cathinone ban, police burden, the balance between care and enforcement, the lack of clear aims of Opium Act listings, and the planned cut to subsidy for Stichting Mainline. The government answered that the ban reduced use, that investments in integrated care are expected to lower costs over time, that the ban aims mainly at health protection, and that the Mainline subsidy cut is justified because other parties can fill its role.
The aim of the ban is primarily the protection of health.
Het doel van het verbod is primair de bescherming van de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Opkomst gemeenteraadsverkiezingen naar dieptepunt’

MP Sneller asked the Minister of the Interior about the record-low turnout in municipal elections of 2022, its structural causes, and what the government is doing to raise turnout for the March 2026 elections, including targeting young people and supporting municipalities. The Minister agreed the causes are structural (notably low trust in politics), outlined campaign shifts, communication toolkits, youth initiatives and a planned webinar, but set no formal numeric turnout target.
The aim is that during the municipal elections of 18 March 2026 more eligible voters cast their vote than in the 2022 elections.
Het streven is dat tijdens de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 18 maart 2026 meer kiesgerechtigden hun stem uitbrengen dan tijdens de verkiezingen in 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Boswijk over de noodzaak om de onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht beter te waarborgen om onze democratische rechtsstaat weerbaarder te maken

MPs Sneller and Boswijk asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security how to better guarantee judicial independence, including the minister's role in appointing Council for the Judiciary members and court managers, the financing of the judiciary, and constitutionally anchoring the Council. The State Secretary answered that Dutch judicial independence is already safeguarded constitutionally and by law, that current safeguards are sufficient, and promised a letter by mid-2025 setting out possible reforms to appointments, financing and the Council's position.
In the letter announced in answer 1, to be sent by mid-2025, I intend to inform the House about the appointment procedures for court administrators.
In de in antwoord 1 genoemde, voor medio 2025 aangekondigde brief ben ik voornemens uw Kamer te informeren over de benoemingsprocedures van gerechtsbestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Sneller over het financieel verslag inzake het faillissement van KHN Rekenwerk

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked about the financial report on the bankruptcy of KHN Rekenwerk, the causes and responsibility for its financial problems, and whether Minister Beljaarts was liable, including the 550,000 euro paid by his D&O insurer and his use of a private spokesperson. The minister answered that the curator is responsible for investigating the bankruptcy, declined to draw conclusions on liability or the insurer's motives, and said the matter is private and predates his appointment.
It is for the curator to draw a conclusion on that basis and possibly assess the conduct of the directors in this matter.
Het is aan de curator om op basis daarvan een conclusie te trekken en daarmee eventueel een beoordeling te geven over het handelen van de bestuurders in deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het financieel verslag inzake het faillissement van KHN Rekenwerk

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked the Prime Minister why his answers to earlier questions on the KHN Rekenwerk bankruptcy report were referred to the minister involved, and when he would send his reflection on financial and business interests of incoming ministers. The Prime Minister said ministers answer for their own personal matters, that the earlier answers were sent on his behalf on 17 March 2025, and that a reflection letter will come by Q3 2027 at the latest.
As I noted in the letter, my aim is to review the existing framework ahead of a next formation.
Zoals ik heb opgemerkt in de genoemde brief is mijn oogmerk het bestaande kader tegen het licht te houden ten behoeve van een volgende formatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht 'Openbare agenda’s van bewindslieden geven te weinig inzicht in hun lobbywerk'

D66 MPs Podt and Sneller asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why his public agenda omitted or delayed entries, whether he had met burgomasters and key migration bodies. The minister answered that the agenda is generally accurate, that omissions were corrected, and listed meetings held with the Adviesraad Migratie, IOM, Nidos, UNHCR and the Inspectie, while admitting no contact with Vluchtingenwerk Nederland and Inspectie Jeugd & Gezin.
There were some omissions in the agenda, which have already been corrected.
Er was sprake van enkele omissies in de agenda, die zijn reeds hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Vijlbrief over de verplichte jaarlijkse WOZ-waardebepaling door gemeenten

MPs Sneller and Vijlbrief asked the government about replacing the mandatory annual WOZ property valuation with a biennial one, following a VNG motion, and about related costs and private users. The state secretary replied that a VNG-commissioned study is underway, that no reaction is yet warranted, that municipalities cannot set their own valuation frequency due to uniformity requirements, and that the cost and revenue data are not available, promising to consider the option in the Ombuigingslijst.
At this moment such figures are not available.
Op dit moment zijn dergelijke cijfers niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘De druppel die de emmer doet overlopen, naar een toekomstbestendige WETS-procedure voor overname van strafexecutie in Nederland de wetgever aan zet’

An MP asked the government about the lack of a direct hearing and limited legal remedies for convicted persons in the Dutch WETS recognition procedure for foreign prison sentences, and whether the procedure should be revised after the Arnhem-Leeuwarden appeal court was ruled inadmissible to refer questions to the European Court. The state secretary answered that convicted persons can submit written views, that civil courts remain available, and that a WODC study will examine the procedure's allocation of roles and legal protection.
Whether there is reason to revise the recognition procedure, as regards the legal protection of the convicted person, is the subject of the already announced study by the WODC.

Of er aanleiding bestaat om de erkenningsprocedure, wat betreft de rechtsbescherming van de veroordeelde, te herzien, is onderwerp van het reeds aangekondigde onderzoek van het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Hoofdeconoom BNP Paribas: ‘Kom gewoon met een pan-Europees regime voor bedrijven'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal for a pan-European corporate regime (28th regime) to ease cross-border operation in the EU. The minister said the government is broadly positive, supports deepening the single market and capital markets union, sees no added value for mortgages or pensions, and awaits the Commission's proposal.
The cabinet has in principle a positive attitude towards proposals that contribute to cross-border operation, the capital markets union and free movement in the internal market.
Het kabinet heeft in beginsel een positieve grondhouding naar voorstellen die bijdragen aan grensoverschrijdend opereren, de kapitaalmarktunie en het vrije verkeer op de interne markt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Dringend meer geld nodig voor schoolgebouwen'

MPs Sneller and Rooderkerk asked the government whether school building funding is adequate, citing an IBO finding of at least 730 million euros a year shortfall, and how school housing fits the Herstelplan and the planned school housing bill. The State Secretary acknowledged the IBO figure and the need for faster renewal but said no additional funds are available, and argued the housing bill sets no new building standards and that gemeenten will be compensated via the gemeentefonds.
The honest story is that this cabinet has had to make hard choices; there are no additional funds.
Het eerlijke verhaal is dat dit kabinet scherpe keuzes heeft moeten maken; er zijn geen aanvullende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het artikel 'Ongrijpbaar voor haar ambtenaren, onbereikbaar voor de buitenwereld: minister Faber opereert ‘volstrekt ongebruikelijk’'

MPs Sneller and Podt asked about reports that a political assistant to the Minister of Asylum and Migration had not passed an AIVD security screening, whether they had access to sensitive information via WhatsApp groups, and about staff departures and the absence of spokespersons at that ministry. The government declined to discuss the individual case, described the general screening procedure and rules on messaging apps, and said an independent advice on extra rules for political assistants had been requested.
Due to the confidential nature of personnel information of this type, I will not make any statements about individual cases.
In verband met het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter van dit type informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij subsidieverlening

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Sneller asked about the use of the Bibob Act in subsidy grants by central government, including RVO's practice, data sharing with municipalities, and LBB advice requests. The minister answers that Bibob use is left to each state body and is risk-based, describes the RVO advisory group and ten LBB requests, and promises further evaluation and updates.
Because of the confidentiality duty in the Bibob Act, the LBB only shares figures on advice requests where they cannot be traced back to individual cases.
Het LBB deelt in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht in de Wet Bibob alleen cijfers over adviesaanvragen als deze cijfers niet te herleiden zijn naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de toepasbaarheid van resultaatfinanciering (zoals Social Impact Bonds) bij het verstrekken van subsidies en opdrachten

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about applying results-based financing such as Social Impact Bonds to subsidies and contracts, including the value of UK evidence, expertise-building, knowledge partnerships, a results fund, legislation like SIPPRA, and results-based subsidies. The minister acknowledged potential benefits and risks, deferred several questions to other ministers, and committed only to considering lessons from experience.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het wegtrekken van talent uit de Verenigde Staten naar aanleiding van de verkiezingswinst van Trump

Two D66 MPs asked how the Netherlands could attract talent leaving the United States after Trump's 2024 election, including whether to introduce a talent visa like the UK's or France's. The government answered that it runs a neutral, inviting knowledge-migrant policy, pointed to existing schemes, outreach and tax facilities, and said a new talent visa was unnecessary.
The cabinet will not speculate about possible policy the next government in the United States will introduce.
Het kabinet gaat niet speculeren over mogelijk beleid dat de volgende regering in de Verenigde Staten gaat invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht over gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences must keep security measures within fundamental rights, including photographing protesting students, covert listening and guards at meetings. Minister Bruins answered that institutions bear primary responsibility, that the minister has a stelselverantwoordelijkheid, that existing law and the joint protest guidelines suffice, and that complaints should go to the institution or the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
As the minister responsible for the system, I have no involvement in the institution-specific considerations institutions make when developing and implementing their security policy.
Als stelselverantwoordelijk Minister heb ik geen bemoeienis met de instellingsspecifieke afwegingen die instellingen maken bij het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van hun veiligheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Een nieuw kiesstelsel, ongelijk en onevenredig'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about an article arguing that a district electoral system would conflict with the constitutional principles of equal suffrage and proportional representation, and posed 13 questions on overhang seats, proportionality, timing and alternatives. The minister answered that the new system must fit within constitutional limits, that research by Leiden and Twente is underway on three variants, and that a problem analysis will follow in March 2025 without substantive commitments on the questions raised.
As announced in the letter of 4 December, I expect to inform your House in March 2025 about the direction the cabinet has in mind for the electoral system.
Zoals aangekondigd in de brief van 4 december jl. verwacht ik in maart 2025 uw Kamer te informeren over de richting die het kabinet voor ogen heeft voor het Kiesstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Overheid verzaakt plicht om transparant te zijn: ’U wilt die informatie zeker niet meer hè?’'

MP Sneller asks whether ministries try to let Woo information requests lapse, what share are handled on time, what fines were paid, what extra effort is made, and what targets and information-management measures apply. The minister denies steering requests toward lapse, reports that only 39.6% of ministry Woo requests were handled on time in 2023, notes EUR 2.09 million in penalties, and commits to a target of half of requests on time in 2025 plus phased active disclosure and an improved information management plan.
In doing so, it is important that the requester's information need is leading and that there is no steering towards letting information requests lapse.
Het is hierbij wel van belang dat de informatiebehoefte van de verzoeker leidend is en er niet wordt gestuurd op het laten vervallen van informatieverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht “Vrees voor grote chaos door grenscontroles: ellenlange files en klap voor Nederlandse economie”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Asylum and Migration about fears that border controls would cause traffic chaos and harm the Dutch economy, including impacts on border regions and whether an impact analysis would be made. The government answered that controls will be risk-based rather than systematic, no crossing points will be designated, no speed-limiting measures are planned unless strictly necessary, controls will be coordinated with Germany, and no significant extra costs are expected, but it declined to commit to a formal impact analysis.
The cabinet therefore expects that no significant additional costs will arise from the reintroduction of internal border controls.
Het kabinet verwacht daarom dat er geen significante extra kosten zullen ontstaan vanwege de herinvoering van binnengrenstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Gedetineerde uit De Westereen mocht niet in het Fries met beppe bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether a detainee was wrongly barred from calling his dementia-stricken grandmother in Frisian, and whether Frisian speakers' language rights are being respected in detention. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said language restrictions can apply for security monitoring reasons, and noted that the appeals judge found refusing a Frisian interpreter reasonable.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paulusma over de voorbereiding op het vaker opduiken van fentanyl in Nederland

MPs Sneller and Paulusma (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health about preparedness for fentanyl and synthetic opioids appearing more often in the Netherlands, including warnings from Belgium, monitoring of vulnerable groups, prevention budgets and the planned cuts to prevention, harm reduction and the Mainline subsidy. The State Secretary answered that no signals yet show synthetic opioids gaining ground, that a preparedness scan and a ban on risky new psychoactive substances are underway, but defended the budget cuts as necessary while stating that enough funding remains.
The Trimbos Institute has been commissioned in this context to produce a preparedness scan aimed at preventing harmful effects of synthetic opioids.
Het Trimbos-instituut heeft in dat kader opdracht gekregen om te komen tot een preparedness-scan gericht op voorkoming van schadelijke effecten van synthetische opioïden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Overheid verzwijgt informatie over advocatenneef Taghi, AD stapt naar de rechter’

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether earlier information about lawyer Youssef T., nephew of Ridouan Taghi, was withheld, why access to the EBI was not refused sooner, and why AD had to go to court under the Open Government Act. The state secretary refers to earlier answers, says the denial of access was based on signs of misuse of his privileged position and lifted once the bar dean found no evidence, denies obstruction of journalists, and declines to discuss the pending court case.
Since this is an ongoing procedure, I cannot go into the substance of it.
Nu dit een lopende procedure betreft kan ik hier niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bikker over het artikel 'Brede welvaart nu gaat steeds meer ten koste van latere generaties'

MPs Sneller and Bikker asked the Minister of Interior how often the generation test (generatietoets) has been applied since the Segers-Jetten motion, whether it has been evaluated, and how future generations' interests can be weighed structurally. The Minister answered that the test is still being developed in an interdepartmental working group, has not been evaluated yet, will be embedded in the Beleidskompas, and promised to inform the House in Q1 2025.
Ik ben het hier volmondig mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over marktconcentratie op de schoolboeken- en schoolboekendistributiemarkt

MPs Rooderkerk and Sneller asked about market concentration in the school textbook and distribution market, including market shares, ownership, vendor lock-in, costs and waste of workbooks. The State Secretary gave estimates of concentration (about 77% for the three largest VO publishers, about 80% for the four largest PO publishers, two main distributors per sector), said ACM oversight and a study with EZ are underway, and pointed to SIVON, Edu-V and open learning materials, while declining to give exact market-share data.
The Ministry of OCW does not have specific market shares for individual publishers.
Het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over specifieke marktaandelen van afzonderlijke uitgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Maatoug over de inrichting van nieuwe ministeries

MPs Sneller and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister about the organisation of three newly created ministries, including whether shared secretaries-general and FEZ directors comply with rules, the duration, costs, and the ministries' contribution to the staffing cut. The government answered that the arrangement is temporary until 1 January 2025, that minimal changes apply with a dedicated SG and FEZ director per ministry, and that costs are modest and not yet quantified in full, with no formal consultation with the Algemene Rekenkamer.

The Court of Audit notes in its letter on the draft budgets that sound budget management, financial management and operations cannot exist without a well-organised financial function at the ministries.

De Algemene Rekenkamer benoemt in de brief bij de ontwerpbegrotingen dat goed begrotingsbeheer, financieel beheer en bedrijfsvoering niet kan zonder goed ingerichte financiële functie bij de ministeries.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het (niet) openbaar maken van zakelijke belangen

MP Sneller asked whether the State Secretary for Finance holds shares in listed companies and whether the formateur approved not disclosing them, and whether integrity rules for ministers are adequate, citing GRECO and the Huberts critique. The government answered that all ministers declared their interests under the fixed rules, that the decision to name companies rests with the minister concerned, that a recusal rule covers conflicts, and that no external sanction mechanism will be created.
It is up to the minister approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be made public.

12 ) is het aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen openbaar gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Incassobureaus overtreden de wet: ‘Zorgelijk’’

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked about reports that debt collection agencies break the law, how many were inspected, and what the government will do for affected debtors and whether enforcement can start earlier. The government answered that the Inspectorate visited 11 agencies but cannot disclose violation details, that the inspectorate is independent and will keep a information-and-encouragement approach until 2025, and that the minister cannot direct enforcement.
It is up to the Inspectorate JenV to publish, if legally possible, how it shapes its supervision of debt collection agencies and which violations it finds.
Het is aan de Inspectie JenV om (indien juridisch mogelijk) te publiceren over hoe zij het toezicht op incassodienstverleners vormgeeft en welke overtredingen zij daarbij constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de btw-verhoging op logies

Sneller (D66) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the expected revenue, sector effects, border competition, fiscal neutrality, and the lack of an impact analysis for the VAT increase on accommodation. The State Secretary defends the revenue estimate of 1,110 million euro, rejects claims of large shortfalls and border effects as not quantifiable, and says monitoring and an ex-post evaluation in 2028 will follow.
Immediately after introduction, the cabinet will carry out a first analysis of the short-term impact of these measures.
Direct na invoering zal het kabinet een eerste analyse doen van de korte-termijnimpact van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Chakor over de belofte van goed bestuur en de gebrekkige naleving van afspraken over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Chakor asked the Minister of Interior why ministers keep incomplete public agendas and omit external meetings, despite the rule to update them weekly and the GRECO recommendations on transparency. The minister acknowledges the agendas are not kept adequately, says ministers are individually responsible, points to the pending Braun evaluation and a possible lobby register, and says her agenda has been updated retroactively.
The OSF research shows that this is still not happening adequately enough.
Het onderzoek van OSF laat zien dat dit nog niet adequaat genoeg gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport ACM naar aanleiding van de lage spaarrentes bij banken

A D66 MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the ACM report finding that Dutch bank savings rates lag due to insufficient competition and tacit coordination among large banks. The minister acknowledged the findings, promised follow-up steps such as studies on mandatory standalone savings accounts, transparency requirements, and exploring number portability, while noting limits on enforcement and that IBAN portability is technically complex and costly.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who do not have a payment account with them.
Ik ga onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bereiken van de top 5 van de landen met een goede concurrentiepositie

MP Sneller (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the coalition goal of reaching the global top 5 on competitiveness is a concrete, accountable target, how to return to the top 5 of the IMD ranking after Netherlands' sharp drop to ninth, which minister is responsible, and whether a target year will be set. The minister endorsed the goal, said the cabinet will address it in the government programme, and stated that improving the business climate is a shared responsibility of the whole cabinet with the Economic Affairs minister coordinating.
The cabinet will address in the government programme what it considers necessary to improve the business climate so as to return to the top 5 of this ranking.
Het kabinet zal in het regeerprogramma ingaan op wat volgens het kabinet nodig is ter verbetering van het ondernemingsklimaat om terug te keren in de top 5 van deze ranglijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Sneller over het betrekken van deTweede Kamer bij de budgettaire besluitvorming

D66 MPs Vijlbrief and Sneller asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the role of the Prime Minister, the cabinet's budget decision-making and how parliament would be involved before Prinsjesdag 2024. The government answered that decisions are taken collectively in the Council of Ministers, promised talks with parliament's financial spokespeople and the Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen, and said the budget would be presented on Prinsjesdag, but gave limited concrete detail on timing and content.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are therefore secret.
De beraadslagingen van de ministerraad zijn derhalve geheim.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Paternotte en Sneller over de Twintigste Penning in Emmer–Compascuum

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about the twentieth penny, a perpetual erfpacht condition requiring 5% of sale value to be paid to the bare owner in Emmer-Compascuum, including its legal basis, market effects, possible abolition like the thirteenth penny, other support for residents, and similar arrangements elsewhere. The minister answered that the condition rests on the Burgerlijk Wetboek and acquired rights, sees no market distortion, rejects legislative abolition as impractical given EVRM compensation duties, and treats the matter as a private civil-law issue with no government advisory role.
This concerns a matter between the private bare owner(s) and private erfpachters over a possible adjustment of the erfpacht conditions.
Het gaat hier om een zaak tussen de particuliere bloot-eigenaar(s) en de particuliere erfpachters over een eventuele aanpassing van de erfpachtvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Podt en Inge van Dijk over het dreigende vertrek van ASML

MPs Sneller, Podt and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about reports of a secret government operation ('Project Beethoven') to prevent ASML from relocating abroad, the economic stakes, the fourth Growth Fund round, talent attraction and expat policy. The government confirmed Project Beethoven as a sector-support effort, explained the stakes and measures, said the fourth Growth Fund round is paused and will likely be dropped by the new coalition, and outlined talent and migration policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars overstappers belemmeren waardoor de premie onnodig hoog is

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that health insurers hinder switching, keeping premiums unnecessarily high, and about the effects on low-income groups, market oversight and basic-policy complexity. The minister acknowledges the issue, points to NZa information rules and planned exploration of more active notification, says no research into income groups will be commissioned, and notes that investigations by ACM and NZa are independent and confidential.
I will not commission research into the switching behaviour of different income groups.
Ik zal geen onderzoek uitzetten naar het overstapgedrag van verschillende inkomensgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over de verplichtingen voor financiële instellingen om financiering aan ontbossing te voorkomen

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister about obligations for financial institutions to prevent financing deforestation, citing a Greenpeace and Milieudefensie report and asking about the EU Forest Law, CSRD transparency, climate-risk reporting, a green bank tax and the WRR. The minister acknowledged the sector's responsibility under OECD and UN guidelines, said mandatory due diligence for financial institutions was not secured in the CSDDD, and pointed to pending EU effect assessments and a climate-measures exploration with a letter promised around summer.
I intend to inform the House around the summer on the main outlines of the outcomes of the exploration.
Ik ben voornemens om de Kamer rond de zomer te informeren op hoofdlijnen over de uitkomsten van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether civil servants had made a legal analysis of the coalition agreement, whether it would be shared under Article 68 of the Constitution, and whether analyses from other ministries would be shared. The answer refers to a separate letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement dated 7 June 2024, rather than answering the questions directly in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sneller, Chakor and Van Nispen on legal analysis(es) of the coalition agreement (submitted 30 May 2024) were answered by way of a letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord (ingezonden 30 mei 2024) zijn beantwoord middels een brief over Ambtelijke analyses hoofdlijnenakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over een fiscaal neutraal pensioenkader in de tweede en derde pijler

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why pension saving in the second and third pillars is treated differently for the earned income tax credit and other rules, and whether this should be removed for a work-form-neutral pension framework. The State Secretary confirms the differences (e.g. the earned income definition, the company car, high-low pensions and bridging payments), acknowledges that harmonising the earned income definition would cost about 110 million euros per year and require major system changes, and leaves the decision on any change to a future Cabinet.
I leave it to a future Cabinet whether such a legislative amendment should take place and how it should be funded.
Ik laat het aan een volgend Kabinet of een dergelijke wetswijziging plaats dient te vinden en hoe deze gedekt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het onderzoek naar het toekomstbestendig maken van uitvoeringsorganisaties

Sneller (D66) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about low productivity and rising labour intensity at implementing agencies, the failure to act on 28% of evaluation recommendations, and the gap with CPB productivity assumptions. The State Secretary acknowledged the urgency, described IPSE productivity trends and recruitment projections, and promised a broader approach to reduce labour demand, with further information to the Chamber around September.
I will inform the Chamber, if possible in September, further about the options for steering on this.
Ik zal de Kamer, zo mogelijk in september, nader informeren over de mogelijkheden om hierop sturend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Sneller en Veldkamp over het artikel 'Gemeenten bereiden zich voor op ‘paspoortpiek’, vacatures staan open en noodplannen liggen klaar'

MPs Paternotte, Sneller and Veldkamp asked about a expected peak in passport renewal applications, its effect on applications from abroad and voting in the European elections, and whether a French digital passport renewal experiment could be adopted in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that demand will be two to three times higher through 2028, capacity and information campaigns have been expanded, voters need only a valid ID by 31 May, and remote biometric renewal is not yet secure enough, with the government monitoring developments.
The French government website states that from 1 March 2024 an experiment takes place in Canada and Portugal.
Antwoord 8 Op deze website 3 van de Franse overheid is te lezen dat met ingang van 1 maart 2024 een experiment plaatsvindt in Canada en Portugal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het online gebiedsverbod

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether she accepts that a court ruled a municipal ban on online expression unconstitutional yet the Amsterdam mayor imposed one anyway, and whether she will propose national legislation on online incitement. The minister declined to judge the mayor's emergency power, noting the cases differ and are for the council or court, and promised a policy response to parliament by May.
The mayor of Amsterdam informed me that she has used her emergency order power under Article 175 of the Municipalities Act.
De burgemeester van Amsterdam heeft mij laten weten dat zij gebruik heeft gemaakt van haar noodbevelsbevoegdheid op grond van artikel 175 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Zeedijk over de Chinese cyberaanvallen op Nederlandse Kamerleden

MPs Sneller and Zeedijk asked the government about Chinese cyberattacks on Dutch MPs and on journalists, activists and businesses, including the APT31 group, and whether state secrets or information from Dutch politicians were obtained. The government answered that it cannot discuss the methods and knowledge of the intelligence services in public, referred to the public threat reports, and said it shares concerns and raised them with Chinese authorities.
The working methods and level of knowledge of the intelligence and security services are not discussed in public.
Er wordt in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Appelsientje ontwijkt suikertaks met truc: vleugje zuivel maakt sap belastingvrij’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that adding a little dairy lets juice escape the sugar-related beverage excise, and whether a sugar-based tax should be introduced by 2026. The government says dairy and soy drinks remain exempt, that a sugar-differentiated excise is being put to parliament via a contour letter given its caretaker status, and that removing the dairy exemption is a structural change needing 12 to 24 months for Customs.
In the attached contour letter, I and the State Secretary for Health have explained the design of the current exemption for dairy and soy drinks.
In bijgaande contourenbrief heb ik samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de vormgeving van de huidige uitzondering voor zuivel- en sojadranken toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller Waterstaat over het bericht '65 miljoen euro schade door ontplofte lachgascilinders, kabinet overweegt compensatie'

An MP asked the government about explosions at waste processors caused by discarded nitrous oxide cylinders, the resulting 65 million euro in damage, and whether the state will compensate waste companies and municipalities. The government says the explosions stem from illegal disposal, that a direct national compensation is not appropriate and not feasible, and that it will inform the House separately while exploring producer responsibility options.
The cabinet has indicated it is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible for measures that help mitigate the risks in the waste sector.

Het kabinet heeft aangegeven bereid te zijn te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de uitspraak van de rechter over belastingconstructies gericht op belastingontwijking

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling rejecting a PwC-designed tax avoidance structure, whether it falls under the DAC6/MDR reporting duty, how enforcement works, and how many reports have been received. The State Secretary says the structure falls outside MDR because it was a domestic merger, describes the enforcement and anti-avoidance measures taken, notes 7,666 Dutch reports received through 2023, and declines to discuss individual files citing tax secrecy.
Because of the tax confidentiality duty in Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot go into individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Six Dijkstra en Sneller over de verhuizing van het.nl domein

MPs Kathmann, Six Dijkstra and Sneller asked about SIDN's plan to move the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, raising sovereignty, US access, oversight and security concerns. The minister answers that no move has yet occurred, that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps, that the RDI and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will review risks via a DPIA/DTIA, and that a quickscan of Dutch and EU alternatives will be carried out with a further letter expected in Q2.
It has been agreed that SIDN will not take any irreversible steps at this time.
Afgesproken is dat SIDN op dit moment geen onomkeerbare stappen zal zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bamenga over zakelijke vliegreizen binnen de Rijksoverheid

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Interior about the number of business flights by central government staff since 2018, the necessity test, and whether economy class should be the default. The State Secretary gave yearly figures by class, pointed to CAO rules and a checklist, and said economy is default only for certain categories while business class remains optional for flights of six hours or more.
On employment terms agreed in the CAO Rijk I must reach agreement with the trade unions and cannot change them unilaterally.
Over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken uit de CAO Rijk moet ik overeenstemming bereiken met de vakbonden en deze kan ik dus niet eenzijdig aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘dat de politie experimenteert met gezichtsherkenning, maar wetgeving ontbreekt’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police experimentation with facial recognition in the absence of clear legislation, including the police deployment framework, its external involvement, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's view on the legal basis, and the approval of the FaceF1nder software in a specific case. The minister replied that the police framework was shared with parliament, that the legal basis exists in the Police Act and the Police Data Act, that the internal review committee decides independently but the competent authority makes the final call, and that a possible explicit basis in the Code of Criminal Procedure depends on the final EU AI Regulation.
It is however possible to include an explicit basis for the power to use facial recognition technology in the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Het is wel mogelijk om voor de bevoegdheid om gebruik te maken van gezichtsherkenningstechnologie een expliciete grondslag op te nemen in het Wetboek van Strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sneller over ‘Quantumproof encryptie’

MP Sneller (D66) asked the government about the risks quantum computers pose to encryption, how Dutch law compares to the US quantum-safe migration mandate, what support organisations receive, and what research is underway. State Secretary Van Huffelen answered that the government is preparing a cross-government quantum-safe cryptography programme and guidance, but that no equivalent binding US-style migration obligation exists in the Netherlands, relying instead on existing EU and national cybersecurity rules.
Starting preparations now is therefore necessary in order to spread risks, effort and costs.
Nu beginnen met voorbereiden is dan ook noodzakelijk om risico's, inspanning en kosten te kunnen spreiden.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Sneller over belastingvoordelen voor bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax benefits for business families under the business succession scheme (BOR), including whether relatives holding under 0.5% of shares should qualify and whether the scheme is needed in most cases. The State Secretary answered that the scheme aims to prevent inheritance and gift tax from endangering business continuity, disagreed that 75% of cases are unnecessary, and declined to estimate how much of the budgetary cost is truly necessary.
No, it is not possible to estimate which part of the budgetary cost of the BOR is truly necessary from the scheme's objective.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk om een inschatting te geven van welk deel van het budgettaire beslag van de BOR echt noodzakelijk is vanuit de doelstelling van de BOR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘FvD maakt doneren in bitcoin mogelijk: ‘Dit gat moet gedicht worden’’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether political donations in cryptocurrency, such as Forum voor Democratie's bitcoin donation option via ForumPay, undermine the transparency of the Wfpp donor register, how donor identity is verified and audited, and whether crypto donations are regulated and anti-money-laundering rules are enforced. The Minister replied that parties must register donors above €250, that crypto donations are treated as monetary contributions within the Wfpp, that the Wpp draft contains no extra safeguards yet but is under review, that ForumPay is not registered with DNB (a matter for DNB to assess), and that the donation option on the FvD website is no longer active.
I cannot make any statements about this.
Ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sneller over het bericht 'Werkgevers: bedrijven verplaatsen nieuwe investeringen naar het buitenland'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that firms are shifting new investment abroad, the causes, the effects of nitrogen (stikstof) uncertainty, cuts to the National Growth Fund and R&D, and whether the government will commission studies. The minister acknowledges the concerns, attributes relocation mainly to firm-specific growth constraints, and commits to a study of the economic effects of nitrogen and to a letter on securing earning capacity, while leaving other questions to the next cabinet.
However, I can commit to a study to objectively map the main economic consequences of the nitrogen problem.
Wel kan ik een onderzoek toezeggen om de belangrijkste economische gevolgen van de stikstofproblematiek objectief in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de betrokkenheid van een AIVD’er bij het saboteren van het Iraanse kernwapenprogramma

MP Sneller asked the government whether the AIVD was involved in a 2007 sabotage operation against Iran's nuclear programme, who approved it, whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed, and whether the CTIVD should investigate. The minister declined to answer on the specific operation citing the statutory duty of secrecy, stated that the same rules apply abroad as at home, and said the CTIVD decides itself whether to investigate.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the methods of the services, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged involvement of the Netherlands.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Sneller over zorgen over de uitwerking van een Kamerbreed aangenomen motie voor de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten in Nederland en de grote zorgen over de toekomst va

Three MPs from SP, VVD and D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about concerns that the implementation of a House-adopted motion on tolk tenders (removing travel costs and raising the registration tariff by 15 euro) could leave court interpreters worse off. The Minister answered that the tariff increase is meant to compensate interpreters, that pay will be monitored, and that a full assessment of hourly rates will follow later.
Once service provision is fully implemented and the relevant data are available, the fees that intermediaries pay to self-employed interpreters will become transparent.
Zodra dienstverlening volledig is geïmplementeerd en de gegevens hierover beschikbaar zijn, worden de vergoedingen, die intermediairs aan zelfstandig ondernemende tolken betalen, inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Sneller, Michon-Derkzen, Kuik, Mutluer en Temmink over agressie en geweld tegen beroepsgroepen met een publieke functie

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA, GroenLinks-PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reporting, prosecution, sentencing and prevention of aggression and violence against public-service workers. The minister answers that reporting should be made mandatory in practice through employer norms, that no reliable national picture exists, and that existing protocols, WODC research and Weerbaar Bestuur initiatives are being used, while leaving primary employer responsibility with organisations.
A reliable national picture of aggression and violence against officials with a public task is lacking.
Een betrouwbaar landelijk beeld van agressie en geweld tegen functionarissen met een publieke taak ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over het artikel 'Gelekte documenten bewijzen tot nu toe onbekende connecties tussen Rusland en de PVV'

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign donations, including from Russia, could still reach Dutch parties via intermediaries, and about follow-up to a motion and advisory report on investigating Russian financing. The minister said the ban on non-Dutch donations applies since 2023, that a penetration test of the party financing law is underway, and that the motion on investigating Russian financing is a matter for the House Presidium, not his ministry.
I expect to receive the results of this test this year.
Naar verwachting zal ik nog dit jaar de beschikking krijgen over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Mutluer en Piri over de aanhouding van medewerkers van NCTV en politie vanwege het lekken van staatsgeheime informatie

MPs Sneller, Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the arrest of NCTV and police staff for allegedly leaking state secret information, including risks to people, critical infrastructure, timing of an investigation, and foreign contacts. The minister declined to give operational details pending criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations, said no signals currently show acute risk to critical infrastructure, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation concludes.
In the interest of those investigations, and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sneller, Wassenberg en Bromet over het bericht dat prins Bernhard lid was van de NSDAP

Four MPs asked the Prime Minister how he views reports that Prince Bernhard had an NSDAP membership card, and whether he would support a CIDI call for research into the prince's Nazi-era past. The Prime Minister acknowledged the reports and said the information was already publicly known from accessible archives, and that further research will become possible at the Royal House Archive from early 2024 by extending access to 1948.
From the beginning of 2024, further research can be carried out in the Royal House Archive by extending access to the year 1948.
Met ingang van begin 2024 kan verder onderzoek worden verricht in het Koninklijk Huisarchief door verruiming van de toegang tot in het jaar 1948.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen inzake het artikel ‘Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken’

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that municipalities hold informal closed meetings bypassing public council rules, and whether such meetings should be regulated under open-government principles. The Minister replied that council and committee meetings are public by law and closed sessions are an exception requiring justification and a majority vote, that informal gatherings outside the Municipal Act are not prohibited but must not replace formal meetings, and that he will issue a circular on committee types and consult the VNG and council associations rather than seek Raad van State advice.

This starting point emerges, among other things, in the college's duty to inform that applies towards the council as a whole, even when the information is requested by one or more individual council members.

Dit uitgangspunt komt onder meer naar voren in de inlichtingenplicht van het college die jegens de raad als geheel geldt, ook als de inlichtingen door een of meer individuele raadsleden worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Sahla over weren van drugscriminelen uit het zorgdomein

MPs Sneller, Van der Werf and Sahla asked whether drug criminals who own care and staffing agencies (e.g. Ultracare, supplying youth care in Friesland) can be kept out of the care sector, and about Bibob screening and oversight by Justis. The Minister acknowledges the risk, reports that about 5,750 care providers nationwide are owned by persons with convictions, says individual cases cannot be discussed, and points to ongoing Bibob reforms, a planned evaluation from early 2024 and talks with RIEC's and VNG on stronger anti-fraud action.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld op lachgascilinders en het bericht “Maat is vol: afvalverzamelaars gaan ‘levensgevaarlijke’ lachgas cilinders terugsturen”

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked about dangerous nitrous oxide cylinders ending up in waste processing after the nitrous oxide ban, financial damage, responsibility, and collection measures. The government answered that the damage stems from illegal dumping by individuals, that it will explore possible financial support, and that it is working with the waste sector and ministries on collection points, storage capacity and enforcement.
The central government is willing to explore whether a financial contribution is possible, using existing schemes or not, for measures that help mitigate risks in the waste sector.

Het Rijk is wel bereid te verkennen of een financiële tegemoetkoming mogelijk is, al dan niet gebruikmakend van bestaande regelingen, voor het treffen van maatregelen die bijdragen aan het mitigeren van de risico's in de afvalbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de Nederlandse man die al twee maanden om onduidelijke redenen vast zit in een Spaanse cel, in aanvulling op de vragen het lid Van Baarle

An MP asked why a Dutch man not suspected of any crime in the Netherlands has been held in a Spanish prison for two months, and whether Dutch-shared information caused it. The ministers declined to discuss the case substantively, citing the pending court proceedings and privacy rules, but said Dutch police and prosecutors confirmed he is not wanted in the Netherlands and that consular contact and information sharing with his lawyer have taken place.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Temmink over waarschuwingsbrieven van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de onwenselijkheid van omdraaiing van de bewijslast in het strafrecht

MPs Sneller and Temmink asked about 176 warning letters sent by the Public Prosecution Service to people allegedly present at the November 2022 Schiphol climate protest, identified partly via facial recognition, and whether the subsequent interviews reversed the burden of proof. The minister answered that the letters have no formal legal status, that some identifications were wrong and apologies were sent, that people were treated as 'betrokkenen' rather than suspects, and that data of wrongly identified persons will be deleted while further investigation and evaluation are ongoing.
The warning letter has no formal legal status and therefore does not lead to registration in the criminal records.
De waarschuwingsbrief heeft geen formele juridische status en leidt dus ook niet tot vermelding op de justitiële documentatie.
