Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hans Teunissen en Sneller over het artikel ‘VNG waarschuwt voor tekort aan stembureauvrijwilligers bij volgende verkiezingen’

MPs Teunissen and Sneller asked the Interior Minister about a shortage of polling-station volunteers, the planned recruitment campaign, the tax treatment of allowances, small-ballot experiments and the location of polling stations. The minister answered that recruitment is mainly a municipal task supported by a national campaign, that allowance talks with municipalities are ongoing with a report due by year-end, and that experiments and a letter on preparations will follow.
I intend to call on people via regional media (radio and newspapers) and social media to register with a municipality as a polling-station member or teller.
Ik ben voornemens om via de regionale media (radio en dagbladen) en via social media mensen op te roepen om zich bij een gemeente aan te melden als stembureaulid of als teller.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Bromet over het artikel 'Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch municipalities unlawfully hold informal closed meetings to avoid public scrutiny, and how the Municipalities Act and the Open Government Act apply. The Minister replied that the law sets openness as the rule, that informal technical or information meetings without decision-making are not regulated by the Municipalities Act, that no unlawful closed meetings were established, and that a circular on committees is being prepared.
I do not have figures on the number of municipalities that use closed meetings within the meaning of the Municipalities Act and other types of meetings.
Ik beschik niet over cijfermateriaal over het aantal gemeenten dat gebruik maakt van besloten vergaderingen in de zin van de Gemeentewet en andere type bijeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat, Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het piramidespel van IM Academy en Finfluencers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Finance and Economic Affairs about the IM Academy pyramid scheme, its recruitment of young people, and the regulation of finfluencers. The government said the supervisors (Ksa, ACM, AFM) are responsible, explained existing rules and enforcement tools, and said it sees no need for major new rules beyond pressing for stronger European investor protection.
The supervisory authorities are independent in their supervision and make no statements about ongoing or possible future investigations.
De toezichthouders zijn onafhankelijk in hun toezicht en doen geen mededelingen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het persbericht van het Openbaar Ministerie ‘Nieuw college, nieuwe accenten‘

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's announcement that it will focus less on crime prevention, asking about its reasons, effects on prevention programmes, and the coalition agreement. The minister said the OM remains committed to prevention, that the shift is about focusing on core enforcement and faster case handling, and that the coalition agreement commitments will be implemented.
The OM has assured me that the agreements made in the context of the Coalition Agreement are simply being implemented.
Het OM heeft mij verzekerd dat de afspraken die in het kader van het Coalitieakkoord zijn gemaakt gewoon worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Sneller over ‘Versterking kennisfunctie van de Rijksoverheid’

Sneller (D66) asked how the government has followed up on a 2018 KWINK report on open publication of ministry research and protection against political or civil-servant steering, whether a Rijksbrede knowledge function should be strengthened (Rijkslab, chief science officers), and whether ministries should have their own knowledge institutes like the WODC. The minister answered that departments already promote open publication, that no government-wide stakeholder study is needed, that the knowledge function remains a departmental responsibility with only possible interdepartmental agreements, and that the answers could not be given before the committee debate.
I therefore see no need for a government-wide stakeholder study.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak voor een Rijksbreed stakeholdersonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Wuite over het niet tenuitvoerleggen van gevangenisstraffen op Sint Maarten

Dutch MPs asked why at least 136 convicted persons on Sint Maarten were not serving prison sentences due to lack of detention capacity, and about the effects on rule of law, investment imbalance and a new prison. The government answered that prison administration is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, outlined Dutch funding and the UNOPS new-prison project (target 2028), and described temporary transfers of detainees to the Netherlands while declining to give the size of the shortage.
Prison administration is a matter for the constituent country.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het decoratiestelsel

An MP asks the Prime Minister's government about the Dutch honours system: public support for a republic, refusals of royal decorations, non-royal honours, return of decorations after death, and posthumous awards. The minister answers that refusals are rare, defends the royal honours system as ministerially countersigned and case-by-case, and rejects new non-royal or posthumous civil honours.
A royal decoration is therefore, contrary to what is sometimes thought, not a personal favour from the King.
Een koninklijke onderscheiding is dus, in tegenstelling tot wat wel eens wordt gedacht, geen persoonlijke gunst van de Koning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over statiegeld en lachgascilinders

MPs Hagen and Sneller asked the government about the delayed deck-deposit (statiegeld) scheme on cans, risks of drinks cartons and plastic bottles, batteries in household waste, and fire and explosion risks from nitrous oxide cylinders at waste processors. The state secretary answered that the government will report to parliament on the deposit scheme in 2024, that it is monitoring substitution toward cartons and considering a recycling target, that battery fires are being tackled via a taskforce, and that it is working with partners on a practical solution for nitrous oxide cylinders, while rejecting a deposit system for them.
As provided in art. 16 of the Packaging Management Decree, I will send the House of Representatives a report in 2024 on the effectiveness and effects of deposit on beverage packaging.
Zoals bepaald in art. 16 van het Besluit beheer verpakkingen zal ik in 2024 de Tweede Kamer een verslag toesturen over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van statiegeld op drankverpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Journalist Ana van Es werd opgeroepen om te getuigen. ‘Dit schrikt bronnen af’, zegt haar advocaat'

D66 MPs asked whether summoning journalist Ana van Es as a witness, and the resulting risk to source protection, is acceptable under the Wet bronbescherming in strafzaken. The ministers said they cannot comment on individual criminal cases, pointed to the law's safeguards and its evaluation, and stated that journalists may refuse to answer questions about sources even when summoned.
It is not for me to comment on individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het weerbaar maken van onze democratie tegen heimelijke (politieke) beïnvloeding

MPs Sneller and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the ministers about dark money, transparency of advertising and campaign financing, foreign donations to Dutch NGOs, and possible foreign influence on elections. The ministers answered that transparency is being strengthened through the EU political advertising regulation, the Wtmo bill and the Wfpp, but that many issues are still under negotiation or fall under other levels of government.
The cabinet is committed to further increasing this transparency.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om deze transparantie verder te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over de aanpak van milieucriminaliteit

MPs Sneller and Hagen asked how the government will tackle environmental crime, including whether non-conviction transactions are sufficiently deterrent, the Court of Audit's findings on inspection, repeat offenders, and implementation of earlier motions. The Minister answers that a sentencing study will be commissioned, a compliance-based transaction modality is planned, and the motions will be followed up through the IBP VTH programme, while several answers defer to other bodies or to later letters.
The Ministry of Justice and Security will commission scientific research into the current way of sentencing and its effectiveness in environmental offences.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid zal opdracht geven voor een wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de huidige wijze van straffen en de effectiviteit daarvan bij milieufeiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Nederlanders in detentie in het buitenland

MP Sneller asked the Justice and Rule of Law ministers about Dutch nationals detained abroad, the EU evaluation of the WETS transfer procedure (administrative rather than judicial, with limited rights for convicted persons) and the WOTS procedure, including the binding test, transparency and evaluation. Minister Weerwind answered that the procedure is compatible with the framework decision, that the convicted person's rights are adequately protected, and that he will send a policy response before the summer recess; he defended the binding test and gave partial, sometimes data-limited figures.
My policy response to the evaluation report of the Council of the European Union will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Mijn beleidsreactie op het evaluatierapport van de Raad van de Europese Unie zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over toestemming voor Australische psychiaters om psychedelica voor te schrijven voor patiënten met een behandelingsresistente depressie en posttraumatische stressstoor

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the Minister of Health about Australia's decision to allow authorised psychiatrists to prescribe psilocybin and MDMA for treatment-resistant depression and PTSD, and what this means for the Netherlands. The Minister replied that prescribing is currently not possible in the Netherlands beyond clinical research and Spravato, that changing Opium Act lists is not necessary for research or registration, and that a commission on MDMA and a ZonMw report will inform further steps.
I will give you my response to this report in a previously promised letter to the House on the state of affairs regarding psychedelics before the summer recess.
Ik zal u in een eerder toegezegde Kamerbrief over de stand van zaken rondom psychedelica voor het zomerreces mijn reactie geven op dit signalement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

D66 MPs asked ministers whether the Utrecht court ruling that the mayor could not impose an online area ban (ruling it an impermissible restriction of free expression reserved to national legislation) should be accepted, and what alternatives exist to tackle online incitement. The government declined to comment on the pending case, outlined administrative measures and a framework for mayoral powers, and said it would consider alternatives without committing to a specific legislative proposal.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual and/or pending cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele en/of lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het invoeren van een landelijk keurmerk voor coffeeshops

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the 79 experimental closed-chain coffeeshops and the other coffeeshops should prioritise fighting undermining crime, safety and transparency, and whether a national quality mark for coffeeshops should be introduced. The minister answered that the national government will not support a quality mark because it would endorse a tolerated but formally prohibited activity, that banks and coffeeshops should make their own arrangements on payments, and that the outcome of the experiment will be awaited before any further policy change.
Within this context, it is not considered appropriate for the national government to be involved in establishing a quality mark that expresses a quality judgement on a prohibited activity.
Binnen deze context, wordt het niet passend geacht om als rijksoverheid betrokken te zijn bij het instellen van een keurmerk dat een kwaliteitsoordeel uitdraagt van een verboden activiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het bericht 'Een witbrood stelen om de kinderen te laten eten: de oneindige spiraal van schulden en criminaliteit'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked about a press report linking debt to recidivism, the share of prisoners with debts and access to debt assistance, CJIB debt-relief rules, and judges' knowledge of defendants' finances. The minister acknowledges the debt-crime link and describes existing debt-support routes and reclassering initiatives, but gives no current figures on prisoners receiving debt help and says a fuller answer on the probation thesis' recommendations will follow by end 2023.
There is no recent data available on the total percentage of detainees who struggle with debts.
Er zijn geen recente gegevens bekend over het totale percentage gedetineerden dat kampt met schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het zo snel mogelijk starten met de volgende fase van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP from D66 asks the ministers how to speed up the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, including bank accounts for growers, BIBOB screening delays, imports from Canada, transport rules and oversight. The government answers that a start in early 2024 is expected, that a small-scale transition phase is being considered, that imports are barred by UN treaty, and that banks must keep their gatekeeping role under the Wwft.
Annex 5 is not public and is available for inspection at the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Bijlage 5 is niet openbaar en ligt ter inzage bij het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘Illegale sigarettenfabriek ontdekt in Heerlen, 23 aanhoudingen’

An MP asks the government about an illegal cigarette factory in Heerlen, seizure figures, lost excise revenue, social costs, the link between excise increases and smuggling, and EU cooperation against tobacco smuggling. The state secretary gives detailed seizure data, estimates roughly 50 million euros per year lost to illegal trade, cites studies on excise and smuggling, and says current EU cooperation needs no intensification for now.
The cabinet will inform the House about this with the BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer hierover informeren met het BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

Two D66 MPs asked the government about Almelo's municipal bylaw banning online posts that could cause physical disruption of public order, including enforcement, constitutional free-speech concerns under Article 7 of the Constitution, and the lack of a promised legal framework for municipal online monitoring. The Justice Minister answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for their bylaws, that enforcement rests with the mayor, that the censorship ban limits municipalities, and that the promised guidance on social media monitoring is delayed to Q1 2023.
I have understanding for the search by municipalities for ways to maintain public order where the cause lies in online conduct.
Ik heb begrip voor de zoektocht van gemeenten naar manieren om de openbare orde te handhaven als de oorzaak is gelegen in online gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het artikel 'Hoe Thierry Baudet de winst opstrijkt van een uitgeverij die met overheidssubsidie is opgezet'

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister whether Forum voor Democratie used party subsidy to set up the publisher Amsterdam Books, now run by party-linked figures, and whether the subsidy should be stopped or recovered. The minister answered that the Wfpp does not regulate party structure or the conduct of party-linked persons, that the subsidised activities do not cover the BV's founding, and that subsidy would be recovered only if the audited accounts show unlawful spending.
If the process above shows that a political party has spent subsidy unlawfully, this may lead to recovery of the subsidy.
Indien op basis van het hierboven genoemde proces blijkt dat een politieke partij subsidie op onrechtmatige wijze heeft besteed, dan kan dat leiden tot het terugvorderen van de subsidie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse staat geen zicht heeft op Nederlanders die in het buitenland een gevangenisstraf hebben uitgezeten en daarna terugkeren naar Neder

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether the state can monitor Dutch citizens returning after serving prison sentences abroad, and whether transfer rules should be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the gap for sex offenders convicted outside the EU and UK, said an options study will be reported in Q1 2023, but defended the current transfer criteria and the five-year binding test.

I share the concern that there is currently insufficient oversight, because information about a conviction outside the European Union for a sex offence cannot currently be taken into account when assessing an application for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Ik deel de zorg dat daar nu onvoldoende zicht op is, omdat informatie over een veroordeling buiten de Europese Unie (EU) voor een zedenmisdrijf nu niet meegenomen kan worden bij de beoordeling van een aanvraag voor een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over de internationale aanpak van georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit en criminele geldstromen

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the international approach to organised drug crime and criminal money flows, including Dutch-Belgian cooperation, joint investigation teams, liaison officers, cannabis legalisation, and tackling criminal finances such as non-conviction based confiscation. The Minister answered in detail that cooperation is being intensified through existing structures and instruments, that the approach to criminal money flows is a priority, and that a bill on non-conviction based confiscation is in preparation, while declining to set up a new joint police and customs centre and to commit to cannabis legalisation at EU level.
I therefore see the criminal business model as an essential starting point for tackling organised crime.
Het crimineel verdienmodel zie ik dan ook als een essentieel aanknopingspunt voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het over het (niet) gebruiken van beschikbare informatie om advocaat T. te weren uit de EBI Vught

MP Sneller (D66) asks the Minister for Legal Protection why available police information about lawyer Youssef T.'s links to a criminal organisation was not used to bar him from the EBI, and why it was not shared with the bar dean. The minister answers that the information (a DLIO report) could not serve as evidence, was not sufficient to justify refusal, and that details are withheld due to the ongoing criminal case, with the bulk of questions answered in general terms.
Since these concern individual legal-position matters and because this case is still before the criminal court, I will not provide these documents to your House.
Aangezien het hier om rechtspositionele individuele aangelegenheden gaat en omdat deze zaak nog onder de strafrechter is verstrek ik deze stukken niet aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de negatieve gevolgen van langer wachten met de start van een TBS-behandeling.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the negative effects of delaying the start of TBS treatment when prison sentences are imposed first, and about the scope of court advice under art. 37b Sr. The minister answered that the court's advice can be used but that most cases are decided individually, with prison care and pre-passant preparation in place.
Inquiry with the Dutch Custodial Institutions Agency shows that between 2018 and 2022 there were eight cases in which the court gave advice to start TBS treatment earlier.

Navraag bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) levert op dat tussen 2018 en 2022 acht keer een zaak aan de orde is geweest waarin de rechter een advies heeft gegeven om eerder te starten met een tbs-behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het onbenut laten van Bibob-toetsing bij subsidieverlening

MPs Sneller and Michon-Derkzen asked why national ministries, notably RVO and Uitvoering van Beleid SZW, rarely apply the Bibob integrity test when granting subsidies. The minister answers that the test is discretionary, that ministries are in talks to increase its use, that RVO and UVB rely on other controls, and promises an update by the first quarter of 2023.
The Ministry of Justice and Security is engaging with various departments to stimulate the use of the Bibob Act within central government.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) gaat met verschillende departementen in gesprek om het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij de rijksoverheid te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over de hoorplicht bij beroepen tegen verkeersboetes

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has failed for years to inform traffic-fine objectors of their right to be heard, whether it wrongly dismissed appeals as manifestly unfounded, and how the appeal threshold increase affects citizens' protection. The minister acknowledged the OM did not actively communicate the hearing right, said talks are underway to restore it, disputed the 90% manifestly-unfounded figure (1.9% actually), and defended the appeal-threshold rise as restoring the legislator's original intent.
The OM reports that persons who themselves indicated they wish to be heard are in fact heard.
Het OM meldt dat betrokkenen die zelf hebben aangegeven gehoord te willen worden, ook daadwerkelijk zijn gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel ‘Belangenverstrengeling van Statenleden bij stemmingen over stikstofbeleid’

MPs Sneller and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether provincial councillors working in agriculture who voted on nitrogen policy motions, and sometimes filed motions themselves, breached the conflict-of-interest rule in article 28 of the Provinciewet. The Minister answered that the rule only bars voting where a councillor has a direct personal interest, that no conflict of interest can be concluded from the rules, and that commissioners of the King will be informed.
On the basis of this legal framework, the conclusion cannot be drawn that there would have been a conflict of interest.
Op basis van dit wettelijk kader kan niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat sprake zou zijn geweest van belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de open communicatie vanuit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI)

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the open communication from the EBI via lawyer Youssef T. and the deken's findings, including whether signals were used to restrict access. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations limit disclosure, that information from a foreign police force could not be shared with the prison service, and that the lawyer's access was restricted once grounds emerged.
While the criminal investigation into Ridouan T. and Youssef T. is ongoing, I of course cannot provide information about those investigations.
Hangende het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar Ridouan T. en Youssef T. kan ik vanzelfsprekend geen informatie geven over die onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport Drugs de Baas d.d. 23 juni 2022, Denktank: drugsmisdaad wel te bestrijden, reguleer xtc en onderschep de coke d.d. 22 juni 2022

An MP (Sneller, D66) asked the Justice, Health and Finance ministers about the DenkWerk report 'Drugs de baas', covering the cocaine interception rate, the profitability of Dutch drug wholesale, regulation of ecstasy and MDMA, and port-focused enforcement. The Minister answered that the government did not commission the report, that ecstasy and MDMA cannot be legalised due to international treaties, that the interception percentage is not tracked while seizures in kilos are, and that a plan of action on logistics hubs will be sent to the Chamber by end 2022.
Customs further indicates that its reports are based on established data and recorded facts.
De Douane geeft daarnaast aan dat zij in de rapportages uitgaat van vaststaande gegevens en geconstateerde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Strolenberg, Sjoerdsma en Sneller over de mogelijkheid tot online stemmen voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

Four MPs from VVD and D66 asked whether Dutch citizens abroad could be allowed to vote online, citing France's online voting for expats. The Minister of Interior replied that internet voting is rejected because it creates cyber risks to secrecy, freedom, and integrity of elections, that no steps are planned, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Introducing internet voting makes the electoral process vulnerable to cyber risks that put these safeguards at risk, such as ballot secrecy, freedom of voting and integrity.
Het introduceren van internetstemmen maakt het verkiezingsproces kwetsbaar voor cyberrisico's waarbij er risico's zijn voor deze waarborgen, zoals het stemgeheim, de stemvrijheid en de integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het artikel 'Rechters maken schulden van de zwakkeren juist erger'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked whether courts handle around 5,000 default debt collection judgments weekly, why debtors fail to appear, and what has been done with the Raad voor de rechtspraak's recommendations on debt cases. The minister says default judgments have fallen below that level, outlines reforms such as a planned legal basis for courts to impose payment arrangements, a debt officer pilot, lower court fees and a shorter good-faith test, and commits to further letters on cost stacking and experiments.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het faillissement van RCCS, waardoor coffeeshophouders problemen ervaren om hun kasgelden te verwerken en hun reguliere bedrijfsvoering daardoor niet kunnen v

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked about the RCCS cash-transport bankruptcy and banks' de-risking of coffeeshops, which struggle to deposit and withdraw cash. The Minister of Finance answered that banks must apply risk-based customer due diligence under the Wwft, that a Convenant Contant Geld and case law set limits on refusing cash access, and that the sector is being consulted, while declining to change the Wwft guidance and giving only partial information on the RCCS takeover.
I encourage banks and coffeeshop operators to make mutual agreements on their cash needs and expect banks to take the court's considerations into account when making agreements.

Ik stimuleer dat banken en coffeeshophouders onderling afspraken maken over de contantgeldbehoeft en ga ervanuit dat banken bij het maken van afspraken rekening houden met de overwegingen van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over dwingend recht en het toepassen van de menselijke maat door het CBR

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the CBR (driving licence authority) and the courts can take personal circumstances into account, given that the Wegenverkeerswet and RMRG leave little room for balancing interests, and how this fits with proportionality and the Raad van State's reflection report. Minister Harbers answered that the legal framework is strict by design, the CBR uses passend contact and mitigating measures within it, the government is considering an Awb provision allowing administrative bodies to depart from mandatory rules, and a CBR knelpuntenbrief is expected in Q2 2022.

The cabinet is considering various amendments to better safeguard the general principles of proper administration, increase room for tailored decisions, and put the citizen's perspective at the forefront of service delivery.

Het kabinet overweegt diverse wijzigingen om de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur beter te borgen, ruimte voor maatwerk te vergroten en het burgerperspectief in de dienstverlening voorop te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke transnationale kieslijsten in de EU

MPs Sjoerdsma and Sneller asked about the reported March 2022 deal in the European Parliament's constitutional affairs committee on transnational lists (28 extra seats, 3.5% threshold) and lowering the voting age to 16, and how it relates to the Conference on the Future of Europe and the coalition agreement. The government answered that the proposal is not yet final, that it is too early to state a Dutch position, and that the Dutch government will inform parliament once the Council receives the proposal.

Since the final initiative proposal has not yet been published, may still be amended by the EP, and must obtain a majority in the EP plenary, the cabinet considers it premature to determine the Dutch position and stance on this initiative proposal.

Aangezien het definitieve initiatiefvoorstel nog niet is gepubliceerd, het mogelijk nog geamendeerd wordt door het EP, en een meerderheid dient te halen in de plenaire van het EP, acht het kabinet het voortijdig om de Nederlandse positie en inzet ten aanzien dit initiatiefvoorstel te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Documenten kabinetsformatie openbaar’ op de website www.kabinetsformatie2021.nl.

An MP asks the Prime Minister why the post from citizens and organisations received by the 2021 formateurs was not actively published, as in 2017, and whether this breaks with precedent. The Prime Minister answers that GDPR limits publication of personal data, that correspondence with parliament and ministries has been published, that the archive is available on request, and that the formation file is governed by the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
apart from processing in the form of publishing the inventory, which contains many personal data
afgezien van verwerking in de vorm van een publicatie van de inventaris die vele persoonsgegevens bevat

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over een vrijwillige bijdrage aan het Internationaal Strafhof ten behoeve van een onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdrijven, misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid en genocide geple

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government knows of the ICC prosecutor's opening of an investigation into Ukraine and the prosecutor's call for extra funding, and whether it will provide extra money. The government confirmed awareness, supports the investigation, and will pay a voluntary contribution of 1 million euro to the ICC's trust fund while pushing partners for more funding.
The Netherlands will transfer a voluntary financial contribution of 1 million euros to the Trust Fund recently established for the Office of the Prosecutor.
In dat licht zal Nederland een vrijwillige financiële bijdrage van 1 miljoen euro overmaken aan het Trust Fund dat recent ten behoeve van het Parket van de Aanklager is opgericht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima als test voor de monarchie’ uit het Algemeen Dagblad van 31 januari 2022 en de documentaire ‘Een Porseleinen Huwelijk van BNNVARA

MPs Sneller and Leijten asked the Prime Minister and ministers about press and documentary reports on the 2001 decision not to prosecute Jorge Zorreguieta, the role of the Prosecution Service, and an intelligence check on him and Edwin de Roy van Zuydewijn without ministers being informed. The government answered in detail on the chain of communication, the BVD check, and safeguards, denying political influence over the prosecution decision and describing the current naslag arrangements.
No indication of political influence on the content of this decision has been found.
Van politieke beïnvloeding van de inhoud van deze beslissing is niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over procesafspraken tussen verdachte en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM)

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about plea-style agreements (procesafspraken) between the public prosecution service and suspects, which courts have found lack a statutory basis. The Minister replied that the agreements fall within prosecutorial discretion, that a draft OM directive is under discussion and will be published once final, and that no legislative change is considered necessary.
It is therefore desirable that, as the College of Procurators General intends, the conditions for making procedural agreements are laid down transparently in an OM directive.

Het is daarom gewenst dat – zoals het College van procureurs-generaal zich voorneemt – de randvoorwaarden voor het maken van procesafspraken op transparante wijze worden vastgelegd in een OM-aanwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Warmerdam, Paulusma en Sneller over therapeutisch gebruik van psychedelica zoals psilocybine, mdma en ketamine

D66 MPs asked the health minister about therapeutic use of psychedelics (psilocybin, MDMA, ketamine), including research funding, FDA-style fast-track approval, risks of uncoordinated use, and a central steering role. The minister agreed research is needed, pointed to ZonMw funding and a planned state commission on MDMA, and said central steering is for medical professional groups, with the government playing a facilitating and advisory role.
Central steering of research and implementation is for the medical professional groups to shape.
Centrale aansturing op onderzoek en implementatie is aan de medische beroepsgroepen om vorm te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het bericht 'Ombudsman waarschuwt: Als het OM zelf straft, komen slachtofferrechten in het geding' en de brief over positie slachtoffers bij strafbeschikking O

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked about reports that the Public Prosecution Service imposes penal orders (strafbeschikking) even in serious cases where victims want to speak, and about the Ombudsman's warning on victims' rights. The Minister acknowledges that in 4 cases, including one sexual offence, penal orders were used despite the victim wishing to speak, says the OM will re-emphasise the contra-indication and that an evaluation of the new legal aid scheme and a fifth PG study are pending.
In 4 cases it turned out to be so. This involved 1 sexual offence case.
In 4 zaken bleek dat het geval. Het betrof daarbij 1 zedenzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis en ontoereikend beleid op maatschappelijk behoefte

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the minister about medicinal cannabis access, limited varieties for patients with severe symptoms, the lack of information and policy, and the ban on home cultivation. The minister answered that BMC has expanded varieties, a European tender is underway, research is funded, an evaluation is pending, and home cultivation remains prohibited with no individual exemption.
Your House will be informed further before the summer about the next steps following this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer nader geïnformeerd over de vervolgstappen naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Sneller en Ephraim over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de benoeming van een nieuw Nederlands lid van de Europese Rekenkamer

MPs Sneller and Ephraim asked whether the government would delay launching the recruitment procedure for a new Dutch member of the European Court of Auditors until parliament could discuss it, and whether the process had adequate checks and balances and peer-based selection. The minister replied that the open procedure through Bureau Algemene Bestuursdienst is already underway, that an independent selection committee will advise ministers before nomination by the Council of the EU after consulting the European Parliament, and that the process is independent with adequate checks.
After the procedure has concluded, the cabinet will consult the relevant parties to consider whether the procedure needs further shaping in the future.
Het kabinet zal na afloop van de procedure in overleg met de relevante spelers bezien of de procedure in de toekomst nog verdere vormgeving behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sneller over het bericht ‘Jongen (17) krijgt allereerste ‘online gebiedsverbod’ in Nederland, maar wat betekent dat eigenlijk?’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Utrecht mayor's order (last onder dwangsom) barring a 17-year-old from online incitement to riot, and whether it is lawful and what powers mayors have online. The minister said the measure is a local matter for the mayor and courts, that it cannot assess the decision, and that the government will provide guidance on online public-order monitoring for municipalities.
It is not for me to judge the mayor's conduct. That concerns a local matter.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het optreden van de burgemeester. Dat betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ephraim over de benoeming van het Nederlandse lid van de Europese Rekenkamer

MPs Sneller and Ephraim asked why former European Court of Auditors member Brenninkmeijer resigned early, what criteria apply to the Dutch successor, and whether parliament will be involved in the appointment. The minister explained the Treaty criteria, noted Parliament's role via the European Parliament consultation, and said an open selection procedure via the Algemene Bestuursdienst will be used, with the ministerraad deciding and normal parliamentary control applying.
The conduct of a cabinet in this matter is subject to normal parliamentary control.
Het handelen van een kabinet in dezen is aan de normale parlementaire controle onderworpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over drugsgebruik in het verkeer

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about drug driving enforcement, including THC thresholds, saliva tests, medicinal users, licence suspensions and possible discriminatory policing. Minister Grapperhaus defended the uniform per se limits, explained the saliva-then-blood procedure and licence rules, and said he would not comment on individual cases.
The NFI will re-evaluate the scientific insights on this in 2022.
Het NFI zal in 2022 de wetenschappelijke inzichten hieromtrent opnieuw evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over de maatschappelijke behoefte van verkoop van cannabisolie als medicijn

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the health minister about a court ruling that did not sentence a cannabis oil seller despite illegal sales, about patient need for medicinal cannabis oil, and about the barriers to researching its quality. The state secretary answered that patient need is not yet fully mapped, that a research study is planned for early 2022, that BMC rejected Suver Nuver's research exemption in 2019, and that policy changes will be considered after the BMC evaluation.
Together with the Bureau for Medicinal Cannabis and the Trimbos Institute, a study is currently being prepared to gain more insight into this.
Samen met het Bureau voor Medicinale Cannabis en het Trimbos Instituut wordt daarom momenteel gewerkt aan een onderzoek om hier meer inzicht in te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over een corona-uitbraak in een gevangenis en de vaccinatie van gevangenen

MPs Sneller and Paternotte asked about a COVID-19 outbreak in Zaanstad prison, the vaccination rate among prisoners, and current measures in detention facilities. The minister answered that outbreak protocols were followed, the exact vaccination rate is unknown because prisoners need not disclose status, and DJI follows RIVM advice on measures.
The exact vaccination rate among prisoners is not known, because prisoners are not obliged to disclose their vaccination status.
De exacte vaccinatiegraad onder gedetineerden is niet bekend, omdat gedetineerden niet verplicht zijn om de vaccinatiestatus door te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over de berichten ‘Dwangsom asfaltfabriek Eindhoven als te hoge uitstoot kankerverwekkende stof benzeen niet stopt, ‘half miljard naar milieucontrole bedrijven, maar wat g

Two D66 MPs asked about benzene emissions from an Eindhoven asphalt plant exceeding limits, weak enforcement of environmental rules, the lack of data on sanctions and about 570 million euro spent by local environmental services, and continued ship degassing in Flevoland lakes. The state secretary answered that enforcement is the competence of local authorities and environmental services, denied any tolerance policy on degassing, and promised a status overview and a leading policy note by year end.
I do not have figures on how often companies are ultimately (partially) closed down.
Ik heb geen cijfers voorhanden hoe vaak bedrijven uiteindelijk (gedeeltelijk) worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over de subsidieaanvraag van de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

MPs Wassenberg and Sneller asked the minister about the King's subsidy application for managing the Het Loo crown estate, including whether it could circumvent the 358-day public opening requirement and which parcels and hectares were covered. The minister answered that the application is the King's responsibility, that the opening conditions apply to nature-subsidy areas with limited exceptions, and that the application has been published on the estate's website.
It is up to the King (the estate's steward) to complete the subsidy application.
Het is aan (de rentmeester van) de Koning om de subsidieaanvraag in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat de politie zonder wettelijke basis automobilisten en bijrijders heeft gefotografeerd voor opsporing

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked the Justice Minister about reports that police photographed drivers and passengers' faces without a legal basis for investigations, and how oversight, retention and evidence use are handled. Minister Grapperhaus disputes that faces were photographed without basis, explains the ANPR legal grounds and the decision to blur all personal images, notes three cases of unblurred photos being shared, and says the evaluation and oversight by the AP and internal bodies apply.
With regard to the question, I want to emphasise that there is by no means any unlawful surveillance.
Ten aanzien van de vraagstelling wil ik benadrukken dat geenszins sprake is van onrechtmatige surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de afwezigheid van het kabinet en de aanwezigheid van de Koning en Koningin bij de ‘Dutch Grand Prix’ in Zandvoort

An MP asked why ministers and state secretaries should not attend the Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort while the King and Queen do, given the King's role as head of government. The government answered that the cabinet agreed on restraint at events during the corona period, with capacity limited to two-thirds, and that the King's attendance as head of state reinforces the event's international profile.
In that light, the cabinet did not find it appropriate to attend itself.
Het kabinet vond het in dat licht niet gepast om zelf wel aanwezig te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het lobbyverbod voor oud-bewindspersonen en de overstap van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

An MP asked the government whether the post-office lobbying ban for former ministers still applies after the circular was withdrawn, whether officials may contact former ministers acting as lobbyists, and whether the ban should be legally anchored, including the Van Nieuwenhuizen case. The government confirmed the ban remains in force via the Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk and Handboek, noted it is still considering further measures for former ministers, and gave only partial answers on sanctions, exceptions and legal anchoring.
The cabinet is still considering whether further measures for former office-holders are desirable.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op de wenselijkheid van nadere maatregelen voor gewezen bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Laan en Sneller over het artikel ‘Ik zag mijn lichaam en mijn maatschappelijke rol als een gevangenis’

MPs Van der Laan and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper article describing a woman's dismissal from the judicial training programme linked to her gender transition, and whether transition-related leave should exist. The minister answered that the dismissal was for substantive reasons unrelated to the transition, that the Council of State-style oversight via the courts and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens upheld this, and that a study on transition leave will be answered by the next cabinet.
It is not for me to go into the further substance of this case.
Het is niet aan mij om op de verdere inhoud van deze casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Werf en Sneller over het niet uitvoeren van de wens van de Tweede Kamer om het privéadres in de KvK af te schermen

MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Chamber's wish to shield private addresses in the Chamber of Commerce register had not been carried out, after the murder of a lawyer whose address was reportedly found through it. The State Secretary answered that home addresses will be shielded by default via a planned amendment, but shielding registered business addresses that are also home addresses conflicts with EU law and is only done in exceptional cases on request, with a further letter promised.
I have further made a proposal to lay down in the Trade Register Decree 2008 that the Chamber of Commerce will from now on shield registered home addresses by default.
Ik heb voorts een voorstel gedaan om in het Handelsregisterbesluit 2008 vast te leggen dat de Kamer van Koophandel als zodanig ingeschreven woonadressen voortaan standaard afschermt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat een man uit zijn woning werd gezet nadat daar één wietplant was aangetroffen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether mayors still use the Damocles-style closure power (art. 13b Opiumwet) as intended, how many evictions result, and what aftercare exists after a man was evicted over one cannabis plant. The Minister confirmed the report, said no overview of evictions exists, pointed to an ongoing evaluation and a Raad van State review, and stated that proportionality, subsidiarity and council accountability plus legal remedies safeguard those affected.
No overview exists of the number of evictions resulting from closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act.
Over het aantal uithuiszettingen naar aanleiding van sluiting van woningen op basis van artikel 13b Opiumwet bestaat geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over een eventuele subsidieaanvraag voor Kroondomein Het Loo

MPs Sneller and Wassenberg asked whether a new subsidy application for maintenance of Kroondomein Het Loo had been received, and when it would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that the Chamber will be sent the subsidy framework before any application, and that applications must be submitted by 31 December 2021 for subsidy from 1 January 2022.
I will give effect to the above commitment by sending you the framework with the subsidy conditions against which any application will be assessed, before any possible application.
Ik zal invulling aan bovenstaande toezegging geven door u voorafgaande aan een eventuele aanvraag het kader met de subsidievoorwaarden te sturen, waaraan de aanvraag getoetst zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Sneller over het bericht dat Nederland met de regels voor lobbyisten ver achterop zou raken

MPs Van Baarle and Sneller asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch lobbying rules lag behind other countries, including OECD findings, UK disclosure duties, revolving-door rules and the withdrawn lobbying-ban circular. The minister disputes that Netherlands is far behind, says a lobbying register and integrity code exist, promises new rules for former ministers and a possible code of conduct for ministers, but leaves a supervisory body and some measures to a future cabinet.
The Netherlands has no official supervisory body for lobbying activities, but that does not mean lobbying activities can take place without any restriction.
Nederland kent geen officiële toezichthouder op lobbyactiviteiten, maar dat betekent niet dat lobbyactiviteiten in Nederland zonder enige restrictie kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, Bromet en Kathmann over het bericht ‘raadsleden pleiten voor modernisering verlofregeling’

Four MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether leave arrangements for councillors should be modernised, following a letter from three municipal councils. The Minister said the current leave rules for elected representatives were a deliberate choice, that broader leave is not warranted, and that she will consult professional associations and administrative bodies on possible flexibilisation, leaving any legislative change to her successor.

I want to see whether the Dutch Association of Councillors, the Dutch Association of Provincial Members and the Association of Water Board Members support the call for a more flexible arrangement set out in the letter.

Ik wil bezien of de Nederlandse Vereniging van Raadsleden, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Statenleden en de Vereniging van algemeen bestuursleden van de Waterschappen het pleidooi voor een flexibeler regeling uit de brief ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het overgangsrecht bij de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about transitional law for the new Wet Straffen en Beschermen, including suspended inmate transfers to restricted facilities, reduced leave under the new regime, and whether prisoners who self-reported during Covid face stricter rules. The Minister defends immediate application and the 1 July 2021 start date, says DJI will clarify leave-request handling and communicate the rules, but rejects postponing or phasing in the reform.
I am aware that critical questions have been raised, for example by advocates, regarding the immediate effect and the transitional law adopted under the Wet SenB.

Ik ben bekend met het feit dat er kritische vragen zijn gesteld – door bijvoorbeeld belangenbehartigers zoals advocaten – met betrekking tot de onmiddellijke werking en het in het kader van de Wet SenB getroffen overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Paternotte, Snels en Westerveld ver de financiële middelen voor toegangstesten

MPs Sneller, Paternotte, Snels and Westerveld asked the Health Minister about the roughly 925 million euro for access testing, its legal basis, the outsourcing to a private foundation, board pay, and whether funds were committed before parliamentary authorisation. The minister answered that spending is phased with go/no-go decisions, that funds were committed before formal authorisation under Comptabiliteitswet article 2.27, and that contract texts were shared with parliament, while offering to seek Auditdienst Rijk advice.
Your House was informed of the funds for phase 0 through the fourth supplementary budget of VWS on 12 March.
Uw Kamer is door middel de vierde incidentele begroting van VWS op 12 maart geïnformeerd over de middelen voor fase 0.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de belaging van journalisten in Urk en Krimpen aan den IJssel

An MP asked about police inaction against threats and violence toward journalists in Urk and Krimpen aan den IJssel and whether the PersVeilig protocol works as intended. The minister condemned the violence, said police de-escalation kept the situation manageable, and stated the protocol is expected to function, with awareness and additional measures for freelance journalists being pursued.
We have said it before and we say it again: keep your hands off journalists.
Wij hebben het eerder gezegd en zeggen het nu weer: blijf met je handen van journalisten af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Schonis, Bruins en Van der Graaf over de jaarcijfers 2020 van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen gepresenteerd op 25 februari 2021

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about NS's 2020 losses, planned cost cuts, state support and the public-transport concession. The Minister answered that talks with NS on financial support are ongoing, that the availability fee has been extended to end-2021, and that he will inform parliament once concrete results exist.
As indicated in the answer to question 11, the talks are still ongoing. If these have produced concrete results, I will inform your House of them as already promised.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 11 lopen de gesprekken nog. Als deze concrete resultaten hebben opgeleverd zal ik uw Kamer zoals reeds toegezegd daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Kroondomein het Loo

Sneller (D66) asks whether Kroondomein het Loo is state-owned, whether the Kroondrager is usufructuary or economic owner, whether surpluses are paid out and how a subsidy was granted with an exception to public access (5,000 ha closed for three months, justified by privacy and security). The minister answers that the Kroondrager is usufructuary, that the subsidy followed the Kaderwet with a broader closure allowed for privacy, and that tax and private financial matters cannot be disclosed.
Financial transactions of natural persons count as conduct within the personal sphere of life.
Financiële transacties van natuurlijke personen gelden als gedragingen binnen de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Westerveld over de ontstane situatie bij L1

MPs Sneller and Westerveld asked the minister about reports that the director of broadcaster L1 planned hidden cameras and access to staff email, and about the supervisory board's handling of the conflict with staff. The minister answered that covert monitoring is generally prohibited and conditionally allowed, that the director withdrew his plans, that L1's internal appointment falls under internal procedures, and that the outcome of an enterprise-chamber procedure will be awaited.
Covert camera surveillance and access to email correspondence are in principle not permitted, because they constitute a serious intrusion into personal privacy.
Heimelijk cameratoezicht en toegang tot mailcorrespondentie is in beginsel niet toegestaan, omdat het een grote inbreuk maakt op de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sneller en Schonis over het bericht 'Particuliere beleggers slepen notarissen voor de rechter vanwege rol in dubieuze grondhandel'

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, El Yassini, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het bericht dat de NOS na aanhoudende bedreiging van journalisten de logo’s van de auto’s haalt

MPs asked the government about the NOS removing vehicle logos after persistent threats against journalists, and what concrete steps protect press freedom. The minister condemned the threats, described the PersVeilig and protocol measures and reports rising incident numbers, but gave no confirmed prosecution-effect data and committed only to a letter on the scheme's operation.

Because this registration option has only been available for a relatively short time, it cannot yet be established whether there is an increase in the number of cases in which prosecution was instituted for aggression against journalists.

Omdat deze registratiemogelijkheid nog maar relatief korte tijd beschikbaar is, kan nog niet worden vastgesteld of er sprake is van een toename van het aantal zaken waarin vervolging is ingesteld wegens agressie tegen journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de afgebroken vakantiereis van leden van het Koninklijk Huis naar Griekenland

Sneller (D66) asked the Prime Minister whether he would prevent a repeat of the royal holiday to Greece and why the Vice-Prime Minister denied knowledge of it at a press conference, and asked whether communication followed guidelines and why two younger royals' stay was not disclosed. Rutte admits a wrong judgment about the King's planned holiday, says the Vice-PM was not informed beforehand, and argues the royals' private travel falls under their protected private sphere.
In general, foreign trips by the King that are not part of his public function belong to his personal sphere of life, which is protected by articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution.

In het algemeen behoren reizen naar het buitenland van de Koning die geen onderdeel uitmaken van zijn publieke functie, tot zijn persoonlijke levenssfeer die wordt gewaarborgd door de artikelen 10 en 41 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, El Yassini, Sneller en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Hoe Jeroen Pauw vertrok en toch een beetje kon blijven'

MPs asked the minister about reports that BNNVARA rejected a production company's proposal around Jeroen Pauw's contract as a salary-cap workaround, and about transparency of presenter pay constructions at the public broadcaster. The minister answered that he does not interfere in individual contract negotiations, that BNNVARA acted within the BPPO framework, and that he will discuss tighter rules with the NPO and broadcasters, reporting in the November 2021 media budget letter.
Given the division of responsibilities, it is not for me to interfere in individual contract negotiations.
Vanuit de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling die geldt past het mij niet om me te mengen in individuele contractonderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sneller over de gevaarlijke situaties als gevolg van ‘boerenprotesten’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Sneller asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Interior about dangerous situations caused by farmers' tractor blockades of motorways and airports, including whether police acted and what risk assessments applied. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no counts of tractors are available, that protest rights are primarily assessed by local authorities, that police prioritised ending the blockade, and that the government does not see unequal treatment compared with climate protests.
No figures are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht dat journalisten bedreigd zijn na berichtgeving over boerenprotesten

MPs Sneller and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked the government how it views threats and blockades against journalists covering farmer protests, whether complaints were filed, and whether it will engage with the affected media. The Minister answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the PersVeilig initiative and prosecution protocols, reported no fines or known complaints for the Best incident, and said the government stands for a free press without committing to new talks.
Aggression and violence against journalists is unacceptable.
Agressie en geweld tegen journalisten is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over eeuwige grafrust

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about 'eternal grave rest' and perpetual grave rights in municipal and special cemeteries, and whether municipalities may offer them. The Minister answered that the Burial Act does not explicitly regulate eternal grave rest but leaves room for it, that cemetery managers may offer it, and that she supports the decentralised system while being willing to talk with municipalities about religious burial needs.
I am willing to speak with municipalities about this and am already in discussion with representatives of religious organisations about the legal provisions needed.
Ik ben bereid om met gemeenten hierover te spreken en ben met vertegenwoordigers van religieuze organisaties al in gesprek over de wettelijke voorzieningen die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en de Groot over het bericht ‘Koning krijgt ten onrechte subsidie voor het Loo’

MPs Sneller and De Groot asked whether the Minister knew of reports that the King receives subsidy for Het Loo despite exemptions from subsidy conditions, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the subsidy decision would be shared and the legal procedure monitored. The Minister confirmed knowledge, said the Chamber had been informed through budget debates and a letter, shared the subsidy decision as an attachment, defended the subsidy as lawfully granted, and committed to report on the court outcome and to inform the Chamber before any new subsidy is granted.
Yes. I have included the subsidy decision as an annex to this letter.
Ja. Ik heb de subsidiebeschikking als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over het bericht dat de compliance bij ABN AMRO gedurende lange tijd tekortschoot

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's compliance failures in 2015–2017 were known to the board of commissioners, to NLFI and to the ministry, and what the state did about it. The minister answered that compliance is the responsibility of the management and supervisory boards, that he cannot comment on the ongoing Public Prosecution Service investigation, and that NLFI and the ministry had regular contacts with the bank without compliance necessarily being on the agenda.
I therefore cannot go into the circumstances from the bank's past described in the article.
Ik kan daarom niet ingaan op de geschetste omstandigheden uit het verleden van de bank.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Paleis Noordeinde deze zomer niet open voor publiek’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked why Paleis Noordeinde and the Koninklijke Stallen cannot reopen to the public this summer like museums, suggesting ticketed time slots over more days. Prime Minister Rutte answered that access is a matter for the King under article 41 of the Constitution, weighing COVID-19 measures, and that an online alternative is being developed instead.
Access to the palaces is a matter governed by article 41 of the Constitution: the King arranges his household, taking the public interest into account.
De toegang tot de paleizen is een aangelegenheid waarvoor artikel 41 van de Grondwet geldt: de Koning richt, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn huis in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over het afsluiten van Nederlandse betaalrekeningen van Nederlanders buiten Nederland

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked the Finance Minister whether banks may close current accounts of Dutch citizens living outside the EU, and about related costs, French rules and possible legal changes. The Minister answered that banks set their own risk policy within the law, that basic payment account rights apply only to those lawfully residing in the EU, and that no further study is planned for now.
At present I see no added value in a study into the possibility of legally giving Dutch nationals outside the EU the option of a (basic) payment account.
Antwoord 17 Op dit moment zie ik geen toegevoegde waarde in een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om Nederlanders buiten de EU wettelijk de mogelijkheid te geven tot een (basis)betaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over de vergoedingen van de inrichting van de privévertrekken van paleis Huis ten Bosch

Two MPs (Kuiken, Sneller) asked the Prime Minister whether the state or the King paid for furnishing the private quarters of Huis ten Bosch, and whether the B-component of the King's allowance should be evaluated every five years as the Court of Audit recommended. The government answered that the state covers renovation and basic furnishing, the King bears extra costs beyond the standard, the B-component is adjusted through indexation, and it sees no need for new measures, while withholding details of the King's own contribution citing privacy and Article 41 of the Constitution.
On this, given Article 41 of the Constitution and for reasons of protecting personal privacy, I cannot go into further detail.
Hierop kan ik, gelet op artikel 41 Grondwet en om redenen van bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Snels en Bruins over de maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

MPs Sneller, Snels and Bruins asked how the COVID-19 export credit insurance (ekv) relaxation measures were designed, including their composition of the Rijkscommissie, links to debt relief, green transition, and fossil-fuel financing, and whether France's approach should be followed. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered substantively on most points, stating the measures are temporary, open to all sectors, additional to the private market, and that the government will pursue greening of ekv internationally without committing to a fossil-fuel phase-out scenario.
The cabinet will study with interest the French report focusing on scenarios for a full stop of ekv coverage for fossil-fuel-related projects.

Het kabinet zal het Franse rapport dat zich concentreert op scenario's voor volledige stopzetting van dekkingsmogelijkheden vanuit de ekv voor fossiel-gerelateerde projecten met belangstelling bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sneller over het bericht ‘Verzekeringsreus Aon vraagt personeel om loonoffer van 20% vanwege corona’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sneller asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurer Aon requests a 20% pay cut from staff due to COVID-19 while still paying dividends, and what role works councils and unions play. The minister declined to judge individual companies, explained that employees can refuse such requests and that works councils have only advisory or consent rights in limited cases, and noted that pay levels affect NOW subsidies and unemployment benefits.
I do not think it appropriate to go into individual cases.
Ik vind het niet passend om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Nijboer en Sneller over het uitblijven van resultaten na de aankoop van aandelen van Air France – KLM

MPs asked the Finance Minister about the state's stake in Air France-KLM, IATA board seats, the Franse pilot agreements and KLM dividend policy. The minister answered that IATA matters are for airlines, that the Franco-Dutch talks are ongoing without interim detail, and that KLM's dividend is decided by its supervisory board and priority shareholders.
Besides the fact that Air France-KLM is a listed company, it is also not constructive to share interim information about these talks.
Naast het feit dat Air France-KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming is, is het ook niet constructief om tussentijds iets te delen over deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het verbieden van samenkomsten buiten de publieke ruimte

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ban on gatherings outside public space, under COVID-19 emergency ordinances, unduly intrudes on private life and the home, and how it fits Articles 10 and 12 of the Constitution and Article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that the ban rests on public health law, that proportionality and judicial review by courts apply case by case, and that temporary formal legislation with safeguards is planned.
Ultimately it is up to the criminal or administrative court to judge the ban and whether enforcement in a concrete situation affects the private sphere.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de strafrechter of de bestuursrechter om te oordelen over het verbod en of het optreden in een concrete situatie de persoonlijke levenssfeer raakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen overde gevolgen van de Luanda Leaks voor Nederlandse bedrijven en beleid

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the consequences of the Luanda Leaks for Dutch firms and policy, including trust offices, Dutch shell companies, consultancy due diligence and anti-corruption enforcement. The minister answered most questions substantively but declined to say whether investigations are ongoing, citing the prosecution service and FIOD procedures, and promised to study trust-sector evasion and the government procurement leverage.
I cannot go into questions concerning what the Public Prosecution Service, the FIOD and supervisors are doing in terms of (whether or not) ongoing investigations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op vragen die zien op hetgeen door het OM, de FIOD en toezichthouders wordt gedaan in de zin van (al dan niet) lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg, Özütok en Snels over de opschorting van het Wob-verzoek van Pieter Klein

MPs from D66, GroenLinks asked the Health Minister why he suspended a Wob freedom-of-information request from journalist Pieter Klein on coronavirus matters and whether this undermines oversight and press freedom.
