The minister answered that the request was suspended for force majeure due to crisis work, that only coronavirus-related Wob requests are paused with a plan to resume by 1 June, and that alternative channels and appeal routes remain open.
Only in a very exceptional situation can an administrative body invoke force majeure to suspend the decision period for Wob requests.
Uitsluitend in geval van een zeer uitzonderlijke situatie kan een bestuursorgaan met een beroep op overmacht de beslistermijn voor Wob-verzoeken opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Sneller en Groothuizen over de implementatie van noodverordeningen ten behoeve van de ‘intelligente lockdown’

MPs Den Boer, Sneller and Groothuizen asked why the legal basis for new COVID-19 'intelligent lockdown' measures was not communicated, why emergency ordinances took days to draft, whether enforcement before legal force was lawful, and when the ordinances will be withdrawn. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the legal bases were in the Minister of Health's directive to safety regions, acknowledged the omission for future letters, defended announcing measures before the ordinances existed, explained the drafting complexity, and said the measures stay in force until the health minister's directive is withdrawn, with review before 28 April.
In future, care will be taken that these legal bases are also stated when informing the House.
In het vervolg zal erop worden gelet dat deze grondslagen ook worden vermeld bij het informeren van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het meenemen van schadevrije jaren voor autoverzekeringen binnen de Europese Unie

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether no-claims years (schadevrije jaren) for car insurance can be carried across EU member states and whether they should be harmonised, given that people moving to another EU state may pay higher premiums. The minister answered that insurers set their own risk weighting, that cross-border no-claims statements are mandatory but applied differently per country, and that EU-wide harmonisation is not desirable, while the related claims-history form is being negotiated in the MID revision.
I will continue the consultation jointly with the parties involved to examine further whether they can reach a solution and how.
Ik zal met de betrokken partijen gezamenlijk het overleg verder voeren om nader te onderzoeken of de partijen tot een oplossing kunnen komen en op welke wijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van der Graaf, Sneller en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Lokale en regionale kranten zoeken steun om coronacrisis te overleven’

MPs asked the minister for Education and Media about the financial crisis facing local and regional newspapers during the coronavirus crisis, including support options, advertising revenue loss, consultation with publishers and foreign ownership risks. The minister announced a temporary support fund for free newspapers and local public broadcasters, coulance measures, and called on municipalities and provinces to contribute, without addressing executive oversight directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sneller over de lokale noodverordeningen in verband met de bestrijding van het coronavirus

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about the legal basis, decision-making, democratic oversight and publication of local COVID-19 emergency ordinances, and about Latvia's suspension of ECHR rights. The minister acknowledged the omitted legal basis, described the regional chairs' emergency ordinances and the accountability route via municipal councils, and said current measures fit within ECHR limitation clauses.
Omitting the legal basis was an oversight.
Het niet vermelden van de wettelijke grondslag was een omissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het monitoren van mogelijke liquiditeitsproblemen in de financiële sector als gevolg van COVID-19

An MP asked the Finance Minister about short-selling bans and liquidity monitoring in the financial sector during COVID-19, including how DNB and AFM would use regulatory flexibility. The minister answered that the AFM sees no reason for a short-selling ban now, explained the available tools, described DNB's temporary capital relief measures, and said the ministry monitors the sector closely with DNB and AFM.
The AFM, however, sees no reason to date to take measures against short selling.
De AFM ziet tot op heden echter geen aanleiding tot het nemen van maatregelen tegen short selling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over hoe Nederlandse bedrijven een mogelijk zeer schadelijke rol spelen bij uitbuiten van Angola

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers how Dutch companies and shell companies may have helped drain Angolan state funds, and what tools exist to tackle foreign bribery, consultancy oversight, and corporate liability. The government answered that existing criminal law is adequate, that investigations are ongoing and cannot be discussed, that trust-office rules and consultancy regulation are under review, and that it will study a remediation programme for companies.
I cannot make statements about any ongoing investigations.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over eventuele lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de mogelijke schikking met Shell

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked whether the Justice Minister discussed a possible settlement with Shell over the Etosha bribery investigation in Nigeria with prosecutors, whether ministry officials pushed for a settlement, why the Royal Household inquired about the case in 2016, and how the Prime Minister assesses Shell's conduct. The Minister answered that he was only informed of the investigation's status, denied requesting or pushing for a settlement, said the 2016 inquiry concerned a planned royal visit and media attention, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal case.
Has the Minister asked the Public Prosecution Service to reach a settlement with Shell? If so, why did you do that and when did you do it?
Heeft de Minister het OM gevraagd een schikking te treffen met Shell? Zo ja, waarom heeft u dat gedaan en wanneer heeft u dat gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht ‘Financiële sector loopt miljarden mis door focus op de man als klant’

Two MPs (D66) asked the Finance Minister about a report that the financial sector misses large sums by focusing on men as customers, including gender differences in products, lending and advice. The minister said a broader focus on women is plausible and commercially sensible, noted that advisers must consider relevant life circumstances, and said he will address the issue within the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
I will also address this point within the framework of the Consumer Choices Action Plan.
Ik zal dit punt ook in het kader van het Actieplan Consumentenkeuzes adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller, Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Rutte informeert Tweede Kamer onjuist over kunstverkoop Oranjes'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about reports that the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas, a Raden Saleh painting and other art from Princess Juliana's estate were sold or kept out of museums against advice, and about the handling of the estate and the tax-credit scheme. The government answered that legal constraints on privacy and tax confidentiality limit disclosure of the estate settlement, that the atlas sale was not subject to a binding guarantee of staying in the Netherlands, and that the policy on displaying art acquired via the scheme is not legally binding but policy-based, with a commitment to follow the advisory committee's report.
As I noted in answer to question 2, various statutory provisions prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the various private heirs and other parties.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 2 heb opgemerkt staan verschillende wettelijke voorschriften er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over het bericht dat DPG Media uitgeverij Sanoma overneemt

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about DPG Media's takeover of publisher Sanoma and its effects on media plurality and competition. The minister replied that media concentration is not automatically a loss of plurality, that the ACM will assess competition effects in its merger review, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media monitors plurality annually.
Concentration of ownership within the media sector cannot simply be equated with a restriction of plurality.
Concentratie van eigenaarschap binnen de mediasector kan niet zonder meer gelijk gesteld worden aan inperking van pluriformiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het niet verkopen van ABN AMRO en het miljardenverlies op deze aandelen

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister why the state has not sold ABN AMRO shares since September 2017, how the sale procedure and NLFI's advice work, and what the timing criteria are. The minister answered that NLFI advises on strategy and that the minister approves each step, but he declined to disclose confidential advice, the number of sale meetings, and the reasoning behind timing, citing market sensitivity, while promising to publish some advice after transactions.

Disclosing NLFI's considerations, now or in the past, when advising on the share sale strategy and my own considerations, both then and now, could lead to expectations among investors that allow them to anticipate a state transaction.

Het openbaar maken van de afwegingen van NLFI, nu of in het verleden, bij het adviseren over de verkoopstrategie van de aandelen en mijn afwegingen hierbij, zowel destijds als nu, kunnen leiden tot mogelijke verwachtingen bij beleggers waardoor zij mogelijk kunnen anticiperen op een transactie van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat slechts 6 op de 10 Nederlanders weten wat de termen ‘budget’, ‘inflatie’ en ‘rente’ betekenen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a survey finding that many Dutch people do not understand basic financial terms, and about how the government will improve financial literacy and consumer choices. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to education curricula, the Week van het geld, Wijzer in geldzaken and the Actieplan Consumentenkeuzes, and largely declines to set concrete SMART targets beyond facilitating partnerships.
Yes, I am aware of that.
Ja, daar ben ik mee bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over het bericht dat AstroTV in 2020 van tv verdwijnt

MPs Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister about misuse of non-compete clauses, including the AstroTV case where Talpa ended broadcasting in 2020 and the producer continued via phone and app. The government answered that media companies decide their own programming without prior oversight, that consumer-protection rules still apply via the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie, and that it sees no need to act on the broadcast.
The ACM makes no statements about any ongoing investigations.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken doet de ACM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het kunnen meenemen van schadevrije jaren

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether foreign no-claims years can be transferred to Dutch insurance, whether partners and regular drivers can build no-claims years, and whether no-claims years can be split on divorce. The minister answered that transfer depends on each insurer's rules, that children and partners build no-claims years only if registered, and that no change is planned because some insurers already offer splitting.
I do not intervene in the acceptance conditions of individual insurers.
Ik treed niet in de acceptatievoorwaarden van individuele verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de berichten ‘Smith: Air France en KLM nog meer integreren’ en ‘France Hits Out at Dutch in Feud Over Air France-KLM Holdings’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about press reports that Air France-KLM's CEO wants further integration and about a French official's public demand that the Netherlands choose between its holding and KLM stakes, including how KLM's position, jobs, foundations and state guarantees are protected. The minister answered that the government will monitor the agreements and guarantees, that the Franch-Dutch working group is ongoing, and that he will not disclose talks or comment on specific operational matters because Air France-KLM is listed.
Beyond that, I will not go into the content of the talks, as in my view this does not serve the talks.
Verder ga ik niet in op de inhoud van de gesprekken in de werkgroep, dit komt mijns inziens de gesprekken niet ten goede.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het uitblijven van een akkoord met de Franse Staat over het waarborgen van de Nederlandse publieke belangen na de aandelenaankoop van Air France-KLM

Two MPs (D66) asked why the agreed June 2019 target for a deal with the French state on guarantees and protecting Dutch public interests after the Air France-KLM share purchase was missed, and about the Aigle Azur bid and convertible bond. Minister Hoekstra replied that a working group is in place, talks are complex and confidential, the state exercises shareholder rights, it declined to discuss the Aigle Azur case as price-sensitive, and it did not subscribe to the convertible bond.
This may concern price-sensitive information, so the substance of this case cannot be addressed.
Dit betreft mogelijk koersgevoelige informatie, dus op de inhoud van deze casus kan niet worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het betalen door de regering voor het werk van koningin Máxima als speciaal pleitbezorger namens de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the government whether it pays about 150,000 euros a year for Queen Máxima's UN work as Special Advocate, and whether further royal costs sit outside the Crown budget. The government confirmed the roughly 150,000 euros annual average from the 'special multilateral activities' budget of Foreign Trade and Development, said some staff costs are not separately identified, and admitted its 2014 statement had wrongly implied only the Kroondomein subsidy fell outside the Crown budget.
During Queen Máxima's visits as UNSGSA, support is provided by local UN offices and logistical support by staff of the Dutch diplomatic missions.

Tijdens de bezoeken van Koningin Máxima als UNSGSA wordt ondersteuning verleend vanuit lokale kantoren van de VN en (logistieke) ondersteuning door medewerkers van de Nederlandse diplomatieke vertegenwoordigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de overheid op één dag meer dan een miljard heeft verloren op de aandelen van ABN AMRO

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that the state lost over a billion euros in one day on its ABN AMRO shares, why no shares have been sold since his appointment, and how democratic control over the holding via NLFI is organised. The minister confirms the regeerakkoord goal of full market sale as soon as responsible, declines to explain sale timing for market-sensitivity reasons, and describes the NLFI governance and ministerial approval arrangements.
This information could be price-sensitive and disclosing it could have a negative effect on intended transactions.
Deze informatie zou koersgevoelig kunnen zijn en openbaarmaking daarvan zou een negatief effect op voorgenomen transacties kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Sneller over het bericht dat de NPO overweegt om uit NLZIET te stappen

MPs Van der Molen and Sneller asked the minister about reports that the NPO might leave the NLZIET platform for NPO Start Plus, and about a working group's draft scenario diverging from the vision letter. The minister answered that the NPO denies this, the draft was an unapproved staff document, the NPO remains loyal to NLZIET, and stricter conditions for NPO Start Plus are planned from the next concession period.
The NPO has assured me that this report is not correct.
De NPO heeft mij verzekerd dat dit bericht niet klopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over hoge marktconcentratie onder dagbladuitgeverijen

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about high market concentration among Dutch newspaper publishers, including De Persgroep's expansion, falling freelance rates, and whether the market remains competitive. The minister answered that concentration is high but the market is hybrid and digitalising, that the ACM reviewed and approved the Independer takeover on competition grounds, and that the government is pursuing collective bargaining options for freelancers while having no comparative EU data.
The takeover of Independer by De Persgroep was notified to the ACM at the end of October 2018.
De overname van Independer door De Persgroep is eind oktober 2018 bij de ACM gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Aartsen, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de problemen bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister about problems at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including a reprimand of a board member, his side job at Mail.ru, the handling of a dismissed member, and the continuity of the board. The minister acknowledged inadequate information provision, said no consequences were attached to the reprimand, defended the Mail.ru side job as not objectionable for now, and promised to review the wachtgeld and side-job rules with the new chair.
However, I conclude that in this case the provision of information was not sufficient, as it has since emerged that I did not have certain information.
Wel concludeer ik dat in dit geval de informatievoorziening niet voldoende was nu achteraf is gebleken dat ik bepaalde informatie niet had.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het Rapport van de Special Rapporteur on extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions: Investigation into the unlawful death of Mr. Jamal Khashoggi

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Special Rapporteur's report finding Khashoggi's killing a premeditated extrajudicial execution attributable to Saudi Arabia, and about recommendations on accountability, press safety, surveillance exports and targeted sanctions. The minister acknowledged the report's seriousness, urged Saudi cooperation and further investigation, said sanctions currently lack the needed broad support, and listed bilateral and multilateral follow-up steps.
For this reason the Netherlands and the EU continue to call on Saudi Arabia to fully cooperate with all investigations and to make all information about the case available.
Nederland en de EU blijven daarom Saoedi-Arabië oproepen om volledige medewerking te verlenen aan alle onderzoeken en om alle informatie over de zaak beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over een gelijk speelveld voor alternatieve kredietverleners en banken bij de financiering van het midden- en kleinbedrijf

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked about the level playing field between banks and alternative lenders in financing SMEs, including differing SME definitions, the professionalisation of alternative lenders, implementation of a motion, and why certain subsidy schemes channel funds only through banks. The government replied that bank financing remains dominant but non-bank finance is growing, that a study on SME financing is underway with a report expected in the second half of the year, and that schemes will be reviewed for level-playing-field effects.
What matters is that SMEs have a sufficiently diverse financing landscape available that meets their legitimate credit needs.
Van belang is dat mkb'ers een voldoende divers financieringslandschap ter beschikking staat dat voorziet in hun legitieme kredietbehoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de voormalig Oostenrijkse vice-kanselier een Oostenrijkse krant wilde verkopen aan een Russische investeerder

MP Sneller asked about reports that former Austrian vice-chancellor Strache offered a Kronen Zeitung stake to a Russian-linked investor, and about rules for foreign takeovers of Dutch newspapers and whether such takeovers are desirable for democratic resilience. The minister declined to comment on the Austrian matter as internal to Austria, said no sector-specific takeover rules exist (ACM and EU merger control apply generally), and announced planned bans on donations from outside the EU to political parties and a forthcoming Political Parties Act.
It does not befit me to go into the circumstances of the matter, since this is an internal Austrian affair.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op de toedracht van de zaak, aangezien het hier een interne Oostenrijkse aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sneller over het bericht ‘NPO blokkeert mogelijkheid om programmastreams te downloaden’

MPs Van Meenen and Sneller asked the minister why the public broadcaster NPO blocks downloading of programme streams since March 2019, and whether public-funded programmes should be freely available, including for schools. The minister answered that DRM was introduced to protect copyright and for reporting reasons, that downloads are not required of public broadcasters, and that educational reuse is facilitated via Beeld en Geluid.
A public institution such as the NPO cannot be expected to disregard agreements and the rights of producers, broadcasters and makers.
Er kan niet van een publieke instelling als de NPO worden verwacht dat hij afspraken en rechten van producenten, omroepen en makers negeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over Koninklijke onderscheidingen aan buitenlandse staatshoofden

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked whether royal Dutch honours given to foreign heads of state can be inappropriate when controversy or human rights violations are involved, and whether revocation grounds should be widened. The minister listed nine heads of state honoured in the past five years, said honours are a diplomatic instrument, opposed widening revocation grounds, and was willing to have the standard practice evaluated.
I am of the view that broadening the revocation grounds for honours will not contribute to a better substantive discussion with the country concerned about respecting international law.

Ik ben van mening dat het verruimen van intrekkingsgronden van onderscheidingen niet zal bijdragen aan een betere inhoudelijke discussie met het betrokken land over het respecteren van het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Den Boer over het bericht ««Helft vrouwelijke journalisten heeft met bedreigingen te maken» NRC checkt»

MPs Sneller and Den Boer asked the government about an NRC report finding that nearly half of female journalists face threats, and about the recommendations to protect them, including freelancers and journalists with a migration background. Minister Slob answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the Stuurgroep agreement and the PersVeilig project, and said the specific position of female and minority journalists will be addressed in a safety plan due in autumn.
It is unacceptable that journalists carrying out their work are hindered in doing so by the actions of others.
Het is onaanvaardbaar dat journalisten die hun werk uitvoeren, belemmerd worden in de uitvoering hiervan door de acties van anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sneller over berichten dat Sint Maarten niet optreedt tegen witwassen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about reports that Sint Maarten is not acting against money laundering, including the economic consequences of FATF non-compliance, EU and Kingdom implications, casino transaction reporting, and the Integrity Chamber. The government answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing FATF recommendations, outlined possible CFATF countermeasures and grey-list risks, noted Dutch and World Bank technical support, and described the Integrity Chamber's powers, while stating that money laundering prosecution falls outside that chamber.
Foremost, anchoring the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendations in legislation is a responsibility of the country of Sint Maarten.
Voorop staat dat de verankering van de aanbevelingen van de Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in wetgeving een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Sneller over het bericht 'ING en milieuorganisaties bepleiten klimaatrichtlijnen voor financiële sector'

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government will act on an NGO and ING call for climate guidelines for banks, including requesting IEA scenarios and a single carbon measurement method. The minister answered that the IEA Sustainable Development Scenario already suffices, that the Dutch financial sector's commitment to Paris-aligned targets is welcomed, and that a single measurement method is premature while harmonisation proceeds.
However, in my view it is still too early to introduce a single standard measurement method for the climate impact of investments at this time.
Het is echter wat mij betreft nog te vroeg om op dit moment één standaard meetmethode in te voeren voor de klimaatimpact van investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller inzake de groeiende maatschappelijke zorgen over de plannen voor Paleis Soestdijk

MPs Van Eijs and Sneller (D66) asked whether the Paleis Soestdijk redevelopment by Made by Holland, which now adds a 120-room hotel and about 33 extra homes beyond the original bid, is still within the sale concept and how the municipality and province should be involved. The Secretary of State answers that the changes fit the original concept under the sale contract, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf consented, and that planning decisions and conditions such as the number of homes and use of proceeds are the responsibility of the province and municipality.
Since this concerns a further elaboration of the plan area, the province and municipality are the competent authorities because of its public-law character.
Aangezien het om een nadere invulling van het plangebied gaat, zijn de provincie en de gemeente vanwege het publiekrechtelijke karakter het bevoegde gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller over de berichten ‘Grondspeculant belemmert bouwplannen van gemeenten’, ‘Dubieuze handel in kavels veel omvangrijker dan gedacht en ‘Niemand wil bouwen op versnipperde

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Finance and of the Interior about reports that land speculation obstructs municipal building plans, that land trading in plots is more extensive than thought, and that fragmented land is hard to build on, asking about municipal pre-emption rights, the reach of the Wvg after the Omgevingswet, and AFM supervision of speculative land offerings. The minister acknowledged speculation can delay projects but could not assess how many municipalities are affected, said the pre-emption right is an effective tool and that she had received no signals of municipal unawareness, and explained that land offerings structured as leases or self-managed fall outside AFM supervision, with a bill on investment objects planned for late 2019.
However, I cannot assess to what extent and in how many municipalities concrete (firm) building plans are actually obstructed by land speculation.
Ik kan echter niet beoordelen in hoeverre en in hoeveel gemeenten daadwerkelijk door grondspeculatie concrete (harde) bouwplannen worden bemoeilijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sneller over het verkrijgen van inzicht in de gevolgen van maximumsnelheden

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government gains insight into the effects of speed limits, including the 130 km/h motorway limit, on road safety, air quality, costs, liveability and congestion, and whether evaluation and cost-benefit analyses are adequate. The minister answered that effects are tracked in annual monitors, that road safety is a priority but the speed limits will be kept, that the Court of Audit has a study pending, and that a French-style study in the Netherlands is not needed.
If not, do you agree that it would be desirable to have these insights?
Zo nee, deelt u de mening dat het wenselijk zou zijn om wel over deze inzichten te beschikken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht dat in Brunei nieuwe shariawetten zijn ingevoerd

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Brunei's new Sharia penal code, including stoning for same-sex relations, Dutch diplomatic response, and whether the sultan's Dutch royal honour should be revoked. The minister condemned the measures, cited diplomatic efforts and the sultan's announced moratorium and UNCAT ratification, but declined to revoke the honour, stating the law only permits revocation after a one-year prison sentence and that broadening revocation grounds would not help dialogue.
Under the law, a decoration can only be revoked if the decorated person has been sentenced to a final prison term of at least one year.
Volgens de wetgeving kan een onderscheiding alleen worden ingetrokken als de gedecoreerde persoon veroordeeld is tot een onherroepelijke gevangenisstraf van minimaal één jaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Ronnes en Van der Linde over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën de beantwoording van Kamervragen over het handelen van het Bureau Kredietregistratie (BKR) met dat bureau

MPs Sneller, Ronnes and Van der Linde asked whether the Ministry of Finance aligned its answers to earlier parliamentary questions on BKR (credit registration bureau) conduct with BKR itself, whether measures were agreed with BKR, and about free access to personal data. The minister replies that BKR was consulted on factual points and a proposed approach was adjusted, that BKR remains independent and decides on measures, and that free access under the GDPR is provided, with no limit on the number of requests.
It is customary that, to answer parliamentary questions, contact is sought with involved parties both inside and outside government.
Het is gebruikelijk dat ten behoeve van de beantwoording van Kamervragen contact wordt gezocht met betrokken partijen van binnen en buiten de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een Russische bank miljarden witwaste, ook via Nederlandse banken

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that a Russian bank laundered billions, partly through Dutch banks, and about ING's role and the EU high-risk third-country list. The minister said supervisory information on individual institutions is confidential, outlined DNB's AML enforcement powers, and explained the Netherlands' objection to the Commission's list on procedural grounds while declining to comment on individual cases or diplomatic communications.
Information on individual institutions is subject to supervisory confidentiality. DNB therefore cannot share this information, not even with your House or with me.
Informatie over individuele instellingen is toezichtsvertrouwelijk. DNB kan deze informatie daarom niet delen, ook niet met uw Kamer of met mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels, Sneller, Bruins en Nijboer over de ING-witwasaffaire

Four MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his ministry suggested wording to DNB on its letter about the ING money-laundering case, whether it steered answers, and how ministerial responsibility for DNB is exercised. The minister answered that his officials only asked clarifying questions, that DNB decides its own wording, that he holds only system responsibility for DNB, and that he was first informed of the case on 31 August 2018.
DNB is independent in carrying out the tasks assigned to it as an independent administrative body: it judges individual cases autonomously and is not subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

DNB is onafhankelijk in de uitvoering van de taken die haar als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zijn opgedragen: zij oordeelt zelfstandig over individuele gevallen en is niet ondergeschikt aan de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de NPO-app op tv’s van vóór 2014 niet meer werkt

An MP asked the minister about reports that the NPO app no longer works on TVs made before 2014, whether the public broadcaster must serve everyone including catch-up viewing, and whether a solution would be explored for affected viewers. The minister confirmed the problem, stated that the NPO is responsible under the Mediawet for accessibility, and declined to adapt the app for older Smart TVs, pointing to cost and to alternative viewing routes such as the website and casting.
Adapting apps for all versions of Smart TVs involves relatively high costs, while the media offering is also available through other means.
Het aanpassen van apps voor alle versies van Smart TV’s gaat gepaard met relatief hoge kosten terwijl het media-aanbod ook via andere manieren beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over het bericht dat koningin Maxima in Argentinië de belasting zou hebben ontdoken

MPs Kuiken and Sneller asked the Prime Minister whether Queen Máxima underpaid tax in Argentina by understating the value of real estate, and whether royals have an exemplary role. Prime Minister Rutte answered that such investments fall within the private sphere protected by articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution, that the public interest is not affected where laws are followed, and gave no substantive confirmation or denial.
This advice clarifies concretely, among other things, that investments in real estate abroad belong to the private sphere and that reporting on them does not in itself detract from that.

Deze voorlichting maakt in concrete zin onder meer duidelijk dat investeringen in onroerend goed in het buitenland behoren tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer en dat berichtgeving hierover daaraan op zichzelf niet afdoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat sommige kleine Europese landen in trek zijn voor licenties van nieuwe betaaldiensten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that small EU states attract payment-licence applicants and about supervisory capacity, money-laundering risks linked to citizenship-by-investment schemes in Malta and Cyprus, and whether supervision should be centralised at EU level. The minister answered that PSD II harmonises supervision, that Dutch supervisors can escalate to the EBA, that the Commission is monitoring citizenship schemes, and that the government favours only gradual, criteria-based centralisation, so EU-level supervision of payment services is not warranted for now.
The cabinet therefore favours a gradual transfer of supervisory tasks away from national supervisors.
Het kabinet is daarom voorstander van een geleidelijke overgang van toezichttaken van nationale toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked whether the state bought royal art and heritage objects since the 1980s, whether a list of purchases can be published, and why public access is limited. The minister answered that only palace-bound inventory was bought and placed with the Royal Household, that private owners decide on disclosure and sales, and that some palaces are partly open to the public.
Regarding openness and transparency for art held in private ownership, I note that it is up to the private owner to decide whether and how insight is given.
Wat betreft openbaarheid en transparantie bij kunstbezit in privé eigendom merk ik op dat het aan de particuliere eigenaar is om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, inzicht wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

Two D66 MPs asked whether a Rubens drawing and other artworks sold by princess Christina at Sotheby's had ever belonged to a Orange foundation, and if so how they moved to private ownership. The minister answered simply that they had not.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over de herijking van de businesscase voor civiele dienstauto’s, zoals genoemd in de Najaarsnota 2018

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the revised business case for civilian service cars, including fleet numbers, cost and sale-value adjustments, and a correction to the Najaarsnota 2018 text. The state secretary answered in detail on replacement terms, the EUR 59.2 million downward revision, the BPM error in earlier sale-value estimates, operating costs and cash flows, and acknowledged the Najaarsnota error.
I note that an error was made in the text of the Najaarsnota regarding Defence's civilian service cars.
Ik merk op dat er een fout is gemaakt in de tekst van de Najaarsnota over de civiele dienstauto's van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over het bericht 'Defensie vervroegt vervanging vipvliegtuig'

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked whether Defence plans to replace the government Gulfstream IV early, why parliament was not informed, the cost and business case, and whether this priority is morally defensible while staff lack a collective agreement. The State Secretary confirmed earlier replacement (before 2022) due to ageing and groundings, said parliament will receive the A-brief, stated the purchase will be under 100 million euro, and said procurement is not linked to pay negotiations.
In the A-brief I will inform the House about the replacement of the Gulfstream IV.
In de A-brief zal ik de Kamer informeren over de vervanging van de Gulfstream IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Alkaya, Snels en Bruins over het bericht dat banken financiering van fossiele energie niet hebben teruggebracht

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks and insurers still invest far more in fossil energy than in renewables, and about the transparency and comparability of financial institutions' climate investments. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to DNB monitoring, the sector's climate commitment within the Klimaatakkoord, and EU sustainability disclosure work, without committing to new mandatory reporting rules.
At the request of a motion by MPs Snels and Sneller, I have asked DNB to continue monitoring the Dutch financial sector's exposures to CO2-intensive sectors.
Ik heb DNB, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Snels en Sneller 3 , gevraagd de uitzettingen van de Nederlandse financiële sector op CO 2 -intensieve sectoren te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over toepassing van het verlaagde btw-tarief op e-publicaties

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked whether the government will lower VAT on e-publications following the October 2018 EU political agreement, and what preparations, timeline and consultation with the sector are planned. The state secretary confirmed the agreement and earlier commitments, said preparations are underway including a draft bill for internet consultation in the first half of 2019, and targeted entry into force on 1 January 2020.
Furthermore, I intend to consult broadly on a draft bill in the first half of 2019 via an internet consultation, so that all stakeholders have the opportunity to respond.

Verder ben ik voornemens om een conceptwetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2019 breed te consulteren via een internetconsultatie, zodat alle belanghebbenden in de gelegenheid worden gesteld te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht 'Koninklijke cadeaus, vorstelijke problemen: hoe de Oranjes omgaan met geschenken'

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked the Prime Minister about reports that a Rubens drawing sold at auction may have been on loan from a royal foundation, and whether ownership and the sale had been properly checked. The government answered that the publications do not change its earlier position that the work is private property, that the sale is for the private owner to decide, that no RVD involvement was found, and that it cannot establish whether other works sit in royal foundations.
It is up to the private owner to decide whether, and in what manner, an artwork is sold.
Het is aan de particuliere eigenaar om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, een kunstwerk wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over Astro TV

MPs Sneller and Alkaya asked whether the psychic programme 'Astro TV' and similar shows that promise financial good fortune to callers, aimed at vulnerable people, amount to misleading practice and whether the Authority for Consumers and Markets or other supervisors should act. The government answered that the programme cited is actually RTL's 'Dit is mijn toekomst', that responsibility for assessing misleading practices lies with the ACM and the courts, that the AFM and Commissariaat have no clear remit, and that RTL has agreed limits on advice and is reconsidering the programme.

Ultimately it is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the courts to determine whether the practices of Astro TV, 'Dit is mijn toekomst' and similar media are misleading in that context.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te bepalen of de praktijken van Astro TV, «Dit is mijn toekomst» en soortgelijke media in dat kader misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Aartsen over het bericht dat John van den Heuvel wegens dreiging niet meer in de studio van RTL kan verschijnen

MPs Sneller and Aartsen asked why journalist John van den Heuvel could no longer appear in the RTL studio due to threats and how this squares with the agreement on protecting journalists. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the decision was a proportionate local security assessment by the Amsterdam triangle, that press freedom is not curtailed, and that the agreed journalist-protection measures are being implemented.
There is, however, no question of Mr Van den Heuvel being denied the right to speak or being advised against expressing himself (on television).
Er is echter geen sprake van dat dhr. van den Heuvel het woord wordt ontnomen of hem wordt afgeraden zich (op televisie) te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat 24 van de 100 journalistieke banen bij de KRO-NCRV verdwijnen

Sneller (D66) asked whether the minister had conditioned the 40 million euro compensation for NPO advertising shortfalls on not reversing earlier decisions, which would infringe broadcasters' journalistic independence. The minister denied any such condition, said the funds were made available to protect programming as far as possible, and stated he knows of no such condition.
Making these funds available may indeed not be a vehicle for imposing conditions that conflict with the independence of the public broadcaster.
Het beschikbaar stellen van deze middelen mag inderdaad geen vehikel zijn om voorwaarden te stellen die in strijd zijn met de onafhankelijkheid van de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de strengere gedragscode van de NPO niet wordt nageleefd

Sneller (D66) asked why public broadcasters have not yet published side-jobs of key journalistic staff, such as presenters, as required by the 2018 Governance Code, and what sanctions apply. Minister Slob confirmed the disclosure duty covers presenters, said the NPO and the CIPO oversight commission must enforce it, noted that a compliance review had just begun, and that the NPO board could withhold budget or the Commissariaat could fine for breaches.
It is up to the NPO and the Public Broadcasting Integrity Commission (CIPO) to point broadcasters to their obligations arising from the Governance Code.
Het is aan de NPO en de Commissie integriteit publieke omroep (CIPO) om omroepen te wijzen op hun verplichtingen die voorvloeien uit de Governancecode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Ronnes over het bericht dat financiële bijsluiters niet geschikt zijn voor consumenten

MPs Sneller and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about a University of Groningen study finding financial information documents (bijsluiters) hard for consumers to understand, and about whether the EU KID and WRR-recommended measures strengthen consumers' position against financial institutions. The minister acknowledged comprehension problems, described KID improvements, pointed to the provision ban, duty of care and product oversight, and said the EU evaluation has not yet started, promising to push for a swift evaluation.
I will work to push for a swift evaluation at European level and stress that the evaluation should consider the user-friendliness and effectiveness of the KID for consumer choices.

Ik zal mij inzetten om in Europees verband een snelle evaluatie te bepleiten en benadrukken dat in de evaluatie oog is voor de gebruiksvriendelijkheid en de effectiviteit van het KID voor consumentenkeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de bronbescherming van journalisten

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service has adequately safeguarded internal procedures protecting journalists' source protection after recent cases where a journalist's call was wiretapped. The Minister answered that the directive is being updated to match the new source protection law, training will be expanded, and no extra measures are currently considered necessary.
The new directive will be widely communicated within the OM, and the OM's training courses will devote even more attention to this subject.
De nieuwe aanwijzing zal binnen het OM breed worden uitgedragen en in de leergangen van het OM zal nog meer aandacht worden besteed aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de NPO gaat experimenteren met nasynchronisatie van buitenlandse series

MPs Sneller and Van Meenen asked the minister about the NPO's experiment with dubbing foreign series, including the effects on language learning. The minister answered that the public broadcaster is independent in programme matters, that the experiment is for audience research, and that he is not involved in its evaluation.
The experiment falls under the NPO's programme autonomy.
Het experiment behoort tot de programma-autonomie van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Westerveld, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘Zó ‘helpt’ de televisie kwetsbare tieners’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Basic and Secondary Education and Media about an article on a broadcaster's treatment of vulnerable teenagers in a TV programme, including what rules apply and whether NPO governance rules and the NPO ombudsman's remit should be tightened. The minister replied that media freedom and the Mediawet 2008 leave programme content to broadcasters without prior supervision, that BNNVARA's own code applies, and that he will consult the NPO and College van Omroepen on whether duty of care toward participants can be added to governance rules or the ombudsman's remit, reporting to parliament with the 2019 media budget letter.

I will consult with the NPO and the CvO on how careful treatment of programme participants can be part of the codes of conduct, for example through the governance code or the broadcasters' programme statutes, and whether the ombudsman can have a role.

Ik zal met de NPO en het CvO overleggen op welke manier zorgvuldige omgang met deelnemers aan programma's onderdeel kan zijn van de gedragsregels, bijvoorbeeld via de governancecode of de programmastatuten van de omroepen, en of de ombudsman een rol kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sneller over het bericht dat miljoenen te besparen valt op dure medicijnen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether doctors prescribe cheaper, equally effective biosimilars less often, whether this could save hundreds of millions a year, and what is being done to improve their reputation. The minister acknowledged rising biosimilar use, said the savings potential is uncertain, and pointed to a subsidised implementation programme and ongoing stakeholder engagement, without any structural change to oversight.
Prescribing biosimilars, however, is not a goal in itself.
Het voorschrijven van biosimilars is echter geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht 'Kabinet huurt tijdelijk regeringstoestel'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the government's temporary leased aircraft after a news report, questioning the ad-hoc availability and quality, the operator's security compliance, possible links to royal family use, and funding. The minister answered that KLM arranged a third party to operate a permanently available, suitably equipped aircraft, that the 6.7 million euro budget may be exceeded with details to follow in the Voorjaarsnota, and denied any link between lease costs and royal use.
As indicated in the earlier letter to your House, I will further inform your House about the additional costs and their coverage within the IenW budget at the Spring Memorandum.
Zoals aangegeven in de eerdere brief aan uw Kamer zal ik uw Kamer ten aanzien van de additionele kosten en de dekking daarvan binnen de begroting van IenW nader informeren bij de Voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over de continuïteit van DBFM(O)-projecten na faillissement van de private aanbieder

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister how DBFM(O) public-private projects stay continuous if a private contractor goes bankrupt, following the collapse of a large British construction firm. The minister answered that no Dutch DBFM(O) contractor has ever gone bankrupt, that continuity is secured through project company structures, contracts and direct agreements with financiers, and that the state is not responsible for projects of subnational governments.
The central government is not responsible for DBFM(O) at subnational governments because they are autonomous and responsible for their own projects, budgets and the choice of contract form.
Het Rijk is niet verantwoordelijk voor DBFM(O) bij medeoverheden omdat deze autonoom zijn en verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen projecten, budgetten en de afweging over de beste contractvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over dreigend geweld tegen journalisten

An MP asked the ministers how the government and prosecutors respond to threats against journalists, whether they support a special protection scheme like that for public-task workers, and whether they will meet the prosecution service and the NVJ on an action plan. The government says threats are unacceptable and that talks on journalist protection are ongoing in a steering group, but it considers a scheme like Veilige Publieke Taak hard to realise for journalists.
A protection comparable to the Veilige Publieke Taak programme is, however, difficult to realise.
Een vergelijkbare bescherming zoals het programma Veilige Publieke Taak is echter lastig te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller over de beïnvloeding door buitenlandse entiteiten van democratische verkiezingen

Three D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about foreign influence on elections via social media, including Russian political ads on Facebook, data protection against microtargeting, and advertiser transparency. The government replied by referring to a separate letter on covert influence of public opinion by state actors, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Verhoeven, Den Boer and Sneller (all D66), question number 2017Z15194, have been answered by means of the letter 'Covert influence on public opinion by state actors'.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over woonfraude

An SP MP asked the ministers about rental fraud in The Hague, including whether it should be added to the victimisation survey, separately registered by police, supported by the Fraudehelpdesk, and whether it strengthens the case for a national rental register. The ministers answered that the survey and registration questions will be explored in 2026, the Fraudehelpdesk already warns and supports victims, and a rental register is being examined with a consultation expected in early 2026.

I am currently examining the added value of a rental register, following various motions from the House, in which a rental register is seen as an instrument to bring private rental into view and better tackle fraudulent rental practices.

Ik onderzoek op dit moment de meerwaarde van een huurregister, dit n.a.v. van verschillende Kamermoties, waarin in een huurregister een instrument wordt gezien om particuliere verhuur in beeld te krijgen en frauduleuze verhuurpraktijken beter aan te kunnen pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff en Armut over de gezondheid van scholieren na één van de zwaarste aardbevingen in Groningen

MPs Beckerman, Bushoff and Armut asked the State Secretary for the Interior about a report on the effects of gas-extraction earthquakes on Groningen schoolchildren's health, the pace of reinforcement and damage repair, restoring trust in government, mental health support, youth participation, and long-term monitoring. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to the school reinforcement programme, the Social Agenda, the equalisation of immaterial damage compensation for children, participatory youth projects and longitudinal research, while committing to further information in January 2026.
That is why I consider projects such as 'Lang verhaal kort' by the IMG important.
Daarom vind ik projecten zoals « Lang verhaal kort » van het IMG belangrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Podt, Bromet, Eerdmans, Grinwis, Beckerman, Graus en Dassen over ‘het door de Kamer geëiste verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij, dat de minister nog altijd niet hee

MPs from eight parties asked the minister why the ban on electric shock equipment in livestock farming, which parliament demanded, is still unsigned and may not take effect on 1 January 2026. The minister replied that the final decision steps are ready, that an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period may allow 1 January 2026, and that the aim remains entry into force on that date.
Within the cabinet policy on fixed change moments, I see room to use an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period, so that entry into force on 1 January 2026 remains possible.

Binnen het kabinetsbeleid over de vaste verandermomenten zie ik ruimte om gebruik te maken van een uitzonderingsgrond op de vaste invoeringstermijn van twee maanden, waardoor inwerkingtreding op 1 januari 2026 een mogelijkheid blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de brief ‘Uitnodiging bewonersonderzoek’

An SP MP asks why the government sent a resident survey on a possible nuclear plant in Eemshaven despite strong opposition in Groningen, why Eemshaven was kept in the site study despite a motion to exclude Groningen, and how much the survey costs. The minister answers that Eemshaven must remain in the site assessment for legal reasons, that it has been removed as a safeguarding location for nuclear plants, that the survey costs €56,240 excluding VAT, and that the government will continue to engage with Groningen.
Eemshaven is removed as a safeguarding location for the establishment of nuclear power plants.
Eemshaven wordt geschrapt als waarborgingslocatie voor de vestiging van kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de immateriële schaderegeling tussen DeHaan en de NAM

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the State Secretary about the immaterial damage settlement between DeHaan and NAM and why IMG's own scheme scores poorly, asking whether it creates unfair differences and whether it will be revised. The State Secretary welcomed the settlement, said IMG's scheme was carefully designed and court-tested, expects a loss-of-living-enjoyment scheme around 2027, and declined to ask IMG to revise its scheme.
I will not ask the IMG to revise the scheme.
Ik ga het IMG niet vragen de regeling te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Huurder Elsbeth wordt wakker met piepende ademhaling: ‘De laatste jaren woon ik hier niet meer met plezier’

An SP MP asked the housing minister about Heimstaden's plan to sell 12,000 social rental homes after years of poor maintenance, and whether the government would force maintenance, ensure the homes return to a housing corporation, and act against speculative investors. The minister answered that landlords must follow maintenance rules, pointed to municipal enforcement and the Huurcommissie, declined to judge Heimstaden's conduct, and stated no preference for who owns the homes.
Municipalities, from their responsibility for the built environment, are authorised to enforce when relevant building regulations are not complied with.
Gemeenten zijn – vanuit hun verantwoordelijkheid voor de gebouwde omgeving – bevoegd om handhavend op te treden wanneer relevante bouwregelgeving- en voorschriften niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Wie ruzie krijgt met huisbaas Vesteda, moet stevig in zijn schoenen staan'

MP Beckerman asked the minister about Vesteda's eviction request to tenants in The Hague, its exclusion of the Vesteda Platform, and whether the Overlegwet is adequately enforced and protects tenant organisations. The minister answered that compliance is for the courts to judge, that Vesteda says it informed the tenant organisation, and that the Overlegwet will be evaluated and information improved, without committing to statutory changes now.
It is not for me to assess to what extent an individual case complies with the legislation. That is a matter for the court.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen in hoeverre een individuele casus in overeenstemming is met de wetgeving. Dit is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en De Hoop over de aanpassingen van de Wet betaalbare huur

Two opposition MPs asked why the government put out consultation on changes to the Affordable Rent Act during the summer holiday, despite a parliamentary majority motion against amending it, and questioned the rent and tenant-security effects of four proposals. The minister defended the timing and the proposals as targeted relief for landlords that keeps the rent protections in place, and said no alternatives or further delay were needed.

At the same time as sending this reply, I am starting the formal pre-consultation procedure for the draft decree, so that your House still has the opportunity to express its views on the desirability of the measures.

Gelijktijdig met verzending van deze beantwoording start ik de formele voorhangprocedure voor het ontwerpbesluit, waardoor ook uw Kamer nog de gelegenheid heeft zich over de wenselijkheid van de maatregelen uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over machtsvorming via overnames in de huisdierenbranche

An SP MP asked the ministers about market concentration through acquisitions in the pet sector, including harm to animal welfare and affordability, and whether the ACM should review such takeovers more strictly. The minister acknowledges concerns but defends case-by-case market supervision, announces plans to extend merger control to smaller acquisitions, declines a new study on pet-care prices and rejects price caps, while the ACM can only act on concrete signals.
That is why I am positive about the intention to update merger control so that smaller acquisitions that may have anti-competitive effects can also fall under ACM supervision.

Daarom sta ik positief tegenover het voornemen het concentratietoezicht te actualiseren, zodat ook kleinere overnames die mogelijk mededingingsbeperkende gevolgen kunnen hebben, voortaan onder het toezicht van ACM kunnen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over private equity-keten Evidensia, die jarenlang pensioengeld van werknemers in eigen zak stopte

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the government about private equity-owned vet chain Evidensia allegedly withholding employee pension contributions, poor employer conduct, unqualified staff, bonuses for referrals, and measures against private equity takeovers. The state secretary replied that the pension matter is between employer and employees outside DNB's supervision, that the government will await the ACM market study before deciding on price regulation, and that it is strengthening consumer information and profession-quality safeguards.
I have no insight into the precise circumstances at the company named in the article and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Op de precieze inhoud van de situaties bij de in het artikel genoemde bedrijf heb ik geen zicht en hier kan ik daarom geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'gerommel met stikstofcijfers voor de bouw bij Natura 2000 van vakantieparken'

An SP MP asks the state secretary about nitrogen calculations for the restructuring of the Sandevoerde holiday park near Natura 2000 Kennemerland-Zuid, including claims that deposition exceeds limits and that earlier calculations are invalid. The state secretary answers that the province of Noord-Holland, as competent authority, is assessing the permit and will review any counter-report in the objection procedure, and that the rules apply equally to all projects, deferring substantive judgement to the competent authority.
The competent authority, namely the province of Noord-Holland, is currently assessing the permit application.
Het bevoegd gezag, i.c. de provincie Noord-Holland, is momenteel bezig met de beoordeling van de vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Investeerder Blackstone

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the takeover of RCN holiday parks by private equity firm Blackstone threatens social missions, affordability and tax transparency, and whether rules such as a public-interest test should be introduced. The minister answered that no legal guarantees exist for social activities, that the competition authority ACM cleared the deal without weighing public values, that tax questions cannot be discussed, and that a study of a public-interest test will be reported by year end.
Governments, such as municipalities, provinces or the national government, are legally obliged to prepare decisions carefully and to take the relevant facts and interests into account.
Overheden, zoals gemeenten, provincies of het Rijk, zijn wettelijk verplicht om besluiten zorgvuldig voor te bereiden en daarbij de relevante feiten en belangen mee te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het niet coulant omgaan met bezwaren van gedupeerde Groningers

An SP MP asks why the NCG Groningen is not generous with objections filed after the appeal deadline, despite ministerial promises and adopted motions and amendments on the issue. The State Secretary replies that NCG is lenient on deadlines but assesses each late objection individually and may declare it inadmissible, pointing to the General Administrative Law Act and to other options such as reconsideration requests.
Being lenient does not, however, mean that every request actually leads to an objection that can be substantively considered.
Coulant betekent echter niet dat elk verzoek ook daadwerkelijk leidt tot een bezwaar dat inhoudelijk in behandeling kan worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'SodM vindt zoutwinning Zuidwending onveilig, maar Minister Hermans wil door met Nobian. 'Essentieel''

MP Beckerman asks the minister why he proceeds with the Nobian salt mining permit at Zuidwending despite SodM considering the cavern closure risks too high, and questions safety, precedent from Groningen, and public involvement. The minister replies that SodM, TNO and the Mijnraad consider continued mining safe, that closure risks are addressed through binding conditions requiring five years of further research, and that no nuclear waste site is currently designated; he refuses to suspend the permit but commits to further study and publication of risk analyses.
The cabinet did not choose to set aside SodM's advice, but has examined it carefully and involved it in the decision-making.
Het kabinet heeft er niet voor gekozen om het advies van SodM naast zich neer te leggen, maar heeft hier zorgvuldig naar gekeken en betrokken bij de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Beckerman over de sloop van de woonwijk Mrija voor 1000 Oekraïners in Vlaardingen

MPs De Nispen and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about plans to demolish the Mrija housing estate housing about 1,000 Ukrainians in Vlaardingen for a new wastewater treatment plant, questioning responsibility, the waste of recently built homes, and alternatives. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the wastewater plant is a Delfland water board responsibility, the municipality is responsible for follow-up choices, the Rijk supports relocation and subsidises housing business cases, and she invites the municipality to submit business cases to the NOO.
The Rijk has no direct involvement in carrying out that obligation.
Het Rijk heeft met de uitvoering van die verplichting geen directe betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Beckerman en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Uitvoering reorganisatie Aardwetenschappen halfjaar uitgesteld'

MPs Beckerman and Gabriëls asked whether the VU's planned reorganisation of its Earth sciences department, and the national budget cuts behind it, endanger national knowledge capacity, and asked the minister to intervene. The minister answered that the reorganisation stems from several factors besides cuts, that institutions are autonomous, and that he will not intervene or pause the decision-making, while noting the VU is consulting and commissioning an external study.
Institutions have autonomy over starting, stopping and shaping their teaching and research.
Instellingen hebben autonomie over het starten, stoppen en het vormgeven van hun onderwijs en onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten 'Grond schudt in Warffum door beving met kracht van 2.1: 'Dreun en trillingen door het hele huis'' en 'Hartenkreet van actievoerders om gaswinning Wa

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about a 2.1 earthquake in Warffum and protests against continued gas extraction from the small Warffum field, pointing to SodM's refusal to tolerate extraction and the province's and municipality's appeal. The Minister answers that extraction can proceed safely based on TNO, SodM and Mijnraad advice, that the seismic risk management plan was tightened with an earlier shutdown threshold, that a Council of State interim ruling allowed resumption, and that no meeting with residents is planned.
SodM did not reject the extraction plan. In its advice on the extraction plan, SodM stated that extraction can technically take place safely.
SodM heeft het winningsplan niet afgewezen. SodM heeft in het advies op het winningsplan aangegeven dat de winning technisch veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over het bericht 'Wanhoop groot in versterkingsgebied: fouten in zeker 213 versterkingsdossiers'

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked about a Pointer report finding errors in 213 reinforcement files in Groningen and the government's handling of building and report errors. The State Secretary says ACVG found no errors affecting safety verdicts in regular assessments, but commits to NCG re-checking all assessments, extra building supervision, a one-government approach and a aftercare desk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Leerlingen pesten elkaar met nepnaaktbeelden, middelbare scholen willen verbod op uitkleedapps'

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked about reports that pupils circulate AI-generated fake nude images of classmates and schools want a ban on nudify apps. The government says bullying is unacceptable, points to existing criminal law, school safety duties, support for School & Veiligheid and Helpwanted, and rejects a general ban as easily circumvented, while promising a cabinet response to the 'Online seksueel geweld' report after the summer.
A more general ban on offering the nudify apps does not, however, seem appropriate at this time.
Een algemener verbod op het aanbieden van de uitkleedapps ligt op dit moment echter niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over gedupeerde Groningers die nog wachten op compensatie voor de eigen gemaakte kosten bij de versterking

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked why Groningen residents who paid their own money for reinforcement works are still waiting for compensation or are being rejected, and whether the motion-Beckerman/Nijboer is being implemented properly. The State Secretary answers that a NCG reporting point is analysing claims with municipalities, that many rejections rest on the view that residents already received enough budget, that some older NAM/CVW settlements cannot be reopened except under the hardship clause, and that remedies for Batch 1588 rent-related exclusions are being explored with a report promised in autumn.
I will address the status of this investigation in more detail in my progress letter ahead of the committee debate on 2 July.
Ik zal in mijn voortgangsbrief voorafgaand aan het commissiedebat van 2 juli aanstaande nader ingaan op de stand van zaken van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Pijpelink en Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationaal Onderwijsmuseum in Dordrecht dreigt te verdwijnen vanwege geldgebrek'

MPs asked why the Minister is ending funding for the National Education Museum in Dordrecht, whether alternatives were explored, and whether the decision will be reconsidered. The Staatssecretaris replied that budget cuts forced choices favouring core education tasks, that alternatives would require a substantial subsidy increase deemed unavailable, that the collection belongs to the museum foundation, and that no reconsideration is planned.
I informed the Education Museum as early as possible to give it the chance to seek alternative funding or, if it sees no options, to achieve a careful wind-down.

Ik heb het Onderwijsmuseum zo vroeg mogelijk geïnformeerd om de kans te bieden op zoek te gaan naar alternatieve financiering of, als zij hier geen mogelijkheden voor zien, een zorgvuldige afbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opkoop van campings en recreatieparken waardoor recreanten moeten wijken

An SP MP asked the government about takeovers of campsites and recreation parks that force long-term residents to leave, including questions on tenant protection, environmental safeguards, Natura 2000 areas and an initiative note 'Red de Camping'. The minister answered that existing tenancy law and the Omgevingswet provide sufficient protection, rejected calls for halting takeovers, and promised a reply to the initiative note and a conversation with affected residents.
No. Recreants can invoke general tenancy law and this provides sufficient protection.
Nee. Recreanten kunnen zich beroepen op het algemeen huurrecht en dit biedt voldoende bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over de vertraging bij de versterking en problemen met de schadeafhandeling en de psychosociale problemen als gevolg daarvan

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff ask the State Secretary about delays in reinforcement and damage settlement in Groningen, the psychosocial harm this causes, and related concerns including construction defects, IMG procedures, NAM-era settlements and compensation. The State Secretary answers that the timeline is being managed through NCG plans and diepteanalyse, acknowledges longer processing times, points to existing and planned measures (Nij Begun, psychosocial funding, bewonersbegeleiders), and in many cases defers details or promises further information before summer.
I cannot go into the precise situation and the solution being worked on.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de precieze situatie en de oplossing waar aan wordt gewerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over “de aanhoudende problemen van gedupeerde Groningers met het kwijtraken van toeslagen of kwijtschelding en extra belastingheffingen als gevolg van de schadevergoe

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked why Groningen residents still lose benefits, allowances or remission and face extra tax after receiving damage compensation, and what steps will be taken. The government answers that fiscal consequences should be avoided, that IMG and NCG can compensate where unavoidable, that several measures and ongoing talks are underway, and that communication and some rules (e.g. Participatiewet exemptions) are being improved, while declining to answer in time for the debate.
As already indicated in the letter of 28 October 2024, we have also taken a number of measures to prevent fiscal consequences as much as possible.
Zoals al in de brief van 28 oktober 2024 aangegeven, 3 hebben wij hiernaast nog een aantal maatregelen getroffen om fiscale gevolgen zo veel mogelijk te voorkomen, waaronder:
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sloop van sociale huurwoningen in o.a. Meezenbroek en Versiliënbosch in Heerlen, de Pompenburgflat in Rotterdam en Prinsejagt in Woensel

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the housing minister about demolition of social rental homes in Heerlen, Rotterdam and Eindhoven, citing resident exclusion, heritage value, and carbon concerns, and asks why residents were poorly informed and whether tenants should have a veto like the 70% consent required for renovation. The minister answers that local parties hold primary responsibility, points to the Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut and the Huurders-Verhuurder overleg rules, declines to judge individual cases, and rejects a tenant veto over demolition while promising a study on demolition versus renovation due in 2025.
For far-reaching measures such as demolition, consultation with residents is required.
Bij ingrijpende maatregelen zoals sloop moet worden overlegd met de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Dakloos door zwarte lijsten van woningcorporaties’

MPs Beckerman and De Hoop asked the housing minister about black lists of tenants kept by housing corporations that leave people homeless, and whether the state is meeting its homelessness goals. The minister says corporations act only as a last resort, that black lists are regional and not monitored nationally, that tenants can challenge listings via the Data Protection Authority or the courts, and that homelessness is handled through gemeenten and existing shelter, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel ‘Volop trucs om huurregels te ontwijken, maar huurcommissie veegt 'shortstaycontract’ van tafel’, uit het FD van 25 februari jl
