An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that landlords use short-stay and friends contracts to circumvent the rent rules, and what the government will do about it. The minister says these contracts are restrictively applicable, that the rent-regulation framework was clarified, that no monitoring data exist, and that the short-stay issue will be covered in the evaluation of the new rental laws.
It is always undesirable when the law is circumvented.
Het is altijd onwenselijk als de wet wordt omzeild.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Westerveld over het beboeten van dakloze mensen

MPs Beckerman and Westerveld asked why municipalities still fine homeless people for sleeping rough, begging and camping, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary agrees fines worsen homelessness, says municipalities set these rules under their own powers, and says talks with the VNG about alternatives are ongoing.
Municipal councils have, however, under Article 147 of the Municipalities Act, the power to adopt bylaws that they consider necessary in the interest of the municipality.
Gemeenteraden hebben echter op grond van artikel 147 Gemeentewet de bevoegdheid om verordeningen vast te stellen, die zij in het belang van de gemeente nodig achten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van mijnschade in Limburg

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister for Climate and Green Growth why mining damage compensation in Limburg is delayed to late 2025, whether the presumption of causation will apply, and how the scheme is financed and organised. The minister answers that a temporary body will open the scheme at end-2025 in postcode tranches, that the Limburg commission will assess plausibility of damage, that a motion on the presumption for all mining is being addressed later, and that budget and organisation details will follow in June.
The cabinet will inform you shortly about how effect is given to the motion by the members Beckerman and Bushoff.
Het kabinet zal u op korte termijn informeren over hoe invulling wordt gegeven aan de motie van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten ‘Groningen schrikt wakker van aardbeving (2.2) bij Usquert: 'Het bed schudde'’, ‘Verzoek NAM om gas te winnen in Warffum afgewezen’ en ‘toezichthoude

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about an earthquake near Usquert, the controversial extension of gas extraction at Warffum, and reports that the SodM supervisor had changed its advice. The government answered that the Warffum decision was taken after advice from TNO, SodM and the Mijnraad, that no new SodM advice exists, and that SodM's refusal to tolerate continued extraction was its own competence.
These advisers indicate that the extraction can take place safely.
Deze adviseurs geven aan dat de winning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beschikbaarheid van essentiële data met betrekking tot aardbevingen in Groningen

An SP MP asked whether KNMI data on Groningen earthquakes (catalogue, PGA/PGV values) had become outdated or harder to access after the seismic chain migrated to AWS, and how this affects residents and lawyers. The minister denied any reduction in availability, stated the data remain updated and accessible via KNMI platforms, pointed to the IMG taking new scientific insights into account, and committed to continued stakeholder consultation.
All data and products are unchanged available on AWS, in a renewed and more maintainable system that contributes to robust 24/7 availability.
Alle data en producten zijn op AWS onverminderd beschikbaar, in een vernieuwd en beter te onderhouden systeem dat bijdraagt aan een robuuste 24/7-beschikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over de versterkingsrapporten die gedupeerde Groningers krijgen

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked the State Secretary about reports of serious errors in Groningen earthquake reinforcement assessments and whether residents can trust that homes judged safe are safe, and asked about follow-up on SodM findings, the Van Geel report, and an amendment on appeal rights and legal aid. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to a two-track approach (NCG resident dialogue and independent ACVG research into the quality of assessments), declined to say whether homes were wrongly labelled safe pending that research, and described steps on legal aid and the amendment's implementation.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the independent investigation before answering that.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onafhankelijke onderzoek daarvoor af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over het uitsluiten triple glas en kozijnen bij isolatiesubsidie 'maatregel 29’ van Nij Begun

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why triple glazing and window frames were excluded from the Groningen insulation subsidy (maatregel 29) and why this fits earlier promises of full subsidy. The minister answers that these measures are not necessary to reach the insulation standard, grants 50% or 100% retroactive coulance for those who already invested, and offers 30% under ISDE for new applications.
We have listened carefully to the responses to the internet consultation and have adjusted and supplemented the scheme on this point.
Wij hebben goed geluisterd naar de reacties op de internetconsultatie en de regeling op dit punt aangepast en aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Beckerman over het ontbreken van huurdersbelangen bij de Woontop

MPs De Hoop and Beckerman asked why the Woonbond did not sign the Woontop housing agreements, what the government did to keep it on board, and about rent increases, financing gaps and the impact on tenants. The minister regrets the Woonbond's refusal, describes efforts to reach agreement, defends the 4.5% social rent-increase cap and the 7.7% middle-segment cap as political trade-offs, and says the financing gaps are manageable with regional solidarity and municipal co-financing.
I will work with the parties to see how these uncertainties can be made smaller and/or controlled.
Ik ga samen met de partijen kijken hoe die onzekerheden kleiner en/of beheerst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Criminelen vroegen studiefinanciering aan op naam van Helmondse vrouw: rechter geeft minister veeg uit de pan’

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked how the ministry and DUO respond to a court finding that inadequate checks let student finance be fraudulently claimed in a victim's name, and about compensation, DigiD safeguards and legal access. The minister acknowledged a 2018 control gap that has been fixed, said the debt of the victim will be written off and DUO will try to recover from perpetrators, and committed to reviewing the court's ruling on advance payments without a legal basis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Dijk over de artikelen 'Er zijn genoeg leraren, maar ze staan niet voor de klas', 'The hidden reserve of nurses and teachers in the Netherlands' en 'Increasing the working hou

MPs Beckerman and Dijk (SP) asked why the hidden reserve of qualified teachers and nurses exceeds current shortages and what measures the government will take to activate it, including flexible working hours and reducing workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that taking up work is an individual choice, that the government pursues broader labour market policy (salaries, workload funding, a teacher campaign, admin reduction in care), and that several measures such as strategic personnel policy and a Monitor Zeggenschap are underway, but did not commit to a specific plan for the reserve.
Directly approaching or writing to the hidden reserve is technically not possible under the GDPR.
Het direct benaderen en/of aanschrijven van de stille reserve is AVG technisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘gerommel’ met versterkingsrapporten van onveilige huizen in Groningen

An SP MP asks the state secretary about a Groningen resident's reinforcement report that wrongly recommended reinforcing a non-existent chimney, and about quality control of reinforcement reports, the residents' right to their own expert, and the Raad van State ruling on NCG's duty to verify. The state secretary admits the error, says the engineering firm corrected the draft but the chimney error went unnoticed, announces a quality study and more residents' contact moments, and says the NCG's verification duty is still before the court.
I will consult with ACVG and NCG on how we can check the quality of the assessment reports and which party can carry this out.
Ik zal met ACVG en NCG in overleg gaan hoe we de kwaliteit van de beoordelingsrapporten kunnen gaan controleren en welke partij dit kan gaan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de hoge dierenartskosten en de macht van (private equity) ketens

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Agriculture about rising veterinary costs and private equity chain dominance after a clinic closure, and whether the government would act via research, legislation and competition oversight. The State Secretary replied that a study on veterinary tariffs is underway and will be shared shortly, and that the competition-law part of the motion falls under the Economic Affairs minister, who will report in spring 2025.

I expect to be able to send you this study, including my response to the results, the external analysis of foreign countries and my exploration of possible government measures, in the very short term.

Ik verwacht dat ik u dit onderzoek, inclusief mijn reactie op de resultaten, de externe analyse naar het buitenland en mijn verkenning naar mogelijke maatregelen vanuit de overheid, op zeer korte termijn kan doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Beckerman/Nijboer (Kamerstuk 33 529, nr. 1154)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about implementing the motion requiring full compensation for Groningen residents who paid their own money for reinforcement work, including rejections, delays and Batch 1588 cases. The State Secretary reported 214 reports to the NCG reporting point, most still pending or rejected, promised further review and a letter before summer, and said compensation for residents already settled with NAM is being explored.
I will inform the House before the summer about the outcomes of this exploration.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer over de uitkomsten van deze verkenning.
Beantwoording op vragen van de leden Kröger c.s. over het gaswinningsproject bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, PvdD and D66 asked why the government will not share TNO and Mijnraad advice, the official appraisal of those advice, the Wnb permit, and why not all relevant documents were published under Awb 3:11 and the Aarhus Convention, plus questions on Waddenzee World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value. The minister refused to publish the advice before the decision, citing negotiating position with NAM and protection of a careful decision-making process, offering only confidential inspection by the Kamer, and asserted procedures were correctly followed.
Once the decision-making is complete, the cabinet will of course make the advice public and inform the Kamer about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming is afgerond zal het kabinet de adviezen uiteraard openbaar maken en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Beckerman, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over gaswinning bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, D66 and PvdD asked whether the gas extraction permit at Ternaard was properly re-tested in light of SodM advice, Waddenacademie and UNESCO warnings, MER commission input and undisclosed advice, and whether all studies would be shared. The minister replied that the permit was granted in February 2024 under the Nature Protection Act, that the relevant advice gave no reason to revoke or amend it, that the Landsadvocaat advised UNESCO's position falls outside the legal test, and that the government would share some advice confidentially and publish others after final decision-making.

In line with my commitment in the debate of 11 December, I am willing to make the advice of TNO, SodM and Mijnraad available confidentially for inspection, so that committee members can read the content of this advice.

Conform mijn toezegging in het debat van 11 december, ben ik bereid de adviezen van TNO, SodM en Mijnraad vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen, zodat de commissieleden van de inhoud van deze adviezen kennis kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the government about ExxonMobil's new arbitration claim against the Dutch state over the Groningen gas field closure, including whether talks with Shell and ExxonMobil would continue, whether the companies should pay for Groningen damage and the ereschuld, and whether levies on NAM could be widened. The minister answered that talks are under review and will not resume without prior notice to parliament, that the arbitration does not affect damage settlement, that levies on NAM are constrained by the constitution and ECHR, and that the answers were delayed.
The talks will not be resumed without informing the House in advance.
De gesprekken zullen niet hervat worden zonder de Kamer hierover vooraf te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Kennisgeving besluit omgevingsvergunning waterinjectie Schoonebeek-447' en 'Kennisgeving besluitwinningsplan Schoonebeek-Gas'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the safety of wastewater injection and oil/gas extraction at Schoonebeek, monitoring, implementing the parliamentary motion on the statutory presumption of damage for all mining activities, groundwater and water-system effects, public participation, and Dutch oil demand. The minister answered that SodM can halt injection if unsafe, that monitoring is being expanded, that the motion's application is being referred to the Raad van State for advice, that water-supply risks fall to other authorities, and that domestic oil production remains justified.
The cabinet understands the concerns residents have, such as around Schoonebeek, about possible damage from mining and how it is handled.
Het kabinet begrijpt de zorgen die er bij bewoners zijn, zoals rond Schoonebeek, over mogelijke schades door mijnbouw en de afhandeling daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de problemen van huurders in het mijnbouwschadegebied

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about tenants in the Groningen earthquake-damaged area living in mouldy, unhealthy homes awaiting reinforcement or demolition, rent increases after rebuilding, inadequate relocation compensation, and the failure to implement a motion on Marenland tenants and an independent complaints desk. The State Secretary answered that housing corporations are responsible for repairs and rent decisions, that tenants should not bear costs of reinforcement, that talks with corporations and the NCG are underway, and that the complaints desk is still being explored.
I believe tenants should not suffer any disadvantage from the reinforcement, such as being unable to bear the housing costs.
Ik vind dat huurders geen nadeel mogen ondervinden van de versterking, zoals het niet kunnen dragen van de woonlasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht «Mbo-instelling verbiedt telefoongebruik in de klas»

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether a Dutch vocational college's ban on phones in class is supported, whether national rules, support or research on phone-free lessons are planned. The minister welcomed the initiative but declined national rules, research or dedicated support, leaving the matter to institutions and pointing to the lumpsum budget.
I am not considering introducing a national guideline for all vocational education institutions.
Ik overweeg niet om een landelijke richtlijn voor alle mbo-instellingen in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

MPs Van Kent and Beckerman asked about Transavia trainees deployed as regular staff in 2023 and what the government would do about it. The minister says trainees must not replace regular workers, that the Labour Inspectorate fined the airline and withdrew its preventive shutdown warning after adequate changes, and points to complaint routes but declines to rule on individual cases.
However, it is not for the cabinet to make statements about this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om hier in individuele gevallen uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Groningers die door immateriële schadevergoeding buitengesloten worden voor kwijtschelding van waterschaps- en gemeentebelasting

An SP MP asked whether Groningen residents receiving immaterial damages from the IMG are excluded from waterschap and municipal tax relief because the payment counts as wealth, and what is being done about it. The government confirms the payment counts as wealth, says municipalities and water boards can waive collection and are cooperative in practice, points residents to the Noordelijk Belastingkantoor, and says the energy allowance system cannot be copied.

Although this touches on the autonomy of municipalities and water boards, which I cannot intervene in, contacts with the municipalities and water board concerned have shown that they apply this option benevolently in the case of damages paid by the IMG and NCG.

Hoewel dit raakt aan de autonomie van gemeenten en waterschappen waar ik niet in kan treden, is uit contacten met de desbetreffende gemeenten en het desbetreffende waterschap gebleken dat ze deze mogelijkheid in het geval van schadevergoeding door het IMG en de NCG welwillend toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Groningers die door een ZAV-vergoeding uitgesloten worden voor toeslagen

An SP MP asked why the ZAV compensation for Groningen earthquake damage is not exempt from the asset test for benefits such as rent and childcare allowances, and how to prevent recipients losing entitlements. The government answered that the ZAV payment is not an exempt asset, that three rent-allowance and one child-benefit claims were compensated by the NCG and IMG, and that information and support are offered to affected residents.
Affected Groningen residents are not disadvantaged in applying for allowances because of receiving the ZAV payment.
Gedupeerde Groningers worden niet achtergesteld met het aanvragen van toeslagen door het ontvangen van de ZAV-vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘Gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten: zij voelen zich bespied, wat was er aan de hand?’

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Education about reports that Radboud University security staff monitored a pro-Palestinian student meeting, and whether such preventive security, including plainclothes officers, is appropriate and how academic freedom is protected. The Minister answered that universities are responsible for their own security policy and that he lacks knowledge of individual situations, pointed to the academic freedom provisions in the WHW and to complaint routes, and committed only to continued dialogue with student groups.
As Minister I have no knowledge of all security situations that occur at the institutions.
Als Minister heb ik geen kennis van alle situaties op het gebied van veiligheid die zich op de instellingen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sloop van sociale huurwoningen in Roofvogelwijk (Spoorlaan, Landweerstraat-Noord, Sperwerstraat, Wouwstraat en Vijversingel) te Oss

An SP MP asks the housing minister about BrabantWonen's plan to demolish social rental homes in the Roofvogelbuurt in Oss, after residents were told of renovation, and whether this breaches consultation law, the minister's view on resident participation, and the Ombudsman's recommendations. The minister says the tenant-landlord consultation law leaves this to the Huurcommissie or civil courts, points to the new national demolition and renovation statute for earlier participation, and declines to intervene locally, leaving the decision to the corporation and Oss.
It is not for me to judge in an individual case whether there is a breach of the Tenant-Landlord Consultation Act.
Het is niet aan mij om in een individueel geval te oordelen of er sprake is van schending van de Wet op het overleg huurders en verhuurder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘GBB en Warffum-Alert trekken aan de bel in brief aan minister Sophie Hermans’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how she weighs local concerns from Warffum and the GBB about extending gas extraction from the Warffum field after 2024, including subsidence, earthquake risk, and calls to end small-field extraction equally. The minister answered that the NAM extension request is still under assessment with advice from SodM, TNO and others, that she cannot prejudge the outcome or stop extraction without statutory grounds, and that a decision is expected by end of year with a draft decision open to public objection.
Currently the NAM request for extension of the gas extraction period is being assessed.
Momenteel wordt de aanvraag van NAM voor verlenging van de periode van gaswinning beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Een munitiedepot middenin bevingsgebied, dat is onmenselijk'

An MP (Beckerman, SP) asks the government about the plan to site a military ammunition depot in earthquake-affected Groningen, citing the health and social harm to residents and the lack of prior communication about candidate locations. The State Secretary replies that the government recognises its debt to Groningen and that social context and local support will weigh in the choice, but declines to drop candidate sites, pointing to the planMER process and promising to share results and consult the region.
The outcomes of the research will be shared with your House and with residents.
De uitkomsten van het onderzoek zullen met uw Kamer en inwoners worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Meerderheid Amsterdammers tegen verkoop van Afval Energie Bedrijf, wethouder noemt runnen afvalverwerking ‘geen kerntaak’'

An SP MP asked ministers about the City of Amsterdam's planned sale of the waste-processing company AEB, public opposition to it, guarantees for public interests, and whether the national government would take a majority stake. The government answered that the municipality handles the sale and has secured public interests through contract conditions, that the national government sees no reason to take a majority stake, and that it will take no steps on the matter.
The national government sees no reason to take a majority stake in AEB.
Het Rijk ziet geen aanleiding om een meerderheidsaandeel te nemen in AEB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Beckerman, Pijpelink en Ergin over het delen van alternatieve opties voor het uitstellen van de curriculumherziening

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Education to share a scenario exploration document on revising the core objectives (kerndoelen) before a committee debate on the curriculum reform. The State Secretary refused, citing the convention that documents prepared for cabinet and sub-committee deliberations are not made public to protect cabinet unity.
In line with cabinet-wide disclosure policy, documents prepared for the Council of Ministers and its sub-committees are in principle not made public in order to safeguard the unity of cabinet policy.

In lijn met het kabinetsbrede beleid rondom openbaarmaking worden stukken ter voorbereiding van de ministerraad en onderraden in principe niet openbaar gemaakt om de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen: kans op sinkholes bij afsluiten zoutcavernes Oost-Groningen. 'Klinkt als een echo van het aardbevingsdossier'’

An SP MP asked the minister about SodM's warnings that closing very large salt caverns in Groningen may not be safe, and about risks of instability, sinkholes, compensation and possible reconsideration of salt mining. The minister confirmed the concerns, said a SodM advice on Nobian's new winning plan and closure research is still pending, promised closure only if safe, and pointed to monitoring, existing compensation arrangements and a possible further study.
That advice does not yet exist. I therefore cannot anticipate the results.
Dit advies is er nog niet. Ik kan dan ook niet op de resultaten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht «Ook in Breda en Zwolle betalen studenten nu 30 procent meer voor een kamer»

An SP MP asked the housing minister how to lower student room rents, protect students from malicious landlords, and reconsider the exemption of students from the ban on temporary leases. The minister answered that the Affordable Rent Act now caps rents, the Good Landlordship Act gives municipalities enforcement tools, the temporary-lease exemption is retained, and new funding and a student housing plan aim to add affordable units.
The cabinet maintains the policy of exempting students from the Fixed-Term Rental Contracts Act.
Het kabinet handhaaft het beleid om studenten uit te zonderen van de Wet vaste huurcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het verwijderen van brievenbussen door PostNL

MPs Dijk and Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why PostNL may remove letterboxes, especially outside cities, and how it protects elderly and offline residents, whether it still meets legal distance rules, and whether postal service should be market-based. The minister answered that PostNL may remove boxes within legal distance limits (1 km or 2.5 km), that it must consult consumer and local bodies and respond in writing, that ACM supervises compliance, and that a policy review on postal service improvement is under way.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises this as the regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt hier als toezichthouder toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het op 18 juli 2024 in NRC gepubliceerde bericht ‘Commerciële dierenartsketens zetten onderzoek naar hoge rekeningen naar hun hand’

MP Beckerman asks why the ministry involved commercial veterinary chains in consultations on a study into vet fees, why no report of the stakeholder meeting exists, and how independence and access to care are ensured. The minister says stakeholders were only consulted on draft research questions, the study is independent, and the final results are expected this autumn.
There is therefore no question of influence over the research, only involvement.
Er is dan ook geen sprake van invloed op het onderzoek, wel betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toenemend aantal acuut onveilige situaties (AOS) in Groningen

An SP MP asked why acute unsafe situations (AOS) in Groningen rose, how quickly residents are helped, and how IMG and NCG cooperate. The government says the rise in valid reports is within a stable multi-year range, that inspections happen within 48 hours, that temporary measures are taken but structural fixes can take long, and that no faster process is currently foreseen.
In answering parliamentary questions, however, I cannot go into the personal situations of residents.
In de beantwoording van Kamervragen kan ik echter niet ingaan op persoonlijke situaties van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht “Zonnepanelen minder lucratief maar leveren nog altijd 17 jaar gratis stroom”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a 2024 report that solar panel owners face rising costs such as feed-in charges under ACM model contracts, and about the reasonableness of large fixed-fee increases. The minister answered that the ACM will review model contract terms, will examine whether feed-in charges may be introduced, and has found the examined tariffs of four suppliers reasonable, while confirming that further ACM scrutiny is planned.
However, on 15 August 2024 the ACM announced that it will revise the terms of the model contract, partly due to the adjustments required by the Energy Act bill.
Wel heeft de ACM op 15 augustus 2024 bekendgemaakt dat zij de voorwaarden van het modelcontract zal herzien, mede door de aanpassingen die benodigd zijn vanuit het wetsvoorstel Energiewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de vertraging in de versterking, problemen bij de schadeafhandeling en de ongelijkheid in Groningen en Noord-Drenthe

An MP asks the State Secretary about delays in reinforcing homes in Groningen, problems in damage settlement by IMG and NCG, inequality between residents, and the non-use of a presumption of proof for all mining. The State Secretary answers that the timeline is under review, that a diepteanalyse on the 2028 deadline will be shared after summer, that some measures will be reconsidered, and that the government cannot direct NCG the same way it can IMG but can give NCG instructions where needed.
I will send the outcomes of that study to your House after the summer.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek na de zomer aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Maandenlang geen chauffeurs voorleerlingenvervoer: 'Kinderen staan op straat''

An SP MP asked the minister about news reports that around 600 pupils in the Utrecht region could not be transported to school after the summer due to a shortage of drivers, and about contingency measures and responsibilities. The state secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, that they are arranging alternative transport and parental compensation, and that the sector-wide driver shortage is being addressed through a broader improvement agenda.
First and foremost, it is up to the Utrecht region to get pupil transport in order together.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de regio Utrecht om samen het leerlingenvervoer op orde te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen minder lucratief, ‘maar leveren nog altijd 17 jaar gratis stroom’’

An MP asked the energy minister about energy suppliers charging solar owners for feeding electricity back to the grid, and about consumer information, batteries and tenants of housing corporations. The minister answered that the costs are cost-based and not prohibited, that the ACM found tariffs not unreasonable, that the matter is for the regulator and suppliers, and that the terugleverkosten effects on tenants will be studied.
It is up to the ACM as an independent regulator to take steps if it considers this necessary.
Het is aan de ACM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om stappen te ondernemen indien zij dit noodzakelijk acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Beckerman en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Sterke stijging aantal zaken over servicekosten, bezwaar vaak succesvol’

MPs Beckerman and Grinwis asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tenants win most service-cost and defect disputes, especially against private landlords, and what is being done about landlords who push the limits of service charges. The Minister says the rules on service charges are being tightened through a bill (limited list of cost categories, lower thresholds for collective claims), that municipalities can now enforce against misuse under the Good Landlordship Act, and that the bill is expected after the summer; on several points, such as refusing optional services and the 6.4 billion euro repayment reports, the answer is limited or refers back to existing law.
The Huurcommissie currently does not track which defects occur most often.
Door de Huurcommissie wordt op dit moment niet bijgehouden welke gebreken het meest voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vernielen van een unieke archeologische vindplaats in de gemeente Emmen

MP Beckerman asks about the destruction of a unique archaeological site in Emmen for a distribution centre, the failure of the municipality and the weak oversight of municipal archaeology duties. The State Secretary acknowledges the municipality made mistakes, describes the RCE's unsuccessful efforts and the start of provincial interbestuurlijk toezicht, and mostly points to existing structures and the Erfgoed & Overheid programme without committing to new legal powers.
It is up to the provinces, through interbestuurlijk toezicht, to ensure that municipalities carry out their archaeology duties properly, in whatever form.
Het is aan de provincies om er – via het interbestuurlijk toezicht – op toe te zien dat gemeenten hun taken op het gebied van archeologie goed uitvoeren, in welke vorm dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het sluiten van de nachtspoedhulp van het Evidensia dierenziekenhuis in Den Haag

An SP MP asks the agriculture minister about Evidensia closing its overnight emergency animal clinic in The Hague, sending owners to Amsterdam and Barendrecht, and whether this shows private chains' power over animal care. The minister says emergency care organisation is for the profession, a regional meeting is planned, a plan is due before summer, and price and chain-power research results are expected in autumn.
It is up to the profession how care, including emergency care, is organised and kept accessible.
Het is aan de beroepsgroep hoe zorg, waaronder de spoedhulp, ingericht wordt en toegankelijk blijft.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Beckerman over bericht dat energieleveranciers klanten misleiden met ‘CO2-gecompenseerd gas’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether reports that energy suppliers mislead customers with CO2-compensated gas are accurate, whether compensation projects underdeliver, whether cheap or non-additional projects and vague terms should be banned, and whether CO2 certificates work at all. The Minister answered that the ACM enforces against misleading claims, that a new EU directive from mid-2026 will prohibit neutrality claims based on offsetting, and that a ban on purchasing offsets from projects outside the EU is not planned for now.
It is not for me as Minister to comment on a specific case that was before the Advertising Code Committee.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om op een specifieke zaak die voorlag bij de Reclame Code Commissie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Groter brandgevaar bij flexwoningen en verduurzaming, vrees voor dodelijke slachtoffers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report on fire risks in flexible housing (flexwoningen) and façade/roof fires, including who is liable for damage and whether the building rules are adequate. The minister said the NIPV report concerns façade and roof fires for all buildings, not flexwoningen specifically, announced a dialogue with the sector and updated guidance, and rejected pausing flexwoningen or changing the permit regime.
There is no national database of fires. I therefore cannot provide an overview of the number of fires in different types of housing.
Er bestaat geen landelijke database van branden. Ik kan daarom geen overzicht geven van het aantal branden in verschillende typen woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het uitsluiten van bewoners van Annerveenschekanaal voor de waardedalingsregeling

An SP MP asked why residents of Annerveenschekanaal are excluded from the value-decline compensation scheme for Groningen earthquake damage while neighbouring villages qualify, and why expert analyses of postcode-level discrepancies and risk-area boundaries were not acted on. The State Secretary answered that the independent advisory committee reviewed the case twice and found no objective ground for an exception, that the methodology was validated, and that the area received a €10,000 housing improvement subsidy instead.
That is why in September 2023, after the meeting with residents you refer to, I asked the IMG to have the Advisory Committee on Value Decline reconsider this.
Daarom heb ik in september 2023, na het gesprek met bewoners waar u naar verwijst, het IMG verzocht de adviescommissie Waardedaling te vragen om dit nogmaals te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over compensatie van gedupeerden die eigen geld hebben moeten inleggen voor de versterking of sloop-nieuwbouw van hun woning

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked about residents who paid their own money for Groningen house reinforcement or demolition-rebuilding and are still waiting for compensation, including the NCG complaint point, numbers, timing, payment method and confusion between NCG and municipalities. The Secretary of State answers that 186 reports totaling over eleven million euros have been received, individual assessment of first reports is done, Batch 1588 cases take longer, and the NCG will handle them with municipalities.
I have asked the NCG to take on the handling of these reports jointly with the municipalities.
Ik heb de NCG gevraagd gezamenlijk met de gemeenten de uitvoering van deze meldingen ter hand te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de ongelijkheid voor bewoners van de Stadsweg in Ten Boer

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why residents of the Stadsweg in Ten Boer are treated unequally in reinforcement and insulation compared to neighbours, and whether the government will fix this. The State Secretary says a full insulation subsidy up to 40,000 euro with retroactive effect applies, that the municipality and NCG will address remaining differences via area-based planning, and that no parties are blocking a solution.
I will inform your House soon in more detail about the progress on this motion.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort nader informeren over de voortgang op deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de plotselinge sloopaankondiging van 46 woningen in Boskoop

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the sudden demolition announcement for 46 social rental homes in Boskoop by Woonforte, covering foundation failures, resident support, relocation, and prevention policy. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570) rather than answering the questions directly.

A further answer: the written questions of MP Beckerman on the sudden demolition announcement for 46 homes in Boskoop (submitted 12 March 2024) have been answered by means of the letter on the National Demolition and Renovation Statute.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over de plotselinge sloopaankondiging van 46 woningen in Boskoop (ingezonden op 12 maart 2024) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about many demolition projects, including Berghem, Oss, Den Bosch, Winschoten and Rotterdam, questioning whether renovation was considered, tenants' participation and rights, and the role of municipalities and social rental stock. The Minister's answer refers the reader to a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570) rather than answering the questions substantively.

Further answer: The written questions from MP Beckerman about various demolition projects (submitted 6 November 2023) have been answered by means of the letter National demolition and renovation statute (Kamerstuk 29 453, no. 570).

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten (ingezonden op 6 november 2023) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut (Kamerstuk 29 453, nr. 570 )
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the planned demolition of affordable post-war social housing in the Osse Vogelwijk, the loss of community, renovation as a more sustainable option, and alleged discrimination between tenants in different parts of the neighbourhood. The document is a short note stating that the questions were answered in a separate letter on the national demolition and renovation statute, without the substance being reproduced here.
The written questions from MP Beckerman on various demolition projects (submitted 13 November 2023) have been answered by letter on the national demolition and renovation statute.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Beckerman over verschillende sloopprojecten (ingezonden op 13 november 2023) zijn beantwoord middels brief Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat ‘buitenlandse beleggers een flat in Den Bosch laten verslonzen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign investors neglecting maintenance of a Den Bosch flat, and the planned sale of social rental homes, were acceptable and what would protect tenants. The minister acknowledged the neglect, pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap, planned extension of Huurcommissie access to middle-segment tenants, and municipal enforcement, while calling resale to starters acceptable and leaving corporation purchases to local decision-making.
That is why I intend, with the affordable rent bill, to extend tenants' options to request a rent reduction from the Huurcommissie in case of defects to the middle rental segment.

Daarom ben ik voornemens om met het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur de mogelijkheden voor huurders om – in geval van gebreken – bij de Huurcommissie een huurverlaging te vragen, uit te breiden naar het middenhuursegment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationale ombudsman vindt aanvraagprocedure Noodfonds Energie oneerlijk'

An SP MP asked the ministers about the National Ombudsman's criticism that the digital application procedure for the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was unfair, excluding people without DigiD, guardianship cases and those with block connections. The minister defended the fund's targeting and accessibility support, said the fund is now closed, and offered no new fund or rule changes beyond promises to consult energy suppliers on future support.
The Emergency Fund is a private initiative that, within the limits of implementation possibilities and budget, reached as large a share of this target group as possible.
Daarnaast is het Noodfonds een privaat initiatief dat binnen de kaders van de uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en het uitvoeringsbudget een zo groot mogelijk aandeel van deze doelgroep heeft bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten de nieuwe norm voor grotere schoolpleinen niet meenemen in beleid

SP MPs asked whether the government will act on reports that municipalities are not applying the new norm for larger school playgrounds in their policy, and whether they will discuss this with the VNG and school associations or fund larger playgrounds. The minister replied that the norm is a non-binding guideline, that space trade-offs are a municipal responsibility, that the government will discuss it with the VNG and school associations, and that municipal funds are freely spendable.
It is possible that municipalities sometimes get into difficulty in this area and have to make choices.
Het is mogelijk dat gemeenten soms in de knel komen op dit vlak en keuzes moeten maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Borselse Voorwaarden

An MP asked about Borsele municipal conditions for new nuclear plants, including a 2050 final repository and zoning of salt caverns, and the timing of the 2130 repository policy. The state secretary answered that the conditions will be negotiated with the province and municipality without guarantees, that the 2130 policy remains, and that the NPRA update with an environmental assessment and public participation will follow later.
Current policy on radioactive waste concerns putting a geological final repository into operation in 2130.
Het huidige beleid ten aanzien van radioactief afval ziet op het in bedrijf nemen van een geologische eindberging in 2130.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en De Hoop over de uitspraak van de kantonrechter in Amsterdam om enkel glas als gebrek te erkennen

MPs Beckerman and De Hoop asked the Minister of Interior about a Amsterdam cantonal court ruling recognising single glazing as a defect, and whether the minister's letter was misused and whether a national deadline for phasing out single glazing should be set. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with appeal pending, that policy on integral sustainability renovation remains, that tenants should not be forced to litigate, and that existing housing-corporation performance agreements and 2029 label requirements will be pursued without extra funding.
The court ruling concerns one case; given the specific aspects, it cannot be said that this requires reconsidering the general policy.
De uitspraak van de rechter heeft betrekking op 1 zaak; gegeven de specifieke aspecten kan niet worden gesteld dat die heroverweging nodig maakt van het algemene beleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Teunissen en Beckerman over belastingontwijking door bedrijven zoals Chemours

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Chemours, including whether its low corporate tax payments reflect transfer pricing and whether the Tax Authority supervises it. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, explained loss offset and arm's-length transfer pricing in general terms, and set out measures against tax avoidance and conduit companies.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van Shell en ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the state secretary about the arbitration launched by Shell and ExxonMobil against the Dutch state, whether it could slow Groningen damage settlement and reinforcement, the costs of billing the companies, and whether other means exist to make them pay. The government answered that the arbitration does not affect damage handling or reinforcement, that the NAM has paid all damage invoices but about half of the reinforcement bill remains unpaid, and that it is still studying the arbitration's effect on talks and the options for a broader levy, to return to parliament soon.
I can assure you that the discussions between the NAM or Shell and ExxonMobil about the costs have no effect whatsoever on the implementation of the damage settlement and reinforcement operation.
Ik kan u verzekeren dat de discussies tussen de NAM of Shell en ExxonMobil over de kosten geen enkel effect hebben op de uitvoering van de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de acuut onveilige situatie van de Vlamovenflat in Delfzijl

An MP asked the State Secretary about the acutely unsafe Vlamoven flat in Delfzijl, where bricks are falling and residents feel unheard, and about damage claims, timelines, and support for residents. The State Secretary answered that IMG has secured the building with fencing, that the structure meets the earthquake safety norm, that the damage claim is prioritised but no timeline can yet be given, and that residents can seek support or contact the Huurcommissie.
IMG cannot yet make any statements about the exact processing time of the damage claim.
Het IMG kan op dit moment nog geen uitspraken doen over de precieze doorlooptijd van de schademelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de impact van lozingen op het IJsselmeer

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports that toxic discharges into the IJsselmeer endanger drinking water, including indirect industrial discharges via sewers, weak permit and enforcement control, and the Grip op indirecte lozingen pilot. The minister replied that water quality has generally improved, that a broader review of the VTH permitting, supervision and enforcement system with water boards is planned, and that a pilot report is expected in spring 2024.

At the legislative consultation on water on 29 January 2024 the Chamber was promised that the ministry, together with the water boards, would investigate the functioning of the permitting, supervision and enforcement system.

Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg Water op 29 januari 2024 is aan de Kamer toegezegd dat het ministerie onder meer samen met de waterschappen een onderzoek gaat doen naar het functioneren van het stelsel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Het 'giftigste' terrein van Nederland wordt eindelijk aangepakt, maar zorgen bij omgeving blijven'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about contamination at the former EMK site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, including health risks, company liability, and remediation cost and timing. The State Secretary answered that residents are safe, the state bears responsibility for remediation after the bankrupt firm's failure, and remediation is planned to start in spring 2024 and take about four years.
Since there is currently no basis to hold these companies responsible for anything, it is not useful to name specific companies.
Aangezien er op dit moment geen grondslag is om deze bedrijven iets te verwijten, is het niet zinvol specifieke bedrijven bij naam te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Hoe kon het zo misgaan voor de veelgeprezen Amsterdamse Fixbrigade?‘

An MP asked the Interior and Climate ministers why Amsterdam awarded a 5,050-home insulation tender to Energiebox rather than the locally praised FIXbrigade, and about criteria, impact on tenants, and support for public fix teams. The minister answered that the municipality runs the tender and the national government lacks insight into bids, points to the municipality's criteria and its willingness to help FIXbrigade, and says the state funds municipalities with discretion without setting detailed requirements.
We therefore have no insight into the submitted documents and the assessment, beyond what the municipality of Amsterdam publicly reports about it.
Wij hebben daarmee geen inzicht in de ingediende stukken en de beoordeling, buiten wat de gemeente Amsterdam daar publiekelijk over rapporteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Paternotte over het bericht 'Mbo’er Sem (20) zoekt al drie jaar een studentenwoning in Amsterdam: ‘Ik wil hier mijn eigen leven beginnen’'

MPs Beckerman and Paternotte asked whether it is acceptable that MBO students are refused student housing and how the government will ensure access, including whether this counts as housing discrimination and whether landlords will be engaged. The minister answered that MBO students should have access, that a Human Rights Institute advice on banning distinction by education level is being requested, and that 11 of 13 Kences corporations admit MBO students, with the rest being asked to change.

On behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will shortly request advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights on the desirability of a ban on distinction by education level in the General Equal Treatment Act.

Mede namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal ik op korte termijn advies vragen aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over de wenselijkheid van een verbod op onderscheid naar opleidingsniveau in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel "'Per direct' geen stroomaansluitingen mogelijk voor nieuwbouwwoningen Almere, gemeente is geschokt"

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about reports that grid operators would stop new electricity connections in parts of Almere, and about the grid measures, communication and waiting list involved. The minister answered that small-consumer connections remain possible until 2026, that grid congestion is being addressed through the national programme with new measures and local pilots, and that a waiting list of about 210 businesses in Flevoland exists and is being worked on.
To begin with, power connections for new housing remain possible for the municipality of Almere.
Om te beginnen blijven stroomaansluitingen voor nieuwbouwwoningen mogelijk voor de gemeente Almere.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel ''Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen''

Two SP MPs asked whether a Volkskrant report that energy supplier HEM may have manipulated the price-cap subsidy is accurate, and how the regulators (RVO and ACM) oversaw it, including whether HEM should have received the subsidy while operating with a supply licence in question. The minister answered that RVO and ACM monitor compliance, that ongoing investigations and procedures cannot be discussed, that ACM tightened HEM's licence conditions in December 2023, and that no evidence yet shows consumers overpaid.
Regarding any ongoing legal procedures directly related to this, I cannot make any statements at this time.
Over eventueel lopende juridische procedures die hier direct mee samenhangen, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman naar aanleiding van de vragen over het opstarten van twee productielocaties op het Groningenveld

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why two Groningen gas production sites were restarted on the cold-weather waakvlam regime, whether industry demand reduction was considered, and how Groningers are affected. The State Secretary answered that the restart follows the 2023-2024 determination (capacity shortfall at low temperatures, not a volume shortage), that alternatives like industry curtailment cannot act fast enough, and that the field will still close on 1 October 2024, while acknowledging the unrest caused by late notice to local authorities.
Should this situation unexpectedly occur again, I will inform the authorities in Groningen earlier.
Mocht zich deze situatie onverhoopt nog een keer voor doen, dan zal ik de overheden in Groningen eerder informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel 'Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen'

MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked how energy supplier HEM obtained a licence despite suspicions about its founders, whether the BIBOB integrity screening applied, and how misuse of the energy price cap could be prevented and recovered. The minister replied that the ACM granted the licence in 2020 under the then-applicable rules, that tightened admission criteria followed in 2022, that BIBOB is not part of licensing but is planned for the Energy Act, that no similar price cap is currently planned, and that a margin test will be applied to subsidies.
I have included in the Energy Act proposal that a licence can be refused or revoked on the basis of the BIBOB Act.
Ik heb in het voorstel voor de Energiewet opgenomen dat een vergunning kan worden geweigerd of ingetrokken op basis van de Wet BIBOB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over vocht en schimmelproblematiek, enkel glas, slecht uitgevoerde renovaties, foute energielabels en flexwoningen

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior about damp and mould, single-glazed windows, poor renovations, incorrect energy labels and flex housing, raising tenant burdens and the adequacy of enforcement tools. The Minister answers that tenant-focused energy measures and an integrated renovation approach are pursued, that existing rules (Huurcommissie, courts, municipal enforcement) are sufficient, and rejects a national APK inspection, a national reporting point and a list of affected dwellings, while promising some follow-up such as a participation bill and survey monitoring.
As I explained in my answer to question 17, my impression is that landlords generally act timely and adequately when problems with damp and mould arise.
Antwoord 23 Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 17 heb aangegeven, heb ik het beeld dat verhuurders over het algemeen tijdig en adequaat optreden bij problemen met bij vocht en schimmel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel “NAM: ‘Laatste aardgas uit velden halen, is niet voor meer ruimte afvalwater oliewinning’”

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM's plan to restart gas extraction in southeast Drenthe, its link to wastewater storage for oil extraction, municipal and provincial objections, subsidence and damage claims, and participation procedures. The State Secretary answered that the plan has no link to oil wastewater storage, that TNO and SodM advise on subsidence (about 0.5 mm extra, with 6 cm cumulative per NAM), that the public participation and appeal procedure applies, and that the Schoonebeek process will be evaluated in early 2024.
I find it regrettable that the municipalities of Emmen and Coevorden feel taken by surprise.
Ik vind het vervelend dat de gemeenten Emmen en Coevorden zich overvallen voelen.
Antwoord op van vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht Bewoners de Olmenhof over vertrek uit flat: ‘Ik kan bij Leger des Heils gaan aanbellen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether tenants of De Olmenhof, who must leave a flat rented under the Leegstandwet (temporary vacancy law), are protected against homelessness, whether the law should be changed, and related questions on housing rights and the mental health effects of such rentals. The Minister answered that tenants knew the lease was temporary, that the Leegstandwet has no tenant protection by design, and that he has no intention to amend it, while pointing to municipal responsibility and planned housing-regulation legislation.
I do not intend to amend the Leegstandwet.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de Leegstandswet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Agenten willen meer aandacht voor milieu: ‘Delicten met de meeste doden krijgen geen prioriteit.’'

MP Beckerman asked the ministers of Justice and Infrastructure about a police manifesto urging more priority for environmental crime and whether 'ecocide' should be made a crime. The government answered that prosecution priorities are set by the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to extra investment in environmental enforcement capacity, and said the revised EU environmental crime directive will be implemented, with a ecocide-like aggravating ground expected in a bill after 2024.
It is unacceptable that companies knowingly violate environmental laws. These companies must be tackled.
Het is onacceptabel dat bedrijven willens en wetens milieuwetten overtreden. Deze bedrijven moeten aangepakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel ‘EPA okays Chemours request to export GenX from the Netherlands to Fayetteville Works plant'

Beckerman (SP) asked the state secretary about the US EPA approving Chemours' request to export GenX waste from the Netherlands to North Carolina, and about health and environmental risks, information received, oversight, and regulation. The state secretary answered that the EPA decides on imports, that the ILT received required information, that the EPA withdrew its consent on 30 November, and that the EU export regulation revision is under negotiation, while promising to ask the ILT to share the information received.
I will ask the ILT to share with your House the information it received from Chemours regarding the transports currently permitted.
Ik zal de ILT verzoeken de informatie die zij heeft ontvangen van Chemours met betrekking tot de op dit moment vergunde transporten met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de extra belasting van woningcorporaties met betrekking tot schadevergoedingen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why compensation paid to housing corporations for Groningen mining damage is taxed as corporate profit, and whether it should be exempted or compensated. The government replied that the compensation is fiscally neutral over time because associated repair costs offset it, that it sees no reason to defiscalise or compensate, and that the EUR 135 million subsidy, including EUR 750 per tenant, benefits tenants.
However, a compensation payment is fiscally neutral for housing corporations.
Een schadevergoeding pakt voor woningcorporaties echter fiscaal neutraal uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij

Two SP MPs asked the Infrastructure minister whether the sale of Arriva to a US investment firm was imminent, what it means for passengers and staff, and whether public ownership of transport operators should be the rule. The minister answered that services and concession terms are expected to be unaffected, that provinces hold consent rights in some concessions, and that public ownership is not a precondition for good public transport, though the government will keep monitoring.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij.

SP MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked about the sale of Arriva to US investor I Squared Capital, including provincial powers to block it, consequences of refusal and public spending on Arriva. The Staatssecretaris answered that most concessions are unaffected, that Limburg and Noord-Brabant have consent clauses, that nationalisation is not warranted, and that public-sector purchase of other operators would be explored if offered.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen

An MP asked the Staatssecretaris about reports that Claessen Tankcleaning discharged carcinogenic substances into the Maas, and about oversight failures by the omgevingsdienst, Arbeidsinspectie, police and OM over several years. The state secretary answered that the inspection regime is being strengthened through the IBP VTH programme, that enforcement steps were taken (including a dwangsom in 2023), and that no concrete new action beyond ongoing programme work was committed.
Without independently verified evidence of a violation, an authority cannot take enforcement action.
Zonder onafhankelijk geverifieerd bewijs van overtreding, kan een instantie niet handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Pure Energie aast op bouw windpark tussen Woltersum, Ten Boer en Ten Post. Boeren worden verleid om grond beschikbaar te stellen

An SP MP asked the Cabinet whether it finds it undesirable that commercial firm Pure Energie approaches landowners for high wind turbines near Groningen's earthquake zone, and how participation and trust can be safeguarded. The minister answered that the area is not designated for large-scale wind, that local decision-making lies with regional and municipal authorities, and that participation and financial participation are being pursued without committing to halt or block the project.
It is up to the decentralised authorities to assess the plans of (commercial) parties, including those not within the RES search areas.
Het is aan de decentrale overheden om de plannen van (commerciële) partijen – ook die niet binnen de RES-zoekgebieden vallen – te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'NAM dient winningsplan Norg in'

An SP MP asks the government whether it opposes NAM's winning plan for cushion gas at the Norg storage field near Groningen, whether the state should have taken over the storage sites, and questions the Norg agreement's financial benefits for NAM. The minister answers that the winning plan will be assessed under the Mining Act with advice from SodM, the Mijnraad and regional authorities over one and a half to two years, that ACM must assess supply security, and that the Norg agreement does not bring extra income to NAM but compensates it for its disadvantage.
In my role as licensing authority I am obliged to assess this winning plan under the procedure of the Mining Act.
In mijn rol als vergunningverlener ben ik verplicht dit winningsplan te beoordelen volgens de procedure uit de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Canadese vastgoedbelegger zet duizenden Nederlandse huurhuizen te koop'

The MP Beckerman asks the Minister about reports that Canadian investor ERES is selling thousands of Dutch rental homes, and about whether investors should be relied on for affordable housing versus public or social landlords. The Minister says ERES is only conducting a strategic review, defends a mixed system of corporations and investors, and declines to change ownership or to take steps beyond monitoring the situation.
As stated in the answer to question 2, ERES REIT is conducting an internal review and no decision has yet been taken on what it intends to do with its housing portfolio.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 doet ERES REIT een intern onderzoek en is er nog geen besluit genomen over hetgeen zij met hun woningportefeuille willen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Syngenta een studie naar glyfosaat en hersenschade meer dan twintig jaar achterhield

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that Syngenta withheld a neurotoxicity study on a glyphosate salt form and about the EU renewal of glyphosate, and whether the minister would take further steps such as fines. The minister answered that the study concerned a different substance (glyphosate-trimesium), that EFSA nonetheless included it and found no indication of neurotoxic effects, that the Commission plans a ten-year renewal which the Netherlands will oppose per a parliamentary motion, and that research into neurotoxicity testing is under way.
Every marketing authorisation holder of an active substance is obliged to submit all new relevant scientific information to the licensing authorities.
Iedere toelatingshouder van een werkzame stof heeft de verplichting om alle nieuwe relevante wetenschappelijke informatie aan te leveren bij de toelatingsautoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman en Thijssen over PFAS

MPs Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman and Thijssen asked about PFAS: licensed emitters, drinking water, health and economic effects, contaminated sites, enforcement against Chemours and 3M, and whether the government knew of harms. The minister answered that no central emissions register exists, outlined permitting and monitoring responsibilities, and said ongoing RIVM research and legal action continue, while declining to comment on several pending matters.
No, there is no centralised overview of this.
Nee, hiervan is geen gecentraliseerd overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over niet-toegelaten instellingen

MPs asked why tenants with low incomes of non-admitted housing providers were excluded from the one-off rent reduction given to social housing tenants of admitted housing associations, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that the rent reduction is a legal duty only for admitted associations, that extending it to private landlords would infringe property rights and is impractical, and that other landlords may voluntarily grant it on tenant request.
Other landlords other than housing associations are free to lower rent for low-income tenants to €575.03, like housing associations, but they are not legally obliged to do so.

Het staat andere verhuurders dan woningcorporaties vrij om net als woningcorporaties de huur voor huurders met een laag inkomen naar € 575,03 te verlagen, maar zij zijn daartoe niet wettelijk verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘Groninger gedupeerden die nog steeds de prijs betalen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Groningen earthquake victims who still pay out of pocket for reinforcement, demolition-rebuilding, defects and lost compensation, citing several parliamentary motions. The government acknowledges some residents paid their own costs, promises a reporting point by 1 October 2023 with full reimbursement where proven, an extra 23% budget for batch 1588, and further checks on indexation and compensation, while rejecting some claims.

For cases where this is the case, a reporting point will be set up where residents can register if they believe they have incurred costs themselves for necessary reinforcement measures or costs directly arising from them.

Voor de gevallen waar dit wel het geval is, zal een meldpunt worden ingericht waar bewoners zich kunnen melden die menen dat zij zelf kosten hebben gemaakt voor noodzakelijke versterkingsmaatregelen of kosten die daar direct uit voortkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de grote archeologische ontdekkingen bij Tiel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Tiel archaeological finds, the construction of warehouses on the site, public display of finds, funding for analysis, and the quality and capacity of archaeological research and municipal archaeology. The State Secretary answers that the municipality weighed interests, that existing legal frameworks and funding (Mondriaanfonds, a research platform, €3 million for municipal heritage care) address these concerns, and commits to several follow-up steps.
I therefore make €3 million per year available to strengthen heritage care at municipalities.
Ik stel daarom € 3 miljoen per jaar beschikbaar voor het versterken van de erfgoedzorg bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘De notaris, de katvanger en de waakhond’

An SP MP asks the housing minister, after a Groene Amsterdammer article alleging large profits and weak oversight in the sale of about 1,100 social rental homes by housing corporations, whether the sales harmed tenants, whether oversight failed, and whether sales should stop. The minister rejects the allegations as unproven (noting a court ordered the article rectified), defends a well-considered sales policy, says the Aw and BFT oversight was adequate, and commits to an evaluation of appraiser independence due end 2023.
I have no indications that board members generally fall short in this regard.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat bestuurders hierin in het algemeen tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het mogelijk verbod op onderkeldering in Amsterdam

SP MP Beckerman asked the housing minister about a possible ban on basement excavation in Amsterdam after subsidence damage, the ombudsman's criticism of compensation-based redress, and the role of Blackstone. The minister answered that the municipality reports no link between the damage and the excavation and no Blackstone involvement, points to legal aid and private-law recourse against contractors, and notes Amsterdam's groundwater permit policy without committing to a new ban or compensation scheme.
Unless the damage can be demonstrably attributed to the government, there is no liability or obligation to compensate by the government.
Tenzij eventuele schade aantoonbaar aan de overheid te wijten is, is er geen sprake van aansprakelijkheid of een plicht tot compensatie door de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Rijk kan kant-en-klare flexwoningen niet kwijt'

The MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister for Housing about reports that the state cannot place pre-ordered prefab flex-homes, and about their quality, location, tenancy security, cost and risks. The Minister acknowledges slow uptake, gives stock and placement figures, defends flex-homes as a quick way to add social housing and a flexible buffer, and largely refuses to concede the criticisms.
I am aware of this report. I acknowledge that practice has proven more stubborn than hoped.
Ik ben bekend met dit bericht. Ik erken dat de praktijk weerbarstiger is gebleken dan gehoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de tijdelijke verrekenfactor voor nieuwbouw vanwege de hoger uitgevallen milieubelasting van warmtepompen

Two MPs (SP) asked why a temporary calculation factor for heat pumps' environmental impact was introduced without informing parliament, whether legal advice was obtained, and what the consequences are for the climate goals. The minister replies that the factor was developed by the independent Stichting NMD, that the government did not seek legal advice because the method itself was unchanged, that parliament was not informed since the database is managed by the sector, and that heat pumps remain climate-friendly overall.
If the calculation method or requirement designated in the building regulations is changed, your House will be informed of this.
Als de in de bouwregelgeving aangewezen bepalingsmethode of eis wordt gewijzigd, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Citadelhof in Den Bosch opent eigen 'museum'' in het Brabants Dagblad (BD) van 24 januari jongstleden

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the demolition of the Citadelhof flats in Den Bosch for a museum, asking about heritage value, tenant participation under the Overlegwet, and whether urgent own-use eviction is misused. The minister said heritage is one factor among others, that demolition is a local decision, that no direct link exists with the museum, and that existing tenant consultation rules are adequate.
I do not agree that there is a lack of control for residents.
Ik deel niet dat er sprake is van het ontbreken van zeggenschap van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat tijdelijke huurders Peperstraat Zaandam snel moeten verkassen omdat hun contract niet kan worden verlengd

An SP MP asked the housing minister about temporary tenants in the Peperstraat in Zaandam who must move quickly because their temporary contracts cannot be extended, raising questions about displacement, consultation, urgency status, and the planned national social statute. The minister answered that such temporary contracts cannot be extended after two years by law, that no legal terugkeergarantie exists but local agreements are possible, and that a national social statute for housing corporations will be finalised before summer.
I see no reason to enter into discussion with the parties involved.
Ik zie geen aanleiding met de betrokken partijen het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Lage inkomenshuishoudens in de knel op de woningmarkt door Rotterdams woonbeleid' namens de Gezamenlijke Overleg Huurdersorganisaties (GOH)
