Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister for Housing about a Rotterdam tenant organisation's criticism of city housing policy, a Rotterdam Audit Office report on unreliable social housing figures, the conduct of the municipality and private market influence, and the reliability of national funding based on local data. The Minister answers that Rotterdam housing policy is a local democratic matter, that he will agree a regional housing deal and a national definition of social rent, and that he sees no need for a national investigation or a moratorium on sales and demolition.
However, it is not for me to judge Rotterdam's housing policy: this is shaped in the local Rotterdam democratic process.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te oordelen over het Rotterdamse woonbeleid: dit komt tot stand in het lokale Rotterdamse democratische proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de staat die doorprocedeert tegen inwoners

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the state keeps appealing losing mining-damage cases against Groningen residents, and whether this conflicts with the government's stated aim of standing beside residents. The State Secretary agrees appeals burden residents, says IMG will use prejudicial questions instead, not reclaim compensation if it appeals, and promises a less legalistic approach, with a letter this spring.
I have discussed with the IMG that in these distressing cases it will not reclaim the compensation paid if the IMG is found to be right.
Ik heb met het IMG besproken dat het voor deze schrijnende gevallen de uitgekeerde vergoeding niet zal terugvorderen als het IMG in het gelijk wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘de vertraagde versterking in Ten Post’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about delays in reinforcement (versterking) of homes in Ten Post, the trust deficit with residents, compensation for higher energy costs, and SodM's criticism of slow execution. The State Secretary acknowledges delays and residents' distress, outlines a new timetable (completion in H2 2024), improved communication and a review of processes, but declines to commit to compensation for energy costs, citing existing schemes and an ongoing identification exercise.
At the committee debate on Mining Groningen on 1 February I committed to this Chamber that I would talk with these residents and inform this Chamber of the outcome.
Tijdens het commissiedebat Mijnbouw Groningen van 1 februari jl. heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd met deze bewoners in gesprek te gaan en uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Sociale huurwoningen entrepotdok: ‘Stop de massale uitverkoop’

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the sale of social rental flats at Entrepotdok in Amsterdam by De Alliantie, questioning whether it breaches national and local agreements and the right to adequate housing. The minister answered that sales are part of sound management, that the Alliantie has paused the sale and a mediation process with the municipality has started, and that the government's policy aims to grow the social rental stock.

By mutual agreement, it was decided to enter a mediation process together to examine whether the Samenwerkingsafspraken agreed between the municipality and housing corporations were actually followed.

In goed overleg is besloten om samen een mediation-traject in te gaan om na te gaan of er daadwerkelijk conform de Samenwerkingsafspraken, zoals vastgesteld in het overleg tussen gemeente en de woningcorporaties, is gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Missende rookmelders en enige vluchtroutes vol spullen: veiligheid ver te zoeken in oude portiekflats’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about press reports on fire safety in old walk-up flats in Amersfoort, including missing smoke detectors, single escape routes blocked by belongings, and a complaint about housing association De Alliantie. The Minister answered at length that building fire safety is primarily the owner's responsibility and the municipality's as competent authority, that existing buildings need not meet new-build standards, that a planned amendment to the building decree and a NIPV study are under way, and that tenants can turn to the Huurcommissie, rechter, or the municipality.
I take tenants' complaints seriously, but ultimately it is up to the landlord to act.
Ik neem klachten van huurders serieus, maar het is uiteindelijk aan de verhuurder om iets te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Vraagtekens over brandveiligheid Riekerhaven: ‘Als dit ’s nachts was gebeurd, was de ellende niet te overzien’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Housing about fire safety of container homes at Riekerhaven in Amsterdam, after a fire and fire brigade concerns, including whether containers should be investigated, whether the brigade should be involved in unit construction, and whether the housing corporation Lieven de Key is culpable. The minister answers that the municipality is the competent authority, that existing Building Decree rules apply, that the outcomes of Amsterdam investigations will be studied with experts before deciding on national action, and that residents are not his responsibility.

I want to study the outcomes of the Amsterdam investigations and then, in consultation with fire safety experts, the Association of Building and Housing Supervision Netherlands and the Fire Brigade Netherlands, assess whether further (national) action is needed.

Ik wil de uitkomsten van de Amsterdamse onderzoeken bestuderen en aansluitend in samenspraak met brandveiligheidsdeskundigen, de Vereniging Bouw- en Woningtoezicht Nederland en Brandweer Nederland bezien of nadere (landelijke) acties nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een grote stijging van de bouw van recreatiewoningen en hotels vlakbij beschermde natuur

An SP MP asked the government about a reported 90% rise in holiday homes and hotels near protected Natura 2000 areas, asking for data, regulation, appeal figures, nitrogen effects and whether more building should be restricted. The minister answered that she lacks most of the requested data since provinces are the competent authority, considers the existing rules sufficient, and will examine with BZK whether the monitoring instruments suffice, without committing to new restrictions.
In our decentralised system, the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten) is the competent authority for permit granting and enforcement concerning Natura 2000 areas.
In ons gedecentraliseerde bestel zijn gedeputeerde staten bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening en handhaving met betrekking tot Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'In deze studentenflat is de stank ondraaglijk, huurders lijden onder bedwantsen, ratten en schimmel’

An MP asked the minister about reports of severe living conditions in a Den Haag student flat (odour, bedbugs, rats, mould, fire alarms) and about the rights of tenants on temporary and campus contracts, including the handling of landlord misconduct by the municipality. The minister answered that tenant protection is insufficient, pointed to the Wet goed verhuurderschap as the instrument to strengthen municipal enforcement, said the municipality already acts against defects, and declined to commit to new national rules or a separate investigation.

In addition, once the Wet goed verhuurderschap takes effect, the municipality of Den Haag can introduce a rental permit in areas where liveability is under pressure, on condition that landlords have and carry out a maintenance plan.

Daarnaast kan de gemeente Den Haag, zodra het wetsvoorstel goed verhuurderschap inwerking treedt, in gebieden waar de leefbaarheid onder druk staat een verhuurvergunning instellen met als voorwaarde dat verhuurders een onderhoudsplan hebben en uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over misbruik datalek IMG en bedrijven die verdienen aan schadeafhandeling

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the IMG data leak and commercial firms that take a commission on Groningen earthquake damage claims, including a misleading letter from 'loket bevingsschade'. The State Secretary confirms the two IMG data leaks and the firm's misleading branding, says a commercial service is unnecessary, notes IMG cannot quantify the firms' earnings, and points to existing independent support and the Tijdelijke wet Groningen amendment on compensation for legal and technical assistance.
IMG regrets that people's data was wrongly shared and has announced it will file a criminal complaint against the company concerned.
Het IMG betreurt dat er onterecht gegevens van mensen zijn gedeeld en heeft inmiddels bekend gemaakt aangifte te doen tegen het bedrijf in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over terugtreden aannemer bij sloop-nieuwbouw in het kader van de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

An SP MP asks the state secretary about a contractor withdrawing from a demolition-and-rebuild job in Loppersum, the delay this causes for a resident, and recurring problems with NCG budgets, planning and payments. The state secretary says the withdrawal is exceptional and not caused by NCG, commits to a replacement contractor and talks with contractors, but gives no concrete fix for the delays.
However, a proposal for a replacement contractor will be made as quickly as possible.
Er wordt echter zo snel als mogelijk een voorstel gedaan voor een vervangende aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Boulakjar over het IMG die de wachttijd voor schadeafhandeling laat oplopen naar 21 maanden

MPs Beckerman and Boulakjar asked why Groningen mining-damage claimants now face waits of up to 21 months, with extended decision periods, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State acknowledges the wait is unacceptable, says IMG operates independently without consulting the ministry on procedures, and commits to monitoring and steering IMG toward faster handling of complex files.
The IMG does not keep separate records of how many letters extending decision periods it has sent.
Het IMG houdt niet separaat bij in hoeveel gevallen zij een brief met een verlenging van beslistermijnen hebben verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over lozingen op de Waddenzee

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about FrieslandCampina's discharges of nitrogen and phosphate into the Wadden Sea, the adequacy of its permit and supervision, and the lack of a water permit for the HoWa pipeline. The minister answered that the Omgevingsdienst Groningen judged the permit compliant, that supervision occurred annually, that a water permit was being processed by Rijkswaterstaat, and that no illegal discharge exists, though some questions were not answered in time.
There is no question of an illegal discharge via the HoWa pipeline by FrieslandCampina.
Er is geen sprake van een illegale lozing op de HoWa-leiding door FrieslandCampina.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport ‘onderzoek opkopen vakantieparken’

An SP MP asks the ministers about a report on the buy-up of holiday parks, raising criminal and speculative investors, stikstof, intimidation of tenants, weak tenant protection under RECRON terms, and the role of municipalities. The minister answers that the government sees no need for a moratorium, buy-up protection, Bibob mandatory checks or a revolving fund, while pointing to municipal tools, the Actie-agenda and a dialogue with the sector on tenant information.
In the first place it is up to the local competent authority, the municipality or province, to determine whether buying up and restructuring a given holiday park is desirable or possible.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan het lokale bevoegd gezag, de gemeente of provincie, om te bepalen of het opkopen en herstructureren van een gegeven vakantiepark wenselijk danwel mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de recente aardbevingen in Groningen, schadeherstel en versterking

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about renewed earthquakes in Groningen, damage settlement and reinforcement, including the IMG's damage handling, legal support, the Woo transparency requests, and reinforcement delays. The State Secretary largely acknowledges the problems and commits to several reviews and follow-up letters, but declines to legally fix the end date of gas extraction and rejects raising immaterial damage compensation.
I am doing everything I can to carry out the reinforcement operation as quickly as possible so that unsafe houses meet the safety standard.
Ik zet alles op alles om de versterkingsoperatie zo snel als mogelijk uit te voeren zodat onveilige huizen aan de veiligheidsnorm voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het 'kanaaldrama' bij het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about residents of the Almelo-De Haandrik canal whose homes were damaged and who feel compensation from the province of Overijssel is inadequate, asking about contacts, objections, the burden of proof and national intervention. The minister repeatedly declined substantive comment, stating that the canal is a provincial waterway managed by Overijssel and that the Rijk has no authority over it, while offering that the provincial deputy could brief the House on request.
Management of the Almelo-De Haandrik canal is in the hands of the province of Overijssel because it is a provincial waterway.
Het beheer van het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is in handen van de provincie Overijssel omdat het gaat om een provinciale vaarweg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Onveilige situaties voor 2 op de 5 jonge huurders door wooncrisis: 'Mijn huisbaas weet dat ik nergens anders heen kan'’

Two MPs asked the housing minister about reports that young tenants face unsafe situations and exploitation by landlords amid the housing crisis, and about interim protections before the Goed Verhuurderschap bill takes effect. The minister said the bill will give municipalities enforcement tools and a reporting point, declined a national reporting point and national tenant teams for now, and promised to examine expanding the Huurcommissie's remit and regulating mid-rent housing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht '650 nieuwe procedures tegen Change=' van 16 juni jongstleden van Stichting Woon

An MP asked the minister about reports of hundreds of rent-service-cost procedures against landlord Change= and whether the government would intervene, including on alleged intimidation, withheld deposits and negative landlord references. The minister answered that existing rules already allow collective handling, that the motion is superfluous, that he has talked with both parties but will not intervene while the Huurcommissie case is pending, and that the leges and related rules are under evaluation.
As long as no ruling has been made, it is not appropriate for me to interfere in the situation.
Zolang er nog geen uitspraak is gedaan, ligt het niet in de rede dat ik mij in de situatie meng.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘onderhandse financiering van vakantiewoningen baart experts zorgen’

SP MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked ministers about reports that private, non-bank mortgage financing of holiday parks and homes raises money-laundering and undermining risks, and about regulation of park takeovers and oversight of gatekeepers. The government answered that such financing can be a risk indicator, that the Actie-agenda vakantieparken and existing Wwft and FIU measures apply, that no regulation of individual transactions is planned, and that it will report the results of the Actie-agenda and a banks/gatekeeper dialogue later.
It is important that all parties that may have insight into this are alert to it in performing their tasks.
Het is belangrijk dat alle betrokken partijen die hierop zicht kunnen hebben, daar alert op zijn bij de uitoefening van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Het uitkopen van boeren is wéér een bail-out voor banken’

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether banks such as Rabobank, which hold large food and agri loans, share responsibility for the nitrogen crisis and whether buy-out schemes for farmers amount to a bail-out for banks. The minister answered that banks share a joint responsibility, that the buy-out schemes are financed from state funds and may be used to repay bank loans, and that the government will inform parliament further on expecting a non-voluntary contribution from banks.
It is not for the government to intervene in the settlement of these financial obligations between private parties.
Het is niet aan de overheid om in de afhandeling van deze financiële verplichtingen tussen private partijen te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over twaalf extra te plaatsen zoutcavernes door Nobian

MP Beckerman (SP) asked about residents' concerns over twelve new salt caverns planned by Nobian near Winschoten, the lack of damage-claim evidence in stacked mining areas, the handling of damage claims by the IMG and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, and seismicity and monitoring at existing caverns. The State Secretary answered that the procedure is in the environmental assessment stage, that the two agencies cooperate and that the government is reviewing the process and commissioning research on cumulative effects, while stating that no structural end to mining is warranted.
I have asked the agencies to work out options for this and will inform the House about it.
Ik heb de instanties gevraagd om mogelijkheden hierover uit te werken en zal u Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de casus met betrekking tot ‘(bouwkundige) problemen die ontstaan tijdens versterking en sloop-nieuwbouw in Groningen'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about construction defects in Groningen's earthquake-strengthening and demolition-rebuild projects, including the Overschild and Woltersum cases, bewilderment of residents, and inspection and liability arrangements. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems and said compensation and repairs were agreed in Overschild and that inspection, quality-assurance and warranty rules are in place, but did not track how many defects arise.
It is not recorded how many errors this concerns exactly, or how many of them are of a structural nature.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden om hoeveel fouten dit precies gaat, of hoeveel hiervan van bouwkundige aard zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over vakantieparken die mogelijk misbruikt worden door criminelen om hun geld wit te wassen

Two MPs from the SP asked ministers about holiday parks possibly misused by criminals for money laundering, including the role of municipalities, BIBOB screening and intimidation of officials. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the problem is known, that an interdepartmental action agenda and guidance exist, that a Kadaster registration change is being evaluated, and that no mandatory BIBOB screening will be imposed, leaving this to municipalities' discretion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verlaging van de gezondheidsnorm voor GenX in drinkwater in de Verenigde Staten

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the state secretary about stricter US EPA health advisories for GenX in drinking water and what this means for Dutch RIVM limits, Chemours discharge rules, filtration, and oversight of GenX waste flows. The state secretary answered that RIVM relies on EFSA values, that no new RIVM advice is currently needed, that GenX discharges are already subject to the strictest minimisation duty, and that the ILT and competent authority are improving insight into GenX in waste streams, with a regulatory change planned for 2023.
Therefore there is currently no reason to ask RIVM to advise again on the currently applicable drinking water guideline value.
Daarom is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om het RIVM te vragen opnieuw te adviseren over de nu geldende drinkwaterrichtwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, en Nijboer over het boren van een zoutput door Nedmag

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether the ministry allowed Nedmag to drill toward well VE-7 without a permit and before the required analysis, and why enforcement was refused. The state secretary answered that a permit was granted for the drilling under the environmental-permit procedure, that mining from VE-7 still requires a separate winning-plan change, and that SodM found no grounds for enforcement.
I also want to make a working visit to speak with residents and Nedmag.
Ik wil daarnaast ook op werkbezoek gaan om te spreken met inwoners en Nedmag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'de tijd tikt door in het Klokkenhof’

MPs Beckerman asked the minister about reports that Vesteda and Amsterdam let tenants on generic temporary contracts become homeless or be moved within the same complex to avoid permanent contracts, questioning the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt and related rights. The minister defended the temporary contract regime, said the cases fall within the law, pointed to planned measures (WWS extension, municipal powers in vulnerable areas, the goed verhuurderschap bill) and declined to abolish the law or track homelessness effects precisely.
I am not aware whether there were parents with children housed in the Vesteda building who did not find suitable housing after their temporary tenancy ended.
Het is mij onbekend of er in het gebouw van Vesteda ouders met kinderen gehuisvest waren die geen passende huisvesting hebben gevonden nadat hun tijdelijke huurovereenkomst eindigde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardheden en d

The SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh rules and information management, including inventories of harsh legislation, methods used, new-proposal safeguards, chat-message retention and FOI request backlogs. The minister answered that each department is conducting an inventory of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for timelines and methods, said chat messages need only be kept when the decision is not recorded elsewhere, and provided a FOI overview in an annex.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department is conducting an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardhe

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked which measures the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has taken following the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh consequences of laws and the handling of information. The minister responded that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that research reports and timelines were or will be shared, and described the chat-message retention policy and pending Wob/Woo request figures.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every department is carrying out an inventory of laws and regulations that have harsh effects on people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toepassen van de Wet voorkeursrecht gemeenten op een woonwijk in Arnhem, en de bewoners die daartegen in opstand komen

An SP MP asked the housing minister about the municipality of Arnhem applying the pre-emption right (voorkeursrecht) under the Wet voorkeursrecht gemeenten to an entire residential neighbourhood before any plan exists, causing resident protests, and whether such use should be restrained. The minister answered that the right only restricts sale, does not affect use or cause demolition by itself, and that he has confidence in the municipality to engage residents, while declining to urge Arnhem to withdraw it.
A pre-emption right therefore only restricts the transferability of the immovable property (the land and buildings on it) and of certain limited rights on the property.
Een voorkeursrecht beperkt dus alleen de overdraagbaarheid van de onroerende zaak (de grond en de bouwwerken daarop) en van enkele beperkte rechten op de onroerende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de opslag van aardgascondensaat in Roodeschool

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about the State Supervision of Mines' advice to relocate the condensate loading station at Roodeschool and whether the current activities are permissible. The State Secretary acknowledged SodM's findings, said activities are halted until a gravel bed is repaired, prefers relocation, and promised to update the permit and report after the summer recess.
I have taken note of SodM's advice, in which it states that it currently assumes the activities permitted in 2004 at this location are not permittable.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het advies van SodM, waarin zij stelt dat zij er op dit moment van uitgaan dat de in 2004 vergunde activiteiten op deze locatie niet vergunbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel 'Bewoners in schimmelende horrorflat zijn het spuugzat’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing about reports of mould, collapsing balconies and neglected maintenance at a Vreeland flat owned by housing corporation De Alliantie, and about wider housing-quality and tenant-protection issues. The minister says the balconies are propped and not in imminent danger, that tenants can use the Rent Tribunal or courts, and that no landmark new oversight or APK-style inspection is planned.
I cannot make a statement on that in general terms.
Ik kan daar in algemene zin geen uitspraak over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel in het AD met als titel ‘Hugo de Jonge is dolblij met deze huizen, maar het is net een sauna: ‘Het is hier 27 graden’’ van 27 maart jongstleden

An SP MP asked Minister De Jonge about flex housing, its security of tenure, durability, business case, and the Groningen container student housing controversy, including high energy bills, abusive subletting, and poor landlord conduct. The minister largely defended flex housing as a supplement to regular supply, said tenant protection remains via existing rules and local action, and declined to answer several detailed questions, deferring to municipalities and others.
As stated in the coalition agreement, fixed-term rental contracts must remain the norm.
Zoals in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen, moeten vaste huurcontracten de norm blijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het kwartaalbericht van de Nationaal Hypotheek Garantie (NHG); 'minder verlies en lagere restschulden, maar hogere risicobereidheid consument om een huis te kopen' en het bez

An MP asks the minister about NHG's quarterly report on higher consumer risk appetite for buying homes, starter mortgages, cooperative housing, support for vulnerable owners, and energy-saving subsidies for low incomes. The minister answers largely by pointing to existing and planned measures (basisbeurs, Nibud advice in autumn, Warmtefonds, NIP, NPLV) and declines to launch several proposed studies or funds.
I see that consumers tend to show riskier behaviour, such as buying without a financing contingency.
Ik zie ook dat consumenten geneigd zijn om risicovoller gedrag te vertonen, zoals het kopen zonder voorbehoud van financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Change= verlengt contract lastige huurders niet’

MP Beckerman (SP) asked whether landlord Change= refuses to renew tenancy contracts of tenants who object to service charges, deducts deposits wrongly, withholds positive landlord references, uses bailiffs and intimidates tenants, and whether the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt undermines tenants' housing rights. Minister De Jonge answers that tenants can refer service-charge disputes to the Huurcommissie, that landlords may decline renewal of temporary contracts, that the Wet goed verhuurderschap will give municipalities enforcement powers, and that the temporary-contract regime is being reweighed.
It is up to the landlord whether a temporary tenancy agreement is extended.
Het is aan de verhuurder of een tijdelijke huurovereenkomst wordt verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en van Nispen over de kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen en de zaak van de 90-jarige gedupeerde landeigenaar

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked about municipal and provincial demands that a 90-year-old landowner pay for clean-up of chemical drug waste dumped on his land, and about the adequacy of the national compensation scheme. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing a pending objection procedure, acknowledged the scheme's EUR 25,000 cap is being exceeded in large cases, and said talks with the provinces and BIJ12 are ongoing with an update promised before summer.
There is an objection procedure ongoing in this case with the competent authority.
Er loopt in deze zaak een bezwaarprocedure bij het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar NAM

The MP asked about a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into NAM's wastewater handling, when it started, whether the Chamber was informed, and about the risks, permits and responsibilities for produced-water injection and transport. The Staatssecretaris answered that the investigation is independent and ongoing, withheld details of its scope and timing, and explained the production-water process, the permit regime and the supervisory roles of SodM and ILT.
The Public Prosecution Service decides whether and when it announces that an investigation has started and what information, such as the nature of the suspicion, it discloses.
Het OM bepaalt of en wanneer het bekend maakt dat het een onderzoek is gestart en welke informatie, zoals de aard van de verdenking, het daarbij bekend maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de opslag van aardgascondensaat in Roodeschool

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a gas condensate transfer facility remains in the village of Roodeschool despite earlier statements that it should move, and what the government will do about relocation, funding, inspections and resident information. The State Secretary answered that relocation cannot be enforced because the permit and risk levels are within legal norms, that relocation is in principle possible but funding is not available, and that a broad review of mining permits and inspections is underway with results expected in May 2022.
Ik kan een verplaatsing niet afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitvoering van de subsidieregeling ter verduurzaming en verbetering Groningen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Groningen sustainability subsidy: incomplete applications asked for more information within two weeks, the handling of applications, and the unpaid €250 million for those who were turned away. The State Secretary answered that SNN asks for supplementary information rather than rejecting applicants, that about 990 applicants were asked for more detail, and that a new application round with the funds will be communicated before 1 May.
I regret the course of events surrounding the opening in January of this year.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken rondom de openstelling in januari van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te veel lood in de grond van het Oosterpark in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about lead contamination in the soil of Amsterdam's Oosterpark, where children play, and whether the GGD's standards differ from national guidance. The state secretary replied that the municipality of Amsterdam is the competent authority, that national guidance sets no generic lead norm, that the GGD found no health risk for park visitors, and that the municipality will be asked to respond to the new soil survey.
The competent authority (under the Soil Protection Act) for the quality of the soil of the Oosterpark.
Het Bevoegd gezag (Wet bodembescherming) ten aanzien van de kwaliteit van de bodem van het Oosterpark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Ik ben ziek geworden van mijn huis' en 'Trees woonde 1,5 jaar in hotel vanwege huurhuis vol schimmel, nu moet ze 11.000 euro betalen'

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the housing minister, citing newspaper reports on tenants made ill by mould and legionella and a tenant who lived in a hotel and was then billed, why the government does not force landlords to fix damp and mould faster, and asks about a national approach, an APK-style inspection, and faster procedures. The minister answers that landlords are primarily responsible, that a broad approach (priorities, TNO handbooks, funding, Aedes agreements) is in place, that no national reporting point, compulsory inspection, ultimatum or new legislation is planned, and that tenants can use the Huurcommissie, the courts or the municipality.
I am not in favour of a mandatory general periodic inspection for rented homes.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een verplichte algemene periodieke keuring voor huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Interventieteam

The SP MP Beckerman asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the Groningen intervention team for stuck earthquake-damage and reinforcement cases, including whether the 50 million euro budget suffices, how residents are involved, whether some were pressured into settlements, and how the team relates to other bodies. The State Secretary answered that the budget is currently sufficient with 1.2 million spent, that the team offers tailored solutions but residents decide whether to accept, declined to discuss individual cases, and committed to further monitoring reports.
Unfortunately, I cannot go into individual situations.
Op individuele situaties kan ik helaas niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over plannen van de NAM met oliewinning in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the minister about NAM's plan to keep extracting oil from the Rotterdam field until 2050, including subsidence, injection of water, the information evening and climate consistency. The state secretary answered that the updated winning plan is being assessed under current law, that no new extraction is involved, that subsidence is limited to a maximum of 2 cm further, and that restrictive conditions are imposed.
Therefore, in the draft decision I have prescribed a limit on the maximum pressure in the oil reservoir and I do not consent to techniques that lead to cracking in the sealing layer of the oil field.

Daarom heb ik in het ontwerpbesluit een beperking van de maximale druk in het oliereservoir voorgeschreven en stem ik niet in met technieken wanneer die tot scheurvorming in de afsluitende laag van het olieveld leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opzegging van de overeenkomsten van de standplaatsen op het Vakantiepark Berkenven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about the termination of pitch agreements at Het Berkenven campsite, where residents live permanently, and whether children and elderly residents risk homelessness. The minister answered that the termination is a private-law matter, that most residents have found other housing, that the owner has committed to preventing homelessness, that no legal rehousing duty exists, and that a study on investor takeover of holiday parks is underway.
It is not for me, or for my colleague minister of EZK, to assess whether the landlord has complied with the agreements and conditions in this case.
Het is niet aan mij, of aan mijn collegaminister van EZK, om te beoordelen of de verhuurder zich in dit geval aan de afspraken en voorwaarden heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over gelijke gevallen die ongelijk worden behandeld

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why homes in similar situations in Groningen (Ten Boer, Delfzijl, Ganzenerf) are treated differently under the earthquake-damage reinforcement and compensation rules, and whether the six-month decision period for joint reinforcement is justified. The state secretary answered that unexplained differences will be reviewed for a letter to parliament before summer, that the same six-month period applies to all owners, and that compensation and subsidy options exist for some cases, without committing to a specific change now.

As stated, I am looking at the differences that have arisen over the years in an integrated way and will inform the House of the options the cabinet sees to limit the unexplainable differences as much as possible.

Zoals benoemd, kijk ik integraal naar de verschillen die door de jaren heen zijn ontstaan en zal ik de Kamer berichten welke mogelijkheden het kabinet ziet om de onuitlegbare verschillen zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het nationaliseren van de kleine NAM-velden

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister whether the state should buy the NAM's small gas fields to phase out gas extraction, citing other countries ending new drilling permits, subsidies, damage compensation and the Sebaldeburen and Pieterzijl fracking cases. The state secretary replied that the government wants to keep Dutch small-field gas production as a supply-security and infrastructure asset during the transition, has no plans to buy the fields, and points to the Commission Mijnbouwschade and existing procedures for damage and permit issues.
The cabinet has no plans to buy the gas fields.
Het kabinet heeft geen plannen om de gasvelden te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Fort Velsen en het industrieterrein Edam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about damage to Fort Velsen, part of the Stelling van Amsterdam (a rijksmonument and UNESCO World Heritage site), the boundary change for the Edam industrial estate, and enforcement and oversight of the heritage. The State Secretary said the municipality stopped the works and can take enforcement action, that the RCE and province are coordinating, and that the Edam boundary change was approved by UNESCO after a formal procedure, while damage assessment and restoration are still pending.
The fort is a national monument. Municipalities play an important role in maintaining national monuments.
Het fort is een rijksmonument. Gemeenten hebben bij de instandhouding van rijksmonumenten een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Een jaar dakloos en dertig vakantieparken achter de rug en nu is het bijna kerst'

An SP MP asks how a family was made homeless after a housing corporation ended its tenancy over nuisance, and whether municipalities, corporations and the state have duties to prevent such eviction, including blacklists and rent allowance. The minister answers that corporations have no formal duty to offer alternatives but should consider them, that municipalities are responsible for housing policy and do not discuss individual cases, that the national plan 'Een thuis voor iedereen' will be sent to parliament, and that the blacklist use is governed by a model protocol with data-protection safeguards.

As I indicated in answers 2 and 3, it is part of the housing corporation's task to look at alternative housing when ending a tenancy agreement or to refer tenants to a place where they can go, but there is no formal duty for this.

Zoals ik in de beantwoording op vraag 2 en 3 aangaf past het bij de taak van de woningcorporatie om voor het beëindigen van de huurovereenkomst met huurders te kijken naar alternatieve woonruimte of hen te verwijzen naar een plek waar zij daar voor terecht kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opzegging van de overeenkomsten van de standplaatsen op het Vakantiepark Meerzicht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the termination of standplaats leases at Vakantiepark Meerzicht by new owner Europarcs, including the sharp notice, compensation, nature impacts and the wider buyout of holiday parks by private equity. The minister answered that the matter is primarily a private-law contract issue, that the government has commissioned a joint study with EZK due in Q2 2022, and that other questions fall to municipalities, provinces or the courts.
It is not for me, or for the Minister of EZK, to assess whether the landlord has complied with the agreements and conditions in this case.
Het is niet aan mij, of aan de Minister van EZK, om te beoordelen of de verhuurder zich in dit geval aan de afspraken en voorwaarden heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het coalitieakkoord

An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about rent increases amid high inflation, the coalition agreement's plans for income-dependent and phased rent rises, and related affordability risks. The minister answered that the 2022 social rent increase is capped at inflation (2.3%), that details of the coalition's rent measures will be worked out in a separate affordability programme, and that a full answer could not be given before the debate.
I will consider and work out the rent measures announced in the coalition agreement together, in the affordability programme under the National Housing and Construction Agenda.
Ik zal de in het coalitieakkoord aangekondigde huurmaatregelen in onderlinge samenhang bezien en uitwerken in het programma Betaalbaarheid onder de Nationale Wonen en Bouwen Agenda (NWBA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het Onderzoeksrapport inzake het faillissement van Flexenergie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the investigation report into the bankruptcy of energy supplier Flexenergie, including why the ACM did not intervene earlier, whether the supplier misused customer prepayments and tax money, whether revoking its licence would have been better, and what has changed in licensing and consumer protection. The minister defended the independent ACM, said it intervened in 2017 after completing its investigation, described the prepayment system, and pointed to planned Energiewet tightening of licence requirements and a study on consumer protection in supplier bankruptcies.
The ACM completed its investigation at the end of 2017 and decided to intervene at Flexenergie.
De ACM heeft haar onderzoek eind 2017 afgerond en besloten om in te grijpen bij Flexenergie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de 10.000 euro subsidie voor verbetering/verduurzaming van woningen in het gaswinningsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the 10,000 euro Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out of budget, why applicants queued for hours, and whether this was fair. The State Secretary admitted the budget was underestimated, added 250 million euro, acknowledged the queuing and technical problems, and committed to further review and a policy letter.
I informed your House on 14 January 2022 by letter that the cabinet is allocating an additional 250 million euro for this scheme.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 14 januari 2022 per brief («Benutting budget woningverbeteringssubsidie») gemeld dat het kabinet 250 miljoen euro extra voor deze regeling uittrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘versnellende factoren van de versterkingsoperatie die tot vertraging leiden’

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the government why the Groningen reinforcement operation remains delayed despite acceleration measures, asking about batch planning, contractor payments, the building-contractor pool, the Eigen Kiest Bouwer programme and the Tuikwerd typology approach. The State Secretary answered in detail with progress figures and plans for 2022, acknowledged some delays, and stated that residents would not have to invest their own money in reinforcement.
I am aware of delays within this project.
Ik ben op de hoogte van vertraging binnen dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het woonplan “Dijkzone” in Den Helder

An SP MP asked the government about the Dijkzone housing plan in Den Helder, built on a sea dike, and whether it accounts for sea-level rise and the Deltacommissaris's advice. The minister answered that the dike design assumes 3.5 m sea-level rise over 200 years, that responsibility lies with the water board, municipality and province, and that the project is still in feasibility study with no irreversible decisions taken.
It has therefore not yet been determined whether this housing plan can proceed.
Daarmee is nog niet vastgesteld of dit woonplan al dan niet doorgang kan vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Rechter: de beslissingen van de Minister zijn redelijk kort door de bocht'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Housing whether the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties may ignore tenants' interests when approving housing corporation sales to investors, and whether the authority checks residents' objections (zienswijzen) substantively. The Minister answers that tenant interests are not an approval criterion but are voiced through performance agreements and mandatory objections, that the authority only checks alignment with those agreements, and rejects a need for a new review.

It is up to local parties – municipality, housing corporations and tenant associations – to determine in consultation what the size, spread across neighbourhoods and composition of the social housing stock should be.

Het is aan lokale partijen – gemeente, woningcorporaties en huurdersverenigingen – om in overleg te bepalen wat de omvang, spreiding over wijken en buurten en samenstelling van de sociale woningvoorraad moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over faillissementen van energiebedrijven

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked about the bankruptcy of energy supplier Welkom Energie, its consumers' losses and whether consumers can be protected or compensated. The State Secretary answered that consumers are unsecured creditors, that compensation is impractical so general tax cuts were chosen, and that stricter supplier requirements and further research on protecting consumers are planned.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of data, the ACM cannot provide information on whether more energy suppliers are in acute financial trouble.
De ACM kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van gegevens geen informatie verstrekken of er meer energieleveranciers in acute financiële problemen verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de recorduitgaven aan de landsadvocaat

SP MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked why government spending on the state's lawyer (landsadvocaat) reached a record in 2020, how it is itemised, and how this squares with the aim of curbing juridification and with refusing legal aid to Groningen gas-damage victims. The minister explained the rise as incident-driven (COVID and Groningen litigation), itemised costs per ministry, and said legal aid for Groningen residents is being arranged through a novella while the state's own lawyer use is necessary and kept under scrutiny.
The cabinet is preparing for that with the state's lawyer.
Het kabinet bereidt zich daar met de landsadvocaat op voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van schade door de voormalige steenkoolwinning

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's criticism of how mining damage from former coal mining in Limburg is handled, and about the government's responsibility for aftercare. The minister answered that a structural arrangement with the region is being built, that the government aims to take the lead via the Commissie Mijnbouwschade and a public fund for time-barred damage, and that a project group will report in April 2022 while further steps depend on a new cabinet.

For damage caused by former coal mining, I am taking the lead, as stated in earlier letters, in that I am working on an independent, low-threshold, extrajudicial settlement by placing it, in line with the national approach to mining damage, with the Commissie Mijnbouwschade.

9 Voor de schade als gevolg van de voormalige steenkolenwinning neem ik, zoals in eerdere brieven 10 aangegeven, regie in de zin dat ik werk aan een onafhankelijke, laagdrempelige en buitengerechtelijke afhandeling door deze, in lijn met de landelijke aanpak voor afhandeling van mijnbouwschade, onder te brengen bij de Commissie Mijnbouwschade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “de zware gasbeving in Garrelsweer’’

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the ministers about the Garrelsweer gas-quake, the overrun of the seismic density threshold, schade-afhandeling delays at the IMG, the slow reinforcement operation and the Ombudsman's criticism. Minister Blok answers at length, largely defending the current approach, acknowledging delays and promising a further letter on seismic analyses and a law closing the Groningen field.
As SodM indicates, on 8 November, due to the magnitude 1.7 earthquake near Westeremden, one of the monitoring parameters, the earthquake density near Zeerijp, reached its highest level.

Zoals SodM aangeeft heeft op 8 november jl., door de aardbeving met magnitude 1,7 bij Westeremden, één van de monitoringsparameters, namelijk de aardbevingsdichtheid, nabij Zeerijp het hoogste niveau bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het varend ontgassen van kankerverwekkend gif

An SP MP asks the Infrastructure minister why the ban on in-transit gassing of carcinogenic cargo gases is not yet enforced, why a 2020 motion for a July 2020 ban was not executed, and why a map of permitted gassing routes exists. The minister replies that a national ban requires ratification of the CDNI convention by all parties, that enforcement is by the ILT with monitoring via e-noses, and that the sector will be engaged to reduce gassing in the meantime.
At Netherlands' initiative a national ban on in-transit gassing will come about on the basis of international agreements.
Op initiatief van Nederland gaat er een nationaal verbod op varend ontgassen komen op grond van internationale afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht “PUR-cowboys hebben vrij spel”

MPs asked the government about reports that spray PUR insulation is applied carelessly, the number of complaints, certification, worker protection and the reliability of the GGD protocol. The minister answered that compliance with rules and certification is the responsibility of companies and supervisors, promised an evaluation of work practice with a proposal in summer 2022, and provided complaint figures and an explanation of the protocol's funding.
With the evaluation of work practice I want to gain more insight into how regulations, rules and private certification are applied in practice.
Met de evaluatie van de werkpraktijk wil ik meer inzicht krijgen hoe de regelgeving, voorschriften en private certificering in de praktijk worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichtgeving over verzakte huizen aan het Stieltjeskanaal

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of homes sinking near the Stieltjeskanaal, where residents did not know where to turn for compensation, whether mining damage was recorded, how evidence of cause could be shown, and what would be done for those affected. The minister answered that liability depends on the cause, pointed to the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, municipal and national support channels, and a Fugro study in Emmen attributing the damage mainly to peat oxidation and subsidence rather than gas extraction, while promising no new concrete measures beyond existing programmes.
To determine who is liable for foundation damage, it is necessary to know the cause of the damage that has occurred.
Om te bepalen wie aansprakelijk is voor funderingsschade is het noodzakelijk de oorzaak van de ontstane schade te kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “het bericht dat vergelijkbare bevingsschades ongelijk beoordeeld worden”

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that comparable earthquake damage claims in Groningen are assessed inconsistently, and about the Wet Bewijsvermoeden Groningen, the IMG's assessment framework, the handling of secondary costs, and the Ombudsman's report. The minister acknowledges variation in assessments, defends the IMG's independence and the new framework, and largely declines to go beyond deferring to the IMG or the courts, while promising a separate letter on the Ombudsman's report.
The IMG is independent and itself determines, within the legal framework, its working method for handling damage.
Het IMG is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf binnen het wettelijk kader de werkwijze voor de afhandeling van schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over vervuild slib in de Kaliwaal

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about K3-Delta's plan to deposit PFAS-contaminated dredging sludge in the Kaliwaal depot, the drinking water risks, the applicable norms, and why the permit could not be refused. The State Secretary answered that the permits are still under review, that higher PFAS levels are acceptable at this site according to the province and Rijkswaterstaat, that the handling framework will be published after the summer recess, and that residents can object during the permit procedure.
Both the province and Rijkswaterstaat state that higher PFAS levels are indeed justified in this case.
Zowel de provincie als Rijkswaterstaat geven aan dat hogere PFAS-gehalten in dit geval inderdaad verantwoord zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Nieuwe werkwijze Huurcommissie onrechtmatig, huurders de dupe’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that the Huurcommissie's new working method of issuing summary chairman's rulings without hearings is unlawful and harms tenants, with questions on case numbers, waiting times, objection rates, budget, and tenants' rights. The minister rejects the claim of unlawfulness, states the method is legally based and reduces backlogs, reports objection rates around 28%, and declines structural changes such as a rent-check for the free sector or enforceable repair rights.
Applying the manifest chairman's ruling follows from the law and is not unlawful.
Het toepassen van de kennelijke voorzittersuitspraak volgt uit de wet en is niet onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden sociale huurwoningen in slechte staat en soms rijp voor de sloop’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tens of thousands of social rental homes are in poor condition, asking what the government will do, how corporations are supervised, the Huurcommissie waiting times, and whether an APK-style periodic inspection is warranted. The Minister acknowledges differences between corporations and points to prestatieafspraken, Aw supervision, Civil Code tenant rights and the Huurcommissie, but rejects a mandatory periodic inspection and automatic rent reductions, and largely disputes the data of specific corporations.
I am not in favour of a mandatory general periodic inspection for rental homes.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een verplichte algemene periodieke keuring voor huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het loten door SNN voor het verlenen van subsidie

MP Beckerman asked whether the lottery used by SNN to order applications for the Groningen earthquake-area home improvement subsidy is acceptable and whether everyone entitled will receive it. The minister explained that lotteries are a standard way to order same-day applications, but to avoid one, sufficient budget will be made available this year for complete applications received on the cap day, with decisions by 18 November 2021, and budgets for 2022 and 2023 will be merged.
Therefore I will ensure that sufficient budget becomes available this year for those who submitted a complete application on the day the subsidy ceiling is exceeded.
Daarom zal ik ervoor zorgdragen dat er voor degenen die een volledige aanvraag hebben gedaan op de dag van overschrijding van het subsidieplafond dit jaar al voldoende budget beschikbaar komt
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het ontbreken van wetgeving tegen hittestress bij diertransporten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why no legislation exists against heat stress during animal transport and how inspections can be strengthened. The minister answered that a plan of action on heat stress is being drafted, that existing rules and the national plan are enforced by the NVWA, that EU revision is expected, and that NVWA inspections and capacity are described.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse universiteiten weer overspoeld worden door buitenlandse studenten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked the ministers about students sleeping in tents, emergency shelters and on couches because of the student housing shortage, and what will be done for the coming academic year. The government answered that it is working with municipalities and housers through the national student housing action plan, that universities are not primarily responsible for housing, and that it cannot easily quantify homeless students.
It is difficult to establish how many students precisely have housing problems.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan hoeveel studenten precies problemen hebben met huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gezinnen die door Vestia uit de Tweebosbuurt verdreven worden

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether Vestia's eviction proceedings against families in the Tweebosbuurt, linked to RVV subsidy deadlines, were acceptable, and whether the UN rapporteurs' concerns and the earlier motion on resident consent were being followed. The minister answered that the matter is before the courts, that Vestia's reasons include housing, liveability and financial grounds, that a review of the RVV deadlines with Vestia will be held, and that the minister will not intervene in local consultation.
The case is now before the courts, so it is for the judge to rule on it.
Daarmee is de zaak nu onder de rechter en is het aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'opnieuw uitstel sloop en nieuwbouw in Ten Boer’

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Interior Minister about the gemeente Groningen's refusal to build further temporary replacement homes in Ten Boer, the resulting two-year wait for residents, budget and shortages per municipality, and the slow pace of the Groningen earthquake reinforcement. Minister Ollongren answers that 35 replacement homes are available, the works are phased, the NCG has budget for temporary housing, and the Rijk targets completion of assessments by end 2023 and reinforcement by 2028.
However, arranging replacement housing themselves proves complicated for many owners.
Het zelf regelen van de wisselwoningen blijkt voor veel eigenaren echter ingewikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over brandveiligheid en overbewoning

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety and overcrowding after a fatal fire at an overcrowded house in The Hague, including whether the municipality acted adequately and whether enforcement tools against malicious landlords are sufficient. The Minister answered that municipalities hold the enforcement powers, that current instruments are generally adequate, that the repetition requirement is expected to be dropped on 1 January 2022, and that a 'goed verhuurderschap' bill is in consultation, without assessing the municipality's conduct.
It is not for me to judge whether a municipality acted adequately in a case.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of een gemeente in een geval adequaat handelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over beleggers op de woningmarkt

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister of Interior about investors buying homes, Blackstone's rent increases, data on investor purchases and rental contracts, and whether tenants in the free rental sector need stronger protection and the government should regulate rents. The Minister confirms the Kadaster figures, defends investors as needed for housing supply, describes measures taken (opkoopbescherming, transfer tax differentiation, rent caps, a planned landlord permit), says some data is unavailable, and does not commit to new rent-control or tenant-rights measures beyond ongoing studies.
I see no possibilities to reliably provide the information you requested.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden betrouwbaar in de door u gevraagde informatie te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over nieuw gifschandaal in binnenvaart

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about a new phosphine gas incident on three inland vessels, prior warnings, prevention measures, who is responsible, and whether incidents with biocides have occurred. The government acknowledged the incident as unacceptable, explained the cause as non-compliance with existing rules for rail transport of fumigated cargo, and announced international proposals, a chain analysis due end-2021, and a criminal investigation led by police.
A criminal investigation is currently underway on the instruction of the Public Prosecutor, led by the national police unit.
Er loopt in opdracht van de Officier van Justitie nu een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waarin de landelijke eenheid van de politie de regie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het opkopen van vakantieparken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about buy-outs and transformation of holiday parks and campsites, including non-renewed leases, tenants' rights and municipal powers. The minister answered that data on the trend is not available, that the sector is market-driven, that parties must follow existing law, and that municipalities have planning and private-law instruments, while rejecting extending rent protection to recreational leases.
I cannot confirm that this trend exists, because the data are not available.
Ik kan niet bevestigen of er sprake is van bovengenoemde trend, omdat deze data niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over dat er negen jaar na de aardbeving bij Huizinge een chronische ramp gaande is in Groningen

An MP asks whether the Groningen earthquake reconstruction is delivering on its promises, given delays, unequal treatment of victims, and unresolved cases; the minister defends progress (more homes in works, a reconstruction target of 2028) but acknowledges delays, a missed 1 July deadline, and that some cases remain unclear. The government answers most questions on substance, promises letters and an intervention team, and withholds nothing material.
The previously communicated date of 1 July 2021 for the reinforcement advice to these residents was unfortunately not met.
De eerder gecommuniceerde datum van 1 juli 2021 voor het versterkingsadvies aan deze bewoners is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de subsidie Verduurzaming en Verbetering voor gedupeerden in Groningen, die binnen 5 dagen op is

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the 2021 budget for the Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out within five days and whether all eligible owners can be reached, including the number of eligible homes and the regimes in place. The ministers answer that the subsidy is phased over three years by design, that no legal entitlement exists, and that they will raise the ceiling via a Staatscourant amendment if needed, though they do not commit to extra funding now.
This year €75 million was available, for which more than 8,100 owners submitted an application.
Dit jaar was € 75 mln. beschikbaar, waar door meer dan 8.100 eigenaren een aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Baarle over de sloop van de Tweebosbuurt en de VN brief aan Rotterdam

MPs Beckerman and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Interior about the demolition of the Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam, the UN rapporteurs' communication alleging human rights violations, and resident participation. The minister answered that dialogue with the UN and the municipality continues, that the courts are handling the appeal on the demolition, and that housing policy is a matter for local authorities, declining to order an independent investigation or halt the demolition.
An appeal has currently been lodged in this case, so it is for the court to assess whether the residents have been sufficiently involved.
Op dit moment is in deze casus een hoger beroep ingesteld, het is daarom aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de bewoners voldoende zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de zoutwinning en lekkages bij Nedmag

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the 2018 brine leak and the approval of Nedmag's salt mining through 2045, including its risks to groundwater, subsidence, damage compensation and whether lessons from Groningen gas extraction apply. The minister replied that the leak was not foreseeable, that the approval set cavern volume and pressure limits and found groundwater risks negligible, and that an independent damage commission and a guarantee fund now cover claims, while rejecting a separate fund and a statutory burden-of-proof reversal outside Groningen.
From 1 November 2021 people with damage can report to the Mining Damage Committee, which will assess the damage.
Vanaf 1 november 2021 kunnen mensen met schade zich melden bij de Commissie Mijnbouwschade die de schade zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de fatale brand in Arnhem en lessen voor brandveiligheid

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about the fatal Arnhem flat fire, fire-safety supervision of existing buildings, single-escape-route flats, and fire safety of mattresses and upholstered furniture. The minister said she will respond to the Onderzoeksraad recommendations within six months, await an IFV study due in October, and promised further consultation with municipalities and building owners, but did not commit to specific new regulation.
I am going to talk with municipalities and building owners about this supervision.
Ik ga in gesprek met gemeenten en gebouweigenaren over dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about inadequate compensation for homeowners harmed by works on the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, and whether this resembles the childcare benefits and Groningen gas-extraction affairs. The minister replied that the Rijk has no control over the canal, that the province is responsible for the compensation scheme and related procedures, and declined to take a substantive position or any role beyond expressing regret.
Because the central government has no control over this canal, I cannot give a substantive judgement on the situation.
Omdat het Rijk geen zeggenschap heeft over dit kanaal, kan ik geen inhoudelijk oordeel geven over de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid van gebouwen in Nederland

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior why fire safety of buildings has still not been fully mapped nearly four years after Grenfell, and questioned provinces' and municipalities' handling of the inventory, including municipalities that have not reported. The Minister answers that provinces and municipalities have policy discretion, that an inventory is being completed with a follow-up survey of 80 municipalities this year, and that she will inform the House at year end.
Provinces have policy discretion over how interadministrative supervision is given shape.
Provincies hebben beleidsvrijheid hoe aan het interbestuurlijke toezicht vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het Meldpunt huurtoeslag van de Woonbond

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked about the Woonbond's housing benefit complaints line and the tax authority's handling of housing, care and child benefit cases, including wrongful intent/gross negligence labels. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, estimated about 500 affected citizens in comparable cases, and said a compensation scheme is being prepared, with acute cases able to apply for emergency support now.
These reports confirm the need for a restoration scheme.
Deze meldingen bevestigen de noodzaak van een herstelregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over winsten die worden gemaakt met publiek geld voor verduurzaming

SP MPs asked the government about private profits from publicly subsidised wind and solar, electricity bills, overcompensation under the SDE+ scheme, and the Court of Audit's findings. The State Secretary maintained that overwinsten are limited by the tender design and PBL cost estimates, committed to a new evaluation and to monitoring participation, but refused to quantify private profits and rejected socialising renewable energy.
I have no direct insight into the amount of private profit made with SDE+ subsidies.
Ik heb geen direct inzicht in de hoeveelheid private winst die is gemaakt met SDE+-subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het lozen van verontreinigd water boven Schiermonnikoog

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about discharge of contaminated produced water and drill cuttings into the North Sea about 20 km from Schiermonnikoog, including environmental effects, methanol use, reinjection options, and calls to align with stricter German rules. The minister answered that SodM's advice led to a condition requiring evaluation of discharged water after three years, that the EIA found limited effects, and that he saw no need to refuse the permits or adopt German standards.
I adopted SodM's advice by including these conditions as a requirement in the environmental permit for the platform.
Het advies van SodM heb ik overgenomen door deze voorwaarden op te nemen als voorschrift bij de omgevingsvergunning voor het platform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety of buildings after the Grenfell fire, including the lack of an inventory of risky buildings, the status of municipal inventories and provincial oversight, and whether municipalities can be compelled to act. The Minister answered that most provinces and municipalities are progressing, that municipalities have policy discretion but are expected to complete the inventory, and that results will be sent to parliament by end 2021.
I asked the provinces to indicate what actions they have taken following my request.
Ik heb de provincies verzocht om aan te geven welke acties zij hebben ondernomen naar aanleiding van mijn verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ziek worden door luchtvervuiling

An MP asked the ministers whether the government will act on children's health harm from air pollution, including around Tata Steel in IJmuiden, and on oversight and enforcement of industrial emissions. The state secretary answered that the Clean Air Accord targets 50% health gain by 2030, that monitoring and enforcement lie largely with the province and environmental services, and that a plan on the VTH enforcement advisory report will follow from the next cabinet.
It is up to the competent authorities and environmental services to ensure, in their permitting, that emissions remain within the norms
Het is aan de bevoegde gezagen en omgevingsdiensten om in hun vergunningverlening er op toe te zien dat uitstoot binnen de normen blijft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over studentenwoningen niet meetellen als sociale huurwoningen

An SP MP asked whether student housing should count as social rental housing, citing Rotterdam's practice, rising waiting times and high rents in projects like Our Domain and Lee Towers. The minister answered that dwellings meeting the social rental criteria may be counted even when let to students, that monitoring them as a separate category is preferable, and that the choice of monitoring method rests with municipalities.
That is why municipalities may count student housing as social rental housing in their monitoring, including the municipality of Rotterdam.
Daarom kunnen gemeenten studentenwoningen in hun monitoring meetellen als sociale huurwoningen, ook de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'de belofte van het kabinet dat de versterking nu echt op stoom komt en de uitvoering van het bestuursakkoord'

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the government whether its promise that reinforcement of Groningen homes is finally gaining momentum is credible, whether the budget for batch 1588 is sufficient, and how the 2020 Bestuursakkoord (governance agreement) is being implemented across its blocks and categories. Minister Ollongren answers at length that implementation is progressing, that the amendment-Beckerman on restoring living space is being worked out with municipalities and NCG, and that various regulations, funds and plans are in preparation, but gives few firm figures on outcomes.
On the additional costs I am in consultation with municipalities, the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) and the housing corporations.
Over de meerkosten ben ik met gemeenten, de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) en de woningcorporaties in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over artikel over sloop in de Groningse Schildersbuurt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the loss of historic interiors and chimneys in the Groningen Schildersbuurt due to conversions of student rooms into self-contained flats and demolition, asking about protection options, extent of the problem and municipal tools. The minister answered that the area is a protected townscape where only exteriors are largely protected, that about 41 conversions and 60 demolition notifications occurred, that municipalities have some tools but no watertight solution, and that simplifying monument procedures is not needed.
The municipality of Groningen is not aware whether chimneys or stained glass specifically have been demolished in the Schildersbuurt.
Het is de gemeente Groningen niet bekend of er specifiek schoorstenen of glas-in-lood in de Schildersbuurt zijn gesloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het oprichten van een wooncoöperatie in de Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why housing corporation Vestia refuses to cooperate with tenants of the Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam who want to form a residents' cooperative to prevent demolition, and how this fits the cabinet's aim to expand cooperatives. The minister answered that the initiative does not meet the Housing Act definition (eight scattered homes, not five neighbouring units forming a unit), that corporations are not obliged to sell, and that the ministry supports cooperative initiatives via Platform31.
Although the Housing Act imposes no restrictions on initiatives wishing to set up a housing cooperative, the housing corporation is not obliged to sell the homes to the initiative.
Hoewel de Woningwet geen beperkingen oplegt aan initiatieven die een wooncoöperatie wensen op de richten is de woningcorporatie niet verplicht om de woningen aan het initiatief te verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over bewoners die na een verwoestende brand in een door gaswinning onveilige woning nu alles kwijt zijn

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about a family whose Groningen house, damaged by gas-extraction earthquakes and vacated in 2017, burned down in 2020, leaving them with no compensation or replacement home, and whether the government will ensure restitution and limit prolonged legal battles. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, said liability must be assessed case by case, pointed to NCG and IMG support and meetings with affected residents, and gave no concrete new commitment.
However, we do not make statements about the details of individual situations.
Wij doen echter geen mededelingen over de details van individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘’belemmerende factoren voor een rechtvaardig herstel van kapotte en onveilige huizen’’

An SP MP asked the ministers about obstacles to fair repair of damaged and unsafe houses in Groningen caused by gas extraction, covering the evidential presumption, KNMI measurement errors, backlogs, foundation damage and value-loss compensation. The minister answered that the independent IMG handles claims under the statutory presumption, is working to speed up processing and refine its approach, and that the measurement errors had no effect on damage handling.
The IMG applies the statutory evidential presumption and uses the report of the expert panel the IMG commissioned in 2019.
Het IMG past het wettelijke bewijsvermoeden toe en gebruikt hierbij het rapport van het panel van deskundigen dat het IMG in 2019 heeft uitgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over ‘de compensatie van Shell en Exxon voor het verlagen van de gaswinning’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil received at least 1.5 billion euros in compensation for the Groningen gas closure, and pressed on the NAM's payments for damage and reinforcement costs, the stuwmeer scheme, the Norg storage dispute and possible taxation of the oil companies. The minister denied the 1.5 billion figure, said the profit-split change was about 1.3 billion for 2018-2023 but much lower in practice, and explained the cost recovery from NAM and the ongoing arbitration, while declining to disclose commercially confidential information and promising to inform parliament on a levy.
All agreements with Shell, ExxonMobil or the NAM are public, except for commercially confidential information.
Alle overeenkomsten met Shell, ExxonMobil of de NAM zijn, behoudens bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de voorgenomen verkoop van het gemeentelijk recreatieoord Hoek van Holland

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Minister of Interior about the planned sale or long lease of Rotterdam's municipal recreation park at Hoek van Holland, tenant rights, consultation, and whether the municipality should keep it in public hands.
