The Minister answered that the decision is the municipality's competence, that existing tenancy contracts transfer to a new landlord, and that the Rijk has no role or intention to intervene.
As Minister of BZK I have no role or competence in this matter.
Als Minister van BZK heb ik in deze kwestie geen rol of bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de enorme ambities van Vermillion

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Vermilion's gas extraction plan under Burgum (11.5 billion cubic metres), its compatibility with the energy transition, timing and criteria of the decision, subsidence compensation, a presumption of causation for damage, why the plan was not public, and fracking. The minister answered that the plan is still in advisory procedure with a decision expected at least two months away, that gas remains needed, that a Commission Mijnbouwschade handles damage claims, that a statutory presumption of causation is not justified outside Groningen, and that the plan was published on signing the draft decision under the standard procedure.
The extraction plan is still in the first phase of the procedure in which I request advice from the statutory advisers.
Het winningsplan zit nog in de eerste fase van de procedure waarin ik advies vraag aan de wettelijk adviseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de virtuele verkoop van groene stroom aan Amazon

MPs Beckerman and Van Gerven asked about the virtual sale of green electricity guarantees from Dutch offshore wind to Amazon, and whether this undermines climate goals, public subsidies and transparency. The minister explains that guarantees of origin are an administrative instrument, that Dutch wind power mainly serves Dutch consumers, and that overviews of certificate trade are published by CertiQ, though some data are aggregated for confidentiality.
This overview does provide aggregated volumes, due to commercially confidential information.
Dit overzicht biedt wel geaggregeerde volumes in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport van Gronings Perspectief over Voortgang en voetangels in het gaswinningsdossiers, Professionals over een complex systeem

An MP asked the ministers about a Groningen Perspectief report finding that officials and professionals in the gas-extraction file are overburdened by a fragmented, complex system. The minister reports that NAM has no role in damage handling or reinforcement, outlines existing channels, the reinforcement bill and communication measures, and largely states that existing processes are sufficient without committing to a structural change.

It is of great importance that the central government, the region, experts, the House and civil society organisations remain in constant contact to reach the best possible solutions for the situation in Groningen.

Het is van groot belang dat Rijk, regio, experts, Kamer en maatschappelijke organisaties voortdurend met elkaar in contact blijven om tot de best mogelijke oplossingen voor de situatie in Groningen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die na sloop/nieuwbouw niet terug kunnen naar hun oude plek

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether tenants in the Groningen gas-field area who must be rehoused after demolition can return to their old neighbourhood at the same size, and why some are being offered smaller homes or homes elsewhere. The minister answered that corporations talk individually with each tenant, aim for a suitable home and same-street return where possible, but cannot always rebuild exactly what stood before, and that all corporations follow the same approach.
It is not always possible to rebuild exactly what stood there.
Het is niet altijd mogelijk exact terug te bouwen wat er stond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het winnen van gas onder Spijkenisse

An MP asked the minister about gas extraction under Spijkenisse, including delayed seismic monitoring stations, reported tremors, damage claims and information for residents. The minister answered that the stations were installed and connected, no earthquakes were registered, and that a compensation commission and a risk management plan exist.
I have already stipulated in the approval decision that the measuring station must be placed and connected to the KNMI network by 13 January 2021.
Ik heb reeds in het instemmingsbesluit vastgelegd dat het meetstation voor 13 januari 2021 geplaatst en aangesloten dient te zijn op het KNMI-netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over koolmonoxide vergiftigingen door onveilige cv-ketel

MP Beckerman asked the government about a carbon monoxide poisoning incident in Amsterdam-Oost and the safety of AGPO Ferroli boilers, including recall warnings, certification, and enforcement. The minister answered that the incident was not caused by a defective Ferroli boiler but by improper reinstallation of a flue after maintenance, that Ferroli had issued warnings, and that new certification rules apply from 2022.
The carbon monoxide poisoning turns out not to have been caused by a defective boiler, but by the flue duct not being carefully reinstalled after maintenance.
De koolmonoxidevergiftiging blijkt niet veroorzaakt te zijn door een defecte cv-ketel, maar doordat het rookgasafvoerkanaal na onderhoud niet zorgvuldig werd teruggeplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten in verloederde huizen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior about a landlord repeatedly linked to exploiting migrant workers and letting dilapidated housing, and about how municipalities and the government can prevent such landlords moving between municipalities. The Minister answered that enforcement lies mainly with municipalities, pointed to a regional pilot, knowledge sharing, planned tools such as a landlord permit and a blacklist review, and promised further letters including a government response to the migrant worker task force.
Enforcement of these abuses lies with the municipalities concerned themselves.
De handhaving van deze misstanden ligt bij de betrokken gemeenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs ask why owners of homes slated for demolition or rebuilding are excluded from the Groningen home-value-loss compensation, why some applications are rejected, why residents in some postcode areas or who moved away are excluded, and whether NAM-compensated residents can get reassessment. The minister answers that the IMG applies a methodology based on advisory committee advice, that demolished/rebuilt homes are generally assessed as having gained value, that rejections follow legal limits, that a 2021 external review of past NAM settlements is planned, and that most decisions meet the 8-week deadline.
I have informed your House that, to give a well-founded answer on whether residents have been treated justly, I will request an independent assessment based on research by an external party.

Ik heb uw Kamer inmiddels meegedeeld (Kamerstuk 33 529, nr. 832 ) dat ik, om een goed onderbouwd antwoord te kunnen geven op de vraag of bewoners recht is gedaan, een onafhankelijk oordeel zal vragen op basis van onderzoek door een externe partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de reactie van de Europese Ombudsman op de gunning van een onderzoeksopdracht aan BlackRock door de Europese Commissie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance Minister how he views the European Ombudsman's finding of serious shortcomings in controlling conflicts of interest around BlackRock's award of a sustainable finance advisory contract by the European Commission. The minister replied that the Ombudsman found no maladministration, that the Commission should strengthen its procurement framework, and that he will encourage the Commission to act and inform the House.
I will encourage the European Commission in the relevant bodies to take this up promptly and ask how it intends to take forward the Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie in de relevante gremia aanmoedigen dit voortvarend op te pakken en vragen hoe zij voornemens is de aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman verder te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onwenselijke sloopplannen van de Peperstraat in Zaandam

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about plans to demolish the Peperstraat in Zaandam, including resident participation, relocation of tenants, the consideration of renovation, and whether the project falls under the woningbouwimpuls subsidy. The minister answered that the redevelopment is part of a wider area plan with participation via information meetings and a klankbordgroep, that a social plan covers relocation, and that the subsidy assessment followed the standard procedure, while leaving assessment of participation and communication largely to the municipality.
Giving a judgment on this is not for me. The municipality makes its own choice that suits the specific situation.
Een oordeel hierover geven is niet aan mij. De gemeente maakt daarin de eigen keuze die past bij de specifieke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het uitblijven van een vervolgingsbeslissing in de strafzaak tegen de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked why the public prosecutor has still not decided on prosecuting the NAM five years after the Groninger Bodem Beweging filed its complaint, despite the investigation being completed in September 2019, and whether the delay amounts to a de facto refusal to prosecute. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the investigation and assessment were complex, that the NAM's response period and COVID-19 caused further delay, and that the prosecution service will publish its outcome and position soon, while declining to comment on the Court of Appeal's findings or on the merits of pending decisions.

Moreover, the prosecution service has informed me that it will soon make the outcome of the investigation public, and at that point the position the prosecution service takes in this case will also be made public.

Overigens heeft het OM mij bericht dat zij binnen afzienbare tijd naar buiten komen met de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en dan zal tevens het standpunt dat het OM in deze zaak inneemt, naar buiten worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over mijn eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen over een zinkgat in Kerkrade

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Ploumen pressed the minister on who is liable for damage from a sinkhole in Kerkrade, whether the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade had been contacted, whether residents were informed of risks, whether 12 people lived in the adjacent building, and what lessons were learned. The minister answered that the Waarborgfonds is liable for mining damage to private persons, that no structural damage to homes has been found, that the municipality handles communication, that the adjacent building was unoccupied apart from a foundation's use, and that lessons will be discussed after remediation finishes in June 2021.
Some time after the shaft is tapped, remediation of the shaft begins.
Vervolgens wordt enige tijd na het aanboren van de schacht de sanering aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht 'De beladen bunker van Seyss-Inquart kwijnt weg'

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the deteriorating Seyss-Inquart bunker, a national monument, and how to protect it during its sale, including maintenance duties, heritage protection against unsuitable buyers, and whether stricter conditions can be imposed. The minister answered that maintenance continues, the sale is planned to conclude by end 2021, existing heritage law and zoning rules are sufficient protection, and additional conditions are being considered.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has carried out the necessary maintenance in recent years and will continue to do so until transfer to a new owner.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) heeft de afgelopen jaren het nodige instandhoudingsonderhoud gepleegd en zal dit ook tot de overdracht aan een nieuwe eigenaar blijven plegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over Vestia en de huurverlaging

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about Vestia's rent policy, its WSW sanitation constraints, the Social Rent Accord rent cut, and the transfer tax increase for housing corporations. The minister answered that Vestia may freeze or lower rents within the sanitation framework, that a mandatory rent reduction applies to Vestia tenants from 1 January 2021, and that a structural solution will be reported before year-end, while declining to offer specific compensation.
As promised in the committee meeting of 9 November 2020, I will inform the House before the end of the year about the steps I am taking to ensure a solution is on the table next year.

Zoals toegezegd in het WGO Wonen en Ruimte van 9 november 2020, informeer ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar over de stappen die ik neem om te zorgen dat er volgend jaar een oplossing op tafel komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het agressief incassobeleid bij woningcorporatie De Key

The SP MP Beckerman asks the Minister of the Interior about De Key housing corporation's automated letters threatening bailiffs over disputed 2020 rent increases, and about tenants' rights to object. The Minister says objecting tenants should not receive payment reminders while proceedings run, describes the rappel procedure and cooperation with municipalities, and refers to ongoing work and information websites, without giving data on objections or on sector-wide practice.
I do not have an overview of the extent to which the over 2.2 million households in the social rental sector have objected to the rent increase effective 1 July.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht in hoeverre de ruim 2,2 miljoen huishoudens in de sociale huursector bezwaar hebben aangetekend tegen de huurverhoging per 1 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd 2.0

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about residents of Groningen gas-field villages facing demolition and rebuilding of houses with limited choice, unfair treatment of owners who lost upgrades, and the fairness of differing 'regie' under the Bouwakkoord. The minister defended the process, admitted that individual wishes and upgrades cannot be fully guaranteed under current building rules, and promised to explore agreements to speed up reinforcement.
I am aware that residents of the earthquake region may experience stress and uncertainty as a result of gas extraction.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat bewoners van de aardbevingsregio door de gevolgen van de gaswinning stress en onzekerheid kunnen ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd”

An SP MP asks the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about unequal treatment of residents of Overschild (Groningen) across three reinforcement batches, including differing subsidies, delays, and damage handling. The minister confirms the statements and admits some unexplainable differences are unavoidable, promising talks with the region and a clarifying update soon.
Although I agree with you that it is important to prevent differences where possible, especially at neighbourhood level, this is unfortunately unavoidable.
Hoewel ik met u deel dat het van belang is om waar mogelijk verschillen te voorkomen, zeker op wijkniveau, is dit helaas onvermijdelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de causaliteit van schade en gaswinning

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether earthquake damage in Groningen can be linked to gas extraction even far from the epicentre, and questions the IMG's decision to pause claims in part of the area. The minister says the IMG is independent, applies the statutory presumption of causation, and has temporarily suspended decisions on about 1,250 claims pending expert advice on subsidence, while answering several questions only partly or with reference to other bodies.
The IMG applies the presumption of evidence and will continue to apply the presumption of evidence in the future.
Het IMG past het bewijsvermoeden toe en blijft het bewijsvermoeden in de toekomst toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond laagfrequent geluid bij windturbines

SP MPs asked why, despite RIVM findings on low-frequency wind turbine noise, no additional noise or distance norms exist, and whether health studies and a community-inclusive knowledge platform will follow. The government answered that current Dutch noise norms are adequate, that no distance norm or separate low-frequency norm is needed, that a health study will be explored with RIVM, and that existing platforms already represent residents.
Yes, the current norm assumes a serious nuisance rate of about 9% at the maximum permissible noise load.
Ja, de huidige normering gaat uit van een percentage ernstige hinder van ongeveer 9% bij de maximaal toelaatbare geluidbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een huisuitzetting van een huurder die herstellend is van corona

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a planned eviction of a corona-recovering tenant on 15 September 2020, the court's appeal timing, and how this fits the sector's pledge to avoid evictions during the pandemic. The minister answered that the eviction was suspended after a summary proceeding, that the pledge covered only arrears-based evictions and this case stemmed from a pre-corona ruling, and that she remains in talks with landlord organisations on preventing evictions.
It is up to the judge to rule on individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Smeulders en Nijboer over huisuitzettingen in de tweede coronagolf

MPs Beckerman, Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about evictions of antikraak residents during the second COVID wave, a possible ban on evictions, a rehousing guarantee, and renewed agreements with landlords. The Minister said a general eviction ban is not desirable, that courts should weigh individual cases, that a case was resolved by alternative housing, and that the earlier agreements remain in force with some landlord associations and municipalities.
A general ban on evictions is not considered desirable by the cabinet.
Een algeheel verbod op huisuitzettingen acht het kabinet niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over een sinkhole in Kerkrade

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a sinkhole in Kerkrade caused by sanitising an old mine shaft, covering instability, funding, liability, resident information, lessons learned and damage to neighbouring homes. The minister answered that the shaft is being sanitised, funded through a 12 million euro package, that damage claims go to the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade, and that the municipality is monitoring nearby homes, with a follow-up consultation planned.
After the remediation, this historic shaft will be stabilised and safe.
Na de sanering is deze historische schacht gestabiliseerd en veilig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Absurditeit op Amsterdamse huizenmarkt: mini-hotelkamer te huur als woning'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a 6 m2 'long stay' hotel room offered as housing for 799 euro a month falls under tenancy protection, whether it meets the Building Decree, and what will be done to protect students. The minister answered that hotel use is a separate legal category, that tenancy protection applies only to housing and courts decide, that the Amsterdam municipality must check the Building Decree, and that the government opposes hotel housing as the norm while working on a national student housing plan.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to determine whether there is regular rent.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van reguliere huur.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de NAM die geen bemoeienis meer heeft in afhandeling van de bevingsschade

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's claim that it has finished handling Groningen earthquake damage claims, including whether old claims are settled, pending lawsuits, vouchers, and disputes over payments. The Minister replies that all 6,199 old claims have been offered settlements and arbiter rulings followed, with about 25 cases still before the civil courts and some payment disputes ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht: 'Minister die niet reageert op omstreden vertrekpremie directeur woningcorporatie Woonbron'

MPs Beckerman asked the minister why she had not responded to reports that housing corporation Woonbron's 2019 annual report still defended a severance payment to its former director as lawful. The minister replied that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties had already reacted to Woonbron, that Woonbron has since disavowed the wording and committed to the government's policy, and that a separate letter from the minister was unnecessary.
Woonbron indeed placed the following statement on its website on 3 September, after the Aw's reaction referred to in the answer to question 1.
Woonbron heeft namelijk na de in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangehaalde reactie van de Aw op 3 september het volgende bericht op haar website geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de grootste vervuilers amper betalen aan klimaatbeleid

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether heavy industry pays too little for climate policy while SMEs and households fund subsidies that benefit major emitters, and asked about ending industrial energy-tax exemptions. The minister rejected the premise, arguing heavy industry does pay through the ODE levy and the CO2 levy, that exemptions protect competitiveness pending EU reform, and that the 2020 levy shift relieves households and SMEs.
The cabinet welcomes this reform, because it may offer room to limit specific exemptions for companies or sectors, while preserving a level playing field.
Het kabinet verwelkomt deze hervorming, omdat die ruimte kan bieden om specifieke uitzonderingen voor bedrijven of sectoren te beperken, met behoud van het gelijke speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de nieuwe vertragingen van de versterking

An SP MP asked the Interior and Health ministers about new delays in the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation, payment and negotiation problems with contractors, and health and trust impacts on residents. The Interior Minister acknowledges delays partly caused by COVID-19 measures, says the policy itself is unchanged, and gives partial answers, withholding commercial details and deferring some matters to the NCG and municipalities.
NCG makes no statement on the content of these negotiations because of commercially sensitive information and because a statement could affect the negotiations.
Over de inhoud van deze onderhandelingen doet NCG geen uitspraak in verband met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en het feit dat een uitspraak hierover de onderhandelingen kan beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Zonneparken: goud voor de ontwikkelaars, nauwelijks verdiensten voor inwoners’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether residents benefit from solar park profits and whether the SDE+ subsidy and levy shift undermine public support, and asked about foreign ownership, unfair climate policy, and shared ownership targets. The minister answered that participation agreements in the Climate Agreement are being implemented, that SDE+ covers only the unprofitable top with a reasonable return, that foreign ownership cannot be controlled under EU rules, and that a participation monitor and a 50% local ownership target are being pursued.
Data on solar parks owned by foreign shareholders is not available to me, and it is also not possible to verify this.
Gegevens over zonneparken die in handen van buitenlandse aandeelhouders zijn, heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking en het is ook niet mogelijk om dit te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de gevolgen voor huurders tijdens en na gedwongen verhuizing

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about who is eligible for moving-cost compensation when tenants must relocate for reinforcement works, the timeline, the handling of disputes that force residents to court, and the health complaints about indoor climate in upgraded homes. The Minister answered that new arrangements to equalise compensation for tenants and owners and a one-off allowance for tenants are planned to take effect on 1 October 2020, that the aim is to prevent court cases, and that the GGD Groningen has not started the research referred to, while the Health Council advice will be answered in autumn.

The intention is to bring into effect on 1 October the arrangements aimed at equalising, as far as possible, compensation for owners and tenants in the reinforcement programme, as well as the allowance scheme.

Het voornemen is om de afspraken die toezien op het zoveel als mogelijk gelijktrekken van vergoedingen voor eigenaren en huurders in de versterkingsopgave alsmede de tegemoetkomingsregeling per 1 oktober aanstaande in te laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de drie aardbevingen in Groningen de afgelopen week

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about three earthquakes in Groningen, the response to affected residents, damage claims backlogs at the IMG, COVID-related delays, reinforcement operations and a new norm. The minister replied that gas extraction will end around 2022, that damage handling and reinforcement are ongoing with a six-month target, that a new norm will be applied from 1 September 2020, and that the government is consulting the region, but he declined to answer the questions in the one-week timeframe requested.
The IMG is an independent administrative body and determines its own working method for handling damage claims.
Het IMG is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en bepaalt zijn eigen werkwijze voor de afhandeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de projecten ‘Heft in Eigen Hand’ en ‘Eigen Initiatief’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Heft in Eigen Hand and Eigen Initiatief programmes, where Groningen residents organise their own earthquake-strengthening work, and reports of stalled projects, pressure from building supervisors, budget cuts and unclear rules. The Minister denied that projects are widely stuck, said 26 addresses are complete, acknowledged some interpretation differences and a reduced temporary housing allowance, and committed to talks with residents and to informing parliament on a motion.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the implementation of this motion.
Ik informeer uw Kamer zo snel mogelijk over de uitvoering van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de olieprijs die onder nul dollar zakt

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the oil price falling below zero, and how this affects gas and oil operators, mine damage compensation, safety, decommissioning, workers, Vermilion's liabilities and EBN. The minister answered that the Dutch oil sector is small, that the government does not guarantee compensation for residents but the Commissie Mijnbouwschade handles claims, that safety and decommissioning are secured through supervision and financial security, and that workers' retraining is a matter for the sector itself.

The government does not guarantee compensation for residents, but as I indicated in my letter of 9 June 2020, I ensure a low-threshold, transparent and expert handling of damage by the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, which takes on the burden of proof.

De overheid staat niet garant voor schadeloosstelling van omwonenden, maar zoals ik mijn brief van 9 juni 2020 heb aangegeven zorg ik voor een laagdrempelige, transparante en deskundige afhandeling van schade door de Commissie Mijnbouwschade die de bewijslast oppakt.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over onterechte huurverhogingen door foutieve huishoudverklaringen door de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked how 932 household statements with a wrong AOW age led to unlawful higher rent increases, and what happens if landlords do not reverse them. The government answered that the error stemmed from an outdated parameter in software, that the Tax Authority informed landlords and tenants by letter and phone, and that reversing increases is the landlord's responsibility under civil rental law.
The Tax Authority is not leaving it to the tenants.
De Belastingdienst laat het niet over aan de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over maatwerk voor huurders bij Vestia in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about Vestia's limited investment in tenant housing (mould, maintenance), rent increases, maximum rent hikes and the non-use of rent relief, and whether the government would act on tenant hardship and the 2014 rescue support. The Minister answered that Vestia is not barred from investing, that a 10-year programme of EUR 886 million for existing stock is planned, that remedial duties apply under good landlordship, and that monitoring of rent increases is possible but a full administration is not warranted.
It is incorrect that Vestia may no longer make any investments.
Het is onjuist dat Vestia geen investeringen meer mag doen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de waardedalingsregeling in het Groninger aardbevingsgebied

An MP asks the minister why the Groningen waardedaling (value-loss) compensation scheme uses a 20% postcode threshold, excludes people who lost out via NAM settlements, and disadvantages residents outside the core area. The minister answers that the independent IMG chose the Atlas voor Gemeenten method on expert advice, that the 20% figure is a result of the research rather than a condition, and that IMG sets its own procedures, so no direct change is promised.
I would like to emphasise the independence of the IMG.
Ik benadruk hier graag de onafhankelijkheid van het IMG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over kortingen aan verhuurders op de verhuurderheffing in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior why the discount on the rental levy does not check rent development after first tenant turnover, despite the aim of keeping social rentals affordable long-term, and why a 10-year commitment was used for the Rotterdam Parlando project. The minister replies that the subsidy is checked at the starting rent, that turnover is rare and liberalisation limited, that random post-completion rent checks by RVO are planned with possible withdrawal of the discount, and that the Ministry was not party to the 10-year agreement.
In addition, random checks will soon be started on the rents of homes realised with the help of a levy reduction.
Daarnaast zal er binnenkort ook gestart worden met het steekproefsgewijs opvragen van de huren van woningen die zijn gerealiseerd met behulp van een heffingsvermindering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de versterking in Groningen

An MP asks the Interior Minister about slow and inconsistent handling of earthquake reinforcement (versterking) in Groningen, including rejected inspection requests, homeowners in the programme unaware of it, unreported inspections, and delayed P50 advice. The minister answers that 330 of 523 on-request inspections were granted, explains the procedures and capacity targets, and says full assessments of all buildings by end 2020 are not feasible.
As soon as a resident-friendly reinforcement advice is available, the owner concerned will be contacted about it.
Zodra een bewonersvriendelijk versterkingsadvies beschikbaar is, wordt daarover contact opgenomen met de betreffende eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de uitspraak van de Raad van State die zegt dat mijnschade niet verjaard is

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Council of State ruling that Groningen... Limburg mining damage claims are not time-barred, asking about compensation timelines, the Guarantee Fund, notification of homeowners, the Commission for Mining Damage, and whether the statute of limitations should be abolished. Minister Wiebes answered that the ruling complicates the planned public pre-financed fund, that compensation will be paid and a new decision on devaluation taken within 12 weeks, that the Guarantee Fund is sufficiently filled, and that the Commission for Mining Damage is targeted to start on 1 July 2020, while declining to abolish the limitation period.
I see no reason to abolish the statute of limitations for mining damage.
Voor het afschaffen van de verjaringstermijn bij mijnbouwschade zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Smeulders en Beckerman over het tijdelijk bevriezen van huurprijzen

MPs Nijboer, Smeulders and Beckerman asked how the minister will implement the Senate motion to temporarily freeze rents in both the free and social sectors, and whether housing corporations should be compensated for lost rent. The minister answered that a general freeze is not proportionate or timely, relies on case-by-case maatwerk, a complaints desk at the Huurcommissie, monitoring, and a decision in August, and will table a separate bill on temporary rent reductions.
Capping or generally postponing the rent increases customarily applied on 1 July does not reflect proper governance, for two reasons.
Het nu maximeren of generiek uitstellen van de huurverhogingen die gebruikelijk plaats vindt op 1 juli getuigt niet van behoorlijk bestuur, vanwege twee redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over stijgende huurprijzen in het geliberaliseerde huursegment

MP Beckerman asked the minister about rising rents in the liberalised rental sector, whether a rent cap or a tenant right to the rent committee should be introduced, and about a planned 'emergency button' for middle-income rents. The minister acknowledged affordability pressure but said rent increases are easing, estimated about 82,200 liberalised-sector renters wish to buy, argued mortgage and rent affordability tests are comparable, and committed to a bill capping annual rent increases at inflation plus 2.5%, while rejecting broader regulation.
I aim to present the bill to your House as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar het wetsvoorstel zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer te presenteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het feit dat vermogensbeheerder BlackRock de Europese Commissie gaat voorzien van advies over duurzaamheidsbeleid bij bankenbeleid op Europees niveau

SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why the European Commission chose BlackRock, a major investor in fossil fuel companies, to advise on ESG and sustainability in bank regulation, and whether this is a conflict of interest. Minister Hoekstra answered that the contract was awarded through a transparent public tender with nine bids, that expert input is customary, that the Netherlands as a Council member will co-decide EU legislation, and that he sees no reason to intervene in the procurement.
The European Commission awarded the research assignment through a public tender procedure.
De Europese Commissie heeft de onderzoeksopdracht uitgezet via een openbare aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over kortingen aan verhuurders op de verhuurderheffing

Labour MP Beckerman asked whether housing-association rent reductions on the landlord levy (RVV) produced permanent affordable homes, how long rents must stay regulated, whether Vestia's Tweebosbuurt project abuses the scheme, and whether the levy should be abolished. Minister Knops gave detailed counts of applications and realised investments, said there is no fixed holding period and rejected a 20-year term as too burdensome, and promised a study of corporations' finances before summer 2020.
If there is evidence and RVO receives signals that the rent has risen excessively shortly after the dwelling is realised, RVO has the option to withdraw the definitive levy reduction.

Indien er wel bewijs is en RVO signalen ontvangt dat de huur op korte termijn na realisatie van de woning excessief is gestegen, heeft RVO de mogelijkheid over te gaan tot intrekking van de definitieve heffingsvermindering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vergeten hoekje van Opwierde

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why residents of several streets in Appingedam's Opwierde neighbourhood still lack clarity on Groningen earthquake reinforcement, why a district-based approach was not chosen, and how compensation will be provided. The minister answered that these homes are already registered, will be assessed this year, and that the risk-based prioritisation sets their lower-risk status, while committing to continued communication and capacity expansion.
The homes in the named streets in Appingedam have already been registered and will be assessed this year so that residents of these homes also have clarity.
De woningen in de genoemde straten in Appingedam zijn reeds opgenomen en zullen dit jaar beoordeeld worden zodat ook de bewoners van deze woningen duidelijkheid hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over plannen voor extra huurverhogingen door Vestia

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about Vestia's plan for extra rent increases of 0.5% above inflation in 2021-2022 in Den Haag, Delft and Rotterdam, and about related financial pressures. The minister answered that such a rent rise fits within the rules if local parties agree, that Vestia's rents remain within legal maxima, that the verhuurderheffing and ATAD questions are under review with results expected by summer 2020, and that tenants can turn to the huurcommissie on disputes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gedwongen verhuizingen in Leiden

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about forced evictions of temporary (antikraak) tenants in Leiden during the coronavirus crisis, including whether the owner's termination and asbestos work justify the move. The Minister says the housing corporation and vacancy manager are helping tenants without alternative housing, that most already have it, and that the works and relocations proceed under RIVM guidance.
The housing corporation and vacancy manager say they are jointly doing everything possible, in consultation with residents, to find timely alternative housing for residents who do not yet have it.

De betrokken woningcorporatie en leegstandbeheerder zetten naar eigen zeggen gezamenlijk en in overleg met de bewoners alles op alles om voor de bewoners die nog niet over alternatieve woonruimte beschikken tijdig andere woonruimte te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de archeologie

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether archaeology firms can access COVID-19 support schemes (TOGS, NOW), late payment rules, and heritage education funding. The minister declined to add the broad SBI code 7220 to TOGS, pointed to other support schemes, and promised to consider extensions to the archaeology quality registration.
I am in consultation with the SIKB, the CCvDA and the IOeE about which leniency measures are needed to keep the archaeology quality system functioning.

Ik ben in overleg met de Stichting Infrastructuur Kwaliteit Bodem (SIKB), het centraal College van Deskundigen in de Archeologie (CCvDA) en de Inspectie voor Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed (IOeE) over welke coulancemaatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het gebruik van de sloopregeling door Vestia in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the minister whether the rent-free demolition reduction of the landlord levy used by Vestia in Rotterdam (Tweebosbuurt) allows rents of replacement homes to be liberalised quickly, and how many such applications exist. The minister answered that thousands of demolition applications are pending, that no reliable data exists on post-move rent increases, and that RVO can withdraw the reduction if rents rise excessively soon after completion.
No conclusive administration is available on moves and rent developments to answer this question.
Er is geen sluitende administratie beschikbaar van verhuizingen en huurontwikkeling om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het doorgaan van huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis ondanks haar statement en andere nadelige gevolgen op huisvesting

An SP MP asked the minister why a voluntary landlord statement was chosen over emergency legislation to halt evictions during the COVID-19 crisis, and about evictions, antikraak occupants, campsite residents and double rent burdens. The minister answered that landlords have agreed to postpone evictions except for evident cases, that an emergency law to extend temporary leases is planned, and that municipalities and safety regions are asked to allow residents of campsites to stay.
I will keep a close eye on the situation; if undesirable situations emerge, I will examine the possibilities for targeted further measures.
Ik blijf de vinger aan de pols houden, indien er onwenselijke situaties naar voren komen, zal ik de mogelijkheden voor gerichte, nadere maatregelen onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers about housing and safety of migrant workers during the coronavirus crisis, including infection risks, information provision, and evictions. The government answered that employers share responsibility, that information is distributed in several languages, that municipalities can close recreational sites with exemptions, and that agreements were made to prevent evictions.
No data are known to me on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over het bericht dat Shell een enorme plasticfabriek in de VS laat bouwen

Two SP MPs asked the government about Shell's plan to build a large plastics plant in the US, its environmental and CO2 impact, and how it fits with the Plastic Pact and climate goals. The state secretary answered that investment decisions are Shell's responsibility, that Shell has not yet stated environmental or CO2 impacts, and that the government will promote recycling, pricing measures and EU-level rules, while agreeing to talk with Shell.
The investment decisions that Shell makes in the US are the responsibility of Shell.
De investeringsbeslissingen die Shell in de VS neemt, zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van Shell.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over vergoeding nieuw gevonden schade tijdens herstelwerkzaamheden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how new earthquake damage found during repairs is handled, whether there is a priority procedure, how quickly costs are reimbursed, and what residents should do about extra work costs and contractor bills they cannot pay. The minister replied that newly discovered damage can be reported to the TCMG, which decides whether to include it in an existing or new procedure, that the damage calculation includes reasonably expected extra work, that objection and appeal remain open, and that the contractor variant exists but is little used; no figures are kept on how often new damage is found.
The TCMG has indicated that no exact figures are known because it is not recorded how often new mining damage is discovered during repairs.
De TCMG heeft laten weten dat er geen exacte aantallen bekend zijn omdat niet wordt geregistreerd hoe vaak het voorkomt dat tijdens het herstel nieuwe mijnbouwschade wordt ontdekt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de aardbevingen van 22 en 23 maart ten tijde van corona

An MP asked ministers about earthquakes in Groningen on 22-23 March 2020 during the coronavirus lockdown, including whether residents can safely stay home, whether monitoring thresholds were exceeded, the TCMG's reduced evening availability, relocation to temporary housing, speeding up reinforcement, and asking Shell/NAM for extra money. The ministers answered that no monitoring thresholds were exceeded, that TCMG adjusted opening hours and piloted remote damage inspections while keeping acute-unsafe-situation handling, that reinforcement is being accelerated as gas extraction falls, and that all reinforcement costs are borne by NAM and its shareholders.
I have the authority to intervene in extraction at any time if the safety situation gives cause for it.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid om te allen tijde in de winning in te grijpen als de veiligheidssituatie daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de bomenkap voor stadsverwarming in Purmerend

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether 16,000 trees were felled in the Schoorl dunes, whether the wood fed Purmerend's district heating, and whether a Staatsbosbeheer representative's roles (Enerco, Energiehout, former FSC board) amounted to conflict of interest. The minister answers that the felling was a 2018-2019 thinning, the wood went to the wood industry, and no conflict of interest exists given functional separation and that FSC does not certify.
In response to your questions I obtained information from Staatsbosbeheer.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van uw vragen informatie ingewonnen bij Staatsbosbeheer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Beckerman en Agnes Mulder over het rapport van de Noordelijke Rekenkamer ‘Herverdeling onder Hoogspanning, een onderzoek naar de verdeling naar de kosten en baten rondom wind- en

MPs asked the ministers about the Northern Audit Office report on how costs and benefits of wind and solar parks are distributed, including whether provinces can enforce compensation for residents and whether uniform national rules are needed. The minister said financial participation is important, that provinces' legal powers are being mapped with the interbestuurlijk level and will be reported after summer 2020, and that he opposes uniform national legal norms because projects differ.
Within interbestuurlijk consultation, it is currently being mapped which legal possibilities and powers decentralised governments have to set requirements on financial participation.
Binnen interbestuurlijk verband wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht welke juridische mogelijkheden/bevoegdheden decentrale overheden hebben om eisen te stellen aan financiële participatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de belastingen voor woningcorporaties die Vestia willen helpen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about tax and policy measures for housing corporations, including the Vestia rescue, the transfer of Vestia homes to other corporations, property transfer tax exemptions and the Tweebosbuurt case. The minister answered that a Vestia housing transfer study is pending, that abolishing the rental levy only for corporations is not an option, and declined to comment on several local or ongoing legal matters.
This concerns a local matter on which Vestia must weigh considerations in consultation with the municipality.
Het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid waarover Vestia in samenspraak met de gemeente een afweging moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over brandgevaar in parkeergarages en onder woningen

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked ministers about fire risks from charging electric vehicles in underground car parks and under homes, and the government replied that NEN is drafting a new fire-safety standard for car parks (expected 2021), that no electric car or charger is known to have caused a car park fire in the Netherlands, and that it will update guidance and consider further measures without committing to specific Building Decree changes now. Several questions (sprinklers, mandatory fire detectors, charger placement) were deferred to the pending NEN standard.
The Dutch Normalisation Institute (NEN), at my request, is working on a new NEN standard for the integrated fire safety of car parks, expected to be ready in 2021.
Het Nederlandse Normalisatie Instituut (hierna NEN) werkt op mijn verzoek aan een nieuwe NEN-norm voor de integrale brandveiligheid van parkeergarage, die naar verwachting in 2021 gereed is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag  en Mulder over de compensatieregeling voor omwonenden van de windparken N33 en Oostermoer

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about compensation for property value loss near the N33 and Oostermoer wind farms, including how many homes lost value and whether a 2019 VU/UvA study on turbine size and house prices calls for fairer compensation. The Minister replied that no compensation for value loss was promised, residents can apply for planning damage (planschade) compensation via the municipality or RVO, a rijksbijdrage of 2.1 million euro was added to the Drentse Monden and Oostermoer area fund, and the N33 request will be assessed similarly while no direct compensation is planned.
I do not have an overview of the number of homes in the areas of the N33 and De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farms that have lost value, or the amount of value lost.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal woningen in de gebieden van de windparken N33 en De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer dat in waarde is gedaald en wat de waardedaling van deze woningen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de besteding van de gelden van het Nationaal Programma Groningen (NPG)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about how funds from the Nationaal Programma Groningen (NPG) are being spent, including the share already allocated, the costs of programme management, and links to Shell and the New Energy Coalition. The Minister answered most questions, explaining the allocation process, the six project conditions, participation channels, and that several requested breakdowns are not yet available.
At this moment it is not yet possible to state precisely how much of the 1,150 million euros goes to 'making plans' or 'starting projects'.
Het is op dit moment nog niet mogelijk om al precies aan te geven hoeveel van de 1.150 euro miljoen gaat naar het «maken van plannen» of het «opstarten van projecten».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘het stoppen van het sensorennetwerk in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM ending the TNO sensor network in the Groningen earthquake area and removing sensors from homes, including residents who wish to keep them. The minister answered that residents may keep their sensors, that consultation and an investigation into a resident-participation network are underway, that the network no longer yields new insights, and that the government will not take it over.
I have asked NAM to pause the removal.
Ik heb de NAM gevraagd het verwijderen te pauzeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het stopzetten van een zaak door Arbiter Bodembeweging

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Arbiter Bodembeweging dropping a Groningen farm family's mining damage case as the arbiter body winds down, and what this means for remaining claims. The minister answered that three manure-cellar cases will move to the TCMG if claimants withdraw, that about 33 cases remain with the arbiter (most to be decided by 1 May 2020), and declined to comment on individual cases.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het loket “Oude schades” van de provincie Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the 'Oude schades' claims desk run by the Groningen province, including how many claims were assessed, rejected or granted, the role of NAM, and whether the desk should stay open. The Minister reports 193 requests with 80 in scope and 23 granted so far, that NAM makes the first assessment, that the desk closed on 1 March 2020 without extension, and that individual cases are not discussed.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Tien keer meer lood in water op de Kramatweg (Amsterdam) dan toegestaan: ‘Ik word al jaren vergiftigd hier’'

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports of lead levels in tap water on the Kramatweg in Amsterdam, the health risks, a possible lower lead norm, a landelijk ban on lead pipes, and tenant rights and compensation. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the norm review is pending with the Minister of IenW, noted the landlord has started replacing pipes, and pointed to existing tenancy-law and court remedies, declining to make specific compensation agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Bewoners van de Iep beide kerstdagen zonder verwarming' en 'Vestia biedt Tweebossers schimmelwoningen aan'

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports of heating failures in Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and mouldy homes offered to Tweebosbuurt residents by housing corporation Vestia, asking about maintenance, compensation and pressure on tenants. The minister acknowledged the problems, said Vestia must meet legal maintenance norms and is funded under its recovery plan, but largely pointed to existing oversight and tenant remedies rather than new action.
This is also explicitly part of Vestia's approved improvement plan and funds have been reserved for it.
Dit maakt ook nadrukkelijk onderdeel uit van het vastgestelde verbeterplan van Vestia en hier zijn ook middelen voor gereserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat gasbedrijven Gronings onderzoek naar duurzame energie domineren

Two SP MPs asked whether gas companies dominating the New Energy Coalition's research on sustainable energy in Groningen is problematic, including its university and subsidy links and the NAM's role. The minister defended the open involvement of fossil-fuel firms in the energy transition, said the NEC's conduct is not a government concern absent evidence of breach, and promised a study of third-party funding of research.
In accordance with this motion, a study will be carried out, with the Ministry of OCW taking the lead.
Conform deze motie zal een onderzoek worden uitgevoerd, waarbij het Ministerie van OCW het voortouw zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het afsluiten van de stroom op vakantiepark Anloo en een mogelijke ontruiming van vakantiepark De Groene Heuvels in Beuningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Environment and Housing about the cut-off of electricity at holiday parks Anloo and De Groene Heuvels, the vulnerable permanent residents affected, municipal responsibility and eviction plans, asking 18 numbered questions. The Minister answered largely that the municipality and the bankrupt park's curator bear responsibility, that consumer protection rules apply, that evictions are municipal choices, and that she expects municipalities to seek housing alternatives for residents.
The municipality has no statutory duty of care to prevent the electricity from being cut off.
De gemeente heeft geen wettelijke zorgplicht om te voorkomen dat de stroom werd afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de overheid nog steeds miljarden aan investeringen in de fossiele industrie dekt

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the state's export credit insurance (EKV) still covers large amounts of fossil-fuel investment and whether it should be phased out, and asked the government to study the effect on climate policy. The government disputes the press figures, says about 30% of the portfolio is fossil-related, pledges to green the portfolio and measure it better, but rejects phasing out fossil cover unilaterally, citing effectiveness and jobs.
No. Phasing out in the Netherlands the granting of insurance for all investments related to fossil fuels would go too far.
Nee. Het in Nederland uitfaseren van het geven van verzekeringen voor alle investeringen die te maken hebben met fossiel gaat een brug te ver.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opmars van tijdelijke huurcontracten en de gevolgen daarvan

An SP MP asks the housing minister why temporary rental contracts are spreading, whether government discourages them, and whether they harm tenants in a housing crisis, and asks for data and an evaluation. The minister replies that open-ended leases remain the norm, that temporary contracts serve specific groups, that CBS data show about 8% of private and 3% of housing-corporation lets are temporary, and that the Housing Market Flow Act 2015 will be evaluated by mid-2021 with no cap planned for now.
I am going to evaluate the Housing Market Flow Act 2015 soon.
Ik ga de Wet Doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 binnenkort evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en lid Hijink over het bericht dat een man in hongerstaking gaat

MPs Beckerman and Hijink asked the government how it will help Dhani Hoekstra, who announced a hunger strike over Groningen earthquake damage, and what it will do for people suffering psychological distress from gas extraction. The minister said the case is handled by responsible bodies, declined to comment on the individual case, and outlined gas-extraction phase-out, extra funding for social-emotional support and mental health care, without giving a count of users.
Beyond that, I will not comment on this individual case.
Voor het overige doe ik geen uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het bericht dat de huidige Voorzitter van de Raad van de Europese Unie wordt gesponsord door de gaslobby

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the Croatian EU Council presidency accepting corporate sponsorship, including from oil company INA, is acceptable, and how this relates to the EU Ombudsman's call for strict rules and to the Green Deal. Minister Blok replied that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable, that the Council will respond to the Ombudsman's recommendations by 6 April 2020, and that the Dutch aim is guidelines similar to those of the Dutch 2016 presidency.
The cabinet is of the view that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat sponsoring in beginsel niet ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het niet verstrekken van een volmacht door de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) voor betalingen van versterkingsprojecten

An SP MP asked why residents in Groningen could not sign depot agreements for reinforcement works after NAM's role ended on 1 January 2020, who holds the authority, and how residents could start in January. The Minister answered that no work was blocked, that the NCG now signs depot agreements in place of NAM, and that ongoing cases continue under the NCG, with advance payments used in the interim.
As a result, since 1 January 2020 it is the NCG, not NAM, that concludes the depot agreements for reinforcement with residents.
Het gevolg van die handeling is dat sinds 1 januari 2020 niet NAM maar de NCG de depotovereenkomsten voor de versterking aangaat met de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die in Appingedam vanuit een onveilig huis in een huis met gebreken komen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenants in the Groningen earthquake area who moved into energy-neutral homes in Appingedam still suffering mould, defects and heat-pump failures, and about Woongroep Marenland refusing mediation and heading to court. The Minister answered that the corporation reports no mould problems, that complaints are being addressed, and that he is convening a 'corporatietafel' with housing corporations, municipalities and tenant groups, while noting the tenant-law framework and legal aid options.
I keep a finger on the pulse.
Ik houd een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huisjesmelkers aan de Pieter Calandlaan in Amsterdam, Nieuw-West

The MP asks whether renting an 8 m2 room for 700 euro per month on Pieter Calandlaan in Amsterdam is reasonable, whether such rent fits the points system, and whether short six-month contracts are lawful and can be curbed, plus which tools exist to fine landlords who charge excessive rent. The minister answers that such rent is theoretically possible under the points system, that tenants can appeal to the Huurcommissie, that short contracts are lawful and will be evaluated before 2021, and that fining instruments are being developed together with the motion Asscher/Heerma without a concrete date.
To test this, any tenant can turn to the Huurcommissie.
Om dit te toetsen kan elke huurder zich tot de Huurcommissie wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het schimmeldrama in aardbevingsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about mould and damp in social rental homes in the Groningen earthquake area, including Woongroep Marenland's four years of neglected maintenance, timelines for repairs, compensation for tenants, and corporations' communication. The minister apologised via the corporation, outlined planned repairs and a national approach to damp and mould, but offered no direct compensation and pointed tenants to the rent tribunal.
four years of uncertainty and living in a home with mould is not acceptable
vier jaar onzekerheid en leven in een woning met schimmel is niet acceptabel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders in Ten Post de versterking “on hold” willen zetten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about tenants in Ten Post who want reinforcement works paused, including fears of moving, rent increases, and a threatened legal route to end leases if 70% did not sign the social plan. The Minister answered that the corporation and municipality are engaging with tenants, that tenants will be involved in planning, and that the corporation says court enforcement of the 70% norm is not on the table.
Wierden en Borgen has stated that enforcing the 70% norm for signing the social plan through the courts is not an issue.
Wierden en Borgen heeft aangegeven dat de 70%-norm voor het tekenen van het sociaal plan via de rechter afdwingen niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Vestia-ellende in Honselse burgemeestersbuurt

An SP MP asked the housing minister about Vestia's renovation works in the Burgemeestersbuurt in Honselersdijk, including unclear compensation, consent and information for tenants, and whether municipalities or corporations should take over Vestia housing. The minister expressed regret, said Vestia admitted a planning error and trusts Vestia and the municipality to find a solution, and gave general rules on consent, compensation and tenant information while declining to take a position on individual cases and not committing to a concrete new step.
These questions concern individual case matters under the care of local stakeholders.
Deze vragen betreffen vragen over individuele casuïstiek onder de zorg van lokale stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten aan de TU-Delft zijn opgelicht door nep-verhuurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing and the Minister of Education about students at TU Delft defrauded by fake landlords, including how many were foreign students, and about platform controls, blacklists, licensing and a quality mark. The minister answered that no standard registration or national figures exist, described information campaigns, the Wet toeristische verhuur, ACM action against intermediary fees, pilots on local landlord licensing, and said fake landlords are a criminal law matter rather than housing policy.
There is no standard registration of this available at TU Delft.
Er is geen standaardregistratie hiervan beschikbaar bij de TU Delft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de vervuiling door gaswinning in de provincie Overijssel

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about soil and groundwater pollution from gas extraction in Overijssel, including timelines for remediation at Wanneperveen-1 and Tubbergen-7, drinking water quality, and monitoring of old wells. The minister answered that the locations are not urgent under the Wbb, that the province is competent authority for historic contamination, that remediation is proceeding with NAM, and that SodM continues its investigations.
It is not for the Ministry of EZK to draw up an action plan for these locations.
Het is niet aan het Ministerie van EZK om voor deze locaties een plan van aanpak op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Beckerman over de uitspraak van SodM-topman dat omgekeerde bewijslast ook buiten Groningen moet gelden

MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why he does not follow the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) advice to extend the reversed burden of proof to mining damage outside Groningen, and why residents must prove their damage. The Minister answers that a statutory presumption is justified only for Groningen, and instead creates a Commissie Mijnbouwschade to investigate reported damage elsewhere, expected operational by mid-2020.
I follow the advice of the Technical Committee on Subsidence (Tcbb) on this point.
Ik volg het advies van de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de kosten van de gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak

MPs Futselaar and Beckerman asked where the 500 million euro nitrogen reserve comes from, whether it is sufficient, how the 1 billion euro housing boost is divided, and what the costs for municipalities and provinces will be. The minister answered that the reserve is funded from a 2019 budget underspend, that the amount's adequacy is still unknown, that the housing boost is separate and not earmarked, and that the financial impact on local governments is not yet known, with support helpdesks and a team being set up.
At this moment it is not yet clear what the exact financial consequences of the nitrogen ruling are for municipalities and provinces.
Op dit moment is nog niet inzichtelijk wat de exacte financiële gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak voor gemeenten en provincies zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huurtoeslag en het minimumloon

Two SP MPs asked why the rent-subsidy (huurtoeslag) rent ceiling is lower for under-23s, how many young tenants miss out, and whether the age limit should be lowered to 18 and the youth minimum wage raised. The minister answered that the lower ceiling is deliberate to keep young people's housing affordable, that raising it would push up rents, and that no change is planned, while noting the government's stance on the youth minimum wage.
All things considered, there is currently no reason to lower the age limit of 23.
Alles overziend is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrens van 23 jaar te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over gevaarlijke AGPO Ferroli CV-ketels

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about dangerous AGPO Ferroli central heating boilers, including NVWA findings on poor maintenance, disagreement among maintenance firms, housing corporations' replacement decisions, and whether a 0800 helpline should be opened. The Minister answered that maintenance is the owner's responsibility, the NVWA has imposed corrective actions on the manufacturer under its supervision, corporations decide replacement themselves, and the NVWA's existing number suffices, while promising a progress update before summer 2020.
I will inform you before summer 2020 about the progress of the corrective actions the NVWA imposed on Ferroli.
Ik zal u voor de zomer van 2020 informeren over de voortgang van de door de NVWA aan Ferroli opgelegde corrigerende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het interview op RTVNoord ‘Minister Eric Wiebes blikt terug’

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs minister who was responsible for the Groningen reinforcement operation, when the Centrum Veilig Wonen's underperformance became known, why the CVW was to be wound down, and how progress compares with earlier reports. The minister answered that responsibility shifted from NAM to the ministries, that the CVW contract was not renewed to distance NAM, and that figures are provisional and not fully comparable with earlier quarterly reports.
The overview has been compiled with due care, but at this moment it cannot be ruled out that some figures will still be adjusted and added.
Het overzicht is met de nodige zorgvuldigheid tot stand gekomen maar het valt op dit moment niet uit te sluiten dat er op onderdelen nog aantallen worden aangepast en toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over "de landsadvocaat die ruim 2,1 miljoen euro verdiende aan de Groninger gaswinning"

SP MPs asked for a total overview of legal costs in Groningen gas-damage lawsuits, costs per case, and how the State Attorney's costs relate to the damage claims and the 200,000 euro legal-aid amendment. The minister provided yearly fees for the State Attorney in civil suits against the State, the number and cost of the six Northern Netherlands cases, declined to discuss the individual Nijhof case, and said the costs are not charged to compensation budgets while cost-minimisation remains the aim.
I cannot go into individual procedures that have been or are being conducted.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele procedures die zijn of worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over het bericht dat de SSH& voortaan haar kamers zal verhuren door middel van loting

SP MPs asked whether a housing association's switch to a lottery for student rooms breached the national student housing action plan and whether students were properly consulted. The minister answered that local parties are responsible for the consultation, that the housing association consulted its tenants' organisation as the law requires, and that the government will monitor whether student unions are included.
From central government we will keep a close eye on this.
Vanuit het Rijk zullen we vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “het bericht dat klanten slecht beschermd zijn tegen het faillissement van hun energieleverancier”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Consumentenbond study showing that energy customers are poorly protected if their supplier goes bankrupt, including whether consumers can recover lost prepayments and whether a guarantee fund should be explored. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to licensing and ACM supervision, said stricter supplier requirements are being examined for the new Energy Act, and rejected a guarantee fund because of market risks.
This may lead to tightening of the licensing requirements and of ACM's supervision of them.
Dit zal mogelijk tot een aanscherping van de vergunningseisen en het toezicht door ACM daarop leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gedwongen verhuizing van bewoners van Vakantiepark Arnhem

An SP MP asked the Minister about residents of Vakantiepark Arnhem being forced to move chalets on short notice, living conditions, legality, compensation, municipal action and the pilot programme for holiday parks. The minister answered that the municipality disapproves of the owner's conduct, that the legal assessment is for courts case by case, and that pilots and further information will follow.
The municipality of Arnhem informed me that the College sent a letter to the owner disapproving of the owner's handling of the relocations on the park.
De gemeente Arnhem liet mij weten dat het College een brief aan de eigenaar heeft gestuurd waarin zij de handelwijze van de eigenaar omtrent de verhuizingen op het park afkeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Een derde kinderen leeft in ongezond huis’

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about a report finding that a third of children live in unhealthy homes, including whether landlords should be obliged to keep homes healthy, whether building rules will change, and why tenants report more mould. The Minister acknowledged the concern, described the existing landlord-tenant division of repair duties and tenant remedies (rent reduction, court orders, municipal enforcement), pointed to existing health rules in the Building Decree, and promised a faster local mould approach and more information on healthy living.
I want to accelerate the approach and I am focusing on the local approach in those G4 and G40 municipalities where tenants say mould occurs most often.
Ik wil een versnelling in de aanpak en richt mij daarbij op de lokale aanpak in die G4 en G40 gemeenten waar vocht en schimmel volgens huurders het vaakst voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de honderden miljoenen euro's aan lobbyuitgaven van olie- en gasgiganten

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the government accepts a Corporate Europe Observatory finding that oil and gas lobbying spent over 251 million euro to slow EU climate targets, and whether it will hold Shell and others to account and limit their influence on climate policy.
