The minister said the figures are not known to the government, that the government does not track individual firms' lobbying, that companies may pursue their interests within the rule of law, and that the Klimaatakkoord deliberately involves industry alongside other stakeholders.
All parties are always free to pursue their interests as long as this stays within the bounds of the rule of law.
Het staat alle partijen altijd vrij hun belangen te behartigen zolang dit binnen de grenzen van de rechtstaat past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat bezwaar maken tegen windmolenparken zinloos is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether objecting to wind farms is pointless, whether residents were informed early enough, whether the Crisis- en herstelwet undermines participation, and whether noise and shadow flicker should be grounds for objection, citing WHO noise guidance and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister answered that participation is a shared responsibility of the competent authority and developer, that legal norms for noise and shadow flicker exist and courts can annul plans that breach them, that no separate low-frequency norm is needed, and that a RIVM study on the WHO report is pending with a compensation overview promised before summer 2020.
Opportunities for public participation and legal protection are secured in laws and regulations.
Inspraakmogelijkheden en rechtsbescherming zijn geborgd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitzending van EenVandaag over de versterkingsoperatie

An SP MP asked the minister about an EenVandaag broadcast on the Groningen reinforcement operation, including residents who received reinforcement advice but are not yet scheduled for works, and why records are only available via FOI requests. The minister explained that advice was issued under the older NPR 2015 standard, that residents were told advice creates no rights, that reassessment via a sample is pending, and gave progress figures.
Once there is clarity on what this will mean for the actual reinforcement, the cabinet will inform residents and your House about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over wat dit voor de daadwerkelijke versterking zal gaan betekenen, zal het kabinet de bewoners en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de berichten dat studenten op camping neerstrijken

Two SP MPs asked how many students sleep in tents, hostels or bungalow parks due to housing shortages, how they are supported, and what rent protections exist. The minister said the situation is more nuanced than media reports, described municipal and institutional emergency housing arrangements, pointed to monitoring, the Huurcommissie campaigns and the Goed Verhuurderschap pilots, and promised to continue talks with partners without specifying enforceable consequences.

Regarding your questions on numbers of students in temporary emergency accommodation (campsites, hostels and holiday bungalows) and the costs for students, I made inquiries with various municipalities and educational institutions.

Wat betreft uw vragen over aantallen studenten in tijdelijke noodvoorzieningen (campings, hostels en vakantiebungalows) en de kosten voor de student, heb ik bij verschillende gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen navraag gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “de lobby van multinationals die al jaren helpen de politieke agenda te formuleren”

An MP asks the Economy minister about informal lobbying by multinationals (ABDUP, PHAUSD) and their access to government, including meetings with ministers, tax lobbying, and Wob requests. The minister acknowledges the contacts as legitimate stakeholder dialogue, says the government has no oversight of ABDUP and no minutes, declines to disclose confidential exchanges, and rejects claims of undue influence.
It is not for me to make public the points raised in such consultations.
Het is het niet aan mij om ingebrachte punten uit dergelijke overleggen naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de onhoudbare situatie in Woltersum

The MP asks whether houses in Woltersum needing both damage repair and reinforcement are identified, why they are classed as acutely unsafe despite not being high-risk, and how the NCG and TCMG will coordinate combined files. The minister says four addresses are prioritised by NCG, one acute unsafe situation was resolved with shoring, and a cooperation agreement signed on 11 September 2019 will allow coordinated 'combination files' through a one-counter approach starting with a selection of cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het weren van zwangerschappen en baby’s in huurwoningen

An SP MP asked whether landlords excluding pregnant women, babies and families from certain Amsterdam rental homes amounts to discrimination, and what can be done for tenants and applicants. The minister answered that the landlord's clause limiting occupancy to two people is not aimed at excluding children, that such clauses are void if they disadvantage tenants, and pointed to Amsterdam housing-supply measures and legal aid for tenants.
A clause in a lease stating that no children may live in the dwelling is therefore contrary to that right.
Een beding in een huurcontract dat in de woning geen kinderen mogen wonen, is daarmee in strijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het CETA-verdrag dat afbouw gaswinning in de weg staat

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether the CETA trade agreement could allow gas companies to claim compensation that burdens the Dutch state and hinders the Groningen gas phase-out and energy transition. The minister answered that no claims are expected, that CETA preserves the state's right to regulate in the public interest, and that the Netherlands cannot guarantee CETA's fate if it does not ratify.
The CETA treaty text explicitly confirms the right of governments to regulate in the public interest.
De verdragstekst van CETA bevestigt expliciet het recht voor overheden om te reguleren in het publieke belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de hoge prijs die huurders betalen voor de verkoop van sociale huurhuizen aan beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether social rental homes sold to investors leave tenants paying high rents, whether the Social Rental Accord rent cap should apply to private landlords, and about the status of studies, a self-occupancy requirement and transfer tax measures. The Minister replied that private landlords face the same per-dwelling rent caps, that the government does not stimulate sales (local parties decide), that studies and a transfer tax differentiation are underway with results expected by year end, and that a website for foreign investors will be merged into another.
It is up to local parties to determine how many social rental dwellings are needed.
Het is aan lokale partijen om te bepalen hoeveel sociale huurwoningen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de wanhoop van huurders in Middelstum

An MP asked ministers about tenants in Middelstum, Groningen, who face forced double relocation due to earthquake reinforcement and asked about compensation, sloop/rebuild numbers, and support. The minister acknowledged the burden, cited legal relocation allowances and an extra payment of €609.50 for the double move, said corporations and tenants must resolve the dispute with a mediator, and committed to consulting NCG and housing corporations.
Because this is a recurring problem, I will take the initiative to consult with NCG and housing corporations.
Omdat dit een terugkerend probleem is zal ik het initiatief nemen om in overleg te treden met NCG en woningcorporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over de ongepaste en onwettelijke inzage in de onderzoeksopzet Shell Papers

Two SP MPs asked whether the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate's request for the research outline of a journalistic FOIA request on Shell was improper and unlawful. The minister answered that the request was too broad and needed clarification under the Wob, that EZK speaks on behalf of 14 other bodies without a formal mandate, and that the purpose question was asked only to specify the request, not to restrict journalism.
It is up to the requester to indicate what specific information they wish to receive; the administrative body can only assist in this.
Het is aan de verzoeker om aan te geven waar hij of zij specifiek informatie over wenst te ontvangen; het bestuursorgaan kan hierbij slechts behulpzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gezondheidssituatie van veel Groningers in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the health situation of Groningen residents affected by earthquakes, including slow damage settlement, reinforcement delays, support for vulnerable residents, the buy-out scheme and a complaints line. The minister answers that the government is accelerating damage handling and reinforcement, taking over settlement from NAM, creating a new institute (IMG) and offering social-emotional support and a special cases committee, while declining to say whether health risks differ from elsewhere in the Netherlands.
I cannot draw conclusions about the different risks of health problems in Groningen compared with the rest of the Netherlands.
Daarom kan ik geen conclusies trekken over de verschillende risico’s op gezondheidsproblemen in Groningen ten opzichte van de rest van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verkoop van hofjeswoningen door corporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the sale of 29 almshouse dwellings and a chapel by housing corporation Lefier could be stopped despite opposition from tenants, the municipality and the church, and what role the Autoriteit woningcorporaties plays. The minister answered that the sale was approved under the BTIV rules, that the municipality's objection is still pending, and that she sees no reason for new regulation, while answering the remaining questions largely by restating existing rules and municipal responsibilities.
The Aw issued a positive decision on the proposed sale.
De Aw heeft een positief besluit afgegeven op de voorgenomen verkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over journalistiek onderzoek naar kleine gasvelden in Noord-Nederland

MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a journalistic report claiming small gas fields in the northeast are being drained faster than permitted, and asks about closures, phase-out plans, damage handling and compensation. The minister denies accelerated extraction, points to declining production figures and the permit-change procedure, and promises a new liability-guarantee bill and a national damage scheme, but gives only general answers on several points.
The assumption that more natural gas is being extracted from small fields than originally licensed, and that the small fields are being drained faster, is incorrect.
De veronderstelling dat er meer aardgas gewonnen wordt uit kleine velden dan oorspronkelijk vergund en dat de kleine velden versneld worden leeggehaald, is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie naar het overschrijden van dagvolumes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into gas producers exceeding permitted daily volumes from small Groningen-area fields, and what consequences, monitoring and information to residents would follow. The minister answered that the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) handles enforcement, that criminal investigations are normally conducted confidentially and their outcomes are for the prosecutor to communicate, and that existing instruments are adequate.
It is customary for the Public Prosecution Service to conduct criminal investigations in silence.
Het is gebruikelijk dat het OM de strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in stilte uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over intimidatie van huurders door huisbazen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports of intimidation of tenants by landlords in cities with housing shortages, and about what the government is doing, including licensing and criminalising such conduct. The Minister answered that the government is working through woondeals, the Aanpak Goed Verhuurderschap and five city pilots, rejects a national licensing scheme as disproportionate, and considers intimidation already criminal so no separate economic offence is needed.
It is not known how many complaints tenants have filed against landlords, because the police do not record them in that way.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel aangiftes zijn gedaan door huurders tegen verhuurders, omdat die aangiftes niet op die manier door de politie worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het verdwijnen van kleine woningcorporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about rising audit costs and the disappearance of small housing associations, including the effects of the OOB status threshold at 5,000 units. The minister answered that controls were reduced, the market share of smaller audit firms has grown, the OOB threshold was kept, and fusion decisions are left to the regulator, Autoriteit woningcorporaties.
As far as I am aware, the study is not carried out annually.
Voor zover mij bekend wordt het onderzoek niet jaarlijks uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over `Wob-verzoeken Groningen`

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about RTV Noord's report that the ministry misleads Groningers, the 'underpromise and overdeliver' principle, the many pending Wob (freedom of information) requests on gas extraction, and transparency. The minister denied misleading residents, said he would share information needed for parliamentary oversight, listed ten pending Wob requests, and argued that publishing technical documents would not reduce residents' stress.
I provide the House with the information necessary for the exercise of its supervisory task.
Ik voorzie de Kamer van de informatie die nodig is voor de uitoefening van zijn controlerende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het NRC-artikel ‘De weerbarstige realiteit van Wiebes’ beloftes’

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a NRC article claiming the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation had stalled and that promises were broken, and asked why reports were withheld, how many addresses were inspected, how the engineering tenders and damage compensation (old damage, arbitration, legal aid) are handled. The minister denied a standstill, said the reports were shared with stakeholders rather than confidential and summarized the new risk-based approach, progress dashboard, new public implementing organisation and commitments on arbitration payments, while giving few concrete figures and deferring some details.
For completeness, I have attached the reports, which as indicated have been shared with civil society organisations and other governments.
Volledigheidshalve heb ik de rapporten, die zoals aangegeven zijn gedeeld met maatschappelijke organisaties en medeoverheden, bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied 2.0

Two MPs asked whether a housing corporation's rent increases for tenants in a Groningen earthquake-risk complex, which was flagged as elevated risk, were justified, and what tenants could do. The minister answered that the increase was regular, that reinforcement assessments are handled by the National Coordinator Groningen, that tenants can object to the Rent Tribunal, and that she is not party to the dispute and will not reverse it.
I am not a party to this matter and it is not for me to reverse the rent increase.
Ik ben geen partij in deze kwestie en het is niet aan mij om de huurverhoging ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over geschonden mensenrechten in Groningen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about UN Human Rights Committee recommendations on Groningen gas extraction, compensation, reinforcement of homes, health and rights protection, and a timetable for measures. The minister responds that gas extraction is being phased out faster than planned, that damage handling and reinforcement are top priorities with new legislation (Tijdelijke Wet Groningen) submitted, and that a timetable cannot be given exactly but key milestones are listed.
The cabinet remains firmly committed to bringing gas extraction from the Groningen field to zero as quickly as possible, compensating damage and strengthening homes.
Het kabinet zet zich onverminderd in om de gaswinning uit het Groningenveld zo snel als mogelijk naar nul te brengen, de schade te vergoeden en de huizen te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over dat er mogelijk meer versterkingen nodig zijn door onnauwkeurige metingen

An MP asked ministers whether inaccurate seismic measurements mean more Groningen homes need reinforcement, the timing of NAM risk calculations, interim support for residents, and clarity on KNMI and NAM roles. The government says the reinforcement is not halted or delayed, the SodM audit takes 12 to 18 months, the KNMI/NAM roles await an evaluation, and tenants' safety and compensation are covered through corporation agreements.
As promised in the letter of 10 July, we adopt this SodM advice.
Zoals in de brief van 10 juli jl. (Kamerstuk 2019Z14913 ) toegezegd nemen wij dit advies van SodM over.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het plan voor een gebiedsfonds waar omwonenden van het windpark N33 niet blij mee zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about residents' dissatisfaction with a proposed community fund for the N33 wind park, including whether participation was handled badly, whether the ministry chose the location, whether residents will be compensated, and where residents can go for planning-damage claims. The minister answered that residents were informed and consulted at several stages, the location was chosen by the province and later adopted nationally, the Council of State found the plan compliant, no compensation is planned beyond a developer contribution to a community fund, and planning-damage claims go to the municipality and RVO.
The Council of State ultimately reviewed the plan and the procedure against the legal requirements and concluded that the plan meets the requirements of proper spatial planning.
De Raad van State heeft het plan en de procedure tenslotte getoetst aan de wettelijke vereisten en heeft geconcludeerd dat het plan voldoet aan de vereisten van een goede ruimtelijke ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het deels instorten van het dak van het stadion van AZ in Alkmaar

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked the government about the partial collapse of the AZ stadium roof in Alkmaar, including whether budget cuts, municipal oversight, pressure on the municipality, and solar panels contributed. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality found no evidence the roof was underbuilt, that investigations by Haskoning and the Onderzoeksraad are pending, and that she will inform parliament once outcomes are known.
The municipality of Alkmaar will inform me of the outcomes of this investigation. Once that has happened, I am willing to inform your House.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de gemeente Alkmaar mij informeren. Nadat dit is gebeurd, ben ik bereid uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de rechten van Groningers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Supreme Court's answers on Groningen earthquake damage, state responsibility before 2005, compensation for lost living enjoyment and immaterial damage, and whether exclusive jurisdiction for the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen conflicts with Article 112 of the Constitution. The minister answered that the proposed Tijdelijke Wet Groningen would channel all damage claims to the IMG, that the state took steps from 2013 and decided to end gas extraction in 2018, and that after Raad van State advice the law was amended so victims can still go to the civil court.
The Council of State, in its advice on the Temporary Groningen Act, notes among other things that distancing the operator does not require making the Institute exclusively competent to settle damage.

De Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State (de Afdeling) wijst er in haar advies over het wetsvoorstel voor een Tijdelijke Wet Groningen onder meer op dat het voor het op afstand plaatsen van de exploitant niet noodzakelijk is om het Instituut exclusief bevoegd te maken tot het afhandelen van schade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het bericht dat er gevaarlijke stoffen zijn gelekt bij twee chemiebedrijven in Delfzijl

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reported leaks of hazardous substances at two chemical plants in Delfzijl, including whether residents should feel unsafe and for an overview of incidents and supervision. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen, via the Omgevingsdienst Groningen, is the competent authority, that no incidents in 2019 posed a danger to the surroundings, and that inspections found no violations except a warning to Lubrizol for late reporting.
Licensing, supervision and enforcement are carried out on behalf of the province by the Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving worden namens de provincie uitgevoerd door de Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de landelijke risico’s door gevaarlijke gasleidingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the national risks of hazardous gas pipes (grey cast iron and asbestos-cement), including accountability, prioritisation, replacement deadlines and how residents are informed. The minister agreed with the SodM report, said replacement should be accelerated, that the 2040 end date stands, and that Stedin's prioritisation was broadly correct, while deferring to SodM and network operators on details.
I endorse SodM's advice to the network operators and will also convey this to the network operators.
Ik onderschrijf het advies van SodM aan de netbeheerders en dit zal ik ook richting de netbeheerders uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het opkopen van huizen om duur te verhuren in studentensteden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about investors buying homes in university cities to rent out at high prices, squeezing starters and social tenants, and proposed a maximum number of properties, a residence obligation, higher transfer tax for investors, and action on banks promoting such investment. The Minister acknowledged the concern, rejected a property cap and a broader ground-level restriction as disproportionate, said studies on price effects and a differentiated transfer tax are underway, and pointed to existing municipal powers and a planned rent-abuse measure.
I therefore have reservations about the proportionality of this instrument.
Ik heb dan ook bedenkingen bij de proportionaliteit van dit instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huizen met gebreken, zoals schimmel, vooral huurhuizen zijn en niet elke huurder ermee naar de huurcommissie kan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many homes have serious defects such as mould and that tenants, especially in the private free sector, cannot always turn to the Huurcommissie, and asked about action timelines, Huurcommissie backlogs and rights for free-sector tenants. The minister answered that an integrated local approach is being pursued, outlined the tenant and landlord responsibilities and Huurcommissie procedures, explained the backlog increase as a trend break rather than a budget cut, and said she will encourage landlords to allow Huurcommissie advice in free-sector leases.
I do not have the exact information on the number of persons living in a home with mould and damp problems.
Ik beschik niet over de exacte informatie van het aantal personen dat woont in een woning met schimmel- en vochtproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het laten verkrotten van panden

An SP MP asked the minister how a property speculator can repeatedly avoid paying penalties while letting listed buildings and plots decay in several municipalities, and what the state can do to stop such patterns. The minister answered that enforcement is primarily a municipal competence, listed the available instruments (penalties, enforced repair, takeover, expropriation, criminal enforcement), and said existing law is sufficient, without providing the requested cost and penalty figures.
I do not have the data you requested.
Over de door u gevraagde gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over arbeidsmigranten die een goudmijn zijn voor verhuurders

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked about reports that holiday bungalows in Ewijk are used to house migrant workers as a profitable model, the adequacy of oversight of exploitation and housing conditions, and what legal tools exist against exploitative landlords. The minister called such use undesirable in principle, said the Inspectorate SZW cannot judge exploitation from press reports, described lokal housing inspection and inter-agency cooperation, and pointed to pilots against bad landlords and forthcoming measures.
I cannot assess from the press reports whether there is exploitation or judge the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this is assigned to other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de nieuwe versterkingsaanpak

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the new reinforcement approach for earthquake-damaged buildings in Groningen, including governance, the role of NAM and CVW, and resident influence. The Minister defended the Besluit versterken gebouwen Groningen, stating the owner keeps the final say, municipalities gain material client role, and NAM is removed from steering, while acknowledging ongoing concerns and committing to monitor and possibly amend the rules.
The decision gives substance to the joint agreements of the central government and regional authorities on carrying out the reinforcement, and thereby provides clarity to the people of Groningen.
Het besluit geeft invulling aan de gezamenlijke afspraken van het Rijk en regionale overheden voor de uitvoering van de versterking en daarmee duidelijkheid aan de Groningers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over schade ontstaan door het afsluiten van een lekkende gasput

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about damage to nearby homes caused by sealing a leaking gas well in Monster, and about liability, monitoring and the handling of claims. The minister answered that NAM is responsible for the damage, that claims are being settled, that the well is under three months of monitoring, and that a monitoring policy for abandoned wells will follow from SodM and KEM research.
NAM has committed to paying the damage and has itself pointed out to residents that they can submit a claim.
NAM heeft toegezegd de schade te betalen en heeft ook zelf de omwonenden erop gewezen dat zij een claim kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ouderen in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked the minister about elderly, less self-reliant residents in the Groningen earthquake area: whether their homes should be treated as care buildings with higher safety standards, whether elderly people are being adequately considered, and whether ending the Eigen Initiatief strengthening route leaves them waiting. The minister replied that safety is paramount, that homes can be made age-proof during strengthening, that no new Eigen Initiatief round will open for now (though existing participants continue), and that the strengthening operation was never stopped.
However, I have no insight into which of these homes are inhabited by elderly people.
Ik heb er echter geen inzicht in welke van deze woningen bewoond worden door ouderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag en Agnes Mulder over de miljoenen waardedaling van huizen door windparken

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about property value losses near wind farms, the adequacy of the planning damage scheme, the Rijkscoördinatieregeling (RCR) limiting local participation, and profit-sharing with residents. The Minister defended the existing independent planning damage procedure, promised to update the VU study and reconsider how wind areas are designated, and said participation and ownership shares will be addressed in the Klimaatakkoord framework without legally enforcing some transparency demands.
I will consult with the VU to give substance to the update.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de VU om invulling te geven aan de actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het 'anders toewijzen' van huurwoningen in Utrecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing corporation Portaal may select tenants in Utrecht's Overvecht who commit to being good neighbours, and what the limits are. The minister said such additional conditions are legal within the Woningwet and housing rules provided no discriminatory criteria are used, cited other examples, and noted that liveability measures are governed by municipal performance agreements.
Within the allocation rules of the Housing Act there is room for additional conditions when allocating rental homes.
Binnen de toewijzingsregels van de Woningwet is ruimte voor additionele voorwaarden bij toewijzing van huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht dat kleine gemeenten met erfgoed hulp nodig hebben

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she shares the Raad voor Cultuur's view that small municipalities need more help protecting their heritage, and whether she will provide more money and options and coordinate with provinces and the Interior Minister. The Minister agreed in principle, describing existing support (Erfgoedacademie, RCE advice, provincial heritage hubs, Erfgoeddeal) and promised a written response to the Raad's advice in May.
I will respond in writing to your House's request regarding the advice of the Raad voor Cultuur, in which I will go further into how I support municipalities.
Ik kom op het verzoek van uw Kamer met een schriftelijke reactie op het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur, waarin ik nader in zal gaan op de wijze waarop ik gemeenten ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ook omgekeerde bewijslast mijnbouwschade in Drenthe

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reversed burden of proof for mining damage recommended by the Tcbb for all of the Netherlands will be adopted, and raises confusion over Groningen versus Drenthe earthquake causes, the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, communication with residents and risk information. The minister says the Tcbb advice will be appraised before summer 2019, a bill to amend the Mijnbouwwet is expected for consultation in autumn, and he commits to better communication with municipalities and residents.
I am aware of this advice, which was drafted at my request by the Tcbb.
Ik ken dit advies dat op mijn verzoek is opgesteld door de Tcbb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gevaarlijke typen Ferroli-cv- ketels

An SP MP asked the ministers about dangerous Ferroli central heating boilers, including conflicting maintenance advice, complaints received, corporation Vestia's handling, and whether the boilers should be replaced. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that no outcome can be anticipated, that Vestia is taking interim measures such as biennial maintenance, and that the government is working on a certification system for gas installation work.

I cannot anticipate the outcome of this investigation. As promised in the General Consultation on the NVWA of 23 April 2019, I will inform the House before summer about the progress of the investigation.

Op de uitkomst van dit onderzoek kan ik niet vooruitlopen. Zoals toegezegd in het Algemeen Overleg NVWA d.d. 23 april 2019 zal ik de Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het grote tekort aan sociale huurhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the shortage of social rental housing, including flexible and temporary contracts, housing for vulnerable groups, sales of social housing to investors, waiting times, and the burden of the landlord levy. The minister answered that she is pursuing many housing measures, that social housing sales are governed by local performance agreements, that waiting-time data are published in separate reports, and that a study on corporations' financial capacity will follow by end 2019.
By the end of 2019 I expect to be able to present the results of these studies to the House.
Eind 2019 verwacht ik de Kamer de resultaten van deze onderzoeken te kunnen presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over discriminatie op bestelling door verhuurmakelaars

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked the minister about landlord agents who agree to discriminate on request and charge illegal intermediary fees. The minister called the findings unacceptable, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap project, self-regulation, a research study and a Rotterdam pilot, and said prosecution is not feasible because willingness to discriminate is not yet actual discrimination.
I find these figures very disappointing and unacceptable.
Ik vind deze cijfers zeer teleurstellend en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toestaan van meer gaswinning dan SodM adviseert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why he permitted NAM to extract more gas from the UMOG cluster and Grijpskerk than SodM advised, whether damage occurred, where residents can claim, and when a compensation loket and a closure plan for small fields will exist. The minister replied that he follows SodM's safety assessment, that the production volumes were clarified via TNO's published overview, that no damage reports are known, and that a national mining damage commission is planned, possibly only from 2021.
I give my consent to a winning plan if, in the opinion of the supervisory authority State Supervision of Mines, extraction can take place safely and responsibly.
Ik geef mijn instemming op een winningsplan als de winning naar het oordeel van de toezichthouder Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen veilig en verantwoord kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over problemen met prefab-huizen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about defects in Slokker prefab homes (moisture, draughts, subsidence, cracking, shaking floors, skewed frames), whether other builders are affected, how complaints are handled, and whether the building supervision and regulation are adequate. The minister replied that the defects are being addressed by the builder, that the municipality found and is enforcing a missing energy-performance requirement, that no wider national problem exists so no independent inquiry is planned, and pointed to a pending quality-assurance bill.
No, carrying out such an investigation myself is not appropriate because there are no signals of nationwide problems with prefab homes.
Nee, het uitvoeren van zo’n onderzoek door mij ligt niet in de rede omdat er geen signalen zijn dat er landelijke problemen zijn met prefab-woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het oordeel van de VN dat mensenrechten worden aangetast door beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a UN finding that investors such as Blackstone violate tenants' rights through housing purchases and tenant treatment, and about Blackstone's acquisitions in Amsterdam and Rotterdam. The minister answered that Dutch tenant protection prevents such practices, announced studies and a possible 'emergency button' on rents, and answered the questions in a numbered but partly clustered manner.
Little is yet known about this specific case.
Er is nog weinig bekend over deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een Zweedse belegger die huurhuizen opkoopt

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the sale of nearly 10,000 Dutch rental homes from Round Hill Capital to Swedish investor Heimstaden, including tenant impacts, tax revenue, and past sales by housing corporations. The Minister said investors may buy and sell freely, explained that existing rental contracts continue and tenant protections apply, declined to comment on individual tax positions, and said the 2015 sale exemption was granted by an independent regulator.
The assessment of proposed sales of homes by housing corporations is carried out on behalf of the Minister by a supervisor, who reaches an independent judgment.
De beoordeling van voorgenomen verkopen van woningen door woningcorporaties wordt namens de Minister door een toezichthouder uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over wederom onveilige CV-ketels

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether about 150,000 older Agpo Ferroli central heating boilers are dangerous, why earlier answers omitted problems with these models, and what the NVWA knew and did. The minister says the NVWA opened an investigation after a Kassa broadcast, did not keep figures on boiler incidents, received no earlier complaints since the 2008-2009 corrective actions, and promises to act if the investigation warrants it.
Following the Kassa broadcast of 16 March 2019, the NVWA started an investigation at the producer.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Kassa van 16 maart 2019 is de NVWA een onderzoek bij de producent gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het stoppen van het project “Heft in Eigen Hand” of “Eigen Initiatief”

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Heft in Eigen Hand / Eigen Initiatief project was halted for about 250 households, and how it affects people's control over their homes in Groningen, including NAM and CVW involvement and wellbeing. The Minister replied that Eigen Initiatief is not stopped but has no follow-up for now because it does not fit the risk-based reinforcement approach, and committed to explore with the region whether owner-led reinforcement can be fitted within conditions.

Together with the stakeholders in the region I want to work out within which conditions a form of reinforcement under own management can be realised, as I also promised your House during the committee meeting on mining.

Samen met de belanghebbenden in de regio wil ik uitwerken binnen welke randvoorwaarden een vorm van versterking in eigen beheer gerealiseerd kan worden, zoals ik uw Kamer ook heb toegezegd tijdens het AO mijnbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over problemen bij de Huurcommissie

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the Huurcommissie's inability to handle a flood of tenant complaints, what is needed to meet statutory deadlines, and whether halving government funding caused the backlog. The Minister acknowledges the need to balance careful work with reasonable timeframes, points to measures taken and planned in a separate letter, and denies that the backlog is linked to the 2018 funding change.
The Huurcommissie does its utmost to keep processing times as short as possible.
De Huurcommissie doet haar uiterste best om de doorlooptijden zo kort mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over inschrijfkosten bij woningcorporaties voor woonruimteverdeelsystemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether registration and renewal fees for regional housing allocation systems should be made free or uniform, and asked for an updated overview of fees and what the government has done to make fees cost-based. The minister agreed fees should be lower and more uniform but opposed making them free, supported a joint national system led by housing associations and municipalities, and provided a fee table for 2019 versus 2016.
I too would like to see registration and renewal fees lowered and made uniform for all tenants.
Ook ik zie graag dat de inschrijvings- en verlengingskosten zouden worden verlaagd en tevens voor alle huurders eenduidig worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huren in Hellevoetsluis

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk (SP) asked about rising rents in Hellevoetsluis, housing conditions and possible exploitation of migrant workers, waiting times for social housing and data on migrant workers. Minister Ollongren answered that housing shortages drive up rents, that municipalities and the province are responsible for local supply, that exploitation questions fall to other bodies, and that updated migrant worker figures will follow later in the year.
I cannot judge from the reporting whether there is exploitation or assess the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this lies with other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Hijink over de zorg in het aardbevingsgebied

SP MPs asked about strain on healthcare in the Groningen earthquake area, including uncertainty over reinforcement of care buildings, staff stress, sick-leave data and the status of the care plan. The minister replied that the Groninger Zorgakkoord was signed, that support coaches are provided for care staff, that no sick-leave figures exist specifically for the area, and that reinforcement costs are borne by NAM.
There are no known figures on sick leave in care and welfare specifically in the earthquake area.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het ziekteverzuim in zorg en welzijn specifiek in het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over investeringen door woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister about housing corporations leaving investment capacity unused, the rising landlord levy, liberalisation and sale of rental homes, and rising construction costs. The minister answers that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties' views are its own, that indicative investment room exists, that the WOZ-based levy is being studied under a motion, and that sector capacity limits drive construction costs.
I do not have information on how many of the potentially liberalisable homes were actually liberalised after sale.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hoeveel van de potentieel te liberaliseren woningen daadwerkelijk geliberaliseerd zijn na verkoop
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de afwijkende metingen bij de versnellingsmeters van KNMI

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the KNMI kept quiet for months about deviating accelerometer readings in Groningen, what the errors mean for the HRA model, damage assessment and public trust, and whether the measurement network will be expanded. The ministers say the errors were reported late, that KNMI's hazard maps are not affected, that an evaluation, a working group and an audit are underway, and that they cannot answer by 5 March.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de positie van de civiele rechter bij de mijnbouwschade in Groningen en de toegang tot het recht

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked whether the draft bill moving earthquake damage claims from civil courts to administrative law (Instituut Mijnbouwschade) weakens Groningen residents' access to justice, and what is being done to make civil justice more accessible. Minister Wiebes replied that the bill is still with the Raad van State for advice, that administrative appeal is low-threshold, that the TCMG and a 200,000 euro fund for test cases are in place, and that the civil justice reform programme and an experiment law are planned.

The bill establishing the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is currently with the Council of State's Advisory Division for advice. For this reason I cannot anticipate discussions touching on the content of the bill.

Het wetsvoorstel Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen ligt op dit moment voor advies voor aan de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State. Om die reden kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen op discussies die aan de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het woningtekort

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a study by Capital Value and ABF Research showing a larger housing shortage, the discrepancy with the government's shortage figures, the share of social rental housing in the shortage, and how the 75,000 homes-per-year target and the 2030 forecast relate to it. The minister acknowledged the study, defended her shortage projections and the 75,000 target as sufficient, noted that the shortage is not broken down by dwelling type, and listed measures to speed up construction.
I am therefore not aware of any shortage figures for rental housing in general or for social rental housing.
Er zijn mij dan ook geen tekortcijfers bekend over huurwoningen in het algemeen of over sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het schenden van regels van zoutbedrijven bij diesel in de ondergrond

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about salt companies Nedmag and Nouryon violating rules on using diesel in underground salt caverns, why this surfaced late, whether tighter supervision and penalties apply, whether the safety reports will be shared, and whether salt mining should be curtailed or phased out. The minister confirms enforcement is underway, explains REACH registration failures, says criminal sanctions are for the prosecutor, refuses to halt or phase out mining, and promises to inform parliament after SodM's assessment.
I will inform your House of this assessment by SodM.
Ik zal uw Kamer over dit oordeel van SodM informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bewijs dat door Airbnb de huizenprijzen stijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about research claiming Airbnb raises house prices, the status of motions on enforcing illegal short-term rentals, and monitoring of housing prices. The minister said the Los Angeles findings cannot be transferred directly to Amsterdam, announced a registration obligation bill for consultation, and said a study with Kadaster, DNB and UvA on investor price effects will be reported later this year.
The bill is meant to change this through a registration obligation.
Het wetsvoorstel moet daar verandering in gaan brengen door middel van een registratieplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over flatbewoners die actie eisen tegen ‘onderwaterkelders’ in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about residents of the Slingeflat in Rotterdam whose cellars have been flooded for months, with mould, and about the landlord Vestia's response, possible rent reduction and sanctions. The minister replied that the cause turned out to be defective rainwater drain connections rather than groundwater, that Vestia will repair them and start a planned maintenance approach, that Vestia is examining compensation, and that tenants can go to the Huurcommissie, but did not commit to a two-month timeline.
Vestia is examining the possibilities of compensation for residents who have been unable to use their storage space for a longer period due to the water nuisance.
Vestia onderzoekt de mogelijkheden van een compensatie voor bewoners die gedurende een langere periode geen gebruik hebben kunnen maken van hun berging als gevolg van de wateroverlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over slecht geïsoleerde particuliere huurwoningen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about poorly insulated private rental homes, high energy-label shares, rent freezes, and subsidies for private and corporate rentals above the liberalisation limit. Minister Ollongren answered that tenants already have legal routes (courts, rent commission, right of initiative under art. 7:243 BW), that data on maintenance and insulation are not yet available, and that subsidy options await the integrated Klimaatakkoord package.
Once the research results are available, the Chamber will be informed about them.
Zodra de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over vorderingen van de Belastingdienst inzake schadevergoedingen gaswinningsschade

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority taxes part of earthquake damage compensation paid to entrepreneurs and households, and whether this is fair. The minister answered that compensation for lost business income is taxed as business profit while costs of repair can be deducted, that damage compensation for private persons is generally not taxed except via box 3 wealth, and that no separate fiscal policy is planned.
I cannot respond substantively to a situation that is not described in more detail.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk reageren op een niet nader beschreven situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht ‘Archeologie bij gemeenten ondergeschoven kindje’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how to respond to a report that municipal archaeological oversight falls short, citing monitor figures on policy currency, staffing, inter-municipal cooperation, finds reporting and enforcement. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, argues the figures do not necessarily mean poor practice, points to ongoing instruments and projects with the heritage agency, and sees no need for an action plan.
I see no reason for an action plan.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Vermillion die bij Woerden naar olie wil boren

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Vermilion's planned second well near Woerden has been licensed, where similar gas-injection oil extraction occurs, what the effects on soil and drinking water are, and whether Vermilion has a fund to cover damage. The Minister answers that no revised production plan or environmental permit has yet been submitted, that the technique is used abroad but not in the Netherlands, that environmental and safety assessments apply at the plan stage, and that a national damage protocol and Waarborgfonds cover any shortfall.
Vermilion has currently not submitted an updated production plan to me, nor applied for an environmental permit for extracting oil or gas in the Papekopveld.
Vermilion heeft op dit moment bij mij geen geactualiseerd winningsplan ingediend of een omgevingsvergunning aangevraagd voor de winning van aardolie of aardgas in het Papekopveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voorkomen van onveilige balkons

Beckerman (SP) asks the minister whether galleries and balconies are being adequately inspected for safety, whether a mandatory inspection duty should be extended to balconies, and whether municipalities should have sanctioning powers and owners' associations should be supported. The minister says the gallery inspection duty stays limited to galleries, that municipalities bear the burden of proof for Bouwbesluit violations, that she will commission a study with VvE Belang on owners' associations' readiness to assess building condition, and that she opposes a general mandatory periodic inspection regime.
I therefore see no reason at present to extend this inspection duty.
Ik zie daarom thans geen aanleiding om deze onderzoeksplicht uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de inkomensgrens voor sociale huur omhoog kan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the CJEU ruling allowing the social rental income limit to be raised should lead to a broader target group, whether earlier interpretations of EU rules were wrong, and whether the ATAD earnings-stripping rule should exempt housing associations. The Minister rejected the claim that the income limit can be raised, said the Commission decision binds the government, and found no reason to revisit ATAD or seek exemption for housing associations.
I do not share your conclusion that the income limit for social rental housing can be raised.
Ik deel niet uw conclusie dat de inkomensgrens voor de sociale huur omhoog kan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huiseigenaren die arbeidsmigranten in kamertjes proppen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked ministers about homeowners housing migrant workers in overcrowded rooms, the shortage of adequate housing, Hilvarenbeek's housing target, and the government's role. The minister answers that housing is a regional and local responsibility, points to the SNF quality mark and a forthcoming guide for municipalities, but declines to give a count of migrant workers without adequate housing and offers no national lead role.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be determined at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NAM die de uitspraak van de Arbiter Bodembeweging niet uitvoert

MP Beckerman asks the minister why NAM does not comply with Arbiter Bodembeweging rulings on Groningen gas-damage claims, including a case where a resident waited a year for compensation, and whether a general pardon is warranted. The minister says NAM generally complies, that only one case involved fundamental objections, that the matters are individual, and that no general pardon is needed since the remaining claims are still before the arbiter.
Furthermore, it is not appropriate for me to address individual cases that are or have been before the arbiter.
Verder past het mij niet om in te gaan op individuele zaken die bij de arbiter in behandeling zijn of zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beantwoording van vragen inzake het lekken van gif door de NAM en het bericht ‘Metingen NAM-lek ver boven grens’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas condensate leaks by the NAM at Delfzijl, measurement levels, prior incidents, safety rules and possible unreported incidents. The Minister answered that the Veiligheidsregio and SodM are responsible for measurements and inspections, that the criminal investigation is with the Openbaar Ministerie, and that a NAM exposure study is due by 1 February 2019, while acknowledging the Veiligheidsregio initially did not apply the RIVM advisory value.
The Public Prosecution Service leads the criminal investigation. I have no insight into the status or progress of this investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie geeft leiding aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Ik heb geen inzicht in de status of de voortgang van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat er miljoenen liters pekelwater zijn weggelekt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that millions of litres of brine leaked from a Nedmag pipeline, including whether diesel was released, the environmental impact, monitoring, whether Nedmag should be placed under intensified supervision, and how residents were informed. The minister answered that the leak is not a mining activity, so the province of Groningen and its Omgevingsdienst are the competent authority and supervisor, that no diesel was released, that Nedmag must investigate contamination and repairs and replacement are underway, and that the province sees no reason for intensified supervision.
With regard to Nedmag's mining activities, I am the competent authority and the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) is the supervisor.
Ten aanzien van de mijnbouwactiviteiten van Nedmag ben ik het bevoegd gezag en is Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Nedmag maximaal zout mag winnen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Nedmag's revised salt-mining plan, subsidence of 95 cm, the April 2018 leak, new drilling, diesel use and objection rights. The minister said the plan is still under technical review by SodM, TNO and Tcbb, that a 95 cm subsidence is not allowed under the current plan, that objections are possible via a draft decision and a zienswijze procedure, and that absolute safety cannot be guaranteed.
The advice of SodM and all other advisers will be taken into account in my approval decision on this amended mining plan.
Het advies van SodM en alle andere adviseurs zal ik meenemen in mijn instemmingsbesluit op dit gewijzigde winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij alle duurzame aardwarmteprojecten in Nederland'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of possible leakage at geothermal projects, its environmental effects, the need for more investment, and whether households would face higher heat prices. The minister acknowledged the sector's technical challenges, said no contamination had been confirmed yet, pointed to SodM supervision and a forthcoming RIVM risk study, and stated that heat prices for end users are capped by a gas reference.
Based on the RIVM report, which will be published this month, SodM will start an environmental programme focused on the risks.
Op basis van het RIVM-rapport, dat deze maand zal worden gepubliceerd, zal door SodM een milieuprogramma worden opgestart dat zich richt op de risico's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een studie betreffende methaanlekkages bij oude en verlaten gaswinningsputten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a University of Utrecht study on methane leakage from abandoned gas wells, the risks, the leaking well at Monster, and whether leak costs are charged to the polluter. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the current risk is very small, outlined SodM supervision of abandonment and remediation, and committed to developing a leak-detection protocol with TNO and ECN.
SodM supervises the duty of care resting on the mining company to leave wells fully and durably sealed.
SodM houdt toezicht op de zorgplicht die rust bij het mijnbouwbedrijf om putten volledig en duurzaam afgesloten achter te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gestapelde mijnbouw naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Expertmeeting' moet oplossingen bieden rond zoutwinning Nouryon en Nedmag’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about how damage from stacked mining (Groningen gas extraction plus salt mining by Nedmag and Nouryon) will be handled, including which claims body is responsible, whether the reversed burden of proof applies, timing, and the role of the National Coordinator Groningen. The Minister answered that two bodies (IMG and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade) will split claims, the reversed burden of proof applies only to Groningen gas damage, and that dismantling salt mining is not deemed necessary.
I aim to bring a bill to this effect into procedure this year.
Ik streef ernaar nog dit jaar een hiertoe strekkend wetsvoorstel in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van der Lee en Nijboer over woningen die eerst versterkt zouden worden, maar nu veilig blijken te zijn volgens het HRA-model

MPs Beckerman, Van der Lee and Nijboer asked the minister why Groningen homes in batches 1581 and 1588, promised reinforcement under earlier motions, now appear safe under the HRA model, and how residents keep control over their homes. The minister says reinforcement continues for batch 1588, that batch 1581 is handled via prepared advice with owner choice, declines to comment on individual cases, and stresses owners have the final say while admitting uncertainty remains.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views on an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar van gedachten te wisselen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over privacy schending van woningzoekenden

The SP MP Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing allocation systems such as Woonnet Haaglanden breach the GDPR by requesting income declarations at registration, how many corporations do so, and whether applicants refused for earning too much or for withholding income data are compensated. The Minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is competent to judge GDPR compliance, that Woonnet says it only requests income data once a allocation is imminent, and that she has no figures on refusals or compensation, while asking Aedes to communicate the AP's view if one is issued.
The judgement whether these corporations or cooperation bodies act in breach of the GDPR falls to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Het oordeel of deze – samenwerkingsverbanden van – corporaties in strijd handelen met de AVG komt toe aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over inwoners die in de kou zitten door torenhoge stookkosten in Delft

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about residents in Delft facing very high heating costs, including a housing corporation's metering system and tenants' demands. The Minister explained the general billing system, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and their legal remedies, and said the government does not register which metering systems corporations use or where complaints arise.
It is not registered which system landlords use to measure heating costs.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd welk systeem verhuurders toepassen voor het meten van de stookkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het vastlopen van de versterking in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about reported criticism of the Groningen reinforcement operation, including claims of delay tactics, staff distrust, the HRA model, financing of home inspections and inequality between municipalities. The minister denied deliberate delay, said the HRA model is only used for risk prioritisation, confirmed NAM will cover reinforcement costs, and said some schemes will be reviewed while no concrete timetable was promised.
The implementation of the reinforcement cannot, however, wait for this.
Dit uitvoering van de versterking kan hier echter niet op wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de nieuwbouw van een school in de problemen komt door stijgende bouwkosten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers whether rising construction costs delaying a school building in De Bilt reflect a national problem, whether budgets are sufficient, and how mould and damp in schools are addressed. The ministers replied that rising costs are a market trend with no specific school-building data kept, that existing budgets for maintenance are adequate, and that they see no further options to curb cost increases beyond a pilot programme.
Beyond that, I see no options for curbing the rising costs of school construction resulting from market developments.
Verder zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de stijgende kosten van scholenbouw als gevolg van marktontwikkelingen in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders slechter af zijn dan huizenbezitters

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that tenants are worse off than homeowners, including their housing-cost burden, purchasing power, rent reduction and satisfaction with housing. The minister rejects the notion of a housing divide, argues that tenant and owner groups are hard to compare, and says a general rent reduction is not appropriate while rent affordability keeps her attention.
I do not share your view that there is a divide in the housing market.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat er sprake is van een tweedeling op de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de door de gemeente Delfzijl aan te leggen noodleiding bij het NAM tankenpark in Farmsum

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a temporary emergency sewer built by Delfzijl municipality around the NAM tank park in Farmsum after condensate leaked into a canal, covering who pays, what happens to the contaminated pipes and stored water, inspection frequency, quantities released and health effects, and prevention. The minister answered that NAM pays the costs, the sewer was cleaned and reopened, about 29 m3 of condensate reached the canal with limited resident exposure, and SodM imposed additional safety measures and put the site under intensified supervision.
After discovering the cause of the condensate leak, SodM ordered NAM to repair the damage.
Na het ontdekken van de oorzaak van de lekkage van het aardgascondensaat heeft SodM de NAM gesommeerd om de schade te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het lekken van gif door de NAM in Farmsum

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about the NAM condensate leak at the Farmsum tank park, including exposure of residents, prior SodM inspections, BRZO status, enforcement, sewer connection, health checks, and incident history. Minister Wiebes answered in detail, saying exposure was limited, SodM placed the site under heightened supervision with measures imposed on NAM, and a criminal investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie is ongoing, which he could not comment on.
The tank park is currently under heightened supervision.
Het tankenpark staat momenteel onder verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat woningcorporaties geen energiesubsidies mogen aanvragen

An MP asked whether housing associations are barred from applying for SDE+ renewable energy subsidies, and why some could while others could not, and whether the rules can be harmonised. The minister replied that the Woningwet does not exclude associations from SDE+ subsidy, that electricity sold to third parties falls outside their core work, that the Aw supervises individual cases, and that the issue will be considered in the upcoming Woningwet evaluation.
Housing associations are not excluded from applying for SDE subsidy under the Housing Act, and the subsidy scheme also contains no exclusion of associations from receiving SDE subsidy.

Woningcorporaties zijn op grond van de Woningwet niet uitgesloten van het aanvragen van SDE-subsidie en ook de subsidieregeling kent ook geen uitsluiting voor verlening van SDE-subsidie aan corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Beckerman over het dreigende tekort aan stroom in België vanwege uitgeschakelde kernreactoren

MPs Wassenberg and Beckerman asked whether the Netherlands would supply emergency electricity to Belgium amid nuclear reactor shutdowns, raising CO2, price, reactor safety and parliamentary consultation concerns. The minister answered that Belgium seeks optimised interconnector capacity rather than extra power, that CO2 emissions cannot be excluded, that FANC is responsible for nuclear safety, and that the operational measures fall within TenneT's competence.
Question 11: Are you willing to avoid irreversible steps and submit decisions on supplying electricity to Belgium to the House?
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen en besluiten over de levering van stroom aan België voor te leggen aan de Kamer?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de achteruitgang van leefbaarheid in wijken

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior about the deterioration of neighbourhood liveability, the options for municipalities and housing corporations, and whether the income limit for social housing and the passend toewijzen rules should be changed. The Minister acknowledged the survey and Leefbarometer findings, pointed to existing instruments for mixing neighbourhoods, said the Woningwet evaluation will report by year end, and declined to commit to raising the income limit or changing passend toewijzen now.
I am of the view that this set of instruments gives local parties sufficient opportunities to address keeping neighbourhoods liveable and safe.
Ik ben van mening dat dit instrumentarium lokale partijen voldoende mogelijkheden biedt om zorg en invulling te geven aan het leefbaar en veilig houden van wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over blazers bij chemiebedrijf ESD-SIC in Delfzijl

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the State Secretary about recurring 'blazers' (sulphur dust clouds released with a bang from smelting furnaces) at chemical company ESD-SIC in Delfzijl, and whether the government can end them, fine the company, and acknowledge local health and odour nuisance. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen is the competent authority responsible for permitting and enforcement, that Rijkswaterstaat-Infomil can advise it, that blazers are not prohibited under the current permit, and that the province adopted a maatwerkbesluit requiring a study into avoiding them, while acknowledging the nuisance for residents.
Naturally, the province remains responsible for granting permits and supervising the company.
Uiteraard blijft de provincie verantwoordelijk voor de vergunningverlening en het toezicht op het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over de brandveiligheid van gebouwen

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked about fire-safety of buildings, including combustible facade panels, the reported Nijmegen plan to loosen fire-safety enforcement, and what the minister can do to intervene in municipalities. The minister said an inventory of risky buildings is being prepared with the VBWTN and fire service, with a letter expected end of November, that municipalities have policy freedom in enforcement and are accountable to their councils, and that she has no power to intervene since interbestuurlijk toezicht lies with the provinces.
Although it is therefore not for me to have an opinion on this, I made inquiries with the municipality as part of the right of reply.
Hoewel het dus niet aan mij is om hierover een mening te hebben, heb ik in het kader van wederhoor navraag gedaan bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gevolgen van de WOZ-waarde in het huurpuntenstelsel en de verhuurderheffing

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the effects of WOZ property values in the rent-points system and the landlord levy on social rents, liberalisation thresholds and municipal property tax. The Minister answered that the WOZ-based model was deliberate, that its effects are being evaluated, that the levy revenues have not exceeded the original projections, and that she will not divert levy gains to tenants but will report on local options.

How many social rental homes have crossed the liberalisation threshold since the rent-points system, in which the WOZ value determines a large part of the rent, was introduced will emerge from the evaluation of the WWS.

Hoeveel sociale huurwoningen de liberalisatiegrens zijn overgegaan sinds het ingaan van het huurpuntenstelsel waarin de WOZ-waarde een groot deel van de huurprijs bepaalt, zal naar voren komen bij de evaluatie van het WWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat in de vier grote steden 1 op de 5 huizen wordt verkocht aan beleggers

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the public sale of social rental flats in Groningen to investors, and the growing share of investor purchases in big cities, will drive up rents and house prices. The Minister answered that the corporation and municipality acted lawfully, that municipal and tenant consultation rules apply, that the government is monitoring investor effects and will report next year, and that local solutions for starters are the responsibility of municipalities.
I do not have figures on how often a social rental home is sold through a comparable tender.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers hoe vaak een sociale huurwoning via een vergelijkbare aanbesteding wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘opinie veiligheid Groningers staat zeker voorop’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the 2018/2019 Groningen gas extraction (19.4 bcm) exceeds the SodM safe level of 12 bcm, and whether the minister's claim that Groningers' safety comes first holds given the lack of a legal phase-out plan. The minister answers that extraction will fall below 12 bcm within a few years via measures and a phase-out plan, but that a cold year may require more extraction to avoid disconnecting consumers.
The cabinet presented a phase-out plan on 29 March.
Het kabinet heeft op 29 maart jl. een afbouwplan gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Onderzoek: ‘Redenen waarom eigenaren aanbod schade-afhandeling niet hebben geaccepteerd’

MP Beckerman asked the minister why owners rejected NAM's damage settlement offers, whether 84% acceptance means fair offers, and how old damage claims will be resolved. The minister said the study covers only rejecters, that NAM revised some offers after signals, that rejecters can go to the Arbiter Bodembeweging, and that the arbiter aims to finish by September 2019.
The study gives no substantive judgment on NAM's functioning.
Het onderzoek geeft geen inhoudelijk oordeel over het functioneren van NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over illegale boetes door huisbazen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether a Nijmegen landlord may impose fines of 50 to 100 euro for misplaced bicycles or forgotten keys, and whether this is common and how the government will act against abuse of tenants' dependent position. The minister answers that fines are permitted if agreed in the lease and reasonable, that a landlord may only charge a cost-based reimbursement absent such terms, that unlawful brokerage fees are banned, and that she is working to improve enforcement as requested in a motion.
Landlords are permitted to include penalty clauses in their lease contracts or general terms for cases where the tenant does not comply with certain agreements on house rules.

Het is verhuurders toegestaan om in hun huurcontracten dan wel in de algemene voorwaarden bij de huurcontracten boetebepalingen op te nemen voor gevallen de huurder bepaalde afspraken omtrent «huisregels» niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over verhuurder Camelot

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Interior and Education Ministers about the letting company Camelot and its treatment of student tenants at the University of Twente, including deposits, mandatory services, referrals and whether rules need tightening. Minister Ollongren answered that companies may choose their business, that Camelot has reduced its deposit to 1,000 euro after university consultation, that tenants can seek legal advice and rulings, and that the issues feed into the student housing action plan and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach, with a follow-up letter promised after a sector meeting.
I will meet the sector on 1 November about the Goed verhuurderschap approach.
Ik spreek op 1 november met de sector over de aanpak Goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de versterking van scholen in het aardbevingsgebied in Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the reinforcement of Groningen earthquake-area schools (notably De Wilgenstee in Zeerijp) has been delayed or put on hold, whether NAM halted the process, and whether NAM still decides which buildings are reinforced. The minister answered that delays at the Abt Emo affect the sequencing, that the programme as a whole is not delayed, that the bouwvergunning issue is a municipal matter outside NAM's influence, and that reinforcement advice is not revised in light of the phase-out.
It cannot be ruled out that delays will arise in individual projects due to, for example, objections from local residents, delays in permit granting or unforeseen weather conditions.
Het is niet uit te sluiten dat bij individuele projecten vertraging ontstaat door bijvoorbeeld bezwaar van omwonenden, vertraging in de vergunningverlening of onvoorziene weersomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NVWA en vervolgonderzoeken naar onveilige cv-ketels

An MP asks how the NVWA handled the safety of Nefit gas boilers (B3L and B3M) from 2009 to 2018, including the handling of heat exchanger problems, oversight design, certification plans, registration of appliances and periodic inspection. The government answers that the NVWA acted in line with its powers, that a certification regime and related bill are being prepared, and it declines to introduce central serial-number registration or mandatory periodic inspection of home installations.
The NVWA was informed about this by the German authorities.
De NVWA is daarover door de Duitse autoriteiten geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over studenten die naar de rechter moeten voor onterecht betaalde bemiddelingskosten

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why students must go to court to recover improperly charged brokerage fees, and what the ACM and government will do about it.
