The minister answered that courts judge individual cases, that the ACM acts only on systematic violations, that a Huurcommissie role and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach are being explored, and that data on the number of affected tenants and municipal support are not available.
I do not have figures on the number of brokers who wrongly charge disguised brokerage fees or on how many tenants have been wrongly charged.

Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die ten onrechte verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen en aan hoeveel huurders ten onrechte bemiddelingskosten in rekening is gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurtoeslag voor mensen die beschermd wonen of huren via een instelling

The SP's Beckerman asked why the Tax Administration's website dropped the statement that residents of temporary housing, such as shelters, receive no housing allowance, and whether this followed a 2015 Council of State ruling; he also asked about clawbacks, the number of affected tenants, and how the government will improve move-on from shelters. The minister answered that the ruling and a 2016 law on fixed-term contracts reduced such exclusions, that clawbacks continue where contracts are for short-term use, and that the government is exploring a model contract and a target-group contract with the sector, with results to Parliament by end 2018.
Precise figures on how many people currently rent a home through a social or care institution are not known, because they are not registered nationally.
Over het aantal mensen dat op dit moment een woning via een maatschappelijke of zorginstelling huurt zijn geen precieze cijfers bekend, omdat deze niet landelijk worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat er ook bevingen bij zoutwinning kunnen ontstaan

MPs Beckerman (SP) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about KNMI findings that salt mining can cause tremors near Groningen, the risk of a salt cavern near Winschoten, the advice to halt new wells in Veendam, damage compensation liability, and whether salt mining should be phased out. The minister denied the problems are more serious than thought, said the Winschoten cavern is stable but monitored, said the Veendam expansion requires an amended mining plan by 1 January 2019, and committed to follow SodM recommendations.
Individuals who believe they have suffered damage can, after the mining company has rejected the claim, appeal to the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb).
Particulieren die menen schade te hebben kunnen, nadat deze claim is afgewezen door het desbetreffende mijnbouwbedrijf, een beroep doen op de Tcbb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Tritium in het Maaswater

MP Beckerman asked whether the 100 Bq/l tritium drinking-water limit would force a halt to Maas water intake, what dose is safe, whether any safe dose exists for chronic low-dose beta exposure, and whether an intervention value of 19 Bq/l should be set. The minister answered that the 100 Bq/l value is a screening threshold not reached in practice, that no safe low-dose value can be scientifically established, and that no lower intervention value is warranted, citing continuous monitoring at Eijsden.
I see no reason to include an intervention value (i.e. a signalling value) for tritium for intake surface water in the Drinking Water Regulation.
Ik zie geen reden om een interventiewaarde (i.c. een signaleringswaarde) voor tritium voor in te nemen oppervlaktewater in de Drinkwaterregeling op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de lessen die Nederland heeft getrokken ruim een jaar na de brand in de Londense Grenfell Tower

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior what lessons the Netherlands has drawn from the 2017 Grenfell Tower fire, including fire safety of buildings, insulation materials, and EPBD implications. The minister replied that the UK inquiry report is delayed, so lessons await it, an advisory body has been tasked, and municipalities will be asked to inventory high-risk buildings and consider stricter regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de inventarisatie van brandgevaarlijke gevelplaten

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether more information exists on the extent of fire-hazardous facade panels in the Netherlands, whether suppliers were approached, whether municipalities are asked to inventory affected buildings, and whether Nijmegen's self-inspection by housing corporations is problematic. The Minister says all municipalities will be asked to inventory the most risky buildings and check Bouwbesluit compliance, with the approach still being discussed with VBWTN and the fire service, and that building owners bear primary responsibility while municipalities have policy freedom in building supervision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

An SP MP asks the minister about the slow handling of Groningen earthquake damage claims, the Arbiter backlog, NAM's automatic referral of large C-damage claims, and the uncertainty surrounding reinforcement operations. The minister responds that old claims are being resolved, refuses to compensate residents directly at state expense, promises to review the TU Delft report and to send an assessment to parliament, and acknowledges that reinforcement uncertainty has damaged residents' trust.

I will shortly send your House a final report from NAM on the approach to old damage cases, with exact figures on how many residents accepted NAM's offer and how many of them registered with the Arbiter.

Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort een eindrapportage van NAM aanbieden over de aanpak oude schadegevallen, met exacte cijfers over hoeveel bewoners het aanbod van NAM hebben geaccepteerd en hoeveel van hen zich bij de Arbiter hebben aangemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de belofte dat mensen uit batch 1588 voor 19 juli duidelijkheid zouden hebben en de gevolgen voor de stressbeleving van mensen wanneer dit niet gebeurt

An SP MP asked whether residents of batch 1.588 received the promised letter giving clarity before 19 July, and about stress and distrust when clarity is delayed. The minister confirmed the letter was sent, said the group's composition is unchanged and the reinforcement approach can proceed, and reported on the health action plan and related programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het verpatsen van sociale huurhuizen aan buitenlandse beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a government website promoting Dutch social rental housing to foreign investors, trade missions to London and Southeast Asia, and the liberalisation and sale of social housing to foreign investors were justified, and what they cost. The Minister answered that the website only informs investors about the Dutch housing market, reported modest costs, said further trips were not planned, and pointed to sale rules and local authority roles while declining to ban foreign buyers as New Zealand did.
Question 4: How much public money did the foreign trips and the website cost?
Vraag 4 Hoeveel gemeenschapsgeld hebben de buitenlandse reizen en de website gekost?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige balkons en galerijen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about a collapsed balcony in Groningen, why 312 balconies were closed despite recent renovation, prior warnings, whether all gallery flats were inspected, inspection results nationally, and balcony safety outside gallery flats. The Minister answered that corporations and the municipality investigated and took measures, that the national inspection duty lies with owners and municipalities with provincial oversight, and that the Minister holds no results data and will await the ongoing investigation.

Supervision of compliance with the gallery flat inspection duty lies with the municipality. Inter-governmental supervision of this municipal task lies with the province. I have no role in this supervision.

Het toezicht op de naleving van de onderzoeksplicht van galerijflats ligt bij de gemeente. Het interbestuurlijke toezicht op deze gemeentelijke taak ligt bij de provincie. Ik heb geen rol bij dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over wijken die kunnen veranderen in getto’s

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing policy such as passend toewijzen is causing neighbourhoods to become one-sided 'ghettos', and asked for a new multi-year neighbourhood policy. The Minister rejected the ghetto framing, said local actors bear primary responsibility and listed tools they have, and declined to introduce a new neighbourhood policy or to change the Woningwet ahead of its 2018 evaluation.
Given these possibilities, I do not consider the introduction of a new multi-year neighbourhood policy to be necessary.
Gegeven deze mogelijkheden acht ik de introductie van een nieuw meerjarig wijkenbeleid niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat het aantal huurwoningen in handen van particulieren de afgelopen tien jaar met 40% is gestegen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the rise in privately owned rental homes and buy-to-let investment threatens first-time buyers and warrants national measures. The minister disputes the 40% rise figure as a data artefact, argues private renting is a welcome supply addition best handled locally, and rejects general restrictions while promising a later letter on good landlordship and regional measures.
I do not see private renting in itself as a problem, but as an opportunity for more mid-market rental homes.
Particuliere verhuur zie ik op zichzelf niet als probleem, maar als een kans voor meer middenhuurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de tarieflijst Tijdelijke Commissie Mijnbouwschade Groningen (TCMG) waarin ook de overlastvergoeding genoemd wordt

The MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the TCMG tariff list, which includes a 250 euro nuisance allowance, asking whether it applies only to post-31 March 2017 damage claims, whether tenants and old-damage claimants are covered, and whether the payments affect tax and benefits. The Minister answered that the TCMG handles only claims after 31 March 2017 while NAM handles old claims generously, that tenant arrangements are being explored, and that the allowance does not affect other compensation, though the claim must be filed individually.
The TCMG expects to be able to provide clarity on this in the short term.
De TCMG verwacht hier op korte termijn duidelijkheid over te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de storing in de kerncentrale Borssele

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a third shutdown of the Borssele nuclear plant within a year, whether a pattern exists, the INES level, and why the latest incident was not on the ANVS timeline sooner. The government answered that no pattern is evident across 15 unusual events since 2015, all rated INES-0, and that EPZ reported the event and ANVS published it on its website, with the timeline entry added on 7 August once details were clear.
From both the nature and the number of unusual events and shutdowns at the Borssele nuclear plant, no pattern can be inferred.
Uit zowel de aard als het aantal ongewone gebeurtenissen en afschakelingen bij de kerncentrale Borssele is geen patroon af te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de sanering van tritium gelukt is

An SP MP asked whether the tritium remediation at Petten is nearing its end, whether the plan of approach was approved with monthly and semi-annual monitoring, and whether the groundwater remediation norm being raised from 100 to 5000 Bq/L makes further remediation unnecessary and endangers crops and food. The State Secretary confirmed approval of NRG's new plan on 15 June 2018, explained the norm change was based on a RIVM risk analysis finding negligible risk (below 10 microsievert per year), and described the monitoring regime.
On 15 June 2018 I approved the new Plan of Approach of NRG for the remediation of the tritium contamination in the soil of the Petten research site (OLP).

Op 15 juni 2018 heb ik het nieuwe Plan van Aanpak van de Nuclear Research and consultancy Group (NRG) voor de sanering van de tritiumverontreiniging in de bodem van de Onderzoekslocatie Petten (OLP) goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de schadevergoeding van Belastingdienst in verband met inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked about the consequences of a court ruling that the Tax Authority must pay damages to a tenant for wrongly disclosing income data to a landlord for income-dependent rent increases, and whether affected rents should be reversed. The minister answered that the government disagrees with the ruling and has appealed, does not believe rents should be reduced to 2012 levels, and sees no reason to start talks with those affected and the Woonbond.

How many households actually received a higher income-dependent rent increase is not known to me, because it is up to landlords whether or not to use the option of an income-dependent (higher) rent increase.

Voor hoeveel huishoudens daadwerkelijk een inkomensafhankelijke hogere huurverhoging is toegepast is mij niet bekend, omdat het aan verhuurders is om al dan niet gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid tot inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht op de website van de belastingdienst getiteld 'Wat betekent de vergoeding voor aardbevingsschade voor mijn toeslagen?'

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether compensation for Groningen earthquake damage should reduce childcare and child benefit allowances, and whether recipients face double harm and other benefit effects. The minister answered that compensation should leave people no worse off, that only a very limited group is affected through box 3 income, that such effects count as consequential damage claimable at the TCMG, and that no specific fiscal regulation is planned.
I am asking the TCMG to actively inform about this and am looking with them at how this can best be arranged in practice.
Ik vraag de TCMG hier actief over te informeren en kijk met hen hoe dit uitvoeringstechnisch het beste kan worden geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht dat energiebedrijven met miljardenclaims klimaatbeleid tegenhouden

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that energy companies use multi-billion-euro claims under the Energy Charter Treaty to block climate policy, including whether Dutch letterbox firms exploit the treaty. Minister Kaag replied that the treaty gives investors limited protection, that the Netherlands opposes letterbox firms using it, and that renegotiation in 2019 will seek an explicit right for states to regulate in the public interest.
The cabinet will, among other things, advocate that letterbox companies be excluded from protection under the Energy Charter Treaty.
Het kabinet zal er daarbij onder meer voor pleiten dat brievenbusfirma’s worden uitgesloten van bescherming onder het Energiehandvestverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gratis zonnepanelen voor huurders

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations should install solar panels on rented homes without rent increases, how many social rental homes have panels, whether corporate reserves could fund over a million panels, and why panel costs can be passed on through service charges. The minister answered that such choices are local matters for corporations, tenants and municipalities, gave Aedes figures for 67,900 corporation homes with panels, estimated capacity from non-DAEB reserves with caveats, and explained the legal tenant-consent rules (70% for complexes) without committing to change the rules.
I see no reason to actively steer the agreements made locally on this.
Ik zie geen reden om actief te gaan sturen op de afspraken die hierover lokaal gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de investeringen in kolencentrales in de Westelijke Balkan

Two SP MPs asked the government about Chinese investment in coal plants in the Western Balkans, whether this shows weak EU accession commitment, how it affects Dutch coal phase-out and EU climate targets, and whether the Netherlands will raise environmental standards with EU partners. The minister answered that accession countries must align with EU law including the ETS, that the EU 40% target stays, that accession is a long process with strict, fair criteria, and that the Netherlands will continue to insist on these conditions including environmental ones.
The cabinet adheres to a strict and fair EU accession policy and consistently emphasises this in European forums.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan een strikt en fair EU-toetredingsbeleid en benadrukt dit steevast in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beving bij Warder

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the June 2018 earthquake near Warder, its link to gas fields, damage claims, safety risks of small gas fields, monitoring, and whether small-field extraction should be phased out faster. The Minister confirmed the quake is classified as induced, most likely by gas extraction, but said causation from the nearest field cannot be stated with certainty; he reported one minor damage claim, found no monitoring change needed, and saw no reason to accelerate phase-out.
No, I do not see that reason.
Nee, die aanleiding zie ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat het bedrijf Nedmag zijn zoutwinningslocatie sluit als gevolg van problemen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a leak and pressure drop at Nedmag's Tripscompagnie salt field, its accelerated shutdown, risks of subsidence and groundwater contamination, stacked mining in Groningen, and whether the Borgercompagnie expansion should be halted. The minister answered that the leak is stabilised and under SodM-supervised investigation, that the field will be wound down over about eighteen months, and that pending expansion permits are on hold until the leak's cause and effects are clear, but gave no firm halt commitment.
The investigation into the cause and effects of the leak is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de oorzaak en effecten van de lekkage is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de spanning tussen oude en nieuwe schades

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about cases where damage from before 31 March 2017 worsened after later earthquakes, so that residents could be bounced between NAM and the TCMG, and about the handling and privacy of old files. The minister answered that no such cases of residents being sent back and forth are known, that old files are partly retained and remain accessible until year-end, and that a temporary handover with the resident's consent is possible.
In any case, there should be no situation in which residents are endlessly sent from one body to the other.
Er mag sowieso geen sprake van zijn dat bewoners eindeloos van de ene naar de andere instantie worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de zorgen van SodM over zoutwinning door AkzoNobel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) concerns over salt extraction by AkzoNobel, including cavern shape changes near Heiligerlee, leaks, and the location and risks of ongoing extraction. The minister answered that monitoring networks are being set up, that residents are informed via company channels, that leaks are investigated under SodM supervision, and that no reason exists to suspend extraction as SodM has not judged the risks unacceptable.
I will ask SodM to interpret the results of this research and make them public.
Ik zal SodM vragen om de resultaten dit onderzoek te duiden en openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Karabulut over de Nederlandse deelname aan de Iran Oil Show

MPs Beckerman and Karabulut asked whether Dutch government support for Dutch firms at the Iran Oil Show, including RVO and Dutch Energy Solutions programmes for the Iranian gas market, is consistent with Dutch climate policy, and what support is given to the oil and gas sector. The minister answered that participation is a matter for individual firms, that no direct financial aid is given, that the support is mainly embassy networking and export instruments, and that the government sees no reason to stop it.
It is up to individual companies to decide which international events they wish to attend.
Het is aan individuele bedrijven om te bepalen aan welke internationale bijeenkomsten zij willen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over beleggingen van het pensioenfonds ABP

An SP MP asked ministers whether the ABP pension fund's rising fossil fuel investments, and its holdings in companies harming climate and environment, are acceptable for a fund serving public-sector workers, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that ABP invests for employees rather than the state, that engagement with companies is the chosen approach, that IMVO covenants with the financial sector are being negotiated, and that the IORP directive will require more disclosure to members.
As also mentioned in the answer to question 1, ABP is the pension fund of the employees concerned and not of the government.
Zoals ook genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, is ABP het pensioenfonds van betreffende werknemers en niet van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked ministers about rent increases imposed by housing corporations in the Groningen earthquake area on tenants whose homes are unsafe and not yet reinforced, and about compensation and reinforcement timelines. The ministers said corporations decide rent increases, tenants can seek reductions via the Huurcommissie, reinforcement plans await advisory reports, and value-loss compensation is being studied.
Rental regulations provide that tenants can go to the Rent Tribunal and that the Rent Tribunal can judge a rent increase as unreasonable
De huurregelgeving regelt dat huurders naar de Huurcommissie kunnen stappen en dat de Huurcommissie een huurverhoging als onredelijk kan beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over crimineel geld in de Amsterdamse huizenmarkt

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether criminal money is entering the Amsterdam housing market, how large it is, what measures exist to keep it out, and whether police have enough capacity. The Minister replied that the reports describe risks rather than established facts, pointed to an upcoming WODC study, and listed existing anti-money-laundering and RIEC cooperation measures while acknowledging police capacity is scarce.
The article, like the police unit's 'Trends and developments' report, speaks of risks rather than established facts.
Het artikel spreekt, net als het rapport «Trends en ontwikkelingen» van de politie-eenheid Amsterdam over risico’s, niet over vastgestelde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat een zonnebedrijf zich schuldig zou maken aan dubieuze grondtransacties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether solar company Powerfield's land transactions amounted to speculation, whether subsidies were justified, and whether the energy transition is better left to public hands. The minister declined to judge the company's conduct, deferring to the AFM and police, explained SDE+ subsidy rules and that unrealised projects receive no subsidy, and said private parties are better placed to develop projects.
It is not for me to judge land speculation.
Het is niet aan mij te oordelen over grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Beckerman en Futselaar over een geplande zoutwinning in de gemeente Enschede

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the municipality of Enschede was not informed or consulted about a German company's planned salt mining, and about the risks of subsidence. The minister replied that under the old Mining Act municipalities had no formal role, that the new Act gives them an advisory role, that the national minister must decide on mining and that the company still lacks an approved extraction plan.
I agree with the municipality of Enschede's position on the role it wishes to have in the permit processes for salt extraction.
Ik ben het eens met het standpunt van de gemeente Enschede over de door haar gewenste rol in de vergunningenprocessen voor de zoutwinning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat voor het eerst in haar geschiedenis de Universiteit van Amsterdam meer aanmeldingen heeft van studenten met een buitenlandse vooropleiding dan m

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether the University of Amsterdam receiving more applications from foreign-educated than Dutch-educated students raises student housing shortages, and asked about housing policy, corporation finances and a planned cap on international student housing. The minister answered that applications are not enrolments, that a joint action plan on student housing is being prepared, and that the government will not limit international student intake or housing, though the answers are largely general.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het energiezuiniger maken van woningen wat huurders meer kost

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why tenants of very energy-efficient homes sometimes pay more rather than less, and how many energy performance fees (EPV) have been agreed and at what level. The minister answered that individual cases are not tracked, that a quickscan found most tenants pay nothing or less at annual settlement, that tenants can go to the rental committee, and that she will not reconsider the EPV or introduce the promised woonlastenwaarborg yet.
In the evaluation of the law, which I am carrying out this year, I will therefore pay attention to tenants' housing costs.
In de evaluatie van de wet, welke ik dit jaar uitvoer, zal ik daarom aandacht houden voor de woonlasten van de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de afhandeling van oude schades door de NAM

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that NAM handles old Groningen damage claims carelessly, including forgotten files and delays after court rulings. The Minister says NAM must process claims carefully and promptly, reports that over half of old claims are resolved, and points to an independent survey and the Onafhankelijke raadsman and Arbiter Bodembeweging as routes for complaints.
In principle I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het The Hague Institute for Global Justice

An SP MP asks the minister about The Hague Institute for Global Justice, questioning whether gas-revenue funding was wasted on luxury events and whether the supervisory board failed to act. The government answers that the one-off subsidy met its conditions, that the board appointments followed the statutes, and that the institute's activities fit the subsidy's purpose.
It was the responsibility of the interim board to appoint the members of the Supervisory Board in accordance with the articles of association.
Het was de verantwoordelijkheid van het tijdelijk bestuur om de leden van de Raad van Toezicht te benoemen conform de statuten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Arno Rutte en Beckerman over het gijzelen van een huurster in Groningen

Three MPs asked the ministers about a Groningen landlord who allegedly locked a tenant in her room by screwing the door shut, and whether such practices occur more widely. The minister declined to comment on the specific case pending investigation, called such confinement unacceptable, outlined planned action against bad landlords including sector agreements and possible legal changes, and noted that exact figures on such offences are not registered.
As long as not all the facts are known, I refrain from commenting on this specific case.
Zolang niet alle feiten bekend zijn onthoud ik mij van een reactie over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NAM die uitspraken van de arbiter naast zich neerlegt

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM repeatedly fails to implement Arbiter Bodembeweging rulings, delaying compensation for Groningen earthquake damage, and what will be done. The minister denies the pattern, says NAM is working on old damage claims and that the Onafhankelijke Raadsman's concerns will be raised, and rejects amending the arbiter's rules to cover consequential damage.
I therefore see no reason to amend the regulations.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de reglementen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Tongeren en Nijboer over de afhandeling van oude schades

MPs Beckerman, Van Tongeren and Nijboer asked the minister whether NAM's handling of old Groningen earthquake damage claims is truly successful, raising concerns about low offers, inspections, the six-week arbiter deadline, the waardevermeerdering scheme, independent research, complaints channels and enforcement of arbiter rulings. The minister replied that acceptance rates are encouraging but success is not yet certain, pointed to an independent study and a SNN scheme for the former buitengebied, and said he cannot impose a deadline on NAM but will press it to act on arbiter rulings.
In addition, an independent investigation into the handling of old damage reports has been started. I will inform your House of the outcomes of this investigation.
Daarnaast is een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de afhandeling van oude schademeldingen gestart. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders duizenden euro’s meer moeten betalen door blokverwarming

The SP MP Beckerman asked whether tenants of a Staedion apartment complex facing large heating bills after the installation of heat meters could be helped, whether independent research into the meters and bills was warranted, and what measures would prevent such cases. The minister replied that the change to metered billing explains the higher costs, that no independent research is planned because tenants can turn to the rent tribunal and courts, and that the landlord has offered consultations and any overcharge would be refunded.
If there are indeed excessive charges, that amount will of course have to be refunded.
Mocht er overigens sprake zijn van teveel in rekening gebrachte kosten, dan zal dit bedrag vanzelfsprekend moeten worden terug betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vervolg van de aanpak van schimmelhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the answers to 37 sets of written questions on mould and damp housing would be forwarded to the municipalities concerned, and whether they could be answered before a committee meeting. The minister replied that the relevant answer letter and questions would be brought to the attention of the municipalities shortly, but that timing did not allow answering before the meeting.
I will bring the content of the relevant answer letter of 12 April, as well as the questions underlying it, to the attention of the municipalities concerned shortly.
Ik zal de inhoud van de betreffende antwoordbrief van 12 april jl., alsmede van de daaraan ten grondslag liggende vragen, op korte termijn onder de aandacht van de betrokken gemeenten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de mogelijkheid van een Airbnb-hypotheek

MP Beckerman asked whether co-financed mortgages tied to Airbnb rental (Loftium) exist in the Netherlands, whether they should be banned, whether the government will use its tourist-rental instrument to ban them, why a platform agreement to collect tourist tax is not possible, and how platforms can be prosecuted for website violations. The minister answered that no such products are known in the Netherlands, that they are undesirable but no ban is warranted, that a platform tourist-tax agreement is not feasible, and that platforms can be prosecuted under criminal or administrative law.
Since I am not aware that such products are currently offered in the Netherlands, I see no reason for a ban.
Aangezien mij niet bekend is dat dergelijke producten op dit moment in Nederland aangeboden worden, zie ik echter geen aanleiding voor een verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Van Engelshoven stelt 17 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor Gronings erfgoed’

MPs asked whether the government will extend subsidies for mining-damaged national monuments in Groningen to monuments outside the ten earthquake municipalities, and about complaints that NAM damage offers ignore monumental value. The minister answered that monuments outside those municipalities are not eligible for the earthquake-specific subsidies but can use other schemes, and that expert damage assessment remains a principle in the TCMG process.
It is correct that these national monuments are not eligible for the relevant subsidy schemes.
Het klopt dat deze rijksmonumenten niet in aanmerking komen voor de betreffende subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van bestaande complexe gevallen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether existing complex Groningen earthquake damage cases fall under the new damage protocol and how they will be resolved by 1 July 2018. The minister answered that pre-March 2017 claims are handled by NAM with a deadline of 1 July 2018, that all old claims get access to the Arbiter Bodembeweging, and that moving them to the new protocol is not feasible.
In addition, after consultation with NAM and the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have decided to give all damage reports from before 31 March 2017 access to the Arbiter Bodembeweging.
Daarnaast heb ik, na overleg met NAM en de Arbiter Bodembeweging, besloten om ook alle schademeldingen van voor 31 maart 2017 toegang te geven tot de Arbiter Bodembeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over corporatiedirecteuren die boven de norm verdienen

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about housing corporation directors earning above the statutory pay norm (WNT), including why transitional rules permit overruns, whether seven top officials repaid excess pay, whether transitional rules will be shortened, and whether corporation directors should fall under the collective labour agreement. The minister answered that transitional rules protect property rights under the ECHR, that five of seven officials have repaid excess pay with the other two still pending and monitored by the supervisor, that no early phase-out is planned, and that the CAO question is for social partners, not the cabinet.
The WNT offers the possibility to impose an order subject to a penalty payment on the corporation.
De WNT biedt de mogelijkheid aan de corporatie een last onder dwangsom op te leggen.
Antwoord op meerdere vragensets van het lid Beckerman over schimmelhuizen in diverse gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about mould-affected rented homes at two addresses in Middelstum, the housing corporation's response, tenants' remedies, and whether the ministry should conduct nationwide research and a national action plan. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the existing tenant remedies (complaints committee, Huurcommissie rent reduction, municipal building supervision, kantonrechter) and corporation-sector initiatives, and said the WoON 2018 survey will count mould-affected dwellings with results to be sent to parliament in early 2019.
As Minister I do not intervene in individual cases, as also indicated in answers to earlier parliamentary questions.
Als Minister treed ik niet in individuele casuïstiek, zoals ook in antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen is aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over asbest bij onderhoud en renovatie van huurwoningen

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked about tenants' rights during renovations of rental housing, including asbestos removal, relocation housing, and whether asbestos removal in Utrecht Overvecht was done without adequate protection. The government answered that tenants have a strong legal position, that landlords must ensure safety and assess asbestos, that disputes can go to court, and that it declines to share inspection reports, which the municipalities or housing corporation control.
It is up to the municipalities or housing corporation Portaal to share the reports with third parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten of woningbouwcorporatie Portaal om de rapporten met derden te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de gevolgen voor bewoners tijdens renovaties

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about tenant rights and living conditions during housing renovations, including temporary housing, compensation for damage, nuisance duration, asbestos, toilet facilities, and tenant participation. The minister answered that tenants have legal rights to compensation and temporary housing where relocation is objectively necessary, that disputes can go to court, and that existing rules suffice, while encouraging agreements between landlords and tenants.
There is therefore an independent procedure for disputes over temporary replacement housing during renovation work.
Er bestaat dus een onafhankelijke procedure voor geschillen over tijdelijke vervangende woon- of verblijfruimte tijdens renovatiewerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de zaak van Jannie Knot nog altijd niet is afgehandeld

MP Beckerman asked the minister why gas-extraction damage claimant Jannie Knot still had not received compensation months after the Arbiter Bodembeweging ruled in her favour, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister acknowledged the delay, said NAM had agreed to resolve old damage claims by 1 July 2018 and that NAM would advance a payment to Knot, but declined to discuss her individual case in detail.
Because this concerns an individual case and the personal situation of a resident with damage, I do not want to go into detail on this.
Omdat het hier over een individuele casus gaat en over de persoonlijke situatie van een bewoonster met schade wil ik hier niet in detail op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat bewoners in het aardbevingsgebied problemen ondervinden met hun hypotheek

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate and provide a remedy for Groningen homeowners facing falling home values and unsaleable homes due to earthquake risk, and whether banks are supporting them. The minister answered that banks will talk with affected owners, that CBS monitors the housing market, and that existing schemes such as the Koopinstrument, NAM value-loss scheme and Commissie Bijzondere Situaties apply, with the issue part of ongoing talks with the region.
Following the report, banks, through the Dutch Banking Association, have stated they are willing to talk with Groningen homeowners experiencing mortgage problems.

Naar aanleiding van het rapport hebben banken bij monde van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken te kennen gegeven dat zij graag in gesprek gaan met Groningse huiseigenaren die problemen met hun hypotheek ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de oprichting van een dochteronderneming door woningcorporatie De Key

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenant opposition to housing corporation De Key creating a commercial subsidiary to take over property, questioning the exemption, the internal loan rate, consultation and tenant protection. The Minister declined to answer substantively because objections under the General Administrative Law Act are pending before the Authority for Housing Corporations, referred most questions there, and stated that the Minister does not intervene in supervisory casework.
Answering some of the questions would anticipate these legal procedures, which is undesirable.
Met het geven van antwoord op een deel van de gestelde vragen zou vooruitgelopen worden op deze juridische procedures, hetgeen onwenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s van gespoten purschuim

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that workers and a family became ill from sprayed PUR foam, and how responsibility and damages should be handled. The minister answered that employers and the installing firm are primarily responsible, victims can pursue civil claims, and the diagnostic protocol was co-funded by the sector, but declined to recognise damage and did not answer the question on the sector's influence in full detail, and refused to answer within 48 hours.
It is not for me to recognise damage.
Het is niet aan mij om schade te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de houding van de NAM bij een arbitragezaak

MPs asked the minister whether he still trusts NAM to handle Groningen damage claims fairly after NAM refused fresh damage photos and sought a counter-expertise in an arbitration case already assessed at tens of thousands of euros. The minister replied that he and the Groningen Commissioner of the King monitor NAM's handling of old claims closely and trust the independent Arbiter Bodembeweging, to which NAM has committed.
For individual damage cases in procedure before the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have confidence in the working method and independent judgment of the Arbiter.
Voor individuele schadezaken die in procedure zijn bij de Arbiter Bodembeweging geldt dat ik vertrouwen heb in de werkwijze en het onafhankelijke oordeel van de Arbiter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdam minima een korting op de energierekening wil geven

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether he would use Amsterdam's plan for an energy-bill discount for low-income households as inspiration nationally, and how he views Belgium's social tariff. The minister answered that income support is better provided through general social policy, that energy pricing should not be used for income policy, and that a municipal discount could improperly cross national policy, leaving the council to prevent this.
This is in the first instance primarily a responsibility of the municipal council, as the controlling body, to prevent that cross-over.
Het betreft hier in eerste instantie primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad – als controlerend orgaan-, om die doorkruising te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over kwaliteit van en toezicht op de archeologie nav advertentie Volkskrant d.d. 26 januari ´Creatief met archeologie, tips voor projectontwikkelaars´

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an advertisement advising developers how to avoid archaeological obligations, and about oversight of archaeology by municipalities and inspectorates. The minister denied that unlawful excavation is widespread, said no structural oversight gap exists, but acknowledged definitional confusion and some quality and backlog issues, and promised further case study and monitoring.
I have no reason to think that this system does not meet its requirements.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te denken dat dit stelsel niet voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige cv-ketels

An SP MP asked why the government's answers on faulty Nefit cv-boilers (types B3L and B3M) did not address heat-exchanger problems, when NVWA was informed, and whether boilers meet safety rules, among other questions about a carbon monoxide study and OvV recommendations. The minister answered that the NVWA was informed of B3L heat-exchanger problems from 2012 and of B3M issues in 2016, issued a formal order to Nefit to report all incidents, and that the independent CO study and RTL-commissioned research will be shared before summer, but gave evasive or referral answers on legislation, installer training and the OvV recommendations.
The NVWA then decided to demand all information about incidents involving the B3M type.
Daarop besloot de NVWA alle informatie over incidenten met het type B3M te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over het bericht dat energiebedrijven experimenteren met prepaid energie

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked whether prepaid energy pilots that bypass disconnection protections are acceptable and whether the minister would ban them. The minister replied that the voluntary pilots are small, that existing disconnection rules still apply, that no ministerial permission was required, and that the ACM and a broader debt-relief approach will be relied on.
No permission was requested or obtained.
Er is geen toestemming gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over het bericht dat de aardbevingen in Groningen de gezondheid van Groningers aantasten

Two SP MPs asked whether the government accepts that earthquakes in Groningen harm residents' health, including a reported PTSD-like picture, and whether the state is responsible and will act. The minister acknowledges the health impact, says removing the causes of stress is the top priority, promises gas production reduction options and a public-law damage protocol, and commits to a health action plan from the RIVM and GGD by end of April.
Removing the causes of stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat lage- en middeninkomens in de financiële problemen komen bij gasloos wonen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister whether low and middle incomes will face financial strain from switching homes off gas, citing a Milieudefensie-commissioned study, and how affordability and support for insulation will be ensured. The minister acknowledged the study, said the transition will carry costs for households and that affordability is a key starting point for the Klimaat- en Energieakkoord, pointed to existing subsidies and funds, and gave no concrete new commitments.
The cabinet's aim is to achieve the ambitious climate targets for 2030 and 2050 at the lowest possible cost for citizens and businesses.
Het is de inzet van het kabinet om de ambitieuze klimaatdoelstellingen voor 2030 en 2050 tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten voor burgers en bedrijven te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat stress in bevingsgebied Groningen tot sterfgevallen leidt

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman (SP) asked ministers whether reports that earthquake-related stress in Groningen leads to deaths were known, and how affected people would be supported. Minister Wiebes replied that the government finds this worrying, prioritises removing the causes of stress, wants gas extraction reduced further this term, and wants damage settlement accelerated, referring to an earlier answer.
Removing the causes of the stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het blokkeren van de laagdrempelige procedure bij de Spreekuurrechter voor aardbevingsschadezaken

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked whether the Rechtbank Noord-Nederland blocked a Groningen earthquake damage case from the low-threshold Spreekuurrechter procedure after an internal intervention and contact with the NAM, and how access to justice for gas-damage victims will be ensured. The minister answers that the Spreekuurrechter pilot is for relatively simple disputes, the court itself judged the earthquake case unsuitable, the NAM was informed by letter and phone, and the new damage protocol and the EUR 200,000 fund for legal costs are being pursued.

For this deviating procedure a procedural regulation has been drawn up, which establishes that the Spreekuurrechter may decide that a case is not suitable for handling by the Spreekuurrechter, even if the parties would want it.

Voor deze afwijkende procedure is een procesreglement opgesteld en daarin is vastgelegd dat de Spreekuurrechter kan bepalen dat een zaak zich niet leent voor behandeling door de Spreekuurrechter, zelfs indien partijen dat wel zouden willen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over doorstroming en drukte bij maatschappelijke opvang

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman asked about shortages and slow move-on in women's shelters and emergency homelessness shelters, including Groningen's reduced capacity and the lack of affordable housing for shelter residents. The minister responded that a working group with several ministries and municipal follow-up will address bottlenecks from the Ombudsman's report, municipalities will carry local responsibility for housing and capacity agreements, and a multi-year agenda on sheltered housing is being developed.
Currently, work is underway to set up this working group.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het opzetten van deze werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid van gespoten purschuim

Two SP members asked the Ministers of Interior and of Social Affairs about health risks of sprayed polyurethane foam insulation, including whether residents are protected, whether certified firms follow the 2013 guidelines, and whether isocyanates are listed as substances of very high concern. The Minister replied that TNO and RPS studies did not establish causality but precautions were taken, that the Bouwbesluit 2012 will be amended to require residents to leave and forced ventilation, that a diagnostic protocol exists, and that the REACH restriction proposal is pending.
I therefore want to include this as a requirement in the Bouwbesluit 2012.
Ik wil dit daarom als eis opnemen in het Bouwbesluit 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat ook in Nederland gebouwen staan die, net als de afgebrande Grenfell-toren in Londen, zijn bekleed met brandonveilige gevelpanelen

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about whether fire-unsafe cladding panels like those on Grenfell Tower are used in Dutch buildings, how municipal inspection of cladding works, and whether rules should be tightened. The Minister answered that such panels are mainly used in non-residential buildings, that the Building Decree 2012 already regulates fire safety, that municipal inspection is sample-based and builders bear primary responsibility, and that the Kwaliteitsborging bill is the planned improvement.
The English investigation report into the Grenfell fire is not yet available.
Het Engelse onderzoeksrapport naar de Grenfell brand is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat aardbevingsdemonstranten politiebezoek kregen voorafgaand aan een geplande protestactie

Beckerman (SP) asked whether police visited earthquake-protest demonstrators at home before a planned action against NAM, based on a Facebook event list, and whether this was proportionate and a breach of the right to demonstrate. Minister Grapperhaus replied that home visits to gather information on possible public-order risks are normal police work under the mayor's responsibility, that the Groningen mayor said the method could have been less intrusive, and that the police chief spoke with the citizens concerned.
Actively contacting the persons involved following such signals by the police is one of the options for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van Tongeren en Beckerman over de NAM-uitspraken en technische mogelijkheden voor het verminderen van gaswinning

MPs Nijboer, Van Tongeren and Beckerman asked the minister about NAM's claim that no additional safety measures were needed after a tremor, that the code red was wrongly issued, and about options to reduce Groningen gas extraction and exports of low-calorific gas. The minister defended SodM's assessment that the earthquake fit expected patterns, and outlined short-term limits and longer-term options to reduce gas demand, while declining to direct NAM's communications.
However, I do not decide on the way NAM presents its figures, reports and letters.
Ik ga echter niet over de wijze waarop NAM zijn cijfers, rapporten en brieven presenteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en Van Kent over het bericht dat de bouw zich niets aantrekt van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether the construction sector ignores recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) and how recurring recommendations on coordination, responsibility, safety awareness and risk assessment will be implemented. The minister acknowledges the problem, lists steps taken (guidelines, a Kwaliteitsborging bill, Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit changes, a study on a central party for site safety) and commits to further follow-up, though some recommendations remain unaddressed.
It is currently being examined how a single central party can be made responsible for safeguarding site safety at construction sites.
Er wordt momenteel nagegaan hoe één centrale partij verantwoordelijk kan worden gemaakt voor de borging van de omgevingsveiligheid bij bouwplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat mensen vanaf Fort Oranje op een andere camping geplaatst worden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about residents of Fort Oranje being moved to other campsites, including whether rehousing is solved or merely displaced. The minister said municipality Zundert provides case managers and that camp placements are undesirable but tolerated temporarily for about 10 people, with national support and an evaluation to follow.

I consider it in principle undesirable that residents of Fort Oranje are rehoused on a campsite, because that housing may not meet the minimum housing requirements and residents may lose sight of care and support.

Ik acht het in principe niet wenselijk dat bewoners van Fort Oranje opnieuw op een camping worden gehuisvest, omdat daarbij de kans bestaat dat die huisvesting niet voldoet aan de minimumeisen die we aan woonruimte stellen en bewoners uit zicht kunnen raken van zorg en hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige cv-ketels

An MP asked the government about reports that Nefit concealed defects in its boiler (TopLine/B3M) from the food and product safety regulator NVWA, and about fire and carbon monoxide risks, and whether periodic inspections should be introduced. The government denied knowledge of concealment, reported 180 incidents and 10 fires linked to the boiler, described the NVWA's oversight and corrective action, and said it would not introduce an APK inspection but would implement an installer certification scheme recommended by the Safety Board.
In 2016 the NVWA received a report from a former Nefit employee about both boiler types (B3L and B3M) indicating that the problems were more serious than previously assumed.

In 2016 werd bij de NVWA een melding ontvangen van een ex-werknemer van Nefit met betrekking tot beide typen cv-ketels (B3L en B3M) waarin werd aangegeven dat de problemen ernstiger waren dan eerder aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Nederland de EU-duurzaamheidsdoelen niet haalt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government favours fossil industry interests or ambitious climate policy, how it will tackle the industry's ties to the economy, and how a Klimaat- en Energieakkoord will bind heavy industry. The minister answered that the government targets a 49% greenhouse gas cut by 2030, will push the EU target to 55%, sees CCS as a transition technology, and will set sectoral reduction targets for industry within the upcoming Climate and Energy Agreement.
The cabinet will make agreements in the Climate and Energy Agreement on how the 2030 reduction target will be achieved and the role of the share of renewable energy in this.
Het kabinet zal in het Klimaat- en Energieakkoord afspraken maken op welke manier het reductiedoel in 2030 wordt gerealiseerd en de rol van het aandeel hernieuwbare energie hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over contourenlijnen in het aardbevingsgebied

Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether the administrative contour lines should still determine damage assessment and reinforcement of homes in the Groningen earthquake area, and why different building norms apply outside the contour. Minister Wiebes answered that NAM is liable regardless of location, a new damage protocol without NAM's role is being negotiated, the NPR applies inside the area while outside it additional norms add no value, and he declined to comment on an individual court case.
Intensive consultation is currently taking place among all parties on a new damage protocol in which NAM no longer plays a role in assessing damage reports.
Op dit moment vindt intensief overleg plaats tussen alle betrokken partijen over een nieuw schadeprotocol, waarin NAM geen rol meer speelt in de beoordeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over het bericht “Echtpaar kraakt droomhuis om sloop te voorkomen”

MPs asked the minister about a couple who squatted a characteristic farmhouse in Middelstum to prevent its demolition by NAM, and whether NAM's demand that they leave within two days was acceptable. The minister said the couple left for safety reasons, that the future of the building is separate, that heritage preservation is a key principle and NAM has pledged to work toward keeping the house, and that a state housing company will be set up to manage acquired property.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Coalitie-Overeenkomst NPRZ tussen marktpartijen, de gemeente Rotterdam en woningcorporaties voor de aanpak van de particuliere woningvoorraad in Rotterdam-Zuid

The MP asked the minister about the NPRZ coalition agreement between market parties, Rotterdam and housing corporations to tackle 2,000 private homes in Rotterdam-South, why this differs from the earlier 10,000-home target, and whether corporation-bought homes funded by tenants would be resold. The minister sent the agreement, said the 10,000-home ambition stands and 2,000 homes are a first phase, and said local details and funding arrangements will be set in a programme committee and performance agreements.
The agreements on this are made at local level and form part of the programme committee mentioned in the answer to question 2.
De afspraken hierover worden op lokaal niveau gemaakt en maken deel uit van de in het antwoord op vraag 2 genoemde programmacommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de gaslobby

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked ministers about gas-industry lobbying, Shell's role at Rotterdam School of Management, government access for Shell, gas infrastructure overcapacity, EU lobbying transparency, and methane emissions. The ministers answered that universities set curricula, Shell has the same access as other firms, network investments follow public consultation and regulator review, existing lobbying rules need no change, and a methane letter will follow by Q2 2018.
There is no reason to amend the existing rules and regulations on lobbying.
Er is geen aanleiding om de bestaande regels en voorschriften met betrekking tot lobbyen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de Belgische kerncentrale Doel opnieuw stil is gelegd

MPs asked the state secretary about the extended shutdown of Belgian nuclear reactor Doel 3, whether concrete degradation is the cause, which safety regions have emergency plans for nuclear incidents, and whether the government will press Belgium to close the plant. The state secretary answered that the shutdown was extended for concrete reinforcement work, that safety oversight lies with Belgian regulators, and that the government will focus on cooperation and better information for residents rather than demanding closure.
That is why I currently prefer to focus on cooperation with Belgium, on improved information provision and on involving residents on the Dutch side.
Daarom richt ik mij op dit moment liever op de samenwerking met België, aan verbeterde informatievoorziening en betrokkenheid van omwonende aan Nederlandse kant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat de export van Gronings gas verder stijgt

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether rising exports of Groningen gas were undesirable, whether they conflict with the Chamber's wish to end export contracts early, and for export forecasts and full disclosure of export contracts. The minister replied that export volumes follow physical demand abroad, that no new export contracts have been signed since 2014, and that forecasts fall to zero by 2030, but declined full disclosure of the contracts as commercially confidential.
Since these contracts are concluded between private parties and also contain commercially confidential information, I do not intend to make them public.
Aangezien deze contracten zijn gesloten tussen private partijen en daarnaast ook bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten, ben ik niet voornemens deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat er een lek is geweest bij een Duitse kerncentrale

An SP MP asked the Dutch government about a reported leak at the German Emsland nuclear plant near Emmen, including its safety classification, whether ANVS would investigate, cross-border cooperation and whether the plant should be closed early. The state secretary answered that the leak was a minor INES-0 event affecting non-radioactive cooling water, that ANVS would not conduct its own investigation as the incident occurred abroad, and that nuclear safety is a German national responsibility.
No. The ANVS indicates it does not have the impression that the German supervisor and the license holder are failing to fulfil their responsibility in this unusual event.
Nee. De ANVS geeft aan niet het beeld te hebben dat de Duitse toezichthouder en de vergunninghouder in deze ongewone gebeurtenis hun verantwoordelijkheid niet goed invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gevolgen van schade door aardbevingen op de gezondheid

An SP MP asks the ministers about the health effects of earthquake damage in Groningen, citing a rise in health complaints, the under-counting of damage in the NAM register, the closed damage protocol, and the NAM's close operational and financial ties to the Centrum Veilig Wonen. The minister answers that the damage process is stalled pending a new protocol, that NAM will step back from damage decisions, and that a regional fund and a public-controlled damage fund are being explored, while declining to publish the NAM-CVW contract and stating that the KPMG report was already sent to parliament.
However, the old damage-handling protocol set by NAM has been closed and damage handling has been at a standstill for some time pending a new damage protocol.
Het oude, door NAM vastgestelde protocol voor behandeling van schademeldingen is echter gesloten en de schadeafhandeling ligt al geruime tijd stil in afwachting van een nieuw schadeprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurwoningen vaak onbetaalbaar zijn voor mensen met een middeninkomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many middle-income households cannot afford rents above €700, and why they are labelled 'scheefwoners', and whether rent protection should be extended to middle-rent homes. The minister disputes the 28% figure as a theoretical calculation, argues middle incomes have ample housing options, refuses to extend the social-rent regime, and points to municipal instruments and a working group on middle-rent housing.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het Beckerman over het bericht dat steeds meer woningen worden opgekocht door particuliere beleggers om duur te verhuren (buy to let)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about buy-to-let investors buying homes to rent out at high rents, including rent levels, displacement of first-time buyers, corporation home sales and possible tax or contractual limits. The Minister answered that buy-to-let can add to the rental supply, that displacement of starters seems limited to Amsterdam so no national measures are planned, and that corporation sales are already controlled via the Autoriteit woningcorporaties and prestatieafspraken.
Displacement of first-time buyers so far only seems to occur in Amsterdam, so I do not consider it appropriate to take national measures to curb buy-to-let.
Verdringing van koopstarters lijkt zich vooralsnog alleen voor te doen in Amsterdam, waardoor ik het nemen van landelijke maatregelen om buy to let af te remmen niet passend acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Corrupte constructies: Shell in het nauw’

SP MPs asked the minister about a Vrij Nederland report on Shell's purchase of Nigerian oil block OPL 245 via a corrupt intermediary, questioning Shell's conduct, the alternative payment structure, and calling for corporate human rights rules and prosecution. The minister declined substantive comment because the OM and FIOD are investigating, pointed to Dutch integrated anti-corruption policy and the existing binding anti-bribery law, and said prosecution decisions rest with investigators and the prosecutor.
While this investigation is ongoing, no substantive response will be given.
Lopende dit onderzoek zal niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Raan en Kröger over de Jonge Klimaatagenda

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Young Climate Agenda, including how young people can be involved in climate policy and how its themes of work and education will be reflected in implementation. The minister acknowledged youth's importance, pointed to past support for youth participation and a Climate Envoy, and said work and education themes will be explored in coming months, including via a forthcoming SER advisory report.

In the coming months I will, together with relevant cabinet colleagues and in consultation with social partners and education, examine how these themes can be incorporated into the further elaboration of the plans.

In de komende maanden zal ik in samenwerking met de relevante collega’s uit het kabinet en in overleg met sociale partners en het onderwijs, bezien op welke wijze deze thema’s kunnen worden meegenomen in de verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “verloedering van de bouwwereld”

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the construction sector is deteriorating, whether municipal building supervision failed in cases of unsafe concrete floors, who is liable for damage, and how to prevent the sector from being left to self-supervision. The minister disagreed that the sector is deteriorating, stated that municipalities supervise compliance but builders bear responsibility for quality, and said the inventory of affected buildings is ongoing.
As far as can currently be estimated, hundreds of buildings will actually need to be examined.
Voor zover nu wordt ingeschat, zullen honderden gebouwen daadwerkelijk moeten worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over grotere vermogensongelijkheid door het volkshuisvestingsbeleid

Member Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister whether the government's promotion of home ownership, the housing market rules and planned measures would reduce wealth inequality and improve access to housing for lower-income households. The Minister answered that the effects of specific measures cannot be generalised, that many factors affect wealth inequality, and that the government expects to strengthen middle-rent supply and housing construction without predicting effects on wealth distribution.
It is not possible to say in general what effect a change in the rules on the mortgage market or the free rental sector has on wealth differences and access to the housing market.

Het is niet mogelijk om in zijn algemeenheid te zeggen welk effect een verandering van de regels op de hypotheekmarkt of de vrije huursector heeft op de vermogensverschillen en de toegang tot de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over onderhoud van huurhuizen in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about housing corporations in Groningen halting maintenance on rental homes, the use of foam insulation on roofs, and tenants being left to live in unsafe, poorly maintained homes during the earthquake-reinforcement operation. The ministers answered that tenants can raise maintenance with corporations, the Huurcommissie, the municipality, or the kantonrechter, that the government acknowledges delays and will consult the region on reinforcement and sustainability.
Tenants can also turn to the municipality if deferred maintenance leads to insufficient structural quality.
Ook kunnen huurders zich tot de gemeente wenden als achterstallig onderhoud ertoe leidt dat de bouwtechnische kwaliteit onvoldoende lijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vervolg van de sluiting en de ontruiming van Fort Oranje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the municipality of Zundert behaved properly in promising a temporary closure of Fort Oranje campsite and then fully evicting residents, denying compensation for structures, and restricting press access, and how vulnerable residents are protected. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible and accountable to its council, explained the eviction as a response to a sudden closure announcement and resulting disorder, said a rehousing solution was realised after a court case, described the compensation and valuation arrangements, and said vulnerable residents received GGD-based care plans.
It is up to the college/mayor to account for this to the municipal council.
Het is aan het college/de burgemeester om hierover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Groningse opkoopregeling van huizen die niet eerlijk verlopen is

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the unfair Groningen house-buyback pilot (Koopinstrument), including the lottery-style selection, unclear criteria, the handling of a complaint outside the General Administrative Law Act complaint procedure, and the broader lack of trust and state leadership in the gas-extraction region. The minister defends the pilot as fair, acknowledges the Ombudsman's recommendations on communication and transparency, refuses to revisit rejections, and commits to developing a follow-up buyback scheme via the NCG.

Nevertheless, I must note that the National Ombudsman recommends that the NCG and I provide more clarity on the role, position and responsibility of the NCG in a follow-up to the Koopinstrument and communicate this clearly to Groningers.

Desondanks moet ik vaststellen dat de Nationale ombudsman de NCG en mij aanbeveelt om bij een vervolg van het Koopinstrument meer helderheid te verschaffen over de rol, positie en verantwoordelijkheid van de NCG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het incident bij het tankenpark van de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked about a leak of aardgascondensaat at the NAM tank park near Farmsum, its environmental and safety effects, earthquake resistance of tanks, incident history, and supervision. The government answered that SodM and ILT supervise the site, the leak was cleaned up with no reported fauna deaths, the tanks are on the priority list for earthquake-resistance review, and supervision of loading procedures is ongoing.
It is being examined whether preventive additional measures are needed in case an earthquake occurs that is stronger than any so far in the area.
Onderzocht wordt of preventief aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn voor het geval een aardbeving plaatsvindt die zwaarder is dan zich tot nu toe heeft voorgedaan in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Drentse gasopslag bij Steenbergen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for a timeline of permit changes and capacity expansions at the Norg gas storage facility, and whether the permitting and seismic assessments were independently reviewed. The Minister gave a detailed chronology, said SodM and Tcbb advice was independent, and confirmed the 2015 pressure decision must be reconsidered after a Council of State ruling, with the storage ceiling temporarily reduced.
I see no reason to question the independence of their judgement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de onafhankelijkheid van hun oordeel in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verdrievoudiging van de gaswinning bij Wapse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about competent authority over the Wapse gas extraction, the environmental impact assessment requirements, and the legal status of the gas volume units and extraction permit. The minister explained the division of competences, defended the MER procedure and independent review, and said the court will settle the unit question while the case remains pending.
The entire matter is currently before the court.
De hele kwestie ligt momenteel onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Gesprekken over schadeprotocol aardbevingsgebied vastgelopen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about confusion and delays in Groningen damage handling for the 'buitengebied' (outside the former contour), including the status of border areas, the TU Delft study, the voucher and second-opinion process, and the independence of the reviewing bureaus. The minister replied that the former contour was dropped, that the TU Delft study results are due in early 2018, that second opinions will be done by selected bureaus under a uniform method, and that the voucher acceptance numbers are premature to interpret.
There is no such thing as 'the outer area'.
Er is geen sprake van «het buitengebied».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de energierekening volgend jaar verder stijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the renewable energy levy (ODE) and energy tax rise, whether polluters pay and whether households are fairly burdened compared with industry. The minister defended the 50-50 household-business split as balanced, explained the temporary energy tax increase as funding for housing corporation energy saving under the Energy Agreement, and gave tariff and budget tables.
Because of this starting point, a degressive tariff structure comparable to the energy tax was also chosen.
Vanwege dit uitgangspunt is tevens gekozen voor een degressieve tariefstructuur die vergelijkbaar is met de energiebelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over forse overschrijdingen van het gaswinningplan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about large overshoots of permitted gas production at Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk, the NAM's claim that overshoots are allowed at end of field life, monitoring, risks, and enforcement. The minister said SodM confirmed the maximum permitted production was exceeded, that the instruction decisions need clearer production-limit wording, that he does not see a structural problem, that a new plan was filed for Maasdijk and Monster, and that SodM is preparing a penalty order against NAM.
In its advice of June 2017 to me, SodM indicated that for Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk it was found that the maximum permitted production had been exceeded.
In haar adviezen van juni 2017 aan mij heeft SodM aangegeven dat voor Hardenberg-Oost, Monster en Maasdijk is geconstateerd dat de maximaal vergunde productie is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de grootste gasvondst van afgelopen 25 jaar

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the largest Dutch gas find in 25 years, covering risks of the exploration drilling, timeline to production, fault mapping, gas quality, phase-out of Dutch gas extraction and supply security. The minister said the test drilling was successful, that monitoring and existing safety rules apply, that further permits would take at least two years, and that the gas is low-calorific and extraction is not yet at issue.
Further activities and the timeline following this exploratory drilling depend on Hansa's (extraction) plans.
Verdere activiteiten en het tijdpad van het vervolg van deze exploratieboring zijn afhankelijk van de (winnings)plannen van Hansa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een keuringsplicht voor rookwering en balkons

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about fire safety in rented rooms after a fatal fire in Leeuwarden, the lack of a mandatory inspection regime for fire doors and balconies, and enforcement capacity of municipalities. The Minister said no inspection obligation has existed, rejected a mandatory periodic inspection, and pointed to existing Bouwbesluit rules, notification duties and municipal enforcement, while promising only a regulation on CO-monitor installers.
