I do not have information on this. Municipalities can themselves determine and prioritise supervision and enforcement of building fire safety.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hierover. Gemeenten kunnen het toezicht en de handhaving op de brandveiligheid van gebouwen zelf bepalen en prioriteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat steeds meer woningen worden opgekocht door particuliere beleggers om duur te verhuren ('buy to let')

The SP MP Beckerman asks whether buy-to-let investors are squeezing housing affordability, pushing up prices for starters, and whether the government will act or research the trend. The minister answers that investor purchases are about 9-10% of sales, that only Amsterdam shows clear crowding-out of starters, that the government sees no need to discourage investment and rejects the claim that the landlord levy encourages it, and that municipalities hold enforcement tools while research is already ongoing.
About 9 to 10% of homes are bought not to be lived in by the buyer.
Circa 9 tot 10% van de woningen wordt gekocht om niet zelf in te wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about demands to remove the Centrum Veilig Wonen from the new Groningen damage process, and about delays in damage handling and reinforcement caused by NAM's involvement. The minister said the NCG is in talks with NAM and CVW, that NAM will step back from damage decisions while keeping liability, and that responsibility for delays is shared and not with one party.
The NCG is holding talks with NAM and CVW to keep the backlog as small as possible and achieve structural improvements.
De NCG voert gesprekken met NAM en CVW om de achterstand zo klein mogelijk te houden en tot structurele verbeteringen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de exorbitante ontslagvergoeding van een ex-topman bij Alliander

An SP MP asked why the government tolerates an exorbitant severance payment to a former Alliander executive, why Alliander won a 2016 sustainability prize, and how the topsalary law and grid-operator rules were handled. The minister answers that the Wet normering topinkomens does not apply to the network company Alliander by deliberate choice, that the prize is judged on transparency, and that the Raad van Commissarissen introduced a pay ceiling and shareholders pressed for more moderation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de kamernood onder studenten in veel steden hoog is

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked ministers about reports of severe student housing shortages, growth of international students, possible homelessness and displacement of Dutch students, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged shortages mainly in the Randstad, argued the government does not steer international student numbers for financial reasons, said it cannot confirm homelessness data, and deferred funding and levy changes to a future cabinet.
No specific figures are available on any displacement of Dutch students searching for a room by international students.
Er zijn geen specifieke cijfers beschikbaar over eventuele verdringing van Nederlandse studenten die op zoek zijn naar een kamer door buitenlandse studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de ontruiming van Fort Oranje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the eviction of Fort Oranje campsite, the minister's responsibility, costs, relocation, and whether other campsites face similar issues. The minister replied that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that the state will support mayors and provides €5.3 million of an estimated €15 million cost via a deduction from a grant, and that no national overview of similar campsites exists yet.
For now there is no national overview of the number of campsites with the same accumulation of problems as Fort Oranje campsite.
Vooralsnog is er geen landelijk overzicht van het aantal campings waar sprake is van eenzelfde probleemcumulatie als op camping Fort Oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het mogelijk steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen, in dit geval Boskalis en van Oord

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (Atradius DSB) would support Boskalis and Van Oord's role in the Nord Stream 2 pipeline and whether this conflicts with Paris climate goals. The government answered that a non-binding letter of interest was issued, that each application will undergo an environmental and social assessment, and that it sees no reason to exclude oil and gas projects from export credit insurance, while stating the political debate falls outside the scope of the export credit framework.
When assessing any applications, political and financial risks will be examined and an assessment of environmental and social impacts will be carried out.
Bij de beoordeling van eventuele aanvragen zal naar de politieke en financiële risico's worden gekeken en zal een beoordeling van de milieu en sociale gevolgen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (EKV) support for fossil-fuel-related projects conflicts with the Paris Agreement, and asked about a phase-out plan, disclosure, coal and fossil exclusion lists and related OECD and fund matters. The Secretary of State answered that EKV is a generic, demand-driven instrument, that no phase-out plan is being prepared, that information disclosure and CSR policy are being developed, and that the government still supports ending public finance for new coal plants abroad but rejects an oil and gas exclusion list.
As described in the answer to question 2, no such plan is being worked on.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 beschreven wordt er niet gewerkt aan een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een onderzoek dat stelt dat de huidige gaswinning de kans op ernstige aardbevingen niet vermindert

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about a study by Dempsey and Suckale finding that current Groningen gas extraction does not reduce the chance of serious earthquakes, and about the 17% probability of a M3.6 quake, the expert conclusions, and whether SodM will consult the authors. The minister said the study was commissioned by NAM for a 2016 expert workshop, that SodM and TNO found no fundamentally new insights, that the risk figures were considered in the 2016 and 2017 winningsplan decisions, and that he saw no reason to ask SodM to contact the researchers urgently, while listing ongoing research programmes.
Experts from SodM have however assured me that these studies have so far not led to any substantial new or different insights regarding seismicity in Groningen.
Deskundigen van SodM hebben mij echter verzekerd dat deze onderzoeken tot nu toe niet hebben geleid tot wezenlijke nieuwe of andere inzichten inzake de seismiciteit in Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huishoudens twee derde van de milieubelastingen betalen

An SP MP asked the government about reports that households pay two-thirds of environmental taxes, the industry's share of those levies, whether the burden distribution undermines public support, and where the revenue is spent. The government confirmed the figures, said industry's share of energy tax and renewable energy levy was about 10% and that a full breakdown is not registered, and pointed to the Energy Agenda, an SER study and the general budget as the spending channels.
A complete picture of the precise contribution of the industrial sector to the revenues from environmental taxes and levies is lacking.
Een volledig beeld omtrent de precieze bijdrage van de sector industrie aan de opbrengsten van de milieubelastingen en heffingen ontbreekt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Beckerman en Gijs van Dijk over werkbezoek aan de Reede van Texel waar historische scheepswrakken uit de 16e, 17e en 18e eeuw in de zeebodem dreigen te vergaan en over het congres ‘SO

MPs from CDA, SP and PvdA asked whether the government will act on the erosion of historic shipwrecks in Dutch coastal waters, including a programmatic approach requested by coastal provinces, a bigger role for volunteer divers, adjusted working-conditions rules for diving, and a national maritime archaeology museum. The minister acknowledged the erosion problem, said talks with the provinces aim for initial agreements by end 2017 and a proposal in spring 2018, committed to consulting amateur diving associations on an exemption, said the working-conditions rules will be examined with the Social Affairs minister, and argued that maritime heritage is already displayed across several museums.
We have agreed to reach initial agreements by the end of 2017.
We hebben afgesproken om voor het einde van 2017 tot eerste afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten hun aandelen Eneco verkopen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about municipalities selling their Eneco shares, including concerns about public control of energy, the energy transition and jobs. The minister replies that network operation remains in public hands under the Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer, that the energy transition targets and instruments are unaffected, and that the decision on selling shares lies with the municipal shareholders.
It is up to the shareholders of Eneco to decide whether they wish to give up their shares.
Het is aan de aandeelhouders van Eneco is om te besluiten of zij afstand willen doen van hun aandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het onderzoek naar aardbevingsschade in het buitengebied dat de prullenbak in kan

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister for a detailed response to a critique by a law firm of Witteveen+Bos's study of 1,600 earthquake damage claims in rural Groningen, and whether the minister would consult the National Coordinator Groningen on the demand of the Groninger Gasberaad. The minister replied that the claims were handled under the protocol in force until 31 March 2017, that Parliament had already been informed, that Witteveen+Bos has published a substantive response, and that a meeting between NAM and Gasberaad on an independent review of the study is being arranged.
At the initiative of the NCG, a meeting will soon take place between NAM and Gasberaad, in which the possibility of an independent review of the study will be discussed.
Op initiatief van de NCG zal binnenkort een gesprek plaatsvinden tussen NAM en Gasberaad, waarin de mogelijkheid van een onafhankelijke toetsing van het onderzoek wordt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Marijnissen over de impact van de Groningse versterkingsopgave voor de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Economic Affairs how the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation affects care institutions, including guarantees of support, who bears costs, resident relocation and compensation, and whether gas extraction should be reduced further. The government answered that a joint programme with the NCG, care providers, insurers and local authorities is being prepared, that NAM pays for safety reinforcement while costs of future-proofing fall to care providers and insurers, and that the production ceiling is reduced by 10% from October 2017 with a broader gas phase-out to be considered in transition paths.
Further details on the implementation of the reinforcement operation will follow once the steering group has completed the programme.
Verdere details over de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave volgen als de stuurgroep het programma gereed heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Staat van de sector geothermie

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about safety risks, safety culture, permitting, and oversight in the geothermal energy sector, following the SodM 'State of the Sector' report. The minister answered that a 'verbeterplan geothermie' is underway, that new geothermal-specific legislation is targeted for late 2017, and that permit and safety checks, including seismic risk analysis near Groningen, will be tightened, though many answers defer to ongoing work.
It is not acceptable if laws and regulations are not complied with.
Het is niet acceptabel als wet- en regelgeving niet wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verdrievoudiging van de gaswinning bij Wapse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about tripling gas extraction at Wapse, the MER threshold, subsidence measurement, and the criminal referral of the Vermilion file. The minister defended the permit as meeting legal criteria, argued subsidence is driven by total volume, and declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any substantive statement about the content of the file or the status and progress of the investigation.
Gaande het strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededeling doen omtrent de inhoud van het dossier, alsmede over de status en voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Beckerman over het bericht dat er een sterke groei is van het aantal gezinnen dat bij de noodopvang belandde

MPs Kooiman and Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in families ending up in emergency shelter in 2016, its causes, and possible structural fixes. The government answered that it is improving monitoring, that data on homeless families are incomplete, that debt rules are not a legal barrier to renting, and that it supports a Amsterdam-style approach while leaving most solutions to municipalities.
I do not know whether, and if so how often, this happens with homeless families.
Het is mij niet bekend of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit gebeurt bij dakloze gezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het achterblijven van de categorie biobrandstof als aandeel in duurzame energie

An SP MP asked why biofuel blending in petrol and diesel lags despite legal obligations, and why the CBS figures on actual biofuel use are uncertain. The state secretary acknowledged the gap between CBS and register figures, attributed it to 2015 rule changes allowing early booking, and said a legal amendment would tie booking to delivery at the pump, with a decision deferred until talks with NEa, CBS and industry conclude.
Before the end of the year I will inform the House of the outcomes.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the government about permanent residence on holiday parks, including the number affected, the burgemeester of Putten's call for a national approach, reviving a withdrawn bill, and provincial housing shortages. Minister Plasterk answered that no national count exists, that municipalities hold the primary responsibility, that the bill will not be revived, and gave provincial statistical housing shortage figures while noting affordability and elderly-suitable housing cannot be precisely quantified.
The municipality is responsible for its own enforcement and housing policy and therefore holds the lead role in giving shape to a solution.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen handhaving- en woonbeleid en heeft daarmee de regierol in handen om invulling te geven aan een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over nieuwe problemen die ontstaan naar aanleiding van de versterkingsopgave van woningen in Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new problems arising from the reinforcement of houses in Groningen, including calls to separate SodM from the ministry, the safety standard used, the 13,000 unresolved damage claims and verjaring risks, and the role of municipalities. The minister largely defended the existing arrangements, pointing to the NCG's Meerjarenprogramma, the new schadeprotocol, and a planned annual review of gas extraction levels, while stating that total scope cannot yet be determined.
Regarding SodM's positioning relative to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the cabinet recently took a position following the Safety Board's evaluation of earthquake risks in Groningen.

Over de positionering van SodM ten opzichte van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (EZ) heeft het kabinet onlangs, naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid inzake aardbevingsrisico’s in Groningen, een standpunt ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de vergelijkingssite van de energieleveranciers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the energy comparison website and whether model contracts are offered there, whether comparison sites must include them, the notice period, and redress for consumers. The minister answered that suppliers must offer model contracts on their own sites, comparison sites may choose which products to include but must be clear about it, the 30-day notice period applies, and complaints go first to the supplier and then to the Geschillencommissie Energie, with the ACM supervising.
The signal that the model contract could not in all cases actually be concluded, I have therefore passed on to the ACM.
Het signaal over het modelcontract dat niet in alle gevallen daadwerkelijk af te sluiten zou zijn, heb ik dan ook aan de ACM doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een toename van meldingen over verwarde huurders

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a rise in reports of disturbance by confused tenants at housing corporations and police, and whether decentralisation and GGZ cuts are causes and whether every municipality has a coordinated approach. The minister answered that the figures are not conclusive, that police incident codes do not show whether persons are tenants, that the national Schakelteam aims for a working approach in every municipality by October 2018, and that housing corporations and municipalities bear responsibility for prevention.
Responsibility for realising a coordinated approach lies with all involved chain partners, both local and regional, under the lead of the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het realiseren van een sluitende aanpak ligt bij alle betrokken ketenpartners, zowel lokaal als regionaal, onder regie van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over sociale huurhuizen in de regio Rotterdam

MP Beckerman asks about the financial trouble of Stichting Humanitas Huisvesting in Rotterdam, its possible merger with Woonbron, lack of performance agreements with Rotterdam, broken lifts at Havensteder and a Capelle aan den IJssel public-space deal. Minister Plasterk confirms a sanitation request is under WSW review with the clock restarted, says a merger would not affect tenants, explains performance-agreement rules and the lift problem handling, and defends the corporations' contributions without substantive new commitments.
A possible merger has no consequences for sitting tenants; the existing tenancy agreement will pass to the merged organisation.
Een eventuele fusie heeft geen gevolgen voor de zittende huurders, de bestaande huurovereenkomst zal overgaan op de fusieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sluiting van camping Fort Oranje

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior about the municipality of Zundert's closure of camp Fort Oranje, where some 600 vulnerable residents including 120 children live, and about rehousing, funding, similar problems elsewhere, and whether municipalities have enough legal powers to close campsites. The Minister defers most matters to the municipality, notes existing enforcement tools, says he is not yet convinced new powers are needed, and promises an evaluation and a CCV handbook.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to go further into the policy of the municipality of Zundert.
Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om verder op het beleid van de gemeente Zundert in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de onwenselijkheid van beleggingen van pensioenfondsen in de kerncentrale Tihange

An SP MP asked why Dutch pension funds, including ABP, hold shares in Engie, owner of the Tihange nuclear plant, and whether the government will press them to divest given safety concerns and municipal and parliamentary motions to close the plant. The state secretary answered that pension funds decide their own investment policy under OECD and UN guidelines, that the accountability bodies can pressure the boards, and that the government does not intervene in those decisions.
Pension funds themselves decide on their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen gaan zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over voedselverspilling voor energiewinning

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about food waste being diverted to anaerobic digesters for energy, including subsidy effects, energy crop land use, co-digestion controls and the SDE+ incentive. The State Secretary largely defended the policy as technology-neutral and needed for renewable energy targets, noted that enforcement by the NVWA has been strengthened, and promised follow-up through a biomass and food transition agenda.
In the programme De Monitor I said I am willing to examine whether the subsidy on biogas digestion leads to good food being used for digestion.
In het programma De Monitor heb ik gezegd dat ik bereid ben na te gaan of er door de subsidie op biovergisting goed voedsel voor vergisting gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voornemen last onder dwangsom gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

An MP asked why the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) rejected a enforcement request on gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, why the NAM's long-term subsidence study was judged insufficient, and whether extraction would be halted. The minister defended the rejection and the deadline handling, said the IGM independently judged the study inadequate and intends a penalty order, and declined to give opinions on the study or to halt extraction, pointing to the Auditcommissie and the Hand aan de Kraan procedure.
As Minister, I cannot and will not give judgments or instructions on the study to be delivered or on this assessment by the IGM.
Als Minister kan en wil ik geen oordelen of aanwijzingen geven over het op te leveren onderzoek of dit oordeel van de IGM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het uitsluiten van laagopgeleiden door Havensteder

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation Havensteder may exclude low-educated applicants from social rental homes, what legal basis exists for selecting on education level, and how Rotterdam's experiment is legitimised. The Minister answers that the municipality says the exclusion claim is incorrect, that education cannot be a allocation criterion outside the Wbmgp, and that Havensteder has changed its communication.
For this reason, Havensteder has since adapted its communication about the letting of this complex.
Mede hierom heeft Havensteder de communicatie rondom de verhuur van dit complex inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat nieuwbouwwoningen nog steeds op gas worden aangesloten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they accept that stopping new homes from being connected to gas is vital for Groningen and climate goals, how the many already-built homes will switch later, and how municipalities wanting gas-free building can be supported. The minister agreed the step is important, said the gas-connection obligation will be replaced by a connection right via amendment and the Omgevingswet would let municipalities set their own rules, and pointed to the Green Deal and a transition path, without giving a firm timeline.
The bill on progress of the energy transition (Kamerstuk 34 627) is pending before your House, with amendments submitted on the right to a gas connection.
Bij uw Kamer is aanhangig het wetsvoorstel voortgang energietransitie (Kamerstuk 34 627 ) waarop amendementen zijn ingediend met betrekking tot het recht op een gasaansluiting.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kwint en Beckerman over archeologische topvondsten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman asked the minister about archaeological top finds whose costly follow-up research may be unaffordable for municipalities, and about extending the 2015 one-off fund, an excess-cost scheme and funding for maritime and synthesis research. The minister said the regular costs are borne by initiators, rejected reinstating the excess-cost scheme, and will decide on the fund's continuation after an evaluation due by 1 September 2017, deferring cost estimates.
I will inform the House about this before 1 September 2017.
Ik zal uw kamer hierover voor 1 september 2017 informeren.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Beckerman over het geld dat de oud-topman van woningcorporatie Rochdale aan de Staat moet betalen

Beckerman (SP) asked how money ordered by the court to be paid by the former Rochdale housing corporation executive and staff could flow back to the tenants and corporation harmed by their mismanagement. The minister explains the money is a criminal confiscation (ontneming) payable to the State, that victims could claim as injured parties or in civil proceedings, and that Rochdale's civil claim is paused because the former director was declared personally bankrupt.
Persons who have suffered direct harm from a criminal offence can join the criminal proceedings as an injured party to obtain compensation.
Personen die rechtstreeks schade hebben geleden door een strafbaar feit kunnen zich voor het verkrijgen van schadevergoeding als benadeelde partij voegen in het strafproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de stelling dat de aardbevingsproblematiek is opgeblazen tot bureaucratisch monstrum

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the earthquake problem in Groningen has become a bureaucratic monster, and about how value loss is assessed in the three-expert procedure, the outcomes compared with research, and the buy-out scheme. The minister declined to comment on the merits of the value-loss scheme because it is before the courts, explained the methods and CBS findings, and said a follow-up to the buy-out pilot is being prepared.
Since the case is still before the court, I cannot make substantive statements about it.
Aangezien de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik hierover geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van gasboringen in de Wadden

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether recent NAM research shows that subsidence forecasts after gas production stops are highly uncertain, whether the Natura 2000 policy premise still holds, whether the Wadden 'accommodation space' is exceeded, and why the LTS study was delayed. The minister answered that SodM judged the NAM study insufficient but correctable by October 2017, that no exceedance of the natural limit is currently foreseen, that the 'hand on the tap' commitment stands, and that no evidence of deliberate delay was found.

The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) indicates that the identified shortcomings in the NAM study, traced by SodM to a number of concretely named points for improvement, can and must be remedied by 31 October 2017.

Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) geeft aan dat de geconstateerde tekortkomingen in de NAM-studie, die door SodM zijn herleid tot een aantal concreet benoemde verbeterpunten, uiterlijk 31 oktober 2017 hersteld kunnen en moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Gronings Erfgoedloket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NCG had abandoned a heritage help desk for Groningen monuments, why the tender was halted, what budget is available, and whether the response to earthquake damage to heritage is adequate. The minister said the desk is still planned, the tender was stopped on procurement grounds, a joint heritage programme is being developed, and a separate approach and budget for heritage is agreed in principle.
Alongside the budgets needed for damage repair and reinforcement by NAM, the joint heritage programme will determine which budget is needed.
Naast de benodigde budgetten voor schadeherstel en versterken bij NAM zal in het kader van het gezamenlijke erfgoedprogramma in beeld gebracht worden welk budget nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voorkomen van koolmonoxidevergiftiging

An MP asked the ministers about carbon monoxide detectors that failed NVWA safety tests, whether sales would be banned, why periodic inspections of home installations are not mandatory, when licensing rules for gas appliance work will take effect, and how installer competence will be guaranteed. The minister answered that banned products were withdrawn or prohibited, that periodic inspections will not be mandated but a licensing scheme for installers is being pursued with an expected entry into force in 2019, and that progress will be reported to parliament in autumn 2017.
I do not intend to introduce a mandatory periodic inspection for combustion installations.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een verplichte periodieke keuring voor verbrandingsinstallaties in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over enorm hoge vertrekpremies bij woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior about very high departure premiums paid to former managers at housing associations such as Ymere and De Alliantie, questioning their justification and whether they can be clawed back. The minister answers that moderate pay policy is expected of such institutions, that accountants and the Autoriteit woningcorporaties check legality, that clawback is only possible for payments made contrary to regulations, and that the WNT extension may cover non-top officials.
It is up to the accountants of the housing associations concerned to check whether the institutions' departure premiums comply with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het is aan de accountants van de betreffende woningcorporaties om te controleren of de instellingen met de vertrekpremies voldoen aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Wassenberg en Beckerman over het bericht 'Netherlands to get first US LNG cargot'

MPs Van Tongeren, Wassenberg and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a US shale gas LNG cargo would arrive in Rotterdam, whether it is meant for the Dutch market, whether shale gas from the US is undesirable, and whether the government can block this transport. The minister answered that the buyer decides the destination, that the origin of the gas cannot be verified, that countries are sovereign over their resources, and that a blockade would be unenforceable, contrary to EU law and to diversification goals.
In doing so, I see no reason nor possibility to impose a blockade on gas from the United States or on shale gas.
Daarbij zie ik geen reden noch mogelijkheid om een blokkade op te werpen ten aanzien van gas uit de Verenigde Staten of ten aanzien van schaliegas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te dure studentenkamers en studentenhotels

The SP MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Interior about student rooms rented above the WWS rent-point standard, regional differences, sanctions on landlords, a longer complaint window, and studentenhotels. Minister Plasterk answers that contractual freedom allows rents above the standard, that fines do not apply to such overcharging, that a higher leges tariff for repeat losers is planned, and that the publicity of Huurcommissie review and a further report on enforcement instruments will follow.
I intend to inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer voor de zomer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het steeds opnieuw naar de Huurcommissie moeten voor dezelfde kamer

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why tenants must repeatedly go to the Rent Tribunal to win rent reductions for the same dwelling, and whether landlords could be obliged to follow tribunal rulings and the points system. The minister replied that new contracts allow new rents under contractual freedom, that the tribunal is not equipped to enforce such an obligation, and pointed to a proposed graduated fee and more public information instead.
Landlord and tenant are free to agree a new rent.
Het staat de verhuurder en de huurder vrij om een nieuwe huurprijs overeen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het schadeonderzoek Groningen Buitengebied

The SP MP Beckerman asked the minister whether the Witteveen+Bos damage study on the Groningen outer area, commissioned by NAM, is credible and whether NAM should withdraw from damage handling. The minister answered that an independent steering committee supervised the study, that NAM is withdrawing, that a one-off offer of up to 1,500 euro for non-recognised damage is being made, and that residents keep their choice and existing procedures.
Residents make their own independent assessment of whether to accept this NAM offer or not.
Bewoners maken een zelfstandige afweging of zij dit aanbod van NAM accepteren of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de NAM toch meepraat over het nieuwe op te stellen schadeprotocol

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM's continued involvement in drafting the new damage protocol for Groningen gas-extraction claims undermines residents' trust, and whether the minister would halt talks with NAM. The minister answered that NAM will no longer assess or settle damage claims under the new procedure run by the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen, though NAM remains liable and will be consulted only on liability.
NAM will no longer have any involvement in assessing damage or determining compensation amounts under the new procedure.
NAM heeft in de nieuwe procedure geen betrokkenheid meer bij de beoordeling van schades en de vaststelling van schadebedragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de winning van hoog- en laagcalorisch gas

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs which fields supply high- and low-calorific gas, how conversion installations are fed and used, their history, and related capacity and industrial connection questions. The minister answered in detail on field allocation, Wobbe-index ranges, nitrogen conversion use rising sharply since 2015, cost and feasibility of switching industrial users, and storage capacity at Norg.
Making a breakdown of the Wobbe index per well adds no value.
Het maken van een uitsplitsing naar de Wobbe-index per put heeft geen toegevoegde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die huisuitzetting riskeren door trage gemeente

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about Rotterdam tenants risking eviction due to long waiting times for housing permits under the Rotterdam Act, and about related information, evaluation and possible changes to the law. The minister answered that eviction should not follow from permit delays, that current data are unavailable pending an evaluation due October 2017, that no legal change on information provision is needed, and that the Rotterdam Act's segregation goal is being met, while the municipality is considering measures to shorten waits.
At this moment these figures are not available.
Op dit moment zijn deze cijfers niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat klimaatlasten oneerlijk zijn verdeeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is unfair that the poorest households bear relatively more of the costs of climate policy, and whether the government will ensure industry pays, protects low incomes and broadens public support. The minister acknowledged the regressive burden, pointed to the Energy Agenda, ETS strengthening, housing-corporation insulation rules and ongoing dialogue, but gave largely general answers without firm new commitments beyond a promised letter before summer.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will inform the House before the summer about the further elaboration and the investments required from housing corporations and their effects.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de verdere uitwerking en de daarvoor benodigde investeringen van corporaties en de effecten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de informatievoorziening over de gasboring in Heerenveen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about information provision on a gas drilling project in Heerenveen, including the responsibilities of operators versus the ministry, legal options for municipalities, and permission for Vermilion to continue production under a pending amended winning plan. The Minister answers that operators are responsible for their own communication, that the ministry handles information tied to the procedure, that there is no legal framework for operator communication, and that production was allowed pending formal review after TNO analyses showed no safety concern.
Companies are themselves responsible for communication and environmental management regarding the projects they carry out; this also applies to mining companies.
Bedrijven zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie en het omgevingsmanagement rond de projecten die zij uitvoeren, dit geldt ook voor mijnbouwbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te hoge huurprijzen in de vrije sector

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about high rents in the private rental sector, the size of the middle-income group pushed into it, and whether rent protection or liberalisation limits should change. The minister answered that middle-rent supply should be arranged locally with new coordination tables and planning tools, that the Huurcommissie distinction for corporations is still under study, and that the liberalisation threshold stays frozen at 710.68 euro.
Before the summer I will inform the House, as already promised, about the state of affairs regarding the cooperation tables.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer, zoals reeds toegezegd, informeren over de stand van zaken rondom de samenwerkingstafels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de subsidiëring van fossiele energie

An MP asked the ministers about a European Parliament report claiming the Netherlands gave 10 billion USD in fossil fuel subsidies in 2015, asked for a ten-year breakdown of fossil and renewable subsidies, and asked whether the government would reduce emissions and meet climate commitments. The minister disputed that fossil fuels are subsidised in the Netherlands, listed only treaty-based excise exemptions and the degressive energy tax structure, gave renewable subsidy budgets for 2017 and 2023, and pointed to ETS and energy-transition paths without committing to new concrete measures.
Fossil fuels in the Netherlands, unlike renewable energy, are not subsidised, not even through fiscal measures.
Fossiele brandstoffen worden in Nederland, in tegenstelling tot hernieuwbare energie, niet gesubsidieerd, ook niet via fiscale maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bedonderen van ontevreden huurders in Groningen

MPs asked whether it is acceptable that legal advisers are paid by landlords not to take on tenant cases, and how the government will prevent this and protect tenants' access to the Huurcommissie. The minister said such contracts are disapproved of but depend on the case and are for courts to judge, that the Huurcommissie is accessible without legal aid, and that the number of such contracts is unknown.
In principle, citizens and businesses are free to decide with whom they enter into an agreement, when they do so, and what the content of the agreement is.
Het staat burgers en bedrijven in beginsel vrij om zelf te bepalen met wie zij een overeenkomst aangaan, op welk moment zij dat doen en om te bepalen wat de inhoud van de overeenkomst is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over schimmel in huurhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about mould and damp in rented housing, including calls for action in The Hague, serious leaks in housing for vulnerable elderly, a national inventory, compensation and fines data, municipal enforcement, the Wkb quality-assurance bill, and abolishing the landlord levy. The minister answered that landlords must maintain housing, that The Hague has a mould action plan, that a national survey (WoON 2018) will cover the issue, that no data exist on compensation, fines or municipal orders, and that the levy leaves corporations enough room to invest.
I am not aware of any data on the number and amounts of compensation related to damp and mould problems, nor of penalty payments imposed in the past five years for this problem.

Mij zijn geen gegevens bekend over aantallen en bedragen schadevergoeding verbandhoudend met vocht- en schimmelproblemen en evenmin over dwangsommen die in de afgelopen vijf jaar zijn opgelegd vanwege deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de waakvlam bij Loppersum

The MP asks about the NAM's gas production from the five Loppersum clusters, which after Council of State rulings was reduced to a minimum 'waakvlam' level of about 1.6 billion m3 per year, and whether SodM, the SAC and gas production reductions should be involved given increased earthquakes. The minister replies that production is limited to what is needed for supply security, that a reduction in the Groningen production ceiling of 10 percent is being prepared, and that SodM's advice has been sent to parliament.
In line with SodM's advice, I will work with NAM and GTS to examine how production in Loppersum, which takes place for capacity-related supply security, can be further restricted.

Conform het advies van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) zal ik in samenwerking met NAM en GTS bezien hoe de productie in Loppersum, die plaatsvindt omwille van de capaciteitsmatige leveringszekerheid, nader kan worden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Lacin over de zorgen van werknemers in de kolenketen

MPs Beckerman and Lacin asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about funds for closing coal plants, compensation flows to shareholders, support for workers, and an FNV-proposed 800 million euro coal fund. The minister replied that no funds have been allocated for closing the oldest plants or any future closures, that the FNV fund is acknowledged, and that committing the money before the first closure is not on the agenda.
No funds have been allocated for closing the oldest coal plants before 1 July 2017, nor have funds been allocated for any future closure of coal plants.
Er zijn geen middelen vrijgemaakt voor de sluiting van de oudste kolencentrales voor 1 juli 2017, noch zijn er middelen vrijgemaakt voor eventuele sluiting van kolencentrales in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitverkoop van slecht geïsoleerde corporatiewoningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations are deliberately selling poorly insulated rental homes with low energy labels to raise their average label, and how they will meet the 2021 average label B target. The minister denied a deliberate strategy, noted corporations' rising energy investments, and acknowledged that further investment and legislation will be needed, with an update promised before summer.
I have no indication that corporations pursue a strategy in which they only sell homes with low energy labels in order to bring their stock to an average label B.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat corporaties een strategie hanteren waarin zij enkel door verkoop van woningen met lage energielabels hun voorraad naar gemiddeld label B willen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor houtpellets

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about sustainability criteria for wood pellets used in industrial power generation, including verification of biomass at specific plants, the Enviva case and indirect land-use change, and whether subsidy money should go to other energy measures. The minister answered that the criteria apply to co-firing and SDE+ steam, that verification will be done by accredited verifiers under a designated supervisor, that only one installation is expected to start in 2017, and that she disagrees subsidies should shift to other sustainability measures.
In addition to accrediting verifiers, I will appoint a supervisor to ensure that no abuses occur when the declarations are issued.
Naast de accreditatie van verificateurs zal ik een toezichthouder aanwijzen om erop toe te zien dat zich geen misstanden voordoen bij het afgeven van de verklaringen.

m: Amendement van de leden Van Oosten en Berndsen-Jansen waarmee de schuldvariant uit het wetsvoorstel wordt verwijderd
Removes the 'should reasonably suspect' fault standard from the criminal offence of using services of trafficking victims, so only knowing conduct is covered.
Under the amendment, the offence is met only when there is intent ('he knows').
Ingevolge het amendement wordt enkel wanneer sprake is van opzet («hij weet»), voldaan aan de delictsomschrijving.
Motie van de leden Segers en Berndsen-Jansen over Veiligheid onderbrengen bij het ministerie van BZK
States that Security, including police management, should move back from the Ministry of Justice and Security to the Ministry of the Interior to restore a healthier balance of power.
declares that at the next appropriate moment Security, including police management, must again be placed under the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations
spreekt uit dat op het eerstvolgende geëigende moment Veiligheid, waaronder het beheer van de politie, weer moet worden ondergebracht bij het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties
Motie van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Segers over een onderzoek naar de bestuurlijke houdbaarheid van het ministerie van V en J

Asks the government to study the administrative viability of the Ministry of Security and Justice and develop a scenario returning the Security portfolio to the Interior Ministry, reporting by 1 May 2016.
requests the government to examine the administrative sustainability of the department and develop a scenario in which Security returns to the Ministry of the Interior
verzoekt de regering om, de bestuurlijke houdbaarheid van het departement te onderzoeken en een scenario te ontwikkelen
Motie van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het geactualiseerde rapport over de haalbaarheid van de bezuinigingen bij het OM
Asks the government to send the updated feasibility report on Public Prosecution Service budget cuts to the House before summer, with a policy response.
requests the government to send the report to the House before summer, with a policy response
verzoekt de regering, het rapport nog voor de zomer aan de Kamer te zenden, voorzien van een beleidsreactie
Motie van de leden Kooiman en Berndsen-Jansen over de effectiviteit van het rijksbrede preventiebeleid

for offences carrying twelve years or more imprisonment, insofar as the act caused a person's death
voor de misdrijven waarop een gevangenisstraf van twaalf jaren of meer is gesteld, voor zover het feit iemands dood ten gevolge heeft gehad

requests the government to investigate the main causes why criminal cases lapse
verzoekt de regering, om te onderzoeken wat de belangrijkste oorzaken zijn waardoor strafzaken verjaren

requests the government to investigate how the legal protection offered by objection and appeal possibilities in Bibob procedures can be strengthened
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe de rechtsbeschermende werking van bezwaar- en beroepsmogelijkheden in Bibob-procedures versterkt kan worden

Requires prior judicial authorisation by the appeals commission before the head of a detention institution can order involuntary medical treatment of detainees, strengthening detainees' legal protection.
may only be taken after a corresponding authorisation from the appeals commission
kan slechts worden genomen na een daartoe strekkende machtiging van de beroepscommissie
Motie Slob c.s. over versterking van het brandpreventiebeleid
Asks the government to explore additional ways to strengthen fire prevention policy and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with relevant parties, to examine what additional options exist to further strengthen fire prevention policy
verzoekt de regering in overleg met betrokken partijen te onderzoeken welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er nog zijn
Motie Berndsen c.s. over de informatiehuishouding voor brand- en rampenbestrijding
Asks the government to keep information management for fire and disaster response under the Minister of Safety and Justice until its placement within the Institute for Physical Safety is clear.
Requests the government to keep information management for fire and disaster response temporarily under the Minister of Safety and Justice.
verzoekt de regering de informatiehuishouding voor brand- en rampenbestrijding voorlopig in het beheer van de minister voor Veiligheid en Justitie te houden
Amendement van de leden Bouwmeester en Berndsen-Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een rechterlijke toetsing voorafgaand aan de dwangbehandeling

Requires prior judicial authorisation before a prison director may impose involuntary medical treatment, with the Raad's appeal commission deciding, instead of a director's decision subject only to appeal.
To this end it is necessary that the judge gives prior permission for involuntary medical treatment.
Daartoe is het nodig dat de rechter vooraf toestemming geeft voor een onvrijwillige geneeskundige behandeling.
Amendement van de leden Bouwmeester en Berndsen-Jansen ter vervanging nr 9 over een patientenvertrouwenspersoon
Adds a patient advocate for detained persons receiving medical treatment, with a duty to advise and assist and an obligation for the director to inform them of the option.
The submitter believes an independent patient advocate can contribute to the legal protection of these detainees.
De indiener is van mening dat een onafhankelijke patiëntenvertrouwenspersoon kan bijdragen aan de rechtsbescherming van deze gedetineerden.
Motie Berndsen c.s. over wijziging van de Aanwijzingen externe contacten rijksambtenaren
Asks the government to loosen the guidelines on external contacts between civil servants and members of parliament, so requests from either chamber are granted in principle.
requests from either chamber of the States General for written or oral contacts with officials are in principle granted
op verzoeken vanwege een van beide Kamers van de Staten-Generaal om schriftelijke of mondelinge contacten met ambtenaren in beginsel positief wordt beslist
Motie Berndsen c.s. over intrekking van de dataretentierichtlijn
Asks the government to lobby in Brussels for withdrawal of the data retention directive because of privacy concerns.
asks the government to strongly push for withdrawal of the data retention directive at European level
vraagt de regering zich in Europees verband hard te maken voor de intrekking van de dataretentierichtlijn

Amendement van het lid Schouten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 strekkende tot het handhaven van de eis dat bij direct marketing burgers telkens worden gewezen op de mogelijkheden tot het doen van verz
Retains the Wbp requirement that direct marketers must inform individuals of their right to object each time they are contacted.
Article 41, paragraph 4, Wbp, provides that the data subject is pointed to the possibility of objecting each time he is approached in connection with direct marketing.
Artikel 41, lid 4, Wbp, regelt dat betrokkene elke keer dat hij in verband met direct marketing wordt benaderd wordt gewezen op de mogelijkheid tot het doen van verzet.
Amendement van het lid Gesthuizen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het terugbrengen van de bewaartermijn voor gegevens in verband met telefonie over een vast of mobiel netwerk tot zes maanden
Shortens the mandatory telecommunications data retention period for telephone traffic from twelve months to six months, the minimum allowed under the EU directive.
This amendment also aims to reduce the retention period for telephone traffic to the minimum permitted under the data retention directive.
Dit amendement beoogt ook de termijn van de bewaarplicht voor telefoonverkeer terug te brengen tot het minimum dat op grond van de richtlijn dataretentie is toegestaan.
Asks the government for a broad vision on how existing and proposed criminal sanction modalities fit together, and how the new freedom-restricting measure fits among them.
requests the government to come with a broad vision on the internal coherence of existing and proposed sanction modalities
verzoekt de regering met een brede visie op de interne samenhang van bestaande en voorgestelde sanctiemodaliteiten te komen
Motie Berndsen c.s. over het onderzoeksbelang
Asks the government to amend the bill so that the investigative-interest criterion for DNA kinship research gets a basis in formal law rather than only in a prosecutors' instruction.
requests the government to send the Chamber an amendment note to give the investigative-interest criterion a basis in formal law
verzoekt de regering een nota van wijziging aan de Kamer te zenden om het criterium van het onderzoeksbelang een basis in de formele wet te geven
Motie Van der Steur c.s. over onafhankelijkheid van de DNA-databank
Asks the government to position the DNA database independently of the NFI so that quality and access are guaranteed for all laboratories while remaining under government.
requests the government to position the DNA database so that independence for both quality and access is guaranteed
verzoekt de regering de DNA-databank zodanig te positioneren dat de onafhankelijkheid voor zowel de kwaliteit als de toegang is gegarandeerd

Amendement van het lid Arib c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 69 over verhogen van de capaciteit bij de politie voor de opsporing van en bestrijding van kindermisbruik en -pornografie ten koste van een aant
Shifts 75 fte of police capacity from the animal cops programme to investigating child abuse and child pornography.
This amendment aims to ensure that the police have sufficient capacity for investigating and combating child abuse and child pornography.
Dit amendement beoogt te bewerkstelligen dat er voldoende capaciteit bij de politie komt voor de opsporing en bestrijding van kindermisbruik en -pornografie.
Motie Marcouch c.s. over een "terbeschikkingstelling aan het onderwijs"-maatregel
Asks the government to develop a measure compelling young offenders serving prison sentences to follow education, with sentence length tied to completing it.
requests the government to develop a 'placement at education' measure
verzoekt de regering een «terbeschikkingstelling aan het onderwijs»-maatregel
Motie Gesthuizen c.s. over gemeentelijke vrijheid bij de aanpak van de softdrugsproblematiek
Asks the government to leave municipalities free to tackle soft drug problems effectively instead of imposing generic club-pass rules on coffeeshops.
requests the government to leave municipalities free to tackle soft drug problems effectively and not to set generic rules
verzoekt de regering de gemeente de vrijheid te laten de softdrugsproblematiek aan te pakken op een effectieve manier en geen generieke voorschriften vast te stellen
Motie Gesthuizen c.s. over de invloed van de financieringssystematiek van de rechterlijke macht op de kwaliteit van de vonnissen
Asks the government to commission research into how the per-case financing of the judiciary affects the quality of court judgments.
requests the government to commission research into the influence of the financing system in the judiciary on the quality of judicial rulings
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek in te stellen naar de invloed van de financieringssystematiek in de rechterlijke macht op de kwaliteit van de rechterlijke vonnissen
Motie Dibi c.s. over uitbreiding van de partiële notificatieplicht bij de bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid

Asks the government to extend partial notification duty to parliament for all cases where the Justice Minister's special instruction power influences individual criminal investigations and prosecutions, with periodic substantive reporting.
requests the government to extend the partial notification duty for formal or informal use of the special instruction power
verzoekt de regering de partiële notificatieplicht bij het formele of informele gebruik van de bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid uit te breiden
Motie Van der Steur c.s. over herijking van het systeem van het beslagrecht

Asks the government to state its position on reforming attachment law (beslagrecht), including a possible duty to substantiate claims, judicial review of attachment petitions, and a simple way for the debtor to be heard after attachment.

requests the government to state its position to the House shortly after receiving the working group's recommendations, including a possible duty to substantiate, review of the petition by the judge in chambers

verzoekt de regering om kort na de ontvangst van de aanbevelingen van de werkgroep een standpunt aan de Kamer kenbaar te maken en daarbij in ieder geval te betrekken een eventuele substantiëringsplicht, de toetsing van het verzoekschrift door de voorzieningenrechter
Motie Dibi c.s. over een landelijke wapeninleveractie
Asks the government to organise a nationwide weapons amnesty collection action soon.
requests the government to organise a nationwide weapons collection action in the short term
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn een landelijke wapeninleveractie te organiseren
Motie Kuiken c.s. over meetbare doelstellingen van de politiesterke
Asks the government to set police strength objectives that are measurable and to report progress to the Chamber every half year.
requests the government to formulate the police strength objectives so that progress is measurable and to inform the Chamber about it every half year
verzoekt de regering om de doelstellingen ten aanzien van de politie sterkte zodanig te formuleren dat de voortgang daarvan meetbaar wordt en de Kamer daar halfjaarlijks over te informeren
Motie Elissen c.s. over erkenning van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers als officiële gesprekspartner
Asks the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner.
requests the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner
verzoekt de regering om de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers te erkennen als officiële gesprekspartner
Motie Gesthuizen c.s. over verhoging van het ambitieniveau voor het ontnemen van misdaadgeld
Asks the government to make a realistic estimate of the share of criminal proceeds confiscated each year and set a higher ambition level on that basis.
requests the government to make a realistic estimate of the percentage of criminal proceeds confiscated annually from criminals
verzoekt de regering een realistische schatting te maken van het percentage van het misdaadgeld dat jaarlijks van criminelen wordt ontnomen
Motie Hennis-Plasschaert c.s. over regionalisering van de brandweer
Asks the government to move towards regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law.
requests the government to proceed to regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law
verzoekt de regering over te gaan tot regionalisering van de brandweer binnen de wet Veiligheidsregio's
Motie Berndsen c.s. over inzichtelijk maken van de administratieve lasten bij extra taken voor de politie
Asks the government to make the administrative burden on police visible in advance and inform the House when a College of Procurators-General instruction adds extra police tasks.
make the administrative burden on the police transparent in advance and inform the House about it
de administratieve lastendruk op de politie vooraf inzichtelijk te maken en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over een gerichte verhoging van de tarieven voor verkeersboetes
Asks the government to raise traffic fines selectively for serious offences rather than by a uniform percentage.
requests the government, within the available budget, not to choose a uniform percentage increase for all traffic fines
verzoekt de regering om binnen het beschikbare budget niet te kiezen voor een algehele procentuele verhoging voor alle verkeersboetes
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over berichten in de media omtrent de “massale vernietiging van bewijsmateriaal van buitenlandse verkeersovertreders”

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether evidence on foreign traffic offenders was massively destroyed, why, and how EU cooperation on collecting traffic fines works. The Minister answered that no fines were destroyed, that about 20% of fines are not collected, that cooperation generally works well, and that digital enforcement is being extended to foreign plates, though the reasons for deleting some data are only set out in a separate letter.
There is no question of destroyed fines.
Er is geen sprake van vernietigde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de berichtgeving dat de belastingdienst kweekbenodigdheden voor de hennepteelt heeft doorverkocht op een veiling

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority wrongly auctioned cannabis-cultivation equipment seized for tax debts, in conflict with Opiumwet article 11a, and how such sales will be prevented. The minister answered that the seizure was fiscal, predated article 11a's entry into force, that a national procedure now requires police consultation and destruction of such goods, and declined to disclose sale proceeds.
Information on the sale proceeds falls under the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the Invorderingswet 1990.
Informatie over de verkoopopbrengst valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Invorderingswet 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over de detentie van een Nederlands staatsburger in het buitenland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Berndsen-Jansen asked why the government refuses to transfer Dutch detainee Mr Singh from the US and why WOTS requests are refused for Dutch citizens abroad for more than five years. The minister answered that transfer requires sufficient ties with the Netherlands and a remaining sentence of at least four months, neither of which is met, and that the five-year rule is only an indication while medical situation is subordinate to resocialisation.
In this case neither of the two criteria is met.
In deze casus wordt aan beide criteria niet voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over de berichten dat de Nederlandse Politie Sint Maarten te corrupt vindt

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked about reports that the Dutch police consider the Sint Maarten police too corrupt to cooperate with, and about the rules, powers and remedies around the Recherche Samenwerkingsteam. The government answered that the team's reinforcement is planned for 24 months, that an Integrity Chamber law was adopted in Sint Maarten, and that cooperation with the Sint Maarten police will be intensified under the 24 May 2015 protocol.
The Integrity Chamber Ordinance was adopted by the Estates of Sint Maarten on 18 August 2015.
De Landsverordening Integriteitkamer is op 18 augustus 2015 door de Staten van Sint Maarten vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over kennis en procedures van de politie over bedreigingen en huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about errors in the police investigation of threats against a victim, the number of comparable cases, police capacity and expertise, protocols for threats, and officer training. The minister acknowledged the errors but said no comparable case count is known, the police have sufficient powers and training, and a specific protocol is not considered necessary.
The requested number of comparable cases is not known.
Het gevraagde aantal vergelijkbare gevallen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet toegerust is op Syriëgangers

Two D66 MPs asked whether youth care institutions are equipped to treat young people who attempted to travel to Syria, including the role of closed youth care, parents, foster care and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that treatment is still being developed case by case, that closed placement may be needed to prevent departure, that an Exit facility and a family support point are being set up, and that no known radicalised minors travelled to the Middle East after closed placement.
In the first place it is up to municipalities together with youth care institutions to give content to this.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan gemeenten samen met de jeugdhulpinstellingen hier inhoud aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de gevolgen van ongewenst verklaring van personen tijdens tbs

An MP asks the State Secretary about the consequences for foreign nationals in TBS (forensic psychiatric treatment) whose residence rights end during treatment, leading to revoked leave and interrupted resocialisation, and how often this happens. The State Secretary answers that return to the country of origin is the policy framework, that about eleven such cases are being sought safe alternatives, that the policy on leave after residence termination will not change, and that an inventory has been made to align immigration and criminal decisions earlier.
I do not intend to change this policy.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over seksueel misbruik bij boeddhisten in Nederland

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Bergkamp asked the ministers about alleged sexual abuse by Buddhist monks and teachers in the Netherlands, including prevention, reporting, victim support and prosecution limits. The government said it cannot establish misconduct from police and prosecutor information but cannot rule it out, pointed to free certificates of conduct for volunteers, a 'safe church' toolkit, awareness campaigns and victim support services, and noted that statutes of limitation no longer apply to serious sexual offences against children.
Based on information from the Public Prosecution Service and the police, I cannot establish whether Buddhist monks and/or teachers have committed sexual abuse.
Op basis van de informatie van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie kan ik niet vaststellen of boeddhistische monniken en/of leraren zich schuldig hebben gemaakt aan seksueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Pleidooi voor instellen speciaal tuchtrecht voor politie-agenten”

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a special disciplinary law for police officers, similar to that for soldiers, should be studied given calls from police unions and experts. The Minister acknowledged the proposal and said it is being considered within the broader reform of how police use of force is handled, promising to inform parliament before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate of my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de overheid zelf materiaal voor het kweken van hennep bij een veiling heeft aangeboden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether government auctions offered cannabis-cultivation equipment, including seized items, and whether this breached the Opium Act. The minister answered that four seized items (three transformers and a tent) were offered via a state auction agency in error, withdrawn on 18 May 2015, and that controls were tightened.
DRZ has in the meantime reviewed and tightened the control mechanisms again to prevent recurrence.
Inmiddels heeft DRZ de controlemechanismen nogmaals doorgenomen en aangescherpt om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de Friese rechtspraak wordt ontmanteld

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice whether the Frisian judiciary is being dismantled, citing cases moved to Groningen and Zwolle, and what this means for accessibility and Frisian-language proceedings. The minister denied dismantling, explained the court allocation rules and concentration of administrative law cases in Groningen, and said the Council for the Judiciary will decide on the multi-year plan, which will be sent to parliament.
I refer further to my answers to questions 5, 6 and 7.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoorden op vragen 5, 6 en 7.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Recourt, Berndsen-Jansen, Segers en Van Tongeren over de uitzending van Argos over de verdwenen tapgesprekken

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an Argos broadcast on missing wiretap recordings, including whether the ADR inquiry into the system failure was adequate, the role of the supplier, and whether the government controls the stored data. The minister replied that the broadcast revealed no new facts, that the ADR found no sign of deliberate human action, that the supplier withheld one detail for trade-secret reasons, and that the police manage the system and have taken additional measures.
It is true that the ADR investigation did not provide complete clarity on all points.
Het klopt dat het onderzoek van de ADR niet op alle punten volledige duidelijkheid heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de nationale politie proeven houdt met privacy schendende chips in kentekenplaten

D66 MPs asked whether the national police is testing privacy-invasive RFID chips in number plates that could track all drivers' movements, and how this relates to the pending ANPR bill. The minister denied police involvement, said a private developers' field test at a defence training centre is underway, and said a privacy assessment and CBP advice would follow only if the government later decides to introduce the chip.
Once the results of the test are known, the cabinet will consider whether it is desirable to introduce the RFID chip.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van de proef bekend zijn, zal het kabinet bezien of het wenselijk is om de RFID-chip in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over geweldsfilmpjes bij jongeren

Two MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries how to explain the reported trend of youths filming and sharing violent videos, how many youths are involved, and what measures exist to stop it. The government answered that it has no figures because filming violence is not a separate offence, that prosecution is possible where the filmers can be treated as accomplices or instigators, and that anti-bullying policy, school safety rules from August 2015 and online information campaigns are the main responses.
I do not have figures, because filming an assault or public violence is not an independent criminal offence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers, omdat het filmen van een mishandeling of openlijke geweldpleging geen zelfstandig strafbaar feit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zorgen van gemeenten omtrent de financiering van de Veiligheidsregio’s

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about municipal concerns over cost increases and budget cuts at the safety regions, including a 56% contribution rise in Langedijk, and how this affects safety and democratic control. The minister replied that service levels are the regional board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate can intervene if performance is inadequate, and that municipal councils can influence funding through the regional arrangement, without giving figures on how many municipalities face problems.
I do not have an overview of the number of municipalities that have problems with the funding. That is a matter for the municipalities and the safety region.
Ik beschik niet over een beeld van het aantal gemeenten dat problemen heeft met de bekostiging. Dat is zaak van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over schendingen van de rechten van sekswerkers

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Amsterdam mayor's request for a legal basis to process sex workers' sensitive personal data, the requirement to assess sex workers' self-reliance, and banking and insurance exclusion. The minister said talks with Amsterdam were ongoing and largely pointed to existing draft rules and other ministries on the banking question, while answering the rights questions in general terms.
Following the Amsterdam mayor's request, I am currently still in consultation with the municipality of Amsterdam.
Naar aanleiding van het verzoek van de burgemeester van Amsterdam ben ik momenteel nog in overleg met de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht ‘Bluscapaciteit ontoereikend bij grote brand’

MPs Hachchi, Van Veldhoven and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether insufficient firefighting water capacity in the water mains poses a national risk to businesses, schools and hospitals, whether the government knew of it, and what should be done. The minister answered that he was not aware of such a problem, that the Veiligheidsberaad sees no national issue and deems water supply a matter for municipalities and safety regions, and that no extra action is needed.
The Veiligheidsberaad indicates that the availability of firefighting water is a matter for municipalities and safety regions; the fire service is part of the safety region.
Het Veiligheidsberaad geeft daarbij aan dat de beschikbaarheid van bluswater een zaak is van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's; de brandweer maakt deel uit van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over opgepakte Nederlandse jihadisten bij de Turks-Syrische grens door Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked how many Dutch jihadists Turkey has detained at the Syrian border, what happens to them, whether agreements or extradition requests exist, and what the Netherlands does to stop those released from returning or travelling again. The minister answers that about 10 Dutch nationals were reported by Turkey since early 2015, that Turkey deports them, that no specific agreements exist, that extradition has not been considered so far, and lists Dutch measures such as passport invalidation, alerts and a pending travel-ban bill.
On whether there is an intention to submit extradition requests, no answer can be given in view of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Op de vraag of het voornemen bestaat uitleveringsverzoeken in te dienen, kan met het oog op belangen van opsporing en vervolging geen antwoord gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het draagvlak voor legalisering van softdrugs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a poll showing majority support for municipal cannabis cultivation experiments and whether he would allow regulated cultivation to address nuisance, illegal drug trade and fires. The minister declined to allow cultivation experiments, citing international drug treaties, a WODC report that 80-90% of Dutch-grown cannabis is exported, and pointing to the new criminalisation of preparatory cultivation acts while committing to continued joint enforcement.
In light of the international agreements the Netherlands has committed to, it is currently not possible to proceed to (experiments with) regulation of cultivation.
In het licht van de internationale afspraken waar Nederland zich aan heeft verbonden is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om over te gaan tot (experimenten met) regulering van de teelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges are refusing committal (gijzeling) requests for unpaid fines, which the courts say the Public Prosecution Service files automatically with thin justifications. The minister acknowledges the need for better motivation of such requests, points to planned measures such as instalment payments from 1 July, and says the Public Prosecution Service and CJIB will improve reasoning for the new-style requests.
I am of the view that these requests must be submitted to judges with such motivation that they are enabled to test the lawfulness of the request on that basis.
