Ik ben van mening dat deze vorderingen zodanig gemotiveerd moeten worden voorgelegd aan rechters dat zij in staat worden gesteld de rechtmatigheid van de vordering hierop te toetsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het waarborgen van privacy binnen de Jeugdwet

D66 MPs asked whether the Youth Act adequately protects children's privacy, given reports of unnecessary labelling and parents being forced to disclose information to get care reimbursed. The Secretary of State answered that privacy is protected within the Wbp and Youth Act, pointed to completed privacy impact assessments and training for municipal staff, and argued there is no legal gap, while adding clarifying provisions in a separate bill.
It is the responsibility of the municipal executive to handle personal data carefully within these frameworks.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W om binnen deze kaders op een zorgvuldige manier om te gaan met de persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht: ‘7 op de 10 hoort niets na aangifte woninginbraak’

MP Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about public dissatisfaction with police feedback after reporting burglaries, and whether reporting is worthwhile given low reporting and clearance rates. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to multichannel reporting, victim follow-up measures and a planned status-tracking service, and said he lacked proof of causal effects of policy while providing statistics by reference to published reports.
Therefore a nationwide 'reporting tracking service' will be realised this year, through which victims are better informed about the start and progress of their case.
Daarom zal dit jaar landelijk een «aangiftevolgservice» worden gerealiseerd, waarmee slachtoffers beter worden geïnformeerd over de aanvang en de voortgang in hun zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het aantal instromende discriminatiezaken bij het OM op het laagst gemeten aantal is

Two D66 MPs asked why reported discrimination cases reaching the Public Prosecution Service fell to a record low despite thousands of police reports, and whether police and prosecutors are adequately resourced. The minister explains the gap through registration differences and lack of perpetrator indicators, says capacity is sufficient, and promises a broader report from 2016 while declining to publish the current figures report now.
No. The discrimination figures of the Public Prosecution Service have already been made public with the sending of the progress letter on discrimination.
Nee. De discriminatiecijfers van het OM zijn reeds bekend gemaakt met de toezending van de Voortgangsbrief discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Meld Misdaad Anoniem vaker getipt over drugslabs”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Meld Misdaad Anoniem's hotline is not reachable from abroad, whether many internationally relevant crimes can be reported anonymously, and how access could be improved quickly. The minister confirmed that foreign access depends on local providers, pointed to the international Crime Stoppers channel and planned online reporting, and said a separate number via KPN is being explored at extra cost.
Meld Misdaad Anoniem is currently working on enabling anonymous online reporting as well.
Bovendien werkt Meld Misdaad Anoniem op dit moment aan het realiseren van de mogelijkheid om ook online anoniem te kunnen melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) de noodklok luidt omdat het oplossen van misdaden in gevaar komt

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the NFI's warning that solving crimes is at risk means the planned THC testing for the cannabis measure lacks capacity, and whether the measure should be withdrawn. The minister answered that enforcement will be funded within existing budgets, the NFI is drafting a contour plan still under discussion, and the core production and capacity for investigations will be safeguarded; the measure will not be withdrawn.
Enforcement of the measure will take place within the existing budgetary frameworks.
De handhaving van de maatregel zal binnen de bestaande budgettaire kaders plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over de stelselverantwoordelijkheid in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health who is responsible for investigating a child death in Rotterdam, and where national versus municipal responsibility lies in youth care. The State Secretary answered that the joint national inspectorates supervise the Youth Act, that Rotterdam asked the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to investigate, and that the Rijk bears system responsibility which may lead to adjusting rules if the system malfunctions.
Rotterdam's request to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to carry out this investigation is in line with these agreements.
Het verzoek dat de gemeente Rotterdam heeft gedaan aan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg om dit onderzoek uit te voeren is in lijn met deze afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over extra maatregelen tegen terreur

The MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (D66) asked the ministers about France's terrorism funding, Dutch security measures after the Paris attacks, intelligence staffing at the AIVD, and cooperation with neighbouring countries. The government answered by referring to its letter to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288) on additional counter-terrorism measures, rather than answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (both D66), question number 2015Z01185, have been answered by letter 'additional counter-terrorism measures and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Parliamentary paper 29 754, no. 288).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2015Z01185 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het verwijt van de burgemeester van Maastricht dat er onvoldoende steun uit Den Haag komt in de strijd tegen criminaliteit

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether drug policy explains rising high-impact crime in Maastricht and why the government does not respond to the mayor's call to regulate cannabis cultivation. The minister answered that no causal link can be shown, that he maintains contact with mayors, and that the response lies in an integrated enforcement approach, citing additional police capacity in southern provinces.
I regard local government as a very important partner in the joint approach to crime and nuisance.
Ik beschouw het lokaal bestuur als een zeer belangrijke partner in de gezamenlijke aanpak van criminaliteit en overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zin en onzin van aangifte doen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police handling of online crime reports is slow, incomplete and inconsistent across units, and what is being done about it. The minister answered that the online form is secure, improvements such as DigiD identification are due in Q2 2015, and that the police handle about one million reports a year with no capacity problem, while promising to inform parliament further in February 2015.
In February 2015 I will inform the House in more detail about progress in implementing these measures.
In februari 2015 zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang bij de uitvoering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Reorganisatie politie kost honderden miljoenen extra’

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked whether the police reorganisation would cost hundreds of millions more than budgeted, how extra costs would be covered, and whether the Court of Audit should check the costs. Minister Opstelten answered that the 230 million euro friction-cost budget is considered sufficient, that extra costs must fit within the budget, that the accounts are audited externally, and that he sees no reason for a separate Court of Audit review.
I see no reason to ask the Court of Audit, on top of the external accountant's audit, to look again specifically at the spending within the friction-cost budget.
Ik zie geen reden om bovenop de accountantscontrole de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nog eens extra specifiek naar de uitgaven binnen het frictiekostenbudget te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de vervolging van een Nederlandse coffeeshopeigenaar in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service informed Thai authorities about a Dutch coffeeshop owner's case, and why, given the Dutch gedoogbeleid and recent court rulings on back-door supply. The Minister confirmed a Dutch investigation into four Noord-Brabant coffeeshops, said the information sharing aimed to speed up a mutual legal assistance request, and stated that the case goes beyond back-door issues and that the suspect's nationality is not decisive.

The purpose of informing the Thai authorities was therefore to promote and expedite the execution of the legal assistance request in view of the progress of the criminal investigation in the Netherlands.

Het doel van het informeren van de Thaise autoriteiten was dan ook de uitvoering van het rechtshulpverzoek te bevorderen en te bespoedigen met het oog op de voortgang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt

MPs Van Nispen and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about reports that super-fast-track justice (supersnelrecht) fails around New Year's Eve, including sentencing gaps and appeal rates. Minister Opstelten rejected the claim of failure, defended the measure as a signal against public-space violence, and said the procedure is carefully applied under the prosecution menu, with appeal rates not notably different from other cases.
I do not share the claim that the use of super-fast-track justice around New Year's fails.
De stelling dat de inzet van supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Berndsen-Jansen over de ontnemingsschikking met Cees H. en het bericht Teeven weer in opspraak

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about a settlement with Cees H. (EUR 750,000 agreed), the unclear actual payment flows via Luxembourg, the exclusion of the tax authority, and a prosecutor's side agreement on a pardon. The minister replied that the actual financial settlement cannot be verified further, that the agreed amount stands, that no further investigation into the pardon matter is warranted, and that the Staatssecretaris was questioned by the investigator and by the minister.
After this investigation I informed the House by letter of 3 June 2014 that I unfortunately could not inform it further about the actual financial settlement of the agreement.
Ik heb uw Kamer na dit onderzoek bij brief van 3 juni 2014 laten weten dat ik uw Kamer helaas niet verder kon informeren over de feitelijke financiële afwikkeling van de schikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zorgen van de Nationale ombudsman over onterechte invallen in woningen bij het opsporen van hennepkwekerijen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the National Ombudsman's concerns over wrongful home raids while searching for cannabis cultivation sites, including how often raids occurred, their impact on residents, police capacity and costs. The minister answered that wrongful raids were not previously registered, that the police added a registration option in September 2014, and that capacity and compensation costs are not separately recorded.
Entries into premises as such are not registered.
Binnentredingen als zodanig worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het toenemende aantal drugslabs in seniorenflats

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising numbers of drug labs and cannabis grow sites in senior flats, the expected increase in production, health and fire risks, and fire casualty figures. The minister answered that the forecast is not clearly based, that enforcement intensification is underway, that no national shift to senior flats is known, and that cost and fire-cause data are incomplete or unavailable.
There is no complete picture of the extent of (drug) crime, and these higher registration figures may also result from prioritising the fight against drug crime.
Er bestaat geen volledig beeld van de omvang van (drugs)criminaliteit en deze hogere registratiecijfers kunnen ook het gevolg zijn van de prioritering van de bestrijding van drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over de plannen om rechtbanken in Noord-Nederland te sluiten waardoor de provincie Friesland zonder rechtspraak komt te zitten

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about plans to merge the Leeuwarden and Assen courts into a super court in Groningen, which could leave Friesland without local court sittings, and about whether this conflicts with the judicial map and access principles. The Minister answered that no decision to centralise the court's office function has been taken, that court sittings will remain in all 32 designated locations including Assen and Leeuwarden, and that the Council for the Judiciary has been informed and will monitor access, with evaluations promised later.

There is no question that justice will continue to be administered in the 32 sitting locations designated by general administrative order with a statutory pre-consultation procedure, including Assen and Leeuwarden.

Niet ter discussie staat dat er blijvend recht zal worden gesproken in de 32 bij algemene maatregel van bestuur met wettelijke voorhangprocedure aangewezen zittingsplaatsen, waaronder ook in Assen en Leeuwarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het hacken van servers door de politie terwijl de zogenaamde ‘hackwet’ nog niet door de Kamer is behandeld

Members Berndsen-Jansen and Verhoeven asked whether police hacking of servers in the Blackshades investigation has a legal basis while the 'hackwet' bill is pending. The Minister answered that the police acted under article 125i of the Criminal Procedure Code with prior authorisation from an examining judge, in only two exceptional cases, and that the Computercriminaliteit III bill will be submitted early next year.
Under certain circumstances it is possible, on the basis of article 125i of the Code of Criminal Procedure with authorisation from the examining judge, to enter a computer system remotely.
Het is onder bepaalde omstandigheden op basis van artikel 125i van het Wetboek van Strafvordering met een machtiging van de rechter-commissaris mogelijk om op afstand een computersysteem te betreden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het harde drugsbeleid op festivals zowel advocaten als verslavingszorginstellingen te ver gaat

D66 MPs asked whether festival-goers are adequately informed that accepting an on-the-spot fine gives them a criminal record, whether they can consult a lawyer on site, and whether strict drug enforcement at festivals helps health and safety. The Minister of Justice answered that the public prosecutor informs suspects on request, that a suspect can ask for a lawyer and the case is then postponed, and that the effects of enforcement are limited and no harder data exist.
There is no question of a specific strict drug policy at festivals.
Er is geen sprake van een specifiek streng drugsbeleid op festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat hackers 1,2 miljard inloggegevens en 500 miljoen e-mailadressen hebben gestolen

MPs Verhoeven and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hackers stole 1.2 billion login credentials and 500 million email addresses, and whether Dutch organisations were affected and how this relates to the data breach notification bill. The minister could neither confirm nor deny the claim, said the NCSC had alerted its government and critical-sector audience and is seeking information from Hold Security, and explained that breaches like this would generally need to be reported under the proposed duty.
This claim I can neither confirm nor deny.
Deze claim kan ik bevestigen noch ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over fraude bij schadeherstel van auto’s

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about widespread fraud in car bodywork repair, reported by the insurers' association, and whether the government would act if the sector fails to fix it. Minister Opstelten said he supports industry measures within legal and proportionality limits, pointed to a convenant and a shared-data approach with RDW and VbV, and described existing police and prosecution arrangements, without announcing new government intervention.
I think it is good that the Association of Insurers has investigated irregularities and fraud in the repair of bodywork damage to passenger cars.
Ik vind het goed dat het Verbond van Verzekeraars onderzoek heeft gedaan naar onregelmatigheden en fraude bij de reparatie van blikschade aan personenauto's
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat Van der G. zijn leven niet zeker

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked whether serious threats had been made against Van der G., whether a former AIVD agent's warnings were included in the security analysis, and whether the minister would inform the House in closed session. The minister said he was unaware of the former agent's role, that threat assessments are current and not disclosed publicly for security reasons, and that he saw no reason for a closed briefing.
No statements are made in public about the extent and nature of the threat and risk, or about security measures.
Over de mate en aard van dreiging en risico en over beveiligingsmaatregelen worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat politie en justitie de strijd tegen de georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit niet aan kunnen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecutors can cope with organised drug crime, what measures and evidence of effectiveness exist, whether they have warned of capacity limits, and whether budget cuts should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the fight is a top priority, that the target of doubling the number of criminal groups tackled is on track, that no hard figures on organised drug crime exist, and that no extra funds are available to reverse cuts.
I do not recognise the picture that police and the Public Prosecution Service would not be equal to organised crime.
Het beeld dat politie en OM niet zouden zijn opgewassen tegen de georganiseerde criminaliteit herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Segers over de waarborgen voor voldoende landelijke specialistische opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Segers asked whether specialist national shelter for trafficking victims, especially minors, will survive decentralisation of youth and women's care, and how regional inequality and funding gaps will be prevented. The State Secretary replied that from 2015 municipalities will jointly procure this shelter nationally, that a VNG transition arrangement reserves funds, and that continuity of care is guaranteed, but gave few concrete figures or time limits.
The VNG will set aside funds for shelter for this category of victims and procure this form of women's shelter centrally.
De VNG gaat middelen voor de opvang van deze categorie slachtoffers apart zetten en deze vorm van vrouwenopvang centraal inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de verdubbeling van het aantal brandslachtoffers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that fire deaths had doubled, its causes, prevention for elderly residents, and whether crew size and workload are linked to casualties. The minister said the figures are preliminary and unanalysed, pointed to existing prevention projects and a pending smoke-detector study, and said no link to crew size or workload is known.
Because an analysis has not yet taken place, no information on the causes of the fires is available.
Doordat een analyse nog niet heeft plaatsgevonden, is er geen informatie over de oorzaken van de branden beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat een coffeeshop plotseling vervolgd wordt wegens te grote voorraden

The MP asks whether a coffeeshop can operate without stocking more than 500 grams and whether the back-door supply gap undermines enforcement of coffeeshop policy. The minister replies that the 500-gram limit is a condition of the tolerance policy, that the operator is responsible for compliance, and that the tension with the ban on cultivation and sale outside coffeeshops has long been recognised.
The tolerance policy covers, apart from so-called user spaces, only the sale of small quantities of cannabis by coffeeshops under strict conditions.
Het gedoogbeleid omvat, naast de zogeheten gebruikersruimten, alleen het onder strikte voorwaarden verkopen van kleine hoeveelheden cannabis door coffeeshops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Nederlandse homostellen niet langer Russische kinderen kunnen adopteren

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Russia's 2014 decree blocking adoptions by same-sex married couples and unmarried persons from countries allowing same-sex marriage affects Dutch applicants, and whether the Netherlands would support them before the European Court of Human Rights. The government answered that Russia-Netherlands adoption cooperation has never existed so effects are limited, and that intervention in ECHR cases would be assessed case by case and only in exceptional situations.
Whether the Netherlands will support any Dutch couples will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
Of Nederland eventuele Nederlandse stellen zal bijstaan zal per zaak worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over het bericht dat “verdachten profiteren in kinderpornozaken van een te vage tenlastelegging”

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that suspects in child pornography cases benefit from vague charging documents, and about a legal disagreement between the Public Prosecution Service and the Hague court on how possession charges must be drafted. The Minister confirmed a legal disagreement limited to a few court chambers, said several dozen cases were delayed and four summons declared void with only occasional sentence effects, and stated there are no formal OM-judiciary agreements, with the OM pressing for a uniform court position and a new test case expected to clarify matters.
The OM Den Haag will soon bring another case using the new method of charging.
Het OM Den Haag zal binnenkort weer een zaak aanbrengen met de nieuwe wijze van tenlastelegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat verboden wapens gemakkelijk in buurlanden verkrijgbaar zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how prohibited alarm and gas pistols can be bought easily in Germany and Belgium, how cross-border sales and imports are controlled, and whether the government will take extra measures or raise the issue with neighbouring countries and in Brussels. The minister said the difference in laws is a fact, that Dutch import controls by customs and police work well, that the investigation into the specific weapon is not finished, and that no additional measures are warranted.
No, I see no reason in this incident to take or undertake additional measures or actions.
Nee, ik zie in dit incident geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen of acties te (onder)nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de VN geen inzage krijgt in misbruikdossiers van Vaticaan

Two D66 MPs asked why the Holy See refuses to give the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child detailed information on child abuse cases by clergy, and whether it should do so under the Convention. The Foreign Minister answered that the Convention requires cooperation but not detailed case information, that the Holy See does assist foreign mutual legal assistance requests, and that Nederland will not press the Holy See on the matter.
Given the answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, however, it is not reasonable for the Netherlands to confront the Holy See on this.
Gezien het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 ligt het echter niet in de rede dat Nederland de Heilige Stoel hierop aanspreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat homostellen hun kind niet kunnen erkennen

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether married gay men can be prevented from recognising an unborn child they fathered with an unmarried woman, given differing municipal practice under Article 1:204(1)(e) of the Civil Code. The State Secretary agreed there is no good reason for unequal treatment, explained that a 2013 amendment removes the provision (planned for 1 April 2014), and said municipalities apply the law individually.
From the standpoint of equal treatment, however, there is no good reason to continue giving the man married to a woman other than the mother a different position from a man married to a man.

Er is vanuit het oogpunt van gelijke behandeling evenwel geen goede reden om de met een andere vrouw dan de moeder gehuwde man een andere positie te blijven laten innemen dan de met een man gehuwde man.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen naar aanleiding van diens brief over ‘tapgesprekken in de zaak Van Rey’, een reconstructie van de NOS, en het bericht dat de uitleg over de tapgesprekken onwaarsch

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about recurring wiretap system outages, a September 2012 power failure that lost roughly 2,000 taps in the Van Rey case, and missing incident records. The minister answered that the outage was an internal power-supply fault rather than a utility failure, that storage and logging procedures are being tightened, and that expert review and a technical backup are being considered.
In the concrete case of the outage on 20 September 2012, it was regrettably neglected to immediately inform the users of the wiretap system that an outage had occurred.
In het concrete geval van de storing op 20 september 2012 is helaas verzuimd om direct de gebruikers van het tapsysteem op de hoogte te stellen van het feit dat zich een storing had voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over politie-inzet bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Dijkstra (D66) asked whether the 281,552 police hours spent on football matches in 2012–2013 were high compared with other events, whether this fits local priorities, and what preventive measures would reduce it. Minister Opstelten answered that football-related police deployment has fallen by 5% year-on-year and 15% over three seasons, that local authorities decide the balance of police deployment, and that cooperation with clubs and the KNVB is the preventive route.
That weighing is made at local level by the local authority, which has control over police deployment.
Die afweging wordt op lokaal niveau gemaakt door het lokaal gezag, dat zeggenschap heeft over de inzet van politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over de inzet van het alcoholslot

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about the high number of drivers refusing the alcohol lock programme (ASP), its relation to criminal sentencing, cost hardship, the CBR's automatic imposition without regard to personal circumstances, and measurement errors. The minister answered that refusal reasons are varied, the administrative and criminal tracks run largely separately, the CBR cannot consider personal circumstances while administrative judges can (rarely do), and that the lock is calibrated to near-zero error though it cannot distinguish mouth from blood alcohol; an interim report is promised alongside the letter.
The administrative judge does have room to take the offender's situation into account.
De bestuursrechter heeft wel ruimte om rekening te houden met de situatie van de overtreder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het tekort aan cyberspecialisten bij het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service lacks cybercrime specialists, what staffing was planned and realised for 2012-2014, and what measures would be taken. Minister Opstelten answered that existing specialist teams are sufficient, that no additional measures are planned, and that the High Tech Crime unit's results are not lagging its targets.
Since these staff also handle other types of crime to a greater or lesser extent, I cannot give concrete FTE numbers in this context.
Aangezien deze medewerkers zich naast cybercrime ook in meer of mindere mate bezighouden met de aanpak van andere soorten strafbare feiten, kan ik in dit verband geen concrete aantallen fte's noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de politie op grote schaal misbruik maakt van internet- en telefoongegevens

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police misuse telecom and internet data via the CIOT system, including unlawful requests, shared access codes, repeated audit findings and the number of requests. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate's 2012 recommendations are being implemented on schedule, that the request volume reflects multiple queries per investigation, and that no services have been cut off from CIOT access so far.
I hereby inform you about the status of the various measures I have taken to give effect to these recommendations.
Bij deze informeer ik u over de stand van zaken van de verschillende maatregelen die ik heb getroffen om hieraan gestalte te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen over het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers als gevolg van vervuilde xtc pillen

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked about deaths linked to contaminated ecstasy, the number of drug-related deaths over 20 years, and whether on-site drug testing at festivals should be reinstated. The government answered that cause of death is uncertain, that a full testing system is impossible and on-site testing gives false security, and that it sees no reason to revise drug policy, though it asked Trimbos to address the issue with professionals.
I see no reason to reconsider the current drug policy.
Ik zie geen reden het huidige drugsbeleid te heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over duizenden onterechte boetes op de A13

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of thousands of wrongly issued speeding fines on the A13 after a missing speed sign near hectometre post 11.0. The minister replied that the speed limit is sufficiently clear, that no investigation or refunds are needed, and that Rijkswaterstaat checks reported signage problems.
There is indeed no sign in the central reservation.
Er staat inderdaad geen bord in de middenberm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van homoparen bij interlandelijke adoptie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch intercountry adoption practice through Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions tolerates discrimination against same-sex and non-Christian couples in South Africa, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary replied that the South African discrimination investigation is ongoing, that Abba Adoptions has removed discriminatory criteria, that the Central Authority acted adequately, and that the government is open to a second intermediary and to a possible European working group, without committing to a new discrimination-free alternative.
As I have already shared with your House, there are no longer any discriminatory conditions in the cooperation between Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions.
Antwoord 5 Zoals ik al eerder met uw Kamer heb gedeeld 3 , zijn er geen discriminerende voorwaarden meer in de samenwerking tussen Wereldkinderen en Abba adoptions.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Weyenberg over het achterhalen van vaders van niet-erkende kinderen

D66 MPs asked whether municipalities may pursue biological fathers of non-recognised children for benefit recovery, how paternity is established, how this relates to privacy, and whether mothers can lose benefits for refusing cooperation. The state secretary explained the municipal procedure, the court route under the Civil Code, the mother's duty to cooperate with possible suspension of benefits, and that sperm donors are generally not liable for maintenance.
Those who carry out work under the WWB are subject to a duty of confidentiality (article 65 WWB), which adequately safeguards the privacy of those involved in municipal benefit recovery.

Voor degenen die werkzaamheden verrichten in het kader van de uitvoering van de WWB geldt een geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 65 WWB) waarmee de privacy van de betrokkenen bij gemeentelijk bijstandsverhaal afdoende is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat de politie ongeoorloofd stealth sms’jes naar mobiele telefoons stuurt om verdachten te kunnen volgen

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice about reports that police covertly send 'silent SMS' to track suspects without proper authorisation, and about court criticism of this method. The minister confirmed the method is used, defended its legality and said police and prosecutors will tighten procedures, but declined to disclose how often it is used or how often it contributed to convictions.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service have informed me that they will take these critical points to heart and tighten the procedure for the use of the silent SMS.
Politie en OM hebben mij laten weten deze kritische punten ter harte te nemen en de procedure voor de inzet van de stille sms te zullen aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Berndsen-Jansen over de kosten van het softdrugsbeleid van de financiële effecten van het reguleren van softdrugs

MPs Koolmees and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about enforcement costs of soft drug policy, the Taskforce B5 results and costs, coffeeshop turnover and tax revenue, and the financial effects of regulating soft drugs. The government answered that enforcement capacity is not earmarked, the Taskforce B5 cost about 1.99 million euro, and that tax data on coffeeshops are not available per branch, while stating that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs.
Whereas the current cabinet is doing everything it can to turn the tide and tackle crime, nuisance and drug tourism hard.
Dit terwijl het huidige kabinet er juist alles aan doet om het tij te keren en criminaliteit, overlast en drugstoerisme hard aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Meenen en Berendsen inzake het profielwerkstuk “De Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag”

MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries of Education and Justice about young people's awareness of the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and whether education could deter crime, citing a student survey. The government acknowledges the low awareness, notes that only 650 youth applications were refused in 2012 and that the lookback period for adolescents was shortened, and commits to an information newsletter, awareness work with the CSV, and further outreach.
We endorse the importance of tailored information for young people about the existence of the VOG and the consequences a refusal may have for future study, internship or employment.
Wij onderschrijven het belang van voorlichting op maat aan de jongeren over het bestaan van de VOG en de gevolgen die een weigering hiervan kan hebben voor een toekomstige studie, stage of baan.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onvoldoende bescherming van minderjarige slachtoffers van mensenhandel (ingezonden 30 mei 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Netherlands inadequately protects minor victims of trafficking, why registered minor victims have doubled, whether the immigration regime outweighs victim care, and whether trauma experts should join interviews. The Minister acknowledges the UNICEF/Defence for Children critique, cites existing protective measures (protected shelter places, reflection period, trained investigators) and promises a policy response letter, but rejects the call for trauma experts.
As requested, your House will soon receive a policy response to the report.
Zoals verzocht zal uw Kamer binnenkort een beleidsreactie ontvangen op het rapport.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de aanbeveling van het VN-Comité tegen Marteling om af te zien van het gebruik van stroomstootwapens (Taser) bij de Nederlandse politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the UN Committee Against Torture's recommendation to stop using Tasers and abandon the planned pilot in regular police units. The minister replied that a Taser pilot in basic police care is planned for 2014, that Taser use is considered relatively safe when used correctly, and that the committee's call for a complete ban is not shared.
However, I do not believe there is reason to reconsider the pilot or abandon it.
Ik ben echter niet van mening dat er reden is om de pilot te heroverwegen of hiervan af te zien.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen-Jansen over de overlast door criminele straatdealers en het handhaven van het ingezetenencriterium

An MP asked the Justice Minister about street-level drug dealing and nuisance linked to the coffeeshop residence criterion (ingezetenencriterium), including whether it displaced nuisance, whether the policy works, and how police capacity is used. The minister replied that nuisance has generally fallen, that the policy will be maintained, that police enforce on both street dealing and coffeeshops, and that he will report on enforcement by the summer recess.
As promised to your House, before the summer recess I will come with an interim report on the implementation of enforcement (local customisation) in the municipalities of the Netherlands.
Zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer kom ik voor het zomerreces met een tussenstand over de invulling van de handhaving (lokaal maatwerk) in de gemeenten in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat gratis trouwen uit de hand loopt

MP Berndsen-Jansen asked the Interior Minister about reports that free civil marriages are overloaded and whether the 1897 rule enabling them is outdated, and whether an income test should be introduced. Minister Plasterk replied that municipalities set the free-marriage slots, that the rule should stay so marriage remains open to all, and that income-related fees are reserved to the national government, so no change is planned.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat onbemande militaire vliegtuigen (“drones”) steeds vaker in Nederland worden ingezet als opsporingsmiddel van de politie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the police use Defence's unmanned Raven aircraft for investigations and public order, and about legal basis, costs, liability, privacy, oversight and public information. The minister answered that 14 requests were granted in 2012 (81 flights), that the legal basis is the assistance regime of the Politiewet 2012, that data are kept only if relevant to criminal cases, and that civilian drone use is governed by Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport permits.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het capaciteitsverlies van de Koninklijke Marechaussee door het handhaven van het qat-verbod

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice how enforcement of the qat ban affects Marechaussee capacity, qat use, prices, illegal trade, addiction, and local nuisance. The Minister answered that qat enforcement is incidental for the KMar, that no data yet show reduced use or rising illegal trade, and that municipalities can already act under the Opium Act and the local Public Order Ordinance (APV).
There is as yet no data showing that the qat ban leads to less qat use.
Er zijn nog geen gegevens voorhanden waaruit zou blijken dat het qatverbod leidt tot minder qatgebruik
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Kooiman en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat er geen sms wordt verzonden via AMBER Alert na 22 uur

MPs Oskam, Kooiman and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether AMBER Alert SMS messages are withheld between 22:00 and 07:00 and why, and whether differentiated night-time delivery could be arranged. The minister confirmed that night-time SMS alerts were stopped after complaints about disturbed sleep, and promised a website option allowing participants to opt in to night-time SMS within one to one and a half months.
There was a risk that participants would drop out because they were disturbed at night by incoming SMS messages.
Het risico ontstond dat deelnemers zouden afhaken omdat ze ’s nachts gestoord worden door binnenkomende SMS-berichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het onderzoeken en het tijdig voorkomen van pedofilie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked about the lack of research on female paedophilia, the availability of help for people with paedophilic feelings, the Stop It Now! helpline and its funding. The minister answered that no separate figures on female offenders or the hidden group exist, that existing bodies do not distinguish offenders by sex, and that funding for Stop It Now! will be reviewed with VWS and reported in April 2013.
Figures on the size of the hidden group of (female) paedophiles do not exist as far as I am aware.
Cijfers over de omvang van de verborgen groep (vrouwelijke) pedofielen bestaan voor zover ik weet niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over pedofiele praktijken door vrouwen

MPs from VVD, SP, D66 and CDA asked the Justice Minister about a broadcast on female paedophile practices, including whether the conduct is prosecutable, whether a new network exists, and whether police and prosecutors are aware of female offenders. The minister condemned the conduct, said the OM is cooperating with Greek investigators and will assess Dutch prosecution, and confirmed existing awareness of female offenders while referring to earlier answers.

In light of the findings within the Greek investigation, it will be examined whether the conduct is prosecutable under Dutch law, individually or in association, and whether a criminal investigation in the Netherlands is warranted.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen binnen het Griekse opsporingsonderzoek zal worden bezien of gedragingen individueel dan wel in verenigingsverband naar Nederlands recht vervolgbaar zijn en een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland aangewezen is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about reports that more children are sexually exploited, including whether agencies under-report victims and whether the government underestimates the problem. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, saying CoMensha records age at the time of reporting, describing pilots and training to spot trafficking signals, and denying a structural shortage of shelter places.
It is being examined whether additional information on victims can be supplied to CoMensha and recorded in a new registration system.
Er wordt bekeken of het mogelijk is aanvullende informatie over slachtoffers aan CoMensha te leveren en te registreren in een nieuw registratiesysteem.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pechtold over het belang van een onafhankelijke Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the independence of the Dutch Safety Board, including its placement under his ministry, its budget, the appointment of members, and the vacancies and planned reduction in members. The minister answered that statutory safeguards ensure independence, that the 2008 evaluation found the framework adequate, and that a new evaluation commission will review effectiveness, while the vacancies are held open pending that evaluation.
All these safeguards together ensure that, even if services under my responsibility were the subject of investigation, the Board could carry out that investigation in full independence.
Al deze waarborgen tezamen stellen zeker dat ook indien diensten, ressorterend onder mij, onderwerp van onderzoek zouden worden, de raad dat onderzoek in volledige onafhankelijkheid kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het blokkeren van gestolen mobiele telefoons

An MP asked whether the ministry is negotiating with telecom providers to remotely block stolen mobile phones, and how this fits with police investigation practice and the goal of raising arrest rates. The minister answered that a working group with providers, police and the Public Prosecution Service expects results this year, and that blocking is expected to deter theft.
These talks led me, together with my colleague of EZ and representatives of the telecom providers, to set up a working group.
Deze gesprekken hebben ertoe geleid dat ik samen met mijn ambtgenoot van EZ en vertegenwoordigers van de telecomproviders een werkgroep heb geformeerd
Antwoord vragen Berndsen-Jansen over de hackplannen van de minister

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Nederlands Juristenblad article criticising police hacking plans, including claims of identity theft, undermined judicial oversight by the rechter-commissaris, conflicts with antivirus software, and fundamental rights. The minister defended the plans as not constituting identity theft, promised further study of secure logging and the rechter-commissaris role in a forthcoming bill, and rejected a constitutional explicitation of computer confidentiality as of limited added value.
Regarding the role of the rechter-commissaris, the differences between the analogue and digital worlds are in my view not as large as the author claims in his article.
Met betrekking tot de rol van de rechter-commissaris zijn de verschillen tussen de analoge en digitale wereld mijns inziens niet zo groot als de auteur in zijn artikel stelt.

Vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het falen van de opsporing van georganiseerde misdaad door te veel prioriteiten en te weinig capaciteit (ingezonden 24 oktober 2012

An MP asks the Justice Minister about reports that too many enforcement priorities leave police and prosecutors short of capacity against organised crime, and why an internal progress report was not sent to parliament earlier. The minister rejects the claim that they are not keeping up, says the target of doubling dismantled criminal groups by 2014 is on track, and promises to send the reports to parliament before the 2013 budget debate.
The requested reports will be sent to your House by separate letter, together with these answers, before the budget debate of my department.
De gevraagde rapportages komen uw Kamer per separate brief en – evenals deze antwoorden – voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling van mijn departement, toe.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen met betrekking tot de onduidelijke taakopvatting en bevoegdheden van buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren

Berndsen (D66) asks the Minister of Security and Justice how the growing role of municipal enforcement officers (boa's) alongside the police fits with earlier statements that they are not a substitute for police, and what steps will clarify their tasks and powers and the police-boa division. The Minister says cooperation and information-sharing are being reviewed with partners, the police hold operational direction while municipalities hold strategic direction, and a VNG vision on boa's is expected by year-end.
Based on this inventory, I will determine together with the parties involved in early 2013 which actions are needed to improve information exchange.
Op grond van deze inventarisatie bepaal ik begin 2013 samen met betrokken partijen welke acties nodig zijn om tot een verbetering van de informatieuitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen met betrekking tot de politietop en de wietpas

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that police leadership must keep quiet about the wietpas (cannabis pass) policy, including whether critical views exist and whether officials were reprimanded or removed. The minister replied that the police committed to enforce what was agreed, that a gag order is not at issue, and that no officials were reprimanded or removed.
A gag order is not an issue.
Een spreekverbod is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen en Verhoeven over de onveilige wegen op Goeree-Overflakkee

D66 MPs Berndsen and Verhoeven asked the minister about road safety on Goeree-Overflakkee, including the absence of lighting and crash barriers, fragmented responsibility among several authorities, and the quality of accident data. The minister replied that the Rijk roads follow the Handboek Wegontwerp, that the province is coordinating road safety, that accident risk there is average, and that planned upgrades on the N57 will finish by end 2013.
I do not recognise the picture that on Goeree-Overflakkee there is slow implementation of consistent and safe infrastructure as a result of divided responsibilities.
Ik herken het beeld dan ook niet dat er op Goeree-Overflakkee sprake is van een trage implementatie van een consistente en veilige infrastructuur als gevolg van verdeelde verantwoordelijkheden.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie het rijbewijs van dronken fietsers inneemt (ingezonden 10 juli 2012).

An MP asked the minister whether police were confiscating driving licences from drunk cyclists, which the Wegenverkeerswet does not allow, and how this squares with the law. The state secretary said police are not competent to seize licences from cyclists, that this is not police policy, that measures were taken to prevent wrongful seizures, and that affected cyclists can claim damages under article 164(9).
Measures have now been taken to prevent wrongful seizure of driving licences from drunk cyclists.
Er zijn inmiddels maatregelen genomen om onterechte invordering van het rijbewijs van dronken fietsers te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de behandeling van slachtoffers van zedenmisdrijven (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MP Berndsen asks the state secretary about a press report and a lawyers' blacklist showing problems in how sex-crime victims are treated, what will be done about it, and whether justice has enough capacity given budget cuts. The state secretary acknowledges the LANZS list as a serious signal, reports that OM and Rvdr have analysed the points and that a follow-up evaluation with stakeholders is planned, and says victim attention need not add costs.
Next autumn a follow-up consultation will take place at my ministry with the parties involved to evaluate the results of the chosen solutions.
Komend najaar vindt op mijn ministerie vervolgoverleg plaats met de betrokken partijen om het resultaat van de gekozen oplossingen te evalueren.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over de inzet van studenten bij internet patrouilles

Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a police pilot using students to patrol the internet for cybercrime, asking about the legal basis, privacy safeguards, entrapment risks, scope, duration and whether parliament will be informed. The minister answered that the students only screen open internet sources without investigative powers, work anonymously on police computers, the pilot ran until 30 June 2012 targeting illegal drugs, fake medicines and online loverboys, results go to the Raad van Korpschefs, and that there is no entrapment.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de verhouding tussen handhaving door stadswachten en de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Amsterdam stadswachten (municipal enforcement officers) incident and how expanding boa powers relates to the police monopoly on force and the risk of municipal policing replacing neighbourhood police officers. The minister replied that boa's work alongside the police, that municipalities have their own enforcement role, and that uniform standardisation and public information are being explored with stakeholders.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over belastingvrije donaties aan sekten.

Berndsen (D66) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Security and Justice whether sects can qualify as ANBI charities, whether Scientology is benefiting via a side route after a court ruling, and whether ANBI fraud or money laundering occurs. State Secretary Weekers answered that a sect has no clear legal meaning, that improper use of ANBI status is unacceptable and can lead to retroactive revocation after an Tax Authority investigation, and that no ANBI fraud cases are currently under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
The statutory duty of confidentiality does not allow me to address facts or assumptions concerning individual institutions.
De wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht staat mij niet toe in te gaan op feiten of veronderstellingen ten aanzien van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Berndsen over het afschaffen van de verplichting van het ‘gratis’ huwelijk

MPs Schouw and Berndsen asked whether the legal obligation for municipalities to offer free weddings should be abolished, given the claimed cost and misuse. Minister Spies replied that she sees no need to change the rule, that municipalities report no problems, and that no data on usage or lost revenue is available.
These figures are not known to me.
Deze cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over de geschiktheid van Nederlandse wetgeving voor het gebruik van spyware

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the KLPD's use of spyware, the Big Brother Award it received, and whether Dutch law, including article 126l of the Code of Criminal Procedure, is adequate for such tools. The minister acknowledged the award and the KLPD's use of spyware, and referred back to an earlier answer rather than stating a new position on whether specific legislation is needed.
I refer to my answer to question 2 from Member Recourt of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Schouw over gebruik van andermans naam op sociale media

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of other people's names on social media, such as Twitter, and whether current law is adequate, including whether criminal prosecution should be possible and when it amounts to identity fraud. The minister confirmed awareness of the incidents and referred the MPs to earlier answers given to other MPs on the same subject.
I refer to my answer to the questions from member Kooiman of your House
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kooiman van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Berndsen en Kuiken over het bericht dat ‘politie getraumatiseerde agenten in de steek laat’

MPs Berndsen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a RTL report that police forces do not recognise or treat officers' psychological trauma, including court cases against officers and differing approaches to PTSD as an occupational illness. The Minister said the report troubled him, pointed to the Professional Resilience programme, and said he has asked police forces to apply one nationally uniform approach based on objective medical criteria and the NCvB registration guideline, with a further study announced.
I have therefore asked the force managers to conform to the registration guideline of the Dutch Centre for Occupational Diseases (NCvB) on PTSD.
Ik heb de korpsbeheerders daarom verzocht om zich te conformeren aan de registratierichtlijn van het Nederlands Centrum voor Beroepsziekten (NCvB) betreffende PTSS.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over de beslissing van de rechter dat het dienstwapen van de politie opnieuw moet worden aanbesteed

Berndsen (D66) asks why the minister did not hold a fresh tender after cancelling the SIG-Sauer contract, and about the cost, budget, safety and timing consequences of the court ordering a new tender for the police service pistol. The minister answers that returning to the earlier tender was the fastest option, that the court ruled it a new contract, that a new tender takes 12 to 18 months at extra cost of roughly 3 to 4 million euro, and that existing pistols are maintained through periodic inspection and spare parts.
Returning to the result of the earlier tender procedure and to the second-ranked bidder appeared the fastest option and seemed, based on case law, well defensible.

Het teruggaan naar het aanbestedingsresultaat van de eerder afgesloten aanbestedingsprocedure en naar de als nummer twee geëindigde inschrijver bleek de snelste optie en leek op basis van de jurisprudentie goed verdedigbaar.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen(D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bommen op baggerschepen (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MP Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how two live WWII British bombs ended up on dredging ships from Weesp, the risk of disaster, how many transports remain, and what controls prevent bombs entering the ships. The minister confirmed the finds, said the risk is small but cannot be excluded, described pre-survey, magnetometer and diver checks, and expanded the search zone, but declined to order the municipality to take further measures.
I consider the safety risk in the Netherlands manageable given the clear division of responsibilities mentioned above
Ik acht het veiligheidsrisico in Nederland beheersbaar gezien de duidelijke verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling zoals hierboven vermeld
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onjuiste berekening van de politiesterkte (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether counting police trainees at 100% in operational police strength, while acknowledging they are only 40% deployable, creates a misleading picture, and asked how operational strength is defined and calculated. The Minister says he has not created confusion, points to earlier letters defining operational strength and showing the trainee share, and declines to introduce a separate deployable-strength measure, citing the many factors affecting actual deployability.
I therefore maintain the definition of operational strength agreed with your House in 2009.
Ik houd daarom vast aan de in 2009 met uw Kamer afgesproken definitie van operationele sterkte.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Politie zoekt vermiste sekteleden» (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

MP Berndsen asked the minister about reports that members of the Efraim Genootschap, including minors, had disappeared, and why authorities did not intervene earlier. The state secretary answered that the prosecutor found no grounds for criminal investigation since the father had known of the plans and raised no concern, the sons have returned, a victims' reporting point is being considered, and no new sect policy is planned.
On the basis of these facts and circumstances, the public prosecutor decided not to start a criminal investigation and asked the police to withdraw the alert on the woman.
Op grond van deze feiten en omstandigheden heeft de officier van justitie besloten geen opsporingsonderzoek te starten en de politie gevraagd om de signalering van de vrouw in te trekken.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van de Veiligheid en Justitie over afluisteren van advocaten en cliënten (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether recording equipment in prison visiting rooms, which may be used to record lawyer-client conversations, threatens the confidentiality of lawyer-client contact and the right to a fair trial, and whether the Dutch bar's planned summary proceedings against the state are welcome. The secretary answers that recording equipment may be present for order and security, that the prison service has committed to giving lawyers rooms without it or to disclosing and switching off any equipment, that equipment remains in some institutions housing high-risk detainees for capacity and security reasons, and declines to assess the chances of the court case.
It is not the presence of recording equipment in a visiting room but the recording of a conversation that would infringe a detainee's right to a confidential conversation with his lawyer.

Niet het aanwezig zijn van opnameapparatuur in een spreekkamer, maar het opnemen van een gesprek zou een inbreuk betekenen op het recht van een gedetineerde op een vertrouwelijk gesprek met zijn advocaat.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over wapenhandel in Nederland (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a broadcast exposing an illegal arms dealer who was also a shooting club member, and about police capacity and European action against illegal arms trade. The minister answered that illegal arms trade is unacceptable, that no separate police capacity is registered for firearms investigations, and pointed to existing programmes and EU measures without committing to new action.
Beyond that, I cannot go further into the substance of this case, as the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Voor het overige kan ik, nu het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt op de inhoud van deze casus niet nader ingaan.
Vragen van de leden Berndsen en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sluiting van Huize Alexandra (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

MPs Berndsen and Koşer Kaya asked whether the Alexandra youth institution in Almelo will close, why renovated premises are being vacated, how the move saves money, and whether the Sassenheim site preserves expertise for loverboy victims. The state secretary confirmed closure by 1 January 2013, said the move is not a saving but a reallocation of capacity, and argued the new site keeps the same specialist care and security for girls.
There is therefore no question of a saving.
Er is dus geen sprake van een bezuiniging.
Vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van spysoftware (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

MPs Schouw and Berndsen asked the Justice Minister whether the Dutch government holds covert computer-spying software, who developed or bought it, whether source code is available, whether it has been used under judicial authorisation, and what safeguards exist. The minister confirmed the KLPD's Unit Landelijke Interceptie holds such software, limited by law to recording confidential communications under art. 126l Sv with authorisation, refused to disclose product or supplier details for operational reasons, and said it has been used in very few cases within legal limits.
Providing information on which specific software investigative services possess poses an unacceptable risk to the usability of those means.
Het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software opsporingsdiensten beschikken vormt een onaanvaardbaar risico voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het wantrouwen jegens allochtone agenten binnen de Nederlandse politie (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a PhD study reporting that allochtone police officers face exclusion mechanisms, distrust and pressure to prove themselves, and whether structural measures will follow. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the study did not quantify exits, and states diversity policy will be anchored in regular HRM policy, with the planned national police as an opportunity, but announces no specific new measures or timeline.
I want to anchor the diversity policy in the regular HRM policy of the police.
Ik wil het diversiteitbeleid daarom verankeren in het reguliere HRM-beleid van de politie.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over veelvoorkomende oplichting van ouderen door middel van babbeltrucs (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

MP Berndsen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reported large number of elderly people defrauded through distraction scams, and whether police, research and a prevention campaign would be pursued. The minister could not confirm the figure of 30,000 victims, pointed to existing police and Fraudehelpdesk awareness work, and saw no reason for new criminological research.
The distraction scam is known to the police.
De babbeltruc is bekend bij de politie.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over rellen veroorzaakt door voetbalsupporters in Rotterdam (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

Deputy Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he views the football-supporter riots in Rotterdam, whether local authorities have adequate tools to combat such disorder, and whether the Football Act was used. The minister deplored the riots, said mayors have sufficient powers under the APV, Gemeentewet and emergency powers, and explained the Football Act was not applied because the rioters were first offenders rather than repeat troublemakers.
However, the case at hand involved first offenders, not notorious nuisance offenders.
Het ging in de onderhavige casus echter om «first offenders», niet om notoire overlastplegers.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de fysieke en mentale weerbaarheid van politieagenten (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Berndsen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police officers' physical and mental resilience, including officers not intervening in risky situations, training, fear of being held accountable for force, rostering, and support for injured officers. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's concerns stem from 2009 and are being checked, that an action programme with a 32-hour training element per officer is planned for completion by 2014, and that rostering and medal policy are being examined.
I expect that by 2014 all police officers can have been trained in the new way.
Ik verwacht dat in 2014 alle politieambtenaren op de nieuwe wijze getraind kunnen zijn
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat agenten minder bekeuringen dreigen uit te schrijven (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

Berndsen asks the Minister of Security and Justice how traffic fines are proportioned to the seriousness of offences and how the government responds to police officers' complaints that fines are too high. The minister says the fines are fixed tariffs set with parliamentary consent under the tarievenhuis framework, where more dangerous offences are fined more heavily, and that the aim is to reduce offences and improve road safety.
Within the system of the Mulder Act, fixed fine rates have been chosen, which are, incidentally, set with the approval of the House of Representatives.
Binnen de systematiek van de Wet Mulder is gekozen voor vaste boetetarieven, die overigens met instemming van de Tweede Kamer worden vastgesteld.

Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat bewakingsbeelden zonder tussenkomst van politie en justitie openbaar gemaakt worden (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that private CCTV footage of thieves was published online without police or prosecutor involvement, raising concern about innocent people being shown and privacy. Minister Opstelten said the preferred route is that citizens hand footage to police and prosecutors, that private publication may be lawful under conditions, and that he is considering a better rule in the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens announced in a forthcoming letter.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de brand bij de radiotoren bij IJsselstein (ingezonden 26 augu

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs why the findings of investigations into the fire at the IJsselstein radio mast remain undisclosed and whether they should be made public immediately. The minister replied that the cause is not yet definitively established, that the investigations are commissioned by the parties and insurers and are still ongoing, and that he will announce findings publicly once available and will address responsibilities for mast safety in a forthcoming review.
I am of the view that once this is the case, the cause of the fire must also be communicated publicly.
Ik ben van mening dat zodra dit wel het geval is, over de oorzaak van de brand ook in de openbaarheid moet worden gecommuniceerd.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over brute overvallen op juwelierszaken (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Berndsen (D66) asks the Justice minister about the rise in brutal robberies of jewellers, including the trend in robbery numbers, the government's response, the face-scanner pilot in Rotterdam and shops refusing entry to certain population groups. Minister Opstelten gives robbery figures for 2006–2011, points to the Ketenaanpak programme and the Goud & Zilver measures, and says the scanner pilot's results and privacy aspects will be awaited before judging it.
I would like to await the outcomes of the pilot before passing judgment on this.
Ik wacht graag de uitkomsten van de proef af alvorens hierover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Vragen van de leden Berndsen en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de termijn voor een beslissing van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

MPs Berndsen and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the nine-month time the Public Prosecution Service took to decide on prosecuting officers involved in a 2010 Hellevoetsluis death was acceptable, and what measures would speed up such decisions. The minister acknowledged the delay was caused by a miscommunication in sending forensic orders, regretted it, and said the prosecution office had been reminded to supervise such transmissions more closely, with no further measures deemed necessary.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it is aware that it was important for both the officers involved and the next of kin to obtain clarity about the case as quickly as possible, and that it regrets the delay that arose.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat het zich ervan bewust is dat het zowel voor de betrokken agenten als de nabestaanden van belang was om zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te krijgen over de zaak en dat het de ontstane vertraging betreurt.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een automobilist die 2,5 ton aan bekeuringen heeft openstaan (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

The MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a motorist with about 2.5 million euros in outstanding fines and whether this is exceptional. The Minister clarifies that the man was detained for an unpaid confiscation order (ontnemingsmaatregel), not traffic fines, cites a 95.6% collection rate in 2010, and describes the enforcement steps the CJIB takes.
In the news report and the subsequent media coverage, a traffic fine was erroneously referred to instead of a confiscation order.
In het nieuwsbericht en de daarop volgende berichtgeving in de media wordt abusievelijk gesproken van een verkeersboete in plaats van een ontnemingsmaatregel.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opsporingsproblemen bij politie (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

Member Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police investigation failures raised in a Zembla broadcast, including incomplete data entry in the BVH and BVO systems, their lack of connection, fewer cases handed to the Public Prosecution Service, low clear-up rates, and staffing shortages. The Minister acknowledged the data-entry problems, said a decision on improving or replacing the systems will follow the Court of Audit study, rejected the claim of understaffing, and promised a plan of action after the summer.
After the Court of Audit has completed its study, I will decide on the further improvement or replacement of both systems.
Na afronding van het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer zal ik een besluit nemen over de verdere verbetering dan wel vervanging van beide systemen.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onderzoeken van de effecten van geweld op hulpverleners (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a study of the nature, extent and effects of PTSD among all emergency workers, not only police, would be undertaken and whether their care should be regulated by law. Minister Donner answered that existing research and a guideline cover the issue, that employers bear primary responsibility under the Arbo law, and that no separate study or statutory regulation is deemed necessary.
This monitoring, the research gathered for the guideline and the research by the NCvB amply meet the information need, so additional research is currently not necessary.

Deze monitoring, het voor de richtlijn verzamelde onderzoek en het onderzoek door het NCvB voorzien ruimschoots in de informatiebehoefte waardoor een extra onderzoek op dit moment niet noodzakelijk is.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van onzichtbare sms-jes bij de opsporing (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

MPs Recourt and Berndsen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and the AIVD use invisible SMS messages to track mobile phones, on what legal basis, and with what safeguards. The minister confirmed the police use the method only alongside a wiretap with prior written authorisation from the investigating judge, that it is used in a small minority of wiretap cases, and that the AIVD's use is governed by the 2002 Intelligence and Security Services Act and supervised by the CTIVD.
This means it is used only when a wiretap is running on the relevant phone number.
Dit middel wordt alleen ingezet wanneer er een telefoontap op het desbetreffende telefoonnummer loopt.

Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet goed functioneren van de rampenwebsite en het speciale telefoonnummer tijdens de brand in Moerdijk (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).
