Replaces the judge's duty to decide as soon as possible in a court-ordered expert examination or witness hearing with a fixed term extended by three weeks.
the term referred to in paragraph 1, parts a, b, c or e, is extended by three weeks.
wordt de termijn, bedoeld in het eerste lid, onderdelen a, b, c of e, met drie weken verlengd
Amendement van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Laan over een schriftelijke beslissing bij onvrijwillige zorg uiterlijk binnen 48 uur
Amendment requires that a written decision on involuntary care taken without a care plan be recorded within 48 hours at the latest.
Amendement van de leden Van der Laan en Van den Berg over verplichte BIG-registratie voor deskundigen
Amendment requires that the expert assessing will-capacity (wilsbekwaamheid) in second instance also be BIG-registered, keeping a quality safeguard for the client's rights.

However, the submitters want to retain the requirement that this expert must be registered under the Individual Health Care Professions Act, also for second-instance assessment where no agreement is reached.
De indieners willen echter wel vasthouden aan de eis dat deze deskundige geregistreerd dient te zijn op grond van de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Pestgedrag, intimidatie en seksuele relaties tussen hoogleraren en studenten op Radboud Universiteit'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports of harassment, intimidation and sexual misconduct by professors at Radboud University and whether complaint and reporting structures at universities are adequate. The minister acknowledged shortcomings flagged by the Inspectorate, committed to further research into complaint procedures, a possible national reporting point and a regulatory duty of care, but declined to share signals between institutions citing privacy law.
I will inform your House of the findings of the research in due course.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de inzichten uit het onderzoek te zijner tijd nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Kat en Van der Laan over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken

D66 MPs asked how young people can be protected from influencers who lure them into scams around match-fixing sports betting, including crypto flows, gambling-addiction protection, advertising oversight and cross-border enforcement. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, platform obligations and existing regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM, Commissariaat voor de Media) cover the issue, and promised a campaign, a ministry review of labelling edited ads and a werkagenda by year-end.
As previously promised, the House will receive the work agenda by the end of this year, setting out ongoing and future activities on addiction prevention.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt de Kamer eind dit jaar de werkagenda waarin lopende en toekomstige activiteiten op het gebied van verslavingspreventie een plek krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'COC meldt 'homohaat tegen kinderen', pand in Eindhoven belaagd'

An MP asked the ministers about reports of anti-LGBTI harassment linked to football supporters, the frequency of discriminatory chants and sanctions, and the KNVB's enforcement of its anti-discrimination rules. The minister gave partial answers: investigations were ongoing, incident data were not recorded in the requested form, and several questions were answered by describing existing policy and planned follow-up action.
At this moment I cannot make any statements about this in connection with ongoing investigation.
Op dit moment kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen in verband met lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van der Laan, Mohandis en Bikker over het lekken van cijfers over misbruik in de danswereld

MPs asked the minister why figures from the dance-sector abuse investigation leaked before the victims were informed, and who held the figures. The minister answered that the leak is regretted, that only the ministries of VWS and OCW received the draft conclusions, and that the government will respond after studying the final report due 22 May.
I have not yet responded substantively, but I think it is important to state that my concern is with the victims.
Ik heb nog niet inhoudelijk gereageerd, maar vind het wel belangrijk om aan te geven dat mijn zorg uitgaat naar de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van der Laan over berichten over schermtijd

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van der Laan asked the State Secretaries for Health and for the Interior about reports on rising screen time among babies and young children, its effects, and what government will do to inform parents and address tech companies' role. The government answered that screen time has both benefits and harms, outlined existing youth health-care guidance, a planned public campaign, reliance on the EU Digital Services Act and talks with platforms, and declined to adopt France's age-15 social media rule because Dutch GDPR implementation already protects children under 16.

At the commission of the Alliance for a Digital Society, the Trimbos Institute is surveying the extent to which existing research can show the relationship between mental, social and physical health and screen time.

Het Trimbos-instituut inventariseert in opdracht van de Alliantie Digitaal Samenleven in welke mate bestaande onderzoeken beeld kunnen geven van de relatie tussen mentale, sociale en fysieke gezondheid en schermtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Belhaj over het bericht 'Medewerker diversiteit hoger onderwijs geïntimideerd en bedreigd

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Education and of Justice about reports that diversity officers in higher education were intimidated and threatened online, and what the government would do to strengthen their position. The minister condemned the doxing and threats, pointed to a pending bill criminalising doxing and a forthcoming approach to online discrimination, but gave only general answers on strengthening diversity officers' position, deferring responsibility for staff safety to institutional boards.
The cabinet will develop an approach in 2023 to intensify cabinet policy against online discrimination, racism and hate speech.
Het kabinet zal in 2023 een aanpak ontwikkelen voor een intensivering van het kabinetsbeleid voor het tegengaan van online discriminatie, racisme en hate speech.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het rapport 'Opvattingen over seksuele en genderdiversiteit in Nederland en Europa 2022'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the SCP's decision to end its LHBT monitor and how monitoring on LGBTI people will be continued, including questions on scope, independence and consultation with LGBTI organisations. The Minister answered that periodic monitoring will continue every two years, that a new research body is being explored for the LHBT monitor, and that the scope will be broadened, without yet naming the new institution.
As stated in the Emancipation Note 2022–2025, both monitors will continue to be published every two years in this cabinet period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Emancipatienota 2022–2025, blijven deze beide monitors ook in deze kabinetsperiode elke twee jaar verschijnen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked the government about discriminatory chants at football matches, including why FC Twente did not stop a match over homophobic chants and how often matches are halted. The minister answered that clubs bear primary responsibility, that the rules do not depend on chant duration, that exact figures are not kept, and that he is willing to talk with supporters' groups and plans a follow-up to the OVIVI action plan.
Exact figures are not known and reports are not centrally registered and kept for a longer period.
Exacte cijfers zijn niet bekend en meldingen worden niet centraal geregistreerd en voor langere tijd bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Hoe nu verder?' vragen gezondheidsorganisaties zich af nu Staatssecretaris Van Ooijen overleg over alcoholpreventie staakt

An MP from D66 asks the state secretary for Health about the impact of ending the alcohol table (alcoholtafel) under the National Prevention Agreement, and about future cooperation with parties including the alcohol industry. The state secretary answers that the table did not yield effective measures, that commitment to the 2040 targets remains, that the tobacco and overweight tables continue, and that he will keep talking with parties in specific situations and will share his approach before year end.
Before the end of the year I will share with your House the approach with which I will contribute to the NPA targets.
Voor het eind van het jaar deel ik mijn inzet waarmee ik ga bijdragen aan de NPA-doelen met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'NVDI en STAP: samenstelling Alcoholtafel van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord leidt niet tot het gewenste resultaat'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government will take further measures against problem alcohol use after the NVDI and STAP withdrew from the alcohol table of the National Prevention Agreement over conflicting interests. The state secretary said he supports the agreement's goals, has ended the table as ineffective, and will share his approach with parliament before year-end, while committing to evidence-based measures.
I no longer consider the consultation table appropriate for the challenges we face.
Ik acht de overlegtafel niet meer passend voor de uitdagingen waar we voor staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Westerveld over diverse berichten over het disfunctioneren van het ISR en de negatieve gevolgen voor de sporters/sportsters

MPs Van der Laan and Westerveld asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is failing, harming victims of abuse in sport, including former gymnasts. The minister answers that an independent review of sports disciplinary law is underway with results expected in early 2023, that professionalisation measures and additional subsidy conditions are planned, and that the ministry's powers over sports disciplinary law are limited.
I am willing to inform the House in broad outline about the content of the additional subsidy conditions once they have been sent to the institution with the subsidy award.
Ik ben bereid om de Kamer op hoofdlijnen te informeren over de invulling van de aanvullende subsidievoorwaarden zodra deze in de subsidieverlening aan de instelling zijn verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Rechter: gemeente mag student niet uitsluiten van € 800 energietoeslag'

Two MPs asked the minister how a court ruling that a municipality may not exclude a student from the energy allowance affects national guidance excluding students as a group. The minister maintains that categorical exclusion is justified, directs individual students to individual special assistance, and notes extra funding for municipalities.
The national guidelines will be supplemented with a more extensive justification for not granting the one-off energy allowance to students on a categorical basis.
De landelijke richtlijnen zullen worden aangevuld met een uitgebreidere motivering voor het niet categoriaal verstrekken van de eenmalige energietoeslag aan studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Blijf weg als je geen kamer hebt’

MPs Boulakjar and Van der Laan asked whether universities advising international and Dutch students without housing to stay away, and how the government ensures sufficient student housing. The ministers acknowledged the advice, pointed to shared responsibility with municipalities and housing providers, and referred to a national action plan, forthcoming legal steering instruments and the Kronenburg short-stay question under study.
Question 1: Is the Minister aware that the Vrije Universiteit and the University of Amsterdam urge international students not to come to the Netherlands if they have no housing?
Vraag 1 Is de Minister ervan op de hoogte dat de Vrije Universiteit en de Universiteit van Amsterdam internationale studenten oproepen om niet naar Nederland te komen als zij geen huisvesting hebben?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Antispieksoftware herkent zwarte VU-studente niet, daarom dient ze klacht in'

An MP asked whether the minister is aware of a VU student's complaint about proctoring software that failed to recognise her as a Black student, whether discrimination occurred, whether the minister will discuss apologies with UNLI and the VU, and how institutions can avoid discriminatory software. The minister acknowledged the complaint, said the VU found no proven discrimination based on the vendor's confidential study and regretted the situation, placed responsibility on institutions, and urged them to scrutinise software and use the SURF purchasing system.
Educational institutions themselves decide on the procurement and use of software and technology and therefore bear responsibility for it themselves.
Onderwijsinstellingen gaan zelf over de inkoop en het gebruik van software en technologie en dragen daarin dus zelf verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over “het bericht 'Uitsluiting studenten energietoeslag is onrechtmatig, zeggen juristen'

MPs Podt and Van der Laan asked whether excluding students from the categorical energy allowance is justified, given reports that lawyers call it unlawful. The minister defends advising municipalities to exclude students, citing the diversity of student housing, and points to individual special assistance and a planned DUO communication.
I cannot state how many students are facing a higher energy bill.
Ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel studenten te maken hebben met een hogere energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Romke de Jong over een suikertaks

MPs Van der Laan and Romke de Jong asked whether the coalition's sugar tax, which raises the existing beverage excise, would also make bottled water more expensive and whether this fits prevention goals. The government confirmed that mineral water is temporarily included, plans to exempt it from 1 January 2024, and will study tariff differentiation by sugar content.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Brede welvaart verder onder druk door slechtere gezondheid'

MP Van der Laan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Rabobank report finding women's broad welfare fell more than men's in the past year, and whether this warrants further research. The minister replied that CBS monitor data show no diverging trend between women and men, that the differences are limited, and that no further research is deemed necessary.
On the basis of these results, it does not seem necessary to me to conduct further research.
Op basis van deze resultaten lijkt het mij daarom niet nodig nader onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Kuiken over het artikel 'Vaccinatie kleine kinderen tegen rotavirus opnieuw niet vergoed

MPs Van der Laan and Kuiken asked why the rotavirus vaccine was not reimbursed for infants despite a positive Health Council advice, and about cost-effectiveness criteria. The State Secretary said no structural funding is available, the vaccine's cost-effectiveness depends on tender prices, and he will not instruct RIVM to start a tender, while promising a broader review of the basic-package test later in the year.
As I wrote to your House in my letter of 23 May, no financial coverage is available for rotavirus vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 23 mei j.l. aan uw Kamer heb geschreven is er geen financiële dekking beschikbaar voor rotavirusvaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij de voetbalwedstrijd tussen de nationale mannenelftallen van Nederland en Duitsland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked whether homophobic chants were heard at the Netherlands–Germany football match, why the match was not halted, and how the motion on stopping matches for racist or homophobic chants is being implemented. The minister confirmed the chants, said the organisers acted by sending stewards and the chants stopped quickly, and pointed to the OVIVI plan and KNVB rules as the framework, referring to an earlier letter for details.
Furthermore, I am in discussion with the KNVB to bring chants more to the attention of the professional football organisations.
Voorts ben ik met de KNVB in gesprek om spreekkoren meer onder de aandacht te brengen van de betaald voetbalorganisaties (bvo's).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Van Nispen over de ontoereikendheid van de aanpak om ontuchtplegers en daders van seksueel geweld in de sport te weren

MPs Van der Laan and Van Nispen asked the minister whether screening tools such as the VOG and the NOC*NSF blacklist adequately keep sex offenders out of sports coaching, and about information-sharing gaps. The minister acknowledged the gap, declined to link disciplinary information to the VOG, said a shared registration system is blocked by the GDPR, and promised further talks and a national action plan without committing to a specific legal change.
I consider linking disciplinary information to the Certificate of Conduct for Natural Persons (VOG) undesirable.
Ik acht het koppelen van tuchtrechtinformatie aan de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag Natuurlijke Personen (VOG) niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de zorgelijke toestand van etnisch-Russische studenten, docenten en onderzoekers

MPs Podt, Van der Laan and Sjoerdsma asked about the difficult situation of ethnic-Russian and Belarusian students, teachers and researchers in the Netherlands after sanctions, including financial hardship, work-hour limits, unclear visa prospects and knowledge-leakage risks. The minister acknowledged the problems, said work-hour limits will not be changed, urged institutions to support these students, and said residence rights are kept while study conditions are met.
Adjusting the number of hours students may work is not seen as a solution.
Het aanpassen van het aantal uren dat studenten mogen werken wordt niet als oplossing gezien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Sahla en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Minister zet ventilatie op scholen op 1'

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about ventilation in schools, childcare, vve, mbo, hbo and universities, CO2 measurement, and whether the school helpline extends to these sectors. The government answered that ventilation responsibility lies primarily with providers and institutions, that existing rules and risk-based inspection apply, and that the helpline is not extended, pointing instead to RIVM guidance and an app.
The cabinet has no insight into the measures regarding ventilation at institution level in secondary vocational education (mbo) and higher education (ho).
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de maatregelen met betrekking tot ventilatie op instellingsniveau in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) en hoger onderwijs (ho).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over de positie van klokkenluiders binnen de sport

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about whistleblower protection in sport, noting that the planned whistleblower scheme only applies to organisations with 50 or more employees, which most sports bodies do not reach. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to the Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland as the existing reporting point, and said the positioning of that centre is under discussion and will be considered, without committing to a concrete deadline or new scheme.
I am in consultation with parties about the positioning of the Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland, as also requested in the motion by Van der Laan et al.
Ik ben met partijen in overleg over de positionering van het Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland zoals ook motie Van der Laan c.s. vraagt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Chinese app MY2022 voor de Olympische Spelen 2022 gevoelige data van o.a. de Nederlandse Olympiërs verzamelt en politiek sensitieve conten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Chinese MY2022 Olympic app collecting sensitive data of Dutch athletes and storing politically sensitive content, including IFlytek links, university ties, a security audit, mandatory use, censorship, and raising the issue with the IOC and EU. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described the security flaws found by Citizen Lab, said athletes were not obliged to use the app but had to provide personal health data, and noted the government had raised concerns bilaterally, through briefings and with the Chinese ambassador, while answers to the questions were delayed.

Given the technical aspects of the questions asked and the interdepartmental coordination they required, it has unfortunately not proved possible to answer these questions before the start of the Olympic Games.

Gezien de technische aspecten van de gestelde vragen en de interdepartementale afstemming die deze vergden, is het helaas niet mogelijk gebleken om deze vragen voor de aanvang van de Olympische Spelen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ginneken, Van der Laan en Simons over de moorden op, geweld tegen en zelfdodingen door trans-personen in Nederland

MPs Simons, Van der Laan and Van Ginneken asked about murders of, violence against, and suicides among trans people in the Netherlands, including official statistics, a registration system, anti-violence and reporting policy, and suicide prevention. The Minister answered that no separate registration system is planned, cited police and prosecution data, and described existing LHBTI safety, reporting and suicide-prevention measures and waiting-list efforts in trans care.
In light of the available material, I see no reason to set up an additional registration system.
In het licht van het beschikbare materiaal, zie ik geen aanleiding om een aanvullend registratiesysteem in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Thuiszorghulp heeft voortaan ook recht op sociale zekerheidsregelingen’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van der Laan asked the government about a court ruling that personal care helpers paid via a PGB (personal budget) are entitled to unemployment insurance (WW) under indirect sex discrimination, and about its consequences for premiums, informal work, and social security for domestic workers. The minister answered that the ruling is under appeal at the CRvB and should not be extrapolated, that UWV continues to apply the exemption pending the appeal, and that extending WW coverage would have far-reaching implications for the system, so no change is planned.
This concerns a ruling by one court in an individual case. There is therefore no settled case law.
Het betreft hier een uitspraak van één rechtbank in een individuele casus. Daarmee is geen sprake van bestendige jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Poolse Izabela is overleden omdat zij geen abortus mocht ondergaan

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister how the government views reports that a Polish woman died after being denied an abortion, and what the Netherlands is doing about Polish abortion law, civil society funding and support for women. The minister said the government is concerned about regressive pressure on women's rights, stated it has raised concerns with Poland, and said the Human Rights Fund cannot finance individuals or abortion services, while noting Dutch healthcare is a member-state competence.
In this specific case it is unclear whether the tragic death was a direct consequence of the abortion legislation or the result of a medical error.
In deze specifieke zaak is het onduidelijk of het tragische overlijden het rechtstreekse gevolg is van de abortuswetgeving of het gevolg was van een medische fout.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paternotte en Van der Laan over sporters van teamNL, die met corona besmet zijn geraakt

MPs Omtzigt, Paternotte and Van der Laan asked whether lessons were drawn after TeamNL athletes caught COVID-19 on the Tokyo flight, what measures China imposes, and whether flying on a single pre-departure test is safe. The minister replied that NOC*NSF evaluated the trip and adopted adjusted travel measures for Beijing, that no approach can reach zero risk, and that the cabinet considers a single test sufficiently safe while leaving the operational responsibility with NOC*NSF.
It is up to NOC*NSF to ensure that the TeamNL delegation can be sent to the Games in a safe manner.
Het is aan NOC*NSF om ervoor te zorgen dat de TeamNL-delegatie op een veilige manier kan worden uitgezonden naar de Spelen.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Van den Berg, Inge van Dijk  en Van der Laan over het volgens het kabinet benodigde onderzoek om de sportsector toe te voegen aan de groep van essentiële sectoren

MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the research needed before adding the sports sector to the essential sectors (per the Van den Berg motion) is finished, and what additional research is still required given existing studies on fitness and sport participation. The minister said the government considers sport a high priority, cites its own consideration of existing studies and OMT advice, and reports that a large part of sport was allowed again from 14 January 2022.
That is why the cabinet has stated that sport is a high priority, even though it does not fall under the definition of essential retail and/or services.
Daarom heeft het kabinet uitgesproken dat sport een hoge prioriteit heeft, ook al valt het niet onder de definitie van essentiële detailhandel en/of dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over de diplomatermijn in combinatie met topsport

Two D66 MPs asked how the ten-year diploma deadline for student finance is extended for elite athletes, including the criteria, definition of top sport, the role of DUO and NOC*NSF, and COVID effects. The minister explained that extensions depend on special circumstances, top sport is narrowly defined as international competition, and DUO will explore broadening the definition, but she gave no data on past extensions and did not answer by the requested deadline.
The reason for granting the extension of the diploma deadline is not registered in DUO's systems.
De reden van de toekenning voor de verlenging van de diplomatermijn wordt niet in de systemen van DUO geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Van Nispen en Westerveld over het sterker, gerichter en efficiënter fixen van matchfixing

Three MPs (Van der Laan, Van Nispen, Westerveld) asked the ministers about matchfixing, including its prevalence, prosecutability under Dutch criminal law, information sharing between betting operators, investigators and sports bodies, and funding for prevention. The minister answered that the government is reviewing the anti-matchfixing structure, that existing offences like fraud and bribery only partly cover matchfixing, and that monitoring and the Kansspelwet evaluation will follow, with no clear commitment to new legislation yet.
The nature and extent of matchfixing in the Netherlands is not known.
De aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Inge van Dijk over wederom een bericht over matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government will act on KNVB calls for further investigation into possible matchfixing in youth football, whether betting operators monitor these competitions, and whether an OM study on criminalising matchfixing will be shared with parliament. The minister says the Signalenoverleg Sportfraude will discuss the signals, that betting on the Onder 21 competition is prohibited, and that the OM study is still being advised on, with parliament to be informed later.
Your House will be informed about the advice afterwards.
Uw Kamer wordt daarna geïnformeerd over het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van der Laan over het WRR-rapport: Kiezen voor houdbare zorg

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the WRR report on sustainable healthcare, including quick wins, citizen forums, foreign care workers and prevention. The minister answered that hard political choices are needed but largely deferred concrete responses on the recommendations to a next cabinet, pointing to existing policy documents.
It is up to a next cabinet to make choices on this and to respond substantively to the WRR recommendations.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om daar keuzes in te maken en inhoudelijk te reageren op de aanbevelingen van de WRR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Kuiken over het niet opnemen van het rotavaccin in het rijksvaccinatieprogramma ondanks het positieve advies van de Gezondheidsraad

MPs Van der Laan and Kuiken asked why the rotavirus vaccine has not been added to the national vaccination programme despite positive Health Council advice, and why the decision is deferred to a new cabinet. The state secretary answered that a definitive decision awaits the next cabinet and budget cover, that the vaccine's cost-effectiveness depends on price, and that an implementation plan will be prepared.
In my letter of 20 September I informed the House that I am positive about the Health Council's advice, but that it is up to the next cabinet to take a definitive decision based on this advice.

In mijn brief van 20 september jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik positief sta tegenover het advies van de Gezondheidsraad, maar dat het aan het volgend kabinet is om naar aanleiding van dit advies een definitief besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan internationale eisen voor antidopingbeleid en de mogelijke sancties voor de Nederlandse Sport

MPs Van der Laan, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands fails to meet WADA's revised anti-doping code, when the government and the anti-doping authority learned of the non-compliance, and what sanctions Dutch sport could face. Minister Blokhuis answered that the independence of the Doping Appeals Committee (BND) is the remaining compliance issue, that legislation is being prepared, and that sanctions would not apply retroactively and could be contested before CAS.
I have answered the questions separately.
Ik heb de vragen afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Laan over de capaciteit bij de GGD’en

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD capacity, outbreak preparedness, staffing shortages, contact tracing gaps, and the public-private testing and appointment arrangements during the COVID-19 period. The minister responded that GGDs had been assessed as generally capable, that preparedness was coordinated via RIVM and existing programmes, and that capacity and scheduling were adequate, though he gave limited detail on some preparedness contacts and did not commit to new concrete steps.
The GGD appointment system functions adequately.
Het afsprakensysteem van de GGD'en functioneert adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Van Meenen over het artikel 'Moslimcollege Beverwijk wil jongens en meisjes op school scheiden'

MPs Van der Laan and Van Meenen asked the minister whether a proposed Islamic school in Haarlem that would separate boys and girls, and reject sexual diversity, is acceptable under Dutch law and recent motions. The minister replied that no application has yet been filed, that new schools will be assessed under the stricter legal criteria, that schools may not reject sexual diversity or drop sexual education, and that gender-separated classes are permitted only with equivalent provision.
No school may opt out of any core objective, so also not of the core objectives concerning citizenship, sexual education and sexual diversity.
Geen enkele school mag zich onttrekken aan enig kerndoel, dus ook niet aan de kerndoelen met betrekking tot burgerschap, seksuele voorlichting en seksuele diversiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Onvoldoende steun voor gedragscode conversietherapie’

MPs Van der Woude and Van der Laan asked why a proposed code of conduct on conversion therapy for LGBTI people failed to gain support from religious umbrella bodies. The Minister says it is too early to speak of failure, reports that CIO and CMO declined to participate, and commits to a broader exploration of measures, including possible legal prohibition.
The cabinet will carry out a broad but targeted exploration of possible, effective further measures, including legislation and regulations.
Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede, maar gerichte verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, waaronder wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Laan en Sneller over het artikel ‘Ik zag mijn lichaam en mijn maatschappelijke rol als een gevangenis’

MPs Van der Laan and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper article describing a woman's dismissal from the judicial training programme linked to her gender transition, and whether transition-related leave should exist. The minister answered that the dismissal was for substantive reasons unrelated to the transition, that the Council of State-style oversight via the courts and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens upheld this, and that a study on transition leave will be answered by the next cabinet.
It is not for me to go into the further substance of this case.
Het is niet aan mij om op de verdere inhoud van deze casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, Bromet en Kathmann over het bericht ‘raadsleden pleiten voor modernisering verlofregeling’

Four MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether leave arrangements for councillors should be modernised, following a letter from three municipal councils. The Minister said the current leave rules for elected representatives were a deliberate choice, that broader leave is not warranted, and that she will consult professional associations and administrative bodies on possible flexibilisation, leaving any legislative change to her successor.

I want to see whether the Dutch Association of Councillors, the Dutch Association of Provincial Members and the Association of Water Board Members support the call for a more flexible arrangement set out in the letter.

Ik wil bezien of de Nederlandse Vereniging van Raadsleden, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Statenleden en de Vereniging van algemeen bestuursleden van de Waterschappen het pleidooi voor een flexibeler regeling uit de brief ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over sportprotheses

Two MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether sports prostheses should be covered by health insurance or municipalities, the costs involved, co-payments and waiting or appeal issues. The minister answered that eligibility for insurance coverage is based on clinical criteria, that prostheses for social participation go through municipalities, cited cost estimates and the Uniek Sporten Hulpmiddelen fund, and promised further monitoring and a progress update.
How many cases are currently not reimbursed and the outcomes of appeal procedures are currently not known.
In hoeveel gevallen er momenteel niet vergoed wordt en de uitkomsten van bezwaarprocedures zijn momenteel niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Smeets over het fixen van matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Smeets asked about match-fixing, including how bookmakers, the FIU, the Wwft and privacy rules affect timely reporting to sports bodies, and who is responsible for what. The minister answered at length, setting out each actor's role, explaining that Wwft confidentiality can delay signals reaching sports bodies, and describing a planned 'fast lane' at the FIU to be evaluated after a year.
To prevent possible delay, it has been agreed with the sports federations that a so-called fast lane will be set up at the FIU-Netherlands for signals of possible match-fixing.
Om mogelijke vertraging te voorkomen is speciaal voor signalen van mogelijke matchfixing met de sportbonden afgesproken dat bij de FIU-Nederland een zogeheten fast lane zal worden vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over het bericht 'Hoe vrouwen vergeten werden in het Covid-19-onderzoek'

MPs Van der Laan and Paternotte asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that women were overlooked in Covid-19 research, including whether sex differences should be studied in treatments and medication and whether the Netherlands will push this at EU level. The minister agrees sex should be considered in research, says the CBG review results do not directly require changes to regulatory guidelines, and states that the Gender and Gezondheid programme continues with 3 million euro proposed for 2021 and diversity requirements added to ZonMw funding.
Where appropriate, the Netherlands will emphasise the importance of including relevant diversity characteristics, including sex, in research.
Waar opportuun zal vanuit Nederland het belang worden onderstreept dat bij onderzoek relevante kenmerken van diversiteit, waaronder sekse, worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan ‘over matchfixing en het Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR)’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about match-fixing in basketball and whether the private Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) has enough powers and funding to investigate, and how it relates to the prosecution service and police. The minister answered that the ISR is a private body without investigative powers, that criminal investigation lies with police and prosecutors, and that extra funding for the ISR is aimed at handling more reports.
The ISR is a private organisation and therefore does not have the investigative powers reserved for our investigative authorities.
Het ISR is een private organisatie en heeft derhalve niet de beschikking over de opsporingsmiddelen die zijn voorbehouden aan onze opsporingsinstanties.

Amendement van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over het in de basisregistratie personen opnemen van contactgegevens en tijdelijke verblijfplaatsen van niet-ingezetenen

Requires non-resident contact details and temporary addresses to be recorded in the civil registry (BRP/RNI) so municipalities and the labour inspectorate can access them, with a safeguard that unreliable data is not taken over.
