Allows ministers, by ministerial regulation, to accept a test on arrival rather than before departure for travellers to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
For entry into Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba, the test result may in cases set by ministerial regulation also be obtained directly after arrival.

Ten aanzien van inreis in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius of Saba kan de in het eerste lid bedoelde testuitslag in bij ministeriële regeling bepaalde gevallen ook worden verkregen direct na het moment van aankomst.
Amendement van het lid Kuiken c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over de mogelijkheid van een test bij aankomst op de BES-eilanden
Allows, by ministerial regulation in certain cases, a COVID test result for arrivals on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba to be obtained after arrival rather than before departure.
For entry into Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba, the test result referred to in the first paragraph may, in cases determined by ministerial regulation, also be obtained directly after arrival.

Ten aanzien van inreis in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius of Saba kan de in het eerste lid bedoelde testuitslag in bij ministeriële regeling bepaalde gevallen ook worden verkregen direct na het moment van aankomst.
Amendement van het lid Vestering c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over een grondslag voor het stellen van brandveiligheidsregels
Creates a statutory basis in the Animal Act so the government can set fire-safety rules protecting farm animals from stable fires by or under a general administrative order (AMvB).
This amendment aims to create the legal basis for setting rules to protect farm animals from the dangers of stable fires by or under a general administrative order

Dit amendement beoogt de wettelijke basis te creëren voor het stellen van regels voor de bescherming van landbouwhuisdieren tegen de gevaren van stalbranden bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘werkloze ouderen komen nog altijd moeilijk aan een baan’

MPs Den Haan and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether older workers and people with chronic illness have very low odds of finding paid work within a quarter, and what the government will do about labour market activation. The minister disputes the framing, gives labour market statistics and describes existing and planned measures (Seniorenkansenvisie, banenafspraak, communication on working after AOW age), while stating the effects of abolishing zero-hour contracts on pensioners' participation will be assessed.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Ja, ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het Advies van de Gezondheidsraad ‘Vaccinatie van ouderen tegen pneumokokken (2023)’

An MP asked whether people aged 80 or older in 2020 (born before 1941) who want pneumococcal vaccination should get priority, in line with COVID-19 policy, and whether COVID-19 and pneumococcal vaccination of vulnerable elderly could be combined this year. The state secretary said he will consider the Health Council advice, needs more time for a financial feasibility study, and explained the current age-cohort rollout while stating COVID-19 vaccination cannot be combined with the others this year.
As soon as I have more clarity on this, I will inform the House as soon as possible.
Zodra ik hier meer duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik de Kamer zo spoedig als mogelijk is informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over deelname aan het arbeidsproces wordt in sommige gevallen moeilijk gemaakt voor gepensioneerden c.q. AOW-gerechtigden

An MP asks whether working should pay for pensioners who want to keep working and whether the five-year administrative expiry rule for chained temporary contracts should be relaxed for them. The minister says work should pay, that information campaigns will start, that a structural fix is being sought for a benefit overlap affecting breadwinners rather than pensioners, and that no separate exemption or further study is planned beyond the existing SEO evaluation.
The cabinet believes that work must pay, including for AOW recipients.
Het kabinet vindt dat werken moet lonen, zo ook voor AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat artsen minder nieuwe kankermedicijnen gaan voorschrijven

A parliamentary member asked the health minister about reports that oncologists will prescribe fewer new cancer drugs by tightening PASKWIL criteria, raising concerns about access, trial research, costs and patient consultation. The minister replied that the professional body sets prescribing criteria, that insurers decide reimbursement under the 'state of science and practice' test, and that the government sees no direct causal link to research or access and did not intend to intervene.
It is up to the professional group to decide whether or not to include a medicine in the guideline.
Het is aan de beroepsgroep om te bepalen of zij een geneesmiddel wel of niet opnemen in de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘Aanzienlijk onbenut arbeidspotentieel onder gepensioneerden’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an ESB report on unused labour potential among retirees, including barriers for employers and flexibility in contracts. The minister answered that existing instruments already allow flexible retirement timing, that awareness campaigns will be launched, and that the zero-hours contract ban and basiscontract proposal will be monitored in consultation without new exemptions for older workers.
Given the information already known, I see no need for further research.
Gezien de reeds bekende informatie, zie ik geen noodzaak voor verder onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht ‘Minister Kuipers ziet de wachttijden van nieuwe medicijnen afnemen’

MP Den Haan asked Minister Kuipers about reported waiting times for new medicines, the responsibility for dossier completeness, the sluis (cost-containment gateway) durations, insurer pre-assessment, and access arrangements for patients. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut controls the assessment only after a complete dossier, that average sluis durations are longer mainly due to atypical multiple myeloma drugs, and that insurers' CieBAG process is a controlled inflow monitored by the NZa, while declining to propose a German/French-style access scheme and promising a PIP4 document and an FMS-led methodology by early 2024.
The Zorginstituut can only start its assessment after receiving a dossier containing all relevant data.
Het Zorginstituut kan haar beoordeling pas starten na ontvangst van een dossier waarin alle relevante gegevens zijn opgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht ‘Minister Kuipers ziet de wachttijden van nieuwe medicijnen afnemen’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why waiting times for expensive new medicines are so long, what drives review delays at the Zorginstituut and in price negotiations, and whether timelines and joint reviews with manufacturers will be introduced. The Minister defended a different measurement method, said he is working with the Zorginstituut and industry on shortening delays and a transparency dashboard, but declined to break down review and reaction times further or adopt rigid timelines.
I do not consider it relevant to break down the lead time at a more detailed level than already presented in my letter.
Ik acht het niet relevant om de doorlooptijd op een nog dieper detailniveau uit te splitsen dan reeds gepresenteerd in mijn brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Den Haan over moleculaire diagnostiek bij oncologie

Two MPs asked the health minister about molecular diagnostics in oncology, including data quality from DICA, concentration of complex cancer care, delays in MKNT test lists and the pathology quality standard, and regional variation in treatment. The minister answered that work is ongoing via the implementation trajectory, that legal instruments are a last resort, and that the lists and standard will be published in stages with a target of July 2023 for the quality standard.
When these lists are available, they will be placed on the websites of the relevant scientific associations.
Wanneer deze lijsten beschikbaar zijn, worden deze op de websites van de betrokken wetenschappelijke verenigingen geplaatst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over de doorlooptijden van medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about lengthening waiting times for expensive medicines in the price-negotiation ('sluis') procedure, the pilot and parallel procedures, the lowered threshold, patient access during the wait, and transparency dashboards. The Minister attributed longer waits mainly to a group of multiple myeloma drugs, promised further talks and updates, but declined to commission a cost study on patient waiting and left the dashboard delayed.
I consider such a study virtually unfeasible, e.g. because the impact differs per medicine.
Ik acht een dergelijk onderzoek nagenoeg niet uitvoerbaar, b.v. omdat de impact per medicijn verschilt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht ‘Telefoonlijnen roodgloeiend bij uitkerende instanties over tegenvallende AOW-uitkering’

An MP asked the minister why AOW recipients were not proactively informed that the increase would be smaller than 10% and whether they would be compensated for inflation. The minister said information was published on government and SVB websites, that call volumes rose less than 5%, and pointed to existing income measures such as the energy price cap and higher rent and care allowances.
So proactive communication did take place about the AOW increase, though I understand not everyone received this message.
Er is dus proactief gecommuniceerd over de stijging van de AOW-uitkering, tegelijk begrijp ik dat niet iedereen deze boodschap heeft ontvangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij, Den Haan, Van Kent, Léon de Jong en Ephraim over onbegrijpelijke en op het eerste oog onjuiste scenario’s die DNB gemaakt heeft op basis van de adviezen van de commi

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Pensions why the 2022 Parameter Committee lowered the expected stock return while DNB's scenario charts appeared to show higher returns, and about standard deviation, validation and the release of draft DNB calculations. The minister answered that the scenarios follow the committee's advice, that the charts are consistent with it, and declined to share draft DNB reports, citing the value of confidential expert exchange, while committing to answer by a set date.
I do not consider it appropriate to share draft reports with your House.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om conceptrapportages met uw Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat ouderen in kleine instellingen soms zonder basiszorg zitten

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that elderly residents of small institutions sometimes lack basic medical care, and about when a structural fix would be ready, why some regions manage this and others do not, what happens meanwhile, and how the specialist's conditions will improve. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a sector project with a planning to be reported to parliament in early 2023, cited IGJ/NZa causes, and listed interim measures and a list of factors affecting the approach.
Your House will be informed in early 2023 about the progress and the planning.
Uw Kamer wordt begin 2023 geïnformeerd over de voortgang en de planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden doden na valincidenten'

An MP asked about reports that fatal fall incidents have doubled in ten years, the timing of a fall-prevention programme plan, how municipal funds for fall prevention will be ensured to go to effective measures, and whether municipalities are preparing. The minister acknowledged the concern, linked the rise to an ageing population, said the programme plan would be sent to the House before Christmas, and described a specific grant and national support being prepared.
The House will be informed about this before Christmas.
De Kamer wordt hierover voor de kerst geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over de langetermijnaanpak Corona

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the long-term COVID strategy: whether enough is done to prevent early spread, the evidence for spat screens, the COronapass rationale, protection of vulnerable groups, the motion on sector plans, antiviral procurement, Evusheld distribution and the German approach. The minister answered most questions substantively, stating the government set frameworks for sector plans and will consider a bill for a COVID access pass, while declining exact figures for Evusheld administrations.
The cabinet has thereby set frameworks for the sector plans, exercised direction, and assessed the plans in an integrated way for conflicting interests.
Het kabinet heeft daarmee kaders opgesteld voor de sectorplannen, regie gevoerd en heeft de plannen integraal getoetst op tegengestelde belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Moeizame toelating medicijn dupeert patiënt'

An MP asks the health minister whether the government will address the French firm Servier refusing to supply an unapproved oncology drug free of charge under compassionate use to Dutch patients, and how to prevent more pharma firms from withholding new drugs, including whether firms could be paid retrospectively. The minister says the reimbursement delay is not solely Dutch, rejects paying firms after early supply as incompatible with the Dutch reimbursement rules, and promises talks with the pharma industry association on compassionate use.

I find it no more than logical that, in the interest of the Dutch patient and premium payer, we carefully assess whether new expensive medicines are effective and negotiate the price so that we do not pay more for a medicine than necessary.
Ik vind het niet meer dan logisch dat we, in het belang van de Nederlandse patiënt en premiebetaler, goed bezien of nieuwe dure geneesmiddelen effectief zijn en dat we over de prijs onderhandelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Den Haan over het nader verslag inzake wijziging van de Pensioenwet, de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 en enige andere wetten in verband met herziening va

MPs Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Den Haan asked whether the government's pension projection table ignores the 1.5% projection return, whether pensions can keep pace with 2%, 4% or 6% inflation, and whether more detailed scenario tables are possible. The minister admitted the table was a simplified example with an implicit zero nominal projection return and that the assumptions should have been stated more clearly, argued the new contract offers earlier prospects of indexation than the current one, and promised supplementary DNB calculations before the 12 September hearing.
I acknowledge that the answer could have been clearer about the assumptions underlying the projection return used.
Ik erken dat in de beantwoording duidelijker had kunnen worden aangegeven van welke veronderstellingen bij het gehanteerde projectierendement is uitgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Kuiken en Den Haan over problemen met het notariaat op Saba en Sint Eustatius

MPs Ceder, Kuiken and Den Haan asked about the closure of the only notary office on Saba and Sint Eustatius from 1 July 2022, its consequences, the lack of a legal fallback, and plans for a durable solution. The minister said a temporary notary (waarnemer) is being recruited, that a longer-term extension of Bonaire notaries' work area is intended, and that individual cases will get tailored help, without a fixed timetable.
I am willing to take the necessary measures to ensure that residents of Saba and Sint Eustatius have sustainable access to notarial services.
Ik ben bereid om de noodzakelijke maatregelen te treffen om ervoor te zorgen dat de inwoners van Saba en Sint Eustatius duurzaam van toegang tot het notariaat zijn voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Den Haan over de afspraken tussen de beroepsorganisaties en zorgverzekeraars uit het multidisciplinair document ‘Afbouwen antidepressiva (SSRI’s & SNRI’s)’

MPs Paulusma and Den Haan asked the Minister of Health about insurers' compliance with the 2018 multidisciplinary agreement on tapering antidepressants, and why insurers differ on covering taper strips. The Minister replied that insurers endorse the document, that evidence for specific tapering schemes is lacking, that some insurers cover taper strips under conditions while others do not, and pointed to a new TAPER-AD study and integrated care agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van der Staaij en Den Haan over zelfvoorzienendheid met betrekking tot geneesmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen

MPs Van den Berg, Van der Staaij and Den Haan asked the Minister of Health about self-sufficiency in medicines and medical devices, including the Berger report, the IGJ list of production facilities, insurers' purchasing criteria, compounding pharmacy capacity and the investment climate for generic producers. The minister answered that the report will be studied externally with results expected in July, that the IGJ database cannot give the number of Dutch tablet producers, that talks with insurers have not led to mandated local purchasing, and that policy will be shaped after four studies due in summer.
As a result, the number of producers of generic tablet medicines established in the Netherlands cannot be given based on this list.
Daarmee is het aantal in Nederland gevestigde producenten van generieke medicijnen in tabletvorm op basis van deze lijst niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht Annelies zit al twee jaar in isolatie, maar Nederland is traag met medicatie voor kwetsbaren

An MP asks the health minister why Covid medicines for immunocompromised patients are slow to arrive, including procurement via the EU, expected delivery of Evusheld, and whether masks should be mandatory. The minister answers that procurement routes are chosen per drug, Evusheld is expected in June, mask decisions rest with care institutions, and FFP2 masks for vulnerable groups are being investigated.
I expect the first delivery of Evusheld in June.
Ik verwacht in juni eerste levering van Evusheld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid den Haan over de nieuwe cao-afspraken voor personeel in de Verpleeg- en Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorg (VVT)

MP Den Haan asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about wage gaps for VVT care staff, the adequacy of OVA indexation, and whether insurers should compensate the gap and whether underspending in community nursing should fund a higher VVT pay rise. The Minister replies that the OVA system works, wage differences are complex to compare, the government provides a 675 million euro boost and the VVT cao offers up to about 6.25 percent, and declines to use underspending or to change insurer obligations, which are for private parties.
Collective labour agreements are concluded at the bargaining table by employers and trade unions.
Cao's worden door werkgevers en vakbonden gesloten aan de cao-tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Kuzu over het bericht dat de zorg nog niet klaar is om de groeiende groep oudere migranten met dementie op passende wijze zorg te verlenen

MPs Den Haan and Kuzu asked whether healthcare is adequately prepared for older migrants with dementia, citing missed diagnoses, language barriers and lack of culturally adapted tests. The minister answered that GP guidelines already address this, that a study on interpreters is underway with results expected around summer, that culture-specific care guidance exists, and that a letter on culturally sensitive care will follow in autumn 2022.
Given the growing number of people with a migration background who depend on good care, I will send your House a letter on culturally sensitive care in autumn 2022.
Gegeven het toenemend aantal mensen met een migratie-achtergrond dat op goede zorg is aangewezen, zal ik uw Kamer in het najaar 2022 een brief doen toekomen over cultuursensitieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat steeds meer zorgverzekeraars tweelingpolissen aanbieden

MP Den Haan asks the health minister whether the consumer information rules fail to stop near-identical 'twin' policies, whether improving risk equalisation and constrained regression could stop chronically ill being predictably loss-making, and whether insurers could market to them. Minister Kuipers answers that information rules are not aimed at twin policies, that risk equalisation is ongoing work with the Zorginstituut and insurers but insurers must themselves change their policy offers, and that a monitor found insurers' advertising targets a broad audience.
The aim of risk equalisation is to remove predictable profits and losses for insurers arising from health differences in their insured population.
Het doel van de risicoverevening is het wegnemen van voorspelbare winsten en verliezen voor verzekeraars die het gevolg zijn van gezondheidsverschillen in hun verzekerdenpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat steeds meer zorgverzekeraars tweelingpolissen aanbieden

The MP asks whether the Minister considers twin health insurance policies, which are nearly identical cheaper products that may amount to risk selection, undesirable and whether insurers should flag them and whether an independent comparison site is needed. The Minister says the policy supply is under continued attention, a study on policy differentiation is underway with results expected in spring 2022, insurers must publish overviews of near-identical policies, and comparison sites committed to an objective comparison standard are noted.
I expect to send the results of the study to the House of Representatives in spring 2022.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van het onderzoek in het voorjaar van 2022 naar uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het item dat de druk op de thuiszorg nog nooit zo groot is geweest en het bericht van Actiz met betrekking tot hun waarschuwing voor een coronatsunami

MP Den Haan asked the health minister about reports that home-care pressure is at a record high, Actiz's warning of a 'corona tsunami', and rising infections among home-dwelling elderly. The minister acknowledged the pressure, described measures such as ROAZ coordination, the Nationale Zorgreserve and bed scale-up, and said the questions could not be answered before the next plenary debate.
Question 14: Are you willing to answer these questions before the next plenary debate on the developments surrounding the coronavirus? Answer 14: Unfortunately this has not been possible.
Vraag 14 Bent u bereid deze vragen voor het volgende plenaire Kamerdebat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus te beantwoorden? Antwoord 14 Dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Tien jaar medicijnen slikken, zonder controle tussendoor: is het niet tijd voor een jaarlijkse medicatie-APK?’

An MP asked the state secretary about a RADAR broadcast finding that many long-term medication users hear nothing from their pharmacist or doctor, and whether a yearly medication check should be introduced. The state secretary answered that tailored care is the responsibility of prescribers and pharmacists, that an annual check for all long-term users is not necessary and could weaken care for high-need patients, and that a broader study on medication safety is being tendered with results expected mid-2022.
An annual check for all patients who use medication long-term is therefore not necessary for everyone.
Een jaarlijkse controle bij alle patiënten die langdurig medicijnen gebruiken is daarom niet voor iedereen noodzakelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat de kosten van valincidenten zullen verdubbelen naar 2,4 miljard euro

MP Den Haan asks the health minister about projections that fall-related costs will double to 2.4 billion euros, what measures are being taken, the status of the Zorginstituut assessment on fall prevention in the basic insurance, and monitoring of fall prevention uptake among older people. The minister acknowledges the concern, says the Zorginstituut assessment is delayed to early 2022, outlines ongoing preventive initiatives, and says structural monitoring and further funding decisions are left to the next cabinet.
It is not known how many municipalities offer cost-effective forms of interventions in fall prevention.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten (kosten)effectieve vormen van interventies aanbieden op het gebied van valpreventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat mensen met dementie na de lockdown nog steeds thuiszitten

An MP asks the health minister about reports that people with dementia remain housebound after the lockdown, and about support for carers, day-care transport, municipal Wmo budget cuts, monitoring and the role of dementia case managers. The minister answers that municipalities are responsible and compensated, that most people with dementia are vaccinated, that transport rules were eased, that monitoring is limited to general developments, and promises an inspiration guide, funding for about 30 municipalities and a possible ZonMw scheme.
From VWS we do not monitor the use of day care at local or regional level.
Vanuit VWS monitoren we de inzet van dagbesteding niet op lokaal – of regionaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat de dementiestrategie nog niet leidt tot zinvolle dagbesteding

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that the national dementia strategy is not yet producing meaningful day care for people with dementia, and about how municipalities can be pushed and financially supported. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible under the Wmo 2015, that a Movisie study and an inspiration guide, one-off funding for over 30 municipalities and a possible ZonMw scheme are planned, and that municipal councils supervise local policy.
Municipalities are responsible under the Wmo 2015 for providing social support to people who cannot participate independently and/or have a psychosocial disorder.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van de Wmo2015 verantwoordelijk voor aanbieden van maatschappelijke ondersteuning voor mensen die niet zelfstandig kunnen participeren en/of een psychosociale stoornis hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat er jaarlijks tientallen meldingen binnenkomen over financiële uitbuiting van ouderen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of financial exploitation of older people, the outcome of a consultation with municipalities, the role of volunteer networks and local alliances, whether municipalities should be obliged to address elder abuse, and the awareness campaign. The state secretary answered that an expert pool for municipalities is planned for October, that municipalities are responsible under the Wmo and no detailed national requirements will be imposed, and that a reporting on the approach will follow in the progress report at the end of the year.
I do not have a precise picture of how many municipalities have or do not have an approach to elder abuse, and specifically financial abuse.
Ik heb niet precies in beeld hoeveel gemeenten wel of geen aanpak hebben op het gebied van ouderenmishandeling, en specifiek financieel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het initiatief Extra handen voor de Zorg

MPs Den Haan asked the minister about how personal data of volunteers signed up to Extra Handen voor de Zorg were stored and matched, whether fees were charged, match criteria, outcomes for people with care backgrounds, the Nationale Zorgklas, follow-up after the Commissie Werken in de Zorg report, and data transfer to a new platform. The minister answered in detail, describing the data handling with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, the deletion of Excel files, match statistics, and planned follow-up such as an inventory and a Nationale Zorgreserve exploration, while some questions were answered only in part or referred to pending inventories.
Extra Handen voor de Zorg was set up as a temporary crisis facility to provide organisations in need with temporary extra staff.
Extra Handen voor de Zorg is opgericht als tijdelijke crisisfaciliteit om zorgorganisaties in nood te voorzien van tijdelijke extra mensen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden euro’s schade bij gepensioneerden door nabetaling pensioen'

MP Den Haan asked whether pensioners harmed by lump-sum back-payments from ABP, and whether the Tax Authority should proactively inform them or find a generic solution. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the matter is mainly the paying pension fund's responsibility, explained the tax treatment and averaging options, and said ABP offers compensation for residual harm.
I see no role for myself or the Tax Authority in the arrangements between ABP and pension recipients.
Voor een rol in de afspraken tussen ABP en de pensioengerechtigden zie ik geen plaats voor mijzelf of de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat 65.000 stemmen van 70-plussers niet zijn meegeteld door fouten bij briefstemmen

MP Den Haan asked why about 65,000 votes cast by voters aged 70 and over by post were not counted, whether the government would investigate, and how other countries compare. Minister Ollongren said about 95% of postal votes were valid, that uncounted votes mostly resulted from missing ballot or polling card, that the Kiesraad and Tweede Kamer, not the minister, determine the result, and that the election evaluation and campaign evaluation are underway.
I am evaluating the Tweede Kamer election.
Ik ben de Tweede Kamerverkiezing aan het evalueren.

requests the government to make clear in the 2026 budget which specific funds will achieve all these goals, including subgoals

Motion asking the government to postpone full draining of the Julianakanaal until the Borgharen weir is fully functional again.
requests the government to postpone the full draining of the Julianakanaal until at least the Borgharen weir is fully functional again

requests the government to closely supervise how the water boards interpret the term gebiedskenmerken

Amendment removing statutory definitions and provisions that would let water boards spend public money on investments toward future climate neutrality and extra renewable energy.
that it will not be legally established that water boards may spend tax money on investments

Motie van het lid Heutink over in Brussel pleiten voor het schrappen van het "one out, all out"-principe ten aanzien van de Kaderrichtlijn Water
Asks the government to lobby in Brussels for dropping the one-out-all-out principle under the Water Framework Directive and to report on those talks before summer recess.
requests the government to lobby in Brussels for scrapping the one-out-all-out principle regarding the Water Framework Directive

requests the government to press in Brussels for more flexible regulation regarding water quality and the associated KRW targets

Motie van het lid Heutink over gedeeltelijk prestatieafhankelijke salarissen voor de topbestuurders van NS en ProRail
Asks the government to make a substantial part of the top executives' salaries at NS and ProRail performance-related in future pay policy.
requests the government to make a substantial part of the top executives' salaries at NS and ProRail performance-dependent in future pay policy
verzoekt de regering om in het toekomstig beloningsbeleid van NS en ProRail een flink deel van de salarissen van de topbestuurders prestatieafhankelijk te laten zijn
Motie van het lid Heutink c.s. over onderzoek naar invoering van een gepersonaliseerd kenteken
Asks the government to study introducing personalised number plates and report costs and benefits before summer recess.
requests the government to investigate whether a personalised number plate can be introduced
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of een gepersonaliseerd kenteken ingevoerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Heutink over tot er een nieuw kabinet is geen onomkeerbare stappen zetten in relatie tot de herprioritering
Asks the government to take no irreversible steps on reprioritising MIRT infrastructure projects until a new cabinet is in place.
requests the government not to take irreversible steps regarding the reprioritisation until a new cabinet is in place
verzoekt de regering om geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten in relatie tot de herprioritering tot er een nieuw kabinet is
Motie van het lid Heutink over een plan van aanpak over het hervatten en herfinancieren van de zeventien gepauzeerde MIRT-projecten
Asks the government to present a plan before the summer recess on how it will refinance and resume the seventeen paused MIRT transport projects.
requests the government to come up with a plan of action before the summer recess on how it intends to refinance and resume the seventeen paused MIRT projects
verzoekt de regering om met een plan van aanpak te komen, nog voor het zomerreces, over hoe zij denkt de zeventien gepauzeerde MIRT-projecten te herfinancieren en te hervatten
Amendement van het lid Heutink c.s. over extra middelen voor de N35
Amendment shifts €94 million from the national highways budget to the exploration reserve so the N35 project regains funding under earlier administrative agreements.
Therefore the submitters propose through this amendment to reverse the reprioritisation insofar as it comes at the expense of the N35
Daarom stellen indieners voor om middels dit amendement het herprioriteren voor zover dat ten koste gaat van de N35 terug te draaien
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over de campagne spitsspreiden en -mijden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government's 10 percent peak-traffic reduction through peak-spreading and peak-avoidance campaigns is a smokescreen for stalled road projects, and asked about past campaigns, MIRT project completion, and why infrastructure is not built instead. The minister rejected the smokescreen claim, said the campaign targets only people able and willing to change travel times, noted the evaluation is due around February 2026, and admitted serious financial, nitrogen and staffing constraints delaying MIRT projects.
The evaluation of the campaign is not yet available. We expect the report around February 2026.
De evaluatie van de campagne is nog niet beschikbaar. We verwachten de rapportage rond februari 2026.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het artikel van de NOS van 14 mei 2025, waarin wordt vermeld dat er problemen rondom drinkwater kunnen ontstaan omdat het besparen van drinkwater te langzaam zou gaan

Heutink (PVV) asked the minister whether there is a shortage of permits rather than water for new drinking water abstraction points, whether conservation campaigns are wrong, whether environmental groups frustrate permitting through lawsuits, and when law changes will help. The minister said permitting requires several conditions, outlined the Actieprogramma and the Leven met water campaign, noted that appeal and objection rights are a required and important part of the democratic system, and said that decentralised authorities can already speed decisions under current law.
Under the General Administrative Law Act, decisions of the competent authority are open to appeal and objection.
Op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht staan besluiten van het bevoegd gezag open voor beroep en bezwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het artikel waarin wordt bekendgemaakt dat buitenlandse ondernemers geen boete krijgen als zij met een vervuilend voertuig een zero-emissiezone inrijden

An MP asks the state secretary whether foreign vehicles entering zero-emission zones can avoid fines because they cannot be automatically enforced, and whether this justifies postponing the zones. The state secretary acknowledges the enforcement gap, says it is being addressed through bilateral agreements and manual checks by municipalities, and rejects postponement to 2029.
It is therefore being examined whether bilateral agreements can be made with the countries that account for the largest shares of foreign vehicles driving in Dutch cities.
Er wordt daarom onderzocht of er bilaterale afspraken gemaakt kunnen worden met de landen die de grootste aandelen buitenlandse voertuigen in de Nederlandse steden hebben rijden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat werkzaamheden aan het spoor en het alternatieve vervoer, als gevolg daarvan, niet goed geregeld zijn

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that NS's information provision and replacement transport during rail works are poorly organised, and about NS's annual report claiming good information provision. The state secretary said NS meets its concession obligations, is implementing some of Rover's recommendations, will discuss earlier publication of works with NS, and will keep looking for improvements, without committing to a concrete new rule.

According to article 11 of the concession, in the event of a train service disruption NS must ensure 1) the shortest possible time for alternative travel options 2) with the shortest possible travel time extension, insofar as reasonably possible and necessary.

Volgens artikel 11 van de concessie dient NS in het geval van een treindienstverstoring te zorgen voor 1) een zo kort mogelijke termijn voor alternatieve reisopties 2) met een zo kort mogelijke omreistijd voor zover dit redelijkerwijs mogelijk en noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Emiel van Dijk en Heutink over het bericht ‘OM vervolgt niemand na aangifte om mishandeling NS-conducteur’

MPs Van Dijk and Heutink asked why no one was prosecuted after a reported assault on an NS conductor, whether minor offences could be pursued, and what measures are being taken to curb violence on public transport. The State Secretary answered that the prosecutor found insufficient evidence, outlined existing measures (travel bans, bodycams, camera coverage, planned access to the driving-licence register for OV-boa's), and said NS is evaluating a broader rollout of bodycams.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on a decision by the Public Prosecution Service in a specific investigation.
Het past mij niet om een oordeel te vellen over een beslissing van het OM in een specifiek onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht uit de Telegraaf van 4 oktober jl. 'Boosheid om ophoping waterschapsbelasting: Rekening van €1200 binnen zeven maanden tijd’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a water board's system failure that caused residents to receive multiple large water-tax bills in a short period, and about its effects and oversight. The minister acknowledged the problem, described hardship relief and instalment options, said the issue stemmed from a Waternet-only ICT system, and noted that oversight of water boards lies primarily with the provinces while the water board is expected to resolve it itself.
In the first instance, it is the responsibility of the general board to hold the executive board to account if it believes the tasks are not being carried out properly.
Het behoort in eerste instantie tot de bevoegdheid van het algemeen bestuur om het dagelijks bestuur erop aan te spreken, indien het van mening is dat de taken niet goed worden uitgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Velde en Heutink over ‘de onacceptabele uitsluiting van PVV-bewindspersonen door UN Women bij de aftrap van een campagne tegen geweld tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Enschede.’

PVV MPs asked whether UN Women excluded PVV state secretaries from a campaign launch against violence against women in Enschede because of their party affiliation, and whether this is acceptable. The government condemned unequal treatment on political grounds, said UN Women Nederland is an independent Dutch foundation rather than a UN body, and noted the Enschede municipality has withdrawn from the event.
If ministers are excluded because of their political affiliation, that is completely unacceptable.
Indien bewindslieden omwille van hun politieke affiliatie worden uitgesloten is dat volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat NS verwacht dat treinen in de tweede helft van het jaar vaker te laat komen

An MP asked the state secretary whether NS's expectation of more late trains in the second half of 2024 is acceptable and how the HRN concession performance standards will be enforced. The state secretary admitted performance is disappointing, said a formal assessment will follow the 2024 annual reports and that sanctions are possible if minimum values are missed, and pointed to the Betrouwbaar Beter programme.
Based on the concession agreements, a sanction can be imposed if the minimum values are not met.
Aan de hand van de concessieafspraken kan een sanctie worden opgelegd als niet aan de bodemwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over de verzorgingsplaatsen

MP Heutink (PVV) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the planned exclusive charging-tender model at motorway rest stops, which would bar operators from offering both EV chargers and fossil fuel, unduly harms fuel station operators and their profitability. The minister rejects the premise of a forced choice, defends a single large charging plot per stop allocated by tender for equal access and competition reasons, and says a transitional policy rule currently limits new charger permits.
The picture that there is a forced choice between offering fossil fuel and fast chargers is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake is van een gedwongen keuze tussen het aanbieden van fossiele brandstof en snellaadpalen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heutink en Madlener over het bericht in diverse media dat drinkwaterbedrijf Vitens de noodklok luidt vanwege het toenemende tekort aan drinkwater in Nederland

MPs Heutink and Madlener asked the ministers about reports that Vitens warns of a drinking water shortage that could block connections for new housing and businesses, and about refusals of business clients, planned measures, and whether permit refusals should be eased. The minister answered that water supply concerns are recognised, pointed to the Actieprogramma beschikbaarheid drinkwaterbronnen 2023–2030 and a drinking water saving plan, said Rijk intervention is not preferred but not excluded, and that permit decisions rest with the competent authority, while committing to further work with provinces.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heutink en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat het Europees Parlement heeft ingestemd met een nieuwe rijbewijsrichtlijn

MPs Heutink and Emiel van Dijk asked whether the government's plan to end the tolerance arrangement for driving electric vans with a B licence on 1 July 2024 would change after the European Parliament's first-reading vote on the new driving licence directive, and whether the arrangement could be extended. The minister replied that the first reading does not yet change the decision, that further trilogue negotiations and a later procedure must be awaited with no certain outcome, and that no new grounds for extending the tolerance are seen.
This does not currently give new grounds to change the earlier decision to end the tolerance period on 1 July 2024.
Dit geeft op dit moment nog geen nieuwe grond voor verandering van het eerder genomen besluit om de gedoogperiode op 1 juli 2024 te beëindigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat fors meer treinreizen dit jaar zijn vertraagd

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that train delays rose sharply, whether sanctions will be imposed on NS and ProRail, and how punctuality will improve. The state secretary acknowledged poor punctuality, said sanctions will be decided after annual accounts arrive by 1 March 2024, and listed planned measures without promising a guaranteed improvement.
Whether I will impose sanctions I am considering on the basis of the annual accounts of NS and ProRail. I will receive these by 1 March 2024 at the latest. I will then inform your House about it.
Of ik sancties ga opleggen, bekijk ik op basis van de jaarverantwoordingen van NS en ProRail. Deze ontvang ik uiterlijk 1 maart 2024. Ik zal uw Kamer daar vervolgens over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het besluit om Elektrische bestelbussen onder een B-rijbewijs niet langer te gedogen per 1 juli 2024

Heutink (PVV) asks why the government ended the tolerance for electric vans driven on a B licence from 1 July 2024 and why it does not permanently codify the exemption as Germany did. The minister answers that legal anchoring is currently unfeasible due to enforcement, fraud-risk and EU weight-rule problems, that the tolerance is extended to 1 July 2024, and that talks with the European Commission continue without guarantee of a solution.
That is why I currently consider legal anchoring of an exemption in the Netherlands unfeasible.
Daarom acht ik momenteel een wettelijke verankering van een vrijstelling in Nederland onhaalbaar.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Hoeff c.s. over onderzoeken welke ondersteuning nodig is om leerlingen met internaliserende problematiek en leerlingen met externaliserende problematiek in het speciaal onder
Asks the government to investigate and report to the House what support teachers and pupils need when mixing pupils with internalising and externalising problems in special education.
requests the government to investigate what support is needed for the teacher and the pupil
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken wat er qua ondersteuning voor de leraar en de leerling nodig is
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Hoef en Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’ en anti

MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a disrupted lecture at Radboud University, lecturers linked to Scholars for Palestine, alleged antisemitic slogans at demonstrations, and the awarding of a contract for antisemitism-prevention lessons in schools. The Minister said universities must report offences and take measures proportionate to the situation, that the TU Delft and UM handle their own assessments, and that the Fawaka contract was awarded on multiple criteria with the award documents withheld as confidential.
The associated award and assessment documents cannot be sent to the House, because they contain commercially sensitive and confidential information.
De bijbehorende gunnings- en beoordelingsdocumenten kunnen we niet aan de Kamer toesturen, omdat deze bedrijfsgevoelige en vertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over signalen van islamisering in het Nederlandse onderwijs

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education about reports of religiously motivated pressure, intimidation of teachers, and antisemitism in Dutch schools, and whether schools' neutrality and safety are being undermined. The state secretary condemned such conduct, pointed to existing duties (civic education, neutrality, safety care) and the inspectorate's enforcement, and said a Vrij en veilig onderwijs bill with an incident-reporting duty is in preparation, but declined an independent investigation.

Are you willing to have independently investigated the extent to which religious pressure, antisemitism and administrative looking away undermine freedom of education, the safety of pupils and teachers, and equality within schools?

Bent u bereid om onafhankelijk te laten onderzoeken in hoeverre religieuze druk, antisemitisme en bestuurlijk wegkijken de onderwijsvrijheid, de veiligheid van leerlingen en docenten en de gelijkwaardigheid binnen de school aantasten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over de structurele gedragscrisis in het Nederlandse onderwijs

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Education about a reported crisis in classroom discipline, linking poor behaviour to weaker learning outcomes, teacher authority and school safety, and asked about zero-tolerance measures. The State Secretary said causation cannot be firmly established, pointed to the Herstelplan and planned attention to classroom management, noted that schools and employers are responsible for discipline and teacher training, and referred to a Wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs and school safety support.
In the debate on educational opportunities I committed to also paying attention to maintaining order and classroom management in the elaboration of this plan.
In het debat over onderwijskansen heb ik toegezegd in de uitwerking van dit plan ook aandacht te hebben voor het orde houden en klassenmanagement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over islamitische iftars en/of gebedsmomenten op openbare scholen

MPs Uppelschoten and Wilders asked whether an Islamic iftar with prayer at Einstein Lyceum, and similar events at public schools, are compatible with the neutrality of public education, and how many schools hold them. The State Secretary answered that schools may hold religious activities provided no single religion is favoured and no religious acts are imposed, that the Inspectorate will act if this is breached, and that no figures on such events are kept.
I do not know when and how often public schools organise iftars or other religious gatherings such as Chanukah celebrations, Diwali or Christmas celebrations.
Bij mij is niet bekend wanneer en hoe vaak openbare scholen iftars of andere religieuze bijeenkomsten zoals Chanoekavieringen, Diwali of kerstvieringen organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over het stopzetten van subsidie aan stichting 'Na de Oorlog'

An MP asked the state secretary why the grant to foundation 'Na de Oorlog', which gives guest lessons on the Holocaust and antisemitism, was ended and given to Fawaka, an organisation focused on decolonisation, and questioned Fawaka's expertise and links to radical views. The secretary replied that the project subsidy simply expired under the agreement, that Fawaka won the tender on the three published criteria, and that there is no reason to doubt its competence and no reason to reconsider the award.
The subsidy for foundation Na de Oorlog was a project subsidy implementing an amendment by MPs Ellian (VVD) and Segers (CU) to the 2023 budget.
De subsidie voor stichting Na de Oorlog was een projectsubsidie ter invulling van een amendement van de leden Ellian (VVD) en Segers (CU) op de begroting van 2023
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Kinderen voor wie geen plaats is op school zijn een goudmijn voor slimme ondernemers'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Education about a Follow the Money report on private 'stay-at-home' (thuiszitters) initiatives using unproven methods, and how quality and misuse of public funds are controlled. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate supervises schools and partnerships, that privately funded initiatives outside OCW funding have no supervision, and that a bill on tailored education-care solutions with additional quality requirements is being prepared.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, however, there are also initiatives that are not subject to any supervision.
Zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 aangegeven bestaan er echter ook initiatieven waar geen toezicht op is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de radiouitzending 'Schimmige praktijken bij ZonMw' en de Kamerbrief van Minister Schippers van 3 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 30850-45)

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about a radio report on conflict-of-interest practices at ZonMw, including whether its 2016-2017 evaluation checked compliance with the Awb and codes of conduct, and whether exceptions to the conflict-of-interest code exist elsewhere. The minister replied that the evaluation did not cover these aspects, acknowledged a legal exception clause was removed after a 2015 appeal ruling, found a single NWO case of insufficiently strict application, announced a joint code evaluation that will delete the exception clause, and promised further measures and to send the answers to the Chamber.
Following that, the application of and supervision of compliance with the code of conduct has been tightened for all ZonMw committees.
Naar aanleiding daarvan is de toepassing van en het toezicht op naleving van de gedragscode voor alle ZonMw-commissies verscherpt.
Vragen van het lid Schippers (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tandartsbehandelingen (ingezonden 19 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a TV report on dental care: insufficient quality supervision (one half-time inspector for dental care), whether patients are told when a dental assistant treats them, limits on preventive assistants performing tandarts tasks, and whether assistant treatment should carry a lower tariff. The minister says he will examine expanding inspection capacity, will consult the Inspectorate on tightening its 2008 circular, will not amend the Wet BIG, and sees no need for separate assistant tariffs.
Given a rising number of reports of quality problems, especially at large dental care institutions, I want to examine whether there are grounds to expand inspection capacity for this care domain.

Gelet op een stijgend aantal meldingen over kwaliteitsproblemen, vooral bij de grote instellingen voor mondzorg, wil ik nagaan of er gronden bestaan om de inspectiecapaciteit voor dit zorgdomein uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Schippers (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ORIO-programma (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister about the ORIO programme, its shift from export-linked ORET, the large share of funds going to consultants, and whether it serves Dutch employment. The minister defends ORIO as targeting concrete infrastructure results, says the consultant share is essential development-phase work, and expects Dutch firms to benefit at tender stage with evaluation in 2012.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat duizenden kwetsbare patiënten slechtziend zullen worden door onverantwoorde bezuiniging van zorgverzekeraars

Kooiman (SP) asks whether insurers forcing ophthalmologists to use only cheap injections, which may leave vulnerable patients blind, is acceptable, and what the minister will do about insurers limiting expensive injections. Minister Bruins replies that the three drugs are broadly equivalent, that insurers may lawfully steer to the cheapest effective option while leaving room for the dearer drug, that no evidence yet shows the alternatives work for bevacizumab non-responders, and that manufacturers should submit a dossier to the Zorginstituut.
Based on the information I have now, I cannot say that health insurers are evading their duty of care.
Op basis van de informatie die ik nu heb, kan ik niet stellen dat zorgverzekeraars hun zorgplicht ontduiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over miljoenen aan onwettige subsidies verstrekt door ZonMw

An MP asked the Minister of Health about grants awarded by ZonMw in which committee members could assess their own applications, and whether those grants should be re-assessed and the committee members removed. The Minister acknowledged that the exception clause in ZonMw's conflict-of-interest code weakened safeguards against the appearance of conflicts, said it was no longer applied from 2016 and would be scrapped, but rejected re-assessment and denied any unlawful grants or personal enrichment.
Article 4 will be scrapped in that process.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Eijs over schade door rubberkorrels kunstgras

MPs Diertens and Van Eijs asked about reports that water boards did not study rubber granulate contamination near artificial turf pitches and whether standards should be reviewed. The State Secretary disputed the claim of dozens of seriously contaminated fields, said heavy metals and PAHs may be present, ordered a RIVM study and promised to raise the concern with the water boards.
I have instructed the RIVM to map the environmental effects of the spread of rubber granulate into the surroundings.
Ik heb het RIVM opdracht gegeven de milieueffecten van de verspreiding van rubbergranulaat naar de omgeving in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederland een centrale rol in een wereldwijd netwerk speelt dat mensen helpt bij het kopen van euthanatica

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that the Netherlands plays a central role in a global network helping people buy euthanasia drugs, and about enforcement against facilitators, customs controls and testing labs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that no central Dutch role appears in the article, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, that there is no tolerance policy and the law is enforced, and that customs conducts risk-based checks while the Inspectorate and prosecutors were unaware of the testing lab.
I repeat that the Public Prosecution Service can never make statements about ongoing cases, but there is confidence in the Public Prosecution Service that it will do what it must do: enforce the law.
Ik herhaal hier dat het Openbaar Ministerie nooit mededelingen kan doen over lopende zaken maar dat er vertrouwen is in het Openbaar Ministerie dat het doet wat het moet doen: de wet handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Hoge blootstelling pesticide geeft geboorteafwijking'

An SP MP asked the government whether it would respond to Californian findings linking pesticide exposure to birth defects, whether comparable pesticides are used in the Dutch sector, whether Dutch data are missing, and whether health risks including birth defects are covered by the RIVM exposure study. The minister referred all five questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents, giving no substantive answers.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over pesticide die schadelijk zijn voor baby’s

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether a Nature study linking pesticide exposure to premature births and birth defects applies to the Netherlands, and whether Dutch research and protective measures are planned. The minister answered that she had taken note of the study and referred all substantive questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents near agricultural fields.
I refer you to my letter on the status of research into the effects of crop protection products on residents living near agricultural fields.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief met onderwerp: Stand van zaken van het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor omwonenden van agrarische percelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het onderzoek “Onvoldoende doelmatigheid en transparantie in klinisch geneesmiddelenonderzoek”

MP Ellemeet asked the minister about a University of Utrecht study finding that more than half of clinical drug trials are wasted and poorly published, and whether bias, transparency and reward structures should be addressed. The minister answered that publication requirements in EU and Dutch rules already ensure results are made public, that no further measures seem necessary, and that research evaluation is governed by the SEP protocol.
Further measures therefore do not seem necessary to me.
Verdere maatregelen lijken mij dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gebrek aan medische kennis bij sportverenigingen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the lack of medical knowledge at sports clubs, including whether trainers need first-aid certificates and how many clubs have AEDs. The minister answered that medical responsibility lies mainly with sports federations and clubs, that there is no legal requirement for first-aid training or AEDs, and that no national registry of sport-related cardiac deaths exists.
There is no national policy or statutory rules for medical knowledge at sports clubs.
Er is geen landelijk beleid of wettelijke regels voor medische kennis bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over verloskundigen die massaal hun contract opzeggen bij de zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health why midwives are terminating contracts with insurers over tariffs and why insurers have objected to the NZa's 2018 tariff increase, and what will guarantee basic care.
