The minister answered that contracting is a matter between insurers and providers, that the NZa's objection procedure timing is set by law, and that insurers must ensure sufficient care, with the NZa supervising and able to intervene.
The NZa supervises this and will also intervene if that is not the case.
De NZa ziet daarop toe en zal ook ingrijpen als niet geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kooiman over het conflict tussen verloskundigen en zorgverzekeraars inzake tarieven

MPs Ellemeet and Kooiman asked whether insurers pay midwife practices in integrated care experiments the maximum NZa tariff, thereby pushing them toward integrated funding contrary to the Leijten motion, and how a level playing field and voluntariness are ensured. Minister Bruins answers that switching to integrated funding is voluntary for regions, that insurers may set their own tariffs and merely incentivise integrated contracts, and that the NZa is monitoring the contracts.
Midwives state that insurers are willing to reimburse the childbirth care agreed under integrated contracts more generously than under monodisciplinary contracts. I have no insight into this.

Verloskundigen geven aan dat zorgverzekeraars bereid te zijn om de geboortezorg die binnen de integrale contracten wordt overeengekomen ruimer te vergoeden dan binnen monodisciplinaire contracten. Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat zaakwaarnemers ruim 600 miljoen aan zomertransfers hebben verdiend

MP Van Nispen asked the health minister for a response to reports that intermediaries earned over 600 million euros from summer transfers, and asked what measures could bring more transparency on intermediaries at European and Dutch level. The minister answered that football bodies have the primary role, that the KNVB keeps a public register of intermediaries, and that no additional measures are foreseen.
I do not foresee taking additional measures at this moment.
Het treffen van extra maatregelen voorzie ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over het bericht dat PSV-spelers racistisch zijn bejegend in Venlo

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about racist chanting directed at PSV players in Venlo, including what clubs, referees and the KNVB did, whether criminal prosecution is underway, and whether penalties for discriminatory football-related offences should be raised. The Minister said the KNVB disciplinary process is pending, a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and he will not comment on it, and that prosecutors may raise sentence demands by 50% for football-related discrimination offences.
As is customary, while the criminal investigation is ongoing, I make no statements on the progress of this criminal investigation and the prosecution.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk doe ik, gaande het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen uitspraken over het verloop van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek en de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bezuinigingen die bestuurders van ZGT Hengelo en Almelo willen doordrukken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether ZGT hospital board's cost-cutting and possible patient stops in Hengelo and Almelo are acceptable, and whether the minister would intervene and inform parliament. The minister answered that contracting is a matter between hospital and insurers, that ZGT denies patient stops are planned, and that the minister will not intervene but expects good communication and will not inform parliament beyond the information already given.
However, I am not interfering in this.
Ik meng mij hier echter niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over wel of geen deal met Vertex Pharmaceuticals inzake het geneesmiddel Orkambi

PVV MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the refusal to reimburse Orkambi reflected a price dispute with Vertex, questioning the cost-effectiveness assessment, the delay and the negotiation tactics. The minister defended the delay on price and cost grounds, said she had now reached an acceptable price and would add Orkambi to the basic package from 1 November, while answering many points by referring to the Zorginstituut or to other countries.
Vertex, however, has not given insight into its development costs.
Vertex heeft echter geen inzage gegeven in hun ontwikkelingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Rouvoet voorzitter platform Divorce Challenge’

An MP asked why a platform chair was appointed to follow up the Divorce Challenge on separation, what the government's role is, and about the Rechtspraak vision document, uniform support offers, and the role of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren). The minister answered that the platform, chaired by André Rouvoet, will report in early 2018, that the government wants a multi-party approach to reduce harm to children, and that the fee issue for special guardians awaits the Van der Meer commission.
Early 2018 Rouvoet will present the results of his Platform.
Begin 2018 zal Rouvoet de resultaten van zijn Platform presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Diertens over de noodzaak van een onderzoek naar de dwang bij patiënten om ROM-lijsten in te vullen

MPs Kooiman and Diertens asked the health minister whether patients are being coerced into filling in ROM questionnaires and whether insurers' budget cuts for under-delivery of ROM data should be banned. The minister answered that ROM is voluntary, insurers and providers must settle delivery targets between themselves, she has no signals of coercion, and the Data Protection Authority is still investigating.
As I indicated in the answers to your earlier parliamentary questions on ROM, I have no signals of coercion to complete ROM.
Antwoord 9 Zoals ik aangaf in de antwoorden op uw eerdere Kamervragen over ROM 5 heb ik geen signalen over dwang tot het invullen van ROM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over zogenaamd ‘Slimme deals van farmaceuten’

An MP asked the health minister whether the US pharmaceutical firm Allergan's transfer of Restasis patents to a Native American tribe, which blocks patent challenges, is unethical and what the government will do about it. The minister explained the US mechanism, said the case has not been tested in court, and stated it is not possible in the Netherlands, so no action is needed.
I therefore see no need or opportunity to act against this.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak en gelegenheid om hiertegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de blijvende chaos binnen Treant

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the ongoing governance turmoil at hospital group Treant, including the inspectorate's oversight, its review of the proposed experimental board model, the €15 million savings target, the works council's treatment and whether advisory councils should have consent rights. The Minister replied that the inspectorate applies intensive supervision and the governance framework, that hospitals are responsible for their own organisation and are not pre-approved, that she cannot judge Treant's financial trade-offs or the works council dispute, and that the Cliëntenraden law will strengthen patient councils' rights.
Good governance is an important part of this intensive supervision trajectory, and the Good Governance supervision framework is of course applied.
Goed bestuur is een belangrijk onderdeel van dit intensieve toezichttraject en uiteraard wordt het kader Toezicht op Goed Bestuur daarbij toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van Engelshoven en Jetten over de berichtgeving dat de nieuwe drugstest voor automobilisten mogelijk problematisch is voor mensen met ADHD medicatie

Three D66 MPs asked whether the new saliva drug test for drivers could wrongly flag people taking ADHD medication containing dexamfetamine, and whether this risks loss of driving licences and discourages necessary medication. The minister confirms the test detects amphetamine including dexamfetamine, says medicinal users rarely show signs prompting testing and can explain their medication to the prosecutor, and announces a broader exemption for medically supervised use of dexamfetamine, morphine and medicinal cannabis to be worked out with pharmacists and implementing bodies, with Parliament to be informed as soon as possible.
They will look at an exception to criminalisation for persons who use these substances on medical prescription and under medical supervision and take part in traffic.
Wij zullen daarbij kijken naar een uitzondering op de strafbaarstelling voor personen die op medisch voorschrift en onder medisch toezicht deze stoffen gebruiken en deelnemen aan het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat ziekenhuisfusie tussen het AMC en VUmc niet in het belang is van patiënten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's warning that the AMC-VUmc merger harms patients (higher prices, lower quality, 'too big to fail') and whether oversight by ACM, NZa and IGJ is adequate. The minister replied that fusion oversight is legally split between NZa and ACM, that the ACM cleared the merger on competition grounds, and that she wanted stronger fusion rules via a bill which the Tweede Kamer declared controversial.
I find it highly undesirable if mergers lead to such market power that the price of care rises and/or quality and accessibility decline.
Ik vind het zeer onwenselijk als fusies leiden tot een zodanige mate van marktmacht dat daardoor de prijs van zorg stijgt en of de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid dalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat huisartsenposten overbelast zijn

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that GP out-of-hours posts are overloaded, rising complex caseloads, referrals to ambulances, budget and bed-reduction policy. Minister Schippers answered that the problem is real, gave causes and planned joint action across the acute care chain, but declined to reverse bed reductions or raise the GP budget beyond the agreed indexation.
There is certainly a problem; I have also shared this in several debates and letters with your House.
Er is zeker sprake van een probleem, ik heb dat ook in meerdere debatten en kamerbrieven met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over hoe de supportersclub Oranje zichzelf verrijkte ten koste van de fans

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how board members of the Oranje supporters club enriched themselves at fans' expense, why the KNVB did not supervise them, and what sanctions and repayment would follow. The minister replied that the club is an independent organisation over which she has no influence, that malversation can be reported to the police, and that the KNVB is not its supervisor; she noted an independent investigation commissioned by the club.
The Oranje supporters club is an independent organisation that independently makes choices regarding business operations, accountability and supervision.
De supportersclub Oranje is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig keuzes maakt betreffende bedrijfsvoering, verantwoording en toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de winst die op de handel in geneesmiddelen wordt gemaakt

An MP asked the health minister about Advent's alleged extraction of half a billion euros and a 61 million dollar loan from pharmaceutical wholesaler Mediq, the resulting drop in solvency, and risks to medicine supply. The minister replied that the wholesale and pharmacy businesses were sold before the payout, that Mediq no longer plays a role in medicine supply, that supply continuity was never at risk, and that private profit-making is a matter for company law.
There is therefore in fact no payout to Advent that was extracted from a pharmaceutical wholesaler.
Er is daarom feitelijk geen sprake van een uitkering aan Advent die is onttrokken aan een farmaceutische groothandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het weren van pers en bezorgde inwoners bij een informatiebijeenkomst over de kerncentrale in Tihange

An MP asked the government about differences in iodine tablet distribution across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, and about the exclusion of press and concerned residents from a Tihange information meeting. The government said harmonisation with neighbours is partial, regional authorities may act independently, Belgian nuclear safety is a national responsibility, and it has no influence over the safety-region meetings, declining to answer the questions in time for the meeting.
The meetings were organised by the safety regions in Limburg. I have no need to exert influence over that.
De bijeenkomsten zijn georganiseerd door de veiligheidsregio's in Limburg. Ik heb geen behoefte om daar invloed op uit te oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil omtrent een zelfdodingsmiddel

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij ask whether a lethal substance advised by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil for suicide is legal, traceable, safe, and whether the cooperative's advice constitutes criminal assistance in suicide, and whether it should be banned. The ministers answer that they do not know the substance, that criminal liability is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that a ban under article 2:20 BW faces high legal thresholds, and that the government opposes spreading such information and will rely on suicide prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Onrust in je hoofd en geen plek waar je hulp kunt krijgen’

An MP asks the minister about reports that people with acute mental health needs cannot get timely help, citing declining inpatient beds, weak ambulatory capacity, and gaps in acute care. The minister says ambulantisation is proceeding but too slowly, points to new agreements with insurers and providers under NZa supervision, and argues acute care supply is secured by the insurers' statutory duty of care rather than a legal guarantee.

I have therefore made further agreements on this with health insurers and care providers in the Waiting Times Approach for mental health care, which should lead insurers to finance good plans from mental health providers.

Ik heb dan ook nadere afspraken hierover gemaakt met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders in de Aanpak wachttijden ggz die ertoe moeten leiden dat zorgverzekeraars goede plannen van ggz-aanbieders zullen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het beëindigen van de collectieve zorgverzekering voor minima door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Zilveren Kruis ending its collective health insurance contracts for low-income people in three municipalities undermines solidarity and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary answered that contracts are extended one year where no alternative exists, that insurers must accept everyone but need not offer collectives, that municipalities choose their own instruments, and that VWS is not a party to negotiations but has spoken with the insurer.
Health insurers have the social duty to insure all Dutch residents, but not the obligation to accept everyone for all collectives.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben de maatschappelijke taak om alle Nederlanders te verzekeren, maar niet de verplichting om iedereen voor alle collectiviteiten te accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Arts doet greep naar de macht'

MP Rutte asked the health minister about reports of a power struggle at Treant Zorggroep over admitting practising medical specialists to the board, and whether this threatens care quality and whether the IGZ and NZa are involved. The minister declined to judge the dispute, said the IGZ sees no care-quality signals, supports specialist board membership with safeguards against conflicts of interest, and noted that hospitals themselves are responsible for their governance structure.
Hospitals are private parties and therefore themselves responsible for governing their organisation. I do not decide on that.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private partijen en in dat kader zelf verantwoordelijk voor de besturing van hun organisatie. Ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat stervende patiënten overgeplaatst worden om het sterftecijfer laag te houden

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether hospitals moving dying patients to keep mortality rates low, as reported in a column, is shocking and whether the Inspectorate will act. The minister replied that the column contains no concrete evidence of substandard care, that hospital mortality ratios need nuance, and that she sees no reason for further action or sanctions.
Concrete indications of substandard care for dying patients cannot be derived from the article.
Concrete aanwijzingen voor tekortschietende zorg bij stervende patiënten zijn aan het artikel niet te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over de ontslagen bij ziekenhuis Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) Enschede

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health about MST Enschede's cost-cutting plan of 30 million euros, which eliminates about 155 jobs, its effects on patient safety, regional referrals, and executive salaries and bonuses. The Minister answered that MST cites rising care demand, new building costs and the need to fund a new EPD, that the IGZ monitors risks, and that executive pay falls under the WNT and supervisory board responsibility, declining to intervene.
That is not my responsibility as Minister.
Dat is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Özturk over de uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie over de informatievoorziening van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over orgaandonatie

Two MPs asked the health minister how the ministry responded to a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that its organ donation information failed to explain the legal meaning of brain death and death, and why similar shortcomings persisted after an earlier ruling and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that website, brochure and letter texts were supplemented with explanations of brain and heart death, that information is continuously updated, and that all texts will be externally reviewed and the Chamber informed of the outcome.
I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes.
Ik zal de Kamer van de uitkomsten op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het bericht dat er deze zomer meer mensen verdronken zijn dan in voorgaande zomers

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked the Minister of Health about reports of more drownings this summer, the decline in swimming skills linked to cuts to school swimming, and what measures are needed. The minister said the number of drownings is comparable to other years, that parents are primarily responsible for teaching swimming, that school swimming is the responsibility of municipalities and schools, and that a sector action plan is being finalised.
School swimming is a responsibility of municipalities and schools.
Schoolzwemmen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over ernstige misstanden veroorzaakt door kinderkwakzalvers

An MP asks the Health Minister whether she shares concern about 16 serious harms to children caused by alternative child healers, how parents are informed of risks, and whether the list of misconduct should be published or such practitioners without medical background banned from treating children. The minister responds that the Wkkgz requires alternative practitioners not to cause harm, that the IGZ supervises this, that she will not amend the rules or publish the list, but considers it important that the list is shared with the IGZ.
I do not intend to amend the existing laws and regulations, nor to make this list of misconduct public.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de bestaande wet- en regelgeving aan te passen, dan wel deze lijst met misstanden openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘SCP: Nederlandse topsport dreigt internationaal weg te zakken’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about a SCP report warning that Dutch top sport risks declining internationally, including whether budgets for sport at local and regional level are falling. The minister acknowledged the study, said she recognises the perspectives but leaves policy conclusions to her successor, and stated municipal sport spending has been stable at around 1.1 billion euro per year.
Which policy conclusions are linked to these insights I leave to my successor.
Welke beleidsconclusies verbonden worden aan deze inzichten laat ik aan mijn ambtsopvolger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat psychologen nog steeds niet positief zijn over de financiering van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

MP Kooiman asks the Health Minister about survey findings that psychologists remain dissatisfied with mental health (GGZ) financing, including the DBC system, and whether this shows market-based care has failed. The minister acknowledges the criticism, says a new payment model is being developed with the NZa and sector organisations and piloted for introduction around 2020, and rejects the claim of market failure while noting improvements to the current system are wanted.

At present the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa), on the proposal of and together with provider organisations (including the NIP), insurers and patients in mental health care, is working on a new funding model for basic, specialised and forensic mental health care.

Op dit moment werkt de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) dan ook op voorstel van en samen met organisaties van aanbieders (waaronder het NIP, het Nederlands Instituut van Psychologen), verzekeraars en patiënten in de ggz aan een nieuw bekostigingsmodel voor de basis-ggz, gespecialiseerde ggz en forensische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht 'Een groeiend aantal basisartsen moet wachten op een vervolgopleiding'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Özdil asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports that a growing number of newly graduated basic doctors cannot obtain a specialist training place, and whether government was steering this gap. The minister answered that there is no entitlement to a vervolgopleiding, that current intake is judged sufficient for most specialties, that a Capacity Council scenario analysis is pending, and that no measures are currently planned.
In assessing what is sufficient, the projections of the Capacity Council play an important role.
Bij de beoordeling van de vraag wat voldoende is, spelen de ramingen van het Capaciteitsorgaan 3 een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Hepatitis E in varkensvleesproducten

An MP asks the Health Minister whether Hepatitis E found in Dutch pork products endangers consumers, whether labelling, recall, notification duties and export warnings are needed, and whether blood and organ donations are at risk. The minister replies that HEV RNA does not prove infectious virus, the risk is limited to defined risk groups who receive dietary advice, and a notification duty is not needed for now, while the EFSA opinion and RIVM study are awaited.
Given the international dimension of the problem, a coordinating role for the European Commission is desirable and necessary for such additional measures.
Gezien de internationale dimensie van het probleem is bij dergelijke aanvullende maatregelen een coördinerende rol van de Europese Commissie gewenst en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de het bericht dat medisch specialisten definitief buiten de Wet Normering Topinkomens vallen

An SP MP asks why medical specialists are exempt from the Dutch top-salary cap (WNT), why their pay is not public, and whether excessive salaries and severance should be curbed. The minister answers that the exemption is a deliberate policy to make employment attractive, that the WNT cannot practically cap specialists' pay, and that the cabinet does not intend to change the WNT on this point.
The government deliberately chose to exclude medical specialists from the scope of the WNT.
De regering heeft er nadrukkelijk voor gekozen om medisch specialisten buiten het toepassingsbereik van de WNT te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kooiman over ‘de toename van het aantal dakloze jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Kooiman asked why homeless young people rose from 8,000 to 12,000 in 2016, and whether the cost-sharing norm, psychiatric cuts, briefadres access and benefit rules contribute. The government acknowledges the rise, points to a pending Federatie Opvang report and a research project, defers responsibility to municipalities, and largely declines to commit to new legislative change.
Municipalities are responsible for tackling this target group and for making good policy to prevent people from becoming homeless.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aanpak van deze doelgroep en het maken van goed beleid om te voorkomen dat mensen dakloos raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitzending van EenVandaag over euthanasie bij demente mensen

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Health Minister how to treat earlier written euthanasia declarations when dementia changes a person's wishes, and whether a doctor's call for relatives to press a demented parent into euthanasia crosses a line. Minister Schippers answered that the patient's current, competent wish is central, that written declarations can be honoured if the patient was competent when writing them, and that such conversations are important while the statutory due-care requirements still apply.

The starting point remains that the person's wish is honoured at any stage of the illness, provided the wish is expressed while competent or, if the person is no longer competent, was recorded in writing beforehand while competent.

Uitgangspunt blijft dat de wens van de persoon gehonoreerd wordt, in welk stadium van de ziekte dan ook, mits die wens wilsbekwaam wordt geuit of, indien iemand niet meer wilsbekwaam is, diens wens daarvóór wilsbekwaam schriftelijk is vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat meerderheid van de zorgsites onbeveiligd is

MPs Dijkstra and Verhoeven asked whether the Minister would act after a report that most healthcare provider websites lack secure connections, and why some sectors perform worse. The Minister replied that information security is primarily the providers' own responsibility, enforced by the Data Protection Authority and IGZ, and pointed to an action plan and awareness efforts without new binding measures.
I do not have a specific explanation for why one healthcare sector has a higher percentage of secure connections than another.
Ik heb niet een specifieke verklaring waarom de ene zorgsector een hoger percentage beveiligde verbindingen heeft dan de andere zorgsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het onderzoek dat een meerderheid van de zorgwebsites geen veilige HTTPS-verbinding heeft

An MP asked the health minister whether she accepts that care providers must secure sensitive data, whether HTTPS should be mandated for care websites as it is for government sites, whether she will engage hospitals and providers, and what further measures exist. The minister answered that HTTPS is already required under the Wbp when special personal data is processed, that care providers bear the same responsibility as government for their websites, that an action plan on patient data security addresses awareness, and that the Data Protection Authority supervises data security.
The Data Protection Authority supervises the security of personal data.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens houdt toezicht op de veiligheid van de persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Keijzer over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Health ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands, its consequences for innovation and jobs, and how supply shortages would be prevented. The minister answered that production has been largely abroad for years, that Nederland specialises in R&D, that topsector policy and acquisition efforts continue, and that the medicines register and shortage reporting body would monitor any relocation.
The largest part of medicine production has been taking place outside the Netherlands for a very long time.
Het grootste deel van de geneesmiddelenproductie vindt al heel lang buiten Nederland plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitgifte van een invalidenparkeerkaart voor zorginstellingen gefinancierd door een persoonsgebonden budget

MP Bergkamp asked about the status of changes needed so care institutions funded by a personal budget (PGB) can obtain a disabled parking card, and about interim options. The government answered that it is coordinating with the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment on a single comprehensive regulatory amendment to be presented in autumn, and that competent authorities can grant exemptions under article 87 RVV 1990 in the meantime.
The Minister of IenM therefore aims to present you with one comprehensive amendment of the relevant regulations in the autumn.
De Minister van IenM streeft er daarom naar u in het najaar één omvattende wijziging van de relevante regelgeving voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat fipronilkippen ondanks een verbod toch verkocht zouden zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a report that fipronil-contaminated hens were sold despite a ban, including how many blocked farms sold hens, whether the NVWA's permit procedure was sound, and why a quote was removed from the RTL article. The minister answered that two breeding farms supplied hens to laying farms that were then also blocked, that the exemption to move hens was granted on animal welfare grounds via a NVWA permit procedure, and that the NVWA only corrected factual errors in the article.
The blocked breeding farm submits a request for exemption to the NVWA.
Het geblokkeerde opfokbedrijf dient bij de NVWA een verzoek in voor ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat kinderartsen afhankelijk werden van geld van farmaceutische bedrijven

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that paediatricians became dependent on pharmaceutical company funding, including whether they prescribe unnecessarily expensive growth hormones in exchange for research money. The minister said the IGZ will handle the case as a report and examine it, that the Medicines Act bans inducements tied to prescribing, and that the IGZ, NZa and the Transparantieregister Zorg are the relevant safeguards, while awaiting the IGZ findings.
The IGZ has committed to handle this case as a report.
De IGZ heeft toegezegd, om deze casus als melding te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de afhankelijkheid van farmaceutische bedrijven

An MP asked the health minister about pharmaceutical companies' influence on paediatric prescribing, including deals linking drug purchases to research funding, conflicts of interest and a growth-hormone director's dual role. The minister said the IGZ will assess the case as a complaint and await the supervisors' findings, pointed to existing rules on gifts, advertising and governance, and said transparency has been increased since 2012.
The IGZ has committed to treating this case as a report and will assess it, request further information and investigate further if necessary.
De IGZ heeft mij toegezegd deze casus als melding te behandelen en zal deze beoordelen, nader informatie opvragen en zo nodig verder onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de eisen van zorgverzekeraars voor het krijgen van een assistentiehond

An MP asked the minister whether health insurers impose stricter conditions for assistance dogs, whether existing users must re-justify their need, and about costs, savings and the number of approved applications. The minister replied that she knows of no such signals, that the criteria are unchanged and reassessment happens only when circumstances change, and that exact approval figures and savings evidence are not available, while pointing to ongoing studies.
Exact figures on how many applications were approved are not known.
Exacte cijfers over hoeveel aanvragen zijn ingewilligd, zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat er camera’s hangen in de kleedkamers van fitness keten Fit For Free

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked whether cameras in changing rooms of fitness chain Fit For Free, even if switched off, violate privacy, and what oversight exists. The government answered that cameras in changing rooms and toilets go too far, that installed-but-unused cameras involve no personal data processing, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority handled two complaints and the cameras were removed, and that no law change is needed.
Camera surveillance in changing rooms or toilets goes too far because people would be filmed undressed.
Cameratoezicht in kleedkamers of toiletten gaat te ver omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat door invoering van eigen bijdrage ggz de dwangopnames zijn verdubbeld en crisisopnamen zijn toegenomen

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked whether the 2012 co-payment for mental health care, which a study linked to doubled involuntary admissions and more crisis care and a net cost increase, was sensible, and what the government would do about care avoidance and unequal effects by income. Minister Schippers acknowledged the findings, said the co-payment was abolished in 2013, stressed the Wvggz bill and ambulantisation as responses, and pointed to municipal compensation measures without committing to new research.
The co-payment in secondary mental health care was abolished in 2013, so I do not consider it necessary to conduct further research into it.
De eigen bijdrage in de tweedelijns ggz is in 2013 afgeschaft, waardoor ik het niet nodig acht daar verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Verhoeven over patiënten die onder druk gezet worden om bijzondere persoonsgegevens af te staan in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Health about a clinic fining patients who did not complete ROM questionnaires, whether ROM data use for benchmarking is appropriate, and whether patients are pressured into sharing sensitive data. The Minister said patients must be able to refuse, financial pressure is unacceptable, the practice has stopped, and no further signals of pressure are known so no further inquiry is planned.
In doing so, a patient must always have the option to refuse to participate in ROM or to withhold consent for passing personal data on to Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).
Daarbij moet een patiënt wel altijd de mogelijkheid hebben te weigeren om mee te werken aan ROM of geen toestemming te geven voor doorlevering van persoonsgegevens aan Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van de afdeling cardiologie in ZGT Hengelo

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the cardiology department at ZGT Hengelo, including fears it foreshadows further cutbacks, the reasons, patient travel times, and the role of the Inspectorate. The Minister answered that the closure is temporary due to summer staff shortages, patients are redirected to Almelo, responsibility for regional access lies with providers and insurers, and the Inspectorate has pressed ZGT to manage the transition safely.
Accessibility and availability of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het zorgaanbod in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet toekennen van voldoende financiële middelen aan het ziekenhuis in Den Helder om de acute verloskundige zorg en spoedzorg in de lucht te houden

MP Kooiman asks whether the Minister will guarantee that acute obstetric and emergency care in Den Helder hospital remains available, given the Noordwest Ziekenhuisgroep threat to close them without €9m extra annual funding and the NZa's refusal. Minister Schippers says the hospital and insurers must agree the location profile, that she will consider using her powers under the Wtzi to ensure access to acute care, and that the NZa has invited VGZ and NWZ to talk.
I will therefore consider using the powers included in the Wtzi.
Ik zal mij daarom beraden op het inzetten van de bevoegdheden die in de Wtzi zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op de leden Pia Dijkstra en Diertens over het niet uitvoeren van een rechterlijke uitspraak betreffende erkenning van beroepskwalificaties voor mensen met een buitenland diploma

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Diertens asked why the government does not implement a court ruling that a required additional training course for a foreign-trained psychotherapist was unlawful, and how many applicants are affected. Minister Schippers says she has appealed the ruling because the Dutch curriculum requires two courses, that a settlement was reached in the interim relief proceedings, that the appeal has no suspensive effect, and that she will decide on consequences once the Council of State rules.
Because I do not agree with the court's finding that the person concerned need only take one deepening course, I have lodged an appeal against this ruling.
Omdat ik het niet eens ben met het oordeel van de rechtbank dat betrokkene slechts een verdiepingscursus moet volgen, heb ik tegen deze uitspraak hoger beroep ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bestuurlijke instabiliteit van Treant en de dreigende teloorgang van volwaardige ziekenhuiszorg op de ziekenhuislocaties in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about governance instability at hospital group Treant, the threat to full hospital care in Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, and whether an independent investigation or replacement of the board is warranted. The minister answered that the IGZ monitors quality and sees no reason for intervention, that hospitals are responsible for their own governance, and that she has no role beyond calling for dialogue.
Hospitals are private institutions and as such are themselves responsible for steering their organisation.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private instellingen en in dat kader zelf verantwoordelijk voor de besturing van hun organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat door een tegenvaller van 400 miljoen de zorgpremie gaat stijgen

An MP asks the Health Minister how a shortfall of 400 million euros in the health insurance fund could raise premiums, and whether insurers should use reserves or pass on savings. The minister answers that insurers set premiums themselves, the shortfall stems from fewer chronic-disease cost groups in the equalisation payment (not fewer hospital treatments), and the government will publish its premium estimate on Prinsjesdag.
The cause of the decline in the DKGs is not yet known; this is now being further investigated by the Zorginstituut, in consultation with VWS, NZa and insurers.
Oorzaak van de daling in de DKG's is nog niet bekend; dit wordt nu verder uitgezocht door het Zorginstituut, in overleg met VWS, NZa en verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de enorme bezuiniging die het bestuur van de Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT) in Hengelo en Almelo wil doordrukken

An SP MP asked the health minister about planned cuts of 10 to 15 million euros at the ZGT hospital group, including possible closures and concentration of care, and whether the Inspectorate was involved. The minister answered that financial management is the hospital board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate only acts if patient safety is at risk, and that decisions on emergency services and locations are for the hospital and insurers to make in consultation with stakeholders.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to keep the organisation financially healthy and to adjust course where necessary. In that responsibility, I as Minister do not intervene.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur om de organisatie financieel gezond te houden en zo nodig bij te sturen. In die verantwoordelijkheid treed ik als Minister niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat het UMC Utrecht weer in opspraak is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of problems at the UMC Utrecht home-ventilation unit, including patient safety, working conditions, and dismissals of whistleblowers, and asked how the Inspectorate missed it. The Minister replied that the situation was already known and covered in the Inspectorate's report on the hospital board, that the board has taken measures after an independent investigation, and that the Inspectorate maintains intensive supervision, while declining to investigate the whistleblower dismissals beyond noting that protections exist.
Are you willing to look into this and inform the House about it? If not, why not?
Bent u bereid dit uit te zoeken en de Kamer hierover te informeren? Zo neen, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over een buitensporige ontslagvergoeding voor een ziekenhuisdirecteur en beloningen van medisch specialisten in het Noorden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked about a severance payment of over a quarter million euros to a hospital department head at Nij Smellinghe, whether the WNT pay cap allows buying out waiting-benefit entitlements, and why medical specialists in the north earn above the Balkende norm. The minister answered that the individual severance cases fall to the accountant and the WNT supervisor (CIBG), that no change to the WNT is planned, and that medical specialists were removed from the WNT's scope from 1 July 2017, so their pay is no longer published.
A severance payment to a non-top official is not capped under the WNT, because the WNT only caps the pay and severance of top officials.
Een ontslagvergoeding aan een niet-topfunctionaris wordt niet genormeerd in het kader van de WNT, omdat de WNT alleen de bezoldiging en ontslagvergoedingen van topfunctionarissen normeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de zaadkwaliteit van de westerse man keldert door gebruik van hormoon verstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Western sperm quality is declining due to hormone-disrupting substances, and about concrete measures, hospital practice, pregnancy information and BPA regulation. The minister agreed the trend is undesirable, outlined EU and national steps (hospital awareness, RIVM work, EU medical device rules, a pending BPA norm decision), but stated the causal link to sperm quality is unclear and gave no firm national ban.
I am taking the following steps to break this impasse.
Ik onderneem de volgende stappen om deze impasse te doorbreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het risico op een mazelen uitbraak toeneemt door een dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asks the Minister of Health why her letter on falling vaccination rates omitted the RIVM warning that measles herd immunity may be at risk, and asks about e-learning uptake, consultation time for vaccination counselling, municipal measures and research on late vaccination. The minister denies downplaying the issue, points to the RIVM warning and the 2017 measures, and answers each question, committing to inform parliament in autumn but declining further research on late vaccination.
I will inform your House in the autumn about participation in the e-learning.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het najaar over de deelname aan de e-learning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht "De zorg is een goudmijn"

An MP asks the health minister about reports that care companies (zorg-BV's) pay out profits, and whether the state will investigate, tighten fines, and oversee municipal spending. The minister says she lacks an overview of profit-paying care BVs, leaves Wmo oversight to municipalities and the IGZ's existing profit-ban supervision, sees no need for new investigation or fines, and points to existing reporting.
I do not have that overview.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Marijnissen over het bericht dat melkgeitenhouders in opmars zijn

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that goat dairy farms are expanding despite Q-fever concerns, whether expansion raises infection risk, what advice local health services gave on a specific expansion, and whether compensation for Q-fever victims will be reconsidered. The government answered that existing measures such as vaccination and milk-tank monitoring keep the risk low, that permitting is a municipal responsibility, that it does not track expansion locations, and deferred the compensation question to a separate cabinet response.
The Brabant Due Diligence Score is not public until the expansion permit is granted.
De Brabantse Zorgvuldigheidsscore is niet openbaar tot toekenning van de vergunning tot uitbreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van de spoedeisende hulppost in Woerden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Health Minister about the closure of the emergency department and GP post in Woerden and whether this was properly decided and communicated. The minister answered that the closure followed from the hospital merger and the GP post's relocation, that the 45-minute norm is met, that regulators NZa and ACM approved the plans, and that the hospital and GP post should engage residents in dialogue.
Healthcare providers and health insurers are responsible for good and accessible emergency care in the region.
Zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars zijn verantwoordelijk voor goede en toegankelijke spoedzorg in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afkoop van het regresrecht waardoor letselschadeslachtoffers gedupeerd raken

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the buyout of the Wmo regress right via the VNG-Verbond van Verzekeraars convenant harms personal injury victims, who may be sent to municipalities first and face delays. The State Secretary replied that regress is a matter between insurer and municipality, that the victim is not affected, that the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade is not breached, and that no talks with stakeholders are planned.
Regress takes place in the relationship between insurer and regress claimant.
Regres speelt zich af in de verhouding tussen verzekeraar en regresnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders over het bericht dat bepaalde wijken in Den Haag 30% meer zorgkosten declareren

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the Health Minister to respond to a report that healthcare costs in certain The Hague neighbourhoods are 30% higher, and whether this reflects fraud or non-Western migrant background. The minister answered that socio-economic factors such as income and education explain the higher costs, that insurers are responsible for checking claims, and that there is no data on extra costs from Ramadan.
Checking is a task of the health insurers. The NZa supervises this as the regulator.
Het controleren is een taak van de zorgverzekeraars. De NZa ziet daarop toe als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen getroffen zijn door ransomware-aanvallen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about reports that hospitals were hit by ransomware, including how much data was lost, whether ransom was paid, how many hospitals run outdated medical equipment, who is responsible for securing it, and what will be done. The minister answered that the NCSC registered five hospital ransomware reports since 2014 with no known ransom payments or data losses, that hospitals are primarily responsible for securing their equipment, and listed new measures such as an action plan, the sector CERT Z-CERT and an information-sharing body.
It is not known whether ransom has been paid.
Er is niet bekend of er losgeld is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het risico op een mazelen uitbraak toeneemt door een dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asked the health minister why her letter did not state that measles vaccination coverage had fallen so far that herd immunity might be at risk, and what she would do to restore coverage. The minister answered that the 95% WHO target was not linked to a hard threshold for outbreaks, that the cause of the decline was still unknown and was being researched, and listed measures such as an e-learning course, more consultation time in youth health care from 2018, and continued monitoring.
Failing to meet the 95% norm for the BMR vaccination was not mentioned in the letter because the risk of a measles outbreak is not linked to that 95%.
Het niet voldoen aan de norm van 95% voor de BMR-vaccinatie is in de brief niet vermeld omdat het risico op een mazelenuitbraak niet gekoppeld is aan die 95%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de verhoogde kans op longontsteking nabij pluimveebedrijven

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders asked about a study finding higher pneumonia rates near poultry farms and what the government will do about it. The state secretary cited the study's statistical association, pointed to forthcoming measures and an interim wet veedichte gebieden bill, and said emissions rose after the battery-cage ban.
Work is also underway on a proposal for an interim act on densely farmed areas.
Verder wordt gewerkt aan het voorstel voor een interim-wet veedichte gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands while thriving abroad, and what the government will do to keep research and production in the country. The minister answers that the number of firms has been stable, that production is under pressure due to specialisation, that the government supports life sciences policy and IMI participation, and that it is working to attract the European Medicines Agency, without committing to new concrete measures.
The research has not declined, but there are signals that production is under pressure.
Het onderzoek is niet afgenomen, maar er zijn signalen dat de productie onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de classificatie van transpersonen binnen de aankomende International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11)

An MP asked the ministers whether transgender classification in the draft ICD-11 should move out of the mental disorders chapter, and whether the government would support the proposal and end the categorisation of transgender identity as a mental or behavioural disorder. The minister agreed that gender identity should not be treated as an illness, said she would convey her position to the WHO-FIC and TNN and ask to be kept informed, but did not commit to a formal endorsement or a fixed position on the WHO process.
I will bring my position to the attention of the WHO-FIC with the request to convey this position to the WHO.
Ik zal mijn standpunt in deze onder de aandacht brengen van het WHO-FIC met het verzoek dit standpunt in te brengen bij de WHO
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de corruptieschandalen binnen de FIFA

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the FIFA corruption scandals, the Garcia report on the 2018 and 2022 World Cup bids, possible further investigation, Dutch-Belgian bid payments, and whether bid funds reached tax-haven structures. The minister answered that the report shows no clear proof of bribery, that Swiss and US investigations are ongoing, that the EU presidency pushed for transparency rules on major sports events, and that the KNVB-commissioned review found no unlawful payments and no signals of tax-avoidance flows.
Should I receive information about this, for example from the Swiss or American investigation, I will inform you further.
Mocht ik daar informatie over krijgen, bijvoorbeeld uit het Zwiters of Amerikaans onderzoek (zie antwoord op vraag 3) zal ik u daarover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de berichtgeving dat matchfixing toeneemt in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about expected growth in matchfixing in the Netherlands and how it is being tackled, including reporting channels, police and prosecution capacity, information sharing, and a proposed dedicated criminal law provision. Minister Blok answered that the rise is linked to the growing online gambling market, that a national platform, reporting channels and the upcoming online gambling law are being used, and that prosecutors see no need for a new statutory article.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about ongoing investigations or what prompted them.
Over lopende onderzoeken en wat de aanleiding voor deze onderzoeken is geweest doet het OM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de berichtgeving dat matchfixing toeneemt in Nederland

Member Diertens (D66) asked whether current law is sufficient to combat matchfixing, following KNVB calls for stricter rules, and what has been done with the 2013 report's recommendations. The minister replies that existing legislation offers enough prosecution options, refers to earlier answers for the report's recommendations, which led to a national matchfixing platform and sports-side prevention measures, and defers on the international approach.
In my answer to earlier parliamentary questions on matchfixing I indicated that the current legislation offers sufficient possibilities for prosecution.
In mijn antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen over matchfixing heb ik aangegeven dat de huidige wetgeving voldoende mogelijkheden biedt tot vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het Universitair Medich Centrum (UMC) Utrecht weer onder vergrootglas ligt na een dubieus sterfgeval

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Inspectorate for Health Care should start independent investigation into a sudden death after a medical procedure at UMC Utrecht, and whether patient trust and safety are assured given earlier problems there. The Minister answered that the hospital was ordered to investigate under the Wkkgz, with an external independent expert, that the Inspectorate continues intensive supervision, and that it oversees the hospital's response.
The hospital must now work hard to carry out these measures and restore trust.
Het ziekenhuis moet nu hard aan het werk om deze maatregelen uit te voeren en het vertrouwen weer te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (Nza) waarschuwt voor de versnippering van ziekenhuiszorg

An SP MP asked the health minister to respond to a Nza market scan warning that hospital concentration may reduce access and quality, and whether she would halt hospital mergers. The minister agreed concentration can have drawbacks, said oversight by ACM and Nza is in place, denied that the scan shows fragmentation, and declined to halt mergers.
I attach importance to the supervisory authorities intervening where there is cause to do so.
Ik hecht eraan dat de toezichthouders ingrijpen indien daartoe aanleiding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over dure geneesmiddelen die in de toekomst door apothekers veel goedkoper gemaakt kunnen worden

An MP asked the health minister about a pharmacist-led device that could make biological medicines cheaply for individual patients, whether the curriculum should change, whether legal limits on magistral preparation hinder it, and what the biosimilar initiative is doing. The minister said the research is at proof-of-principle stage with results expected next year, deferred curriculum questions to universities, and will explore with the researcher and inspectorate whether current rules allow the approach, while listing existing biosimilar promotion activities.
I have invited Prof. Schellekens to explain his article and ideas.
Ik heb prof. Schellekens uitgenodigd om zijn artikel en ideeën toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een zorgbestuurder de Wet Normering Topinkomens middels een riante vertrekpremie omzeilt

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the health minister whether a hospital board member's EUR 75,000 departure payment circumvents the Dutch top-income cap (WNT) and whether the law will be amended. The minister replied that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary up to EUR 75,000, does not regulate when such payments may be contracted, so the payment is not in breach, and the cabinet does not intend to amend the WNT on severance.
The WNT does not prescribe in which cases a severance payment may be included in the employment contract.
De WNT schrijft niet voor in welke gevallen een beëindigingsvergoeding in het arbeidscontract mag worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de internetconsultatie rondom het wetsvoorstel beroepenregulering

MP Ellemeet asked why the planned autumn 2016 internet consultation on the professional regulation bill was delayed, whether the two nursing profiles would be implemented, and what the transitional arrangements and titles for nurses would be. Minister Schippers explained the delay as due to careful sounding out of the sector, confirmed support for the nursing profiles, and deferred details on titles and transitional rules to the bill to be consulted later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de hoge werklast van huisartsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about rising GP workload linked to elderly care shifts, the need for more time per patient, VGZ pilot results, unused GP budget, and substitution capacity. The minister answered that research shows more GP time for elderly patients, pointed to existing budget room and pilots, and said the choice of sharing data and organising care lies with insurers and providers, while committing to a fixed number of GP training places and a conditional budget shift for substitution.
It is up to VGZ to choose whether it wants to share such research results.
Het is aan VGZ om te kiezen of zij dergelijke onderzoeksresultaten willen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en van Nispen inzake het bericht dat scholen stoppen met schoolzwemmen

The SP MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether they are concerned that four Utrecht primary schools stopped offering school swimming after a child drowned, whether other schools have done so, and what concrete measures the government will take to keep schools offering swimming lessons and to improve supervision and responsibility-sharing with pools. State Secretary Dekker answered that the decision lies with schools, that the government does not track their reasons centrally, that it will reiterate the 2005 school swimming protocol and the national platform's plan due at the end of 2017.
Offering school swimming is a consideration that schools make themselves.
Het aanbieden van schoolzwemmen is een afweging die scholen zelf maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat Nederlanders generieke Pre-Expositie Profylaxe (PrEP) uit het buitenland halen omdat het in Nederland nog niet verkrijgbaar is

D66 MPs asked whether generic PrEP imported from abroad because it is not available in the Netherlands is undesirable, what the medical risks of unsupervised use are, and when PrEP can be made available. The minister said reimbursement is for each country to decide, a Gezondheidsraad advice is awaited before national policy is set, and unsupervised use of the prescription-only drug is strongly discouraged.
I do not want to anticipate this advice.
Ik wil niet op dit advies vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar patiënten die niet wisten dat ze een proefkonijn waren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister about the progress of the IGZ investigation into patients who were unknowingly used as test subjects for a cryoballoon heart procedure. The minister confirms the investigation was completed in May, that the report will be published by the IGZ before summer after a consultation with those involved, subject to privacy rules.
The report is expected to be published on the IGZ website before the summer.
Het rapport zal naar verwachting voor de zomer worden gepubliceerd op de site van de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de verdubbeling van het aantal datalekken door ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health why data breaches at hospitals had doubled, what measures would reduce human error, and whether losing a USB stick counts as serious negligence. The minister said hospitals are responsible for their own security, pointed to an action plan on patient data security and a sector CERT, and referred the causes and enforcement questions to the Data Protection Authority.
It is for the Data Protection Authority to explain the causes of the growth in the number of data breaches.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te verklaren wat de oorzaken zijn van de groei van het aantal datalekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onderbezetting bij de KID-DNA databank

An SP MP asked the health minister about the Fiom KID-DNA databank being understaffed, forcing donor children toward commercial services, and whether budget cuts are to blame. The minister said donor children conceived after 2004 have a legal right to identity via the Sdkb, that she is discussing capacity expansion and support with Fiom and others, but gave no data on waiting times and denied a link to budget cuts.
I have no insight into this. The Fiom KID-DNA Databank was not initiated by VWS and is not subsidised by VWS.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in. De Fiom KID-DNA Databank is niet geïnitieerd door VWS en wordt niet gesubsidieerd door VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet toelaten van geneesmiddel Orkambi tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why Orkambi was not added to the basic insurance package, given its high cost per patient and the treatment of cystic fibrosis patients. The minister answered that the Health Care Institute advised against unconditional reimbursement because of unfavourable cost-effectiveness and crowding-out of other care, that she considers the price unacceptable and wants pharmaceutical companies to be more transparent, and that negotiations with Vertex continue.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de onderhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het niet vergoeden van een medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte

Two PVV MPs asked the minister why Orkambi, a cystic fibrosis drug, is not reimbursed despite a petition, and about alternatives, price negotiations and reimbursement elsewhere. The minister answered that the price of around 170,000 euros per year and the budget impact make reimbursement not responsible at present, while offering to reconsider a new proposal and to hold talks with the manufacturer on 20 June.
I have a meeting with the manufacturer on 20 June to discuss a possible continuation of the talks together with the Netherlands and Belgium.
Ik heb op 20 juni aanstaande een gesprek met de fabrikant om te praten over een mogelijk vervolg van de gesprekken tezamen met Nederland en België.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het declareren van yogalessen als psychiatrische behandeling

An MP asked whether yoga, massage, meditation and personal training billed as psychiatric treatment via day-care by a mental health provider should be reimbursed, and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister answered that such wellbeing activities are not covered by the basic package, that the NZa rules exclude them from day-care, that no such claims have yet been made by Vitalis, and that a bill on verification is pending.
Yoga lessons and massages are therefore not separately identifiable in the reimbursement system.
Yogalessen en massages zijn dus niet apart herkenbaar in de vergoedingssystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands, De Graaf en Wilders over speciale voorzieningen in ziekenhuizen tijdens de ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked the health minister whether it is the hospital's task to provide special Ramadan facilities, whether this raises patient risks, who pays, and whether it breaches the Hippocratic oath. The minister answered that the material is supportive, that patients and their care providers decide on managing diabetes during Ramadan, that costs are covered from DBC revenue, and that she sees no breach of the oath and will not intervene.
I see no breach arising of the Dutch physicians' oath, which is derived from the Hippocratic oath.
Ik zie geen inbreuk ontstaan op de (van de eed van Hippocrates afgeleide) Nederlandse artseneed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voorkomen van koolmonoxidevergiftiging

An MP asked the ministers about carbon monoxide detectors that failed NVWA safety tests, whether sales would be banned, why periodic inspections of home installations are not mandatory, when licensing rules for gas appliance work will take effect, and how installer competence will be guaranteed. The minister answered that banned products were withdrawn or prohibited, that periodic inspections will not be mandated but a licensing scheme for installers is being pursued with an expected entry into force in 2019, and that progress will be reported to parliament in autumn 2017.
I do not intend to introduce a mandatory periodic inspection for combustion installations.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een verplichte periodieke keuring voor verbrandingsinstallaties in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over ernstige gezondheidsklachten bij medewerkers van het AZC in Ter Apel

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary and Health Minister about health complaints among COA staff at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including calls for deeper investigation and doubts about soil research. The State Secretary answered that 17 staff are currently on sick leave, that an independent commission of external experts has been set up to investigate the causes, and that soil studies found no contamination capable of causing the complaints.
The COA board has decided to set up an independent investigation committee with external experts.
Het bestuur van het COA heeft besloten tot het instellen van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie met externe deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het nieuwbouw proefdiercentrum van het Erasmus MC

An MP asked the state secretary about a new 6,000 m2 animal research centre at Erasmus MC, funded by a 4.2 million euro interest-free loan, and whether this fits the government's goal of leading in animal-free research by 2025. The state secretary confirmed the project, said it consolidates existing facilities without increasing animal experiments, and that subsidy requests are assessed on economic, social, scientific and 3Vs criteria.
It does not concern an increase in the number of animal experiments but an improvement of the conditions for the research.
Het gaat daarbij niet om een uitbreiding van het aantal dierproeven maar om verbetering van de omstandigheden voor het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat de huisartsenpraktijk uit Woerden verdwijnt

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the out-of-hours GP post in Woerden, which is closing and merging into Leidsche Rijn, is adequate for Woerden residents and whether a local alternative was considered. The Minister defended the decision as a matter for GPs and insurers based on quality and patient safety, noting that residents still have access and that similar consolidation is a national trend.
It is up to GPs and health insurers to organise care at local level so that quality and accessibility are adequately guaranteed.
Het is aan huisartsen en zorgverzekeraars om de zorg op lokaal niveau zo in te richten dat kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid voldoende zijn gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het niet vergoeden van een hoopgevend maar peperduur geneesmiddel

MP Gerbrands (PVV) asked the Minister of Health about the non-reimbursement of the expensive drug eculizumab (Soliris), questioning its efficacy, patient impact, development origin, alternatives, patent expiry, and international reimbursement. Minister Schippers answered that the drug is effective and fully reimbursed for PNH and aHUS, that Alexion's pricing is undisclosed, that a price negotiation and decision will follow, and that a full international price overview cannot be given due to confidential agreements.
Alexion has so far not provided information on the price structure or profit margin for eculizumab.
Alexion heeft vooralsnog geen informatie verstrekt over de prijsopbouw of de winstmarge voor eculizumab.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over antidepressiva en taperingstrips

MPs asked the government whether health insurers should reimburse tapering strips for gradually withdrawing antidepressants, given reports that insurers refuse them while covering the drugs themselves. The state secretary answered that insurers and the Zorginstituut assess coverage under the basic package and rational pharmacotherapy, that the government cannot itself judge the evidence, and that the decision on guidelines and reimbursement rests with professional bodies and insurers, so no new policy will be made.
It is not my responsibility to assess whether a particular tapering strategy using tapering strips meets the legal criterion of 'the state of science and practice'.
Het is niet mijn bevoegdheid om te beoordelen of een bepaalde afbouwstrategie die gebruik maakt van taperingstrips voldoet aan het wettelijk criterium van «de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk 1 ».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de constructie van De Wit thuiszorgorganisatie

MPs Marijnissen and Van Kent asked about thuiszorgorganisatie De Wit employing 'zorg-au pairs' from Eastern Europe under Wlz care, inspection history, language requirements, pay and oversight. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate issued an aanwijzing after repeated non-compliance, that foreign care workers are allowed if qualified, that a WTZi reform bill is in preparation, and that topfunctionaris pay is not publicly disclosed because the organisation lacks a WTZi licence.
It is up to the institution itself whether and how it wants to be transparent about the pay of its top officials.
Het is aan de instelling zelf of en hoe zij transparant wil zijn over bezoldigingen van haar topfunctionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over problemen met hygiëne in een ggz-instelling

An SP MP asked the Minister about hygiene problems at an addiction clinic reported by patients who felt unheard by management and the Inspectorate, and whether the Inspectorate has capacity to oversee hygiene. The State Secretary said the institution is responsible, patients should use complaint procedures and the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg, the Inspectorate has a specialist hygiene team, and it has ordered the board to report on hygiene and will discuss it soon.
The inspectorate has instructed the institution's board of directors to report on how the institution ensures good hygiene throughout the entire institution and how this is safeguarded.

De inspectie heeft de raad van bestuur van de instelling de opdracht gegeven te rapporteren op welke wijze de instelling zorg draagt voor goede hygiëne binnen de gehele instelling en de manier waarop dat wordt geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over de intimidatie van proefpersonen bij medicijntesten in ontwikkelingslanden door farmaceutische bedrijven

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about alleged intimidation of clinical trial participants in Egypt by pharmaceutical company Roche and about oversight of drug testing in developing countries. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies primarily with sponsors, that the Roche matter concerns publication rather than trial conduct, and that EMA-coordinated GCP inspections and the GCP IWG address oversight, without committing to new action.
Ultimately it remains the responsibility of the sponsor, usually a drug manufacturer, to decide where it has its clinical research carried out.
Het blijft uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de sponsor -veelal een fabrikant van geneesmiddelen- om te bepalen waar hij zijn (klinisch) onderzoek laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het essay ‘De apotheek is geen euthanasie-automaat’

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the minister about pharmacists' concerns over supplying euthanasia drugs, including unclear professional norms, conscientious objection, time pressure from doctors, and the absence of this issue from the third evaluation of the Euthanasia Act. The state secretary replied that the 2012 KNMP/KNMG guideline is the applicable norm, that pharmacists may refuse on principled grounds, and that doctors bear final responsibility, but declined further research on the pharmacist's role.
It is therefore sensible for the professional associations to keep their members continuously informed about the existence and content of the guideline, including during pharmacist training.
Het is daarom zinvol als de beroepsverenigingen hun achterban blijvend informeren over het bestaan en de inhoud van de richtlijn, ook gedurende de opleiding tot apotheker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat barcodes op medicijnen 47 sterfgevallen per jaar kunnen voorkomen

An MP asked the Minister why barcoding on medicines, which could prevent around 47 deaths a year, has been delayed and why about 20% of medicines still lack a barcode, and whether it should be made mandatory. The state secretary answered that a cost-benefit study found about 20% of hospital medicines lack a primary-pack barcode, that a national mandate is not considered efficient, and that follow-up consultations with stakeholders have been agreed.
In the letter of 31 May 2013 the Minister stated that it is not efficient to proceed to a national legal obligation regarding uniform barcoding for medicines.
247 ) heeft de Minister aangegeven dat het niet doelmatig is om over te gaan tot een nationale wettelijke verplichting met betrekking tot uniforme barcodering voor geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat patiënten langer kunnen leven door een super eenvoudig pompje

An MP asked the minister how the health system can be sick if a cheaper chemotherapy pump extending life for colorectal cancer patients is funded by the KWF and not yet available in the Netherlands, and asked for immediate availability. The state secretary said the Zorginstituut considers the intra-arterial liver infusion method in principle reimbursable but the specific drug and patient group under study are unclear, and that reimbursement depends on the Zorginstituut's determination of standard of science and practice.
As long as it has not been established whether the applied intervention meets the standard of science and practice, the treatment cannot be reimbursed under the Health Insurance Act.
Zolang niet is vastgesteld of de toegepaste interventie volgens «stand van wetenschap en praktijk» is, kan de behandeling niet worden vergoed ten laste van de zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de Alrijne ziekenhuizen die verlies draaien

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether extra supervision of the financially troubled Alrijne hospitals was coming, whether an inquiry into the 2015 merger would be held, and whether the Medical Specialist Company model should be replaced by salaried specialists. The Secretary of State said the Inspectorate is monitoring the situation and has asked the board for a response, that no inquiry is warranted because managing finances is the board's responsibility, and that hospitals and specialists must choose their own governance model.
Financial signals can give the IGZ reason to ask further questions about ensuring the quality and safety of care.
Financiële signalen kunnen voor de IGZ reden zijn om nadere vragen te stellen met betrekking tot de borging van de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de tekorten aan ambulancepersoneel

Two SP MPs asked the government about shortages of ambulance staff, reliance on temporary agency workers, pay and workload, and whether market-based regulation of ambulance care is acceptable. The state secretary answered that an advisory study of ordering variants is underway, that staffing is the responsibility of providers and insurers supervised by the NZa and Inspectie, that AZN assured sufficient staff, and that pay is a matter for CAO negotiations; the government declined to address the desirability of market mechanisms given its caretaker status.
Because the cabinet is caretaker, I will not address questions on the desirability of market mechanisms in ambulance care.
Vanwege de demissionaire status van het kabinet zal ik niet ingaan op vragen over de wenselijkheid van marktwerking in de ambulancezorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het toch niet beschikbaar komen van canules voor de heer Vercoutre, waarmee hij kan praten en hij minder benauwd is

An MP asked the minister why custom cannulas for a patient, which would let him speak and breathe more easily, still had not become available despite earlier answers and urged expert consultation. The state secretary replied that the patient died on 4 May 2017 from kidney problems at Erasmus MC and expressed condolences to the family.
