I regret to inform you that Mr Vercoutre died on Thursday 4 May from the consequences of kidney problems at Erasmus MC in Rotterdam.
Ik moet u helaas mededelen dat de heer Vercoutre op donderdag 4 mei jl. aan de gevolgen van nierproblemen is overleden in het Rotterdams Erasmus MC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Menzis keurmerken voor wijkverpleging verplicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary about insurer Menzis requiring Kiwa quality marks for home-care staff, the threat of withheld payments, and whether such requirements are acceptable. The government answered that insurers may set quality conditions, that the Kiwa mark is a practical tool for self-employed carers, and that Menzis has improved its communication and contacted the affected carers.
An health insurer is free to set (quality) requirements for care providers as long as the content and scope of the entitlement are not restricted and the insurer fulfils its duty of care.
Een zorgverzekeraar is vrij om (kwaliteits)eisen te stellen aan zorgaanbieders zolang de inhoud en de omvang van de aanspraak hiermee niet wordt beperkt en de zorgverzekeraar zijn zorgplicht nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat Nederlandse ziekenhuizen miljoenen teveel betalen voor implantaten

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to a report that Dutch hospitals overpay for orthopaedic implants, and whether a near-25% margin should be tackled. The state secretary called the signal worrying, pointed to suggested remedies such as switching suppliers, benchmarking and joint purchasing, and said he would discuss any bottlenecks with the parties without committing to new measures.
I assume that the parties will take up these suggestions, and I am happy to discuss with them if bottlenecks emerge.
Ik ga er vanuit dat partijen deze suggesties oppakken en ik ga graag met hen in gesprek indien daarbij knelpunten naar voren komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal in Rusland in 2018

Two MPs asked the government about reports of forced labour and modern slavery among North Korean workers building a World Cup stadium in Russia, whether this breaches sanctions, and what Dutch action is possible. The minister said the reports are serious, that FIFA should investigate and that the Netherlands will press for action in EU and UN settings, while noting the sanctions do not ban such employment.
The cabinet expects FIFA to investigate this matter thoroughly and to take the results of the investigation seriously.
Het kabinet verwacht van de FIFA dat het deze zaak grondig onderzoekt en de resultaten van het onderzoek serieus neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de eerder ontvangen antwoorden op vragen aangaande wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg.

MPs Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the minister to explain how transgender care waiting lists would be reduced, whether coordinated care contracting and the rejection of separate contracting is evidence-based, the stigma of certain statements, the informed consent model, and the timeline of the quality standard. The government answered with capacity expansions, a planned quality standard by April 2018, a defence of coordinated multidisciplinary care, and that waiting times of two years are not recognised from available data.
The VUmc has decided to again substantially increase the capacity of its Knowledge and Care Centre for Gender Dysphoria for 2017, by 20%.
Het VUmc heeft besloten om voor 2017 de capaciteit van het Kennis- en Zorgcentrum voor Genderdysforie (KZcG) opnieuw fors, te weten met 20%, te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de problemen met de uitvoering van de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT)

MP Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister about midwives' complaints that the NIPT prenatal test is customer-unfriendly, with few blood-draw sites, a multi-step online payment process, and why only three laboratories perform the test. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said the payment process has been simplified and an evaluation of blood-draw locations will take place mid-May with adjustments where needed, while defending the limited number of labs on cost and quality grounds.
In mid-May an evaluation will take place of the number of blood-draw locations and their distribution across the Netherlands.
Half mei zal er een evaluatie plaatsvinden van het aantal bloedafnamelocaties en de spreiding in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gokcriminelen in het betaald voetbal

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about illegal gambling syndicates influencing Dutch professional football, including a press report on a footballer drawn into gambling and the status of the Feniks investigation. The minister answered that the Feniks investigation is complete, no players or officials are suspected of match-fixing in a related case, and the KNVB has taken prevention measures.
The criminal investigation Feniks has been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek Feniks is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat Siemens eigenaar is geworden van de operatiekamers van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis in Goes

An SP MP asked the minister about Siemens becoming owner of the operating rooms at the financially troubled ADRZ hospital in Goes, and the risks of commercial ownership for quality of care, financing trends and the competition implications of the contract. The state secretary replied that hospitals are private entities responsible for their own operations, that the hospital remains ultimately responsible for care quality under the Inspectorate's supervision, that the arrangement is a financing alternative, and that competition assessment belongs to the ACM.
Hospitals are private institutions and themselves responsible for their business operations.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private instellingen en zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het toestemmingsvereiste voor de verwerking van ROM gegevens

MP Marijnissen asked the minister whether ROM mental health data shared with SBG without explicit patient consent is unlawful, and what the government will do, including deleting data, halting callcenters, and a repair law. The state secretary answered that data sharing can continue on the basis of consent, that providers must still try to deliver under contract, that a legislative exploration is underway, and that the Chamber will be informed after consultation with the Dutch data protection authority.
I do not possess that data, so that is not for me.
Ik ben niet in het bezit van die gegevens, dus dat is niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het testen van medicijnen

An MP asks the Health Minister about pharmaceutical companies testing drugs in poor countries, including ethics and oversight of such trials, available sanctions, and reports of pressure on critics. The State Secretary says ethics is a national competence, describes EU GCP-based inspections that can lead to refusal or suspension of licences, and says he has no insight into pressure on critics though finds it unacceptable.
Ethics is par excellence a national competence, not culturally transferable, and the EU Treaties also establish this as such.
Ethiek is bij uitstek een nationale bevoegdheid en niet cultureel overdraagbaar en in de Verdragen van de Europese Unie is dit ook als zodanig vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het LUMC zich inzet om vluchtelingen aan een baan te helpen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether it is a hospital's task to create training places for refugees, how much money goes to language and support for these trainees, and whether this circumvents the numerus fixus and preferential rules for refugees. The state secretary answered that the LUMC's initiative is a matter for the institutions, that the places are apprenticeship posts under regular funding with no displacement effect, and that no numerus fixus applies to level-4 nursing.
It is the joint responsibility of training and care institutions to ensure that sufficient training places with associated practical placements are available in view of future care demand.

Het is de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van opleidings- en zorginstellingen om ervoor te zorgen dat er met het oog op de toekomstige zorgvraag voldoende opleidingsplaatsen met bijbehorende praktijkplaatsen beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de forse kritiek van de inspectie op de ZGT ziekenhuizen in Hengelo en Almelo

The SP MP Marijnissen asked the state secretary to react to the Inspectorate's critical year-talk report on ZGT hospitals in Hengelo and Almelo, including medication, emergency staffing and high mortality, and to commit to a plan restoring both hospitals to full service. The state secretary answered that the report is standard transparency, that the Inspectorate sees improvement points but no grounds for formal measures, and that it sees no link between the concentration of specialisms and quality problems, so no plan is announced.
It is the task of the IGZ to supervise healthcare institutions and, where necessary, to require improvement measures.
Het is de taak van de IGZ om toezicht te houden op zorginstellingen en waar nodig verbetermaatregelen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over acute zorg op de Zuid-Hollandse eilanden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the continuity of acute care on the South Holland islands, including emergency department pressure, ambulance response times, the role of the regional acute care body ROAZ and of municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the ROAZ is monitoring the situation, has taken steps on training and staffing, and that municipalities are not formal members but should be informed, while declining to require consultation of municipal councils.
I am aware of the signals that residents and local organisations are concerned about the future of acute care on the South Holland islands.
Ik ken de signalen dat bewoners en lokale organisaties zich zorgen maken over de toekomst van de acute zorg op de Zuid-Hollandse eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat onethische verdienmodellen van de farmaceutische industrie de prijzen voor geneesmiddelen opdrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether the price increases of four medicines bought by Essential Pharmaceuticals, which push patients into co-payments, are unethical and what can be done. The state secretary answered that price increases are legal, that the company refused to lower prices or disclose cost structures, that a maximum price has been set only for Camcolit, and that no means exist to recover costs from the manufacturer.
I cannot enforce this transparency, but it is very regrettable that Essential Pharmaceuticals has so far given no justification for the price increase
Ik kan deze transparantie niet afdwingen, maar het is zeer te betreuren dat Essential Pharmaceuticals tot op heden geen onderbouwing geeft van de prijsverhoging
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de risico’s van een curettage na een miskraam of tijdens een abortus provocatus

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked about risks of curettage after miscarriage or abortion, including a possible shift toward expectant management and whether all women are fully informed of risks beforehand. The Secretary of State replied that curettage is considered safe, that alternatives exist and are used when medically indicated, that professional guidelines are updated with new evidence, and that the WGBO already requires risk information, with a planned WGBO amendment pending at the Raad van State.
Furthermore, together with the Minister of Security and Justice, I am preparing an amendment to the WGBO.
Verder bereid ik samen met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie een wijziging voor van de WGBO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veertig Nederlanders de Amerikaanse fabrikant van Bekkenbodem- en liesbreukmatjes Johnson en Johnson voor de rechter dagen wegens blijvende schad

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the reported lawsuit by about forty patients against Johnson & Johnson over pelvic floor mesh harm, and about related issues such as compensation, implant removal, information provision and market approval. The state secretary answered that the problem is regrettable, pointed to new EU medical device rules and the Wkkgz complaints regime, rejected a dedicated compensation fund, and said existing care and reporting rules already apply.
I cannot assess whether there is a case of inadequate measures here.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of er in dit geval sprake is van inadequate maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat honderden mensen per jaar worden opgenomen door onjuist gebruik van pijnstillers

An MP asked the minister how patients will be warned about dangerous use of opioid painkillers such as oxycodone combined with alcohol, why there are no precise national figures on deaths from painkiller misuse, and whether prescribing should be limited to three months. The state secretary replied that the CBG and Lareb see insufficient reason for additional measures, that prescribers are responsible for patient information, that no national registry of such deaths exists, and that the ministry is consulting stakeholders on implementing medication safety recommendations, while declining to restrict prescribing duration.
There are no exact figures known on possible deaths from misuse of medicines because there is no national registration of such deaths.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen bekend van mogelijke sterfgevallen door verkeerd gebruik van geneesmiddelen omdat er geen landelijke registratie is van dergelijke sterfgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat de topinkomens in de zorgsector explosief zijn gestegen

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether top incomes in the healthcare sector had risen sharply, why the Governance Code failed to stop this, and what action would be taken against healthcare executives earning above the Balkenende norm. The state secretary answered that the WNT applies to the sector, that the reported tripling is inaccurate because medical specialists were included who fall outside the WNT, that the Governance Code sets no pay limits, and that the WNT will be enforced by the CIBG where violations occur.
In case of violations, the WNT supervisor in healthcare, the CIBG, will enforce the law.
Bij overtredingen zal de toezichthouder op de WNT in de zorg, het CIBG, de wet handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onvoldoende middelen en capaciteit bij het Expertisebureau Online Kindermisbruik

An SP member asked the Justice and Health ministers about insufficient funding and capacity at the Expertise Bureau Online Child Abuse (EOKM), including police follow-up on Tor reports, proactive search powers, hosting provider takedown, sexting and sextortion support, Stop It Now funding and child sex tourism campaigns. The minister answered that current funding is considered adequate for now, that the police handle reports through a prioritisation process, that the EOKM has no investigative powers, and that other initiatives and funding decisions are being reviewed.
I will await this plan before entering further discussions with the EOKM about its future intentions.
Ik wacht dit plan af alvorens met het EOKM verder in gesprek te gaan over hun toekomstige voornemens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de waarschuwing van 120 huisartsen voor de dreigende fusie tussen het Havenziekenhuis in Rotterdam met het IJssellandziekenhuis in Capelle aan den IJssel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether converting Havenziekenhuis Rotterdam into a polyclinic after a merger with IJsselland Ziekenhuis would reduce access to care for elderly patients, and whether the state should intervene. The minister replied that the polyclinic care continues, nearby hospitals remain accessible, the NZa and ACM will assess any merger, and the state sees no reason to intervene since care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers.
The organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of the care providers and health insurers involved.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het conflict tussen de directie en radiologen in het Zuyderlandziekenhuis in Heerlen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the conflict between the board and radiologists at Zuyderland hospital, its impact on care quality, and conflicts of interest from radiologists owning shares in a private clinic. The state secretary answered that the IGZ has no signals of compromised care quality, that the hospital is not the employer of the radiologists, and that the governance code addresses conflicts of interest, while rejecting the premise that market forces prioritise competition over care.
If the IGZ receives signals that the quality and safety of care are at stake, it will act on them directly.
Indien de IGZ signalen bereiken dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid van zorg in het geding zijn zal zij hier direct naar handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat ook Nederlandse bedrijven vlees van Braziliaanse vleessjoemelaars afnemen

An SP MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs state secretaries whether rotten meat from Brazilian firms JBS and BRF reached Dutch shops or restaurants, and what the NVWA was doing. The government replied that the NVWA found no sign of contaminated meat on the Dutch market, has rejected many shipments and intensified inspections, and will not recall products, while noting a possible import ban is among the options.
I do not have access to the administration of individual companies.
Ik heb geen inzage in de administratie van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de toekomst van het Besthesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen en het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about the future of the Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen and Refaja hospital in Stadskanaal, including obstetrics, level 3 emergency care, loss of eye care, and dialogue with the region. The State Secretary answered that nothing has changed since earlier answers, obstetrics and emergency care remain guaranteed, Treant plans regional dialogue, and the regional acute care working group's conclusions are expected before summer.
For all hospital locations of Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal and Scheper in Emmen), clinical and acute obstetrics is available 24/7.
Voor alle ziekenhuislocaties van de Treant Zorggroep (Bethesda in Hoogeveen, Refaja in Stadskanaal en Scheper in Emmen) geldt dat de klinische en acute verloskunde 24/7 voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat amateursportclubs het niet redden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that many amateur sports clubs, especially football clubs, struggle financially and with volunteers, and whether club numbers are falling. The Staatssecretaris answered that support lies mainly with sports federations and municipalities, pointed to existing programmes and tools, and said the number of clubs fell only modestly through mergers while membership per club stayed flat.
Responsibility for supporting sports clubs lies with the sports federations and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de ondersteuning van de sportverenigingen ligt bij de sportbonden en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de tijdelijke opvang van ouderen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a reported explosive growth in temporary care for elderly patients after hospital discharge, and about insurers paying less than the full cost of a 'recovery hotel' stay. The state secretary disputed the claimed doubling of demand, explained the insurance rules and maximum tariffs for first-line stays, and said the NZa as regulator is responsible for enforcing the duty of care, with a future NZa report possibly prompting talks with insurers.
The NZa quick scan sent to the House on 22 December 2016 shows no signs that insufficient care was contracted for 2016 and 2017.
Antwoord 6 Uit de quikscan van de NZa 3 , die uw Kamer op 22 december 2016 is toegestuurd, blijkt dat er geen signalen zijn dat er voor 2016 en 2017 onvoldoende zorg is ingekocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het feit dat voor de zoveelste keer een zelfmoord wordt gepleegd ten gevolge van sexting

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about a suicide linked to sexting and bullying, asking about school responsibility, investigation, victim support, internet providers, the Dutch Data Protection Authority budget, the Kindertelefoon, and legal action. The state secretary answered that school anti-bullying duties and sexting education exist, that a police investigation is ongoing, and that IP-address identification is increasingly unreliable, while stating that bullying itself is not a crime.
The police are currently investigating this case both online and offline.
De politie is op dit moment zowel online als offline bezig met een onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over de subsidieregeling Energiebesparing en duurzame energie sportaccommodaties die opnieuw overvraagd wordt

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked whether the energy-saving subsidy scheme for sports facilities was again oversubscribed within days, and about the scale of applications, the effect on club finances, and whether more funding would be provided. The State Secretary reported 583 applications totalling about 6.7 million euros as of 1 March 2017 with half still under review, gave breakdowns by measure and sport, estimated the cost of full coverage, and said the government will not add extra funds but will reuse unspent 2016 money.
I have previously informed you that this cabinet is not willing to make extra funds available for this subsidy scheme.
Ik heb u eerder laten weten dat dit kabinet niet bereid is om extra middelen vrij te maken voor deze subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de noodkreet van transgenders over veel te lange wachtlijsten

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about lengthening waiting lists for gender clinics, rising referral numbers, risks from self-medication with hormones, whether Treek norms apply, specialist shortages, and whether a national network is desirable. Minister Schippers answered that referrals are rising, that providers and insurers must spread care and recruit staff, that the NZa has asked providers to publish waiting times without a Treek norm, and that a quality standard is being developed.
I believe providers and health insurers must work hard on spreading this care, scaling up chain treatment and recruiting staff.
Ik vind dat aanbieders en zorgverzekeraars hard moeten werken aan spreiding van deze zorg, het opschalen van ketenbehandeling en het werven van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de protesten tegen het verplicht in moeten vullen en aan moeten leveren van routine outcome measure (Rom) gegevens in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about protests against mandatory Routine Outcome Measurement (ROM) data collection and submission in mental health care, raising concerns about privacy, informed consent, reliability of data, and SBG's independence and financing. The Minister defends ROM as a standard set by sector parties, argues SBG's data is pseudonymised and privacy-protected, acknowledges that consent is the legal basis after the Dutch Data Protection Authority's ruling, and says a legislative review may be needed.

Obtaining explicit patient consent is one of the grounds. Since the consent requirement became the only legal basis for ROM after the AP ruling, I am consulting with parties and the AP, and I want to see whether further legislation is needed.

Het verkrijgen van expliciete toestemming van de patiënt is een van de grondslagen. Omdat het toestemmingsvereiste sinds de genoemde uitspraak van de AP de enige wettelijke grondslag is voor ROM, ben ik in overleg met partijen en de AP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de financiële relatie tussen de gemeenten en het rijk verstoord is

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about advice from the Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen on simplifying the state-municipality finance system, multi-year certainty for municipal funding, earmarking social-domain budgets, and a CBS report on municipal reserves; the government answered that the review is ongoing, that the normering system is independent of social-domain cuts, that earmarking is rejected in favour of spending freedom with monitoring via Iv3 and the overall social-domain report, and that the CBS figures were not wrong. The answers are largely defensive, deferring to later decisions and reports, while committing to forward the review and reports.
The cabinet is of the view that spending conditions do not fit the principle of the decentralisations, namely policy and spending freedom at municipal level, within the legal framework.

Het kabinet is van mening dat bestedingsvoorwaarden niet passen bij het uitgangspunt van de decentralisaties, namelijk beleidsvrijheid en bestedingsvrijheid op gemeentelijk niveau, binnen de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops over de lobby om het Europese geneesmiddelenagentschap naar Nederland te halen

Two CDA MPs asked why the government focuses its bid to host the European Medicines Agency on a site near Schiphol and whether South Limburg was considered. The minister answered that Schiphol's accessibility and facilities best meet the agency's criteria and that South Limburg was assessed but offers fewer connections, while declining to commit to including South Limburg in the bid.
The Netherlands wants to put the best possible bid on the table, and the cabinet believes the Netherlands creates the most promising offer with an EMA location near Schiphol.
Nederland wil het best mogelijke bod op tafel leggen en het kabinet is van mening dat Nederland het meest kansrijke aanbod creëert met een locatie van de EMA in de nabijheid van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het Q-koorts kompas en het advies van Brabantadvies

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the Q-fever compass published by Q-support and a BrabantAdvies warning that Q-fever knowledge and experience may be lost, asking whether patients get adequate support and whether the advice will be adopted. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports but deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming letter covering all Q-fever advice.
In the letter of 21 February on the committee's request for a response to the BrabantAdvies advice, we indicated that we wish to inform the House comprehensively on all Q-fever advice.

In de brief van 21 februari jl naar aanleiding van de vraag van de vaste Kamercommissie om een reactie op het advies van BrabantAdvies is aangegeven dat wij de Kamer graag in samenhang willen berichten over alle adviezen over Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Leijten over overname van huishoudelijke verzorging door Tzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the planned transfer of home-care services from Amstelring to Tzorg, including worker consultation, wage and terms-of-employment protection, and municipal oversight. The government answered that the Autoriteit Consument & Markt is reviewing the takeover, that works councils approved it after conditions were agreed, that transfer rules protect workers' rights, and that municipalities are monitoring compliance.
It is not for me to assess these plans.
Het is niet aan mij om deze plannen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een bestuurder 65.000 euro kreeg zonder een dag te werken

An MP asked the minister about a care executive who received a 65,000 euro severance payment without working for the organisation, whether this complies with the WNT pay-cap law, how often such arrangements occur, and about appointment favouritism and oversight failures at Vivantes. The government answered that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary (max 75,000 euro) and sees no need to change it, that the supervisor found no such cases in 2014–2015, that the supervisory board failed and is resigning, and that the inspectorate will monitor the situation.
The supervisory board clearly did not function properly.
De raad van toezicht heeft duidelijk niet goed gefunctioneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over seksueel misbruik in de sport

The SP MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how she responds to calls to address sexual abuse in sport, including mandatory central reporting, a national reporting point, and a dedicated sports investigation body. The Minister replies that an independent NOC*NSF investigation is pending, that existing disciplinary rules and a cooperation protocol with police and prosecutors are being developed, and that no further measures will be decided until its outcome is known.
Based on the outcomes of the investigation, it can be decided whether additional measures are necessary.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek kan worden besloten of extra maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over een ZEMBLA-uitzending over de gezondheidseffecten van rubbergranulaat

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a ZEMBLA broadcast on health effects of rubber granulate on sports pitches warranted new measures or a different RIVM advice, and how the tyre industry's norm compares to EU and RIVM norms. The minister answered that the broadcast does not change RIVM's advice that safe use of the pitches is possible, that RIVM will consider the unpublished study once published, and that the industry norm is stricter than the existing EU limits while the government aims to lower it further.
As long as it is not known which substances in which concentrations were found by the VU, RIVM cannot make a statement
Zolang niet bekend is welke stoffen in welke concentraties door de VU zijn aangetroffen, kan het RIVM geen uitspraak doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Pechtold over het bericht dat de benodigde gelden voor Huntington onderzoek niet op tafel komen

D66 MPs Pechtold and Pia Dijkstra asked whether the Health Ministry told Huntington researchers to seek the required 4 million euro elsewhere, whether this matches the minister's promised support, and whether the money should be provided quickly. Minister Schippers answered that ministry staff assisted in contacting RVO, Life Sciences & Health, NWO and ZonMw, that the ministry has no innovation fund for the sum, and that drug development is primarily the pharmaceutical industry's responsibility, while promising to keep assisting.
However, I did commit to support the researchers in finding other possible sources of funding.
Wel heb ik toegezegd om de onderzoekers te ondersteunen bij het vinden van andere mogelijke financieringsbronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de door het Europees Parlement aangenomen resolutie over matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will criminalise match-fixing as a specific offence following a European Parliament resolution, and whether further research is warranted. The Minister replied that no specific offence is being studied, as current fraud, bribery, money laundering and forgery provisions are considered sufficient.
A specific criminal offence for match-fixing is not being investigated.
Een specifieke strafbaarstelling van matchfixing wordt niet onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Veel sportclubs melden seksueel overschrijdend gedrag niet bij instanties’, ‘Bij elke club kan een verborgen camera in de kleedkamer hangen’ en 'Vertr

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked the ministers about reports that many sports clubs do not report sexual misconduct, the Vertrouwenspunt Sport of NOC*NSF, and the need for a reporting code, VOG checks, a blacklist and independent research. The minister answered that reporting should be encouraged, that the independent research will inform further measures, that a VOG is voluntary (free) rather than mandatory in sport, and that an independent inquiry will be supported financially.
It is important that it is a high-quality study that makes use of the knowledge and experience gained in recent times from earlier studies in other sectors.

Het is van belang dat het een kwalitatief goed onderzoek is waarbij gebruik wordt gemaakt van de kennis en ervaringen die in de afgelopen tijd zijn opgedaan bij eerdere onderzoeken in andere sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht '15-jarige scholier pleegt zelfmoord na pesterijen'

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers how the government will act on bullying after a 15-year-old pupil took her life, including whether an independent investigation will be launched and what is done to prevent bullying. The state secretary answers that school-safety law, inspection oversight and an ongoing joint inspectorate review are in place, that an independent review into the authorities' conduct is underway, and that specific national suicide-by-bullying figures are not available.
Under the banner of the Social Domain Supervision/Joint Youth Supervision (TSD/STJ), a preliminary investigation is currently taking place.
Onder de vlag van het Toezicht Sociaal Domein/Samenwerkend Toezicht Jeugd (TSD/STJ) vindt momenteel een vooronderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over niet heimelijk euthanasie plegen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health whether euthanasia in advanced dementia, based on written declarations and without the patient's current consent, is legally and ethically sound after specialists criticised such cases. The Minister defended the Wtl framework, said one of three reviewed cases was judged not careful by the Rte and referred to IGZ and OM, and declined to tighten the rules or the handreiking.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Hoe de lobby het rubber in het gras hield'

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about press reports on industry lobbying over rubber granulate in artificial turf and whether the Netherlands shifted from treating it as an article to a mixture under REACH. The government answered that it reversed its position to align with the European Commission and most member states, that the health risk to sports users was judged low, and that it did not commit to a new national action beyond pursuing a lower EU norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Elke dag kijk ik in haar kamer of ze nog leeft!”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports of long waiting lists for eating disorder clinics, whether young people who have not responded to Dutch treatment should be able to try therapy abroad, and whether the government would commission advice on options at home and abroad. The Minister gave waiting time figures, pointed to a new care standard in preparation and to insurers' and the NZa's role, said treatment abroad must be proven effective to be reimbursed, and declined to request advice for now.
For now I see no reason to request advice in this area.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om op dit gebied om een advies te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuiken over het bericht dat een Brabantse amateurvoetbalclub vier voetballertjes heeft weggestuurd omdat ze te weinig lootjes hebben verkocht

MPs Van Dekken and Kuiken asked the minister whether an amateur football club was right to expel four children for not selling enough lottery tickets, whether minors can be obliged to sell tickets, and what legal recourse parents have. The minister answered that the club has since reconciled with the parents and the children are welcome back, that clubs may impose obligations on members via their statutes, and that members may appeal a royement internally and then to the civil courts.
A royement can only be imposed if the member acts in breach of the association's statutes, regulations or decisions, or if the association is unreasonably harmed.
Een royement kan alleen worden uitgesproken als het lid in strijd handelt met de statuten, reglementen of besluiten van de vereniging of de vereniging op onredelijke wijze benadeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over jongeren die in een psychiatrische kliniek belanden na sexting

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising psychiatric admissions of young people after sexting, whether it should be criminalised, who the victims are, and whether clinics are prepared. The government answered that existing criminal law (art. 240b, 240, 139f/g, 266, 261, 262, 284, 138ab Sr) suffices, that prevention and parental/school education are being expanded, and that trauma care via CSGs and specialised youth psychiatry exists, while committing only to an ongoing study of victims' reporting motives.
As my predecessor indicated in the letter of 29 February 2016 to the House, there is no reason to amend the criminal law in connection with sexting.
Zoals mijn ambtsvoorganger in de brief van 29 februari 2016 aan uw Kamer heeft aangegeven is voor aanpassing van de strafwet in verband met «sexting» geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de fusie van ziekenhuizen in Hoogeveen en Emmen leidt tot ernstige verschraling van de zorg in Hoogeveen

MPs Voortman and Van Gerven asked whether Treant's plan to end intensive care at Bethesda Hoogeveen and Refaja Stadskanaal, keeping it only in Emmen, and related changes to emergency and obstetric care were acceptable, and what the minister would do to prevent hospitals in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal being stripped. The minister said the organisation of care is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, that emergency and obstetric care remain in place, and that she expects Treant to engage in real dialogue with the region, while declining to judge the decision itself.
The accessibility and availability of care provision is the primary responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het zorgaanbod is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die nog altijd de restitutietarieven voor niet-gecontracteerde geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) niet bekend hebben gemaakt

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why insurers Menzis, VGZ and De Friesland had not yet published restitution tariffs for non-contracted mental health care, and whether this discouraged care and warranted enforcement. Minister Schippers attributed the delay to late NZa tariff decisions after an insurers' appeal, said the tariffs were now published, that continuity of care was not at risk, and that current rules were adequate.
The health insurers have informed me that, due to the late publication of the NZa tariffs, they were able to publish their list of maximum reimbursements for non-contracted care later than planned.

De zorgverzekeraars hebben mij laten weten dat zij door de late bekendmaking van de NZa-tarieven hun lijst met maximale vergoedingen voor niet-gecontracteerde zorg later dan gepland hebben kunnen publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermue over de online verkoop van medicijnen

An MP asked the Health Minister about online sales of prescription-only medicines such as Dormicum via websites, whether this breaks the law, and what the inspectorate and European partners are doing. The minister answered that the sale is illegal, the inspectorate had the first website taken offline but the operator moved abroad, the investigation into another site continues, and an awareness campaign has reached many visitors.
The inspectorate investigated this website, but the holder of this website cannot be traced.
De inspectie heeft onderzoek gedaan naar deze website, maar de houder van deze website is niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over nieuwe onderzoek naar de effectiviteit van medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the health minister about insurers dropping medicinal cannabis coverage, morphine side effects as an alternative, exports to Germany, and the scope of research by the Zorginstituut. The minister said insurers decide coverage, cannabis remains available on prescription, and a Zorginstituut round-table will examine whether a further advice on effectiveness is possible.
It is up to the health insurers to decide whether or not to reimburse.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om te beslissen of zij wel of niet vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voortgang van de gesprekken met de Huntington-onderzoekers en het Campagneteam Huntington

The MP asks whether the minister has held the promised talks with Huntington researchers and the Huntington campaign team about funding a breakthrough, and what their progress and results are. The minister answers that VWS staff and the Life Sciences & Health top sector met them, that RVO is exploring European and TKI funding options, and that outcomes will be discussed with all parties at the end of February.
At the end of February, the researchers, the campaign team, RVO and the top sector LSH will jointly discuss the outcomes and next steps.
Eind februari zullen de onderzoekers, het Campagneteam, RVO en de topsector LSH samen de uitkomsten en vervolgstappen bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het toch niet beschikbaar komen van canules voor de heer Vercoutre, waarmee hij kan praten en hij minder benauwd is

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why a manufacturer no longer produces custom tracheostomy cannulas for ventilated patient Rene Vercoutre, leaving him unable to speak and more breathless, and what the government can do. The minister answered that the original mould no longer exists, that tailored replacements were supplied with insurer funding, that a suitable solution has not yet been found, and that alternatives are being explored.
I have learned that efforts are currently still being made to look for possible alternatives.
Ik heb vernomen dat men momenteel nog verder zoekt naar mogelijke alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over blootstelling aan schadelijke minerale oliën via verpakkingen van voedsel

An MP asked the Minister of Health about consumer exposure to mineral oils from food packaging, asking whether monitoring delays justify interim measures, how monitoring and toxicological research are coordinated in Europe, and whether results will be published. The minister answered that monitoring will take time and binding norms are not expected soon, that industry measures are underway, that there is insufficient insight into interim measures, and that publication of results depends on factors including monitoring coverage.
Regarding publication of the monitoring data, the NVWA aims to make the results public.
Wat de openbaarmaking van de monitoringgegevens betreft, is het streven van de NVWA om resultaten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over slechte beveiliging van ziekenhuiswebsites

An MP asks the Health and Justice ministers about poor security of hospital websites, citing reports that many hospitals lack encrypted connections and that patient data may leak. The minister acknowledges the problem, places primary responsibility on hospitals under the Wbp and NEN norms with supervision by the AP and IGZ, and promises an action plan on patient data security.
Information security and privacy protection are first and foremost the responsibility of the healthcare provider itself.
Informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming zijn in de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Waar blijven de jodiumpillen tegen de gevolgen van een kernramp’

An MP asks why iodine tablets promised in March 2016 for pregnant women and under-18s within 100 km of nuclear plants have not yet been distributed, and why the group excludes residents under 40 elsewhere. The minister says a distribution plan is being drafted with a letter to parliament expected by April, that the age limits follow neighbouring countries and radiation physics, and that predistribution is targeted for 2017.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this by April at the latest.
Ik verwacht dat ik uiterlijk in april uw Kamer hierover kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bouwmeester over een uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over medezeggenschap in zorginstellingen

MPs Dik-Faber and Bouwmeester asked the minister how a Supreme Court ruling on client councils in care institutions affects participation, including plans for local councils, budgets and timing of the new law. The minister answered that she will clarify the level of participation in the new bill, requiring per-location councils on request, guarantee facilities and funding, but declined to take immediate measures and gave a timeline of submission after Council of State advice.
I will make the desired clarification in the bill for a new Client Participation in Care Institutions Act.
Ik zal de gewenste verduidelijking aanbrengen in het wetsvoorstel voor een nieuwe Wet medezeggenschap cliënten zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de veiligheid in operatiekamers onder druk staat door een tekort aan operatieassistenten en verpleegkundigen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that operating-theatre safety is under pressure from shortages of surgical assistants and nurses, including whether non-qualified nurses perform theatre tasks, nurse sick leave, training capacity cuts and the rise of agency work. The Minister answered that staffing and safety are primarily the employers' responsibility, that the Capacity Body sees national supply as just sufficient and advises expanding training, and that she will monitor employers' efforts and act if needed.
Ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care provided in a hospital are the board members and internal supervisory directors.
Eindverantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg in een ziekenhuis zijn de bestuurders en interne toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen arme patiënten gratis overgebleven medicijnen geven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that GPs give leftover medicines free to patients who cannot afford care, and about conflicting evidence on care avoidance caused by the deductible. The Minister says the GP survey does not establish frequency, opposes handing out medicines outside the pharmacy, and argues non-financial reasons also explain care avoidance while listing existing compensation measures.
I consider it undesirable that people avoid necessary care for financial reasons.
Ik vind het ongewenst als mensen vanwege financiële redenen noodzakelijke zorg mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht 'Amsterdamse ziekenhuizen moeten zwangeren weigeren'

Labour MP Wolbert asks the health minister about Amsterdam hospitals turning away pregnant women due to lack of obstetric beds, the closure of MC Slotervaart's maternity ward, and who is responsible. Minister Schippers answers that regional bodies (ROAZ) and insurers should address capacity, that no incidents are known to the inspectorate, and that the NZa will assess continuity of care without committing to a specific government intervention.
Without a thorough analysis of these figures, I cannot give a judgement on that.
Zonder een gedegen analyse van deze cijfers kan ik daar geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de uitvoering van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about implementation of the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), including the government's stance on a CEDAW Committee recommendation to compensate self-employed women who gave birth in 2005, sexism, intersex and transgender care, abortion pill rules, sex work registration, and a conference. The government answered most questions by restating its positions, citing pending Centrale Raad van Beroep cases, and promising to inform parliament of outcomes.
Several procedures are currently pending before the Central Appeals Tribunal. The cabinet is waiting for those rulings.
Er lopen nu enkele procedures bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Die uitspraken wacht het kabinet af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de forse toename van wachttijden in ziekenhuizen en poliklinieken

An MP asks the Minister of Health why waiting times in hospitals and outpatient clinics rose from 2014 to 2016 according to Mediquest, whether this shows a structural problem, and whether the budget and revenue-cap system causes waiting lists. The Minister replies that average waits remain within the Treeknorm, that the NZa is investigating whether long waits breach insurers' duty of care, and that transparency rules and insurer wait-list mediation already apply.
The NZa is additionally examining to what extent longer waiting times are problematic for citizens and actually lead to insurers failing to meet their duty of care.
De NZa onderzoekt daarnaast in hoeverre lange(re) wachttijden problematisch zijn voor burgers en daadwerkelijk leiden tot het niet naleven van de zorgplicht door zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de monopoliepositie van het Vu medisch centrum (VUmc) in de transgenderzorg

An MP asked whether the LUMC stopping gender clinic care for new patients would create a monopoly for VUmc in transgender care, and how this fits with 2014 motions calling for alternative locations. The minister said the LUMC/Curium will continue existing patients, that VUmc is the only full-trajectory provider, that spreading care is being discussed with partners and will be put on the agenda of the next periodic consultation.
I intend to put the issue of spreading care back on the agenda at the upcoming periodic consultation with all parties, which is planned for next spring.
Ik ben voornemens om tijdens het komende periodieke overleg met alle betrokken partijen dat voor aankomend voorjaar weer in de planning staat, het onderwerp spreiding van zorg opnieuw te agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht van bestuursvoorzitter van het VU medisch centrum: Wouter Bos bepleit winstplafond voor farmabedrijven

An MP asked the health minister whether she supports a profit cap on pharmaceutical companies, proposed by a hospital director, and whether her existing pricing policy is adequate. The minister agrees excessive margins are undesirable but rejects a profit cap as unworkable due to international operation, enforcement difficulties and EU law, while pointing to transparency demands and a package of pricing and business-model measures.
Requiring pharmaceutical companies to make the development costs of a medicine transparent is not simply possible.
Farmaceutische bedrijven verplichten tot het inzichtelijk maken van de ontwikkelkosten van een medicijn is overigens niet zomaar mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te strenge limieten voor topsporters

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether Dutch Olympic qualification limits for athletes are too strict compared with other countries, and why. The minister replied that setting selection criteria is the responsibility of Dutch sport (NOC*NSF and the federations), not the government, and declined to change the limits or to engage with the federations.
It is up to Dutch sport itself to set the conditions for qualifying for dispatch to major international events.
Het is aan de Nederlandse sport zelf om voorwaarden te stellen om in aanmerking te komen voor uitzending naar grote internationale evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht: “Fiscus geeft oude maatschap nieuwe kans”

An MP asked the Health Minister whether tax authority rulings allowing former medical partnerships to be re-established undermine the policy of salaried specialists and integrated funding. The minister answered that there is no return to old partnership structures, that the tax assessment framework is unchanged, and that the government has no preference between the salaried and participation models.
The assessment framework for entrepreneurship has not changed.
Het beoordelingskader van het ondernemerschap is niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onderzoek naar seksueel misbruik in de sport

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about NOC*NSF's planned investigation into sexual abuse in Dutch sport, including its scope, support from the ministry, concrete measures, cooperation with police and prosecutors, and aftercare for athletes. The minister welcomed the sector-led investigation, said it would be independent and that the ministry had offered expertise without a funding request, and described existing prevention, complaint, disciplinary and reporting arrangements.
NOC*NSF has the investigation carried out independently.
NOC*NSF laat het onderzoek onafhankelijk uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding van het exoskelet (ingezonden 17 december 2015).

An MP asked the health minister about reimbursement of an exoskeleton for a paraplegic patient who wanted to keep it after a trial and had to crowdfund, and whether such innovations should be funded and made widely available. The minister's follow-up answer relays the Health Care Institute's view that the exoskeleton falls under the Health Insurance Act but is not yet covered because evidence of effectiveness is insufficient, and that it is too early for conditional admission to the basic package.

The Health Care Institute considers that this exoskeleton does not (yet) meet the criterion 'state of science and practice' because there is still insufficient evidence of the positive effects of using an exoskeleton.

Het Zorginstituut is van oordeel dat dit exoskelet (nog) niet voldoet aan het criterium «stand van de wetenschap en praktijk» omdat er nog onvoldoende bewijs is van de positieve effecten van het gebruik van een exoskelet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over jong ouderschap

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary how municipalities can better use decentralisation to support young parents, avoid new silos, handle the region-binding rule for shelters, address housing access, administrative burdens, preventive funding, education support and consultations with FIOM and Siriz. The state secretary answered that municipalities are implementing the transition locally and are supported via guidance and monitoring, that no national data exists on homeless teen mothers and a study is planned, and promised to report back in May and after the Voorjaarsnota.
These figures are not registered in a way that allows a national overview to be generated.
Deze cijfers worden niet geregistreerd op een wijze waarmee landelijk overzicht kan worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het aanvragen van een invalidenparkeerkaart door zorginstellingen die niet onder de Wet Toelating Zorginstellingen (WTZi) vallen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Health about care institutions not covered by the WTZi being denied disabled parking permits, and whether an exception should be created. The state secretary said the permit rules sit with the Infrastructure ministry and that he wants no distinction by funding route and will examine with that ministry whether the regulation can be amended.
I will examine together with Infrastructure and Environment whether the regulations can be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal samen met Infrastructuur en Milieu bezien of de regelgeving op dit punt kan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de door een farmaceutisch bedrijf opgezette website ‘Dokter Jaap’ dat huisartsen benadert om erectiepillen voor te schrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether the website 'Dokter Jaap', set up with Eli Lilly, which approaches GPs to prescribe erectile dysfunction pills to men who left their data, is lawful and acceptable, including its unsecured email handling of health data. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ is investigating the website and its parties, that GDPR-style consent rules and medical confidentiality apply and the AP may investigate, and that she has no information on GP approaches or other similar websites.
The IGZ has informed me that it is investigating the website and the working methods of the parties involved.
De IGZ heeft mij laten weten dat zij de website en de werkwijze van de betrokken partijen onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de financiering van zorg voor kwetsbare ggz-patiënten bij Arkin

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about Zilveren Kruis Achmea's refusal to pay Arkin over €10 million for mental health care to vulnerable patients, and whether this endangers care and breaches contracts. The Minister answered that the dispute is a private contract matter for the independent dispute body and courts, that insurers have a care duty, and that she sees no need to change wait-list oversight or the Zvw/Wlz boundary now, though an uitvoeringstoets on Wlz access is pending.
This concerns a contract between a care provider and a health insurer. I am not a party to it.
Het betreft hier een contract tussen een zorgaanbieder en een zorgverzekeraar. Ik ben daarin geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars steeds vaker op de stoel van de arts gaan zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister whether insurers overriding specialists' referrals for rehabilitation care, and demanding medical data, breaches the insurers' duty of care and amounts to risk selection. The minister answered that insurers may check entitlement and refuse prior approval on care grounds, that complaints can go to the NZa, and that she would not intervene directly, while the NZa is responsible for enforcing the duty of care.
If a patient believes they are unjustly kept waiting, or a procedure lasts 'months' without the insurer intervening, they can report this to the NZa.
Mocht een patiënt van mening zijn dat hij onterecht moet wachten, of een procedure duurt «maandenlang» zonder dat de zorgverzekeraar ingrijpt, dan kan hij dat melden bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Leijten over het bericht dat kinder IC’s in Nederland vol zouden zitten

MPs Bruins Slot and Leijten asked whether all Dutch paediatric intensive care units were full in December 2016, forcing cancelled elective surgery and transfers abroad, and about capacity, staffing, oversight and discharge problems. The minister confirmed that all eight PICUs were full, that some elective operations were postponed for at least three weeks and ten children were transferred to Belgian and German hospitals, while noting the IGZ was informed and that the NVK and hospital heads will analyse causes and propose improvements.
I expect the PICUs to implement these quickly.
Ik verwacht van de PICU’s dat ze één en ander snel doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘Een tragische gebeurtenis in Tergooi’ van de onderzoekscommissie Meurs

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Meurs commission report on the death of a 21-year-old patient at Tergooi hospital, including whether the settlement agreement amounted to an unacceptable gag clause, whether the hospital board and IGZ bear responsibility, and whether calamity definitions and the ban on restrictive settlements should change. The minister acknowledged the agreement contained undesirable confidentiality terms, said the board is responsible for it, reported fines and a disciplinary complaint, defended the current calamity-reporting policy, and promised a letter on settlements in Q1 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tienduizenden spiraaltjes worden teruggeroepen

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the recall of tens of thousands of Mirena contraceptive coils, covering when and how the defect was found, prevention, which women are affected, and where to report problems. The minister answered that the recall was agreed with the IGZ and CBG, that at most 200 coils from the batch may be faulty, that the fabricator issued professional notices and advised echo checks for unchecked insertions, and that reporting points are available.
It cannot be said how many of the 200 possibly incorrectly assembled coils were dispensed in the Netherlands.
Het is niet te zeggen hoeveel van de 200 mogelijk verkeerd geassembleerde spiralen er in Nederland uitgegeven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how the Council of State ruling that the NZa rightly refused to disclose per-provider DIS claims data affects transparency, whether prices count as confidential business information, and whether the law should change. The Minister answered that the ruling does not stop the goal of price transparency, that the NZa is preparing a traject for public access to hospital tariffs in 2017, and that no legislative change is needed.
The ruling on DIS data on declared care products per provider does nothing to diminish the importance of increasing insight for patients and insured persons into hospital tariffs.
De uitspraak over DIS-gegevens over gedeclareerde zorgproducten per zorgaanbieder doet niets af aan het belang om voor patiënten en verzekerden inzicht in de ziekenhuistarieven te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de uitzending van Zembla waaruit blijkt dat cliënten onvoldoende gewezen worden op de risico’s bij Lasik-oogchirurgie

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister, after a Zembla broadcast, whether patients receive inadequate warnings about Lasik risks and whether clinics misleadingly market the surgery, and whether the inspectorate should intervene. The minister answered that providers must inform patients under the WGBO, that she sees no reason yet for re-evaluation or closures, and that the inspectorate will act only on signals of acute danger.
Based on this broadcast, it is insufficiently clear to me whether patients have been adequately informed.
Het is voor mij op basis van deze uitzending onvoldoende duidelijk of patiënten voldoende zijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat artsen vaker kiezen voor pillen van farmaceuten waarvan zij sponsorgeld ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports that doctors prescribe more expensive drugs from pharma companies that sponsor them, and whether sponsorship, visits and the Transparency Register explain this and should be restricted. The minister answered that the data cannot show extra spending or causation, leaves follow-up research to insurers, and rejects an immediate ban on sponsorship and doctor visits.
The research does not indicate how much extra money has been spent as a result.
Het onderzoek geeft niet aan hoeveel extra geld hierdoor is uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Oudere kankerpatiënt krijgt andere behandeling dan jongere”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about an IKNL report finding that older cancer patients receive different treatment than younger ones, with large hospital variation. The Minister says care should be tailored, that variation should be examined through regional Comprehensive Cancer Networks, and sees no reason to start separate talks with parties.
At this moment I see no reason to enter into separate discussions with parties about this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier apart over met partijen in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht “ Duitse minister: nepvlees mag geen schnitzel heten”

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether vegetarian products may use meat-related names such as 'schnitzel' and whether the Netherlands would follow a German proposed ban. The minister answered that such names are not per se misleading if labelling is clear, that the NVWA enforces against consumer deception including online, and that no national ban is planned because consumers have not reported problems.

When meatless products use terms that are (also) customary for meat-containing products, this is not by definition unclear and misleading, provided the labelling is clear about the absence of meat and the use of other ingredients.

Als voor vleesloze producten termen worden gebruikt die (ook) voor vleeshoudende producten gebruikelijk zijn, is dit niet per definitie onduidelijk en misleidend, als de aanduidingen helder zijn over de afwezigheid van vlees en over het gebruik van andere grondstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de petitie die is aangeboden door Millions Missing Holland

An MP asked the Health Minister whether she would act on the plight of ME patients, who often lack benefits, care and aids, whether she would fund biomedical research and improve medical training on the condition. The minister acknowledged the protest and said the Health Council is preparing an advisory report due spring 2017, on the basis of which further steps will be considered.
On the basis of this advice it can be considered which steps are best.
Op basis van dit advies kan worden bezien welke stappen het beste zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over het bericht 'Om te winnen is elke truc toegestaan'

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about tax and money-laundering oversight of football finances revealed by Football Leaks, including Dutch company use, transfer-pricing of image rights, and a delayed DNB investigation. The government answered that the Tax Authority will check the leaked information and act where Dutch tax is evaded, describes existing supervision by the Tax Authority, FIOD, DNB and KNVB, and says DNB will publish its general conclusions soon.
The Tax Authority is collecting the information published in Football Leaks and will verify it, as it has done with earlier leaks.
De Belastingdienst verzamelt de informatie die wordt gepubliceerd in Football Leaks en zal deze natrekken, zoals ook bij eerdere leaks is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over financiële arrangementen voor hepatitis C-medicijnen

The MP Bruins Slot asked whether the financial arrangements for hepatitis C drugs apply to asylum seekers, prison inmates and long-term addiction care patients, and what savings would result. The Minister confirmed the arrangements only cover the Zorgverzekeringswet, explained the separate payment routes for these groups, and declined to give confidential figures on the possible savings.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot say anything about the possible savings on these gross expenditures if the financial arrangements were also applied to this scheme.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid kan ik geen uitspraak doen over de mogelijke besparingen op deze bruto uitgaven indien de financiële arrangementen ook op deze regeling van toepassing zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Maak nieuwe regels voor kunstgraskorrels’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether artificial turf rubber granules should fall under stricter consumer PAH limits, and whether a special norm closer to the consumer standard should be set after consulting industry and RIVM. The government answered that EU REACH treats granules as a mixture with a looser limit, that it will push at EU level to lower the limit toward the consumer standard, and that it will continue talks with industry.
The cabinet aims for a source-based approach, in this case the cleanest possible car tyres.
Het kabinet streeft naar een aanpak aan de bron, in dit geval naar zo schoon mogelijke autobanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat bij het UMC Utrecht ruim anderhalf jaar lang procedurefouten zijn gemaakt bij het IVF-laboratorium

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports of over a year and a half of procedural errors at the UMC Utrecht IVF laboratory, possibly leading to 26 women being inseminated with another man's sperm, and about the inspectorate's role, support for affected couples and oversight. The minister answered that a SIRE investigation is underway, the IGZ will assess the report, affected couples have been informed and offered support, and inspection frequency and IVF laboratory checks were described.

The inspectorate's research report, which will among other things address the actions taken by both the UMC Utrecht and the IGZ to safeguard quality and patient safety requirements, is expected to be completed in March and I will then send it to your House.

Het onderzoeksrapport van de inspectie, dat onder meer in zal gaan op de acties die door zowel het UMC Utrecht als de IGZ zijn genomen om de kwaliteit en eisen voor patiëntveiligheid te borgen, wordt naar verwachting in maart afgerond en zal ik vervolgens aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘UMC blundert met zaad’

MPs De Lange and Rutte asked the Minister of Health about a reported mix-up of sperm cells in ICSI fertility treatment at UMC Utrecht affecting 26 couples, including causes, consequences, resumption of treatment and support for affected parents. The Minister said the incident is being investigated via a SIRE review reported to the Inspectorate, that affected couples were informed and offered paid paternity testing and psychosocial support, and that a broader Inspectorate investigation into patient safety at the hospital is due in March.
I want this to be thoroughly investigated, to ensure it cannot happen again, and for those affected to receive clarity as soon as possible.
Ik wil dat het goed wordt uitgezocht, dat ervoor wordt gezorgd dat het niet meer kan gebeuren en dat mensen die het betreft zo spoedig mogelijk duidelijkheid krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Oosenbrug over commerciële winkels zoals brillen- en gehoorapparatenverkopers die inzage hebben in gegevens van verzekerden

MPs Bouwmeester and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Health about commercial opticians and hearing-aid shops accessing insured persons' policy data via VECOZO, data mining, and software calculating remaining insurance budget. The Minister answered that access is limited to COV for billing purposes under confidentiality agreements, that the Wbp and the AP apply, and that controlling excessive care is mainly for insurers and providers.
I have received no signals about this. If there are concrete indications, I will of course discuss this with health insurers.
Ik heb hierover geen signalen ontvangen. Wanneer er concrete aanwijzingen zijn zal ik dit uiteraard met zorgverzekeraars bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gevaarlijke landbouwgif buprofezin

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the EU will ban pesticide buprofezin for food crops after it can form the carcinogen aniline, why the Dutch Ctgb authorised it recently, and whether authorisation should be suspended while doubts exist. The government replies that the EC has not yet decided, that the Ctgb is an independent body applying EU assessment methods, and that authorisations will be adjusted if the EC changes approval.

The Ctgb, the Dutch authorisation authority, is an independent administrative body that assesses applications using European harmonised assessment methods and takes decisions based on the regulations in force at the time.

Het Ctgb – de Nederlandse toelatingsautoriteit – is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat aanvragen toetst volgens Europees geharmoniseerde beoordelingsmethodieken en besluiten neemt op basis van de op dat moment vigerende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Arno Rutte over het bericht “Ook vrijgevestigde Zorgaanbieders aan WNT gehouden”

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Rutte asked whether solo healthcare providers and independent professionals can fall under the WNT pay-cap law, whether the CIBG wrongly used WTZi admission as a criterion, and what consequences follow for providers who ignored its questionnaire. Minister Schippers answered that WTZi-admitted institutions fall under the WNT by law, that the CIBG's letter was within its supervisory role, and that the uitvraag has been halted with no follow-up this year, while promising a fuller answer later.
I have asked the CIBG to stop the request of 11 November and not to follow up on the information collected this year.
Ik heb het CIBG gevraagd de uitvraag van 11 november stop te zetten en dit jaar geen vervolg te geven aan de verzamelde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over een bericht dat Nederlandse profvoetbalspelers niet mee hebben gedaan naar een onderzoek naar matchfixing en arbeidsomstandigheden

An MP asked the minister about a FIFPro global survey on match-fixing and working conditions, and why Dutch professional footballers and their union VVCS did not take part. The minister answered that the survey questions were judged not relevant to the Dutch situation, that match-fixing is nonetheless recognised as a risk in the Netherlands, and that the VVCS already sits on the national match-fixing platform with frequent consultation.
That is why we are working in the Netherlands on a joint approach to this problem.
Daarom werken wij in Nederland aan een gezamenlijke aanpak van dit probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Wolbert over de Wet Normering topinkomens voor de zorgsector

MPs Kerstens and Wolbert asked whether the WNT pay cap applies to self-employed healthcare professionals such as GPs, dentists and pharmacists, and about the CIBG questionnaire. The minister answered that the WNT applies by law based on organisational form, that CIBG designates no institutions, that the questionnaire was halted to allow consultation, and that medical specialists will be excluded from the WNT via a bill in preparation.
The CIBG does not designate any institutions.
Het CIBG wijst geen instellingen aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de kwaliteit in de hoorzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about criticism of the 2013 hearing-aid reimbursement system, falling device prices, whether low reimbursement harms care quality and encourages low-care high-volume practice, and whether the minister will convene the sector on protocol version 2.0. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut evaluation found user satisfaction with care broadly unchanged, average co-payments halved, and improvements still possible, and that she sees no need to convene the sector while the parties talk constructively.
The evaluation showed that user satisfaction with the quality of care has generally remained the same and has increased in some areas.
Uit de evaluatie bleek dat de tevredenheid van gebruikers over de kwaliteit van zorg over het algemeen gelijk is gebleven en op sommige onderdelen is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over 'gratis' extra bril, zorgproducten of hulpmiddelen

An MP asks the health minister about shops offering a free second pair of glasses or other care aids, which may encourage excessive care use, and whether shops can see insurance details. The minister calls such offers misleading, says insurers must set contract terms, and states that shops only access limited insurance data via COV for legitimate purposes.
However, I do find the suggestion that these glasses are free, and the call for extra care consumption, misleading to put it mildly.
Wel vind ik de suggestie dat deze brillen gratis zijn, en de oproep tot extra zorgconsumptie op zijn zachtst gezegd misleidend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen dit jaar al 304 keer melding hebben gedaan van het verlies van privacygevoelige informatie

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister how she views reports that hospitals filed 304 data-leak notifications this year and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has been sufficiently strict in supervising them, including questions on sanctions, naming hospitals and the role of the Inspectorate. The minister answered that the AP is an independent supervisor responsible for enforcement and publication decisions, that she has no reason to think the AP neglects its role, and that the Inspectorate intervenes when patient safety is at stake, while promising a patient-data security action plan.
This is a matter for the AP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Yücel over een bericht dat de KNWU een onderzoek instelt naar misstanden in de wielersport

Two MPs asked the minister whether she knew of misconduct and intimidation in cycling, including the CIRC report on women's cycling, and what the government was doing about it. The minister said she supports the KNWU-commissioned investigation, points to the existing sports safety action plan and reporting channels, and gave no commitment to a broader government inquiry.
A broad investigation into abuses and intimidation in sport does not seem necessary to me.
