Een breed onderzoek naar misstanden en intimidatie in de sport lijkt mij niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur met het thema: ‘Misbruik in de sport’

An MP asked the health minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on abuse in sport, including reporting figures, sport-specific data, coach training, sanctions, sports federations' powers and police cooperation. The minister answered that reporting figures are only partly available (Vertrouwenspunt Sport numbers for 2014-2015), that training modules on integrity exist, that disciplinary and criminal sanctions apply, and that talks with police and prosecutors are underway to improve cooperation.
I do not have an overview of the reports that come in to these various bodies.
Een overzicht van de meldingen die bij deze verschillende instanties binnenkomen heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onzichtbare samenwerking van het ministerie van VWS met The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus en IQ healthcare

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the origins, costs and reporting of VWS cooperation with The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus and IQ Healthcare, including congress visits, fellowships and an ambtenaar holding a professorship. The Minister described how the Commonwealth Fund ties began in 2006, gave yearly cost tables, argued that congress visits comply with conduct rules, and declined to answer some questions on loyalty and staffing or to meet the one-week deadline.
Data on other costs associated with the cooperation with the Commonwealth Fund are not tracked separately and therefore cannot be provided.
Gegevens over overige kosten die gemoeid zijn met de samenwerking met het Commonwealth Fund worden niet apart bijgehouden en kunnen dus niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de protestactie van ouders met autistische kinderen die geen dubbele kinderbijslag kunnen krijgen

An MP asked whether parents of autistic children who previously received the TOG allowance are losing double child benefit, how many were affected, and what the government will do. The minister says the total number of children receiving intensive-care double child benefit stayed roughly constant, that a shift in target group cannot be excluded, and that he will consult CIZ and SVB on whether parent information on the procedure is adequate.
I am therefore consulting with CIZ and SVB to see whether the information provided to parents about the procedure is sufficiently adequate.
Ik overleg daarom met CIZ en SVB om te bezien of de voorlichting aan ouders over de procedure voldoende adequaat is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister whether transparency on declared care should extend beyond the deductible, whether it serves parliament's oversight role, whether DIS data can be published in anonymised form, and how this relates to NZa pricing transparency. The minister answered that price transparency serves patients and parliament's oversight, that declared care does not equal insurers' administrative costs, that anonymised aggregated DIS data is not contrary to the Wob, and that the NZa is working towards stepwise publication of price data.
Insight into declared care has significant added value at an aggregate level for tracking developments in care expenditure, among other things for the oversight role of your House.

Inzicht in gedeclareerde zorg heeft op geaggregeerd niveau een belangrijke meerwaarde om ontwikkelingen in de zorguitgaven te kunnen volgen, onder meer met het oog op de controlerende taak van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over lip filler behandeling bij meisjes onder de 18 door ‘cosmetisch’ artsen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health about cosmetic lip filler treatment of girls under 18 and related oversight of cosmetic clinics and doctors, including complaints from plastic surgeons and the training standards dispute. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ has no reports of fillers given to under-18s, is examining the broadcast cases and calling clinics to account, and is working on quality norms and a cosmetic-doctor training curriculum with the professional bodies.
The use of mystery guests must not be deployed lightly when minors are involved, also called 'lure youngsters' in this context.
Antwoord 5 De inzet van mystery guests moet niet lichtvaardig ingezet worden, als het om een minderjarigen gaat, in dit verband ook wel «lokjongeren» genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Huidige donorsysteem werkt niet’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that organ donation procedures are delayed or abandoned because no independent retrieval team (ZUT) is available, keeping patients on life support longer. The minister answered that only one such case is known, that between 2014 and mid-2016 110 of 737 procedures did not proceed for medical or procedural reasons (not lack of ZUT), and described ZUT-sharing and a planned move to three regions with one ZUT each.
In this case, in consultation with the next of kin, the donor hospital and the ZUT, it is examined whether procedures can be scheduled one after another.
In dit geval wordt er in samenspraak met de nabestaanden, het donorziekenhuis en met het ZUT gekeken of procedures na elkaar gepland kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Oosenbrug over datalekken bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Oosenbrug and Bouwmeester asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about frequent data breaches at hospitals, their causes, whether patients were informed, and whether the Dutch data protection authority has fined providers for late reporting. The minister answered that breaches stem from various causes, that the authority has not yet imposed fines for late reporting, that a joint action plan on information security for patient data is being prepared, and that the authority's sanctioning choices are its own.
The AP has so far not imposed any fines for failing to report a data breach on time.
De AP heeft tot op heden geen boetes opgelegd vanwege het niet tijdig melden van een datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe zorgverzekering voor ouderen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about a new VGZ insurance product for older people developed with the Nationaal Ouderenfonds and ANBO, including subsidies, commissions, advisers' fees, solidarity concerns and transparency of intermediary payments. The minister answered that it is a collective arrangement on existing policies rather than a new insurer, that the organisations receive no commission from VGZ, and that transparency of intermediary remuneration should improve.
I have no insight into the subsidies these older-persons organisations receive from other governments.
Ik heb geen zicht op de subsidies die deze ouderenorganisaties van andere overheden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over marketing rondom de nipt test

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about Gendia marketing screening tests alongside the NIPT test, including the consent wording and whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens should review it. The minister answered that privacy rules require specific informed consent, that Gendia is itself responsible for compliance, and that the supervisory authorities will act, while leaving the decision to end cooperation with hospitals to the hospitals themselves.
Companies and organisations are themselves responsible for complying with privacy legislation.
Bedrijven en organisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Voortman over Physician Assistants in de GGZ

MPs Bruins Slot and Voortman asked why the NZa excluded Physician Assistants from the GGZ DBC profession table, whether this restricts their ability to open DBCs, and whether it undermines task-shifting from psychiatrists. The minister answered that PAs never had this authority, the NZa relied on advice from the Netwerk Kwaliteitsontwikkeling GGZ, task-shifting remains possible without table inclusion, and that the NZa talks with the professional association itself.

The Network advised not to include the Physician Assistant in the profession table because it is currently insufficiently clear how Physician Assistant psychiatry is a clear addition compared with the existing professions.

Het Netwerk heeft geadviseerd de Physician Assistant niet op te nemen in de beroepentabel omdat het momenteel onvoldoende duidelijk is op welke wijze de Physician Assistant-psychiatrie een duidelijke toevoeging is ten opzichte van de reeds bestaande beroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over reclame van zorgverzekeraars die zich via direct mailings richt op mensen met een hoog inkomen of opleidingsniveau

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Promovendum (part of VGZ) targets higher-educated and higher-income people through direct mailings, which they argued amounts to risk selection, and what criteria and costs apply. The minister answered that the mailings are legal, that Promovendum now omits the 'higher educated' target label, that the NZa will be asked to examine the practice, and that the requested client data is commercially confidential.
This is commercially confidential information that I do not have in my possession.
Dit is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die ik niet in bezit heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en Feyenoord flirten met te jonge buitenlandse talenten’

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether Ajax and Feyenoord evade FIFA and Dutch rules when recruiting very young foreign football talents, and whether rules should change. The minister replied that FIFA article 19 and the Wav already give strict safeguards, no unlawful transfers are known, a referee-style intermediary quality mark is being developed, and no further talks are needed.
Moreover, I am not aware of any cases of unlawful transfers of (too) young talented football players.
Overigens zijn bij mij geen gevallen bekend van onrechtmatige transfers van (te) jonge talentvolle voetbalspelers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het commerciële tv-programma "een nieuw begin"?

SP MPs asked the Health and Culture ministers about the commercial TV programme 'een nieuw begin', which allegedly pressed participants into unnecessary cosmetic and dental treatments, and whether clinics and the Inspectorate had acted. The minister called it a worrying signal, said patient consent and information duties apply, noted the Inspectorate had no complaints about the programme and was investigating CDC Tandzorg on unrelated complaints, and said RTL and producers bear responsibility and will be reviewed.
The Inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of the ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van het lopende onderzoek kan de Inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Bruins Slot en Amhaouch over het bericht dat een verwarde man in de boeien is geslagen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a report of a confused man being hit while handcuffed, whether the police apology was appropriate, and the state of municipal care for confused persons. The minister answered that the matter is covered in a separate letter, that the Aanjaagteam found in September 2016 that no municipality had a well-implemented integrated approach, and that the Schakelteam will monitor progress and share results with parliament.
The Schakelteam has been tasked with promoting and monitoring progress towards an integrated approach.
Het Schakelteam heeft als opdracht meegekregen de voortgang van de sluitende aanpak te bevorderen en te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers about reports that matchfixers are buying European football clubs, whether Dutch clubs could be affected, and whether the KNVB's integrity checks and clemency for players who report matchfixing are adequate. The ministers answered that the KNVB has no signals of Dutch takeovers, that takeover screening is for the KNVB to decide, that clemency is rejected in general criminal law, and that cooperation platforms and international expert groups are in place.
As long as the investigation is ongoing, the KNVB will make no statements about it.
Zolang het onderzoek loopt doet de KNVB hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermue over de website Dokteronline.nl waar mensen zonder doktersbezoek geneesmiddelen kunnen bestellen

An MP asked the minister about Dokteronline.nl, a site where people can order medicines without seeing a doctor, including its legal action against a TV programme, the inspectorate's knowledge and enforcement, Pangea, and the 'echt of nep' campaign. The minister said the IGZ is re-examining possible violations and may enforce, that online prescribing without prior contact is prohibited, that no Dutch-registered doctors currently work for the site, and that the campaign is too new to assess its effect.
Following the Rambam TV broadcast, the IGZ is again examining whether Dutch legislation is being violated and whether it may take enforcement action.
De IGZ onderzoekt naar aanleiding van de tv-uitzending van Rambam opnieuw of de Nederlandse wetgeving wordt overtreden en zij mogelijk handhavend kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van de aanwezigheid van landbouwgif in ons voedsel

MP Ouwehand asked about a French study finding pesticide residues in non-organic muesli, including levels she said exceeded drinking-water limits, possible hormone disruptors, and availability in Dutch supermarkets. The minister answered that residues are below EU maximum limits, the RIVM finds no consumer risk, no consequences or new testing are planned, and the government aims to speed the transition to sustainable crop protection.
I therefore attach no consequences to the results of this French study.
Ik verbind daarom geen consequenties aan de resultaten van deze Franse studie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de uitzending van Rambam met als onderwerp dokteronline.nl

SP MPs asked the health minister about a broadcast on dokteronline.com, a Curaçao-based site selling prescription medicines without a doctor visit, and whether her 2010 warning about online sales still stands and what concrete measures she has taken. The minister confirmed the warning, listed the 2011 law changes, notice-and-takedown agreements, the EU logo scheme and campaigns, and said the Inspectorate can act only against Dutch-based practitioners, so it is contacting Curaçao and foreign authorities.
As far as the IGZ is aware, Dokteronline.com no longer has any BIG-registered doctors or pharmacists working from the Netherlands.
Zover bekend bij de IGZ, zijn er bij Dokteronline.com geen artsen of apothekers meer werkzaam die BIG-geregistreerd zijn en vanuit Nederland werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uniforme herkenbaarheid van voorrangsvoertuigen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid (IFV) was right to enforce against reputable transport providers using OOV striping and the Star of Life, and how the policy was applied to resold ambulances and to historic 2002 rules. The minister answered that unauthorised use is unacceptable, that GP out-of-hours services will adopt the secondary ambulance livery within five years, that talks with the transplant foundation are ongoing, and that the goal of uniform recognisability stands.
An agreement has been reached with the organisation of GP out-of-hours services (InEen) that they will adopt the so-called secondary variant of the ambulance house style.
Met de organisatie van huisartsenposten (InEen) is overeengekomen dat zij de zogenoemde secundaire variant van de ambulancehuisstijl gaan voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over het bericht “Patiënt de dupe van beperkende voorwaarden zorgverzekeraars”

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that restrictive contract conditions imposed by health insurers prevent providers, such as physiotherapists, from giving patients needed treatment, and about hidden restrictions and information for insured persons. The minister answered that patients should not be harmed by contract disputes, that the NZa oversees insurers' information duties and can enforce, that medical necessity should guide treatment, and that talks on the treatment index are ongoing.
The NZa supervises whether insurers comply with this obligation.
De NZa houdt toezicht of verzekeraars zich hieraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Hoogland over hoge parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuizen

Two MPs asked the health minister why nothing is done about high hospital parking charges that burden patients and visitors, and whether she will convene VNG, NVZ and insurers or require transparency. The minister repeatedly answered that she has no role or competence over parking tariffs, which lie with municipalities and hospitals, and said she would merely point these parties to the questions.
I have no role or competence regarding parking tariffs, which is why I cannot set a maximum for parking costs.
Ik heb geen rol en bevoegdheid ten aanzien van parkeertarieven, vandaar dat ik geen maximum kan bepalen voor parkeerkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over de te hoge buffers van zorgverzekeraars

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance and Health ministers about health insurers' excessive capital buffers, the EU Solvency II rules, insolvency risk and consequences for insured persons, and whether premium money is effectively being stolen. The ministers replied that Solvency II already accounts for the Dutch system, that the insolvency probability is about 0.5% per year, that insured persons are protected under Article 31 Zvw, and that insurers may choose their own safety margins, with excess solvency returned via lower premiums.
Should a health insurer go bankrupt, insured persons will look for a new health insurer and take out new health insurance.
Mocht een zorgverzekeraar failliet gaan, dan zullen verzekerden een nieuwe zorgverzekeraar zoeken en een nieuwe zorgverzekering afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a Slovenian match-fixer caught at Schiphol with EUR 75,000 cash, whether the Slovenian conviction is final, whether he is suspected of match-fixing in the Netherlands, and what new insights the case gives. The Justice minister answered that the FIOD found no signs of match-fixing in the Netherlands, that the information was shared with Europol and Interpol, that the man was convicted in Slovenia and in the Netherlands for laundering the cash, and that further details cannot be given because the investigation continues.
I cannot make further statements about this, because this information is still the subject of further investigation.
Ik kan hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen, omdat deze informatie nog onderwerp is van verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat Gendia medische gegevens misbruikt bij de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT)

An MP asked the minister about reports that Gendia misuses women's medical data collected for the NIPT prenatal test, including consent, privacy, and whether hospitals should stop cooperating. The minister said privacy rules apply, the Dutch and Belgian privacy authorities are acting on the case, and the NIPT will become available in the Netherlands from April 2017 with quality safeguards.
On request, the Belgian Privacy Commission indicates that, in consultation with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, it is taking action on the possible privacy violation by Gendia.
Desgevraagd geeft de Belgische Privacycommissie aan dat zij, in overleg met de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, actie onderneemt op de eventuele privacyschending door Gendia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ prostaatkankerzorg wil concentreren in Rotterdam en Nijmegen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether health insurer CZ's plan to concentrate prostate cancer care in Rotterdam and Nijmegen was desirable, and about the wider concentration of care and quality norms. The minister answered that concentration can improve quality, that insurers make their own purchasing policy, that the Zorginstituut has no coordinating role, and that she sees no reason to address CZ.
The Zorginstituut currently has no task, and therefore no powers, to coordinate such a concentration.
Het Zorginstituut heeft op dit moment geen taak, en dus ook geen bevoegdheden, om een dergelijke concentratie te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over hormoonverstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked whether the government should follow France by banning BPA in packaging and DEHP in neonatal and maternity medical devices, and whether a national biomonitoring system for hormone-disrupting substances should be set up. The minister answered that a ban is not appropriate because safer alternatives are not proven, that exposure of vulnerable groups is being reduced through talks with stakeholders, and that the RIVM participates in the European HBM4EU biomonitoring project.
A ban does not deserve to be followed, because manufacturers would then be forced to use alternatives in their products whose safety has not been well investigated.
Een verbod verdient geen navolging, omdat fabrikanten dan worden gedwongen alternatieven te gebruiken in hun producten, waarvan de veiligheid niet goed is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Fokke over afgelaste operaties in de Zuyderland-ziekenhuizen in Geleen en Heerlen

MPs Volp and Fokke asked the minister whether cancelled operations at Zuyderland hospitals in Geleen and Heerlen, caused by full wards and a norovirus outbreak, could be prevented and how patients could be moved to appropriate care. The minister confirmed the five cancelled operations, said operations resumed the next day, pointed to the insurer's duty of care and NZa oversight, and promised a quickscan of the emergency care chain with results before the Christmas recess.
I am having a quickscan carried out of the emergency care chain in our country because there are signals that more is going on than an incident.
Ik laat een quickscan uitvoeren ten aanzien van de spoedeisende keten in ons land omdat er signalen zijn dat er meer aan de hand is dan een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over medische gevolgen van hulptelevisieprogramma’s

An MP asked the health minister about patient experiences in reality-TV dental makeover programmes, including misleading information, and about the duty of care of treating dentists. The minister called it a worrying signal, reaffirmed the duty to inform patients, said the IGZ inspectorate acts on complaints, and noted that its ongoing investigation of one clinic is not linked to the broadcast.
The inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of this ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van dit lopende onderzoek kan de inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante inzake het aanbod van psychische hulp voor studenten

Two MPs asked the ministers whether student psychological help is adequately provided and facilitated across higher education institutions, and whether taboos and access barriers are being addressed. The minister answered that institutions decide staffing, that national norms are unnecessary, that all universities offer psychological help, and that regular mental health care and open institutional culture are the proper routes.
It is up to the institutions themselves to decide how many student psychologists they appoint.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoeveel studentpsychologen zij aanstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bevolkingsonderzoek baarmoederhalskanker voor vrouwen van boven de 60 jaar

An MP asked the Minister of Health why women over 60 no longer receive invitations for the cervical cancer screening programme, and about the evidence behind the age limit, international comparisons, mortality figures, and information given to women. The minister answered that the 30-60 age range rests on Health Council advice and RIVM assessment of risk versus screening harms, that women over 60 receive a final invitation and symptom information, and that the programme was not extended.
Women older than 60 face a relatively low risk of developing cervical cancer.
Vrouwen die ouder dan 60 jaar zijn lopen relatief weinig risico op het krijgen van baarmoederhalskanker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Impact fijnstof zwaar overdreven’

An MP asked the government to react to a newspaper article claiming air pollution has only a small effect on regional health differences, and whether livestock density correlates with chronic illness. The state secretary rejected the article's methodology as unsound, pointed to the VGO study and the planned air-quality measures, and promised to inform parliament about any measures.
Your House will be informed about the measures to be taken.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de te nemen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht “Geld bijna op: VieCuri schort operaties op”

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether postponing operations at VieCuri hospital, reportedly due to running out of money, could be prevented, what the causes are, and what the role of insurers and the NZa is. The minister answered that the hospital attributes the cuts to December leave and maintenance rather than a spending ceiling, and that insurers and the NZa have a duty of care to arrange timely alternative care.
The NZa supervises compliance with this duty of care.
De NZa ziet toe op naleving van deze zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Amhaouch en Knops over ziekenhuizen in Limburg die operaties moeten uitstellen omdat ze door de jaarvergoeding heen zijn

MPs asked whether Limburg hospitals such as VieCuri, AZM, Laurentius and Sint Jans Gasthuis had exhausted annual budgets and postponed operations, and how insurers and the NZa ensure patient information and waiting-time norms. The minister said she lacks insight into individual hospitals' finances, placed responsibility on hospitals and insurers, and pointed to NZa supervision of insurer information duties.
I have no insight into the financial situation of individual hospitals.
Ik heb geen zicht op de financiële situatie van individuele ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van een dakloze Belg die al een half jaar in een ziekenhuis in Harderwijk 'woont'

An MP asked the health minister about a homeless uninsured Belgian patient who has stayed for six months in a Harderwijk hospital because no alternative placement was found, with the hospital bearing the costs. The minister answered that such costs are part of the hospital's ordinary business risk, that contact with Belgian authorities showed the patient was uninsured in Belgium, and that she will raise the case again with Belgian authorities.
Given the Belgian status of the patient, I will again bring this case to the attention of the Belgian authorities concerned.
Gezien de Belgische status van de patiënt zal ik deze casus nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de betrokken Belgische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Keuzevrijheid jeugdzorg onder druk’

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch youth-care law obliges municipalities to present the choice between a personal budget (PGB) and in-kind care, and whether youth teams discourage PGBs, citing monitoring reports and a sample study of ten municipalities. The state secretary answered that municipalities must offer choice where reasonably possible, that the sample study yielded no quantitative data and only signals, and that VNG and Per Saldo will develop a support programme for municipalities.
Most of the municipalities examined could not provide sufficient insight into the number of refusals and their reasons, because this information cannot be retrieved from their systems.
Het merendeel van de onderzochte gemeenten kon onvoldoende inzicht geven in aantallen weigeringen en de redenen daarvan, omdat deze informatie niet uit hun systemen te halen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zorgorganisaties die steeds meer betalen aan accountants

Two SP MPs asked why healthcare organisations spent rising sums on accountants, with the big four firms taking most of it, and whether the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet caused extra bureaucracy. The state secretary answered that accountancy control is necessary, that costs fell on average, that the rise is due to more contracting parties under the new laws, and that standardisation tools and possible further regulation are being pursued.
I do not have the figures on the accountancy costs of these mental health providers and therefore cannot confirm whether this expectation is correct.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van de accountantskosten van deze ggz-aanbieders en kan dus niet staven of deze verwachting wel of niet terecht is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schier eindeloze nasleep van de calamiteit in mei 2007 in het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMC Groningen), waarbij Jelmer Mulder buitengewoon ernstige en onherste

MP Leijten and Van Gerven ask the ministers about the long-running legal dispute after the 2007 UMC Groningen calamity that left baby Jelmer Mulder with severe brain damage, questioning the IGZ's handling, the hospital's conduct in court, and whether the minister can direct the hospital to settle. The minister replies that the IGZ report cannot be published, that the IGZ has apologised and offered compensation, that civil liability is for the civil court, and that the IGZ cannot use its Wkkgz instruction power to force settlement of a civil claim.
The IGZ report of 14 July 2011, as well as the IGZ report of 6 December 2010 withdrawn by the IGZ, is not public.
Het rapport van de IGZ van 14 juli 2011, evenals het door de IGZ ingetrokken rapport d.d. 6 december 2010, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het gebruik van medische gegevens voor de aanbieding van commerciële screeningstesten

MP Bouwmeester asked the Minister of Health whether the Belgian firm Gendia, which performs NIPT prenatal tests for Dutch women, used medical data for commercial screening offers, whether this constitutes tie-selling and privacy violation. The Minister condemned the practice as undesirable, said privacy rules require explicit consent for other uses, and noted that the Dutch and Belgian privacy authorities are acting, while stating she does not know Gendia's internal process.
Without this consent, the data may not be used for another purpose.
Zonder deze toestemming mogen de gegevens niet voor een ander doel gebruikt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Volp over het voorkomen van seksueel misbruik in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Volp asked why the Public Prosecution Service (OM) had apparently not shared with the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) a conviction of a healthcare worker for a serious sexual offence committed in private, and how the procedure works. The minister replied that the OM has informed the IGZ only once since July 2015, that the OM does not register professions, that the protocol is considered sufficiently watertight with no known failures, and that no retroactive review will be ordered.
I currently have no indications that the arrangement set out in the Cooperation Protocol is not watertight.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat de regeling die nu in het Samenwerkingsprotocol is verwoord niet sluitend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het te vaak urgent uitrukken van ambulances door een nieuw triagesysteem

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about a survey claiming a new triage system leads to too many urgent ambulance dispatches, with possible harm and accident risks, and about insurers' duty of care. The minister acknowledged signals of unnecessary urgent rides but reported no evidence of patient harm, said accident data are not registered nationally and that a limited study and evaluations are pending, and promised to decide on changes after those evaluations.
Accidents involving ambulances are currently not registered nationally.
Ongevallen met ambulances worden op dit moment niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over de giftige stoffen in rubbertegels

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health whether rubber playground tiles containing carcinogenic substances pose a health risk, why no research was done at introduction, which alternatives exist, and when EU limits apply. The minister answered that NVWA considered risks negligible, a RIVM risk assessment is expected early 2017, the current 1 mg/kg PAK limit is precautionary, and further measures will follow if risks are found.
The RIVM is currently working on a risk assessment of the rubber tiles. If it turns out the tiles pose a risk to public health, I will take additional measures.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment aan een risicobeoordeling van de rubbertegels. Als daar uitkomt dat de tegels een risico vormen voor de volksgezondheid zal ik aanvullende maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht: te veel bacteriën in thuisbezorgmaaltijden ouderen

MP Krol asked the ministers whether they were aware of a Nutrilab study finding high bacteria levels and salt concerns in home-delivered meals for elderly people, and whether extra inspection and measures would follow. The government answered that the NVWA will treat the results as a signal in hygiene supervision and perform extra checks at the companies concerned, while noting no legal nutritional standards exist for these meals.
The NVWA will take the results of the study as a signal into account in supervising hygiene and temperature control at the producers concerned.
De NVWA zal de resultaten van het onderzoek als signaal meenemen in het toezicht op de hygiëne- en temperatuurbeheersing bij de betrokken producenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over de ziekte van Huntington

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a TV item claiming a medical breakthrough for Huntington's disease was possible with four million euros, about the scope of Health Deals investment, past ZonMw funding, and how expertise centres are financed. The Minister called the breakthrough claim doubtful, said the 130 million euros are existing programme budgets rather than new Huntington investment, and said the Huntington-specific research funding figures are not known to her.
I am not aware of which amounts are available within these centres for research into Huntington's disease.
Het is mij niet bekend welke bedragen binnen deze centra beschikbaar zijn voor onderzoek naar de ziekte van Huntington.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over hoge parkeerkosten voor zieke mensen en hun naasten

An MP asked the health minister about high hospital parking charges for patients and visitors, who ownership and revenue of hospital car parks, and who is responsible for protecting patients from these costs. The minister said hospitals and municipalities are responsible for parking policy, declined to compile a national overview of tariffs and ownership, and only encouraged hospitals to be transparent and to take criticism seriously.
The Ministry of VWS does not have an overview per hospital of parking tariffs, responsibility for the parking facility, ownership, or where the revenue from that facility is used.

Het Ministerie van VWS beschikt niet over een overzicht per ziekenhuis van de hoogte van parkeertarieven, de verantwoordelijkheid van de parkeervoorziening, het eigenaarschap of waar de inkomsten van die parkeervoorziening voor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de relatie tussen The Commonwealth Fund, The Harkness Fellowship, onderzoeksprogramma Celsus, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc en haar ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the links between the Commonwealth Fund, the Harkness Fellowship, the Celsus programme, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc and the ministry, including whether the ministry's funding and staff involvement compromise independence. The minister replied that the ministry's participation is a shared-cost survey and fellowship arrangement, that selection is run by an independent committee, and that there is no risk of influence on outcomes.
I have no insight into the financing and bookkeeping of IQ Healthcare.
Ik heb geen zicht op financiering en boekhouding van IQ Healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het persoonsgebonden budget en huurtoeslag

MP Voortman asked whether persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) leftovers wrongly count as assets for housing benefit (huurtoeslag), causing repayments, and whether a 3,000 euro threshold left some people without relief. The government confirmed that leftover PGB money counts as assets under the box 3 rules, but agreed to offer relief to this group through the hardship clause and to set this out in a ministerial regulation.
People who qualify can report to the Tax Administration/Toeslagen, which will still disregard the leftover personal budget when calculating the allowance.

Mensen die hiervoor in aanmerking komen kunnen zich melden bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen die het restant persoonsgebonden budget alsnog buiten beschouwing zal laten bij de berekening van de toeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het door de fiscus meetellen van een PGB-restant voor de vermogenstoets voor toeslagen

Two D66 MPs asked whether a leftover personal budget (pgb) owed back to a care office can count as debt under the box 3 wealth test and whether this wrongly makes some recipients lose housing benefit. The government confirmed the pgb remainder can be declared as debt above the 3,000 euro threshold, but agreed to a hardship arrangement via the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen for affected cases and to a ministerial regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Pechtold over het bericht dat er geen aidsremmers meer in Curaçao beschikbaar zijn

MPs Dijkstra and Pechtold asked the ministers about reports that HIV/AIDS medication was unavailable in Curaçao, including how many patients were affected and what Nederland would do. Minister Schippers answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own healthcare, declined to provide patient figures, and said she is not currently in talks with Curaçao's government.
In this case it is not for the government of another country, the Netherlands, to judge and intervene in what I regard as internal affairs of the country of Curaçao.
Het is in dit geval niet aan de regering van een ander land, Nederland, om te oordelen over en te interveniëren in wat ik als, interne aangelegenheden van het land Curaçao beschouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het melden en onafhankelijk onderzoeken van calamiteiten bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister why a maternal death at the Diakonessenhuis was not reported as a calamity and whether the external investigator's conduct and the IGZ's handling were sound. The minister acknowledged the failure, said the IGZ found the first investigation not carefully conducted and ordered a new one, but refused to publish the final IGZ report, declined to re-examine other cases, and promised a circular on calamity reporting.
Until then, the IGZ does not make individual calamity reports and reports public for the time being.
Totdat hiervan sprake is maakt de IGZ afzonderlijke calamiteitenmeldingen en -rapportages vooralsnog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Van Dekken over het ziek worden van sporten op kunstgrasvelden

MPs Tanamal and Van Dekken asked whether artificial turf rubber infill poses health risks to players and to workers who install the fields, and whether RIVM and the labour inspectorate will investigate. The minister maintains RIVM's view that exposure poses no health risk, but has asked RIVM for a literature review and a representative sampling study, and will await those results before deciding further steps.
Because the broadcast caused considerable public unrest, the Minister of VWS asked RIVM to conduct a technical literature review.
Omdat de uitzending de nodige onrust in de samenleving heeft veroorzaakt heeft de Minister van VWS het RIVM gevraagd om een technisch literatuuronderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de Zembla uitzending 'Gevaarlijk spel'

The MP Klever asks the ministers why the government reversed its position on banning rubber granulate in artificial turf, whether the RIVM study was adequate, and whether children with leukaemia used such pitches. The minister replies that the government followed the Commission's classification of granulate as a mixture, that no unacceptable health risk has been identified, that RIVM research and an ECHA report are pending, and that no ban is planned.
I have asked the RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Smaling over het bericht dat het sporten op kunststofgrasvelden mogelijk gevaarlijk is voor de gezondheid

MPs Van Nispen and Smaling asked the health minister about reports that playing sport on artificial turf with rubber granulate may harm health, and about the government's position in EU REACH classification. The minister answered that RIVM still finds no health effects on current evidence, that RIVM is analysing new studies and literature, and that results are expected before year-end.
I have asked RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in the granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over kankerverwekkende stoffen in rubbergranulaat op kunstgrasvelden

An MP asked the Health Minister when the research plan on playing on artificial turf would be presented, how sites were selected, whether tiles are included, whether the IndusTox study was funded by manufacturers, why a small study was used, the replacement cost, and the basis for claiming barbecuing is more dangerous than artificial turf. The minister answered that RIVM publishes its protocol, selects sites randomly, covers tiles separately, takes industry funding into account under REACH, and that the scientific basis for barbecue risks is stronger than for turf.
The National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) regularly makes information available via its website on the status of the research.
Het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) stelt regelmatig informatie beschikbaar via zijn website over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slachtoffers van Q-koorts

An MP asks the government whether it will compensate Q-fever victims, cites the sector's responsibility, asks for death and chronic illness figures, and questions a planned 5,000-goat stable in Maasdriel. The minister refuses individual compensation, points to the Q-support foundation, gives case figures and dispersion and emission data, and defers liability questions to the courts and the municipality.
This case is before the court. Your question on liability cannot be answered by us.
Deze zaak is onder de rechter. Uw vraag over aansprakelijkheid kan niet door ons worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de Q-koortsepidemie

Two PvdA MPs asked the Health Minister about the Q-fever epidemic, including the division of lead between Health and Economic Affairs, the Van Dijk commission's recommendation, delayed reporting by farms, and compensation for victims. The minister answered that Health takes the lead in practice, that Q-fever victims received a 10 million euro foundation rather than compensation as the state accepts no liability, and that a screening advice was pending.
Given that the public health interest is paramount for both ministers, the Ministry of VWS takes the lead.
Vanuit het gegeven dat het belang van de volksgezondheid voor beide bewindslieden voorop staat, heeft het Ministerie van VWS daarbij de lead.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de patiëntenstop bij Ziekenhuis Nij Smellinghe

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a patient admission stop at Nij Smellinghe hospital should end immediately, whether the IGZ was notified and whether patients were endangered, and what solutions exist for hospital budget problems. The minister answered that no general admission stop existed, that the hospital did not notify the IGZ (no legal duty), that the IGZ sees no quality risks, and that hospital and insurers bear responsibility for contracting while the minister committed only to reaffirming existing agreements.
There is also no legal obligation to inform the inspectorate in advance of such measures.
Er geldt ook geen wettelijke verplichting om de inspectie vooraf te informeren over dergelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten in de rij staan bij het ziekenhuis Medisch Spectrum Twente

An MP asked the health minister how she would respond to reports of patients queuing at Medisch Spectrum Twente after a dispute between the hospital and insurer VGZ, and what she would do to get them treated quickly, and whether she would hold the hospital and insurer to their duty of care and what sanctions were available. The minister said such disputes should not be fought out over patients, pointed to insurer and hospital responsibilities, and said the independent market regulator NZa is examining whether the insurer meets its duty of care and can use enforcement measures if needed.
The NZa is investigating whether the health insurer is fulfilling its duty of care.
De NZa onderzoekt of de zorgverzekeraar zijn zorgplicht nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de patiëntenstop van het Nij Smellinghe

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the patient admission stop at Nij Smellinghe hospital, its effect on waiting times and travel costs, insurer responsibility, and patient choice under restitution policies. The minister answered that the hospital has not stopped all work, that insurers bear duty of care enforced by the NZa, and that restitution rules are being tightened from 2017.
The NZa supervises that insurers, for insured persons unwilling to wait longer than these standard times, mediate in finding other care providers who can deliver care within the set standard times.

De NZa ziet er op toe dat zorgverzekeraars, voor die verzekerden die niet langer willen wachten dan deze normtijden, bemiddelen bij het vinden van andere zorgaanbieders die wel binnen de gestelde normtijden zorg kunnen verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Patiënten VGZ niet meer welkom zijn bij ziekenhuis MST

An MP asked the health minister whether insurer VGZ properly informed its insured about volume caps at hospital MST, whether patients could still be treated there, and how waiting-time norms are protected. The minister answered that the NZa judges compliance, that ongoing treatments and urgent care continue, that insurers must buy sufficient volume, and that disputes should not be fought over patients' backs.
The NZa does not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet de NZa geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de belasting van huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about GP workload, administrative burden, burnout, practice size norms and training capacity after a Leiden GP quit filling in insurer checklists. The Minister replied that bureaucracy has been reduced through the 'Het Roer Gaat Om' process, that she has no data on GPs leaving practice, and that she sees no need for further measures, while promising a monitor and a capacity forecast.
I do not know how many GPs leave their work early, or for what reason.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel huisartsen vroegtijdig stoppen met hun werk en met welke reden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over zelfstandige behandelcentra die het verbod op winstuitkering omzeilen

An MP asked the health minister whether she knows of and will act against zbc's (independent treatment centres) using a 'u-bend' construction to pay profits despite the ban on profit distribution, and what the outcomes of earlier consultations with tax and prosecution authorities were. The minister answered that enforcement of the profit ban lies with the Health Care Inspectorate, that she sees no evidence of unlawfully distributed profit, and that other bodies enforce the relevant rules on a case-by-case basis.
In view of the above, it is not for me to investigate profit distribution by zbc's; it is the task of the IGZ to monitor this.
Gelet op het bovenstaande is het niet aan mij om onderzoek te doen naar winstuitkering door ZBC's, maar is het de taak van de IGZ om erop toe te zien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZBC’s ontduiken verbod winstuitkering’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether standalone treatment centres evade the ban on profit distribution and good-governance rules through BV structures and direct contracting, and whether investigations or new rules would follow. The minister replied that outsourcing is permitted, that the IGZ and NZa supervise compliance and can intervene case by case, and that she sees no need for her own investigation or for banning outsourcing to subsidiaries.
Supervision of compliance with the profit-making ban rests with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Het toezicht op de naleving van het verbod op winstoogmerk is neergelegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onterechte suggestie dat fysiotherapie van mensen in de aanvullende verzekering vergoed is

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether insurers forcing physiotherapists to treat patients less than covered, via the behandelindex, is acceptable and whether it breaches the insurer's duty of care. Minister Schippers answered that treatment numbers are for the professional to judge, that the behandelindex is a benchmark used as mirror information (with some insurers linking it to contracts in exceptional cases), and promised to raise its use with stakeholders.
It cannot be the case that a care provider stops a necessary treatment for financial motives.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat een zorgverlener uit financiële motieven een noodzakelijke behandeling stopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de hulpbereidheid bij eerste hulp (Herdruk)

An MP asked the health minister about low public willingness to give first aid, the share of Dutch people with first-aid certificates, costs of courses and insurance, and plans to recover AED pad costs from insurers. The minister answered that the figures do not support firm conclusions, that first aid is voluntary, that course costs and insurance are varied, and promised to inform parliament about AED pad reimbursement in spring 2017.
I expect to be able to inform you about this in spring 2017.
Ik verwacht u hierover in het voorjaar van 2017 te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de inzameling van medicijnafval

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the ministers whether municipalities are living up to their responsibility for collecting unused medicines, whether pharmacies are being charged for it, and how waste costs are divided. The State Secretary answers that cooperation between municipalities and pharmacies is needed, that municipalities should make agreements to collect medicines without pharmacies bearing the costs, and that information will be provided to municipalities and pharmacies.
I therefore ask municipalities to reach agreements with pharmacists on the collection of unused medicines.
Ik vraag gemeenten daarom om samen met apothekers tot afspraken te komen voor de inzameling van ongebruikte geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over patiënten die als proefkonijn werden gebruikt in het Erasmus MC

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports that Erasmus MC doctors tested a new atrial fibrillation instrument on patients without their knowledge, and about whether this was regular care or research under the WMO. The Minister said the IGZ is still investigating (with the CCMO) and will report in early 2017, declined to judge the specific case, and explained the consent rules under the WMO and the WGBO.
I will inform your House of the outcome of the investigation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over draagmoederschap

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the NVOG position on donor-gamete assisted reproduction was linked to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, whether more research is needed, and whether hightech surrogacy can be offered to same-sex couples. The minister answered that the NVOG position was accelerated at the commission's request, supported registration and research priorities, and saw no legal barrier for hospitals to offer surrogacy to same-sex couples, without intending to promote it.
Since I have no other information about the existing need, I see no reason at this time to generally promote that hospitals begin offering the treatment.
Aangezien ik geen andere informatie heb over de bestaande behoefte, zie ik nu geen aanleiding om in algemene zin te bevorderen dat ziekenhuizen de behandeling gaan aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van vaccinaties bij kinderen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister why a nine-year-old disabled boy's vaccination was not reimbursed when it had to take place away from the planned location, and whether exceptions exist. The minister acknowledged poor communication in that case, said vaccination is always free with alternative locations or home visits, and estimated such exceptions occur only a few dozen times a year.
I have taken note of the report and regrettably must note that communication in this situation did not go well.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de melding en moet helaas constateren dat de communicatie in deze situatie niet goed is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over dubieuze spelersmakelaars in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about dubious football player agents who take money from parents with false promises, and what rules govern agents. The government answered that no other signals had been received, that only KNVB-registered intermediaries may act, that a quality mark is in development, and that a fraud complaint has been filed and will be investigated by police.
Only persons registered with the KNVB as intermediaries may also act as such.
Uitsluitend personen die bij de KNVB staan geregistreerd als intermediair mogen ook als zodanig optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de noodkreet over de nieuwe contracteerronde fysiotherapie

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a physiotherapists' distress call on the 2017 contracting round, including opaque use of the treatment index, quality-measurement conditions, benchmarks, below-cost tariffs, and third-party access to patient records. Minister Schippers answered at length, largely deferring to private insurer-provider negotiations, noting NZa oversight, transparency rules, and ongoing working-group and monitoring initiatives, while committing to follow-up but not to new binding action.
The contract terms form part of a contract between two private parties, to which the NZa does not automatically have access.
De contractvoorwaarden maken onderdeel uit van een contract tussen twee private partijen, hier heeft de NZa niet zonder meer inzage in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over vechtende voetbalhooligans

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about secret fights between football hooligans, whether they resemble the 1997 Beverwijk fight in which a man died, and whether clubs share responsibility. The minister says the scale is unknown but appears limited to a few incidents, that the fights are less comparable to Beverwijk, that clubs should take a stand, and that participants commit a crime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en De Lange over het bericht “Amsterdam krijgt ‘Turks’ ziekenhuis”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports of a 'Turkish' hospital in Amsterdam, including its funding, whether it respects equal treatment, patient rights and gender norms, and when the inspectorate will visit. The minister answered that funding is for the hospital to disclose, that patient choice and anti-discrimination rules apply equally, that the hospital holds a WTZi licence and has been sent the inspectorate's questionnaire, and that a visit depends on the information received.
If there are signals that a hospital is not complying with the rules, action will be taken against it.
Indien er signalen zijn dat een ziekenhuis zich niet aan de regels houdt dan zal hier tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over belastingschulden van amateur voetbalclubs

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the ministers about tax debts at amateur football clubs, how the KNVB and the Tax Authority share information on suspected fraud, and whether the KNVB licensing system and club accounts can help prevent it. The State Secretary answered that contact with the KNVB is regular, that the Tax Authority is bound by fiscal secrecy and cannot share fraud data with the KNVB, and that the KNVB will explore sporting sanctions while criminal investigations are not disclosed.
The Tax Authority has a general fiscal confidentiality obligation that also applies towards the KNVB licensing committee.
De Belastingdienst heeft een algemene fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht die ook werkt jegens de KNVB licentiecommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending van De Monitor over “verwarde personen”

Christian Democrat MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Health and Justice about a De Monitor broadcast on confused persons, the police plan to stop transporting and holding such persons from 1 January 2017, the legal basis for police cell detention, the readiness of municipalities and mental health providers, and the availability of assertive community treatment teams. The minister answered that the police will phase out this role in 2017, that no full coordinated approach will be in place by 1 January 2017, and that a Schakelteam and ZonMw funding will support municipalities until 2018.

That the police want to stop holding confused persons in cells from 1 January and transporting them during 2017 when they have committed no offence is in line with the recommendations of the Confused Persons Task Force.

Dat de politie per 1 januari wil stoppen met de opvang in cellen en in de loop van 2017 met het vervoer van verwarde personen die geen strafbaar feit hebben gepleegd, is in lijn met de aanbevelingen van het Aanjaagteam Verwarde Personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over de komst van een Turks ziekenhuis in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether they object to a Turkish hospital opening in Amsterdam, whether Turkish influence should be resisted, and whether the Inspectorate will check the clinic, including on circumcision and medication. The minister replied that she has no objection while the clinic meets Dutch standards, that the IGZ and NZa supervise it, and that it will be inspected like other new entrants.
The IGZ treats and inspects the Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center as it inspects all new entrants to check whether they meet the standards applicable in the Netherlands.
De IGZ behandelt en inspecteert de Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center zoals zij alle nieuwe toetreders inspecteert of aan de in Nederland geldende normen wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de opening van een polikliniek voor allochtonen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether a clinic for people of non-Dutch origin with memory disorders should be stopped, questioning whether it is discriminatory and who pays for extra services. The minister said she has no objection as long as care meets Dutch rules and standards, that differentiated diagnostics by population group can sometimes be necessary, and that she will not block the clinic.

As long as the care provided there complies with Dutch healthcare legislation and good care is delivered as established by Dutch stakeholders and professional associations, I have no objection to this clinic.
Zolang de zorg die daar verleent wordt, voldoet aan de Nederlandse gezondheidszorgwetgeving en goede zorg wordt geleverd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over rattenoverlast

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the government about rising rat infestations, the increase in Weil's disease cases, the effectiveness of Integrated Pest Management and rodenticide use, and whether doctors are informed. The government answered that monitoring is still too short for firm trends, that Integrated Pest Management is essential, that cases rose but not tenfold, and that it will evaluate the policy with results expected in 2021.
The number of patients has not increased tenfold in the past year.
Het aantal patiënten is het afgelopen jaar niet verachtvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Albert de Vries Albert over spoedeisende medische zorg op zee

MPs Vermue and Albert de Vries asked the ministers of Health and of Justice and Security about emergency medical care at sea, including whether the Zeeland provincial government's concerns are shared and whether a RIVM norm for sea rescue should be developed. Minister Schippers replied that the government is examining with the Infrastructure minister what sea medical care can learn from land care, with a response on the Safety Board report promised before year end, and she set out existing maritime rescue care norms and the division of responsibilities.
Before the end of the year the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment will respond on behalf of the government to the Safety Board report and send that response to the House.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu namens de regering reageren op het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad en deze reactie aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS zorgverleners aanraadt om browsers niet te updaten

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked why the Ministry of Health advised healthcare providers not to update browsers over Java plugin support ending, and whether this exposed patient data to cyberattacks. The minister explained the advice was to avoid uncontrolled updates that could break software, that responsibility lies with providers, that NCSC was not initially involved but now is, and that a solution is expected by year-end.
It is important that healthcare providers themselves weigh security against possible limits on functionality.
Het is belangrijk dat zorgverleners zelf de afweging maken tussen beveiliging en mogelijke beperking in functionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat orthodontisten de rekening opdrijven

An MP asked the health minister about reports that orthodontists inflate bills through paper intermediary companies and why braces have not become cheaper despite tariff cuts. The minister answered that the NZa supervises one-to-one pass-through of material costs, that a complaints channel found many patients felt under-informed, and that the NZa has tightened supervision and will act where rules are broken.
It is up to the NZa to supervise the one-to-one pass-through of material and technique costs and it will enforce where necessary.
Het is aan de NZa om toezicht te houden op het één op één doorberekenen van de materiaal- en techniekkosten en zal waar nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Bouwmeester over zeggenschap van bewoners, patiënten en cliënten over hun zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Volp asked why residents of care home Thebe cannot sleep under their own bedding when the board will not pay for washing it, and whether the sector's leadership and the Taskforce Waardigheid en Trots should act for those with low incomes. Minister Schippers answered that the Zorginstituut now specifies that the care institution is responsible for washing bedlinen, including residents' own, with the cliëntenraad's agreement, and pointed to the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden and a planned amendment to strengthen client councils' rights.
The institution is responsible for washing the flat linen.
De instelling is verantwoordelijk voor het wassen van het platgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake de aandacht op de publieke tv-zenders voor de Paralympische Spelen

An MP asked the government about the limited TV airtime (about 35 hours) the public broadcasters gave the Paralympics compared with the Olympics, and whether the government would investigate a fairer split. The State Secretary declined to judge the airtime allocation, stressed that public broadcasters decide their own programming under the Mediawet, pointed to increased Paralympic coverage and online streams, and rejected a study as unnecessary and undesirable.
The Mediawet explicitly provides that the public media institutions themselves determine the form and content of their media offering and are themselves responsible for it.
In de Mediawet is nadrukkelijk bepaald dat de publieke media-instellingen zelf de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod bepalen en daar ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over verwijzingen naar abortusklinieken in AZC’s

MPs asked how pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres are cared for, whether COA policy on unplanned pregnancies includes independent counselling on alternatives to abortion, and whether they are being referred to abortion clinics with standard referral letters, with calls for independent investigation. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same maternity care rights as Dutch citizens, that GC A follows NHG standards with referral to clinics or counselling bodies possible, that it finds such steering unacceptable, has received no such signals, and sees no reason for an investigation at present.
At this moment there is no reason for me to conduct an investigation.
Op dit moment is er voor mij geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat een ruzie tussen verschillende trombosediensten de patiënten zou duperen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that a dispute between thrombosis services endangers patients, and about the safety, evidence and prescribing of newer anticoagulants (NOACs) versus traditional ones. The Minister denied any signals of patient harm or calamities, reported that the Medicines Evaluation Board judges the NOACs' benefit-risk balance positive, and said further research and monitoring are under way.
I currently have no signals that patient safety or the quality of care is at stake.
Ik heb nu geen signalen dat de patiëntveiligheid of de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat orthodontisten vingerafdrukken afnemen

An MP asked whether orthodontists may take and store children's fingerprints and whether this breaches privacy rules. The minister answered that the practice uses finger-scan templates linked to patient numbers rather than fingerprints, that consent is required under the data protection rules, and that roughly 15 of about 200 practices use it, with the Dutch Data Protection Authority responsible for judging compliance.
It is therefore not appropriate for me to pass judgement on whether the applicable regulations are being violated.
Het past mij dan ook niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of de geldende regelgeving wordt geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Je laat je kind niet in de steek”

MP Leijten asked ministers about a newspaper report on a psychotic, addicted unemployed man left without support, asking for analysis, cost data, housing figures, and coordination between agencies. Minister Schippers acknowledged fragmented, cross-domain service delivery, stated she lacks overviews on costs and discharges without housing, and said she will urge regional parties to act but cannot resolve the individual case.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Verpleeghuizen boycotten IGZ-uitvraag’

An SP MP asked whether nursing homes boycotting the Inspectorate's (IGZ) request for basic safety indicators was acceptable, whether a sector can withdraw from IGZ oversight, and what the IGZ will do. The State Secretary replied that not supplying the indicators is unacceptable, that the IGZ will demand the information from individual providers, and that the sector's withdrawal from oversight cannot be a real option.
The IGZ will demand the information from individual care providers that do not supply the indicators and take all steps that go with that.
De IGZ zal bij individuele zorgaanbieders die de indicatoren niet aanleveren de informatie vorderen en alle stappen nemen die daar bij horen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de gevolgen van de vrijhandelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP) voor asbesthoudende producten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked whether CETA and TTIP could let asbestos-containing products enter the EU market and whether the precautionary principle is weakened. The minister answered that REACH bans asbestos imports, that mutual recognition does not apply to asbestos, that inspection services have adequate powers, and that the precautionary principle is secured in CETA, while Dutch government asked the Commission for a binding declaration.
To clarify matters, the Netherlands has asked the European Commission to also include the precautionary principle for future safety and health measures in a legally binding declaration.

Ter verduidelijking heeft Nederland de Europese Commissie verzocht om het voorzorgsprincipe voor toekomstige veiligheids- en gezondheidsmaatregelen ook op te nemen in een juridisch bindende verklaring
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Reddingsbrigade Nederland zich ernstige zorgen maakt over de afnemende zwemvaardigheid van kinderen

MP Van Nispen asked the minister about the Reddingsbrigade's concern over declining child swimming ability, and whether compulsory school swimming should be reintroduced. The minister answered that parents have primary responsibility, 95 percent of children obtain diploma A, and reintroducing compulsory swimming lessons is not considered appropriate, while promising an update on the swimming education plan in autumn 2016.
For this reason, the cabinet does not consider it relevant to possibly reintroduce compulsory swimming education nationwide.
Mede hierom acht het kabinet het eventueel opnieuw Rijksbreed invoeren van verplicht zwemonderwijs niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de teelt van medicinale wiet in Tilburg

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about Tilburg allowing home cultivation of medicinal cannabis, including whether the minister was informed, whether other municipalities allow it, and the conditions set. The minister answered that she was not informed beforehand, knows of no other municipalities, considers the mayor's conditions a matter of his discretion, and maintains that home cultivation is prohibited and only ministerial exemptions allow medicinal cannabis production.
Insofar as the mayor applies his own conditions for whether to use administrative enforcement instruments, the mayor has policy discretion and it is not for me to judge this.

Voor zover de burgemeester zijn eigen gestelde voorwaarden 2 hanteert voor het al dan niet inzetten van het bestuurlijk instrumentarium, heeft de burgemeester daar beleidsvrijheid en is het niet aan mij daar een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over “Wageningse geurval kan malaria uitroeien”

An MP asked the ministers whether a scent-trap method for malaria mosquitoes could be applied in the Caribbean Netherlands to combat chikungunya and Zika, and whether a pilot would be started. The minister answered that such research is important but results do not transfer directly to other settings, and committed to a joint plan with Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius, with a pilot only if research supports it.
With these islands it has been agreed that they will jointly work out a plan with the RIVM.
Met deze eilanden is afgesproken dat zij met het RIVM gezamenlijk tot een plan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het twittergedrag van het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why the ministry tweeted five corrective 'facts' after a Buitenhof broadcast on health costs, questioning the sourcing, selected years and the claim that patients get more care for their premium. The minister defended the tweets as correcting incorrect information, gave the requested figures and sources, and said the ministry aims for adequate and correct information.
The ministry considers itself called upon to communicate facts when incorrect information is circulating, and not to enter into discussion for reasons of purity.
Het ministerie acht zich geroepen om als er niet-correcte informatie rondgaat feiten te communiceren, en om uit oogpunt van zuiverheid niet in discussie te treden.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Çegerek (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte (ingezonden 22 april 2016).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about a planned pilot letting municipalities allow residents to place private play equipment in public space, including consultation, safety, oversight and evaluation. The minister answered that the pilot cannot proceed for now because municipalities are unwilling to take on supervisory responsibility, while stating openness to further ideas.
For this reason, I cannot at this time proceed with a pilot in which the Warenwetbesluit attractie- en speeltoestellen could temporarily be deviated from.
Om deze reden kan ik op dit moment niet overgaan tot een pilot waarin tijdelijk van het Warenwetbesluit attractie- en speeltoestellen kan worden afgeweken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het standpunt van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) over geassisteerde voortplanting

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) asked about the NVOG position on assisted reproduction with donor gametes, donor embryos and surrogacy, its status, and whether the government would engage to speed up a guideline. Minister Schippers answered that the position is a non-binding interim advice, that she sees no reason to talk with the NVOG, and that the NVOG proposes raising the IVF age limit for donor eggs from 45 to 50 with conditions, without changing insurance coverage.
It is up to the professional group to determine whether there is sufficient scientific basis to arrive at a guideline.
Het is aan de beroepsgroep om vast te stellen of er voldoende wetenschappelijke onderbouwing bestaat om tot een richtlijn te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het binden van handelsconsequenties aan de dolfijnslachtingen en illegale walvisvangst door Japan

The MP Thieme asks whether the government will make an end to Japanese dolphin slaughter in Taiji and illegal whaling a condition in EU trade and partnership negotiations with Japan, and how the minister will act on this during a trade mission. The minister answers that the government opposes dolphin slaughter and all whaling, will state this at the IWC meeting, and supports the Commission's push to address the issue in a sustainability chapter of the trade deal rather than linking it as a formal condition.
The cabinet supports this approach of the European Commission.
Het kabinet steunt deze inzet van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het schildkliergeneesmiddel Thyrax niet per september weer beschikbaar is, maar pas in het tweede kwartaal van 2017

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether the government would act against manufacturer Aspen after the thyroid drug Thyrax was delayed until Q2 2017, including whether to compensate patients and tighten the supply obligation.
