The minister said the government will neither recover nor compensate patient costs, pointed to existing enforcement and her pharmaceutical vision, and declined to introduce a supply obligation, arguing the IGZ investigation covered only the earlier shortage.
The recent Aspen announcement about being unable to supply Thyrax for longer has no influence on the conclusions of that investigation.
Het recente bericht van Aspen over het nog langer niet kunnen leveren van Thyrax heeft op de conclusies van dat onderzoek geen invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het door apothekers zelf bereiden en doorleveren van geneesmiddelen indien die niet in Nederland worden geproduceerd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the new IGZ circular allowing pharmacists to supply their own preparations to other pharmacies when manufacturers stop production, and about shortages, price increases and industry influence. The minister defended the circular as a narrow, case-by-case non-enforcement framework, noted alternatives exist for Thyrax, said the circular does not address prices, and explained the IGZ consulted stakeholders.
For that reason the IGZ does not enforce when the restrictive conditions described in the circular are met.
Om die reden treedt de IGZ niet-handhavend op wanneer aan de in de circulaire beschreven restrictieve voorwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van de locatie Den Helder van de Noordwest Ziekenhuisgroep

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Den Helder hospital location can remain a basic hospital under its 2014 profile, given plans to concentrate complex multi-day cardiology care in Alkmaar, and what the government will do about local unrest. The Minister answered that the concentration concerns only complex multi-day cardiology, that the Den Helder emergency department must have a cardiologist available within a set time, that the organisation is primarily a matter for providers and insurers supervised by the IGJ and NZa, and that the hospital has commissioned an independent review due in autumn.
It is up to the hospital to discuss intended changes to the profile with the region and to take the region into account in the deliberations on the matter.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis om voornemens tot wijziging van het profiel met de regio te bespreken en de regio mee te nemen in de afwegingen terzake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van de gemeente Den Helder over het verdwijnen van cardiologie uit het Gemini Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a letter from Den Helder municipality opposing the concentration of complex cardiology care in Alkmaar, which they feared would dismantle Gemini Hospital, and asked about insurer VGZ's role, the risk of hospital mergers and whether a merger ban should be imposed. The minister replied that only complex multi-day cardiology is concentrated, that location decisions are for providers and insurers supervised by the IGZ and NZa, that VGZ will evaluate the profile, and that a general merger ban is not desirable, pointing instead to existing merger and competition tests.
A general merger ban is therefore not desirable.
Een algeheel fusieverbod is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een van corruptie en valsheid in geschrifte verdachte ziekenhuisdirecteur

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about reports that a hospital director responsible for building the Prinses Máxima Centrum was arrested on suspicion of corruption and forgery at his previous hospital, and whether the Centre's supervisory board checked his background. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and gave no details, that the Centre's own review found no irregularities in the tender, and that the Centre did check with his former employer and saw no reason to revise the appointment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Sionsberg in Dokkum wankelt door ruzie met zorgverzekeraar De Friesland-Achmea

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that hospital De Sionsberg in Dokkum is at risk after insurer De Friesland-Achmea terminated its contract, and whether the insurer is meeting its duty of care amid rising waiting lists. The minister said she has urged the parties to find a solution, asked the NZa and IGZ to examine the insurer's duty of care and care quality, and stated that good accessible care in Dokkum must be guaranteed, though she declined to judge whether a breach of contract occurred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Jacobi over het ziekenhuis in Dokkum

MPs Bouwmeester and Jacobi (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health why an agreement on a new care arrangement for the Dokkum hospital is not being implemented, which parties are not honouring it, and whether the NZa will again monitor the process. The Minister regrets the situation, says no single party is to blame, reports no signal that continuity of care is at risk, notes the NZa sees no risks to the duty of care while investigating possible bottlenecks, and calls on all parties to cooperate.
I do not want to comment on the question of who is responsible for what is happening.
Ik wil mij ook niet uitlaten over de vraag door wiens toedoen wat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Falen met psychoten’

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health about a news report on failures in dealing with psychiatric patients who may pose a danger, including whether municipalities had a plan of action by summer 2016, why the aanjaagteam target was missed, and whether the Hoekstra monitoring report had been received. The Minister replied that the aim of a sound approach by all municipalities in summer 2016 was ambitious, that answers will follow in the government's reaction to the second interim report in late September, and that the Hoekstra report will be submitted by 15 October.
I have not yet received the monitoring report from Mr Hoekstra.
Het monitorrapport van de heer Hoekstra heb ik nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat de risico’s van de drug 4-FA groter zijn dan tot nu toe bekend

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the risks of the drug 4-FA are greater than previously known, including rising user numbers, poisonings and health risks. The state secretary answered that a warning was issued, an information leaflet was prepared, a CAM risk assessment was commissioned ahead of possible Opiumwet listing, and registration of drug incidents is done via MDI and LIS networks.
Based on the risk assessment, the CAM will advise me on measures to be taken.
Het CAM zal op basis van de risicoschatting advies aan mij uitbrengen over te nemen maatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Zorgverzekeraars claimen 50 miljoen bij aanbieders wijkverpleging en het bericht van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zi

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked about reports that health insurers claim 50 million from home-care providers for exceeding revenue caps, and about insurers' duty of care for insured persons. The State Secretary answered that such contractual revenue caps and clawbacks are a matter between insurers and providers, that insurers' statutory duty of care remains intact, and described the dispute-resolution route and the numbers of additional contracts and care hours.
This concerns a component of a contractual agreement between an individual care provider and an individual health insurer, of which I am not a party.
Dit betreft een onderdeel van een contractuele overeenkomst tussen een individuele zorgaanbieder en een individuele zorgverzekeraar waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de negatieve gevolgen van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the ministers whether TTIP's tariff cuts on sugar, alcohol and tobacco would harm public health, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that tariff cuts may lower consumer prices, that public health policy space remains under TTIP, and that a full response will follow once Ecorys' final report is published.
Once the final report is published, the cabinet will give a comprehensive response.
Zodra het definitieve rapport is gepubliceerd, zal het kabinet een uitgebreide reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Nederlanders schrikbarend lang stilzitten

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Social Affairs ministers about reports that Dutch people, especially young people, sit for very long periods and move too little, and whether sitting should be treated as a health threat. Minister Schippers answered that sitting time is linked to health risks, that causes are not well studied, and that existing programmes (Gezonde School, Alles is Gezondheid, Arbo rules) and a pending Health Council advice will be used, without committing to a new sitting norm.
I expect this overview by the end of 2016.
Ik verwacht dit overzicht voor eind 2016.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht Meander MC laat verzekerden VGZ langer wachten (ingezonden 22 juli 2016).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about Meander Medical Centre making VGZ insured patients wait longer due to a budget ceiling dispute, asking about scale, fairness, and resolution. The minister's follow-up answer reports constructive talks and that Meander has lifted the longer waiting times for VGZ patients from 5 September, with regular access times restored.
Meanwhile I have understood from both Meander Medical Centre and VGZ that they are currently holding constructive talks with each other.
Ondertussen heb ik zowel van Meander Medisch Centrum als VGZ begrepen dat zij momenteel constructieve gesprekken met elkaar voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuisbestuurders een calamiteitenrapport herschrijven voordat het naar de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) gaat

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about reports that hospital boards rewrite incident reports before they go to the Health Inspectorate (IGZ), and how the inspectorate's risk-based oversight and incident handling work. The Minister replied that boards are responsible for investigating calamities, that the IGZ intervenes when reports conceal causes, and that it does not keep a list of rewritten reports, while rejecting a culture of concealment and offering no new 24-hour investigation team.
When the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) finds that board members conceal the main causes of a calamity in an incident report to prevent reputational damage, it intervenes.

Wanneer de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) erachter komt dat bestuurders hoofdoorzaken van een calamiteit in een calamiteitenrapport verhullen om reputatieschade te voorkomen, dan grijpt zij in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Selectiecriteria geven duidelijkheid over deelname aan ketenzorg

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about criteria for chronic-care programme participation, the VGZ insurer's handling of primary care contracting, and whether insurers abuse market power. The minister answered that inclusion/exclusion criteria were agreed jointly to improve clarity, add no administrative burden, and that disputes can go to an independent dispute body while the NZa and ACM handle complaints.
It is for the ACM to handle individual complaints reported to them.
Het is aan de ACM om individuele klachten die bij hen gemeld worden, te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de uitzending 'hoe de mysterieuze Stellar-group voetbalfamilies verleidt'

An MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate the Stellar Group's approaches to young footballers' families before the boys turn 16, and about the rules, supervision and possible new measures against child transfers. The minister answered that FIFA and the KNVB supervise the rules, that existing rules are adequate, and that no new measures are planned, while declining to say whether the Public Prosecution Service investigates.
As previously indicated to your House, the Public Prosecution Service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating something.
Zoals eerder aangegeven richting uw Kamer, kan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de deprivatisering van sportaccommodaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the privatisation and de-privatisation of sports facilities such as swimming pools, including costs, risks to public interest, and possible national support for municipalities. The minister replied that sports facility policy is a municipal responsibility, that no form of management is inherently better, and that the ministry offers support mainly through the Buurtsportcoach scheme and knowledge bodies without new funding.
Sports facility policy is a responsibility of the municipality itself.
Sportaccommodatie beleid is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de facelift met draadjes verboden moet worden

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the government would ban threadlifts after plastic surgeons warned that the procedure is misleading, often done by untrained doctors in non-sterile settings, and uses materials linked to banned fillers. The minister replied that the IGZ has received no complaints, that the claims are not substantiated enough to act on, and that a ban would need concrete evidence, while promising to act if complaints or calamities arise.
If calamities occur or the NVPC believes based on research that threadlifts unnecessarily harm patients' health, they can report this to the IGZ.
Als zich calamiteiten voordoen of de NVPC meent op basis van onderzoek dat draadlifts onnodig schadelijke gevolgen hebben voor de gezondheid van patiënten, dan kunnen zij dit melden bij de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over Het niet melden van een medische misser

MPs De Lange and Rutte asked the health minister about a hospital that again did not report a suspected medical error (calamity) in a baby's death, and whether the Inspectorate (IGZ) can adequately review such investigations and should be supported by external expertise or a task force. The minister answered that the hospital has now changed its procedure to report suspected calamities directly to the IGZ, that the IGZ supervises calamity investigations and their quality and parental involvement, and that a mandatory national task force is not considered necessary.

The IGZ assesses the report and asks the hospital itself to investigate calamities, unless the nature of the report or other information about the hospital gives reason for the IGZ to conduct the investigation itself.

De IGZ beoordeelt de melding en vraagt het ziekenhuis zelf calamiteiten te onderzoeken, tenzij de aard van de melding of andere informatie over het betrokken ziekenhuis aanleiding geven dat de IGZ zelf onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een nieuwe vondst van het hepatitis E-virus op Nederlandse leverworst en paté

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether leverworst and paté containing hepatitis E should be withdrawn from sale, labelled, or subject to systematic testing and a reporting duty for farms and slaughterhouses. The minister refused withdrawal and labelling because the risk to the general population is very low, announced a nutrition advice for high-risk patients and ongoing NVWA testing, and declined a reporting duty.
I see no reason to withdraw leverworst and paté from sale or to take additional labelling measures for these pork products.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het uit de handel halen van leverworst en paté of aanvullende maatregelen voor het etiketteren van deze varkensvleesproducten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Meander MC laat verzekerden VGZ langer wachten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital Meander MC making insured patients of insurer VGZ wait longer after exceeding a contracted budget ceiling. The minister says the hospital and insurer disagree, that acute care remains available to all, and that the parties should resolve the dispute, with the independent dispute body available if needed.
I regret that these citizens are being harmed by a dispute between a hospital and an insurer.
Ik betreur het dat deze burgers gedupeerd worden door een geschil tussen een ziekenhuis en een verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat miljoenen euro's zorggeld verdwijnen in de zakken van directeuren

The SP MP Leijten asks the State Secretary how small care providers can make very high profits, why a third of recognised care businesses do not file full annual accounts, how profit-taking in care can be stopped, and whether a licensing requirement or a ban on care-sector BV structures should be introduced. The State Secretary responds that profit distribution is restricted for intramural care under the WTZi, that the IGZ is investigating specific cases, that supervisory boards and purchasers bear primary responsibility, that partial reporting for a substantial share of providers is allowed under the rules, and that existing licensing already applies, while declining to ban the BV structure.
The IGZ investigations into these matters are currently ongoing and I cannot anticipate their content or outcomes.
De onderzoeken van de IGZ hiernaar lopen op dit moment en ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de inhoud en de uitkomsten ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de tolkenvergoeding in de zorg

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Health whether the non-reimbursement of interpreter costs leaves refugees without equal access to care, and whether interpreter costs should be covered while refugees lack sufficient Dutch. The minister acknowledges communication problems, says Dutch is needed for basic communication, states that the Qualification Directive is met, and only commits to discussing support for GPs with the LHV.
The Netherlands meets the obligations of the Qualification Directive.
Nederland voldoet aan de verplichtingen van de Kwalificatierichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de verspreiding van abortuspillen door Women on Waves naar Noord-Ierland

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the Women on Waves abortion-pill action toward Northern Ireland was lawful, whether the Dutch permit was affected, and whether there was contact with Ireland. The Minister answered that Northern Ireland's authorities are responsible for enforcement, no temporary permit was required since the action took place abroad, and there was no contact with Ireland or Northern Ireland.
Since Women on Waves' conduct did not take place on Dutch territory, no permit is required under Article 296(5) of the Criminal Code.
Aangezien het handelen van Women on Waves niet op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvond, is er geen vergunning vereist
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de ambulancedienst in de regio Haaglanden het werk niet aan kan

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about reports that the ambulance service in the Haaglanden region cannot cope with its workload, including staff and vehicle shortages, response times and emergency ward waiting times. The Minister acknowledged the signals of pressure, attributed them to rising demand and staff scarcity, and said she would inform the House after the summer, though she declined to provide ward waiting time data and deferred the closure decision at Antoniushove to the hospital.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet openbaar maken van het Thyrax rapport door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why the Inspectorate has not yet published its report on the Thyrax shortage, who objected to publication, and how often publication of inspection reports is contested. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate intends to publish, that a concerned party has objected and the objection is being weighed under the Wob, and that sixteen objections were raised in 2016 so far.
The inspectorate intends to make this report public.
De inspectie is voornemens dit rapport openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de fusie tussen Achterhoekse ziekenhuizen accordeert.

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the NZa's approval of the merger of two Achterhoek hospitals, including effects on care, staff, patients, the reasons for merging, the future of the Winterswijk hospital, choice for patients, and the number of merger approvals and rejections. The minister answered that the competition authority ACM must assess the merger under competition law, that the NZa found continuity of crucial care safeguarded, that the Winterswijk hospital remains sensitive for emergency and acute obstetric care, and that she leaves merger decisions to the independent regulators.
Should the merger go ahead definitively, it is up to the board to provide clarity on how they intend to give substance to the merger and what the consequences are.
Mocht de fusie definitief doorgaan, dan is het aan het bestuur om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij invulling willen geven aan de fusie en wat de gevolgen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over problemen bij uitbetaling van verleende palliatieve zorg

The SGP MP Van der Staaij asks the minister about billing problems for palliative care, including the rule that blocks parallel palliative and active clinical billing, and why the NZa postponed a fix until 2018. Minister Schippers replies that parallel billing is already possible via another specialty, that the NZa is running a broader inventory with quick wins planned, and that the intercollegial consult rule will not be abolished.
I do not intend to abolish this rule.
Ik ben niet voornemens deze regel af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat drie kankerpatiënten onder verdachte omstandigheden zijn overleden na behandeling in een alternatieve kankerkliniek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that three cancer patients died after treatment at a German alternative cancer clinic, including whether Dutch patients were affected, whether the clinic should be closed, how oversight of alternative healers works, and whether insurers reimburse such treatment. The minister answered that the German authorities are investigating with Dutch support, that the Dutch inspectorate has contacted patients, that the clinic has halted operations, and that foreign oversight and insurance coverage fall outside her direct responsibility.
While this German investigation is ongoing, I cannot inform you further about the content of the case.
Lopende dit Duitse onderzoek kan ik u niet nader over de inhoud van de zaak informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over  Het openbaar maken van ziekenhuistarieven en de rol van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) hierin

An MP asked the health minister why the NZa refuses to publish hospital tariffs despite welcoming CZ's partial disclosure, and whether a legal barrier under the Wmg and Wet openbaarheid van bestuur prevents transparency. The minister replied that the NZa cannot disclose competitively sensitive information, that a court case is pending, and that the ministry will hold an expert meeting and report to parliament in autumn.
It is not for me to anticipate the court's ruling.
Het is niet aan mij om op de uitspraak van de rechter vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgkosten juist zullen stijgen door het openbaar maken van tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether publishing hospital tariffs would raise care costs, whether published prices reflect real costs and quality, and whether patients can meaningfully choose providers. Minister Schippers replied that she supports transparency on costs and quality, argues price transparency is unlikely to raise prices, promises to report on an October expert meeting, and defends the current performance-based payment system.
The Ministry of Health is organising a meeting with experts on this subject in October.
Het Ministerie van VWS organiseert in oktober een bijeenkomst met experts op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veel palliatieve zorg in ziekenhuizen niet wordt vergoed door fouten in de bekostigingssystematiek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether hospitals are not reimbursed for palliative care due to flaws in the DBC funding system, and why some hospitals have stopped providing it. The minister replied that palliative care can be reimbursed through a palliative care team with a different specialist opening the palliative DBC, that the NZa is running an inventory with results due in January 2017 and changes for 2018, and that the current DBC system functions with problems addressed where they exist.
The NZa has concluded that there are currently bottlenecks in the funding of palliative care throughout the entire chain.
De NZa heeft geconcludeerd dat er momenteel in de bekostiging van palliatieve zorg in de gehele keten knelpunten zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Leenders over verwijsproblemen van Brabantse huisartsen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Brabant GPs struggle to refer MRSA patients, including hospitals refusing pig farmers and patients going to Belgium, and about isolation beds for stroke patients. The minister answered that the reports rest on suspicions without concrete cases, that one incident was resolved by referral to another hospital, that no formal reports were filed with the IGZ, and that no norms exist for isolation beds, which the IGZ oversees.
I have made inquiries in the region as to whether there is a question of major problems.
Ik heb in de regio navraag gedaan of er sprake is van grote problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over tekortschietende leeftijdscontrole van jongeren die onder de zonnebank willen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about lax age checks for young people using sunbeds, the NHG's skin-cancer guideline, the role of GPs versus dermatologists, and SCENIHR findings on sunbed-related melanoma, and asked whether licensing or ID requirements for sunbed providers should be introduced. The Minister replied that the guideline is due in mid-2017, that she is awaiting SCENIHR's final opinion and is exploring with stakeholders how to improve compliance, and that she has no conclusions yet on NVWA enforcement powers.
On ways to improve the enforcement powers of the NVWA, I do not yet want to draw conclusions at this point.
Over manieren om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de NVWA te verbeteren, wil ik op dit moment nog geen conclusies trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de ophanden zijnde sluiting van het Psycho Trauma Centrum (PTC) van Rivierduinen in Leiden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the Psycho Trauma Centre at Rivierduinen in Leiden, its reasons, alternatives for patients, waiting lists, job losses and worker participation. The minister answered that psychotrauma treatment remains available but shifts to outpatient care for patients, that the provider decides organisation and content, and that individual arrangements are made for current patients.
How this is given organisational or care-content shape is not up to me.
Hoe daar organisatorisch of zorginhoudelijk invulling aan wordt gegeven, is niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de vervuiling van supermarktproducten

An MP asked the health minister about mineral oil hydrocarbons (MOAH/MOSH) found in supermarket food, whether they are banned, what enforcement and recalls followed, and whether harder action than a renewed appeal to supermarkets is planned. The minister replied that the NVWA does not yet test for these substances because no specific legal limits or sufficient scientific clarity exist, that a European monitoring study runs into 2017 with norms to be considered afterwards, and that companies bear responsibility for safety, with the industry federation acting.
In my answers of 23 November 2015 I indicated that the NVWA is currently not checking for the presence of the mineral oils MOAH and MOSH in foodstuffs.

In mijn antwoorden van 23 november 2015 4 op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber heb ik aangegeven dat de NVWA op dit moment niet op de aanwezigheid van de minerale oliën MOAH en MOSH in levensmiddelen controleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht “Twee miljoen voor in opspraak geraakte oud-Achmea-bestuurder”

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about severance and salary payments to former Achmea board members, one linked to a fraud case, and whether public money is involved. The minister replied that the pay complied with WNT rules, that the members were not responsible for care activities, that a court has ordered the conditional severance paid, and that individual pay judgements are left to the institutions.
The Cabinet wants socially acceptable incomes for care executives and for executives of health insurers.
Het Kabinet wil maatschappelijk acceptabele inkomens voor zorgbestuurders en bestuurders van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over jong ouderschap naar aanleiding van het congres Jong en Ouder

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the state secretary about support, housing, funding fragmentation and care for young parents, including teen pregnancies in closed youth care. The state secretary largely pointed to municipal responsibility, existing initiatives and the taskforce, promising follow-up letters on national procurement and a study on the demand side.
Municipalities precisely have the opportunity to look, using funds from different sources, at how integrated tailored support can best be delivered.
Gemeenten hebben juist de mogelijkheid om met middelen die uit verschillende bronnen komen te kijken op welke wijze integraal het beste maatwerk kan worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht “Top slechte verpleegtehuizen verdient meer dan balkenendenorm”

MPs Kerstens and Volp asked whether it is appropriate that executives of underperforming nursing homes earn more than the Balkenende norm, and whether boards should hold back salary increases and urge reductions. The state secretary answered that the WNT sets the maximum, that supervisory boards must weigh pay case by case, that salaries are already public, and that the CIBG enforces the WNT if violations occur.
Within the limits set by the WNT, it is up to the internal supervisors to determine what an appropriate remuneration for the executive(s) concerned is.
Binnen de grenzen die de WNT stelt, is het aan de interne toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning voor de betrokken bestuurder(s) is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over ‘Toezichthouders MCL gaan er fors op vooruit’ (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Wet normering topinkomens, which raised the maximum pay for supervisory board members, invites supervisors to rush to the new maximum, especially in healthcare, and whether the stated reason for the increase (compensating for lower executive pay) was accurate. The minister answered that the increase reflects broader supervisory roles and greater actual time spent, that individual agreements must stay within the law, and that the increase was separately motivated in the legislative process.
Any increases in remuneration must also be seen in the context of this broadening of roles, responsibilities and time commitment.
Eventuele verhogingen van de bezoldiging moeten ook in het kader van deze verruiming van de rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en tijdsbesteding worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hoge ziekteverzuim in de zorg

An SP MP asks the government why sickness absence in health and welfare care is higher than the national average, why it is high in care homes and social services, whether burnout follows from understaffing, and what measures will reduce it, including the staffing norm for long-term care demanded by the Leijten motion. The state secretary answers that absence has long been higher in this sector and reflects demanding work, that the 2016 Q1 figures are not clearly higher than 2015, that a staffing guideline is being developed and due by 1 October, and that existing programmes and sector campaigns address sustainable employability.
I see this as a good opportunity to raise the prevention of work stress and sickness absence in care on the agenda.
Ik zie dat als een goede gelegenheid om het tegengaan van werkstress en ziekteverzuim in de zorg aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Leijten over de handelswijze van bestuurders bij Alliade Zorggroep

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at Alliade Zorggroep, where two directors earned money through subcontracting companies, and whether the supervisory board, accountants, IGZ and NZa failed in their oversight. The state secretary answered that IGZ and NZa investigated, found no unlawful use of care funds, and that Alliade has committed to measures such as tighter internal rules and disclosure, with the IGZ to monitor compliance.
I share with IGZ and NZa that any appearance of conflict of interest must be avoided and I agree with their judgment that Alliade must remedy this.
Ik deel met IGZ en NZa dat iedere schijn van belangenverstrengeling moet worden vermeden en deel hun oordeel dat Alliade dit moet herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Arno Rutte over het bericht dat de gemeente Heerhugowaard gedeeld eigenaar van een ziekenhuis wil worden

MPs Veldman and Rutte asked whether Heerhugowaard may co-own a hospital under the Fido Act, how the province supervises the financial risk, and whether a municipality could have an incentive to weaken WMO care to fill beds. The minister answered that the municipal council must judge whether co-ownership serves the public interest, that the province exercises only repressive supervision and cannot block the investment in advance, and that the WMO concern is not realistic.
Heerhugowaard is currently subject to repressive supervision, so its structural and real budgetary balance is assessed only afterwards.
Voor de gemeente Heerhugowaard geldt momenteel het repressieve toezicht, waardoor het structurele en reële begrotingsevenwicht alleen achteraf wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over de uitbuiting van Nederlandse voetbaltrainers in China

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether reports that Dutch football coaches in China receive little pay and return disillusioned, and any related exploitation, corruption or deception, warrant government action and whether the KNVB should warn coaches of the risks. The minister said the individual case is unknown, coaches should prepare themselves, Dutch embassy advised seeking a lawyer, the government sees no direct role beyond the courts, and the KNVB will be consulted on informing coaches.
Since I do not know the individual case, I cannot make a statement about it.
Aangezien ik de individuele casus niet ken kan ik hier geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over zingeving in de zorg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the ZonMw report on meaning-giving (zingeving) in care, the NPCF finding that 83% of patients want attention to meaning in care, and whether knowledge agendas and funding should follow. The Minister agreed meaning-giving should be part of personalised care, noted that under half of patients have experienced such attention, and pointed to existing ZonMw programmes and a NVKG research agenda while promising to keep raising the issue.

I agree with the authors of the report that, since not everyone finds all aspects of meaning-giving equally important, it is necessary to make individual needs discussable, producing care tailored to each person.
Ik ben het met opstellers van het signalement eens dat, aangezien niet iedereen alle aspecten van zingeving (even) belangrijk vindt, het noodzakelijk is om individuele behoeften bespreekbaar te maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het aantal orgaantransplantaties in 2015

An MP asked the health minister about the 2015 fall in heartbeating donors, the large variation in living kidney donation across transplant centres, and measures to reduce it. The minister attributed the donor fluctuation to chance and the regional structure of centres, and pointed to a revised donation-by-living-donor subsidy scheme and joint guidelines as the response.
I believe policy should not aim at reducing the large differences between the centres.
Ik vind dat het beleid zich niet moet richten op het verkleinen van de grote verschillen tussen de centra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing en georganiseerde criminaliteit

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about match-fixing, organised crime links, information exchange with Germany (Rode Paul case) and prosecution priorities. The minister answered that police and prosecutors give match-fixing priority, that international cooperation will be stepped up through EU expert groups, and that organised-crime links will be examined in a 2017 threat assessment.
Repeatedly requesting the same case documents from German colleagues by different investigative and prosecution services has indeed not been efficient.
Het meermalen opvragen in het verleden door verschillende opsporings- dan wel vervolgingsdiensten van dezelfde dossierstukken bij de Duitse collega’s is inderdaad niet efficiënt geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Cyber security van apparatuur in ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar’

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked about reports that medical equipment in hospitals is vulnerable to cyber attacks, including malware infections and whether ministers would investigate device security and push for a national approach. The minister replied that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, pointed to existing NCSC initiatives (ISAC, Z-CERT) and a forthcoming quickscan, and committed to further study and discussion with stakeholders.
Information security is an own responsibility of a healthcare institution.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over PrEP

An MP asked the health minister about the effectiveness and safety of PrEP, why its introduction awaits EMA registration despite FDA approval elsewhere, and whether preparatory steps can avoid delay. The minister replied that PrEP awaits EMA registration, will seek a Health Council advisory opinion, and cannot anticipate those outcomes.
I will ask the Health Council for advice on the desirability of deploying PrEP for very specific risk groups.
Ik ga de Gezondheidsraad om advies vragen over de opportuniteit van de inzet van PrEP bij zeer specifieke risicogroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het nieuwe bevolkingsonderzoek 108 kankergevallen voorkomt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that the new cervical cancer screening would prevent 108 cancer cases, and about the discrepancy with earlier figures, the reliability of self-sampling, cost effects, and conflicts of interest of a researcher (Meijer) involved in the screening. The Minister explained the differing figures stem from different sources and modelling assumptions, pointed to ongoing cost-effectiveness and IMPROVE studies, declined to comment on the integrity committee's conclusions (leaving that to VUmc), and said the Health Inspectorate sees no reason for an investigation into conflicts of interest but will examine whether patient material was used without proper consent.
I leave the judgment on this to the Scientific Integrity Committee of VU-VUMC.
Ik laat het oordeel hierover aan de Wetenschappelijke Commissie Integriteit van VU-VUMC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over sport en bewegen voor cliënten in de opvang

An MP asked the minister about sport and exercise opportunities for clients in shelters, including for asylum seekers in COA locations, and about the results of the Meedoen programme and its continuation. The minister said such opportunities are important, pointed to existing funding and projects, reported satisfaction with Meedoen results, and committed to talks with the Federatie Opvang on keeping the results in place.
As promised in the sport committee debate of 30 June, I spoke with the State Secretary at your request to examine whether sport and exercise are embedded.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO sport van 30 juni jongstleden heb ik op uw verzoek gesproken met de Staatssecretaris om te bezien of sport en bewegen is ingebed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de bezettingsnorm voor zorg aan ernstig zieke baby's op de afdeling neonatologie

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about staffing norms for specialised nurses caring for critically ill babies in neonatology, including night-time ratios and whether tasks can be shifted to other staff. The Minister answered that the field norms come from a 2000 Health Council report, that the hospital and inspectorate are responsible for staffing, and that the inspectorate will intervene if quality falls short.
It is not for the Ministry of VWS but for the hospital or department itself, within the framework of applicable laws and regulations, to organise a care offer with sufficient qualified staff.

Het is niet aan het Ministerie van VWS maar aan het betreffende ziekenhuis of afdeling zelf om binnen het kader van geldende wet- en regelgeving een zorgaanbod te organiseren met voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over Driezorg in Zwolle en de Wet normering topinkomens

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked about a 426,113 euro severance payment to the former director of Driezorg in Zwolle and whether it complies with the WNT pay cap. The state secretary answered that the amount exceeds the WNT limit but that pre-WNT agreements apply until four years after 2013, that the accountant found no violations, and that the CIBG will nonetheless investigate.
Nevertheless, the CIBG will carry out an investigation to ensure there is no question of violations.
Desondanks zal het CIBG een onderzoek uitvoeren om zeker te stellen dat er geen sprake is van overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het gebruik van antibiotica door boeren

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretaries whether they were aware of the SDa report on antibiotic use in livestock in 2015, why the 58% reduction since 2009 falls short of the 70% target and what further steps will be taken, and whether more demanding targets, further analysis and binding measures are planned for farms that show no reduction. The government welcomed the reduction, announced additional measures for high-use farms and vets, committed to a sector analysis of critical success factors and a pilot at high-use farms, and promised to inform parliament before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess we will inform you about this follow-up policy.
Voor het zomerreces informeren wij u over dit vervolgbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de inzet van professionele tolken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about a Nivel study finding that doctors need professional interpreters about three times more often than they can be deployed, and whether the minister would widen interpreter reimbursement beyond three specific groups. The minister acknowledged the communication problems and said she would discuss the identified practical bottlenecks with the KNMG, but kept the principle that patients should speak Dutch and did not commit to broadening reimbursement.
In principle there is no interpreter reimbursement in healthcare because the starting point is that people speak Dutch.
Er is in beginsel geen tolkenvergoeding in de zorg omdat het uitgangspunt is dat men Nederlands spreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP ask the health and justice ministers whether the government's answer on the written euthanasia request guidance was adequate and whether its wording on dementia patients, which they say confuses doctors and the public, should be changed. The minister replies that the sentence should be read in the context of dementia cases, that it is clear, and that the working group decided not to amend it.
In consultation, the members of the working group on the written euthanasia declaration have therefore decided not to amend the passage.
In overleg hebben de leden van de werkgroep «Schriftelijke wilsverklaring euthanasie» dan ook besloten de passage niet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht «RDW gaat mogelijk Opel Zafira’s in heel Europa terugroepen»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that the RDW might recall Opel Zafira cars across Europe, and about possible emissions-software irregularities at Fiat and the handling of such cases. The minister replied that no recall is yet underway, that the German KBA is investigating possible prohibited defeat devices, that no reason for further action has been found so far, and that Italian authorities are responsible for the Fiat investigation.
There is currently no recall planned. Should a recall come, the appropriate procedures will be followed.
Er is op dit moment geen terugroepactie voorzien. Mocht er een terugroepactie komen, dan zullen daarvoor de geëigende procedures worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van extreme weersomstandigheden

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of extreme weather, climate scenarios, municipal climate risk preparedness, funding for adaptation, and event planning. The government answered that existing Delta Programme decisions remain valid, gave an overview of current programmes and an evaluation due end 2016, and said municipal capacity is the responsibility of local authorities.
The ambition is that by 2020 climate-resilient action and water-robust planning will be an integral part of their policy and conduct.
De ambitie hierbij is dat in 2020 klimaatbestendig handelen en waterrobuust inrichten een integraal onderdeel van hun beleid en handelen is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de farmaceutische industrie artsen betaalt via een sluiproute

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms pay doctors via commercial education bureaus outside the Transparantieregister Zorg, and what should be done. Minister Schippers answered that such payments should be reported where the company knows of or influences the doctor's engagement, that self-regulation through the CGR code is relied upon, and that she sees no reason yet to make participation legally mandatory.
I do not have the data to make such an estimate.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens om een dergelijke inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht  “Oudere met kanker loopt juiste zorg mis”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report that elderly cancer patients receive inconsistent treatment depending on hospital, and questioned causes, socio-economic effects, and insurer purchasing policy. The Minister acknowledged hospital variation, attributed it mainly to lack of evidence for older patients, and promised research agenda work and regional oncology networks but said she had no data on several points.
I agree with the doctors in the article that the patient's place of residence should not determine the treatment.
Ik ben het met de artsen uit het artikel eens dat de woonplaats van de patiënt niet bepalend mag zijn voor de behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de doofpotcultuur bij medische missers

An MP (PVV) asked the health minister about a culture of concealing medical errors, failure to report calamities to the Inspectorate, lack of support for patients after errors, and whether fines were imposed on hospitals for late or non-reporting. The minister answered that the IGZ will issue a circular on the reporting duty and hold dialogues with the sector, that fines and warnings apply for late or non-reporting (warnings in 2013-2015, one fine in 2015), and that aftercare for patients fits within the Wkkgz, with the sector responsible for implementing it.
The IGZ will send a circular in the autumn explaining the duty to report calamities and will discuss with the care sector what a calamity is.
De IGZ zal in het najaar een circulaire sturen met een toelichting op de meldplicht bij calamiteiten en zal met het zorgveld in gesprek gaan over wat een calamiteit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over toezichthouders in de zorg die hun vergoeding verhogen

An SP MP asked whether it is morally objectionable that care-sector supervisors raised their own pay sharply, and whether the government foresaw this after loosening the pay norm. The minister explained that the WNT norm was raised to match the actual time spent on supervision and defended the increases as part of expanded responsibilities, while declining to track total public spending on these pay packages.
Remuneration exceeding the pay maxima will, subject to transitional law, have to be brought back down to the norm.
Bezoldigingen die de bezoldigingsmaxima te boven gaan zullen, met inachtneming van het overgangsrecht, teruggebracht moeten worden naar de norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de topinkomens in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether it is troubling that healthcare executives earn above the minister's salary, and whether executives should voluntarily forgo pay above the WNT norm, and whether they are paid in line with the WNT. The minister answered that pay limits are set by the WNT, that institutions and supervisors make a societal assessment within those limits, that pay is a recurring topic with employer organisations, and that CIBG supervises WNT compliance and enforces where needed.
CIBG, the supervisory body in healthcare, monitors compliance with the WNT and enforces it where necessary.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg, ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT en treedt, indien nodig, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een groot ziekenhuis over een paar jaar achterhaald is

MP Leijten asked the minister on what research she based her claim that large hospitals will be obsolete within a few years, and how this fits with ongoing hospital mergers and emergency-room closures. The minister answered that hospital care must reorganise toward networks and home-based treatment, that she does not consider hospitals unnecessary, and that the Nza and ACM review mergers while market oversight is being strengthened.
I informed your House about this in more detail by letter on 6 June.
Ik heb uw Kamer daar op 6 juni per brief nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de geschillencommissie onder de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether low-threshold recognised complaints committees under the Wkkgz will be available from 1 January 2017, and why none had yet been recognised. The minister said providers must join a recognised dispute body from that date, no recognition had yet been granted, parties were working on setting them up with the expected recognitions in the coming months, and she saw no reason to doubt compliance.
At this moment I have not yet granted recognition for such a dispute body.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen erkenning verleend voor een dergelijke geschilleninstantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over besmette zandbakken in speeltuinen

An MP asked the government about contamination of playground sandpits with dog and cat faeces that can carry toxoplasmosis and toxocariasis, including infection rates, disease course, and whether the NVWA oversees sandpit surfaces. The Minister replied that infection rates are not tracked, the NVWA supervises owners' duty to keep surfaces safe, and advised parents and owners on hygiene and sand use without committing to new measures.
There is no notification obligation for Toxoplasma or Toxocara. There is therefore no overview of the number of cases.
Er bestaat geen meldingsplicht voor Toxoplasma of Toxocara. Er is dus geen overzicht van het aantal gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het schenden van mensenrechten in Brazilië in de aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about police violence and erosion of protest and expression rights in Brazil ahead of the Olympics, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns with Brazilian authorities and the Olympic Committee. The minister acknowledged serious concern about urban violence and police conduct, said the Netherlands raises human rights issues in bilateral and EU dialogues and at the consulate, and said it would voice concern about the anti-terrorism law if it restricts protest or expression, but did not commit to a specific new initiative with the Olympic Committee.
If application of this law indeed leads to restriction of the right to peaceful protest or freedom of expression, the Netherlands will express its concern about this to the Brazilian authorities.

Indien toepassing van deze wet inderdaad leidt tot inperking van het recht op vreedzame protesten of vrijheid van meningsuiting, zal Nederland zijn zorg hierover uiten aan de Braziliaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat ggz-patiënten (patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg) vaker in een tbs-kliniek zitten

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the ministers how BOPZ psychiatric patients can be transferred to a TBS clinic without a judge's involvement, why suitable GGZ places are lacking, and whether the bed reduction is to blame. The government answered that transfers are based on BOPZ article 55 with a copy to the judge, are rare (about 0.24% of BOPZ patients, 38 people), are made by the medical director on psychiatric indication, and that a broader study and IGZ talks will follow.
These are BOPZ patients whose judicial measure is converted into a BOPZ authorisation.
Het gaat hierbij om BOPZ-patiënten van wie de justitiële maatregel wordt omgezet in een BOPZ-machtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het oordeel van de IGZ inzake het mensgebonden onderzoek bij psychiatrische patiënten bij GGZ NHN

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) handling of a human-subject drug study with psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, including whether the report and whistleblower treatment would be made public and whether violations were reported to the prosecutor. The minister declined to release the report because affected parties must first be consulted, said the case was passed to the Public Prosecution Service, and stated that the IGZ found no direct patient harm while acknowledging shortcomings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het hoge aantal abortussen

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister about the rising global abortion count, the apparently high rate among some immigrant groups, and whether abortion may encourage risky sexual behaviour. The minister answered that the Netherlands has one of the lowest abortion rates internationally, that origin is not registered so no evidence of higher rates among specific immigrant groups exists, and that no additional research or targeted policy is planned.

I do not intend to commission additional research into the effect of abortion legislation on sexual risk-taking, since the Netherlands is internationally among the countries with the lowest abortion rate.

Ik ben niet voornemens om extra onderzoek te laten doen naar het gevolg van de abortuswetgeving op seksueel risicogedrag, aangezien Nederland internationaal tot de landen behoort met het laagste abortuscijfer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Griffierecht hoort in het medisch tuchtrecht niet thuis’

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked whether the government still plans a 50-euro court fee for health-care disciplinary cases and whether that fee serves the public interest. Minister Schippers confirmed the plan, citing parallel fees for legal professions, argued it filters out unsuitable complaints while refunding founded ones, and said she will submit a bill to the Wet BIG.
I intend to submit a bill to parliament to include the court fee in the Wet BIG.
Ik ben voornemens om een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om het griffierecht op te nemen in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Minister aanklagen vanwege miskramen’ en het uitsluiten van belangenverstrengeling

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the NIPT consortium and Gendia have conflicts of interest with the Health Council's advice on the NIPT test, after a Gendia director accused her of medical malpractice. The Minister rejected the accusations, said Gendia is not involved in the Health Council advice, described the consortium's links and its conflict-of-interest rules, and explained the Council's procedures for excluding conflicted experts.
Gendia is not involved in any way in the Health Council's advice on the NIPT.
Gendia wordt op geen enkele manier betrokken bij het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de NIPT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Gebrekkig ict-systeem apothekers vormt risico’

An MP asked the minister about reports that outdated ICT and fax-based communication between pharmacists, doctors and hospitals create medication-safety risks, and what is being done about electronic data exchange and patient access to medication records. The minister answered that electronic exchange is incomplete (mainly outside primary care), listed ongoing measures such as revising the medication transfer guideline, an information standard and the pending client-rights bill, and said patients' electronic access rights will be strengthened.
I am of the view that electronic data exchange contributes to the quality of care.
Ik ben van mening dat elektronische gegevensuitwisseling bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice whether matchfixing in professional tennis is more widespread than known, whether attempts occurred at Dutch matches, whether they are punishable, whether complaints or criminal investigations exist. The minister answered that signals were shared with the Tennis Integrity Unit, that attempted fixing is criminally punishable under certain articles if leads arise, that no complaint was filed because players involved were unidentified, and that the Public Prosecution Service does not disclose investigations.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no announcement about whether or not it is investigating anything.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededeling over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over misstanden in de Nederlandse vogelhandel

An MP asked the state secretary and the health minister about animal welfare, illegal trade and disease risks at Dutch bird markets after a broadcast, including whether bird markets should be abolished. The government acknowledged the abuses and pointed to existing rules and NVWA enforcement, but said it could not verify the trade claims, gave limited answers on enforcement, and promised to draw attention to the psittacosis reporting duty with the veterinary association and to ask the NVWA to focus on illegal trade and welfare at such events.
I regret the abuses shown in the broadcast.
Ik betreur de misstanden die worden getoond in de uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de omstreden komst van een gigastal voor 5.100 geiten

An MP asked whether the municipality of Maasdriel would involve the council in a permit for a 5,100-goat stal, whether a family link to a CDA leader raises integrity concerns, and whether the government would act on Q-fever risks and impose a moratorium. The State Secretary answered that the municipality decides on the permit and bestemmingsplan, family ties play no role, the GGD gave a positive advice, and no moratorium is planned, pointing to earlier answers.
The municipality will make a substantive judgment on this application, in which family relationships play no role.
De gemeente zal een inhoudelijk oordeel vellen over deze aanvraag, waarbij familierelaties geen rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijk kankerverwekkende stoffen in voeding

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister about mineral oil contamination (MOSH and MOAH) in food and packaging, including company responsibility, recycled packaging barriers, ink de-inking, and whether national standards should be set. The minister replied that monitoring with validated methods is needed first, that the food industry must take responsibility, and that national standards and NVWA enforcement will follow only once EU monitoring results are available.
As soon as exposure to such substances reaches (near) harmful levels, everything must be done to reduce it.
Zodra de blootstelling van dergelijke stoffen op (nagenoeg) schadelijke niveaus ligt moet alles in het werk worden gesteld om dit terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het feit dat er veel meer doden door Q-koorts zijn gevallen dan gedacht

MP Van Dekken asked the minister about reports that many more people died from Q fever than previously thought, and whether further research and missed patients were being addressed. Minister Schippers acknowledged the impact, said the new research shows 74 deaths and that more research and a follow-up on diagnosis and treatment will be shared with parliament, but stated no reason to think patients are not getting correct treatment.
I will share the results with your House.
Ik zal de resultaten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de mogelijkheid om op termijn de Grand Prix naar Nederland te halen

An MP asked the health and sport minister whether she would welcome a Dutch Formula 1 Grand Prix in 2020, what is needed, and whether she would ask the Sportraad to study feasibility. The minister is positive in general but says the initiative lies with motorsport, business and local government, that she awaits the business case (end 2016) and may then ask the Sportraad for advice.
The initiative for this does not lie with the central government, but with motorsport, business and the local government.
Het initiatief hiertoe ligt niet bij de rijksoverheid, maar bij de autosport, het bedrijfsleven en de lokale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over een doppler echo om vast te stellen of foetale bloedvaten voor de geboorte-uitgang liggen

An MP asked the health minister about a baby who died from undetected vasa praevia, and whether routine Doppler ultrasound at 20 weeks should be introduced to prevent such harm. The minister reported that vasa praevia is rare, that referral happens only for specific placenta findings per current guidelines, and that the guideline revision is for the professional bodies, so no change in practice is planned.
I therefore see no reason to ask them to change current practice.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding hen te vragen de huidige praktijk aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitgave over E-health

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the cost and purpose of a government publication on e-health, including its reach, a quote calling privacy a hurdle, the phrase 'privacy mafia', and possible sponsorship by Philips and Focus Cura. Minister Schippers answered that the publication cost 97,500 euro, that it was a legitimate government communication, that privacy rules remain binding, and that the company contributions were limited to photos and not sponsorship.
The publication was produced without financial contributions from third parties. There is no form of sponsorship.
De uitgave is zonder financiële bijdragen van derden tot stand gekomen. Er is geen sprake van enige vorm van sponsoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Voorkomen van infecties in ziekenhuizen kan echt nog beter’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister how she will respond to an IGZ report finding that hospitals still fall short on infection prevention and to a TV report on dirty hospital conditions, and whether the IGZ should take stronger action. The minister acknowledges the shortcomings, says hospitals bear primary responsibility, states the IGZ will continue supervision and follow up, and points to a network-based antibiotic resistance policy with a 50% reduction target.
The IGZ will continue its supervision of the visited hospitals until they have improved sufficiently.
De IGZ zal haar toezicht bij de bezochte ziekenhuizen voortzetten tot zij voldoende verbeterd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de World Health Assembly

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the Dutch role at the 2016 World Health Assembly and pressed for a stronger international framework on R&D financing and affordable medicines, such as a convention or a second Open-Ended Meeting. The Minister described the Dutch delegation and EU presidency role, said the adopted resolution goes beyond an observatory, and stated that a binding convention is not currently feasible while a second Open-Ended Meeting is for the 70th Assembly to consider.
An international agreement or Convention is currently not a feasible option.
Een internationale overeenkomst of Conventie is momenteel geen haalbare kaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over schelden bij jeugdvoetbal

An MP asked the ministers about verbal abuse, aggression and discrimination at youth football and what the Naar een veiliger sportklimaat programme has achieved. The minister answered that the programme is being extended by two years with a focus on weak clubs and volunteer board members, and pointed to fair play competitions and the referee and player licence system, without addressing the MP's specific questions in detail.
For that reason I have extended the action plan 'Towards a Safer Sports Climate' by two years.
Om die reden heb ik dan ook het actieplan «Naar een Veiliger Sportklimaat» met twee jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in ziekenhuizen

MPs Çegerek and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about specialists' warnings on endocrine-disrupting substances leaking from medical devices in hospitals, WHO and Gezondheidsraad signals, and whether hospitals should phase out plastics. The Minister says the government is acting on BPA and DEHP, convening hospital associations and professional groups on a stepwise plan, and pursuing EU criteria and new medical device rules, but does not commit to a specific ban.

In the short term I have therefore invited the hospital associations and the professional groups relevant to the most vulnerable patients to jointly consider how reducing exposure can best be done, for example through a targeted step-by-step plan.

Op korte termijn heb ik daarom de koepels van ziekenhuizen en de voor de meest kwetsbare patiënten relevante beroepsgroepen uitgenodigd om gezamenlijk na te denken over de manier waarop terugdringing van de blootstelling het beste gedaan kan worden, bijvoorbeeld via een gericht stappenplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over nader onderzoek naar het verband tussen het gebruik van bepaalde medicijnen en agressie

Two MPs from the SP asked the Justice and Health ministers about research into links between antidepressant or benzodiazepine use and aggression, the Public Prosecution Service's stance on such research, and whether suspects should be tested for medication. The minister replied that pharmacovigilance via Lareb and the CBG already handles side-effect reporting, that no legal basis for mandatory blood tests of suspects should be created, and pointed to ZonMw research funding.
At present there is no legal basis for taking blood samples from suspects after a (violent) offence to determine whether medication has been used.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke grondslag om na een (gewelds)delict bloedmonsters af te nemen bij verdachten om te achterhalen of er sprake is van gebruik van geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over Q-koorts en een geitenstal in Rossum

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Health whether a large goat stall in Rossum, which the GGD warned could pose risks if operations deviate even slightly, is acceptable given the Q-fever outbreak history, and why residents' objections were overridden. The government answered that the GGD gave positive advice, that Q-fever measures and vaccination mean no raised risk, that the municipality is responsible for the zoning plan and emissions, and that objections were handled in the normal zoning process.
For the environmental measures the municipality is responsible in its capacity as competent authority for the environmental permit.
Voor de milieumaatregelen is de gemeente verantwoordelijk in zijn hoedanigheid van bevoegd gezag voor de omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat artsen en zorginstellingen meer sponsorgeld krijgen van de farmaceutische industrie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that pharmaceutical sponsorship of doctors and care institutions rose 36% per the Transparency Register, and whether this threatens independent prescribing and patient organisations. The Minister answered that self-regulation applies, the increase reflects more reporting obligations, safeguards exist for patient organisations, and the Inspectorate will examine high payments for unlawful benefits.
It is up to the IGZ to determine whether there is unlawful benefit.
Het is aan de IGZ om te bepalen of hier sprake is van ongeoorloofd gunstbetoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over spoed-ambulances die vaak te laat komen

An MP asked the health minister why ambulances often miss the 15-minute emergency response norm, whether it is a planning or performance norm, and what sanctions apply to insurers who fail their duty of care. The minister answered that the norm is a performance norm, that insurers share responsibility with the RAV, that the NZa is overseeing improvement plans, and that no firm deadline or change to the temporary rules will be set.
Following the investigation, the NZa has instructed insurers together with the RAVs in regions where the norm is not met to draw up improvement plans.
De NZa heeft naar aanleiding van het onderzoek zorgverzekeraars opgedragen om samen met de RAV-en in de regio's waar de norm niet wordt gehaald verbeterplannen op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte

MPs Van Dekken and Çegerek asked the Minister of Health about a possible three-year pilot letting municipalities set safety rules for privately placed play equipment, its design, safety, parent information, and whether it leads to legislation. The minister answered that the pilot is still under study, municipal views vary, consultation with the ROW has taken place, and any evaluation would be independent and could lead to a single national solution.
An evaluation will then be carried out by an independent research bureau.
Een evaluatie zal dan door een onafhankelijk onderzoeksbureau worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het is een prachtig kind. Waarom is hij overleden’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report on a stillbirth linked to disputes between midwives and obstetricians over a fetal growth restriction protocol and the use of ultrasound. The minister answered that professional groups should cooperate, that the IRIS study on a third-trimester scan is delayed, that stakeholders were invited to talk, and that the government will not introduce universal third-trimester scans without evidence and professional support.
I do not intend to introduce a universal third-trimester ultrasound without sufficient scientific evidence and without support among the professional groups.
Ik ben niet van plan om, zonder voldoende wetenschappelijk bewijs en zonder draagvlak onder de gezamenlijke beroepsgroepen, over te gaan op algehele invoering van een 3 e termijn echo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht Europese privacyregels zijn nekslag voor biomedisch onderzoek

An MP asked the Health Minister how the new EU data protection regulation affects Dutch biomedical research, including whether exemptions are possible and whether patients must consent repeatedly. The minister replied that the regulation allows broader consent and specific research derogations, that anonymised data fall outside it, and that a Dutch bill on control over body material is in preparation, without committing to new exemptions for Dutch research.
As I indicated above in answering questions 3 and 8, the regulation contains specific rules on scientific research that ensure researchers are not confronted with unnecessary legal obstacles.

Zoals ik hierboven bij de beantwoording van de vragen 3 en 8 heb aangegeven, bevat de verordening specifieke regels over wetenschappelijk onderzoek die ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekers niet met onnodige juridische belemmeringen worden geconfronteerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het in opdracht van de Amerikaanse farmaceutische industrie uitgevoerde onderzoek naar de machtsverhoudingen binnen het Nederlandse zorgstelsel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about an Erasmus University study commissioned by AmCham's pharmaceutical arm on power relations in the Dutch healthcare system, including who paid, whether it was appropriate given industry influence, and the conduct of officials and the NPCF at an AmCham forum. The minister answered that parties may freely contract such research within legal limits, that the payment is a matter between the parties, that the study's conclusions are not endorsed as a formal policy position, and that regulators (NZa, ACM) must assess individual cases.
I am not aware of what was paid for the research. That is part of the agreement between the parties themselves.
Het is mij niet bekend wat is betaald voor het onderzoek. Dat is onderdeel van de overeenkomst tussen partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Kind ligt onnodig lang in het ziekenhuis’

An MP asked whether a child staying unnecessarily long in hospital was caused by the 600 million euro cut to home care, why there is a shortage of children's nurses, and what the extra costs are. The state secretary said he supports moving child care from hospital to home, will convene parties to discuss the nurse shortage, and could not give the extra costs because they are not registered separately.
The V&VN signal that there are too few children's nurses is reason for me to invite the parties involved in the short term to discuss this signal.
Het signaal van V&VN dat er te weinig kinderverpleegkundigen zijn is voor mij aanleiding op korte termijn de betrokken partijen uit te nodigen om dit signaal te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat behandelaars in de ggz volgens onderzoek “heel flexibel” om zouden gaan met declaratieregels

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a study reporting that mental health practitioners handle declaration rules very flexibly, and about the role of care consultants. The minister answered that the NZa-commissioned study does not accuse the sector, that the NZa will discuss the findings with insurers and practitioners, and that the role of care consultants was not part of the study's scope.
The study was carried out on the initiative and commission of the NZa.
Het onderzoek is uitgevoerd op initiatief en in opdracht van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het faillissement van het centrum voor verslavingszorg Victas en de overname ervan door ggz-instelling Arkin

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of addiction care centre Victas, its building costs, the responsibility of its boards, and its takeover by Arkin. The minister answered that the curator is investigating the causes and any mismanagement, that the competition and regulatory authorities cleared the takeover, and that she cannot judge the board's conduct before the investigation concludes.
It is for the curator to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy. The final bankruptcy report will therefore have to be awaited.
Het is aan de curator om de oorzaken van het faillissement te onderzoeken. Het definitieve faillissementsverslag zal dus moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat de Dopingautoriteit opheldering wil van NOC*NSF over bloedtesten

An MP asks whether NOC*NSF's sports-medical bloodtesting, including the off-score, can and must be shared with the Dopingautoriteit, and whether a Dutch anti-doping law is planned. The minister answers that the medical programme is not aimed at detecting doping, that NOC*NSF has no legal duty to share such data, that cooperation will be improved through agreements, and that a Wet uitvoering anti-dopingbeleid is pending before the Raad van State.
There is no legislation that obliges NOC*NSF to share collected data that may indicate doping use with the Dopingautoriteit.
Er is geen wetgeving die NOC*NSF verplicht verzamelde gegevens die kunnen wijzen op dopinggebruik te delen met de Dopingautoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima Medisch Centrum verzwijgt calamiteit voor inspectie’
