MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a hospital (MMC) that did not report a surgical calamity to the inspectorate, whether the patient will be compensated, whether the surgeon still operates, and how many disciplinary cases followed patient or family reports. The minister called the non-reporting regrettable, said the hospital remains legally responsible and has apologised, noted the disciplinary college issued the surgeon a warning, and reported 28 disciplinary cases since 2011, only two initiated by patients.

Regardless of whether the hospital works with employees or contracted staff, the hospital remains, as a care provider under the Healthcare Quality, Complaints and Disputes Act, ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care and legally obliged to report a calamity to the IGZ.

Ongeacht of het ziekenhuis werkt met medewerkers in loondienst of medewerkers die in opdracht werken, het ziekenhuis blijft, als zorgaanbieder in de zin van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz), eindverantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg en in geval van een calamiteit wettelijk verplicht om dit bij de IGZ te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat meer soa’s (seksueel overdraagbare aandoeningen) zijn gevonden bij vrouwen en heteroseksuele mannen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that STI diagnoses are rising while fewer people get tested, and about waiting times at STI clinics for high-risk contacts. The minister answered that testing data are incomplete, that rising diagnoses may reflect better targeting, and that the government funds supplementary sexual health care for high-risk groups while GP care remains available.
To get a view of the total number of people in the Netherlands who get tested for an STI, insight is also needed into the number of tests carried out by GPs and through home testing.

Om zicht te kunnen krijgen op het totale aantal mensen in Nederland dat zich op een soa laat testen, is ook zicht nodig op het aantal testen dat wordt gedaan door de huisarts en door middel van thuistesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de interne crisis in zorginstelling De Gelderhorst

An MP asks the minister about the prolonged internal conflict between the supervisory board and the rest of care institution De Gelderhorst, including threats to care continuity, poor communication and mediation. The state secretary says the situation is undesirable, that the IGZ is investigating including the role of the board parties, and that no current signs show care continuity is at risk, while leaving resolution largely to the parties themselves.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating the current situation at De Gelderhorst and is also looking at the role of the governing parties.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzoekt de actuele situatie bij De Gelderhorst en kijkt daarin ook naar de rol van de bestuurlijke partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over regiebehandelaarschap van de orthopedagoog generalist

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health why the orthopedagogue generalist was excluded from acting as regiebehandelaar under the model quality statute for mental health care, and whether inclusion in the BIG register would be expedited. The Minister said the consequences are limited, noted a transitional arrangement, and promised to inform parliament before summer about the timing of a bill amending the BIG Act.
I will inform you further about the planning of this bill before the summer.
Ik zal u vóór de zomer over de planning van dit wetsvoorstel nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Nederlandse Organisatie van Verloskundigen (KNOV) haar vertrouwen opzegt in het bestuur van het College Perinatale Zorg (CPZ)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister about the KNOV withdrawing confidence in the CPZ board, the CPZ chair's critical remarks on midwives' risk selection, the rejected care standard, and whether the Zorginstituut's takeover of the process will take the KNOV's input seriously. The minister regretted the situation, said the chair apologised, defended the CPZ and the Zorginstituut's procedures, and described the planned commission to revise the standard.
The result will be sent for consultation to all involved organisations, after which the ACK will offer the final version to the Zorginstituut's board for adoption.
Het resultaat zal ter consultatie naar alle betrokken organisaties gestuurd worden, waarna de ACK de definitieve versie ter vaststelling aan de raad van bestuur van het Zorginstituut zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over de onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwilligers die voortvloeit uit de Regeling verkeersregelaars 2009

Two MPs asked about excessive regulatory burden on volunteer traffic marshals under the 2009 traffic marshals regulation, following Actal advice, and about sports bodies' exclusion from consultation and proposed reforms such as a national database and removal of individual appointments. The minister replied that a working group has a draft amendment ready for internet consultation, that the national e-learning database will replace separate appointment passes, and that motorcycle marshals remain barred from giving signals from vehicles for safety reasons.
It is expected that this draft proposal will be put to internet consultation by the Ministry of IenM this spring.
Naar verwachting zal dit conceptvoorstel dit voorjaar door het Ministerie van IenM in internetconsultatie kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Servaes over het Amnesty-rapport 'WK Voetbal Qatar: FIFA negeert uitbuiting arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Van Dekken and Servaes asked the ministers about Amnesty's report on exploitation of migrant workers building Qatar 2022 World Cup venues, FIFA's inaction, and Qatar's sponsorship system. The ministers acknowledged serious abuses remain, pointed to EU-level pressure on FIFA and Qatar, the ILO mission and complaint process, and the EU Presidency's integrity agenda, without committing to new binding steps.
The cabinet will therefore continue to press for improvements in the position of migrant workers in talks with Qatar and business.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom in de gesprekken met Qatar en het bedrijfsleven blijven inzetten voor de verbetering van de positie van arbeidsmigranten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een 74-jarige verlamde poliopatiënt al 60 jaar afhankelijk is van een buisje voor ademen en praten, dat al 20 jaar niet meer gemaakt wordt en deze nu

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the government would act, including sending an official to China, after a 74-year-old polio patient faced losing his decades-old latex breathing tube that is no longer manufactured. The minister answered that over a thousand tracheostomy tubes exist, that medical devices must meet EU CE rules, and that the supplier Teleflex, with the German manufacturer, is restarting production of the old tube with delivery expected within weeks.
Even before the media coverage, Teleflex was busy working with the manufacturer to find a solution.
Al voor de berichtgeving in de media was Teleflex druk doende om in overleg met de fabrikant voor een oplossing te zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over Het bericht 'Steekproef Consumentenbond: zorgdossiers zijn rommeltje'

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how she would respond to a Consumentenbond mystery-shopper survey finding that many hospital medical records were incomplete, inaccurate or misdirected, and what oversight bodies would do. The minister said she takes the findings seriously, will raise record-keeping quality with hospital associations, and that the IGZ and AP oversee the issue, though the IGZ could not draw firm conclusions from the small sample.
I consider the findings of the sample an important signal for the sector.
Ik vind de bevindingen van de steekproef een belangrijk signaal voor het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over PrEP

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister about the GGD Amsterdam PrEP demonstration project, EU/WHO recommendations, Dutch guidelines, pricing (about 7,000 euro per year for Truvada) and reimbursement of PrEP. The minister answered that PrEP is still in EMA registration, that a Dutch guideline is being prepared by the professional groups, and that no decision on adding PrEP to the insured package or changing prices can yet be made, deferring to ZIN.
Anticipating the EMA decision, I cannot yet make any statements on this.
Ik kan hier, vooruitlopend op het besluit van de EMA, dan ook nog geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked about the handreiking on written euthanasia requests, including how the brochure was drafted, uptake among doctors, and wording on dementia suffering. The ministers answered that the handreiking was developed by a working group with consultation of stakeholders to clarify the Wtl, that uptake is unknown, and that doctors must still assess unbearable suffering case by case.
We have no insight into the extent to which doctors use the handreiking.
Antwoord 3 We hebben geen inzicht in de schaal waarop artsen gebruikmaken van de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid die de groei van de melkveestapel met zich mee brengt en heeft gebracht

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked whether growing dairy herds and farm sizes pose public health risks, including infectious disease and Streptococcus agalactiae, and whether hard caps on cow numbers should be set. The minister answered that farm size is only one factor among many, that no link to S. agalactiae in humans is established, that the VGO study on livestock and resident health will report before summer, and that no hard caps are planned.
A possible link between livestock farming and public health, however, I take very seriously.
Een mogelijk verband tussen veehouderijen en volksgezondheid neem ik echter zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het megalomane project van Daelzicht

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about Daelzicht's abandoned theme-park project, its spending of over 1 million euros on planning, possible liability of board members, the myOwn care robot, staff complaints and the supervisory role of the Raad van Toezicht and the IGZ. The state secretary answered that the decisions rest with the institution and its supervisory board, that the IGZ monitors care quality without signs of risk so far, that board liability requires judicial findings, and that an independent investigation is not considered necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over geweld in het amateurvoetbal

Two MPs asked whether violence in amateur football is increasing and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that police and KNVB figures show no clear upward trend, that incidents still occur, and that the safer sports action plan will be continued with added support for at-risk clubs.
On the basis of the available figures, there is so far no sign of an increase in violence in amateur football.
Op basis van de beschikbare cijfers lijkt van een stijging van geweld in het amateurvoetbal vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Noodtoestand in Amerikaans ziekenhuis wegens ransomware’ (een chantagemethode op internet)

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether a ransomware-driven emergency like the US hospital case could happen in the Netherlands and what safeguards exist for hospital IT. The minister answers that no such emergency is known, that information security is the hospitals' own responsibility under existing NEN norms, and points to breach notification duties, IGZ outreach, and planned NIS directive and Z-CERT measures, but declines to commit to mandatory IT testing.
Information security is the hospital's own responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend tekort aan hoogopgeleide verpleegkundigen'

MPs Lucas and Schut-Welkzijn (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Health about a report on a shortage of highly educated nurses, including unfunded training, co-financing for demand-driven funding experiments, mbo training requirements versus BIG rules, and ways to make nursing more attractive. The ministers answered that funded and unfunded institutions complement each other, that demand-driven funding experiments are delayed in care, that an independent facilitator and a commission will be set up, that interpretation room exists in hours rules, and listed several measures to address shortages mainly in community and elderly care.
By Prinsjesdag at the latest I will inform your House about the state of affairs.
Uiterlijk op Prinsjesdag zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de erkenning van beroepskwalificaties in de zorg voor mensen met een buitenlands diploma

An MP asked the health minister about recognition of foreign qualifications in healthcare, including application volumes, processing times and compliance with statutory deadlines. The minister reported 719 and 790 applications in 2014 and 2015, explained average processing times by profession, and acknowledged that faster processing is needed while outlining improvements.
I consider a further acceleration of the application process necessary and desirable.
Ik acht een verdere versnelling van het aanvraagproces noodzakelijk en gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en De Lange over de tweedeling somatische en psychische spoedzorg

MPs Rutte and De Lange asked the Minister of Health about a claimed divide between somatic and psychiatric emergency care that causes problems for patients with acute mental and physical needs. The Minister said the SiRM report and IGZ research did not identify this divide as a problem, that no registration exists of such cases, and pointed to ongoing sector-wide improvement work, including a coming quality framework.
This is not known; no separate registration is kept of this.
Dit is niet bekend, hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Oosten over moleculaire drugs die niet onder de Opiumwet vallen

MPs Ziengs and Van Oosten (VVD) asked about reports that new molecular drugs fall outside the Opium Act, the online trade in such drugs, and related research. The state secretary answered that existing procedures (CAM, EMCDDA, WHO risk assessments) can place substances under the Opium Act, that current enforcement against online drug trade is adequate, and that pending WODC and Trimbos studies will be sent to parliament.
I consider the current effort adequate.
Ik acht de huidige inzet afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de Rudmer Heerema en Van Dekken over de opmerking van Blatter dat het WK-bid van Nederland en België altijd kansloos is geweest

MPs Heerema and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether Blatter's claim that the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid was always hopeless is true, and whether the costs of about 10 million euros could be recovered. The minister replied that the KNVB feels misled, awaits an external audit of the Diallo payment due in June before deciding on action, and that she has put sports integrity and transparent event awards on the EU presidency agenda.
An external accountant is currently conducting an investigation, commissioned by the KNVB, into the payment to Diallo in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid.
Momenteel loopt in opdracht van de KNVB het onderzoek door een extern accountant naar de betaling aan Diallo bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de mogelijke wijziging van het Planningsbesluit IVF (in vitrofertilisatie)

An MP asked the Minister of Health why she called refusal of an IVF licence application legally vulnerable under a planning decision updated in 2000, 2004 and 2014, and why the licence numbers were not expanded earlier. The minister replied that the 1998 needs estimate and quality guideline are outdated, so the Planningsbesluit must first be updated to let the IGZ assess the pending application, and she allowed only limited growth in clinics.
That is why it is necessary to first update the Planningsbesluit now.
Daarom is het nodig nu eerst het Planningsbesluit te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe zorgondernemer Loek Winter een imperium opbouwde en 21,6 miljoen staatssteun lospeuterde’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a report on hospital entrepreneur Loek Winter and EUR 21.6 million in state aid for the IJsselmeer hospitals taken over by MC Groep. The minister answered that the WNT compliance case is under investigation by CIBG, defended private participation and the 2009 rescue package, and declined to detail contract terms between hospitals and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek dat er op wijst dat thuisbevallingen voor vrouwen met een lagere sociaal-economische status onveiliger zijn

MP Wolbert asks the minister about a study finding home births less safe for women of lower socio-economic status and whether the co-payment for hospital births without medical indication should be scrapped or widened to a social indication. Minister Schippers answers that the research is for professional groups to study, that ZonMw may fund follow-up research, that vulnerable pregnant women are a known concern, and that the co-payment question awaits the health insurance institute's advice expected by August 2016.
I have asked the Health Insurance Institute to advise me on this.
Ik heb het Zorginstituut gevraagd mij hierover te adviseren.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en sport over het bericht dat zorginstellingen in de problemen zitten door falend beleid van «dikke ikke» bestuurder

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about a BDO report saying most care institutions struggle to manage constant change, blaming weak management, and asked about IT spending, external consultants and board accountability. The minister answered that the report mainly shows boards find change difficult, pointed to the 'Goed Bestuur in de Zorg' agenda and accreditation of boards and supervisors, and said institutions are responsible for their own spending and that supervisory boards oversee management.
Care providers, as private organisations, are themselves responsible for their own business operations and the choices they make in them.
Zorgaanbieders zijn als private organisaties zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen bedrijfsvoering en de keuzes die zij daarin maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verontrustende bijwerkingen van de sterilisatiemethode Essure

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about serious complaints from women following Essure sterilisation, the NVOG's stance, pre-market approval and post-market monitoring, reporting figures, patient information, compensation and whether randomised trials should be required. The Minister answered that the IGZ is registering complaints and a RIVM inventory is underway, that informing patients is the treating doctor's duty, that manufacturers bear liability and the burden of proof for product defects is not shifted, and that EU rules on monitoring are being pursued.
The RIVM has been commissioned by the Inspectorate to inventory these complaints for side effects, after which they will be clinically interpreted.
Het RIVM heeft van de Inspectie opdracht gekregen deze klachten te inventariseren op bijwerkingen, waarna deze klinisch zullen worden geduid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mensenrechten in relatie tot grote sportevenementen

MP Van Nispen asked the minister how sports event awarding rules and criteria could protect human rights, how the EU guidelines might be strengthened, and what Dutch steps follow during the EU presidency. The minister answered that awarding is the responsibility of sports bodies, that the Netherlands will push for transparency and good governance via EU Council conclusions, and that the EU's limited competence and non-binding guidelines prevent binding rules.
It is not possible to make binding agreements within the EU on this theme, because the EU has only a supporting competence in the field of sport.
Het is niet mogelijk om binnen de EU bindende afspraken te maken over dit thema, omdat de EU op het terrein van sport alleen een ondersteunende bevoegdheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over de verduurzaming van sportcomplexen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether greening sports facilities was an agreed measure of the Energy Agreement, whether the sports energy-savings subsidy is the main instrument, whether its budget will be topped up, and what the added value is if not. The minister replied that the subsidy stems from a parliamentary motion and is separate from the Energy Agreement, that no budget top-up is planned, and that other schemes remain available.
No, both my colleague of Economic Affairs and I see no possibilities within our budgets to top up the budget.
Nee, zowel mijn collega van Economische Zaken als ik zien geen mogelijkheden binnen onze begrotingen om het budget nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over ggz-behandelingen waar patiënten geen baat bij hebben

An MP asked the Minister of Health about research showing one in three mental health patients (depression and anxiety) gains no benefit from treatment, and whether the sector and inspectorate should act. The minister welcomed the benchmarking, said the study does not justify an inspectorate investigation or sector-wide conclusions, and pointed to the quality statute, outcome measurement and transparency agreements as the response.
Additional research by the IGZ therefore does not seem warranted to me now, especially since major steps are currently being taken to durably improve quality in mental health care.
Aanvullend onderzoek door de IGZ vind ik daarom nu niet aangewezen, vooral ook omdat momenteel grote stappen worden gezet om de kwaliteit in de ggz duurzaam te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over hormoon verstorende stoffen en de relatie met de volksgezondheid

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Health about national and EU measures to reduce exposure to BPA and other hormone-disrupting substances, including prenatal advice, cancer trends and costs. The Minister replied that hospital and industry agreements, pressure on EFSA and the EU, and further research and advice updates are under way, with no firm timelines for some measures.
I have submitted the RIVM report to the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) and urged it to reconsider the tolerable daily intake (TDI) standard in light of the new insights.

Ik heb het RIVM-rapport aan de Europese Autoriteit voor Voedselveiligheid (EFSA) aangeboden en er op aangedrongen de norm voor de toelaatbare dagelijkse inname (Tolerabele Daily Intake, TDI) op grond van de nieuwe inzichten opnieuw te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Nieuwe software NZa zet care op achterstand’

An SP MP asked the minister about delays caused by a new NZa software system in the long-term care sector, including the effects on budgets, accounts, continuity of care and whether the deadline for cost settlements was too tight. The government answered that technical and organisational problems caused delays, that the NZa offered a temporary solution, that no financial problems were known, and that the NZa would treat late submissions leniently.
The NZa has indicated that when the system was put into use there were technical and organisational problems that caused delay.
De NZa heeft aangegeven dat bij de ingebruikname van het systeem er sprake is geweest van technische en organisatorische problemen waardoor vertraging is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verloren cassatie waar de diensten van een magnetiseur als gelijkwaardig werden betiteld aan die van BIG-geregistreerde psychologen en psychiaters

An SP MP asked the Health and Finance ministers about a Supreme Court ruling that treated a magnetiser's services as equivalent to those of BIG-registered psychologists and psychiatrists for VAT exemption, and about alleged fraud and the revenue loss. The State Secretary replied that the ruling forces a broader application of the medical VAT exemption under fiscal neutrality, that the policy decision was updated, that about 28 million euro structural annual loss results (52 million total exemption cost), that the Tax Service does not intervene in individual court cases, and that reopening is only possible in exceptional circumstances.
The cabinet does not interfere in these cases and does not pronounce on them.
Het kabinet mengt zich niet in deze zaken en doet daar ook geen uitspraak over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de subsidieregeling energiebesparing sportaccommodaties

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the sports-venue energy-saving subsidy, which was nearly exhausted within days of opening and whose abolition of the energy-tax refund may leave clubs worse off. The minister answered that the scheme's popularity is a success, gave application breakdowns, and declined to add budget or ask for additional funds.
I see the great willingness of sports clubs to invest in energy saving and sustainable energy as a success
Ik zie de grote bereidheid van de sportverenigingen om te investeren in energiebesparing en duurzame energie als een succes
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over de privacyschending door ziekenhuizen

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers whether hospitals' outsourcing of scanning patient files to Belgian prisoners, and the resulting privacy breaches reported by Omroep Max, were acceptable and what action would be taken. Minister Schippers answered that the situation is undesirable, that a national investigation into hospital data-security practice will be reported by end 2016, and that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is investigating, while stressing its independence and enforcement priorities.
As indicated, I find the situation undesirable and not discreetly handling patient data unacceptable.
Zoals aangegeven vind ik de situatie onwenselijk en het niet discreet omgaan met patiëntgegevens niet acceptabel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gerven en Leijten over het feitelijk niet verkrijgbaar zijn van het generieke dimethylfumaraat voor de behandeling van MS en andere zaken omtrent dure geneesmiddelen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about unavailability of generic dimethylfumarate for MS, seeding trials, Fampyra and Amfexa pricing, and ADHD medication. The minister answered that compounded supply is not available, opposed seeding trials, described the Fampyra and Amfexa positions, and rejected the view that ADHD diagnosis is questionable.
I am not in favour of seeding trials.
Ik ben geen voorstander van seeding trials.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over de rectificatie van Kamervragen betreffende de werkwijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Opposition MP Leijten asked why it took so long to discover that the IGZ had wrongly answered two earlier sets of parliamentary questions about a deceased care-dependent woman, and how families are treated by the inspectorate. State Secretary Van Rijn acknowledged the error, said it did not change the final IGZ verdict, and defended IGZ's family involvement while refusing to make medical files available to relatives beyond patient consent and Wob rules.
It was not previously known to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) that the answer was incorrect.
Het was bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet eerder bekend dat de beantwoording onjuist was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de overlast van verwarde personen de pan uit rijst

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about reports that nuisance from confused persons is rising sharply, the police figures behind it, and whether mental health care budget cuts, bed reductions, the FACT-team rollout and police capacity cuts are to blame. The minister answered that police registrations rose about 65% between 2011 and 2015 but are incident counts rather than unique persons, that no causal link to ggz cuts has been shown, and that the aanjaagteam, a regional study and a handle for insurers and municipalities are underway.
I make growth room available for curative mental health care every year and therefore do not cut.
Ik stel elk jaar groeiruimte beschikbaar voor de curatieve GGZ en bezuinig dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Neppérus over het bericht dat ZZP-ers niet langer meer in de zorg kunnen werken

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Neppérus asked whether the Tax Authority's rejection of a freelancer's model contract in care, and an alleged conflict with the Wkkgz, would stop self-employed care workers from working in care after the VAR expires. The government denied any conflict, said the Wkkgz does not hinder self-employed work in care and that no legal amendment is needed, while noting that false self-employment must be prevented.
The Wkkgz does not form an obstacle to working as a self-employed person in care.
De Wkkgz vormt geen belemmering om als zzp’er in de zorg werkzaam te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het faillissement van Freecare

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of Freecare, a care-services foundation, including unpaid staff wages, the continuity of care for clients, and whether a proposed civil bans on board members could prevent repeat directors from setting up care organisations. The State Secretary answered that the municipality of Heerhugowaard had terminated the contract but guaranteed continuity for six clients, that he lacked sufficient facts to judge the directors, and that the proposed civil bestuursverbod applies only under strict criteria for the court to assess.
I have too little factual information to be able to pass judgement on that.
Ik beschik over te weinig feitelijke informatie om een oordeel daarover te kunnen uitspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het tekort aan crisisbedden bij GGZ-instelling Reinier van Arkel vanwege de bezuinigingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a reported shortage of crisis beds at GGZ provider Reinier van Arkel caused by budget cuts, the chair's departure, executive pay, bed reduction and street confusion. Minister Schippers denied a structural shortage, pointed to NZa findings and yearly growth room, said she has no view on the chair's motives, and deferred the bed-reduction and ambulatory questions to a separate monitor letter.
I have no insight into the reasons why executives of care institutions decide to step down.
Ik heb geen zicht op de motieven waarom bestuurders van zorginstellingen besluiten op te stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door Tergooi Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the IGZ's assessment of a settlement agreement between Tergooi Hospital and the relatives of a deceased patient could be sent to Parliament before a scheduled committee meeting. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found it a voluntary civil settlement that does not breach the duty to report calamities, but considers gag clauses and waivers of further legal recourse undesirable, and she will examine whether the Wkkgz can be amended to address them.
I will therefore examine whether it is possible to regulate this through a provision in the Wkkgz so that care providers can be held to account by the inspectorate in such cases.
Ik zal dan ook bezien of het mogelijk is dit via een bepaling in de Wkkgz te regelen opdat zorgaanbieders daar in een voorkomend geval door de inspectie op aangesproken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Albert de Vries en Vermeij over de overname van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) door het Erasmus MC

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about Erasmus MC's planned takeover of ADRZ hospital in Zeeland, including effects on care access, cooperation with Zorgsaam, patient information and continuity in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The minister answered that the takeover is not yet decided, pointed to review by the NZa and ACM and to the joint Zeeland care vision, and said the outcome of the planned hospital cooperation would be clear before summer.
There is currently a planned takeover; the decision that ADRZ continues as an independent holding within Erasmus MC is not yet final.
Er is op dit moment sprake van een voornemen tot overname, de beslissing dat ADRZ als zelfstandige holding binnen het Erasmus MC door gaat is nog niet definitief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht de omstreden KNO-arts weer laat opereren

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the UMC Utrecht was right to let a suspended ENT surgeon, linked to two fatal incidents, resume patient care and surgery while the Inspectorate's investigation was ongoing, and why the Inspectorate's results were not awaited. Minister Schippers answered that re-integration is the hospital board's responsibility, that the IGZ will assess the conditions and the investigation remains open, and that she cannot comment substantively on the ongoing inquiry.
Although I understand that questions are repeatedly asked about this case, I cannot respond substantively while the inspectorate's investigation is ongoing.
Hoewel ik begrijp dat over deze casus telkens vragen worden gesteld, kan ik lopende het onderzoek van de inspectie daar inhoudelijk niet op reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over oerwoudgeluiden bij Harkemase boys

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about racist shouting by a supporter toward a dark-skinned player at an amateur football match, whether such incidents are frequent, and what the Safe Sport programme does to prevent them. The minister condemned the behaviour, said no figures exist on amateur incidents, pointed to reporting channels, and described the KNVB-HALT action plan and monitoring results showing reduced feelings of insecurity.
No figures are available on how often incidents of this kind occur on amateur football pitches.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal keer dat incidenten van deze aard plaatsvinden op het amateurveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Otwin van Dijk over de stand van zaken rondom projecten waarbij medicijnresten uit het water worden gezuiverd

MPs Jacobi and Otwin van Dijk asked about the halting of a pilot medicine-residue water treatment installation at Isala hospital, its cost-effectiveness, and related Pharmafilter projects. The state secretary answered that the Isala installation was a time-limited research facility now stopped due to high operating costs, that treatment is being explored in a broader chain approach, and that no specific new commitments were made beyond further reviews.
The installation was stopped because there are currently no new research questions related to it and its operating costs are considerable.
De installatie is stopgezet omdat er op dit moment geen nieuwe onderzoeksvragen in relatie tot deze installatie zijn en de exploitatiekosten van de installatie aanzienlijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over privacy in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about patient data privacy in care, including the Dutch data protection authority's open letter, its finding that WhatsApp does not meet the standard for sharing sensitive data, and a privacy-friendly pilot. The minister answered that an independent study of how hospitals and mental health institutions protect patient data will be commissioned with results expected end 2016, that safer alternatives to WhatsApp should be developed, and that existing initiatives will be supported through the Informatieberaad programme and the pending data exchange law.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het hoge aantal gevallen van longkanker in Brabant en het effect hierop van de intensieve veeteelt

Two MPs asked whether the government will act on reports of high lung cancer rates in Brabant linked to intensive livestock farming, including research, registration and a moratorium on new permits pending study. The minister replied that the ongoing VGO study does not cover lung cancer, that the GGD has started an exploratory study with results expected end of April, and that the Health Council may be asked to revise its 2012 advice, but no permit moratorium is accepted since no scientific indications of risk are known.
Following the report, the GGD in the Brabant region is immediately starting an exploratory study into the relationship between lung cancer and livestock farming.
Naar aanleiding van het genoemde bericht start de GGD in de regio Brabant per direct een verkennend onderzoek naar de relatie longkanker en veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over wangedrag van zichzelf voetbalsupporter noemende Nederlanders in Madrid

MPs asked how the government views Dutch football supporters' misconduct in Madrid, whether mayors can impose liberty-restricting measures under article 172a of the Municipalities Act for racist behaviour, and when the new football-violence law takes effect. The minister said Spanish authorities lead, the club has issued stadium bans, mayors decide on individual measures, and the law has applied since 1 July 2015, extending the available powers.
It is up to the mayor of the municipality from which a person originates to determine whether there is cause to impose a measure under the Municipalities Act.
Het is aan de burgemeester van de gemeente waaruit een persoon afkomstig is om te bepalen of er aanleiding is om een maatregel op grond van de Gemeentewet op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Patiëntgegevens op straat deel II’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports that prisoners in Belgium processed hospital patient records under a contract with Iguana, including whether consent of confidentiality was signed and what action will be taken. The Minister says the matter needs further investigation, the Dutch Data Protection Authority is looking into it, she finds the practice undesirable, will review rules, and will commission research into hospitals' handling of patient data.
As I announced in my letter of 16 March, this needs to be investigated further.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 16 maart jl. heb aangekondigd, moet dit nader onderzocht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door het Tergooi Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a hospital's failure to report a calamity to the Inspectorate, reports of hush money paid to relatives, and the Inspectorate's reluctance to give aggregate figures on unreported calamities. The Minister said the Inspectorate has started enforcement against the hospital, will publish more reliable aggregate data after reviewing its disclosure policy, and is assessing whether the settlement agreement is permissible.
After the broadcast, the Inspectorate asked the hospital's board to provide this agreement to it.
De IGZ heeft na de uitzending de raad van bestuur gevraagd deze overeenkomst aan haar te overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how health care costs have shifted to citizens, including the split of BKZ costs between citizens and businesses, the treatment of self-employed workers, the Zvw transition and tax credits. The minister said costs paid from general funds cannot be split between citizens and businesses, defended treating self-employed as households in some statistics, promised further calculations for some questions later and listed the tax credits.
These figures can be provided, but more time is needed. If desired, I can deliver them before the summer.
Deze cijfers zijn wel te geven, maar daarvoor is meer tijd nodig. Desgewenst kan ik die voor de zomer leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over de opbouw van schulden naar aanleiding van gedwongen opname in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why people compulsorily admitted to psychiatric facilities may lose benefits and face debts, and whether this gap was known and remains unfixed. The state secretary answered that such persons are eligible for special assistance (bijzondere bijstand) under the Participatiewet, which was amended in 2008 with retroactive effect, leaving municipalities to decide case by case; she did not provide figures on affected people.
I do not have figures on this matter.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nieuwe calamiteiten binnen het Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about Zembla reports of new calamities at UMC Utrecht, including craniosynostosis operations against guidelines, threatening letters to sources, and failure to report incidents. The Minister answered that an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing with an external commission, expected to conclude in summer 2016, and declined to pre-judge findings or order enforcement.
The IGZ investigation will be completed mid-year, after which I will inform you of the outcomes.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ zal halverwege dit jaar gereed zijn, waarna ik u informeer over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over stijging van kapitaallasten van ziekenhuizen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the rise in capital costs of hospitals, requesting a breakdown into depreciation, rent and financing costs, and questioned the Plexus/BKB findings on the abolition of the building regime. The minister provided CBS figures, defended the Plexus/BKB estimate as a reasonable but uncertain assessment, and explained that the Waarborgfonds guarantee lowers interest costs by about 1 to 2 percent, while no comparison with ordinary businesses is available.
A comparison with the business sector is not possible due to the lack of insight into the average interest rates that ordinary businesses pay for their financing.
Vergelijking met het bedrijfsleven is niet mogelijk wegens het ontbreken van inzicht in de gemiddelde rentetarieven die «reguliere bedrijven» betalen voor hun financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Onderzoek baarmoederhalskanker mogelijk veel duurder. Veel meer vrouwen met hpv besmet dan gedacht’

MPs Van Gerven and Bruins Slot asked whether a Jeroen Bosch Hospital study showing higher HPV infection would raise the costs of the new cervical cancer screening, affect patients' own-risk payments, and whether the IMPROVE study and cost-effectiveness analysis were sound. The minister said the findings were not new, that costs are uncertain but patients would pay less overall, that the cost-effectiveness results are expected this year, and that the new screening's start is based on the Health Council's advice.
The tender request from the RIVM, containing the research assignment, is attached.
Het offerteverzoek van het RIVM, met daarin de onderzoeksopdracht, is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over mogelijke wijziging van het Planningsbesluit IVF.

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether she will amend the 1998 IVF planning decision to allow more clinics, and whether it will be finalised before parliament can respond. The Minister confirms she intends to update the decision, allowing controlled growth from 13 to 16 clinics, mainly for legal reasons, and declines to delay it.
I intend to update the Planning Decision on in vitro fertilisation (hereinafter: the planning decision).
Ik ben voornemens het Planningsbesluit in-vitrofertilisatie (verder: het planningsbesluit) te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over medische thermografie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a TV report on commercial medical thermography marketed as an alternative to mammography, including whether misleading claims undermine the breast cancer screening programme and whether the Health Inspectorate will investigate. The Minister acknowledged the misleading marketing, stated no provider holds the required screening licence, and said the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation, expected to conclude after the summer, will address it.
The IGZ previously received a report about thermography and the investigation into it is currently ongoing.
De IGZ heeft eerder over thermografie een melding ontvangen en het onderzoek hiernaar loopt op dit moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onverwachte rekening mortuariumkosten voor nabestaanden

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of hospital mortuary charges unexpectedly billed to bereaved families, whether these charges are clearly disclosed, and what remedies and complaint routes families have. The minister answered that responsibility lies primarily with mortuary operators who must conclude explicit agreements, that complaints should go to the mortuary operator, and that the ministry has no data on whether information has improved.
Bereaved relatives should primarily direct complaints to the mortuary operator.
Nabestaanden dienen klachten primair te richten aan de mortuariumbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de plannen voor een megastal met grootschalige embryowinning in Wichmond en de gevolgen daarvan voor hormoonemissies naar het milieu

An MP asked the government about hormone emissions from the planned Wichmond cattle farm with embryo harvesting, including whether an environmental impact assessment and permits should block it. The state secretaries answered that no hormone-specific study or specific emission rules exist for the farm, that no MER is required for the first two phases, and that the municipality and province hold the relevant planning and permit powers.
For phase 3, it is up to the municipality to assess whether the final farm fits within the zoning plan.
Voor fase 3 is het aan de gemeente ter beoordeling of het uiteindelijke bedrijf inpasbaar is in het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de niet-reanimerenpenning

MP Krol asked the Minister of Health about the delayed update on talks to have the do-not-resuscitate pendant issued neutrally, and about the timeline. The minister said private parties were reluctant, the NPCF is considering the request pending an impact analysis, and she expects to report this spring, with full transfer by 1 January 2017 if the NPCF agrees.
As soon as I have more clarity, I will inform you about this.
Zodra ik meer duidelijkheid heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over de illegale handel in slaapmiddelen

Rutte (VVD) asked the Health Minister about prescribing and dispensing of addictive sleeping pills such as oxazepam, whether doctors and pharmacists keep addiction going, what sanctions exist, and whether Belgian pharmacies dispense on copied prescriptions. Minister Schippers answered that NIVEL data do not confirm the picture, cited about 150,000 long-term users, promised consultation with professional groups and possible further research, and said the IGZ has few grounds for action from the broadcast.
For applying measures following the reporting in the Brandpunt broadcast, this broadcast offers insufficient handholds.
Voor het toepassen van maatregelen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in de uitzending van Brandpunt biedt deze uitzending onvoldoende handvatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de “Erfelijkheidstest voor alle mensen met een kinderwens”

MPs Bruins Slot asked whether the planned preconception carrier screening offered by AMC and VUmc is covered by the Population Screening Act and needs a licence, and how it fits the minister's health check policy. The minister answered that carrier testing falls under the Medical Special Procedures Act licence for clinical genetics rather than the Population Screening Act, and that it is outside the health check definition, with quality safeguards and ongoing UMCG research.
The clinical genetic examination involved in the carrier test does fall under the licensing requirement defined in Article 2 of the Medical Special Procedures Act (WBMV).
Het klinisch genetisch onderzoek dat bij de dragerschapstest aan de orde is, valt wel onder de vergunningplicht zoals gedefinieerd in artikel 2 Wet op Bijzondere Medische Verrichtingen (WBMV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Marketing kunstvoeding bedreigt borstvoeding’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Health Minister about reports that marketing of infant formula threatens breastfeeding, and about the regulation, monitoring, professional training and support for breastfeeding mothers. The minister answered that formula rules are strict under EU and Dutch law, that breastfeeding rates have risen, and pointed to existing platforms, certification and planned e-learning, without new binding measures.
In the Netherlands the government does not conduct research into the influence of infant formula marketing on breastfeeding.
In Nederland wordt door de overheid geen onderzoek gedaan naar de invloed van marketing van kunstvoeding op het geven van borstvoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Grote verschillen in nierzorg tussen ziekenhuizen’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a Nieuwsuur report showing large differences between hospitals in kidney care, including referrals for transplant, dialysis duration incentives, home dialysis decline and the transplant waiting list. Minister Schippers answered that the profession and existing quality instruments (HKZ certification, Renine, Zorginzicht.nl) address the differences, denied that the waiting list is artificially kept small, and gave no new concrete measures beyond earlier initiatives.
This concerns a matter for the profession itself, and the profession has addressed the relevant Boards of Directors.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid van de beroepsgroep zelf en de beroepsgroep heeft de betreffende Raden van Bestuur aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over voeding in de zorg

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about nutrition in care: medical training, malnutrition screening, transmural guidelines, cancer screening advice, prevention funding and food concepts in hospitals. The Minister answered that professional bodies and guideline makers should lead on curriculum and guidelines, pointed to existing initiatives, and promised letters on prevention and a Kwaliteitsinstituut request.
I will ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to promote attention to nutrition in the relevant guidelines.
Daarnaast zal ik het Kwaliteitsinstituut vragen om te bevorderen dat in de relevante richtlijnen aandacht is voor voeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht Erasmus MC Rotterdam gaat botox-lessen geven

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views academic hospitals such as Erasmus MC offering training in cosmetic procedures like botox, whether a cosmetic-doctor title should be protected, and whether cosmetic surgery should be discouraged rather than trained for. The minister supports quality and qualified providers, describes the training modules and their participant numbers, says a protected title is welcome but is for the CGS to assess, and declines to actively discourage cosmetic surgery.
At Erasmus MC, the dermatology training devotes attention to aesthetic treatment only in its extracurricular components.
In het Erasmus MC wordt in de opleiding dermatologie enkel in de extracurriculaire onderdelen aandacht besteed aan behandeling gericht op esthetiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over sluipsuikers in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Health Minister about sugar levels in children's drink cartons, the Akkoord Verbetering Productsamenstelling, daily sugar limits and EU action. The minister described existing prevention programmes, the staged sugar-reduction agreements (with results not yet available), and plans to raise product reformulation at the EU level during the Dutch presidency.
How much of these drinks from drink cartons is consumed is not known.
Hoeveel van deze dranken uit drinkpakjes worden genuttigd is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Wolbert inzake de gevolgen van de afschaffing van leerlinggebonden financiering en de positie van logopedisten in de eerste lijn

MPs Ypma and Wolbert asked whether speech therapy in primary care is only reimbursed for activities performed in the patient's presence, whether unpaid coordination work is a problem, and what insurers' role is. The Secretary of State answered that telespeech therapy can be billed under the NZa tariff, that contact with other professionals is covered by existing tariffs, that inequality cannot be concluded, and that insurers have a duty to purchase quality care without signals of non-compliance.
No, a care provider can also bill for a speech therapy treatment that takes place without the patient being directly present.
Nee, een zorgaanbieder kan een logopedische behandeling ook in rekening brengen wanneer deze plaatsvindt zonder directe aanwezigheid van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dat er veel mis is met de zorg in woonzorgcentrum Titus Brandsmahof

The SP MP Leijten asked the minister, after press reports of serious care failures at the Titus Brandsmahof care home, why the IGZ inspectorate did not impose intensified supervision given prior complaints and a damning inspection report, and about the role of the supervisory board. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ sees no direct risks at present, is monitoring closely with unannounced inspections, will ensure continuity after a board change, and will enforce if improvements stall, while many follow-up questions were answered by pointing to the inspectorate or the provider.
However, the IGZ is currently closely monitoring the situation at Titus Brandsmahof and Carint Reggeland, including through unannounced inspections.
Wel houdt de IGZ op dit moment de situatie bij Titus Brandsmahof en Carint Reggeland nauwlettend in de gaten, onder andere met onaangekondigde inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over medische websites die gezondheidsgegevens lekken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about medical websites leaking health data via cookies, the limited capacity of the Data Protection Authority, and privacy safeguards in eHealth. The minister said the AP and ACM oversee cookies and data processing, the Informatieberaad will discuss extra safeguards with a first agreement expected in September, and organisations bear primary responsibility for compliance.
Given my eHealth ambitions, I will discuss with the members of the Informatieberaad whether there are possibilities to realise extra safeguards and promote privacy by design.
Gezien mijn eHealth ambities zal ik met de leden van het Informatieberaad bespreken of er mogelijkheden zijn om extra waarborgen te realiseren en «privacy by design» te stimuleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voor zorgbestuurders perverse prikkel tot fuseren vanwege salarissen hoger dan de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the WNT salary cap creates an incentive for hospital boards to merge, and whether the cap should be tightened for executives running several hospitals. The minister answered that gelieerde instellingen' pay is aggregated under the cap, that existing merger safeguards (governance code, zorgspecifieke fusietoets) are sufficient, and that the cumulation question is under review as part of the WNT evaluation.
The cabinet is currently considering, following the WNT law evaluation, whether tightening of the WNT is necessary based on the evaluation.
Het kabinet bekijkt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie WNT of aanscherping van de WNT nodig is op basis van de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht van de FBI ‘Health care systems and medical devices at risk for increased cyber intrusions for financial gain’

An SP MP asked ministers about an FBI warning that medical records have value for criminals, and about data security in Dutch healthcare after reports on Belgian prisoners handling patient files. Minister Schippers answered that information security is the responsibility of healthcare providers under data protection law and NEN 7510, supervised by the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the Health Inspectorate, but declined to provide figures on past data breaches.
I have no insight into the number of healthcare organisations and hospitals that have experienced problems with the security of their electronic data systems and devices over the past five years.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal zorgorganisaties en ziekenhuizen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar te maken heeft gekregen met problemen in de beveiliging van hun elektronische datasystemen en apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de website ‘woman on web’

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether Women on Web, a Dutch-hosted online abortion-information and medication service, offering free abortions to women with Zika may be unlawful and harmful, and when more will be known about Zika's link to microcephaly and Guillain-Barré. The minister answered that Dutch law only permits abortion in licensed facilities and bars internet prescribing without a doctor-patient relationship, that the IGZ has asked follow-up questions, and that scientific conclusions on Zika will take weeks to months.
The IGZ has asked Women on Web additional questions about the working method of this online community following the reports.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van de berichtgevingen Women on Web aanvullende vragen gesteld over de werkwijze van deze online gemeenschap

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de uitspraken van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC Groep over het inkomen boven de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) en geld verdienen in de zo

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the Slotervaart hospital board's remarks on earnings above the WNT pay cap, personal investments, loans to the hospital at attractive rates, and volume growth. The minister answered that the CIBG supervisor must assess individual WNT compliance, that the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek loans were ordinary commercial arrangements, that the profit-distribution ban is not known to be breached, and that new patient volume reflects healthy competition rather than inflation, with supervision by NZa and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de financiering van sport door het Rijk

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the lack of an integrated overview of government spending on sport and whether one should be compiled and sent to parliament. The minister answered that no integral overview of all sport-related government spending exists, pointed to article 6 of the VWS budget, and considered the municipal spending study plus the VWS budget sufficient for current planning.
An integral overview of all sport-related government expenditure does not exist, and therefore I cannot provide you with a labelling of expenditure or an overview of sport-related FTE deployment.

Een (integraal) overzicht van alle sportgerelateerde overheidsuitgaven bestaat niet, en derhalve kan ik u ook geen labeling van uitgaven doen toekomen noch een overzicht van aan sport gerelateerde fte inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de berichtgeving dat één op de drie artsen het falen van een collega niet meldt

An MP asked the health minister about reports that one in three doctors does not report a colleague's failure, and whether a culture of fear endangers patient safety, and what measures and supervision apply. The minister answered that primary responsibility for preventing and addressing underperformance lies with care institutions, professionals and professional bodies, that the IGZ will push them to act on the IQ Healthcare recommendations, and that a letter on safe reporting will follow.
The primary responsibility for preventing underperformance and responding adequately to signals lies primarily with care institutions, healthcare professionals and professional organisations.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid om disfunctioneren te voorkómen en adequaat te reageren op signalen ligt primair bij de zorginstellingen, de beroepsbeoefenaren en de beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Koser Kaya over het suikergehalte in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dijkstra and Koşer Kaya asked about Foodwatch findings that children's drink cartons contain more sugar than Coca-Cola, the child-targeted marketing of these products, and whether the 2020 sugar-reduction target is adequate. The minister points to the Product Composition Agreement, a stepwise approach to sugar reduction, EU-level action, and existing health education programmes, without committing to a stricter target.
A stepwise approach is needed to achieve sustainable results, both because of consumer taste adaptation and because of feasibility for industry.
Een stapsgewijze aanpak is nodig om duurzaam resultaat te behalen, zowel vanwege smaakgewenning bij de consument als vanwege haalbaarheid voor het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Çegerek over het feit dat de geloofwaardigheid van keurmerken onder druk staat

MPs Dikkers and Çegerek asked the State Secretary about the ACM finding that eco-label credibility is undermined by proliferation and unclear meaning, and whether government should define criteria and coordinate a framework. The State Secretary referred to his earlier letter, declined to set criteria himself but invited parties to act on ACM and Milieu Centraal recommendations, and noted an agreement to achieve an ordering of robust sustainability labels by end 2016.
I therefore do not consider it reasonable for the government to formulate the requirements itself.
Ik vind het dan ook niet in de rede liggen om vanuit de overheid de eisen te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Oncologische revalidatie te beperkt’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether oncological rehabilitation after cancer treatment is adequately covered under the Zvw, including quality of life and return to work, and whether ministries coordinate on it. The minister replied that the Zorginstituut confirmed oncological rehabilitation is covered Zvw care in several forms, that the Zorginstituut is reviewing return-to-work questions with a response expected mid-2016, and that such care is available regardless of income where effective.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over experimenten op psychiatrische patiënten van GGZ Noord-Holland-Noord (GGZ NHN)

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about experiments on psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, a whistleblower's treatment, the governance code breach, and whether the IGZ and CCMO are examining the research under the WMO. The Minister answered that the governance code was breached but the institution has since complied, that the IGZ investigation is near completion with a report expected in Q1 2016, and that the follow-up study was judged non-WMO by the CCMO.
The IGZ expects to be able to finalise the report at the end of the first quarter of 2016.
De IGZ verwacht het rapport eind eerste kwartaal 2016 te kunnen vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens

Two PvdA MPs asked about the executive pay of boards at the Slotervaart hospital and MC Groep, the Balkenende-norm style WNT cap, delayed repayment of municipal and provincial loans, profit distribution and NZa oversight. The minister answered that no ministry had approved the salary, that CIBG will investigate deeptime fraction issues within about eight weeks, that the WNT will be tightened in future legislation, and that the IGZ sees no quality risk.
The cabinet is currently preparing new legislation following the evaluation of the law to sharpen its effectiveness where necessary.
Het kabinet bereidt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie nieuwe wetgeving voor om de effectiviteit van de wet waar nodig aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Ypma over de positie van de cliëntenraad bij de fusie van het Zuwe Hofpoort (Woerden) en Antonius Ziekenhuis (Nieuwegein)

MPs Bouwmeester and Ypma asked the Minister of Health about the works council's position in the merger of Zuwe Hofpoort and Antonius Ziekenhuis, including the board's unilateral dissolution of the client council, the merger's status while objections were pending, and the NZa's reasoning. The minister answered that the board jointly decided the change, that the NZa has now rejected the council's objections, that the merger went ahead lawfully without suspensive effect, and that the government is consulting on strengthening client participation.
However, the court can review the lawfulness of such decisions under the Client Participation in Healthcare Institutions Act (Wmcz).
Wel kan de rechter op grond van de Wet medezeggenschap cliënten Zorginstellingen (Wmcz) de rechtmatigheid van dergelijke besluiten toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over 'minder vrouwen aan de top in de zorg'

Two PvdA MPs asked why women are underrepresented in top healthcare management despite forming most of the workforce, and whether diversity could improve quality. The minister answered that the government pursues a 30% target for women in senior government posts, is extending the statutory gender quota for large companies, and will consider a semi-public sector target in the Wbt evaluation, while noting that women hold 38% of healthcare board seats and that care institutions are private employers responsible for their own personnel policy.
The cabinet endorses that this pursuit of diversity should also apply to the sector financed with public funds.
Het kabinet onderschrijft dat dit streven naar diversiteit ook zou moeten gelden voor de met publieke middelen gefinancierde sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitzending over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Health about a documentary on a euthanasia clinic, criticism of its conduct, the assessment of a psychiatric case and whether the regional review committees (RTE's) can be trusted and supervised. The Minister defends the RTE's and the euthanasia framework, says a documentary is unsuitable as assessment material, notes that review outcomes are published and periodically evaluated, and promises a policy response on the Voltooid leven report before summer.
In addition, the RTEs account to me and the Minister of Security and Justice through the annual report, which is also submitted to the House of Representatives.
Daarnaast leggen de RTE's verantwoording af aan mij en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie door middel van het jaarverslag dat ook aan de Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de berichtgeving van het schending van privacy door Certe

An MP asked the Health Minister about press reports that the laboratory Certe breached patient privacy by sharing medical results with hospitals under an opt-out procedure, and asked about oversight and safeguards. The minister said the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is assessing the case and that oversight is its responsibility, while explaining the legal rules on sharing medical data and pointing to security standards.
I am awaiting the assessment of the AP.
Ik wacht de beoordeling van de AP af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP asks the Health Minister about the Levenseindekliniek (end-of-life clinic) shown in a documentary: whether 'treatment' language fits euthanasia, whether expertise on dementia and psychiatry is secured in the regional review committees, how cases where doctors refused are handled, and whether an independent investigation is needed. The minister replies that the review committees adequately assess cases, the clinic's procedures meet the law, and no independent study is needed, while promising a policy response on Voltooid leven later.
I see no reason to change the procedure of the regional review committees.
Ik zie geen reden om de procedure van de RTE's te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over dat er tonnen verdiend worden met ‘slimmer declareren’

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister how she views reports that mental health providers earn large sums by advising on 'smart declaring' (billing) and whether this conflicts with policy on patient care and fraud. The minister says she prefers correct billing, rejects financially driven care, refuses to name a revenue overview or order an NZa investigation, and points to planned reforms and existing controls.
I have not found in the article you cited any facts that give reason to ask the NZa to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb in het door u aangehaalde artikel geen feiten aangetroffen die aanleiding geven om de NZa te vragen nader onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Poging tot matchfixing in eredivisie'

An MP asked ministers about reports of attempted match-fixing in the Eredivisie, including the scope of approaches to players, the criminal investigation and the KNVB's notification of clubs. The minister condemned the conduct, confirmed a criminal investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie without disclosing its target, and deferred answering the remaining questions until the investigation concludes.
On the question of who the investigation is directed at, the OM makes no statements.
Over de vraag op wie het onderzoek zich richt, doet het OM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over racistische uitingen van de supporters van ADO Den Haag tijdens de wedstrijd tegen Ajax

MPs Kuzu and others asked ministers about racist chants by ADO Den Haag supporters against Ajax players and whether the government would act, including on investigation, prosecution and the KNVB's handling of such incidents. The government replied that clubs, KNVB and Eredivisie CV agreed to act faster against offensive chants, that prosecution is considered in provable cases, and that existing monitoring and action plans are sufficient, declining new investigations.
Professional football clubs, the KNVB and Eredivisie CV have agreed to act faster and more firmly against offensive chants in football.
Betaald voetbalclubs, KNVB en Eredivisie CV hebben afgesproken sneller en kordater op te treden tegen scheldkoren in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het aanvallen van een scheidsrechter door spelers van de voetbalclub Nieuw Sloten

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a complaint had been filed over football players of Nieuw Sloten attacking a referee, whether the Public Prosecution Service would prosecute, and whether the KNVB was investigating. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the OM decided not to prosecute given the seriousness, the referee's wish not to file, and the club withdrawing the team, and that the KNVB disciplinary investigation is ongoing with players suspended.
The Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute ex officio, given the seriousness of what occurred.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft besloten niet ambtshalve tot vervolging over te gaan, vanwege de ernst van hetgeen dat is voorgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ook huisartsen werken mee aan dubieuze bloedtests’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether she was troubled that lab prick-posts cooperate with a commercial firm offering dubious preventive blood tests, and asked about quality, pricing, unregulated lab diagnostics and professional criticism. The Minister said consumers may choose such tests if quality is assured, noted the lab had cut ties with the firm, found current regulation and IGZ oversight sufficient, and promised further talks with stakeholders on conditions for adequate diagnostics.
I will discuss the matter further with the parties involved to draw up conditions for adequate diagnostics.
Ik zal met betrokken partijen nader in gesprek gaan om randvoorwaarden voor adequate diagnostiek op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Dikkers over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in voedingsverpakkingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked the ministers about hormone-disrupting substances such as BPA in food packaging, the protective measures, alternatives, and Dutch EU presidency efforts. The government answered that BPA exposure should be reduced through tighter EU limits rather than a ban, as substitutes are not yet proven safe, and committed to raising the issue at the Environment Council.
The Cabinet therefore adopts the RIVM advice to promote tightening of the current European standards and to reduce exposure to BPA as far as possible at national level.

Het Kabinet neemt daarom de adviezen van het RIVM over om aanscherping van de huidige Europese normen te bevorderen en om op nationaal niveau de blootstelling aan BPA zo ver mogelijk terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Gerven over over giftige bontkragen op kinderjassen

MPs Thieme and Van Gerven asked whether fur collars on children's jackets, found to contain formaldehyde and ethoxylates above guideline levels, should be recalled and banned, and whether fur labelling should be improved. The minister replied that the NVWA and RIVM judge exposure acceptable, that no national ban or recall is warranted for now, and that EU consultation on formaldehyde and labelling efforts are ongoing.
The NVWA concludes that the actual amount of toxic substances that can be released from the product is at a scientifically acceptable level.
De NVWA concludeert dat de feitelijke hoeveelheid giftige stoffen die uit het product kunnen vrijkomen onder het wetenschappelijk gezien acceptabele niveau liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het opvragen van de gegevens van een ggz-patiënt door een zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a health insurer that requested referral letters and diagnoses of mental health patients who had objected to data sharing, and about whether other insurers and the insurer itself would face sanctions and how supervision would work. The minister said the Data Protection Authority found one insurer violated the rules in 2015, which has since stopped, that the DPA can now impose fines, and that the NZa and DPA cooperate on supervision with findings expected in spring 2016.
It is clear that one health insurer did not comply with the rules.
Het is duidelijk dat één zorgverzekeraar zich niet aan de regels heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het slechte onderhoud van Automatische Externe Defibrillatoren (AED’s)

An MP asked the health minister about poor maintenance of AEDs and the IGZ's 2013 action with manufacturers, and about registration in volunteer alert networks. The minister said no national data exist on AED maintenance, described the IGZ's past steps, judged no new manufacturer letter necessary for now, and left registration largely to private parties while considering conditions on a subsidy.
I cannot draw a general conclusion about the state of maintenance of the AEDs present in the Netherlands.
Een algemene conclusie over de stand van het onderhoud van de in Nederland aanwezige AED's kan ik niet trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van een morfinepomp

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a health insurer's refusal to reimburse a morphine pump and about the general reimbursement of prescribed aids. The minister said the insurer admitted miscommunication, tightened procedures, and that insurers must provide adequate aids under their duty of care, with the NZa supervising, while deferring a broader medical-necessity review to a letter in June.
In the insurer's view, two things went wrong.
Naar oordeel van de zorgverzekeraar zijn er twee zaken niet goed gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de benoeming van de voorzitter van Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MP Dik-Faber asked whether former NVVE chair Jacob Kohnstamm's appointment as coordinating chair of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees was procedurally sound and whether his past role at a pro-euthanasia advocacy group compromised impartiality, and whether doctors' pressure linked to NVVE activities should be addressed. The ministers answered that the procedure followed a joint nomination by the committee chairs with published profile and selection steps, that Kohnstamm's past NVVE chairmanship is not an obstacle given the committee's role, and that they will not require him to resign from NVVE membership.
The chairs of the RTEs stated in their nomination that Mr Kohnstamm shows a keen awareness of the impartial position and role of the coordinating chair and the RTEs.
De voorzitters van de RTE's hebben in hun voordracht aangegeven dat de heer Kohnstamm blijk geeft van een scherp zicht op de onpartijdige positie en rol van de coördinerend voorzitter en de RTE's.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de benoeming van een voormalig voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor een Vrijwillig Levenseinde (NVVE) tot voorzitter van de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthan
