An SGP MP asked whether the appointment of a former NVVE chair and co-initiator of a euthanasia bill as coordinating chair of the Regional Review Committees on Euthanasia was procedurally sound, impartial, and compatible with independent oversight. The ministers answered that an open procedure was followed, that the appointee was chosen as the best candidate, that his past NVVE role is different from the committees' legal task, and that existing accountability mechanisms and evaluations are sufficient.
We did not choose Mr Kohnstamm for a politically or socially profiled appointment, but for the best candidate proposed by the RTEs after an open application procedure.

Wij hebben met de heer Kohnstamm niet gekozen voor een politiek of maatschappelijk geprofileerde benoeming, maar voor de beste kandidaat die na een open sollicitatieprocedure door de RTE’s is voorgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen kiezen voor een verhoogd eigen risico

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that more people choose a higher voluntary deductible and about NZa findings that such polices and budget policies may enable risk selection and undermine solidarity. Minister Schippers answered that the 2016 uptake figures are not yet known, that voluntary deductibles are a legitimate consumer choice, and that she awaits the NZa follow-up study before deciding whether to act.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the NZa's supplementary study.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het aanvullende onderzoek van de NZa af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek naar tienerzwangerschappen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a Rutgers study on teenage pregnancies, including whether abortion is rejected by many pregnant teenagers, whether support for young mothers is adequate, and whether prevention and counselling should stress abortion's negative consequences. The State Secretary answered that girls' choices are respected, that doctors judge whether decisions are free and informed, that existing funding for support organisations is sufficient, and that counselling covers all options and consequences of abortion.
It is up to the doctor to determine whether a woman who comes to him for an abortus has made this choice freely and well informed.
Het is aan de arts om te bepalen of een vrouw die bij hem komt voor een abortus deze keuze in vrijheid en goed geïnformeerd heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de privacyschending door ziekenhuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers whether outsourcing scanning of patient records to a Belgian firm that used prisoners and sheltered workshops, and the resulting privacy breach, was acceptable, and how destruction of records and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' powers are supervised. The minister answered that such outsourcing is allowed under the Wbp if processor agreements are in place, that hospitals remain responsible, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens has sufficient enforcement powers, and that the Inspectie will write to hospitals and watch processor agreements.
The Health Care Inspectorate has already indicated to me that it is paying attention to how processor agreements were concluded at those hospitals still transitioning from paper to digital records.

De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg heeft mij al aangegeven dat zij aandacht hebben voor de wijze waarop de bewerkersovereenkomsten zijn gesloten bij die ziekenhuizen die nog in transitie zijn van papieren naar digitale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het lekken van patiëntgegevens

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government would investigate who was responsible for leaking 4,559 patient records from a Geldrop hospital and whether the incident fell under the data breach notification duty and constituted a breach of medical confidentiality. The minister answered that hospitals are primarily responsible, that the breach was reported to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, and that prosecution or sanctions are for the Public Prosecution Service and the Data Protection Authority to decide.
Hospitals themselves are primarily responsible for this.
Ziekenhuizen zijn hier in eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over Nederlandse patiëntgegevens in Belgische gevangenis

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about Dutch patient records being handled by Belgian prisoners and records of several hospitals being exposed online. Minister Schippers answered that responsibility lies primarily with the hospitals and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg, that existing rules are sufficient, and that the inspectorate will alert hospitals via letters.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority to judge whether the Personal Data Protection Act was violated in these situations.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te oordelen of in deze situaties de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over misleiding bij voedselproducten door supermarkten

An MP asked the ministers whether supermarkets misleading consumers on food labels (e.g. diluted juice priced above full juice) is known, what sanctions apply, and what instruments exist to enforce labelling rules. The minister answered that the NVWA assesses case by case, warnings and fines are available, no fines were recently issued for juice labelling, and a plan of action on labelling is promised for spring 2016.
Furthermore, I have committed to come up with an action plan in spring 2016 on the basis of this research and the NVWA's experience regarding food labelling.
Daarnaast heb ik u toegezegd op basis van dit onderzoek en de ervaringen van de NVWA voor wat betreft etikettering van voedingsmiddelen in het voorjaar van 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verdwijnen van 300 banen bij het Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) mede vanwege 239 miljoen kostende nieuwbouw

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about 300 job losses at Medisch Spectrum Twente linked to a 239 million euro new building, including whether the financing used swaps and why capital costs in healthcare rose after the building regime was abolished. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own building decisions, declined detailed knowledge of the plans, said data on capital costs were not available, and said no public rate norm applies to bank lending to care institutions.
It is up to hospitals themselves to make decisions about any necessary new buildings and the trade-offs made in that process, such as the organisation of the institution.
Het is aan ziekenhuizen zelf om beslissingen te nemen over eventueel noodzakelijke nieuwbouw en de afwegingen die daarbij worden gemaakt over bijvoorbeeld de inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het zikavirus

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about Zika virus information for pregnant women, travel advice consistency with Belgium, and implementation of a motion on a medical rapid-response unit. The minister answered that information is provided via RIVM, LCR and foreign affairs channels, that the Netherlands follows WHO advice without a negative travel advice, and that Dutch contributions to the EU medical corps and WHO reform are underway.
The RIVM follows the WHO advice unless conditions in the Netherlands are so different that they justify different advice.
Het RIVM volgt de advisering van de WHO tenzij de omstandigheden in Nederland zo anders zijn dat dit een andere advisering rechtvaardigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Uitbraak Zikavirus: miljoenen besmettingen verwacht’ en ‘Experts waarschuwen: Zikavirus deze zomer in Zuid-Europa’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports of Zika virus outbreaks and the risk of spread to the Netherlands, including mosquito control, pregnancy advice and wetland effects. The minister answered that Aedes mosquitoes cannot establish in Europe, that monitoring by RIVM and WHO continues, and that a RIVM/NVWA policy advice on native mosquitoes is delayed to around March 2016.
As soon as I have received this policy advice, I will send it to the House of Representatives.
Zodra ik dit beleidsadvies ontvangen heb zal ik deze de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de ‘wereldwijde noodsituatie’ door het zikavirus

MP Bruins Slot asked the health minister how Erasmus MC, RIVM and WHO cooperate on the Zika emergency, whether travellers are tested, the origins and seriousness of the virus, blood donation rules, sexual transmission advice, tyre import controls, and testing of invasive mosquitoes. The minister answered that the institutes share work and data, travellers are not routinely tested or screened at airports, blood donors must wait four weeks after leaving Europe, enforcement on tyre importers runs through municipalities with a planned law change to shift responsibility to the minister, and invasive mosquitoes are not tested for viruses.
The bill is currently with the Council of State. I expect to submit it to your House at the end of March or beginning of April 2016.
Het wetsvoorstel ligt op dit moment bij de Raad van State. Ik verwacht het eind maart, begin april 2016 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Inzet ID-scanners bij leeftijdscontrole tabak in strijd met Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens’

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether using ID scanners for tobacco age checks breaches the Dutch data protection act, and what the government will do about it and about poor compliance with the age limit. The State Secretary replied that the Data Protection Authority says such scanners are not automatically unlawful, depending on the data scanned and how they are used, that retailers must follow the law but the government will not prescribe a system, and that the DPA alone decides enforcement priorities, while the NVWA has intensified supervision and he will report on compliance mid-year.
Under the EU privacy directive and the Dutch Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor of the Wbp.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is krachtens de EU-privacyrichtlijn en de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) de onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether a Follow the Money report showed that healthcare costs had shifted unseen onto citizens since 2004 and whether the minister's claims about premiums were misleading. The minister replied that the increase largely reflects omitting the healthcare allowance, that the 50/50 burden-sharing rule keeps employer shares roughly constant, and that a CBS misclassification will be corrected while the minister's earlier claims stand.
The CBS, among other things, counts self-employed persons as businesses in the cited flow charts.
Het CBS rekent onder andere in de genoemde stroomschema's zelfstandigen tot bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Bouwmeester over een patstelling tussen kinderpsychiatrische zorginstellingen en zorgverzekeraars door achteraf aangepaste regels en normen

MPs Ypma and Bouwmeester asked the minister whether the stalemate between youth mental health institutions and health insurers, caused by retroactively changed NZa rules and self-audit, is acceptable and whether the child's interest and reliance on agreed norms are respected. The minister called the stalemate undesirable, said the NZa would be asked to clarify and adjust the rules retroactively in consultation with the parties, and that the self-audit was voluntary and not a sector-wide fraud investigation.
I have therefore decided to ask the NZa to adjust the relevant rules (on direct time of the main practitioner and residential services) with retroactive effect and in consultation with the parties.

Ik heb daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «de diagnose na 10 jaar markt» (ingezonden 30 december 2015).

MP Bouwmeester (PvdA) asks the Health Minister about a newspaper piece on ten years of the market-based care system, questioning patient position, cost growth, equity, life expectancy and insurer-provider power. Minister Schippers rejects the claim that patient position has not strengthened, cites cost growth figures, equal burden for low incomes, prevention policy and ongoing monitoring of contracting, promising continued action.
I do not share your view either. The position of patients has demonstrably become stronger in recent years.
Ik deel uw mening ook niet. De positie van patiënten is de afgelopen jaren aantoonbaar sterker geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het al dan niet vergoeden van dimethylfumaraat bij de behandeling van MS

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurer Zilveren Kruis Achmea stopped reimbursing the cheap compounded dimethylfumarate for MS, leaving only the expensive branded Tecfidera covered, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. The minister answered that the insurer stopped reimbursing only supplied compounded preparations, not in-pharmacy preparations, that registered Tecfidera remains reimbursed, and that she is examining European rules on pricing and new active substances.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea has stated that it no longer reimburses the supplied preparations of dimethylfumarate.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea heeft aangegeven dat zij de doorgeleverde bereidingen van dimethylfumuraat niet meer vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de voorwaardelijke toelating van fampridine (Fampyra) in het basispakket

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why fampridine (Fampyra) was placed under conditional reimbursement despite a negative Zorginstituut advice, why the cheaper pharmacy preparation was not chosen, and how this relates to Tecfidera and earlier motions on high-priced medicines. The minister answered that Fampyra was selected through the new top-down conditional admission route, that a lower negotiated price (about EUR 151 per 4 weeks) was agreed, and that the case is not adaptive licensing, while acknowledging undesirably high prices are a concern.
The medicine Fampyra was selected in consultation with the Zorginstituut on the basis of the top-down procedure.
Het geneesmiddel Fampyra is in overleg met het Zorginstituut geselecteerd op basis van de top-down procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Je operatie in een animatie’ over patiënt gericht informeren

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a doctor who relies on crowdfunding to develop animated patient information should be seen as a sign that patient-centred communication is not properly funded, and whether visual information should be the norm. The Minister said initiatives will be promoted through insurers and information websites, that the WGBO may be amended to require shared decision-making, and that funding for patient-centred information will be reviewed and reported before summer.
To do something about this, I am considering an amendment to the Medical Treatment Agreement Act (WGBO).
Om daar iets aan te doen overweeg ik een wijziging van de Wet op de geneeskundige behandelovereenkomst (WGBO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Dit is wat teveel energiedrank met je lichaam doet’

MPs Koşer Kaya and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister how consumers, including minors, can learn from energy drink packaging that heavy consumption may cause serious health effects, and whether labelling and corporate responsibility are adequate. The minister replied that mandatory high-caffeine warnings already apply under EU rules, that industry's voluntary code adds further labelling and marketing limits, and that the government promotes information via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes.
Yes, see answer 2. In addition, I am focusing, for example, via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes on targeted information about healthy and unhealthy food
Ja, zie antwoord 2. Daarnaast zet ik bijvoorbeeld via het Voedingscentrum en schoolprogramma's in op gerichte voorlichting over gezonde en ongezonde voeding
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toekomst van de ambulancezorg en het definitieve rapport “Ordening ambulancezorg” van Zorgconsultancybureau SiRM

The MPs Leijten and Van Gerven (SP) asked why the SiRM report on ambulance care was dated 29 September 2015 but only sent to parliament in December, why it was not sent separately, who commissioned and guided it, whether earlier drafts and meeting minutes exist, and why the government opposes a public variant and did not examine labour market effects. Minister Schippers answered that the report was sent in December to avoid delay, that the commissioning and drafts were handled internally with no written minutes, and that the government sees no need for a public variant because quality is already regulated, while the options studied do not change the basic structure of ambulance care.
No written minutes were drawn up of that meeting.
Van dat overleg is geen schriftelijk verslag opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de “ADHD-epidemie”

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about the reported fourfold rise in ADHD medication over ten years, the risk of over-medicalisation of children, and whether psychiatrists' concerns and calls for more diagnostics were being addressed. The state secretary acknowledged the rise as worrying, pointed to the Health Council report and a 'Plan van Aanpak Gepaste Zorg' with concrete actions and a session on diagnostic pressure, but gave no independent analysis of the causes.
This strong increase in the use of medication for ADHD in recent years is worrying, although the Health Council found no clear explanation for the increase in its advice.

Deze forse stijging in het gebruik van medicatie bij ADHD de afgelopen jaren is zorgelijk, alhoewel de Gezondheidsraad in haar advies geen duidelijke verklaring heeft gevonden voor de toename in het gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het niet melden van een ernstig incident met een baby in het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC)

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about a serious incident involving a baby at the AMC that was not promptly reported, and about the AMC's KNO department training climate and patient safety. The Minister answered that the IGZ is investigating the reporting and will send a follow-up letter, while describing the training accreditation decision, improvement measures, and the reporting obligations.

Once the investigation into this event is concluded (expected within a few weeks), I will resume answering the questions in the form of a letter with information on the outcomes of this investigation.

Zodra het onderzoek naar deze gebeurtenis is afgerond (naar verwachting binnen enkele weken), zal ik de beantwoording van de vragen hernemen in de vorm van een brief met informatie over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Rutte over de beperking van transplantaties in het Leids Universitair Medisch Centrum (LUMC) vanwege ruzie onder artsen

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about the temporary restriction of transplantation at LUMC due to a conflict among surgeons and whether patient safety was at risk. The minister answered that the hospital acted adequately, transplants were moved to Rotterdam where needed, no organs were lost, and the hospital's programme is fully running again.
The IGZ will continue to monitor the situation through its regular supervision.
De IGZ blijft de situatie met haar reguliere toezicht volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) in Amsterdam

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a reported unsafe training climate and a concealed medical incident at the AMC's ENT department, including what was done after the RGS critical visitation report, whether patient safety is at risk, why the inspectorate was not alerted, and whether the investigation covers the working climate. The minister answered that a safe climate is an important condition but does not by itself mean acute patient risk, that measures have been taken, that the inspectorate found no reason to close the department, that the hospital board was not obliged to report but the inspectorate will discuss it, and that the inspectorate's investigation covers only the incident, with the outcome to follow.
The investigation into the report to the inspectorate is ongoing and I will inform your House of the outcome soon.
Het onderzoek naar de melding bij de inspectie loopt en ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het kwaliteitsonderzoek telefonische informatieverstrekking zorgverzekeraars

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers Zilveren Kruis/Achmea, VGZ and CZ went to court against the NZa's critical study of phone information provision, and about the NZa's outsourcing of the research to TNS NIPO. The minister answered that insurers will discuss the method with the NZa, that the NZa is reviewing how to conduct such studies after the court ruling, and that the NZa outsourced 24 studies in 2014 and 46 in 2015, spending about 1.6% and 2.8% of its budget on third-party research.
The NZa is currently considering how best to shape similar studies to the one in this case.
Momenteel beziet de NZa hoe zij het beste vorm kan geven aan soortgelijke onderzoeken als in deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over commerciële handel in weefsel van geaborteerde kinderen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Health whether Planned Parenthood clinics engaged in commercial trade in foetal tissue and altered abortion methods, and what diplomatic or subsidy measures the government would take regarding IPPF funding. The minister answered that no commercial trade occurs under US law, that Dutch law forbids compensation for foetal tissue, that IPPF receives about 2.5 million euro annually for youth sexual and reproductive health, and that withdrawing subsidies is neither warranted nor desired.
There is no question of commercial trade or of a profit motive.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële handel of van een winstoogmerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een importverbod van kangoeroeproducten

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers about hygiene, health risks, welfare and a possible import ban on kangaroo meat, citing Australian and US reports. The minister answers that current contamination levels give no reason to change policy, that a Russian-style ban is not justified, and that the welfare-based ban argument lacks a legal basis under EU rules.
The current contamination level of kangaroo meat gives me no reason to change the policy pursued.
De huidige besmettingsgraad van kangoeroevlees geeft mij geen aanleiding het ingezette beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over snellere overdracht tussen ambulance en ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Health Minister about faster digital handover of patient data from ambulance to hospital, and whether RAV IJsselland's linked approach could be adopted nationally. The minister welcomed the initiatives, described existing e-Spoed standards and pre-announcement practice, and said remaining steps are mainly up to hospitals; she acknowledged that WGBO blocks feedback to ambulance staff without patient consent and said the ministry is consulting on that.

The ministry is consulting with Ambulancezorg Nederland and the Dutch Association of Hospitals to examine whether this information provision is possible and how patient consent can be properly embedded.

Het ministerie is in overleg met Ambulancezorg Nederland en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Ziekenhuizen om te bezien of deze informatievoorziening mogelijk is en hoe de toestemming van de patiënt op een goede manier kan worden ingebed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Bouwmeester en Otwin van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Geldzaken in de praktijk 2015’ van het Nibud

MPs Yücel, Bouwmeester and Otwin van Dijk asked about Nibud findings on debt arrears driven by health costs, low public awareness of financial aid, the role of municipalities and integrated financial desks, and how health-cost compensation is made known and used. The government answered that it monitors low incomes, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and receive extra funding, and that it is running information campaigns on the deductible and health-cost compensation.
In response to this motion I visited the Geldloket in Amersfoort.
In reactie op deze motie ben ik op bezoek geweest bij het Geldloket in Amersfoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht “NZA: Voorlichting zorgverzekeraars onder de maat”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the NZa finding that health insurers gave wrong answers to about one in five consumer questions, and about the risks this poses for policyholders. The Minister acknowledged the problem, noted that the NZa's sanction on three insurers was suspended by a court, and pointed to complaint and reporting routes without committing to new measures.
On 15 January the judge suspended the NZa's directive given to health insurers, because the NZa cannot adequately substantiate the investigation, among other things.
Op 15 januari jl. heeft de rechter de door de NZa aan zorgverzekeraars gegeven aanwijzing geschorst, omdat de NZa het onderzoek onder andere niet voldoende kan onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over agressie tegen zorgverleners

An MP asks the health minister about rising aggression against hospital staff, the continuation of the Veilig Werken in de Zorg action plan, and whether drug packets found on patients in the emergency room are returned to them. The minister reports falling physical aggression, says the action plan continues in 2016 with social partners, and explains that found drugs are handed to police under the KNMG guidance.
The Veilig Werken in de Zorg action plan will be continued for one more year for this purpose.
Het Actieplan Veilig Werken in de Zorg wordt daarvoor nog een jaar voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat sport voor kinderen onbetaalbaar wordt

MPs Van Nispen asked whether the rising cost of youth sports clubs, and the reported strain on club finances, is a concern and what the government will do. The minister says sport must be affordable, points to Jeugdsportfonds funding, notes that municipalities set their own sports spending and that club finances appear stable, and promises extra money for low-income children.
Yes, sport must be affordable for everyone.
Ja, sport moet betaalbaar zijn voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over de Special Olympic World Games

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the Health Minister about the Dutch team's medal results at the Special Olympics in Los Angeles and whether the government would encourage athletes at the 2017 Winter Games in Austria. The minister expressed pride in the athletes and said she would try to attend and cheer them on in Austria, depending on her agenda.
I will work to give the athletes encouragement, just as during the preparation for the World Summer Games in Los Angeles.
Ik zal mij inzetten om net zoals tijdens de voorbereiding van de World Summer Games in Los Angeles de sporters een hart onder de riem te steken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een nieuwe vondst van Colistine resistentie op Nederlands kippenvlees en geïmporteerd kalkoenvlees

An MP (PvdD) asked the minister whether conditions for pigs and poultry should be improved to reduce antibiotic use, whether colistin should be phased out early, whether consumers should be warned about antibiotic-resistant bacteria in meat, whether colistin resistance should be monitored and reported, and whether colistin resistance exists in pigs. The minister answered that colistin sales fell by about 67% since 2011 on a voluntary basis, that EU-level measures and a 2016-2020 policy will be presented in spring 2016, that a warning label on poultry is being optimised, that testing for colistin resistance will be extended, and that a reporting obligation would need legal change and will be considered after the EMA advice.
Tightening of the legal conditions of use or statutory phase-out is reserved for the EU.
Aanscherping van de wettelijke gebruikseisen of wettelijke uitfasering is voorbehouden aan de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bergkamp over de continuïteit van hospicezorg

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the government about waiting lists and funding gaps at Hospice Dignitas, insurers' expenditure caps for 2016, and whether insurers meet their care duty when contracting little with regional hospices. The State Secretary answered that waiting times are undesirable, that insurers are expected to contract sufficiently and reorganise contracting, that local shortages occur but are not structural, and that the NZa transparency rule and a dispute body are being developed.
Health insurers have a duty of care; they must provide insured persons with good-quality care that is within their reach and delivered in a timely manner.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben zorgplicht, zij moeten verzekerden voorzien van kwalitatief goede zorg die binnen hun bereik is af te nemen en tijdig wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Bouwmeester over het fusiebesluit over het Antonius Ziekenhuis en het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis in Woerden

MPs Bouwmeester and Ypma asked the minister about the NZa's finding that the Antonius and Zuwe Hofpoort hospital merger was carefully conducted despite disputes, and about the client council's objection that it was only informed rather than consulted. The minister answered that the NZa is independent and has judged stakeholder involvement careful, that she will prepare measures to improve client council participation in decisions affecting clients.
I am currently preparing a coherent package of measures to improve participation of client councils.
Om die reden ben ik momenteel een samenhangend pakket aan maatregelen aan het voorbereiden om de medezeggenschap te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT)

MPs Bouwmeester and Kerstens asked about executive pay at Slotervaart hospital and the MC group in relation to the WNT pay cap, including dual board roles, part-time factors above full time and governance concerns. The minister said the WNT supervisor CIBG and the accountant are responsible for assessing compliance, referred the matter to them, and said the IGZ found no grounds for stricter enforcement.
As part of its regular supervision under the WNT, the CIBG will examine this case.
In het kader van zijn reguliere toezicht op de WNT zal het CIBG deze casus onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat bij veel zelfzorggeneesmiddelen noodzakelijke informatie ontbreekt

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dijk asked whether many over-the-counter medicines lack information on shelf life after opening, and whether the CBG and government enforce the duty to test and label it. The minister answered that since 2001 manufacturers must test and label post-opening shelf life, that the CBG checks this at licensing, and that the CBG is negotiating with industry to label it on all multi-use products.
This obligation is checked by the CBG when granting a marketing authorisation, at which point the product information is also approved.
Deze verplichting controleert het CBG bij het verlenen van een handelsvergunning, waarbij ook de productinformatie wordt goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de WK-kandidatuur van Nederland en België

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked whether the minister pressed the KNVB for an independent investigation into the Netherlands-Belgium 2018 World Cup bid, who commissions and conducts it, whether the Public Prosecution Service will investigate, what the 2009 departure of Alain Courtois and ministry knowledge of alleged Belgian misconduct involved, and whether the minister has contacted Belgian counterparts. The minister answers that the KNVB independently commissioned an independent accountant's investigation expected in Q1 2016, that the ministry has contact with the KNVB and will be informed of results, that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on its investigations, that the 2011 evaluation was limited in scope, that the ministry had no subsidy relationship with Beltomundial, and that the ministry has contacted Belgian colleagues who await their own internal investigation.
Once the results are known, the KNVB will inform me of the findings and conclusions and I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn, zal de KNVB mij op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen en conclusies en zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Pia Dijkstra over gesjoemel bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid

MPs Van Dekken and Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about alleged payments, including EUR 10,000 to vote-canvasser Amadou Diallo, in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid. The minister answered that the KNVB found no violations in an initial review, that an independent accountant is investigating with results expected in Q1 2016, that business-sensitive documents will not be made public, and that she will await outcomes before considering recovering funds.
Documents containing business-sensitive information that give insight into the operational process for this bid have not been made public by me under the Wob.
Documenten met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, die inzicht geven in het bedrijfsvoeringproces ten behoeve van dit bid zijn, in het kader van de Wob, door mij niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de vergoeding van het exoskelet

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a paraplegic patient should keep a robotic exoskeleton funded after a trial, whether such innovations should be reimbursed, and what financing options exist. The minister said the device is CE-marked and eligible for reimbursement case by case under either the Wmo (municipalities) or the Zvw (health insurers), and that the Zorginstituut is asked to clarify which regime applies, with a promise to inform parliament later.
Because this is a demarcation issue between the Zvw and the Wmo, I have asked the Zorginstituut to clarify under which scheme this type of aid can fall.
Omdat hier sprake is van een afbakeningsvraagstuk tussen Zvw en Wmo, heb ik het Zorginstituut gevraagd om een verduidelijking binnen welke regeling dit soort hulpmiddelen kunnen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het AMC

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why AMC did not report a medical incident to the Health Inspectorate, whether it was a calamity or a complication, and how the hospital handled complaints and the parents. The Minister answered that the IGZ is investigating whether AMC met its reporting duty and cannot comment during the inquiry, and refused to release the full file because of privacy and Wob balancing.

No. Regarding the full file and the still to be drawn up (final) report on the event, the IGZ is legally required under the Wob to weigh the public interest in disclosure against the interest in protecting patients' privacy and preventing disproportionate harm to all involved.

Nee. Ten aanzien van het volledige dossier en nog op te stellen (eind)rapportage van de gebeurtenis is de IGZ op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), wettelijk gehouden een afweging te maken tussen het publieke belang bij openbaarmaking enerzijds, en het belang van eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van patiënten/cliënten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over 175.000 Nederlanders die hun schildkliermedicijn Thyrax Duotab tijdelijk niet kunnen ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about a shortage of the thyroid drug Thyrax Duotab affecting 175,000 patients, including side effects of switching drugs, the manufacturer's conduct, and whether pharmaceutical supply policy should change. The minister said the IGZ is investigating the manufacturer, that alternatives are available and Euthyrox may be imported, and that no change to drug policy is planned, though the minister will talk to the industry association and intensify the drug-shortage working group.
To answer whether the manufacturer can be blamed for socially irresponsible conduct, I want to await the IGZ investigation and not anticipate its results.

Voor de beantwoording van de vraag of de fabrikant maatschappelijk onverantwoord gedrag kan worden verweten wil ik het onderzoek van de IGZ afwachten en niet nu al vooruitlopen op de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bruins Slot over over een dreigend tekort aan een geneesmiddel voor schildklierpatiënten

MPs Dijkstra (D66) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the health minister about an impending shortage of the thyroid medicine Thyrax Duotab 0.025 mg, including whether the manufacturer's planning error, its legal duty to keep stock, the inspectorate's enforcement and the EMA's role were handled properly. Minister Schippers answered that the inspectorate is investigating possible breach of the duty to keep stock and will not prejudge it, that alternative suppliers can partly fill the gap, and that she is concerned by the rising number of shortages and will bring parties together.
While the investigation is ongoing, the IGZ and I cannot say anything about the possible outcome or any enforcement action.
Lopende het onderzoek kunnen de IGZ en ik over de mogelijke uitkomst en eventuele inzet van handhaving niets zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de berichtgeving rondom de te verwachte toekomstige tekorten van het schildkliergeneesmiddel Thyrax

An MP asked the health minister about expected shortages of the thyroid medicine Thyrax, the manufacturer's delayed notice, and whether the state can compel producers to keep medicines available. The minister answered that producers are legally obliged to keep supply adequate and notify discontinuations, that the IGZ is investigating the Thyrax case including possible breach of the Medicines Act, and that she will intensify the shortage working group.
The marketing authorisation holder did not comply with the period specified in the Medicines Act.
De handelsvergunninghouder heeft zich niet aan de in de Geneesmiddelwet gespecificeerde termijn gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de ingrediënten die aan wijn worden toegevoegd

An MP asked the ministers about additives in wine after a consumer programme, and why wine is exempt from full ingredient labelling. The ministers said EU rules allow certain winemaking processes and exempt drinks above 1.2% alcohol from ingredient labelling, and that they await a Commission report before deciding on mandatory labelling.
As regards possible future mandatory listing of ingredients on alcoholic drinks, I am awaiting the Commission's report.
Voor wat betreft een eventuele toekomstige verplichte vermelding van de ingrediënten op alcoholische dranken wacht ik het verslag van de Commissie af
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht “Specialisten gaan terug naar oude maatschap”

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports that specialists are returning to the old partnership structure to keep fiscal entrepreneur status, and whether the MSB is a sham construction, the Fyra comparison, and the market power of regional partnerships. The minister replied that no actual returns to the old structure have occurred (only requests to the Tax Authority), that the Tax Authority assesses each case, that integrated tariffs reduce fiscal entrepreneurship risks, and that the NZa and TIAS review will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat medische websites gezondheidsgegevens lekken

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health whether medical websites such as thuisarts.nl and hospital sites passing visitors' health data to commercial data firms without explicit notice is unacceptable, and whether such practices should be banned and investigated. The Minister said enforcement rests with the Data Protection Authority, found misuse of health data undesirable, and will discuss additional safeguards with the Informatieberaad without committing to a ban or a full investigation.
It is up to the Data Protection Authority, formerly the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, to judge to what extent practices like these comply with laws and regulations.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, voorheen College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, om te oordelen in hoeverre praktijksituaties als deze aan wet- en regelgeving voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de veel te hoge prijs die Nederland betaalt voor kankergeneesmiddelen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands overpays for cancer drugs, noting it ranks in the top three payers for seven of nine costly drugs, and why Spanish hospitals obtain larger discounts. The minister acknowledged the study, said price transparency and purchasing power need strengthening, and promised a broader medicines policy vision and package of measures in Q1 2016.
That is why I am in favour of more transparency about prices.
Ik ben mede daarom voorstander van meer transparantie over de prijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over indicatieproblemen bij terminale thuiszorg

MPs Wolbert and Bouwmeester asked why terminally ill patients in care institutions sometimes cannot die at home because of indication problems with the Wlz and ZZP profiles, and who is responsible for timely solutions. The State Secretary called this undesirable, said the CIZ can now issue palliative terminal care indications for home deaths, and clarified that care offices and providers share responsibility for timely follow-up care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht “Nederlanders hebben weinig kennis van zorg”

MP Bouwmeester asked the minister about a poll showing low public knowledge of health insurance and whether the system is too complex, and what could be done to simplify it. Minister Schippers disputed that the poll proves insufficient knowledge, pointed to information campaigns, clearer policy terms and monitoring, and stressed that insurers and the NZa share responsibility.
I do however consider it desirable to increase the level of knowledge in the field of the Health Insurance Act where possible.
Ik vind het overigens wel wenselijk om het kennisniveau op het terrein van de Zorgverzekeringswet waar mogelijk te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht 'VGZ constateert grote prijsverschillen ziekenhuizen'

An MP asks the health minister about a report that insurer VGZ finds large price differences between hospitals, whether contracting should weigh quality, how realistic cost pricing can be achieved, the VGZ-Martini dispute, and timing of contracts and patient involvement. The minister answers that quality is central to contracting, that insurers use existing standards, that the NZa is simplifying DBC pricing and supervising transparency, and that contracting timelines and patient roles are being addressed with the sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat vrouwen die zwanger zijn of willen worden, door een zorgverzekeraar worden verwezen naar een andere zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked whether an insurer steering pregnant women toward other insurers, and promoting the supplementary policy as unattractive for them, amounts to indirect risk selection, and asked the minister to refer the case to the NZa. The minister said supplementary insurance is a free-market product, insurers may refuse applicants there, and European rules prevent intervention, but NZa research on risk selection, including supplementary policies, is underway with results expected in early 2016.
The NZa will take this case into account in its analysis.
De NZa zal deze casus in haar analyse meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Controle op medicijngebruik schiet tekort”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the health minister about a report that medication checks for elderly patients fall short, including whether outcome-based payment, higher tariffs, and more information would help. Minister Schippers said responsibility for tariffs lies with providers and insurers, that the IGZ is inspecting medication reviews from July 2015 under a growth model, and that she will consult KBO and the sector on the bottlenecks.
I take this signal seriously and will therefore shortly consult with Unie KBO and healthcare providers and insurers about the report and the bottlenecks described in it.
Dit signaal neem ik serieus zal daarom op korte termijn samen met Unie KBO in overleg treden met zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars over het rapport en de knelpunten die daarin beschreven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Inspectie verzwijgt misstanden. Rapport over grove fouten Helders verzorgingshuis geheimgehouden’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the health inspectorate IGZ concealed serious failures at care home De Golfstroom, why its calamity report was not published, and whether it would send the report to parliament. The State Secretary denied concealment, pointed to published inspection reports, said the calamity report is withheld to protect individual privacy under the open government act, and gave no commitment to send it.
On 17 February 2015 and 7 November 2015 the inspectorate actively published the reports it drew up following its inspection of the quality of care.

De inspectie heeft op 17 februari 2015 en op 7 november 2015 de door haar opgestelde rapporten naar aanleiding van het inspectieonderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de chaos voor consumenten die zorgpolis zoeken

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers disagree on the savings from restricting free choice of doctors, how selective contracting on 'top care' quality labels affects consumers, and whether budget policies are cross-subsidised. The Minister replied that the measure was one part of the framework agreements, replaced by the 'Kwaliteit loont' package, and that selective contracting can lower premiums without endangering the duty of care.
With the lapse of this measure the framework agreements came under pressure, and with them the €1 billion in returns.
Met het vervallen van deze maatregel stonden de hoofdlijnenakkoorden onder druk en daarmee de opbrengsten van € 1 mld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT) via Prenacheck

An MP asked the minister whether the Prenacheck website, which offered NIPT tests ordered from Germany outside the TRIDENT study, gave incomplete counselling and information, and what oversight applied under the Population Screening Act. The minister said the site was offline, that limited website information does not meet quality standards for counselling, and that the IGZ is investigating the linked laboratory and monitoring the site.
The IGZ is currently conducting further investigation at this organisation in connection with the report about the website bloedwaardentest.nl (possible violation of the WBO).
De IGZ verricht momenteel nader onderzoek bij deze organisatie in het kader van de melding over de website bloedwaardentest.nl (mogelijke overtreding van de WBO).
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Voortman over het overtreden van regels van de farmaceutische industrie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about record fines imposed on pharmaceutical firms for prohibited advertising, why the figures only became public through a FOIA request, and whether the inspectorate has enough capacity and whether companies should be forced to disclose more. The minister confirmed the fines, explained the timing and capacity of the inspectorate, pointed to a pending amendment to the Health Act on publishing enforcement data, and saw no need for further measures.
Measures of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) are not actively made public because there is no legal basis for doing so.
Maatregelen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt omdat daar geen wettelijke basis voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over budgetplafonds die de vrije artsenkeuze inperken

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether budget caps in health insurer contracts with providers undermine free choice of doctor, whether these caps are secret and whether insurers should disclose them, and whether restitution policies should be exempt from the caps. The minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about contracting, that the NZa supervises this, that insurers' duty of care remains, and that she will not intervene in private negotiations on caps, so no concrete new obligation is promised.
The NZa supervises health insurers' compliance with these transparency requirements.
De NZa houdt toezicht op de zorgverzekeraars op het naleven van deze transparantievereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgadviseur” strijkt 68.000 euro op’

MPs Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk and Tanamal asked whether a former board chair of care institution Reinier van Arkel received about 368,000 euro as an adviser after leaving in 2013, whether this complied with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT), and whether the arrangement amounted to a disguised continuation of the top role. The minister confirmed the pay figures in the annual accounts, said the WNT does not cap pay of former top officials, referred the case to the regulator CIBG for routine supervision, and stated no sham arrangement had been established.
The WNT regulator for the care sector, the CIBG, will examine this case within the regular supervision of the WNT.
De toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorgsector, het CIBG, zal deze casus in het kader van het reguliere toezicht op de WNT onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to distinguish 'smart' declaring from upcoding in mental health care, and about the role of consultants such as P5COM, including whether the NZa checks their role. Minister Schippers answered that correct declaring is required, that she does not comment on consultants or ongoing NZa investigations, and that she sees no direct link between consultants and upcoding oversight.
The NZa does not make announcements about ongoing investigations.
De NZa doet geen mededelingen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over voorzorgsmaatregelen tegen een chemische en/of biologische terreuraanval

MPs asked whether the Netherlands is prepared for a chemical or biological terrorist attack, including specific civilian protocols, public information, cross-border planning and a Frenchstyle antidote stockpile. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the Netherlands has multidisciplinary CBRN protocols, specialist units, citizen information via Crisis.nl and NL-Alert, existing atropine stocks and EU and BTWC cooperation.
The Netherlands has in recent years taken a package of measures to prepare for incidents involving chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear (CBRN) material.
Nederland heeft de afgelopen jaren een pakket maatregelen genomen ter voorbereiding op incidenten met chemisch, biologisch, radiologisch of nucleair (CBRN) materiaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Gerven over het onderschatte gevaar van koolmonoxide

MPs Bashir and Van Gerven asked the ministers about the underestimated carbon monoxide danger identified by the Safety Board, including modern boilers being involved, mandatory inspections, detector testing, and public information. The minister replied that a cabinet position would be sent in spring 2016, acknowledged that modern appliances are involved in many incidents, rejected mandatory inspections for now, and defended existing rules while deferring most concrete measures to the forthcoming cabinet position.
The minister of VWS and I are currently working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over het bericht ‘NZa bemiddelt bij ruzies inkoop wijkverpleging’

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked whether the NZa was asked to mediate in disputes over home-care contracting and whether patients should be involved in the process. The State Secretary answered that he did not request mediation, that the NZa described the meeting as general rather than mediation with no patients present, and that he is preparing two bills to strengthen patient and client influence.
Although the involvement of insured persons and patients takes various forms in different places, we are still far from there.
Hoewel het betrekken van verzekerden en patiënten op verschillende plekken op diverse wijzen vorm krijgt, zijn we er nog lang niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ' Nog geen deal tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen'

Mr Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister why major insurers and hospitals had not concluded 2016 contracts by the 19 November deadline, what this means for insured patients and whether the NZa will enforce transparency rules. Minister Schippers answers that patients must be informed of contracted care, that the NZa supervises this, that contracting is disappointingly slow, and that she will ask the parties to take measures and discuss it at the December Bestuurlijk Overleg.
I find the pace of contracting disappointing and will ask the parties to take measures on this.
Ik vind het tempo van contracteren teleurstellend en zal partijen vragen om hierop maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

SP MPs asked the health minister about consultancy firm P5COM advising mental health providers, whether this involves upcoding, and whether advice spending and NZa oversight of advisory firms are appropriate. The minister answered that upcoding is illegal and that there is no indication of it in the press report, that engaging advisers is a matter for providers themselves, and that the NZa has not investigated advisory firms since its remit covers insurers and providers only.
When asked, the NZa states it has not conducted any investigation into this.
Desgevraagd geeft de NZa aan hier geen onderzoek naar te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Maasstad pluist oud pand na op pillen en dossiers’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the discovery of patient-related forms and medication left in the former Clara hospital building, and whether the hospital handled records and privacy responsibly. The minister answered that the forms were older and had been scanned, that patient files are complete, that the hospital's own SIRE analysis found the situation was preventable, and that the privacy regulator closed its inquiry after the hospital said no medical data remained.
In hindsight, the situation at issue could have been prevented, as the hospital's own investigation also states.
Achteraf bezien was de situatie waar het hier om gaat te voorkomen geweest, zo stelt ook het eigen onderzoek van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over een ziekenhuisbestuurder die vindt dat ziekenhuisbestuurders meer moeten verdienen dan een minister

Two MPs asked the health minister whether the WNT pay cap should still apply to hospital directors after a hospital chair argued directors should earn more than a minister. The minister answered that the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is maintained, with lower pay maxima for healthcare from 2016, and that institutions and directors make their own choices within the law.
The cabinet considers capping the income of healthcare executives desirable. That is why it has been laid down in law.
Het kabinet vindt normering van het inkomen van zorgbestuurders wenselijk. Daarom is dat wettelijk vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de financiering van het kwaliteitsregister in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about uncertain 2016 funding for quality registries in healthcare and how patient quality information could be made more comparable. The Minister said partners should settle funding within existing DBC/DOT payment, that the Kwaliteitsinstituut could be asked to intervene, and that a transparency programme and a toetsingskader are underway.
I see a role here for the Kwaliteitsinstituut and will, if necessary, ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to enter into discussions with the parties.
Ik zie hier een rol weggelegd voor het Kwaliteitsinstituut en zal het Kwaliteitsinstituut zo nodig verzoeken met partijen in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat één op de drie patiënten vorig jaar het voorgeschreven geneesmiddel niet heeft opgehaald

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether one in three patients not collecting prescribed medicine is a problem, how much money is wasted by uncollected medicines and missed specialist appointments, and whether pharmacists should charge a symbolic fee for uncollected prescriptions. The Minister referred to earlier letters on care avoidance, said waste cannot be precisely quantified, and rejected the fee idea as adding administrative burden without being an effective tool.
It is not possible to state how much money is wasted because patients do not show up for appointments with a medical specialist.
Daarom is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel geld verspild wordt doordat patiënten niet komen opdagen bij een afspraak met een medisch specialist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat het WADA en het IOC voor de Winterspelen in Sotsji hadden moeten ingrijpen in Rusland

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether WADA and the IOC should have intervened over suspected Russian doping before the Sochi 2014 Winter Games, including the reinstatement of a suspended lab, and what the Netherlands would do during its EU presidency. The minister answered that sports bodies bear primary responsibility, that the lab had improved in time, that independent observers found no major irregularities, and that the Netherlands will put sports integrity and an anti-doping conference on the EU presidency agenda.
It is up to WADA and the IOC themselves to take their responsibility if they have concrete indications of systematic doping by athletes in a country.
Het is aan WADA en aan het IOC zelf om hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen indien zij concrete aanwijzingen hebben over systematisch dopinggebruik van atleten in een land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het advies om een grensverleggend medicijn in de strijd tegen longkanker niet te vergoeden

MPs Klever and Wilders asked why the Zorginstituut advised against reimbursing nivolumab for lung cancer, questioned the €80,000 cost-effectiveness benchmark, savings on medicines, and budget priorities compared with asylum spending. Minister Schippers said negotiations with the manufacturer are ongoing and she will inform parliament of the outcome, that the €80,000 figure is a reference value rather than a fixed ceiling, and that the savings were redirected elsewhere in healthcare.
Once this negotiation is concluded, I will inform your House of the outcome and of my decision whether or not to admit Nivolumab to the insured package.
Na afronding van deze onderhandeling zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst hiervan en mijn besluit of ik Nivolumab wel of niet toelaat tot het verzekerde pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Agema over de geheugenpoli voor immigranten

MPs Klever and Agema (PVV) asked the health minister whether a memory clinic for immigrants is undesirable, whether autochthonous patients can attend, who pays for interpreters and social work, and why it should not be ended. The minister saw it as strengthening regional dementia care, said such targeted services can be acceptable if financially viable, and stated that access is guaranteed for all and that she has no intention of changing the Health Insurance Act.
I do not intend to amend the Health Insurance Act on these points.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Zorgverzekeringwet op deze punten te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het boek De Kraak van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the book on the Slotervaart hospital, covering the consultant's role, the heroin production contract with Di-AcetylM BV, dividends, board members' side activities, and oversight by regulators. The minister answered most questions, denying conflicts of interest and mostly deferring on the involvement of other bodies, while declining to give details of some hospital decisions for reasons of possible criminal risk and a confidentiality clause.
It is not for me to give an explanation of their functioning in the history of the Slotervaart hospital.
Het is niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op hun functioneren in de geschiedenis van het Slotervaartziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht “Nog geen deal tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the lack of contracting agreements between health insurers and hospitals for 2016 and the consequences for policyholders choosing a policy before contracts are finalised. The minister acknowledged the importance of transparency, said insurers must disclose contracted providers by 19 November under NZa rules, rejected extending the choice period or mandating prior-year coverage, and said the NZa would enforce the rules if needed.
I do not rule out that the 19 November deadline also works as a pressure tool towards insurers in the negotiations.
Ik sluit niet uit dat de deadline van 19 november ook werkt als een drukmiddel richting verzekeraars in de onderhandelingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat visverwerkers oude vis oplappen met verboden middelen met waterstofperoxide (ingezonden 20 november 2015).

MP Van Gerven asks whether the fish-processing aid Mucusol (hydrogen peroxide) is lawful, whether its approval was consulted with EU authorities, and whether industry lobbying influenced NVWA; the minister replies that Mucusol is a permitted technical processing aid under national competence, that no EU consultation was needed, that the NVWA keeps no usage records, and that she sees no reason for a ban or a lobbying rule. Answers are largely evasive on lobbying transparency and records, and the minister rejects a ban and a lobbying regulation.
It can no longer be traced whether consultation with fish producers also took place.
Het is niet meer te achterhalen of ook overleg met visproducenten heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending “Hogere eigen bijdragen ziekenhuis”

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about a Radar broadcast on higher hospital co-payments, focusing on the hardship (hinderpaal) criterion for non-contracted care, budget insurance policies, insurers' duty to inform, and whether fixed reimbursement percentages should be set. The minister answers that insurers must disclose contracting information, that the hardship criterion cannot be captured in a calculation model, that the NZa will scrutinise reimbursement below 75 percent for 2016 policies, and that the overstapseizoen will be evaluated.
Insurers will evaluate the functioning of the information leaflet after the switching season, also examining whether additional measures are necessary.
Zorgverzekeraars gaan de werking van de bijsluiter na het overstapseizoen evalueren, waarbij ook zal worden nagegaan of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat verzekeraars nog niet alle contracten met ziekenhuizen hebben gesloten, maar dat patiënten nu wel hun zorgverzekering moeten kiezen

An MP asked the Health Minister about insurers not yet having contracted all hospitals while patients must choose their health insurance for 2016, and asked about enforcement by the NZa and the agreement deadline. The Minister said insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care under NZa rules, that the 19 November deadline is not fully met but contracts are being added daily, and that she will discuss contracting deadlines with providers and insurers.
The NZa supervises this transparency by the health insurer.
De NZa houdt toezicht op deze transparantie door de zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht dat visverwerkers oude vis oplappen met verboden middelen met waterstofperoxide

MP Koşer Kaya asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers whether fish processors use banned hydrogen peroxide agents to disguise old fish, and why the NVWA did not detect it. Minister Schippers replied that the NVWA cannot confirm the practice but will pay more attention to it, that hydrogen peroxide is lawful as a processing aid, and that she cannot rule out unsafe fish reaching consumers pending NVWA investigation.
The NVWA cannot confirm this suspicion, but takes the signal seriously and will pay attention to it during inspections.
De NVWA kan dit vermoeden niet bevestigen, maar neemt het signaal wel serieus en besteedt hier bij de controles aandacht aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ de bonuscultuur introduceert in de operatiekamer

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer CZ's plan to reward Catharina Hospital cardiology quality (a bonus culture) is a stunt, whether the contract can be shared, and whether such pay-for-quality contracts should be banned. The minister answered that the bonus goes to hospital budget tied to measured outcomes, declined to share the private contract citing commercial confidentiality, and rejected a ban while supporting quality-based contracting.
These are agreements between private parties and they contain commercially sensitive information.
Dit zijn afspraken tussen private partijen en deze bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat omzetplafonds de keuzevrijheid van de patiënt bedreigen

An MP asked the health minister whether hospital revenue caps (omzetplafonds) threaten patients' freedom of choice and create waiting lists, and whether patients with restitution policies are protected. The minister replied that insurers' duty of care and the legal right to continue started treatment apply regardless of caps, that the NZa monitors transparency, and that she rejects a general ban on revenue caps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het gebruik van het middel Mucusol door visverwerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether the NVWA had knowingly allowed Mucusol, a disinfectant, to be used as a fish de-slimming agent in 2008-2009 and why enforcement only started in 2016. The Minister answered that the NVWA has no inspection data showing improper use, that use as a de-slimming agent is permitted, and that the NVWA will check for misuse in regular inspections, without giving a full account of past decisions.
I have no reason to assume that the NVWA did not act correctly in this case.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat de NVWA in deze casus niet juist zou hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen zich voorbereiden op het uitkeren van winst

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about hospitals converting to BVs ahead of allowing profit distribution, and about risks to premium money, public bailout funds, and investor returns. The minister replied that hospitals may choose their legal form, profit distribution stays banned until the bill passes, and the bill contains safeguards such as Inspectorate and NZa pre-checks.
I have now received the advice of the Council of State. I am currently examining what consequences this advice has for the bill and will then inform your House and the Senate.

Ik heb het advies van de Raad van State inmiddels ontvangen. Momenteel ben ik aan het bekijken welke gevolgen dit advies heeft voor het wetsvoorstel en zal vervolgens uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat ziekenhuisrekeningen vaak te hoog uitvallen en niet begrijpelijk voor patiënten zijn

An MP from the PvdA asked the health minister about reports that hospital bills are often too high and hard for patients to understand, including a CZ insurer case of erroneous charges and surprise bills after emergency visits. The minister answered that bills have become more transparent since June 2014, that an evaluation with stakeholders will follow in early 2016, that errors are administrative rather than fraud, and that patients can contest bills via insurer, NZa and SKGZ.
On the basis of this evaluation I will consider whether, and if so which, additional measures are needed.
Op basis van deze evaluatie zal ik bezien of en zo ja welke extra maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de reactie op de verzwegen misstanden bij Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht (UMCU) en de handelswijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether an ENT surgeon remains active during the Inspectorate's investigation, whether the department should be closed, and whether the Inspectorate can independently investigate its own conduct and the review period from 2009. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ investigates without closing the department, the hospital has relieved the doctors of patient care, the hospital will review deaths from 2011, and the IGZ will set the terms of an external commission.
The broader investigation is carried out by the IGZ, which is assisted by a commission.
Het bredere onderzoek wordt door de IGZ uitgevoerd, daarbij laat de IGZ zich bijstaan door een commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht Renteswap kost Zwols Isala-ziekenhuis minstens 25 miljoen euro

MP Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that an interest rate swap cost Isala hospital at least 25 million euros, and about supervision by the hospital's board and supervisory board. The minister said the hospital took an open position, that she will legally anchor a ban on risky derivatives in the WTZi, that she cannot judge the earlier decisions with today's knowledge, and that financial oversight of hospitals lies primarily with their boards and supervisory boards.
For the healthcare sector I want to legally anchor the principles of the derivatives policy framework through a provision in the WTZi 2.
Voor de zorgsector wil ik de uitgangspunten van het beleidskader derivaten wettelijk verankeren door middel van een voorziening in de WTZi 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het verlieslijdend Zorgsaam haar oud-bestuurders tonnen betaalt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that loss-making Zorgsaam paid severance of several tonnes to ousted board members, questioning its morality, supervision of the supervisory board, and the reasoning behind amounts exceeding the Scheidsgerecht ruling. The minister said the WNT caps severance at 75,000 euro and institutions decide within legal bounds, a CIBG investigation into possible violations is ongoing, and she will address internal supervision professionalisation in a governance progress report.
The CIBG already has an investigation underway into a possible violation regarding severance payments at this healthcare institution.
Het CIBG heeft al een onderzoek lopen naar een mogelijke overtreding met betrekking tot ontslagvergoedingen bij deze zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het terugeisen van belastinggeld dat besteed is voor het WK bid 2018

The MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the Netherlands should reclaim money spent on the 2018 World Cup bid from FIFA, given alleged corruption in the vote. The Minister declined to take a position, awaiting outcomes of US and Swiss investigations, and said the Dutch state contributed 3 million euros, with the KNVB and KBVB exploring reclaiming funds.
I make no statement on that. As I have already said above, I will first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik doe daar geen uitspraak over. Zoals ik hierboven al heb gesteld wacht ik eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat homo mannen één jaar geen seks mogen hebben voordat ze bloed doneren

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about reports that gay men must abstain from sex for a year before donating blood, questioning the rationale, the lack of attention to sexual risk behaviour and HIV testing windows, and the scientific basis for the 12-month deferral. Minister Schippers answered that the policy is based on epidemiological risk, that 12 months is a common deferral in Western countries, that sexual risk behaviour is already asked about, and that she will monitor international developments and talk again with Sanquin and COC next year.
Should data become available in the near future that allow further adjustment of the MSM donor selection policy without compromising the safety of the blood supply, I will of course consider this.

Mochten in de nabije toekomst gegevens beschikbaar komen die een verdere aanpassing van het donorselectiebeleid rond MSM mogelijk maken zónder dat dit ten koste gaat van de veiligheid van de bloedvoorziening, dan zal ik dit uiteraard in overweging nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Vermue over de toegankelijkheid van acute psychische zorg in Zeeland

MPs Tanamal and Vermue asked the Minister of Health about closing the psychiatric wards in Vlissingen and Terneuzen and converting them to intensive home treatment, and about timely access to acute mental health care in Zeeland. The minister answered that Terneuzen reduces inpatient capacity with about 40% moved to Kloetinge, that Vlissingen phases out mid-2016, that the NZa monitors the statutory care duty without signalling concern, and that residents were involved via the Zeeland care commission.
The NZa states in this report that the survey outcomes on waiting times in acute mental health care do not show a worrying picture.
In dit rapport geeft de NZa aan dat de uitkomsten van de enquête naar de wachttijden in de acute GGZ geen verontrustend beeld opleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een onnatuurlijke dood in zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the minister why the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ) does not investigate unnatural deaths in care institutions, and whether external chairs and external expertise are appointed for calamity investigations, including why only elderly and disability care sectors got stricter rules and whether the Bartiméus family was pressured into signing a communication line. The state secretary answered that stricter rules apply to those two sectors from 1 October 2015, that IGZ reviews all calamity investigations and does not count follow-up investigations, and that pressure on the Bartiméus family would be regrettable though the family did not sign.
However, the IGZ currently does not register how often, within its calamity investigations, it does or does not instruct institutions to conduct their own follow-up investigations.
De IGZ registreert op dit moment echter niet hoe vaak zij binnen haar onderzoek naar calamiteiten, instellingen (g)een opdracht geeft om eigen (vervolg)onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de handreiking ‘Zorg voor mensen die bewust afzien van eten en drinken om het levenseinde te bespoedigen’

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Health whether the KNMG/V&VN guidance on care for people who stop eating and drinking to hasten death wrongly treats this as a natural death rather than suicide, and whether it protects vulnerable patients, lacks legal or ethical review, and should be monitored. The Minister replies that the legal terms are undefined, that the guidance is a professional-body document not subject to government review, that current certification practice suffices, and that the 2010 mortality study estimated about 600 deaths, with a new study due in 2017.
I see no role for the government in having a guidance document drawn up by the professional group reviewed on legal or ethical grounds.
Ik zie geen taak voor de overheid om een handreiking opgesteld door de beroepsgroep te toetsen op juridische of ethische gronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over winstuitkeringen aan bestuurder/eigenaar van een thuiszorginstelling

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether dividend payouts to the owner of a home-care provider (Breederzorg) comply with the WNT pay-cap and other rules, and whether tighter rules are needed on owner-managers and profit distributions in publicly funded care. The state secretary replied that dividends are not governed by the WNT, that CIBG will examine the case under routine supervision, and that existing law and the governance code provide sufficient safeguards.
CIBG will, as the responsible supervisor, examine this further within regular WNT supervision of the institution.
