Het CIBG zal dit als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder nader onderzoeken in het kader van het reguliere WNT-toezicht op de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers about the tendering of forensic medical care and forensic investigation by the National Police, including whether the process was stalled, who provides the care, and whether tendering should be avoided until legal safeguards are in place. The minister answered that the tender was halted in July because no bidder met the requirements, existing contracts are being extended, and the police are deciding on next steps while maintaining that current arrangements sufficiently safeguard forensic medicine.
The police are currently deliberating on the follow-up to the halted tender procedure.
De politie beraadt zich op dit moment over het vervolg op de gestaakte aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Bouwmeester over het bericht “Kinderarts Radboudumc opgepakt voor kinderporno”

MPs Volp and Bouwmeester asked about the arrest of a Radboudumc paediatric intensive care doctor on suspicion of possessing child pornography, including whether patients were harmed, how parents were informed, screening (VOG) at hiring, and information sharing between prosecutors, the IGZ and employers. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the notification of parents and the revised IGZ-OM protocol, and said no further extension of the Wjsg was needed.
I will not comment on the accuracy of media reports concerning individual ongoing (criminal) cases.
Ik ga niet in op de (on)juistheid van berichten in de media met betrekking tot individuele lopende (straf) zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het effectiever vormgeven van geneesmiddelenonderzoek

An MP asked the health minister whether pharmaceutical firms' focus on single cancer drugs wastes potentially useful combination-therapy research, and what role government could play in encouraging more efficient R&D. The minister answered that combination research is possible but depends on competing firms, that firms are responsible for their own efficiency, that the CBG offers scientific advice, and that ZonMw translational research funding is available, without committing to a new government role.
Pharmaceutical companies are free to collaborate in the development stage to investigate combination therapies and to organise an efficient R&D approach.
Het staat farmaceutische bedrijven vrij om samen te werken in het ontwikkelstadium om combinatietherapieën te onderzoeken en een efficiënte R&D-werkwijze in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over Ajax-fans die gedupeerd worden door antisemitische uitlatingen van anderen

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about antisemitic chants at a football match and whether an KNVB sanction that let FC Utrecht fans sit elsewhere in the stadium undermined the fight against antisemitism. The minister replied that the sanction was legally applied, that no perpetrators could be identified for criminal prosecution, and that a zero-tolerance policy already exists.
I understand that FC Utrecht has decided to allow the supporters of the Bunnikside to take seats elsewhere.
Ik heb begrepen dat FC Utrecht besloten heeft de supporters van de Bunnikside in de gelegenheid te stellen elders plaats te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de mogelijke aanwezigheid van schadelijke stoffen in gerecyclede verpakkingen

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about mineral oil hydrocarbons found in recycled food packaging after a Foodwatch study, including health risks, regulation, NVWA oversight and industry engagement. The minister confirmed the findings are not surprising, said risk assessment and a possible norm are under study, noted no legal limits exist yet, and committed to talks with industry and RIVM and to raising the issue at EU level.
I will engage in discussion with industry to talk about which initiatives have been taken and which additional actions are possible.
Ik ga het gesprek met de industrie aan om te bespreken welke initiatieven er genomen zijn en welke aanvullende acties mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over geweigerde terminale thuiszorg aan mensen die thuis wilden sterven

An MP asked the state secretary whether insurer CZ's refusal to timely buy terminal home care, forcing over 20 patients into hospital, is acceptable and what will be done to guarantee home care. The government says insurers have a duty of care, only one case is known to it, the hospital does not recognise the 23 figure, and it will emphasise regional agreements and a proactive attitude.
Health insurers have a duty of care and must ensure sufficient and timely available terminal home care.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en moeten voor voldoende en tijdig beschikbare terminale thuiszorg zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het gebruik van ADHD-middelen voor recreatieve doeleinden

An MP asked the health minister about the Utrecht study estimating that about one in five Dutch secondary pupils on ADHD medication takes methylphenidate for non-medical reasons, illegal resale, data on use, and whether guidelines for prescribing should be tightened. The minister called the signals worrying, stated that illegal resale is prohibited and penalised, cited prescription data and ongoing studies, and pointed to existing professional guidelines without committing to new rules.
Indications of the scale and extent of trade in, or improper use of, ADHD medication are lacking.
Indicaties voor schaal en omvang van de handel in dan wel het oneigenlijk gebruik van ADHD-medicatie ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de opkomst van lachgas als partydrug bij minderjarigen

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the rise of nitrous oxide (lachgas) as a party drug among minors, its health risks, nuisance to residents, and why enforcement under the Medicines Act is not applied. The government acknowledges rising use, points to existing Trimbos information channels, says local authorities decide on nuisance enforcement, and explains that police and inspectorate enforcement is limited by priorities and that use itself is not criminal.
Enforcement action by the police against nitrous oxide under the Economic Offences Act has no priority in maintaining public order and enforcing criminal offences.
Handhavend optreden door de politie ten aanzien van lachgas op grond van de WED heeft bij de handhaving van de openbare orde en strafbare feiten geen prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over een nieuwe Europese richtlijn over antibioticagebruik

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether the new EU antibiotic guidelines for animal husbandry fall short of Dutch rules and how the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action during its presidency. The State Secretary replied that the guidelines are non-binding, draw on Dutch experience, and that the Netherlands will advocate stricter EU rules and raise the issue at a February ministerial conference.
I agree with you that the approach to antibiotic resistance must be addressed at European level.
Ik deel met u dat de aanpak van antibioticaresistentie op Europees niveau moet worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

The MPs asked whether psycho-oncology centres such as the Helen Dowling Institute, as specialist mental health providers, should be funded as part of the somatic DBC/DOT system, what happens to psychological care after a somatic treatment ends, whether partners and children are covered, and whether the centres' continued existence falls under insurers' duty of care. The minister answered that a national working group report sets out actions for psychosocial care, that care stays within medical specialist care while the somatic trajectory continues and the GP is responsible afterwards, that family support falls under the insured entitlement, and that insurers must buy sufficient care but choose providers themselves.
Soon I will consult with the parties involved about who will take which action and when it should be completed.
Binnenkort overleg ik met betrokken partijen wie welke actie gaat oppakken en wanneer dat gereed moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over medische claims over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the NVWA's January 2015 finding that Souvenaid is not medical dietary food, the warning to Nutricia, and enforcement after the deadline expired. The minister confirmed the finding and warning, said a September 2015 re-inspection found the product still sold as medical dietary food, and said the NVWA's standard intervention policy is being applied, with Nutricia able to respond.
The NVWA then started its intervention policy and is following it consistently and carefully.
De NVWA is vervolgens gestart met haar interventiebeleid en doorloopt deze consequent en zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de gezondheidsscreening van asielzoekers

Christian Union MP Voordewind asked whether the April 2015 tuberculosis screening protocol for asylum seekers is being followed, given signals that screening is far from optimal, and how coverage and responsibility are monitored. The state secretary answered that screening of Syrians was temporarily suspended due to low TB prevalence, that over 900 people had not yet been screened in mid-October but the backlog is being cleared, and that GGD and COA share coordination, with COA records used for monitoring and changes to crisis emergency shelter procedures announced.
Following the high influx, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport decided to (temporarily) suspend the screening of asylum seekers from Syria.
Naar aanleiding van de hoge instroom heeft het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) besloten de screening van asielzoekers uit Syrië (tijdelijk) op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘GGZ-instelling weigert VGZ-klanten nog te behandelen’

Rep. Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that GGZ patients insured with VGZ may be refused treatment late in the year because of volume caps, whether insurers must disclose such caps in advance, whether providers may refuse patients under a must-deliver obligation, and what alternatives to caps exist. The Minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted providers and caps, that the insurer lifted the must-deliver obligation for the specific institution and arranges referrals, and that insurers are free to use alternative contracting forms.
Insured persons have a right to care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het intrekken van bestaande vergunningen voor apotheekhoudende huisartsen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether pharmacy-dispensing GPs should keep their licences in ageing shrinking regions and why CIBG refused renewal for the Annen practice. The minister defended the distance-based licensing rules, said CIBG does not periodically revisit licences, and refused to scrap the main/associate licence distinction or to override the distance test for Annen.
At a distance between 3.5 and 4.5 kilometres I do not have full legal discretion.
Bij een afstand tussen de 3,5 en 4,5 kilometer beschik ik niet over alle wettelijke vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over selectieve zorginkoop en de gevolgen daarvan voor zorgaanbieders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about selective health-care procurement by Zilveren Kruis Achmea, including its termination of a shoemaker's contract and the fairness of the power balance with providers. The minister defended selective procurement as an important instrument, referred the contested contract dispute to the courts and to a planned complaints committee, and said the NZa and ACM oversee market power.
For the next contracting period a complaints committee will be established where care providers can go with complaints about the procurement procedure.
Voor de volgende contracteerperiode wordt een geschillencommissie in het leven geroepen waar zorgaanbieders met klachten over de inkoopprocedure terecht kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over de voorgenomen sluiting van de kraamafdeling van het Vlietland Ziekenhuis in Schiedam

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister about concerns over the proposed closure of the Vlietland hospital maternity ward in Schiedam, including travel times, staffing, and whether local stakeholders were consulted. The minister answered that ambulance-model travel times remain within the norm, that a stakeholder steering group is in place, and that the decision lies with hospital and insurer rather than the ministry.
The process is still ongoing and no decision has yet been taken.
Het proces is nog gaande en er is nog geen besluit genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de berichtgeving van het Vlietland Ziekenhuis om de kraamafdeling op te heffen en te verhuizen naar het Sint Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asks the minister about Vlietland Hospital's plan to close its maternity ward and move it to Franciscus Gasthuis Rotterdam, including the 45-minute accessibility norm, traffic congestion and regional maternity care planning. The minister answers that hospital boards and insurers are responsible for accessible care, that the accessibility model does not account for refusals or financial barriers, and that the RIVM analysis shows neither hospital is sensitive to closure, but offers no concrete government action.

It is the responsibility of the Boards of Directors of Franciscus Gasthuis and Vlietland hospital to ensure, mindful of the steering group's advice and in consultation with parties in the maternity care chain, adequate infrastructure meeting the relevant guidelines and regulations.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Bestuur van het Franciscus Gasthuis en Vlietland ziekenhuis om, indachtig het advies van de stuurgroep en in overleg met betrokken partijen in de verloskundige keten, te zorgen voor een adequate infrastructuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Achmea premiekorting biedt in ruil voor privédata

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Achmea's offer of premium discounts in exchange for private driving and health-related data is acceptable, and how it complies with privacy law. The minister answered that insurers may use behavioural data within the Wbp framework, that the DPA is responsible for enforcement, that Achmea has not yet submitted the plan to the DPA, and that sharing with third parties is not Achmea's intent, while declining to judge the desirability of such practices.
It is not my place to pass judgment on the way insurers treat their customers.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de manier waarop verzekeraars hun klanten tegemoet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake het bieden van premiekorting in ruil voor privédata door verzekeraar Achmea

MPs Grashoff and Voortman asked ministers whether insurer Achmea may offer premium discounts in exchange for personal behavioural data, and how data use, consent, sanctions and societal effects would be policed. The government answered that such data use is permitted only within the Wbp framework and purpose limitation, that the Cbp supervises compliance, and that insurers must inform customers of privacy risks, while acknowledging possible societal effects.
It is up to the Cbp to assess whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan het Cbp om te beoordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over mogelijk falen van GGZ crisisdienst in Gilze en Rijen

MP De Lange asked the Minister of Health whether the GGZ crisis service in Gilze en Rijen failed during an incident involving an asylum seeker, and whether the findings and measures to prevent recurrence would be shared with parliament. The minister said an internal review by GGZ Breburg identified information-exchange issues with the police, that local parties will agree improvements, and that the national task force on confused persons will only be involved if the problem proves broader.
It is up to local parties themselves to find solutions to the points of attention that have been identified.
Antwoord 3 Het is aan lokale partijen zelf om oplossingen te vinden voor de aandachtspunten die zijn gesignaleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over fatale gevolgen na het missen van diagnoses

An MP asks the Minister of Health about repeated missed diagnoses in IJsselland Hospital's cardiology department that led to young patients dying, and about the hospital's measures, patient information, and referral rules for under-16s. The Minister expresses regret, describes the measures taken and IGZ oversight, and says the cases are situational without signs of structural problems, leaving referral norms to professional societies.
What has happened is situational in nature and therefore tied to the IJsselland hospital.
Wat zich heeft voorgedaan is situationeel van aard en daarmee gebonden aan het IJsselland ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over personen die wedstrijdinformatie doorspelen via de telefoon vanaf voetbaltribunes

MPs asked whether people relaying match statistics by phone from football stands are a growing problem, what powers clubs have to remove them, and whether gambling restrictions are needed. The minister answered that clubs set house rules and can remove people for misconduct or nuisance, that there is no increase in complaints, and that the gambling questions are addressed in a separate bill answer.
It is up to the clubs themselves to determine the level of nuisance.
Het is aan de clubs zelf om de mate van overlast te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over investeringen in gezondheidsinnovaties

An MP asked the health minister how she stimulates health innovations by start-ups, how the gap between ideas and insurer investment can be bridged, what role insurers should play, and how publicly funded innovations reach the wider public. The minister points to existing policy letters, a start-up network, insurers' freedom to invest premium income, and existing websites for innovators, while acknowledging that innovation spread is limited and procurement is regional.
Health insurers are responsible for efficiently purchasing good-quality care and therefore benefit from start-ups and care innovation.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn verantwoordelijk voor het doelmatig inkopen van kwalitatief goede zorg en hebben derhalve baat bij start-ups en zorgvernieuwing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Euthanasie is geen consumptieartikel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about an article arguing that euthanasia requests often mask fear and loss of control, and that physicians cannot judge whether a life is meaningful, so the 'unbearable and hopeless suffering' criterion should be narrowed. The Minister answered that existential suffering can already qualify, that palliative care awareness is being raised, that physicians assess unbearable suffering from the patient's perspective rather than meaningfulness of life, and that the current definition will be kept.
I therefore see no reason to depart from the current definition.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om af te stappen de huidige definitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de afnemende beschikbaarheid van smalspectrum antibiotica

An MP asked the health minister about the disappearance of narrow-spectrum antibiotics from the Dutch market, linked to antibiotic resistance, and whether rules on importing alternatives and insurer reimbursement should change. The minister denied a rising trend in withdrawals, pointed to existing shortage and emergency import mechanisms, and said insurers should reimburse at maximum tariffs and consider quality of care.

In line with my commitment during the infection prevention committee debate, I will ask the working group on medicine shortages whether it is necessary to speed up the procedures for importing unregistered medicines.

In lijn met mijn toezegging tijdens het AO infectiepreventie zal ik de werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten vragen of het noodzakelijk is om de procedures rond de import van ongeregistreerde geneesmiddelen te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kraamafdeling Vlietland moet open blijven’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister how she views the planned closure of the Vlietland hospital maternity ward after its merger with Sint Franciscus Gasthuis, and whether closure is acceptable given accessibility for Vlaardingen and Schiedam residents. The minister replies that the hospital board is responsible for the arrangements, that accessibility and quality norms are the test, that she sees no scientific proof that scale enlargement improves care, and that she leaves regional planning to the insurers and local parties, without committing to a national plan.
It is not for me to decide whether a department in a hospital must remain open.
Het is niet aan mij om te bepalen of een afdeling in een ziekenhuis open moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de aanrijtijden van ambulances in de gemeente Epe

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health why ambulances missed the 15-minute response norm in 12.8% of cases in Epe, whether the reference framework is reliable, what the government will do about the 93% performance target for Noord- en Oost-Gelderland, and whether an ambulance post in Emst should be opened. The Minister answered that the RAV and insurers are working toward the 93% target, that the framework is not a blueprint, that the NZa is investigating insurers' duty of care, and that she cannot judge the Emst post herself.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) is currently investigating how insurers fulfil their duty of care in relation to response times.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) doet momenteel onderzoek naar de invulling van de zorgplicht door verzekeraars in relatie tot de aanrijdtijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de internetverkoop van de NIPT

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the online sale of the NIPT prenatal test via bloedwaardentest.nl, including counselling quality, possible Wbo violations, links to U-Diagnostics and UMCU, and whether sales should stop. The Minister said the IGZ is examining the reported possible Wbo violation and will await its outcome, while declining to provide sales figures or other data.
The website bloedwaardentest.nl has been reported to the IGZ as a possible violation of the Wbo.
De website bloedwaardentest.nl is bij de IGZ gemeld als mogelijke overtreding van de WBO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en De Lange over transparantie bij zorginstellingen

MPs Bouwmeester and De Lange asked why only 4 of 188 large healthcare institutions disclosed board expenses and declarations, whether the sector coordinated refusals to RTL Nieuws, and what role supervisory boards should play. Minister Schippers regretted the lack of openness, said good governance is the responsibility of private care providers, and pointed to a sector-led governance code revision on 25 November rather than government measures.
I am convinced, as indicated in the good governance agenda, that the necessary cultural change is best achieved through discussion within the sector itself.
Ik ben er van overtuigd, zoals in de agenda goed bestuur is aangegeven, dat de benodigde cultuurverandering het beste tot stand komt door discussie in de sector zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het stilleggen van Nederlands grieponderzoek

MP Ziengs asked the minister whether Dutch avian flu research had stopped because of tighter US funding conditions on gain-of-function work, and what the consequences for publication, biosecurity and vaccine development would be. The minister confirmed that US funders have tightened safety requirements, said the Dutch-funded avian flu research is not being stopped and can continue if those conditions are met, and pointed to existing Dutch biosecurity and export-control rules.
The avian flu research funded by the Netherlands is not being stopped.
Het door Nederland gefinancierde vogelgrieponderzoek wordt niet stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de onduidelijkheid over privacygevoeligheid van zorgdeclaraties

An MP asked the Health Minister about the NZa's refusal to release care declaration data, citing privacy risks, and whether the data can be traced to individuals, contrary to earlier ministerial statements. The minister said two court cases are pending, that the risk of linking data to individuals is managed through technical and organisational measures, and that a legal basis for data sharing is being examined with the NZa.
In the following answer I will not go into the court cases in substance.
In de navolgende beantwoording ga ik inhoudelijk niet nader in op de rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een verboden emulgator in frisdranken AH en Jumbo zit

Two D66 MPs asked how a banned emulsifier could end up in soft drinks sold by AH and Jumbo without enforcement, and how import controls by the NVWA work. The minister answered that businesses are responsible for food safety, the NVWA uses risk-based inspection, the chain acted after a signal, and full certainty cannot be given.
The NVWA enforces compliance with food legislation. It deploys its capacity and resources based on risk assessments.
De NVWA handhaaft de naleving van de levensmiddelenwetgeving. Zij zet haar capaciteit en middelen in op basis van risico-inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het niet meer vergoeden van medicatie

An MP asks the health minister why a patient's medication for neurofibromatosis was reportedly no longer reimbursed, whether stopping treatment without alternative breaches insurers' duty of care, and why medicines are cut while insurers hold large reserves. The minister replies that the drug is in the basic package and still reimbursed, that she does not know the patient's specific reason, that complaints can go to the provider or the national complaints point, and that insurers may not stop basic-package treatment unless the treating doctor advises it.
If the patient disagrees that he no longer receives the drug, he can file a complaint with his care provider.
Mocht de patiënt het niet mee eens zijn dat hij het middel niet meer krijgt, kan hij een klacht indienen bij zijn zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vergoeding in de basisverzekering van rifaximine (Xifaxan) voor de behandeling van chronische hepatische encefalopathie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether rifaximin should be reimbursed under basic insurance for preventing hepatic encephalopathy, and whether the Zorginstituut's negative advice on cost-effectiveness, using a 50,000 euro per QALY threshold, was justified. The Minister answered that the advice rested on an insufficiently documented cost-effectiveness analysis from the manufacturer, that the Zorginstituut could make no reliable assessment, and that she will not reverse the decision unless a new dossier is submitted.
I therefore maintain my decision not to include this medicine.
Ik blijf daarom bij mijn besluit om dit geneesmiddel niet op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over zorginstellingen die weigeren inzage te geven in het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why care institutions refuse to disclose board members' expense claims and whether the minister will oblige them by law to make declarations transparent. The minister regrets the lack of transparency, says governance is the sector's own responsibility, and points to the upcoming revision of the sector-wide governance code and a survey of expense rules at university medical centres.
Good governance and the associated integrity policy are the responsibility of care providers themselves.
Goed bestuur en het daarbij behorende integriteitsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mogelijke gevolgen van het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnerschip (TTIP) voor het beleid rond medicijnen en medische hulpmiddelen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister, in ten questions, how the TTIP trade deal could affect medicine pricing, reimbursement, data exclusivity, patents and generics, and whether the Dutch mixed healthcare system is protected. The minister answers that IP scope is still undecided and Netherlands will push for restraint, that the Commission must stay within its mandate, and that public health services are excluded by a general carve-out, with the Netherlands checking whether its mixed system needs an explicit exemption.
The Netherlands, like other member states, is closely involved in the negotiations conducted by the European Commission.
Nederland is, net als andere lidstaten, nauw betrokken bij de onderhandelingen die de Europese Commissie voert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Levensbeëindiging pasgeborenen niet gemeld”

MP Arib asks the Minister of Health whether non-reporting of late termination and end-of-life decisions for newborns, as reported in the press, stems from doctors' lack of trust in the regulation, and what will be done to ensure proper reporting under the new rules. The Minister acknowledges the evaluation found the regulation unclear and says the amended regulation and a new committee will clarify criteria and roles, while maintaining that societal oversight is important.
Yes, I still believe that societal oversight is of great importance in the context of transparency and ensuring the carefulness of medical practice.
Ja, ik ben nog steeds van mening dat maatschappelijk toezicht van groot belang is in het kader van transparantie en het waarborgen van de zorgvuldigheid in het medisch handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over het opschorten van de screening op TBC bij Syrische asielzoekers

MPs Klever and Fritsma asked why TB screening of Syrian asylum seekers was suspended, whether the minister considered passport fraud, how many unscreened asylum seekers remain, for how long, and whether no asylum seeker should be admitted. The minister answered that screening is risk-based, Syrian TB risk is low, about 3,000 unregistered people were present with roughly 900 non-Syrians unscreened, the backlog should be cleared in about two weeks, and asylum seekers able to find protection in the region should be returned there.
Parties involved in infectious disease control have indicated they will work to clear this backlog as soon as possible.
Partijen betrokken bij de infectieziektebestrijding hebben aangegeven zich in te zullen spannen om deze achterstand zo spoedig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Vaccins ouderen bewust verzwegen”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Health Minister about a newspaper report that effective vaccines for elderly people (shingles, pneumonia) are not offered, including questions on timing of Gezondheidsraad advice, standard offering, and information campaigns. The minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad advice on shingles is pending, that a joint vaccination assessment body is being set up, that RIVM will improve public information, and that she considers prevention for the elderly a priority.
I do not wish to anticipate the Gezondheidsraad advice on shingles and pneumonia.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de adviezen van de Gezondheidsraad over gordelroos en longontsteking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘OM wil van RIVM info hielprik baby container’

MPs Oskam and Bruins Slot asked whether the Public Prosecution Service could compel RIVM to release medical data from a newborn heel-prick test in a baby-in-container case, and how medical confidentiality is protected. The ministers replied that no court action is currently under consideration, that confidentiality can be overridden only in exceptional circumstances as set by the Supreme Court, and that RIVM has rarely received such requests and has not overridden confidentiality since 2012.
Taking legal steps is currently not at all on the agenda.
Het nemen van gerechtelijke stappen is op dit moment in het geheel niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de advertentie van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland: “Je kunt niet iedere Nederlander toegang geven tot de allerbeste zorg zonder af en toe ‘nee’ te verkopen”

An MP asks the Health Minister about a Zorgverzekeraars Nederland advertisement claiming insurers must sometimes say no to grant all citizens access to the best care, and about low public trust in insurers. The minister welcomes the dialogue initiative, says it is up to ZN how to shape it, notes the NZa oversees insurers, and promises a participation bill in spring 2016.
Health insurers must carry out the Health Insurance Act within the existing legal framework. The NZa supervises this and will enforce where necessary.
Zorgverzekeraars dienen binnen het geldende wettelijke kader de Zorgverzekeringswet uit te voeren. De NZa ziet hierop toe en zal zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een nieuw systeem voor een veiliger patiëntendossier

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how she views Amsterdam GPs' alternative to the national LSP patient-data exchange, whether a pilot giving three care institutions LSP access falls within existing patient consent, and whether the privacy regulator was involved. The minister answered that oversight of systems rests with the CBP, that she cannot guarantee GPs' contracting freedom, and that the pilot relies on existing consent and no separate CBP review is required.
It is for the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens to supervise this and take enforcement action.
Het is aan het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens daar toezicht op te houden en handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about marketing of Souvenaid as a medical dietary product for early Alzheimer's, its price, online sales, and NVWA enforcement, including whether labelling has been corrected. The minister answered that NVWA found Souvenaid does not meet the definition of medical dietary food, issued a warning to Nutricia, and that further steps depend on the company's response, while several questions were deferred to the NVWA or left without substantive detail.
The NVWA then established that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of dietary food for medical use.
De NVWA heeft vervolgens vastgesteld dat Souvenaid niet aan de definitie voor dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik voldoet.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Keijzer over zorg na coma

MPs Dik-Faber and Keijzer asked the health minister about care after coma, including the Zorginstituut's review of early intensive neurorehabilitation for adults over 25, misdiagnosis and poor diagnostics in prolonged disorders of consciousness, and a national expertise network. The minister said the Zorginstituut expects to publish its review in spring 2016, and that diagnosis, treatment and knowledge development are the responsibility of professional bodies rather than the government.
It is up to the representative professional groups to interpret the knowledge development on this and, where necessary, incorporate it into the (new) guidelines for responsible care.
Het is aan de representatieve beroepgroepen om de kennisontwikkeling terzake te duiden en zo nodig te verdisconteren in de (nieuwe) richtlijnen voor verantwoorde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over frisdrankautomaten en frituurpannen op middelbare scholen

An MP asked the health minister whether he agrees with a municipal alderman that soft drinks and deep fryers do not belong in secondary schools, and whether the voluntary approach to healthy school canteens is sufficient given only 105 of 2000 targeted canteens qualify. The state secretary agrees the environment matters and that the goal is supported, but defers the detailed answers on timing and steps to a letter sent later than promised.
As stated in my letter responding to the Wolbert motion CZ-141843 dated 7 October 2015, I fully support the goal of making school canteens healthy.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief in reactie op de motie Wolbert CZ-141843 d.d. 7 oktober 2015, ondersteun ik het doel om schoolkantines gezond te krijgen volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over wachtlijsten die door omzetplafonds worden veroorzaakt

An MP asked the health minister about waiting lists caused by insurer revenue caps (omzetplafonds), including whether the Treeknorm waiting-time standard was missed and whether insurers can use waiting lists to steer patient flows. The minister answered that waiting times are broadly stable, that publishing waiting times per insurer or per department is not feasible due to administrative burden, that insurers may refer to the Treeknorm in contracts, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, while declining to commit to new transparency measures.
As I noted in my letter of 15 September following this article, publishing waiting times per health insurer is not feasible, as it would lead to a great deal of administrative burden for providers.

Zoals ik in mijn bief van 15 september naar aanleiding van dit artikel opmerk, is het publiceren van wachttijden per zorgverzekeraar niet uitvoerbaar, aangezien dit leidt tot veel administratieve lasten bij de aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het openen van een Hy-Care stal voor vleesvarkens

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked whether the minister would open a Hy-Care pig housing concept for fattening pigs in Bladel, which critics say confines pigs in stackable plastic crates, and how this fits government opposition to further industrialisation of intensive livestock farming. The minister answered that the farmer was told the minister would not attend the opening, that developing new housing concepts is the sector's responsibility under existing welfare, health, antibiotic and environmental rules, and that the minister never made the commitment to open the stal.
Developing new housing concepts is the responsibility of the sector.
Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe houderijconcepten is de verantwoordelijkheid van de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het plaatsen van particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte

An MP asked the health minister about privately placed play equipment in public space, following reports that Zwolle allows residents to install it despite national safety rules that are stricter for public than private equipment. The minister confirmed safety must be ensured, said she will examine whether municipalities could supervise these rules in certain cases, and agreed to explore giving municipalities room, with a first meeting with Zwolle held.
I want to examine whether supervision by municipalities of the national safety requirements for play equipment is possible in certain cases.
Ik wil onderzoeken of toezicht door gemeenten op de landelijke veiligheidseisen voor speeltoestellen in bepaalde gevallen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de fair play competitie voor jonge voetballertjes

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about the KNVB's fair play youth football competition without referees and with parents kept at a distance, and whether it could be rolled out nationally. The minister replied that she supports the KNVB initiative and the Veiliger Sportklimaat action plan, leaving scaling-up to sport itself while sports clubs are linked to partners in a broader chain approach.
I therefore support the KNVB in continuing this process.
Ik steun de KNVB dan ook in het doorzetten van dit traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de reddingsbrigade schoolzwemmen terug wil om te voorkomen dat er nog meer kinderen verdrinken

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government will respond to the Reddingsbrigade's call to reinstate compulsory school swimming and to take action given rising drowning figures. The minister replied that parents are primarily responsible for children's swimming ability, supported by schools and municipalities, and that the government awaits a sector action plan before deciding on further school swimming initiatives.
Once this plan is in place, your chamber will receive a response, including whether talks with municipalities and schools about more school swimming initiatives are desirable.
Zodra dit plan er ligt, zal uw kamer een reactie ontvangen, inclusief het antwoord of gesprekken met gemeenten en scholen voor meer initiatieven voor schoolzwemmen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het informeren van familie bij erfelijke aanleg voor kanker

An MP asked the Minister of Health about whether relatives at risk from the BRCA1 gene mutation are being informed, and whether active cascade screening should replace the current passive approach that places responsibility on the index patient. The minister said the professional guideline puts primary responsibility on the patient, that the professional body will tighten and monitor compliance, but that there is no general legal duty to inform relatives and no plan for new legal change.
I have no insight into this.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het delen van informatie over erfelijke ziekten

An MP asked the health minister whether law and professional guidelines ensure that information about hereditary cancer, such as breast cancer, reaches relatives, and how clinics handle this. The minister answered that no general duty to inform relatives exists, that the professional guideline of the VKGN governs case-by-case balancing, and that clinics will be asked to consistently follow up with patients.
Under national or international law there is no duty to inform the patient's family members.
Er is naar nationaal of internationaal recht geen plicht tot het informeren van familieleden van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Staking ambulancepersoneel, tientallen boze medewerkers demonstreren op het Spui”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Health about the nationwide ambulance staff work stoppage of 2 September 2015, the expired ambulance collective labour agreement, its differences from hospital staff terms, and special arrangements for older workers. Minister Schippers acknowledged the news and declined to comment on the cao, stating that collective agreements in healthcare are the responsibility of social partners.
I cannot and will not interfere in the responsibility of the social partners.
In die verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners kan en wil ik niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat wachttijden in ziekenhuizen schijn zijn

An MP asked the health minister about a report that hospital waiting times are largely artificial, with capacity available but insurer budgets exhausted, and whether academic hospitals deliberately lengthen waits and whether insurers evade their duty of care. The minister rejected these claims, pointing to existing transparency rules and NZa monitoring, and promised only continued monitoring and an annual market scan without a separate meeting with parties.
The NZa has received no signals that academic hospitals fail to comply with these regulations.
Bij de NZa zijn geen signalen binnengekomen dat de academische ziekenhuizen deze regelingen niet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de lage mate van vertrouwen van Nederlanders in zorgverzekeraars (Herdruk)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about low public trust in health insurers and whether patient organisations should get formal input into insurers' purchasing policy and member participation. The minister acknowledged the survey findings, welcomed the insurers' 'Kern gezond' action plan on transparency and simpler switching, and said a bill on insured persons' influence is in preparation, while opposing formalising patient-organisation involvement.
To give insured persons a say in the purchasing policy and general policy of health insurers, a bill is currently in preparation.
Om verzekerden inspraak te geven op het inkoopbeleid en het algemene beleid van zorgverzekeraars, is op dit moment een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Leijten over bemiddelingsbureaus in de zorg

An SP MP asked the health ministers about intermediary agencies in care that charge high fees to self-employed care workers, including non-compete clauses and fines. The state secretary answered that fees are a matter for agreements between parties, that he will commission research into agency fees and services in care, and that agencies without added value should be reduced.
I therefore intend to have research carried out into the fees that intermediary agencies charge self-employed workers in care and the services the agencies provide.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de fees die bemiddelingsbureaus voor zzp'ers in de zorg hanteren en de diensten die de bemiddelingsbureaus leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Geen tijd meer voor gewone darmpatiënt’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports of longer waiting lists for bowel surgery at academic centres, possibly caused by bowel cancer screening, and a delayed operation for a patient. The minister said the causes are unclear, stressed that providers must refer patients and insurers must meet their care duty, and pointed to new specialist training places and existing waiting-time norms.
It is the duty of the care provider to deliver responsible care.
Het is de plicht van de zorgverlener om verantwoorde zorg te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Gesthuizen over de omgang met sociale media in (geestelijke gezondheids) zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Gesthuizen asked the health minister how mental health institutions handle patients' social media use and whether family can be involved in treatment after a mother complained in Metro. The minister answered that no similar signals are known, that self-determination limits restrictions unless a patient is involuntarily admitted under the Bopz, and that family policy and a new family support module are being developed.
It is important that providers are alert to translating the policy into day-to-day practice.
Het is wel van belang dat aanbieders alert zijn op het doorvertalen van het beleid naar de werkvloer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over het verkopen van buitenlandse geneesmiddelen door een Nederlands bedrijf

An MP asked the health minister whether unregistered foreign medicines sold by a Dutch company are lawful, how exceptional access schemes work, and how faster EU and national approval of new medicines could be achieved. The minister explained the narrow exceptions for unregistered medicines, cited usage figures, and said she would pursue flexible EU approval and send a response to the Actal report within months.
I expect that this will be the case within a few months.
Ik verwacht dat dit binnen enkele maanden het geval zal zijn.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verzekeraar weigert patiënt bandage tegen pijnlijk vocht» (ingezonden 3 augustus 2015).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether insurer Menzis may refuse reimbursement of a thoracic bandage prescribed to breast cancer patients, and how many such refusals occurred. The minister answered that Menzis applies a prior-authorisation procedure permitted under the Zvw, that all correctly requested bandages were reimbursed this year, and that no structural refusals were found, so no further investigation is planned.
Because thoracic bandages are requested and claimed under the broad heading of compression aids, it cannot be determined how many were requested or refused in recent years.
Omdat thoraxbandages onder de grote noemer compressiehulpmiddelen worden aangevraagd en gedeclareerd, valt niet te achterhalen hoeveel er de afgelopen jaren zijn aangevraagd of afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het niet vergoeden van basisbandage voor kankerpatiënten door een zorgverzekeraar

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why insurer Menzis refused to reimburse thoracic bandages for cancer patients from the basic package, and whether other insurers do the same. The minister replied that Menzis states the bandages are reimbursed when policy conditions are met, that Menzis's prior-authorisation procedure is in its policy terms, and that she sees no need for measures, noting the NZa and IGJ supervise insurers' statutory duty of care.
I do not intend to take measures now that Menzis has stated that these aids will be reimbursed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om maatregelen te nemen nu Menzis heeft verklaard dat deze hulpmiddelen vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een veelbelovend longkankermedicijn niet voor elke patiënt beschikbaar is

An MP asked the health minister how access to the lung cancer drug nivolumab is guaranteed regardless of place of residence, given that only four of twelve designated hospitals currently provide it, and what doctors should do when no nearby hospital has capacity. The minister answered that the drug is free while in the scheme, care is covered by insurers' duty of care, insurers must arrange access, and a 10-hospital phone check shows access is largely in place.

I call on the parties, where this has not yet happened, to make concrete agreements in the ongoing contracts as soon as possible to remove any remaining uncertainty about the (reimbursement for) provision of nivolumab.

Ik roep partijen op om, daar waar dit nog niet is gebeurd, op zo kort mogelijke termijn concrete afspraken te maken in de lopende contracten die nodig zijn om eventuele resterende onduidelijkheid rond de (vergoeding bij) verstrekking van nivolumab weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leijten over gegijzelde patiënten in Kenia

MPs Smaling and Leijten asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of patient hostage-taking, moonlighting staff and resale of equipment in Kenyan hospitals, and about the scope of Dutch aid and corruption risks. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, described existing zero-tolerance rules and risk assessments (including for the ORIO hospital project), and promised to check the adequacy of risk analysis and to press partner embassies to stay alert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over de opslag van DNA-data bij onder andere Google en Amazon

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the lack of oversight of DNA data storage and sale by companies such as Google, Amazon and Illumina, including consent, legal basis, and the role of the Cbp. The minister answered that DNA is a free market regulated by privacy law, that the Cbp decides independently whether to investigate, and that a planned bill on control over body material and EU data-protection rules are in progress.
Given the independent position of the Cbp, it is up to the Cbp itself to determine whether it proceeds to do so.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Cbp, is het aan het Cbp zelf om te bepalen of het daartoe overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen in de zorg aan onnodig fiscaal advies verspild zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether medical specialists' founding of new companies to keep entrepreneurial status was unnecessary after declaration rules changed, and about the role of tax advice and Article 3.5 Wet IB 2001. The State Secretary answered that the loss of direct declaration rights generally does not by itself establish entrepreneurship, that the Tax Service did not pressure parties, and that eligibility depends on all relevant risks, with the government open to contracts being submitted to the Tax Service.
I note that in practice some unclarity has arisen about the extent of the personnel risks to be borne.
Ik merk hierbij op dat in de praktijk enige onduidelijkheid is gerezen over de omvang van de te lopen personeelsrisico's.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Klever over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg wegens geldgebrek

Mr. Klever (PVV) asked the minister whether elderly people forgoing medication or specialist checks due to money problems is acceptable, how this will be prevented, and why asylum seekers receive free care while Dutch citizens pay their own risk. Minister Schippers said a study on care avoidance will be delivered before the budget debate, noted the GP visit is excluded from the own risk, and explained that asylum seekers' care is organized by COA and that once housed they must take out insurance.
That research will be ready in October and is being carried out by the Ministry of VWS together with the Consumentenbond, the Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland.
Dat onderzoek zal in oktober gereed zijn en laat het Ministerie van VWS samen met de Consumentenbond, de Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karalabut over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg vanwege geldgebrek

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the ministers of health and social affairs about reports that elderly people forgo care due to money problems, including questions on rising out-of-pocket costs, dental care, municipal co-payments, and income losses for pensioners. The minister answered that no evidence shows growing numbers forgoing Wmo or Wlz care because of co-payments, that a study on care avoidance will be sent to parliament before the budget debate, and that income measures will be weighed in the August decision-making.
Research into the nature and extent of care avoidance is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzoek verricht naar de aard en omvang van zorgmijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de richtlijn voor reanimatie

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the health minister whether the resuscitation guideline rested on an outdated figure of 50% brain damage among resuscitated over-70s, whether this affected choices about resuscitation, and about a neutral Do-Not-Resuscitate pendant. The minister acknowledged the new AMC research, said the guideline will be reviewed with stakeholders, agreed vitality of older patients should be considered, and promised a report on the pendant in October.
I am therefore examining the possibilities for having a uniform, neutral (not linked to any particular foundation or association) NR pendant issued.
Ik onderzoek dan ook de mogelijkheden tot het laten uitgeven van een uniforme, neutrale (niet aan een bepaalde stichting of vereniging gelieerde) NR-penning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Bouwmeester over de hogere tarieven na sluitingstijd van apothekers in dunbevolkte gebieden

MPs Van Dijk and Bouwmeester asked whether higher after-hours pharmacy tariffs in sparsely populated areas, sometimes up to €70 more, are acceptable and whether patients delay collecting urgent medication to avoid them. The minister acknowledged the regional tariff differences and the risk of a negative spiral, and said the problem would be resolved from 2016 after talks with the NZa and sector parties, though she defended tariff differences as part of how care is financed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de hoge zorgkosten van allochtonen

An MP asked the health minister about the higher healthcare costs of allochtonen, whether this relates to unpaid premiums, and how to curb it. The minister answered that the data show higher average costs for some groups but not excessive use, that care is not free and collection measures apply, and that she sees no added value in research linking non-payment to care use.
I furthermore see no added value in research that establishes a link between the extent to which people fail to pay and the amount of care they use.
Ik zie voorts geen toegevoegde waarde voor onderzoek dat een relatie legt tussen de mate waarin mensen wanbetalen en de hoeveelheid zorg die zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Pia Dijkstra over apotheken die ’s nachts in dorpen soms tien keer duurder zijn dan in de stad

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked why out-of-hours pharmacy prices differ up to tenfold between regions and whether the 2014 financing model, a possible night closure, or a national tariff could fix this. The minister acknowledged the problem and said it is resolved from 2016 after talks with the NZa and stakeholders, but declined to commit to a national tariff, citing subsidiarity and proportionality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over "de (h)erkenning van endometriose"

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether endometriosis is grounds for UWV to refuse sickness benefit or disability assessment, and why Netherlands has not formally recognised it as an illness. The government answered that a diagnosis alone does not determine entitlement; the insurance physician assesses functional limitations, guided by an international ESHRE guideline, and that recognising diseases is the task of professional bodies, not the state.
Recognising illnesses is not a government task.
Het erkennen van ziekten is geen overheidstaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een niet-natuurlijk overlijden in zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the health inspectorate IGZ does not investigate non-natural deaths in care institutions, how often such deaths go uninvestigated, and whether the IGZ can rely on institutions' own inquiries, which may be shaped by reputational concerns. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ will widen family involvement and use an external chair for inquiries in elderly and disability care, that the IGZ does not register many of the figures asked for, and that the IGZ assesses institutions' calamity reports while the public prosecutor handles possible crimes.
The IGZ does not register this, so I cannot answer this question.
De IGZ registreert dit niet, dus ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de 20 wekenecho door Siriz en de NPV

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about a survey finding that a quarter of women were not fully satisfied with information after an abnormality was detected at the 20-week scan, and about related questions on information quality, the rising share choosing the scan, and new prenatal screening. The Minister said information will be reviewed for neutrality and that the Health Council will advise on the wider screening chain by 2016, but declined further study of the information itself.
I will review the information in light of this so that it is as neutral and complete as possible.
Ik zal naar aanleiding daarvan de informatie tegen het licht houden opdat de informatie neutraal en zo volledig mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een borderline patiënte die hulp nodig heeft

An MP asked the Health Minister about a borderline patient who reportedly needed help but was referred toward euthanasia services, and about treatment access and youth-to-adult care transitions. The minister said care follows professional guidelines, described transition arrangements, and explained that the NVVE does not refer those wishing to live to euthanasia clinics.
When asked, the NVVE indicated that if someone states they do not wish to end their life but wants to be considered for further treatment, the help-seeker cannot be referred to an end-of-life clinic.

Desgevraagd heeft de NVVE laten weten dat wanneer iemand te kennen geeft geen wens tot beëindiging van het leven te hebben, maar voor verdere behandeling in aanmerking wil komen, de hulpvrager niet kan worden doorverwezen naar een levenseinde kliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de mogelijke inperking van de vrije artsenkeuze door het macrobeheersinstrument

An MP asked the health minister whether changes to the macro-budget instrument (mbi) shift cost burdens onto non-contracted providers, pressure providers into contracts, and undermine patient free choice of provider. The minister declined to answer substantively, saying the concerns are known and will be addressed in a forthcoming bill's explanatory memorandum, and rejected the claim that patient choice is affected.
The explanatory memorandum accompanying the bill will set out the reasoning regarding the LVVP's response.
In de memorie van toelichting bij het wetsvoorstel zal gemotiveerd worden ingegaan op de reactie van de LVVP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over 'Declaraties topziekenhuizen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether top hospital executives' expense claims (dolphin swimming, starred restaurant meals) are acceptable and what measures, including the role of supervisory boards, will be taken. The minister regrets the reports, asked the NVZ and NFU to remind members to keep claims frugal, and said the NFU will inventory declaration rules, with the hospital boards' associations to respond in coming weeks.
It is up to the Supervisory Boards to make agreements with the members of the Executive Boards about claims and to check whether these are complied with.
Het is aan Raden van Toezicht om met de leden van de Raden van Bestuur afspraken te maken over declaraties en te bekijken of die ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het Nederlands ziekenhuis in het weekend dodelijker is

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she responds to reports that Dutch hospitals have higher weekend mortality, whether specialists are more often absent at weekends, and whether she will investigate why Australian hospitals do not show this effect. The minister answered that the Dutch monitoring data show a weekday-weighted pattern with more harm on Thursday and Friday, that the cited study covered only six hospitals and cannot prove Australian hospitals are safer, that weekend staffing is lower but sufficient specialist availability is required, and declined to start a new investigation.
No. I refer to my answer to question 1 and question 5.
Nee. Ik verwijs daarvoor naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 en vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over bestuurders van academische ziekenhuizen die massaal de declaratieregels aan hun laars lappen

Two SP MPs asked the minister about academic hospital board members who allegedly ignore expense rules, with luxury and private spending charged to care funds. The minister regrets the reports, asked the hospital federations to remind members of frugality, says individual cases and enforcement fall to the supervisory boards, and points to a planned NFU inventory of expense rules.
I cannot go into the individual cases. The information for that is lacking. It is also not my task; it is a task of the Supervisory Board.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de individuele casuïstiek. Daarvoor ontbreekt informatie. Het is ook niet mijn taak, het is een taak van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat bestuurders van ziekenhuizen massaal declaratieregels negeren

An MP asked the health minister about reports that hospital boards exceed declaration norms and ignore collective agreement rules, and whether governance is in order and what will be done. The minister regretted the reports, asked the hospital associations to remind members of the rules, said the NFU will inventory declaration rules, and pointed to planned governance measures, while stating that hospitals are private institutions whose supervisory boards are responsible for compliance.
I have no information about how declaration rules are handled and what those rules look like.
Ik heb geen informatie over de omgang met declaratieregels en hoe deze regels eruit zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de afkoopsom voor een oud-bestuurder van ggz-instelling Rivierduinen

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the ministers whether a severance payment equal to half a year's salary given to a former Rivierduinen mental health board member, despite few years of service, was justified and whether the WNT tightening should apply. The minister said CIBG will examine whether the arrangement complied with the WNT, that the WNT's severance cap does not apply to pre-existing contracts under transitional law, and that dismissals follow the CAO GGZ.
The CIBG will investigate whether this severance arrangement was implemented in accordance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT).
Het CIBG zal onderzoeken of deze ontslagregeling conform de Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Bouwmeester over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de zorg

MPs Oosenbrug and Bouwmeester asked whether the health sector is aware of new data-protection rules (the breach-notification duty effective 1 January 2016) and whether WhatsApp is secure enough for exchanging patient data. Minister Schippers answered that sector implementation is the responsibility of healthcare providers, that the CBP will issue guidance and oversee compliance, and that the government will promote awareness and proceed with its client-rights bill, without monitoring sector preparations directly.
I do not keep track of the preparations healthcare institutions are making, because it is up to the institutions themselves to comply with the regulations.
Ik houd geen zicht op de voorbereidingen die zorginstellingen treffen, omdat het aan de zorginstellingen zelf is om aan de regelgeving te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten zorg mijden vanwege de kosten voor het eigen risico

An MP asked the minister whether patients avoiding care because of the deductible (eigen risico) was acceptable and what measures would be taken. The minister said the matter is under study and the results will be sent to parliament before the VWS budget debate, without committing to specific measures now.
As previously promised, I will send the results of this study to your House before the VWS budget debate.
Zoals eerder is toegezegd zal ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek voor de behandeling van de VWS-begroting aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ronselpraktijken in de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the minister whether a home-care provider's letter urging clients to refer relatives for a 25-euro voucher, and the practice of 'poaching' clients, is acceptable. The minister called the initiative undesirable, said clients decide their provider and the nurse decides eligibility, and promised to discuss it with the sector's umbrella body.
I will enter into discussion with home-care organisations to exchange views on this.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met thuiszorgorganisaties om hierover van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een bestuurder voor twee weken werk ruim één ton vangt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether a UMC Maastricht board member received over one hundred thousand euros for about 15 days of work, whether the dismissal was timed across New Year to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether this reflects good governance and internal conflict. The minister replied that the severance was for the whole six-plus-year employment, that WNT norms cannot be evaded by postponing payment, that the supervisor CIBG will examine the case, and that she has no insight into the reasons for the departure.
The supervisor on compliance with the WNT in healthcare, the CIBG, will investigate this case.
De toezichthouder op de naleving van de WNT in de zorg, het CIBG, zal deze casus onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff over de voorlichting van de Rijksoverheid over TTIP

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Grashoff asked the ministers whether government information on TTIP was misleading and how food safety, regulatory cooperation, MRLs and investor-state dispute settlement would be protected. The minister answered that regulatory cooperation does not allow lower EU standards, the regulatory cooperation body would be advisory only, and ISDS is being reformed toward a transparent, democratically supervised system.

As explained in a letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499), the European Commission confirms that this body may only have an advisory role, that European and national democratic procedures may therefore not be bypassed, and that all stakeholders must be able to contribute equally.

Zoals toegelicht in een Kamerbrief (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499 ), bevestigt de Europese Commissie dat deze instantie enkel een adviesrecht mag hebben, dat Europese en nationale democratische procedures daardoor niet doorkruist mogen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over toenemende agressie ten aanzien van apothekersassistenten

MPs Voortman and Dik-Faber asked the minister about rising aggression toward pharmacy assistants, linked to the 2014 split of the first dispensing conversation from the standard dispensing fee, and about falling job satisfaction, the trust relationship with patients, and whether the financing should be reversed. The minister acknowledged the preliminary survey results, said the NZa is negotiating with sector parties on a solution, and promised further talks with Optima Farma while defending the new payment as necessary for care content.
I hope that any solution will quickly bring clarity to all those involved and contribute to reducing aggression at the counter.
Ik hoop dat een eventuele oplossing snel tot duidelijkheid leidt voor alle betrokkenen en zal bijdragen aan de vermindering van agressie aan de balie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de ramadan goed zou zijn tegen diabetes

An MP from the PVV asks the minister of health whether she will act against claims that Ramadan fasting cures diabetes, which the MP says is dangerous medical advice, and whether the resulting extra care costs can be recovered from its source. The minister answers that assessing diabetes and Ramadan is a matter for the medical profession and individual care plans, that patients decide how to manage their illness with their care providers, and refers to earlier answers on the cost question.
I consider the assessment of the effects of participation in Ramadan on diabetes to be a responsibility of the medical profession.
De beoordeling van de effecten van deelname aan de ramadan op diabetes vind ik een verantwoordelijkheid van de medische beroepsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het ontstaan voor onveilige situatie voor een patiënt door het niet adequaat reageren van hulpdiensten op een vraag om acute hulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether emergency services' inadequate response to a request for urgent help, leaving a 75-year-old stroke patient without assistance, would be investigated and reported on, and how often such failures occur. The minister declined to investigate the individual case itself, said the Inspectorate might examine it, and described existing triage protocols and quality programmes.
It is not for me to investigate an individual case like this.
Het is niet aan mij om een individuele casus als deze te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het weigeren van single vrouwen die IVF-behandeling willen

An MP asked the health minister whether hospitals refusing IVF to single and lesbian women violates the protocol and equal-treatment law, and what she will do to ensure equal access. The minister agrees such blanket exclusion is wrong and contrary to the NVOG protocol and the AWGB, but says enforcement is for the professional body, the IGZ has received no complaints, and she sees no further role for herself.
I believe it is the role of the professional group to bring the protocol again to the attention of hospitals and practitioners.
Ik vind het de rol van de beroepsgroep om het protocol opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij ziekenhuizen en beroepsbeoefenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de helft van de ziekenhuizen Ivf-behandelingen aan alleenstaande vrouwen weigert

MP Voortman asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that half of hospitals refuse IVF to single women, whether screening of single women but not couples is justified, and whether she will engage hospitals on this. The minister answered that single women are protected by equal-treatment law, that the NVOG protocol allows only case-specific assessment, and that she will talk to the NVOG but not to individual hospitals.
I will discuss this matter with the NVOG, but I see it as the task of the professional association to bring its own protocol back to the attention of practitioners and hospitals
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de NVOG over deze kwestie, maar zie het als taak van de beroepsvereniging om het eigen protocol opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Van Laar en Rebel over het bericht 'Afrikaanse voetballers verhandeld in Azië'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about a BBC report on African footballers trafficked to Asia, including estimates of victims, Dutch signals, and EU/FIFA enforcement. Minister Schippers answered that the report alone gives no basis for judgment, that FIFA is already acting, that FIFA transfer rules and KNVB policy are in place, and that no Dutch intervention is warranted.
Additional research into the numbers is therefore, in my judgment, not necessary.
Aanvullend onderzoek naar aantallen is naar mijn oordeel dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over shirtsponsoring van een betaald voetbalorganisatie door ggz-instelling Inter-Psy

An MP asked the Health Minister whether a mental health provider (Inter-Psy) using a partner platform to sponsor FC Groningen shirts is appropriate, whether this is advertising funded by care money, and how its executive fees are treated under the law. The minister replied that private parties' arrangements are not her responsibility, that advertising is governed by the Advertising Code and the private firms' own decisions, and that management fees are permissible remuneration under the WNT rather than profit distribution, while leaving insurer and fee questions to others.
It is not for me to pass judgement on a cooperation between two private parties.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over een samenwerking tussen twee private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over volgens de WHO (Wereld gezondheidsorganisatie) teveel ingeleide bevallingen in Nederland

An MP asked the minister about a reported WHO concern over rising induced births in the Netherlands, and whether research and hospital-level figures would follow. The minister said the WHO report does not exist, no professional signals were received, no specific research is currently planned, and national figures show a stable rate around 24% since 2010 with anonymised hospital differences in the Zorgbalans.
I have national figures on the number of inductions, and these figures have been made public via the Zorgbalans 2014 of the RIVM.
Ik beschik over landelijke cijfers met betrekking tot het aantal inleidingen en die cijfers zijn via de Zorgbalans 2014 van het RIVM 3 bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vertraging van de Dopingwet

An SP MP asks the health minister why the anti-doping law has been delayed since 2010, why the number of doping controls fell, and why the law is not a priority. The minister answers that the law is needed for a proper legal basis for processing personal data, that doping is mainly a matter for sports bodies, that she disagrees with the claim that Dutch credibility is at stake, and that advisory bodies are expected to advise soon.
I am in discussion with the Doping Authority and NOC*NSF about the lagging number of controls.
Ik ben in gesprek met de Dopingautoriteit en NOC*NSF over het achterblijven van het aantal controles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zwerven door de zorg’

An MP asks the Health Minister to respond to a column on uninsured homeless people, whether residence-address rules exclude vulnerable people from health insurance, and why no national registration of uninsured people or of care refusals exists. The minister answers that insurance depends on residence criteria with an address as a key indicator, that the BSN is unsuitable as proof of insurance right, that no registration or investigation of care refusals is planned for cost reasons, and that practical solutions with municipalities are being explored.
Furthermore, I do not have information about care providers that do not treat uninsured persons.
Ik beschik voorts niet over informatie ten aanzien van zorgaanbieders die onverzekerde personen niet behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de MERS-uitbraak in Zuid-Korea

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about lessons from the 2015 MERS outbreak in South Korea, including hospital infection control, contact tracing, cooperation with aviation, and traveller information. The minister answered that the outbreak was winding down, listed the contributing factors identified by WHO, and described existing guidance, reporting and traveller information measures without announcing new structural changes.

This outbreak shows the importance of early detection of the disease by doctors (GPs and secondary-care specialists), applying the right prevention measures (such as isolating the patient) when MERS-CoV is suspected, and identifying and continuing to monitor contacts.

Deze uitbraak toont het belang aan van vroegsignalering van de ziekte door artsen (huisartsen en tweedelijns specialisten), het uitvoeren van de juiste preventiemaatregelen (zoals isolatie van de zieke) bij een verdenking van MERS-CoV en het inventariseren en blijven monitoren van contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de toename van euthanasie bij psychiatrisch patiënten via de levenseindekliniek
