An MP asks the health minister about rising euthanasia among psychiatric and cancer patients via the Levenseindekliniek and about doctors refusing requests. The minister confirms the increase in cancer-patient referrals without knowing the cause, cites a 2012 ZonMw evaluation on refusals, notes ongoing trajectories, and promises the commission of wise men's report later in 2015.
I expect to receive the report later this year, and will send it to your House after its publication.
Het rapport verwacht ik later dit jaar te ontvangen, en zal ik na het verschijnen aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toegenomen problemen met zorgverzekeraars die weigeren bereide of merkmedicijnen te vergoeden

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurers refusing to reimburse compounded and brand-name medicines, including inconsistent coverage, the Competition Act's effect on coordinated benefit decisions, and forced switching to biosimilars. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for applying the basic package, that talks with ZN, Zorginstituut and ACM are ongoing with a solution promised before the end of summer, and that prescribing decisions rest with the treating physician, while largely declining to address the specific cases and motions raised.
I am in discussion with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland and the ACM about a possible solution to this.
Ik ben met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland en de ACM in overleg over een mogelijke oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘dat de drie BAR-gemeenten af willen van verzekeraar CZ’

MPs Leijten asked whether the government would act on reports that three municipalities want to drop insurer CZ as partner for long-term care and whether gemeenten can choose another insurer. The State Secretary answered that the reported wish is not recognised from recent talks, that a regional secretary programme and ongoing talks are in place, and that the preferred insurer is designated by market share, so municipalities cannot choose; the prestatie wijkgericht werken is kept in 2016 to encourage agreements.
In that sense municipalities have no option to choose a particular health insurer; they will have to cooperate with it.
Gemeenten hebben in die zin geen mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een bepaalde zorgverzekeraar, zij zullen daarmee moeten samenwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weinig coulante houding van Zorginstituut Nederland bij vermissingszaken

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Zorginstituut Nederland was right to show no leniency toward the family of a missing woman, and what should be done about insurance, banks and care premiums for relatives of missing persons. The minister regretted the Institute's overly formal handling, reported an apology and internal measures, and pointed to a model protocol, ongoing sector talks and Slachtofferhulp Nederland's support.
The Zorginstituut positioned itself too formally in this emotional case.
Het Zorginstituut heeft zich in deze emotionele zaak te formeel opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over verzwegen signalen van corruptie rondom het Holland-Belgium Bid

An MP asked the ministers whether bid organisers should have withdrawn from the Holland-Belgium World Cup bid after corruption signals, how much public money was spent, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the bid cost about 10.5 million euros with about 2.8 million from the state, that the bid was the responsibility of the two football associations and FIFA, and that the US and Swiss investigations must be awaited before any follow-up steps are considered.
Media reports show that US and Swiss authorities are currently investigating, among other things, the bidding procedures for 2018 and 2022.
Uit mediaberichten blijkt dat op dit moment door de Amerikaanse en Zwitserse autoriteiten onderzoek wordt gedaan naar onder meer de bidprocedures van 2018 en 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over tekorten aan medicijnen die tot recordhoogte zijn opgelopen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister about record-high medicine shortages, questioning the impact on patients, why shortages persist when the same products are available in neighbouring countries, and what measures she will take. The Minister acknowledges the rising shortages and concern, says the working group is not yet sufficient, attributes causes to market conditions such as low prices, and commits to talking with insurers and encouraging broader supplier participation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over eigen kracht-conferenties bij verplichte ggz (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asks the Minister of Health about preliminary VUmc findings that family group conferences (Eigen Kracht-conferenties) can reduce coercive mental health care, and whether the Wvggz should be amended and the conferences funded structurally. The minister finds the early results positive, says the conferences can help find alternatives to coercion and that artikel 5:7 already allows a family-drawn plan, and promises to include the findings in a nota van wijziging and to consult the researchers.
The research results on the use of Eigen Kracht Conferences will be taken into account in the nota van wijziging of the Wet verplichte ggz.
De onderzoeksresultaten naar de inzet van de Eigen Kracht Conferenties worden mee genomen in de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over levensbeëindiging bij pasgeborenen

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the Health Minister about possible unlawful neonatal end-of-life decisions, the adequacy of public oversight given the weak trust in the central expert committee's review regulation, and the UN Children's Rights Committee's concerns. Minister Schippers answered that no such cases are known, that the current regulation lacks clarity and she will revise it, and that the UN committee did not request further information.

In the cabinet position on the evaluation of the Regulation I have therefore already announced that I will amend the Regulation in a way that does justice to the evaluation's findings and is workable for medical professionals.

In het kabinetsstandpunt op de evaluatie van de Regeling heb ik daarom al aangekondigd de Regeling te zullen aanpassen op een wijze die recht doet aan de bevindingen van de evaluatie en werkbaar is voor de medische professionals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over levensbeëindiging bij pasgeborenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the minister sees too little attention to oversight of end-of-life decisions for newborns, the reporting of such cases to the expert committee, and the legal (fundamental-rights) dimensions. Minister Schippers answered that reporting is important but incomplete, that the regulation is being revised, that legal safeguards are clear, and that the revised regulation is expected in autumn 2015.
That is why I also announced that I would amend the Regulation.
Daarom heb ik ook aangekondigd de Regeling te zullen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat zzp'ers bij donatie van een nier vaak in financiële problemen komen

MPs Arib and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Health about reports that self-employed donors of a kidney often face financial problems, and whether lost income is compensated, how often donors refrain from donating, and whether insurers and Kifid are involved. Minister Schippers acknowledged, based on an evaluation of the donation subsidy scheme, that self-employed donors without disability insurance face financial barriers, promised to study remedies and report this year, and stated Kifid has received no related complaints.
Now that the evaluation of the scheme has shown that there are indeed unnecessary financial barriers for self-employed people without disability insurance, I will take measures to change this.

Nu uit de evaluatie van de regeling is gebleken dat er voor zzp'ers zonder arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering weldegelijk onnodige financiële belemmeringen bestaan, zal ik maatregelen nemen om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over reanimatie en gebruik van AED’s (Automatische Externe Defibrillator)

An MP asked the health minister about public knowledge of resuscitation and the locations of AEDs in the Netherlands, citing a Red Cross survey. The minister answered that civil resuscitation is a societal responsibility supplementing professional care, referred to existing Red Cross and Heart Foundation initiatives and an app, and committed to action only where the government must step in.
If there are bottlenecks that the government must resolve, I am of course prepared to do so.
Mochten er knelpunten zijn die de overheid moet oplossen, dan ben ik daar natuurlijk toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen miljoenen tegoed hebben

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why hospitals owe nurses tens of millions in irregularity allowances, what the court ruling means financially, and whether employers will be urged to compensate. The minister declined to take a position, calling it a matter between employers and employees, and said she could not assess the financial consequences.
It is not for me to make a statement on this. This is a matter between employees and employers.
Het is niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen. Dit is iets tussen werknemers en werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat steeds minder kinderen hun zwemdiploma halen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how she views reports that fewer children are obtaining swimming diplomas, whether this is worrying, its causes, and measures to reverse the trend. The minister replied that she is awaiting the swimming sector's action plan, which will allow the government to monitor swimming ability, and promised to consult her OCW colleague and report back once it is available.
Once the action plan is in place, I will consult with my OCW colleague and inform you of the outcomes.
Zodra het plan van aanpak er ligt, zal ik met mijn OCW collega overleggen en u van de uitkomsten in kennis stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht dat een oud-topman van een zorginstelling na zijn vertrek nog 235.000 bij dezelfde instelling verdiende

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a former Pleyade care-institution director received €235,000 after leaving in 2013, including a six-month continued salary and a €75,000 severance, and whether this circumvented WNT rules, while 200 staff were dismissed. The ministers said the figures in the annual accounts show a 2013 salary of €125,393 plus €75,000 severance and a 2014 project-role salary of €59,793, that the WNT supervisor CIBG will examine the case, and that they lack detailed insight into staff severance.
This case will be assessed against the WNT by the WNT supervisor for care, the CIBG.
Deze casus zal aan de WNT worden getoetst door de toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorg, het CIBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over privacy regels die de veiligheid en de gezondheid belemmeren

MPs asked whether addresses of ambulance call-outs remain findable online, whether privacy rules block locating callers in emergencies, and why the address-anonymity issue has not been resolved after two years. The Minister says alternative alerting methods are being explored in half the regions, encryption is an option in the new C2000 tender, and precise location of 112 callers is limited only by technical factors, so no wise-persons commission is needed.
The possibility of a more precise location determination is limited only by technical factors and the time required, not by (privacy) legislation.
De mogelijkheid voor het doen van een meer nauwkeurige plaatsbepaling wordt alleen beperkt door technische factoren en de tijd die ervoor nodig is, niet door (privacy)wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over gezondheidsschade door hormoonverstorende stoffen in medische hulpmiddelen

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about health harm from hormone-disrupting substances leaking from medical devices used on premature infants, children and dialysis patients, and about BPA and phthalates in such devices. The minister answered that risks are not conclusively established, that EU criteria for endocrine disruptors are being developed, that the RIVM is studying the matter, and that she will pursue EU-level regulation and clearer labelling.
The RIVM has produced an overview of the main national and international risk assessments of BPA for humans and the environment, and of the uncertainties in them.
Het RIVM heeft een overzicht gemaakt van de belangrijkste nationale en internationale risicobeoordelingen van BPA voor mens en milieu, en de onzekerheden daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het per direct opstappen van de bestuursvoorzitter van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sudden resignation of the chair of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital board, insurer CZ's role, and whether the supervisory board and regulators failed. The minister answered that the supervisory board is responsible for board appointments and dismissals, that insurers may voice quality concerns, that the IGZ had acted, and that she sees no need to change the system.
I currently have no insight into the conditions under which this board member's employment contract was terminated.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de voorwaarden waaronder de arbeidsovereenkomst van deze bestuurder is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de introductie van de thuis-pretecho’s

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether home 'pret echo' devices (Babywatcher) should be used only under medical supervision, whether they risk harming pregnancy care and the unborn child, and who approves such products. The Minister answers that the product is not professional care, that it is unclear what safety limits apply, that existing product safety and medical device rules govern it, and that a quality model for obstetric ultrasound is under development.
I am not responsible for pret echos.
Ik ga niet over pret echo's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Aantal donoren kan fors omhoog; organen wegschenken na euthanasie”

MP Arib asked the health minister about reports that organ donation after euthanasia could sharply increase donor numbers, and about how often it occurs and whether patients are informed. The minister answered that only 9 such procedures have occurred in the Netherlands (21 in Belgium), that the benefit for waiting lists is hard to predict, and that a guideline on the subject is expected after the summer.
As I previously promised, I will inform the House as soon as the guideline is ready.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd, informeer ik de Kamer zodra de handreiking gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Zilveren Kruis Achmea het eigen risico van mensen verrekent met het PGB-wijkverpleging (Persoonsgebonden Budget)

An MP asked the minister whether Zilveren Kruis Achmea may offset PGB (personal budget) payments for district nursing against outstanding eigen risico debts, and whether this should stop. The minister answered that insurers may offset payments against due claims under the Civil Code, that no misuse or fraud occurs because the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds, and that four insurers apply such offsetting.
No, there is no misuse (or even fraud), since the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds.
Neen, er is geen sprake van verkeerd besteden (of zelfs fraude), aangezien het eigen risico niet wordt betaald uit pgb-gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het mogelijk onbewust aangaan van een budgetpolis en de niet te voorziene gevolgen daarvan

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether budget health insurance policies, which restrict hospital choice, are really cheaper, since insured people paid more in co-payments on average. Minister Schippers answered that most budget-policy holders had no co-payments, that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care, and that Achmea informed budget-policy holders and offered switching, with 97% choosing not to switch.
Health insurers are obliged to properly inform their insured about which care is contracted for a policy.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn verplicht om hun verzekerden goed te informeren over welke zorgaanbod gecontracteerd is voor een polis
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom die het LangeLand Ziekenhuis heeft betaald aan een ex-topman

An MP asked the health minister how a hospital could pay a settlement of nearly half a million euros to an ex-director who had driven it near bankruptcy, and whether measures could prevent such payouts and provide overviews of severance packages. The minister said the court had ruled on the settlement and that the hospital's own boards can pursue liability for mismanagement, and promised an annual report on sector executive pay later without providing the requested per-institution data.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het opnieuw in de fout gaan van visverwerker Foppen

An MP asked why food processor Foppen was warned in 2010 about using sodium nitrite yet was only re-checked in 2014, and whether NVWA policy will change. The minister replied that the 2010 warning was about stock, the 2014 audit found actual use, risk to health was judged absent, the fine was the maximum, and that NVWA's intervention policy and a supervisory framework will be tightened.
The NVWA's intervention policy means that after a detected violation, follow-up inspections take place to ensure the identified shortcomings have been remedied.
Het interventiebeleid van de NVWA houdt in dat na een geconstateerde overtreding vervolginspecties plaatsvinden om zeker te stellen dat de geconstateerde tekortkomingen zijn verholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over gezondheidsrisico’s die kunnen optreden als gevolg van aderlating of ‘wet cupping therapie’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about health risks of bloodletting and 'wet cupping' therapy, including infection and hepatitis transmission, and whether practitioners may legally make incisions. The minister agreed the practice falls under the BIG Act as a reserved medical act, said the IGZ supervises it with fines and criminal enforcement available, and committed to asking the IGZ and Education Inspectorate to visit a training institute, though she gave no figures on practitioners and did not commit to new rules.
I will ask the IGZ and the Education Inspectorate whether they are willing to visit this training institute.
Ik zal de IGZ en de Onderwijsinspectie vragen of zij dit opleidingsinstituut willen gaan bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de alternatieve geneeswijze ‘cupping’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the alternative practice of cupping (hijama), including its health risks, whether it is a reserved medical act under the BIG Act, and whether clinics need licensing and who supervises them. The Minister answered that cupping involving tissue disruption is a reserved act under the BIG Act, that the IGZ supervises it with fines and criminal enforcement possible, and that no licensing requirement exists for cupping clinics unlike tattoo and piercing shops.
Only designated and competent healthcare providers, such as doctors, are formally authorised to perform this act. The IGZ supervises this.
Alleen daartoe aangewezen en bekwame zorgverleners, zoals artsen, zijn formeel bevoegd deze handeling uit te voeren. De IGZ houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over cupping-praktijken

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about cupping practices, including health risks, untrained practitioners cutting skin, cancer claims, and whether cupping should be regulated under the Warenwet like tattooing. The minister replied that cupping is a reserved medical act under the Wet BIG, supervised by the IGZ with fines, disciplinary and criminal routes available, that no incidents have been reported, that the cancer claim is misleading, and that she rejects bringing cupping under the Warenwet.
Cupping, as a reserved surgical treatment, falls under the Individual Health Care Professions Act (Wet BIG).
Cupping valt, als voorbehouden heelkundige behandeling, onder de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg (Wet BIG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom van een vertrokken zorgbestuurder

An MP asked the Minister of Health about severance payments of about EUR 977,020 total to three departed VUmc board members who were involved in serious scandals, and whether these reduce the budget for expensive medicines. The minister said the government favours limiting severance pay, pointed to the WNT cap in force since 2013, said the payments do not come from the expensive-medicines budget, and noted that CIBG supervises WNT compliance.
The cabinet considers limiting severance payments desirable for society.
Het kabinet acht beperking van ontslagvergoedingen maatschappelijk wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Ik wil niet dood, ik wil alleen hulp”

An MP asks the minister about a newspaper article describing a person seeking mental health help who cannot get adequate care, including bridging care gaps and who is responsible for it. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the professional and legal framework for treatment, waiting-time norms and the division of responsibilities between municipalities, insurers and the Wlz, but does not commit to a new concrete action.
The signal in the article that cuts are being made in mental health care I do not recognise.
Het signaal in het artikel dat wordt bezuinigd in de GGZ herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het hoofdbehandelaarschap GGZ in de zorginkoop voor 2016

An MP asked the health minister about the consequences for 2016 insurer purchasing of rules on the GGZ main-practitioner role, including whether orthopedagogues-generalist and intellectual disability doctors can be main practitioners and the delay in responding to a request to register orthopedagogues in the BIG Act. The minister replied that the commission's advice targets 2017, that current NZa rules allow tailoring for some professionals but not intellectual disability doctors in 2016, and that a bill to register orthopedagogues-generalist under the BIG Act will be submitted to parliament.
I have decided to submit a bill to parliament to include the orthopedagogue-generalist in Article 3 of the BIG Act.
Ik heb besloten een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om de orthopedagoog-generalist op te nemen in artikel 3 van de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Matchfixing in amateurvoetbal aan orde van de dag”

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the government about match-fixing in amateur football, including preventive measures, disciplinary and criminal tools, and reporting to the KNVB. Minister Schippers answered that the KNVB and NOC*NSF run education and reporting channels, a national platform coordinates enforcement, and the OM takes signals seriously but intervenes only when there are sufficient grounds.
Match-fixing can only be combated through close cooperation between the sports, gambling and investigation and prosecution sectors.
Matchfixing kan alleen worden bestreden door nauwe samenwerking tussen de sectoren sport, kansspel en opsporing en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheid bij sportevenementen

An SP MP asked the health minister why sports event organisers face no legal obligation to use the VoorZorg medical advice tool, who is primarily responsible for sports medical care and safety, and whether binding rules or an evaluation are planned. The minister answered that the organiser is primarily responsible, municipalities can attach safety conditions to permits, binding rules are not considered necessary, and the VSG will evaluate the tool in 2015 with a possible update and information to parliament.
Use of the instrument currently has no binding character.
Het gebruik van het instrument heeft op dit moment geen verplicht karakter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het toegenomen antibioticagebruik bij kippen en de antibioticadoelstelling

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked about the rise in antibiotic use in broiler chickens, its threat to the 70% reduction target for end-2015, and what measures will be taken against poultry farms with high use. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges the rise, attributes it possibly to later treatment at higher weight, announces sector measures and says the 70% target remains but will be hard to reach.
Antibiotic use in the four major livestock sectors (including broiler chickens) fell by 4% in 2014 compared with 2013.
Het antibioticumgebruik in de vier grote veehouderijsectoren (inclusief vleeskuikens) is in 2014 gedaald met 4% ten opzichte van 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why specialised psychological care for cancer patients depends on fundraising, and whether patients with adjustment disorders are excluded from insured care. The Minister said she is not against private funding but will not intervene in provider operations or insurer tariffs, has asked insurers to promote peer centres and will report before the budget debate, and maintains that adjustment disorders stay outside the insured package.
As Minister, I do not concern myself with the business operations of individual care providers.
Ik ga als Minister niet over de bedrijfsvoering van individuele zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het Pia Dijkstra over instituten die psychische hulp verlenen aan kankerpatiënten en afhankelijk zijn van goodwill

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about psycho-oncology institutes that depend on goodwill and face financial hardship, asking why reimbursement is based on regular mental health tariffs, how care is secured without national coverage, and whether dependence on goodwill is acceptable. Minister Schippers answered that she is engaging umbrella organisations and IPSO, will inform parliament before the budget debate, sees no reason to think maximum tariffs are insufficient, and does not judge the private funding share of individual providers.

I have agreed with IPSO to talk with them and other relevant parties in the field about this in the short term, so that it becomes clear whether improvements are needed in the organisation or funding of this care.

Ik heb met IPSO afgesproken met hen en met andere relevante partijen in het veld daarover op korte termijn door te praten, zodat helder wordt of er verbeteringen nodig zijn in de organisatie of bekostiging van deze zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de wachtgeldregeling van een vertrokken zorgbestuurder

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a €370,419 severance payment to a departing hospital executive, whether current executives can claim similar packages, and how the government will address overpaid executives. The minister said the CIBG is checking compliance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens, that the cap applies from 2013 with older arrangements under transitional rules, that no forced dismissals occurred at the OZG hospital group, and that the government supports moderate executive pay.
The CIBG is examining whether this severance arrangement was implemented in accordance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT).
Het CIBG onderzoekt of deze wachtgeldregeling conform de Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over omzetplafonds in de zorg

An MP asks the health minister to explain how patients are protected when hospital volume caps (omzetplafonds) are reached mid-treatment, including whether patients must seek another provider and whether NZa supervises adequate volumes. The minister answers that patients keep the right to continue ongoing treatment, that NZa is examining contracting and access to care through reports due in 2015, and that transparency measures for policies are being pursued.
I expect care providers to complete a care pathway that has started, unless for clinical reasons it is desirable for care to continue elsewhere.
Ik verwacht van zorgaanbieders dat zij een zorgtraject dat is gestart ook afronden, tenzij het om zorginhoudelijke redenen wenselijk is dat de zorg elders wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de onvolledigheid van het Transparantieregister Zorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the Transparantieregister Zorg, a largely voluntary register of payments from pharmaceutical firms to doctors and hospitals, gives a complete picture, and whether it should be enforced by the inspectorate. Minister Schippers answered that the register is adequate within its chosen framework, that self-regulation works, that the IGZ already has enforcement powers, and that no new law is needed.
I am of the view that, within the framework chosen for the register, the Transparantieregister gives a good picture of the financial relationships doctors have with pharmaceutical companies.
Ik ben van mening dat, binnen de kaders die voor het register gekozen zijn, het Transparantieregister een goed beeld geeft van de financiële relaties die artsen hebben met farmaceutische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de jeugd-ggz in Almere geen behandeling meer kan bieden omdat het geld bij de gemeente op is

MP Kooiman asked the Minister about a youth mental health provider in Almere halting intake because the 2015 budget was spent, including parents' letters, data on waiting lists and other municipalities, and whether the municipality's one-month promise was realistic. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are legally responsible for youth care under the Jeugdwet, that the municipality is working with the provider, that national monitoring does not track waiting times, and that there is no reason to hold municipalities to account now.
It is up to municipalities to ensure that all children who need youth care receive it.
Het is aan gemeenten om ervoor te zorgen dat alle kinderen die jeugdhulp nodig hebben, deze krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat medisch specialisten volgens de Belastingdienst nog steeds zelfstandig ondernemers zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority's view that medical specialists remain self-employed contradicts government policy on integrated care funding and whether the costs of cooperative models were unnecessary. The minister answered that the government's position is unchanged, that self-employment depends on facts and circumstances, and that the transition subsidy aims to make employment a real option.
The cabinet has not changed its position on the self-employment of medical specialists.
Het kabinet heeft zijn standpunt ten aanzien van het ondernemerschap van medisch specialisten niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Patiënt snakt naar elektronisch dossier’

MP Bouwmeester asked the Health Minister about a press report on patients wanting access to their electronic records, and whether the government would take the lead in developing a patient-controlled personal health record. Minister Schippers said the sector is developing the PGD 2020 framework, promised to push standardisation and patient access without a commission of wise persons, and declined to set up such a commission.
I therefore see no added value in a commission of wise persons.
Ik zie dan ook geen toegevoegde waarde in een commissie van wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het risico van gebruik van zonnebanken

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether a licensing system and ID requirement for sunbed operators will be introduced after reports of minors using sunbeds and declining compliance with the age limit. The Minister confirmed the health risks, said she is considering a licence or ID requirement and will review the new SCENHIR advice, but does not plan a ban and prefers the industry to comply with existing rules.
I intend to examine the various options to counter the irresponsible offering of sunbeds.
Ik ben voornemens de verschillende mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om het onverantwoord aanbieden van zonnebanken tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het geld voor sportblessurepreventie

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked whether sports injury costs remain about 1.5 billion euros a year and why funding for sports injury prevention is being cut to 675,000 euros. Minister Schippers answered that the figures are the most recent, denied any cut (previous spending of about 900,000 euros, now 675,000 plus 250,000 for knowledge and monitoring), and said sports knowledge would be bundled into a new knowledge centre.
This is not correct. Previously about 900,000 euros was spent annually on the prevention of sports injuries.
Dit is niet juist. Voorheen werd jaarlijks circa 900.000 euro uitgegeven aan de preventie van sportblessures
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over corruptie bij de FIFA

An MP asked the health minister about FIFA corruption, including whether the Netherlands should file a complaint, claim back the 4.5 million euro contributed to the 2018 World Cup bid, and whether FIFA's leadership could be re-elected. The minister said she awaits the Swiss and US investigations, will consider steps if corruption in the award process is shown, and that a new, more transparent FIFA leadership is now a matter for FIFA's members.
Should the investigation show that the award process was corrupt, I will consider taking steps.
Mocht uit het onderzoek blijken dat het proces bij de gunning corrupt is geweest dan zal ik me beraden op te nemen stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Tonnen wachtgeld voor oud-zorgtopman’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports of large severance and early-retirement payments to care executives, including a €370,419 payout to a former care boss who resigned, and whether this is acceptable. The minister responds that the government considers normalising executive pay and severance in care desirable, points to the WNT pay cap (€178,000 from 2015), says the CIBG will examine the specific cases, and promises an annual report on executive pay in December 2015 without disaggregating the figures further.
The CIBG will investigate whether the WNT has been complied with.
Het CIBG zal onderzoeken of conform de WNT is gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever en Wilders over het bericht 'Medische raad bij ramadan'

Three PVV MPs asked whether patients who fast during Ramadan knowingly endanger their health and whether insurers should bear the extra advice and care costs of those who become medically unstable. Minister Schippers answered that the Health Insurance Act requires care decisions to rest on care-content criteria, that she does not intend to amend it, and that no registrations exist to determine the extra costs.
I am not aware of any records from which these extra costs could be derived without further ado.
Er zijn mij geen registraties bekend waar deze extra kosten zonder meer uit af te leiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Audiciens naar rechter om eisen zorgverzekeraar’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about audiologists going to court over insurer contracting demands, whether selection on price undermines hearing-care quality, whether patients may lose devices they are satisfied with, whether child coverage should rise to 100%, and whether hearing care for the elderly was proposed for removal from the basic package. The minister says she cannot judge from a press report, expects price selection to lower premiums, points to a dispute protocol and calls on parties to improve it, decides on child co-payments in spring 2016, and says current policy will not change after the evaluation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over de voortdurende schending van arbeidsrechten bij de voorbereidingen voor het WK voetbal in Qatar

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the government about continued labour rights abuses of migrant workers in Qatar linked to World Cup preparations, including Amnesty's findings, journalist detentions, union rights, Dutch company monitoring and FIFA corruption. The Minister answered that the government shares concerns, sees early steps by Qatar, pressed for ratification of ILO conventions 87 and 98, and engages bilaterally, through the EU, with business and the NCP, while declining to pre-judge ongoing FIFA investigations.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the various investigations currently being conducted by the Swiss and American authorities.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op de verschillende onderzoeken door de Zwitserse en Amerikaanse autoriteiten die momenteel lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs asked the ministers why GPs in Reusel-De Mierden warn of rising resistant-bacteria infections in livestock farmers when RIVM data do not show it, whether data submission should be made mandatory, and whether the GGD study will be shared. The minister replied that RIVM data reflect local trends adequately, that laboratory participation is good and all relevant institutions will be connected by end 2015, that a letter on antibiotic resistance will follow before summer, and that the GGD will not publish a report.
The GGD Brabant-Zuidoost has indicated that it will not publish a report.
De GGD Brabant-Zuidoost heeft aangegeven dat zij geen rapport zullen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over toenemende goodwillpraktijken bij huisartsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about rising goodwill payments by young GPs taking over practices, the scale of the problem, insurers' contract clauses and possible legal measures. The Minister opposes goodwill, says its scale is unknown, notes only one insurer has a clause, and promises further analysis and a letter after the summer.
At present I am analysing what options there are to prevent goodwill. After the summer I will inform you again on this subject by letter.
Op dit moment analyseer ik welke mogelijkheden er zijn om goodwill te voorkomen. Na de zomer zal ik u per brief opnieuw over dit onderwerp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het afdwingen van euthanasie bij patiënten die volgens de behandelend arts wilsonbekwaam zijn

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister how a physician who barely knows a patient can override the treating doctors' judgement on the patient's competence in a request for euthanasia, and whether such cases occur. Minister Schippers answered that no specific cases are known, that competence is assessed per decision, that courts found the patient competent in a specific case, and that the regional review committees are bound by secrecy so the specific assessment cannot be disclosed.
Article 14 of the Termination of Life on Request and Assisted Suicide Act states that the regional review committees are bound to secrecy.
Artikel 14 van de Wtl stelt dat de Rte tot geheimhouding zijn verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de effectiviteit van campagnes voor orgaandonatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the effectiveness and cost of organ donation campaigns since 2008, citing reports that about 20 million euros was spent without raising registrations. The Minister confirmed roughly 20 million euros was spent, said registrations and transplant numbers have risen, and promised a new communication strategy and a letter to parliament before summer.
As promised in the AO on organ donation of 12 March, I will, if possible, send a letter to the House of Representatives before the summer about the new strategy.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO orgaandonatie van 12 maart jongstleden zal ik zo mogelijk voor de zomer een brief naar de Tweede Kamer sturen over de nieuwe strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de gezondheidsklachten bij mensen die in de buurt van stallen en boerderijen wonen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the 2015 NIVEL/IRAS findings on health complaints near livestock farms, and the lack of firm conclusions in the 2012 Health Council report, meant the government would set distance criteria or other health norms. The state secretary answered that evidence is still insufficient, pointed to the ongoing RIVM VGO study due in 2016 and the Wgv odour framework, and said action would be considered after that study.
After this study is completed in 2016, it will be examined whether additional measures regarding public health aspects are needed.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek in 2016, zal worden bezien of aanvullende maatregelen in relatie tot volksgezondheidsaspecten aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over het bericht dat de ingrijpende gevolgen van Q-koorts onderschat worden

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the health consequences of Q-fever, including chronic patients who may be overlooked, are being underestimated, and whether doctors' training, compensation and a general fund for future zoonosis outbreaks will be pursued. The Minister of Health answered that Q-fever remains serious, that Q-support and professional training will address recognition, rejected direct state compensation while promising to review arguments from patient groups, and saw no need for a general zoonosis fund.
I will of course carefully examine whether there are indeed more or different insights that could change the position.
Ik zal uiteraard zorgvuldig bezien of er inderdaad meer of andere inzichten zijn die het standpunt kunnen wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorgdirecteuren weigeren hulp aan loonsverlaging’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked why the sector association NVZD refuses to cooperate on a ministerial salary-cap regulation (staffel) for healthcare executives under the WNT, and whether the government will act despite this. The minister regrets the NVZD's stance, says consultation continues with the NVTZ and VWS so unilateral action is not needed, and commits to publishing the sector regulation in November 2015.
For that reason, unilateral adjustment of the regulation is not currently on the table.
Om die reden is eenzijdige aanpassing van de regeling op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de brief van de stomapoli van het Diakonessenziekenhuis te Leiden

An MP asked the health minister about a letter from a hospital stoma clinic on the role of stoma nurses, the choice of stoma materials, cost transparency and patients' recourse when a supplied device does not fit. The minister answered that insurers must meet their duty of care, that patients can ask for reconsideration and complain to SKGZ, and promised further information on a ZonMw study and talks with the NZa before summer.
It is for the health insurer to give substance to its duty of care for adequate aids for its insured.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om invulling te geven aan zijn zorgplicht voor adequate hulpmiddelen voor zijn verzekerde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de zorgmodule Pro Life

MP Arib (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health whether the Pro Life health insurance module, which excludes abortion, euthanasia and sex-reassignment surgery, is compatible with insurers' duty of care, and what it covers and excludes. The Minister answered that the exception in article 11(5) of the Health Insurance Act allows such modules, that insurers must contract sufficient care but may consider Christian identity, that the exclusions are clearly published, and that she sees no reason for further measures.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take further measures on this.
Gezien het voorgaande zie ik geen aanleiding hierop nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de signalen dat de verplichting van DigiD met SMS notificatie tot problemen leidt

SP MPs asked the ministers whether mandatory DigiD with SMS notification harms access to services, notably for low-literate people and for trustees (bewindvoerders) unable to act for clients. The minister answered that DigiD is personal, that health insurers use various declaration options, and that the ministry is studying electronic support for trustees, without any concrete new commitment.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is studying, together with various ministries and implementing organisations, which forms of electronic support in situations of authorisation and (statutory) representation are desirable and possible.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties onderzoekt in dit kader – in samenwerking met diverse ministeries en uitvoeringsorganisaties – welke vormen van elektronische ondersteuning in situaties van machtiging en (wettelijke) vertegenwoordiging wenselijk en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de lucratieve jacht op jeugdige voetbalspelers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views foreign clubs recruiting very young footballers, whether this amounts to child trafficking, and what is being done about FIFA rules and the age threshold. The minister said children should grow up in their familiar environment, that FIFA rules bar most under-18 international transfers, that the KNVB could not establish how many under-12 children moved abroad, that she supports extending approval to under-10s, and that the Netherlands cannot solve the problem alone given EU free movement.
The Netherlands cannot solve this problem independently.
Nederland kan zelfstandig dit probleem niet oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid De Lange over falende hartapparatuur bij de ambulancedienst Gelderland-Zuid

MP De Lange asked the health minister about reported failures of cardiac monitoring equipment at the Gelderland-Zuid ambulance service, including incident counts, similar cases elsewhere, and resolution timelines. The minister confirmed internal reports were made and the inspectorate is handling them, declined to discuss specifics while the inspectorate's review is ongoing, and said responsibility lies with the provider and manufacturer.
At this moment the IGZ is handling the report on this case. It is not possible to address this question substantively while the report is being handled.
Op dit moment behandelt de IGZ de melding over deze casuïstiek. Het is niet mogelijk inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vraag gedurende de behandeling van de melding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over haperende apparatuur van Gelderse ambulances

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about malfunctioning monitoring equipment in Gelderland ambulances, whether it is acceptable, who is responsible, and whether patient safety is at risk across all safety regions. The minister declined to comment on the specific case because the Inspectorate for Health Care is handling a report, pointed to the ambulance provider and manufacturer as responsible, and said the inspectorate will act if needed.
I therefore cannot go into the substance of the case.
Ik kan daarom niet inhoudelijk op de casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat AstraZeneca Hartpatiënten Nederland dreigt met een proces

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views AstraZeneca's threatened legal action against the patient organisation Hartpatiënten Nederland over its warnings about Onglyza, and about patients' right to information and the drug's safety. The minister answers that legal threats are unconstructive while dialogue continues, that patient groups may state views if well-founded, notes the CBG is reviewing the FDA safety analysis, and declines further action.
I do not find it constructive for the dialogue when legal proceedings are threatened at the same time.
Ik vind het voor de dialoog daarbij niet constructief wanneer er gelijktijdig met juridische procedures wordt gedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over naalden die lijm lekken

An MP asked the health minister why RIVM experts and doctors disagreed on health harms from glue leaking from injection needles, whether other manufacturers' needles also leak, who sets the acceptable leakage norm, how patients are informed, and whether monitoring of manufacturers' incident reporting is being improved. The minister answered that RIVM found no expected health harm, that other manufacturers' needles showed similar small amounts of residue, that the inspectorate wants limits added to the harmonised standard, that no patient information change is needed, and that the central adverse-event reporting point is being examined and will be reported by summer.
At the request of the IGZ, the RIVM conducted research into the health risks of the injection needles.
In opdracht van de IGZ heeft het RIVM onderzoek gedaan naar de gezondheidrisico's van de injectienaalden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de hoge premie voor de waddenheli

The MP Dik-Faber asks why the Friesland helicopter ambulance cost may raise premiums and whether insurers could exclude Frisians, and asks about the RAV Fryslân takeover of patient transport. Minister Schippers answers that the NZa will be instructed to use an availability contribution (beschikbaarheidbijdrage), that the required regulation change may not be ready by 1 July, and that retroactive effect will be considered.
To guarantee the availability of emergency ambulance transport for patients from the Frisian Wadden islands, I will ask the NZa to set an availability contribution.
Om de beschikbaarheid van spoedeisend ambulancevervoer voor patiënten van de Friese Waddeneilanden te garanderen zal ik de NZa vragen een beschikbaarheidbijdrage vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de bruine vloot en de mogelijkheden om in Denemarken te varen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the deadline for certifying Dutch sailing ships (the 'bruine vloot') to sail to Danish ports could be postponed to winter, and whether she would negotiate with Denmark. The minister replied that a formalised solution now lets such ships sail to Denmark on a declaration of compliance plus a certified safety management system due by year-end.
I am pleased to inform you that the solution proposal about which I informed you earlier has been formalised.
Met genoegen kan ik u melden dat het oplossingsvoorstel waarover ik u eerder heb geïnformeerd, is geformaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie steeds vaker te maken krijgt met verwarde en overspannen mensen

Two MPs asked whether rising police contact with confused persons reflects cuts to psychiatric beds, and about notifications from ministries and municipalities. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that no notifications from other ministries or municipalities were received, and that the bed reduction was not meant as savings and a misunderstanding about GGZ cuts exists.

As already announced, consultation will be held with the chain partners involved, focusing on relieving the police and identifying bottlenecks and improvements regarding confused persons on the street.

Zoals reeds aangekondigd zal overleg gevoerd worden met de bij het onderwerp betrokken ketenpartners, waarin zowel aandacht zal zijn voor het ontlasten van de politie als voor het inventariseren van knelpunten en het aandragen van verbeteringen met betrekking tot de verwarde personen op straat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Reumazorg verdwijnt uit Bravis-ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about the Bravis hospital's reumatologists leaving to set up their own treatment centre, including consequences for patients, staff and the hospital, and whether the hospital's governance played a role. The Minister responds that the hospital intends to keep rheumatology care and recruit new specialists, that patients can choose and insurers have contracted the new centre, and that the decision is the specialists' own, noting such splits can weaken regional hospitals.
It is the choice of the specialists concerned to take this step.
Het is de keuze van de betreffende specialisten om deze stap te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de verkoop van voetbalkaartjes via Marktplaats

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about the resale of football tickets on Marktplaats, including security risks, price inflation, fraud and the powers of clubs and the KNVB to stop it. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the KNVB can cancel invalid tickets and impose stadium bans, and concludes that further government intervention does not appear necessary for now.
No, this does not appear to be necessary for now.
Nee, dit lijkt vooralsnog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het dwingen van vrouwen om een abortus te doen plegen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health whether pressuring women into abortion is permitted, what criminal law applies, how the Public Prosecution Service handles such cases, and whether the government will take measures to prevent coerced abortions. The Minister answered that coercion is undesirable and that the abortion law requires voluntary, informed decisions, but that the criminal code has no specific provision and she sees no need for additional measures.
The Public Prosecution Service will have to determine, on the basis of a report, whether a criminal offence has taken place.
Het Openbaar Ministerie zal aan de hand van een aangifte moeten bepalen of er sprake is geweest van een strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het onder druk zetten van de cliëntenraad voor het programma ‘Anita wordt opgenomen’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the management of GGZ-Centraal pressured the client council into allowing the filming of the TV programme 'Anita wordt opgenomen', and about patient consent, possible damage claims, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister said pressure on the client council would be regrettable if proven, that the matter is for the supervisory board and the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden, that the IGZ would handle a new signal, and that medezeggenschap rules will be tightened.
It is not for me to assess whether the care provider exerted pressure on the client council to end the advisory process and whether (high) damage claims were discussed.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de zorgaanbieder daarbij druk heeft uitgeoefend op de cliëntenraad om het adviestraject te beëindigen en of er daarbij gesproken is over (hoge) schadeclaims.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de NIP-test (ingezonden 10 april 2015)

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about the societal effects of NIPT prenatal screening, its proportionality, counselling safeguards and abortion rates after Down syndrome diagnoses. The minister answered that an implementation study runs until April 2016, a Health Council advice on prenatal screening is expected in 2016, counselling and voluntary choice safeguards exist, and that the 2013 abortion data does not record diagnoses.
Furthermore, I have asked the Health Council for advice on the entire prenatal screening chain and the role and place of new developments therein.
Verder heb ik de Gezondheidsraad om advies gevraagd over de gehele prenatale screeningsketen en de rol en plaats van nieuwe ontwikkelingen daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over schadelijke stoffen in veel gekleurde tatoeage-inkten

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about harmful substances found in many coloured tattoo inks, the NVWA's enforcement record and fines, and whether the industry and the 'Think before you ink' campaign will be engaged. The Minister answered that harmful substances should not be in inks, that fines are 525 euro with a 50% recidive surcharge, that she does not plan to raise fine levels, and that she will consult the NVWA and the tattoo industry on related points.
I do not intend to raise these fine amounts.
Ik ben niet voornemens deze boetebedragen te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de progressieve spierziekte ALS

An MP asked the government about municipal knowledge of ALS, support and equipment for patients, Wmo procedure delays, carer support and leave, and podiatry coverage. The minister answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015 for tailored support, that patient organisations and the VNG should disseminate ALS knowledge and parties will consult on guidance, and that carer leave rules are being extended from 1 July.
Under the Wmo 2015, municipalities have the responsibility to provide appropriate support to people who are dependent on it.
Gemeenten hebben op grond van de Wmo 2015 de verantwoordelijkheid mensen, die hier op aangewezen zijn, passende ondersteuning te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over niet-westerse vrouwen die zich te laat melden bij de verloskundige

An MP asks the health minister why non-Western pregnant women register late with midwives, what is being done to reverse this and whether best practices will be made the norm. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing programmes and says she has no plans for specific measures in big cities and that setting a field norm is up to the sector.
I currently have no plans to introduce specific measures in the big cities.
Ik heb op dit moment geen plannen om specifieke maatregelen in grote steden in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kleine ziekenhuizen: Grote Financiële nood’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a BDO report showing financial strain at small hospitals, including the 'stress test' results, the role of the macro-control instrument and the availability allowance. The Minister answered that hospitals must manage their finances themselves, that small hospitals are less resilient but can remain viable, that the availability allowance criteria will be revised and that the macro-control instrument is a last resort, with a letter to follow.
I have informed your House about the macro-control instrument in my letter of 31 March 2015.
Over het macrobeheersinstrument heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd met brief van 31 maart 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van vogelgriep in Barneveld

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government about a bird flu outbreak in Barneveld, including preventive culling, animal welfare in culling, the broeder transport ban, and the Wet dieraantallen en volksgezondheid and Brabantwet. The state secretary answered that no preventive culling occurred, that vaccination is not yet a feasible alternative, that the sector must prepare for transport bans, and that the outbreak does not warrant the Brabant law's use in Gelderland.
No animals have been preventively culled on farms surrounding the infected company.
Er zijn geen dieren preventief geruimd op bedrijven rondom het besmette bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de abortuspil bij de huisarts

An MP asked the health minister about allowing GPs to perform medication abortion, citing Women on Waves' view that early pregnancy is not legally covered, and about access, counseling and registration. The minister said she disagrees that the situation causes unrest or that access is problematic, but is willing to consult stakeholders on whether GP treatment adds value, provided quality and safety are not compromised.
I would like to look at the added value of treatment by the GP.
Daarom wil ik graag kijken naar de meerwaarde van behandeling door de huisarts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Aantal abortussen in Duitsland weer gedaald’

An SGP MP asked the health minister why German abortions fell 25% over ten years while Dutch numbers did not, and whether Dutch policy should change to reduce abortions, including counselling and waiting-period issues. The minister said the causes of the German decline are unknown, saw no need for extra measures, pointed to existing counselling guidance, and declined to bring forward the abortion-motives study due in 2016.
I do not intend to take additional measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens om extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het dopingrapport van de UCI (Internationale Wielrenunie)

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the UCI cycling doping report, including the role of government investigative powers, the reporting of doctors to the IGZ, and European coordination. The Minister confirmed the report's findings, explained that criminal investigative powers apply to doping-related offences but not to doping use itself, noted that tuchtrechter referral does not require IGZ reporting, and pointed to existing European anti-doping cooperation.
For taking a case to the disciplinary court, reporting to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is not necessary.
Voor een gang naar de tuchtrechter is melding bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over psychiaters en psychotherapeuten die weigeren contracten te tekenen met zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the minister about psychiatrists and psychotherapists refusing contracts with health insurers, insurers' control over treatment techniques, ROM data benchmarking, privacy of medical data used by insurers (including for mortgages), and complaint routes. The minister defends contracting as the quality and cost vehicle, says insurers may only assess whether treatments meet standards, describes ROM and the benchmark as safeguarded and generally non-uniform, denies misuse of data for mortgages, and cites statutory privacy protections and NZa rules, promising a bill and AMvB to be submitted later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over late abortussen in België

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister about reports that more Dutch couples travel to Belgium for late abortions and whether Dutch guidance and support are adequate. The minister said such travel is undesirable, gave the available case figures, and said the national late-termination regulation will be revised to address the gaps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Tanamal over het bericht ‘ “Anita wordt opgenomen” kwam tot stand na dreigementen Cliëntenraad’

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the client council of a mental health provider was pressured into consenting to a TV programme, whether the supervisory board was involved, and how client council participation can be strengthened. The minister declined to launch an investigation, saying disputes go to the LCvV and the kantonrechter, but announced plans to tighten client council rules, including consent rights and IGZ inspection of compliance.
I consider it important that administrators comply with the rules of the Wmcz and take the client perspective into account in decision-making.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat bestuurders de regels van de Wmcz in acht nemen en het perspectief van cliënten meenemen in de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht 'Hulplijn slaat alarm om hulpeloze ggz-patiënten'

An MP asked the health minister how people with mental health problems are referred to the right care within the Treek norms, whether she recognises capacity problems and insurers failing their duty of care, and how treatment plans fit client needs. The minister said she takes the signals seriously, will send a reaction on acute mental health care soon, and will convene chain partners on care for confused persons, while saying she has no other signals on treatment plans and pointing to the WGBO and client organisations.
Health insurers are obliged to purchase sufficient care so that people receive the care they need and can obtain it within a reasonable time.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn gehouden voldoende zorg in te kopen, zodat mensen zorg ontvangen die zij nodig hebben en deze ook binnen redelijke termijn kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een toenemend aantal schrijnende verhalen door wachtlijsten in de GGZ

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health about reports that GGZ (mental health) patients face long waiting lists and are left without timely care, and about the role of the helpline Sensoor. The Minister acknowledged the signals, promised a response on acute care and a chain-wide review with the Justice Minister, but said the signals were contradictory, lacked waiting-list figures from the patient federation, and that the Nza analysis would follow in June.
Regarding acute GGZ care, I will shortly send you my response in order to realise improvements here.
Met betrekking tot de zorg in de acute GGZ zend ik u binnenkort mijn reactie om hier verbeteringen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de gevolgen van omzetplafonds in de zorg

Member Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the Minister of Health whether turnover caps (omzetplafonds) in healthcare could create waiting lists, how insurers inform insured persons, what volumes are purchased, and who pays for ongoing treatment when a cap is reached. The Minister answered that insurers must meet their duty of care by mediating to other providers or making extra agreements, that she sees no current risk of waiting lists, and that the NZa supervises insurers' purchasing and information duties.
It is up to the NZa to supervise this.
Het is aan de NZa om hierop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers whether they share concern from Reusel-De Mierden GPs about rising multiresistant infections and requested an overview of infection trends in Noord-Brabant. The minister replied that Brabant infection rates are not higher than elsewhere in the Netherlands, no regional data for Reusel-De Mierden is available, and an integrated antibiotic resistance approach letter will follow before summer.
Separate data for Reusel-De Mierden are currently not available to us.
Aparte gegevens voor Reusel-De Mierden zijn bij ons op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voorgenomen sluiting van de enige nachtapotheek in de regio De Langstraat

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the only night pharmacy in De Langstraat, its effect on 45-minute access norms, the HAP/SEH merger and regional plans. The minister replied that insurers are responsible for contracting out-of-hours pharmaceutical care, that emergency medication remains available via Tilburg and Den Bosch pharmacies and GPs, that no statutory distance norm exists, and that the regional plans were abandoned by insurers in 2014.
Whether insurers comply with their duty of care is for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Vee heeft invloed op gezondheid’

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about preliminary research suggesting livestock farming affects residents' health, and whether a moratorium on new large stables should follow. The government replied that the findings are not conclusive, that the study will finish in 2016, that no measures are warranted now, and that permitting is a decentralised matter.
That means the interim results are not a basis for taking any measures at this time.
Dat betekent dat de tussentijdse resultaten geen basis zijn om op dit moment maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Iedereen kiest opeens voor dure beugel; orthodontist krikt omzet op ondanks lagere tarieven’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why orthodontists' revenue rose despite two 16% tariff cuts, whether patients are choosing pricier braces, and whether the NZa and Consumentenbond complaint action will reveal practice variation and over-billing. The minister attributes the revenue rise to material cost growth, a 2.6% rise in patient numbers and more partial treatments, says the decoupling of material costs lets patients choose pricier braces, and notes the complaint portal closes in April with the NZa to assess whether further measures are needed.
This complaint action does not provide insight into practice variation.
Met deze meldactie wordt geen inzicht gegeven in de praktijkvariatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het TTIP vrijhandelsverdrag en het Nederlandse zorgstelsel

Two MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP's health-services reservation protects the Dutch healthcare system, whether UKIP-style investor claims against national health policy are a risk, and whether the government will pursue opt-outs and more individual choice in health insurance. The government replied that the EU reserves the right to regulate publicly funded health services, that investor protection rules apply only to breaches of standards with compensation for expropriation, that the Netherlands seeks maximum policy freedom, and that no opt-outs are needed because healthcare remains a national competence.
As a result, EU Member States can themselves determine how they organise their public services.
Hierdoor kunnen EU Lidstaten zelf bepalen hoe zij hun publieke diensten inrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over voetbalgeweld door zichzelf Feyenoord-supporters noemende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked about Dutch Feyenoord supporters rioting in Rome, Dutch mayors' powers to impose restrictions for conduct abroad, EU options to deport or ban convicted hooligans, Italian fine enforcement, and Engeland's travel bans. The government answered that mayors may consider foreign conduct under art. 172a Gemeentewet, that EU deportation is limited to genuine threats to public order, that Italy may seek Dutch help on fines after judgments become final, and that it will raise an international stadium ban in EU and Council of Europe fora.
I will ask the European Union and the Council of Europe to pay attention to establishing an international stadium ban and to explore other options to prevent hooligans from causing problems abroad.

Ik vraag binnen de Europese Unie en de Raad van Europa aandacht voor het tot stand brengen van een internationaal stadionverbod en voor het onderzoeken van andere mogelijkheden om te voorkomen dat hooligans in het buitenland voor problemen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Levenseindekliniek voor de vierde keer in een jaar is berispt

Arib asks the minister how the Levenseindekliniek can be repeatedly reprimanded, whether an independent study of the clinic is needed before the 2016 evaluation, and when a psychiatrist will sit on the regional review committees for complex euthanasia cases. The minister says four reprimands concern separate cases, that existing VUMC/AMC research and the 2016 evaluation suffice without a new study, and that two new physician members (a psychiatrist and an elderly-care specialist) are nominated for appointment.
On the four individual cases I will not comment, given the ongoing investigations by the Public Prosecution Service and the Health Care Inspectorate.
Op de vier individuele casus ga ik niet in lopende de onderzoeken van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Levenseindekliniek niet blij met ‘gebrek aan nuance’ bij toetsing’

MPs Dijkstra and Tellegen asked the Health Minister about a report that the euthanasia clinic objected to the 'onzorgvuldig' label used by review committees even where only procedural shortcomings existed, and about whether doctors can demonstrate no alternative treatment was possible. The minister acknowledged that the terminology can create a non-nuanced picture, said it would be discussed with the committees, explained the review process and the referral to the IGZ and Public Prosecution Service, and said a forthcoming code of practice will clarify how the care criteria are applied.
I will therefore discuss the use of this terminology in a periodic consultation with the Rte.
Ik zal daarom in een periodieke overleg met de Rte het gebruik van deze terminologie bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het oordeel ‘onzorgvuldig’ door de toetsingscommissies euthanasie

An MP asks why the regional euthanasia review committees again judged a Levenseindekliniek euthanasia case 'onzorgvuldig' and whether the committees overstep by nuancing that judgment, and asks the government to act against the clinic and order an independent investigation. The minister replies that the committees only assess compliance with the statutory due-care criteria, that the case has been referred to the IGZ and the Public Prosecution Service which must decide independently, and that she sees no grounds for measures or an independent investigation at this stage.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitspraken van de secretaris van de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie (RTE)

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the RTE euthanasia review committees' secretary was right to say the term 'onzorgvuldig' (not careful) gives a wrong impression, and whether her remarks undermine the committees' statutory role and the euthanasia care standards. The Minister refers to earlier answers, says the RTE use 'zorgvuldig/onzorgvuldig' only in summaries and annual reports for readability, that this may give a nuanced picture misleadingly in the media, that the Levenseindekliniek has no influence on the independent RTE, and that she will discuss the terminology with the RTE in periodic consultation.
I will therefore discuss the use of this terminology with the RTE in a periodic consultation with them.
Ik zal daarom in een periodiek overleg met de Rte met hen het gebruik van deze terminologie bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over materiële controles door zorgverzekeraars bij huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether Achmea's statistically triggered material audits of GP practices, including detailed checks that may breach medical confidentiality, are justified, and raised related issues such as terminal-care limits and a contractual gag clause. The Minister replied that audits follow a statutory stepwise procedure with privacy safeguards, that the insurer had communicated poorly in one case, and that she will ask the NZa to review insurers' contracting models and will look into the gag clause.
Health insurers themselves determine how they carry out material audits within the applicable laws and regulations.
Zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf hoe zij binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving de materiële controles uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘Ouderen in problemen door budgetpolis’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about reports that older people with budget health insurance policies can only order medicines online, causing problems for less mobile and less internet-capable patients, especially outside cities. The minister says insurers must ensure adequate care access and inform policyholders, that the NZa is investigating budget policies, and that transparency will be improved.
An insurer providing care in kind must have contracted sufficient care for policyholders who choose the budget policy to meet its duty of care: within reasonable distance and a reasonable time.

Een zorgverzekeraar die zorg in natura levert moet voor de verzekerden die kiezen voor de budgetpolis voldoende zorg hebben ingekocht om aan zijn zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen: binnen redelijke afstand en redelijke termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat basiszorg voor daklozen een urgent probleem is

Ms Leijten (SP) asked the minister how to respond to a study of street doctors showing poor healthcare access for homeless people, including questions on registration, identification barriers, and coordination. Minister Schippers replied that existing rights and municipal responsibilities suffice, gave no new counts or uniform registration, and promised only a talk with the Dutch street doctors group.
In the short term, talks will be held with the Dutch street doctors group to further exchange views on the bottlenecks they encounter in practice.
Op korte termijn zal met de Nederlandse straatdoktersgroep in gesprek worden gegaan om nader van gedachten te wisselen over de knelpunten die zij in de praktijk tegen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Tanamal over het passeren van een cliëntenraad van een GGZ instelling bij tv-opnamen

MPs Bouwmeester and Tanamal asked the health minister whether a mental health institution overrode its client council by allowing TV filming, and requested the facts and the council's role. Minister Schippers answered that the advisory right must be taken seriously, that the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden ruled in the council's favour, that the board ignored the advice, and that the Wmcz client participation rules will be tightened.
However, I agree with the commission that client privacy is very important and that the client council must be able to have serious say on such matters.
Ik ben echter met de commissie van mening dat privacy van cliënten zeer belangrijk is en dat de cliëntenraad op dergelijke onderwerpen serieus inspraak moet kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de inspectie niet in actie kwam na de dood van een psychiatrisch patiënt

An MP asked whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) failed to act after a psychiatric patient died during coercive care, and why it let the care provider investigate first. The minister confirmed the IGZ initially delegated the investigation under its guidelines, later decided to investigate itself, said the probe is ongoing with results expected mid-year, and declined to support the family's legal action beyond pointing to legal aid options.
The IGZ investigation is still ongoing at this time.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ loopt op dit moment nog.
