Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling betaalt 3 ton voor interimmer’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a care institution's interim director, placed via agency Boer&Croon, was paid above the WNT pay cap by signing a contract in December 2012 before the law took effect. The minister confirmed the pay exceeded the norm but said transitional law applies, so no recovery is possible, and that the CIBG has looked into the case.
There is an excess over the maximum pay norm of the WNT, but because the pay was agreed before the law entered into force, it falls under transitional law.
Er is sprake van een overschrijding van de maximum bezoldigingsnorm van de WNT, maar omdat de bezoldiging voor de inwerkingtreding van de wet is overeengekomen, valt deze onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het onderzoek van ActiZ naar de inkoop wijkverpleging 2015

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about an ActiZ study showing large volume cuts (up to 40%) imposed by health insurers on district nursing providers in 2015, and the resulting threats to waiting lists, specialised care, budgets and contract terms. The state secretary answered that the cuts are within the agreed framework, insurers have a duty of care, budgets are monitored, and the issue of splitting segment 1 and 2 will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.
The NZa supervises health insurers' implementation of the Zvw and enforces when necessary.
De NZa houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de Zvw door zorgverzekeraars en handhaaft wanneer noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van het openbaar maken van het calamiteitenrapport van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over de casus Tuitjenhorn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the IGZ calamity report on the Tuitjenhorn case, which concerns euthanasia practice, was not yet made public and whether it could clarify matters before the evaluation commission reports. Minister Schippers answered that the report will be sent to parliament together with the commission's report on 31 March 2015, with some passages redacted for privacy, and that publication was delayed to avoid obstructing the independent investigation.
In line with the previously announced intention, the Minister of Security and Justice and I will send the IGZ calamity report to your House together with the commission's report.

Conform het eerder aan uw Kamer gemelde voornemen, zullen de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik het calamiteitenrapport van de IGZ, gezamenlijk met het rapport van de commissie, aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat zorgcentrum Vinkenoord mogelijk de deuren moet sluiten

An MP asked whether residents of care centre Vinkenoord would have adequate alternative care if the centre closed due to financial problems, and whether local initiatives could help. The state secretary answered that the care reform keeps people in the region, that local closures are situational, and that the national government supports citizen initiatives mainly through the right to challenge in the Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de etikettering van vruchtendranken

An MP asked the Health Minister about misleading labelling of fruit drinks, including whether front-of-pack names must match the main fruit content and whether naming rules should change. The minister said misleading labels are banned, the NVWA judges case by case, and she will consult European counterparts and industry on possible stricter rules and on naming the main fruit on the front of packs.
I will check with my European colleagues how they deal with these kinds of situations and whether they have specific laws and regulations for them.
Daarom zal ik bij mijn Europese collega’s nagaan hoe zij met dit soort situaties omgaan en of zij hiervoor specifieke wet- en regelgeving kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de verkoop van bedorven slavinken

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government would act on a Consumentenbond finding that some supermarket sliced chicken (slavinken) was spoiled before its use-by date and was too high in salt and saturated fat, and how the NVWA inspects such products. The minister answered that the NVWA intervenes when it finds spoiled products, sanctions and sampling are described, the NVWA is not at fault, and salt and fat matters are handled through a voluntary industry accord.
I will discuss the results of the research in the steering group of the Accord.
Ik zal de resultaten van het onderzoek in de stuurgroep van het Akkoord bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over de financiële situatie van kleine ziekenhuizen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister about the financial position of small hospitals, the BDO benchmark finding many in financial danger, their share in shrink regions, the 10-point plan, a availability subsidy, administrative burden, uniform indicators and mergers. The minister acknowledged the report, said hospital boards bear responsibility for their finances, promised to consider regional care and administrative burden measures, and declined to commit to a funding subsidy or hard agreements on indicators.
I consider it important that basic care remains available nearby.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat basiszorg dichtbij beschikbaar blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de praktijken van het AOT Instituut en de heer Barry W.

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the unproven addiction treatments at AOT Instituut and whether the IGZ and advertising rules can act against them. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ has no basis under current law to intervene unless harm is proven, that insurers set their own supplementary packages, and that a planned quality law (Wkkgz) would let the IGZ act on excesses.
The IGZ can only act against irresponsible treatment methods if there is a demonstrable link between the harm caused and the (alternative) treatment.
De IGZ kan alleen dan optreden tegen onverantwoorde behandelwijzen, als er sprake is van een aantoonbare relatie tussen ontstane schade en de (alternatieve) behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Arts weer aan de slag ondanks moordpoging’

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Van Wijngaarden asked the health minister how she views reports that a doctor returned to work despite a murder attempt, whether BIG-registered professionals convicted of serious offences should be barred from patient contact, and how this relates to equal treatment with non-registered care workers. The minister said disciplinary matters are for the independent disciplinary judge, announced tuchtrecht extensions and a mandatory VOG requirement for care workers handling vulnerable patients.

I intend to regulate, through a general administrative order under the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, that employers are obliged to require care workers who wish to work at their institution to present a Certificate of Conduct (VOG).

Ik ben voornemens binnen de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg met een algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen dat werkgevers verplicht worden om zorgverleners die bij hun zorginstelling aan de slag willen, een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) te laten overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over feit dat geneesmiddelenfabrikanten de prijzen van geneesmiddelen hebben opgedreven, en de kosten voor geneesmiddelen hebben verhoogd

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the Health Minister about manufacturers raising drug prices, including hospital discounts versus higher outpatient prices, evergreening, and the ACM report, and whether reference pricing, the GVS reimbursement system, or prescriber behaviour should change. Minister Schippers largely defended existing policy, pointed to pending GVS recalculation and ongoing agreements with prescribers, and promised a broader approach with proposals in the autumn.
I will take the ACM's recommendations into account in the broader approach I referred to in my answer to questions 5 and 6.
Ik zal de aanbevelingen van ACM betrekken bij de bredere aanpak waar ik in mijn antwoord op vragen 5 en 6 naar verwees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck gelanceerd’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the launch of the Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck, a preventive health check, raising concerns about false reassurance, legality under the population screening law, commercial interests, unequal access and unnecessary care. The minister answered that the check is lawful in its current form, that its effects on health gains are not yet known and will be monitored, and that the Health Council is advising on health check criteria.
Whether large-scale application of such an instrument actually yields health gains, we do not yet know.
Of grootschalig toepassen van een dergelijk instrument ook daadwerkelijk gezondheidswinst oplevert, weten we nog niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het betrekken van ouders bij beslissing levenseinde kind

An MP asked the Health Minister whether parents should be more involved in end-of-life decisions for seriously ill children, and about the status of the paediatricians' association's position on child euthanasia and a support point for such decisions. The minister agreed parents should be involved, pointed to existing professional norms and a forthcoming paediatric association position and study, and said a support point would be considered in that study.
I consider it of great importance that parents are involved in decisions surrounding the end of life of their child.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat ouders betrokken worden bij beslissingen rondom het levenseinde van hun kind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van onderzoek naar effectiviteit en veiligheid van nieuwe antistollingsmiddelen

Two SP MPs asked why, more than two years after the introduction of NOACs (new anticoagulants), no independent safety, effectiveness and cost-effectiveness research has been completed, and raised conflict-of-interest concerns about the lead researcher. The minister replied that a pilot was run, a more demanding methodology is being developed by ZonMw and the researchers, Lareb monitors side effects, and that current evidence gives no reason to change the conclusion that the drugs are appropriately used.
It is not the case that research into the effectiveness and safety has failed to materialise.
Het is niet zo dat het onderzoek naar de effectiviteit en veiligheid uitgebleven is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het plotseling niet meer vergoeden van een aantal geneesmiddelen

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Bouwmeester ask why health insurers suddenly stopped reimbursing about 300-400 compounded medicines from 1 March 2015, how the IGZ supervises compounded supplies, and whether the Zorginstituut should rule on them. Minister Schippers admits the insurers' communication was poor and promises to raise it with them, says the IGZ checks compounding dossiers by sampling, and states that disputed cases will go to talks and possibly the Zorginstituut.
I have addressed Zorgverzekeraars Nederland on this.
Ik heb Zorgverzekeraars Nederland hierop aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Sociale Dienst eist van huisartsen dossier op

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister how she assessed reports that a municipal social services department in Eindhoven pressured GPs and patients to hand over medical files, and what steps would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is primarily the responsibility of the municipality, referred to the municipality's answers to council questions, and stated that the municipal council considers its conduct to be within current law.
This matter is primarily the responsibility of the municipality of Eindhoven.
Deze zaak is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Eindhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Drankje tegen Alzheimer Souvenaid te snel op de markt’

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether Souvenaid was marketed too early, whether industry influence (Nutricia, Deltaplan Dementie) compromises research independence, and about dementia prevalence figures. Minister Schippers answered that the NVWA concluded Souvenaid does not meet the medical dietary food definition and enforcement has started, that ZonMw's conflict-of-interest codes and transparency register provide sufficient safeguards, and that prevalence estimates broadly align with international studies.
The NVWA investigation has been completed. The NVWA concluded that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of food for special medical purposes.
Het onderzoek van de NVWA is afgerond. De NVWA heeft geconcludeerd dat Souvenaid niet voldoet aan de definitie van dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked about long-term effects of Q fever, including whether the government will settle claims with patients outside court and reach an amicable settlement. The minister acknowledged the health burden, pointed to support via Stichting Q-support and research funding, but stated the state accepts no liability and sees no reason for an amicable settlement.
According to the State, however, there is no question of unlawful conduct as a result of which Q-fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

An MP asked why livestock farmers can claim compensation for animal disease outbreaks while people made ill by Q fever cannot, and whether the government will pay damages to Q fever victims. The minister replied that Dutch law places own-damage risk on individuals with solidarity-based health care, that farmers receive culling compensation from the Animal Health Fund but not consequential losses, and that the state sees no unlawful act and therefore no reason for damages, though it funded the Q-support foundation.
According to the State, there is however no unlawful act as a result of which Q fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over willekeur bij toetsing euthanasie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about inconsistent SCEN-doctor assessments of euthanasia requests from patients without a short-term terminal illness, and whether stricter verification or revision of the KNMG guideline is needed. The Minister acknowledged the study, said complete uniformity is unrealistic given individual judgment, rejected limiting the SCEN doctor to verifying hopeless suffering, and committed to discussing whether the KNMG guideline still fits current practice.
I will discuss with the KNMG whether the guideline still sufficiently fits the current way the law is applied.
Ik zal met de KNMG in gesprek gaan of de richtlijn nog voldoende aansluit bij de huidige wijze waarop invulling wordt gegeven aan de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over een voor het bezit van kinderporno veroordeelde psychiater die werkt met misbruikte patiënten

MPs asked whether a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography continued to treat patients with histories of sexual abuse, and whether the Public Prosecution Service informs the Health Inspectorate about such convictions. The minister confirmed the psychiatrist treated such a patient, that the Inspectorate now refers such cases to the disciplinary judge, and that a revised cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service is being prepared, with a promise to finish it within months.
Following the tightened position, the IGZ and the OM are working intensively on renewing the cooperation protocol.
Naar aanleiding van het aangescherpte standpunt werken de IGZ en het OM intensief aan het vernieuwen van het samenwerkingsprotocol.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over de rol van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bij een psychiater die veroordeeld is voor het bezit van kinderporno en nog

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked how the health inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) handled a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography who kept practising, and whether the employer should have been informed. The ministers answered that the IGZ was informed in 2012, opened an investigation and a supervision plan, took a disciplinary case in 2014, and that the OM-IGZ cooperation protocol is being revised to allow sharing of such information.

From the standpoint of patient safety, my view is that possessing, distributing or viewing child pornography by healthcare professionals is so transgressive that it poses a risk to patient safety, and that the convicted psychiatrist should have informed his employer of his conviction.

Vanuit oogpunt van de patiëntveiligheid is mijn standpunt dat het, verspreiden of bekijken van kinderporno door zorgprofessionals dermate grensoverschrijdend is dat het een risico vormt voor de veiligheid van patiënten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over “patiënten met een armenpolis die steeds vaker bij moeten betalen na een behandeling in het ziekenhuis”

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about patients with budget health insurance policies who are increasingly billed by hospitals after treatment, asking about scale, costs, insurer information duties and contracting obligations. The minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders, that data is being requested from insurers and an NVZ survey found affected patients at 73% of hospitals, that a hospital portal is being developed, and that reintroducing a contracting obligation is undesirable.
I have no data on the number of people who use the option of installment payments linked to bills not reimbursed by the health insurer because the care was not contracted.

Ik heb geen gegevens over het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen, dat samenhangt met rekeningen die niet vergoed worden door de zorgverzekeraar omdat er geen sprake is van gecontracteerde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Amateurclub OFC naar de top dankzij dubieuze geldschieter’ en ‘De bad boys van Young Boys’

An MP asked whether amateur football clubs are protected against criminal influence, match-fixing and money laundering, and whether investigations into OFC's sponsor and into other clubs would be opened. The minister answered that preventive measures and new legislation on doping and gambling are in preparation, that clubs can make their own rules, and that no comment can be made on ongoing criminal investigations.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Oefenwedstrijden Nederlandse teams in Spanje mogelijk gefixt”

An MP asked whether Dutch sports teams' friendly matches abroad may have been fixed and about the status of the justice investigation into match-fixing. The Minister replied that the OM continuously reviews signals, cannot disclose ongoing investigations, that five suspects were recently arrested, and that measures against match-fixing are being implemented with the sports sector.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health whether she shares concern that the Levenseindekliniek is again under scrutiny after a third notification was judged careless, whether she will talk with the clinic, and whether an independent investigation into its functioning will follow. The minister answered that the Inspectie and the Openbaar Ministerie are responsible for assessing the case, that she sees no reason to talk with the clinic, and that she already explained in an earlier reply why no additional investigation is needed.
I do not consider it opportune to discuss this case with the Levenseindekliniek.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om over deze casus in gesprek te gaan met de Levenseindekliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slechte score op voedselveiligheid van visbedrijven

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about the poor food safety scores of fish processing firms, the NVWA's inspection frequency and capacity, the classification of Foppen as 'red' despite earlier praise from the Safety Board, and why inspection reports are published later for processors than auctions. Minister Schippers acknowledged the share of 'green' firms is too low, defended the inspection system and its risk-based frequency, declined to disclose individual firm inspection results, and committed to adding inspectors and publishing reports from 2015-2016.
I do not inform the House about the individual inspection results.
Ik informeer de Kamer niet over de individuele inspectieresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over collectieve zorgverzekeringen waarbij chronisch zieken geen baat hebben (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden bijlage)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about chronically ill people not benefiting from municipal collective health insurance, the loss of compensation schemes, and the removal of long-term physiotherapy for rheumatism from the basic package. The minister rejected the premise, said municipalities have been expanding collective schemes and bear responsibility for support, and maintained that evidence for long-term physiotherapy is insufficient while remaining open to a study.
Due to the multitude of factors, it is not feasible to give a clear picture of the costs and their development.
Door de veelheid van factoren is het niet doenlijk om een duidelijk beeld van de kosten en de ontwikkeling daarin te schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de defecte Spijkenisserbrug, die cruciaal is voor ambulances

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health whether ambulance access to Voorne-Putten is at risk given repeated stoppages of the Spijkenisse bridge, and what will be done about pressure on emergency staff and the lack of a 24/7 emergency department in Spijkenisse. The Minister replied that partners report no disruption to ambulance care or measurable effect on response times, that Rijkswaterstaat and the province have arranged a backup via the Hartel bridge, and that the Inspectorate has received no incident reports.
The parties involved have informed me that the stoppages of the past period have not yet led to disruptions of ambulance care on Voorne Putten.
De betrokken partijen hebben mij laten weten dat de stremmingen van de afgelopen periode nog niet hebben geleid tot verstoringen van de ambulancezorg op Voorne Putten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de behandeling van mensen die zichzelf beschadigen op de spoedeisende hulp (SEH)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Health Minister, after a documentary on self-harming patients' treatment at emergency departments, how the government views unsedated stitching, refusals, dismissive remarks by staff, unreported complaints, and training. Minister Schippers condemned the reported conduct, said the IGZ is examining signals received via the national complaints office, and offered to encourage patients to report, while noting the NVSHA does not recognise the picture.
The IGZ takes these signals seriously. Within a few weeks the IGZ will consider what it can do with the picture from the signals.
De IGZ neemt deze signalen serieus. Binnen een aantal weken beziet de IGZ wat ze met het beeld uit de signalen kan en gaat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending Beschadigd

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister about a documentary on self-harm and negative experiences of patients at emergency departments, covering prevalence, treatment, the quality of care and training, and whether 'no self-harm' contracts are used. The Minister finds the treatment unacceptable, reports that the IGZ is examining signals received via the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg and will act within weeks, and says she has no insight into the use of such contracts.
Within a few weeks the IGZ will consider what it can and will do with the picture from the signals.
Binnen een aantal weken beziet de IGZ wat ze met het beeld uit de signalen kan en gaat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet vergoed krijgen van medisch noodzakelijke plastische chirurgie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about medically necessary plastic surgery no longer covered in basic insurance, citing cases such as a teenager with Poland syndrome and an older woman with drooping eyelids. The minister replied that the 2005 restrictions aim to prevent cosmetic procedures being billed as necessary, that she has no plans to widen coverage now, and that specialists must first show they use care appropriately.
I currently have no plans to expand coverage of plastic surgery in health insurance or to loosen the existing limited coverage.
Ik heb momenteel geen plannen om de vergoeding van plastische chirurgie in de zorgverzekering uit te breiden of de bestaande beperkte vergoeding te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de ingangsdatum van de subsidieregeling energiebelasting voor sportverenigingen

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the energy-tax refund for sports clubs is being abolished, whether clubs face higher costs in 2015 with no refund or subsidy available for that year, and how provinces and clubs are affected. The minister replied that the 2014 refund is still paid in 2015, the new energy-saving subsidy starts 1 January 2016 with no transitional compensation, and the change is designed to reward sustainability investment and is compatible with provincial schemes.
No compensation can be claimed for the calendar year 2015.
Over het kalenderjaar 2015 kan geen compensatie worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “Het Radboud UMC weigert orgaandonatie na euthanasie”

MP Arib asked the Minister of Health whether Radboud UMC refused organ donation after euthanasia for lack of a treatment relationship, and whether the rules and hospital conduct were adequate. The minister answered that both procedures were handled carefully, that communication to the patient was unclear, that all parties had said no obstacles existed, and that existing law is sufficient while a practical guideline is welcomed.
I therefore consider this legislation sufficiently appropriate for the combination of organ donation after euthanasia, especially given the sequential nature of the procedures.
Ik acht deze wetgeving dan ook voldoende passend voor de combinatie van orgaandonatie na euthanasie, zeker gelet op de volgtijdelijkheid van de procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tellegen over geen donatie na euthanasie

An MP asks the health minister about the legal framework, the draft guideline and the Radboud hospital's refusal to cooperate in combining euthanasia with organ donation, and the potential donor pool. The minister explains the two separate procedures, says the guideline is a field initiative still under review, states the hospitals were willing to proceed and no information on the donor potential is available.
No, I have no insight into that.
Nee, daar heb ik geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de herkomstetikettering op vlees

MP Dikkers (PvdA) asked the Health Minister whether the government would act on a European Parliament resolution calling for mandatory origin labelling of meat in processed products, and would amend the Dutch Warenwet to require it now. Minister Schippers said she supports origin labelling at EU level, will press for it in the Council, but will not amend the Warenwet in advance because a single EU market requires EU-wide rules.
Once this subject is on the agenda of the relevant Council in Brussels, the above-mentioned position will be put forward.
Zodra dit onderwerp op de agenda staat bij de betreffende Raad in Brussel, zal bovengenoemd standpunt ingebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitzending met betrekking tot het gerommel met zwemdiploma’s

The SP MP Van Nispen asks the minister of Health about quality differences between Dutch swimming diplomas, the lack of clear rules allowing anyone to run swimming lessons and issue diplomas, and the implementation of a motion on a swimming-skills research programme. Minister Schippers acknowledges concerns shared by the sector, says a sector-wide consultation took place and that the sector will work on a common approach, with results to be reported to parliament by summer 2015.
I share your concerns about the increased variety of swimming diplomas and the lack of clarity about quality requirements.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de toegenomen verscheidenheid aan zwemdiploma’s en de onduidelijkheid rond de kwaliteitseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Tilburg dreigt zorgbedrijven met topinkomens’

Two MPs asked whether Tilburg will stop subsidising care institutions with staff paid above a minister's salary from 2016, and what central government is doing to support local pay caps. The minister confirmed Tilburg's plan, said the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is decent, and reported an interbureaucratic network with VNG and IPO preparing model approaches due by 1 June 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het Arib over celkerntransplantatie, gericht op het voorkomen van de geboorte van een kind met een ernstige mitochondriale aandoening

An MP asked the Health Minister about mitochondrial donation (nuclear transfer) after UK news, asking how often it has led to pregnancies in the Netherlands, the status of Dutch research on clinical applicability, and how many families are affected. The minister answered that the technique is not performed in the Netherlands, that a feasibility study including international developments is nearly finished and will be sent to parliament, and gave prevalence estimates.
As soon as I have received the completed report, I will send it to your House.
Zodra ik het afgeronde rapport heb ontvangen, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer laten toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van ’t Wout over het bericht «Mug met virus groeit hard in poldermoeras»

Two VVD MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers how mosquito-borne disease is monitored and whether wetland restoration raises public health risks such as dengue and West Nile virus. The minister answered that current mosquito species pose no significant disease risk, that monitoring and existing Alterra and RIVM studies continue, and that wetland expansion is a provincial matter with no current measured disease burden, so further RIVM advice is awaited.
The RIVM is currently working with the NVWA's Centre for Vector Monitoring on policy advice on the control of native mosquitoes.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment in samenwerking met het Centrum Monitoring Vectoren van de NVWA aan een beleidsadvies over de inheemse muggenbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that this year's flu vaccine offers little protection, whether the mismatch was foreseeable, and whether the vaccination should be evaluated or cancelled. The minister answered that the strain selection is made months in advance and a mismatch could not be ruled out, declined to quantify extra cases or deaths and the extra costs, and rejected a new evaluation and cancellation as unwarranted, while noting planned effectiveness research.
Direct, reliable information on the number of deaths from flu is not available.
Directe, betrouwbare informatie over het aantal sterfgevallen door griep is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de inkoop van goedkopere bloedglucosemeters door zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health about insurers steering diabetes patients to cheaper blood glucose meters of uncertain quality, and about the lack of mandatory independent physical quality checks. The Minister answered that insurers may control costs as long as quality is assured, that existing CE and ISO 15197 standards apply, and that the Inspectorate has asked RIVM to investigate reported measurement deviations.
The inspectorate has asked the RIVM to start an investigation.
De inspectie heeft het RIVM gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de mogelijkheid van online sperma kopen in Denemarken

An MP asks the health minister whether buying donor sperm online from abroad, including Danish banks offering selection by eye colour, is lawful and how it squares with the child's right to know its origins and the donor's privacy under Article 8 ECHR. The minister answers that Dutch clinics must report donor data but parents who import donor sperma themselves are responsible for their own choices, and that the matter falls under the law of the country of origin.
If prospective parents order anonymous donor sperm via foreign websites or collect it abroad, this is their own responsibility.
Indien wensouders anoniem donorsperma bestellen via buitenlandse websites of dit donorsperma in het buitenland ophalen, is dit hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de oproep van viroloog Osterhaus

An MP asked the health minister about virologist Osterhaus's call urging people to obtain antivirals from their GP, whether she would distance herself from it, and about his financial ties to pharmaceutical firms and the value of flu vaccination. The minister answered that patient care is a matter between doctor and patient guided by professional standards, that the debate is for experts, that she has no overview of his financial interests, and that she sees no reason to change the flu vaccination programme.
I have no overview of the financial interests of prof. dr. Osterhaus.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de financiële belangen van prof. dr. Osterhaus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible conflict of interest of committee member Wilschut, who has paid ties to Sanofi Pasteur, and about the membership of a new Gezondheidsraad committee on antivirals. The minister answered that disclosed interests do not automatically constitute a conflict, that the Gezondheidsraad's conflict-of-interest procedures were followed, that the new committee is not yet installed and its composition will be published, and that no new antiviral stock will be bought before the Kamer can form a view unless circumstances require otherwise.
I do think it is important that full transparency is practised in this regard.
Ik vind het wel belangrijk dat hierover volledige transparantie betracht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Keijzer over de hulp aan gewonde oud-militair die met Koerden vocht tegen ISIS

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Health about the plight of a seriously wounded former conscript who fought alongside Kurds against ISIS, and whether the government would help repatriate and treat him. The government answered that he was not a veteran, that consular assistance was provided, that he left Northern Iraq, and that without adequate insurance the state does not finance treatment or repatriation.
With due regard to the security aspect, the usual consular assistance was provided to the person concerned.
Met in achtneming van het veiligheidsaspect is aan betrokkene de gebruikelijke consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een op non-actief gestelde topambtenaar die toch bij de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) aan de slag ging

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked how a senior civil servant placed off duty at Defence could later work at the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa, whether this was a favour, and what the usual practice is. The minister replied that the official was never suspended or placed on non-active status but offered his post himself after IT restructuring, that the Defence Minister's investigation is awaited, and denied any favour or cover-up, while declining to give a full overview of reassignments.
I want to emphasise that in this case there is no question of an official who is or has been placed on non-active status.
Ik wil benadrukken dat er in dit geval geen sprake is van een ambtenaar die op non-actief is of wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Albert de Vries over de rapportage van de Zeeuwse zorgverkenner

MPs Bouwmeester and De Vries asked the Minister of Health whether she shared the Zeeland care reviewer's view that regional hospital care is sick due to lack of cooperation, and whether insurer CZ should act and the Ministry and NZa should intervene as in Dokkum. The Minister acknowledged the need for cooperation, said she will consult stakeholders on a vision, and explained that insurers' duty of care is enforced by the NZa through informal and formal instruments, with the government intervening only as a last resort.
I agree with that and will soon speak with those involved (hospitals, primary care, provincial and municipal officials and the insurer) about their vision of what needs to happen.
Ik deel dat en zal betrokkenen (ziekenhuizen, eerste lijn, provinciale en gemeentelijke bestuurders en de verzekeraar) binnenkort spreken over hun visie op wat er zal moeten gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars voor juiste informatievoorziening via vergelijkingssites

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Health how to respond to a Health Care Authority (NZa) finding that some comparison websites give consumers misleading information about insurance policies, and who is liable for wrongly chosen policies. The Minister says insurers must check how comparison sites interpret policy terms and will ask the NZa for rules, but she could not say how many people were misled and referred consumers to existing complaint and court routes.

Health insurers must not only ensure correct information is supplied to comparison sites, but also check afterwards whether the information published about their policies has been correctly processed.

Zorgverzekeraars moeten niet alleen zorg dragen voor een juiste informatieverstrekking aan vergelijkingssites, maar ook achteraf nagaan of de daarop vermelde informatie over hun polissen juist is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over snoepautomaten in ziekenhuizen

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a survey showing most hospitals offer candy and snack vending machines, with few healthy options, and whether hospitals should adopt specific healthy-food policies and broad agreements. The Minister acknowledged the survey, said healthy choice is a goal but hospital management is responsible for its own layout, and pointed to existing guidelines and the Alles is Gezondheid programme without committing to new binding action.
Responsibility for the layout of a hospital lies with the relevant hospital board.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de inrichting van een ziekenhuis ligt bij het betreffende bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over minutenregistratie voor persoonsgebonden budgetten

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether insurers' requirement to declare personal budget care in five-minute blocks, and their earlier promise to act against minute registration, would be addressed. The Secretary of State says insurers will change their declaration method in consultation with ZN and Per Saldo so pgb holders can declare in a way comparable to the AWBZ, with some insurers needing time to adjust their forms.
In consultation with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Per Saldo it was discussed that this creates an undesirable situation for pgb holders.
In overleg met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) en Per Saldo is besproken dat dit voor pgb-houders een onwenselijke situatie oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het onderzoeksrapport van Unie KBO ‘Ruim half miljoen senioren verloren voor internet’

An MP asked ministers how they would address the finding that about 600,000 seniors want to learn internet skills and that many seniors will never use the internet, and how offline seniors can keep contact with government. The minister responded that internet access among seniors is improving, pointed to subsidised digital-skills programmes and alternative offline channels, and said digital government services will continue to be developed toward 2017 with a measurement to be reported later this year.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de hulpverlening aan Q-koortspatiënten

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the minister about support for Q-fever patients, including Q-support's reach, overheads, consultation with patient organisation Q-uestion, future outbreak support, and goat vaccination across the Belgian and German borders. The minister answered that Q-support is reaching more patients, overheads were about 11% in its start-up year, Q-uestion is consulted through structural channels, and that member states set their own Q-fever policy with no EU-wide rules, while the ministry lacks data on foreign farms.
My colleague at Economic Affairs does not have data on companies in Belgium or Germany, only on goat farms in the Netherlands.
Mijn collega van Economische Zaken beschikt niet over gegevens van bedrijven in België of Duitsland, uitsluitend over gegevens van geitenbedrijven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Levenseindekliniek weer op de vingers is getikt

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether she is concerned that the Levenseindekliniek was again found to have acted carelessly by the euthanasia review committee, its director's call for more lenient review, the need for research into its effect on demand and psychiatric expertise of review committees. The Minister declines to judge the case, which is with the IGZ and the Public Prosecution Service, declines an independent study pending the 2016 evaluation, and promises to involve a psychiatrist in complex psychiatric cases.
Both bodies have the task, within their own competence, to investigate the matter further and take a decision on that basis.
Beide instanties hebben binnen hun eigen bevoegdheid de taak om de zaak verder te onderzoeken en naar aanleiding daarvan een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Veen en Anne Mulder over het artikel "Meer nadelen dan voordelen"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the effects of the new Wet werk en zekerheid's chain-contract rule on amateur sports clubs, and about an exemption for professional football. The minister explains the tighter chain rule, grants a cao-based exemption for professional football contract players and coaches by ministerial regulation, and says he does not expect amateur clubs to struggle to recruit staff.
For the time being I do not expect amateur sports associations to experience more difficulty in recruiting staff.
Vooralsnog verwacht ik niet dat amateursportverenigingen meer moeite zullen ondervinden bij het aantrekken van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Kerstens en Servaes over het bericht ‘FIFA: Welzijn arbeiders Qatar niet onze zaak’

PvdA MPs asked whether the government would press the KNVB, the ITUC and FIFA's president to take responsibility for migrant worker conditions building World Cup 2022 stadiums in Qatar. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, wants FIFA to publish its bid report, and considers the KNVB proactive and the ITUC capable of acting itself, but said it cannot compel FIFA's president to explain publicly.
I note a proactive attitude from the KNVB regarding the position of migrant workers and will remain in discussion with them about it.
Ik constateer een pro-actieve houding van de KNVB over de positie van arbeidsmigranten en blijf hierover met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgbestuurder vangt twee ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about a report that a mental-health care board member received about 200,000 euros for one month of work in 2013, and how this fits the WNT pay-cap law. The minister disputes the figure, states the total remuneration was 181,722 euros, explains the former top official was not subject to the 2013 cap beyond January, and says the interim-norm decree will come in mid-2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over financiering van de nieuwe tropenopleiding

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Health why the Internationale Gezondheidszorg en Tropische Geneeskunde (IGT) training, recognised by the KNMG, lacks structural public funding and is paid for by students, and whether the Minister would meet the training institute to find a structural solution. Minister Schippers answered that the training is privately funded by design, that it is not eligible for public funding as it prepares doctors for care abroad, and that she sees no reason to fund it, while noting that development-aid funds are not used for training in the Netherlands.
As I indicated at the infectious disease control committee debate of 26 November 2014, I see no reason to fund the training.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven bij het AO infectieziektebestrijding van 26 november 2014 zie ik geen aanleiding om de opleiding te financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over veertig keer zo duur worden van een geneesmiddel na nieuwe registratie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the re-registration of MabCampath (leukaemia drug) as Lemtrada for multiple sclerosis, raising the price from about 15 to 618 euro per milligram, and whether such price increases should be curbed and the drug excluded. The minister called the price difference discutable and said pricing reform, EU and competition aspects are being examined, with the Zorginstituut's assessment awaited before deciding on reimbursement and any financial arrangement.
I disapprove if manufacturers were to choose to pursue disproportionately high profit margins over taking their social responsibility to contribute to patient care at acceptable prices.
Ik keur het af indien fabrikanten zouden kiezen voor het nastreven van onevenredig hoge winstmarges boven het nemen van hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het bericht dat het eigen risico niet meer te betalen is

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that people can no longer afford the mandatory deductible, and whether she would lower it using insurer reserves and cut spending on asylum, EU payments and aid. The minister replied that the solidarity system and zorgtoeslag protect low incomes, that reserves are private and cannot be used to lower the deductible though insurers may return surpluses, and that health care remains a government priority.
Healthcare costs should in principle not be a reason to forgo necessary care.
Zorgkosten hoeven in beginsel geen reden te zijn om af te zien van noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het explosief stijgend aantal mensen dat het eigen risico niet meer kan betalen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sharp rise in people unable to pay their mandatory deductible (eigen risico), including payment arrangements with insurers, reactions to reported avoidance of necessary care, and whether the deductible should be phased out. The minister said she lacks data on the total rise in payment arrangements, pointed to planned research on care avoidance and a Vektis analysis, and ruled out abolishing or reducing the deductible for now.
I have no insight into the increase in the number of people using the option to pay the deductible in instalments.
Ik heb geen inzage in de stijging van het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen van het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de klantenwerving van zorgverzekeraars

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurer Promovendum approaching people unsolicited, about inducements such as free months, gifts and referral payments used to attract customers to health insurers, and whether these target profitable groups (risk selection). The Minister answered that insurers may set their own marketing strategy within legal limits, that she asked the NZa to examine indirect risk selection, and that she would act if the NZa finds problems, while leaving cost data and some questions to the insurers and the NZa.
If the research shows that there is risk selection with certain policies, I will take the necessary measures.
Als uit het onderzoek naar voren komt dat er sprake is van risicoselectie bij bepaalde polissen, dan zal ik de nodige maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht van Foodwatch over de lijst van producten die mogelijk paardenvlees bevatten

An MP asked the Minister of Health why the names of companies that bought Selten meat in the horsemeat scandal were withheld after a Foodwatch FOI request, and who decides on disclosure. The government answered that the Staatssecretaris of Economic Affairs, as the NVWA's parent ministry, decides on disclosure under the Wob, and that disclosure would unfairly harm the companies' reputations, so only a summary without names was released, with citizens' information needs weighed.
Therefore it was chosen, on the basis of article 7 of the Wob, first paragraph, opening words and under c, to provide the data as an extract or summary, that is without the brand and producer names.

Daarom is ervoor gekozen om op basis van artikel 7 van de Wob, eerste lid, aanhef, en onder c, de gegevens te verstrekken in de vorm van een uittreksel of samenvatting, dat wil zeggen zonder de merk- en producentennamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen dreigen patiënten te weigeren om dure medicijnen

An MP from the CDA asked the Health Minister whether hospitals may refuse patients expensive medicines because of unclear cost responsibility, and how insurers' duty of care and complaint routes work. The minister answered that financial barriers may not justify refusing covered care, that the risk is only signalled by stakeholders, and that a working group and NZa analysis will investigate and report before summer.
I have agreed with them to set up a working group in which all relevant stakeholders are represented.
Ik heb met hen afgesproken om een werkgroep in te stellen waarin alle relevante veldpartijen zijn vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inkoop van huisartsenzorg

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister why GPs are criticising insurers' contracting for primary care, why VGZ wrote to a GP who spoke out in the media, and whether the insurer's threat of damages and demand for direct contact is fair, including effects on palliative care and mental health support for patients without contracts. Minister Schippers replies that contracting is a private matter between insurers and providers, that she prefers disputes not be aired in the media, that she has no view on VGZ's communication, and that she will discuss lessons for 2016 with the parties.
The contracting process is a private-law matter between the health insurer and the care provider.
Het contracteringsproces is een privaatrechtelijke aangelegenheid tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gemeden zorg door hoge kosten

Van Klaveren asked the health minister about reports that high deductibles cause people to avoid care, and whether tax burdens and lack of choice in the basic package are to blame. Minister Schippers disputed that 800,000 payment arrangements signal a problem, said care costs need not deter necessary care, and argued the government pursues several measures at once including cost control and stable premiums.
It is not known how many people using the option to spread payment of the compulsory deductible do so out of financial necessity.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel mensen die gebruik maken van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen van het eigen risico, dat doen uit financiële noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de crowdfundingsite www.geefgezondheid.nu

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that people with health needs must compete for donations on the crowdfunding site geefgezondheid.nu, whether the government will make the site unnecessary by ensuring insurers and municipalities cover needs, and whether it will analyse crowdfunding requests for wrongly denied care. The minister answered that eligibility decisions rest with insurers and municipalities, that crowdfunded items fall outside or only partly within the basic package and that the government has no duty there, and declined to analyse the requests.
These concern forms of care or provisions that are not part of the basic Zvw package or only partly fall under the Wmo
Het gaat hier om zorgvormen of voorzieningen die geen onderdeel zijn van het basispakket van de Zvw of slechts ten dele vallen onder de Wmo
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de zaak Spijkers

An MP asks ministers about the Spijkers settlement, including whether medical records were ordered destroyed without the claimant's explicit consent, who may access the archived file, and whether it was improperly kept secret. The government denies any destruction decision was taken, states the digital record was deleted by the former occupational health provider with a destruction statement, says the file was transferred to the National Archives under access rules, and refuses to open the full file to the Chamber or researchers on the grounds set out in earlier letters.
Otherwise a check of what was transferred would not have been possible.
Een controle van hetgeen werd overgedragen was anders niet mogelijk geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) van ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that the intensive care unit at Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen would be scaled down, including internal intensivist emails, possible links to a concept plan, insurer Achmea's role, staff consequences and consistency with the Minister's stance on small regional hospitals. The Minister answered that the IC is not being closed, that the internal note is only a discussion document, that patients are transferred to Emmen only when medically necessary or after 72 hours of ventilation, and that the board, insurers and supervisory bodies bear the responsibility.
The inspectorate supervises the quality of care delivered and checks whether the preconditions for care are present.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit van geleverde zorg en toetst of de randvoorwaarden voor geleverde zorg aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de dreigende sluiting van de intensive care (IC) in Ziekenhuis Bethesda te Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the planned closure of intensive care units at Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal hospitals was known in advance, whether the board chair's assurances were credible, and whether limited special care with remote intensivist consultation is responsible. The minister answered that the document is an internal discussion note without decision status, no closure is decided, the board remains responsible, the supervisory board should be involved in any decision, and quality oversight lies with the IGZ and NZa.

Once the new guideline is established, organisation-wide policy on IC care will be set so that it meets all requirements for responsible care as well as the Treant Zorggroep multi-year policy framework.

Zodra de nieuwe richtlijn is vastgesteld zal het organisatiebreed beleid ten aanzien van de IC-zorg vastgesteld worden, zodanig dat het zowel voldoet aan alle eisen die er aan verantwoorde zorg gesteld worden als aan het meerjarenbeleidskader van de Treant Zorggroep
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de berisping van een dissidente zorgverzekeraar door de branchevereniging

An MP asked the health minister for her reaction to the industry association ZN reprimanding dissident insurer DSW, whether the association behaves like a cartel, and whether the ACM should investigate possible cartel formation. The minister called the matter an internal affair of ZN, said the ACM and NZa can intervene if cartel formation occurs, and declined to ask the ACM to investigate.
The ACM, as supervisor, is itself responsible for initiating such an investigation if it sees reason to do so.
De ACM is als toezichthouder zelf verantwoordelijk om dergelijk onderzoek in gang te zetten indien zij daar aanleiding toe zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars berispen dissident'

Questioner Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asks whether the health minister will object to the sector association Zorgverzekeraars Nederland rebuking insurer DSW for criticising the market power of large insurers, and how critical voices are heard. The minister declines to judge the internal matter, says individual insurers may hold differing views and that market power is for the NZa and ACM to assess, and offers ongoing talks with insurers.
I regard the correspondence as an internal matter between the association ZN and one of its members and therefore have no opinion on it.
Ik zie de briefwisseling als een interne aangelegenheid tussen de vereniging ZN en één van haar leden en heb daar derhalve geen oordeel over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ellemeet en Bruins Slot over de vergoeding van niet-gecontracteerde zorg in academische ziekenhuizen

MPs Ellemeet and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health whether there is an overview of treatments at academic hospitals that are always reimbursed even when the hospital is not contracted, and how insured persons can know in advance what is covered. The Minister declined to publish a full overview, pointing to insurers' duty of care (zorgplicht) and their obligation to publish contracted providers, and explained that disputes go to the insurer, the SKGZ or the civil court.
Such an overview for all treatments and all insurers is impossible to provide in this way.
Een dusdanig overzicht voor alle behandelingen en voor alle verzekeraars is onmogelijk om zo te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs asked the minister when she would talk with De Riethorst, why doven-ggz is funded differently from general institutions, whether max-max tariffs suffice, and whether an emergency fix like GGMD's can keep the unit open. The minister replied that insurers bear responsibility for access, that she will talk with insurers and commission an NZa study on funding, and that she sees no reason for extra transition measures.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitkomsten van het belevingsonderzoek euthanasie

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Health about a KNMG survey showing doctors feel emotional strain and pressure from patients to perform euthanasia, and whether patients wrongly see euthanasia as a right. Minister Schippers said the survey is clear, that euthanasia is not a right and doctors must be free of undue pressure, and pointed to existing information materials, promising only consultation with the KNMG.
The law provides that doctors are not obliged to grant a request and that the doctor must be convinced the request meets the statutory due-care criteria.
De wet stelt dat artsen niet verplicht zijn om een verzoek in te willigen en dat de arts overtuigd moet zijn dat het verzoek voldoet aan de wettelijke zorgvuldigheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over een onderzoek onder artsen over de morele belasting van de uitvoering van euthanasie

An MP asked the minister about a survey showing doctors feel moral strain and pressure from patients and relatives when performing euthanasia, and whether the public wrongly sees euthanasia as an enforceable right. The minister acknowledged the emotional burden and pressure, said there is no right to euthanasia, pointed to existing information and a national palliative care programme, and promised further awareness initiatives with stakeholders.
The law states that doctors are not obliged to grant a request and that the doctor must be convinced the request meets the legal due-care criteria.
De wet stelt dat artsen niet verplicht zijn om een verzoek in te willigen en dat de arts overtuigd moet zijn dat het verzoek voldoet aan de wettelijke zorgvuldigheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Gemeente weigert brandonveilige instelling te sluiten”

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that a municipality refused to close a fire-unsafe care institution, and about how fire safety in care homes is supervised and enforced. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies primarily with care providers and municipalities, that the government lacks data on inspection frequency and enforcement, and that a fire-safety action programme and a TNO dashboard are under way.
At national level there is no data on how often municipalities have addressed care institutions regarding fire safety.
Op rijksniveau zijn geen gegevens over het aantal keren dat gemeenten zorginstellingen in het kader van brandveiligheid hebben aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het onderzoek van de Inspectie van de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) naar de zelfdoding van een bewoner in De Golfstroom

An MP asked the State Secretary why the health inspectorate's investigation into a resident's suicide at De Golfstroom was reported inconsistently, whether whistleblowers at De Vrijwaard were ignored, and how families and contacts were handled. The State Secretary answered that a case mix-up occurred, that the investigation decision dated from 18 November 2014, that the inspectorate asks providers to investigate first, and that families were involved.
The decision dates from 18 November 2014, following receipt and study of the report.
Het besluit dateert van 18 november 2014, volgend op de ontvangst en bestudering van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over omzetplafonds in de zorg

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether insurer Zilveren Kruis's volume caps (omzetplafonds) on care providers, which can push patients into waiting lists or cut their coverage, are transparent and lawful, and what the insurer must disclose. The Minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about caps and their consequences under the NZa policy rule, that the insurer's duty of care applies when a cap is reached, and that the NZa is examining budget policies for contracting consistency.
In my letter of 2 December to the NZa I asked it to examine explicitly whether contracting through these budget policies is sufficient to meet the duty of care.

In het verlengde hiervan heb ik in mijn brief van 2 december aan de NZa gevraagd om ten aanzien van de budgetpolissen expliciet te kijken of de contractering via deze polissen voldoende is om aan de zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Matchfixing stopt niet bij de grens'

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about matchfixing, betting-related manipulation and the WADA claim that sport is in criminal hands, as well as the status of a national matchfixing platform and convenant. The minister answered that measures are being implemented, that the WADA conclusion is a personal opinion, that the OM cannot say whether it investigates, and that the convenant is still being drafted due to privacy complexities.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de doorstart van Ascensio onder een andere naam

An SP MP asked whether care provider Ascensio, ordered closed by the inspectorate, was continuing care through a new company, Infinitus Zorg, and how the inspectorate supervised the transfer of clients. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate's order covered both companies, Infinitus Zorg was stopped from providing care until verified, and the inspectorate confirmed on 18 December 2014 that both had stopped providing (PGB-funded) care.
I was therefore of the view that my order to cease care provision and transfer clients, as it was directed at Ascensio Zorg B.V., was also directed at Infinitus Zorg B.V.
Ik was dan ook van mening dat mijn aanwijzing tot staken van de zorgverlening en overdracht van de cliënten zoals die zich richtte op Ascensio Zorg B.V. zich (ook) richtte op Infinitus Zorg B.V.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichtgeving ‘Kabinet: ‘FIFA, geef openheid over de toekenning WK’s

MP Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport what steps would be taken to secure openness from FIFA on the 2018 and 2022 World Cup awards, and whether Netherlands would lead EU work on sports integrity and launch international talks on transparency. The minister replied that the KNVB and the Belgian federation requested the FIFA report, that FIFA says it will publish it without a date, that Netherlands helped put sports integrity and good governance on the EU work plan, and that a ministerial round table on the topic is planned for January 2015.
I want to take up this advice during the Dutch EU presidency in the first half of 2016 and make it a priority theme in the sports field.
Ik wil dit advies oppakken tijdens het Nederlands EU-voorzitterschap in de eerste helft van 2016 en tot prioritair thema maken op sportterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik- Faber over het bericht dat therapie de kans op zelfdoding verkleint

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health about a Danish study showing outpatient talking therapy after suicide attempts reduces repetition, and whether the Netherlands should study this model. The minister said Dutch practice already offers similar therapy under existing guidelines and the national suicide prevention agenda, and sent the Lancet article.
I hereby send you the relevant article from The Lancet of 24 November 2014 explaining the findings of this study.
Ik doe u hierbij het betrokken artikel uit the Lancet van 24 november 2014 toekomen waarin de uitkomsten van deze studie toegelicht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het aanbieden van de NIPT in België

Dik-Faber asks the health minister about women travelling to Belgium for the NIPT prenatal test, referral practices by doctors, counselling adequacy, and a remark by a Grendia director about costs of Down syndrome. The minister says the 1.3% share is not alarming, that no official figures exist on doctors' referrals or terminations after Belgian positive results, that the Inspectorate for Health Care oversees compliance with the Wbo, and that she rejects the cost framing.
On this I am in contact with the Inspectorate for Health Care, which has the statutory task of supervising compliance with the Wbo.
Hierover heb ik contact met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg die de wettelijke taak heeft toe te zien op de naleving van de Wbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven toekomen over onderhoud van otter- en dassentunnels

An MP asked the government about badger and otter tunnels left flooded or unmaintained, the cost of construction and maintenance, otter deaths in fyke nets and on roads, and responsibility after decentralisation. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat has tightened maintenance for its tunnels, that most tunnels are managed by provinces and municipalities over which the minister has no responsibility, and that the government is appealing and implementing a court ruling on otter road hazards.
I bear no responsibility for the maintenance of these.
Voor het onderhoud hiervan draag ik geen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over patiënten die fors voor een donornier betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether paid illegal organ trade occurs in the Netherlands, how doctors should handle suspected commercial donors, how medical confidentiality relates to reporting suspicions, and whether a reporting point or donor premium exemption should be introduced. The minister answered that the Netherlands lacks clear evidence of such trade, that existing law and possible criminal reporting already suffice without new guidelines or a reporting point, and that financial incentives are ineffective and legally constrained.
I see no reason at this time to set up a reporting point for healthcare providers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit moment over te gaan tot het instellen van een meldpunt voor zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het misbruik van patiënten door een veroordeelde zedendelinquent

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Health about sexual abuse of patients by care workers, including whether courts impose professional bans on sex offenders and how often the inspectorate receives reports. The government answered that the inspectorate received 133 reports of sexual boundary violations in 2013, that a professional ban by a criminal court has effect beyond the tuchtrecht route, and it committed to a broader disciplinary ban and mandatory certificates of conduct for new staff in some care sectors.
The Minister of Health intends to make a change that would allow a broader ban to be imposed within disciplinary law than the removal of registration for the BIG profession.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport (VWS) is voornemens een wijziging door te voeren waardoor het mogelijk wordt om binnen het tuchtrecht een breder verbod op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat mensen met een budgetpolis volgend jaar niet terecht kunnen bij academische ziekenhuizen

An MP asked whether budget health insurance holders would be excluded from academic hospitals and whether insurers' duty of care and transparency obligations apply. The minister replied that insurers must cover necessary care at academic hospitals even for budget policyholders, that the duty of care already covers this, and that insurers must provide transparent information under existing rules.
If people need care that can only be provided by an academic hospital, this must be provided for and will be fully reimbursed.
Als mensen zorg nodig hebben die alleen door een academisch ziekenhuis verleend kan worden, moet hierin worden voorzien en wordt deze volledig vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over misstanden in het verleden bij spermabanken

An MP asks the health minister about past misconduct at the MC Bijdorp sperm clinic, including whether anonymous donor sperm was used after the 2004 law and how donor children can trace donors. The minister says the Health Inspectorate is investigating recent reports, earlier prosecutions were dropped, records have been moved for safekeeping, and she will consult the donor foundation on whether other clinics are involved.
While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about this.
Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over geestelijke gezondheidszorg en verslavingszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about access to mental health and addiction care, including insurers restricting care, waiting lists not being published centrally, bed reductions, and denial of joint admission for addicted mothers and infants. The Minister replied that insurers must follow professional judgment and their duty of care, that waiting times are publicly listed though not centrally registered, that she sees no signal of rising waiting lists, and that she will send a bed-reduction report in early 2015.
I have no reason to assume that the duty of care is at stake and that patients do not have timely access to care.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat de zorgplicht in het geding is en dat patiënten onvoldoende snel toegang tot zorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the DBC tariffs for 2015 are sufficient to keep the specialist mental health centre De Riethorst for deaf and hard-of-hearing patients open, and whether a solution can be found before the NZa cost study concludes. The Minister says the tariffs and max-max rates leave room, that the provider and insurers have responsibility, that she will talk to insurers and ask the NZa to examine funding, and that she will inform the House after early-2015 talks.
After the talks with the health insurers in early 2015, I will inform the House of the outcomes and the further course.
Na het gesprek met de zorgverzekeraars begin 2015 zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten en over het verdere traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de dreigende sluiting van de beademingsafdeling in Zuidhorn

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Health Minister and State Secretary whether the threatened closure of the chronic ventilation ward in Zuidhorn, which serves patients with conditions such as muscle diseases, is acceptable given unclear financing, and how structural funding will be secured. The State Secretary denied any closure is threatened, said the NZa and the care office are seeking adequate financing with Zuidhorn, and declined to convene the parties for now.
There is no question of an imminent closure.
Er is geen sprake van een dreigende sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de berichtgeving over foute buitenlandse tandartsen die hun praktijken in Nederland voortzetten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that foreign dentists barred from practising in their home countries continued working in the Netherlands, and about registration checks, language requirements and the BIG register. Minister Schippers answered that the CIBG now checks for foreign restrictions via information exchange and a pilot, that language testing is being studied within the EU directive implementation, and that the CIBG does not itself check deregistered persons' practice, while rejecting a dentist shortage argument.
The CIBG does not check whether persons who have been struck off the BIG register actually stop practising in the Netherlands or abroad.
Het CIBG controleert niet of personen die zijn doorgehaald in het BIG-register ook daadwerkelijk hun beroep in Nederland of daarbuiten niet meer uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over foute artsen

A CDA MP asked the health minister about a US-licensed dentist whose misconduct was not reflected in the Dutch BIG register, how US revocations are weighed, and whether Dutch language tests for EU dentists are feasible. The minister explained that foreign sanctions are generally taken over in full, that language proficiency is required for safe care, and promised to inform parliament on implementation of the amended EU directive during 2015.
Foreign measures are taken over in full, unless taking them over would lead to an unreasonable result under the BIG Act (hardship clause).
Buitenlandse maatregelen worden integraal overgenomen, tenzij overname zou leiden tot een onredelijk resultaat in het kader van de Wet BIG (hardheidsclausule).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de monopoliepositie van de Internationale Schaatsunie en de vrijheid van schaatsers en de zeggenschap over de invulling van hun wedstrijdseizoen

MP Van Nispen asked the health minister whether the International Skating Union may bar skaters from outside events under threat of lifetime exclusion, and whether this breaches EU or national law. The minister replied that competition law falls to the European Commission, which must first decide on the matter, and that sports federations must respect national law but skaters can seek review via the Commission.
The European Commission has the authority to investigate and fine possible infringements of the EU competition rules.
De Europese Commissie heeft de bevoegdheid om eventuele inbreuken op de EU-mededingingsregels te onderzoeken en te beboeten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat een kwart van de artsen niet bekend is met de verplichting krachtens de wet tot het uitwisselen van de reden van voorschrijven

MP Van Wijngaarden asked the minister about a report finding that a quarter of doctors are unaware of the legal duty to share the reason for prescribing for certain medicines, and what this means for patient safety and enforcement. The minister acknowledges the low awareness is undesirable, says the duty must be complied with regardless of ICT, notes the IGZ will supervise compliance from 2015, but defers substantive answers on the ICT fix and next steps to a forthcoming definitive position.
I will answer this question in my definitive position on the IVM report, which has yet to be published.
Ik zal deze vraag beantwoorden in mijn nog uit te brengen definitieve standpunt op het rapport van het IVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over artsen die laks zijn bij het voorschrijven van medicijnen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about GPs who fail to record the reason for prescribing medicines, the risks this poses for patients and pharmacists, and what the government will do.
