The minister acknowledged the non-compliance as unacceptable, said pharmacists' advisory role suffers, stated that providers are responsible for record quality, and committed to monitoring and enforcement by the Inspectorate from 1 January 2015.
I find the reasons given in the study in no way do justice to the responsibility that prescribers have for their patients.
Ik vind de in het onderzoek opgegeven redenen op geen enkele manier recht doen aan de verantwoordelijkheid die voorschrijvers voor hun patiënten hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van de hoog pathogene variant van vogelgriep in Hekendorp

Two PvdA MPs asked about measures to prevent human infection and spread of highly pathogenic bird flu from the Hekendorp outbreak, signs of human infection, causes, a possible link to Germany, and measures against future zoonotic outbreaks. The government answered by referring to earlier letters on measures and the investigation, stating there are no signs of human infection, and referring to earlier answers on pandemic risk.
For the answer to this question I refer to the answers to questions about the report 'Pandemic from Brabant is possible'.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op vragen over het bericht «Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over naar de uitzending van Zembla “Fijn dat we verzekerd zijn”

An MP asks the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on insurers selecting against chronically ill patients, risk equalisation shortfalls, and reduced insurer investment in care for undercompensated groups such as home nursing users. The minister acknowledges indirect risk selection as a concern, outlines NZa monitoring and a forthcoming NZa study due May 2015, but says she does not know which insurers or patient groups are affected and commits to further reports and possible measures.
I do not know which health insurers are reluctant to invest in care procurement and innovation, nor for which patient groups precisely and for how long this would have been occurring.
Ik weet niet welke zorgverzekeraars terughoudend zijn in het investeren in zorginkoop en innovatie en niet voor welke groepen patiënten precies en hoe lang dit al zou spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht van Foodwatch over de lijst van producten die mogelijk paardenvlees bevatten

An MP asked why it took about eighteen months for the food safety authority NVWA to release the product names linked to the horsemeat supplier Selten, and why supplier company names were not released. The minister answered that the NVWA refused to disclose company names under the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur, released anonymised product lists in August 2014, and promised a legislative change to enable faster active information disclosure.
Disclosure would constitute an unreasonable disadvantage under the Freedom of Information Act (article 10).
Openbaarmaking zou een onevenredige benadeling op basis van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (artikel 10) betekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de reactie van de minister op de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie met betrekking tot het afschaffen van de vrije artsenkeuze

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether her claim that abolishing free choice of doctor complies with the EU Court of Justice ruling and the patient rights directive was accurate, and about the legal basis and savings of the measure. The minister rejects accusations of misrepresentation, argues the amended Article 13 Zvw fits the directive and Council of State advice, and provides the savings justification of about 1 billion euro.
There is no question of distorting facts regarding rulings of the European Court of Justice.
Er is geen sprake van het verdraaien van feiten inzake uitspraken van het Europees Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen het van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiëntgegevens zonder toestemming zijn gedeeld

MP Klever (PVV) asked the Health Minister about reports that patient data were shared without consent, citing a CBP finding that consent could not be proven in 8 of 149 sampled files, and asked about sanctions under the data protection act and ending the LSP. Minister Schippers answered that the CBP is the independent supervisor and decides on further investigation herself, that VZVZ took tightened consent measures, that a bill giving the CBP power to impose administrative fines was sent to parliament, and that the LSP will not be ended.
I do not intend to conduct further investigation.
Ik ben niet van plan nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toekomst van het Dokkumer ziekenhuis De Sionsberg

The MP asks about the future of Dokkum hospital De Sionsberg, its financial collapse, and hospital care access in Noordoost Friesland. The minister says the hospital's finances have long been weak, a bankruptcy filing is underway, care continuity is not currently at risk, insurers and the NZa are responsible, and she sees no role for herself unless emergency access exceeds 45 minutes.
I see no role for myself, unless the accessibility of emergency care and acute obstetrics within 45 minutes is at stake.
Ik zie geen rol voor mijzelf weggelegd, tenzij de bereikbaarheid van de spoedeisende hulp en de acute verloskunde binnen 45 minuten in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Voortbestaan Gemini Ziekenhuis in Gevaar’

An SP MP asks the health minister about the rejection of Gemini Hospital's request for an availability contribution and whether the ministry will help keep the hospital open. The minister declines to comment on the individual request, says insurers have a duty of care under NZa supervision, and promises no direct funding intervention.
I do not comment on individual applications for an availability contribution. That is an exclusive statutory competence of the NZa.
Ik ga niet in op individuele aanvragen voor een beschikbaarheidsbijdrage. Dat is een exclusieve wettelijke bevoegdheid van de NZa.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het besluit beschikbaarheidsbijdrage Spoedeisende Hulp (SEH) en Acute verloskunde van het ziekenhuis ZorgSa

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the NZa's refusal of a availability contribution for the emergency and acute obstetric departments of ZorgSaam Zeeuws-Vlaanderen, including whether the 45-minute norm and the hospital's sensitivity status are at risk. The Minister declined to comment on individual NZa decisions, said the NZa is exclusively responsible, and stated that insurers have a care duty and were asked to report by 15 December 2014, while the NZa will monitor this.
I will not address individual applications for an availability contribution. That is an exclusive statutory competence of the NZa.
Ik ga niet in op individuele aanvragen voor een beschikbaarheidsbijdrage. Dat is een exclusieve wettelijke bevoegdheid van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het off-label voorschrijven van medicijnen

Green Left MP Voortman asked the health minister about off-label prescribing, noting that eleven of twenty medical professions have no guideline to fall back on despite legal requirements, and that RIVM and the CBG see risks. Minister Schippers answered that off-label use is permitted under the Medicines Act when guidelines are followed or the best treatment is chosen with the pharmacist, that the IGZ supervises prescribing, and that guideline development and drug rediscovery will be pursued, without committing to a new legal change.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) supervises the prescribing behaviour of doctors.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidzorg (IGZ) houdt toezicht op het voorschrijfgedrag van artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over onterechte ziekenhuisrekeningen

An MP asked the health minister about hospital bills wrongly charged to patients following extra audits, and whether the correction of the own-risk payment would be revisited and patients refunded. The minister said the audit outcomes are not yet known, is consulting parties on refunding wrongly paid own-risk amounts per a motion, and rejects that unclear rules cause overbilling, pointing to insurers and providers for setting realistic prices.
The outcomes of the turnover investigations are not yet known.
De uitkomsten van de omzetonderzoeken zijn nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether pension contributions for top officials at health insurers fall within the sectoral pay norm, and how their size is kept in check. The minister answered that the employer pension contribution is normed qualitatively, matched to the sector pension fund's standard entitlements, and declined to add a quantitative cap.
One quantitative norm for the employer share of the pension premium could therefore not be laid down in a generic regulation.
Eén kwantitatieve norm voor het werkgeversdeel van de pensioenpremie was hierdoor niet in een generieke regeling vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verband tussen de toename van het aantal spoedritten en inzet van de traumahelikopter en het gebruikte uitvraagsysteem

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the rising number of emergency ambulance and trauma helicopter dispatches is linked to the AMPDS/ProQA or NTS dispatch systems, and about related data and staff effects. The minister answered that the systems were introduced only gradually since 2011-2014, so no link can yet be analysed, that data on dispatches and MMT deployments are provided, and that the cause of the growth is still being investigated.
I do not yet have a good understanding of the causes of the growth in the number of emergency rides. I am having research carried out into this.
Ik heb op dit moment nog geen goed inzicht in de oorzaken van de groei van het aantal spoedritten. Ik laat hier onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van rapid responders en brambulances

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the rising use of rapid responders in ambulance dispatch and about a 'brambulance' pilot in Rotterdam-Rijnmond, including liability and effectiveness. The Minister defends rapid responders as speeding patient care, rejects further research and the claim that they are used merely to meet response times, and promises an evaluation of the pilot by early 2015.
Once the evaluation is ready, the safety region will make it public so that interested parties can take note of it.
Zodra de evaluatie gereed is, zal deze door de veiligheidsregio openbaar worden gemaakt zodat geïnteresseerden hier kennis van kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de op 1 oktober 2014 geopende CareToGo op het centraal station van Den Haag

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about CareToGo, a privately run walk-in clinic at The Hague central station, raising concerns about paid care, prescribing, data sharing, the doctor-patient relationship and costs. Minister Schippers answered that the clinic is a permitted new entrant outside the basic insurance package, that it does not affect costs or gatekeeping, and that it is privately financed, with no insurers or pharma firms involved.
CareToGo has informed me that no health insurers or pharmaceutical companies are behind CareToGo.
CareToGo heeft mij bericht dat er geen zorgverzekeraars of farmaceutische bedrijven achter CareToGo te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat de georganiseerde misdaad 25% van de wereldwijde beroepsmatige sportbeoefening in handen heeft

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the minister knew the WADA director general's claim that organised crime controls about 25% of professional sport, and asked about Interpol information, a possible global anti-matchfixing agency, and links with doping. The minister said the claim could not be traced to Interpol information, that it was not verifiable, that no link with doping was found, and that Dutch support for the Council of Europe matchfixing convention is the chosen route.
As I already indicated during the Sport Legislative Consultation of 27 October 2014, you cannot expect me to forward all third-party information to your House.
Zoals ik al aangaf tijdens het Wetgevingsoverleg Sport van 27 oktober 2014 kunt u van mij niet verwachten dat ik alle informatie van derden aan uw Kamer doorstuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het invriezen van een deel van de eierstokken zonder medische noodzaak

An MP asks the health minister to explain her stance that she has no principled objection to freezing part of an ovary for non-medical reasons, and whether this is desirable or should be permitted given that some US employers pay for egg freezing. The minister answers that the technique is still experimental and that, once proven safe and effective by doctors, she sees no reason for government to ban it, with the woman bearing the costs, while the age limit and reimbursement questions are left to doctors and remain premature to settle.
For a medical procedure, it is first of all important whether the technique applied is proven to be safe and effective.
Het is bij een medische ingreep allereerst van belang of de toegepaste techniek bewezen veilig en effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de beschikbaarheidsbijdrage spoedeisende hulp en acute verloskunde

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether emergency-room and acute obstetric availability payments should remain available for vulnerable hospitals, how the NZa applies its criteria, and what happened to the Gemini hospital in Den Helder. The minister answered that the NZa has refused all applications, that insurers retain their duty of care, and that the NZa will supervise compliance, but declined to comment on the individual Gemini case.
I will not comment on individual applications for an availability contribution. That is an exclusive statutory competence of the NZa.
Ik ga niet in op individuele aanvragen voor een beschikbaarheidsbijdrage. Dat is een exclusieve wettelijke bevoegdheid van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van furazolidon in de voedselketen en het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek

An MP asked whether potentially carcinogenic furazolidon in meat poses consumer health risks and whether the precautionary principle should apply to informing consumers while a criminal investigation is ongoing. The minister answered that the NVWA's risk assessment found negligible risk, that consumers are informed when a real health risk exists, and that affected animals were destroyed.
If there is a danger to public health from possibly contaminated foodstuffs, the consumer is informed of this so that they can take their own measures.
In het geval er een gevaar voor de volksgezondheid is door mogelijk besmette of verontreinigde voedingsmiddelen wordt de consument daarover geïnformeerd, zodat deze zelf maatregelen kan nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Van der Staaij over illegaal draagmoederschap

MPs Arib and Van der Staaij asked about illegal surrogacy, including enforcement by the prosecution service, whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming can track children born through surrogacy, a reporting structure, and screening of surrogates and intended parents. The government answered that it sees no reason to tighten enforcement, a reporting structure or screening now, deferring these questions to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap due mid-2016.
On this basis I see no reason to ask the Public Prosecution Service to tighten the current enforcement policy on surrogacy or to give it more priority with the police.

Ik zie op basis hiervan geen aanleiding het Openbaar Ministerie te verzoeken het huidige handhavingsbeleid ten aanzien van draagmoederschap aan te scherpen of het meer prioriteit te geven bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de strijd rondom ADHD-medicatie voor volwassen

An MP asked the health minister about the regulatory rejection of Concerta for adults with ADHD, the Strattera trial populations, and whether the non-registration was kept secret; the minister answered that the CBG rejected the adult indication on risk-benefit grounds, that the rejection was published, and that she will await the psychiatric association's guideline before responding further. The answers are largely substantive but defer on the guideline and on new research.
This is incorrect, the rejection was not kept secret.
Dit is onjuist, de afwijzing is niet geheim gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Vrouw-Moeder-Kind-centrum in het Atrium ziekenhuis in Heerlen er niet komt

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister whether the planned women-mother-child centre at Atrium hospital in Heerlen has been cancelled and whether the Heerlen-Sittard hospital merger should be abandoned. The minister denies the centre is cancelled, says the merger is on track for 1 January 2015, and states that hospital boards and the NZA/regulators are responsible for the details.
I do not recognise or know the confidential documents. It is up to the boards of Atrium and Orbis to prepare the further implementation of the centre.
Ik herken en ken de vertrouwelijk stukken niet. Het is aan de Raden van Bestuur van Atrium en Orbis om de verdere invulling van het centrum voor te bereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over EU-wetgeving medische DNA-tests

MP Tellegen asks about EU regulation of medical DNA tests and whether consumers can be adequately protected from misinterpreting results. Minister Schippers answers that the EU in-vitro diagnostics regulation is still under negotiation, that Netherlands supports letting member states set national requirements for supplying genetic tests but opposes medical-ethical requirements at EU level, and that a Health Council advisory report is expected by year-end.
The Netherlands can support a provision that gives member states the option to set additional national requirements for the supply of genetic tests.
Nederland kan wel een bepaling steunen die lidstaten de mogelijkheid geeft om nationaal aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de aflevering van genetische testen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Arib over één neutrale, landelijke niet-reanimeerpenning

MPs Dik-Faber and Arib asked whether a single neutral national do-not-resuscitate pendant should replace privately distributed ones, and whether registration and distribution should be arranged publicly. The minister supports a neutral, uniform pendant, will examine how VWS can facilitate one, and agrees to consult patient organisations on information.
I will explore the possibilities of issuing, or having issued, a uniform, neutral NR pendant not linked to any particular foundation or association.
Ik zal de mogelijkheden onderzoeken een uniforme, neutrale (niet aan een bepaalde stichting of vereniging gelieerde) NR-penning uit te (laten) geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het aankopen van miljoenen griepkuren door de overheid tussen 2005 en 2009, terwijl de werkzaamheid ervan niet vaststond

An MP asked the Health Minister about the government's purchase of 5 million flu antivirals (oseltamivir and zanamivir) between 2005 and 2009 despite unproven efficacy, including the failure to re-examine efficacy and the withholding of trial data. The minister replied that purchases followed a 2004 Health Council advice, that no repeat purchases occurred, that safety is monitored by registration authorities, and that a new Health Council advice has been requested.
Following the possibility that there are new scientific insights that could lead to policy adjustment, I have requested a new advice from the Health Council.
Naar aanleiding van de mogelijkheid dat er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten zijn die tot aanpassing van beleid zouden kunnen leiden heb ik een nieuw advies aan de GR gevraagd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de vergoeding van een geneesmiddel zonder de meerwaarde ervan te beoordelen

An MP asked the health minister why the Zorginstituut clustered Tecfidera without comparing its price to a cheaper compounded DMF product, and why its price rise leaves patients paying about €875 per month. The minister answered that the price of Tecfidera is not part of the clustering assessment under the GVS, that no price negotiation was started because the drug fell in an existing cluster, and that drug-rediscovery pricing will be examined further.
For all these individual arrangements, the agreed price reductions are not made public.
Voor al deze individuele arrangementen geldt dat de overeengekomen prijsverlagingen niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over wilsbekwaamheid bij zieke kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about whether young children (under 12) can be considered capable of deciding on their own medical treatment and research participation, citing a study of decision-making competence. The Minister answered that the study does not justify general conclusions, that a fixed age limit of 12 should be kept for legal certainty, and that the government will send a proposal to align the research law's age threshold with the WGBO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over communicatie aan burgers bij een mogelijke ebola-uitbraak

An MP asked the Health Minister how citizens are informed about a possible Ebola outbreak, including which bodies communicate, whether there are agreements, and who decides the message. The Minister answered that RIVM provides factual information, a helpline was opened, no outbreak is occurring, and communication roles and agreements are set out in the Public Health Act framework.
RIVM communicates on behalf of the government about developments, precautionary measures and courses of action.
Het RIVM communiceert namens de overheid over de ontwikkelingen, voorzorgsmaatregelen en handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rutte over het bericht “Wildgroei aan medische zelftesten”

An MP asked the Health Minister about the growth of unvalidated, freely available medical self-tests, their effect on care costs, and how consumers can verify reliability. The minister acknowledged risks from non-compliant online tests, said little is known about cost effects, and pointed to government website warnings, inspectorate enforcement, and EU negotiations, while noting that foreign online sellers are hard to control.
The Ministry of VWS and the inspectorate are jointly paying attention to this.
Het Ministerie van VWS en de inspectie besteden hier gezamenlijk aandacht aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het gebrek aan voorlichting aan meisjes en vrouwen met kanker over het behoud van hun vruchtbaarheid

An MP asked the Health Minister why only about 1 in 10 women with cancer are referred to a specialist to discuss fertility preservation, and whether guidelines are followed. The minister replied that counselling is part of care, that the field is responsible for guideline content and compliance, and that IGZ supervises compliance through risk-based oversight, without committing to new action.
The field itself is responsible for the content of the guidelines and their compliance.
Het veld is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud van de richtlijnen en de naleving daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de vrije artsenkeuze en Europeesrechtelijke belemmeringen

An MP from the CDA asks the Health Minister whether the proposed amendment of Article 13 Zorgverzekeringswet, which limits reimbursement for non-contracted care under naturapolissen, conflicts with EU law and the ruling in the Petru case, and what this means for free choice of doctor and for medical tourism. The Minister rejects the claim of incompatibility, argues the amendment fits Directive 2011/24/EU, says the Petru ruling changes nothing in existing practice, and promises transparency obligations for insurers overseen by the NZa.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis in Woerden met het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis in Nieuwegein

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the planned merger of the Zuwe Hofpoort hospital in Woerden with St. Antonius in Nieuwegein, including petition signatures, staffing, emergency care, and the basis for claims that bigger hospitals are more efficient. The Minister said the merger was pre-approved by the competition authority, that the NZa would check consultation with works councils and medical staff, and that she could not predict the future, offering largely non-committal answers without releasing requested studies.
This merger was already approved earlier by the ACM under the Competition Act. However, since the merger has not yet taken place in practice, the parties must still notify it to the NZa.

Deze fusie is al eerder op grond van de Mededingingswet door de ACM goedgekeurd. Echter, omdat de fusie in de praktijk nog niet heeft plaatsgevonden moet deze alsnog door partijen worden gemeld bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over over huisartsenorganisaties die tegen het verplicht stellen van een screeningsinstrument voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether insurers making a GGZ screening instrument mandatory in 2015 contracts, opposed by GP organisations, undermines professional autonomy and the GP's gatekeeper role. The minister answered that the instrument only advises, professional autonomy is preserved, the tool was developed by the field, and she sees the insurers' conduct as desirable, declining to take action against insurers.
I am of the opinion that this is desirable conduct.
Ik ben van mening dat hier sprake is van gewenst gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het inperken van het verzekerd pakket in Caribisch Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the insured benefits in Caribbean Netherlands would be cut to match the European Netherlands from 1 January 2015, including the loss of physiotherapy coverage, and whether this is justified given socio-economic conditions. The minister confirmed the scaling-back of physiotherapy coverage, stated that the Statute allows differing rules, and rejected concerns about the viability of physiotherapy and the appropriateness of the measure.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de nieuwe zorgverzekeraar Anno12

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether the new insurer Anno12, which requires members to buy a 850 euro certificate for a premium discount, risks risk selection against low-income and sick insured persons. The minister answered that the discount is permitted under the Zvw, that acceptance duty and the ban on premium differentiation are respected, and that the NZa monitors the insurer.
I therefore consider it important that the NZa monitors compliance with the Zvw and closely follows developments regarding the constructions offered.
Ik vind het daarom van belang dat de NZa toeziet op naleving van de Zvw en ontwikkelingen rondom aangeboden constructies nauwlettend volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over de ebola uitbraak

Two PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands was not part of a ministerial emergency meeting on Ebola, whether the government takes the public health risk seriously, and whether it will push for an EU-wide halt to flights from West Africa. The Minister replied that no invitation was received, that the risk is taken seriously with reference to a letter, and that she rejects flight bans because the virus should be isolated and regional borders kept open.
No. The three affected countries have, in line with WHO guidelines, introduced exit screening.
Nee. De drie getroffen landen hebben, conform de WHO richtlijnen, exit screening ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de aanzienlijk grotere kans op complicaties bij longkankeroperaties op vrijdag

An MP asked the health minister about a study finding higher complication rates for lung cancer surgery on Fridays, personnel shortages in evening and weekend care, and whether patients can access quality information. The minister said the cause is not yet proven, that hospitals and professionals are responsible with the Inspectorate supervising, and that quality transparency efforts continue.
It is primarily up to the care providers themselves to deliver good and safe care and to continuously seek how it can be improved.
Het is primair aan de zorgverleners zelf om goede en veilige zorg te leveren en permanent te zoeken hoe het nog beter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de zorgpremie een stuk lager kan

MP Voortman asks whether health insurers hold excess reserves and profits that could lower the health premium, and whether the minister will urge them to return them. Minister Schippers acknowledges higher-than-required reserves but argues double gearing inflates the figures, says reserves will be needed for Solvency II and the AWBZ transfer, and says she has asked insurers for better, uniform transparency on premium setting.
I believe health insurers have a social duty to properly inform their insured about the level of the premium and the results achieved.
Ik vind dat zorgverzekeraars de maatschappelijke plicht hebben om hun verzekerden goed over de hoogte van de premie en de behaalde resultaten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat mensen die mogelijk met ebola besmet zijn met een leugentje en ibuprofen op het vliegtuig naar Nederland kunnen stappen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that possibly Ebola-infected travellers could board flights to the Netherlands by lying and taking ibuprofen, and asked whether screening is inadequate and whether flights from risk areas should be banned. The minister did not share the concerns and referred to a separate letter on exit and entry screening.
I do not share or endorse your view. In my letter of 21 October 2014 on Ebola I go into exit and entry screening in detail.
Ik deel of onderschrijf uw mening niet. In mijn brief van 21 oktober 2014 over Ebola ga ik uitgebreid in op exit en entry screening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitblijven van onafhankelijk onderzoek naar een overlijden in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why no independent investigation has been opened into the death of a patient at a Lelystad mental health facility after a judo throw and delayed resuscitation, and whether the IGZ is waiting for the prosecutor's criminal inquiry. The minister replies that the criminal investigation is running independently, that the IGZ has ordered a calamity inquiry led by an independent chair to be delivered in October, and that it will also conduct its own follow-up investigation; the action programme on involuntary care does not cover this case.
Given the seriousness of the incident, the IGZ has judged that a joint inquiry by Triade and GGZ-Flevoland under an independent chair is warranted.
Gelet op de ernst van het voorval heeft de IGZ geoordeeld dat een gezamenlijk onderzoek door Triade en de GGZ-Flevoland onder leiding van een onafhankelijke voorzitter is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over terminale patiënten die onnodig in het ziekenhuis liggen

An MP from the PvdA asks the Minister of Health whether she is aware of a report that terminal patients are often unnecessarily kept in hospital, and what would help GPs refer fewer such patients and discuss dying with them. The Minister agrees home care is preferable, points to existing initiatives, the 2015 home-care entitlement and the National Palliative Care Programme, and names coordination between GPs and hospitals as a theme to improve, without committing to a new concrete step.
I find it very desirable, especially if this matches the wishes of the patient and their environment.
Ik vind het zeer wenselijk, zeker als dit aansluit bij de wens van de patiënt en zijn omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht een dreigend tekort aan euthanasieartsen

The MP asks whether over 100 SCEN euthanasia physicians will lose registration under new BIG-register rules, whether regional SCEN groups will lose up to a third of their members, how this fits rising euthanasia requests, and whether knowledge and peer review will be lost. The minister confirms about 100 physicians may not re-register, states that 167 new SCEN physicians have started since 2012 with more in training, says total numbers are not falling and capacity is monitored, and sees no effect on practice.
There is no reason to assume that the inflow and outflow of SCEN physicians has consequences for the practice of euthanasia and assisted suicide.
Er is geen reden om aan te nemen dat de in- en uitstroom van SCEN-artsen gevolgen heeft voor de praktijk van euthanasie en hulp bij zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financiële steun van Reinier Haga Groep aan het LangeLand Ziekenhuis en de mogelijke overname

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the ACM exemption allowing Reinier Haga Groep to financially support LangeLand Hospital, its possible takeover, job losses, service impacts, and an adviser's reported fee. Minister Schippers answered that the exemption was granted due to payment problems, that no integration steps may be taken until final ACM approval, and that details of the takeover and its consequences are the board's responsibility.
Vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bezuiniging op de sportmedische zorg (ingezonden 18 juli 2014).

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether sports medicine is equivalent to a regular medical specialism and how disagreement between the medical specialists' body and the sports medicine association could be resolved. The Minister replied that sports medicine was legally recognised as a specialism from 1 July 2014, that quality improvement is the responsibility of the professional associations within available funds, and that she corrected an earlier reference to the wrong framework decision.
It is the responsibility of the professional associations themselves to ensure quality improvement within the funds made available for that purpose.
Het is de verantwoording van de beroepsverenigingen zelf om te zorgen voor kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de gelden die daarvoor beschikbaar worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgen om het voortbestaan van GGz voor mensen met gehoorproblemen

An MP asks the Health Minister about worries that specialist mental health care for deaf and hard-of-hearing people may not survive, and whether a transitional funding arrangement will be continued. The minister acknowledges past contributions, says care providers and insurers have responsibility, and intends to continue the transitional arrangement for 2015 while exploring a sustainable funding solution.
I will explore with the NZa, the Zorginstituut and the VNG what a sustainable solution for the funding is.
Ik zal met de NZa, het Zorginstituut en de VNG verkennen wat een toekomstbestendige oplossing voor de bekostiging is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen overname van ggz-instelling Antes door de Parnassia Groep

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the planned takeover of Antes by Parnassia Groep, creating a very large mental health provider, and its effects on patients, staff, continuity of care, competition and bed reduction. The minister largely deferred to the NZa and ACM, said continuity and stakeholder involvement are covered by the mandatory merger assessment, and stated that the merger must not harm addiction care in Rijnmond.
It is not for me to judge this. That is reserved for the Dutch Healthcare Authority and the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover te oordelen. Dat is voorbehouden aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit en de Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked ministers about executive pay at health insurers such as VGZ and Achmea, including whether the sectoral pay norm under the WNT is being respected, why severance payments and interim pension premiums are so high, and whether annual reports disclose pension costs. The ministers answered that pay falls within a sectoral norm with transitional rules, that a review of the sector regime has only just started, that the severance was contractually based, and that a data error in Menzis reporting is being corrected.
On the impact of WNT-2 on pay in the second WNT regime, VWS has asked the health insurance sector for attention.
Over de impact van WNT-2 voor de beloningen in het tweede WNT-regime heeft VWS aandacht gevraagd aan de sector zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het voorkomen van onnodige ziekenhuisopnames in de laatste levensfase

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister how to prevent unnecessary hospital admissions at the end of life, including discussing non-treatment options, reimbursing conversations about end-of-life care, and financing palliative home-care consultations. The minister agreed that doctors should raise non-treatment options, pointed to existing and planned tariffs and the National Palliative Care Programme, and said funding for palliative home-care teams is being examined.
I therefore agree with the suggestion that GPs, but also other doctors, raise the option of not treating with people who are terminally ill.
Ik ben het daarom eens met de suggestie dat huisartsen, maar ook andere artsen, de optie «niet behandelen» aan de orde stellen bij mensen die ongeneeslijk ziek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘Hulpdiensten mochten niet in vluchtgebouw’ en ‘Van der Laan wil opvang voor vluchtelingen’

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about reports that ambulance staff were not allowed into an Amsterdam asylum shelter due to asbestos, causing delay in treating an injured asylum seeker, and about the mayor's call for a national bed-bath-bread scheme. The minister answered that protocol requires a safety clearance before entering asbestos-risk buildings, that the delay was 5-7 minutes for the patient and 10-15 minutes wait in the garage case, and referred the bed-bath-bread question to a separate answer.
The ambulance team was told when dispatched that rescue workers could not simply enter the building because of the presence of asbestos.
Het ambulanceteam kreeg bij de ritopdracht de vermelding mee dat hulpverleners het gebouw niet zomaar mochten betreden vanwege de aanwezigheid van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ebola in Nederland

Two Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren MPs asked the Minister of Health about a possible Ebola case in Roelofarendsveen and whether Dutch ebola medicines and preparedness were adequate. The minister replied that the suspected patient, a returning doctor, tested negative for Ebola (malaria was the cause), that hospitals and GGDs are prepared, and that the RIVM is pursuing experimental drug supply.
I have asked the RIVM to actively follow developments in experimental ebola medicines and to keep me informed.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de ontwikkelingen van experimentele medicijnen tegen ebola actief te volgen en mij daarvan op de hoogte te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Wolbert over het bericht dat zeker 10% van de grotere zwangerschapscomplicaties kan worden voorkomen als zwangere vrouwen niet meer roken

MPs Rebel and Wolbert asked the minister whether smoking during pregnancy could be cut to prevent complications, and about costs, measures, lifestyle warnings and the role of midwives. The minister agreed that smoking reduction matters, pointed to existing programmes and inspectorate action, and declined to add warnings to medicine leaflets citing EU rules and industry views.
The instrument also takes lifestyle aspects into account.
Het instrument houdt ook rekening met leefstijlaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afkopen van het eigen risico bij het Iza Cura Rotterdampakket

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether buying back the statutory deductible under the Iza Cura Rotterdam package for low-income people is acceptable, and how premiums relate to expected costs. The minister answered that such supplementary insurance falls outside the Health Insurance Act and is the insurer's responsibility, that buyback is legal and a consumer choice, and that the NZa monitors the market while no change to the deductible is planned.
Profit figures for collective arrangements are not known.
Winstcijfers van collectiviteiten zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) over de wanorde bij toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she would respond to reports of disorder at the NZa, including unsafe medical data and an ignored whistleblower, and whether the board should be suspended pending an investigation. The minister's answer, given by referring to a prior written consultation on the NZa's 2012 functioning, does not address the questions on substance and points to the earlier document.
The written questions from MP Klever (PVV), question number 2014Z06732, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Klever (PVV), vraagnummer 2014Z06732 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012»

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66) over het bericht dat de Nederlandse zorgautoriteit (NZa) jarenlang medische gegevens, onbeveiligd en in strijd met privacy regels, heeft bewaard

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked how the NZa could keep sensitive patient records and bank card copies unsecured and unchecked for years, what safeguards exist for supervisors' data handling, whether the Dutch data protection authority will be involved, and when the Chamber will be informed. The government's answer is a referral to an earlier written consultation letter on the NZa, without substantive answers to the five questions.

The written questions from MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (both D66), question number 2014Z06807, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2014Z06807 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012» (Kamerstuk 25 268, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) over het schrappen van alarmerende cijfers over de financiële positie van ziekenhuizen door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa allegedly removed alarming figures on hospital finances from a market scan, whether this amounts to manipulation, and whether the minister knew of it, with questions on the regulator's independence and a request for the uncensored version. The minister refers to a previous written consultation report on the NZa's functioning and does not answer the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) over het bericht «Tekorten ziekenhuizen verdoezeld»

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the NZa misinformed Parliament and the ministry about hospitals' financial position, and about the timing of the Borstlap inquiry and possible disciplinary action. The minister referred to a previous letter on a written consultation about the NZa's functioning rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Voortman (GroenLinks), question number 2014Z07269, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks), vraagnummer 2014Z07269 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat instanties het medisch beroepsgeheim omzeilen

An MP asks whether insurers and benefit agencies routinely request full medical files, and what the government will do to stop this bypassing of medical confidentiality. The minister says agencies may need some medical data but must request only what is necessary with patient consent, points to pending penalty legislation and NPCF/KNMG information efforts, and declines a broad government awareness campaign.
I have no reason to doubt the accuracy of the figures, as presented by the NPCF.
Ik heb overigens geen reden te twijfelen aan de juistheid van de cijfers, zoals door de NPCF gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Q-koorts: Staat aansprakelijk’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the state is liable for the Q-fever epidemic, including delayed source tracing, withheld information, the role of manure, the Stichting Q-support evaluation, its budget, and individual compensation. The minister acknowledges that government action could have been better, points to measures taken and the first report on Q-support, and declines individual financial compensation in favour of support through the foundation.
The cabinet has acknowledged that the government's action could have been better.
Het kabinet heeft erkend dat het overheidsoptreden beter had gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verzwijgen van details over de medicijndeal en risico’s inzake gebruik NOAC’s

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about secrecy over the financial arrangement with NOAC manufacturers, a civil servant's conduct, and safety data on dabigatran and other NOACs. The minister denied the newspaper's account, explained that confidentiality of prices was a manufacturer condition accepted to secure savings, and said the EMA and CBG are reviewing the safety findings without committing to a new blood-level monitoring requirement.
I ultimately agreed to this, while repeatedly indicating in contacts with both parties that I wanted to maintain as much transparency as possible beyond the financial details.

Hiermee heb ik uiteindelijk ingestemd, waarbij ik herhaaldelijk in de contacten met beide partijen heb aangegeven buiten de financiële gegevens een zo groot mogelijke transparantie te willen betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Euripid-netwerk

MP Kuzu asked the minister about the state and usefulness of the Euripid network of drug price databases, Dutch participation, its use for the Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen, and whether meeting reports can be published. The minister answered that 22 EU states now contribute, that Nederland mainly joins for price indication, that the database may be used for comparisons, and that the reports cannot be made public because the network agreed that price information is shared only among government bodies.
This means that the reports cannot be made public.
Dit wil zeggen dat de verslagen niet openbaar gemaakt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de IKON-uitzending de Wachtkamer ‘Vechten voor hoop’

MPs Keijzer, Dik-Faber and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a broadcast on coma patients and whether care depends on age and insurer. The minister said no current figures exist for all coma patients, that care follows scientific insight, that the Zorginstituut judged early intensive neurorehabilitation not insured for adults in 2009, and that the institute will re-examine it and may talk to the Zorgen na Coma foundation.
No figures are available on the total number of coma patients, only on the group eligible for early intensive neurorehabilitation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totale aantal comapatiënten, wel over de groep patiënten die in aanmerking komt voor vroege intensieve neurorevalidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Grote fouten bij de hulpverlening bij het dodelijk rallyongeluk op 1 september 2013 in Amsterdam'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reported serious failures in emergency care after a fatal rally accident, including an unqualified private ambulance driver moving an injured child, and about oversight of private ambulance services and profit motives. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing IGZ investigation, said no growth in regulated private ambulance services is occurring, and promised to consult parties involved in event medical care before deciding whether action is needed.
This case is part of an investigation by the IGZ. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on it.
Deze casus is onderdeel van een onderzoek van de IGZ. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik daarover geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over controle op kwalificaties ambulancepersoneel

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether private ambulance services with insufficiently qualified staff are spreading and whether the government will check ambulance staff qualifications before incidents occur. The minister replied that event first-aid providers are not ambulance services, that the IGZ supervises quality through risk-based inspection, and that pre-checking every worker is not feasible, while promising to consult stakeholders on event care confusion.
Prior testing of the qualifications of every care provider by the government is not feasible; this responsibility rests with the care provider responsible for quality.
Vooraf toetsen van de kwalificaties van iedere zorgverlener door de overheid is niet uitvoerbaar, deze verantwoordelijkheid is belegd bij de voor de kwaliteit verantwoordelijke zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het grote aantal abortussen waarbij sprake is van financiële redenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the large share of abortions with financial motives and whether the government would act on it. The minister answered that no extra measures are planned, that the woman decides on the emergency, and that a ZonMW study on abortion motives is expected in mid-2016.
It is not mandatory for the treating physician to register and report the nature of the emergency situation.
Het is niet verplicht voor de behandelend arts om de aard van de noodsituatie te registreren en te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the Q-fever investigation in Herpen is too slow, whether screening should be expanded, and about a dissertation on antibody testing. The Minister replies that the research runs within subsidy deadlines, first results show no large group of missed patients, and a single antibody check one year after acute infection is recommended for patients without risk factors.
At the next revision of the LCI Q-fever guideline, this recommendation will be included.
Bij de volgende revisie van de LCI-richtlijn Q-koorts zal deze aanbeveling opgenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Kwaliteitsvisie Spoedeisende Zorg van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (concentratie van spoedzorg)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the Zorgverzekeraars Nederland quality vision on concentrating emergency care, its possible conflict with competition law flagged by the ACM, and the secrecy of the plans. The Minister replied that the ACM acted on its own supervisory initiative, that the plans are transparent and that insurers decide when to share them, and that she sees no need to assess the plans herself, refusing a national hospital network debate.
My approval is not required for this.
Mijn goedkeuring is hiervoor niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over schendingen van de privacy bij het bellen van het alarmnummer

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked whether the privacy of people is breached when online pages show that ambulance, police or fire services were at a given address, why the issue has not yet been resolved nationally, why some regions shield addresses and others do not, and when it will be fixed. The minister agrees it is undesirable, says a Northern Netherlands approach withholding location in most calls is being evaluated for national use, that encryption of paging messages is being examined, and that the Kamer will be informed later this year.
I find it undesirable from a privacy standpoint that information from paging messages of the emergency services remains visible on internet sites for a long time.
Ik vind het vanuit privacy-oogpunt onwenselijk dat informatie uit pagingberichten van de hulpdiensten langdurig zichtbaar is op internetsites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de tweede berisping in korte tijd voor de Levenseindekliniek

An SGP MP asked the health minister about a second reprimand in a short period for the Levenseindekliniek, including whether the physician properly established unbearable suffering and what measures could be taken. The minister declined to judge pending IGZ and OM proceedings, noted a guidance document on written declarations is being prepared, and said no additional measures were warranted for now, while outlining IGZ's enforcement powers.
Both bodies, within their own competences, have the task of further investigating the matter and taking a decision on that basis.
Beide instanties hebben binnen hun eigen bevoegdheid de taak om de zaak verder te onderzoeken en naar aanleiding daarvan een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over misstanden in het verleden bij spermabanken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about past irregularities at sperm banks, including incorrect donor information for children conceived before 2004 and the Fiom DNA database. The minister said she will consult Fiom and the IGZ, supports the Fiom database financially, but is not planning a government-run DNA database and says some pre-2004 donor records may no longer exist.
I will consult with Fiom about their findings.
Ik zal in overleg treden met Fiom over hun bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Albert De Vries over strijd tussen Zeeuwse ziekenhuizen

MPs Bouwmeester and De Vries asked the Minister of Health about the dispute between two Zeeland hospital organisations and how to ensure patient interests prevail. The Minister answered that hospitals and insurers bear primary responsibility, that a provincial investigator has been appointed, and that she sees no role for herself unless continuity or safety of care is at stake.
I have no role here unless the continuity of essential care or the safety of care is at stake.
Ik heb hier geen rol tenzij de continuïteit van de cruciale zorg of de veiligheid van de zorg in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verband tussen maagzuurremmers en voedselinfecties

An MP asks the health minister about the RIVM finding linking proton-pump inhibitors to Campylobacter infections and about prescribing, information and possible further research. The minister answers that the CBG still judges the benefit-risk balance positively, that prescribers and patients bear responsibility, and that no new research or public campaign is planned.
How many people have died from infections as a result of using acid-suppressing drugs is not known to me.
Hoeveel mensen zijn overleden aan de infecties als gevolg van het gebruik van maagzuurremmers is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de mogelijke wijziging van het Sportbesluit

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about possible changes to the VAT sports exemption after the Bridport judgment, including effects on municipalities and sports clubs. The government answered that the Bridport ruling requires reviewing the exemption, that no decision or cost estimate has been made yet, and that the review will weigh all financial and legal aspects.
As stated, a carefully considered decision on the design of the sports exemption will be taken after weighing all financial, organisational, legal, administrative and implementation aspects.

Zoals gemeld zal met afweging van alle financiële, organisatorische, juridische, administratieve en uitvoeringsaspecten een weloverwogen besluit worden genomen over de vormgeving van de sportvrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stroperige gang van zaken bij een overlijden in het buitenland

The MP asked why repatriating a deceased Dutch national from Germany took a week, forcing a closed-coffin funeral, and what could be done to speed up such cases. The Minister of Foreign Affairs replied that the ministry was not involved in this case, that release of bodies is a matter for local authorities and national procedures, and that EU coordination offers no prospect of change.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in the repatriation of the body of Mr. K.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen betrokkenheid gehad bij de repatriëring van het lichaam van de heer K.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de privacy van patiënten slecht gewaarborgd is

An MP asked the health minister about media reports that patient privacy is poorly protected, including insurer staff unaware of the privacy arrangement, the SBG benchmark database, and the DIS diagnosis database. The minister replied that insurers must respect the privacy regulation, that SBG and DIS use pseudonymisation and controls that the CBP accepted, and that the data collection is lawful and worth continuing.
Insurers have meanwhile reminded the relevant staff once more of the existence of the privacy arrangement.
Inmiddels hebben zorgverzekeraars de medewerkers waar dit relevant voor is nogmaals gewezen op het bestaan van de privacyregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de beloning van interim-adviseur van het Kennemer Gasthuis

An SP MP asks ministers whether a hospital's interim adviser paid above the WNT pay cap, and whether consultancy firms are evading the WNT, is acceptable and should be investigated. The minister replies that the WNT applies, that oversight tools exist, that her ministry does not audit hospital management or consultancies, and that she will review the audit protocol for annual reports.
It is not my task to audit the business operations of healthcare institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de rol en zorgvuldigheid van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's handling of an informal agreement with a psychologist who had a relationship with a patient, the legal basis for such agreements, the Tuchtcollege ruling on the lack of a transitional arrangement, and an erroneous IGZ report on a Leeuwarden hospital. The Minister answered that the case did not involve an informal agreement under the agreed criteria, that the policy change was documented and public, that 13 individuals were identified with no current involvement, and that the erroneous wording was corrected by erratum.
In this case there is no question of an informal occupational restriction agreement between the practitioner and the IGZ.
Er is in deze casus geen sprake van een onderhandse beroepsbeperkende afspraak tussen de beroepsbeoefenaar en de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Reddingsbrigade een ongekend drukke tijd heeft

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about declining swimming ability among children, whether compulsory swimming lessons were abolished as a cause, whether the Zwem-ABC should be required, the decline of school swimming, and whether a new safety-net scheme should be reinstated. The minister answered that 94% of children still obtain at least one swimming diploma, that swimming skill is mainly parents' responsibility, that no evidence links the abolition to declining skills, and that no new safety-net scheme is planned.
I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie hier geen aanleiding toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de aanstelling van de heer Plukker als interim-voorzitter van de raad van bestuur van het Radboudumc

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the appointment of F. Plukker as interim chair of the Radboudumc board, his remuneration, caps on hours and pay, and transparency of interim executives' pay. The minister answered that the WNT sets the legal framework, that supervisory boards decide pay independently, and that enforcement under the WNT is ex post, so she has no intention to intervene in the details.
It is not for the Minister of VWS to negotiate the employment contract of executives together with a supervisory board.
Het is niet aan de Minister van VWS om samen met een Raad van Toezicht het arbeidscontract van bestuurders uit te onderhandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Ex-manager ziekenhuis krijgt 3,4 ton mee’

An MP asked ministers whether a hospital manager's €340,000 severance payment falls under the Wet normering topinkomens, why it exceeds the usual cantonal-judge formula, and what steps will be taken against the hospital and the sector. The minister confirmed the payment, said the manager is not a top official under the Wnt so the pay cap does not apply, pointed to a planned extension of the cap to all (semi)public-sector staff with a conclusion expected in 2015, and said no rules were broken so no action is needed.
The cabinet is currently carrying out a policy exploration in preparation for that bill.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment een beleidsverkenning uit als voorbereiding op dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Half miljoen vertrekregeling voor bestuurder VUmc’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked about a severance arrangement of over 300,000 euro, plus eight months of continued pay, for a former VUmc board member, and whether it breaches the WNT, who will recover it, and why it was not published earlier. The government answers that the arrangement was agreed before the WNT entered into force, so transitional law applies, that it is reported in the annual report as required, and that it does not intend to reopen the transitional rules.
Because the agreements were made before this law entered into force, they probably fall under the transitional law.
Omdat de afspraken hierover voor de inwerkingtreding van deze wet zijn gemaakt, vallen deze waarschijnlijk onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mogelijke sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp in Weert

MPs Bruins Slot and Knops asked the minister about the possible closure of the emergency department at Sint Jans Gasthuis in Weert, the planned regional reorganisation of acute care, and whether the 45-minute access norm and quality criteria are adequately protected. The minister answered that insurers bear primary responsibility for contracting, the joint insurer plan has been suspended after ACM concerns, and the 45-minute norm remains the key safeguard, while declining to make the regional plans public.
It is also not for me to make these plans public.
Het is ook niet aan mij om deze plannen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over verrassingsrekeningen na bezoek aan spoedeisende hulp in het ziekenhuis

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister how patients can be better informed about where to go for urgent care and its costs, to avoid surprise bills after emergency department visits. The minister acknowledged the need for better cost information, pointed to ongoing initiatives with insurers and providers, and gave partial answers on which hospitals lack GP cooperation and on monitoring ED use.
The information on which hospitals have not made agreements with GPs on reducing unnecessary use of the emergency department is not known to me.
De informatie in welke ziekenhuizen geen afspraken zijn gemaakt met huisartsen over het terugdringen van het onnodig gebruik van de SEH is mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afhandeling van overtredingen van de Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg door de NZa totdat het nieuwe samenwerkingsprotocol met het OM in werking is getreden

MPs Leijten (SP) asked how the NZa will handle Wmg violations involving possible overlap with criminal conduct until the new cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service takes effect, including whether the 'grown practice' of referring only deliberate cases to the OM is appropriate, and how the VUmc children's ward fraud case will be handled. The ministers answered that the NZa applies its enforcement policy, that the CSO Zorg practice is a non-binding agreement among partners, that an updated protocol is expected before 1 October 2014, and declined to comment on the individual ongoing VUmc case.
The protocol is an agreement between the participating partners among themselves; it is up to the partners themselves to hold each other to the working arrangements.
Het protocol is een afspraak van de deelnemende partners onderling, het is aan de partners zelf om elkaar op werkafspraken aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over financiering en eigendom Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep Groningen

An MP asked the Health and Interior ministers about the OZG hospital group becoming a subsidiary of UMCG, a provincial loan of 50 million euro for new building, possible state aid issues, and effects on neighbouring hospitals. The minister answered that competition authorities NZa and ACM are reviewing the takeover, that the province has not yet decided on the loan and state-aid compliance is the province's responsibility, and that insurers decide their own contracting under their duty of care.
In principle it is not prohibited for the UMCG to take over other care providers.
Het is in beginsel niet verboden voor het UMCG om andere zorgaanbieders over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het besluit van de NZa om het onderzoeksrapport inzake de boeteoplegging aan het Sint Antonius Ziekenhuis  niet openbaar te maken

An MP asked why the NZa refused to publish its investigation report on the fine imposed on the Sint Antonius hospital, questioning the Wob basis, whether secrecy still applies after the case closed, and whether an anonymised version could be released so parliament can exercise oversight. The minister replied that the report is a separate document from the fining decision, that the report of findings has now been attached to a letter to parliament, and that the fining decision itself was already published.

The report of findings of the supervisory authority has now been attached as an annex to the letter 'Submission of the Borstlap committee report, evaluation of the Wmg and other assessment of NZa administrative costs'.
Het rapport van bevindingen van de toezichthouder is inmiddels als bijlage bij de brief «Aanbieding rapport commissie Borstlap, evaluatie Wmg en andere beoordeling bestuurskosten NZa» bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de invoering van NIPT

An MP asked the health minister about the rollout of non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT), including who qualifies as high-risk, whether a foreign lab offers it without a licence, and how it is funded abroad. The minister answered that NIPT is limited to women with an increased risk after a positive combination test, that the Inspectorate is being consulted on the foreign lab, and that the Health Council will be asked to advise on the whole prenatal screening chain.
I have made the funding available for this. Dutch care providers cooperating with this foreign laboratory are possibly violating the Wbo.
Ik heb de financiering hiervoor ter beschikking gesteld. Nederlandse zorgaanbieders die samenwerken met dit buitenlandse laboratorium overtreden hiermee mogelijk de Wbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat tijdelijke bestuurders de zorg overspoelen

The SP's Leijten asks the health minister about reports that temporary and externally hired executives are increasingly running care organisations, and whether this harms governance, continuity and accountability. The minister answers that such contracts are not inherently problematic, that supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and governance, and declines to compile lists of failed or temporary executives or to pursue a collective agreement or structural change to board models.
It is not my task to examine the business operations of care institutions, nor to supervise the suitability of individual executives of care institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten, noch om toe te zien op de geschiktheid van individuele bestuurders van zorginstellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het afsluiten van lopende behandelingen in de eerstelijns geestelijke gezondheidszorg vanwege het bereiken van het inkoopplafond van zorgverzekeraars Menzis en Achmea

An MP asked the Minister whether insurers Menzis and Achmea ending ongoing mental health treatments after reaching spending caps was acceptable, and about switching therapists and self-payment consequences. The Minister replied that reaching a spending cap is not a reason to stop treatment, that providers must finish treatment or refer patients, and that insurers have a duty of care to contract sufficient care, while saying she would not herself act beyond these points.
Reaching the revenue cap is not a reason to stop a treatment.
Het bereiken van het omzetplafond is geen reden om een behandeling te staken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de winststijging van Achmea Zorg tot 159 miljoen euro in het eerste halfjaar van 2014

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether it is acceptable that health insurer Achmea's profits and reserves keep rising, and whether reserves should be capped or skimmed to lower premiums. Minister Schippers answered that the reserves are needed for solvency under Solvency II and the transfers from the AWBZ, that she will not claw back reserves or set maximum solvency limits, and that insurers themselves decide how to use surplus reserves.
I am not willing to do so. Firstly, it is not for me to determine which part of the reserves can be labelled as superfluous, and secondly I also have no legal powers to claw back reserves.

Ik ben daartoe niet bereid. In de eerste plaats is het niet aan mij om te bepalen welk deel van de reserves als overbodig kunnen worden betiteld en in de tweede plaats heb ik ook geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om reserves af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over “het groeiende antisemitisme en anti-Israëlsentiment”

The MP asks the ministers about a Sparta goalkeeper calling the CIDI a criminal organisation, the KNVB's response, why Muslim communities do not condemn conflicts abroad, and whether antisemitism is growing. The minister deplores the remark, notes the KNVB and Sparta see no role for themselves, and defers the question on growing antisemitism to a parallel answer given to the Prime Minister.
Both the KNVB and football club Sparta see no role for themselves in this.
Zowel de KNVB als voetbalclub Sparta zien hierin geen rol voor zichzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de GGZ-instellingen uitstel vragen voor de jaarrekening

MP Leijten asked the Health Minister about GGZ mental health providers failing to produce their 2013 annual accounts, including when the government knew of the problem, the grant of deadline extensions without informing parliament, and whether the DBC payment system works. The minister answered that she has been working with the sector on a plan of action, granted a final generic extension to 1 October 2014, and attributed the problems to norm unclarity and transition issues while declining to provide figures on banks or bankruptcy risk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de recente ebola-uitbraak in Afrika

An MP asked the Health Minister about Dutch preparedness for a possible Ebola arrival, including whether flights from affected countries should be blocked and what the government would do given spread to Nigeria and transport of cases to the US. The minister answered that RIVM advises organisations, protocols and reporting duties exist, WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions, and RIVM monitors developments closely.
RIVM follows the daily updates issued by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO).
Het RIVM volgt de dagelijkse updates die het European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) en de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de uitbraak van het ebolavirus in West-Afrika

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the spread of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa, Dutch involvement, risks to Dutch public health, screening of travellers, and the differing travel advice of the US and the Netherlands. The government answered that the risk in the Netherlands is low, that it follows WHO, RIVM and LCR advice, that entry screening is not recommended, and that it has provided funding and tightened travel advice for some affected countries.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs therefore has no view of the exact number of Dutch nationals in these countries.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft daarom geen zicht op het exacte aantal Nederlanders in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer en Leijten over de ebola-uitbraak in West-Afrika

SP MPs asked the government to explain the WHO's declaration of the West African Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency, which requests for help Dutch authorities had received, whether Nederland would provide solidarity and logistical support, and why. The minister answered that Nederland contributes about 822,600 euro via Artsen Zonder Grenzen and the Red Cross plus indirect funding through the EU, CERF and WHO, and that a further WHO request for medical experts and field hospitals was still being studied.
At this moment the recent WHO request, which in addition to financial support also asks for medical experts, field hospitals, etc., is still being studied.
Op dit moment wordt het recente verzoek van de WHO, waarin naast financiële steun ook wordt verzocht om medische experts veldziekenhuizen, etc nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het schrappen van vluchten van en naar ebola-landen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why KLM still flies to Nigeria during the Ebola outbreak while British Airways suspended flights, how the government views staff fear, and whether it will close Dutch airspace to Ebola-country flights. The minister answered that airlines make their own assessments, that the WHO advises no travel restrictions which the government follows, that screening and guidance are in place, and that closing airspace is not proposed.
No. We currently follow the WHO advice, which states that no restrictions on international traffic are necessary.
Nee. Wij volgen op dit moment de adviezen van de WHO die aangeeft dat er geen beperkingen van internationaal verkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat patiënten niet kunnen wisselen van huisarts

An MP asked the minister about a NPCF study finding that a third of patients wanting to switch GP cannot do so, and whether GP market-sharing arrangements exist. The minister acknowledged the problem, committed to talks with the LHV and NPCF, said no own research data exist, and noted that market-sharing agreements are generally prohibited and enforced by the ACM.
I have committed to your House to enter into talks with the Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging and the NPCF to jointly find a solution to this problem.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd om in gesprek te gaan met de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging en de NPCF om gezamenlijk tot een oplossing voor dit probleem te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ziekenhuizen in Sittard-Geleen en Heerlen en de mogelijke concentratie van klinische verloskunde in Heerlen

An SP MP asked the minister about the Sittard-Geleen and Heerlen hospital merger, financial problems, the proposed concentration of obstetrics in Heerlen, staffing, quality, accessibility and home births.
