The minister replied that finances are positive, the merger is planned for 1 January 2015, obstetrics concentration is a hospital decision, quality and accessibility norms are currently met, and she declines to intervene.
No, I am not willing to do so.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht 'Slechts één kliniek voor protonenbestraling'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health whether the allocation of only one proton therapy clinic, and the granting of four licences, amounts to a cartel arrangement by health insurers and whether the NZa and ACM should be asked to impose fines. The Minister answered that the ACM, not the NZa, supervises cartel rules, that insurers are responsible for compliance, and that the licences were granted because all four applicants met the regulation's conditions.
It is therefore up to the ACM to assess whether there are cartel agreements that restrict competition.
Het is dan ook aan de ACM om te toetsen of sprake is van kartelafspraken die de concurrentie beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bijwerkingen van de Nuvaring

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reported side effects of the Nuvaring contraceptive, including allegedly withheld data, a US settlement, and whether the product should still be used given higher thrombosis risk. The Minister replied that the CBG found no withheld information, that the relative thrombosis risk is higher than second-generation pills but absolute risk remains low, and that the package leaflet was recently revised.
I asked the College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) to inform me about this.
Ik heb het College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) gevraagd mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over actieve levensbeëindiging bij kinderen tussen 1 en 12 jaar

An MP asked the health minister about calls within the Dutch paediatric association to allow active end-of-life decisions for children aged 1 to 12, the lack of registration of euthanasia requests, and low reporting to the Hubben committee for newborns. The minister answered that such acts are not currently permitted for this age group, that the newborn regulation will be clarified by spring 2015, and that the paediatric association will issue a position and commission an inventory study before any further action.
There is no central registration of euthanasia requests, whether from minors or adults.
Er is geen centrale registratie van euthanasieverzoeken, ongeacht of die afkomstig zijn van minderjarigen of meerderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vondst van de tijgermug bij diverse bandenbedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about tiger mosquitoes found at several tyre companies despite a covenant, and whether legal regulation, prosecution or stricter import rules should follow. The Minister said the cause is being investigated by the NVWA, that the covenant is enforceable via the Environmental Management Act duty of care, and that voluntary agreements are preferred over statutory rules, while also answering questions on the Asian bush mosquito, communication to Lelystad residents and company locations.
It is still unclear why tiger mosquitoes were found at several locations despite measures taken.
Het is nog onduidelijk waarom er op meerdere locaties ondanks genomen maatregelen tijgermuggen zijn aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende teloorgang van het St. Jans Gasthuis in Weert door het beleid van CZ, VGZ en andere zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked whether health insurers CZ, VGZ and others plan to stop contracting stroke, childbirth and hip operation care at St. Jans Gasthuis in Weert, and whether they should publish their hospital plans. The minister replied that the joint insurer trajectory has ended, that each insurer decides its own purchasing policy, that the IGZ sees no quality problems, and that ZN's criteria are public.
It is the responsibility of individual health insurers to weigh up, based on price and quality data among other things, decisions on care purchasing.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van individuele zorgverzekeraars om op basis van onder andere prijs- en kwaliteitsgegevens afwegingen te maken bij de zorginkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over een richtlijn over het bespreken van alternatieven voor abortus door huisartsen

Parliamentary member Van der Staaij asked whether GPs should have a guideline and legal duty to inform women with unwanted pregnancies about alternatives to abortion, given that six in ten are referred to abortion clinics by GPs. Minister Schippers replied that the legal duty to inform on alternatives applies to clinics and hospitals rather than GPs, but that GPs play an important role, pointed to existing tools (a Fiom/NHG quickscan and an NGvA guideline) and said a handling protocol for GPs and specialists is being developed.
For the GP, such obligations are not included in the regulations.
Voor de huisarts zijn dergelijke verplichtingen niet opgenomen in de regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onrust die is ontstaan in Zeeland rondom de plannen van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about planned cuts to ADRZ hospital services on Walcheren, including access to the CEAN report, the CZ regional vision, staffing, referral practices and links to private clinics. The minister answered that she has not seen the CEAN report or CZ's vision, that capacity decisions on Walcheren are not yet final, that acute care is considered guaranteed, and that hospital organisation is a matter for the parties involved.
I do not have CZ's Regiovisie and it is not for me to make it public.
Ik heb de Regiovisie van CZ niet en het is ook niet aan mij om die openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving over de verminderde psychologische hulp aan partners van kankerpatiënten

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that psychological help for partners of cancer patients is no longer reimbursed under the basic insurance since 2013, and whether this leads to a shift toward specialist mental health care. The minister replies that such care is not covered by basic insurance absent a disorder, points to supplementary insurance, GP practice-assistant GGZ, internet therapy and inloophuizen, and promises to raise these options with the Dutch GP association.
No, there is no insight into the number of partners of cancer patients who forgo psychological help.
Nee, er is geen inzicht in het aantal partners van kankerpatiënten dat afziet van psychologische hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bezuiniging op de sportmedische zorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why subsidies for preventive sports medicine and injury prevention were reported to be cut by 40% in 2015 and ended in 2016, and what the consequences would be. The Minister replied that subsidy to the Vereniging voor Sportgeneeskunde ends in 2016 following recognition of sports medicine as a medical specialty, that injury-prevention funding will be redirected rather than eliminated, and that she expects no increase in social costs or deterioration in care.
I am ending project funding to the Dutch Association of Sports Medicine (VSG) from 2016 because sports medicine was recognised as a medical specialty earlier this year.
Ik beëindig de projectfinanciering aan de Vereniging van Sportgeneeskunde (VSG) met ingang van 2016 vanwege de erkenning van de sportgeneeskunde als geneeskundig specialisme eerder dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Wolbert over stagetekort voor studenten Medische hulpverlening

MPs Mohandis and Wolbert asked about a shortage of internship places for Medical Assistance (Medisch hulpverlener) students and whether the profession would be BIG-registered. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said it is primarily the responsibility of hospitals, and said registration decision is being prepared with an expected answer after the summer.
The civil-servant preparation for the decision-making by the Minister of VWS has meanwhile been set in motion.
De ambtelijke voorbereiding voor de besluitvorming door de Minister van VWS is inmiddels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de voorgenomen aanpassing van het Sportbesluit

Rep. Van Veen asks whether the State Secretary of Finance signalled to sports parties a far-reaching revision of the Sportbesluit after the Bridport CJEU ruling, and about its financial and municipal consequences. The government confirms the Bridport ruling prompted reconsideration of the VAT sports exemption, says the financial impact is not yet quantified and will be assessed carefully, and promises a decision later via the Fiscale Verzamelwet 2015.
A substantiation of the amount has (for the time being) not been shared with us.
Een onderbouwing van het bedrag is (vooralsnog) niet met ons gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het verbieden van festivals waar niet krachtig tegen drugsgebruik wordt opgetreden

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked whether festivals with drug problems should keep receiving permits and what legal grounds exist to refuse or revoke them. The government answered that no national rules set permit conditions, that municipalities may refuse permits only where drug use would likely cause public order or health problems, and that some municipalities already attach anti-drug conditions.
The suspicion of drug use in itself is not a ground for refusal.
Het vermoeden van drugsgebruik op zich is geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert De Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat het RIVM heeft geconcludeerd dat bewoners van Krimpregio’s zich gemiddeld minder gezond voelen

MPs Albert de Vries and Wolbert asked about the RIVM finding that residents of shrinking regions feel less healthy on average, and whether equal health rights, care provision and local action are being ensured. The minister acknowledges the socioeconomic link, points to primary responsibility at local level and existing programmes, and promises follow-up letters on curative care and the RIVM study after the summer.
Proximity of care, also for the patient/citizen in the shrinking regions, is one of the policy priorities.
Nabijheid van zorg, ook voor de patiënt/burger in de krimpregio’s, is één van de speerpunten van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen terugkrijgen

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented migrants in Amsterdam receive free medicines, whether the mayor breaches agreements, and how the government will ensure departure. The minister answered that undocumented migrants are responsible for care costs, that reimbursement via Zorginstituut is possible with a €5 correction, that the mayor's payment of that amount is a municipal matter, and that she was not consulted in advance.
To what extent municipalities bear these costs themselves and how they have organised this is not for me to assess.
In hoeverre gemeenten deze kosten voor eigen rekening nemen en hoe zij dit georganiseerd hebben, staat niet aan mij ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het voortbestaan van het onafhankelijke Geneesmiddelenbulletin

MP Van Gerven asked whether the minister commissioned Significant to evaluate the independent Geneesmiddelenbulletin and whether its existence is at stake. The minister confirmed the evaluation concerns the effectiveness of ministry subsidy in achieving policy goals, not the bulletin's right to exist, and promised a separate letter after the summer recess.
The achieved result is leading here, and not the right to exist of, in this case, the Geneesmiddelenbulletin.
Het bereikte resultaat is hierbij leidend, en niet het bestaansrecht van, in dit geval, het Geneesmiddelenbulletin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgsector een goede markt is voor interim-managers

An MP asked the health minister for a reaction to a report that hourly rates for interim managers in healthcare rose from €112 to €145, and how this squares with layoffs and the WNT pay norms. The minister declined to answer substantively, arguing the study's small healthcare sample (11% of 484 respondents) and mixed methodology make the findings unreliable.
Therefore it is impossible for me to give a good answer to your questions.
Derhalve is het voor mij onmogelijk op uw vragen een goed antwoord op te geven.
Vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de gouden handdruk van een weggestuurde ziekenhuisbestuurder (ingezonden 18 juni 2014).

MP Klever (PVV) asked the Minister of Health why a dismissed hospital board member received a large severance payment, who approved it, what measures will end such payments, and whether a blacklist of dysfunctional managers should be created. The Minister replied that the Wnt wage-norm law now caps such severance, that the supervisory board of VUMC honoured earlier contractual agreements, that board appointments are the supervisory board's responsibility, and that she sees no need for a blacklist, which she declined to organise.
I am of the view that supervisory boards must exercise all due care when filling board vacancies and examine candidates' earlier careers for factors that could make them unsuitable.
Ik ben van mening dat Raden van Toezicht bij het vervullen van vacatures voor bestuurders alle zorgvuldigheid in acht moeten nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Ypma over het bericht ‘Kinderen de dupe van slecht georganiseerd zwemonderwijs’

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that children are poorly served by a proliferation of swimming diplomas and that many are insufficiently swim-proficient. The minister disputed the 66% figure, said most children obtain at least one diploma, placed responsibility on parents, and declined to introduce a legally certified swimming diploma.
I have no reason to do so.
Ik heb daar geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de wijze waarop ziekenhuizen euthanasieverzoeken behandelen

An MP asked the Minister of Health how hospitals handle euthanasia requests, citing a report that Albert Schweitzer hospital received over 100 requests while carrying out only 15 euthanasias. The Minister answered that the ratio differs from national figures (with comparability uncertain), that doctors find it hard to judge true wishes to die, and that hospitals are free to organise euthanasia care as they see fit, with a dedicated consultant being one option.
Hospitals are free to shape their services in this area.
Ziekenhuizen zijn vrij om hun dienstverlening op dit gebied vorm te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek van de huisartsen waaruit blijkt dat bijna alle huisartsen meemaken dat patiënten vanwege financiële redenen zich niet laten doorsturen naar het ziekenhuis of naa

An MP asks the health minister about an LHV survey in which nearly all GPs report patients skipping referrals, lab tests or medication for financial reasons, and how this fits government efforts to reduce socioeconomic health gaps. The minister says the survey is hard to interpret and not conclusive, points to four earlier studies finding no clear rise in care avoidance, and promises a further Vektis study on second-line care use before summer 2015.
I think it is good that the LHV conducted such a survey among its members.
Ik vind het goed dat de LHV een dergelijk onderzoek onder haar leden heeft gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gouden handdruk van een weggestuurde ziekenhuisbestuurder

An MP asked the health minister about a severance payment of about half a million euros given to a dismissed hospital board member and asked for measures and a blacklist of underperforming executives. The minister said the Wnt pay-cap law now limits such severance, that the supervisory board honoured prior contractual agreements, and that a blacklist would not be set up, while the boards must screen candidates carefully.

I am of the view that supervisory boards must exercise all due care when filling executive vacancies and must examine candidates' earlier careers for factors that could show they are unsuitable for the post.
Ik ben van mening dat Raden van Toezicht bij het vervullen van vacatures voor bestuurders alle zorgvuldigheid in acht moeten nemen en de eerdere loopbaan van kandidaten moeten nalopen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Health, and Interior about the planned tendering of forensic medical care and examination by the National Police, including quality, fragmentation, and ministerial responsibility. The government answered that the tender is in its preparatory phase under the light regime of the Aanbestedingswet, that existing providers may bid, and that it rejects a single-ministry responsibility, while declining to disclose some preparatory information.
For the second part of your first question, answering it would release information that may not be disclosed during the preparation of this tender.
Voor het tweede deel van uw eerste vraag geldt dat antwoord geven op deze vraag leidt tot het vrijgeven van informatie die tijdens de voorbereiding van deze aanbesteding niet vrijgegeven mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over het bericht “Patiënt te snel naar ziekenhuis”

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a report that patients are sent to hospital too quickly, including the lack of understandable cost and quality information, potential premium savings, incentives for GP care, and the transparency of hospital bills and prices. The Minister replied that a cost-awareness trajectory with stakeholders is underway, that exact savings cannot be given, that GP substitution is being promoted through hoofdlijnenakkoorden, and that new price and billing information is being published, but gave no figures or binding commitments on quality transparency.
Exact amounts cannot be given for this.
Exacte bedragen zijn hiervoor niet te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgverzekeraars die hun verzekerden geen inzicht willen (helpen) bieden in de opbouw van hun zorgnota en de onduidelijkheid bij verzekerden over het juiste loket voor klacht

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether insured persons can check their care bills, since insurers and providers often withhold the underlying treatment records and diagnosis, and where to complain. The minister replied that a more detailed care bill from 1 June 2014 is on schedule, that insurers are the first point of contact with the SKGZ as fallback, and that agreements on complaint handling are being finalised.
Until 1 June 2014, when the more transparent care bill takes effect, insurers and providers are formally not obliged to supply patients with information at the level of care activities delivered.

Verzekeraars en zorgaanbieders zijn tot 1 juni 2014, wanneer de beter inzichtelijke zorgnota in werking treedt, formeel niet verplicht informatie uit te leveren aan patiënten op het niveau van geleverde zorgactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Aandeelhouders farma belangrijker dan patiënten’

An MP asked whether pharmaceutical R&D serves health needs rather than best-selling drugs, whether financial incentives are right, whether public-funded business models should be studied, and whether industry invests enough in research relative to profits. The minister answered that drug development is primarily the industry's responsibility, that regulation also matters, that she will not commission a broad study of public-funded business models but will pursue targeted measures such as antibiotics and EU initiatives, and that she cannot judge the investment-to-profit ratio.
I am not a proponent of a broad and unqualified study into possibly more effective business models based on public financing for the entire pharmaceutical sector.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een breed en ongeclausuleerd onderzoek naar mogelijk effectievere businessmodellen op basis van publieke financiering voor de hele farmaceutische sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Recourt over lijkschouwers die nog steeds misdrijven missen door gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Wolbert and Recourt asked whether forensic doctors with a short 30-day course get the same powers as those with a four-year profile training, and whether national figures on missed unnatural deaths exist. The minister answered that no such figures are kept, that the professional body's register is considered sufficient guarantee of quality, and that the supply of forensic doctors is not seen as requiring short-term measures.
I do not have figures on the number of times it later became apparent that a natural cause of death had been wrongly assumed.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal keren dat in een later stadium is gebleken dat aanvankelijk onterecht is uitgegaan van een natuurlijke doodsoorzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Separeercel nog te vaak gebruikt’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of frequent and prolonged use of isolation cells in psychiatric care, and what is being done to reduce it, including consultation of the Centre for Consultation and Expertise and inspection oversight. The Minister answered that isolation is a last resort, that the inspectorate enforces a review framework on consultation and isolation, that the number of patients isolated over three months is lower than reported, and that the Wvggz bill is intended to limit coercion further.
Where the IGZ finds that (long-term) isolation is not applied in line with the norms, it takes enforcement action and will hold the institution to its responsibilities.
Daar waar de IGZ constateert dat de (langdurige) separatie niet conform de normen wordt toegepast, treedt zij handhavend op en zal zij de instelling aanspreken op haar verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over de verwachte toename van medische kosten voor asielzoekers

PVV MPs Klever and Fritsma asked about rising costs of medical care for asylum seekers, including screening, costs per asylum seeker, the budget source, contraception coverage, co-payments and whether a deductible or medically-necessary-only limit should apply. The answers state that asylum seekers are screened for tuberculosis at arrival, that 2013 curative medical costs were 72.6 million euro (about 4,870 per person), that the extra costs are funded from the ODA budget, and that the government declines to introduce a deductible or limit care to medically necessary treatment.
Introducing a deductible would mean that the Dutch government reimburses this to itself for asylum seekers.
Het instellen van een eigen risico zou betekenen dat de Nederlandse overheid dit voor asielzoekers aan zichzelf vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over ziekenhuizen die doorverwijzingen van het bevolkingsonderzoek darmkanker niet aan kunnen

Two PvdA MPs asked why referrals from the colorectal cancer screening programme were nearly triple expectations, whether hospitals could cope, and what would be done about waiting times. Minister Schippers attributed the surplus to higher uptake, starting with older cohorts and a more sensitive test, said waiting times had been cut by inviting fewer people, and announced a higher cut-off value to reduce referrals and an effectiveness evaluation.
As soon as the national appointments point signalled that waiting times were rising, the number of invitations was reduced.
Zodra in het landelijke afsprakenpunt werd gesignaleerd dat de wachttijden opliepen, is het aantal uitnodigingen teruggebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over het bericht «Venlo eist salarisverlaging top Zorggroep»

MPs Kerstens, Van Dijk and Fokke asked about a 5% salary increase for the chair of the Zorggroep Noord- en Midden-Limburg board, its link to the Venlo council's demand for a salary cut, and whether the government would back the executive's stance and coordinate with VNG and IPO on local pay norms. Minister Plasterk answered that the increase was lawful under the WNT transitional rules, that voluntary pay cuts are encouraged, and that the case will be raised with VNG and IPO, which are still in talks.
I will include the case in the consultation with VNG and IPO.
Ik zal de casus betrekken bij het overleg met VNG en IPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over over het bericht dat allochtonen vaker een burn-out hebben

MP Kuzu asked the minister about reports that non-Western immigrants suffer burn-out more often, and what the government is doing about it. The minister acknowledges the higher rates, attributes them mainly to labour-market position and other factors, and points to existing campaigns, guidelines and tools without committing to a new investigation.
But every burn-out is one too many.
Maar elke burn-out is er één te veel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over het bericht ‘Eén op de twintig jongeren gebruikt Ritalin bij toetsen’

MP Rutte asked the Health Minister whether she is aware of reports that about 10% of young people use Ritalin, anxiolytics and sleeping pills as study aids, whether doctors prescribe these wrongly, and whether illegal trade exists. The minister agreed the use is undesirable, saw no evidence of improper prescribing, and pointed to illegal internet sales, with IGZ removing offers and a possible future campaign targeting buyers.
I am considering explicitly addressing users who obtain medicines illegally in a future campaign.
Ik overweeg om in een volgende campagne expliciet aandacht te besteden aan gebruikers die op illegale wijze geneesmiddelen aanschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het tekort aan weefseldonoren

Labour MP Arib asks the Minister of Health about the 2013 decline in tissue, skin and cornea donors, its causes, and how to reverse it. Minister Schippers acknowledges the drop, says causes are hard to pinpoint, points to a donation-stimulation plan by the NTS with results promised by year-end, and notes stable transplant numbers.
I expect to be able to inform you of the results at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht dat ik u aan het einde van dit jaar kan informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over handel in illegale en levensbedreigende afslankproducten en doping

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about the easy online sale of illegal slimming pills, anabolics and EPO, low prosecution priority, enforcement capacity, reporting of counterfeit medicines and the doping law. The minister answered that enforcement is part of regular inspection work, a reporting point is being studied with results expected late 2014, and a doping bill has been delayed to late 2014.
After the summer recess you will receive a letter from me on the implementation of the Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra motion.
Na het zomerreces ontvangt u van mij een brief over de uitvoering van de motie Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over mogelijke leveringsproblemen van preferente geneesmiddelen

An MP asked the health minister whether shortages of preferred medicines persist, whether the preference policy lowers costs, and whether wholesalers and the IGZ should be made to ensure adequate stock. The minister answered that shortages are mostly due to manufacturers, that wholesalers have no obligation to be fully assorted, and that the IGZ already checks stock levels without a new instruction.
I will not instruct the IGZ to audit wholesalers on sufficient stock, because the IGZ already routinely includes this point in its supervision of wholesalers.
Ik zal de IGZ geen opdracht geven groothandels te toetsen op het punt van voldoende voorraad omdat de IGZ in haar toezicht op groothandels dit punt al sinds enige tijd standaard meeneemt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de uitzending “Undercover in Nederland” over hulp bij zelfdoding

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a TV programme showing a De Einder counsellor advising on assisted suicide, and about the scale of such advice and referral practices. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and that suicidal people often do not reach care, but gave no figures on De Einder's advice or its link to suicides and declined to discuss the ongoing OM investigation.
Regarding ongoing investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over lopende onderzoeken van het OM kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht “Nepdokteren in Kenia wordt beloond met ridderorde in Nederland”

MPs Van Laar and Kuzu asked ministers about a Dutch homeopath whose non-profit distributes the homeopathic remedy Iquilai as a substitute for antiretrovirals in Kenya, and about his knighthood. The minister says such substitution is harmful, will ask the Dutch embassy to inform Kenyan authorities and asks the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine options, but states she has no power to revoke the honour and no action is possible abroad.
I have therefore asked the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine what options there are to investigate this matter further.
Ik heb daarom de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg gevraagd om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze zaak nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Keijzer over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat een consulent van Stichting De Einder adviezen over zelfdoding geeft

MPs Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked whether a counsellor of Stichting De Einder giving concrete suicide advice and a supplier address to a young woman was acceptable, and whether it was criminal, asking the government to act against the foundation and the Chinese supplier. The minister confirmed the reports, said the Openbaar Ministerie has opened an investigation and declined to comment on it, noted that article 294 Sr is not met since no suicide followed, and pointed to existing medicines-law and economic-offence powers against the supplier.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) is launching an investigation following the reports mentioned.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een onderzoek in naar aanleiding van voornoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het onderzoek naar het verband tussen medicijngebruik en agressie

MPs Van Nispen and Van Gerven asked whether the government will do more research into a possible link between certain medicines, such as antidepressants, and aggression, including taking blood samples from suspects after violent offences. Minister Opstelten answers that the existing drug safety system (CBG, Lareb) already monitors side effects, that the evidence on aggression is mixed and hard to establish in individual cases, that no registration of medicine-linked violence exists, and that there is no legal basis for blood testing of suspects for prescribed medication, which he considers undesirable.
I also do not consider it desirable to create such a legal basis.
Ik acht het ook niet wenselijk om een dergelijke grondslag te creëren.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over garanties in het kader van het bid voor het Europees Kampioenschap v

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt ask the health and finance ministers why tax and VAT exemptions were promised to UEFA for a Euro 2020 bid, why the Chamber was informed late, and why the template and tax guarantees were not shared or justified. The minister's follow-up answer largely sends the signed convenant with the KNVB, Amsterdam and the Arena and says the bid cooperation was agreed as promised, without substantively addressing the tax and legal-basis questions.
I hereby send you the convenant on the Amsterdam UEFA EURO 2020 bid signed by all parties (KNVB, municipality of Amsterdam, Amsterdam Arena and VWS).
Hierbij zend ik u het door alle partijen (KNVB, gemeente Amsterdam, Amsterdam Arena en VWS) ondertekende convenant inzake het Amsterdam UEFA EURO 2020 bid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Helder over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)  het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft gepasseerd bij het fraudeonderzoek in het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis te Nieuwegei

MPs Klever and Helder asked whether the NZa bypassed the Public Prosecution Service (OM) by imposing only an administrative fine in the St. Antonius hospital fraud case, and whether the tripartite protocol was followed. The ministers answered that the NZa independently concluded there was no intent, so the case did not qualify as a criminal offence under the ne bis in idem rules, that the hospital repaid improper claims, and that fraud must be fought through an integrated approach.

The NZa independently concluded, on the basis of the available investigative material, that no intent had been shown in this case and that the conduct therefore did not also constitute a criminal offence.

De NZa heeft zelfstandig, op basis van het beschikbare onderzoeksmateriaal, de conclusie getrokken dat er in het onderhavige geval van opzet niet is gebleken en de gedraging derhalve niet tevens een strafbaar feit opleverde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over een Europees burgerinitiatief tegen onderzoek met menselijke embryonale stamcellen

An MP asks the Health Minister about the European citizens' initiative 'One of Us' opposing research on human embryonic stem cells and whether Dutch rules on embryo research are dependent on EU funding and regulation. The minister defends the value of embryonic stem cell research, states Dutch law is carefully designed though partly shaped by EU directives, and says Dutch context should lead, with Dutch resistance to EU provisions with a medical-ethical character.
I endorse the principle that any adjustments to our legal arrangements should in principle be guided only by the Dutch context.
Ik onderschrijf het uitgangspunt dat voor eventuele aanpassingen van onze wettelijke regelingen en afspraken in principe alleen de Nederlandse context leidend zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Vos Mei Li over het bericht 'Sporter is straks meer kwijt als gemeente niet oplet'

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked whether the Market and Government Act forces municipalities to pass on full costs of sports facilities to clubs, and whether municipalities can instead designate facilities as services of general economic interest (DAEB) to avoid this. The minister answered that the Act aims to prevent unfair competition, that a DAEB designation is possible but subject to supervisory review, and declined to send municipalities a model DAEB decision, relying instead on information sessions organised with the VSG and VNG.
A municipality can, if in its judgement the general interest opposes passing on the full integral cost, refrain from doing so by qualifying the activity as an activity carried out under a DAEB.

Een gemeente kan, indien het algemeen belang zich naar haar oordeel verzet tegen doorberekening van de integrale kostprijs, hiervan afzien door de activiteit te kwalificeren als een activiteit ter uitvoering van een DAEB.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Van Hijum en Slob over de situatie dat Zwolse rolstoelafhankelijke vrouwen voor de screening op borstkanker niet meer terecht kunnen in het ziekenhuis in Zwolle

MPs asked why wheelchair-dependent women from Zwolle cannot use the Isala hospital for breast cancer screening and must travel to a fixed unit in Apeldoorn, and whether the 45-minute travel rule and Valys transport limits should be changed. The minister confirms the situation, defends the policy of prioritising fixed units for quality reasons, refuses to exempt screening trips from Valys kilometre limits, and mentions a possible fixed unit in Zwolle.
I am not willing to exempt transport to the population screening from the maximum number of kilometres a person can travel per year with Valys, as this could set a precedent for other situations.

Ik ben niet bereid om het vervoer naar het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te zonderen van het maximaal aantal kilometers dat iemand op jaarbasis met Valys kan reizen aangezien dit een precedent kan scheppen voor andere situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the ministers about reports that 33% to 60% of Herpen residents had Q-fever, the validity of a new test, chronic Q-fever diagnoses, expanding screening, underreporting and livestock farming limits. The minister answered that the GGD study results are due spring 2015 and that screening expansion will await them, while Q-support has started and an evaluation is planned for around September 2014.
I am awaiting the final result of this study and the related conclusions and recommendations before I seek advice on the necessity and usefulness of a more extensive study.
Ik wacht het uiteindelijke resultaat van dit onderzoek en de daarbij behorende conclusies en aanbevelingen af, voordat ik mij laat adviseren over nut en noodzaak van een uitgebreider onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over patiënten die lange wachttijden melden voor tweedelijns geestelijke gezondheidszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about long waiting times in second-line mental health care reported on TV, including the number of patients waiting, whether zorgverzekeraars are failing their zorgplicht, and what the NZa is doing. The minister said no current national waiting-list data exist, promised an NZa waiting-time measurement and a monitor, said insurers have a duty to refer patients, and committed to pressing insurers and providers on information and to reviewing the NZa information policy rule.
Currently no up-to-date national data are known about waiting lists in mental health care (GGZ).
Momenteel zijn geen actuele landelijke gegevens bekend over wachtlijsten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het gebrek aan kennis over de onderliggende oorzaken van suïcidaal gedrag

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister about the claim that knowledge of the underlying causes of suicidal behaviour is lacking, the rise in suicides, and whether more research investment and prevention were planned. The minister said research is the responsibility of the professional groups, pointed to the existing national suicide prevention agenda 2014-2017 with EUR 1.1 million allocated, and gave no new commitments beyond periodic information to parliament.
It is the responsibility of the professional group(s) themselves to set up and carry out scientific research where gaps in knowledge exist regarding causes and/or treatment.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgroep(en) zelf om daar waar leemtes in kennis zitten op het terrein van oorzaken en/of behandeling, wetenschappelijk onderzoek op te zetten en uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over een uitzending waarin een BIG-geregistreerde arts een ALS-patiënt dupeert

An MP asked the minister about a broadcast showing a BIG-registered doctor falsely promising to cure ALS, and what the Inspectorate had done. The minister said the Inspectorate referred the doctor to the disciplinary court, ordered him to remove misleading material, and described existing and proposed oversight powers over alternative care.
The IGZ decided to submit the doctor's conduct to the disciplinary court for review.
De IGZ heeft besloten het handelen van de arts ter toetsing voor te leggen aan de tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de (dreigende) uitbraak van MERS-CoV

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about the WHO warnings on the rising MERS-CoV outbreak, the apparent contradiction on human-to-human transmission, Saudi advice to risk groups on Hajj, and support for research on animal-to-human transmission. The minister answered that the Netherlands follows WHO advice, informs travellers and clinicians via RIVM and LCR, and that further research on animal transmission should happen mainly on the Arabian peninsula.
Ik onderschrijf de adviezen van de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Bruins Slot en Voortman over het gesloten zorgakkoord met de vijf-partijencoalitie

MPs Leijten, Bruins Slot and Voortman asked the health minister for the text and financial basis of the June 2014 care agreement with the five-party coalition, whether the Finance Ministry and CPB were involved, which care organisations took part, and her view on amendments to the Health Insurance Act. The minister answered that no written agreement exists beyond the amendments, that Finance and CPB were involved in the costing, that the sector bodies signed the sector-level agreements, and that she supports most amendments while opposing those that would reverse the change to article 13.
Apart from this, there is no agreement committed to writing.
Er is hiernaast geen sprake van een op schrift gesteld akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat Alzheimer met preventieve maatregelen terug te dringen is

An MP asked the minister whether Alzheimer's can be delayed or prevented through preventive measures, whether the public is aware of this, whether prevention organisations cooperate on it, what obstacles exist, and when research results are expected. The minister answered that research on prevention is ongoing under the Deltaplan Dementie, promoted healthy lifestyles via the Nationaal Preventie Programma, and expects first research results in 2016.
The first results are expected in 2016.
De eerste resultaten worden in 2016 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over stijging van de inkomens van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether top executive pay in elderly care rose 19% in 2013, whether the WNT transitional rules allow this, and how to prevent further rises during the reform. The government said it cannot yet confirm the figure, that no accountant has reported a WNT breach, that it agrees top pay should not outpace sector wages, and that it will act through supervision and reclaim undue payments if needed.
Moreover, I have not received any reports from the accountants that the WNT has been breached.
Overigens heb ik op dit moment geen meldingen binnen gekregen van de accountants dat de Wnt zou zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het beleid van kinderdagverblijven t.a.v. inentingen van kinderen waar zij zorg voor dragen

An MP asked whether parents have a right to know how daycare centres handle unvaccinated children and whether GGD inspections should cover this, and whether daycares may refuse unvaccinated children. The minister answered that parents may be informed and daycares may voluntarily register vaccination status, that outright refusal lacks a legal basis and could breach anti-discrimination law absent a justification, and that the minister will consult the GGD about raising vaccination registration in inspections.
The Minister of SZW will consult with the GGD on whether, in line with the RIVM advice, attention can be given during GGD inspections to registering the vaccination status of children in care.

De Minister van SZW zal in overleg met de GGD bezien of bij de GGD-inspectie – conform het advies van het RIVM – aandacht kan worden gegeven aan het belang van een registratie van de vaccinatiestatus van de opgevangen kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Siderius over het bericht dat een chronische aandoening een struikelblok is voor het kopen van een woning

MPs Jansen and Siderius (SP) asked the ministers whether a chronic illness obstructs obtaining a mortgage or life-insurance policy and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what action is needed. The government answered that about 97% of consumers are accepted on normal terms, that insurers may use medical assessment, that the market functions, and that the Wgbh/cz anti-discrimination law may be amended as part of ratifying the UN disability convention.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het voorschrijven van groeihormonen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether hospital-driven switching of growth hormones for non-medical reasons (budget pressure) is acceptable, and whether national central procurement should be considered. The Minister replied that prescribing is the prescriber's responsibility under treatment guidelines, that the IGZ supervises prescribing, that switching must not reduce treatment quality, that budget is sufficient macro-level, and that central procurement does not fit the Dutch care system.
I am of the view that switching medicines must not lead to a loss of treatment quality.
Ik ben van mening dat het switchen van geneesmiddelen niet mag leiden tot kwaliteitsverlies van een behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat experts alarm slaan over gevaarlijke bijwerkingen van antidepressiva

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister for her response to reports that experts warn of dangerous side effects of antidepressants, including whether SSRIs are over-prescribed for mild conditions, whether an aggression warning should be added to packaging, and whether DNA testing should be introduced. The minister answered that prescribing is a matter for treating physicians under guidelines, that she referred to earlier answers, and that the medicines regulator CBG is primarily responsible for assessing studies and considering further measures.
It is up to the treating physicians to assess whether antidepressants should be prescribed to the patient, and if so, which ones.
Het is aan de behandelende artsen om te beoordelen of aan de patiënt antidepressiva moeten worden voorgeschreven, en zo ja welke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bijwerkingen van antidepressiva (SSRI’s)

An MP asks the Health Minister about reported aggression, suicide and violence linked to SSRI antidepressants, including the regulator's studies, label warnings, PSUR reporting, DNA testing and treatment guidelines. The minister answers that adverse effects are monitored, label warnings exist, aggression was added for under-18s and is under review for adults, and that DNA testing and mandatory changes to guidelines are not currently warranted.
The CBG is currently assessing Lareb's latest recommendation to include this side effect in the package leaflet, in the context of earlier measures and European discussions.
Het CBG beoordeelt op dit moment de laatste aanbeveling van Lareb over het opnemen van deze bijwerking in de bijsluiter in de context van eerder genomen maatregelen en Europese discussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het houden van kamelen en dromedarissen en de overdracht van MERS

An MP asked whether the Berlicum camel dairy's exemption for keeping dromedaries, its routine oxytocin use and mother-young separation, and the MERS transmission risk were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the exemption was extended to 2018 under conditions, oxytocin is no longer used structurally, MERS is not present in the Netherlands, and no ban or further investigation is planned.

Given that the welfare regulations for production animals are complied with, the company is under veterinary supervision and oxytocin is no longer structurally used to stimulate milk release, I extended the exemption for the company in 2013 by 5 years to 1 March 2018, subject to conditions.

Gelet het feit dat de voorschriften van het Besluit welzijn productiedieren wordt nageleefd, het bedrijf onder controle staat van een dierenarts en oxytocine niet meer structureel wordt toegepast om de melkgift te stimuleren heb ik onder voorwaarden de ontheffing voor het bedrijf in 2013 verlengd met 5 jaar tot 1 maart 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat verzekeraars Buurtzorg Nederland weigeren te betalen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministry whether insurers refusing to pay Buurtzorg Nederland for care already delivered was justified, and why Buurtzorg had not been compensated for overproduction. The State Secretary answered that care should be paid only within agreed contracting frameworks, that a doelmatigheidsonderzoek into Buurtzorg's efficiency would be commissioned, and that the AWBZ was almost fully spent in 2013.
The NZa policy rules establish that the care provider is not reimbursed more than what has been agreed in advance.
Het is in de NZa beleidsregels vastgelegd dat de zorgaanbieder niet meer vergoed krijgt dan op voorhand afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Hoge bloeddruk? Eet minder zout’ en Wereld Hypertensie Dag

An MP asked the minister about a Voedingscentrum message on salt and blood pressure, the progress on salt maximums in foods, and the role and binding force of the scientific advisory committee and steering group under the food industry agreement. The minister said the committee reviews industry proposals at the front end, advises a steering group chaired by VWS, the committee's advice weighs heavily, and the initiative stays with industry, with progress reviewed yearly and a report promised by end 2014.
The advice of the scientific advisory committee carries significant weight in this.
Het advies van de wetenschappelijke adviescommissie weegt hierbij zwaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het ontbreken van een spoedeisende eerste hulp in Spijkenisse n.a.v. een chloorlek in het zwembad aldaar, waardoor veel kinderen met spoed naar het ziekenhuis moesten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about the absence of a 24-hour emergency department in Spijkenisse after a chlorine leak at a local pool sent many children to hospital, and about ambulance and helicopter deployment. The minister answered the factual questions, said the 45-minute standard applies to spread rather than arrival times, and stated that regional emergency care is coordinated through partner hospitals without committing to a new emergency department in Spijkenisse.
For me the starting point is that care in the region is responsible and accessible and matched to regional needs.
Voor mij is het uitgangspunt dat de zorg in de regio verantwoord en bereikbaar is en is afgestemd op de behoeften in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het aantreffen van het levensgevaarlijk MERS-virus in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister when the MERS-infected patient was identified, whether all contacts had been traced, what measures prevent MERS import and spread, and whether all travellers from Saudi Arabia should be screened. The minister answered that all close contacts were reached and monitored, that travellers and doctors are informed through existing channels, and that universal screening is neither necessary nor feasible.
No. Many thousands of people travel from the Netherlands to the Middle East each year. It is neither necessary nor feasible to test all of these people on return for the MERS coronavirus.
Nee. Per jaar reizen er vele duizenden mensen vanuit Nederland naar het Midden-Oosten. Het is niet nodig en niet haalbaar om al deze mensen bij thuiskomst te testen op het MERS-Corona virus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de mortuariumkosten van ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about hospital mortuary charges for post-mortem care, including whether tariffs should be published, whether maximum tariffs should apply, and whether pacemaker removal counts as necessary care. The Minister said the state should not regulate tariffs for offered services, that families should explicitly agree to desirable care, and that she sees no ministerial responsibility for publishing tariffs.
I am of the view that the government should not concern itself with how service providers (in this case hospitals) agree on their services with the recipients of those services.
Ik ben van mening dat de overheid zich niet moet bezighouden met de wijze waarop dienstverleners (in casu ziekenhuizen) over hun diensten afspraken maken met de afnemers van die diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht het bericht ‘onderzoek naar monsterzege’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about football match-fixing concerns, including the KNVB's referral of the FC Oss–Emmen match to the Public Prosecution Service and the claim that a German prosecutor's reported suspect matches were 'fiction'. The minister answered that the referral led to no further steps, that the KNVB's integrity unit has not triggered any prosecutor-requested investigations, and that information-sharing about the German matter was not authorised.
The report did not lead to any follow-up steps.
De melding heeft niet tot vervolgstappen geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over sturend gedrag van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the health minister how she views the NZa report on insurers steering the insured through acceptance practices, whether additional legal tightening is needed, whether the NZa should investigate supplementary insurance as a steering tool, and whether a uniform enrolment method can be enforced. The minister responds that she backs the NZa actions, will ask the NZa to address indirect risk selection, sees no need yet for legal tightening, and will await the NZa's findings on enrolment before considering further steps.
As I wrote in my letter to your House, I support the actions the NZa is taking following the findings in the report.
Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer heb geschreven, sta ik achter de acties die de NZa inzet naar aanleiding van de bevindingen in het rapport.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sommige apothekers euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te verstrekken (ingezonden 17 april 2014).

An MP asked the health minister whether pharmacists may refuse to supply euthanasia drugs, on what grounds, and whether a referral duty or a role for pharmacists in the Euthanasia Act should be created. The minister answered that pharmacists may refuse, that referral notice is set in a joint guideline, and that no change to the Euthanasia Act is planned, while exchanges with the KNMP will continue.
In general there is no duty for pharmacists to supply.
Er bestaat ten algemene geen leveringsplicht voor apothekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers soms euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te leveren

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how she views reports that pharmacists sometimes refuse to supply euthanasia drugs, how often this happens, and whether pharmacists should have a formal role in the Euthanasia Act. The minister answered that pharmacists have an independent responsibility for safe dispensing but no duty to participate, that early contact with doctors is advisable, that no figures are kept, and that she sees no reason to amend the Euthanasia Act.
At present I see no reason to amend the Euthanasia Act.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de Euthanasiewet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het Europese burgerinitiatief ‘One of Us’

Dijkstra (D66) asked the ministers about the European citizens' initiative 'One of Us', which would end EU funding for research and aid activities that may destroy embryos, and its effects on Dutch embryonic stem cell research, Flemish diabetes and Parkinson's research, and women's reproductive health aid. The ministers answered that the initiative conflicts with Dutch policy, that it would harm Dutch and Belgian research and reproductive health aid, and that the Netherlands will oppose tightening EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klein en Baay-Timmerman over gewijzigde tarieven van personenalarmering

Two MPs asked why the VAT exemption for personal alarm services was removed, pushing the state to justify the sharp price rise and to bring alarm equipment into the basic health insurance package for frail elderly. The State Secretary explained the VAT change as a competition measure, said the price rise can only partly be explained by VAT, refused to extend basic insurance coverage to elderly people not already eligible, and declined to consult insurers.
Based on the attached document, it is unclear to me what the underlying causes are of the rise in the tariff apart from VAT.
Op basis van bijgevoegd stuk is mij onduidelijk wat de onderliggende oorzaken zijn van de stijging van het tarief los van de btw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het proefschrift van dr. Peggy van der Pol ‘The Dynamics of Cannabis Use and Dependence’

An MP asks how the government views a dissertation finding that about 40% of initially non-dependent heavy cannabis users became dependent over three years, and whether it will take measures against cannabis use and dependence. The state secretary says the study shows other factors matter as much as potency, that prevention and treatment should be updated, and that the findings give no reason for further measures.
The findings of this study give me no reason for further measures.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek geven mij geen aanleiding tot nadere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de resultaten van de zorgverzekeringsactiviteiten van verzekeraar ASR

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about ASR's 2013 health insurance premium income, the unreported results of its health insurance activities, and whether profits or dividends from basic insurance premiums flow to its non-health business, plus transparency and Solvency figures. The Minister confirmed €579m premium income, said the health results will be published by DNB in Q3 and that ASR will be asked to disclose them explicitly, denied profits are transferred, and rejected extra accountability rules for profit-making insurers.
I will ask ASR to explicitly report the results of its health insurance activities in its annual figures publication in future, as other insurance groups offering non-health insurance do.

Ik zal ASR vragen om in de toekomst, net als andere verzekeringsgroepen die naast zorgverzekeringen andere vormen van verzekeringen aanbieden, haar cijfers ten aanzien van resultaten van de zorgverzekeringsactiviteiten in haar publicatie van de jaarcijfers expliciet te vermelden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie dat je bij zaken als opvangcentra voor verkrachte vrouwen kan afvragen of dat een taak is voor de overheid

An MP asked whether the state secretary's remark that funding shelters for raped women may not be a government task, comparable to beekeeping in Malawi, reflected cabinet policy. The government replied that the remark was not meant to question state responsibility, that municipalities are responsible for victim shelter under the Wmo, and that no consultation with the health ministry had taken place.
Under the Social Support Act, municipalities are responsible for arranging shelter for victims of domestic violence who need it.
Op grond van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning hebben de gemeenten de verantwoordelijkheid om opvang te regelen voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld, die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Twee onnodige doden door ruzie cardiochirurgen Den Haag’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that two avoidable deaths at The Hague's HagaZiekenhuis resulted from a dispute between cardiac surgeons, and about the IGZ's handling, including why no disciplinary case was brought. The minister replied that the facts broadly match the hospital's report, that mortality is in line with the national average, that two calamities were reported and deemed adequately addressed, and that the IGZ found no individual culpable conduct warranting a disciplinary referral.
The IGZ decided not to refer the matter to the disciplinary judge because it considers there was no culpable individual conduct.
De IGZ heeft besloten om de zaak niet voor te leggen aan de tuchtrechter omdat zij van oordeel is dat er geen sprake is van verwijtbaar individueel handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat het declaratiesysteem voor de zorg foute declaraties uitlokt

Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the health minister about reports that the hospital declaration system (DOT) induces incorrect billing, and whether the NZa, which both sets and enforces the rules, is marking its own homework. Minister Schippers denied hospitals are forced into fraud, said the NZa's rule-making and enforcement powers are organisationally separated, admitted DOT will need simplification, and pointed to an ongoing cost-awareness process with a progress letter promised before summer.
These powers are organisationally separated within the NZa.
Deze bevoegdheden zijn binnen de NZa organisatorisch gescheiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat UEFA-bobo’s geen taks betalen

An SP MP asked why UEFA and its officials would pay no tax if the Netherlands hosts Euro 2020 matches, and what the costs and conditions are. The minister replied that the tax guarantees fit existing Dutch tax rules, grant no special exemption, and only allow UEFA to use standard exemption schemes if conditions are met, with no costs expected and no change to tax law needed.
So it is not the case that UEFA is exempt from paying taxes upon award of the bid.
Het is dus niet zo dat de UEFA bij toewijzing van het bid is vrijgesteld van het betalen van belastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over garanties in het kader van het bid voor het Europees Kampioenschap voetbal in 2020

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Health about why government guarantees for the Euro 2020 football bid, including tax exemptions and a no-new-legislation commitment, were signed before parliament was informed, and requested documents and details of the tax guarantees. The minister replies that guarantees were kept within existing legal frameworks, that parliament was informed once the bid was finalized, that the tax guarantees do not create specific exemptions beyond existing law, and that some documents will be sent later or are publicly available.
I then informed the House that same day about the submission of the bid and the government guarantees I signed on behalf of the state, which form part of the bid.
Ik heb vervolgens de Kamer die dag terstond geïnformeerd over het uitbrengen van het bid en de overheidsgaranties die ik namens het Rijk heb ondertekend en onderdeel uitmaken van het bid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het gebruiken van foetussen als energiebron

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister whether Dutch rules allow using foetuses from miscarriages and abortions as an energy source, and how compliance and parental information are ensured. The Minister answered that the Wlb and Wfw do not permit energy use, that the IGZ found no compliance problems, and that hospitals and clinics follow NVOG guidance, with individual wishes considered.
For the avoidance of doubt, I note that using a foetus explicitly for generating energy cannot be considered one of the permitted purposes.
Voor alle duidelijkheid merk ik op dat gebruik van een foetus dat expliciet is gericht op het opwekken van energie, dan niet geacht kan worden onder die toegestane doeleinden te vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat op Den Haag Centraal Station een inloopkliniek opent

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CareToGo walk-in clinic at The Hague Central Station, its 35 euro consult fee, two-tier care concerns, effects on GP relationships and referrals, insurance coverage, GP qualifications and who authorised it. The minister answered that the NZa requires CareToGo to follow its tariff rules (the 35 euro fee is not allowed), that the coverage request is pending, that GPs are registered, and that no formal experiment or permission was needed.
Following the launch of this initiative, the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa) contacted CareToGo and told them they must remain within the regulations the NZa sets.

De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) heeft naar aanleiding van de start van dit initiatief contact opgenomen met CareToGo en hen aangegeven dat zij moeten blijven binnen de regelgeving die de NZa vaststelt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over namaakvoedsel

An MP asked the ministers whether the NVWA's plan of action addresses trade in counterfeit food and whether organised crime is involved. The government answered that the issue concerns mislabelled food, that the NVWA has enforcement tools and is strengthening fraud detection, and that it would inform the House by summer 2014.
At the General Consultation on Food of 18 December 2013 I committed to informing the House before summer 2014 about my approach to misleading labelling.
In het Algemeen Overleg Voedsel van 18 december 2013 heb ik toegezegd voor de zomer 2014 de Kamer te informeren over mijn aanpak voor wat betreft misleidende etikettering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ruim 300.000 Nederlanders niet veilig omgaan met vrij verkrijgbare pijnstillers, zoals diclofenac, ibuprofen en naproxen

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how to respond to reports that over 300,000 Dutch people use over-the-counter NSAIDs such as diclofenac, ibuprofen and naproxen unsafely, including overdosing and long-term use, and whether sales should be restricted to pharmacists. The Minister answered that drug classification is for the CBG, that risks are addressed through leaflets and ongoing monitoring, and that no national registry of complications exists, while rejecting the need to restrict sales to pharmacies.
No national registrations are available of the number of complications or deaths resulting from (improper) use of NSAIDs.
Er zijn geen landelijke registraties beschikbaar van het aantal complicaties of overlijden als gevolg van (oneigenlijk) gebruik van NSAID's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over HIV zelftests

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister about the growing availability of HIV and STI self-tests, their reliability, and whether quality standards and oversight should be tightened. The minister answered that online self-tests often lack CE marking and may give false results, pointed to EU regulatory negotiations and the inspectorate's enforcement limits, and said a separate quality mark is not useful while tests fail existing rules.
In these negotiations and more broadly in European Commission working groups, I will specifically raise the issue of (online) self-tests.
Ik zal in deze onderhandelingen en breder in werkgroepen van de Europese Commissie specifiek aandacht vragen voor de problematiek rond de (online) zelftests.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het waarschuwen van zwangere vrouwen voor alcoholgebruik

An MP asked the government about Heineken's campaign against drinking during pregnancy, public-private cooperation in health promotion, and whether warnings should appear on contraceptives and pregnancy tests. The state secretary supports cooperation with clear shared goals, reports that pharmaceutical bodies declined voluntary warnings citing EU rules, and says no additional measures are planned beyond existing information and a pregnancy logo on alcoholic drinks.
I see the introduction of a pregnancy logo on alcoholic drinks as a logical next step in informing people about the risks of alcohol use during pregnancy.
Ik zie de invoering van het zwangerschapslogo op alcoholhoudende dranken als een logische volgende stap in de voorlichting over de risico's van het gebruik van alcohol bij zwangerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een neparts een gezonde vrouw laat opereren

An MP asked the health minister how she reacts to reports that a bogus doctor operated on a healthy woman and whether the inspectorate (IGZ) failed to act on earlier complaints. The minister says the matter is under criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, explains the inspectorate's earlier handling of complaints and inspections, and says she cannot comment further while the investigation runs.
While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make statements about this case.
Lopende het onderzoek kan ik over deze zaak geen uitspraken doen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sommige apothekers euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te verstrekken (ingezonden 17 april 2014).

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether some pharmacists refuse to supply euthanasia drugs, on what grounds they may refuse, whether they must refer patients to a colleague, and whether a pharmacist's role should be written into the Euthanasia Act. The minister's letter only announces that the answers are delayed pending a meeting with the pharmacists' association KNMP.
The questions from MP Arib (PvdA) about the report that some pharmacists refuse to supply euthanasia drugs cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Arib (PvdA) over het bericht dat sommige apothekers euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te verstrekken ( 2014Z07110 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over ‘Mening: onjuist geïnformeerd over risicoselectie in de zorg’

An MP asks whether the Minister misinformed parliament about risk selection in health insurance, citing an academic who questions the claim that a level playing field removes selection incentives, and asks about known losses on former AWBZ-indicated insured persons. The Minister rejects the claim that parliament was misinformed, explains ongoing model improvements and a planned study on morbidity-based criteria, and promises to address selection incentives qualitatively in the autumn letter.
In possible model improvements I use signals and suggestions from the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), insurers, patient associations, research bureaus and universities.
Ik maak bij de mogelijke modelverbeteringen gebruik van signalen en suggesties van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa), verzekeraars, patiëntenverenigingen, onderzoeksbureau en universiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het weigeren van het naleven van hygiëneregels door een moslima

MPs Klever and Wilders asked whether hospital hygiene rules should outweigh a Muslim employee's religious conviction, why the IGZ did not enforce hygiene rules, how many similar cases exist, and how hospitals can avoid lawsuits and settlements. The minister answered that religious dress can be restricted only with objective justification such as hygiene, that the IGZ advised the hospital and the hospital bears responsibility, that no overview is available, and that labour relations in care are not her responsibility.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in labour relations in the care sector.
Het behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid om te treden in arbeidsrelaties in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) vijf zorgverzekeraars van Achmea een boete oplegt vanwege een slordige administratie

An SP MP asked the health minister about the NZa fining five Achmea insurers for sloppy administration, questioning the amount, possible intent, profiteering and risk selection. The minister answered that the NZa found 36 reporting errors due to weak internal controls, found no intent or profit, and that other insurers showed no similar problems.
The NZa attributes the errors made to deficient internal control.
De NZa wijt de gemaakte fouten aan een gebrekkige interne beheersing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de eerste praktijk een huisarts een vermogen kost

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that taking over a GP practice can cost a new doctor 100,000 to 150,000 euros in goodwill, and whether this drives consolidation and raises care costs. The minister says she has no data on the scale of goodwill payments, opposes charging goodwill, notes insurers already forbid it in contracts, and says a 2006 change did not create a legal ban.
I am not aware of the scale on which goodwill is currently being requested, or whether institutions and chains are particularly willing to pay money, and what amounts would be involved.
Het is mij niet bekend op welke schaal op dit moment goodwill wordt gevraagd, of met name instellingen en ketens bereid zijn geld te betalen en om welke bedragen het dan zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gebruik van baden met garra-rufavissen

An MP asked the government about health risks, animal welfare and a Belgian advisory opinion concerning fish spa baths with garra rufa fish. The minister said RIVM considers the risks acceptable with user restrictions and hygiene rules, rejected a ban, and pointed to existing animal welfare rules.
I intend to provide, in the amendment of the Bhvbz, that the operator must ensure the fish spa is not used by them.
Daarom ben ik voornemens om bij de wijziging van het Bhvbz te regelen dat de exploitant ervoor zorg moet dragen dat de fish spa niet door hen gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Hijum en Keijzer over stijging van de zorgpremie

MPs Bruins Slot, Van Hijum and Keijzer asked why the CPB projects the nominal health insurance premium rising by EUR 144 to 2015 when the minister had claimed an increase of at most EUR 20 from the transfer of AWBZ care, and asked about funding, compensation and the own-risk increase. The minister answered that the EUR 20 figure covers only the transfer effect, that the remainder stems from the 50/50 rebalancing, reserves and autonomous cost growth, that the temporary state contribution is covered within the revenue framework, and that low-income households are fully compensated via the healthcare allowance, including for the own-risk rise.

The premium increase of at most EUR 20 mentioned in the letter of 4 March 2014 relates only to the expected rise in the nominal premium under the Health Insurance Act (Zvw) in 2015 due to the transfers.

De premiestijging van maximaal € 20 die wordt genoemd in de brief van 4 maart 2014 heeft enkel betrekking op de verwachte stijging van de nominale premie in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) in 2015 door de overhevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “buitenlandse uitzendkracht genept met goedkope zorgpolis”

An MP asked whether health insurance tied to temporary agency workers' contracts is being used against them, including employers keeping collective discounts, unclear policy terms, and loss of cover on dismissal. The minister answered that workers are free to decline employer-offered policies, that employers must not withhold policy information, and that she will discuss the matter with employment agencies, employers and unions.
It is not intended that the employer or the health insurer profit from this at the expense of the migrant worker.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat de werkgever of de zorgverzekeraar daar ten koste van de arbeidsmigrant voordeel uit haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘322 keer euthanasie via Levenseindekliniek’

PvdA MP Arib asked the health minister about reports of 322 euthanasia cases via the Levenseindekliniek, the role of GPs, consultation with the profession, and the clinic's care of psychiatric patients. Minister Schippers answered that the clinic meets a need for complex cases, referred to ongoing sector initiatives on end-of-life communication, and reported 12 euthanasia or assisted-suicide cases in psychiatric patients in 2013.
In two years, euthanasia and assisted suicide were granted 205 times, and 133 notifications have so far been assessed by the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees, all as careful.
In twee jaar tijd is 205 maal euthanasie en hulp bij zelfdoding verleend en er zijn tot nu toe 133 meldingen door de Regionale toetsingscommissies euthanasie beoordeeld, alle als zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de wijze van klachtafhandeling van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg inzake vermeend seksueel misbruik in Zorgresidentie Villa de Luchte te Lochem

MP Siderius asked the minister why the Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg took nearly eighteen months to handle a complaint about suspected sexual abuse of a dementia patient at Villa de Luchte, whether the Nationale ombudsman was left without satisfactory answers, and about the planned takeover of the facility. The state secretary acknowledged the delay exceeded the new eight-month limit, said the inspectorate has been asked to finish quickly, and declined to publish the inspection report on privacy grounds while promising to review the working method.
