I do not consider it desirable when citizens who file a report with the IGZ have to wait almost a year and a half for their report to be handled.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk wanneer burgers die een melding doen bij de IGZ bijna anderhalf jaar moeten wachten op de afhandeling van hun melding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Rutte over inenten op de kinderopvang

Two VVD MPs asked whether childcare centres may refuse unvaccinated children and what can be done about unvaccinated children in childcare. Minister Asscher answered that there is no legal basis for a blanket refusal, that refusal is only justified case by case under proportionality rules judged by the College voor de rechten van de mens or courts, and that the sector will discuss the matter with RIVM.
There is no legal basis for a blanket refusal to admit unvaccinated children to childcare facilities.
Er is geen juridische basis voor een algehele weigering om niet ingeënte kinderen toe te laten tot kinderopvangvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat opleidingen verpleging razend populair zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked the government about the popularity of nursing degrees amid job losses in healthcare, the shortage of internship places, and whether numerus fixus admission limits are acceptable. The minister says intake is still growing, temporary solutions have been found for internships, a meeting with nursing schools is planned, and that restricted intake is acceptable as regional planning.

VWS and OCW are planning a meeting with the representatives of the HBO nursing programmes, in which among other things the situation regarding internship places for the coming academic year will be discussed.
VWS en OCW plannen een afspraak met de vertegenwoordiging van de hbo-verpleegkunde opleidingen, waarin onder meer de situatie rond de stageplaatsen voor het komende studiejaar aan de orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht Besneden vrouw betaalt hersteloperatie zelf

An MP asked why reconstructive surgery for victims of female genital mutilation is not covered by the basic insurance package and whether the College voor Zorgverzekeringen should advise on it. The minister says the basic package covers plastic surgery only in limited cases, describes existing care and subsidised projects, and commits to including reconstructive surgery in the Zorgverzekeringswet once a protocol being drafted by professional groups is finished.
Once this protocol is completed I will bring reconstructive operations for genital mutilation under the Health Insurance Act.
Zodra dit protocol is afgerond zal ik hersteloperaties van genitale verminkingen onder de Zorgverzekeringswet brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over de dreigende sluiting van ruiter- en mountainbikepaden beheerd door Staatsbosbeheer

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether the government shares fears that horse-riding and mountain-bike paths managed by Staatsbosbeheer will decline, and how it oversees path maintenance and possible user fees. The state secretary replied that no closures are planned, that the government does not supervise path maintenance, that it steers Staatsbosbeheer only at a general level, and that it leaves the matter to talks between the agency and sports federations.
The cabinet does not supervise this.
Het kabinet houdt hier geen toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de WHO heeft geadviseerd de dagelijkse hoeveelheid suiker te halveren

MP Dik-Faber asks the health minister about a proposed WHO halving of the recommended daily sugar intake and how the Dutch prevention programme, the industry agreement, labelling and EU action should respond. The minister answers that current Dutch guidance sets no sugar maximum, that she will not anticipate the WHO draft, will ask the Gezondheidsraad to consider the final WHO guideline if timely, sees no reason yet to tighten the industry agreement, and will raise sugar reduction at EU level with a progress report by year end.
I do not want to anticipate a draft WHO guideline for which consultation and expert peer review are still ongoing.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op een conceptrichtlijn van de WHO waarvoor momenteel nog een consultatie en peer-review door experts plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ongeveer 80 procent van de ouders nooit een cursus EHBO bij kinderen heeft gevolgd

An SP MP asked the health minister about a report that about 80 percent of parents never took a child first-aid course, whether the share is too low, and whether first-aid courses should be publicly funded and offered through the consultation bureau. The minister said the figure is unknown, that courses are a voluntary private choice, that she sees no need for cost-effectiveness research, and that she will only seek more awareness via consultation bureaus, not regulation.
I will consult with the consultation bureau to see what the possibilities are here.
Ik zal in overleg met het consultatiebureau kijken wat hier voor de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over zzp’ers in de zorg die geen VAR-wuo krijgen

An SP MP asked the ministers why the Tax Administration now treats self-employed care workers working through care institutions or agencies as employees rather than granting VAR-wuo status, and how many workers and patients are affected. The government answered that the rules have not changed, that the Tax Administration and UWV have long held this position, and that self-employed workers can still work under the 2012 direct-contracting pilot with care offices.
These questions serve as a supplement to earlier questions.
Deze vragen dienen ter aanvulling op eerdere vragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de problemen van zzp’ers in de zorg om een VAR-wuo te krijgen of te behouden

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked how the Tax Authority assesses VAR-wuo self-employment declarations for care workers, and whether withdrawals are leaving zzp'ers without clients. The government answers that the assessment follows uniform legal criteria, that care provision in kind generally implies employment with the institution, and that the policy is unchanged, while noting a pilot allowing direct contracting with care offices and some withdrawals were wrongly made.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over het bericht dat er in de regio Hoogeveen onrust is ontstaan over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) in het Bethesda Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about reported unrest in Hoogeveen over possible downscaling of the intensive care unit at Bethesda Hospital, including the status of a regional advisory report, planned concentrations, and insurer involvement. The minister said the plans are a draft under discussion with stakeholders, declined to publish the report as a regional plan under the responsibility of the parties involved, and said her statutory role applies only if 45-minute ambulance access or care safety is at risk.
Moreover, the regional plans are the responsibility of the parties involved, and it is not for me to send them to the House of Representatives.
Bovendien zijn de regioplannen de verantwoordelijkheid van partijen en is het niet aan mij deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Tongeren, Paulus Jansen, Agnes Mulder en Ouwehand over het verstrekken van jodiumpillen in verband met het beperken van effecten van een nucleaire ramp

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, CDA and PvdD asked the Minister of Health whether Dutch households should receive iodine tablets in advance of a nuclear accident, given the Tsjernobyl and Fukushima experience with central storage. The minister said she is considering door-to-door distribution for some zones, will consult regional partners and the ministries involved, and admitted she does not know how long distribution takes or how many people could be reached.

In the coming months I want to work out, in consultation with the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice and the relevant regional partners, a proposal for effective and efficient distribution of iodine tablets.

De komende maanden wil ik in overleg met de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie en de betrokken regionale partners een voorstel uitwerken voor een effectieve en efficiënte distributie van jodiumtabletten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de kwaliteitsnorm tolkgebruik bij keus voor professionele tolk

An MP asked the health minister about a new quality norm for interpreter use in care and whether it could ground insurer financing of professional interpreters. The minister said the norm is a useful tool, that patients are primarily responsible for Dutch language ability so interpreter costs are not covered by the Zorgverzekeringswet, though insurers may choose to pay, and that a KNMG-commissioned study proposal would be presented in April.

Because patients/clients (or their representatives) are themselves responsible for mastering the Dutch language, the costs of any interpreter deployment are not reimbursed under the Health Insurance Act.

Omdat de patiënten/cliënten (of hun vertegenwoordigers) zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het machtig zijn van de Nederlandse taal, worden de kosten voor de eventuele inzet van een tolk niet vergoed vanuit de Zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het betalen van het eigen risico bij ongevraagde hulpverlening

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health why the mandatory deductible (eigen risico) is charged for unsolicited care such as bemoeizorg or compulsory admission, and whether this is fair when the care later proves unjustified. The Minister replies that all Zvw-covered care, including involuntary care, falls under the mandatory deductible to keep public support for insurance, and that complaints can go to the SKGZ, but does not address the individual cases.
If the insured person disagrees, he can file a complaint with the Foundation for Complaints and Disputes Health Insurance (SKGZ).
Indien de verzekerde het hier niet mee eens is kan hij een klacht indienen bij de Stichting Klachten en Geschillen Zorgverzekeringen (SKGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Achmea gigantische winst maakt op de zorgverzekering

An SP MP asked the minister about Achmea's reported profits on health insurance, whether the figures were obscured by incidental results, whether premium money flowed to dividends, and whether Achmea should be split. The minister took the report as noted, explained the 298 million incidental result as releases of prior-year provisions, denied dividends from basic-insurance premiums, rejected the proposed split, and declined to redirect insurers' profits to avert care cuts.
Achmea has informed me that there are no dividend payments from premiums collected for the basic insurance.
Achmea heeft mij laten weten dat er geen sprake is van dividenduitkeringen afkomstig uit de voor de basisverzekering opgebrachte premies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat vrijwel alle zorgverzekeraars een onvoldoende scoren voor het bestrijden van fraude

An SP MP asked the minister how she responds to reports that most health insurers fail on fraud control, why insurers still do not take it seriously, whether a pass from the NZa was removed from the PInCet draft, and whether pay-per-service billing structurally invites fraud. The minister acknowledged 2012 control shortcomings at eight of eleven insurers, pointed to insurer improvement actions overseen by the NZa, rejected the view that the system itself drives fraud, and gave the number of boete cases without detailing amounts.
The NZa has taken a number of enforcement measures, including directions.
De NZa heeft een aantal handhavingmaatregelen getroffen waaronder aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ruzie binnen de perinatale zorg

An MP asks the minister about disputes between obstetric and midwife professional bodies (NVOG and KNOV) that hinder integrated perinatal care, including whether the College Perinatale Zorg should have a stronger role. The minister says regional care standards are being developed, that the CPZ should lead rather than merely advise, and that she is willing to discuss the CPZ's status if it requests change.
The CPZ must take the lead in order to get things done.
Het CPZ moet leiding nemen om zaken voor elkaar te kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers opnieuw geïntimideerd worden

An SP MP asked the Secretary of State for Health about reports that care workers striking at AxionContinu were intimidated, including threats to withdraw holiday days and wage deductions. The government said it had no evidence of intimidation, explained that strikers lose pay by law (no pay was withheld in the first two strike days, and later strikers acted in their own time), and pointed to existing complaint channels, Inspectie SZW complaint handling (15 reports since 2012), and the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, rejecting a separate reporting point and an investigation.
We do not know whether AxionContinu has intimidated striking employees.
Wij weten niet of AxionContinu actievoerende werknemers heeft geïntimideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de rechter een streep zet door de overname van het Langeland Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views a court ruling blocking Fundis's takeover of the Langeland hospital, whether hospitals are being left to fail, and whether insurers should be stripped of their role and municipalities given control. The minister says the court ruling is for the judiciary, that hospital finances are the hospitals' own responsibility, that insurers are responsible for procuring care and she does not intend to take over steering, and that acute-care concentration plans are still being discussed.
I have no substantive view on a decision of our judiciary.
Ik heb geen inhoudelijk oordeel over een beslissing van onze rechterlijke macht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het personeel van Ambulance Amsterdam gesteund door Abvakabo vanmiddag een petitie indient waarin het vertrek wordt geëist van de directie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about staff unrest at Ambulance Amsterdam, including complaints about workload, equipment and hygiene and the use of rapid responders. The minister answered that operational management is the responsibility of the RAV, that the Inspectorate has intensified its supervision, and that no specific signals on outdated equipment were received.
Responsibility for operational management lies with the Regional Ambulance Service (RAV); I do not deal with that.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de bedrijfsvoering ligt bij de Regionale Ambulancevoorziening (RAV), ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk’

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the government about reports that a pandemic originating in Brabant is possible, including calls to reduce animal numbers, close farms, and separate pig and poultry farms by a kilometre. The minister answered that current hygiene and early-warning measures are sufficient, that reducing animals or fully closed farms is not the solution, and that the RIVM distance advice did not lead to a policy change.
We are of the view that the current measures are sufficient to keep the chance of an outbreak as small as possible.
Wij zijn van mening dat de huidige maatregelen voldoende zijn om de kans op een uitbraak zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over orgaanroof in China

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Dutch government about organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, EU and UN concerns, Dutch patients travelling abroad for transplants, and Dutch hospital ties to Chinese hospitals. The government said it shares the concern, cannot independently verify the allegations, will keep raising the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and knows of no Dutch hospital ties to suspect Chinese hospitals.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts to keep this issue on the EU agenda.
Nederland zal zich blijven inspannen om deze kwestie op de agenda van de EU te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een spotgoedkope zorgverzekering voor buitenlandse arbeidsmigranten

An MP asked the Health Minister whether a cheap health insurance construction for foreign seasonal workers, which reinsures the deductible through supplementary insurance, fits the law and avoids risk selection, and whether tying basic and supplementary insurance is improper bundling. The minister answered that such constructions lie outside the Health Insurance Act, are limited in size and were monitored by the NZa, that deductibles are pro-rated for short coverage, and that the zorgtoeslag is based on annual income under EU rules.
At the time I agreed with the NZa that it would monitor developments regarding reinsurance of the deductible.
Ik heb destijds met de NZa afgesproken dat zij de ontwikkelingen rondom het herverzekeren zouden volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het rapport ambulancepersoneel aan het woord

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a survey report on ambulance staff, covering workload, retirement at 67, aggression, bureaucracy, centralisation of control rooms and privatisation. The minister acknowledged staff commitment, pointed to existing CAO measures, an anti-aggression action plan and a planned national control room organisation, and rejected further privatisation and the 67-year pension concern as sector-specific beyond new policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Eigen medisch dossier inzien te moeilijk’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that patients find it difficult to access their own medical records, and whether patients should have access without obstacles. The minister said patients have a right to access under the WGBO, that the IGZ does not supervise compliance and has no figures on refusals, and that no further research is needed because patients can complain or go to court.
I have no insight into the number of refusals of access per healthcare sector and the causes thereof.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal weigeringen van inzage per zorgsector en de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het Ierse rundvlees dat uit Holland komt

An MP asked whether Jumbo mislabelled beef as Irish when it was Dutch-raised, and how the government would respond. The minister answered that the NVWA addressed one franchise store's labelling error, which was corrected, and that enforcement options and consumer routes exist but the matter is considered closed for the NVWA.
In that store, Dutch beef was sold instead of Irish beef.
In die winkel is in plaats van Iers rundvlees Nederlands rundvlees verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat patiënten hun eigen medisch dossier niet kunnen inzien

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether doctors refusing patients access to their own medical records break the law, where patients can turn, and why patients cannot manage their own records. The minister confirmed that patients have a legal right to inspect or receive copies, pointed to complaint and civil court routes, and rejected the idea that patients should manage their own records.
The starting point is that every patient has the right to inspect, or receive a copy of, his or her file.
Uitgangspunt is dat elke patiënt recht heeft op inzage in, dan wel afschrift van zijn of haar dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Dove zaalvoetballers geplaatst voor Europese Kampioenschappen maar toch thuis blijven door geldgebrek”

MPs Van Dekken and Van Laar asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport why the deaf futsal team qualified for the European Championship could not attend due to lack of funding, and whether the ministry would support it and act structurally. The minister replied that sport bodies decide which programmes get top-sport funding under the 2013-2016 sport agenda, that deaf futsal falls outside this, and that the ministry is in talks with the KNDSB and NOC*NSF.
I regard this as a responsibility of sport, which makes its own decisions, and which I then support.
Ik beschouw dit als een verantwoordelijkheid van de sport, die zelf besluiten neemt en die ik vervolgens ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat arbodienstverlener Zorg van de Zaak Netwerk het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis overneemt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the reported takeover of Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis Beverwijk by occupational health provider Zorg van de Zaak Netwerk, including risks of preferential treatment for client employees and commercialisation. The minister answered that the deal is a private initiative within the existing system, that non-medical selection is prohibited and monitored by the NZa, and that doctor co-ownership is acceptable, while not knowing some specifics.
Selection on non-medical criteria is not permitted. The Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis is, like all other hospitals in the Netherlands, supervised by the NZa.
Selectie op basis van niet-medische criteria is niet toegestaan. Het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis wordt – net als alle andere ziekenhuizen in Nederland – gecontroleerd door de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Eigen medisch dossier taboe voor patiënten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that doctors obstruct patients' access to their own medical records, including blacking out parts and refusing copies. The minister acknowledged patients' right of access under the WGBO, said the IGZ received 17 complaints in 2012-2013 but does not enforce access rights, and listed complaint and civil-court routes.
Patients have the right to inspect their own medical records or receive a copy of them.
Patiënten hebben het recht om hun eigen medische dossiers in te zien dan wel een afschrift daarvan te ontvangen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars het aantal spoedeisende hulpen boven het Noordzeekanaal willen terugbrengen naar drie en het aantal ziekenhuizen dat in Noord-Holland beroer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about insurers' plans to reduce emergency departments north of the Noordzeekanaal to three and stroke care in Noord-Holland to six hospitals, and about the lack of public disclosure and consultation. The minister answered that the plans are still draft regional scenarios under discussion, that the 45-minute access norm will be safeguarded through the regional acute care consultation, and that insurers are fulfilling their statutory role.
These plans are currently still in draft form and are being discussed with the parties in the region.
Deze plannen zijn op dit moment nog in concept en worden besproken met de partijen uit de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de IC van het Reinier de Graaf Gasthuis dreigt weg te vallen

An MP asked the minister whether plans by health insurers to close the intensive care unit at Reinier de Graaf Gasthuis, including the stakeholder support and municipal involvement, were sound. The minister replied that the plan is still a draft to be discussed with regional parties, that acute basic care spreading is important, and that municipal involvement is not necessarily logical for specialised emergency care.
Involvement of municipal governments is not necessarily logical by definition.
Betrokkenheid van gemeentebesturen is niet per definitie logisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de financiering van eerstelijns geboortecentra

An MP asked the health minister whether small birth centres should have independent WMG funding, why NZa tariff increases had not raised insurer payments, and how insurers and hospitals should settle costs. The minister answered that birth centres already have a separate payment title, that a national evaluation will report in 2016, and that the NZa will consult stakeholders shortly on integrated funding.
The NZa will shortly consult all stakeholders on a number of planned policy changes and integrated funding.
De NZa treedt op korte termijn in overleg met alle betrokkenen over een aantal voorgenomen beleidswijzigingen en integrale bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Groeiende kritiek op medische uitzendingen ZVK’

MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked about criticism of the medical referral system (ZVK) for patients from Caribbean Netherlands, including an open letter from Han de Bruijne that the minister says never reached her ministry. The minister partly accepts the criticism, citing complexity and bureaucracy, notes satisfaction survey results, and lists improvements under way, with a Coomeva study expected by year end.
The ZVK is currently undertaking a major improvement effort, which should be completed during 2014.
Het ZVK is momenteel met een flinke verbeterslag bezig, die in de loop van 2014 zijn beslag moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het vergoeden van een medicijn voor MS-patiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the CVZ compared Fampyra with physiotherapy costs, whether a pay-for-performance arrangement could be considered, and which European countries reimburse the drug. The minister answered that no cost comparison was made because no comparative effect data exist, that the CVZ advised against reimbursement, and that conditional admission is being studied with a decision expected in spring 2014.
As I answered previous questions from you, I am studying the possibilities of conditionally admitting Fampyra.
Zoals ik op eerdere vragen van u heb geantwoord bestudeer ik de mogelijkheden om Fampyra voorwaardelijk toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de medicijncheck in slechts 10% van de gevallen plaats heeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that the medication check for elderly patients takes place in only 10% of cases, and about whether insurers should be required to ensure full implementation. The Minister acknowledged the value of periodic medication review but said full compliance with the guideline (1.2 million reviews a year) is not currently feasible, that implementation will be phased in, that supervision by the IGZ will tighten from 2015, and that the government will not generically exempt these reviews from the deductible.
The IGZ will in any case tighten its supervision from 1 January 2015.
De IGZ zal in ieder geval vanaf 1 januari 2015 het toezicht verscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over de falende controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about insufficient checks on medication use by elderly people, including the low uptake of annual medication reviews and whether the Dutch Health Care Insurance (eigen risico) should exclude them. The minister acknowledged medication safety gaps, said implementation of the polypharmacy guideline is shared among GPs, pharmacists and patients, and said the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will tighten supervision from 2015, while declining to exclude reviews from the deductible for now.
The IGZ will in any case tighten supervision from 1 January 2015.
De IGZ zal in ieder geval vanaf 1 januari 2015 het toezicht verscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het stopzetten van de procedure naar het opsporen van doodsoorzaken van minderjarigen per 1 januari 2014

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about ending the NODO procedure for investigating causes of death of minors from 1 January 2014, including parents' rights, the loss of knowledge infrastructure and whether the procedure was effective against child abuse. The government replied that legal duties for doctors and coroners remain unchanged, the sector will handle unexplained child deaths through joint working arrangements, and that talks with the field will start on 17 March with parliament to be informed of the outcome.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de miljoenenboete van het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis na foute declaraties

An MP asked the health minister about the multi-million euro fine on St. Antonius hospital for incorrect billing, whether repayment to insurers is part of the NZa fine, the room insurers have in repayment agreements, and whether full repayment of wrongly billed costs is mandatory. The minister answered that repayment is a civil-law obligation separate from the NZa fine, that such private agreements need not be public, and that incorrect billing should be repaid.
An agreement between a health insurer and a healthcare institution on repayment of incorrect billing is a private-law agreement.
Een afspraak tussen een zorgverzekeraar en zorginstelling over de terugbetaling van foutieve declaraties is een privaatrechtelijke afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de website My Tomorrows geneesmiddelen aanbiedt die zich nog in het onderzoeksstadium bevinden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the commercial firm My Tomorrows, which mediates access to unregistered experimental medicines, is lawful, whether it poses risks to patients, and whether patients should get such drugs free or fund a public fund. The Minister answered that My Tomorrows only mediates within existing named-patient and compassionate-use rules overseen by the IGZ and CBG, that risks are weighed case by case, and that she sees no basis for mandatory industry-funded fund or state intervention.
For both procedures, cost is not part of the procedure. For that reason, data on this are not known to me.
Voor beide procedures geldt dat het kostenaspect geen onderdeel uitmaakt van de procedure. Gegevens daarover zijn om die reden niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulpposten in Sittard-Geleen en Weert mogelijk dicht gaan

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports that emergency departments in Sittard-Geleen and Weert may close, and whether this is acceptable given the population served. The Minister replies that the plans are still draft regional scenarios by insurers, that the government's role is limited to the 45-minute ambulance access norm and to the continuity of critical care rather than any specific hospital, and declines to send the regional plans to the House.
Moreover, the regional plans are the responsibility of the parties, and it is not for me to send them to the House of Representatives.
Bovendien zijn de regioplannen de verantwoordelijkheid van partijen en is het niet aan mij deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de sector geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) verbolgen is over het inkoopbeleid van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would respond to GGZ mental health providers' complaints about insurers' contracting practices, including unilateral digital contracts, unclear and burdensome conditions, and restrictions on the lead treating professional role. The Minister answered that transition problems are expected, pointed to NZa and Q-Consult research, said insurers may impose conditions with a quality rationale, and promised to monitor developments and report back.
As indicated in my letter of 23 January, the parties jointly evaluate the purchasing and selling process for 2014 and examine what they can learn from it for 2015.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief van 23 januari evalueren partijen gezamenlijk het in- en verkoopproces voor 2014 en gaan zij na wat zij daarvan kunnen leren voor het jaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over medische zorg voor vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked how many asylum seekers use medical care during their procedure, what it costs, whether they pay co-payments, and how many rejected applicants receive care. The government answered that care is provided under the Rva and RZA, costs were 72 million euro in 2012, asylum seekers pay no co-payments or deductibles, and it cannot track several requested figures due to medical confidentiality and lack of registration.
Which medical care an asylum seeker has received falls under medical professional confidentiality and is therefore not visible to the non-medical staff of the immigration chain.
Welke medische zorg een asielzoeker heeft ontvangen valt onder het medische beroepsgeheim en is daarom niet inzichtelijk voor het niet-medische personeel van de vreemdelingenketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat DBC Onderhoud de gemiddelde prijzen voor een beperkt aantal zorgproducten publiceert

An MP asked the minister about DBC Onderhoud publishing average prices for a limited set of hospital care products, the Ombudsman's view on patients' lack of insight into costs, the obligation to publish passantentarieven, and whether publishing volumes and prices per provider raises competition or confidentiality concerns. The minister acknowledged the limited scope, said hospitals must publish passantentarieven, and deferred the open-data decision to a forthcoming letter before summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Klever en Wilders over het zwichten van voetbalclub Vitesse voor de Jodenhaat van de VAE (Verenigde Arabische Emiraten)

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Vitesse's decision to travel to the UAE without Jewish player Dan Mori, who was unwelcome there, reflects antisemitism and dhimmitude, and what measures would follow. The minister called the decision a bad signal, acknowledged concern about contemporary antisemitism and announced a study into its causes, but declined any measures against the club and noted that the question about admitting the player was moot after the team's return.
It was a bad signal from Vitesse to travel to the United Arab Emirates without its own player Mori.
Het was een slecht signaal van Vitesse om zonder haar eigen speler Mori af te reizen naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulpposten in Bronovo en ’t Lange Land in Zoetermeer mogelijk dicht gaan

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency departments at Bronovo and 't Lange Land in Zoetermeer may close, citing ambulance staff concerns about longer response times and lower quality. The minister replied that the plans are still at concept stage under insurer-led regional planning, that zorgverzekeraars must keep the 45-minute ambulance access norm, and declined to commit to stopping the plans.
See my answer to question 1, in which I outline the role of the health insurer and the other parties involved.
Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1 waarin ik de rol van de zorgverzekeraar en de andere betrokken partijen in deze schets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Mirro-screeningsinstrument van Achmea

An MP asks the Health Minister about insurer Achmea's Mirro screening tool, including an 8% tariff difference for providers who do not use it and doubts about its validation. The minister replies that the tool was developed by care providers, that use is not mandatory and the clinician decides, that no fully validated tool yet exists, and that insurers do not determine treatment.
It is always up to the care professional, based on their own clinical judgement, to decide whether or not to follow the advice of the screening tool.
Het is altijd aan de zorgprofessional om, op basis van de eigen klinische blik, te besluiten het advies van het screeningsinstrument wel of niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de rol van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bij de ontwikkeling van protonentherapie

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Zorgverzekeraars Nederland's opposition to four proton therapy centres and its call for more research would delay this effective treatment, and how the impasse could be resolved. The Minister answered that insurers may contract fewer centres as long as they meet their duty of care, that the CVZ rather than the Health Council determines insured care, and that she has no reason to think insurers will not act responsibly.
Individual insurers are free to purchase proton therapy from only one or two centres, provided they have bought sufficient care to meet their duty of care.

Het staat individuele verzekeraars vrij om bijvoorbeeld slechts bij één of twee centra protonentherapie in te kopen indien zij daarmee voldoende zorg hebben ingekocht om aan hun zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulp (SEH) van het LangeLand Ziekenhuis gaat verdwijnen

An MP asked the health minister about insurers' plans to close the emergency department and intensive care at LangeLand Hospital, and about the 45-minute access norm, the future of basic hospitals and the impact on Zoetermeer. The minister said the plans are premature, that insurers must safeguard the 45-minute norm under their duty of care, and promised a vision on regional spread of basic hospitals in April.
I will send you this vision in April.
Ik zend u deze visie in april.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Yücel en Kuzu over het niet toelaten van kinderen tot sportverenigingen van op basis van achternamen

MPs asked whether children were refused membership of a Rotterdam football club based on their surname or origin and whether the government would investigate such refusals. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to commission a study of refusal numbers, and said the KNVB had contacted the club and requested a written statement before any further action.
A study into the number of times children are refused on improper grounds is something I will not commission.
Een onderzoek naar het aantal keren dat kinderen op basis van oneigenlijke gronden worden geweigerd, ga ik niet laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat geneesmiddelen van fabrikant Ranbaxy in opspraak zijn, maar in Nederland nog steeds als preferent middel worden voorgeschreven

The MP asked why the IGZ did not immediately act after the US FDA banned imports of Ranbaxy active ingredients, why it did not order a full recall, and what concrete steps were taken after the June 2013 debate. The minister answered that the IGZ took precautionary measures mirroring the FDA import ban, that there is no direct health risk, and that Ranbaxy plants are inspected jointly with European bodies through the EMA.
The IGZ regards the FDA findings as a signal that the plant does not have its quality system in order, which calls for a strong response toward the company.
De IGZ weegt de bevindingen van de FDA als een signaal dat de betreffende fabriek zijn kwaliteitssysteem niet op orde heeft, hetgeen een krachtige reactie vraagt richting de firma.
Antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over het handelen van topambtenaren inzake de problemen op de longchirurgie/intensive care afdelingen van het VUmc (VUmedisch centrum)

MP Van Gerven asks whether senior civil servant Harry Paul misused his position to help his brother, a surgeon at VUmc, and whether the IGZ inspectorate was influenced or should re-examine its handling of the Van Tongeren death and whether VUmc should be asked to commission an external investigation. The minister denies misuse or improper influence, states the IGZ followed its guidelines in accepting VUmc's internal investigation, sees no need for further inquiry, and leaves follow-up with the family to VUmc.
The IGZ's policy is aimed at healthcare institutions first conducting adequate investigation of a report themselves and drawing lessons from it.
Het beleid van de IGZ is er op gericht dat zorginstellingen in eerste instantie zelf adequaat onderzoek doen naar een melding en daar lering uit trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgbeoordelingswebsites alles klakkeloos plaatsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether physician rating websites such as ZorgkaartNederland post reviews uncritically, allowing self-rating, malicious reviews and unverifiable content, and whether this undermines patient choice and transparency. The Minister replied that the sites apply editorial codes and checks, that self-reviews are removed, that negative reviews are inherent but limited in effect, and that the sites contribute to transparency, so no action is planned against them.
I see no reason to question the right to exist of these websites.
Ik zie geen reden om het bestaansrecht van deze websites ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat geneesmiddelen van fabrikant Ranbaxy in opspraak zijn, maar in Nederland nog steeds als preferent middel worden voorgeschreven

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that Ranbaxy medicines, though under scrutiny in the US, were still prescribed as preferred drugs in the Netherlands, and about the adequacy of inspections and data integrity. The minister replied that the IGZ took a precautionary measure only on products made from Ranbaxy's Toansa plant, that no health risk was established, that prior European inspections found no grounds for action, and that no full guarantee against falsified test data can be given, while rejecting a new investigation into IGZ and CBG oversight.
I do not think an investigation is necessary because I have no doubts about the way the IGZ and CBG work.
Ik vind onderzoek niet nodig omdat ik niet twijfel aan de werkwijze van IGZ en CBG.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat patiënten die het slachtoffer zijn geworden van schade door medisch handelen met lege handen staan na het faillissement van een ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether patients harmed by medical care are left empty-handed after the Ruwaard van Putten hospital went bankrupt, and whether insurer MediRisk must process their claims. The Minister declined to give a substantive view because a court ruling had been issued but was not yet final, said 11 claims had been filed after the bankruptcy and that the details of the complaints are unknown to her, and said it is up to private parties to bear responsibility for care.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate to give a substantive judgment on this matter.
Ik vind het derhalve niet opportuun om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Ex-patiënt staat met lege handen”

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether patients harmed by medical errors at a bankrupt hospital can claim damages without being placed behind other creditors, and what the government will do about it. The Minister said the matter is sub judice (a preliminary ruling was issued, possibly appealed) and declined to give a substantive view, while expressing sympathy for the patients.
I therefore do not think it is appropriate to give a substantive judgment on this case.
Ik vind het derhalve niet opportuun om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina ziekenhuis in Eindhoven één miljoen euro moet betalen aan vier frauderende dermatologen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the hospital board or the medical staff is ultimately responsible in a hospital, after an arbitration ruling that the board and specialists are not in a hierarchical relationship. The minister said the hospital board bears final responsibility for quality, safety and billing, disagreed with the ruling, and noted that fraud action remains possible.
The hospital board bears final responsibility for the whole hospital and must be able to be held accountable for it.
De raad van bestuur draagt de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor het totale ziekenhuis en moet daarop kunnen worden aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de enige nachtapotheker in Alphen aan den Rijn op 2 februari gaat sluiten

An SP MP asked the health minister whether residents of Alphen aan den Rijn should travel to Leiden after the only night pharmacy closes, whether insurers Achmea and Zorg & Zekerheid are failing their duty of care, and what the government will do to prevent closure. The minister replied that night-time pharmacy access is the responsibility of pharmacists and insurers, supervised by the NZa and IGZ, that emergency medication can be delivered or given by GPs, and that no specific government role is foreseen.
Within the healthcare system, no specific role for the government is foreseen here.
Binnen het zorgstelsel is hier geen specifieke rol voor de overheid voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de 120.000 verzekerden die al jarenlang geen zorgpremie betalen, waardoor er één miljard euro aan onbetaalde premies open staat

An MP asked the minister how she will tackle the 120,000 chronic non-payers of health insurance premiums (about one billion euros outstanding), whether the planned amendment to the non-payer scheme will address them, and about the share of allochtonen and the effect of opening borders to Bulgarians and Romanians, and whether such non-payers should still receive all care. The minister answered that enforcement is already strict within legal limits, that referral back to insurers is being prepared with CVZ and municipalities, that CBS data on background characteristics is provided and further analysis requested, and that suspending insurance would shift the problem to providers so she opposes it.
I will continue to look for measures or initiatives that substantially reduce this group.
Ik zal voortdurend blijven zoeken naar maatregelen of initiatieven die deze groep substantieel verkleint.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars risicoselectie toepassen op buitenlandse werknemers die in Nederland actief zijn door ze een polis zonder eigen risico aan te bi

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurers' supplementary policies that cover the own risk for foreign seasonal workers amount to risk selection and should be closed off by law. Minister Schippers answers that the constructions are lawful, limited in size (under 2% of insured), grounded in collection risk, and that she sees no need to ban them, though she has asked the NZa to pay extra attention in its market scan.
At the time I agreed with the NZa that they would monitor developments regarding the reinsurance.
Ik heb destijds met de NZa afgesproken dat zij de ontwikkelingen rondom het herverzekeren zouden volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over discriminerende zorgverzekeraars die een spotgoedkope zorgverzekering met nul eigen risico aanbieden aan uitsluitend buitenlanders

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the minister about insurers offering very cheap health policies with zero deductible only to foreigners, and whether this should be ended and extended to Dutch citizens. The minister replied that these are voluntary collective add-on arrangements for groups such as seasonal workers, that the NZa monitors them and finds them small (under 2%), and that she cannot ban them, though she asked the NZa to give them extra attention in its market scan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de betaalbaarheid van kankermedicijnen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about the affordability of cancer medicines, including whether secret price negotiations are the right tool and whether price ceilings, the Norwegian model or NICE-style cost-effectiveness assessment should be used. The Minister answered that Dutch mechanisms (CVZ assessment, price arrangements, hospital budget transfer, registration) are adequate, rejected generic price ceilings, and promised only to await a CVZ report on cost-effectiveness.
Introducing new generic price ceilings or budgets is, in my view, not an alternative for this.
Het instellen van nieuwe, generieke prijsplafonds of budgetten is hiervoor mijn inziens geen alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het sluiten van de apotheekdiensten in Lelystad na 22.00 uur

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the closure of Lelystad's night pharmacy service, the consequences for residents needing urgent medication, and whether insurers' duty of care is breached. The minister answered that insurers and pharmacists have a duty of care, that the NZa and IGZ supervise compliance, that closure is not per se a breach, and that a 45-minute time criterion applies, leaving the assessment to the IGZ.
Whether health insurers comply with their duty of care is for the specific supervisor, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de specifieke toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar De Friesland studenten probeert te lokken door ze een gratis schoonmaakster aan te bieden

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister to respond to reports that insurer De Friesland offered students a free cleaning service to attract them, and questioned whether such marketing costs were properly booked and whether care money was being used appropriately. The minister replied that insurers decide their own marketing strategy and budgets, that the matter falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and cost declarations, and that 2013 profit figures will only be available later.
This falls outside my responsibility as minister.
Dit valt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid als minister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de beoordeling van euthanasie door de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether euthanasia review committees should follow professional guidelines, whether there should be an independent dispute body for KNMG's complaints, and whether a meeting with KNMG had taken place. Minister Schippers answered that committees are not bound by guidelines but use them as a reference, that transparency will be improved via the website, that a separate dispute body is not desirable, and that a meeting with KNMG has been arranged.
We do not consider it desirable that in other situations objection to an Rte judgement be possible.
Wij achten het niet wenselijk dat in andere situaties bezwaar tegen een Rte-oordeel openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over wanbetalers in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about rising numbers of people who do not pay their health insurance premiums, including whether unpaid premiums are growing and what causes and measures apply. The minister confirmed about 320,000 defaulters with roughly 887 million euro outstanding, explained the debt-collection and bronheffing process, and committed to a further package of measures in summer.
I have no data on that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bejegenen van nabestaanden na overlijden in de instelling Bartimeus

MP Leijten asks whether relatives of a woman who died after a bathing incident at Bartimeus received no apologies, were pressured to sign a document blaming a viral infection, and whether the IGZ report and institutional response were adequate. The State Secretary says he was not involved in aftercare, finds the lack of apologies regrettable if true, notes the IGZ found no pressure reported and that Bartimeus's and the hospital's assessments do not diverge, and points to an integral improvement plan and a planned IGZ follow-up visit.
Reports of investigations into calamities are in principle not made public by the IGZ.
Rapporten van onderzoek naar calamiteiten worden door de IGZ in principe niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over euthanasie bij mensen met een psychiatrische aandoening

An MP asked the Minister of Health about euthanasia for psychiatric patients, including the reported rise in cases and whether doctors consult multiple SCEN doctors and whether the review committees hear them all. The minister confirmed 42 notifications in 2013 versus 14 in 2012 and 13 in 2011, attributed the rise to growing doctor willingness and argued that consulting several SCEN doctors is permissible and rarely tracked, with the minister promising to ask the committees for their annual report sooner.
I will ask the Rte to send this annual report to me and the Minister of Security and Justice as soon as possible.
Ik zal de Rte verzoeken dit jaarverslag zo spoedig mogelijk aan mij en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de vergoeding van een medicijn voor MS-patiënten

An MP asked the health minister why the CVZ rejected reimbursement of Fampyra for MS patients despite research showing benefit, whether insurers are dropping physiotherapy cover, and whether the drug will be conditionally admitted. The minister answered that the CVZ's finding of no demonstrated added value over physiotherapy is decisive, that a decision on conditional admission is pending and a decision is expected in spring 2014.
I therefore cannot give a conclusive answer at this time on whether Fampyra can be conditionally admitted.
Ik kan daarom op dit moment geen uitsluitsel geven of Fampyra voorwaardelijk kan worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Kamerleden Cegerek en Dikkers over het bericht dat er teveel dioxine gevonden is in eieren nabij de afvalverbrandingsoven Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked about reports of excessive dioxin in eggs from backyard hens near the Harlingen waste incinerator, whether eggs and milk should be removed, and whether the incinerator and its enforcement by a regional agency posing a conflict of interest are adequately checked. The minister replied that the eggs were not marketed, that existing consumption advice still applies, that a re-evaluation of the EU tolerable weekly intake will be pushed in Europe, that incinerator emissions are continuously monitored and tested twice yearly, that no extra research is needed, and that the regional agency only advises municipalities and enforcement is not delegated.
The province is the competent authority for the waste incineration installation and is not a shareholder.
De provincie is bevoegd gezag voor de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie en geen aandeelhouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het landelijk schakelpunt uitbreidt naar ketenzorg

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about extending the LSP health data exchange to chronic care, including privacy, consent, CBP oversight and insurer incentives. The minister answered that data sharing must comply with WBP and WGBO rules, that the CBP can enforce, and that the LSP is not an obligation for providers.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is tasked with supervising the processing of personal data.
Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft tot taak toe te zien op de verwerking van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat bij de Olympische Spelen grootschalig gegevensopslag plaatsvindt van aanwezige sporters en andere geaccrediteerden

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government whether Dutch Olympic visitors' communications data stored by Russia (three-year retention, accessible to the FSB and other unnamed agencies) could reach Dutch intelligence services and what was being done to inform and protect Dutch citizens. The government answered that Dutch intelligence services have no access to the database, that Dutch visitors are covered by a travel advisory and the Oranje Boekje, and that it cannot exclude storage of delegation members' data for security reasons.
Dutch intelligence and security services have no access to the said database.
Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen toegang tot de genoemde database.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Gerven over het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) dat jonge werkloze medische specialisten met behoud van uitkering aan het werk zet

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that young unemployed medical specialists work unpaid at the AMC while keeping their benefits, and how many are underpaid, whether this is minimum-wage evasion or fraud, and how underpayment will be ended. The State Secretary answered that pay must meet legal and CAO obligations, that the number of unpaid specialists is unknown, that no complaints have reached the inspectorates so no investigation is under way, and that the government sees no underpayment under the specialists' terms of employment.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat onverzekerde Oost-Europeanen ziekenhuizen miljoenen kosten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the government responds to reports that uninsured Eastern Europeans leave hospitals with millions in unpaid bills, asked for figures by year and nationality, and asked what is being done to reduce uninsurance. Minister Schippers said uninsured residents must insure or pay, that the CVZ does not record nationality so figures are unavailable, that hospitals (NVZ, NFU) were asked to map the losses, and that enforcement and information efforts exist but detection of short-stay EU nationals without a citizen service number is not feasible.
I will also ask them whether and to what extent it is possible to break these down further by nationality.
Tevens zal ik aan hen vragen of en in welke mate het mogelijk is deze verder uit te splitsen naar nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er vanaf 1 januari 2014 in Lelystad ’s nachts geen apotheker meer geopend is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the closure of Lelystad's night pharmacy, and patients having to travel to Almere for emergency medicine, was acceptable and whether insurers and pharmacists were meeting their duty to provide 24-hour pharmaceutical care. The minister answered that emergency medicine remains available via insurers' contracting duties and home delivery, that compliance is for the NZa and IGZ to assess, and that no concrete maximum travel distance exists.
Whether health insurers comply with their duty of care is for the specific supervisor, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de specifieke toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten asked whether the €5 per-medicine charge for uninsured foreigners would deter needed care, how pharmacies could assess ability to pay, the CVZ's collection costs and savings, and whether it breaches the European Social Charter. Minister Schippers defended the measure as enforcing the principle that uninsured foreigners pay for care, saying it does not block necessary care, no means test is needed, collection costs are nil, savings are not the aim, and the Charter does not cover illegal residents.
I see no insurmountable barrier to obtaining care in the five-euro measure.
Ik zie in de vijf-euromaatregel geen onoverkomelijke drempel voor het verkrijgen van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de 5 euro die onverzekerbare vreemdelingen moeten betalen voor medicijnen

MPs Maij and Bouwmeester asked why undocumented migrants must pay EUR 5 for medicines, how it was communicated, and what safeguards exist for those unable to pay. Minister Schippers answered that the charge restores the principle that the patient pays, that pharmacies and GPs were informed, that access is not blocked in urgent cases, and that the CVZ will monitor effects in its annual report rather than in a two-month inventory.
I have asked the CVZ to address the five-euro measure in this monitor where possible, and I will include it in the annual VWS Insured Monitor I send to your House.
Ik heb het CVZ gevraagd in deze monitor zo mogelijk in te gaan op de vijf-euromaatregel en zal dit meenemen in de VWS-Verzekerdenmonitor die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer zend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat het VUmc geen geld heeft voor de behandeling van transgenders

An MP asked the health minister whether insurers have provided inadequate budget for gender dysphoria treatment at VUmc, and what the government will do about it. The minister said insurers have a duty of care, that existing treatments continue, that the NZa is investigating, and that responsibility for care chains lies with the sector, with the government facilitating.
The NZa has indicated it is already investigating this case, is alert to the issue and will keep me informed of developments.
De NZa heeft laten weten deze casus al te onderzoeken, alert op deze kwestie te zijn en mij geïnformeerd te houden over de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het budget voor transgenderzorg bij lange na niet toereikend is

MP Leijten asked the Health Minister whether the VUmc's funding shortfall for transgender care, reported in the press, would leave about 600 patients untreated and whether insurers could refuse care. The minister said she could not confirm the reported figures, expressed trust that insurers and the VUmc would meet their duty of care, and noted the regulator NZa is examining the matter.
The NZa has indicated that it is already examining this case, is alert to the issue, and will keep me informed of developments.
De NZa heeft laten weten deze casus al te onderzoeken, alert op deze kwestie te zijn en mij geïnformeerd te houden over de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het VUmc stopt met nieuwe behandelingen van transgenders en patiënten met genderdysforie

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister about VUmc reportedly halting new gender treatments due to lack of funds, and about the right to care, financing, capacity and the 2014 gender-declaration requirement. The minister said insurers and VUmc must resolve financing, pointed to the insurers' duty of care and the NZa's oversight, and said the declaration process is separate from medical treatment.
It is therefore up to insurers to agree with VUmc how much funding is needed for care for transgender people.
Het is dus aan verzekeraars om in overleg met het VUmc af te spreken hoeveel middelen nodig zijn voor de zorg voor transgenders.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Wolbert en Dikkers over het niet voldoen van testen die controleren op de aanwezigheid van hormoonverstorende stoffen in consumentenproducten

MPs Wolbert and Dikkers asked the health minister whether standard tests can detect low but harmful concentrations of hormone-disrupting substances in consumer products, which substances may slip through, and whether national measures and better consumer information are needed. The minister answered that current OECD tests are broadly adequate for some effects, that low-dose risks remain scientifically uncertain, and that no additional national product restrictions are planned for now, while the leaflet and website for pregnant women will be reviewed.

However, it is important that the government contributes to making information available about these uncertain risks, so that citizens have a course of action and can make conscious choices themselves.
Wel is het belangrijk dat de overheid bijdraagt aan het beschikbaar maken van informatie over deze onzekere risico’s, zodat de burger een handelingsperspectief heeft en zelf bewuste keuzes kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over toename openstaande rekeningen in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health about rising unpaid hospital bills from uninsured people, including whether EU citizens can be effectively pursued and whether CVZ should investigate. Minister Schippers answered that EU residents must be insured if they stay over three months and that CVZ's tracing is limited to registered persons, but declined to commission research, saying debt prevention is hospitals' responsibility, while only asking NVZ and NFV to map the losses.
I do not consider research into the nature, scope and causes of uninsured EU citizens failing to take out insurance a task for the CVZ, nor a task for the Dutch government as such.

Ik vind onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en oorzaak van het niet afsluiten van een verzekering door niet verzekerde EU-burgers geen taak voor het CVZ, noch een taak voor de Nederlandse overheid als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over risicoselectie door zorgverzekeraars in de basisverzekering

An MP asks the Health Minister whether risk selection by health insurers in the basic insurance is being adequately policed, citing signals from research that the NZa commissioned. The minister replies that the NZa received no reports of direct violations, that the research shows overstapping patterns it does not treat as unlawful risk selection, and that she will keep monitoring the risk equalisation system without launching a new investigation.
In practice the NZa has received no signals of direct risk selection.
In de praktijk heeft de NZa geen signalen van directe risicoselectie ontvangen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over over het bericht dat honderden hoogzwangere, vooral West-Afrikaanse vrouwen de laatste tijd naar Groot-Brittannië zijn gevlogen om daar tijdens hun bevalling gratis gebruik te make

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether birth tourism, or free use of Dutch healthcare by foreign pregnant women, occurs in the Netherlands and what it costs. The minister gave partial figures for illegal residents (EUR 747,000 for 970 pregnancies in 2012), said data for hospital care and uninsured foreigners are not yet available, and committed to asking hospital associations for more figures.
As far as medical specialist care in hospitals or uninsured foreigners other than illegal residents or uninsurable foreigners is concerned, I currently have no figures available on this.

Voor zover het gaat over medisch specialistische zorg in ziekenhuizen of over onverzekerde buitenlanders, anders dan illegalen of onverzekerbare vreemdelingen,heb ik hierover op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat jonge medisch specialisten steeds vaker onbetaald werken in ziekenhuizen en maatschappen

An MP asks the health minister about reports that newly qualified medical specialists work unpaid in hospitals and practices, and whether this is acceptable given insurers pay for the procedures, and how it affects jobs and pay. The minister replies that there is no registration of unpaid work, that the number is unknown, that DBC pricing allows hospitals to account for actual costs, and that labour law and collective agreements give specialists sufficient means to protect their rights.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond dat zorgverzekeraars zeer gebrekkige of geheel verkeerde informatie aan hun verzekerden verschaffen

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to a Consumentenbond study finding that health insurers give inconsistent or wrong information to policyholders, and what instruments exist to enforce better information. The minister agreed correct information is a core duty, said she will raise it with the insurers' association, noted the NZa supervises transparency, and declined a separate broader investigation.
I therefore see no reason to take other measures, besides the consultation with ZN.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om, naast het overleg met ZN, andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat huisartsen als strenge poortwachters bijdragen aan de hoge kankersterfte in Nederland

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health whether GPs acting as strict gatekeepers delay cancer referrals and contribute to high cancer mortality, and related questions about diagnostic competence, patient involvement and training. The Minister rejected the claim that gatekeeping causes high mortality, citing the Lancet study's limits and Dutch evidence, and promised a forthcoming NHG position and cancer care standard.

I see no reason to assume that cancer patients are regularly treated too late by a specialist due to a strict referral policy of the GP and that this leads to high cancer mortality in the Netherlands.

Ik zie geen reden om aan te nemen dat kankerpatiënten door een streng doorverwijsbeleid van de huisarts regelmatig te laat worden behandeld door een specialist en dat dit leidt tot hoge kankersterfte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Diaconessenhuis in Meppel zich in de toekomst mogelijk zal beperken tot de planbare zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel may limit itself to planned care, closing or relocating departments, and whether insurer Achmea pressured it. The Minister answered that the hospital's profile (basic specialist care, merged HAP/SEH, reduced OR use) is being developed in 2014, that no department closures are currently planned, and that the NZa and ACM oversee the fusion and insurer-provider negotiations.
The Diaconessenhuis has informed me that the profile, see my answer to question 1, is leading and that there is currently no question of closing departments.
Het Diaconessenhuis heeft mij laten weten dat het profiel, zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1, leidend is en er op dit moment geen sprake van sluiting van afdelingen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichten “Groot deel voetbalgeweld bij risicoclubs” en “Duizend gevallen van extreem fysiek geweld”

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that most violence on and around football pitches occurs at a small number of clubs, and how such clubs can be supported and whether violence reporting can be improved. The minister said the KNVB supports struggling clubs, that a chain approach with KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, municipalities and the Justice ministry is being developed, and that the Justice ministry is working to improve the police reporting process.
Currently I am developing with the KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, municipalities and the Ministry of Justice and Security a chain approach to further curb excesses at sports clubs.
Op dit moment ontwikkel ik met KNVB, NOC*NSF, Halt, gemeenten en het Ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie een ketenaanpak om excessen bij sportverenigingen verder terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Matchfixing nog steeds geen prioriteit in Nederland’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that matchfixing is not a priority in the Netherlands and about organised crime's role, and whether the government would push for a European approach. The minister replied that matchfixing takes several forms, that the OM is examining signals of fraud in football within a preliminary investigation, and that the Netherlands is actively negotiating a Council of Europe convention against matchfixing, with adoption targeted for autumn 2014.
The Netherlands actively participates in the negotiations in the Council of Europe to reach a convention to combat matchfixing.
Nederland neemt pro-actief deel aan de onderhandelingen in de Raad van Europa, om tot een verdrag te komen ter bestrijding van matchfixing.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beleid van de Koninklijke Nederlandsche Wielren Unie (KNWU) met betrekking tot het faciliteren van de paralympische equipe (i

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the KNWU's allocation of NOC*NSF and sponsor funds is fair, since paralympic cyclists must pay their own international travel and accommodation while most funds go to coaches and staff, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that the sport is responsible for choices within its budget, cites planned evaluation and better athlete communication, and declines to intervene.
Responsibility for finding a solution lies with sport itself, and sport is working on it.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het vinden van een oplossing ligt bij de sport zelf en daar is de sport mee bezig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toepassing van arsenicum in de kippen- en kalkoenindustrie in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the government about US use of arsenic-based growth promoters in poultry and turkey, EU bans, arsenic toxicity, labelling of imported products, and whether an EU-US trade deal would allow imports of meat from animals given such additives. The government welcomed US attention, confirmed EU bans and limits on arsenic in feed, said it lacked an overview of other countries' rules, and stated that EU food and product safety standards are not up for negotiation in the trade talks.
There will be no compromise on consumer and product safety.
Er zal niet ingeboet worden op consument- en productveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Wolbert over het bericht dat fabrikanten van levensmiddelen verdoezelen hoeveel suiker in producten zitten

MPs asked whether food manufacturers use many names for sugar and claims like 'no added sugars' to mislead consumers, and what labelling should require. The minister said the current EU and Dutch rules already require specific ingredient names, that 'no added sugars' claims are restricted, and that mandatory nutrition declarations with sugar content come from December 2016, and she agreed sugar content should be clearly stated on children's products.
In my view there is still generally too much sugar in our food supply.
Naar mijn mening zit er ten algemene nog teveel suiker in ons levensmiddelenaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de toename van het aantal drugsslachtoffers bij ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister whether rising drug-related emergency room admissions, driven mainly by GHB and XTC use, warrant stronger prevention and whether municipalities have sufficient funds for prevention. The state secretary answered that GHB use is becoming more problematic, described protocols and prevention efforts including a new youth health project from April 2014, and did not commit to new legislative or funding measures.
I am consulting with the Trimbos Institute to determine which additions to or changes in the current preventive approach could be effective.
Ik ben in overleg met het Trimbos instituut om te bepalen welke aanvullingen op of veranderingen in de huidige preventieve aanpak effectief zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Klever over het bericht van de Nationale ombudsman “fraude valt mee”

Two PVV MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the National Ombudsman's statement that fraud is less serious than assumed, and whether they agree that all fraud must be tackled and that such statements insult taxpayers. The Minister replied that all fraud is unacceptable, pointed to the Rijksbrede aanpak Fraude and the zorgfraude plan of action, and said he does not share the view that the Ombudsman's statement is an insult, as the Ombudsman's task is to oversee government.
No, I do not share that view. The National Ombudsman's task is to oversee the government and make statements about it.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. De Nationale Ombudsman heeft tot taak om toe te zien op de overheid en daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over prijsafspraken voor vruchtbaarheidsmiddelen

Opposition MP Klever asks the Health Minister about reported price agreements for fertility drugs that may have excluded cheaper products and breached competition law.
