The minister says she was not involved or informed of the alleged agreements, defends negotiations between providers and manufacturers as lawful, and refers competition oversight to the ACM.
I am not involved in the alleged price agreements and am therefore not aware of their content.
Ik ben niet betrokken bij vermeende prijsafspraken en ben van de inhoud dan ook niet op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat MC Zuiderzee BV nu de enige aandeelhouder is van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

SP MPs asked the health minister about the takeover of Slotervaart Hospital by MC Groep, including the transfer of pharmacy and oncology neurosurgery to the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek, pressure from insurers and creditors, the role of the court-appointed administrator, and whether the IGZ is monitoring care quality. The minister answered that the takeover is a commercial matter, the IGZ has found no care risks, and she defends shareholder participation in healthcare, while promising a central shareholders register.
The amount is not known to me.
Het bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat behandelingen tegen vliegangst vergoed worden uit de basisverzekering

MPs Bouwmeester and Anne Mulder asked whether treatment for fear of flying, offered by PsyQ, can be charged to the basic health insurance, and how transparency of care billing could be improved. Minister Schippers answered that such treatment is not insured GGZ care unless provided as GP care, and announced more detailed invoices from 2014 and a NZa study on showing diagnoses on invoices.
Health insurers may only charge care to the Zvw that is actually insured under the Zvw.
Zorgverzekeraars mogen alleen zorg ten laste van de Zvw brengen die ook daadwerkelijk verzekerd is onder de Zvw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘tandarts maakte behandelingen niet duurder’

An MP asked the health minister how she views a Milliman study claiming dentists only applied inflation corrections during the free-tariff experiment, contrary to NZa findings of over 10% price rises, and about delays in the NZa/Deloitte cost study and the future of dental tariffs. The minister defends the NZa market scans, sees no reason to re-examine them or to launch a new free-price experiment, and says a multi-year agenda is being drawn up with the sector.
Based on the explanations of the methods used by Milliman and the NZa, I have no reason to doubt the outcomes of the NZa market scans.
Op basis van de toelichtingen op de gebruikte methoden door Milliman en de NZa heb ik geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan de uitkomsten van de NZa-marktscans.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over euthanasie bij kinderen

MP Tellegen asked the Health Minister about Belgium loosening its age limit for euthanasia, the gap in Dutch rules for children aged 1 to 12, and how many such children may be left without an option. The minister answered that Dutch rules set the minimum age at 12 with safeguards, that the gap is being addressed by supporting a specialist advisory point for paediatric end-of-life care, and that no data exist on unfiled requests.
No data are kept on requests that were not submitted.
Er worden geen gegevens bijgehouden van niet ingediende verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de hoge kankersterfte in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether high cancer mortality in the Netherlands relates to care avoidance due to co-payments, to high cancer drug prices, whether a maximum reimbursement should be introduced, and whether action will follow a Lancet study. The minister answered that the study covers 2000-2007 when co-payments were limited, sees no link to drug prices, rejects the need for a maximum reimbursement while describing price arrangements, and sees no reason for specific action.
I see no reason to take specific action in response to this study.
Ik zie geen reden om naar aanleiding van dit onderzoek specifieke actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de levensomstandigheden van psychiatrische patiënten bij langdurige opname

An MP asked the health minister about living conditions for long-term psychiatric inpatients after a press report on a patient, including the Inspectorate's views and whether the Bopz 'bestwil' criterion should return. The minister said individual cases fall to providers, cited Inspectorate findings on somatic care, and rejected reinstating the 'bestwil' criterion in favour of the harm-based Wet verplichte GGZ.
As Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, however, I am not competent to mediate in individual cases.
Als minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ben ik echter niet bevoegd om te bemiddelen in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over Legionella op de Verpleegafdeling kortverblijf inwendige geneeskunde in het LUMC

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers why legionella bacteria were found in water at a LUMC ward for years, why patients are told not to drink or shower with tap water, and why bottled water is used instead of filters, and whether this is acceptable. The ministers answer that LUMC is taking preventive measures, that the contaminated pipes are being replaced, that the Inspectorate (ILT) reports and enforcement approach are described, and that other measures were chosen by the hospital.
It is good that the LUMC takes preventive measures when legionella exceeds the norm in the drinking water installation, to prevent contamination of persons with the legionella bacterium.
Het is goed dat het LUMC preventieve maatregelen neemt bij een normoverschrijding van legionella in de drinkwaterinstallatie ter voorkoming van besmetting van personen met de legionellabacterie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nuvaring een verhoogde kans op trombose geeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Nuvaring contraceptive ring raises thrombosis risk, including embolism reports, promotion by manufacturer MSD, and possible market withdrawal. The Minister answered that the risk matches other third and fourth generation pills, that the product information is being tightened following a PRAC advice, that existing inspection of pharmaceutical marketing is adequate, and that the decision on market withdrawal rests with the CBG.
It is the task of the Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG) to weigh this information and decide whether additional measures are needed on the basis of that information.
Het is de taak van het College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) om deze informatie te wegen en te beslissen of er op basis van die informatie aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de afdeling klinische verloskunde uit Hengelo dreigt te verdwijnen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether the obstetric department in Hengelo will close, whether insurer Menzis had a role, and what will be done to prevent closure and further loss of specialist care in Twente. The Minister says the closure plan from the regional hospitals (ZGT and MST) is not yet decided, that IGZ and NZa oversee quality and access, that no hospital location in the region is sensitive to the 45-minute norm, and that she will not intervene directly beyond oversight.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over bacteriën zonder vijand

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the ministers about carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) in the food chain, monitoring, zero-tolerance policy, the role of intensive livestock farming and incentives for new antibiotics. The minister answered that food monitoring since 2011 found no CRE, that RIVM was asked for an integrated advice within three months, and that pull incentives such as patent extension will be explored with the European Commission.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het door ouders laten registreren van kinderen jonger dan 12 jaar voor orgaandonatie (ingezonden 19 november 2013).

An MP asks the health minister whether allowing parents to register children under 12 for organ donation would increase available organs, and about the legal basis for parental consent. The minister answers that it would likely not increase organs, that parents already decide after a child's death, and that she opposes registration by parents, instead promoting discussion and school education.
I am not in favour of parents being able to register their child under 12 in the donor register.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van dat ouders hun kind jonger dan 12 jaar kunnen registreren in het donorregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Van Klaveren over multiresistente bacteriën bij deelnemers aan de jihad in Syrië

MPs Klever and Van Klaveren asked whether returning jihadists from Syria could carry multi-resistant bacteria, whether they are screened and whether they should be quarantined. The minister answered that hospital isolation rules apply only to patients treated abroad, that ordinary travellers are not a risk group, and that quarantine is unnecessary, while prosecution is for the public prosecutor.
Because the risk of spread is limited and no different from that of ordinary travellers, it is unnecessary to place this person in quarantine.
Omdat het risico op verspreiding beperkt is en niet anders dan bij «gewone» reizigers is het onnodig deze persoon in quarantaine te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het BNN-programma “Tot op het bot”

An MP asked the health minister about a BNN programme on anorexia treatment, including mortality, whether hospitals focus only on weight restoration, and hospital-to-GGZ handover. The minister confirmed viewing the programme, cited international mortality figures, pointed to the existing multidisciplinary eating-disorder guideline and the GGZ administrative agreement, and said she would explore further steps in 2014.
I am of the view that more attention can be paid to the relationship between mind and body in care.
Ik ben van mening dat aan de relatie tussen psyche en somatiek meer aandacht kan worden besteed in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de handhaving van de Drank- en Horecawet voor 16- en 17-jarigen

An MP asked whether municipalities may deviate from the new alcohol age limit of 18 through transitional arrangements tied to public order, and how the government views the enforcement consequences. The state secretary answered that municipalities set enforcement priorities but may not deviate from the statutory age limits or create transitional periods, and that the government trusts local balancing of interests.
However, this does not mean that one may deviate from the age limits as laid down by law, nor that a transitional period may be created for a certain group of young people.
Dit betekent echter niet dat mag worden afgeweken van de leeftijdsgrenzen zoals die bij wet zijn vastgelegd en ook niet dat een overgangsperiode mag worden gecreëerd voor een bepaalde groep jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tijgermug en de Aziatische bosmug

An MP from the SP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers about tiger mosquito imports via used tyres and Lucky bamboo, the VACO covenant, and the Asian bush mosquito. The minister replied that the policy targets the highest-risk pathways, that self-regulation via a covenant is used for tyre importers, and that the Asian bush mosquito is not a relevant disease vector in practice and cannot feasibly be eradicated.
My policy focuses on the greatest risks of introduction and spread of tiger mosquitoes in the Netherlands.
Mijn beleid richt zich op de grootste risico’s van introductie en verspreiding van tijgermuggen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het bericht dat scholen steeds minder vaak schoolzwemmen aanbieden

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about reports that municipalities are cutting funding for school swimming and that swimming diploma rates among children are falling. The state secretary answered that swimming skills are primarily the parents' responsibility, supported by schools and municipalities, that 94% of children obtain a diploma, and that no change to the division of responsibilities is warranted.
I see no reason to change the current division of responsibilities.
Zie ik geen aanleiding om de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rutte over hondsdolheid

VVD MPs Heerema and Rutte asked whether rabies poses a risk in the Netherlands, whether current policy is adequate, and whether imports of dogs from Eastern Europe and Morocco should be restricted. The State Secretary answered that Nederland is adequately prepared, that the current euthanasia, vaccination and prophylaxis policy is sufficient, and that she will consider lifting the exemption for unvaccinated puppies under three months and will write to the House early 2014.
Early 2014 I will inform you in a letter in more detail about the measures I am going to take.
Begin 2014 zal ik u in een brief nader informeren over de maatregelen die ik ga nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de verklaring euthanasie jaarlijks verlengd moet worden

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the written euthanasia declaration should have a validity limit of two years and whether it should be discussed with doctors regularly, and asked about dementia cases in 2012. The minister rejected a fixed validity period, said the patient is primarily responsible for discussing the declaration with the doctor, and promised an update from a working group before the 19 December committee meeting.
However, I do not want to go so far as to formulate a period of validity at this moment.
Ik wil echter op dit moment niet zo ver gaan een geldigheidsduur te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

SP MPs asked whether the 2014 requirement that undocumented migrants pay EUR 5 per prescription line at pharmacies, and must pay in full where a pharmacy lacks a CVZ contract, undermines access to necessary care and whether hospital access and reimbursement problems will be addressed. The minister defended the EUR 5 charge as a means to reduce non-payment, denied conflict with the law, said hospital access is sufficient and refused to commission further research.
I therefore do not share the view that an amount of EUR 5 hinders access to medically necessary care.
Ik deel dus niet de mening dat een bedrag van € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de acute zorgpost in Oldenzaal mogelijk sluit

An SP MP asked the Minister whether the planned closure of the daytime acute care post in Oldenzaal, which would force residents to travel to Enschede, was acceptable and whether it was linked to the loss of a 1.5 million euro availability subsidy. The Minister answered that the decision is the responsibility of the hospital and regional parties, that the location is not critical under the 45-minute norm, and that the NZa and Inspectie will assess accessibility and quality.
It is not my responsibility to make a decision about the future of this location.
Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om een besluit te nemen over de toekomst van deze locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over het stoppen van vergoedingen onbeperkt fysiotherapie

MP Slob asked why four insurers are ending unlimited physiotherapy reimbursement in supplementary insurance, how many people use it, and whether the minister will consult insurers, patient groups and the physiotherapy association. The minister says insurers decide coverage independently, declines to share enrollment figures citing commercial confidentiality, and refuses further consultation because seven insurers still offer unlimited cover.
I do not have this information. Such data is commercially sensitive, which insurers do not disclose for competitive reasons.
Ik heb niet de beschikking over deze informatie. Dergelijke gegevens betreffen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die de verzekeraars uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ontoelaatbare kindermarketing via het Nationaal Schoolontbijt

An MP asked whether the Nationaal Schoolontbijt, sponsored by food companies, is allowed to distribute products that are too sweet, salty or fatty and whether industry self-regulation on child-directed advertising under age 12 is working. The state secretary defended the initiative as private responsibility, noted the Voedingscentrum advises on products, and said industry has agreed to stop advertising to children under 12 except for products meeting nutritional criteria from 2014.
I support it when private parties take their social responsibility to promote a healthy lifestyle for young people.
Ik ondersteun het wanneer private partijen hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen om in te zetten op een gezonde leefstijl voor de jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Rebel over zwangeren die alcohol blijven drinken

MPs Wolbert and Rebel asked about reports that many pregnant women keep drinking alcohol and how prevention policy reaches lower-educated women, and whether professionals discuss alcohol before conception. The Staatssecretaris answered that no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy is advised, described existing public information, professional guidelines and training, and said the government will not further evaluate this but points to existing channels.
During pregnancy there is no safe amount of alcohol.
Bij zwangerschap bestaat geen veilige hoeveelheid alcohol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de grootste online hulpwebsite van Nederland, hulpmix.nl, wordt opgedoekt

An MP asked whether the closure of the online help site hulpmix.nl for migrant youth, and the funding gap for online prevention, was consistent with e-health policy and how the government would address it. The minister acknowledged the closure is unfavourable, explained that preventive online counselling is not covered by insurance and that the subsidy scheme applies only to anonymous care, and said the state is not responsible for such youth chat services, referring initiators to municipalities and insurers.
It is not the task of the central government to provide this form of online help.
Het is geen taak van de rijksoverheid om te voorzien in deze vorm van online hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over vergelijkingssites zorgverzekeringen

MPs Dik-Faber and Slob asked the health minister about health insurance comparison websites, including conflicting rankings, whether sites show only policies sold through them, and commissions paid by insurers. The minister answered that transparency about comparison methods and business models is important, pointed to AFM rules and planned deeper AFM review in 2014, and said government no longer provides insurance comparison information via KiesBeter.
The AFM is considering conducting more in-depth research in 2014 into how the comparison is produced.
De AFM overweegt om in 2014 diepgaander onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de vergelijking tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over fouten van vergelijkingssites zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the health minister whether consumers can trust health insurance comparison sites, how regulators supervise them and whether sites must disclose who pays them. The minister answered that transparency is essential, that the AFM binds such sites to a 2011 framework and will investigate further in 2014, and that the ACM is working on barriers to switching insurers.
Based on the AFM norms framework from 2011, comparison sites that mediate health insurance must be open about their revenue model.
Op basis van het AFM normenkader uit 2011 moeten vergelijkingssites die bemiddelen in zorgverzekeringen openheid geven over het verdienmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer, Dik-Faber en Krol over de publicatie ‘Over(-)behandelen. Ethiek van de zorg voor kwetsbare ouderen’

Members of parliament asked the health minister about a publication on over-treatment of frail elderly patients, including whether over-treatment should be curbed, adopting decision-making methods and ethical frameworks, and cost limits. The minister answered that shared decision-making, professional standards set by stakeholders, and a new 'intensive consultation at end of life' activity code are the preferred routes, with no binding new rules or cost ceilings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat artsenorganisatie KNMG wil dat huisartsen voortaan getoetst worden op regels inzake euthanasie

MP Arib asked the Minister of Health about the KNMG's proposal that GPs be tested on euthanasia rules and about the IGZ's handling of the Tuitjenhoorn case, the rise of palliative sedation and whether it masks euthanasia. The minister said GPs are assumed to have adequate knowledge, committed to an independent evaluation of the Tuitjenhoorn case, and gave statistics showing sedation rose 2005-2010 while noting professionalisation and training measures.
I have therefore decided to commission an independent evaluation of the conduct of all the instances involved in the Tuitjenhorn case.
Ik heb daarom besloten een onafhankelijke evaluatie te laten doen van het handelen van alle betrokken instanties in de zaak Tuitjenhorn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de praktijk van draagmoederschap een ethische grens bereikt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Health about reports that surrogacy reaches an ethical limit, including a Dutch surrogate's birth to a child from anonymous Spanish donors and the Child Protection Board's decision to let the child go home with the intended parents. The government answered that Dutch law protects children's right to know their origins, that cross-border surrogacy is undesirable but not fully preventable, and that it will set up a State Commission on surrogacy and multi-parent families and follow Hague Conference work on an international instrument.
I intend to establish such a State Commission in the field of surrogacy and multi-parent families.
ben ik voornemens een dergelijke Staatscommissie in te stellen op het terrein van draagmoederschap en meeroudergezinnen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het opinieartikel het opinieartikel “Niet alleen pillen, ook preventie nodig in de zorg; Grote veranderingen in laatste honderd jaar hebben conflict veroorzaakt tussen onze

An MP asked the minister about an opinion piece calling for a shift from curative to preventive medicine, the role of diet, GP and pharmacist nutrition knowledge, and foreign prevention programmes. The minister agreed prevention deserves a larger role, described existing initiatives and the National Prevention Programme, but declined to adopt a central role for diet or to implement the Iowa model directly.
The plea fits the shift in thinking from illness/care/dependence to health/behaviour/own strength.
Het pleidooi past bij de omslag in het denken van ziekte /zorg/afhankelijkheid naar gezondheid/gedrag/eigen kracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten over matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about media reports of match-fixing in Dutch professional football, including whether Dutch authorities took German signals seriously and whether crimes could still be proven. The minister declined to say whether the prosecutor investigated the specific cases, citing investigative and privacy interests, rejected the claim that Dutch authorities were slow, and rejected the claim that Dutch matches were proven fixed.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating any particular matter.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten dat Nederland blind zou zijn voor matchfixing

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about press reports that the Netherlands is blind to match-fixing, including whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether there were signals of fixing in a World Cup qualifier. The minister declined to say whether the prosecution service is investigating specific reports, while stating the research found match-fixing exists in the Netherlands but no large-scale manipulation, and that the prosecution service's preliminary inquiry is ongoing.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating particular matters.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin Van Dijk over het korten van topinkomens in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether the government supports Rotterdam's plan to cap top salaries at care providers through subsidy conditions, and how municipalities can be encouraged to do so. Minister Plasterk answered that excessive pay is undesirable, that the WNT does not prevent stricter subsidy conditions but may conflict with transitional law, and that he will consult the VNG to align central and local policy and report on the model subsidy regulation.
Although I do not wish to restrict the freedom of local government to make its own choices, it seems sensible to align the policies of central and local government.
Hoewel ik niet de vrijheid van het lokaal bestuur wil beperken om eigen keuzes te maken, lijkt het mij verstandig om het beleid van de centrale en de decentrale overheden op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat logopedisten, fysio- en ergotherapeuten fors gekort worden op hun tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers are cutting tariffs for speech therapists, physiotherapists and occupational therapists, whether the rates are reasonable, and whether contracting power and a ban on collective refusal to sign are acceptable. Minister Schippers replied that insurers are free to negotiate tariffs under the NZa maximums and competition rules, declined to publish per-insurer rates, and promised a joint ACM/NZa review of cooperation barriers.
Firstly, I do not have such data; insurers each make their own agreements on tariffs with care providers.
Ten eerste beschik ik niet over dergelijke gegevens, zorgverzekeraars maken ieder voor zich afspraken over tarieven met zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Huizing en Van Dekken over betaling van spelersmakelaars

MPs Huizing and Van Dekken asked whether football players rather than clubs should pay player agents, and whether agent intermediation falls under the WAADI labour-intermediary law. The minister answered that only pure labour-contract brokerage falls under WAADI, that the cost ban applies only to those brokerage costs, and that parties may agree who pays other agent services, so no exemption is planned.
To protect the employee, WAADI prohibits charging the costs of labour intermediation to the employee.
Ter bescherming van de werknemer is in de Waadi een verbod opgenomen om de kosten van arbeidsmiddeling in rekening te brengen bij de werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars niet overtuigd zijn van de effectiviteit van protonentherapie

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurers doubting proton therapy's effectiveness, whether four centres are justified, and why insurers may contract only one. The minister replied that proton therapy's benefit lies in reduced damage to healthy tissue, that CVZ-listed indications are covered but individually selected, that four licence applicants is the cap but licensing does not guarantee four centres, and that insurers may contract selectively.
Granting a licence does not, however, mean that four proton centres will certainly be realised.
Vergunningverlening betekent overigens niet dat er met zekerheid ook vier protonencentra zullen worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de helft van de zorgverleners vindt dat de zorg is verslechterd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about a report that half of care workers feel care has deteriorated, along with questions on workload, flexible contracts, overtime, and working conditions. The government rejects the claim that care has deteriorated, points to sector benchmarks and inspection, announces a quality agenda, and defers collective labour matters to social partners while referring to its labour market letter.
I am of the view that additional measures, beyond existing policy and supervision by the Health Care Inspectorate, are not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra maatregelen – naast reeds lopend beleid en het toezicht door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg – niet nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht verslaving gaat hand in hand met ADHD

An MP asked the health ministers how they respond to reports that addicts have ADHD far more often than non-addicts, why many addicted patients were never diagnosed, and whether clinicians and addiction services should screen better and integrate treatment. The government replied that ADHD is hard to diagnose alongside addiction, pointed to ongoing guideline revision and a forthcoming Gezondheidsraad advice, and said integrated treatment programmes and a new youth guideline already exist.
In the revision of the ADHD guideline, which the professional groups are currently working on, particular attention is being paid to diagnosis and medicalisation.
Bij de herziening van de richtlijn ADHD, waar de beroepsgroepen op dit moment aan werken, wordt in het bijzonder aandacht besteed aan diagnosticering en medicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over tekort aan huisartsen in Drenthe

An MP asked the health minister about a looming shortage of GPs in rural Drenthe, including whether national steering, tariff differentiation, practice centres and flanking incentives could help. The minister answered that insurers carry the duty of care, that Achmea is working with local GPs on a plan with extra funding, and that the matter is being examined in a quick scan, while declining to use the availability contribution instrument.
It is the responsibility of insurers to purchase sufficient care in order to meet their duty of care towards their insured.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van verzekeraars om voldoende zorg in te kopen om jegens hun verzekerden aan de zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de vergoeding van besnijdenis op medische indicatie

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about circumcision on medical grounds being excluded from the basic insurance package, about a treatment guideline, evaluation, and price differences. The minister said the medical profession (NVU) should draft a guideline, that price variation reflects free price-setting, and that exclusion from the package follows from 2005 criteria.
I call on the Dutch Association for Urology (NVU) to take the initiative in this regard.
Ik roep de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Urologie (NVU) op hiertoe het initiatief te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen door het nieuwe vergoedingensysteem duizenden euro’s zelf moeten betalen voor een hoortoestel

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether people must pay thousands of euros themselves for hearing aids under the new reimbursement system, whether insurers follow the protocol, and whether she will restore the UWV-provided hearing aid benefit. Minister Schippers replied that she cannot yet assess insurer compliance or harm, that the effects will be monitored with a report in spring 2014, that insurers may set policy conditions under the Zvw with disputes referable to the SKGZ, and that she will not restore the separate UWV scheme.

At present I cannot assess whether health insurers comply with the agreements they have made themselves with the hearing aid industry and other parties, nor the number of people who would allegedly have been harmed.

Ik kan op moment niet beoordelen of zorgverzekeraars zich houden aan afspraken die zij zelf met de hoortoestellenbranche en andere partijen gemaakt hebben, noch van het aantal mensen dat naar uw zeggen gedupeerd zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de het lid Bouwmeester over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen

Opposition MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked Minister Schippers whether the hearing aid reimbursement system, which covers only certain categories, excludes cheaper devices and cochlear implants may be chosen as a perverse incentive, and how to optimise the system. The minister defended the current system as offering enough choice, said she would report on monitoring by the end of 2013 but needed to wait for CVZ findings, pushing the promised report to spring 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat dat zorgverzekeraar Achmea zich niks aantrekt van Drenten

An MP asks the Health Minister whether health insurer Achmea ignores patients' wishes in Drenthe and whether hospital and care provision there is at risk, citing a Zorgbelang Drenthe complaint. The minister says insurers have a duty of care, that Achmea is consulting regional stakeholders, that she has no signals of care disappearing, and that patients can switch insurers.
If the insurer does too little to contract sufficient care, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) can hold the insurer to account for its duty of care.
Wanneer de verzekeraar te weinig onderneemt om voldoende zorg te contracteren kan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de verzekeraar aanspreken op zijn zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er 27 fatale gevallen zijn gemeld bij het Lareb die mogelijk verband houden met het gebruik van de Diane-35-pil

An SP MP asked the health minister about 27 reported deaths possibly linked to Diane-35, whether prescribing and reporting were adequate, the role of the CBG and Inspectorate, and whether the drug should be withdrawn or reimbursement stopped. The minister answered that the drug's risks were weighed at registration, that the EMA review found the balance positive with extra monitoring, that doctors should report more, and that the Inspectorate acts against online sellers and misleading advertising.
I am not authorised to take measures regarding individual medicines. That authority rests with the European medicines authorities.
Ik ben niet bevoegd maatregelen nemen terzake van individuele geneesmiddelen. Die bevoegdheid berust bij de Europese geneesmiddelenautoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een jong gezin 800 euro parkeerkosten maakte na de te vroege geboorte van een kind, omdat de parkeerkosten bij het VUmc (VUmedisch centrum) en bij het OLVG (

An SP MP asked the Health Minister to react to reports that a young family paid 800 euro in hospital parking fees after a premature birth, whether hospital parking profits fund patient care, and whether a national cap or discount scheme should apply. The minister said hospitals and municipalities should set parking policy themselves, declined a national rule or investigation, but will ask the OLVG board to review this case.
I have no overview of all parking tariffs, the costs of parking facilities, the profit or loss on parking facilities, or how profitability is recorded in the overall budget.

Ik heb geen overzicht van alle parkeertarieven, de kosten van parkeervoorzieningen, de winst of verlies op parkeervoorzieningen en de wijze waarop de winstgevendheid wordt verwerkt in de totale begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gevaarlijk hoge werkdruk van co-assistenten

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to reports that co-assistants (medical students in clinical rotations) face dangerously high workloads, and what causes it and what measures exist. The minister answered that the 46-hour maximum study load is acceptable, that causes are psychosocial and tied to the transition to clinical practice, that faculties offer support measures, and that patient safety is protected by supervision.
Only on the instruction of a supervising doctor on site may the co-assistant treat a patient themselves.
Slechts in opdracht van een superviserend arts ter plekke mag de coassistent een patiënt zelf behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Inspectie pakt ‘foute’ digitale dokters aan’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the inspectorate is targeting unreliable digital doctor apps, including complaint numbers, notified apps, a KNMG quality mark, reimbursement, and responsibility allocation. The minister answered that no complaints were received, some apps were notified via Farmatec, the KNMG mark does not yet exist, reimbursement is possible in some cases, and the producer bears primary responsibility while the inspectorate supervises compliance.
The IGZ is responsible for supervising whether such apps, registered as medical devices, meet the legal requirements
De IGZ is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht of dergelijke apps, die geregistreerd zijn als medische hulpmiddel, voldoen aan de wettelijke eisen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de Q-koorts

Two MPs asked the health minister about low recorded Q-fever infections among children and young people, whether doctors are more alert, and the status of the 10 million euro Q-support foundation. The minister answered that under-diagnosis is normal for mild cases, that the epidemic is over, that the foundation was set up and is starting activities, and that an evaluation will be reported around September 2014.
I have committed to evaluating, one year after the foundation starts, whether there are still people the foundation has not helped in the way we intended.
Ik heb u toegezegd dat een jaar nadat de stichting van start is gegaan geëvalueerd zal worden of er nog mensen zijn die door de stichting niet geholpen zijn op de manier waarop wij ze wilden helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin Van Dijk over de nieuwe telefoonbemiddelingsdienst voor doven

MPs Van Laar, Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether the new relay service for deaf users, which requires Total Conversation software from a single provider, leaves analogue text-phone users without access and whether insurers cover the costs. The minister answered that TC is an open standard, insurers cover the software licence and equipment, and access is adequate, while acknowledging a small group may briefly lose service.
All insured persons known to have received a text phone in the past have received a letter from their health insurer.
Alle verzekerden van wie bekend is dat men in het verleden een teksttelefoon heeft gekregen, hebben van hun zorgverzekeraar een brief ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Huizing en Bruins Slot over kickboksen door kinderen

Three MPs asked the health minister about children's kickboxing with head strikes allowed, the need for binding rules across fragmented kickboxing federations, and the quality of instructors. The minister agreed head contact is undesirable, said NOC*NSF will lead a plan for sector-wide rules expected by summer 2014, and said she would advise parents against such training while not yet ruling out a legal fallback.
For this, an impulse from outside is needed.
Daartoe is een impuls van buitenaf nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bruins Slot over het bericht dat een medische test homo’s moet ‘detecteren’ en uit Golfstaten weren

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Health whether they consider the development of a medical test aimed at detecting homosexuality, reportedly to bar gay people from Gulf states such as Kuwait, undesirable, and whether they will raise it with those countries and with FIFA regarding the 2022 World Cup. The minister answered that such a test is undesirable, that the proposal under consideration by Kuwait concerns a joint GCC gender test for work and residence visa applicants, and that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over investeren in luxueuze verpleeghuizen door zorgverzekeraar CZ

An SP MP asked the ministers whether health insurer CZ's investment arm, which funds luxury nursing homes for Alzheimer patients, is acceptable, whether vertical integration of insurers and providers is desirable, and whether premium money is used to create a two-tier elderly care system. The State Secretary replied that basic care is equal for everyone, that he has no objection to insurer investments unless they lead to vertical integration, and that the Martha Flora stake, paid from basic-premium income, is acceptable if transparent and intended for innovation.
As long as insurers' investments in care providers do not lead to vertical integration, I have no objection to them.
Zolang investeringen van zorgverzekeraars in zorgverleners niet leiden tot verticale integratie, heb ik daar geen bezwaar tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat voedingsfabrikanten niet gestraft worden voor het plaatsen van misleidende informatie op etiketten

An MP asked the health and economics ministers why food manufacturers face few penalties for misleading labels, how enforcement capacity was increased, who is liable in the chain, and why the NVWA issued only 45 fines from 143 violations. The minister acknowledged that labels cannot be guaranteed fully accurate, described enforcement reprioritisation and planned higher fine ceilings and publication of inspection data.
In addition, I intend to double the fines for violations under the Commodities Act.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens de boetes voor overtredingen in het kader van de Warenwet te verdubbelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Voortman over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de Levenseindekliniek boycotten

MPs Arib and Voortman asked the health minister about reports that insurers are boycotting the Levenseindekliniek (end-of-life clinic) and whether patients are left dependent on donations. The minister answered that insurers have a duty of care but are free to choose contractors, that the CVZ has no specific opinion on the clinic, and that she will monitor developments without committing to new action.
It is up to the health insurer to decide with whom it wishes to contract for the provision of certain care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om te bepalen met wie deze een contract wil sluiten voor het leveren van bepaalde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de consequenties van de voorgenomen opzet basis-GGZ /specialistische GGZ voor met name de behandeling van angst- en stemmingsstoornissen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the planned basic and specialist mental health care structure would undermine treatment of moderate to severe anxiety and mood disorders, citing concerns from NEDKAD about session reductions, assignment criteria, and referral limits. The Minister largely rejects the concerns, relies on expert input and a planned monitor, and declines to commit to revising the criteria beyond monitoring.
I am setting up a monitor to evaluate the generalist basic mental health care.
Ik zet de monitor op om generalistische basis GGZ te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat er teveel landbouwgif op groente en fruit zit

An MP asked the ministers whether the legal pesticide residue limits (MRLs) on fruit and vegetables are unsafe, as reported by Milieudefensie, Foodwatch and TROS Radar, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledges that some MRLs permit intake above the acute reference dose, says Nederland is pushing for revision in Brussels, and argues the share of unsafe MRLs is well below 10% with the actual health risk very small.
I consider the existence of such MRLs undesirable.
Ik vind het bestaan van dergelijke MRL's onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Van Oosten over de aanbevelingen in de dissertatie van mr.dr. R.P. Wijne

Two VVD MPs asked the health and justice ministers about recommendations in a dissertation by R.P. Wijne on easing patients' civil claims for avoidable harm, including reversing the burden of proof and presuming consent violations. The minister replied that the pending Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg already offers a low-threshold compensation route and incident-disclosure duty, and that the government will first assess its effects before considering further changes to the patient's evidentiary position.

We first want to see what the effects of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg bill are, before considering whether, and if so which, further improvement of the patient's evidentiary position is necessary.

Wij willen eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van het wetsvoorstel Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, alvorens te beschouwen of – en zo ja welke – verdere verbetering van de bewijspositie van de patiënt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de lange wachtlijsten voor scolioseoperaties

GroenLinks MP Voortman asked the health minister about long waiting lists for scoliosis surgery, the failure to meet a three-month norm, and whether insurers capped surgeries per hospital. Minister Schippers said waiting times fell by a month since 2008, deferred urgency to specialists and the profession, deregulated prices in 2012, and promised talks with orthopaedic surgeons and monitoring by the NZa.
I have asked the NZa to monitor this and to ask the insurers concerned what they will do to reduce waiting times.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om dit te monitoren en de betrokken zorgverzekeraars te vragen wat zij gaan doen om de wachttijden te verminderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis en het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis een voorgenomen fusie hebben aangemeld bij de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the proposed merger of St. Antonius and Zuwe Hofpoort hospitals notified to the competition authority, probing financial pressure, closure risks for emergency and other departments, staff and stakeholder views, and compliance with a pending merger-review bill. The minister declined to judge the individual merger, pointed to the ACM as competent authority, said she would write to both hospitals urging conduct in the spirit of the bill, and promised to forward any stakeholder views and publish the ACM and advisory opinions once issued.
It is for them to pass a judgment on this. I do not make statements on individual cases.
Het is aan hen hierover een oordeel uit te spreken. Ik doe geen uitspraak over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de invloed van het Apollo netwerk op het beleid

An MP asked the health minister about the Apollo network, its purpose, members' interests and funding, whether it produced reports, and whether it influenced pricing agreements for medicines. The minister answered that the network aims at shared knowledge, that ministry funding since 2010 totals modest sums, that it produced two publications, and that policy is not influenced by industry, though contacts are carefully managed.
I do not have an overview of side positions and of the research and/or advice for which they received contributions from the pharmaceutical industry.
Ik heb geen overzicht van nevenfuncties en de onderzoeken en/of adviezen waarvoor zij een bijdrage hebben ontvangen van de farmaceutische industrie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de afgelopen vier jaar bijna een ton heeft geschonken aan het Apollo netwerk

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that ministry officials, including the director of medicines, take part in the Apollo network alongside pharmaceutical companies, that the ministry has paid about a million euros to it, and whether all exchanges and the conditional-reimbursement report can be made public. The minister defends officials' participation as necessary for practical policy knowledge, reports the ministry's annual contributions (about 20,000 to 24,200 euros a year since 2010), declines to disclose the cost of the contractor Accenture and withholds the network's internal exchanges under agreed confidentiality, while saying it is not a stated aim to publish more.
The Apollo network agreed not to go public except with any completed reports of the network.
In het Apollo netwerk is afgesproken om niet naar buiten te treden behoudens met eventuele afgeronde rapporten van het netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Franse wijnen vol gif zitten

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers whether a Belgian report that French wines contain pesticide residues poses health risks in the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister answered that NVWA testing shows no health risk, that existing EU residue limits for grapes apply to wine, and that no further action is planned.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het aanprijzen van body scans

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she views a Prescan advertisement for a total body scan, whether such advertising should be allowed given the Dutch ban on these scans, and whether the scans cause unnecessary care costs and conflict with medical ethics. The minister answered that she awaits a Gezondheidsraad advisory report due in 2014 before taking a position, that the Dutch screening law does not cover examinations performed abroad, and that she could not provide data on costs or health gains.
As soon as I receive the advice from the Health Council, I will send a position to your House and include the issue of advertising in it.
Zodra ik advies van de Gezondheidsraad ontvang, zal ik een standpunt naar uw Kamer sturen en het punt van reclame daarbij meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over seleenvergiftiging bij zeugen en de volksgezondheidsrisico’s bij de consumptie van varkensvlees

An MP asked about possible selenium poisoning in sows, excessive selenium use in pig feed and public health risks from pork, and whether intensive sow breeding endangers animal welfare. The minister replied that there are no signs of widespread overdosing, that the two farm cases were isolated and within the legal limit, and that existing projects address sow longevity and welfare.
I have no indications that selenium is excessively administered to sows on a large scale.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat selenium op grote schaal overmatig aan zeugen wordt toegediend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plan om de leefbaarheid van het dorp Moerdijk op te offeren voor economische ontwikkeling

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether the advisory commission's view that port and industrial growth at Moerdijk should take priority over village liveability, and the resulting environmental, health and traffic impacts, were acceptable. The government answered that the trade-off is a matter for the regional authorities in the consultation on the port vision, that environmental norms still apply, and that it sees no role for the national government at this stage.
Given this consultation process, I currently see no role for the national government.
Gelet op dit consultatieproces zie ik thans geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verstrekking van medisch noodzakelijke merkmedicijnen door een groep van apotheken

An SP MP asked the minister of Health whether Spanhoff/BENU pharmacies' conditions for dispensing medically necessary brand-name medicines, their refusal to home-deliver or stock brand-name products, and alleged handling of prescriptions by non-pharmacists are lawful and whether she will intervene. The minister declined to assess the pharmacy group's conditions, referring to the regulators (NZa, IGZ) and the SKGZ complaints body, and said there is no VWS role, while noting that the email in question is nearly eighteen months old and not necessarily current.
No, there is no role for VWS here, but for the specific supervisory bodies.
Nee, hier is geen rol voor VWS weggelegd maar voor de specifieke toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgconsultant Humanitas kreeg ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin asked whether a care consultant hired by Humanitas DMH who declared about 95,000 euro for one month's work, and an assistant declaring over 35,000 euro per month, could be curbed under the Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), and whether rules on consultant rates should follow. The minister answered that the case will be enforced under the Wnt, that the consultant's excessive remuneration is not justified, and that a separate bill extending the pay cap to all staff is planned, but declined to set rate limits or provide a registry of such contracts now.
In this case, enforcement will take place in accordance with the law.
In deze casus zal conform de wet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de ex-bestuursvoorzitter van het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis die een exorbitante vergoeding opstreek

An SP MP asked the health minister about the exorbitant severance and salary paid to the former chair of the Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis, its financial distress, dismissal of 160 staff, and insurer Achmea's influence on the board and supervisory board. The minister called the sum a lot of money, said the Wnt now applies, left any clawback to the supervisory board, and defended the Achmea arrangement as giving no control over the hospital, while noting the insurer's nomination rights until 2014.
It is up to the Supervisory Board of the RKZ to possibly start a liability procedure.
Het is aan de Raad van Toezicht van het RKZ om eventueel een aansprakelijkheidsprocedure te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over verzekeraars die werkgevers chanteren om medische gegevens van werknemers door te spelen

An MP asked whether insurers pressuring employers to obtain employees' medical data violate privacy, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges that privacy rules are not always respected in sickness-absence management, calls the practice undesirable, and says the insurers' association will be asked to adjust practices and report on progress, while the CBP is responsible for supervision.
I will ask the VvV to keep me informed of the progress of this, so that such practices are prevented in the future.
Ik zal het VvV vragen mij op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang hiervan, zodat dergelijke uitvoeringspraktijken in de toekomst worden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over de fraude met AGB-codes

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about fraud with AGB provider codes, including reported fake doctors submitting false claims, NZa knowledge, Vektis responsibilities, tribunal suspensions and sanctions. The minister answered that Vektis will periodically check AGB registrations via linked public registers, that NZa is investigating, that suspended practitioners should be blocked, and that sanctions are being reviewed in a December progress report.
Vektis will check the AGB files more often in the short term.
Vektis gaat op korte termijn de AGB bestanden vaker controleren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over valse declaraties door nep-artsen en nep-zorginstellingen door het gebruik van valse artsencodes

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how fraud with fake doctor codes (AGB-codes) in healthcare declarations could occur so widely, whether insurers do enough to check it, and what sanctions and prevention measures are planned. The minister answered that no signals of large-scale fraud are known, announced periodic checks of the AGB register against public registers from November 2013, and described existing sanctions while stating that the insurers' role and sanction powers are not hers to impose.
Vektis, the manager of the AGB registration, will periodically check the files in the short term.
Vektis, de beheerder van de AGB-registratie, gaat op korte termijn de bestanden periodiek controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de inzet van de Koning om de Olympische Spelen naar Nederland te halen

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the King's role in securing his succession on the IOC and in lobbying for the Olympics, and how this fits the coalition agreement's stance against bidding. The minister acknowledged the article, said the IOC decides its own membership with no entitlement to a Dutch seat, that the King's support was a supportive contribution, and that the coalition agreement governs the government's position on hosting.
There is no question of direct succession, because there is no right to a Dutch seat on the IOC.
Van directe opvolging is geen sprake omdat er geen recht bestaat op een Nederlandse zetel in het IOC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het sluiten van de huisartsenpost en het stoppen met kindergeneeskunde en geboortezorg bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the closure of emergency care, paediatrics and maternity care at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the possible relocation of the GP out-of-hours post were acceptable, and how access for patients would be guaranteed. The minister answered that the GP post location is a matter for the doctors, that the hospital cited lack of an IC facility for its decisions, that the Health Inspectorate supervises care quality, and that an extra ambulance is temporarily deployed until a review of drive times is completed.
If at any point it turns out that the preconditions for providing responsible care are not present, the IGZ intervenes.
Als op enig moment blijkt dat de randvoorwaarden om verantwoorde zorg te leveren niet aanwezig zijn grijpt de IGZ in.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de afkoopsom van een ex-bestuurder van het Langeland Ziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister about a severance payment to a former board member of Langeland Ziekenhuis, and whether such payments can be reclaimed or board members held liable. The minister said the supervisory board, not the government, must act, that the Wnt pay cap is in force, and that she has no instrument to recover the payment.
I have no instrument for such an action. It is the supervisory board that could take action in this matter.
Ik heb geen instrument voor een dergelijke actie. Het is de Raad van Toezicht die in dezen tot actie over zou kunnen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat vrouwen niet meer in het ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse kunnen bevallen

The MP Wolbert asks whether the Spijkenisse hospital's end of births in October is justified by RIVM travel-time data, the status of the regional acute-care plan, and whether 24/7 gynaecologist and operating-team cover exists at the remaining hospitals. The Minister says the RIVM models are not the basis for closing the maternity unit, that an extra ambulance was added temporarily with an analysis to follow, that plans are developed by the hospital with insurers in a regional consultation, and that the IGZ supervises safe care, while 24/7 gynaecologist presence is not a required norm.
I will send the conclusions of the research by the RAV and the insurer to your House in due course.
Ik zal de conclusies van het onderzoek van de RAV en de verzekeraar t.z.t. aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat kinderen steeds minder zwemvaardig zijn

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that children are increasingly unable to swim, including questions on school swimming, municipal funding and the former safety-net scheme. The minister replied that swimming ability is primarily a parental responsibility supported by schools and municipalities, that no changes to this division are planned, and that she will not revert to the 2005 decision ending the safety-net scheme.
I endorse the answers to those parliamentary questions and see no reason to make changes to the current division of responsibilities.
Ik schaar me achter de beantwoording van die Kamervragen en zie geen aanleiding aanpassingen te doen in de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ex-baas van Sanquin salaris krijgt doorbetaald

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports that Sanquin's former chair continues to receive salary until March 2014 while the organisation cuts costs and jobs, and whether the minister's earlier statement that he had no bonus or premium entitlement still holds. The minister answered that the payments come from accrued leave and the life-course scheme available to all staff, that the 12,000 euro concerns mandatory employer social charges and pension premiums rather than bonuses, and that the cost-cutting reorganisation is driven by declining blood use.
In Sanquin's annual accounts, the salary, social charges and pension premiums of the board members are specified.
In de jaarrekening van Sanquin worden salaris, sociale lasten en pensioenpremie van de bestuurders gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over langere ambulanceritten vanuit Spijkenisse

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about longer ambulance drive times from Spijkenisse after the emergency department of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital was scaled down, and whether the Inspectorate and GPs are adequately involved. The minister replied that RIVM calculations show the Spijkenisse ED is not crucial for the 45-minute norm, that an extra ambulance is being deployed temporarily, that the insurer and the Inspectorate are responsible for continuity and quality of care, and that GP concerns are handled in regional consultation.
The health insurer, under its duty of care, is responsible for the continuity of critical care and therefore for accessibility.
De zorgverzekeraar is vanuit zijn zorgplicht verantwoordelijk voor de continuïteit van cruciale zorg en daarmee voor de bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over dure SOA-tests

An MP asks the health minister about high prices for STI tests, unnecessary analyses, competition in first-line diagnostics, and the responsibilities of GPs, insurers, labs and the inspectorate. The minister answers that competition is sufficient, that the GP should apply differentiated testing, that insurers are responsible for contracting, and that the inspectorate does not supervise prices.
I have set out my policy on this in the prior-consultation letter on first-line diagnostics of 12 March 2013.
Ik heb mijn beleid daaromtrent verwoord in de voorhangbrief eerstelijnsdiagnostiek van 12 maart 2013
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over eigen betalingen door het preferentiebeleid van Achmea

An MP asked the minister whether an 80-year-old patient had to pay herself for the brand-name drug Plavix under Achmea's preferential policy, despite a claimed medical need, and whether Achmea and the pharmacist acted unlawfully. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, referred the dispute to the SKGZ complaints body, found little evidence of problems across insurers, and said Achmea reported the prescriber judged no medical necessity.
I will not go into the individual case presented because this is apparently a dispute over benefits.
Ik zal niet ingaan op de voorgelegde individuele casus omdat hier kennelijk sprake is van een verstrekkingsgeschil.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dekken en Yücel over het bericht aangaande de handhaving van de antihomowet tijdens de Olympische Spelen van Sotsji in 2014

MPs Dekken and Yücel asked the government whether it would press NOC*NSF and the EU over Russian sports minister statements that the anti-gay law would apply during the Sochi Olympics, and how Dutch athletes would be protected. The government said participants should not be hindered, that the IOC had received written assurances, and that the matter is under ongoing IOC attention, so it saw no reason to instruct NOC*NSF; it also pointed to EU guidelines and a travel advice note.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to call on NOC*NSF to do so.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen reden om het NOC*NSF hiertoe op te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de uitspraken van de Russische minister van Sport

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Russia's anti-gay law would apply to athletes at the Sochi Winter Olympics, whether Russia would guarantee non-interference, and how the Dutch government would act under its human rights note and EU LGBTI guidelines. The government condemned the law as discriminatory, reported the IOC's written guarantee from Russia, and committed to raising the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council and in bilateral contacts.
The Netherlands will continue to press internationally that the anti-gay propaganda law not be applied to participants and visitors during the 2014 Winter Games.
Nederland zal in internationaal verband er op blijven aandringen dat de anti-homopropagandawet tijdens de Winterspelen in 2014 niet op deelnemers en bezoekers wordt toegepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het opgezegde vertrouwen van de ondernemings- en de cliëntenraad in bestuur van Emergis

The SP MP Leijten asked the health minister about the ondernemingsraad and cliëntenraad withdrawing confidence in the Emergis board, including allegations of an intimidating culture, bypassing works council rights, and the role of the supervisory board. Minister Schippers answered that the matter is serious, that the supervisory board commissioned a Berenschot investigation, and that she would send a letter on good governance; she largely declined to judge the board or the supervisory board's conduct.
It is not known to me whether the board deliberately ignored the Works Councils Act.
Het is mij niet bekend of het bestuur bewust de Wet op de ondernemingsraden genegeerd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over bijsluiters bij diergeneesmiddelen

MP Thieme asked the state secretary whether owners buying veterinary medicines receive no package leaflet, and whether leaflets should be mandatory as for human medicines to fight antibiotic resistance. The state secretary replied that leaflets are mandatory and must contain all relevant information, and that a leaflet may only be omitted if the information is already on the packaging, including when medicines are repackaged.
A package leaflet is mandatory and may only be omitted when all relevant information is already on the primary and outer packaging.
Een bijsluiter is verplicht en mag alleen achterwege gelaten worden wanneer alle relevante informatie al op de primaire en op de buitenverpakking is aangebracht.

Vragen van de leden Van Veen en Duisenberg (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap inzake het artikel «Vanaf 2014 loten voor hbo-studie Verpleegkunde aa

MPs Van Veen and Duisenberg asked why the Hanze University introduced a numerus fixus for nursing studies and whether nationwide internship places match future demand. The ministers answered that the number of places is an institutional decision, that shortages are primarily regional, that funding and regional programmes support placements, and that Europe plays no role.
A university of applied sciences may make such decisions itself and is responsible for its own choices.
Een hogeschool mag dit soort beslissingen zelf maken en is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen keuzes.
Antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers verdienen aan geneesmiddelen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether pharmacists receive larger discounts on medicines from wholesalers than they pass on to health insurers, and what should be done. The Minister said she lacks the contracts and discount data to answer, did not know the basis of the press report, and pointed to a sector publication showing falling pharmacy incomes in 2012 and 2013 and noted that insurers' premiums fell.

I cannot answer these questions because I do not have the agreements between pharmacists and pharmaceutical wholesalers, nor the contracts between pharmacists and health insurers containing discount arrangements and their clawback.

Ik kan deze vragen niet beantwoorden omdat ik niet beschik over de afspraken tussen apotheekhoudenden en farmaceutische groothandels en ook niet over de contracten tussen apotheekhoudenden en zorgverzekeraars met afspraken over kortingen en het afromen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de sluiting van een huisartsenpost in Woerden

MP Van Gerven asked the minister whether the Woerden out-of-hours GP post is closing, why, and whether other GP posts face closure. The minister replied that the post stays open evenings and weekends, only the night service moves to Leidsche Rijn for centrality and safety reasons, and that she is aware of no other closures.
There is no question of closing a GP post, as is evident from my answer to question 1.
Er is geen sprake van sluiting van een huisartsenpost, zoals uit mijn antwoord op vraag 1 blijkt.

Interpellatievragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nieuwe aandeelhouders bij het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de gevolgen daarvan voor de continuïteit van het ziekenhui

Leijten (SP) asks the minister whether the Slotervaart hospital is dispensable for continuity of care if it goes bankrupt, and about risks of investor-owner and family ownership changes, including why confidential documents were sent late and why an IGZ governance report was shared only confidentially. Minister Schippers answers that alternative hospitals can take over care, that the NZa and insurers hold the care duty, that she will not ban shareholders in care, and that the documents were sent confidentially because they contain business-sensitive and privacy-sensitive information.
The memo commissioned by the IGZ from the external expert contains, on several points, business-confidential and privacy-sensitive information.
Het memo dat in opdracht van de IGZ door de externe deskundige is opgesteld bevat op verschillende punten bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en privacygevoelige informatie.

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en Kooiman (allen SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van antwoorden op vragen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2013).

MPs from the SP asked why the minister and state secretary of Health did not answer their earlier questions within the three-week deadline and why no postponement was announced. The minister replied that the summer recess and the volume of questions caused the delay, that answers were sent before recess's end or postponement letters were issued, and that all questions have now been answered or postponed.
If it is clear that the three-week deadline will not be met, we send your House a postponement letter.
Indien duidelijk is dat de termijn van 3 weken niet wordt gehaald sturen wij uw Kamer een uitstelbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat boeren in 2012 nog steeds veel antibiotica gebruikten

An MP asked the state secretaries whether farmers' antibiotic use remained high in 2012, why reduction stalled, and about illegal antibiotic use. The government answered that use fell about 15% in 2012 in line with the 70% target, that sectors must tackle structural high users, and that enforcement against illegal trade was intensified.
I agree with the SDa that sectors must above all focus on reducing use in this category of high users.
Ik ben het met de SDa eens dat sectoren zich met name moeten inzetten om het gebruik in deze categorie van veelgebruikers terug te dringen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de berichtgeving inzake de opmars van de gevaarlijke Aziatische tijgermug in Nederland en de lakse aanpak van de overheid

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how the government will respond to press reports that the Asian tiger mosquito is spreading in the Netherlands and that the government is lax in tackling it, including health risks, lessons from Q-fever, whether a voluntary covenant with the tyre industry is ineffective, and whether importers should be required to import mosquito-free goods as Australia does. The minister answered that she had already set out her policy in a June letter, that the measures are proportionate given limited scientific knowledge and uncertainty, that the covenant will be evaluated after summer 2014, and that the goal is protecting public health without committing to mandatory import requirements.
After the summer of 2014 we will evaluate whether the covenant sufficiently prevents the introduction of Asian tiger mosquitoes.
Na de zomer van 2014 zullen wij evalueren of met het convenant de insleep van Aziatische tijgermuggen voldoende wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de massaontslagen in de zorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary of health about mass layoffs across care providers ahead of planned cuts, questioning their consistency with government policy and how quality and workers would be protected. The state secretary replied that employers must respond to changing care demand and that layoff decisions are for employers subject to the preventive dismissal review, while stating the government's aim is sustainable care and that quality oversight remains unchanged.
It is the responsibility of employers to take account of numerous environmental factors and to act on them as well as possible.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om met talloze omgevingsfactoren rekening te houden en daar zo goed mogelijk naar te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat een aan alcohol verslaafde huisarts jarenlang zijn praktijk mag voortzetten van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister why an alcohol-dependent GP was allowed to continue his practice for years despite a court removing him, and why the IGZ inspectorate had not referred him to the College Medisch Toezicht. The minister answered that the IGZ is investigating the GP's functioning and will act if patient safety is at stake, announced new powers for temporary suspension and a sector-wide enforcement framework, and explained the limits of the CMT referral route.
Within disciplinary law I want to create the possibility to immediately suspend a healthcare professional by way of an interim measure.
In het kader van het tuchtrecht wil ik de mogelijkheid creëren om een beroepsbeoefenaar bij wijze van voorlopige voorziening direct te schorsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handelen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg bij een arts met een alcoholprobleem

MP Van Gerven asks how the Inspectorate for Health Care handled reports about a solo GP with an alcohol problem, whether the doctor should continue practising, whether colleagues raised alarms, and how the Inspectorate treats reports of addiction among healthcare workers. The minister answers that the Inspectorate received two reports in 2012, found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has reopened an investigation after new complaints, and will develop norms and an enforcement framework for alcohol and drug misuse, including a power to suspend practitioners provisionally.
The Inspectorate's policy is always to act when a practitioner's conduct, as a result of alcohol or drug misuse, leads to demonstrable patient safety risks.
Het beleid van de IGZ is om altijd op te treden wanneer het handelen van een beroepsbeoefenaar als gevolg van drank- of drugsmisbruik tot aantoonbare patiëntonveiligheid leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over een dronken huisarts

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked whether the Inspectorate should immediately investigate and suspend a doctor who came to work drunk, and about related reporting and disciplinary steps. Minister Schippers said the IGZ investigated in 2012 and found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has now reopened an inquiry after new complaints, plans a legal power for immediate interim suspension, and will work with the sector on alcohol norms and refer to the College van Medisch Toezicht where unfitness is proven.
Within disciplinary law I want to create the possibility to immediately suspend a practitioner by way of interim measure
In het kader van het tuchtrecht wil ik de mogelijkheid creëren om een beroepsbeoefenaar bij wijze van voorlopige voorziening direct te schorsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hoofdbehandelaarschap van orthopedagoog-generalisten en kinder- en jeugdpsychologen
