MP Leijten asked the health minister why orthopedagogen-generalisten and child and youth psychologists were excluded from head-treatment status in mental health care from 2014 (except dyslexia care), and how this fits with professionalisation of youth care. The minister answered that only BIG-registered professionals can be head treaters, grants a temporary exception for these two professions until youth mental health care moves to municipalities, and says the change aligns with the planned professionalisation policy.

I will ask the NZa as soon as possible to include the orthopedagogen-generalist registered with the NVO and the child and youth psychologists registered with the NIP in the limitative list of head treaters

Ik zal de NZa op de kortst mogelijke termijn vragen de orthopedagogen-generalist als geregistreerd bij de NVO en de kinder- en jeugdpsychologen als geregistreerd bij het NIP op te nemen in de limitatieve lijst van hoofdbehandelaars
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘De macht van de tabakslobby, hoe de industrie de winkelier voor haar karretje spant’

An SP MP asked the government for its reaction to a press article on tobacco industry lobbying, including the moral judgement on covertly funded anti-tobacco-prevention campaigns and the FSIT fund linked to the NSO retailers' association, and whether other similar fundraising organisations exist and what will be done to prevent them. The state secretary answered that retailer organisations may freely represent their sector's interests, that other similar bodies may exist, and that they must comply with existing rules such as the tobacco advertising ban, without committing to new action.
It is not for the cabinet to prevent such organisations, which seek to represent the interests of a sector, from being established.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te voorkomen dat dergelijke organisaties, die de belangen van een sector willen vertegenwoordigen, worden opgericht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de ‘beste manier’ om genetische afwijkingen te achterhalen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic abnormalities, including whether the NIPT blood test should be introduced quickly and why Gezondheidsraad advice was delayed. The minister answered that NIPT is promising but must first be shown effective and safe under the Bevolkingsonderzoek law, that advice has been requested, and that a decision will follow promptly after the advice arrives.
Women go abroad on their own initiative to Belgium or Germany. Figures on this are not known to me.
Vrouwen gaan op eigen gelegenheid naar België of Duitsland. Cijfers hierover zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over becherming van persoonsgegevens in digitale patientendossiers

MPs Oosenbrug and Kuzu asked the health and justice ministers about privacy protection in digital patient records after the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found that none of the examined care institutions complied with the Wbp. The minister answered that institutions must improve access controls, that CBP will enforce if breaches continue, that NEN security norms will be made binding via an AMvB, and that IGZ is considering intensifying its supervision.
If the CBP finds that the institutions do not end the violations, the CBP will take enforcement action.
Als het CBP constateert dat de instellingen de overtredingen niet beëindigen, zal het CBP handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgverzekeraar Achmea een omzetgrens hanteert bij het inkopen van zorg

MP Leijten asked the minister whether health insurer Achmea's turnover threshold of 150,000 euros for contracting care providers undermines quality, patient choice and new entrants. The minister replied that insurers bear a duty of care and must contract transparently and non-discriminatorily, that quality and efficiency may justify the threshold, and that no formal opinion is given on individual insurer policy as long as the duty of care is met.

If the purchasing policy fits within the conditions set out in the negotiation results and the requirements mentioned above, it is not for me to give a substantive judgment on the policy Achmea applies.

Als het inkoopbeleid past binnen de randvoorwaarden zoals opgenomen in de onderhandelaarsresultaten en de hiervoor genoemde eisen, is het verder niet aan mij om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over het door Achmea gehanteerde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen zich ernstige zorgen maken over de ontstane situatie na het faillissement van het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about GP concerns over acute care gaps after the bankruptcy of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, the ambulance response times, the sale process and alleged backroom arrangements with insurers and the competition authority. The minister largely deflected: she said acute care coordination belongs to the regional forum, insurers and the NZa/IGZ are responsible, the sale was a curators' decision, and she had no role in the arrangements.
I will not go into what was or was not discussed by others at Saint Paul de Vence.
Ik ga niet in op wat er al dan niet in Saint Paul de Vence door anderen is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de CVA-zorg in het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis acuut is gestopt

An SP MP asked the health minister whether CVA (stroke) care at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital was stopped because the Inspectorate no longer considered it responsible, where stroke patients will go, and whether the new owners and insurers should be held to account for dismantling the care and treating staff badly. The minister answered that the hospital board, in consultation with chain partners, decided to stop acute neurology care because staffing and quality criteria could not be guaranteed, that this was not an Inspectorate decision, that other regional hospitals provide the care, and that no evidence of misuse of bankruptcy law was found.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for the quality of care provided.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht: ouderen slikken teveel of te weinig pillen

An MP asks the health minister about a RIVM report finding that elderly patients are often over- or under-medicated (polypharmacy), poor prescriber and patient communication, and insufficient implementation of guidelines. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the 2012 guideline, planned 2014 financing changes, IGZ supervision, and patient safety agreements, without new binding obligations.
The IGZ will supervise in particular the implementation of periodic medication review based on the guideline.
De IGZ zal gaan toezien op met name de uitvoering van periodieke medicatie-beoordeling op basis van de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over aangepaste lingerie voor vrouwen die een borstamputatie hebben moeten ondergaan

MP Leijten asks whether bras and swimwear adapted for women after breast amputation should be reimbursed from the basic insurance package, and whether their cost creates a barrier. Minister Schippers answers that such items are a common provision that is financially accessible, so they fail the necessity criterion and will not be added to the package.
No, I do not intend to do that.
Nee, dat ben ik niet voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de beste manier om genetische afwijkingen te voorkomen

MPs Arib and Wolbert asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic disorders, including whether Dutch hospitals send blood abroad for the non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) and whether such testing should be allowed meanwhile. The minister said the precise role of hospitals is unknown, that she supports a swift but careful Health Council assessment, and that under the Dutch Population Screening Act testing abroad without a licence is not permitted.
The precise role of the Dutch hospitals is not known to me.
De precieze rol van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Slotervaartziekenhuis in grote financiële problemen verkeert (ingezonden 9 juli 2013).

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reported financial trouble at the Slotervaart hospital, including bank credit cuts, alleged misuse of funds by a former chair, and whether the state would intervene. The minister's follow-up answer says the IGZ commissioned an external legal memo, which cannot be made fully public for confidentiality and privacy reasons, that new facts on ownership were examined without finding new WTZi risks, and that a central shareholder register is being prepared.
On that basis I can inform you that this information cannot be made fully public.
Op basis hiervan kan ik u melden dat deze informatie niet onverkort openbaar kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis behouden blijft

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister of Health about the rescue of LangeLand Hospital in Zoetermeer, covering its future profile, staffing, specialist shareholding, insurer and Vierstroom roles, Vebego's involvement, and comparison with the Ruwaard van Putten bankruptcy. The minister answered that essential emergency and maternity care will remain, that specialist participation is viewed positively, and that the Inspectorate was informed but not involved in the decisions, leaving most details to the hospital and regulators.
The inspectorate was not involved in the decision-making on the structure or the choice of acquiring partner.
De inspectie is niet betrokken geweest bij de besluitvorming over de constructie of de keuze voor een overnamepartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “een arbodienst die medische gegevens doorgegeven heeft aan werkgevers”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act on a privacy regulator finding that an occupational health service and a sickness-absence firm passed unnecessary medical data to employers, and how doctor independence and worker privacy can be guaranteed. The minister says the company's breaches have ended, the regulator will check the occupational health service, and the government awaits SER advice on arbeidsgerelateerde zorg by March 2014 before considering further measures.
I therefore regret that these two companies acted carelessly.
Ik betreur het dan ook dat deze twee bedrijven onzorgvuldig hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zorginstellingen hun eigen vermogens hebben vergroot naar 9 miljard euro

An SP MP asked why care providers grew their own equity to 9 billion euros in 2012 while staff are being dismissed, and whether the government will intervene. The minister answered that the underlying report is not yet available, that equity serves to absorb setbacks and fund investment, and that the government will not intervene or publish a full sector overview.
The report on which the Intrakoop press release is based is not yet available.
Het rapport waarop het persbericht van Intrakoop is gebaseerd, is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het betalen van zorgverzekeringspremie voor Nederlandse gedetineerden in het buitenland

An MP asked why Dutch citizens detained abroad must keep paying health insurance premiums without access to care, and whether suspension was possible, noting debt risks and parents paying for detained children. The minister acknowledged the problem and said a proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw allows suspension of rights and obligations on notification, so exemption from the nominal premium is not needed.
With the proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw, the problem identified has in my view been adequately resolved.
Met het voorstel tot wijziging van artikel 24 van de Zvw is het gesignaleerde probleem naar mijn mening afdoende opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het risico op bloedingen bij het gebruik van nieuwe bloedverdunners

An MP asked the health minister about the bleeding risk of new anticoagulants (dabigatran, rivaroxaban) highlighted in an Erasmus MC study, international concerns, the secret price agreement and follow-up research. The minister answered that the risks were weighed at registration and are monitored, the price agreements run until 2016, and first follow-up results are not expected before 2016.
The agreements with the manufacturers concerned run until 1 January 2016.
De afspraken met de betrokken fabrikanten lopen tot 1 januari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat nieuwe bloedverdunners dodelijke maag-darmbloedingen kunnen veroorzaken

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that new anticoagulants (NOACs) raise the risk of fatal gastrointestinal bleeding, and whether the drugs should be withdrawn. The minister answered that professional guidelines advise caution, that Lareb and the CBG continue to monitor reports (239 reports, 11 deaths, with unclear causality), and that a Dutch study on the indication atrial fibrillation has been started.
This research has already been initiated in cooperation with ZonMw and the relevant professional associations.
Dit onderzoek is al ingezet in samenwerking met ZonMw en de betrokken beroepsverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde verdwijnt in Sittard-Geleen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the planned closure of the obstetrics ward in Sittard-Geleen and its concentration in Heerlen, including accessibility, staff consultation, and the role of insurers. The minister answered that she has no objection as long as quality and accessibility norms are met, and that the hospitals' strategic plan, staff consultation and any new travel-time calculations will be checked by the IGZ and NZa.
As long as the concentration plans meet the quality and accessibility standards, I see no reason to prevent this.
Zolang met de concentratieplannen wordt voldaan aan de normen voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid zie ik geen reden dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht "Arme ouderen laten medicijnen liggen"

Krol (50PLUS) asks whether the minister is aware of reports that poor elderly people leave prescribed medicines at the pharmacy because they cannot pay the co-payment, and whether this poses health risks and undermines equal access to medication. Minister Schippers replies that prescription drugs are almost always available without co-payment, that co-payments apply only exceptionally above reference prices, and that the effects of the own-risk scheme on low incomes will be reviewed after the summer.
After the summer I will inform your House in more detail about how this will be shaped.
Na de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer nader over hoe dit wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht "Kamer te snel leeg bij overlijden"

MP Krol asks the minister whether it is acceptable that some care homes clear a deceased resident's room within one or two days, and what will be done to enforce the seven-day term and inform relatives. The state secretary says the seven-day term is set in general conditions agreed with sector bodies and consumer groups, that undisclosed early clearance wrongs relatives, and that the ministry will raise non-compliance with the sector at regular meetings, without a concrete new measure.
I am of the view that relatives are wronged if a room must be emptied within 7 days without their explicit consent.
Ik ben van mening dat nabestaanden dus onrecht wordt gedaan als een kamer zonder hun expliciete instemming binnen de 7 dagen leeggemaakt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Slotervaartziekenhuis in grote financiële problemen verkeert

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that Slotervaart Hospital faces serious financial problems, including bank credit cuts, debt recall risk, alleged misuse of funds by a former chair, and ministerial contacts. The minister replied that she has no signals of acute financial problems, that hospital governance and financing are the hospital's own responsibility, that the IGZ examined governance, and that she sees no role in a possible bankruptcy because the hospital is not indispensable for crucial care.
It is up to the hospital and to ING Bank themselves to answer these questions.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis en aan de ING Bank zelf om antwoord te geven op deze vragen.
Vragen van het lid Madlener (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Europese Unie verbiedt babyfoto op verpakking babyvoeding» (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

An MP asks whether an EU ban on baby photos on infant formula packaging is correct and why national food matters are regulated by Brussels, questioning what the cabinet will do to stop such EU interference. The minister confirms the rule (extended to follow-on formula by a 2013 regulation, with the ban not covering all baby food), notes Dutch inspections found no such images, and states EU food rules have applied since 1963 for trade and public health, offering no action beyond referring back to that answer.
The ban therefore does not concern all baby food.
Het verbod betreft dus niet alle babyvoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘Laat niet artsen maar rechters oordelen over euthanasieverklaring’

An MP asked the health minister about a proposal to have judges rather than doctors rule on the validity of advance euthanasia declarations for dementia patients, and asked about the number of such cases and a notary-certification proposal. The minister rejected judicial pre-review, said a declaration is already legally valid when dated and signed, opposed notarial certification, and declined to refer the proposal to the working group or consult the judiciary.
I consider it neither sensible nor desirable to involve judges in assessing the validity of the declaration of wishes.
Ik vind het zinvol noch wenselijk rechters te betrekken bij het beoordelen van de geldigheid van de wilsverklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar VGZ de druk op artsen wil opvoeren om vaker te kiezen voor goedkopere medicijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views health insurer VGZ's plan to pressure doctors into prescribing cheaper medicines, whether patients with medical need may lose coverage for brand-name drugs, and whether pharmaceutical marketing to doctors should be curbed. The minister replied that VGZ's preferential policy is legitimate, that brand-name drugs remain covered when medically necessary, and that existing marketing rules and self-regulation are sufficient, so no new measures are announced.
No, that is not the case. Inquiries with VGZ show that since the start of its preferential policy in 2008 it has always covered more expensive brand-name medicines when there is medical necessity.

Nee, daar is geen sprake van. Uit navraag bij VGZ blijkt dat zij vanaf het begin van het preferentiebeleid, in 2008, altijd het beleid heeft gehanteerd duurdere merkmedicijnen te vergoeden als er sprake is van medische noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Agema over gesegregeerde ouderenzorg

MPs Van Klaveren and Agema (PVV) asked whether a care centre for dementia patients organised by cultural background (De Beukelaar, Laurens) is acceptable, how much public money it receives, and whether it should be stopped. The minister said the centre is funded like any AWBZ provider, that cultural background matters for dementia care, that residents mix, and that he will not stop the project.
No, I am not going to do that.
Nee, dat ga ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het misbruiken van Braziliaanse «Moeders voor Moeders» door MSD voor vruchtbaarheidsversnellers voor de bioindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked whether MSD's use of Brazilian women's urine and pregnant mares' blood to produce the fertility drug PG600 for pig farming was misleading, and whether these animal tests should be stopped. The state secretary answered that the women were not properly informed and that the programme has been stopped, that PG600 is a licensed veterinary drug, and that she is investigating whether the horse-blood animal test licence still fits the Animal Testing Act framework.
Exact data on the number of farms using this product and the number of pigs involved are not known.
Exacte gegevens over het aantal bedrijven die dit middel gebruiken en bij hoeveel varkens zijn niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een omstreden neuroloog niet op de zwarte lijst van het BIG-register staat (ingezonden 3 mei 2013).

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether a neurologist judged unfit by a UK regulator is on the Dutch BIG register's blacklist, whether the UK ban applies in the Netherlands, and the status of bilateral agreements with Britain. The minister replied that UK restrictions applied only from 2007 to 2011 and had expired before the 2012 rule change allowing foreign restrictions to be recorded in the Netherlands, so there was no basis to record them.
Since 1 July 2012, under Article 9 of the BIG Act, restrictions on practice imposed abroad on holders of a Dutch diploma can be recorded in the Netherlands.
Sinds 1 juli 2012 kunnen op grond van artikel 9 van Wet BIG bevoegdheidsbeperkingen die in het buitenland zijn opgelegd aan houders van een Nederlands diploma, in Nederland worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over de beschikbaarheid van het Q-koorts medicijn doxycycline

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister about the nationwide shortage of the antibiotic doxycycline, which chronic Q-fever patients depend on, and whether supply is restored. The minister confirmed the shortage, explained supply chain causes, reported partial availability from some suppliers, and pointed to a general plan on medicine shortages without a specific patient-level commitment.
My ambition is therefore, where possible, to address medicine shortages through joint efforts of all parties involved.
Mijn ambitie is dan ook daar waar mogelijk geneesmiddelentekorten aan te pakken door een gezamenlijke inspanning van alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over ‘vechtscheidingen’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the health ministry about rising 'high-conflict divorces', the sources behind claims about their outcomes, research on relationship support and parenting plans, registration of such cases, and whether divorce costs should be studied. The state secretary replies that no rising trend is established, points to ZonMw-funded research and WODC studies on parenting plans, declines to create a statistical definition or register, and says the cost study would not establish causation.
The Ministry of VWS has instructed ZonMw to include 'divorce' as a priority theme within the programme.
Het ministerie van VWS heeft ZonMw opdracht gegeven om «echtscheiding» als prioritair thema binnen het programma op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat huisartsen melden dat patiënten aangeven geen geld te hebben voor medicijnen of vervolgbehandelingen

An MP asked the minister whether patients are avoiding medicines, follow-up treatment or operations because of the forced deductible (eigen risico), including misconceptions that GP visits fall under it. The minister answered that the ongoing research will examine these issues, that the deductible is compensated via the healthcare allowance for low incomes, and that misunderstandings should be corrected.
The research I am having conducted will provide more insight into whether insured persons may refrain from or postpone operations or follow-up treatment, and what the reasons for this are.
Het onderzoek dat ik laat doen, zal meer inzicht geven in de vraag of verzekerden mogelijk afzien van operaties of vervolgbehandelingen of deze uitstellen, en wat daarvan de reden is.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een tandarts die in Duitsland uit zijn ambt is gezet in Den Haag een spoor van

An SP MP asked the health and justice ministers about a dentist removed from practice in Germany who was still registered in the Netherlands and allegedly caused harm and billing fraud. The minister replied that foreign restrictions were not in force at registration, that the IGZ has imposed a ban on practising, and that the OM declined a criminal investigation into billing fraud.
It is not known how many people have been harmed by this dentist's irresponsible medical treatment.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel mensen gedupeerd zijn door onverantwoord medisch handelen van deze tandarts.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over resistente schimmel bij patiënten en in huizen als gevolg van landbouwgif (ingezo

An MP asks the health minister and state secretary whether an azole-resistant Aspergillus fungus spreading in homes and patients is linked to agricultural fungicides, and what is being done. The minister answers that a causal link is not proven but not excluded, that a referral laboratory and a Royal HaskoningDHV study on biocides are under way, and that the Ctgb can withdraw approvals only on new scientific evidence.
It is still unclear where the cause of the resistance lies; it may be in agriculture, but also outside it.
Het is nog onduidelijk waar de oorzaak van de resistentie ligt, dat kan in de landbouw zijn, maar ook er buiten.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Resistente schimmel verspreidt zich» (ingezonde

Two MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that resistant Aspergillus fungi are spreading, possibly linked to azole fungicides used in pesticides and biocides. The minister acknowledged a possible link, said the risk is limited to high-risk patients, pointed to a reference laboratory and a ministry-commissioned study due in summer 2013, and did not commit to new measures.
The risk to public health is limited to certain risk groups that are especially susceptible to infections.
Het risico voor de volksgezondheid beperkt zich tot bepaalde risicogroepen die in verhoogde mate vatbaar zijn voor infecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over medische beslissingen rond het levenseinde bij pasgeborenen met zeer ernstige afwijkingen

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the health minister about the KNMG position on end-of-life decisions for newborns with severe anomalies, including the omission of prior research, spina bifida controversy, the role of neurosurgeons, pre-approval review, and the reliability of 'suffering' as a criterion. Minister Schippers answered that the position fills a need for clarity, that decisions are reviewed afterwards rather than in advance, and that the regulatory framework evaluation is expected in autumn.
After it is sent to your House, I will send your House a position giving the cabinet's view on the Regulation.
Na toezending aan uw Kamer zal ik uw Kamer een standpunt doen toekomen waarin ik de kabinetsvisie zal geven op de Regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vr Van Dekken en Kuzu over het duurder worden van sportbeoefening

Two PvdA MPs asked whether rising sports fees threaten children's and low-income participation in sport and what the government will do. The minister says local authorities are primarily responsible, points to the Sport en Bewegen in de Buurt programme, Sportimpuls, Jeugdsportfonds funding and poverty-policy funds, and commits to discussions with VNG and the Jeugdsportfonds.
Encouraging sport and exercise is primarily a local responsibility.
Het stimuleren van sporten en bewegen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat een Spaanse vruchtbaarheidskliniek Nederlandse paren met een kinderwens werft voor een vruchtbaarheidsbehandeling met anonieme eiceldonatie in Spanje

An MP asks the health minister about a Spanish fertility clinic that recruits Dutch couples for anonymous egg donation in Spain, including its Dutch information point, a genetic carrier test marketed at €400, sponsorship of patient group Freya, and whether Dutch rules are circumvented. The minister answers that the Dutch information point is lawful, that Dutch gynaecologists' cooperation is disapproved, that anonymous donation is not permitted in the Netherlands, that EU-level action is not appropriate, and that she will inform parliament on oversight of health information.
Fertility treatments with anonymous egg donors are not permitted in the Netherlands.
Vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen met anonieme eiceldonoren zijn in Nederland niet toegelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen vrezen voor hun baan

An MP asked the health ministers whether nurses are worried about their jobs, why unemployment among nurses rose, what the vacancy situation is, and whether matching problems exist. The government acknowledged the reports, described a small rise in job seekers as a normal fluctuation, cited falling vacancy rates, and said it had seen no signals of matching problems, promising to review a sector survey after the summer.
We have no data available on the number of open vacancies for nurses.
We hebben geen data voorhanden over het aantal openstaande vacatures voor verpleegkundigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de komst van een mega-melkveebedrijf in Oploo

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the health minister about a mega dairy farm in Oploo, the public health risks flagged by the GGD report, and whether further Health Council research is needed. The government replied that the municipality has taken the GGD's recommendations into account, adopted a stricter odour distance norm and a monitoring system, and commissioned a 3.4 million euro RIVM study on health effects of livestock farming.
As indicated in the letter of 14 June to your House, I have commissioned additional research into the quantitative health effects of livestock farming
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 14 juni jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik opdracht gegeven voor het uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek naar de kwantitatieve gezondheidseffecten van veehouderijen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Intensieve veehouderij in Achtkarspelen: een bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid’

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Health about public health concerns over intensive livestock farming in Achtkarspelen, including fine dust, odour, and municipal expansion despite provincial policy. The government said responsibility for expansion lies with the local authority, pointed to the restrictive national policy and provincial interim rules, and committed to a new RIVM study and a possible knowledge platform.
Responsibility for decisions on any expansion lies with the local competent authority.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor beslissingen aangaande de eventuele uitbreiding ligt bij het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Seksuele intimidatie co-assistenten”

An MP asked the health minister about reports of sexual intimidation of medical co-assistants, whether existing confidential advisers are used, and what sanctions hospitals can impose on staff. The minister said such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to CAO rules, hospital disciplinary regulations and an action plan, and offered to monitor the problem.
I am willing to monitor sexual intimidation of healthcare workers.
Ik ben bereid seksuele intimidatie van zorgverleners te monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een kwart van vrouwelijke co-assistenten seksueel wordt geïntimideerd

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that a quarter of female medical trainees (co-assistenten) face sexual intimidation, and why few report it. The minister says such intimidation is unacceptable, points to hospital CAO rules, sector action plans and a planned NFU review, and says the data on other training tracks are not available.
We do not have this information.
Wij beschikken niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Fraude voedsel niet gemeld”

An MP asked whether food fraud is rarely reported to the NVWA, how it will monitor fraud, whether budget cuts reduce inspections, when the traffic-light disclosure model will publish inspection results, and whether shops and producers will be publicly rated. The government referred to its earlier reaction, said inspections are risk-based and the strategy will be revised, that a disclosure pilot starts in autumn with broader rollout after the Health Act amendment, and that the NVWA can set its own priorities.
Based on the experience with food fraud, the NVWA will revise its supervision strategy.
Op grond van de ervaringen met de voedselfraude zal de NVWA de toezichtstrategie gaan herzien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over het artikel ‘screen op resistente bacteriën’

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister whether the Netherlands is sufficiently prepared against emerging resistant bacteria, including ESBL-like ones such as Oxa-48, NDM-1 and KPC, and about periodic screening and new antibiotic development. The minister replied that antibiotic resistance is a government priority, referred to a letter of 2 July 2013 on the policy, and announced expanded surveillance including nationwide ISIS-AR and a molecular monitoring system.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat een heftige tripdrug vrij verkrijgbaar is

An MP asked whether the government would ban Salvia divinorum, given expert warnings about its dangers, and whether long-term health research would be done. The state secretary answered that the risks are low, the user base is very small, and a ban is not desirable, so no research is planned.
Given the limited risks to public health and the fact that a ban could push sales into other, illegal channels, I do not consider a ban desirable.

Gezien de beperkte risico's voor de volksgezondheid en het feit dat een verbod er mogelijk toe zou kunnen leiden dat de verkoop zich via andere, illegale kanalen gaat afspelen, acht ik een verbod niet wenselijk.
Antwoord vragen Klever over de stortvloed aan operatiefouten

An MP asks the minister how she will tighten supervision of surgical teams after reports of procedural failures and unrecorded errors, and whether providers should pay for corrective care. The minister says the inspectorate will make unannounced visits to 20 hospitals, prosecute wrong-site surgery cases before the disciplinary court, and that providers should pay for care caused by negligence.
The inspectorate will make unannounced visits to the operating departments of 20 hospitals in 2013.
Zo bezoekt de inspectie in 2013 onaangekondigd de operatieafdelingen van 20 ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht “inactiviteit bij kinderen”

PvdA MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the health minister about a TV report on child inactivity, its long-term effects, the performance of sports coaches, and investment in physical education from the PvdA Topsport action plan. The minister acknowledged the concern, said evaluation of sports coaches is still ongoing with results expected end 2013, and pointed to existing programmes and the coalition agreement's ambition for more gym lessons, with OCW to report later.

Given the recent change and the ongoing research, I consider it too early to speak about adjusting the current scheme or to judge the performance of combination officers and neighbourhood sports coaches.

Gezien de recente wijziging en het lopende onderzoek acht ik het daarom te vroeg om te spreken over een aanpassing van de huidige regeling en om te oordelen over de prestaties van combinatiefunctionarissen en buurtsportcoaches.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot over de vraag “Wie controleert de dokter”?

MPs Bruins Slot and Bouwmeester asked the health minister whether patients in disciplinary proceedings against doctors should receive more support, such as IGZ assistance, the ability to amend complaints during hearings, and a reversed burden of proof. The minister said IGZ will not represent patients, that a new Zorgloket will guide complainants, that she will examine amending complaints within the Wet BIG, and that the Wkkgz will make incident documentation mandatory, shifting the burden of proof indirectly.
I support the idea behind this and will examine the proposals further in the context of amending disciplinary law in the Wet BIG.
Ik steun de gedachte hier achter en zal de voorstellen nader onderzoeken in het kader van de aanpassing van het tuchtrecht in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Heijnen over de vertrekregelingen van enkele bestuurders in de gezondheidszorg

MPs Van Dijk and Heijnen (PvdA) asked about severance arrangements for hospital executives, including a VUmc executive's pay and whether the WNT top-income cap and transitional rules allow loopholes such as special leave, advisory roles and salary top-ups. The minister replied that the reported figures were incorrect, that the supervisory board is the employer and no rules were judged broken, that the EUR 75,000 cap applies with a four-year transitional regime for pre-2013 agreements, and that top-ups depend on circumstances while paid special leave without work is not allowed.
Articles 2.10 and 3.7 of the WNT prohibit employers in the public and semi-public sector from agreeing a severance arrangement with a top official exceeding EUR 75,000.
In artikel 2.10 en 3.7 Wnt wordt het werkgevers in de publieke en semipublieke sector verboden een vertrekregeling met een topfunctionaris overeen te komen die hoger is dan € 75.000.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de vertrokken bestuursvoorzitter van het VUmc 700.000 euro kreeg voor nog geen acht maanden werk

An MP asks the health minister how she views the 700,000 euro payout to the departed VUmc chairman of the executive board after less than eight months, the 433,107 euro departure bonus, the supervisory board's role, and sector culture on pay. The minister refers to earlier answers, says the board was bound by the 1999 contract terms, and notes the Wnt norm and that a court-formula payout could have been higher.
The current Supervisory Board is bound to honour the agreements the previous Supervisory Board made when the director was hired in 1999.
De huidige Raad van Toezicht is gehouden de afspraken na te komen die de toenmalige Raad van Toezicht is aangegaan bij de indiensttreding van de bestuurder in 1999.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen die geriatrische revalidatiezorg nodig hebben tussen wal en schip vallen

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister of Health about reports that elderly patients needing geriatric rehabilitation fall between stools since its transfer to the Health Insurance Act, including the requirement of prior hospital admission and unclear referrals. Minister Schippers acknowledges signals, says the rules are not meant to leave patients out, commits to talks with the sector, a standard for care pathways and a CVZ advice, but declines to provide figures on affected patients, long hospital stays or AWBZ placements.
I have no figures on this and I do not see it as my task to collect these figures.
Hierover zijn mij geen cijfers bekend en ik zie het niet als mijn taak om deze cijfers te gaan verzamelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, Jacobi en Wolbert over het bericht dat bij 44% van de Europeanen glyfosaat in de urine zit

MPs Dikkers, Jacobi and Wolbert asked the health and economic affairs ministers about a German study finding glyphosate in the urine of 44% of Europeans, including whether the NVWA tests crops and what risk applies. The minister answered that the RIVM sees no health risk at these microgram levels, that the NVWA tests grains with no MRL exceedances, and that glyphosate is under EU re-evaluation which will be followed closely.
Because the RIVM currently has no indication that the glyphosate levels found in urine give cause for concern, there is no reason to inquire with neighbouring countries about such research.

Omdat het RIVM op dit moment geen aanwijzingen heeft dat de gevonden glyfosaatwaarden in de urine reden tot zorg geven, is er geen aanleiding om bij de omringende landen te informeren naar dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat het aantal ziekenhuizen dat een vordering neerlegt op het tijdelijke vangnet het aantal betalers fors overstijgt

Leijten (SP) asked the health minister how it is possible that more hospitals claim transition payments from the safety-net scheme than pay into it, and whether fraud, cost overruns, financial distress or premium increases can be ruled out. Minister Schippers answered that all transition claims are still to be filed and assessed by the NZa, so no outcomes can yet be stated, and that any overrun would be discussed with the parties in 2014.
All of this means that at present nothing can yet be said about the final amount of the transition payments to be settled, which institutions will receive money and which will have to pay.

Dit alles betekent dat er op dit moment nog niets is te zeggen over de uiteindelijke hoogte van de te verrekenen transitiebedragen, welke instellingen geld zullen ontvangen en welke geld zullen moeten afdragen.
Antwoord vragen Otwin Van Dijk en Wolbert over het bericht “Megaclaims ziekenhuizen bij overheid”

Two Labour MPs asked the health minister about hospital claims for transition payments worth around 300 million euros against roughly 90 million in reported debts, and about the effect on 2014 premiums, possible fraud and the follow-up to a report on transition-model abuse. The minister said no formal applications had yet been submitted so no overview exists, that insurers' central team is assessing applications and will replace estimates with verifiable figures, and that a first insight is expected by year-end.
I therefore have no overview available and cannot anticipate the outcomes of this process.
Ik heb dus geen overzicht beschikbaar en ik kan niet vooruit lopen op de uitkomsten van dit proces.
Antwoord vragen Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat honderden huisartsen gedwongen onveilige software gebruiken

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that hundreds of GP practices were forced to use insecure Java software, risking patient records and data protection. The minister answered that the vendor Promedico had delayed a security patch only for practices using UZI cards, that the fix was released on 3 June, that responsibility for data security lies with care providers and vendors, and that a stricter security norm (NEN 7510) will be referenced by decree.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de exorbitante ontslagvergoedingen aan bestuurders in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about large severance payments to former healthcare executives, including a EUR 200,000 payout at Medisch Centrum Haaglanden and EUR 650,000 at UMC Radboud. The minister said the Wnt pay cap took effect on 1 January 2013 with a EUR 75,000 norm for severance, that the earlier cases predate it, and that the government will tighten the Wnt as set out in the coalition agreement, while rejecting the demand for retroactive clawback as legally unworkable.
The intentions regarding tightening the WNT are included in the coalition agreement.
De voornemens ten aanzien van de aanscherping van de WNT zijn in het regeerakkoord opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Klever over de vertrekbonus van de bestuursvoorzitter VUmc (VUmedisch centrum)

An MP asks the health minister about a four-million-euro departure bonus paid to the VUmc board chair despite Inspectorate concerns about patient safety, and whether it can be reclaimed and how wanbestuurders can be held accountable. The minister answers that the bonus was agreed in 1999 and paid under pre-Wnt rules, that no legal basis exists for reclaiming it, and that she plans a duty for supervisory boards to vet directors, a verklaring omtrent het gedrag, and personal liability for supervisors.
I therefore intend to explicitly impose a duty on supervisory boards to satisfy themselves that they appoint a capable director.
Ik ben daarom van plan de toezichthouders nadrukkelijk een plicht op te leggen om zich ervan te vergewissen dat zij een bestuurder aanstellen die capabel is.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Achmea Health Center adverteert met tien kilo afvallen in tien weken

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Achmea Health Center's advertising of a ten-kilo, ten-week weight-loss programme is misleading, and about the financial ties and discounts between insurer Achmea and AHC. Minister Schippers replied that insurers may pursue such side activities, saw no reason to label the programme unhealthy or misleading, and saw no problem with the ownership link, the 20% discount for Achmea insured, or the advertising costs.
Insurers are free to pursue this kind of side activity and promote it publicly.
Het staat verzekeraars vrij dit soort nevenactiviteiten te ontplooien en publiekelijk aan te prijzen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Van Dekken over het bericht dat weidegang niet noodzakelijk is voor weidepremie

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked whether cow grazing is required for the grazing premium and whether the term 'weidemelk' is misleading, and asked for definitions of sustainability labels. The state secretary replied that weidemelk requires grazing (at least 120 days, 6 hours a day), that existing Warenwet rules on misleading labelling suffice, and that no further conditions or talks with companies are needed.
The term 'weidemelk' applies only to milk from cows that actually get grazing, and in practice this is the case.
De term «weidemelk» geldt alleen voor melk van koeien die daadwerkelijk weidegang krijgen, dat is in de praktijk ook het geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het belastingtarief voor alternatieve genezers

Van Gerven (SP) asks how alternative healers such as magnetisers can be VAT-exempt like psychologists under EU and Dutch law, given no equivalent training or effectiveness proof, and whether the law should be tightened. The state secretary answers that the exemption is limited to GZ-psychologists from 2013, that the court's reading is too broad so cassation was filed, and that EU case law requires equal treatment of competing services.
In my view this is too broad an interpretation of the term 'services of a psychologist' in the exemption provision. I have therefore lodged cassation against this ruling.
Dit is naar mijn oordeel een te ruime uitleg van het begrip «diensten van een psycholoog» als bedoeld in de vrijstellingsbepaling. Daarom heb ik dan ook cassatie ingesteld tegen deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat CZ vier privéklinieken heeft aangewezen voor ooglidcorrecties

MP Leijten asked the minister whether insurer CZ's selective contracting of four private clinics for eyelid corrections, mostly not covered by the basic insurance, undermines free choice of doctor and creates financial incentives to reject medical necessity. The minister replied that these corrections largely fall outside the Zvw and that insurers may contract selectively, declining to comment on motives and tariffs and stating the complex cases are handled elsewhere.
Eyelid corrections, except in the rare cases of congenital eye abnormalities, are not covered by the Health Insurance Act (Zvw).
Ooglidcorrecties vallen, behoudens in de zeldzame gevallen van aangeboren oogafwijkingen, niet onder de dekking van de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw).

Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een omstreden neuroloog niet op de zwarte lijst van het BIG-register staat (ingezonden 3 mei 2013).

An MP asked the health minister whether a British ban on a controversial neurologist applies in the Netherlands, and why he is not on the BIG register's blacklist. The minister said conditional restrictions can be recorded but the UK deregistration was administrative, and that clarity on recording would follow within three weeks, and described new bilateral data exchange with the UK.
Currently it is being examined whether the competence-restricting conditions imposed on the controversial neurologist in the UK at the time must be recorded in the BIG register.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht of de bevoegdheidsbeperkende voorwaarden die destijds in het VK aan de omstreden neuroloog zijn opgelegd, in het BIG-register moeten worden aangetekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Dekken over de handelwijze van de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in de zaak Selten

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked about the NVWA's handling of the Selten meat case, including mislabelling of horse meat as beef, destruction of beef stock, delayed notification after a contaminated horse import, and the EU horse passport system. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, explained labelling rules and the basis for recalling unverifiable meat, and withheld the names of buyers citing privacy law.
In general, and also in this case, we refrain from answering questions about ongoing criminal cases or claims by suspects in ongoing criminal cases.
In het algemeen en ook in deze casus onthouden wij ons van beantwoording van vragen over lopende strafzaken dan wel beweringen van verdachten in lopende strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat borstkankerkliniek Monro niet voor risicopatiënten is

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Alexander Monro breast cancer clinic is not suited to high-risk patients, including whether it meets guidelines, its use of a Zelfstandig Behandel Centrum model without intensive care, its self-description as a centre of excellence, and patient information. The minister answered that the IGZ supervises the clinic, planned inspections, listed the specialists and regional arrangements, and declined to commission further research, while the clinic's self-chosen labels are not regulated.
It is primarily the responsibility of a healthcare institution itself to comply with the guidelines for responsible care.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling zelf om aan de richtlijnen voor verantwoorde zorg te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gegeven dat vrouwen in achterstandswijken nog steeds geen gelijkwaardige perinatale zorg krijgen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether she knows the latest EURO-PERISTAT findings and what concrete steps will narrow perinatal mortality gaps for women in disadvantaged neighbourhoods. Minister Schippers acknowledges the concern, cites the ErasmusMC 'Healthy Pregnancy 4 All' project and CPZ activities, and points to results only expected in 2014 and later.
That does not detract from the fact that I agree with you that perinatal mortality in disadvantaged situations is a point of concern.
Dat laat overigens onverlet dat ik het met u eens ben dat de perinatale sterfte in achterstandssituaties een punt van zorg is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Orde van Medisch Specialisten vindt dat patiënten moeten meebetalen aan een second opinion

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the second opinion should remain covered in the basic insurance package and whether patients should co-pay, after the Medical Specialists' Association suggested patients pay. The minister declined to commit before a decision in spring 2014, said suggestions from parties are being collected and tested by the CVZ, and gave no figures on savings or outcomes.
I do not want to anticipate that decision-making, because I want to base my decision on all advice and suggestions available at that time.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op die besluitvorming, omdat ik mijn beslissing wil baseren op alle adviezen en suggesties die op dat moment voorliggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ophef over vergoeding zorgdirecteur’

MPs Heijnen and Van Dijk asked whether a former Cordaan director received a 300,000 euro severance payment despite already having a new job, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the contractual severance (about 3 million, rounded) was legally binding, that the director has agreed to repay just over two months' salary, and that no legal basis exists to reclaim the full amount since the WNT did not apply at the time; the full scheme will not be disclosed.
This arrangement is an arrangement between employer and employee and as such is not public, not even for VWS.
Deze regeling is een regeling tussen werkgever en werknemer en als zodanig niet openbaar, ook niet voor VWS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een opgestapt lid van het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) forse kritiek uit op ‘de perversies van het  systeem’

An MP asked the health minister to respond to criticism by a departed CBG (medicines assessment board) member of the system's perversions, conflicts of interest with industry, and the lack of transparency. The minister answered that the board is independent, defended the rules on member interests and lengthy tenure, said attempted industry influence was reported only once, and promised to look into that incident and report to parliament.
Attempts at influence by pharmaceutical companies must be reported to the chair.
Pogingen tot beïnvloeding door farmaceutische bedrijven moeten worden gemeld bij de voorzitter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het beoordelingssysteem voor geneesmiddelen niet bevorderlijk is voor de volksgezondheid

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister of Health about radio claims that the drug approval system is not conducive to public health, including the burden of additional research and leaks of advisory information. Minister Schippers answered that few truly new drugs have reached the market, that no single cause can be identified, that the regulator CBG requests additional studies when needed, and that the Escher project examines barriers to drug innovation.
However, I see it as my task to constantly and critically examine the necessity and usefulness of new rules.
Wel zie ik het als opdracht om nut en noodzaak van nieuwe regels constant en kritisch te bezien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het terugdringen van de administratieve druk voor verpleegkundigen in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about nurses in Dutch hospitals being burdened by computer-based administrative tasks and whether this should be reduced. The minister acknowledged the burden, said reducing government-imposed administrative load is a top priority, but argued that much of the data collection is necessary for quality of care and can only be simplified rather than dropped.
As far as government-imposed administrative burdens are concerned, it is clear: it is a top priority for me to minimise these.
Voor zover het de door de overheid opgelegde administratieve lasten betreft is het helder: het is voor mij een topprioriteit om deze tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt  over het falende Nederlandse anti-dopingbeleid

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about reports that Dutch anti-doping policy is failing, including claims of a doubling of doping laboratories, online doping sales and cross-border cooperation with Belgium. The government answered that the picture is not recognised by the IGZ and the OM, outlined existing EU and national cooperation, announced an inter-ministerial consultation and a symposium, and said it sees no need to revise sports self-regulation for now.
The picture sketched in the broadcast is not recognised by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het in de uitzending geschetste beeld wordt door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het openbaar ministerie (OM) niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over dopingdealers

An MP asked ministers about doping dealers, including the risks of doping use, illegal laboratories, cooperation with Belgian and German authorities, and why doping use itself is not criminal. The ministers answered that enforcement is shared among several agencies, that the three IGZ investigations led to one conviction and two dismissals, and that doping use is a sporting rule rather than a crime, so the government focuses on prevention.
Whether this is mostly the case is not known to the OM.
Of dit veelal het geval is, is het OM niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over opsporing van dopinghandel

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about the investigation of doping trade, including illegal laboratories, online sales, cooperation with Belgium and with police, prosecution, customs and the Dutch Doping Authority, plus the estimated 160,000 doping users and a 2005 internal report. The government referred to earlier answers, said the Doping Authority has no investigative task, confirmed the 2009 prevalence study, and declined to publish the 2005 internal note because it was not a final product.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van mestvergisters voor de volksgezondheid

MP Ouwehand asked whether manure digesters pose public health risks, citing a 2012 biogas leak in Coevorden that forced evacuations, and whether local permitting and oversight are adequate and whether national rules or a construction stop are needed. The government answered that the RIVM risk assessment was sound, that the permit and enforcement questions are for the competent local authority and that it has no information on the Coevorden permit, and that it will evaluate co-digestion policy in two years but sees no need for a construction stop.
I have no insight into the permit for the digester in Coevorden and its enforcement by the competent authority.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de vergunning voor de vergister in Coevorden en de handhaving daarvan door het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de coöperatie Laatste Wil

An MP asked the health minister about the newly founded cooperative Laatste Wil, which plans to distribute lethal means for assisted dying, and whether this conflicts with the criminal ban on providing means for suicide. The minister answered that the cooperative says it will work within legal limits, that its activities do not currently fall under article 294 of the Criminal Code, and that no changes to coroner procedures or prosecution guidelines are needed.
I do not share that concern, since the cooperative explicitly states that it wants to work within the framework of the law.
Ik deel die zorg niet, aangezien de coöperatie expliciet aangeeft binnen de kaders van de wet te willen werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen inspringen op cardiologische groeimarkt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether hospitals expanding into cardiology, and the rising number of ICD implantations, reflect financially driven overtreatment and what the government will do about it. The minister denied that financial motives drive ICD placement, cited a broader indication and more replacements as causes, and pointed to insurers' selective purchasing and a planned national study rather than new rules.
The suggestion in your questions that centres place implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) for financial motives is not something I recognise.
De suggestie die in uw vragen gewekt wordt, dat centra implanteerbare cardioverter defibrillatoren (ICD's) zouden plaatsen omwille van financiële motieven, herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat criminelen in toenemende mate APAAN gebruiken als grondstof voor de productie van synthetische harddrugs

MP Oskam asked ministers whether criminals increasingly use APAAN as a precursor for synthetic hard drugs, and why it is not listed under the Dutch precursor law or the EU registered-substances list. The government confirmed rising seizures and conversion labs, explained that the Den Bosch ruling concerned precursor registration rather than drug status, said the appeal was partially withdrawn pending EU Court preliminary questions, and declined to ban APAAN under the Opium Act because it is not a psychoactive drug.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has argued at EU level that APAAN should be placed on the list of registered substances.
Verder heeft Nederland in EU verband bepleit dat APAAN op de lijst met geregistreerde stoffen komt te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp en de Intensive Care in het Diaconessenhuis te Meppel

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency department and intensive care unit of the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel might close, and whether this was linked to the Isala/Noorderboog merger. The minister answered that the hospital board says no closure is planned and no dismissals will occur, while acknowledging ongoing talks with insurers about acute care and deferring any future reorganisation to the regional insurers and ROAZ.
As indicated in answers 2, 3 and 4, according to the Board of Directors there is currently no question of the SEH and IC of the Diaconessenhuis disappearing.
Zoals in vraag 2, 3 en 4 aangegeven is er op dit moment volgens de Raad van Bestuur geen sprake van het verdwijnen van de SEH en IC van het Diaconessenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de toekomst  van de spoedeisende hulp in Meppel

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency department in Meppel might move to Zwolle, and what that would mean for acute care access and norms in the region. The minister said there is no plan to move the emergency department, that talks with insurers on regional acute care are ongoing, and that any future changes would have to keep access guaranteed through the regional acute care consultation.
As indicated in question 2, there is currently no question of the emergency department in Meppel disappearing.
Zoals in vraag 2 aangegeven is er op dit moment geen sprake van het verdwijnen van de Spoedeisende Hulp uit Meppel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Frankrijk de Diane-35 en generieke vormen van de markt heeft gehaald ondanks de uitspraak van het Europese Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC)

An SP MP asked the Health Minister why France withdrew Diane-35 and generics despite the EMA PRAC recommending they stay available under conditions, and whether the Netherlands would follow or push for a ban. The minister replied that national risk assessments are independent, that the EU emergency procedure is not yet concluded, that the CBG represents the Netherlands and the CMDh recommended keeping the drug on the market, and that she will not pre-empt the European decision.
Leaving aside that I am not competent to withdraw marketing authorisations – the Netherlands deliberately left the authorisation and withdrawal of medicines to the independent CBG

Nog daargelaten dat ik niet bevoegd ben om handelsvergunningen in te trekken – in Nederland is er bewust voor gekozen om de toelating en het uit de handel nemen van geneesmiddelen over te laten aan het onafhankelijke CBG
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asked the health minister about euthanasia for patients with dementia, including the status of written euthanasia declarations, whether the Euthanasia Act or the prosecution guideline should be amended, and whether physicians must communicate with patients. The minister said a working group will seek clarity on written declarations but declined to amend the Act or guideline, and the questions were not answered before the scheduled debate.
Together with those present at the consultation, I decided to have a working group including VWS, V&J and KNMG take up this issue quickly.
Ik heb samen met de aanwezigen bij het overleg besloten om een werkgroep van onder meer VWS, V&J en KNMG dit vraagstuk snel verder te laten oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor de volksgezondheid

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked whether an Australian study linking parental pesticide exposure in pregnancy to childhood brain tumours applies in the Netherlands, and whether imidacloprid and similar products should be withdrawn. Minister Schippers answered that RIVM and Ctgb see no evidence of tumour formation from authorised pesticides, that the study cannot establish causation or the substances involved, and that no fixed measures or deadlines can be set in advance for new scientific findings.
The Ctgb and RIVM concluded that for pesticides authorised in the Netherlands there are so far no indications that these agents lead to tumour formation in the brain.
Het Ctgb en het RIVM hebben geconcludeerd dat voor bestrijdingsmiddelen die in Nederland zijn toegelaten vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen zijn dat deze middelen leiden tot tumorvorming in de hersenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Almere nieuwe schaatscentrum’

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Almere would host a new national speed-skating centre, questioning KNSB's commitment to Thialf and the selection criteria. The minister replied that the ministry is not involved in choosing among the three bids, that the KNSB and NOC*NSF make the decision on 15 August 2013, and that she will not intervene.
The Ministry of VWS is not involved in the assessment and choice among the three initiatives.
Het ministerie van VWS is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling en keuze voor één van de drie initiatieven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het doden van zwerfdieren in Sotsji

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that Sochi was removing stray animals before the 2014 Winter Olympics, including whether poison had been used and whether the minister would raise it with foreign counterparts. The minister answered that the matter is for Russian authorities, that animals should be killed humanely if necessary, and that she sees no need to contact foreign colleagues.
It is up to the Russian authorities themselves to determine how the problem of stray animals is tackled.
Het is daarbij aan de Russische autoriteiten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze het probleem van zwerfdieren wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Toezichthouder zorg is mislukt”

An MP asks the health minister about a newspaper article and a PhD thesis claiming the Dutch health care authority (NZa) rarely used its market-power powers, may overlap with the competition authority (NMa), and risks conflict with EU competition law, and whether those powers should be integrated into the ACM. The minister answers that the NZa's powers are useful and necessary, that EU-law conflict risk exists for market-power instruments but not for article 45, that a review is scheduled for 2014, and that the NMa's lost fine cases are a matter for the courts.
I consider the NZa's competition powers useful and necessary.
Ik vind de mededingingsbevoegdheden van de NZa nuttig en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over onnodige sterfte door Hepatitis B en C

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about rising mortality from hepatitis B and C, the trend after 2010, risk groups among first-generation migrants, and the China-in-the-Low-Countries pilot and Bibhep project. The minister answered that cases are similar to 2009-2010, that a screening/vaccination policy for migrant risk groups is being explored with the RIVM and may go to the Gezondheidsraad, and that the pilots are being evaluated and partly supported.
If necessary, the Health Council will be asked for advice.
Zonodig zal de Gezondheidsraad om een advies gevraagd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de huidige schaarste in Nederlandse winkels aan melkpoeder

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about shortages of baby milk powder in Dutch shops, its risks, supply security for hospitals, and whether she would join an industry meeting. The minister answered that there is no absolute shortage, only of certain brands; parents can switch brands, hospitals report no problems, and she sees no need to attend the meeting.
Fortunately, there is no absolute shortage of baby milk powder in the Netherlands.
Gelukkig is er in Nederland geen sprake van een absoluut tekort aan babymelkpoeder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked whether self-employed nurses in hospitals, who are exempt from VAT under the BIG-registration logic, should charge 21% VAT, and how this squares with Article 10 of the VAT Directive and a Breda court ruling. The state secretary answers that such nurses are treated like temporary-staffing agencies, that the work is taxable labour provision, that the Tax Authority has appealed the Breda ruling, and that payment arrangements exist for back-tax assessments.
The Tax Authority has therefore lodged an appeal against the Breda district court ruling.
De Belastingdienst heeft daarom hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Breda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Ziekenhuisfraude van 4 miljard per jaar”

An MP asked the health minister about reports that around 10% of hospital declarations are fraudulent, the NZa's capacity and enforcement record, whether insurers are checked, and whether a fraud reporting duty or government leadership is needed. The minister answered that the scale is unknown and a study is underway, detailed the NZa's inspections, fines and directives against hospitals, insurers and care providers, rejected a reporting duty, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
The NZa has had incorrect declarations in its sights for several years, for example an investigation started in 2009 at the Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep in Winschoten.
De NZa heeft incorrecte declaraties al enige jaren in het vizier, denk bjivoorbeeld aan een in 2009 gestart onderzoek bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep te Winschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over aanpak zorgfraude

Labour MP Bouwmeester asked minister Schippers how healthcare fraud and erroneous billing in hospitals are to be sanctioned, whether the NZa has enough capacity, and how much can be saved. The minister answered that the NZa uses both informal and formal enforcement and plans to publish sanctions, that insurers report fraud signals to the NZa, and that an expert commission will report on the scale of fraud this autumn.
Supervision of compliance with these rules by the NZa is geared to this.
Het toezicht op de naleving hiervan door de NZa is hierop geënt.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Waar is de tiplijn’

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers about a report that no tip line exists for anonymous reports of match-fixing in Dutch football, and about whether a judicial preliminary investigation is needed. The minister answered that the anonymous line Meld Misdaad Anoniem was opened for match-fixing from 1 April 2013, that the KNVB has a tip line, and that the Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into fraud in football, which may include the signals raised.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into various signals about, in short, fraud in the football sector, including match-fixing.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is begonnen met een voorbereidend onderzoek naar diverse signalen over, kort gezegd, fraude in de voetbalbranche, waaronder matchfixing.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat Nutricia claimt dat het drankje Souvenaid belangrijke voedingsstoffen bevat die zouden helpen bij mensen met beginnende Alzheimer

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the health minister how she views Nutricia's claims that the drink Souvenaid helps early-stage Alzheimer patients, whether it should have been assessed by the CBG as a medicine, and about industry ties to Alzheimer research under the Deltaplan Dementie. The minister answered that medical claims on food require CBG assessment, that the Deltaplan is a public-private partnership with scientific committees safeguarding independence, and that ZonMw will run open calls with external review.
A claim that a product has a positive medicinal effect in early-stage Alzheimer must be regarded as a medical claim.
Een claim dat een product een positief geneeskrachtig effect heeft bij beginnende Alzheimer, moet worden gezien als een medische claim.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over Souvenaid

An MP asked the health minister whether Souvenaid, a medical food for early Alzheimer's, should be scientifically proven before being prescribed and reimbursed, and raised concerns about its regulation, study funding by the manufacturer Nutricia, prescribing and marketing. The minister defended the Warenwet framework, said NVWA and IGZ are examining the product, and rejected the need for a new independent body while stating that research is subject to peer review and EMA/CBG oversight.
The NVWA and the IGZ check whether communication stays within the limits of the regulations.
De NVWA en de IGZ controleren of de communicatie binnen de grenzen van de regelgeving blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de reductie van zoutgebruik

An MP asked the health minister whether food industry warnings that salt reduction harms taste are misleading, whether the Netherlands lags other EU countries, and when a further 25% cut in bread salt should be reached. The minister said taste change is manageable and not misleading, disagreed that the Netherlands lags (it performs well in the EU), and set no target, relying on voluntary sector-wide agreements.
I do not regard the food industry's mention of the possible effect of salt reduction on taste as a warning, nor as misleading information.
Ik zie het benoemen van het mogelijke effect van zoutreductie op smaak door de levensmiddelenindustrie niet als een waarschuwing en ook niet als misleidende informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van huisdieren in voedsel en veevoer

An MP asked about reports that stray dogs, road-killed animals and pets were rendered into feed ingredients in Spain, possibly supplied to Dutch firms, and whether Dutch food safety controls (NVWA) are adequate and why no RASFF alert was raised. The state secretary answered that Spanish tests found no dog DNA, no evidence of Dutch involvement, that NVWA controls are sufficient, that licences can be withdrawn for illegal trade, and that dolphin DNA findings in tuna were from a small 2010 study and are being addressed at EU level.
So far there are no indications that this prohibition is being violated in the Netherlands.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat in Nederland dit verbod wordt overtreden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het sterftecijfer te hoog is bij het hartcentrum van het Haga Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports of above-average cardiac surgery mortality at the Haga Hospital heart centre, the referral halt by MCH, the IGZ's role, and whether patient safety is guaranteed. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found no evidence of deliberate misreporting, that the hospital itself took improvement measures and halted operations, and that the IGZ sees no need for further enforcement, while declining to publish the internal report and deferring referral policy to the hospital.
The IGZ therefore sees no reason to take further measures.
De IGZ ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de publicatie van sterftecijfers door Nederlandse ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister whether all Dutch hospitals will publish mortality figures per diagnosis and age group, including the HSMR, and whether the government will compel publication. The minister agreed transparency is important, said most hospitals still publish little or nothing and that a mandatory publication route is being explored, including under Article 38 of the Wmg, with a broad sector consultation planned for May 2013.
That is why I am looking for ways to give shape to an obligation to publish mortality figures.
Daarom zoek ik naar mogelijkheden om een verplichting tot publicatie van sterftecijfers vorm te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het experimenteren met medicijnen op kwetsbare mensen door de farmaceutische industrie

An MP asks whether the myTomorrows online platform giving patients access to unregistered medicines, launched with ministry and IGZ knowledge, is acceptable, and whether such access is covered by good clinical practice and whether patients or insurers pay for it. The minister says the ministry and IGZ were informed but not in advance, that this is facilitated access under the named-patient and compassionate-use rules rather than research, that no public funds pay for it, and that the arrangements are sympathetic but must stay within regulation.
The ministry and IGZ were not informed in advance of the initiative going live on 16 April.
Ministerie en IGZ waren niet vooraf op de hoogte van het «in de lucht gaan» van het initiatief op 16 april jl.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat patiënten vaker in nood zijn door verdwenen medicijnen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that patients increasingly face shortages of medicines withdrawn or unavailable, and about the causes, consequences, and remedies such as a notification duty for manufacturers. The minister acknowledged the concern, said most shortages have substitutes but about 1% have none, and promised a plan of action before the summer recess.
I will, as I previously promised you, send a plan of action to the House of Representatives before the summer recess
Ik zal, zoals ik u eerder reeds heb toegezegd, voor het zomerreces een plan van aanpak naar de Tweede Kamer sturen
