Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat anticonceptiepillen van de derde en vierde generatie door effectieve marketing van de farmaceutische industrie op de markt werden gehouden

An MP asked the health minister how marketing by the pharmaceutical industry may have kept third- and fourth-generation contraceptive pills on the market, including industry-sponsored studies, misleading websites and textbook claims. The minister answered that self-regulation and Inspectie oversight apply, that the websites are being assessed for advertising breaches, and that a conversation with the GP profession will follow.
The inspectorate is currently assessing the named websites and will enforce where necessary.
De inspectie beoordeelt momenteel de genoemde websites en treedt indien nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over Nieuwe medicijnen die niet goed getest zijn

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about a study finding that 15 percent of new chronic-disease drugs approved 2000-2010 did not meet the recommended trial size, and what would be done about it. The minister replied that the recommendation is a guideline weighed case by case, that drugs admitted with fewer patients typically carry conditions for post-approval research, and that pharmacovigilance monitors side effects after market entry.
When a study includes fewer patients than the guideline recommends, the CBG weighs whether registration can proceed.
Wanneer een onderzoek minder patiënten omvat dan in de richtlijn wordt aanbevolen, maakt het CBG een afweging of tot registratie kan worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de keuze voor de FOB Gold test voor bevolkingsonderzoek naar darmkanker

An MP asked the minister why the FOB Gold test was chosen over OC-Sensor for the national bowel cancer screening programme, and whether critics' research was funded by OC-Sensor's maker. The minister answered in detail on test quality, procurement criteria and validation, commits to consulting the Gezondheidsraad on a comparative study, but declines to give price details and says the transparency register does not cover medical devices.
I cannot make statements about the price of both tests as part of the procurement procedure.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de prijs van beide testen als onderdeel van de aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Integraal Kankercentum Zuid de ex-directeur 160.000 euro moet betalen

Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about a court-ordered EUR 160,000 severance payment to the former director of the Integraal Kankercentrum Zuid, the dismissal circumstances, the ministry's role including funding threats, and the merger and cancer registry. The minister said she has no formal position on the dismissal, which is the supervisory board's responsibility, and described the funding changes and the merger process.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de aanwezigheid van castoreum als smaak- of geurstof

An MP asked whether castoreum (beaver gland extract) is used as a flavouring in food, whether it must be labelled, and where it originates. The minister confirmed castoreum may be used as a natural aroma under EU rules, declined to research which foods contain it or to change labelling rules, and said the extract comes from North American beavers since European beavers are protected.
Given that castoreum extract is legally permitted for use as a flavouring in foodstuffs, I see no reason to investigate which foodstuffs contain castoreum extract.
Gezien het feit dat castoreum-extract wettelijk is toegestaan voor gebruik als aroma in levensmiddelen zie ik geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken in welke levensmiddelen castoreum-extract is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de situatie dat Nederlandse zwangeren naar België moeten voor een veilige test

An MP asks the health minister why Dutch pregnant women must travel to Belgium for the non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) that avoids miscarriage risk, and why the Netherlands has not adopted it, given foreign recognition and an academic proposal. The minister answers that the test requires a licence under the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek, that the Health Council is advising on the licence application with a four-month deadline, and that a decision will follow, aiming for speed.
After that, a decision can be taken on introducing the test into screening.
Daarna kan een beslissing worden genomen over invoering van de test in de screening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Scheper Ziekenhuis in Emmen en Ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen met het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether she endorses the proposed merger of Scheper Hospital, Bethesda Hospital and Refaja Hospital, and whether service provision will suffer, given concerns from municipal councils, medical staff and GPs. The minister answered that the competition authority (ACM) already approved the merger, that she is neutral on mergers, and that the forthcoming stricter care-specific merger test (not yet in force) will require stakeholder involvement, but she gave no commitment to block or alter the merger.
Until the bill regulating the tightened care-specific merger review has force of law, it is reserved to the ACM to rule on mergers from a competition-law perspective.

Totdat het wetsvoorstel waarin de aanscherpingen van zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden geregeld kracht van wet heeft, is het voorbehouden aan de ACM om zich uit te spreken over fusies vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk perspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over de skydivesport

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether air traffic control's limits on skydiving centres' altitude and frequency threaten the sport, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that a 2010 regulation and the 2012 Luchtruimvisie prioritise Schiphol traffic, that talks are under way with the KNVvL and clubs on relocating springing sites, and that the sport will be facilitated but the choice of location is not the ministry's.

It is now essential to start a process for General Aviation as a whole to accommodate these functions in a future-proof way and, if necessary, relocate them within the framework of the Luchtruimvisie.

Het is nu zaak om voor de General Aviation in den brede een traject te starten om deze functies toekomstvast te accommoderen en indien nodig te verplaatsen binnen de kaders die de Luchtruimvisie biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘’ Medische gegevens via hoorwinkels op straat”

An MP asked the health minister about reports that customers' medical data from hearing-aid fitting was accessible across hearing shops, raising fraud and privacy concerns. The minister replied that the digital hearing protocol was taken offline after audiciens could view each other's client files, that the access was disproportionate, and that the system will only return once shops guarantee careful handling of client data.
On closer inspection, access to these files appears to have been too generous and not proportionate.
Bij nader inzien blijkt de toegang tot deze dossiers te ruimhartig en niet proportioneel te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat de helft van bezoekers aan de eerste hulppost van het Medisch Centrum Haaglanden doorverwezen wordt naar de huisarts

Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister whether half of walk-in patients at a hospital emergency department could be referred to the GP post, and about integration of ER and GP out-of-hours services, costs, experiments and the payment system. The minister replied that integration is a policy priority, that about 40% of walk-ins at MCH are expected to be referred to the GP post, that savings are uncertain but the business case is positive, and that payment reforms are being prepared.
Cooperation between the GP post (HAP) and the ER is therefore important and aimed at clear access to acute care for the patient with one entrance and one triage
Samenwerking tussen Huisartsenpost (HAP) en SEH is daarom belangrijk en gericht op een voor de patiënt heldere toegang tot acute zorg met één loket en één triage
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de toename van betalingsachterstanden bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked about rising payment arrears at health insurers, the stable number of around 300,000 registered defaulters, timely removal from the defaulter scheme, and whether insurers should be obliged to offer instalment plans and prevention. Minister Schippers answered that payment plans are a positive result of the defaulter law, committed to a bill tightening the scheme, but declined to disclose insurer-level figures on commercial-sensitivity grounds and rejected mandatory proactive instalment offers.
A breakdown of these figures by health insurer cannot be provided, as it concerns business information sensitive to the health insurers.
Een uitsplitsing van deze aantallen naar zorgverzekeraar kan ik u niet verstrekken, aangezien het hier gaat om voor de zorgverzekeraars gevoelige bedrijfsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat GHB de nieuwe heroïne is

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked whether GHB is becoming the new heroin, whether GHB addiction is rising sharply, and what the government will do about monitoring, detection, prevention, enforcement, asset confiscation, treatment costs and the newer drug Krokodil. Minister Opstelten answered that GHB addiction cases rose from about 60 in 2007 to nearly 800 in 2012, outlined treatment and prevention measures, and said existing enforcement tools are sufficient while declining to quantify illicit GHB profits.
Information on the unlawfully obtained benefit in GHB cases cannot be generated from the Public Prosecution Service's business process systems.
Informatie over het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel in GHB-zaken kan niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een vergunning voor de omstreden geitenstal in Landerd

An MP asked the ministers whether the controversial goat stable in Landerd may proceed despite a provincial construction stop and the Health Council's report on livestock health risks, and whether the Crown should annul the building permit. The government answered that annulment is discretionary, that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, that the permit was lawfully granted, and that it will not further suspend or annul the permit or await the cabinet response.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het opzeggen van het Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ door de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Vrijgevestigde Psychologen

MPs Leijten asked the minister about the NVVP suspending its obligations under the GGZ Administrative Agreement, the IGZ's changing advice on whether psychotherapists may be main treatment practitioners (hoofdbehandelaar), and related continuity and consistency concerns. The minister called the suspension premature, said she would take a position after the 30 May deadline for a joint field norm, and provided the consultation documents as an annex.
I am first waiting to see whether the field parties of the administrative agreement submit a proposal supported by all parties on 30 May for main treatment practitioner status
Ik wacht nu eerst af of de veldpartijen van het bestuurlijk akkoord op 30 mei een door alle partijen gedragen voorstel overleggen voor het hoofdbehandelaarschap
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht “ziekenhuizen mogen abortus niet weigeren”

Two MPs asked the health and education ministers about a minister's radio remarks on abortion and a hospital board's decision to offer abortion, including whether conscientious objectors are protected under the Termination of Pregnancy Act. The government answered that the law protects non-participation, that hospital decision-making and ethics committee involvement are internal matters, and that it expects conscientious objectors' position to be sufficiently secured.
I regard this as an internal matter.
Ik zie dit als een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de berichten “Antibraakmiddel eist mogelijk 100 levens” en “Onschuldige kwaal, fataal medicijn”?

PVV MP Klever asked the health minister about reports that the anti-nausea drug domperidone may cause around 100 deaths a year in the Netherlands, and whether it should be removed from the market or made prescription-only. The minister said the figure is a rough estimate from a 2005 study, noted that pharmacists check patients' risk factors before supplying it, and stated that the EU medicines authorities, not the minister, decide on market withdrawal or classification, with a re-evaluation underway.
I am not competent to withdraw domperidone from the market nor to change the classification status of domperidone.
Ik ben niet bevoegd Domperidon uit de handel te nemen noch om de indelings-status van Domperidon te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de farmaceut Johnson & Johnson heeft geprobeerd negatieve onderzoeksresultaten van het Erasmus MC over het antibraakmiddel domperidon
te beïnvloeden

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that Johnson & Johnson tried to influence negative Erasmus MC research on the anti-nausea drug domperidone, whether university drug research should be free of industry influence, and whether alternatives exist. The minister condemned such conduct if it occurred, said researchers must be free to publish, noted the company and researcher deny pressure, said she is not competent to withdraw domperidon and will await the EU re-assessment.
Researchers must be given the room to publish research results in complete freedom, without influence from the commissioning party or financier.
Onderzoekers dienen de ruimte te krijgen om de onderzoeksresultaten in alle vrijheid te publiceren zonder beïnvloeding van de opdrachtgever c.q. de financier.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de berichten  “Aziatische tijgermug heeft zich in Nederland gevestigd” en “Misverstand over tijgermug in Nederland”

The MP Klever (PVV) asked the health minister about reports that the Asian tiger mosquito had established itself in the Netherlands, and about how the ECDC map distinguished introduction from establishment. The minister answered that the map error stemmed from repeated introductions being categorised as establishment, that the mosquito has been introduced but not established, and that monitoring, biocide treatment of imported plants and a contingency plan are in place.

As the director of the Centre for Infectious Disease Control of the RIVM indicated in response to reports including in De Volkskrant, the tiger mosquito has been introduced in the Netherlands but not established.

Zoals de directeur van het Centrum Infectieziektebestrijding van het RIVM in reactie op de berichten in o.a. de Volkskrant heeft aangegeven, is de tijgermug in Nederland wel geïntroduceerd maar niet gevestigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de situatie bij het Slotervaartziekenhuis

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about the 2006 sale of the Slotervaart hospital to Meromi Holding BV, the state's role, ownership and governance concerns, and the hospital's continuity. Minister Schippers answers that the sale followed a CSZ-supervised transparent tender at market value, that the hospital remains bound by the WTZi, that IGZ is investigating possible violations, and that she sees no current signals that cruciale zorg is at risk.
I have asked the CSZ to send you these requests, correspondence and advice, but given the sensitivity of the information a special procedure will have to be used for that.
Ik heb het CSZ gevraagd u deze aanvragen, correspondentie en adviezen toe te sturen, maar gezien de gevoeligheid van de informatie zal daar een speciale procedure voor gebruikt moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanstelling van een toezichthouder als tijdelijk voorzitter van de raad van bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister about a Slotervaart hospital supervisory board member being appointed interim chair of the management board, the Governance Code, statute changes allowing profit distributions, and the Achmea contract. The minister said combining these roles is prohibited under the Wtzi, the IGZ is investigating, compliance with the Governance Code is voluntary while Wtzi compliance is mandatory, and profit distribution is banned for specialist care providers.
Combining a role on the management board with a role on the supervisory board of the same provider is therefore incompatible in that light.
Het combineren van een functie in de raad van bestuur met een functie in de raad van toezicht van dezelfde aanbieder is in dat licht onverenigbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over veiligheidscontroles bij medische kinderdagverblijven

An MP asked whether safety and quality controls at medical day-care centres for young children are adequate and why stricter rules for regular childcare (staff screening, four-eyes principle) do not apply to them. The state secretary replied that medical day-care falls under youth care law and health inspectorate oversight, that the four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, that screening is being studied, and that no new legislation extending the childcare act is planned.
For youth care, it is currently being examined whether permanent screening of staff is possible and advisable.
Voor de zorg voor jeugd wordt momenteel onderzocht of permanente screening van medewerkers mogelijk en opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over toezicht op de medische kinderopvang

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked about the supervision of medical childcare after reports that no checks are carried out, including screening of staff and the four-eyes principle. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate for Youth Care and the Health Care Inspectorate apply risk-based supervision, that no serious concerns emerged from visits, and that a four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, without committing to new steps.
Taking further steps is not necessary in view of the above.
Het nemen van verdere stappen is gezien bovenstaande niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de toetreding van de heer Dekker tot de Raad van Bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

Parliamentary questions from MP Bouwmeester ask whether a supervisory board member becoming temporary chair of the management board of the Slotervaart hospital, and the resulting dual role, conflicts with the Dutch hospital rules and the Zorgbrede Governancecode. The minister agrees that combining these roles is not permitted under the WTZi, says the IGZ is investigating a possible breach, notes that all hospitals now subscribe to the governance codes, and promises a letter on hospital governance before summer.
Combining a role on the management board with a role on the supervisory board of the same provider is therefore incompatible.
Het combineren van een functie in de raad van bestuur met een functie in de raad van toezicht van dezelfde aanbieder is in dat licht onverenigbaar.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er een zelfbenoemde genezer actief is die beweert kanker te kunnen genezen

MP Van Gerven asked whether the government would act against a self-declared healer claiming to cure cancer, including IGZ intervention, tax checks, prosecution under unfair trade rules, and amending the Wet BIG. Minister Schippers said the claims are unacceptable, IGZ can only act once harm is shown, no criminal grounds exist yet, the ACM will be informed, and the Wcz amendment will let IGZ act against harmful alternative providers.
I will bring the broadcast about the Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing to the attention of the ACM.
Ik zal de uitzending over het Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing onder de aandacht brengen van het ACM.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over berichten vanuit Oostenrijk met betrekking tot signalen van matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports from Austrian bookmakers flagging suspicious betting on Dutch Eredivisie matches and whether the Dutch matchfixing investigation could use that information. The minister replied that no such Austrian warning system was found to exist, the information came from a UEFA analyst of doubtful relevance, and UEFA's betting fraud system found no irregular betting on the two matches checked.
Inquiries with the Austrian bookmakers' organisation revealed, however, that information about the Eredivisie matches in question was not provided by that organisation.
Navraag bij de Oostenrijkse organisatie van wedkantoren heeft echter geleerd dat informatie over de bedoelde wedstrijden uit de eredivisie niet door deze organisatie is verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de vertrekbonus van een ex-topman van het UMC St Radboud

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a large departure bonus and salary paid to the former head of UMC St Radboud, and about related advisory fees and cuts. The minister answered that the contract predated the WNT pay-cap law, that the board had lawfully honoured it, that nothing unlawful occurred so there is no basis for recovery, and that she cannot intervene in the hospital's staffing decisions.
From my responsibility I cannot intervene in the responsibility of the supervisory board in this matter.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid kan ik niet treden in de verantwoordelijkheid van de RvT in dezen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over onderzoek door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) bij overlijden in zorginstelling

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGZ's handling of a patient's death in a care institution (SEIN), where the family had to supply key facts and an IGZ employee made an inappropriate remark. The state secretary acknowledged the situation was unacceptable, announced a duty to notify families of incidents, said the IGZ tightened its review method, and declined a separate independent inquiry, pointing to an ongoing IGZ improvement trajectory.
I believe care institutions should inform parents and/or other directly involved persons promptly and correctly about the circumstances of an incident and involve them in the investigation.
Ik vind dat zorginstellingen ouders en/of andere direct betrokkenen tijdig en juist dienen te informeren over de toedracht van een calamiteit en hen dienen te betrekken bij onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling op Koranscholen

The MP asked whether the government knew of reports of abuse at Koran schools in Tilburg, which schools were involved, whether a national inquiry would be launched, and whether all schools using violence should be closed. The state secretary confirmed the reports concern two Tilburg-North venues, declined a new national study pointing to the 2012 inventory, and stated that corporal punishment is prohibited and closure is possible only under specific legal conditions.
We currently see no reason to repeat such a study.
Wij zien nu geen reden om een dergelijk onderzoek 3 te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het EO-programma “De vijfde dag” van 13 februari 2013

An MP asked the minister whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) used its powers enough to guarantee patient safety at SEIN after a repeat incident, and whether oversight of institutions under extra supervision should be made public. The government answered that the IGZ acted adequately, that the 2011 death was not comparable to 2008, and that it will increase transparency about supervised providers and reported incidents.
Secondly, greater transparency about the (alleged) calamities that a care provider reports to the IGZ.
Ten tweede grotere transparantie over de (vermeende) calamiteiten die een zorgaanbieder aan de IGZ meldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over antibioticaresistentie

An MP asked the health minister and economy state secretary about antibiotic resistance, citing a radio warning, the lack of new antibiotic development, and high antibiotic use in livestock farming. The minister acknowledged the threat, pointed to existing and planned national and international measures, and promised letters before the summer recess with further detail.
I will inform you by letter before the summer on how this specific topic will be worked out during the current cabinet period.
Over de uitwerking van dit specifieke onderwerp binnen de huidige kabinetsperiode zal ik u voor de zomer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat domperidon de kans op hartfalen verhoogt en in verband wordt gebracht met fatale bijwerkingen

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that domperidone raises the risk of heart failure and fatal side effects, and why it remains sold without a prescription. The minister replied that the CBG (medicines regulator) has repeatedly reviewed and tightened warnings, that the drug is now pharmacy-only with a pharmacist safety check, that 11 fatal cases are reported to Lareb without confirmed causation, and that the CBG rather than the minister decides on the dispensing status, so she will not ask for a change pending the EU review.
The CBG is the body in the Netherlands that deals with medicines, not the Minister of VWS.
Het CBG is de instantie die in Nederland over geneesmiddelen gaat, niet de minister van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat verzekeringsmaatschappijen discrimineren op basis van ziekteverleden of genetische aanleg

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that insurers discriminate on prior illness or genetic predisposition, and about compliance with the Council of Europe Biomedicine Convention and the Wet op de medische keuringen. The minister largely defended the current risk-selection framework, refused to commission new data or a uniform scientific standard, and said the government is considering whether ratifying the Convention is desirable.
I do not have such data. Nor am I intending to commission such a study.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens. Ik ben ook niet voornemens om een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren

Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het signaal dat groepen patiënten die kanker hebben en patiënten die groeihormonen gebruiken hun medicijnen bij het ziekenhuis moeten halen in plaats van bij de apotheek

An SP MP asked the minister of Health about reports that cancer patients and growth-hormone patients must collect their medicines at hospitals instead of pharmacies after the transfer of drug funding to hospital budgets, and about travel burden, cost savings and whether the policy will be reversed. The minister answered that hospitals organise distribution, that home delivery is available, that data on affected patients are not held, that it is too early to judge cost savings, and that there is no reason to reverse the transfer, while acknowledging some identified problems.
I do not have figures on the number of patients who have to travel as a result of the transfer of medicines to the hospital budget.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over aantallen patiënten die moeten reizen als gevolg van de overheveling van medicijnen naar het ziekenhuisbudget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Kosten door onbegrepen ziekten kunnen omlaag’

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the health minister whether costs of unexplained illnesses could be reduced, as suggested in a newspaper article on a PhD study, and whether extra research or mapping of avoidable healthcare costs is warranted. The minister answered that the study did not examine cost reduction, that no further research is planned, and pointed to a new platform on waste in healthcare.
There will therefore be, for example, a platform on waste in healthcare.
Er komt daarom bijvoorbeeld een platform verspilling in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about matchfixing, including Belgian and German approaches, the claim that Dutch enforcement is lax, possible prosecution of Dutch nationals abroad, and the need for special investigative powers or a dedicated unit at the Public Prosecution Service. Minister Opstelten replied that there are no concrete indications of matchfixing in the Netherlands, that investigations will start if signals arise, that a German investigation concerns Dutch suspects and falls under territoriality, and that special powers and a new unit are not currently justified.
There is no question of concrete indications regarding matchfixing in the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van concrete aanwijzingen met betrekking tot matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina Ziekenhuis een frauderende arts in dienst houdt

MP Klever asks the minister why she relied on an accountant's and insurer's findings rather than checking with the NZa about alleged fraud by a doctor at Catharina Ziekenhuis, and whether a fraud investigation is warranted. The minister explains the answers were based on those findings, that she was unaware of the NZa's own investigation, and that she will await its results rather than order a separate inquiry.
As announced in this letter, I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes of the investigation.
Zoals in deze brief aangekondigd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over grootschalige omkoping bij 380 sportwedstrijden

An SP MP asked the ministers about Europol findings of large-scale match-fixing in 380 football matches, including whether Dutch actors, arrests, profits and additional sports are covered by the government's investigation, and how whistleblowers will be handled. The government referred to its letter of 8 February 2013, said all relevant data will be considered, that no criminal investigation into match-fixing is ongoing in the Netherlands, that football, tennis and harness racing will be examined plus about two more sports, and that a broader study of match-fixing has been commissioned with whistleblower treatment being part of it.
In the Netherlands no criminal investigation into match-fixing is ongoing.
In Nederland loopt geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar matchfixing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het Osteoporose Medisch Centrum via de huisarts een DEXA-scan aanbiedt

SP MPs asked the health minister about a Tros Radar report that the Osteoporose Medisch Centrum offers DEXA scans via GPs, raising questions about medical necessity, patient privacy, fees, GP payments, inspection complaints, ownership and possible action. The minister said the report was unclear about who made the offer, referred the matter to the Inspectie for investigation, stated that screening permit rules apply, and said a Gezondheidsraad advisory request on health checks may cover the case.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) will investigate whether what was shown complies with applicable legislation.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) zal onderzoeken of hetgeen getoond is in overeenstemming met vigerende wetgeving is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat medicijnen bij de dienstapotheek in Roermond contant moeten worden afgerekend

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that patients at the Roermond on-call pharmacy must pay cash because it has no contract with insurer CZ, and about the consequences, distance to alternatives, and remedies. The minister answered that insurers must provide adequate care and that on-call pharmacies cannot refuse acute patients, but declined to intervene in contract negotiations and promised only to report on external scouts' findings.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in the contract negotiations between health insurers and care providers.
Antwoord 6 Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om op te treden in de contractonder-handelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Heijnen over de sluiting van Jellinek Curaçao

MPs Bouwmeester and Heijnen asked whether the closure of Jellinek Curaçao, a rehab clinic funded under a Dutch subsidy programme, shows the project failed its aims, whether the subsidy should be reclaimed, and what lessons follow. The minister replied that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed after final settlement, that the clinic contributed while active, and that the programme's sustainability focus will be strengthened.
Reclaiming after final settlement is inconsistent with the conditions under which the subsidy was granted and is therefore legally impossible.
Terugvordering na vaststelling strookt niet met de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidieverlening is verstrekt en is dus juridisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de aanhouding van Willem II fans te Utrecht

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the arrest of around 42 Willem II supporters in Utrecht and whether a combi-ticket scheme would have prevented it, plus what legal remedies the supporters had and how this fits the planned Voetbalwet changes. The minister explained the police and municipal reasoning for the arrests, said complaints and objections via a bestuurlijke strafbeschikking were available, and argued a combi-ticket scheme was unlikely to have prevented the incident.
The police surrounded and arrested a large group.
Door de politie werd een grote groep ingesloten en aangehouden.
Vragen van het lid Van Veen (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Lijst met 1000 medische zaken uitgelekt» (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that a list of about 1,000 medical cases leaked to RTL and whether patient data was adequately protected at the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ). The minister answered that the IGZ mistakenly passed a list to RTL without intent, that a guarantee against recurrence cannot be given, and that the IGZ is improving safeguards within an ongoing improvement trajectory.
As I have indicated earlier, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ has become known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een lijst van 1000 medische missers (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

Two MPs asked the health minister about a list of 1000 medical errors that the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) mistakenly leaked to RTL, including privacy safeguards, calamity reporting and triage quality. The minister acknowledged the leak was unacceptable and unintentional, promised improvement measures and a legal duty to inform patients of calamity reports, and committed to a Zorgloket and periodic transparency reporting.
As I have previously stated, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ became known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een gelekte lijst met 1000 medische fouten (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

An MP asks the health minister about a leaked list of about 1000 medical incidents that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) mistakenly gave to RTL Nieuws, and about the security of medical data held by the inspectorate. The minister acknowledges the leak should not have happened, cannot guarantee it will not recur, points to an ongoing improvement process, and commits to more transparency about medical incidents and inspectorate reports.
As I have stated before, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ became known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een lijst met duizend medische zaken van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) is uitg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister how a list of about a thousand medical incidents leaked from the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) to RTL, how privacy-sensitive data is secured, and whether openness will be increased. The minister admitted an unintentional leak, gave no guarantee it will not recur, and committed to measures and to more transparency about reported incidents, though details were deferred to an ongoing improvement process.
A guarantee that this will never happen again, I cannot give.
Een garantie dat dit nooit meer zal gebeuren, kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over preventie van obesitas bij kinderen door het toevoegen van smaakjes aan melkproducten te ontraden

MP Thieme asked the minister whether, following a study linking flavoured milk products to childhood overweight, the government would discourage adding flavours to dairy products for children's obesity prevention. The state secretary answered that the evidence is too limited to draw conclusions, that policy focuses on the overall diet rather than specific foods, and that the government will not discourage flavoured dairy, leaving responsibility with parents and industry.
No. See my answer to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Oosten en Tellegen over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a baby house with a foundling chamber in Dordrecht, including whether leaving a newborn there is punishable, whether the initiator could be prosecuted for incitement, quality and supervision criteria, and comparisons with other countries. The government answered that leaving a newborn in such a chamber is punishable, that the baby house conflicts with the Criminal Code and children's rights, and that existing confidential-birth and temporary-care options remain the proper route.
Answering the question about quality criteria and supervision for such a baby house is therefore not relevant.
Beantwoording van de vraag naar kwaliteitscriteria en toezicht voor een dergelijk babyhuis is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman inzake taalproblemen in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about language barriers in healthcare, including whether reduced publicly funded interpreter services lower care quality and raise costs. The minister replied that patients are primarily responsible for communicating in Dutch, pointed to family support, pictorial aids and the Kwaliteitsinstituut, found no proof of quality loss or extra costs, and promised to report on an investigation by May 2013.
I have no indication of extra care costs incurred because the patient does not command the Dutch language
Ik heb geen indicatie van extra zorgkosten die gemaakt worden omdat de patiënt de Nederlandse taal niet machtig is
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over over reclames en patiëntenwerving van GGZ-instelling Indigo

MP Leijten (SP) asks the minister why, despite stating concern about misleading advertising by GGZ provider Indigo, no action is taken, and questions whether the NZa should monitor, whether the GP gatekeeper role is protected, and whether sister companies of Parnassia also recruit patients. The minister replies that Indigo's practices fall within the Wmg and Zvw, that no legal change is needed, that the NZa will monitor the case, and that a free first consult is not prohibited.
That is why I think it is important that the NZa will monitor this case.
Daarom vind ik het belangrijk dat de NZa deze casus wel gaat monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over diefstal van medicatie uit een ziekenhuis

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about a hospital in Bergen op Zoom where morphine was handed out on a fictitious patient's name, raising protocol, oversight by the IGZ and insurer declaration questions. The minister agreed the situation was serious, said the hospital had a protocol and has tightened its procedures, and pointed to IGZ oversight and the hospital's own responsibility, while stating that individual patient medication cannot be traced from insurer declarations.
Subsequently the procedures in the hospital have been tightened. The IGZ supervises this.
Vervolgens zijn de procedures in het ziekenhuis aangescherpt. De IGZ houdt hierop toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix geen beschikbaarheidstoeslag ontvangt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's initial rejection of a hospital availability allowance for Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix in Winterswijk, which they said threatened its survival and the 45-minute acute care norm. The minister said the hospital has appealed, that the hospital is important for the region, that the decision rests with the NZa and regional bodies, and that she has no figures showing financial trouble.
I do not have figures on the basis of which I could conclude that the hospital will run into financial problems in the long term without an SEH availability allowance.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op basis waarvan ik de conclusie zou kunnen trekken dat het ziekenhuis op den duur in financiële problemen komt zonder een beschikbaarheidbijdrage SEH.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Keijzer over het bericht dat orgaandonoren geconfronteerd worden met inkomstenverlies en medische kosten

Two MPs asked the health minister about reports that living organ donors bear income loss and medical costs, citing a scar claim refused by an insurer, an out-of-pocket echo, and a self-employed donor's compensation gap. The minister answered that medical costs necessary for care are covered by insurance within 13 weeks (and by the donor's insurance thereafter), that a subsidy scheme compensates self-employed donors' income loss for up to 13 weeks, and that a dedicated arrangement for rare complications is not feasible within the current social security system.
It is not for me to judge in an individual case whether medically necessary care is involved.
Het is niet aan mij om in een individuele casus te oordelen of hier sprake is van medisch noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over transparantie van zorgverzekeraars met zorgaanbieders

An MP asked the minister about insurers' lack of transparency on which care providers they contract with, and the risk that patients are left exposed when contracts end mid-year. The minister acknowledged the NZa publication, pointed to the BW right to terminate after an unfavourable policy change, and said a bill amending article 13 Zvw would financially incentivise insurers to disclose contracting status six weeks before the new policy year.
I have therefore, as I indicated in the answer to question 5, submitted the bill amending article 13.
Ik heb daarom, zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 5 heb aangegeven, het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van artikel 13 ingediend
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vangst van 900 kilo qat tijdens een grenscontrole op de A16

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about a seizure of 900 kilos of qat at the A16 border check, whether qat trade has grown since the ban, and how the ban is being enforced and publicized among Somali communities. The minister answered that there are no signs of increased trade, that enforcement attention has increased and the seizures indicate success, and that information on the ban has been distributed to a broad network with further consultations planned.
Since 5 January 2013 the investigative services have given extra attention to the criminalisation of possession of qat.
Binnen de opsporingsdiensten is sinds 5 januari 2013 extra aandacht gegeven aan de strafbaarstelling van het bezit van qat
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het middel Alemtuzumab

An MP asked the health minister whether manufacturer Genzyme withdrew access to alemtuzumab for aggressive multiple sclerosis and whether a future higher price for the MS indication is justified. The minister confirmed the drug is off the market for MS outside study settings, said she cannot rule out a higher price on reintroduction, and saw no reason to intervene since trial patients continue treatment.
I understand the manufacturer has submitted a marketing authorisation application to the EMA for the use of alemtuzumab in MS.
Ik heb begrepen dat de fabrikant een registratie-aanvraag bij EMA heeft ingediend voor het gebruik van alemtuzumab bij MS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over diarreebacteriën die van varkens overgaan op mensen

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the transmission of resistant diarrhoea bacteria from pigs to humans, and their presence in air and meat, poses public health risks and calls for testing and policy changes. The government answers that the risk to public health is not large, that a follow-up NVWA meat study is planned for 2014, and that antibiotic reduction policy will continue, but declines to link the findings to the Health Council report or to extend the research beyond planned studies.
The NVWA has planned a follow-up study for 2014 on the presence of the bacterium on meat.
De NVWA heeft voor 2014 een vervolgonderzoek gepland naar het voorkomen van de bacterie op vlees.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht op de site van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Kinderfysiotherapie

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about insurers' new contract terms for child physiotherapists, which removed care at special schools and medical day-care centres, and their late announcement. The minister answered that insurers are free to set terms, that the late notice concerned one insurer which has since introduced a transitional arrangement, and that talks with the professional association and insurers on defining necessary care are ongoing.
Health insurers are free to make agreements about the care they purchase and the manner in which it is delivered.
Het staat zorgverzekeraars vrij om afspraken te maken over de zorg die zij inkopen en op welke manier deze wordt geleverd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen met een lager inkomen een grotere kans hebben om te sterven na een hartaanval

An SP MP asked the health minister how to respond to findings that people with lower income or education have a higher chance of dying after a heart attack, and what should be done about socioeconomic health gaps, medical training and an action plan. The minister answered that the causes are complex and shared among many parties, pointed to prevention, health-literacy and professional standards, and said a national prevention programme outline would be presented to parliament within weeks.
I am currently consulting with the State Secretary and various parties to arrive at a national prevention programme.
Ik ben op dit moment samen met de Staatssecretaris en met verschillende partijen in overleg om tot een nationaal programma preventie te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tellegen over de overtijdbehandeling door een huisarts

A VVD MP asked the health minister whether home-based or GP-administered medical termination of early pregnancy could reduce abortions, illegal online pills and the feared shortage of abortion doctors. The minister answered that about 16,000 early treatments occur yearly, that data on users are not recorded, that GP-provided pills would not lower the number of abortions, and that GP care could meet the legal requirements but would not solve illegal online purchases or a current shortage.
These data are not known. In the context of the woman's anonymity, such questions are not asked during intake and are not recorded.
Deze gegevens zijn niet bekend. In het kader van de anonimiteit van de vrouw worden dergelijke vragen niet gesteld tijdens de intake en ook niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de oprichting van het meldpunt Klokkenluiders verstandelijk gehandicapten

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health why a whistleblower reporting point for people with intellectual disabilities was needed, and about complaint handling, the Inspectorate's capacity, and the power of care providers. The State Secretary acknowledged weaknesses in complaints procedures, pointed to planned reforms (Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, a Zorgloket, binding dispute procedures and a cliëntenvertrouwenspersoon) and largely declined to comment on individual cases or specific providers.
I will not comment on the views of individual care institutions such as Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Ik laat mij niet uit over de opvatting van individuele zorginstellingen zoals Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over een mogelijk tekort aan HCG ten behoeve van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen

MP Wolbert asked the health minister about a shortage of HCG-based fertility drug Pregnyl, whether urine collected via Moeders voor Moeders is used for other purposes, off-label use for slimming and horse breeding, Inspectorate enforcement results, and measures to restrict use to fertility treatment. The minister confirmed a shortage of Pregnyl 1500, said the manufacturer uses urine only for human fertility drugs, reported Inspectorate fines and a conviction, and announced plans to move Pregnyl to hospital-only supply to curb off-label use.
I do not have data on the extent of HCG use as a slimming agent or for bodybuilding.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens wat betreft de mate van gebruik van HCG als afslankmiddel of het gebruik bij bodybuilding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over screening op vasa praevia

An MP asked the health minister about vasa praevia screening, including incidence, preventive caesareans, and whether routine screening should be added to the structural ultrasound. The minister answered that incidence is uncertain, that only one death was recorded in the 2010 perinatal audit, that screening is limited to high-risk groups following NVOG and RCOG practice, and that there is no reason to ask the Centraal Orgaan for renewed advice.
All things considered, I see no reason to ask the Centraal Orgaan for advice again at this time.
Alles afwegend zie ik geen reden om het Centraal Orgaan op dit moment opnieuw om advies te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat tot tweemaal veroordeelde huisarts nog altijd als bevoegd arts in het BIG-register staat

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked why a GP convicted twice for child pornography remained registered in the BIG register, why the IGZ did not pursue deregistration, and what options exist. The minister declined to discuss the case citing privacy, pointed to the IGZ-OM cooperation protocol, and announced a plan to require VOG certificates for all medical professionals including self-employed doctors.
Because of the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into the background of this specific case.
Omwille van de privacy van betrokkene kan ik niet ingaan op de achtergronden van dit concrete geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over een veroordeelde arts die veroordeeld is voor kinderporno, maar nog wel in het BIG-register staat

MP Bouwmeester asks whether it is troubling that a doctor convicted of child pornography remains registered in the BIG register, and how patients can learn of such convictions and how criminal, disciplinary and civil law are linked. The minister says privacy prevents discussing the case, that courts can impose only limited professional bans, that she is consulting on widening those powers, that register entries and publication are in place, and that the prosecutor decides whether to inform the Inspectorate.
I find it unsatisfactory that health professionals who have committed serious sexual or violent offences, and who may reoffend, can (again) practise their profession.
Ik vind het onbevredigend dat beroepsbeoefenaren die ernstige zeden- of geweldsmisdrijven hebben gepleegd, en bij wie een kans op recidive aanwezig is, hun beroep (opnieuw) kunnen uitoefenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Medtronic illegale betalingen aan artsen deed

An SP MP asked the health minister about press reports that Medtronic made illegal payments to doctors in Belgium, and whether similar practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister found no basis to conclude such practices occur in the Netherlands, left enforcement to the sector's self-regulation codes, and said she will push for a reciprocal code by summer.
I consider it the sector's own responsibility to ensure that contacts between them proceed in a proper manner.
Ik vind het een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de sector om te zorgen dat de onderlinge contacten op een nette manier verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht “Meer gedwongen opnames”

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that compulsory psychiatric admissions rose between 2002 and 2009, including whether the trend continues, regional differences, and effects on outpatient care and costs. The minister confirmed the rise (64% for court authorisations, 20% for emergency detentions), said numbers were roughly flat through 2012, and pointed to the new Wet verplichte ggz and outpatient coercion as ways to reduce compulsory admissions.
Preventing compulsory admissions has my attention and is part of the GGZ policy aimed at reducing coercive measures in mental health care.
Het voorkomen van dwangopnamen mijn aandacht en is onderdeel van het ingezette ggz beleid met betrekking tot het terugdringen van dwangtoepassingen in de GGZ.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over gebrek aan controle van ziekenhuisdeclaraties door zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the health minister about lack of insurer checks on hospital declarations, why hospital bills are late and coded, and whether there is an NZa plan to prevent and enforce against incorrect declarations. The minister said the NZa is intensifying supervision, outlined a cross-sector analysis with action areas, explained the reasons for slow hospital billing, and described the NZa's 2013 intervention strategy and reporting.
The healthcare regulator has announced that it will further intensify its supervision.
De zorgautoriteit heeft aangekondigd dat ze haar toezicht verder gaat intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de Diane-35 pil

An MP asks the health minister how her earlier answers on the Diane-35 pill were compiled, why she was unaware of 97 new adverse event reports including 9 deaths, and how she explains that a newspaper had more information than she gave Parliament. The minister answers that Lareb and the CBG were aware of the reports by the day she answered, that timing was overtaken by events as reports kept arriving, and that she did not have the information Trouw reported on 1 March.
On 28 February, Lareb brought this data to the attention of the CBG.
Op 28 februari jl. heeft Lareb deze gegevens ter kennis gebracht bij het CBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de opvang van tienermoeders

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the risk that Siriz's shelter for teenage mothers loses funding after 2014, and what happens to this group after decentralisation to municipalities. The state secretary answers that shelter for teenage mothers should remain available, that advice from VNG and Federatie Opvang is expected before summer 2013, and that the group will move to municipal shelter funding from 2015 without explicit mention in the Wmo.
I consider it important that support and, where necessary, shelter for teenage mothers with (serious) problems remain available.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ondersteuning en zo nodig opvang voor tienermoeders met (ernstige) problemen beschikbaar blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over e-Health diensten en btw-heffing

An MP asked whether the tax authority's demand that care provider Ksyos pay VAT on eHealth services was justified, and whether VAT blocks other care projects. The government declined to discuss the individual case citing tax secrecy, explained that VAT exemptions apply to medical care by doctors but not to the ICT services supporting teledermatology, and said it could not identify other affected projects while the ministries investigate attribution questions.
The questions concern an individual matter. Due to the tax secrecy obligation, no statements can be made about it.
De vragen betreffen een individuele aangelegenheid. Daarover kunnen in verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Achmea en het Slotervaartziekenhuis geen contract hebben afgesloten

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the health minister about Achmea's refusal to contract the Slotervaart hospital, leaving insured patients to pre-pay partly reimbursed bills, and whether patients are being used as pawns and their choice of hospital undermined. The minister answered that non-contracting is a possible outcome of the decentralised system, that patients keep care rights and cancellation rights, that a bill to strengthen insured patients' information duties is pending, and that she sees no sign the dispute concerns quality of care.
How the hospital's invoices are settled is a matter for the parties, in which I cannot and will not interfere.
Hoe de declaraties van het ziekenhuis worden afgehandeld is een zaak van partijen waarin ik me niet kan en wil mengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gevolgen voor patiënten van het niet afsluiten van een contract tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder

An MP asked the health minister about patient consequences of Achmea and the Slotervaart hospital failing to conclude a 2013 contract, including whether patients can switch insurers or pay higher passant tariffs. The minister said contract talks were not finished, outlined a pending bill requiring insurers to disclose contracted providers six weeks before year-end, and noted insurers can only reimburse up to the policy entitlement.
I agree that it is desirable that insured persons, when they choose their health insurer, have clarity about which care providers the insurer has contracted.
Ik deel de mening dat het wenselijk is dat verzekerden, op het moment dat zij hun zorgverzekeraar kiezen, duidelijkheid hebben over welke zorgaanbieders de verzekeraar gecontracteerd heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen gaat overleggen met de Franse geneesmiddelentoezichthouder en 26 andere toezichthouders

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CBG consulting with the French regulator and 26 other regulators over third and fourth generation contraceptive pills, whether this aimed at removing them from the basic insurance package, and why 62 of 586 Lareb reports concerned thrombosis. The minister answered that the consultation is a standard EU procedure triggered by France, not aimed at insurance coverage, that a re-assessment of these drugs has been started, and that all reports are being examined.
The CBG's consultation with the other member states is therefore not aimed at removing the third and fourth generation contraceptive pill from the basic package.
Het overleg van het CBG met de andere lidstaten is er dus niet op gericht om de derde en vierde generatie anticonceptiepil uit het basispakket te halen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Achmea en het Slotervaartziekenhuis geen contract hebben afgesloten

An MP asked the health minister whether Achmea's demand that Slotervaart Hospital cap its spending on rheumatology and cancer medicines could deny patients necessary drugs and push insured patients to other hospitals. The minister said insurers and hospitals keep their care duties even if budgets are exceeded, that Achmea must inform its insured about changes, and that the dispute is a normal outcome of decentralised steering and not yet final.
The failure to conclude a contract between a health insurer and a hospital can be an outcome within the decentralised steering model we have chosen for our healthcare.
Het niet tot stand komen van een contract tussen een zorgverzekeraar en een ziekenhuis kan een uitkomst zijn in het decentrale sturingsmodel waarvoor we voor onze gezondheidszorg hebben gekozen.
Vragen van het lid Klever (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Catharina Ziekenhuis een frauderende arts in dienst houdt (ingezonden 13 februari 2013).

An MP asks the minister about reports that a hospital keeps a fraudulent doctor employed, why doctors cannot be dismissed, whether the NZa and IGZ will investigate, and what protections whistleblowers and a reporting duty for fraud would receive. The minister's supplementary reply says an independent accountant found no fraud and that the NZa has started an investigation into incorrect declarations, with results to be sent to the House.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of this investigation.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Belgische Clinica Aesthetica via Groupon reclame maakt voor cosmetische chirurgie

An SP MP asked the health minister about a Belgian clinic advertising cosmetic surgery via Groupon, and whether such discount deals risk impulse purchases, disadvantage lower-income groups, and whether 16-18 year olds should decide alone, and whether an advertising ban should be introduced. The minister answered that Dutch rules rely on the sector's Leidraad and the WGBO, that she is investigating cosmetic-sector risks and will inform parliament in spring, but that adults bear their own responsibility and an advertising ban will be considered in that ongoing study.
In the spring I will inform the House about my proposals for measures to counter the risks in the cosmetic sector.
In het voorjaar zal ik de Kamer informeren over mijn voorstellen voor maatregelen om de risico's in de cosmetische sector tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over cosmetische chirurgie en ingrepen

An MP asked the health minister about Groupon discount deals for cosmetic surgery, industry advertising standards, consumer information, a broad action plan, and cross-border medical malpractice. The minister said the sector's Leidraad applies as a standard, Belgian rules govern the procedures, adults carry responsibility for risk, a risk-reduction plan will follow in spring, and some EU-level warning mechanisms are being pursued.
In the spring I will come with proposals for measures to reduce risks in the cosmetic sector.
In het voorjaar kom ik met voorstellen voor maatregelen om risico's in de cosmetische sector te verkleinen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Veronica Magazine een facelift verloot onder kopers van de DVD ‘De Verbouwing’

An MP asked the health minister whether a Veronica Magazine promotion raffling a facelift among buyers of a DVD and offering 500 free consultations was acceptable, and what she would do to prevent such cosmetic-surgery promotions. The minister replied that such promotions are not banned, the sector's own publicity norms apply, the plastic surgeon was warned by his professional association and has stopped the publicity, and she is examining the cosmetic sector for possible measures.

I am currently examining the cosmetic sector to possibly take measures against the imbalance that has arisen between the possibilities, the risks and the legal safeguards attached to cosmetic procedures.

Ik onderzoek momenteel de cosmetische sector om eventueel maatregelen te kunnen nemen tegen de disbalans die is ontstaan tussen de mogelijkheden, de risico's en de wettelijke waarborgen die aan cosmetische ingrepen zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat verschillende apotheken in Hengelo, Borne en Hof van Twente nog geen contract hebben met Achmea

MP Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that several pharmacies in Hengelo, Borne and Hof van Twente lacked contracts with Achmea, forcing patients to pay cash, and about patient choice and continuity. The minister replied that insurers and providers may freely decide on contracts, that Achmea reports contracts with 1976 of 1981 pharmacies and that the reported contracts continue into 2013, that patients keep access but may face different reimbursement, and that consumers can complain to the Ombudsman and Disputes Commission, with the NZa supervising the insurer's duty of care.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in the contract negotiations between health insurers and care providers.
Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om op te treden in de contractonderhandelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat het Catharina Ziekenhuis een frauderende arts in dienst houdt

An MP asks the minister whether a hospital that kept a physician suspected of fraud can dismiss her, whether the NZa and IGZ should investigate, and what is being done about whistleblowers and a duty to report fraud. The minister replies that the hospital found no fraud, only improper billing that was repaid, so there is no legal ground for dismissal and no need for NZa or IGZ action, while referring whistleblower protection to a separate initiative and rejecting a reporting duty as too burdensome.
Since this does not concern fraud, there is no legal ground for dismissal (given existing case law).
Aangezien het hier niet gaat om fraude is er geen juridische grond voor ontslag (gegeven bestaande jurisprudentie).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de Diane-35 pil

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she responds to France's plan to withdraw the Diane-35 pill, whether the Netherlands will do the same, and whether users can be assured it is safe. The minister replied that the CBG, not the minister, decides on market withdrawal, that an EU safety review is underway with the Netherlands as rapporteur, and that patients should consult their doctor rather than stop.
I am not authorised to withdraw medicines from the market.
Ik ben niet bevoegd geneesmiddelen uit de handel te nemen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat medicijnen bij de dienstapotheek in Venlo vanaf 1 januari 2013 contant moeten worden afgerekend (ingezonden 7

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that a Venlo on-call pharmacy will only hand out medicines outside hours against immediate cash payment, and whether this endangers patients and what the government will do. The minister answers that insurers must contract adequate out-of-hours care, that on-call pharmacies may not refuse urgent patients, that the pharmacy acts to pressure insurers over pay, and that the government is not planning intervention beyond monitoring by the regulators.
I do not have a complete overview of that.
Ik heb daar geen volledig overzicht van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie tussen de Isala Klinieken in Zwolle, het St Jansdal Ziekenhuis in Harderwijk en de Noorderboog in Meppel

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the planned merger of Isala Klinieken, St Jansdal and Noorderboog hospitals was motivated by capital costs, a Achmea-linked move, closure of obstetric care, and bed-size concerns. The minister replied that the hospitals deny cost-cutting motives, that the planned merger is for the hospitals to decide, and that the new merger-test bill will require justification and stakeholder involvement, without announcing a merger stop.
I am not seeking to stop mergers. I also have no powers over this.
Het gaat mij er niet om om fusies te stoppen. Ik heb daarover ook geen bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat patiënten in de geriatrische revalidatiezorg buiten de boot dreigen te vallen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she would respond to provider Verenso's warning that patients in geriatric rehabilitation care risk falling through the cracks after its transfer from the AWBZ to the Zorgverzekeringswet, and how she would monitor and intervene. The minister rejected the claim, said Parkinson's patients remain covered under specialist care, promised consultations to clear up uncertainties and monitoring with the NZa, but gave no concrete threshold for intervention and no guarantee against transition problems.
Any unclarities about the transfer of geriatric rehabilitation care must be resolved as quickly as possible.
Eventuele onduidelijkheden omtrent de overheveling van geriatrische revalidatiezorg moeten zo snel mogelijk worden weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de achterstand van Nederland in de strijd tegen matchfixing

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers why the Netherlands lags behind criminal networks in combating match-fixing, including whether football associations can detect it and whether reporters are protected. The minister answered that a study by the ministries started on 23 January 2013, that anonymous reporting is possible, and that protective measures will be considered after the study's results.
For that reason, reporters are given the opportunity to tell their story anonymously within the ministries' study, via a web survey and a telephone reporting option.
Om die reden wordt melders in het kader van het onderzoek van onze ministeries via een webenquête en een telefonische meldingsmogelijkheid de mogelijkheid gegeven om anoniem hun verhaal te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars verpleegkundig specialisten niet als hoofdbehandelaar erkennen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether insurers refuse to recognise nurse specialists as main treating professionals, why the issue persists, and how the government will improve use of their skills. The minister confirmed insurers restrict main-treater status, including for nurse specialists, and pointed to a pending IGZ advice and a field norm on main-treater status as the route to clarity.
I therefore expect that the IGZ advice will give more insight into the considerations of health insurers regarding main-treater status.
Ik verwacht daarom dat het advies van de IGZ meer inzicht zal geven in de overwegingen van de zorgverzekeraars op het gebied van het hoofdbehandelaarschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het vechten voor een schone vechtsport

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked ministers about inadequate medical oversight, instructor quality, criminal links and the need for a sports commission in the martial arts sector. The minister acknowledged problems, reported a RIEC report finding criminal links at nearly half of events, noted municipalities are amending local rules, and said she would consult stakeholders on a commission before the summer recess.
I am willing to invite a number of relevant stakeholders to explore what could be a good and feasible way forward in this matter.
Ik ben bereid een aantal relevante stakeholders uit te nodigen om te verkennen wat in deze een goede en begaanbare weg zou kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over boetes voor buitenlandse studenten wegens vermeend ontbreken ziektekostenverzekering

MPs Mohandis and Bouwmeester asked whether foreign students are wrongly fined by the CVZ for allegedly lacking health insurance and how to prevent this. The minister explains that students under 30 who work alongside their studies are rightly insured under Dutch rules, while exchange and non-publicly funded students are wrongly contacted because current administration cannot screen them, and says the communication is being improved and the group may be narrowed further.
In addition, I am examining the possibilities to further limit the group of international students who are currently wrongly contacted.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de groep internationale studenten die nu onterecht worden aangeschreven nog verder te beperken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de minister geen lijst kan presenteren van artsen waarmee de IGZ een deal heeft gesloten om te stoppen met werken

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the minister cannot provide a complete list of IGZ restrictive agreements with doctors since 2000, and whether such agreements are lawful, including the case of Jansen Steur before the 2014 limitation date. The minister answered that the IGZ never systematically recorded these agreements, estimated 10-20 per year, said legality is for the courts, and explained tuchtrecht options against Jansen Steur while promising stronger registration and ICT investment.
Because restrictive agreements were not systematically recorded by the IGZ in the past, including by its regional offices, it is not possible to provide a detailed overview.

Omdat de beroepsbeperkende afspraken in het verleden door de IGZ niet structureel zijn bijgehouden – ook niet door haar regiokantoren – is het niet mogelijk om hiervan een (gedetailleerd) overzicht te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klever, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de poging van de KNVB om de mening van een scheidsrechter te verbieden

MPs from the PVV asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the KNVB's attempt to silence a referee who had made comments on social media about Moroccan youth problems. The minister said the KNVB respects free speech but was concerned about offensive posts, that it is for the KNVB to set its own rules, and declined to summon the KNVB board or demand an apology.
I leave it to the KNVB to choose its own course within the federation.
Ik laat het aan de KNVB om binnen de bond daarin een eigen weg te kiezen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat buitenlandse studenten onterecht een aanmaning voor een zorgverzekering ontvangen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked whether foreign students were wrongly sent demands to take out Dutch health insurance, with fines, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that students registered with DUO are not targeted, that students who work alongside their studies are rightly insured, that fines are withdrawn or refunded once students respond, and that the government will improve communication and an English-language form but will not exempt students with small jobs.
If the student responds to the CVZ or SVB after the letter, no fine is imposed at all.
Als de student na de aanschrijving van het CVZ reageert naar het CVZ of de SVB, dan wordt er in het geheel geen boete opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoeksresultaat dat de babysterfte 's nachts niet hoger is dan overdag?

An MP asked the health minister whether a study showing that infant mortality fell in all hospital types, including night shifts, undermines the rationale for closing obstetric care in Meppel and whether this should change how large organisational changes are weighed. The minister acknowledged the positive trend but noted the study covers only uncomplicated births, declined to issue new recommendations, and said decisions on concentrating obstetric care lie with hospital boards and other parties.
It is up to the hospital boards, insurers, professionals and all other stakeholders to make decisions about concentrating obstetric care.
Het is aan de Raden van Bestuur, de verzekeraars, de professionals en alle andere betrokkenen om besluiten te nemen over concentratie van verloskundige zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat concentratie van zorg niet noodzakelijk is om babysterfte terug te dringen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether concentration of obstetric care is needed to reduce infant mortality, citing reports that night-time births are not more dangerous, and asked about staffing, costs, hospital executive pay and consultation of midwives. The minister declined to reverse the concentration in Meppel and Dokkum, argued that 24/7 obstetric care in every hospital is not necessary, and promised a letter to parliament on consulting midwives.
However, it is not for me to decide on the concentration of care, as long as these decisions are taken within the preconditions for quality and accessibility of care.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te besluiten over concentratie van zorg, zolang deze besluiten worden genomen binnen de randvoorwaarden voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het advies van CVZ over geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) in het basispakket

The SP MP Leijten asks the health minister about public unrest over the CVZ draft advice on mental health care in the basic insurance package, whether the government will act, why the CVZ will not withdraw the draft despite many objections, and whether an advisory committee member's remarks on care boundaries are appropriate. The minister says the draft is still under consultation, invites the sector to propose alternatives, declines to comment on individual responses or committee members, and confirms that the CVZ is to clarify the boundary of insured mental health care and that GGZ treatment should follow guidelines.
I do not consider it appropriate to respond to a statement by an individual ACP member.
Ik acht het niet passend te reageren op een uitspraak van een afzonderlijk ACP-lid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de uitspraken over fusies van ziekenhuizen

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers whether competition authority NMa treats hospital mergers more strictly than hospital cooperation, and whether it discourages cooperation while nudging hospitals toward mergers. The minister replies that NMa is meant to target cartels, not useful cooperation, that NMa issues informal opinions only on request, and that a dedicated merger test for healthcare is being legislated.
The supervision by the NMa is aimed at combating cartels.
Het toezicht van de NMa is erop gericht om kartels tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de verdeling van topsportgelden door NOC*NSF

An SP MP asked the health and sport minister about NOC*NSF's reallocation of top-sport funds to a focus group of sports, which cuts programmes in many other sports.
