The minister replied that the sports federations themselves approved the top-10 ambition, that the process was transparent and audited, that talent support remains possible, and that she will not seek a different allocation.
As I understand from NOC*NSF, the process of reallocating top-sport funds based on the principles of the sports agenda proceeded in a transparent and objective manner.
Naar ik begrijp van NOC*NSF is het proces van herverdeling van de topsportmiddelen op basis van de uitgangspunten in de sportagenda op een transparante en objectieve manier verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de ervaringen met Nader Onderzoek DoodsOorzaak minderjarigen (NODO-procedure)

An MP asked about the NODO procedure for unexplained deaths of minors, prompted by a case involving a severely disabled child, including whether obduction is needed when a medical file exists, procedure duration, the two NODO centres, and training of forensic doctors. The government answered that the procedure is standard for unexplained deaths, explained its steps and criteria, noted a startup evaluation until October 2013, and stated the procedure is neutral and non-judicial, while declining to discuss the individual case.
In answering these and the following questions I cannot go into the individual case.
Bij de beantwoording van deze en volgende vragen kan ik niet ingaan op de casuïstiek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over toezicht op zorgverzekeraars en bundeling van klachten over zorgaanbieders

An MP asked the health minister whether consumers are confused about which financial or health regulator (DNB, AFM, NZa, NMa) to contact about health insurers, whether oversight differs between basic and supplementary insurance, and whether complaints and signals should be published jointly. The minister denied receiving signals of confusion, said the NZa has limited oversight of supplementary insurance, and rejected joint publication of complaints to avoid abuse and protect confidentiality, while agreeing that clarity and cross-referral should be ensured.
The supervisors want to prevent receiving less or no information and being unable to do their work well if confidentiality is not guaranteed.
De toezichthouders willen voorkomen dat zij minder of geen informatie meer krijgen en hun werk niet meer goed kunnen doen als de geheimhouding niet is geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Bosma en Wilders over het bericht “Graaiers moeten inleveren”

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health why top salaries in the public and semi-public sector keep rising, whether pay rises before the WNT pay-cap took effect were improper, and whether executives who sued to escape the cap should be pursued. The minister defended the WNT and its transitional rules, said there is no evidence of pre-emptive pay rises, and stated that challenging government decisions in court is a right.
Anyone is free to have government decisions reviewed by the court.
Het staat een ieder vrij om beslissingen van de overheid door de rechter te laten toetsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de brief van de Caribisch Nederlandse Vereniging van fysiotherapeuten met daarin de wijziging van de ziektekostenverzekering op Caribisch Nederland per 1

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the late announcement and cut-back of physiotherapy and dental care in the Caribbean Netherlands' basic insurance from 1 January 2013, questioning consultation and the 5-working-day notice. The minister conceded five working days was too short, extended the transition to 1 July 2013, promised to announce future package decisions by 1 July of the prior year, but refused to postpone or revise the decision.
For that reason it was decided to introduce a transition period of half a year, in line with common practice in European Netherlands.
Daarom is besloten tot een overgangsperiode van een half jaar conform de gangbare praktijk in Europees Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de gevolgen van de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage voor de ABWZ en WMO als gevolg van de introductie van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling

Member Krol (50PLUS) asks the minister about the income effects of the higher own contributions for AWBZ and Wmo care caused by the capital income levy, and whether the law should be corrected or implementation suspended. The state secretary replies that the previous letter was not misleading, explains how homes and deposits are treated under the levy with timing relief, and says he will first consult the House on which effects it considers undesirable before deciding on changes.
I consider it proper first to consult the House on which effects it evidently considers undesirable.
Ik acht het zuiver eerst met de Kamer in overleg te treden over de vraag welke gevolgen kennelijk door de Kamer ongewenst worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de vertrekkend bestuursvoorzitter van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum een zeer royale ontslagregeling heeft getroffen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that the outgoing Erasmus MC board chair negotiated a generous severance package, including continued salary to 2015, a personal allowance, a mobile phone, laptop and first-class NS season ticket. The minister answered that the arrangement's basis under the CAO is incorrect since the chair was not covered by the CAO, that such a generous arrangement is too generous, but that the WNT cannot yet normalise professor pay.
In my view that is an incorrect reference.
Mijns inziens is dat een onterechte verwijzing.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de illegale handel in antibiotica in de veehouderij

An MP asked the government about the illegal trade in antibiotics for livestock farming, including a seizure of 3.5 tonnes, whether the registration system could prevent such trade, and whether further illegal circuits exist and will be investigated. The state secretary answered that the practice is condemned, the network was detected and dismantled by the NVWA, registration cannot prevent illegality but aids enforcement, a new registration duty for antibiotic traders under the Animal Act is coming, and extra enforcement funding is provided, though no indication of further circuits currently exists.
We have no indication that the illegal network in question could have been detected (much) earlier.
Wij hebben geen indicatie dat het betreffende illegale netwerk (veel) eerder had kunnen worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “PvdA niet tevreden met regeling AOW-gat"

The MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about press reports that most early-retirement and pre-pension recipients would not qualify for the new AOW bridging allowance, and about the feasibility, legal form, EU coordination and cross-border health cover of the scheme. The government answered that roughly 80-90% of early-retirees fall outside the means test, that the scheme is a ministerial regulation under the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies with a commitment to brief parliament, and that a legal fix to Zvw article 69 will close the health-cover gap retroactively.
Given the importance of the subject, however, I attach great value to closely involving the House of Representatives in the drafting of the scheme.
Gelet echter op het belang van het onderwerp hecht ik er zeer aan om de Tweede Kamer nauw bij het tot stand komen van de regeling te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ontwikkelingen bij het Integraal Kankercentrum Zuid IKZ en het Integraal Kankercentrum Nederland IKNL

An SP MP asks the health minister about the dismissal of the IKZ director by its supervisory board, a possible board-member conflict of interest under the governance code, and the merger with IKNL; the minister declines to judge the dismissal as an internal matter, says a board member became interim board chair before an interim appointment was made, and states she has no governance-code bill in preparation.
The dismissal of the IKZ director is an internal matter; I do not deal with it.
Het ontslag van de directeur van het IKZ is een interne aangelegenheid, ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de heer van der V. op interim-basis toetreedt tot de raad van bestuur van het Kennemergasthuis

Two MPs asked the government whether the interim appointment of Mr. van der V. to the Kennemergasthuis board, his pay, and the related merger and reorganisation were acceptable and whether he falls under the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister said the supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and pay, that the WNT applies to interim directors after six months, and declined to disclose individual income or comment on the reorganisation and the merger.
The supervisory boards are responsible for appointing directors, including in the case of the Kennemergasthuis.
De Raden van Toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van bestuurders, ook in het geval van het Kennemergasthuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en de Vereniging van Zorgaanbieders voor Zorgcommunicatie (VZVZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about the ties between Nictiz and VZVZ, including whether Mr Velzel negotiated a company car with chauffeur as a secondary employment condition. The minister replied that the work is done under a consultancy contract and that she has no insight into that contract, so she cannot provide the information requested.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen met een verhoogd risico op een kind met het syndroom van Down niet langer in een Nederlandse ziekenhuis terecht kunnen voor een bloedtes

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that LUMC stopped offering a non-invasive prenatal blood test for Down syndrome after a warning that it lacked the licence required under the Population Screening Act. The minister confirmed the warning, said no licence application had yet been filed, and promised to ask the Health Council for advice once one is submitted and to request a signalement on the test's ethical implications.
The ministry of VWS did warn the LUMC because it did not have the licence required under the Population Screening Act (WBO).
Het ministerie van VWS heeft het LUMC echter gewaarschuwd omdat zij niet beschikte over de vergunning die in het kader van de Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek (WBO) nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en VZVZ

Two MPs asked the health minister about the relationship between VZVZ and Nictiz, their funding, and whether VZVZ is a front for the ministry pushing the EPD/LSP. The minister answered that both are legally independent private organisations, that VZVZ is a self-run initiative of care providers funded partly by insurers, and that the government has no knowledge of a consultant contract's terms.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars te duur hebben ingekocht

An MP asks the health minister about reports that health insurers overpaid hospitals in 2012 through lump-sum contracts, including payments for unproduced care and fewer patients. The minister replies that the picture is not yet clear, that contracting is the responsibility of individual insurers and hospitals, that only delivered care may be paid, and that an expert commission's report is expected by 1 April.
I hope to obtain such an overview, but that will still take some time.
Ik hoop een dergelijk overzicht te krijgen, maar dat zal nog wel enige tijd duren.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht dat bij seksueel geweld allochtone jongeren eerder dan autochtone jongeren de schuld bij het slachtoffer leggen

An MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that Moroccan-origin youths blame sexual assault victims more than native Dutch youths, and about the Rutgers WPF research on cultural differences and sexual boundaries. The government answers that the research informed the 'Maak seks lekker duidelijk' campaign, describes existing sex-education programmes in schools and youth health care, and notes that the new core objectives give extra attention to sexuality.
The research showed that cultural background does indeed play a role in young people's views on sexual boundaries.
Het onderzoek heeft laten zien dat culturele achtergrond inderdaad een rol speelt in de opvattingen van jongeren over seksuele grenzen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat medicijnen bij de Benu Apotheek in Borger contant moeten worden afgerekend

MP Van Gerven asked the minister whether Benu pharmacies forcing DSW-insured patients to pay cash for medicines, and related contract disputes with insurers, were acceptable, and where affected patients could go. Minister Schippers answered that the cash-payment arrangement ended on 11 January 2013 after agreement with DSW, that DSW offers restitution policies where cash payment can be required, and that she does not find it unacceptable.
Meanwhile, patients can again claim directly.
Inmiddels kunnen de patiënten weer rechtstreeks declareren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Steeds minder bedrijfsartsen’

MP Voortman asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about a report on the declining number of occupational physicians, including why intake is low, whether the specialty should be publicly funded, and whether statutory access to occupational physicians should be restored. Minister Asscher answered that responsibility for worker health lies first with workers and employers, that the cause of low intake is not yet explained, that the Arbowet deregulation keeps access to occupational physicians a matter for social partners, and that the government will consider the points in its response to the SER advice.
The Minister of SZW will further take your question into account in preparing the cabinet position on the cited SER advice and on the question of occupational health services in the longer term.

De Minister van SZW zal uw vraag voorts betrekken bij de voorbereiding van het kabinetsstandpunt naar aanleiding van genoemd SER-advies en bij het vraagstuk van de bedrijfsgezondheidszorg op de langere termijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Vlietland Ziekenhuis in Vlaardingen de parkeertarieven verhoogt om de kosten van patiëntenzorg mede te kunnen financieren

An SP MP asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that Vlietland Hospital raises parking fees to help finance patient care, and whether other hospitals do the same. The minister answered that parking policy is a matter for the hospital itself, that she has no information on other hospitals, and that she sees no reason for action.
I am of the opinion that the government should not concern itself with a hospital's parking policy.
Ik ben van mening dat de overheid zich niet moet bezighouden met het parkeerbeleid van een ziekenhuis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over contant betalen bij de apotheek

An MP asks the health minister about insured DSW clients of BENU/Escura/Lloyd pharmacies being told to pay cash because no contract exists, and whether insurers must disclose contracted providers before enrolment. The minister says a new contract was concluded, that restitution policies oblige insurers to reimburse, that NZa supervises disclosure rules, and that a legislative amendment and talks on faster contracting are underway, while refusing a legal right to switch insurers twice a year.
I will keep you informed of the progress.
Ik zal u van de voortgang op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het stopzetten van de vervoersregeling voor gehandicapte teamsporters

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether she is aware that the Fonds Gehandicaptensport has ended its transport scheme for disabled team athletes due to insufficient funds, and whether she will seek a structural solution. The minister confirmed the facts and stated that she is consulting with stakeholders on options for a structural solution, promising to inform parliament by 15 March 2013.
Together with the parties involved, I am in consultation to explore the possibilities of reaching a structural solution for the transport scheme.
Samen met betrokken partijen ben ik in overleg om de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om tot een structurele oplossing te komen voor de vervoersregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat twee Brabantse ziekenhuizen een fusie melden bij de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (NMa)

An SP MP asked the health minister about a merger notification by two Brabant hospitals to the competition authority NMa, including concentration of obstetric care, accessibility, finances, and whether the NMa should pause approvals pending the parliamentary fusion-test bill. The minister answered that concentration of births is defended on quality grounds, the 45-minute norm is safeguarded, and she cannot or will not pause NMa decisions since only the NMa may assess mergers under current law.
I did not commission the specific studies and therefore cannot provide them to you.
De specifieke onderzoeken heb ik niet laten uitvoeren en kan ik u dus niet doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het CBG is gezwicht om een vaginaal antischimmelmiddel op de vrije markt te brengen

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the CBG yielded to pressure in moving a vaginal antifungal from prescription-only to pharmacy-and-drugstore sale, and what studies underpinned the change. The minister answered that the CBG decides independently on scientific grounds, that the leaflet lists all alarm symptoms, and that post-market monitoring of the product will continue.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de stijging van het aantal dierproeven

An MP asks the government about the rise in animal experiments reported by the NVWA and related questions on stock animals, violations, and information provision. The state secretary answers that the trend fits a slightly declining long-term pattern, that the government aims to reduce animal testing, and that Dutch reporting is already extensive, with a promised policy letter in March.
I intend to send you a progress letter in mid-March in which I will further address my level of ambition.
Ik zal u in de stand van zaken brief die ik voornemens ben medio maart aan u te doen toekomen nader ingaan op mijn ambitieniveau.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de derde generatie anticonceptiepil in Frankrijk niet meer wordt vergoed

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the Netherlands views France's decision to stop reimbursing third-generation contraceptive pills over a doubled thrombosis risk, and whether the Dutch reimbursement should end too. The minister replied that each country sets its own reimbursement, that second-generation pills are preferred but third-generation pills remain available for individual cases, and that there is no new evidence warranting ending reimbursement.
So I see no reason to stop reimbursing the third-generation contraceptive pill.
Ik zie dus geen reden om de derde generatie anticonceptiepil niet meer te vergoeden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Schouw over het bericht dat er nauwelijks controle is op het rookverbod in de horeca

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality is too thin, given roughly 3,154 targeted checks by the NVWA in 2012, uneven regional coverage and reported fine figures. The state secretary answered that enforcement is as optimal as current capacity allows, that the problem is concentrated in cafés and discotheques, that about 4,000 targeted checks are planned for 2013, and that he is examining options to expand enforcement capacity.
I am currently examining the options to increase enforcement capacity.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment de mogelijkheden om de handhavingscapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de onzekerheid ten aanzien van wijkverpleegkundigen in de Zichtbare Schakel

An MP asked the health minister whether municipalities were spending only half of the Zichtbare Schakel budget on district nurse projects and how spending would be monitored. The minister said the projects are not being stopped, municipalities may not redirect the funds, and ZonMw will set up a monitor, though details remain undecided.
On your questions about municipalities not spending the funds on Zichtbare schakel projects, we cannot give an answer given the answers to the previous questions.
Op uw vragen over het niet besteden van de middelen door gemeenten aan Zichtbare schakel projecten kunnen wij – gegeven de antwoorden op voorgaande vragen – geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Ziekenhuisfusies zonder winnaar”

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister about reports that hospital mergers in the Netherlands have pushed hospitals beyond optimal size, raising costs, and whether the competition regulator should get stronger tools and the burden of proof on mergers should be reversed. The minister replies that optimal size is not absolute, that mergers are neither inherently undesirable nor desirable, that a pending bill adds mandatory merger impact reports and a care-specific merger test by the NZa, and that she sees the existing two-track merger review as adequate.
As long as the bill establishing the care-specific merger test has not been adopted, I write to all hospitals that indicate they want to merge and point them to the provisions of that bill.

Zolang het wetsontwerp dat de zorgspecifieke fusietoets (zie verder hieronder) nog niet is aangenomen schrijf ik alle ziekenhuizen die aangeven te willen fuseren aan en wijs ik hen op de bepalingen uit dat wetsontwerp.

Antwoord vragen Leijten over de gevolgen van de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage voor de AWBZ en de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) als gevolg van de introductie van een vermogensinkomensbijtelling

An SP MP asked the health minister about hardship caused by the new capital-income surcharge (vermogensinkomensbijtelling) raising AWBZ and Wmo co-payments, including how many people were affected, whether people must borrow to pay, and what measures will be taken. The state secretary answered that 63,532 intramural clients saw a changed co-payment, that about 4,800 may need to draw on their capital, and that a 'review' with the Chamber would come first before any measures.
I consider it proper first to consult the Chamber on which consequences it deems undesirable.
Ik acht het zuiver eerst met de Kamer in overleg te treden over de vraag welke gevolgen kennelijk door de Kamer ongewenst worden geacht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het toezicht van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) op de ouderenzorg

Mr Krol (50PLUS) asked the minister whether the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) made about 100 inspection visits to elderly care in 2012, whether its target is being met, and what complaints it received on unqualified staff, hygiene and medication. The state secretary denies the 100-visit figure, reports 507 visits to 1 November 2012, says the target will be completed in early 2013, and reports 2,200 complaints, mostly about falls.
In 2012 the IGZ carried out a total of 507 inspection visits in elderly care up to 1 November 2012.
In 2012 heeft de IGZ tot 1 november 2012 in totaal 507 inspectiebezoeken afgelegd in de ouderenzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het artikel ‘verslavingszorg zelf ontspoord’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that newly founded addiction clinics charge high residential rates, use non-specialist staff for therapy, and admit patients without medical need, and whether these are systemic or isolated. The minister answered that data show post-2008 clinics declare mainly in the higher residential categories, that insurers can refuse or reclaim improper declarations, that a guideline on head-therapist roles is being prepared, and that a 33% bed reduction is agreed with the sector, while disputing the reported revenue figure.
If health insurers find that declarations are unlawful or inefficient, they need not reimburse those declarations.
Als zorgverzekeraars constateren dat er onrechtmatig of ondoelmatig wordt gedeclareerd, dan hoeven zij die declaraties niet te vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over ontspoorde verslavingszorg

The MP asks whether the minister is aware of reports that addiction care is out of control: new providers billing high-intensity categories, a lack of volume caps, admissions not medically necessary, and unqualified therapists. The minister answers that insurers must check billing, that the 2012 agreements and a bed reduction target apply, and promises a risk analysis on fraud in mental health care including addiction care, with results later that year.
It is up to health insurers to check whether these claims are justified and whether the care provided is efficient.
Het is aan zorgverzekeraars om na te gaan of deze declaraties terecht zijn en of de geleverde zorg doelmatig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de misleidende patiëntenwerving van GGZ-instelling Indigo

An SP MP asked the health minister about GGZ provider Indigo's metro advertising offering free first consultations without a GP referral, and whether this inflates care use and undermines the GP gatekeeper role. The minister answered that the practice appears to fall within the Zvw rules, that the GP still refers patients, and that she will ask the NZa to monitor such practices.
I will ask the NZa to closely monitor this kind of practice.
Ik zal de NZa vragen dit soort handelswijzen nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de aanpak omtrent de Q-koorts

An MP asked the health minister about the Q-koorts (Q fever) response, including the gap between infections, illnesses and notifications, whether a separate reporting point is needed, and whether the policy aims to restore trust in government. The minister answered that mandatory notification already covers acute cases, that chronic cases are monitored through existing databases and screening, and that a limited population study in Herpen will be funded, while pointing to earlier letters for the broader aims.
As I recently indicated in answers to questions from MP Van Gerven, I will fund a population study on chronic Q fever in Herpen on an incidental basis.
Zoals ik onlangs in antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Gerven heb aangegeven zal ik een bevolkingsonderzoek naar chronische Q-koorts in Herpen incidenteel financieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen een bezoek aan de huisarts mijden vanwege een hoger eigen risico

An SP MP asked the health minister about a NIVEL survey showing people avoid GP visits due to a higher deductible, and whether this harms access, health and socio-economic health gaps. The minister answered that the findings are not surprising, that no evidence yet shows people forgo necessary care, that the deductible increase is largely compensated via healthcare allowance, and that no new study is planned.
So far it has not been shown that the mandatory deductible leads insured persons to forgo necessary care.
Tot nu toe is niet gebleken dat het verplicht eigen risico ertoe leidt dat verzekerden afzien van noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht 'Inzet wijkverpleegkundigen op de tocht'

An MP asked the health minister whether roughly half of the 'zichtbare schakel' budget for extra district nurses would no longer be used for that purpose by municipalities, and whether the funding would remain. The minister denied that the budget is being diverted, explaining the uneven yearly amounts as a result of late project starts, and said the funding was made structural for at least two years while the future financing model and the 2015 intensification are still being worked out.
The success of the visible link must be continued.
Het succes van de zichtbare schakel moet worden voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de werkwijze van de IGZ

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the state secretary about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) supervision of nursing homes after a broadcast in which staff said their complaints were ignored, including whether unannounced visits and transparency of reports could be improved. The state secretary defended the IGZ's risk-based approach, stated that a third of general inspection visits are unannounced, noted that all general and thematic reports are published, and said a policy response to two external reports will follow.
The inspectorate publishes all reports from its general and thematic supervision in elderly care on its website.
De inspectie maakt alle rapporten van haar algemene toezicht en thematisch toezicht in de ouderenzorg openbaar op haar website.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg geen dagboek over de situatie in een verpleeghuis in ontvangst wilde nemen

MP Leijten asks why the health inspectorate refused to accept a diary describing conditions in a nursing home and whether this reflects weak inspectorate involvement in elderly care. The state secretary replies that the IGZ asked to receive the diary and will take it into its supervision, and that the inspectorate intensified its elderly-care oversight from 2011 with visits to all care providers, to be completed in early 2013.
The IGZ told the provider, in response to the invitation to publicly receive the book, that it would like to be sent the book and will take it into account in its supervision.

De IGZ heeft in haar reactie op de uitnodiging om het genoemde boek publiekelijk in ontvangst te nemen aan de aanbieder laten weten dat zij het boek graag toegestuurd krijgt en zal betrekken bij haar toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat grootverpakkingen paracetamol uit de schappen verdwijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CBG's decision to cap pack sizes of paracetamol 500 mg for pharmacy and drugstore sale, whether paracetamol should be restricted further given overdose and suicide attempt trends, and whether general-sale status should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the CBG, not the minister, decides on classification, supported the pack-size cap as risk minimisation, and saw no scientific basis for further restrictions.
It is not for me to decide on this. That is the task of the CBG.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover besluiten te nemen. Dit is de taak van het CBG.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de medicijncheck

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reported medication-related hospital admissions among older people, survey figures on pharmacist and GP medication checks, and whether an annual medication check should be mandatory in the basic health insurance package. The minister said the cited figures were not based on a government study, found the savings estimate unrealistic, and noted that periodic medication review already falls under pharmaceutical care that insurers and professionals can arrange, so no mandatory inclusion is planned.

As I also indicated in answering questions 7 and 8, periodic medication review already forms part of the entitlement to pharmaceutical care, and insurers and doctors/pharmacists can make further arrangements about it.

Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 7 en 8 heb aangegeven, maakt de periodieke medicatiebeoordeling al onderdeel uit van de aanspraak op farmaceutische zorg en kunnen verzekeraars en artsen/apothekers hier nadere afspraken over maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over bericht dat de vooruitgang van patiëntveiligheid in ziekenhuizen traag gaat

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the slow progress on patient safety in hospitals is confirmed, why the VMS programme's goal of halving preventable deaths was missed, and how the government will continue and fund patient safety efforts after 2012. The Minister acknowledges that progress is slower than desired, says the 2012 target outcome is still being studied and promises a follow-up letter, and points to sector-led agreements and existing ZonMw programmes as the way forward.
It is still too early to conclude that this target has not been met, but the figures from the latest measurement are not optimistic.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te concluderen dat deze doelstelling niet is gehaald, maar de cijfers van de laatste meting stemmen niet optimistisch.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veen over het artikel ‘VieCuri stelt twee radiologen op non-actief’

An MP asked the minister about press reports that hospital VieCuri suspended two radiologists, and the timeline between the complaint, the investigation and the suspension. The minister answered that an independent investigation was commissioned in September 2012, the suspensions followed on 10 December 2012, and termination of the admission agreements was issued in January 2013.
I have made inquiries about this both with the Board of Directors of VieCuri and with the Inspectorate.
Ik heb hiervoor zowel bij de Raad van Bestuur van het VieCuri als bij de Inspectie navraag laten doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het contracteerbeleid van zorgverzekeraars bij logopedisten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister why insurers offer speech therapists tariffs 6.5 to 13% below the NZa maximum, questioning the NZa's inaction and insurers' market power. The minister answered that maximum tariffs leave insurers free to contract lower, that the NZa has found no grounds for intervention, and that the matter is for competition oversight rather than a norm income for therapists.
The NZa has no indications that corrective action against insurers is needed because they would be impeding competition by abusing their presumed purchasing power.
De NZa heeft geen indicaties dat er corrigerend tegen verzekeraars moet worden opgetreden omdat zij de concurrentie zouden belemmeren door misbruik te maken van hun veronderstelde inkoopmacht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over onderzoek naar Q-koorts in Herpen

MP Van Gerven asked about the status of a Q-fever foundation with ten million euros for research, and whether the minister would support a population study in Herpen proposed by provincial health authorities. The minister referred to an earlier letter on the foundation, said experts advised against general screening but a targeted study in Herpen could be funded as an incidental project subject to ethical conditions.
Because the Q-fever foundation is still being set up and there is a broadly shared wish to start this research quickly, I will finance this as an incidental project
Omdat de stichting inzake Q-koorts nog in oprichting is en er een breed gedragen wens is om snel met dit onderzoek te starten, zal ik dit als een incidenteel project financieren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de ontwikkelingen rond het geitenbedrijf in Ambt Delden, en de relatie volksgezondheid en intensieve veehouderij

An MP asks whether a goat farm in Ambt Delden keeping about 1000 goats without proper permit has a valid permit, whether a plan for 5000 goats is pending, and how this fits with the cabinet's position on maximum farm size and public health risks such as Q fever. The state secretary replies that the environmental permit is still under review after public consultation, that the government will issue a policy response on the Health Council advice by 1 March 2013 including on size limits, fine particulate matter and buffer distances, and that vaccination of goats makes elevated Q fever risk for residents unlikely.
The cabinet will give Parliament a policy response to this advice no later than 1 March 2013.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer uiterlijk 1 maart 2013 een beleidsreactie geven op dit advies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur weer aan het werk zou zijn (geweest) in Duitsland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how the government responded to reports that the disciplined neurologist Jansen Steur was working in Germany, what steps were taken with German authorities, and how similar cases could be prevented across the EU. The minister said the IGZ contacted the Bezirksregierung Arnsberg about documents submitted in 2006, pointed to the cover letter for most substantive answers, and outlined existing tools such as restrictive measures in the BIG register and cross-border cooperation through HPCB.

I will explicitly point the competent authorities in the EU Member States to the list of measures under the BIG Act on the BIG register website and draw their attention to the amendments to the BIG Act since July 2012.

Ik zal de bevoegde autoriteiten in de lidstaten van de EU uitdrukkelijk wijzen op de lijst met maatregelen Wet BIG op de website van het BIG-register en hen daarbij wijzen op de wijzigingen van de Wet BIG sinds juli 2012.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over de ontwikkelingen rondom neuroloog Jansen Steur

MP Klever (PVV) asked the health minister about reports that neurologist Jansen Steur obtained a German post via the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ), about an IGZ settlement with him, whether voluntary BIG-register deregistration is possible, why he was not suspended in 2003, and how to prevent doctors from deregistering voluntarily and to require background checks at job applications. The minister answered that the answers depend on how the German hospital handled IGZ information, that voluntary deregistration is possible at any time, and referred most questions to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
I refer you to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
Ik verwijs u naar paragraaf 4 van de begeleidende brief.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur een verklaring van geen bezwaar zou hebben gekregen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether a German hospital's claim that neurologist Jansen Steur obtained a Dutch certificate of good conduct in 2006 is accurate, and how the minister views her remark that the hospital should have googled him. The minister referred to the accompanying letter for the origin of the certificate and the IGZ's handling, and argued that the 2006 certificate was not relevant to a 2011 application and that employers should check non-national sources and request recent certificates.
I refer you to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
Ik verwijs u naar paragraaf 4 van de begeleidende brief.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat dhr. Jansen Steur zich in 2006 geregistreerd heeft in Duitsland als arts?

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Jansen Steur registered as a doctor in Germany in 2006, which bodies knew, how the IGZ and prosecutors handled the matter, and why he was allowed to work abroad. The minister confirmed the German registration, explained the IGZ's 2006 decisions and the ongoing criminal case, and said he cannot work in the Netherlands because he is not BIG-registered.
The Public Prosecution Service sent several requests for legal assistance to the German authorities in the investigation that led to the case now pending before the Almelo court.

Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in het kader van het onderzoek dat heeft geleid tot de rechtszaak die nu aanhangig is bij de rechtbank Almelo, meerdere rechtshulpverzoeken doen uitgaan naar de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rog over het onderzoek in de affaire Jansen Steur

Three CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers whether the scientific work of neurologist Jansen Steur should be examined, why no body had reviewed it earlier, and about his publications and drug-trial involvement. The minister agreed the reasoning on unreliable research is sound, explained that the IGZ halted its probe after the criminal investigation was dropped, and promised to consult Medisch Spectrum Twente and the KNAW on reviewing the publications.
I will first consult with the former employer of Mr Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, on the design and results of the study into publications set up by that institution.

Er zal door mij eerst met de voormalige werkgever van de heer Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, overlegd worden over opzet en resultaten van het door deze instelling opgezette onderzoek naar publicaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de beroepsbeperkende afspraken door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the legal basis and enforceability of informal professional restriction agreements the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) made with doctors, notably the Jansen Steur case, and about limitation periods and transparency. The minister replied that since 2010 the IGZ uses only public-law measures, that past agreements were not centrally registered, and that IGZ can request expedited tuchtrecht handling but will not reopen past agreements, while promising to refer one question to the CBG.
Since September 2010 the policy is that the IGZ may no longer make private-law professional restriction agreements, but uses its statutory powers to take public-law measures.

Sinds september 2010 geldt het beleid dat de IGZ geen privaatrechtelijke, beroepsbeperkende afspraken meer mag maken, maar gebruik maakt van haar wettelijke bevoegdheden om publiekrechtelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gezondheidsrisico's van de alternatieve behandeling chelatietherapie

Bouwmeester (PvdA) asked the health minister how the government views chelation therapy for heart and vascular disease, which the Health Council deemed unacceptable, and what the IGZ can do, the number of clinics, adverse-event reporting and disciplinary cases. Minister Schippers answered that there is no evidence of efficacy beyond metal poisoning, that the IGZ can act on unsafe practice but not merely because a treatment is ineffective, that adverse events are minimally reported, and that two clinics and two disciplinary rulings concerning one case are known.
The mere fact that an alternative treatment is ineffective, such as chelation therapy for heart and vascular disease, is in itself indeed no reason for enforcement action by the IGZ.
Alleen het enkele feit dat een alternatieve behandeling onwerkzaam is, zoals chelatietherapie bij hartvaatziekte, is als zodanig inderdaad geen aanleiding voor handhavend optreden door IGZ.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over het gevaar van matchfixing in het Nederlandse voetbal

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the danger of match-fixing in Dutch football, citing a criminologist's claim that police and prosecutors do not take it seriously. The minister denied this, pointed to an ongoing study of match-fixing, noted the new gambling regulator's enforcement, and welcomed the KNVB's own anti-match-fixing plans.
As your House is aware, the Ministries of Health, Welfare and Sport and of Security and Justice are currently commissioning research into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend is laten de Ministeries van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie momenteel onderzoek doen naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gebruik van alcohol tijden de zwangerschap

An MP asked the health minister about inconsistent no-alcohol advice in pregnancy among gynaecologists, midwives and GPs, and what government should do to publicise it and target low-SES women. The minister acknowledged the findings, said professional bodies and the Partnership Vroegsignalering Alcohol will raise awareness, pointed to existing preconception campaigns and municipal duties, and gave no new binding commitment.
The PVA will bring the gynaecologists' shortcoming to the attention of the KNMG, with which it cooperates on early signalling.

Het PVA zal het knelpunt voor wat betreft gynaecologen onder de aandacht brengen via de Koninklijke Nederlandsche Maatschappij tot bevordering der Geneeskunst (KNMG), waarmee samenwerking op het gebied van vroegsignalering plaatsvindt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de te hoge werkdruk bij verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the minister about nursing staff reporting workloads too high to keep working until retirement, and asked how the government would retain care staff and reduce workload. The minister answered that the employer and employees bear primary responsibility, cited existing arbo tools and inspectorate checks, and listed government programmes on sustainable employability and professional pride.
It is primarily their responsibility, together with employees, to manage the workload and improve job satisfaction.
Het is primair hun verantwoordelijkheid om, in samenwerking met werknemers, de werkdruk te beheersen en de werktevredenheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) zeer zwakke onderzoeksmethodes gebruikt

An MP asks whether the Dutch health care authority NZa's research on orthodontic tariffs is reliable, after a Leiden professor criticised its quantitative study, and whether NZa research can still be used. The minister says the professor's criticism concerns only one quantitative study, that the NZa's wider body of research is sound, and that no new agreements with the NZa are needed.
In view of the full set of studies, I see no reason in Prof. Gill's criticism to stop using the NZa's data in future.
Ik zie, mede in het licht van het geheel aan onderzoeken, in de kritiek van prof. Gill dan ook geen aanleiding om de gegevens van de NZa voortaan niet meer te gebruiken.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de waarde van een diploma naar aanleiding van een LOOT-programma

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether diplomas from LOOT elite-athlete programmes, with exemptions, carry the same value as regular diplomas, after a turnster was refused entry to a Saxion course because an exemption in economics left her deficient. The government answered that LOOT diplomas are full entry qualifications, that the refusal followed the course's own specific prerequisite, that the evaluation is due in summer 2013, and that no other similar cases are known.
Yes, that is correct. Pupils following an adapted programme in secondary education under the LOOT licence policy rule can obtain a full final diploma.

Leerlingen die een aangepast programma volgen op het middelbaar onderwijs in het kader van mijn Beleidsregel verstrekking Loot-licentie voortgezet onderwijs 1 , kunnen een volwaardig einddiploma verwerven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over speelnatuur en groene schoolpleinen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the health and education ministers about the benefits of green school playgrounds and whether the government supports their spread. The minister replied that municipalities and school boards are responsible, that the government welcomes such initiatives, and that VWS will stimulate healthy school playgrounds from 2013 using extra anti-obesity funds.
The national government has no direct responsibility for the design of school playgrounds and natural play areas.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen directe verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de inrichting van schoolpleinen en speelnatuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over matchfixing in de topsport

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about press reports that tennis player Raemon Sluiter was approached about match-fixing, and why the government said there was no evidence of it in the Netherlands, and about an anonymous reporting line and the handling of old reports. The minister replied that a broad study into the nature and extent of match-fixing is underway, that an anonymous reporting line is being considered, and that the Public Prosecution Service can investigate reports that meet the criminal-law criteria.

That is why I am having, together with my colleague of Justice and Security, an in-depth study carried out into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands and the possibilities to prevent, detect and tackle it.

Vandaar dat ik samen met mijn ambtgenoot van Veiligheid en Justitie een diepgaand onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland en de mogelijkheden om matchfixing te voorkomen, op te sporen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat jongeren onder 18 jaar nog steeds tot zonnebankstudio’s worden toegelaten

MPs Bruins Slot and Geurts asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that studios still admit under-18s to sunbeds, with many non-member studios breaking the age rule. Minister Schippers acknowledged non-compliance (about 80% overall compliance, higher among SVZ members), defended existing Warenwet rules and NVWA enforcement, and declined for now to criminalise minors or introduce an age-check obligation.
For now, the current legislation, aimed at sunbed providers, is sufficient.
Vooralsnog is de huidige wetgeving, gericht op de aanbieders van zonnebanken, afdoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de plannen voor de bouw van een nertsenhouderij nabij Stevensbeek

An MP asked the state secretaries whether a mink farm planned near Stevensbeek, close to a school, an orchard and sports fields, was desirable, and whether they would intervene despite a moratorium and an expected health council advice. The government answered that the municipality is responsible for the environmental permit, that it saw no way to intervene in ongoing permit applications, and that the cabinet's policy response to the health council advice would reach parliament by 1 March 2013.
During that debate I indicated that I see no possibilities to intervene in ongoing permit applications and that this is a municipal responsibility.
Tijdens die behandeling heb ik aangegeven geen mogelijkheden te zien om in te grijpen in lopende vergunningaanvragen en dat het hier een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid betreft.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over maatregelen die moeten voorkomen dat mensen gaan roken

An opposition MP asks the health minister why the government opposes stronger tobacco rules at EU level, such as graphic warnings, fewer cigarette vending machines, minimum age 18 and additive regulation, and why Dutch rankings and smoker numbers have worsened. The state secretary answers that no Commission proposal exists yet so no position is taken, plans to raise the minimum age to 18, and says it is too early to call the rise in smokers a trend.
I intend to raise this age to 18, as is already the case in most EU member states.
Ik ben voornemens om deze leeftijd te verhogen naar 18 jaar, net als in de meeste EU-lidstaten al het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de toename van het aantal rokers

An MP asks the health minister about a report showing a rise in smokers, its causes (small-café exemption, unfunded quit programmes, no anti-smoking campaigns), and whether quit programmes and new tobacco measures will be continued. The state secretary refers to earlier answers on some points, says quit-smoking care enters the basic insurance from 2013 and that existing tobacco measures stay in force, and announces more prevention for youth and a higher minimum purchase age of 18.
In addition, I intend to raise the minimum age for purchasing tobacco to 18.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens de minimumleeftijd voor het kopen van tabak te verhogen naar 18 jaar.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het hoge aantal sterfgevallen in het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse

An MP asked the health minister about the high number of deaths at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital in Spijkenisse, why this surfaced only now, how patients and relatives are informed, and when inspection findings will come. The minister described the inspectorate's measures (admission stop, transfer of cardiology patients, supervised supervision, a ban on the cardiology group), the communication channels, and that results depend on ongoing investigations.
The IGZ is investigating whether patients of the doctors involved received the care they should have received under the professional standard.
De IGZ onderzoekt of patiënten van de betrokken artsen de zorg hebben gekregen die zij op basis van de professionele standaard hadden moeten krijgen
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de sluiting van de afdeling cardiologie in Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis te Spijkenisse

An MP asked the health minister whether patients died from cardiologists' errors at Ruwaard van Putten hospital, whether patients were informed, and what lessons would be learned. The minister answered that the IGZ intervened with a closure order and enhanced supervision, that a Medirede report found substandard care, that IGZ and an internal review are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament later while citing privacy.
Taking into account the privacy of the patients involved and medical confidentiality, I will inform your House of the results of this investigation in due course.
Met inachtneming van de privacy van de betrokken patiënten en het medisch beroepsgeheim zal ik uw Kamer ter gelegener tijd informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about deaths linked to errors at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the regulator's response. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admissions stop, transfer of cardiac patients, supervision, a ban on cardiologists providing care) and that the hospital and Inspectorate are investigating patient files, while withholding timing and detailed results pending the ongoing investigations.
Taking into account the privacy of the patients involved and medical confidentiality, I will inform your House in due course about the results of this investigation.
Met inachtneming van de privacy van de betrokken patiënten en het medisch beroepsgeheim zal ik uw Kamer ter gelegener tijd informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de mogelijk onveilige situatie in het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked Minister Schippers about possibly unsafe conditions at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, including why the Inspectorate did not intervene earlier and whether patient safety and ambulance access are guaranteed. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admission stop, transfers, six-month enhanced supervision, a ban on the cardiology group) and that it is examining safety across all departments, while defending the timing of its interventions and the ambulance arrangements.
Since 15 November, the Ruwaard van Putten hospital as a whole has been under enhanced supervision by the IGZ.
Het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis staat sinds 15 november jl. in zijn geheel onder verscherpt toezicht van de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat Amerika mogelijk in het EPD (Elektronisch Patiëntendossier) kan kijken

An MP asked whether the Patriot Act or FISA could allow US authorities to access Dutch electronic patient records held through CSC, the US firm that built the national LSP. The minister said VZVZ demanded a guarantee from CSC, that Dutch privacy law must be complied with, and that the matter is raised at EU level, while leaving oversight to the IGZ and CBP.
I do not consider it acceptable that Dutch law and regulations are not applied and complied with.
Ik vind het niet toelaatbaar dat de Nederlandse wet en regelgeving niet wordt toegepast en nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rutte over basis-ggz bij huisartsen

Mr Rutte (VVD) asks whether GP-delivered basic mental health care is being squeezed by proposed forward integration of mental health institutions and by the Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ, which could push GPs into a diagnostic-only role and raise costs. Minister Schippers replies that GPs keep a central role, that the POH-GGZ module is being expanded and made functional from 2014, and that forward integration will be prevented through insurer steering on referrals.
With the module being made functional from 2014, other care providers (broadly defined) can indeed contract and organise this POH-GGZ module.
Met het functioneel maken van deze module per 2014 kunnen inderdaad ook andere zorgaanbieders (in brede zin) deze module POH-GGZ contracteren en organiseren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de MRSA-bacterie op vleeskuikenboerderijen

An MP asked the health minister and state secretary about MRSA found on broiler farms and in slaughterhouse workers, the NVWA's advice to reduce antibiotic use and change stunning methods, and what measures are planned. The government answered that antibiotic reduction targets and guidance for exposed workers are in place, that further research on ducks and turkeys is commissioned for 2013, and that stunning changes follow EU rules.
That is why measures have been taken against the cause of multi-resistant bacteria.
Daarom zijn er maatregelen ingezet tegen de oorzaak van het voorkomen van multiresistente bacteriën.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu en Bouwmeester over het vooraf betalen van het eigen risico in de bijstand

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked whether it is acceptable that Agis collects the compulsory deductible monthly in advance from welfare recipients in Amersfoort, whether the minister will intervene, and whether the refund timing is fair. Minister Schippers replied that the collective scheme is voluntary, that municipalities and insurers may agree such arrangements, that refunds come by end 2014 because care billing lags, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason for further consultation with ZN and the VNG, because the arrangement is voluntary.
Ik zie geen reden tot nader overleg met ZN en de VNG, omdat de regeling op vrijwillige basis is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht ‘Chaos troef bij Topklasser FC Chabab; zwart geld, witte lijnen.’

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a former main sponsor of FC Chabab used the club to launder drug money, whether drug money laundering via football clubs has occurred before, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the investigation concerned drug dealing rather than laundering through the club, that no convictions for laundering via football clubs are known, and that anti-laundering measures and a bill raising penalties are in preparation.

The criminal investigation by the National Public Prosecutor's Office into the former main sponsor of FC Chabab, referred to in the article cited in question 1, did not concern laundering drug money through this club.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Landelijk Parket dat plaatsgevonden heeft naar de voormalige hoofdsponsor van FC Chabab en waaraan in het in vraag 1 aangehaalde artikel wordt gerefereerd had geen betrekking op het witwassen van drugsgelden via deze vereniging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een antidopingcommissie in het Nederlandse wielrennen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the newly created doping inquiry commission in Dutch cycling, including the ministry's role, the commission's access to justice information, and its added value relative to the Doping Authority. The minister answered that the ministry shapes the mandate, subsidises up to a third of costs and sits on a supervisory group, that the commission has confidential testimony powers the Doping Authority lacks, and that the Doping Authority's existing powers are adequate.
I cannot comment further on the powers of foreign judicial authorities to share such information.
Ik kan mij verder niet uitlaten over de bevoegdheden van buitenlandse justitiële autoriteiten om dergelijke informatie te delen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitwisseling van gegevens van veroordeelde artsen tussen Nederland en België

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about data exchange between the Netherlands and Belgium on disciplined doctors and whether Dutch inspectorate sanctions are passed to Belgian authorities. The minister agreed exchange needs improving, said talks with Belgium aim at mutual recognition of sanctions, and described existing exchange and public BIG-register disclosure, but gave no concrete new commitment.

With Belgium I want to make clear agreements on taking over disciplinary and criminal measures against healthcare providers, so that situations as described in your enclosed newspaper article are kept to a minimum.

Met België wil ik over het overnemen van de tucht – en strafmaatregelen van zorgverleners duidelijke afspraken maken, zodat situaties als beschreven in uw bijgevoegde krantenartikel tot een minimum beperkt blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het beleid bij IGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the IGZ enforces the duty of hospitals to report calamities on time, including fines, reporting quality, protection of whistleblowers and the safety culture. Minister Schippers answered that fines are possible but only three warnings and no fines have been issued, and she described the IGZ's enforcement framework and the pending bill on splitting large organisations.
The IGZ has to date not imposed any administrative fine for failing to report a calamity without delay.
De IGZ heeft tot op heden geen bestuurlijke boete opgelegd voor het niet onverwijld melden van een calamiteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het geruzie in het VUmc

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports of a possible conspiracy and patient-safety dangers at the VUmc hospital, including how many complaints the Inspectorate has received and what consequences follow. The minister replied that the Inspectorate is investigating the reports, will decide on follow-up actions based on that inquiry, and will refer possible crimes to the Public Prosecution Service, while declining to give complaint numbers yet.
The report in question is currently being investigated by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
De betreffende melding wordt momenteel door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het geruzie in het VUmc en de gevolgen daarvan en het wederom niet melden van een sterfgeval

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about infighting among specialists at VUmc, the IGZ's handling of an external review, and an unreported patient death during surgery. The minister answered that the IGZ asked VUmc to finish its own review first, that the death is being investigated by VUmc at the IGZ's request, and that the inspectorate sees no immediate need for further measures while monitoring under heightened supervision.
The inspectorate asked the hospital to complete its own investigation.
De inspectie heeft het ziekenhuis verzocht het eigen onderzoek af te ronden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraars

The SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether insurers' preferential drug policy has gone too far, endangering drug supply and encroaching on doctors' prescribing, and whether a uniform national scheme should replace it. The minister rejected the claim of excessive insurer power, said the insurers' duty of care is judged by the NZa and that complaints about drugs are few, and refused to abolish apothecary discounts and bonuses.
I do not have the requested information on the number of cases in which the drug dispensed is not the one the doctor marked with 'MN' (medical necessity) on the prescription.

Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie met betrekking tot het aantal gevallen waarin niet het geneesmiddel wordt verstrekt dat de dokter met «MN» (medische noodzaak) op het recept heeft aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over besparingen in de zorg

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about FD proposals for healthcare savings, including tightening the drug price law along Norwegian lines, lowering the GVS reimbursement limits, a preventable co-payment system for medical aids, and transparency of drug prices. The minister said the income-based premium is off the table, the WGP study will be answered later, the savings estimates are not supported, and she rejects the limit-based systems and the public price list proposal.
I will not send the House a proposal for such a system, because limit-based reimbursement has disadvantages
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer geen voorstel voor een dergelijk systeem sturen, omdat aan het hanteren van vergoedingslimieten nadelen zijn verbonden
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers afwijken van medicijnrichtlijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister how to respond to a broadcast showing pharmacists deviating from prescriptions by dispensing generic medicines, and whether this harms patients, insurers' preferential-drug policy, and patient access. The minister argued generics are equivalent, that prescribers can block substitution by stating medical necessity, that pharmacists must consult patient and doctor, and that no further research or measures were needed.
No, that is not known to me. The mere fact that a medicine is generic does not detract from its effect and quality. Further research does not seem warranted.
Nee, dat is mij niet bekend. Het enkele feit dat een geneesmiddel generiek is, doet niets af aan de werking en de kwaliteit van het middel.
Antwoord vragen Agnes Mulder en Bruins Slot over het besluit om bevallingen vanaf 1 januari 2013 niet meer in het Diaconessenhuis in Meppel te laten plaatsvinden

MPs Agnes Mulder and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the health minister whether the decision to stop childbirth at the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel from 1 January 2013 was driven by a shortage of gynaecologists, and about alternatives, effects on rural access and home birth, and compliance with national norms. The minister answered that the hospital board decided on quality and efficiency grounds, that the looming gynaecologist shortage was decisive, that acute obstetric care moves to Zwolle with ambulance arrangements, and that costs remain unclear.
It is still unclear how high the costs and cost reductions resulting from this decision precisely are.
Onduidelijk is nog hoe hoog de kosten en reductie van kosten als gevolg van dit besluit precies zijn
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Verloskunde Sionsberg sluit definitief in december’

MPs De Rouwe and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about the early closure of obstetrics at De Sionsberg hospital, including community consultation, IGZ involvement, travel times and home birth. The minister replied that the closure follows staff departures, that the IGZ was informed and had accepted a reorganisation plan, and that measures were taken to keep emergency access within 45 minutes.
The decision to stop clinical obstetrics at De Sionsberg earlier follows the departure of staff, in anticipation of the closure of the clinical obstetrics department in May 2013.
Het besluit om eerder te stoppen met de klinische verloskunde in De Sionsberg volgt op het vertrek van medewerkers, vooruitlopend op de sluiting van de afdeling klinische verloskunde in mei 2013.
Antwoord vragen Klever over het bericht dat patiënten van de Antonius apotheek geen medicijnen krijgen als zij niet aangesloten zijn op het EPD

An MP asked the health minister whether a hospital pharmacy really refuses medicines to patients not connected to the EPD, whether it should stop, whether other providers do this, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that the hospital called the report incorrect, that patients decide themselves on EPD participation, that pharmacists have a duty of care, and that further measures or investigation are not needed.
The St Antonius Hospital labelled the report about not dispensing medication when the patient gives no consent for access to their data via the care infrastructure as incorrect and corrected it.

Het st Antonius Ziekenhuis heeft het bericht over het niet verstrekken van medicatie als de patiënt geen toestemming geeft voor inzage in zijn gegevens via de zorginfrastructuur als onjuist bestempeld en gecorrigeerd.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het weigeren medicijnen te verstrekken aan patiënten die niet meedoen aan het EPD

An MP asks whether the Antonius Hospital pharmacy was right to refuse medicines to patients who do not opt in to the electronic patient record (EPD), and whether this amounts to coercion. The minister replies that the hospital has labelled the report incorrect and corrected it, that patients decide themselves whether to participate, and that she knows of no other providers imposing such conditions.
The starting point is and remains that the patient himself decides whether he wants to participate in the exchange of his medical data via the care infrastructure.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft dat de patiënt zelf bepaalt of hij wil deelnemen aan de uitwisseling van zijn medische gegevens via de zorginfrastructuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over achterstand bij jongeren met psychoses

An MP asks the health minister about the poor outcomes for young people with psychosis, including unemployment and few partnerships, and what is being done about late intervention, family support, and shortages of antipsychotic medication. The minister replies that early detection teams, the strengthened GP role, family trust persons and a new helpline are in place, declines to register national figures on help requests for privacy and administrative burden, and describes temporary supply measures for penfluridol.
Nationwide registration of the number of people reporting with a request for help for a psychiatric patient is not available.
Landelijke registratie van het aantal mensen dat zich meldt met een hulpvraag voor een psychiatrische patiënt, is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over apen die op wrede wijze worden afgemaakt in een proefdierfokkerij

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that surplus monkeys at a Mauritius primate breeder were killed cruelly, and about Dutch and EU links to that breeder, plus whether the EU Animal Testing Directive covers such practices. The minister replied that she was not familiar with the situation, that the company is based in Mauritius and not Dutch-owned, and that the directive sets rules on breeding, housing, origin and killing of animals but gave no substantive answers to the other questions.
Since I understand from the questions that this concerns a company based in Mauritius and not Dutch-owned, I find it logical that I have not been informed about this matter.
Aangezien het naar ik uit de vragen begrijp om een bedrijf gaat dat gevestigd is op Mauritius en niet in Nederlands eigendom is vind ik het logisch dat ik niet over deze zaak geïnformeerd te ben.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over een schone sport

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about the USADA findings on doping at US Postal and Rabobank, the state's role in anti-doping, the status of a doping law, enforcement of trade bans, information sharing with the Anti-Doping Authority, and a response to a 2010 Health Council advice. The minister answered that sport should largely police itself but the state supports anti-doping through funding and WADA, promised a doping law bill in 2013, rejected a formal information-sharing power while agreeing to convene consultations with justice and customs, and pointed to earlier policy letters.
I will however initiate consultation at official level between my ministry, the Ministry of Security and Justice and the Anti-Doping Authority
Wel zal ik op ambtelijk niveau een overleg initiëren tussen mijn ministerie, het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Dopingautoriteit
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tellegen over nieuwe regels voor orgaandonatie in Denemarken

MP Tellegen (VVD) asked the health minister about a Danish case in which a family was approached for organ donation consent after a misdiagnosis, and whether a similar case could occur in the Netherlands under current or proposed law. Minister Schippers answered that misdiagnosis cannot be prevented by law, that consent may only be requested after death under both systems, and that she contacted the Danish ministry for information.
Making an incorrect diagnosis cannot be prevented by any law; medicine remains human work.
Het stellen van een onjuiste diagnose is met geen enkele wet te voorkomen, geneeskunde blijft mensenwerk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Eenzaamheid onder ouderen neemt toe’

An MP asked the government about reports that loneliness among older people is rising, its health effects, support for local initiatives, the role of internet use, and whether cuts threaten efforts against loneliness. The state secretary answered that combating loneliness is primarily a local matter, that central government will stimulate and facilitate through funding a coalition, tools and a national debate, and that municipalities will be given more room under decentralisation.
Combating loneliness is primarily a local matter.
Bestrijding van eenzaamheid is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het opzeggen van het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep

MPs Kooiman (SP) asked why the Netherlands ended its membership of the Council of Europe's Pompidou Group, whether its wider harm-reduction work is lost, and whether Dutch drug policy abroad is abandoned. The government answers that the overlap with EU and UN work and budget efficiency justified the exit, that the Netherlands still pursues its drug policy through other international channels, and that the group's added value had eroded.
The Netherlands indeed ended its membership of the Pompidou Group because the overlap with the tasks and scope of the European Union and also the UN has increased.
Nederland heeft inderdaad het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep opgezegd omdat de overlap met de taken en het werkterrein van de Europese Unie en ook de VN zijn toegenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over de NODO-procedure in de praktijk

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked why the Child Death Review was dropped, why only two instead of five NODO centres were set up, and whether forensic doctor knowledge gaps affect NODO referrals. The state secretary answered that the CDR could not be funded given budget limits, that two centres were chosen for expertise and cost reasons with a startfase evaluation until October 2013, and that enough qualified forensic doctors are now available.
The available budget has been used to introduce the NODO procedure.
Het beschikbare budget is ingezet om de NODO-procedure in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een ziekenhuis een onrendabele arts mag ontslaan

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister how often doctors are dismissed for being unprofitable, whether specialist incomes make profitability difficult, and how to prevent market forces in hospital care from crowding out patient interests. Minister Schippers said she has no data on dismissals or specialist profitability, will send her response to the specialist income reports later, and maintains that financial and quality interests can reinforce each other under the agreed hospital funding framework.
I do not have information on the number of doctors dismissed because of unprofitable care provision.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over het aantal artsen dat is ontslagen vanwege onrendabele zorgverlening.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het Europees handelsverbod op cosmetica die getest is op dieren

An MP asked the minister whether the EU ban on trading in cosmetics tested on animals, due to take effect in 2013, would be relaxed, and how the government would defend it. The minister said she opposes postponement, is working for broad member-state support to keep the date, and that no Dutch firms conduct such tests since domestic animal testing for cosmetics is banned.
My aim is to secure the broadest possible support among other member states for keeping the ban's entry date.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om een zo groot mogelijk draagvlak bij andere lidstaten te verkrijgen voor handhaving van de ingangsdatum van het verbod.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over veehouders die nog niet voldoen aan antibioticaregels

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would ensure all cattle farmers comply with the new antibiotic registration and inspection rules by year end, and whether he would inform parliament before year end. The government acknowledged 7,000 of about 32,000 dairy and beef farmers were non-compliant, said they were given until 1 December 2012 with disciplinary measures to follow, and promised an updated progress overview in spring 2013.
If a cattle farmer is still in violation after 1 December 2012, the PVV will take disciplinary measures.
Als blijkt dat een rundveehouder na 1 december 2012 nog steeds in overtreding is, zal het PVV tuchtrechtelijke maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het bericht dat er aanwijzingen zijn dat Nederlandse patiënten in het buitenland organen kopen en laten transplanteren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that Dutch patients buy organs abroad, including whether there are concrete cases, whether the government will analyse the Dutch situation, and whether donation practice should be adapted. Minister Schippers answered that one concrete case from 2007 led to tightened reimbursement rules, that a method to estimate organ trade in the Netherlands is awaited from the NTS, and that financial incentives for living donation are legally not possible.
I will inform the House in due course about the data collected using the method proposed by the NTS.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer te zijner tijd informeren over de gegevens die aan de hand van de door NTS voorgestelde methode zijn verzameld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over campylobacterbesmettingen in slachthuizen

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether unequal Campylobacter contamination between slaughterhouses, the lack of progress since 1997 commitments, and the non-public identification of high-risk slaughterhouses were acceptable, and whether sanctions would be strengthened.
