The minister replied that Campylobacter is hard to control, that Dutch slaughterhouses perform better than foreign ones, that the industry-run Convenant will provide data, and that RIVM cannot identify individual slaughterhouses while the NVWA enforces against violators.
The RIVM does not have this data.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis overgenomen wordt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the takeover of LangeLand Ziekenhuis by Loek Winter, its financial problems, staff dismissals and risks to care quality. The minister answered that the hospital boards chose the buyer, that the Inspectorate monitors care quality, and that the takeover would be reviewed by the NMa and NZa.
I have no role in this.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber, Segers en Van der Staaij over berichten dat er binnen Europa een lijst in omloop is waarop ‘anti-choice personalities’ met naam worden genoemd

MPs asked whether a list naming 'anti-choice personalities' circulated by the European Parliamentary Forum for Population and Development (EPF), partly funded by the European Commission, is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise the matter with the EPF or the Commission or question the funding. The minister answered that the EPF is a private initiative operating within EU law, that organisations choose their own strategies, and that she sees no reason to act or to question the funding.
An organisation is itself responsible for a chosen strategy to make its position clear.
Een organisatie is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een gekozen strategie om haar standpunt duidelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er steeds meer kinderen in de crisisopvang komen zonder goede hulp

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about reports that more children are entering crisis shelter without adequate help, and why the number of children in social shelter rose from 7,574 in 2008 to 8,791 in 2010. The state secretary said preventing homelessness is the priority, attributed the rise mainly to the financial crisis and divorces, and committed to adapting the Veerkracht method for social shelter with implementation from early 2014.
It is not known how many families across the Netherlands are on a waiting list at all shelter centres.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen in heel Nederland bij alle opvangcentra op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat pijn bij dementie vaak niet behandeld wordt in verpleeghuizen

MP Leijten (SP) asked the ministers whether pain in dementia patients in nursing homes is often left untreated, what causes this, and what will be done about training, observation tools, research, home care and municipal transfer of care. The state secretary answered that the problem is known, that primary responsibility lies with care professionals and institutions, and that the government cannot judge causes or mandate tools, while pointing to Alzheimer Nederland, the transition bureau and an earlier letter on case management.
Primarily it is up to healthcare practitioners, such as geriatric and elderly care specialists, to take measures on this.
Het is primair aan de beroepsbeoefenaren, zoals specialisten ouderengeneeskunde en geriaters, om daar maatregelen op te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing in Nederland

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about the arrest of Paul R. for handling stolen masterpieces, whether Germany seeks to prosecute him over the Bochum bribery scandal, and whether they should hear him and launch criminal investigation into match-fixing. The minister confirmed the German prosecution and European arrest warrant, said a thorough in-depth study of match-fixing is being commissioned, but no criminal investigation will start because the Netherlands lacks information on possible offences committed here.
Since the Netherlands does not currently have such information, no criminal investigation will be started.
Nu Nederland tot op heden niet over dergelijke informatie beschikt, wordt dan ook geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over nieuwe besmettingen Q-koorts

An MP asks how a goat dairy farm whose goats were all vaccinated against Q fever became infected again, whether faulty bulk-milk testing was to blame, and what will be done about public health risks. The state secretary answers that vaccination reduces but does not eliminate infection, that bulk-milk monitoring is adequately supervised by the national reference institute, and that visitor bans, transport restrictions and hygiene measures are in place.
Control of bulk milk is therefore adequately secured by the national reference institute.
De controle van tankmelk is dus adequaat geborgd door het nationale referentie-instituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake derivatenposities van publieke en semi-publieke instellingen

An MP asks the government for an overview of derivative positions across public and semi-public institutions and for details on municipal, provincial and Groningen Seaports exposures. The minister answers that the central government lacks data on local authorities' derivatives, that horizontal supervision applies, that Groningen Seaports is still being assessed, and that an overview is being prepared.
Insight into derivative positions of decentralised governments is not available at national government level.
Inzicht in derivatenposities van decentrale overheden is op Rijksniveau niet voorhanden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de Inspectie een neparts heeft aangehouden

An MP asked the health minister about a man who worked for years as an illegal doctor, whether the employing institutions would be held accountable, how often impersonation occurred, and whether patients were harmed or informed. The minister replied that the Inspectorate handed the case to the Public Prosecution Service, that employers are primarily responsible for verifying credentials, that no harmed patients have been identified, and that no further Inspectorate action is needed for now.
This investigation has been completed and the case will shortly be transferred to the Public Prosecution Service in connection with criminal offences.
Dit onderzoek is afgerond en de zaak wordt op korte termijn overgedragen aan het OM in verband met strafrechtelijke feiten.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Dit is een klassiek voorbeeld van kinderhandel» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2012).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about press reports of child exploitation through agent-controlled youth football transfers, including long contracts and unlicensed agents, and what the KNVB and FIFA have done. The minister replied that football bodies must enforce their own rules, that the KNVB has limited reach over unlicensed agents, that disciplinary cases have often been dropped for lack of evidence, and that discussions are ongoing at EU and FIFA level.
The KNVB has informed me that it is still consulting with stakeholders, including FIFA, to amend the relevant regulations.
De KNVB heeft mij laten weten dat het nog steeds overleg voert met betrokkenen, onder meer met de FIFA, om te komen tot aanpassing van de betreffende regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bruins Slot over gehoorschade bij de jeugd

MPs Voordewind and Bruins Slot asked about hearing damage among young people from loud music, including its long-term costs, the adequacy of current prevention, and whether a Flemish-style noise limit should be introduced. The state secretary answered that cost data is lacking and a RIVM study is pending, that the music sector's convenant and Oorveilig label are the main tools, and that action will depend on a 2012 evaluation.
On the basis of this evaluation I will examine whether the current approach works or whether further action is necessary and desirable.
Ik zal op basis van deze evaluatie bekijken of de huidige aanpak werkt of dat er nadere actie nodig en gewenst is.
Antwoord vagen van het lid Wolbert over verontrustende cijfers over gehoorschade

An MP asks the health minister about alarming figures on hearing damage among young people from loud music, including what the government has done, which interventions work, and whether it accepts the public's expectation of government oversight. The state secretary answers that the music sector and the Nationale Hoorstichting bear primary responsibility, cites information campaigns, and says the Oorveilig keurmerk and sector convenant will be evaluated in December 2012 before deciding on further action.
Based on this evaluation, I want to work with the sector to see whether further action is necessary and desirable.
Op basis van deze evaluatie wil ik samen met de sector kijken of nadere actie nodig en gewenst is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Van Gerven over het gebruik van DNA uit ziekenhuizen voor opsporingsdoeleinden in strafzaken

MPs Leijten, Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether draft legislation would let justice examine hospital-held DNA for criminal investigations, and whether this breaches purpose limitation and deters patient participation in research. The minister confirmed that draft texts of a Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal were circulated for pre-consultation, that they are not government-approved, and that the dilemmas will be for the new cabinet to decide, referring to an earlier letter.
The draft texts have therefore not yet been approved by me or by the cabinet.
De concept-teksten zijn dus nog niet door mij of het kabinet geaccordeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gevolgen van het preferentiebeleid medicatie

An MP asks the health minister about the effects of the medicine preference policy, including savings, risks to health, patient information, and alternatives. The minister answers that the policy saved about €1.1 billion in 2008–2010, is no health risk since the same active substance is always given, and that complaints channels (NZa, SKGZ, Lareb) exist.
Exactly which savings the preference policy has produced is hard to state because gross drug prices are also affected by other policy measures.
Tot welke besparingen het preferentiebeleid precies heeft geleid is lastig aan te geven omdat de (bruto-)prijzen voor geneesmiddelen ook door andere beleidsmaatregelen worden beïnvloed.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde in Meppel verdwijnt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the closure of clinical obstetrics in Meppel, questioning whether the board's decision was careful, whether the 45-minute norm and quality conditions can be met within two months, and whether staff were consulted. The minister replied that a renewed careful process involving local stakeholders and mediation was followed, that care stays local where possible, and that she sees no reason to intervene or meet staff.
After the initially hastily taken decision, a new and careful process was started to speak and consult with all local stakeholders.
Na de aanvankelijk te snel genomen beslissing is een nieuw en zorgvuldig proces gestart om met alle lokale betrokkenen te spreken en te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Bevallen kan niet meer in ziekenhuis Meppel’

MPs Bruins Slot and Agnes Mulder ask about the decision to end childbirth at Meppel hospital from 2013, including IGZ quality findings, alternatives such as a satellite model, the 45-minute ambulance norm, regional standards, costs, and local consultation. The minister answers that the decision was driven by the expected gynaecologist shortage and low birth volume, that the RIVM and insurer Achmea show accessibility will not worsen, that the regional parties must set cooperation agreements with IGZ oversight, and that local residents were not directly involved in the decision.
The local population was not involved in the decision-making.
De lokale bevolking is in de besluitvorming niet betrokken geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het sluiten van de afdeling klinische verloskunde in Meppel

An MP from the PvdA asks the minister of Health whether the obstetrics department in Meppel will close on 1 January 2013, what conditions must be met for quality and accessibility, and what the College Perinatale Zorg has done in the region. The minister answers that the IGZ will monitor the conditions, refers largely to earlier answers to other MPs, and describes the CPZ's regional visits and the appointment of an external process facilitator.
It is important that the quality and accessibility conditions are still met after the decision. The IGZ monitors this.
Van belang is dat ook na het besluit wordt voldaan aan de randvoorwaarden voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid. De IGZ ziet hierop toe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de AWBZ tariefskorting in de vier grote steden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether AWBZ tariff reductions are imposed on care providers in the four largest cities, why parliament was not informed, and how this fits with needed quality improvements. The government replied that there is no city-specific tariff reduction, that contracts between care providers and care offices may set lower rates than NZa maximums, and that contracting space is not reduced.
There is no tariff reduction specifically aimed at the major cities.
Er is geen sprake van een tariefskorting, specifiek gericht op de grote steden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de invoering van een no-claim door Bewuzt/VGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about VGZ/Bewuzt introducing a no-claim bonus on supplementary insurance, questioning consistency with the 2006 abolition of the basic-insurance no-claim and its effect on chronically ill people. The minister answered that supplementary insurance falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa has no substantive supervisory role there, and that enough choice exists for chronic patients.
As indicated in my reply to question 1, the supplementary insurance falls outside my responsibility.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 1 ligt de aanvullende verzekering buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Hilkens over zwangere rokende vrouwen met een psychische stoornis

Two MPs asked the health minister about pregnant smoking women with psychiatric disorders, including whether mental health providers need specific guidance and a unified message. The minister answered that midwives and GPs are already trained in smoking cessation support, that treatment decisions are left to individual providers, and that no specific mental-health-sector guidance or role is considered necessary.
Specific information for mental health care providers therefore does not appear necessary in my view.
Specifieke voorlichting voor hulpverleners in de GGZ lijkt mijns inziens daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over insecten als eiwitbron voor varkens- en kippenvoer

MP Thieme asks why a Wageningen study into insects as feed protein was subsidised before the rules allow it, and whether ethical and public-support assessments were done before funding insect farming that would kill many more animals. The state secretary replies that the EUR 40,000 study tests feasibility, that the ethical framework and next steps will be considered after the results, that no public-support research was done, and that no law change is planned for now, as insects already appear on the GWWD list.

Now that the results of this study are known, and this animal husbandry appears to have sufficient future prospects, the next steps, including going through the ethical assessment framework, will be further considered.

Nu de resultaten van dit onderzoek bekend zijn, en deze dierhouderij voldoende toekomstperspectieven lijkt te hebben, zullen de vervolgstappen, waaronder het doorlopen van het ethisch afwegingskader, verder worden bezien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over stijgende kosten van medicijnverspilling

An MP asked the health minister about media reports of medicine waste, including whether returned medicines could be reused, and whether binding rules and agreements with stakeholders would be made. The minister agreed waste is undesirable, explained that the professional norm requires destruction of returned medicines for quality reasons, and said a survey of healthcare providers would be sent to parliament later.
I will inform the House of Representatives as soon as possible about the results of that survey and the follow-up actions.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer zo snel mogelijk informeren over de resultaten van die enquête en de vervolgacties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Heerma over de impact van voorgenomen bezuinigingen in het regeerakkoord voor de langdurige ouderenzorg in Nederland

CDA MPs Keijzer and Heerma asked whether the government accepts Gupta's finding that proposed long-term care cuts could cut purchasing power by up to 63% for heavy care users, and whether older people and middle/higher-income groups would be disproportionately hit. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that outcomes depend on how cuts are implemented, that no income guarantees are given, and that the proposals will be worked out with municipalities and target groups.
The cabinet never gives purchasing-power guarantees, so it cannot do so in this case either.
Het kabinet geeft nooit koopkrachtgaranties, dus kan dit in dit geval ook niet doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de toekomst van het Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP)

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister how the Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP) health data exchange is financed in 2012, whether insurers will keep funding it, whether insurers can refuse providers who do not join, how many providers and patients have joined, and whether patients must re-consent when the system changes. The minister replied that insurers paid 6.6 million euro, that a three-year funding agreement has been reached, that the profession itself decides whether LSP membership is a quality requirement, and that exact opt-in numbers are not yet known.
Exact numbers of Dutch citizens who gave consent for data exchange via the LSP on 1 October 2012 are not known to the VZVZ.
Exacte aantallen van Nederlanders die op 1 oktober 2012 toestemming hebben gegeven voor gegevensuitwisseling via het LSP zijn bij de VZVZ niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het financiële beleid van zorgverzekeraars en de zorgpremies

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurers' profits, premium rises, reserves, advertising, salaries, administration costs and pharmacy pricing. The minister answered that insurers must meet solvency rules and are free in spending premium income within the law, pointed to the upcoming WNT salary cap and existing annual-report publication duties, and said pharmacy contracting is a matter for individual insurers and the regulators.
I have no powers to intervene in the financial management of health insurers.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheden om in te grijpen in de financiële huishouding van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van het Bethesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the future of Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen, including a KPMG/Plexus report, a possible merger with Refaja, and the role of insurers. The minister said the hospital group decides on the report's publication and the merger is for the NMa to assess, while stating that accessibility and quality should stay central.
No, it is up to KPMG/Plexus and the hospital group itself to decide whether the report is made public.
Nee, het is aan KPMG/Plexus en de ziekenhuisgroep zelf om te besluiten of het rapport openbaar gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die prijsverschillen van geneesmiddelen ten laste brengen van het eigen risico

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Agis charging €189.08 of the deductible for a medicine priced at €48.15 was justified, and whether insurers' divergent drug price agreements are opaque and wasteful. The minister replied that the price was a contractual agreement that had not yet been revised after a lower advisory price, that prices are visible on insurer websites and in declarations, and that no further investigation was needed.
Achmea is considering adjusting its sales prices more than twice a year in future, so that the agreed prices better match the advisory prices.
Achmea overweegt voor de toekomst hun verkoopprijzen meer dan twee keer per jaar aan te passen, zodat de afgesproken prijzen meer in overeenstemming zijn met de adviesprijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de premie ziektekostenverzekering en de maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the health minister whether insurer premium rises are justified given savings from expiring drug patents and added costs, and whether insurers' profits are socially acceptable. The minister answers that the expected 20 euro premium rise is based on real cost increases without using reserves, provides a solvency table, and leaves judgments on insurers' conduct and profits to the insurers and to consumer choice.
I leave that statement to Mr Oomen.
Ik laat die uitspraak voor rekening van de heer Oomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over mogelijke besparingen door doelmatig gebruik van geneesmiddelen

Rep. Bouwmeester asked the health minister whether she knew of the IMS report claiming USD 500 billion a year is wasted globally through misuse of medicines, how much the Netherlands could save by implementing its recommendations, and how the six recommendations are already reflected in Dutch policy. The minister said the figures are indicative and she sees no point in a national share, but believes savings are possible; she then outlined existing measures on pharmacists, quality assessment, antibiotic reporting, error reporting, and high-risk patient programmes, without new commitments.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over financieel misbruik bij zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the health minister about reported financial misuse by health insurers and whether the government would investigate, impose sanctions, and take measures. The minister replied that Zorgverzekeraars Nederland has set up an expert committee to examine signals, that no funds have yet been drawn from the Zvf, and that she will await the findings before deciding on sanctions or measures.
Before I make a statement about measures to be taken, I first want insight into the actual course of events and to assess whether there is a need to intervene.
Voordat ik een uitspraak doe over te nemen maatregelen wil ik eerst inzicht in de feitelijke gang van zaken en bezien of er noodzaak is om in te grijpen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over tekort aan allochtone medisch specialisten

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about the underrepresentation of doctors with non-Western backgrounds among medical specialists, and whether selection for specialist training is biased, including by age. Minister Schippers answered that ethnicity is not registered by law so the claims cannot be verified, that selection is the responsibility of the medical specialty societies, and that age limits are legally restricted unless objectively justified.
Because registering ethnicity is not legally permitted, it is unknown whether the cited percentages are correct.
Daar registratie van etniciteit wettelijk niet is toegestaan, is onbekend of genoemde percentages correct zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over mogelijk misbruik van het Zorgverzekeringsfonds door zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the health minister about possible misuse of the Zorgverzekeringsfonds by health insurers and hospitals under the transition model, and about the industry body's commissioned investigation. The minister replied that an independent expert group will examine signals, that misuse is unacceptable but not yet established, and that she sees no need to change the market model or the insurers' role.
Following the results of the investigation, I will consider whether further action on my part is needed.
Naar aanleiding van de resultaten uit het onderzoek zal ik bezien of er nader actie van mijn kant nodig is.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over ambulances op de vluchtstrook

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Health about ambulances using the hard shoulder, including why buses get exemptions while B-transport ambulances must queue and request permission per ride, and about a terminal cancer patient stuck in traffic. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Amsterdam dispatch centre had no record of the incident, reported no signals of frequent refusals, and noted that existing rules already allow upgrading B-rides to A-rides, with the health minister to clarify scope with the ambulance association.
To give a substantively correct answer about the incident mentioned, it is important to have the date, time and possibly patient details and/or ride number.
Om inhoudelijk een correct antwoord te kunnen geven op het genoemde incident is het van belang om over datum, tijdstip en eventueel patiëntgegevens en/of ritnummer te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen over ambulances die nog steeds niet over de busbaan mogen rijden

An MP asked ministers why ambulances still cannot use bus lanes despite a 2011 motion, and questioned the delay in implementing it. The minister acknowledges the delay, says overlap with a related Kamervragen answer caused it, and points to a reply sent to the Tweede Kamer stating no regulatory change is needed.
Unfortunately, a response to the motion and answering the questions from MP Wiegman required much consultation, which caused delays in handling.
Tot mijn spijt heeft een reactie op de motie en de beantwoording van de vragen van lid Wiegman veel overleg gekost, waardoor vertraging in de afhandeling is opgetreden.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht “Nederland is onvoldoende voorbereid op nieuwe uitbraak dier op mens overdraagbare ziektes”

An MP asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for new zoonotic outbreaks, citing survey findings that doctors and vets cooperate poorly, and asked how cooperation and a One Health approach will be strengthened. The state secretary replied that preparedness has been improved since the Q-fever outbreak through the EmZoo report and a new human-veterinary risk-analysis structure, disputed that the report notes limited doctor knowledge, accepted that the risk of a new zoonosis is real, and pointed to conferences, training and information-sharing as the way to improve cooperation.
I share the view of the majority of the surveyed veterinarians that the chance of an outbreak of a new zoonosis in the Netherlands is real.
Ik deel de opvatting van de meerderheid van de geënquêteerde dierenartsen dat de kans op een uitbraak van een nieuwe zoönose in Nederland reëel is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “Apothekers kunnen zorgkosten drukken”

MP Bruins Slot asked the minister about a report by Booz & Company suggesting pharmacists could reduce care costs through medication reviews, better medication handover and therapy adherence, and whether the claimed savings of 515 to 755 million euro are accurate. The minister said the report is not public, called the measures sensible but not new, admitted the savings rest on assumptions and are hard to realise, and pointed to pharmacists' role in the care chain.
This report is (still) not publicly available.
Dit rapport is (nog) niet openbaar beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het medicijntekort

An MP asked the health minister about the rising number of unavailable medicines and whether shortages stem from the crisis or the preferential-pricing policy, and whether further shortages are expected. The minister answered that a project with IGZ, CBG and RIVM is studying causes and risk models, that preferential policy may contribute but insurers bear the duty of care, and that EU import rules on active ingredients may pose future risks.
At the end of this year both products will be delivered, after which the House of Representatives will be informed.
Eind dit jaar worden beide producten opgeleverd, waarna de Tweede Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over tekort aan medicijnen

An MP asked the health minister about shortages of cancer and psychosis medicines and what patients were offered as alternatives. The minister said alternative therapies exist, that shortage data from pharmacy reports may be incomplete, and that a project group will report on EU and domestic solutions by end 2012.
At the end of 2012 the House of Representatives will receive a report on the preliminary findings, conclusions and recommendations of the project group.
Eind 2012 ontvangt de Tweede Kamer een rapportage over de voorlopige bevindingen, conclusies en aanbevelingen van de projectgroep.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over antibioticaresistentie bij kalveren door melk

Party for the Animals MP Thieme asked whether feeding calves antibiotic-contaminated milk from treated cows poses resistance and health risks and what the government will do. The state secretary acknowledges the practice is common and risks promoting resistance, says it is contrary to EU feed rules but hard to enforce, and promises sector engagement, possible enforcement, and raising the issue at EU level.
Because of the risk of promoting resistance, milk from cows that have received antibiotics should not be fed to calves within the withdrawal period.
Vanwege het risico dat resistentie bevorderd wordt, dient melk van koeien die antibiotica hebben gekregen, binnen de wachttijd niet aan kalveren gevoederd te worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een klokkenluider in het VUmc wiens positie in het geding is

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the VUmc board may demote whistleblower Professor Postmus for contacting the supervisory board and the IGZ about patient safety, and asked for a reason he cannot return as head of the Lung Diseases department. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, pointing to the hospital's own whistleblower rules, the IGZ's enhanced supervision, the pending court case and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, while promising answers before the court date.
As I have also written in answer to parliamentary questions from members Voortman and Van Gent, it is not for me to make statements about a labour law dispute.
Zoals ik ook eerder in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Voortman en Van Gent 4 heb geschreven, is het niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over een arbeidsrechtelijk conflict.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen voor ruim een half miljard euro aan zorggeld hebben opgepot

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether hospitals building reserves of over half a billion euro with public care money is an efficient use of funds, and how that can be checked. Minister Schippers replied that adequate reserves are necessary and desirable, that hospital solvency has risen but most have not yet reached the sector's 20% target, and that no investigation is needed for now.
Currently, as I outlined above, there is certainly no situation of excessive solvency among Dutch hospitals.
Momenteel is er, zoals ik hierboven schetste, zeker geen situatie van een te grote solvabiliteit bij de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Ypma over het falen van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van marketing van ongezonde voedingsmiddelen gericht op kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Ypma asked the health minister about an IASO report showing rising exposure of Dutch children to unhealthy food advertising, and how this fits with industry self-regulation. The minister replied that self-regulation covers under-7s and calls for restraint for 7-12s, that the report only covers EU Pledge signatories, that free riders can be addressed via the Advertising Code Commission, and that industry should continue monitoring and accountability.
I expect the industry to keep taking steps on this and to keep taking responsibility.
Ik verwacht dat de industrie hierop stappen en haar verantwoording blijft nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat 60% van de claims bij medisch verzekeraars niet wordt uitgekeerd

An MP asked the health minister about a broadcast reporting that around 60% of medical liability claims against medical insurers are not paid out, and about the independence of insurers, the complaints handling and the GOMA code. The minister said she has no view on the 60% figure, cites 52-55% from the insurers who attribute most cases to unavoidable complications, and declines to commission a study of claims handling for now, pointing to ongoing audits and a pending bill.
Question 7: Are you willing to have research carried out into the practice of complaint handling for medical errors by medical insurers?
Vraag 7 Bent u bereid onderzoek te laten doen naar de praktijk van klachtafhandeling bij medische missers door medische verzekeraars
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Hamer over de vermogenstoetsen bij de zorgtoeslag en het kindgebonden budget in geval van een letselschade-uitkering

MPs Klijnsma and Hamer asked whether the new asset tests for healthcare allowance and child-related budget would penalise people receiving personal injury compensation, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that affected cases are mainly settlements paid as lump sums, that private-law solutions should be sought first, and that a limited, temporary compensation scheme will be considered for cases where the impact is disproportionate.
I am willing to introduce a compensatory scheme for cases where this turns out disproportionately hard.
Ik ben bereid voor gevallen waar dit onevenredig hard uitpakt een tegemoetkomende regeling te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over tientallen vrouwen die zijn opgelicht en verkeerde borstimplantaten kregen

An MP asked the health minister whether surgeons secretly used cheaper, controversial PIP breast implants instead of the promised premium brands, and what the inspectorate and professional body had received and would do. The minister said the cases are primarily civil-law matters for courts and the disciplinary judge, noted three inspectorate reports, and announced a central implant register while declining to order a broader inspection.
I am of the view that the situation described, given its nature, falls within the civil-law domain.
Ik ben van mening dat de beschreven situatie gelet op zijn aard in het civielrechtelijke domein thuishoort.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de veiligheidsrisico’s in het VUmc

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether an independent inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc was needed, whether patient safety is guaranteed given board turmoil, whether the supervisory council and board are adequate, and about an IGZ internal draft document and the IGZ's expertise. The minister declined an external inquiry, noted the IGZ's enhanced supervision and the hospital's own external review, and said the IGZ acted adequately.
I currently see no reason for an external inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar vermijdbare sterfte bij het VUmc.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een rapport van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over Quress Cytotron Centre

An SP MP asked the health minister whether an Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) report on Quress Cytotron Centre exists, why a Wob request to make it public was filed, and whether the report will be sent to parliament. The minister confirmed the report exists, said no objection to publication exists apart from a minor privacy aspect, and sent the report to parliament.
Subject to a single privacy aspect, there is no objection to publishing the report, and I am therefore hereby sending it to your House.
Met inachtneming van een enkel privacyaspect bestaat geen bezwaar tegen openbaarmaking van het rapport en ik zend het dan ook hierbij aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen dreigen te raken door speculatie met derivaten

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about reports that hospitals face losses from interest rate derivatives (swaps), including whether this warrants concern, the risks involved, and whether an in-depth investigation is needed given the Vestia parallels. Minister Schippers answered that the negative value is not a debt, that the risk depends on prolonged low variable rates, and that the sector's WFZ survey results will be awaited before further steps are taken.

In the answer (dated 5 October 2012) to written questions from Mr Groot and Ms Wolbert, I indicated that I wish to await the results of a survey by the WFZ among its participating members before taking any further steps.

In antwoord (dd 5 oktober 2012) op schriftelijke vragen van de heer Groot en mevrouw Wolbert heb ik aangegeven de resultaten van een uitvraag van het WFZ onder de aangesloten WFZ-deelnemers te willen afwachten alvorens eventuele vervolgstappen te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over inzake omkoping van ziekenhuizen door thuiszorginstellingen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister whether she knew that at least four hospitals had been paid by home-care providers for referring patients, and what sanctions, recovery of gains and measures would follow. The minister confirmed the reports, said the NZa had ordered the four hospitals to stop charging referral fees and published their names, and said the recovery question is subject to ongoing legal proceedings while the NZa still investigates the AWBZ institutions' role.
The NZa is currently still investigating the role of the AWBZ institutions in this matter.
De NZa onderzoekt op dit moment nog de rol van de AWBZ-instellingen in deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het aangaan van een partnerschap door ZorgSaam en Curamus

An MP asked whether the announced partnership between healthcare organisations ZorgSaam and Curamus is a disguised merger, and about consultation of works and client councils, competition authority involvement, location closures and staffing effects. The state secretary answered that no merger is currently planned though one is not excluded later, that councils have been informed, no locations or departments are being cut, and no staffing consequences are foreseen.
From the institutions I have understood that there is no question of concentration or closing locations and departments.
Van de instellingen heb ik begrepen dat van concentratie of schrappen van locaties en afdelingen geen sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de abortusboot

MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the Women on Waves abortion boat's planned visit to Morocco, where abortion is illegal, risks prosecution, whether the government had contact with Morocco, what permits the foundation holds, its past activities and whether it receives subsidy. The minister answered that the trip is a private initiative, that Morocco regards it as an NGO matter, that the Dutch Waz permit requires a temporary permit and IGZ review for the mobile clinic which the foundation has not requested, and that it receives no ministry subsidy.
However, WoW has not applied for the temporary permit.
WoW heeft de tijdelijke vergunning echter niet aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sap over het nieuws dat een fabrikant van incontinentiemateriaal weer patiënten benadert over incontinentie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister whether she knew that incontinence-product maker Tena was again calling insured patients, whether she would ask Tena to pause until the privacy regulator's investigation into Tena and Achmea was finished, and what measures she would take. The minister said she was aware and had taken note, rejected the call for a pause because the parties had already tightened their working method with KNMP and Achmea, and said supervision of privacy law lies with the CBP, outside her competence.
The CBP supervises compliance with privacy legislation. That lies outside my competence.
Het CBP houdt toezicht op de naleving van de privacywetgeving. Dat ligt buiten mijn bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een geitenbedrijf zonder vergunning

An MP asked why a goat farm with about 1,000 goats operates without a permit, is tolerated by the municipality, and plans to expand to 5,650 goats, and whether the state will prevent this. The state secretary answered that the municipality is competent authority, that enforcement was judged disproportionate given expected legalisation, that vaccination limits health risk, and that no new permit request exists under the motion, deferring the scale decision to the next cabinet.
The municipality of Hof van Twente is the competent authority for the environmental permit.
De gemeente Hof van Twente is het bevoegd gezag voor de milieuvergunning.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgkantoren geen lichte zorgzwaartepakketten meer inkopen

The MP Leijten asked whether care offices are refusing to purchase light care packages (ZZP 1-3) for intramural care despite indications, and whether this breaches their duty of care. The state secretary denied that care offices stop buying light packages, stating they remain bound by their duty of care but are cautious given falling new indications and planned extramuralisation.
Care offices must comply with their duty of care, including for existing clients with an indication for a light care package.
Zorgkantoren moeten aan hun zorgplicht voldoen ook voor bestaande cliënten met een indicatie voor een licht zorgzwaarte pakket.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over vergoeding van fingolimod bij patiënten met MS

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why some insurers reportedly do not reimburse fingolimod for MS patients and whether the CVZ advice allows that. The minister answers that reimbursement is restricted to second-line therapy under the regulation, that insurers apply the conditions, that she will ask the CVZ to review whether the conditions should be adjusted, and that the answers were late.
I will ask them to involve various relevant stakeholders in this.
Ik zal hen vragen om verschillende relevante veldpartijen hierbij te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het weigeren van een verzekerde enkel op grond van Downsyndroom

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the minister why an adopted daughter with Down syndrome was refused coverage under an expat health policy by De Goudse, and whether the acceptance duty applies and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that expat policies are private law contracts outside the Zvw acceptance duty and that EU insurance directives bar government rules on such policies, so no intervention is possible.
Under the European non-life insurance directives, the government may not set rules on policy conditions and premiums for health insurance other than the Zvw.

Op grond van de Europese schadeverzekeringsrichtlijnen mag de overheid ten aanzien van andere soorten van (ziektekosten)verzekeringen dan de Zvw geen regels stellen met betrekking tot verzekeringsvoorwaarden en premiestelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de afdeling geboortezorg van ziekenhuis De Sionsberg in Dokkum louter om financiële redenen is gesloten

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the closure of the obstetrics unit at De Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum was purely financial, whether the Inspectorate acted too closely with insurer De Friesland, and whether it should reopen. The minister rejects the claim of undue influence, says the inspectorate acted independently and no inquiry into integrity is warranted, and states that the unit closes in May 2013 for quality reasons tied to the hospital's inability to provide 24/7 acute operating-theatre care.
I do not share this finding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over Kamervragen over een leeftijdsgrens voor esthetische ingrepen

An MP asked the health minister about an age limit for cosmetic surgery on minors, citing a clinic director's remarks and the professional guidelines of plastic surgeons. The minister said the guidelines bar cosmetic procedures under 18 except in exceptional cases, that the IGZ can intervene if guidelines are not followed, and that she is examining the beauty sector and will consider an age limit, though she gave no firm commitment to legislate.
The answer to both questions is not known to me.
Het antwoord op beide vragen is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Groot over gebruik van financiële derivaten door zorginstellingen

Two MPs asked the health minister about rising use of financial derivatives by healthcare institutions, the risks, oversight by the NZa and the Waarborgfonds voor de Zorgsector, and whether legal limits apply. The minister answered that usage rose per KPMG data, that institutions' boards bear primary responsibility, that the WFZ requires prior approval for derivatives and bars margin calls, that no statutory limits exist, and that a WFZ survey will inform possible future regulation.
It is primarily the responsibility of an institution's Executive Board and then its Supervisory Board to oversee the prudent use of derivatives.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Bestuur en vervolgens van de Raad van Toezicht van een instelling om toezicht te houden op het verstandig gebruik van derivaten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over incontinentiezorg

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether budgeting incontinence supplies into insurer-defined patient profiles leaves patients with inadequate material, and what remedies exist when supplies run out early. Minister Schippers answered that the Zvw guarantees adequate care, that patient profiles are a cost-efficiency measure, and that patients can turn to their insurer, while she has no role in insurer-pharmacy contracts.
I have no role in the agreements that are concluded between the parties.
Ik heb geen rol in de overeenkomsten die tussen partijen worden afgesloten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over overbelaste WMO-loketten en de scheiding van wonen en zorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about overloaded WMO counters at municipalities, requests to delay AWBZ decentralisation and ZZP cuts, the separation of housing and care, and the abolition of ZZP 1-3 for elderly care, posing 15 questions in total. The state secretary replied that she had postponed the measure for ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 and VG 3 and the age-22 cohort to allow more time, but declined substantive response on transport-to-day-care harmonisation because the VGN had lodged an appeal.

On this basis I have decided to take more time for the elaboration of the measure for ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 and VG 3 and for its introduction for clients up to and including age 22, in order to reach a responsible implementation with the parties involved.

Op basis hiervan heb ik besloten om voor de uitwerking van de maatregel voor ZZP VV 3, GGZ 3 en VG 3 en voor de invoering voor cliënten tot en met 22 jaar meer tijd te nemen om met betrokken partijen tot een verantwoorde uitvoering te komen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat cannabis slecht is voor de ontwikkeling van de hersenen van jongeren

The MP asks whether a youth substance-use action plan will be made, whether parents will be informed, whether names of pupils using soft drugs should be disclosed, and about coffeeshop compliance and the wietpas effects. The minister says existing prevention programmes continue, no new action plan is launched due to the caretaker cabinet, incident registration is the tool for schools, and a coffeeshop report will follow in October 2012.
I do not have recent figures on coffeeshops' compliance with the two criteria you mention, but I expect to receive the results of a study commissioned from Intraval shortly.
Ik beschik niet over recente cijfers over de naleving door coffeeshops van de twee in uw vraag genoemde criteria, maar op korte termijn verwacht ik de uitkomsten te ontvangen van een onderzoek
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Kuiken over problemen bij de opleiding tot ambulancebroeder

MPs Jadnanansing and Kuiken asked why the sector requested the medical first-responder training but now cannot or will not offer enough internship places, and what will be done for students. The minister says student intake was reduced from 90 to 75, legal embedding of graduates' powers is under discussion with the sector, and the programme was added to the Stagefonds to fund internship places.
This is being discussed with the Ministry of Health, the universities of applied sciences, the hospitals and the ambulance sector, with the aim of resolving it as soon as possible.
Daarover wordt met het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, de hogescholen, de ziekenhuizen en de ambulancesector gesproken, met als doel op zo kort mogelijke termijn
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het ontslag van klokkenluider bij VU Medisch Centrum

MPs Voortman and Van Gent asked whether the VU Medical Centre dismissed pulmonologist Postmus for raising patient safety concerns, and how whistleblowers in healthcare are protected. The minister says Postmus was placed on non-active status for an employment matter, not dismissed, promises intensified inspection and points to reporting channels and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, but declines a separate inquiry into the case.
This concerns an employment-law matter whose content is not known to me.
Het gaat hier om een arbeidsrechtelijke zaak waarvan de inhoud mij niet bekend is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de bestuurderssalarissen bij bloedbank Sanquin weer zijn toegenomen

SP MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister why Sanquin's board salaries rose again, questioning whether they comply with the Balkenende norm and the BBZ code. The minister said the increase mirrored staff CAO raises, that existing contracts are respected under the WNT transitional rules, that Sanquin will be pressed to align contracts with the BBZ, and that the departing chair receives no bonuses.
I will hold Sanquin to account on this.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de suggestie dat borstkanker is te voorkomen door osteopathie

MP Arib asks the minister whether the claim by the Robuste clinic that good blood supply to breasts reduces breast cancer risk, and the associated website information, are acceptable and whether they can be banned. The minister says no scientific evidence supports the claim, that such misleading claims are unacceptable, and that the Consumer Protection Act already prohibits misleading claims that a product can cure diseases, enforced by the Consumentenautoriteit.
I do not find it acceptable if this suggestion were to be created.
Ik vind het niet acceptabel als deze suggestie zou worden gewekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht bezuinigingen bij Centrum Eetstoornissen Ursula

MP Leijten asked the minister whether cuts at the Centrum Eetstoornissen Ursula, part of Rivierduinen, meant dropping meal moments for patients with eating disorders, and whether quality of care could be guaranteed. The minister replied that institutions decide how to implement cuts within the framework of quality of care, declined to guarantee that no meals would be dropped, and gave no overview of how other GGZ institutions implement cuts.
It is up to the institutions themselves how they give substance to this, provided the quality of care is maintained.
Het is aan instellingen zelf hoe zij invulling hieraan geven, mits de kwaliteit van zorg daarbij gehandhaafd blijft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over onder meer de vermindering van het aantal bedden in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the minister of Health about the planned one-third cut in GGZ beds by 2020, reported shortages of beds for domestic violence victims, human trafficking victims and GHB addicts, waiting lists, and the RvZ advice. The minister answered that the bed reduction is an ambition to be refined after a baseline measurement and cost-benefit analysis, that there is no national bed shortage, that GHB detox is exempt from bed reduction, and that the RvZ advice is left to a new cabinet.
At this moment there are still no aggregated national figures on developments in 2011.
Op dit moment zijn er nog geen geaggregeerde landelijke cijfers over de ontwikkelingen in 2011.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de dreigende sluiting van twee Groningse ziekenhuizen en de riante vertrekregeling van een directeur

SP MPs asked the health minister about the threatened closure of two Groningen hospitals based on a confidential report, the public access to that report, and a generous severance package for a former hospital director, including who is liable. The minister said the closure plans are not confirmed, that a public version of the report will follow, that remuneration decisions are the supervisory board's responsibility, and that she has no power to intervene.
I have no means to intervene in this. This is a responsibility of the Supervisory Board.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheden om hierop in te grijpen. Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over btw-heffing in de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg

MP Kuiken asks the health minister about a regional tax inspector's decision to treat cooperation and coordination funding in integrated primary care as VAT-liable, and whether this affects insurers and GPs. The minister refers to the Finance ministry's parallel answer, says current law and case law leave the inspector little choice, and states that talks with the state secretary of Finance on adjusting VAT treatment have started, with the Chamber to be informed.

As indicated in the answers to Ms Leijten's questions, the State Secretary for Finance is examining together with me and in consultation with the sector whether there are possibilities to adjust the VAT levy on the services concerned.

Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen van mevrouw Leijten is aangegeven, beziet de staatssecretaris van Financiën samen met mij en in overleg met de betrokken sector of er mogelijkheden zijn de btw-heffing ten aanzien van de in het geding zijnde diensten aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over multidisciplinaire samenwerking in de zorg en btw-heffing

An SP MP asked whether VAT charged on support and coordination work by a multidisciplinary primary-care foundation is consistent with government goals of integrated care. The state secretary explained that such non-medical support and coordination services are not VAT-exempt, that the tax inspector decides case by case, and promised to examine with the health minister whether VAT rules for these services can be adjusted.

Given developments in cooperation in primary health care, I will, together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and in consultation with the sector, examine whether there are possibilities to adjust the VAT levy on the services concerned.

Gelet op de ontwikkelingen op het terrein van samenwerking in de eerstelijnsgezondheidszorg zal ik, samen met de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en in overleg met de betrokken sector, bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn de btw-heffing ten aanzien van de in het geding zijnde diensten aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over het slopen van sloppenwijken voor de Olympische Spelen in Rio de Janeiro

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked whether the displacement of about 8,000 people for the Rio Olympics is acceptable and whether the government will raise it internationally, and what has been done on the NGO/sports-body conduct code motions and FIFA/IOC responsibility. The minister answered that the number cannot be verified, housing is offered, no international raising is planned for now, an EU expert group will report by end 2012, and that FIFA/IOC cannot be held responsible for host governments' choices.
An exact number cannot be determined.
Een exact aantal valt niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dijsselbloem over de (on)veiligheid op en rond het water

Two MPs asked ministers about drowning risk, reduced lifeguard supervision in the Gelderland river area, subsidies to lifeguard organisations and who is responsible for supervision. The state secretary answered that supervision is a local decision, that the ministry funds a regional lifeguard cooperation but not local brigades, and that no supervision requirements will be included in the new Zwemwaterwet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de gezondheidszorg in penitentiaire inrichting Nieuwegein

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about alleged inadequate medical care at PI Nieuwegein, including a former detainee's case and calls for IGZ, Ombudsman and inspection investigations. The government replied that care was adequate, cited an IGZ 2011 follow-up finding that care met standards, noted the RSJ rejected the complaint, and declined further investigation or emergency measures.
In view of the above, and my answer to question 2, I do not consider further investigation or emergency measures necessary.
Gelet op het voorgaande, en mijn antwoord op vraag 2, acht ik nader onderzoek en het treffen van noodvoorzieningen niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over tekst op pakjes sigaretten

An MP asked the health minister whether she would change cigarette pack warnings, which research showed do not work, to point smokers toward quit-smoking help instead of health consequences. The minister confirmed the warnings will be replaced from March 2014 under an EU directive, including a referral to a quit-smoking website, and deferred other health recommendations to a future cabinet.
The texts on cigarette packs will be changed as of 28 March 2014.
De teksten op pakjes sigaretten worden aangepast per 28 maart 2014.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het korten op de subsidie voor Fiom, de landelijke hulpverleningsorganisatie op het gebied van zwangerschap, kinderwens, afstamming en adoptie

An MP asked the health minister why the state subsidy to Fiom, a national counselling organisation on pregnancy, fertility and adoption, is being cut, and whether its expertise is lost and costs rise as a result. The minister answered that the structural subsidy is cut to 2 million euro with a transition subsidy for 2013-2014, that regular care and local services can provide similar help, and that the government no longer deems it appropriate to fund this specific work.
Furthermore, the number of unwanted pregnancies is fairly stable, as is the number of adoptions.
Verder is het aantal ongewenste zwangerschappen redelijk stabiel, net als het aantal adopties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over een fusie tussen de ziekenhuizen in Bergen op Zoom en Roosendaal en de concentratie van afdelingen

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a planned merger of the Bergen op Zoom and Roosendaal hospitals, including the concentration of maternity and acute care in Bergen op Zoom, and whether a moratorium on mergers applies. The minister replied that until the pending bill on care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may block mergers, that the internal concentration of departments is for the hospitals themselves, and that the hospitals have consulted their councils and staff and will implement planned measures with conditions to be checked by the IGZ.
Until the bill tightening the rules for care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may decide whether to block mergers.
Totdat het wetsvoorstel, waarmee de regels voor zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden aangescherpt, van kracht is, is het uitsluitend aan de NMa om fusies al dan niet tegen te houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de bezuinigingen bij FIOM

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister why subsidies to the counselling organisation Fiom were cut, how quality and expertise would be preserved, and how teenage mothers and the advisory report on women's shelters were treated. The minister replied that taboos have fallen and mainstream care can provide the help, that Fiom receives a phased transition subsidy to transfer expertise to mainstream organisations, and that teenage mothers will move under municipal shelter policy.

Given the reduced taboo, the availability of offerings within regular provisions and citizens' freedom of choice, I no longer consider it appropriate for the central government to subsidise Fiom's specific psychosocial activities.

Gelet op de afname van het taboe, de beschikbaarheid van het aanbod binnen de reguliere voorzieningen en met het oog op de keuzevrijheid van de burger acht ik het niet langer opportuun om vanuit de rijksoverheid de specifieke activiteiten op het terrein van psychosociale hulpverlening van Fiom te subsidiëren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de meldlijn zelfdoding

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister whether she would act against the NVVE's new hotline for assisted suicide and its publication of stories about helping others die, which they argued may breach article 294 of the Criminal Code. The minister replied that she sees no reason to act while the NVVE stays within the law, that the legal question is for the courts, and that she will not talk to the NVVE to stop it.
The weighing and assessment of that is ultimately reserved for the judge.
De weging en waardering daarvan is uiteindelijk aan de rechter voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over preconceptiezorg

An MP asks the health minister whether preconception care and genetic risk information should be expanded, including a programmatic approach, a preconception consult for all prospective parents, and wider perinatal audit coverage. The minister answers that existing information materials and targeted risk-group efforts suffice for now, that audits already include congenital anomalies, and that a preconception consult will await ZonMw research results.
I indeed am of the view that existing preconception care currently suffices.
Ik ben inderdaad van mening dat de bestaande preconceptiezorg vooralsnog voldoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars onmogelijke eisen stellen in de onderhandelingen met ziekenhuizen

Leijten (SP) asks whether insurers may intervene in hospital governance during contract talks, whether such demands are legally sustainable, why contracting for 2012 is delayed, and whether patients and the hospital framework agreement are at risk. Minister Schippers answers that contracting freedom applies, the legal assessment is not hers, contracting is progressing with no reported liquidity or waiting-list problems, and central planning would not solve allocation issues.
For both the content and the process of contracting between insurer and healthcare provider, there is freedom of contract.
Voor zowel de inhoud als het proces van de contractering tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder is er sprake van contracteervrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen achterstanden hebben bij het betalen van zorgpremie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that more people are falling behind on health insurance premiums, questioning the nominal premium, the 30% penalty regime, the rising deductible, and royalties by insurers. The minister argued that payment arrangements are a positive development, that the health allowance keeps premiums affordable for low incomes, and that the government sees no reason to change policy while promising to route the allowance to collect the penalty premium from 2013.
Apart from two health insurers, ONVZ and ASR, all health insurers have implemented the defaulters' scheme since its entry into force in 2009.
Op twee zorgverzekeraars na, ONVZ en ASR, hebben sinds de inwerkingtreding van de wanbetalersregeling in 2009 alle zorgverzekeraars de wanbetalersregeling uitgevoerd.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handelwijze van Achmea en apothekers bij het verstrekken van incontinentiemateriaal aan patiënten (ingezonden 9 augustus 20

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurer Achmea and pharmacies' handling of incontinence supplies, including pressure on patients to disclose private circumstances and co-payments for preferred products. The minister said she cannot judge the negotiations between parties, that patients should not be pressured and privacy law applies, and that a patient may pay the extra cost of a more expensive product.
It is of course not acceptable that patients are approached in this way.
Het valt natuurlijk niet goed te praten dat patiënten op deze wijze worden benaderd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het artikel “Tena beoordeelt incontinente patient”

An MP asked the health minister about a report that Tena, a manufacturer, assesses which incontinence products patients need, raising concerns about cost, independence, privacy and marketing use of patient data. The minister replied that insurers and pharmacies set the arrangements, that the pharmacist remains responsible for the choice, that privacy rules apply and that she has no insight into the insurer-pharmacy contracts.
I do not have insight into the contracts concluded between the insurer and the pharmacist.
Ik heb geen inzage in de contracten die zijn afgesloten tussen verzekeraar en apotheker.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de bemoeienis van fabrikant Tena met incontinente patiënten

An MP asked the minister about insurer Achmea's per-day pricing of incontinence supplies, apotheker delegation of patient assessment to manufacturer Tena, and whether patient data sharing was lawful. The minister said the insurer-pharmacy contracts are a matter between them, that pharmacists remain responsible, and that the privacy regulator CBP had asked Tena questions but would decide itself whether to investigate.
I do not have access to the contracts concluded between the insurer and the pharmacist.
Ik heb geen inzage in de contracten die zijn afgesloten tussen verzekeraar en apotheker.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Niet alleen Tena belt incontinente patiënten”

MP Voortman asked whether the minister would widen an investigation into Tena's calls to incontinent patients to other manufacturers, halt such calls pending results, and involve the privacy regulator. The minister said no separate investigation is needed since the CBP is already questioning Tena, and that Tena has stopped calling patients for now.
The CBP is an independent administrative body and, as indicated, the CBP has asked Tena questions about the matter.
Het CBP is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en zoals aangeven, heeft het CBP Tena vragen gesteld over het onderwerp.
Antwoord vragen Straus over hoge frequentie en duur separeren van psychiatrische patiënten

An MP asks the minister about Erasmus MC research showing coercive seclusion of psychiatric patients in the Netherlands lasts far longer than elsewhere, and what will be done about training, the multidisciplinary guideline, patient wishes and the Verplichte GGZ bill. The minister says the research was not commissioned by her ministry, outlines the Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ and sector-led guideline work, and promises to send the Verplichte GGZ memorandum in autumn.
I expect to send the memorandum on the report on the Verplichte GGZ Act, together with the amendment memorandum, to your House in the autumn.
Ik verwacht de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag van de Wet verplichte ggz tezamen met de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte ggz in het najaar naar uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz over het bericht ‘In de zorg is fraude oké’

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the government about a report that two care agencies allegedly defrauded 1 million euro, whether the Public Prosecution Service deprioritises care fraud, and how fraud detection and pgb fraud will be strengthened. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution of the reported cases, denied that care fraud lacks priority, listed the many detection bodies and the 2011 fraud figures, and promised a proposal on the extra pgb anti-fraud funding this autumn.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether criminal prosecution is indicated in this case.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of in dit geval strafrechtelijk optreden geïndiceerd is.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het contract van de GGZ-bestuurder van Mondriaan

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the Mondriaan GGZ board chair had a 111% employment contract, and whether the BBZ pay code allows such contracts for executives. The minister answered that the 111% figure was an incorrect representation under the BBZ, which sets 100% as the maximum for a full-time contract, but that actual pay stays within BBZ scales, and that no 111% contracts were found in the 2010 annual reports.
In this case a part-time factor of 111% could therefore not have been justified.
In dit geval had er dus geen deeltijdfactor van 111% 2 kunnen worden verantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het uitkleden van de ziekenhuiszorg in Noord-Holland

SP MPs asked the health minister about the downgrading of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, including loss of maternity care, ambulance response times, and whether mergers should be reversed or subjected to a moratorium pending patient and staff participation. The minister replied that the hospital keeps acute, maternity and planned care, that the merger is legally assessed by the NMa, that no moratorium can be imposed due to EU rules, and that stakeholder involvement is handled by the institutions themselves.
It is the responsibility of healthcare institutions themselves to ensure that stakeholders, including at least clients and staff, are involved in a planned concentration of care.

Het is een verantwoordelijkheid van zorginstellingen zelf om, in geval van een voorgenomen concentratie van zorg, ervoor te zorgen dat de belanghebbenden, waaronder in ieder geval cliënten en personeel, worden betrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid  Kooiman over het straffen en behandelen van grafschennisplegers

MP Kooiman asked why desecrating or damaging a grave carries a lower penalty than general property damage, why grave desecration is not listed in the pre-trial detention provision, and how mentally ill offenders could get treatment. Minister Opstelten explained the legal distinction, said detention is usually possible when property damage is also an offence, and pointed to reclassering advice, treatment conditions and compulsory care under existing and proposed law.
Why the legislature did not also add article 149 of the Criminal Code to that list is not known, because it was never considered.
Waarom de wetgever aan bedoelde opsomming van strafbare feiten niet ook artikel 149 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht heeft toegevoegd, is niet bekend omdat dit nooit is overwogen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the August 2012 bird flu outbreak in Hagestein, its cause, the risk of spread or mutation, and measures to prevent further outbreaks. The state secretary said the exact cause is rarely known, the Hagestein farm was detected through the monitoring system and is unrelated to the Mexico outbreak, and a working group is assessing measures to reduce risks from free-range access.
Once the working group has completed this analysis, I will inform you of the results.
Zodra de werkgroep deze analyse heeft afgerond, zal ik u op de hoogte stellen van de resultaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the duration, method and monitoring of the August 2012 culling of 32,870 laying hens at Hagestein during an avian flu outbreak, including whether the culling ran until Sunday and whether the NVWA monitored it properly. The government answered that the process was correct, indicators were met, the NVWA monitored continuously, and the contractor followed an approved work plan.
The entire process proceeded correctly and the prescribed indicators were achieved.
Het hele proces is correct verlopen en de voorgeschreven indicatoren zijn behaald.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het niet voldoen aan de vaccinatieplicht tegen Q-koorts (sts ELI)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked why 18% of professional goat and sheep farms had not vaccinated against Q fever by the deadline, whether this poses a public health risk, and whether sanctions and breeding bans should be tightened. The state secretary replied that all farms eventually complied after orders under administrative coercion, that current sanctions are adequate with criminal reports filed, and that a breeding ban already applies to unvaccinated animals.
I therefore see no reason to increase the sanctions for failing to vaccinate on time.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor verhoging van de sancties voor het niet tijdig vaccineren.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handelwijze van Achmea en apothekers bij het verstrekken van incontinentiemateriaal aan patiënten (ingezonden 9 augustus 20

An SP MP asks the health minister about insurer Achmea and pharmacists allocating incontinence products to patients, including whether the manufacturer Tena effectively decides quantities, whether patient privacy is affected, and whether Achmea's profile-based allocation conflicts with the Health Insurance Act. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that answers will be delayed because consultation with external parties is needed.
The reason for this delay is that answering these questions requires further consultation with external parties.
De reden voor dit uitstel is dat de beantwoording van deze vragen nadere afstemming met externe partijen vergt.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handelwijze van zorgverzekeraar Achmea en apothekers bij het verstrekken van incontinentiemateriaal aan patiënten (ingezond

An SP MP asks the health minister how Achmea and pharmacists handle incontinence supplies, including whether a patient was pressured to disclose private details by phone and how patients are asked to pay extra. The minister's reply is only an interim notice saying the answers need further consultation with external parties and will follow as soon as possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over agressie op de ggz-werkvloer (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asked the health minister about violence against mental health staff, whether the anti-aggression action plan should be binding, whether staffing is sufficient after budget cuts, and why the nursing association V&VN was not involved in the agreements. The minister answered that the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg contains binding measures, including an evaluation of the ELA prosecution agreements due in December, that V&VN will be involved in the GGZ agreement and the action plan, and that trainings are planned.
I consider it important that mental health workers feel heard. That is why I will involve the V&VN in elaborating the GGZ Administrative Agreement and in the Action Plan.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat medewerkers in de ggz zich gehoord voelen. Mede daarom zal ik de V&VN betrekken bij de uitwerking van het Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ en bij het Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester inzake veiligheid van ggz-verpleegkundigen

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about aggression against mental health nurses, including the petition, whether the labour inspectorate investigates this, and whether nurses should be allowed to decide on patient transfers. The minister said the inspectorate found anti-aggression policies reasonably to well in order, will focus on psychosocial workload in 2012-2013, and will raise nurse transfer authority with social partners, while stating enough treatment places exist.
For 2012, 750 inspections are planned focusing on psychosocial workload.
Voor 2012 zijn er 750 inspecties gepland gericht op psychosociale arbeidsbelasting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over eigen bijdrage voor bevallen in het ziekenhuis of geboortecentrum
