An MP asks the health minister about the copayment for hospital or birth-centre deliveries without medical indication, whether it drives epidural choices or home births, and whether financial factors should influence birth location. The minister says the NZa advised studying differentiated copayments, leaves follow-up to a successor given her caretaker status, cites epidural rate data, and states no research shows financial motives.
Given my caretaker status, I will leave the follow-up of this advice to my successor.
Gezien mijn demissionaire status zal ik de opvolging van dit advies aan mijn opvolger overlaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over gebrek aan ggz familiebeleid en tekortschietende hulp voor kinderen van verslaafde en/ of verwarde ouders

Two MPs asked the minister of Health about inadequate family policy in mental health care and insufficient support for children of addicted or mentally ill parents. The minister acknowledged the importance of family involvement, pointed to existing initiatives, a planned handbook for municipalities, and the forthcoming compulsory mental health bill, but did not commit to mandatory systematic attention to children.
It is the professional responsibility of the individual treating clinician to take this aspect into account in treatment.
Het is de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van de individuele behandelaar om in de behandeling dit aspect mee te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over acute verloskunde in Meppel

An MP asked the health minister about the future of acute midwifery care and paediatrics in Meppel, including a hospital board member's statements, the state of consultations, and whether ambulance response times were at risk. The minister said the parties are being brought back to the table under a facilitated review, that a decision-shaping framework is expected by 1 November 2012, and that independent RIVM research on ambulance travel times will inform local decisions.

I expect that, as agreed in these consultations between all parties, the outlines of the care landscape and the organisation of the maternity care chain in the Meppel region will be known by 1 November 2012.

Ik verwacht dat, zoals afgesproken in deze overleggen tussen alle partijen, op 1 november 2012 de contouren van het zorglandschap en de inrichting van de keten van geboortezorg in de regio Meppel bekend zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de hoge administratievelastendruk bij fysiotherapeuten

An MP asked the health minister about the heavy administrative burden on physiotherapists, including whether insurers demand excessive patient data and whether this threatens patient confidentiality. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said insurers need clear criteria and some data for contracting and claim checks, noted automation can reduce the burden, and referred to earlier questions for the privacy issue.
Health insurers have a statutory duty to purchase care and to pay attention to the quality of the care they purchase.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een wettelijke plicht om zorg in te kopen en daarbij aandacht te besteden aan de kwaliteit van de zorg die zij inkopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dille en Gerbrands over het pubergesprek

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why the government plans a yearly conversation between adolescents and a doctor, questioning whether it is needed given most teens have no problems and whether parents, not doctors, should handle this. The minister defended the extra youth contact moment as part of a healthy-lifestyle investment under the 2013 budget agreement, answered most questions on substance, and refused to drop the plan.
I am not willing to stop this action plan.
Ik ben niet bereid om dit actieplan te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de relatietherapie

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the government would follow the CVZ advice to remove relationship therapy from the basic insurance package, and about the costs and child effects of divorce. The state secretary said the government follows the CVZ view that relationship problems fall outside the basic GGZ package because relationships belong to citizens' private sphere, declined a national study of divorce costs, and pointed to municipal support and a forthcoming guidance document for Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin.
We follow the CVZ's judgement, because this contributes to the sustainability of the geneeskundige GGZ package.
Wij volgen het oordeel van het CVZ, omdat hiermee wordt bijgedragen aan de houdbaarheid van het pakket voor geneeskundige GGZ
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over verloskundige zorg in Meppel en omstreken

An MP asks the health minister about the Meppel maternity care dispute, including a hospital board member's public statement that closing acute obstetrics was unavoidable while talks were ongoing, and whether the decision was effectively already taken. The minister says the board will weigh the Blijham report, expects the outline of regional maternity care by 1 November 2012, and describes the College Perinatale Zorg as having a facilitating role.
The board states that it will take the final report of Mr Blijham into account in its upcoming decision-making.
Het bestuur geeft aan het eindrapport van de heer Blijham mee te wegen in hun komende besluitvorming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over regionale verschillen in moedersterfte in Nederland

An MP asked the health minister about regional differences in maternal mortality in the Netherlands, including higher rates in Zeeland and Rotterdam and among non-Western women and older mothers, and whether targeted measures and a plan of action would be provided. The minister answered that the variation partly reflects known health inequalities, pointed to the Stuurgroep advice and the Healthy Pregnancy 4 All programme, and referred back to the earlier answers for the remaining questions.
For the answer to questions 5 through 9, see my answer to questions 3 and 4.
Voor het antwoord op vraag 5 tot en met 9 zie mijn antwoord op de vragen 3 en 4.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuisbestuurders nog altijd exorbitante vertrekpremies krijgen

An MP asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that 13 hospital executives received 3.3 million euro in departure payments, and whether self-regulation of executive pay works. The minister replied that a statutory pay-norm bill (WNT) is pending in the Senate, that no prior approval is needed for bonuses and no formal rules were breached, and that the bill would ban bonuses.
In the amended bill now before the Senate, however, bonuses are entirely prohibited.
In het geamendeerde wetsvoorstel zoals dat inmiddels bij de Eerste Kamer ligt, zijn bonussen echter helemaal verboden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over investeerders die azen op ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about investors buying hospitals and clinics in financial trouble, expecting high returns despite the ban on profit distribution, and about constructions that may circumvent that ban such as outsourcing, interest payments and resale. Minister Schippers answered that paying return on capital is not prohibited, that private capital is needed for investment and innovation, that she has no data on financing arrangements, and that she will consult investigative authorities on outsourcing abuses.
I am not aware whether, and which, hospitals are technically bankrupt.
Het is mij niet bekend of en welke ziekenhuizen technisch failliet zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Wolbert over de extreem hoge inkomens van bestuurders in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether it is acceptable that 41 elderly-care executives earn well above the Balkenende norm, and whether the government will enforce the Wolbert motion capping sector pay. The state secretary pointed to the forthcoming Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) and said the BBZ pay code has been actively promoted, with a stricter norm to apply when the WNT takes effect.
This proposal is now under consideration in the Senate.
Dit voorstel ligt inmiddels ter behandeling in de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Gerbrands over het bericht dat het College voor Zorgverzekeringen wil stoppen met het vergoeden van dure medicijnen voor enkele zeldzame ziekten

PVV MPs Wilders and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the CVZ's draft advice to stop reimbursing expensive drugs for rare diseases was ethical, what limits on patient numbers and drug costs should apply, and whether she would follow the advice. The minister replied that no final advice exists yet, that the decision rests with her as the political primacy, that rare-disease drugs have a legal prevalence ceiling and no fixed cost limit, and that the CVZ backlog has been resolved.
The final decision rests with me and is therefore the primacy of politics.
De uiteindelijke beslissing ligt bij mij en is daarmee het primaat van de politiek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het concept-advies van het College voor Zorgverzekeringen omtrent het vergoeden van geneesmiddelen aan patiënten met een zeldzame ziekte

An SP MP asked the health minister whether she would distance herself from CVZ draft advice recommending that reimbursement for expensive Pompe and Fabry orphan drugs be ended, and whether price limits should guide the basic package. The minister replied that the CVZ has not yet issued advice, that therapeutic value and cost-effectiveness guide decisions without a fixed price limit, and that she will negotiate prices with manufacturers and inform the House.
I will therefore shortly sit down with the producers of these orphan drugs to negotiate the price in relation to the demonstrated therapeutic added value.
Ik ga dan ook op korte termijn met de producenten van deze weesgeneesmiddelen om de tafel zitten om te onderhandelen over de prijs in relatie tot de gebleken therapeutische meerwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de prijs van het geneesmiddel voor de zeldzame ziekte van Pompe

The MP asks whether the government will act on reports that the Pompe disease drug costs half as much in the US as in the Netherlands, and whether it will impose a price measure instead of delisting the drug. The minister says the US product is approved only for the classic form, that per-dose prices are comparable, and that she will negotiate prices with the manufacturer in pilots and report back.
I will therefore shortly sit down with the producers of these orphan drugs to negotiate the price in relation to the demonstrated therapeutic added value.
Ik ga dan ook op korte termijn met de producenten van deze weesgeneesmiddelen om de tafel zitten om te onderhandelen over de prijs in relatie tot de gebleken therapeutische meerwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht Dubbel verdriet om verlies Danique

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister about a case of parents losing a stillborn or very early-born child and why rights to burial costs, leave and reflection time differ by gestational age, and whether the 24-week abortion limit and 20-week scan were harmful. The minister answered that burial obligations depend on gestation (24 weeks), that insurers and UWV set their own rules, that the 24-week limit will not be raised, and that no changes to the abortion framework are planned.
I have no indication that doctors should fill their role better.
Ik heb geen aanwijzing dat artsen hun rol beter zouden moeten invullen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over niet functionerende psychiater/artsen die bij disfunctioneren jaren door kunnen werken

The MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about a psychiatrist and other doctors who keep working for years despite poor performance, and what the rules and oversight do to prevent this. The minister answered that the inspectorate supervises the case, that a verbeterplan is in place, that a voorlopige voorziening for disciplinary cases is planned, and that the publication of disciplinary measures in the BIG-register has been expanded.
As indicated in the letter on disciplinary law, the Framework Act on disciplinary procedure will include the possibility of an interim measure (for example suspension).

Antwoord 10 Zoals in de brief over het tuchtrecht 4 aangegeven zal in de Kaderwet tuchtprocesrecht de mogelijkheid worden opgenomen tot het treffen van een voorlopige voorziening (bijvoorbeeld schorsing).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra, Van Gent en Marcouch over het niet uitvoeren van de motie die verzoekt bloeddonatie voor homoseksuelen mogelijk te maken

MPs Dijkstra, Van Gent and Marcouch asked why the minister did not implement a motion to allow blood donation by gay men and whether she would reconsider using new scientific evidence and foreign practice. The minister replied that she relies on Sanquin's advice and current epidemiological data, will not yet reconsider, and will inform parliament after consultations with other experts by early September.
I aim to send your House a letter on this subject in the short term, by early September at the latest.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer op korte termijn, uiterlijk begin september, een brief over dit onderwerp te sturen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de mogelijke besmetting van patiënten in het ZBC Medisch Centrum Biltstraat.(zelfstandig behandelcentrum)

An MP asked the health minister about a possible infection of patients at the Medisch Centrum Biltstraat, including whether staff were checked, whether notification was too late, whether the Inspectie was involved, and whether an independent inquiry would be held. The minister answered that 903 patients are in a lookback procedure, that staff were not screened because they were not exposed, that the Inspectie advised the lookback, and that an independent inquiry is not considered necessary at present.
No, I do not see the need for that at this moment.
Nee, daar zie ik op dit moment de noodzaak niet van in.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Veen over noodstroom in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about the reliability of backup power in hospitals, including outdated systems, untested equipment, unclear oversight responsibility and applicable standards. The minister answered that hospital boards are responsible for their electrical infrastructure, cited a 2009-2012 sector resilience study, and pointed to NEN 1010 as the applicable norm used by the inspectorate.
It is the responsibility of the institution itself to ensure that the equipment and infrastructure meet the requirements that current practice places on them.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling zelf om ervoor te zorgen dat de apparatuur en de infrastructuur voldoet aan de eisen die de hedendaagse praktijk hieraan stelt.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de onbetrouwbaarheid van de Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio (HSMR) als indicator van kwaliteit van zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the reliability of the Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio as a quality indicator, citing a critical study, perverse incentives and the risk of patient refusal. The minister maintained that HSMR publication serves as a signal and incentive for quality improvement, acknowledged its limits for one-to-one comparison, and placed responsibility for publication, data quality and sanctions largely on hospitals, insurers and other parties.
However, publication is not my responsibility but that of the Dutch hospitals themselves.
Publicatie is echter niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid, maar die van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Ouders op ramkoers met de GGZ”

The MP asks the minister about a newspaper report on a psychiatric patient's care dispute with the GGZ institution, the role of family, the Inspectorate's handling of notifications, and the limited powers of the consultation centre CCE. The minister says the individual case cannot be assessed from the press report, describes the Inspectorate's earlier reviews and planned follow-up, and states the CCE has no enforcement powers but the Inspectorate can act.
Following the stalled treatment situation now described, the Inspectorate will examine whether the information recently aired in the media may lead to new insights.
Naar aanleiding van de nu beschreven vastgelopen behandelingsituatie zal de IGZ nagaan of de recent in de media geuite informatie nog tot nieuwe inzichten kan leiden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het terugdringen van alcoholmisbruik door jongeren

An MP asks the health minister about municipalities' readiness for the revised Drank- en horecawet on curbing youth alcohol abuse, including local ordinances and preventive policy. The minister says municipalities have time before the 1 January 2013 entry into force, points to a handreiking, training and a support website, and refers to existing model ordinances and national prevention priorities.
There is therefore still enough time for municipalities to prepare for the new tasks and powers.
Er is dus nog tijd genoeg voor gemeenten om zich voor te bereiden op de nieuwe taken en bevoegdheden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over privé-afkickklinieken die verslaafden misleiden

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about private rehab clinics abroad that allegedly mislead addicts and charge insurers and patients very high bills, and how oversight, licensing and executive pay might be addressed. The minister answered that the reports seem to concern one clinic in South Africa, that the IGZ cannot supervise foreign clinics, that the NZa is monitoring and a legal dispute is ongoing, and that no licensing requirement is planned.
I have no insight into the amounts being claimed from health insurers in this matter and therefore do not know whether they can be described as exorbitant.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedragen die bij zorgverzekeraars in deze worden gedeclareerd en weet dus ook niet of deze als exorbitant kunnen worden bestempeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Voortman over de overwegingen van de GGD bij het keuren van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Voortman and Dibi asked whether GGD doctors assessing rejected asylum seekers are influenced by non-medical considerations, whether untreated dental cases reflect this, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. Minister Schippers said doctors must judge objectively, defended excluding specialist dental care from the care fund as parallel to insured patients, and said the Inspectorate will address vulnerable groups broadly rather than a separate inquiry.
I prefer such a broad approach over an approach that only looks at the role of one target group and/or actor.
Ik geef de voorkeur aan een dergelijke brede insteek boven een insteek die slechts toeziet op de rol van één doelgroep en/of actor.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Isoleercel te vaak en onterecht gebruikt’

MP Bouwmeester asks the health minister about reports that isolation cells in mental health care are used too often and wrongly, and about a Erasmus dissertation on this, asking whether she accepts that it is the institutions' responsibility and what she will do. The minister acknowledges the problem, says separation should be a last resort, describes a culture change, a 2012 sector agreement, planned Wet verplichte GGZ and tighter Inspectorate oversight, but states that reducing misuse is a shared responsibility with the field.
The IGZ will focus on 'do not separate unless', eradicating solitary confinement, and internal and external consultation.
De IGZ zal zich richten op het «niet separeren, tenzij», het uitbannen van eenzame opsluiting en de in- en externe consultatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten aan over medicatiebeoordeling bij ouderen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about the new pricing and contracting of medication reviews for elderly patients, including the KBO and KNMP findings that few insurers contract them, and the removal of heartburn drugs from the basic package. The minister answered that the new system only started on 1 January 2012 and is too recent to draw conclusions, that patients bear responsibility for buying such drugs, and that the NZa quick scan and Zichtbare Zorg reports will follow.
The new tariff system and the new service descriptions, preceded by years of preparation and extensively discussed with the House of Representatives, were only introduced on 1 January 2012.

Het nieuwe tariefsysteem en de nieuwe prestatiebeschrijvingen, waaraan jarenlange voorbereiding vooraf is gegaan en waarover met de Tweede Kamer uitgebreid is gewisseld, is pas sinds 1 januari 2012 ingevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Veen over contractering Audiologie

An MP asked the health minister about contracting problems for independent audiology centres, including the ban on holding equity before 2012, banks withdrawing credit, and patients cancelling appointments. The minister answered that a shared solution was agreed with insurers and providers within the macro budget, that a three-year transition model applies, and that existing treatments remain fully reimbursed.
It has been agreed that the problems at these centres will be resolved within the available macro framework.
Afgesproken is de problematiek bij deze centra op te lossen binnen het beschikbare macrokader.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over lobbypraktijken van tabakfabrikant Philip Morris in Bergen op Zoom

An MP asked the health minister whether she knew of Philip Morris letters to Bergen op Zoom councillors and staff framed as job threats, and whether this lobbying was unethical and misleading, and whether the company had lobbied her ministry or the economics ministry on excise increases. The minister said lobbying a local government on local consequences of national policy is not inherently unethical, that she trusts local officials to weigh it, and that no influence on her ministry's excise plans occurred.

The fact that Philip Morris, on a policy field directly affecting its activities, seeks contact with local government and informs them of possible consequences of national policy is not necessarily unethical.

Het feit dat Philip Morris over een beleidsterrein dat hun activiteiten direct raakt, contact zoekt met het lokaal bestuur en hen informeert over mogelijke consequenties van landelijk beleid, is niet per definitie onethisch.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht over zelfdoding onder Hindostaanse meisjes

MP Arib asks the health and education ministers about reports of high suicide among Hindustani girls, whether prior answers on attention to the issue hold up, whether schools and professionals are equipped, and whether recent national figures exist. Minister Schippers answers that suicide prevention has received more investment, that schools will be pointed to available information via the VO-raad without a mandatory approach, and that no recent national figures on migrant young women are available, while promising a forthcoming clinical guideline.
No recent national figures are available on the number of suicide attempts among certain groups of migrant young women.
Er zijn geen recente landelijke cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal suïcidepogingen onder bepaalde groepen migranten jonge vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel ‘Energiedrank de supermarkt uit’

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about a proposal to restrict energy drinks to specialist shops and about warnings for children. The minister rejected the restriction, pointed to parental responsibility and existing labelling rules, and declined to pursue new regulation.
I do not think this is a good idea.
Ik vind dit geen goed idee.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het nieuwe DSM handboek voor de psychiatrie

An MP asked the health minister about the new DSM psychiatric handbook, including professors leaving its working group over broadened diagnostic criteria and industry ties of contributing scientists. The minister declined to judge the DSM working method beyond earlier answers, defended collaboration with industry while pointing to self-regulatory transparency codes and a register due in early 2013.
I support the CGR's initiative to achieve transparency about (financial) ties and I endorse the Code to prevent improper influence.
Ik ondersteun het initiatief van de CGR om te komen tot transparantie over de (financiële) banden en ik onderschrijf de Code ter voorkoming van oneigenlijke beïnvloeding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Uitslag over het bericht ‘Bijna helft cafés nog niet rookvrij’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that nearly half of cafés were still not smoke-free, whether fines were ineffective, and whether enforcement could be intensified. The minister acknowledged compliance is insufficient, said additional measures such as more enforcement or higher fines are needed, but declined to decide now due to the cabinet's caretaker status.
As I indicated in the letter to Parliament of 18 June, I consider the current compliance level insufficient and believe additional measures are necessary to improve compliance.
Zoals ik in de Kamerbrief van 18 juni jl. heb aangegeven, vind ik het huidige naleefniveau onvoldoende en vind ik dat er aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om de naleving te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten en zorgverzekeraar CZ

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about insurer CZ capping treatment revenue (omzetplafonds) for independent psychotherapists, restricting patient access and freedom of choice. The minister answered that such caps fall within agreed insurer procurement policy, that no contract breach occurs since caps change only with provider consent, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, while the way insurers communicate is outside her responsibility.
Insurers are free to agree revenue caps with budgeted institutions, non-budgeted institutions and independent providers alike, as long as the insurer can meet its duty of care.

Het staat zorgverzekeraars vrij om omzetplafonds af te spreken met zowel gebudgetteerde instellingen als met niet gebudgetteerde instellingen als met vrijgevestigde zorgaanbieders, zolang de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het artikel “De Slavische slavencontracten” en de handel in jonge voetballers

MP Van Dekken asks the health and sport minister about a newspaper report on exploitative 'slavery contracts' for young footballers and the role of clubs such as Ajax, and whether the KNVB and government should act against agent trade in minors. The minister says FIFA and KNVB rules govern player agents, clubs should consider their social role, the KNVB already monitors agents and sanctions breaches, and she sees no need for further action or research.
I therefore see no reason for further consultation with the KNVB.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor nader overleg met de KNVB.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over een nieuwe, levensgevaarlijke drug

An MP asked the health and justice ministers whether a new dangerous drug ('badzout') linked to a fatal-looking incident in Miami should be scheduled, and why generic criminalisation of such drugs was not adopted, and how the motion on this is being implemented. The minister answered that the incident was abroad and only toxicology can confirm the substances, that scheduling requires the statutory criteria of Article 3a of the Opium Act, and that RIVM has been asked to study generic criminalisation with results to follow.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over een mogelijke Duitse boycot van het EK voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about a possible German boycott of Euro 2012 over the situation of Ukrainian opposition figures, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit by not sending a political delegation. The minister said concerns about the rule of law and Timoshenko's treatment prompted a conditional stance, that Minister Schippers attended the Netherlands-Denmark match after improvements in Timoshenko's detention, and that the government raised the issue with Ukraine at EU level.
The cabinet previously indicated that if Ms Timoshenko's situation did not sufficiently improve, the Netherlands would not send a political-level delegation to Ukraine.
Door het kabinet is eerder aangegeven dat als de situatie van mevrouw Timosjenko niet voldoende zou verbeteren, Nederland niet op politiek niveau naar Oekraïne zou gaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Van Dekken en Timmermans over homorechten in Oekraïne

MPs Marcouch, Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about the cancelled Kyiv gay pride, a Ukrainian bill criminalising public expression of homosexuality, and whether this should affect Dutch attendance at Euro 2012 matches and the final's location. The government condemned the violence and bill, said Dutch ministers would attend a match with a human rights programme, but rejected moving the final to Poland as impractical.
On 21 May I expressed to the media my disappointment at the cancellation of the Kyiv Pride Parade.
Ik heb op 21 mei jl. tegenover de media mijn teleurstelling uitgesproken over de afgelasting van de Kyiv Pride Parade.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toename van ouderen met een alcoholprobleem

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the rise in alcohol problems among older people, including the number affected, the availability of help and treatment places, and whether general information is enough. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, estimated 150,000 to 200,000 problem drinkers aged 55 and over, pointed to existing general information and treatment, and said a quickscan of elderly treatment is under way with results expected in autumn, along with a platform and talks with a clients' council.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de vergoeding van In Vitro Fertilisatie (IVF)

MP Arib asks the health minister about proposals to restrict IVF reimbursement to women under 41, the cost savings from more efficient drug prescribing, and whether IVF should be stopped or limited. The minister replies that alternative measures including a 43-year age limit were developed and advised on by the CVZ, that three IVF treatments remain reimbursed, and that she has not decided to stop reimbursement.
I have not decided to stop the reimbursement of IVF.
Ik heb niet besloten tot het stopzetten van de vergoeding van IVF.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiële problemen van het ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the financial trouble at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital in Spijkenisse, including links to hospital discount penalties, insurer debts, insurer influence on hospital boards, and bank ties. The minister replied that continuity of care is the responsibility of insurers and providers, that insurers must guarantee emergency care within 45 minutes, and that the government will not support a hospital heading for bankruptcy.
I am not aware of which insurers the RPZ has debts with.
Het is mij niet bekend bij welke verzekeraars het RPZ schulden heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over ontevreden patiënten klachtafhandeling in de zorg

An MP asks the health minister about a Nivel/KNMG study finding patients do not know where to complain, feel unheard and distrust complaint handling in healthcare, and asks how patients' position will be strengthened. The minister acknowledges the findings and says the Wcz bill will introduce binding rulings from an independent dispute body, a patient ombudsman-style support role, and mandatory disclosure of incidents.
For this reason I have included in the Wcz proposal that people must be able to turn to an independent dispute body that makes binding rulings, can award compensation and publishes those rulings.

Om die reden heb ik in het voorstel voor de Wcz opgenomen dat mensen terecht moeten kunnen bij een onafhankelijke geschilleninstantie die bindende uitspraken doet, schadevergoedingen kan toekennen en die uitspraken openbaar maakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het succes van de wijkverpleegkundige en het voortzetten van de Zichtbare Schakel

An MP asked the state secretary about the success of district nurses in the Zichtbare Schakel programme, which is ending without a clear follow-up, causing nurses to leave, and whether indication-free working will be abolished. The state secretary confirmed the programme ends at ZonMw, said the projects will be continued in 2013 and 2014 via a decentralisation grant, and that NZa advice on long-term funding is expected this summer, while indication-free working is still under consideration.
I have received calls from various projects to continue the projects.
Ik heb van diverse projecten een oproep ontvangen om de projecten voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars in medische gegevens van GGZ-patiënten neuzen

An MP asks the health minister about insurer CZ's audit of GGZ provider Europsyche, in which staff viewed patients' treatment plans and session notes and phoned patients. The minister replies that the audit followed the statutory graduated approach, that confidentiality was safeguarded under the medical adviser, and that the CBP is for it to decide whether to investigate.
From insurer CZ I understand that the way they carried out their audit is in line with the rules described above.
Van zorgverzekeraar CZ heb ik begrepen dat de wijze waarop zij hun controle hebben uitgevoerd in overeenstemming is met de hierboven beschreven regels.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over zorgverzekeraars die neuzen in medische gegevens

An SP MP asked the health minister whether health insurers inspected psychiatric patients' treatment plans and interview notes and whether they had called patients, and asked about the legal limits and oversight of such checks. The minister replied that dossier inspection is allowed only as a last resort under the Health Insurance Act and the code of conduct, that the checks at CZ were proportionate and carried out under a medical adviser, and that the NZa and CBP supervise compliance.
Inspection of medical records can therefore only take place as a last resort, if its proportionality can be justified.
Inzage in medische dossiers kan dus uitsluitend plaatsvinden als uiterste middel, indien de proportionaliteit daarvan kan worden gemotiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de miljoenenschuld van GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid (ingezonden 1 juni 2012).

An SP MP asked the health minister about GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid's multi-million euro debt, the causes, the number of directors, salaries, a possible €5 per-person levy on citizens, and whether other GGD regions face problems. The minister replied that municipalities own the GGDs and are responsible for their financial policy and oversight by municipal councils, so the national government is only systemically responsible and the questions cannot be answered substantively.
The municipalities are the owners of the GGDs and therefore also responsible for financial policy.
De gemeenten zijn eigenaar van de GGD’en en daarmee ook verantwoordelijk voor het financiële beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de babysterfte in de Bijlmer de hoogste is van Nederland

An MP asked the health minister whether avoidable infant mortality in the Bijlmer (Amsterdam Zuidoost) is caused by substandard hospital care, and what measures will reduce it. The minister answered that the causes lie mainly in social and medical risk factors, that no signals of lower care quality were received, and pointed to existing programmes (Healthy Pregnancy 4 All with 14 municipalities, the College Perinatale Zorg) with results only available around 2014.
The IGZ has received no signals indicating that, on top of this, the quality of care in Amsterdam hospitals is lower than elsewhere in the country.
De IGZ heeft geen signalen ontvangen waaruit blijkt dat daarbovenop de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening in de Amsterdamse ziekenhuizen minder zou zijn dan elders in het land.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over vergoeding van alternatieve therapieën uit het basispakket

An MP asks the minister about insurers reimbursing alternative therapies outside the basic package through Stichting Europsyche, which uses registered psychiatrists or psychologists as nominal main practitioners, and about the Kwaliteitswet, IGZ oversight and possible legal bans. The minister answers that IGZ and NZa are investigating, that main practitioners must ensure competence and that IGZ recommendations will be adopted, while noting gaps in regulation.
For this question I refer you to my letter of 25 June 2012 and the attached investigation results of the IGZ.
Ik wil u voor deze vraag verwijzen naar mijn brief van 25 juni 2012 en de daarbij gevoegde onderzoeksresultaten van de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de angst bij zorgmedewerkers om aangifte te doen

An MP asks the ministers of Justice and of Health whether healthcare workers fear reporting violence because their names are disclosed, and about the handling of reports filed under personnel numbers and why this is absent from the action plan. The Minister replies that anonymous or personnel-number reporting is possible, that a scheme for reporting on personnel numbers across the public sector is being developed, and that a letter with details will follow in September.

During the general consultations on safe working in healthcare of 23 May 2012 and on the safe public task of 5 June 2012 I promised that a scheme will be introduced enabling reporting under a personnel number.

Tijdens de algemeen overleggen veilig werken in de zorg van 23 mei 2012 en veilige publieke taak van 5 juni 2012 heb ik toegezegd dat er een regeling komt die het mogelijk maakt aangifte op nummer te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vrijgeven van de tarieven in de mondzorg en het bericht dat tandartsen helemaal niet willen concurreren

An MP asks the minister about a report that dentists are unwilling to compete, including reluctance to place a crown for one-off patients under the free-tariff experiment in dental care. The minister says patients must be free to switch dentists and finds the consumer survey findings disappointing.
More freedom of choice for the patient is one of the objectives of the experiment.
Meer keuzevrijheid voor de patiënt is één van de doelstellingen van het experiment.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de miljoenenschuld van GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid (ingezonden 1 juni 2012).

An SP MP asks the health minister about the multi-million euro debt of GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid, including how long the minister has known, why it arose, why so many executives were employed, and whether citizens should pay a 5 euro levy. The response is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline and will follow as soon as possible.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de Kamervragen doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over cosmetische chirurgie als genitale verminking

An MP asked the health minister whether cosmetic genital procedures such as G-spot enlargement amount to deception and mutilation, whether only qualified doctors should perform them, whether private clinics keep adequate records, and whether a minimum age should apply. The minister said the procedures are experimental and not yet assessable, that IGZ oversees quality and information, that no new rules are in preparation beyond a European standard in development, that clinics do report to IGZ, and that she will investigate an age limit for cosmetic surgery and report back.
I have launched an investigation into the possibility of setting an age limit for plastic surgery.
Daartoe heb ik een onderzoek ingesteld naar de mogelijkheid om een leeftijdsgrens in te stellen voor plastische chirurgie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht dat artsen vinden dat ernstig zieke patiënten te lang worden doorbehandeld

An MP asked the health minister how she views reports that doctors feel gravely ill patients are kept in treatment too long, and whether doctors need more support and curriculum attention for end-of-life treatment conversations. The minister agreed the topic matters, attributed the gap partly to patient and family preferences, and said she sees no need for a broader curriculum but supports initiatives and raises the theme herself.
I consider it very important that attention is paid to which treatment goals are pursued.
Ik vind het erg belangrijk dat er aandacht is voor de vraag welke behandeldoelen nagestreefd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat C1000 begint met een EK-oorlog

An SGP MP asked the health minister about a supermarket's alcohol discount promotion during the European Championship, asking whether such price wars should be restricted, whether the industry code is adequate, and whether a national ban on below-cost sales should be considered. The minister answered that local municipalities, including new mayoral powers under the amended Drank- en Horecawet, should handle such promotions, that the industry self-regulation code is sufficient, and that no further national legislation is planned.
I consider such measures a matter where local considerations are necessary.
Ik vind dergelijke maatregelen een zaak waar lokale afwegingen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de plannen van een nieuw toetredende zorgverzekeraar

MP Leijten asks the health minister about the planned new health insurer ANNO12, including licensing status, initiators' backgrounds, the EUR 850 entry payment, risk equalisation, rewards for health behaviour and organ donation, and protection for chronically ill people. The minister answers that no licence application has been filed, that the entry payment is voluntary and not contrary to the acceptance duty, and that NZa and SKGZ oversight remain available to complainants.
The initiators wish to remain anonymous at this stage.
De initiatiefnemers wensen in deze fase anoniem te blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de brandveiligheid in GGZ-instellingen

An MP asked the minister whether fire safety in mental health institutions is inadequate, whether staff are unprepared for fires, whether institutions have enough fire-response staff, and whether fire supervision should be concentrated in one inspectorate. The minister agreed fire safety is insufficient and says the primary responsibility lies with institution managers, with supervision by the competent authority, and that the inspectorates are still discussing consolidating supervision and will inform parliament.
When clarity on that exists, your House will be informed about it.
Wanneer daar duidelijkheid over is wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de nieuwe kritiek op het psychiatrische handboek DSM-5

MP Gerbrands asked the minister of Health about new criticism of the DSM-5 psychiatric handbook, including whether insurers should base reimbursement on it and whether DSM-4 should be kept. The minister replied that the APA is responsible for the classification, that unnecessary medicalisation should be prevented, and that the CVZ will advise on the basic insurance package, with a second advice due December 2012.
On the basis of this, I will adjust my policy where necessary.
Op basis hiervan zal ik zonodig mijn beleid aanpassen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over contact met de alcohol- en tabakslobby

An MP asks the health minister why her ministry does not keep minutes of meetings with the alcohol and tobacco lobby, why it refers to Freedom of Information requests for contact details, and why it did not disclose substantive contact information as promised. The minister replies that informal strategic sessions need no minutes, that only official meetings are minuted, that the Heineken visit has been confirmed, and that conclusions will be sent to the House later.
As soon as the conclusions from these strategic sessions are available, I will send them to the House.
Zodra de conclusies uit deze strategische sessies beschikbaar zijn zal ik deze aan de Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Joldersma en Çörüz over minderjarigen die zich na alcoholgebruik schuldig maken aan misdrijven en (uitgaans)geweld

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about under-16s committing offences and violence after drinking, including how incidents are recorded, whether police should register alcohol use, whether public drunkenness by minors should be punished more harshly, and how higher sentence demands for alcohol-related offences are implemented. Minister Opstelten answered that police registration of alcohol use is being prepared with a bill on testing powers, that public drunkenness by youths is mostly fined already and an objective promille norm is undesirable, and that prosecutors will seek higher sentences once the testing powers take effect.
Before this registration process can be implemented, the police must be given the power to use substance tests.
Alvorens dit registratietraject te implementeren dient de politie de bevoegdheid te krijgen om middelentesten in te zetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over illegale besnijdenissen in Engeland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports of illegal female genital cutting in England, whether Dutch at-risk families send girls abroad, and whether a Europe-wide study and joint approach are planned. The state secretary answered that the reports could not be confirmed, cited ongoing European and Dutch prevalence studies, reported that no one has yet been convicted in the Netherlands, and committed to a European strategy on violence against women that will address this practice.
Yes. The European Commission intends to develop a European strategy on violence against women.
Ja. De Europese commissie is voornemens te komen tot een Europese strategie over geweld tegen vrouwen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over vermijdbare sterfte in de zorg en het Kinderformularium

An MP asked the health minister whether the Children's Formulary would be discontinued on 1 July 2012 for lack of funding, how often it is used, how much it needs, and whether the minister would help keep it alive. The minister said the ministry was only a start-up funder, offered temporary bridge funding until March 2013 while the parties agree a long-term solution, and rejected structural state funding.
I am willing to fund the NKFK during the bridging period needed for the parties to reach agreement among themselves
Ik ben bereid tot een financiering van het NKFK gedurende de overbruggingstijd die nodig is om de partijen met elkaar tot overeenstemming te laten komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over psychische klachten

An MP asked the health minister about a CVZ advice that therapy for psychological complaints should be paid privately, and whether insurers and diagnosis coding are being abused. The minister said the advice clarifies insured GGZ care under stepped care, that providers must triage properly, that the NZa and insurers police improper billing, and that diagnosis codes on claims are legally required with exceptions.
Therefore I will discuss my expectations with the parties involved regarding supervision of correct billing for insured entitlements in mental health care.
Daarom zal ik met betrokken partijen mijn verwachtingen bespreken wat betreft het toezicht op het juist declareren inzake verzekerde aanspraken in de GGZ.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing in Finland, reports of exploitation of young foreign players, and whether the government would investigate and take responsibility. The minister answered that she lacks knowledge of Finland, sees no concrete signs of such practices in the Netherlands and no reason for a study, while placing primary responsibility on players and the KNVB, relying on the existing criminal law system.
Because there are no concrete indications that such practices occur in the Netherlands, I also see no reason to start such an investigation.
Omdat er geen concrete aanwijzingen zijn dat dergelijke praktijken zich in Nederland voordoen zie ik ook geen aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen Arib over schizofrenie bij Marokkaanse jongeren en het taboe dat daarop rust

An MP asked the health minister about the higher rate of schizophrenia among Moroccan-Dutch young men and the stigma and low help-seeking around it. The minister acknowledged the vulnerability, cited stigma and lack of knowledge as barriers, and said the Health Council's advice on migrant youth mental health is pending, with a government response to follow.
A cabinet response will follow on this advice.
Op dit advies zal een kabinetsreactie komen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de Europese richtlijn omtrent de rechten van patiënten bij grensoverschrijdende zorg

An MP asked the health minister about the EU patients' rights directive on cross-border care, including implementation plans, barriers, a border-region test, a national contact point, and a pilot with border hospitals. The minister answered that Dutch law already largely meets the directive, that only a national contact point and recognition of prescriptions need to be added, and that implementation is due by October 2013.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to develop additional legislation in that area.
Nederland hoeft daarom op dat terrein geen aanvullende wetgeving te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over belangen van huisartsen in de tabaksindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister about reports that the pension fund for GPs invests in the tobacco industry, whether the government knew of it, how much is invested, and whether this undermines doctors' credibility in fighting smoking. The minister replied that monitoring individual pension fund investments is not the government's task, that DNB supervises without disclosing fund-level data, and that investing in legal tobacco producers gives no reason for measures.
The law prohibits DNB from disclosing data on individual funds to me.
De wet verbiedt daarbij dat DNB gegevens over individuele fondsen aan mij kenbaar maakt.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het declareren van psychische zorg door niet-geregistreerde hulpverleners

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about mental health care billed for services by unregistered practitioners through Europsyche, including the failure of insurers to check claims, and whether DBC financing and 'verlengde arm' constructions should be abolished. The minister said NZa and IGZ investigations are ongoing, insurers bear responsibility for checking claims, she has doubts about the verlengde arm constructie and has asked CVZ for advice, but rejected abolishing DBC financing and declined to confirm criminal investigations.

Following earlier reports about Europsyche, I asked the NZa and IGZ to investigate further the extent to which Europsyche and comparable care providers comply with all legal frameworks and to inform me about it.

Naar aanleiding van eerdere berichtgeving over Europsyche heb ik de NZa en IGZ gevraagd nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de mate waarin Europsyche en andere vergelijkbare zorgaanbieders in hun functioneren voldoen aan alle wettelijke kaders en mij daarover te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over de nieuwe baan van oud-bestuurder van het Maasstad ziekenhuis, de heer P. Smits

Gerbrands (PVV) asked the minister whether the former Maasstad hospital director Smits taking an interim board seat at Zorgpartners Friesland, after alleged failures in the Klebsiella outbreak, was acceptable, and whether a board-suitability test would be introduced. The minister replied that appointments are the responsibility of the care provider and its supervisory board, that the IGZ found no grounds for corrective measures, and that a letter on good governance this summer would only describe the pros and cons of a suitability test.
As minister of VWS I have no role in the appointment or dismissal of directors; this is an exclusive competence of the supervisory board
Als minister van VWS heb ik geen rol bij de benoeming of het ontslag van bestuurders, dit is een exclusieve bevoegdheid van de raad van toezicht
Antwoord vragen Dille over het niet vergoeden van een hernia-operatie

Dille (PVV) asked the health minister about the non-reimbursement of a PTED hernia operation, citing a Radar broadcast and a claim that the technique allows faster recovery, and asked whether the CVZ's stance should be revised and how innovative treatments can be made accessible. Minister Schippers answered that the CVZ and professional groups will update the evidence and standpoint, that microdiscectomy remains the reimbursed gold standard, and that a conditional-admission pilot exists.
To this end, the overview of the medical-scientific literature on endoscopic techniques will be updated.
Daartoe wordt het overzicht van de medisch wetenschappelijke literatuur over endoscopische technieken geactualiseerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de handelwijze van zorgverzekeraar Achmea om het aanleveren van patiëntengegevens door fysiotherapeuten aan derden te verplichten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether insurer Achmea's requirement that physiotherapists supply patient data to commercial firms for CQ-index measurement, under threat of tariff cuts, breaches medical confidentiality and privacy. The minister replied that contracting is a private matter, that the CQ-measure collects patient experiences with patient consent rather than medical data, and that the CBP handles such notifications without substantive review.
Insurers are private-law bodies. Contracting and any conditions an insurer or care provider wishes to include in those contracts are for the parties themselves.
Verzekeraars zijn privaatrechtelijke instanties. Contractering en eventuele voorwaarden die een verzekeraar of zorgaanbieder in die contracten wil opnemen zijn aan de partijen zelf.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat in de zorg miljoenen aan juridische adviezen worden betaald

An SP MP asked the health minister for a reaction to reports that hospitals, GPs and home-care providers spend millions on legal advice about competition law, and whether this frustrates cooperation and marketisation goals. The minister replied that care providers must follow competition rules enforced by the NMa, defended the patient-centred market model, and declined to collect data on advisory spending, deeming it unnecessary.
Care institutions are not public organisations, so they can themselves choose how they spend their financial resources.
Zorginstellingen zijn geen publieke organisaties, zodat zij zelf de keuze kunnen maken waaraan zij hun financiële middelen besteden.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Jacobi over de financiering van grote sportevenementen

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked whether the First European Sport for All Games 2014 in Friesland, which TAFISA Nederland requested, could count as a major event for the Olympic 2028 bid and why it is excluded from federal co-funding. Minister Schippers answered that the event is a first edition with no reliable data yet, that it fits the Olympic Plan's grassroots goals but not the top-sport criteria, and that the existing events policy applies until a new cabinet decides.
I have not yet published the development of a new framework for the events policy.
Ik heb de ontwikkeling van een nieuw kader voor het evenementenbeleid (nog) niet uitgebracht.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de beheersing van het budget voor huisartsenzorg

Deputy Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Health how the budget for GP care and multidisciplinary care can be kept within macro limits, and whether health insurers share responsibility, including for predicting chronic-care volumes and monitoring quarterly costs. Minister Schippers answered that she is ultimately responsible for collective health spending, that overruns should first be absorbed within the sector, that insurers may shape their purchasing freely but must buy care efficiently, and that quarterly GP cost data will be monitored with the LHV and insurers.
As minister I am ultimately responsible for collective spending in healthcare.
Antwoord 1 Als minister ben ik eindverantwoordelijke voor de collectieve uitgaven in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen Uitslag over het bericht ‘Verbod dumpprijs bier levert 100 miljoen op’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a report that banning below-cost beer prices would raise 100 million euros, asking about the share of alcohol sold at such prices, whether cheap drink appeals to young and heavy drinkers, the Groot-Brittannië-style minimum pricing, and a total approach. The minister said she did not know the share, that price policy is one part of a broader approach, and that local mayors receive new powers under the Drank- en Horecawet to curb price promotions, preferring local tailoring over national minimum prices.
I prefer this form of local customisation over a national system of minimum prices.
Deze vorm van lokaal maatwerk prefereer ik boven een landelijk systeem met minimumprijzen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars belang hebben bij het in de schulden laten zitten van verzekerden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether health insurers profit from insured persons with premium arrears, whether the debt-collection regime is fair, and whether insurers are sufficiently punished for negligence. Minister Schippers answered that the compensation is conditional and not profit, that the regime works and includes protections, that insurers should strengthen prevention with municipalities, and that NZa oversight of insurers will be tightened.
As a result of the recommendation in the evaluation report, I have since held talks with the NZa about tightening supervision of compliance with the debt-collection protocol.
Ik heb inmiddels, als uitvloeisel van de aanbeveling uit het evaluatierapport, gesprekken gevoerd met de NZa over een verscherping van het toezicht op de naleving van het incassoprotocol.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over nazorg bij ruiming in de veehouderij om dierziekte

An MP asked whether aftercare exists for human victims of animal disease crises such as Q fever, and what lessons were drawn from the earlier Q fever outbreak. The minister answered that patients use regular care, GGD informed medical professionals, the Q-uestion patient association was subsidised, and a multidisciplinary guideline and research were funded.
Patients needing aftercare following such an infectious disease can, like patients with other serious illnesses, rely on regular healthcare provision.
Patiënten die nazorg nodig hebben ten gevolge van een dergelijke infectieziekte, kunnen net als patiënten met een andere ernstige ziekte een beroep doen op het reguliere zorgaanbod.
Antwoord vragen  Leijten en Van Gerven over extra zorgkosten, veroorzaakt door aanbieders van zorg die niet voldoet aan de stand van wetenschap en praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about unscientific medical checks such as full body scans and preventive vascular scans, their cost to health care, and whether the Wet op het Bevolkingsonderzoek should block them. The minister answered that such scans are not allowed in the Netherlands without a licence, that she will ask the Gezondheidsraad for advice on allowing them at patients' own request and expense, and that she will commission research on added costs while stressing self-determination and quality standards.
At the consultation on the national health policy note on 5 March I promised to have this investigated.
Ik heb tijdens het notaoverleg over de Landelijke nota gezondheidsbeleid «Gezondheid dichtbij» op 5 maart toegezegd om dit te laten uitzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat er weer meer comazuipers zijn

An SP MP asks the health minister how she will respond to reports of rising numbers of youths hospitalised for alcohol poisoning, the spread of alcohol clinics, the causes and regional differences, and additional measures. The minister answers that she will tighten enforcement and the Drank- en Horecawet, expand alcohol clinics through 2013, add prevention funding, and promise proposals before summer, while noting that registration is incomplete.
Before the summer you will receive proposals from me for additional steps to counter this terrible trend.
Voor de zomer krijgt u van mij voorstellen om extra stappen te zetten in het tegengaan van deze vreselijke trend.
Antwoord vragen Klaver en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van de notulen van de onderraad

MPs Klaver and Peters asked why the government will not release minutes of the subcommittee (onderraad) on Olympic Games information, despite the health minister saying she would like to send them. The Prime Minister replied that confidentiality under the Council rules of procedure (art. 26) applies, that no waiver will be granted, and that the government's information duty is not to be read broadly.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Mos n.a.v. het artikel over het artikel ‘Alfred werd gewoon in zijn gezicht gestampt’ inzake fysiek geweld op het sportveld

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report of violence on a sports field and whether violent members should be barred from all sports clubs via a blacklist. The minister said the KNVB and police are acting, outlined existing court-imposed area bans, and said a sport-wide blacklist is being developed but faces legal hurdles, with no firm date.
There is already a sport-wide registration system for sexual intimidation. Sport is working to extend this system to all other forms of excessive behaviour.
Er is reeds een sportbreed registratiesysteem voor seksuele intimidatie. De sport werkt er aan om dit systeem uit te breiden met alle andere vormen van excessief gedrag
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het verstrekken van informatie over gevaren, misstanden en risico’s i.v.m. het Europees kampioenschap voetbal

MP De Mos asks the health minister about reported dangers, abuses and risks for Dutch supporters at Euro 2012 in Poland and Ukraine, including mafia targeting of hotels and animal welfare and LGBT concerns. The minister answers that these issues fall to local authorities and other countries, that the KNVB will provide a 'Oranje Boekje' travel guide, and that no special website update is needed.
It is up to the local authorities to take action against this.
Het is aan de lokale autoriteiten om hiertegen op te treden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Kuiken over het feit dat tandartspatiënten te veel hebben betaald voor implantaten

PvdA MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister whether dental patients overpaid for implants because dentists did not pass on manufacturer discounts, and about related pricing, oversight and market concerns. The minister referred to earlier answers on the same questions, said prices for dental materials in the Netherlands are not clearly higher than in comparable countries, and reported no formal complaints about counterfeit products.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions on this matter from MPs Van Gerven and Leijten.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen terzake van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de aanwezigheid van pathogenen in kippenvlees

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about pathogens in chicken meat, citing a US study on E. coli, and asked how many Dutch products are contaminated, whether products should be pathogen-free, who bears liability, whether consumers' burden of proof should be eased, and the government's role in tracing infection sources. The minister replied that the US situation is not comparable, that Salmonella is declining, that Campylobacter is found on 20% of chicken, that producers bear primary responsibility, that no special burden-of-proof rules are planned, and described the GGD/NVWA reporting and investigation routes.
I am currently considering additional measures regarding Campylobacter on poultry meat.
Momenteel beraad ik mij op aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van Campylobacter op pluimveevlees
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Tijd voor kleur’

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether a government-funded programme ('Intercultureel fundament', part of 'Kansen voor de Zorg') should be halted, since the coalition agreement ends diversity policy based on sex and ethnicity, and whether care staff should be expected to adapt to other cultures. The state secretary replies that the project received EUR 630,389.93 (EUR 300,000 from VWS), that the programme aims to recruit under-represented groups to address staff shortages, that there is no reason to stop it, and that client-oriented care requires alignment with all clients' needs.
I therefore see no reason at all to stop this programme.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele reden om te stoppen met dit programma.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over een aanpassing van de Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen (WGP)

MP Van der Veen asked the minister whether a ConQuaestor study on changing the Dutch drug price law (WGP) exists, whether it considers using the three lowest EU prices as a benchmark, and when its results will be sent to parliament. The minister confirmed the promised analysis, said the study covers the WGP's functioning and possible changes and will assess a three-lowest-EU-prices benchmark, but stated the report is not yet finished and promised to send it with her reaction before summer 2012.
The report is not yet finished and therefore not yet in my possession.
Het rapport is nog niet klaar en dus ook nog niet in mijn bezit.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de voorgenomen sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Roosendaal

An MP asks the health minister whether the planned closure of the acute obstetrics unit at Roosendaal hospital is acceptable, given quality, travel time and staffing concerns and a SAZ report on concentration of care. The minister answers that the decision rests with the parties after studies on accessibility and quality, that Roosendaal is not crucial for the 45-minute norm, and that she will not intervene to keep the unit open.
Only after these studies are completed will a decision on concentrating acute obstetrics be taken.
Pas nadat deze onderzoeken zijn afgerond zal een besluit over concentratie van de acute verloskunde worden genomen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over herhaalde opnamestops bij de acute verloskunde in Goes

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views repeated admission stops at the acute obstetrics unit in Goes, the concentration of acute obstetric care since 2009, and whether the concentration policy should be re-evaluated. The minister answered that the hospital must resolve the problems quickly, that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will supervise closely, and that the concentration policy's link to the stops is not established.
It is important that the ADRZ resolves its problems with great urgency, and the IGZ will supervise this specifically given the crucial function.
Het is van belang dat het ADRZ haar problemen ter zake met grote spoed oplost en de IGZ zal hierop speciaal toezicht houden gezien de cruciale functie.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het voornemen om de verloskundige zorg in Zuid-Limburg te concentreren op één locatie

An SP MP asked the minister whether hospitals in South Limburg plan to concentrate 24-hour midwifery care at one site, and whether this reduces access, choice and quality, and what volume thresholds apply. The minister replied that the hospitals deny talks on concentration (though a merger of Orbis and Atrium is being explored), that no minimum volume norm for obstetric care exists, and that hospitals and insurers must weigh concentration against the accessibility standard.
There is no minimum volume standard for clinical obstetrics.
Er bestaat geen minimum volumenorm voor de klinische verloskunde.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en De Rouwe over het artikel ‘Sionsberg gaat geboortezorg afbouwen’

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the Sionsberg hospital's plan to phase out obstetric care, including whether the 45-minute access norm and the role of primary-care midwives are met. The minister answered that the hospital's chosen profile removes acute and obstetric care, that ambulance access remains within 45 minutes, and that an independent working group will propose a replacement plan with the College Perinatale Zorg involved.
The Inspectorate will assess the plan, once it has been established by the parties, against the quality and accessibility standards.
De Inspectie toetst het plan, nadat dat is vastgesteld door partijen, aan de normen voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat alsnog sluiting dreigt van de spoedeisende verloskunde in ziekenhuis De Sionsberg

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the closure of the acute obstetrics unit at De Sionsberg hospital would raise maternal and infant mortality and why the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) is cooperating. The minister replied that the IGZ acts in the interest of safe care, that the hospital's care plan is under review against quality and accessibility norms, and that she rejects political interference in the inspectorate's quality judgement.
It is the task of the IGZ to assess the preconditions for providing responsible care for risks to the patient.
Het is de taak van de IGZ om de randvoorwaarden voor het leveren van verantwoorde zorg te beoordelen op risico's voor de patiënt.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over fraude met implantaten door tandartsen (ingezonden 4 april 2012).

SP MPs asked the health minister about dental implant fraud, including whether dentists kept manufacturer discounts from patients, whether the NZa will investigate, and what rules govern industry gifts to dentists. The minister answered that the NZa is monitoring price effects and conducting a fine investigation, that transparency rules apply, and that industry self-regulation is to be strengthened.
Question 6: How many dentists, since the introduction of free prices at the beginning of this year, add an extra profit margin on top of existing discount and sponsorship arrangements?
Vraag 6 Hoeveel tandartsen leggen sinds de invoering van vrije prijzen begin dit jaar een extra winstmarge bovenop bestaande kortings- en sponsorregelingen?
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over fraude met implantaten door tandartsen

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Health whether dentists profited from undisclosed implant discounts and whether the NZa and industry codes were adequate. The minister said no economic offence was clearly established, the NZa sees no reason for a new investigation, rejected a new study into beneficiaries, and relies on self-regulation through the Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen while promising to press professional bodies to sign it.
It is for the NZa to assess whether the applicable rules are being complied with.
Het is aan de NZa om te beoordelen of de geldende regels worden nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de oproep van de NMa aan ziekenhuizen om grote inkoopcombinaties te vormen

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the NMa's call on hospitals to form large purchasing alliances conflicts with their amendment against unnecessary clustering of public tenders, and whether the advice is one-sided. The minister replied that the NMa's recommendation does not require merging tenders, is not in conflict with the amendment or current procurement rules for academic hospitals, and has not created confusion, so no action against the NMA is planned.

I am of the view that the NMa's call for more purchasing alliances does not conflict with the amendment Verhoeven/Gesthuizen, adopted by the House of Representatives, on unnecessary clustering of public contracts.

Ik ben van mening dat de oproep van de NMa om meer inkoopcombinaties te vormen niet haaks staat op het onlangs door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement Verhoeven/Gesthuizen over het onnodig clusteren van overheidsopdrachten.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de zorgen van jonge huisartsen over de toekomst van het vak

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she responds to young GPs' concerns that her policy (NZa advice, abolishing name-based registration, productivity incentives) undermines general practice and gatekeeping. The minister rejects the criticism, says she will receive the young GPs' representatives, denies abolishing registration, and maintains her policy strengthens the first line.
For this reason, a representative of the young GPs action group will also be received at the ministry to discuss their ideas.
Mede om die reden zal een vertegenwoordiging van de actiegroep Jonge Huisartsen ook worden ontvangen op het ministerie om in gesprek te gaan over hun ideeën.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nadelige gevolgen van het vrijgeven van de tarieven en over de fraude met kosten van implantaten (ingezonden 4 april 2012).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that fewer people visit the dentist because of expected cost rises after tariff liberalisation, and about fraud with implant costs, including whether dentists should have passed on manufacturer discounts, whether the NZa will investigate, and how patients and insurers can get refunds and transparency. The minister's reply is only a holding notice saying the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline and will follow as soon as possible.
cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period
kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het naderen van een post-antibioticatijdperk

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about the WHO warning of a post-antibiotic era, whether voluntary reduction targets in livestock farming are adequate, and whether binding measures will follow. The minister answered that existing policy is serious and based on self-regulation combined with strict state supervision, that the 50% reduction target is not the end goal, and that a transition to sustainable farming is needed, without committing to new legislation.
I do not share your view that only non-binding agreements have been made with the livestock sectors, without a stick behind the door.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat er daarbij slechts vrijblijvende afspraken zijn gemaakt met de betreffende veehouderijsectoren, zonder stok achter de deur.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over suggestieve uitspraken van de directeur GGD Nederland over risico’s van overdracht van dierziekten naar mensen

CDA MP Ormel asked the minister about remarks by the GGD Nederland director suggesting worry about zoonotic virus spread, and about the transparency of communication on animal disease outbreaks. The minister said the RIVM found no evidence of Schmallenberg transmission to humans, declined to answer for GGD Nederland, and pointed to existing communication arrangements between EL&I and VWS.
GGD Nederland is not part of VWS.
GGD Nederland is geen onderdeel van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Joldersma over het bericht ‘Verkopers schoonmaakmiddel verdienen fors aan partydrug GHB’

MPs Çörüz and Joldersma (CDA) asked ministers about reports that GBL sellers profit from GHB, including hospital admissions, Netherlands as distribution country, RIVM/CAM purity findings, licensing, denaturation and the FIOD reporting point. Minister Schippers answered that GHB is being moved to list I, GBL purity bans are not desired, prevention will be analysed, and the FIOD reporting point is adequately publicised.
Very soon GHB will be moved from list II to list I of the Opium Act.
Zeer binnenkort zal GHB van lijst II naar lijst I van de Opiumwet worden verplaatst.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Marcouch over homo-acceptatie in het voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether homo-acceptance in football needs an active action plan, whether the Netherlands lags Germany and England, and whether a national John Blankenstein prize should be introduced. The minister answered that existing measures (the safer sport action plan and the Gay Straight Alliance) suffice, declined to draw up a new football-specific plan, and left initiatives such as a prize to the sports parties themselves.
No, the effort described above is comprehensive and already takes the lead in keeping sport enjoyable for everyone regardless of sexual orientation and countering aggression.
Nee, de hierboven beschreven inzet is veelomvattend en neemt al het voortouw om sport voor iedereen ongeacht geaardheid leuk te houden en agressie tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over duidelijke, eenduidige en vindbare informatie over tekortschietende behandelaren

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why psychotherapist Van Steijn, struck off as psychotherapist for malpractice, still appears as a health psychologist in the BIG register, and how IGZ and CIBG handled information and timing. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the law from 1 July 2012 will record such restrictions in the register, and said the IGZ dossier review will be awaited with results expected after the summer.

I share that view. The Act of 7 November 2011 amending the Individual Health Care Professions Act will require that restrictive orders issued by the IGZ are recorded in the BIG register from 1 July 2012.
