Ik deel die mening. De Wet van 7 november 2011, houdende wijziging van de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg
Antwoord vragen Leijten over een nieuwe gerechtelijke uitspraak tegen de verplichting voor psychiaters om diagnose-informatie op declaraties te vermelden

MP Leijten asked the health minister how the NZa could ignore a repeated CBb ruling that diagnosis codes on psychiatric invoices must not be mandatory, and whether this infringes patient privacy. The minister regretted the NZa's failure, said the NZa must take a new decision, and maintained that exceptions for self-paying patients and those who request them suffice.
I expect the NZa to take a new decision in a responsible manner following this new ruling.
Ik ga ervan uit dat de NZa op verantwoorde wijze een nieuw besluit neemt naar aanleiding van deze nieuwe uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over inadequate zorg na de sluiting van de afdeling immunologie van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AzM)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether patients were receiving adequate care after the Maastricht AzM closed its immunology department, and whether the AzM had kept its promise on follow-up care for a specific case. The minister declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, reported that the inspectorate found new patients were being taken over by Utrecht and Nijmegen but that about 250 top-referent patients still awaited transfer, and said the inspectorate continues to monitor the process.
First, for reasons of patient privacy I cannot and will not go into the specific case in substance.
Vooropgesteld kan en wil ik vanwege de privacy van de patiënt niet inhoudelijk op een specifieke casus ingaan.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over EU-miljarden naar topclubs

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked the health and sport minister about EU-backed bailouts of Spanish football clubs, including debt forgiveness, and related EU and UEFA financial fair play rules. The minister agreed that such debt forgiveness is undesirable, noted UEFA and European Commission cooperation on fair play and state aid rules, and said ECB lending decisions are for individual banks and fall outside her remit.
When granting financial support to professional football organisations, national and local governments in the EU must comply with the state aid rules.
Bij het verlenen van financiële steun aan betaaldvoetbalorganisaties (bvo's) moeten de nationale en lokale overheden in de EU zich houden aan de staatssteunregels.

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about online speech therapy (telelogopedie) by TinyEye, its claimed effectiveness, funding links between the UMCG's Triade Groep and the company, and whether the Spraakfonds, a charity chaired by TinyEye's director, supports the firm. The minister answered that telelogopedie is a welcome supplement if preceded by face-to-face intake, that no evidence shows worse results, that speech therapy is fully insured and funding questions fall outside her responsibility or are for donors to check.
Any investments made by the Triade Groep fall outside my area of responsibility.
Eventuele investeringen die zijn gedaan vanuit de Triade Groep vallen buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheidsdomein.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de contractering van zorg in 2012

Leijten (SP) asks whether patients should be protected from being left with hospital bills due to contracting disputes between hospitals and insurers in 2012, and whether insurers rather than hospitals should inform insured persons about which hospitals they are contracted with. Minister Schippers answers that insurers and hospitals must inform patients, that full reimbursement applies to ongoing treatment, and that parties will work out how to settle the contracting problems.
This means that health insurers must, given their duty of care, properly inform their insured persons about the consequences for reimbursement of costs.
Dit betekent dat zorgverzekeraars hun verzekerden, gelet op hun zorgplicht, goed moeten informeren over de gevolgen daarvan voor de vergoeding van kosten.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de contacten met de alcohol- en tabakslobby

An MP asked the health minister to disclose all contacts with the alcohol and tobacco lobby, the minutes of meetings with alcohol industry directors, and the status of those meetings. The minister pointed to tobacco contacts already reported, refused to disclose full alcohol-industry contacts as unnecessary and burdensome, said no minutes were kept of the recent meeting, and called the consultation informal.
I have not made a commitment to provide insight into contacts with the alcohol industry, and I also consider it undesirable to do so.
Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan om inzicht te geven in de contacten met de alcoholindustrie, en ik vind het ook onwenselijk om dit te doen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over tweedeling in de zorg als gevolg van de eigen bijdrage in de tweedelijns ggz (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asked the minister about a Nivel study suggesting the new eigen bijdrage in tweedelijns ggz may cause low-income patients, especially in addiction and youth care, to reduce or stop treatment, creating a two-tier care system. The minister replied that the study measured intentions before introduction, that effects are being monitored with first results due in September, and that the measure was meant to rebalance costs and not to create tiers, with payment arrangements and municipal assistance available.
As I have already informed the House, I am monitoring the effects of the introduction and I will be able to send you the first results in September.
Zoals ik uw Kamer al heb laten weten ben ik de effecten van de invoering aan het monitoren en zal ik u in september de eerste resultaten kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de vernietiging van vaccins tegen de Mexicaanse griep door een blunder van het Nederlands Vaccininstituut

An SP MP asked the minister why roughly 1.2 million H1N1 vaccine doses were discarded after an error by the Netherlands Vaccine Institute, whether the Chamber was fully informed, and what lessons were drawn. The minister said the doses had no remaining market value, that the handling broke procedures but had no external effects warranting notification to the Chamber, and that the employee was disciplined.
Notifying the Chamber does not seem appropriate in such a case.
Melding aan de Tweede Kamer ligt in zo'n geval niet voor de hand.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de contributiestijging bij patiëntenorganisaties als gevolg van de eisen van het Fonds PGO (Patiënten-, Gehandicapten- en Ouderenorganisaties)

MP Leijten (SP) asked whether the Fonds PGO requires patient organisations to charge at least 25 euro membership fees to qualify for subsidy, and whether this forces fee increases and member losses. Minister Schippers confirmed the rule from the 2011 policy framework (applying from 2014), said some organisations may need to raise fees, but refused to drop the requirement, arguing it reflects legitimacy and that smaller groups can receive practical support instead.
I do not consider it desirable and do not intend to drop the membership fee requirement.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk en ben niet van plan om de contributie-eis te laten vervallen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het bericht dat de wachtlijsten voor donororganen explosief zijn gestegen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that organ donation waiting lists had risen sharply, and whether the figures were a fair measure of progress under the Masterplan. The minister disputed the press release as tendentious, defended the waiting-list counting method, and declined to adopt an Active Donor Registration system, while pointing to existing steps to raise transplant numbers.
I consider it of little use to count patients as waiting when in fact they are not, because they cannot undergo a transplant.
Ik vind het weinig zinvol om patiënten als wachtenden aan te merken als zij dat feitelijk niet zijn omdat ze geen transplantatie kunnen ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de financiële situatie van EuroPsyche

An MP asked the health minister whether insurers may suspend payments to the mental health provider EuroPsyche without official findings, whether the Inspectorate or insurers should investigate, and why only EuroPsyche was targeted. The minister said insurers have their own competence to suspend and audit payments, that the Inspectorate and NZa were asked to investigate similar providers, and that she sees no critical continuity problem.

I asked the supervisors (IGZ and NZa) on 7 February 2012 to investigate further the extent to which EuroPsyche and other comparable care providers comply with all applicable legal frameworks and to inform me about it.

Overigens heb ik de toezichthouders (IGZ en de NZa) op 7 februari 2012 verzocht nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de mate waarin Europsyche en andere vergelijkbare zorgaanbieders in hun functioneren voldoen aan alle geldende wettelijke kaders en mij daar over te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het subsidiëren van de promotie van geitenzuivel en geitenvlees

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the minister of Health about government subsidies for promoting goat dairy and goat meat, linked to surplus male kids, antibiotic use and intensification in goat farming. The state secretary denied that the ministry funded goat-dairy promotion, explained that a small EU- and ministry-co-funded practice-network website covered goat-kid meat, acknowledged antibiotic use in goat kid fattening is a concern, and said the sector must take responsibility and provide insight into antibiotic use.
At present there is no central overview of antibiotic use in the goat sector, and there is no insight into the quantities and categories of antibiotics used.
Op dit moment is er nog geen centraal zicht op het gebruik van antibiotica in de geitensector en is er geen inzicht in het gebruik van hoeveelheden en categorieën antibiotica.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat zes op de tien medewerkers niet denkt hun pensioen te halen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that most care workers doubt they can keep working until retirement, and about workload, sick leave, job security in mental health care, and bureaucracy. The government answered that it supports individual arrangements, points to existing measures and a deregulation experiment running to 2014, and says it is an outsider to collective bargaining.
In collective bargaining negotiations the cabinet is simply an outsider.
In CAO-onderhandelingen is het kabinet gewoon een buitenstaander.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over der artikelen “De Alpenzwendel. In het spoor van de voetbalmaffia”en “Enveloppen in Huis ter duin. Talloze lijntjes lopen naar Nederland”en matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether Dutch police and prosecutors had contact with German authorities about match-fixing, whether Interpol and Dutch participation in anti-match-fixing cooperation were adequate, and whether new legislation was needed. The government answered that only a 2009 German mutual legal assistance request concerned a Dutch national, that no Dutch criminal offences were found, that existing criminal law (art. 328ter) suffices, and that prevention is mainly the responsibility of the Dutch football sector and KNVB.
For tackling criminal conduct related to match fixing in our country, the national criminal law system is sufficient.
Voor de aanpak van criminele gedragingen gerelateerd aan match fixing in ons land volstaat het nationale strafrechtelijke stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Oud-topambtenaar wordt tijdelijk boegbeeld IGZ’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a former senior civil servant would serve as interim Inspector-General of the Healthcare Inspectorate, and how this fits with keeping the current IG until a successor is found and with the government's plan to curb costly external hiring. The minister confirmed the interim appointment, explained the IG will leave at retirement rather than stay on, and said the hiring of extra inspectors and mystery guests is not affected.
Initially Mr Van der Wal would stay on at my request until his successor was in place. The IG is giving up on that.
Aanvankelijk zou de heer Van der Wal op mijn verzoek aanblijven tot in zijn opvolging was voorzien. Daar ziet de IG van af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vervanging van de Inspecteur-generaal voor de Gezondheidszorg

The SP MP Leijten asked why an interim head was chosen for the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) while no new Inspector-General had been found, why that person was chosen without a medical background, and what his remuneration and daily costs were. The minister answered that Mr Weck was asked to act as interim Inspector-General given the weight of the tasks, that his remuneration falls under the Wet normering topinkomens, and that the IGZ's reorganisation will continue under his leadership.
Given the weight of the task packages involved with the Inspector-General, I chose to ask Mr Weck to take on the role of acting Inspector-General.
Gelet op de zwaarte van de betrokken takenpakketten van de Inspecteur-generaal heb ik ervoor gekozen om de heer Weck te vragen om de taak van waarnemend Inspecteur-generaal op zich te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de zorg voor kwetsbare vrouwen met psychosociale en psychiatrische problematiek, rond zwangerschap en geboorte

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of the GGZ own-contribution (eigen bijdrage) on vulnerable pregnant women with psychosocial and psychiatric problems, and about why no exemption was created for them. The minister said the effects are still being monitored, acknowledged the risks of care avoidance, but declined a targeted exemption and instead lowered the general contribution to 200 euro with some exceptions.
I am willing to further explore the possibilities for alternative measures for 2013 within the development of the broader policy agenda.
130 ) ook aangegeven dat ik bereid ben om in het kader van de ontwikkeling van de brede beleidsagenda de mogelijkheden voor alternatieve maatregelen voor 2013 verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de gevolgen van de eigen bijdrage in de GGZ voor kwetsbare zwangere vrouwen

Kooiman (SP) asks the health minister about the effects of the new out-of-pocket charge in specialist mental health care on vulnerable pregnant women, including closures of POP clinics, care avoidance, and maternity care costs. The minister defends the charge as a cost-control measure, says no signals of closures or care avoidance have been received, and promises a monitor with first results in September 2012.
I have started a monitor into the effects of the out-of-pocket charge for vulnerable groups in society in general.
Ik heb een monitor gestart naar de effecten van de eigen bijdrage voor kwetsbare groepen in de samenleving in zijn algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een technische briefing over het scheiden van wonen en zorg in de AWBZ

Leijten (SP) asked whether a technical briefing on separating housing and care in the AWBZ was held only for coalition and gedoogpartner parties, why opposition parties were excluded, and whether the briefing would be shared with the Chamber. Minister Schippers answered that briefings are requested by the Chamber itself, that the 7 March briefing was at the request of coalition and gedoogpartner parties, and that the information will be sent to the Chamber, with a list of other briefings given this year and none yet planned.
Of course I am willing to send you this information that was provided on 7 March.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid u deze informatie die op 7 maart is verstrekt hierbij te doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen Smilde over het bericht dat Europa de bijzondere positie van de Nederlandse zorgverzekeraar in het verzekeringsstelsel erkent

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the EU recognises the special position of Dutch health insurers under Solvency II, and whether DNB or EIOPA should set the solvency relief. The minister confirms further negotiation is needed, that the government seeks relief reflecting the risk-equalisation system, and that a Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit report on market entry will be sent to the Chamber.
Soon I will send the Chamber a report that the Dutch Health Care Authority recently prepared on market entry options for health insurers.
Binnenkort stuur ik de Kamer een rapport dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit onlangs heeft opgesteld over de toetredingsmogelijkheden voor zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de dreigende ontmanteling van het Gemini Ziekenhuis in Den Helder

An SP MP asked the health minister about the threatened dismantling of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, the role of consultancy KPMG/Plexus, consultant fees, and whether scaling up hospitals should be reversed. The minister replied that the hospital's future profile keeps 24/7 acute, maternity, planned, chronic and outpatient care, that the study was commissioned internally by the hospital so cost and content are its responsibility, and that she will tighten merger review by giving the NZa a role on quality and accessibility.
It is not for me to provide information on the substantive content, costs and involvement of researchers regarding this study.
Het is niet aan mij om informatie over de inhoudelijke strekking, de kosten en betrokkenheid van onderzoekers aangaande dit onderzoek te verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over het bericht dat het UMC St. Radboud patiënten door middel van DigiD toegang geeft tot het patiëntendossier

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked whether the Radboud UMC may give patients access to their medical records via DigiD, and what oversight prevents misuse and privacy breaches. The minister replied that DigiD level Midden plus a face-to-face identification at the hospital is used, that the hospital is bound by the Wbp under CBP oversight, and that DigiD only authenticates users and does not govern what data they may see.
The UMC St. Radboud is bound by the Personal Data Protection Act (WBP). The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises this.
Het UMC St. Radboud is gehouden aan de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (WBP). Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars 58 miljoen euro aan reclame hebben besteed

An SP MP asked the health minister whether insurers spending 58 million euro on advertising, rising premiums, internet policies favouring younger insured people, and insurers' 7 billion euro reserves are acceptable. The minister replied that advertising spending and market strategy are insurers' own responsibility, that the Don committee is examining risk-equalisation incentives, and that reserves exceed the required solvency level.
The amount of money health insurers spend on advertising falls outside my responsibility.
De hoeveelheid geld die zorgverzekeraars uitgeven aan reclame valt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen Smilde over de ontwikkelingen van E-health

An MP asked the health minister about fragmentation hindering nationwide e-health and what the government would do to stimulate it. The minister acknowledges e-health is not yet deployed at scale, points to a stakeholder initiative, and promises a letter to parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform the House about the cabinet's plans regarding e-health.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de plannen van het kabinet ten aanzien van e-health.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de geconstateerde overtredingen met betrekking tot de productie van filet americain

An MP asked the state secretary and minister about food safety violations in filet americain following a television investigation, including bacteria levels and undisclosed pork. The minister answered that no legal bacteria norm exists for this product, TNO found no pathogens, and she sees no reason to tighten nVWA oversight or add sanctions.
In my view the nVWA oversight is sufficiently adequate on this point, and the television programme has provided no new insights regarding the effectiveness of the oversight.
Naar mijn mening is het nVWA-toezicht voldoende adequaat op dit punt en heeft het televisieprogramma geen nieuwe inzichten opgeleverd ten aanzien van de effectiviteit van het toezicht.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nadelige gevolgen van het vrijgeven van de tarieven en over de fraude met kosten van implantaten (ingezonden 4 april 2012).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that people are visiting the dentist less due to expected cost rises after dental tariffs were liberalised, and about dentists allegedly not passing on large implant discounts from manufacturers, asking whether the NZa will investigate and how patients and insurers will be compensated and informed. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because necessary information is not yet available, and promises answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that not all necessary information is yet available.
De reden van het uitstel bestaat uit het nog niet voorhanden zijn van alle noodzakelijke informatie.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over EHEC-besmetting bij herten

An MP asked the government whether venison from wild deer, found in a German study to be largely carrying EHEC-type bacteria, is adequately controlled and who is liable for food safety in the wild game chain. State Secretary Bleker answered that the bacteria found are mostly harmless STEC, that existing EU and national inspection rules adequately control the risks, and that no new measures or ban are warranted.
I therefore see no reason to ban the consumption of meat from wild animals.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de consumptie van vlees van in het wild levende dieren te verbieden.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma over het “Europees jaar voor Actief ouder worden en Solidariteit tussen de generatie 2012”

An MP asks about the Dutch response to the European Year for Active Ageing 2012, including whether an integrated older-people policy is needed, the aims, budget and coordination with other EU states. The state secretary answers that the SCP shows improving conditions for older people, that departments coordinate their own policy areas, that the year focuses on employment and participation with a EUR 4 million offensive and no dedicated national programme budget, and that experiences are shared with other member states.
Unlike previous European Years, no budget has been made available to member states for implementing a national programme for the 2012 European Year.
In tegenstelling tot eerdere Europese Jaren is er voor het Europees Jaar 2012 aan de lidstaten geen budget voor de uitvoering van een nationaal programma beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de sponsoring door een jeneverproducent van een ziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister to respond to news that a gin producer sponsored a Schiedam hospital, whether such sponsorship could lead to business influence over hospital policy, and whether rules on independence and transparency should be introduced. The minister answered that the donation was not sponsorship, that the board remains responsible for policy, that existing annual-report rules suffice, and that the sector code is being promoted.
No. Through the annual accounts, hospital boards already account for the hospital's financial flows.
Nee. Via de jaarrekening leggen besturen van ziekenhuizen al verantwoording af over de geldstromen van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het betalen van 188.000 euro van VU medisch centrum (VUmc) aan miljonair R.O. van Eyeworks

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister why VUmc agreed to pay 188,000 euro toward production costs of a TV programme with Eyeworks after a medical confidentiality breach, and whether it should be recovered from VUmc decision-makers. The minister regretted the situation, said the costs come from general reserves rather than care funds, and stated the ministry cannot intervene in private contracts while the OM investigation continues, leaving liability to the parties or a judge.
While the OM investigation, which will also cover the agreements between VUmc and Eyeworks, is ongoing, no further statements can be made about the exact content of those agreements.
Lopende het onderzoek van het OM, dat ook betrekking zal hebben op de gemaakte afspraken tussen VUmc en Eyeworks, kunnen verder geen uitspraken gedaan worden over de exacte inhoud van die afspraken.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het artikel ‘Saoedi-Arabië verbiedt vrouwen deel te nemen aan Olympische Spelen’

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister whether it is unacceptable that Saudi Arabia bars women from the Olympics, whether the IOC should exclude such countries, and whether the minister will press colleagues for this. The minister answers that the Dutch government finds exclusion unacceptable, that national Olympic committees choose their own delegations, that talks with the Saudi committee are ongoing, and that the minister will not direct the autonomous IOC but will keep raising equal rights internationally.
No, the IOC follows its own policy in this matter as an autonomous organisation.
Neen, het IOC hanteert als autonome organisatie zijn eigen beleid in deze.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over Veiligheid van en controle op geneesmiddelen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the growing production of medicines in low-wage countries, contaminated Ranbaxy omeprazole, inspection limits, and transparency of quality controls. The minister answered that inspections, GMP certification, batch testing and publicly available reports ensure quality, while acknowledging rising risks and that labour conditions fall outside her responsibility.
I cannot comment on the oversight of social and working conditions on site, as this is not under my responsibility.
Over het toezicht op de sociale en arbeidsomstandigheden ter plaatse kan ik geen uitspraak doen, aangezien dit niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid valt.
Antwoord vragen Samsom en Arib over de besmetting van een ex-AMV-er met hepatitis B, direct na verblijf in het detentiecentrum in Rotterdam

MPs Samsom and Arib asked whether a former unaccompanied minor, released from the Rotterdam immigration detention centre and later found infected with acute hepatitis B, had reported symptoms, how the GGD handled the case, and what measures would prevent sick migrants being released onto the street. The minister declined to answer medical questions, said the State Secretary had asked for an investigation by the IGZ into the care given and precautionary measures, reported the GGD's contact tracing found no link to the centre so far, and said medical intake and aftercare standards apply and a residence offer was made under RANOV.
I cannot answer questions that fall within the medical duty of confidentiality.
Op vragen die vallen binnen de medische geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het aantal sterfgevallen in detentie

MP Bouwmeester asked about deaths in detention, including discrepancies between DJI and IGZ figures and reported deaths of detainees in late 2011. The state secretary explained the differences in counting and reporting, acknowledged that some deaths outside prisons were not reported to the IGZ, and promised intensified cooperation and a policy response after the Nationale Ombudsman study.

I consider it important that such deaths are also reported, so that there is a complete overview of all deceased persons under the responsibility of DJI, and I have therefore asked the penitentiary institutions to comply.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook dergelijke sterfgevallen gemeld worden, zodat er een totaaloverzicht is van alle overledenen onder verantwoordelijkheid van DJI, en heb de pi's dan ook gevraagd hier gehoor aan te geven.
Antwoord vragen Straus over het geweld tegen hulpverleners in de psychiatrie dat vaak onbestraft blijft

An MP asked the government about violence against psychiatric staff that often goes unpunished, including low reporting rates, weak prosecution, and differences between institutions and patient groups. The minister answered that the government is taking the issue seriously, points to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, the ELA agreements and the new Politie-GGZ convenant, and reports no evidence of differences in prioritisation or treatment.
In it we have included measures aimed at the care sector to improve the legal approach to the perpetrator, including an increase in willingness to report.
Daarin hebben wij op de zorgsector gerichte maatregelen opgenomen om de juridische aanpak van de veroorzaker te verbeteren, inclusief een verhoging van de aangiftebereidheid.
Antwoord vragen Samsom en Arib over de besmetting van een ex- AMV-er met hepatitis B, direct na verblijf in het detentiecentrum in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked ministers about a seriously ill Chinese asylum seeker released from immigration detention in Rotterdam with hepatitis B, including alleged neglect, destroyed samples, and a wrongly denied general pardon since 2007. The minister answered that the internal investigation is pending, the IGZ may investigate further, no other infections were found, and the individual's own conduct and unclear identity contributed to the delayed permit, with any compensation left open.
If, after the internal investigation is completed, questions remain unanswered in the inspectorate's view, the IGZ itself, as an independent party, will carry out further investigation.
Wanneer – na afronding van het interne onderzoek – er naar oordeel van de inspectie vragen onbeantwoord blijven, dan zal de IGZ zelf, als onafhankelijke partij, nader onderzoek verrichten.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Enveloppen in Huis ter Duin. Talloze lijntjes Duitse gokmaffia lopen naar Nederland’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked whether the government will act on reports of Dutch involvement in match fixing and bribery in international football. The minister answers that the sports sector is primarily responsible, that no Dutch criminal offences have been identified so far, and that the government will share knowledge and support prevention at national and EU level.
The sports world is primarily responsible for the integrity of sport and gives substance to this itself.
De sportwereld is primair verantwoordelijk voor de integriteit van de sport en geeft daar ook invulling aan.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra en Hachchi over onveilige software in pacemakers

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in SCADA software in pacemakers and insulin pumps, including whether manufacturers must report flaws and whether certification should be mandatory. The minister answered that no central registry exists, that manufacturers must validate software and carry out post-market surveillance, that reports go to notified bodies or the IGZ, and that tightening of the existing regime is planned.
In my letter dated 27 March 2012, I informed you of my plans to tighten the current legal regime.
In mijn brief d.d. 27 maart 2012, heb ik mijn voornemens voor aanscherpingen binnen het huidige wettelijke regime aan u kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asks the ministers of Health and Justice about a euthanasia case involving a dementia patient, including whether the Regional Euthanasia Review Committee's ruling is reliable, whether a Public Prosecution Service investigation is warranted, and the legal status of advance written declarations. The minister defends the committee's ruling, says no prosecution investigation is needed, states that the law clearly allows written declarations, and points to KNMG guidance and the upcoming evaluation of the Euthanasia Act.
The ruling of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees contains a description of the committee's assessment of the notification.
Het oordeel van de Regionale toetsingscommissies euthanasie bevat een weergave van de beoordeling van de melding door de commissie.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er veel meer q-koortsslachtoffers zijn

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Q-fever outbreak was far larger than previously stated, why past estimates were wrong, and whether a Q-fever compensation fund should be set up. The minister answered that earlier figures were not wrong because notified cases differ from infections, that no national estimate of medical or economic costs exists, and that about 250 chronic patients are being treated, with the Visie op schadefondsen letter setting out the position on a fund.
No national estimate has been made of the medical costs and economic damage resulting from Q-fever.
Er is geen landelijke inschatting gemaakt van medische kosten en de economische schade als gevolg van Q-koorts.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de forse rekening die patiënten ontvangen door vrije tarieven in de mondzorg

An MP asked the health minister whether patients face high dental bills under free pricing, whether a consumer federation's finding that tandartsen charge more than insurers reimburse for most treatments is accurate, and what action will be taken. The minister said she relies on the NZa market scans, which show most prices within the conversion bandwidth, and that she maintains no co-payments within the basic package, with the NZa monitor due in June.
While I appreciate the various publications, I am primarily guided by the reports of the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
Met waardering die ik voor de diverse publicaties heb, laat ik mij primair leiden door de rapportages van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht dat aansluiting op het Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP) een minimale kwaliteitseis is

An MP asks the health minister to react to reports that connection to the national switchpoint LSP would become a minimum quality requirement set by health insurers, and asks for no such requirement before a professional norm exists. The minister answers that quality requirements are set by the care professions themselves, that no connection requirement exists yet, and that insurers have said they will not include it in contracts before the profession adopts it.
At this moment there is no requirement to connect to the LSP yet.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.

Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over een EU-pilot voor een Europees elektronisch patiëntendossier en de uitspraken van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland inzake het verplicht stellen van aansluiting bij het Landelijk Schak

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked about privacy safeguards in the EU-pilot EPSOS for a European electronic patient record and about insurers' plans to make connection to the national switchpoint (LSP) a contracting requirement. The minister said EPSOS pilots run only between other countries, that data stays at source with explicit patient consent, and that connection requirements are for the care providers' profession to set, with insurers not yet imposing one.
At this moment there is not yet any requirement to connect to the LSP.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het laten inslapen van vier testapen door de Radboud Universiteit

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether Radboud University euthanised four healthy rhesus monkeys that could have been rehomed, and how the animal ethics committee assessed the procedures. The minister answered that two were killed within the experiment on committee advice and two for veterinary reasons, that the university is responsible for decisions on animals after experiments, and that the NVWA found no violations of the Animal Experiments Act.
In response to your questions, I have asked the NVWA to assess the situation.
Ik heb de NVWA naar aanleiding van uw vragen verzocht de situatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat fysiotherapie te duur is voor mensen met reuma

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about a Reumafonds survey showing physiotherapy costs are unaffordable for rheumatism patients, and about CVZ's basis for excluding certain physiotherapy from basic coverage. The minister replies that only short-term effective physiotherapy is covered, that patients can take out supplementary insurance without medical selection in most cases, that CVZ's advice rests on evidence-based medicine, and that no extra costs are tracked.
CVZ's position on the effectiveness of physiotherapy and exercise therapy for rheumatism is not based on the judgment of a number of rheumatologists.
Het standpunt van het CVZ over de effectiviteit van fysio- en oefentherapie bij reuma is niet gebaseerd op het oordeel van een aantal reumatologen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen over onrust rondom de contractering tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about contracting disputes between insurers and hospitals that could leave insured patients paying for care, including passant prices and whether acute and ongoing treatment is covered. The minister said she has no view on passant prices, that insurers and hospitals must inform patients, that ongoing and acute care is fully reimbursed, and declined to give details of individual contracts as commercially confidential.
Antwoord vragen Klavers en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht van de notulen van de onderraad

Klaver and Peters asked whether the confidentiality rules of the ministerial council (artikel 26 Reglement van Orde) justify withholding the minutes of the onderraad on the Olympic Games, and whether the minister would grant a waiver. The government confirmed the rule allows waiver but answered that confidentiality of council deliberations is a state interest limiting parliamentary information, and gave no commitment to release the minutes.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Van Gerven over marteling en mishandeling in Israëlische detentiecentra

MPs Van Bommel and Van Gerven asked the government about a report alleging torture and ill-treatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres with medical staff involvement, and whether the government would press Israel for independent investigation and accountability. The minister said the government cannot assess the report's findings, leaves judgement and investigation to Israeli authorities and the UN Committee against Torture, and noted Israel's Health Ministry had set up a review commission.
The cabinet does not have the information that would make it possible to form a judgement on the content of the report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de informatie die het mogelijk maakt een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud van het rapport.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over omkoping en bedrog in het internationale voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing and betting-syndicate involvement in international football, including risks to Dutch youth players and whether the Dutch authorities acted after German arrests. The minister said the Dutch federation KNVB leads prevention, that no Dutch cases of youth players being approached are known, and that the German case produced no Dutch investigation, while the government will join Council of Europe negotiations on a match-fixing convention.
First and foremost, sport is in the lead and is doing a great deal on this front with various preventive measures.
Eerst en vooral is de sport aan zet en die zetten hier fors op in met verschillende preventieve maatregelen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Joldersma over het bericht dat hulpverleners in de psychiatrie regelmatig slachtoffer worden van geweld veroorzaakt door een patiënt, en daarvan vaak geen aangifte doen of meld

MPs Bruins Slot and Joldersma (CDA) asked the health minister about reports that psychiatric staff are often assaulted by patients and rarely report it to police, and about how to improve reporting, prosecution follow-up, and support. Minister Schippers answered that violence against care workers is unacceptable, pointed to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, to planned measures including time-outs and new patient-oriented coercion laws, and to annual training support for 100 institutions.
Whatever the background, aggression and violence against care workers is unacceptable.
Wat de achtergrond ook is, agressie en geweld tegen zorgverleners is onacceptabel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de notoire zaken bij de IGZ

MP Leijten asked whether the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) had 215 cases over one year old in early 2011 and 57 in 2012, and why the Chamber was not informed, plus whether the backlog reflects a structural problem and whether media-prominent cases get priority. Minister Schippers answered that the backlog of cases over one year fell from about 1,000 to about 320, that the 25 high-impact cases were cleared, that a one-year norm was adopted with a commission to test feasibility, and that the figures cited concern only hospitals and specialists while the general table covers all providers.
I have also reported that to your Chamber.
Ik heb uw Kamer dat ook gemeld.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over een internationale aanpak van voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked whether an international approach to football hooliganism exists, whether an international combined-ticket scheme should be introduced, and whether municipalities should be compensated for extra costs. Minister Opstelten answered that EU cooperation and information exchange already exist, that a combined-ticket scheme is impractical, that police deployment figures are given, and that municipalities remain responsible and need no compensation.
Maintaining public order remains the responsibility of mayors under article 172 of the Municipalities Act.
De handhaving van de openbare orde is en blijft een verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeesters ingevolge artikel 172 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over voedingszorg voor kinderen met een chronische aandoening

An MP asked the health and education ministers about a report showing high malnutrition risk among chronically ill children at LZK schools, a cost-benefit analysis of nutritional care, and a proposed expertise centre. The minister said the report's conclusions are not sufficiently researched and refused to fund or formally support the expertise centre, which is not a government responsibility.
I am therefore not willing to support this initiative financially or administratively.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om dit initiatief financieel of bestuurlijk te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Smilde over een omstreden maagchirurg in Duitsland

MPs Bruins Slot and Smilde asked the health minister about a controversial stomach surgeon in Germany and how disqualified doctors can be prevented from practising across borders. The minister said the IGZ can inform foreign authorities, that a BIG-register entry for foreign measures is being introduced, and that EU-level information exchange and a warning mechanism are being pursued.
First, the IGZ can inform the competent authorities in the receiving country if the professional concerned is known to those authorities.
Ten eerste kan de IGZ de bevoegde autoriteiten in het ontvangende land informeren ingeval de betrokken beroepsbeoefenaar bij die autoriteiten bekend is.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over de veiligheid van geneesmiddelen en de rol van het CBG

An MP asks the health minister about the safety of medicines, the CBG's assessment practice, contract research organisations, funding, conflicts of interest and the Brandpunt allegations. The minister defends the CBG's assessments and procedures, notes existing checks, pharmacovigilance and a new conflict-of-interest code, and declines to send a letter to parliament.
I see no reason to send such a letter.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het sturen van een dergelijke brief.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over de kosten van bloed

An MP asked the health minister about the high price of blood units sold by Sanquin to hospitals, comparisons with Germany and Belgium, Sanquin's cost structure, its reserves of about 280 million euros, and board salaries. The minister answered that the price is based on total cost allocation, that a ConQuaestor study was commissioned and a position letter will follow, and that board pay follows the applicable pay rules.
I indicated in my reply that I have agreed with the Sanquin Supervisory Board that new board members will be remunerated in line with the Remuneration Code for Healthcare Board Members (BBZ).

Ik heb in mijn beantwoording aangegeven dat ik met de Raad van Toezicht Sanquin ben overeengekomen dat zij nieuwe bestuurders gaan honoreren conform de Beloningscode voor bestuurders in de zorg (BBZ).
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer in het kader van de plannen voor Olympische Spelen in 2028

An MP asks the health minister who received an internal cabinet note on exploratory studies for the 2028 Olympics, whether she knew of civil servants' preference to omit investment costs and cost-benefit balance from the letter, why a €8 billion Finance figure was not in the VMKB, and whether she will respond to and send the second opinion on the VMKB to parliament. The minister answers that the draft was circulated within the sport policy directorate, refers all substantive questions to her letter of 23 March 2012 and says the second opinion was published on planning bureau websites, not sent to parliament.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het bericht dat het VU medisch centrum (VUmc) het medisch beroepsgeheim heeft geschonden

An MP asked the health minister about reports that VUmc hospital allowed a TV company to film emergency-room patients without prior consent, possibly breaching medical confidentiality. The minister said the public prosecutor is investigating whether an offence occurred, the inspectorate awaits that outcome, and she will alert hospitals to the rules on requesting consent, while declining to comment on agreements between VUmc and the filming company.
The OM will not make any statements about the content of those arrangements during the ongoing investigation.
Het OM zal geen mededelingen doen over de inhoud daarvan gedurende het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het plaatsen van tv-camera’s in het VU medisch centrum

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether filming hidden TV cameras at VUmc without patients' knowledge breached medical confidentiality and privacy, and about consent, deleted footage, hospital accountability and commercial ownership. Minister Schippers answered that privacy and confidentiality are distinct, that the CBP is investigating, that the posters approach is inadequate, and that hospital staff should be restrained in media cooperation, but she largely referred back to earlier answers and found no basis to link profit-making to such incidents.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is currently investigating whether privacy has been violated in this case.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) onderzoekt momenteel in deze zaak of de privacy is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht meisje pleegt zelfmoord om beleid minister

An MP (PvdA) asked the health minister whether she knew of a press report that a girl died by suicide because of the minister's policy, whether an investigation would be conducted, and how acute care would be guaranteed despite a 200 euro own-contribution. The minister declined to answer, stating that the report had been found to be inaccurate according to the mental health provider's press release, and considered the questions moot.
I am of the view that answering the questions posed is therefore not relevant.
Ik ben van mening dat antwoord op de gestelde vragen daarmee niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de geringe stijging van het aantal orgaandonoren

Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister why the number of organ donors rises only slightly, covering donor registrations, waiting lists, transplant numbers and whether trends show progress. Minister Schippers answered that registrations and transplants are slowly increasing, that waiting list size is a weak indicator, and that promising hospital pilots are being rolled out nationally, though it is too early to speak of trends.
I expect that further growth can be stimulated by rolling out the pilots in hospitals.
Ik verwacht dat een verdere groei kan worden gestimuleerd door de uitrol van de pilots in de ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over De uitspraak van de Minister-president dat het voor homoseksuele mannen mogelijk wordt bloed te doneren.

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that gay men would be allowed to donate blood is accurate, and whether the government had already decided its position without waiting for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister answered that the policy is under review in consultation with the education minister, that current rules exclude men who have sex with men, and that a decision depends on a forthcoming Council of Europe resolution expected in May 2012, with a letter to parliament promised before the summer recess.
I expect to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer hier voor het zomerreces over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch over het strafrechtelijk afkopen van vervolging na het lastigvallen en bedreigen van een scheidsrechter

MPs asked why three men who harassed and threatened a referee received a 210 euro settlement offer roughly ten months after the incident, and how this fits the government's tough approach to football violence. The minister replied that evidence was insufficient for harassment and threats, that the suspects were offered a 210 euro transaction for theft in association, and that the delay stemmed from further investigation needed after the first report.
For this offence, in line with the applicable guidelines, the Public Prosecution Service offered each of the suspects a transaction proposal of 210 euros.
Het OM heeft voor dit feit – overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen – aan ieder van de verdachten een transactievoorstel van € 210,– aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat door het schrappen van dieetadvisering uit het basispakket, (dreigende) ondervoeding onbehandeld blijft

MP Leijten asked the minister whether removing dietary advice from the basic health insurance package leaves malnutrition untreated, citing over 100 reports and halved home visits, and asked about the total annual cost of malnutrition. Minister Schippers answered that the signal is serious but not directly attributable to the removal, that she does not intend to restore dietary advice to the package given the need for cuts, and that the total cost cannot be calculated due to lack of criteria.
However, I do not share the assumption that the (threatened) increase in malnutrition is a direct consequence of the removal of dietary advice from the basic package of the Health Insurance Act.
Ik deel echter niet de aanname dat de (dreigende) toename van ondervoeding direct het gevolg is van het schrappen van dieetadvisering uit het basispakket van de Zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing en het verkopen van de voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the ministers about match-fixing in football, criminal bookmakers' influence, and whether the KNVB's concerns warrant investigation. The minister answered that data is insufficient to judge the scale, that the sports sector and betting operators bear primary responsibility for prevention, and that existing criminal law suffices, with no concrete information yet of bribery in the Netherlands.
I do not have hard research data indicating how large the influence of criminal bookmakers in football is.
Ik beschik niet over harde onderzoeksgegevens die aangeven hoe groot de invloed is van criminele gokbazen in het voetbal.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het feit dat de 99 procent van het kippenvlees in de supermarkt besmet is met ESBL-producerende bacteriën

An MP asks the health minister whether it is acceptable that 99 percent of supermarket chicken carries ESBL-producing bacteria, and what has become of the 1996 government pledge to ban contaminated chicken products. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, points to existing measures and a Campylobacter covenant, and says she is considering additional measures, while stating that contact with ESBL-contaminated products is not a direct risk for consumers and that a legal ban has not been justified by the EU.
I am therefore considering additional measures regarding Campylobacter and aim to come up with concrete proposals before the end of this year.
Ik beraad mij daarom op aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van Campylobacter en streef ernaar nog voor het eind van dit jaar met concrete voorstellen te komen.
Antwoord vragen Smilde, Bruins Slot en Blanksma-van den Heuvel over het bericht "dure verzekering voor dikke mensen"

Three CDA MPs asked how a person of normal health but high BMI (1.60 m, 90 kg) can pay higher insurance premiums, and how insurers assess health and lifestyle. The minister explained that insurers may use lifestyle factors including overweight for life and disability insurance, that assessment follows insurers' own policies within legal limits, and that health insurance premiums must generally be uniform.
Insurers may not ask more questions than are included in this model health declaration.
Verzekeraars mogen niet meer vragen stellen dan op deze model-gezondheidsverklaring zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over gezondheidsproblemen van illegale vrouwen

An MP from the Labour party asked the health minister how to respond to a dissertation showing that undocumented women have serious unmet health needs, including sexual violence, gynaecological problems and limited access to care. The minister replied that Dutch law already provides access to medically necessary care for undocumented people, that GGDs and existing schemes are adequate, and that no special screening, new pilot or targeted approach is needed.
I am of the opinion that the Netherlands complies with these obligations.
Ik ben van mening dat Nederland voldoet aan deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Ferrier over de gevaren van totaal resistente tbc

CDA MPs Smilde and Ferrier asked about the danger of totally drug-resistant tuberculosis in India, Europe and the Netherlands, the Dutch preparedness plans, funding for new TB drugs, policy coherence and travel advice. The minister answered that resistant TB is significant but TDR-TB has not yet been found in the Netherlands, that existing plans, expert working groups and screening are in place, and that new drug development is largely the pharmaceutical industry's task, with some Dutch funding and no change to travel advice.
TDR-TB has not yet been observed in the Netherlands.
TDR-tbc is nog niet waargenomen in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het gebruik van chemische toevoegingen in dierlijke producten

MP Hazekamp asked the ministers whether ammonium hydroxide (E527) and meat glue (trombine/fibrinogen) are permitted in Dutch meat products, whether they are safe, and how labelling and an EU ban would be handled. Minister Schippers answered that E527 is considered safe and remains permitted under EU rules until a 2013 change, that the Commission is still deciding on enzyme measures, that labelling of meat glue is required on packaged meat but not on unpackaged meat, and that the matter should be settled at EU level.
No, I believe this discussion should be resolved at European level.
Nee, Ik vind dat deze discussie op Europees niveau moet worden beslecht.
Antwoord vragen Mulder over de normtijd van 45 minuten voor ambulances

An MP asked the health minister whether the 45-minute ambulance response norm, which has no scientific basis, should be revised given better ambulance equipment, and whether it will be reviewed. The minister acknowledges better ambulances but insists on keeping the 45-minute norm for access to a basic emergency department and has no plans to update or study it.
I continue to adhere to the 45-minute accessibility norm.
Ik blijf hechten aan de bereikbaarheidsnorm van 45 minuten.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij en Van der Veen over diabetes op het werk

MPs Vermeij and Van der Veen asked about a study showing employers are unprepared for diabetes among workers and about the role of occupational physicians and policy to support early recognition. The state secretary answered that the picture is not uniform, pointed to a Gezond Bedrijf action plan and a ZonMw diabetes-and-work guideline, and gave no new binding measures.
In the action plan Gezond Bedrijf I also devote attention to workers with a chronic condition, such as diabetes.
In het actieplan Gezond Bedrijf besteed ik ook aandacht aan werkenden met een chronische aandoening, zoals diabetes.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over de berichten dat de Saxion Hogeschool de niet-geaccrediteerde opleiding tot CAM-therapeut blijft aanbieden

SP MPs asked whether Saxion Next still offers a non-accredited HBO CAM therapist programme and what happens to students and graduates. The state secretary answered that existing students may finish, that their diplomas are legally valid, that no new students were enrolled after accreditation lapsed, and that the website wording has been amended.
Saxion Next has acknowledged this and has since amended the text on the website.
Saxion Next heeft dit onderkend en heeft de tekst op de website inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij over het ontbreken van richtlijnen voor huisartsen over een gesprek over ongewenste zwangerschap

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether GPs have adequate guidance and training to discuss alternatives with women facing unwanted pregnancy, citing research showing alternatives are rarely discussed. Minister Schippers replied that the GP plays an important role, but that the content of GP training and professional development is for the profession itself, and she sees no need for new measures.
I see no need for any intentions on my part in this area.
Ik zie geen noodzaak tot enige voornemens van mijn zijde op dit vlak.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Menzis doet aangifte tegen Jansen Steur’

Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the minister about Menzis filing a criminal complaint against a former neurologist and whether insurers should recover costs of improperly prescribed treatment. The minister said insurers may pursue claims but the decision is theirs, that IGZ is responsible for investigating improper prescribing, and that she lacks data on past recoveries.
When the IGZ becomes aware that a medicine has been prescribed on incorrect grounds, it is up to the IGZ to investigate this and, where necessary, to take action.
Wanneer de IGZ op de hoogte raakt van het voorschrijven van een geneesmiddel op onjuiste gronden dan ligt het op de weg van de IGZ om daar onderzoek naar te doen en zo nodig op te treden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het advies om zwangere vrouwen te waarschuwen voor het Schmallenbergvirus

An MP asks the health minister whether pregnant women should be warned about Schmallenberg virus risks, given uncertain transmission to humans, and asks about awareness of zoonoses, public information, disclosure of affected farm addresses and research. The minister answers that transmission cannot be excluded, so precautionary hygiene advice for pregnant women is justified, that information is already available, that farm locations are published on the NVWA website, and that RIVM has prepared a research proposal discussed with experts.
Transmission of the virus to humans indeed cannot be ruled out, and therefore preventive measures are justified from the precautionary principle.
Overdracht van het virus naar mensen kan inderdaad niet worden uitgesloten en daarom zijn preventieve maatregelen vanuit het voorzorgprincipe gerechtvaardigd.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht ‘bouwplan MST is financiële ramp’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether she shares concerns that MST's new building plan will become a financial disaster, whether a merger with ZGT could be used to cover MST's losses, and about ZGT's interim-staff costs, service relocations and monopoly risks under market competition. The minister declined to judge hospital financial decisions, said a bank consortium carries MST's loan risk, denied a merger was planned, and answered that hospitals and insurers are responsible for service configuration while promising a merger-review bill.
It is not my responsibility to judge the financial decisions a hospital takes: that is the responsibility of the institution's own board, which must account to the Supervisory Board.

Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid een oordeel te vellen over de financiële besluiten die een ziekenhuis neemt: dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling zelf, waarover verantwoording moet worden afgelegd aan de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Haverkamp over traumahelikopters

MPs Smilde and Haverkamp asked the health minister whether a study finding no proven added value of trauma helicopters over regular ambulance transport was valid and what criteria govern dispatch. The minister disagreed with the study's conclusion, explained the dispatch criteria, and said no obstacles are known to limiting helicopter response.
I think differently about that; in my view that conclusion cannot be drawn.
Daar denk ik anders over, die conclusie kan naar mijn idee niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het besluit in de gemeente Staphorst om informatie over abortus op de website van het Centrum voor Jeugd en Gezin (CJG) weg te laten

MP Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about Staphorst municipality's decision to omit abortion information from its CJG website, whether other municipalities do the same, and whether the minister will set norms. The state secretary replied that municipalities decide their own website content, that the Stichting Opvoeden.nl database is being reviewed, and that she will not impose norms on municipalities.
This does not mean that I want to intervene normatively towards municipalities.
Dit betekent niet dat ik normerend wil optreden richting gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over banenverlies en bezuinigingen bij de GGZ Drenthe

An SP MP asked the health minister about job losses, bed reductions and the EUR 8.5 million cut at GGZ Drenthe, and whether care gaps and drop-outs from the eigen bijdrage would be prevented. The minister regretted the job losses, said no sluiting of sites or forced dismissals were planned, and relied on GGZ Drenthe's assurances and her own monitoring of the eigen bijdrage, while declining to give a national overview of lost intramural places.
I cannot give an overview of the disappearance of intramural places, because implementing the cuts is the responsibility of the GGZ institutions themselves.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven van het verdwijnen van het aantal intramurale plekken, omdat het invullen de bezuinigingen de verantwoordelijkheid van de GGZ-instellingen zelf is.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de ergernis van veehouders aan het wisselend beleid van ziekenhuizen rond MRSA

An MP asked the health minister about veterinary farmers' frustration over inconsistent hospital policy on MRSA and ESBL bacteria, and whether a uniform national protocol, a national reporting point, cost assessments and clearance certificates for farmers are warranted. The minister answered that national guidelines from the WIP already exist, that hospitals are responsible for implementing them, that carrier data are provided, that no further cost study is needed, and that clearance certificates are of doubtful value given the Gezondheidsraad advice to keep current policy.
A national protocol therefore already exists.
Een landelijk protocol bestaat dus al.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over over het bericht dat kraamverzorgenden nog steeds niet geschoold worden in EHBO vaardigheden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister why midwifery aides (kraamverzorgenden) still are not trained in first aid and life-saving skills despite an adopted motion, and what would be done about it. Minister Schippers answered that the training is expected to be added via employers and insurers in bij- en nascholing, pointed to a pending NZa tariff review, and said the existing basic training is adequate, with an evaluation underway.
Given the importance of keeping knowledge and skills on first aid up to date, I expect that care providers will include first aid in in-service and refresher training.
Gezien het belang van het up-to-date houden van kennis en vaardigheden op het terrein van EHBO, verwacht ik dat EHBO door de kraamzorgaanbieders wordt meegenomen in de bij- en nascholing.

Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Smilde over het artikel “Floortje Mols, Melissa S.Y. Thong, Pauline Vissers, Tamar Nijsten, Lonneke V. van de Poll-Franse: ‘Socio-economic implications of cancer survivorship: results from the

MPs Omtzigt and Smilde asked the health minister about a study showing former cancer patients, especially younger ones, struggled to obtain life insurance or mortgages, and whether standard acceptance protocols could be pushed for or the Wet op de medische keuringen tightened. The minister said life insurance has no statutory acceptance duty, saw no reason to change the law now, left responsibility largely with insurers, and noted the NFK is in talks with the insurers' association.
For now I see no reason to amend the law.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het beleid ten aanzien van obesitas

An SP MP asked the health minister about obesity policy, premium differentiation by insurers based on overweight, the removal of dietetic care from the basic insurance package, and the framing of obesity as a lifestyle choice. The minister defended a prevention-focused approach, said insurers are free to differentiate premiums only outside the basic health insurance, and argued that dietetic advice can be borne by patients themselves.
The example that appeared in the media concerns an insurance premium for a death-risk insurance policy.
Het voorbeeld dat in de media verschenen is, betreft een verzekeringspremie van een overlijdensrisicoverzekering.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Hausse aan fusies zorginstellingen’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of a surge in healthcare mergers, the number of registered partnerships since the moratorium, and her talks with providers with merger plans. The minister said no complete registry exists, that she has personally urged several providers to act carefully, and that the IGZ and NZa have limited powers to assess mergers.
However, there is no statutory obligation to report or register partnerships.
Er bestaat echter geen wettelijke verplichting om samenwerkingsverbanden te melden of te registreren.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Van der Veen over de voorgenomen concentratie van Sanquin en het daardoor dreigende banenverlies

MPs Van Dekken and Van der Veen asked the health minister about Sanquin's planned concentration of activities in Amsterdam and Nijmegen, which would reduce its Groningen blood bank and cost jobs there. The minister said the reorganisation was only tested on safety, efficiency and quality rather than employment, that it aims to save costs, that a social plan is under discussion, and that Groningen will keep key functions with no negative service effects.
A reorganisation plan is not tested by me on operational aspects such as employment.
Een voornemen tot reorganisatie wordt door mij niet getoetst op bedrijfsvoeringsaspecten, zoals werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het ontduiken van de afspraken in het Convenant Overgewicht

An MP asks the health minister whether Haribo's sponsorship of a children's TV show and a school promotion breach the Convenant Overgewicht advertising rules, and whether sanctions should apply. The minister replies that the convenant has lapsed, the relevant advertising rules are self-regulatory and not breached, and sanctions are not appropriate under the convenant's structure.
The Convenant Overgewicht is no longer current; it was terminated at the end of 2009.
Het Convenant Overgewicht is niet meer actueel; eind 2009 is dit beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over snoepautomaten in Connexxion bussen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Connexxion's ban on eating self-brought food in snack-machine buses, while snacks are sold, is absurd, amounts to forced retail, and whether Connexxion should be called to order. The minister replied that fruit was tolerated, the change is a pilot, the concession authority is the regional body, and that the ministry cannot instruct Connexxion on its products, with results to be discussed with the Stadsregio.
It is not for me to call Connexxion to account for its products.
Het is niet aan de mij om Connexxion aan te spreken op zijn producten.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Arib over de lobby van de sigarettenindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Arib asked the health minister about reported tobacco industry lobbying, WHO guideline compliance, contacts with the industry, and whether smoking is addictive and the industry's economic role matters to policy. The minister said Dutch practice follows the FCTC 5.3 guideline with transparency, referred to earlier overviews of contacts, said there was no prior contact with the industry on recent measures, and stated tobacco policy is not affected by the industry's economic contribution.
The requested overview of contacts between my ministry and the tobacco industry was previously provided in parliamentary questions of 1 December 2011 and 31 January 2012.
Het gevraagde overzicht van contacten tussen mijn ministerie en de tabaksindustrie heb ik eerder verstrekt in Kamervragen van 1 december 2011 en 31 januari 2012.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Gent over christelijke homotherapie

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Gent asked the health minister how the Health Care Inspectorate investigated the Christian 'homotherapy' provider Different, whether it spoke to former clients, and what the treatment entails. The minister answered that the inspectorate made a site visit, interviewed clients and management, found weak diagnosis practices, and ordered improvements with a follow-up check within two months.
The IGZ will monitor these improvement measures over the coming period and will carry out a new check within 2 months, focused on sound diagnosis, information provision and codes of conduct.
De IGZ monitort deze verbetermaatregelen de komende periode en zal binnen 2 maanden een nieuwe toets uitvoeren, gericht op deugdelijke diagnosestelling, voorlichting en gedragscodering.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het onderzoek van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg naar het aanbieden van christelijke homotherapie

An MP from D66 asked the health minister to explain the government's view that Different's therapy does not aim to cure homosexuality, and why the Inspectorate's report does not reflect former clients' testimonies. The minister answered that the therapy supports acceptance of one's sexuality, that the Inspectorate has told Different that treatment aimed at curing homosexuality can never comply with guidelines, and that former clients' experiences were included and the Inspectorate will re-check within two months.
If the IGZ still receives reports from (former) clients pointing to treatment aimed at 'curing' homosexuality, the IGZ will investigate these directly and take measures where necessary.
Als de IGZ alsnog meldingen krijgt van (ex-) cliënten die wijzen op behandeling gericht op het «genezen» van homoseksualiteit, dan zal de IGZ deze direct onderzoeken en zo nodig maatregelen treffen
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Van der Staaij over de beslissingsmacht van zorgverzekeraars over een ambulancepost op Walcheren

MPs Van der Veen and Van der Staaij asked whether the minister remains responsible for keeping the Walcheren ambulance post open, given that the NZa and insurers could let it close, and how this fits the 45-minute norm and her responsibility for vital care. The minister answered that the NZa independently assessed the request, approved retroactive extra budget for the ambulance service, and that responsibility for acute care is clearly divided between insurers, the NZa and the RAV.
I will ask the NZa to add these funds to the budget of the RAVZ.
Ik zal de NZa verzoeken deze middelen aan het budget van de RAVZ toe te voegen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over het gesteggel rond de financiering van de extra ambulance op de Kop van Walcheren en het geboortecentrum in Vlissingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the dispute over funding an extra ambulance on Walcheren and the Vlissingen birth centre, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says the NZa has independently raised the Connexxion budget retroactively and that the birth centre stays open, while stressing the NZa's independence and placing responsibility for regional care with insurers and providers.
I am politically responsible for the functioning of the NZa as a whole. However, in its judgement the NZa is independent.
Ik ben politiek verantwoordelijk voor het functioneren van de NZa als geheel. In haar oordeelsvorming is de NZa echter onafhankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat wijkverpleegkundigen goedkoper en beter zijn dan verpleeghuiszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether research showing district nurses are cheaper and better than nursing-home care (44.7% lower costs in a comparison) holds, and whether more district nurses should be deployed. The state secretary answered that the 44.7% figure rests on a single-client financial comparison that cannot support general conclusions, that the NPCF/V&VN, ZonMw and BMC findings are broadly consistent, and that the NZa will issue a feasibility review before deciding on financing.
It should be clear that no general conclusions can be drawn from this.
Het moge duidelijk zijn dat hieruit geen algemene conclusies getrokken kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van het middel Caphosol en speekselsubstituten/mondspoelmiddelen aan onder andere kinderen met kanker

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the minister refuses to reimburse Caphosol and similar saliva substitutes for children and others with cancer-treatment mouth sores, and whether OHRA's exceptional reimbursement shows the drug should be covered. The minister answered that these products are not on the reimbursement list, are classed as self-care products not medically necessary, and that the CZ group's coulance policy would not generally cover them.
Caphosol, like all other saliva substitutes/mouthwashes (except Salvia Orthana), is not a registered medicine but an aid.
Caphosol is net als alle andere speekselsubstituten/mondspoelingen (behalve Salvia Orthana) geen geregistreerd geneesmiddel, maar een hulpmiddel.
Antwoord vragen Arib over concentratie van verloskundige zorg

An MP asks the minister about the planned concentration of acute obstetric care from Meppel to Zwolle, the required ambulance adjustments, the role of the College Perinatale Zorg, and national overviews. The minister answers that the hospital decision is not yet final pending accessibility guarantees, lists ongoing consultations and inventories, and promises further reports before the parliamentary debate.
I cannot currently give you an overview of the initiatives to concentrate obstetric care in the Netherlands.
Ik kan u op dit moment geen overzicht geven van de initiatieven tot concentratie van verloskundige zorg in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Leijten over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op de GGZ voor de politie

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked whether cuts to mental health care (GGZ) and the introduction of patient contributions would increase police workload and crime, and whether such effects will be monitored and registered. The ministers answer that a monitor will track whether patient charges deter care use, that the police and GGZ have agreed new cooperation arrangements, and that registration of GGZ-related nuisance is only partly in place and will be developed regionally.
Whether the introduction of the patient contribution actually leads to avoidance of care will be closely monitored by the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport via a monitor this year.
Of de invoering van de eigen bijdrage daadwerkelijk leidt tot zorgmijding volgt de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dit jaar nauwlettend via een monitor.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen over overstappen en concurrentie tussen zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the minister about switching between health insurers, premium coordination, market concentration, collective contracts and the Independer website stake held by Achmea. The minister declined to give switcher figures before the NZa market scan, rejected coordination claims as speculative, and argued that competitive pressure and oversight by NZa and NMa remain adequate.
At this moment I do not have sufficiently reliable information to answer questions 1 to 3. I am awaiting the NZa market scan for this, due in the second quarter of this year.
Op dit moment heb ik onvoldoende betrouwbare informatie om antwoord te kunnen geven op de vragen 1 t/m 3. Ik wacht daarvoor de marktscan van de NZa af in het tweede kwartaal van dit jaar.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een vrijwillig wetenschappelijk moratorium van 60 dagen op onderzoek naar levensgevaarlijk vogelgriepvirus
