An MP from the CDA asked the government about a voluntary 60-day scientific moratorium on research into H5N1 bird flu virus, the planned international forum, publication safeguards, licensing of other potentially dangerous micro-organisms, and bioterrorism risk oversight. The minister answered that the government supports the WHO-facilitated international discussion, that transparency on licensed projects is limited for state security reasons, and that a body to review risks is under consideration, with a letter to follow.
Precisely in the interest of state security, no public overview of those projects can be given.
Juist in het belang van de staatsveiligheid kan er geen openbaar overzicht van die projecten worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen voor uitwendige elektrostimulatie ter behandeling van chronische pijn

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether chronic pain should be treated as a serious condition rather than low disease burden, and whether TENS and similar electrostimulation should remain reimbursed despite a planned CVZ advice to drop them. The minister said the CVZ advice was still a confidential draft, that a position would follow with the annual package advice, and that reimbursement requires proven value rather than a physician's judgement.
I assume that the advice will be incorporated into the 2012 package advice.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het advies meeloopt in het pakketadvies 2012.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de sluiting van de GGNet- (poli)kliniek in Zevenaar en Winterswijk en groei aantal patiënten geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

An SP MP asks the health minister about the closure of GGNet clinics and outpatient clinics in Zevenaar and Winterswijk, the 7.2 million euro cut, job losses, longer travel for patients, and how the mental health cuts fit with rising client numbers. The minister answers that the board of GGNet is responsible for these choices, describes alternative care arrangements, and defends the policy of reducing inpatient capacity and introducing a co-payment in specialist mental health care.
However, the board of the institution is responsible for the choices it makes in this.
Het bestuur van de instelling is echter verantwoordelijk voor de keuzes die men hierin maakt.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verminderen van het aantal bedden in de GGZ en sluiting herstellingsoord (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about planned bed reductions at GGZ mental health institutions Mondriaan and Pro Persona, the closure of Pro Persona's recovery home, and whether insurers are driving these cuts. Minister Schippers answers that deinstitutionalisation is policy, that the institutions bear responsibility for bed decisions, and that insurers may decide what care they purchase, while offering no information on waiting lists or on the reasoning behind the cuts.
The institution's board is responsible for the decisions it takes on reducing beds, including where these concern crisis beds.
Het bestuur van de instelling is verantwoordelijk voor de besluiten die zij neemt met betrekking tot het reduceren van bedden, ook als dat crisisbedden betreft.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over levensgevaarlijke therapieën voor huilbaby's (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about therapists treating crying babies with dangerous manipulations, including whether regulated practitioners must disclose non-regular treatments, how many complaints the inspectorate received, and whether government should ensure parents make informed choices. The minister answers that practitioners must inform patients and distinguish regular from alternative treatments, that the inspectorate received one 2008 report and will be asked to investigate, and that parents' informed choice and their own responsibility are primary, while declining several questions as outside policy responsibility.
I will ask the IGZ to investigate these practices.
Ik zal de IGZ vragen naar deze praktijken onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nieuwsbericht dat huilbaby’s worden blootgesteld aan levensgevaarlijke alternatieve therapieën van alternatieve therap

MP Dille asks the state secretary about a news report that crying babies are being treated with potentially lethal alternative therapies, asking whether such therapies should be banned for children and whether data on treated babies and child deaths exist. The minister answers that the Wet BIG leaves alternative treatments largely free, that treatment data are not known, and that she will ask the inspectorate (IGZ) to investigate.
I will ask the IGZ to investigate this and to examine whether dangerous, health-threatening acts are being performed.
Ik zal de IGZ vragen hiernaar onderzoek te doen en te bezien of hier gevaarlijke, gezondheidsbedreigende handelingen worden verricht.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over selectieve zorginkoop door verzekeraars (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a CBB interim ruling that restricts insurers' selective purchasing of specialist drugs, including whether the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit approved policy terms limiting coverage, cost differences and DBC tariff effects. The Minister says she is examining how to respond to the ruling, considers selective purchasing desirable, admits the costs are hard to estimate, and promises to inform parliament in March.
I intend to inform your House further on this matter in March.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer in maart nader te informeren over deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het moeilijk kunnen krijgen van een hypotheek of verzekering na kanker

SP MPs asked the health minister about cancer survivors facing higher premiums or refusal for life insurance and mortgages, and whether this breaches equal treatment. The minister acknowledged the social-economic problems, rejected the claim of exploitation or a constitutional breach, and committed only to general attention and existing contact between insurers and patient groups.
For life insurance there is no statutory duty to accept applicants, as there is for the basic health insurance package.
Voor levensverzekeringen geldt geen wettelijke acceptatieplicht, zoals die voor het basispakket van de zorgverzekering wel geldt.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over wettelijke eisen aan de responstijd van de crisisdienst psychiatrie

An MP asked the health minister why the psychiatric crisis service has no statutory response-time norm, unlike police, ambulance and other acute services, and whether one should be introduced to reduce aggression against responders. The minister replied that existing acute-care norms and the police-GGZ covenant (arrival within 2 hours, or 3 hours) are sufficient, so no statutory norm is planned, while promising a national action plan on aggression against care workers.
I therefore see no reason in advance to legally anchor a specific (accessibility) norm for the crisis service.
Ik zie daarom op voorhand geen aanleiding om een specifieke (bereikbaarheids)norm voor de crisisdienst wettelijk te verankeren.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Van Dekken over de financiële situatie van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Doven Sport Bond

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the financial position of the Dutch deaf sports federation KNDSB, its membership of NOC*NSF, earmarked funding for deaf sport, exclusion from the Paralympics, and a meeting with the federation. The minister said the KNDSB does not yet meet NOC*NSF membership criteria and that earmarking is partly done via Special Heroes, but declined to earmark budget for deaf sport or to meet the federation, since government policy favours integration into regular sports federations.
For that reason I see no need to enter into discussion with the KNSDB.
Om die reden zie ik geen noodzaak om in gesprek te gaan met de KNSDB.
Antwoord vragen Van Miltenburg over Doorbehandelen ondanks niet-behandelverklaringen

Van Miltenburg (VVD) asked the health minister about doctors treating patients despite non-treatment declarations, including how often this occurs, their legal status, liability, and clarity for care providers. Minister Schippers answered that such cases are not recorded, that a non-treatment declaration is a binding will which providers must weigh with professional judgment, that liability depends on a defensible decision for courts to decide, and that the KNMG guidance and a Verenso resuscitation guideline are being developed.
Incidentally, it is not for me but for the judge to determine whether the doctor acted correctly in a specific situation and whether compensation is appropriate.
Het is overigens niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter om te bepalen of de arts in een specifieke situatie correct heeft gehandeld en of schadevergoeding op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de remmende werking van preventie op de stijging van de zorgkosten en het terughoudende beleid inzake overgewicht

An MP asks the health minister about a study claiming prevention could cut health cost growth and about the government's restrained obesity policy, and asks for a fuller response before a debate. The minister answers that the cost-saving estimates rest on unlikely assumptions, that prevention is not expected to cut costs much, that policy is integrated across ministries, and commits to sending a written reaction before the debate.
Antwoord vragen Joldersma over het bericht waarin wordt aangegeven dat toevoegingen aan tabak nog altijd geheim zijn

An MP asked the health minister why tobacco ingredient data supplied by industry has not yet been published and when a consumer-friendly publication can be expected. The minister replied that publication is planned in two phases, with the second phase (industry-supplied ingredient data) being prepared with RIVM and expected this year, while citing the need for context and protection of trade secrets.
Because the second phase also involves protecting trade secrets and competitive relations, publication of this information must take place carefully.
Omdat bij de tweede fase ook de bescherming van bedrijfsgeheimen en onderlinge concurrentieverhoudingen een rol spelen, dient openbaarmaking van deze informatie op zorgvuldige wijze plaats te vinden.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma over patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties (pgo’s) die meerdere ziekten vertegenwoordigen

MP Klijnsma asks whether the new subsidy rules for patient and disability organisations representing several conditions penalise cooperation, since such organisations may see funding drop sharply, and proposes a per-condition voucher adjustment. Minister Schippers defends the one-subsidy-per-condition policy as encouraging cooperation, rejects the per-condition voucher change as undermining the cooperation it aims for, and promises to review the framework for organisations that have already merged this spring.
At the upcoming update of the policy framework this spring, I will examine whether I can accommodate these organisations within the system and principles of the scheme.
Ik zal bij de komende actualisering van het beleidskader dit voorjaar bezien of ik deze organisaties tegemoet kan komen binnen de systematiek en uitgangspunten van de regeling.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de onduidelijkheid rond toevoegingen aan tabak door de tabaksindustrie

Questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) ask why tobacco packaging does not list ingredients like food does, why additives are not banned, and why manufacturer ingredient data submitted to RIVM since 2007 has not been published, plus why Trouw's FOIA request for policy documents was partly withheld. The minister argues packaging is unsuitable for ingredient information, defends a phased publication via RIVM's tabakinfo.nl, states insufficient evidence to regulate additives, and declines full disclosure of documents citing the Wob exceptions and a pending objection by Trouw.
As long as this objection procedure is still under consideration, I will not make any further statements about this.
Zolang deze bezwaarprocedure nog in behandeling is, doe ik hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de bezuinigingen en reorganisaties van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) en Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST)

Labour MP Van Gerven asks the health minister about cost cuts and reorganisations at two Twente hospital groups, covering weekend psychiatric closures, a hiring freeze, executive pay, service transfers and possible mergers. The minister answers that these are the hospital boards' own decisions, that continuity of care must be guaranteed, that the NZa oversees insurers' duty of care, and that no merger plans have been notified.
Such a decision is for the board of the healthcare institution concerned.
Een dergelijk besluit is aan het bestuur van de betreffende zorginstelling.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het tekort aan maag-darm-leverartsen (MDL-artsen)

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about a bed-admission stop at the Jeroen Bosch hospital caused by a shortage of gastroenterology specialists, whether alternatives were considered, the national shortage and training numbers, the advice on training places, and effects on bowel cancer screening and the numerus fixus. The minister defended the hospital's proportionate measures, reported growing training numbers and screening phased in from 2013 to 2019, and promised a letter on the numerus fixus in spring 2012.
The letter is expected to be sent to you in spring 2012.
Naar verwachting wordt de brief in het voorjaar van 2012 aan u aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet vergoeden van de kosten die ouders moeten maken om hun zieke kind te laten behandelen in het buitenland

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why insurers cover an experimental treatment abroad for a sick child but not the parents' living costs, and whether the treatment would be available in the Netherlands. The minister replied that experimental treatment abroad is not insured care under the Zvw, that living costs of family are not covered, that insurers can seek a CVZ opinion, and that no registry of such cases exists.
There are no public registrations tracking how many children undergo treatment abroad for life-threatening reasons.
Er zijn geen publieke registraties die bijhouden hoeveel kinderen er om levensbedreigende redenen een behandeling in het buitenland ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat duizenden vrouwen zijn verminkt door rimpelvullers

An SP MP asked the health minister how thousands of women came to be disfigured by permanent wrinkle fillers, whether permanent fillers should be banned, and how clinics and victims are supervised and helped. The minister answered that the IGZ has warned against permanent fillers since 2006, that only a handful of complaints have come in since, and that a ban is not opportune because permanent fillers are also used in reconstructive surgery and a ban would need EU action.
On this basis I have received no indications that permanent wrinkle fillers are still being used for cosmetic purposes in Dutch hospitals or clinics.
Op grond hiervan heb ik geen aanwijzingen gekregen dat er in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen of klinieken nog permanente rimpelvullers worden gebruikt voor cosmetische doeleinden.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over maximumtarieven in de tandheelkundige zorg (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether insurers setting maximum dental fee reimbursements effectively replace the NZa in setting dental prices, whether this removes free pricing, and whether higher costs will be passed to insured persons via premiums and reduced basic care. The minister rejects that insurers are taking over the NZa's role, says the NZa's first estimate is a limited average price rise, declines to give an overview of current maximum reimbursements because they are in flux, and states she has no say over insurer premiums and does not intend to restrict basic dental care.
I prefer to inform you at a later time once the maximum reimbursements have stabilised more.
Ik geef er de voorkeur aan om u op een later tijdstip nader te informeren als de maximumvergoedingen meer gestabiliseerd zijn.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het medicijn Remicade

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the drug Remicade for colitis ulcerosa may be removed from the basic insurance package and whether patients could pay for it themselves. The minister said extra hospital funding would be stopped because additional cost-effectiveness research was not done, but patients keep their entitlement until the CVZ issues its advice, which will be sent to parliament.
Once the CVZ issues a package advice on Remicade, I will ultimately decide whether the drug for this indication belongs in the package or not.
Als het CVZ een pakketadvies uitbrengt over Remicade, zal ik uiteindelijk beslissen of het middel bij deze indicatie tot het pakket behoort of niet.

Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het conceptadvies van het College voor zorgverzekeringen om remicade voor de indicatie colitis ulcerosa uit het pakket te schrappen zodat patiënten eerder een darmoperatie dreigen te moete

An SP MP asks whether the CVZ advice to remove Remicade for colitis ulcerosa from the basic package, which could push patients toward surgery, is true and whether the minister will reject it and protect patients. The minister confirms the NZa extra financing condition was not met, but says patients keep entitlement for now, will send the CVZ advice when issued, and will not anticipate it.
Once the CVZ issues a package advice on this, I will send it to you.
Zodra het CVZ een pakketadvies uitbrengt hierover, zal ik dat aan u opsturen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in ziekenhuis de Sionsberg te Dokkum

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the acute obstetrics unit at Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum would close and how the 45-minute access norm and maternal safety would be guaranteed. The minister answered that care providers must draw up a regional maternity care plan by 1 May 2012, that regular births continue meanwhile, and that the Inspectorate will review the plan, while leaving much of the responsibility to providers and insurers.
The care providers are responsible for drawing up a coherent plan for maternity care.
De zorgaanbieders zijn aan zet om een samenhangend plan voor de geboortezorg op te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de juridische houdbaarheid van de verplichting voor zorgverleners om mee te werken aan het Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD)

An SP MP asked the minister whether the duty for healthcare providers to cooperate with the electronic patient record (EPD), and insurers enforcing data delivery through contracts, is legally tenable and compatible with medical confidentiality. The minister replied that no statutory obligation to connect to the national switchpoint currently exists, that data may only be shared with patient consent, and that insurers' contractual demands and professional standards remain subject to that consent requirement.
To be clear, there is currently no obligation to connect to the national switchpoint.
Voor alle helderheid, er is momenteel geen verplichting tot aansluiting op het landelijk schakelpunt.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verplicht logo alcohol en zwangerschap op fles» (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about a mandatory warning logo on alcohol bottles for pregnancy, including how many pregnant women keep drinking and whether the logo could be introduced. The minister answered that prevalence data are outdated, that prevention exists through websites, midwives and GP's, that she will explore introducing the logo through industry self-regulation and will report back.
I intend to explore whether it is possible to introduce the logo through self-regulation.
Ik ben voornemens te inventariseren of het mogelijk is het logo via zelfregulering in te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over falend toezicht door de IGZ (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister whether, after a UMCG case where the IGZ failed to act, she would reconsider the PvdA's earlier call for independent investigation of the IGZ and have the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid conduct it. The minister answered that she will commission an external audit of the IGZ's organisation to check whether it can carry out its new supervisory vision, reporting to parliament in summer, but declined to assign the review to the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid.

To keep a close watch on whether the IGZ organisation is robust enough to carry out the supervisory vision and whether its processes and systems are sufficiently designed for this, I will have the IGZ organisation externally audited.

Om goed de vinger aan de pols te houden of de organisatie van de IGZ robuust genoeg is om de toezichtvisie uit te voeren en of de processen en systemen hierop voldoende zijn berekend, zal ik extern de organisatie van de IGZ laten doorlichten.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de sluiting van de GGZ-kliniek in Boxmeer en het schrappen van de geplande nieuwbouw

Several MP Van Gerven asked the minister about the closure of the GGZ clinic in Boxmeer and cancellation of planned new building, and about the continued collection of mental health co-payments despite cuts. The minister answered that the provider GGZ Oost-Brabant decided on financial grounds, that care will shift to outpatient services and other regional clinics, and that co-payments are justified and will be monitored.
For the year 2012 onward I am setting up a monitor of the effect of the co-payment on vulnerable groups.
Ik zet voor het jaar 2012 en verder een monitor uit naar het effect van de eigen bijdrage op de kwetsbare groepen.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht dat de zorgverzekeraar de vestiging van huisarts bepaalt

MP Gerbrands asked whether insurers effectively decide where GPs may settle, in light of the NMa fine on the LHV, and whether Menzis should be barred from providing GP care. Minister Schippers answered that the NMa fine concerned LHV advice on settlement policy, not insurer contracting, that the NMa examined insurers' role without fining them, and that she is working on measures to prevent vertical integration of insurers and providers though it is currently still permitted.
I am working on developing measures to prevent integration between health insurers and care providers.
Ik ben bezig met de uitwerking van maatregelen om integratie tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over fusieplannen van ziekenhuizen in Winterswijk en Doetinchem

An SP MP asks the health minister how she responds to plans by two hospitals in the Achterhoek to merge, possibly closing the Winterswijk site, and what she will do about the resulting local unrest and risks to emergency access. The minister says mergers are not always undesirable, announces a tightened merger review bill now before the Council of State, asks the providers to act carefully, and promises mandatory stakeholder involvement, while declining to assess the exact consequences of the merger.
That is why the merger review will be tightened; a bill to that effect is currently with the Council of State.
Vandaar dat de fusietoetsing zal worden aangescherpt, een wetsvoorstel daartoe ligt thans bij de Raad van State voor.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verminderen van het aantal bedden in de GGZ en sluiting herstellingsoord (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about plans by mental health provider Mondriaan to cut 142 beds in Limburg, the closure of the Pro Persona recovery home, the reasons and effects on waiting lists and crisis beds, and insurer Menzis' role. The document is only an interim notice from minister Schippers that the substantive answers will be delayed for careful consideration.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de tabakslobby die meespreekt in Den Haag

An SP MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about contacts between ministry officials and the tobacco industry, including an informal arrangement that industry would first raise issues with the director-general, and whether the ministry follows WHO guidelines limiting industry interaction. The minister answered that such contacts are part of normal stakeholder engagement, that the ministry is transparent about them, and that he disagrees with critics' characterisations of tobacco policy.
I was not aware of this specific arrangement, and that is not necessary because it fits the policy line I indicated in answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Ik was niet op de hoogte van deze specifieke afspraak, en dat hoeft ook niet want hij past in de beleidslijn zoals ik bij vraag 1 heb aangegeven.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands en Van Klaveren over de vergoeding van anti-homotherapie

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Van Klaveren asked whether insurers must reimburse 'anti-homosexuality therapy' offered by a recognised care institution and how it will be removed from the basic package. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not part of the Zorgverzekeringswet package, that IGZ inspection found no such therapy being provided, and that IGZ will act if a complaint is filed.
However, the inspection visit that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid to the institution in question shows that no such therapy is being provided.
Uit het inspectiebezoek dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) aan de betreffende instelling heeft gebracht blijkt echter dat er geen sprake is van het verlenen van een dergelijke therapie.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het bericht dat homotherapie vergoed wordt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether health insurers must reimburse 'homotherapy' aimed at curing homosexuality, which medical bodies call unsound and dangerous. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not covered by the Zvw, that the IGZ inspection found Different offers no treatment aimed at curing homosexuality, and that the IGZ will act on any new complaints.
Following the newspaper report, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid an inspection visit to care organisation Different in Amsterdam.
Naar aanleiding van bedoeld krantenbericht, heeft de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) een inspectiebezoek gebracht aan zorgorganisatie Different te Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Mulder over christelijke homotherapie

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister whether insurers are legally obliged to pay for Christian 'homotherapy' and what measures would end this. The minister answered that such therapy is not covered by the basic insurance package, insurers may not reimburse it, and no such obligation exists.
Insurers are not permitted to reimburse care that does not belong to the package.
Het is zorgverzekeraars niet toegestaan zorg te vergoeden die niet behoort tot het pakket.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over dat de controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen faalt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to ensure medication checks for elderly patients on five or more drugs, including pharmacist review, insurer reimbursement and oversight of mail-order pharmacies and self-bought medicine. The minister agreed such checks are important, pointed to pending NZa market scans and existing guidelines, declined to disclose insurer contract details citing competition sensitivity, and promised no new oversight measures.
I note, however, that this partly concerns competitively sensitive information that I could not simply disclose even if I had it.
Ik merk wel op dat het hier deels om concurrentiegevoelige informatie gaat die ik niet zonder meer naar buiten zou kunnen brengen als ik er wel over beschikte.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Snijder-Hazelfhoff (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over de veiligheid van aanstekers op de Nederlandse markt (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the safety of lighters sold on the Dutch market, including the share from China, enforcement measures, injury figures and whether the NVWA should conduct new research. The minister answered that the NVWA already supervises importers and distributors, that a supplementary inspection will conclude in February 2012, and that policy will be adjusted if the results warrant it.
I will study the results of the NVWA investigation and, if there is cause, I will adjust my policy.
Ik zal de resultaten van het onderzoek van de NVWA bestuderen en wanneer daartoe aanleiding is, zal ik mijn beleid aanpassen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het verdwijnen van bedden bij de GGZ Noord-Holland Noord

An SP MP asked the health minister about the reduction of psychiatric beds at GGZ Noord-Holland Noord, including Geestercogge in Schagen, and whether this was driven by financial motives. The minister welcomed the shift to home crisis treatment, said the institution remains responsible for care quality, and declined to monitor the new model closely or order extra inspection beyond routine supervision.
I see no reason to instruct the IGZ, beyond its usual supervision, to pay extra attention to this situation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de IGZ, anders dan het gebruikelijke toezicht, een opdracht te geven om extra aandacht te besteden aan deze situatie.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er niet naar de zorgen en signalen van familie van de patiën

SP MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether family and friends of schizophrenia patients have nowhere to turn with their concerns, and how often police, municipalities, housing corporations and care providers receive such signals. The minister answered that relatives can approach GPs, municipal complaint points and the IGZ, that no figures are registered for most bodies, and that a family-involvement policy and a pending mental-health bill are being developed.
It is not possible to quantify "signals or cries for help from family members" from police systems.
Het is niet mogelijk om «signalen c.q. noodkreten van familieleden» uit de politiesystemen te kwantificeren.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de wijze waarop Nederland zich aan internationale afspraken houdt inzake preventie (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Netherlands honours its international commitments on chronic disease prevention, including the UN political declaration, the WHO's tobacco stance and the FCTC, and how it will fund prevention. The minister replies that the Netherlands largely follows WHO recommendations, that national policy freedom is retained, and that prevention spending is increased although its cost effects should not be overstated.
Since this cabinet took office, no meeting has yet taken place at ministerial level with the tobacco industry.
Sinds het aantreden van dit kabinet heeft op ministerieel niveau nog geen gesprek met de tabaksindustrie plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het noodgedwongen stopzetten van psychologische behandeling door weigering aanvullende zorgverzekering

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about Menzis imposing turnover caps on psychotherapists, forcing patients to switch insurers, and the cuts to psychotherapy care. The minister answered that insurers may set such caps within their purchasing and duty-of-care framework, that medical selection in supplementary insurance is the insurer's own matter, and that she sees no reason to intervene or reverse the cuts.
Yes, as far as I am aware the majority of health insurers apply turnover caps for non-budgeted curative mental health providers, including self-employed psychotherapists.
Ja, voor zover bij mij bekend hanteert het merendeel van de zorgverzekeraars omzetplafonds voor niet-gebudgetteerde curatieve GGZ-aanbieders, waaronder vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht dat de gemiddelde leeftijd van de eerste keer seks niet klopt

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister whether public sex education policy rests on a wrong norm, since the average age of first intercourse (16.5) reportedly holds for only about half of Dutch youth, and whether the median should be used instead. The minister rejected the claim that policy is based on a faulty norm, said prevention is aimed at a broad age group, and promised clearer labelling of the average as applying to sexually active youth, while declining to change the policy or run a comprehensive sex education campaign.
I do not believe that government policy on sex education is based on a faulty norm.
Ik ben niet van mening dat het overheidsbeleid op het gebied van seksuele voorlichting is afgestemd op een foutieve norm.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het RIVM een huisarts voor de rechter daagt (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An MP asks whether the RIVM director's dual role creates a perceived conflict of interest and whether the Gezondheidsraad is under investigation for conflicts of interest in the Mexican flu inquiry. The minister defends encouraging dual appointments for innovation policy, states that transparency and safeguards are in place, and denies that the Gezondheidsraad's role is being examined.
This means there must at least be full transparency about interests, the origin of funding and the way advisers are involved in the subject on which they advise.

Dit houdt in dat er in elk geval volledige transparantie moet zijn over de belangen, over de herkomst van de financiering en over manier waarop adviseurs betrokken zijn bij het onderwerp waarover men adviseert.

An MP asks the health minister whether the inspectorate now advises removing PIP breast implants even without a detected rupture, and why the joint IGZ/NVPC advice was tightened, how many women have come forward, and how other countries reimburse explantation and replacement. The minister confirms the joint advice, explains the change as driven by reported symptoms and avoiding constant monitoring, and says the number of women seeking checks is unknown because there is no central registration.
How many women have so far reported is not known. There is no central registration in which institutions keep track of this.
Hoeveel vrouwen zich tot dusver hebben gemeld is niet bekend. Er is geen centrale registratie waarin de instellingen dit bijhouden.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een brief naar aanleiding van een noodoproep in verband met de dengue-epidemie op Bonaire (ingezonden 9 dece

MPs Dijkstra and Hachchi asked how much money is spent on strengthening public health care on Bonaire, the role of RIVM, GGD and CAREC in dengue control, how local prevention policy will be continued and evaluated, and the cost of prevention relative to incomes. The minister answers that the island authorities are responsible for public health, that the ministry supports them with funding of up to 0.7 million euro a year for RIVM work and about 1 million euro for the GGD project to mid-2013, and that local evaluation is the island government's responsibility.

The island executives of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (the BES islands), like municipal governments in the Netherlands, are themselves responsible for public health care, including infectious disease control.

De bestuurscolleges van Bonaire, Sint Eustasius en Saba (de BES-eilanden) zijn net als gemeentebesturen in Nederland, zelf verantwoordelijk voor de publieke gezondheidszorg, waaronder infectieziektebestrijding.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de problemen bij de intensive care van het VU Medisch Centrum (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about serious problems on the VU Medical Centre intensive care unit, including two possibly preventable deaths, a whistleblower sidelined, and a possible link to a merger. The minister answered that the Health Inspectorate is acting actively, the hospital board has a remediation plan under inspection, the whistleblower is not suspended but not operating, and the merger is not considered a cause.
Both reports are under investigation and being handled by the IGZ.
Beide meldingen zijn in onderzoek en behandeling door de IGZ.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over spoedzorg in Dokkum (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

CDA MPs asked the health minister about the closure of acute and obstetric care at hospital De Sionsberg in Dokkum, and how access to care and the 45-minute response time would be guaranteed. The minister answered that the hospital cannot meet quality norms given its size, that the Inspectorate is requiring a care policy plan, and that extra ambulance capacity and UMCG backup have been arranged.
The IGZ will continue to closely monitor De Sionsberg to see whether the plans are responsibly developed and implemented.
De IGZ blijft De Sionsberg intensief volgen om te zien of de plannen verantwoord worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aangekondigde fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Health about the announced merger of two mental health institutions and how to prevent further mergers before stricter merger rules take effect. The minister says she cannot judge individual mergers, has no legal power to impose a merger moratorium or require a merger impact report yet, and will urge providers to act in the spirit of the coming rules.
I will also address the GGZ institutions concerned on this.
Ik zal hierop ook de betreffende GGZ-instellingen aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen Emergis en de Parnassia Bavo Groep (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about the proposed merger of Emergis and Parnassia Bavo Groep, including its cost control, continuity-of-care risks, advisory input from regulators and staff councils, whether the requested moratorium motion and stricter merger rules will block it, and job losses. The minister answers that merger assessment is for the competition authority, that stricter merger rules are not yet in force so parties cannot be compelled, that no withholding of the regulator's view is claimed since the NZa was not yet consulted, and that the Parnassia job losses are not directly linked to the merger.
Until the bill has entered into force, parties cannot be forced to do so.
Totdat het wetsvoorstel in werking is getreden kunnen partijen daartoe niet worden gedwongen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the Inspectorate for Health Care had assessed the effect of a merger between two mental health providers on care quality, and if so, what its verdict was. The minister replied that the regulators lack approval powers over mergers until stricter rules are enacted, but the inspectorate will monitor the providers more closely and intervene if care quality is endangered.

As long as the planned care-specific tightening of merger review is not legally anchored, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) have no approval power over proposed mergers.

Zolang de voorgenomen zorgspecifieke aanscherping van de fusietoetsing niet wettelijk is verankerd, hebben de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) geen goedkeuringsbevoegdheid ten aanzien van voorgenomen fusies.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van de ziekenhuiszorg in (Noord-oost) Friesland.

MPs Van Gerven, Leijten and Jacobi asked the health minister about the restructuring of hospital De Sionsberg in north-east Friesland, including reliance on confidential KPMG Plexus reports, lifting of supervision by the inspectorate, the insurer's role and the 45-minute ambulance standard. The minister answered that the restructuring decision rests with the hospital board and the inspectorate, that the study's costs, financiers and publication are for the commissioning parties, and that extra ambulance capacity secures acute access.
Information on the costs and financiers of this study and the involvement of researchers is therefore not available to me.
Informatie over de kosten en financiers van dit onderzoek en de betrokkenheid van onderzoekers heb ik dan ook niet tot mijn beschikking.
Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voorbereiding van gemeenten op de gewijzigde Drank- en horecawet (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether municipalities are prepared for the amended Drank- en horecawet, citing reports that most have no implementation plan and lack capacity and funding. The minister answers that the law is not yet adopted, that guidance, an expertise centre and a funding agreement with municipalities are in place or planned, and rejects the claim of insufficient funds.
A handbook will come that supports municipalities in setting up enforcement policy and implementing the new tasks in the municipal organisation.
Er komt een handreiking die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het opzetten van een handhavingsbeleid en de implementatie van de nieuwe taken in de gemeentelijke organisatie.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aanpak van onderzoeksfraude in patiëntgebonden onderzoek, naar aanleiding van een opinieartikel over de affaire-Poldermans i

An MP asked the health minister about research fraud in patient-related studies following the Poldermans affair, including harm to patients, extra quality controls, FDA-style inspection, and publication of data. The minister replied that the Inspectorate is investigating, that existing rules (WMO, Geneesmiddelenwet, VSNU code) are sufficient, that repression is not the best tool, and that she will rely on the Schuyt commission and planned measures such as METC professionalisation and publication of results.
The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating the Poldermans case, particularly where it concerns the direct conduct of the research and the patients involved.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzoekt de casus Poldermans met name daar waar het de directe uitvoering van, en daarmee de patiënten in, het onderzoek betreft.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht voornemens is een eicelbank te openen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a planned egg bank at UMC Utrecht, offering donors about 1000 euro, complies with the Dutch Embryo Act's ban on commercial egg donation, and about age limits and funding. The minister said the reimbursement is a cost allowance still under review by the profession, that the 45-year age limit is kept, that treatment is covered by the basic package, and that the Netherlands' rules match European standards.
I await the formal position on the amount and will decide on that basis whether this amount is indeed a direct consequence of the acts performed with the germ cells.

Ik wacht het formele standpunt over de hoogte van het bedrag af en bepaal op basis daarvan of dit bedrag inderdaad een rechtstreeks gevolg is van de «handelingen die met de geslachtscellen zijn verricht».
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontwikkelingen bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether hospital services in Delfzijl and Winschoten were being concentrated, whether the surgical and cardiology changes affected access to acute care, and what the role of insurers was. Minister Schippers answered that the ICU and cardiac monitoring were moved to Winschoten with substitute beds in Delfzijl, that the changes are the hospital's responsibility under quality criteria, and that the availability-contribution decision awaited the Health Council advice.
The hospital has informed me that preparations are being made to turn department A2 into a heart and lung department.
Het ziekenhuis heeft mij laten weten dat er voorbereidingen worden getroffen om van afdeling A2 een hart- en longafdeling te maken.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Snijder-Hazelhoff (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inwerkingtreding van Verordening (EU) nr 284/2011 door een wijziging van het Ware

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about EU Regulation 284/2011 on aflatoxin controls, including who pays for inspections, turnaround times and possible trade standstill. The minister answered that importers will pay cost-covering fees from early 2012, that the turnaround is indicatively one working week, and that no maximum turnaround is set to protect the thoroughness of the testing.
The Regulation does not set a maximum turnaround time.
De Verordening stelt geen maximum doorlooptijd vast.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beëindigen van de samenwerking van de anti-corruptiewaakhond Transparency International (TI) met d

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked the health minister about Transparency International ending its cooperation with FIFA and not being admitted to an anti-corruption panel. The minister replied that FIFA is a private Swiss body outside her responsibility, that TI withdrew voluntarily, and that she will not raise the issue internationally, though she pursued an EU expert group on sports governance.
I see no role for myself in this.
Ik zie hier geen rol voor mijzelf in weggelegd.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de «big business» in hoortoestellen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the high share of premium hearing aids sold, the gap between purchase and retail prices, transparency on price and quality, a possible cartel probe, and abolishing reimbursement limits. The minister says market forces set prices, refers cartel questions to the independent competition authority NMa, points to insurers and a quality protocol, and defers the reimbursement decision to spring 2012.
I will bring the hearing aid market to the attention of the NMa.
Ik zal de hoortoestellenmarkt onder de aandacht brengen van de NMa.

Vragen de leden Wolbert en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat toezichthouders in de zorg de bezoldigingsnorm overschrijden (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether supervisory board members in care institutions exceeding the NVTZ pay norm, and how this relates to the WNT pay-cap amendment. The minister answered that only about 2.5% exceed the norm, that consequences of the amendments are being inventoried, and that under the WNT the accountant reports overruns and she could enforce corrections via a dwangsom or dwangbevel.
I cannot verify whether the remuneration of supervisory board members in an unknown but selected sample has doubled over two years.
Ik kan niet verifiëren of de beloning van toezichthouders in een mij onbekende, maar selecte steekproef in twee jaar is verdubbeld.

Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het omzeilen van de acceptatieplicht en het verbod op premiedifferentiatie door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether Promovendum and Besured group insurance premium discounts and their Achmea/Avéro involvement breach the Health Insurance Act's acceptance duty and ban on premium differentiation, and whether Blue's daily cancellability shifts costs to other insurers. The minister answered that collective discounts up to 10% are permitted, that Achmea/Avéro shows no sign of breaching the acceptance duty, that the NZa will explicitly monitor compliance, and that the NZa found no cost-shifting from the similar Zekur policy.
I have no reason to assume that Achmea/Avéro does not comply with the acceptance duty.
Ik heb geen reden aan te nemen dat Achmea/Avéro zich niet aan de acceptatieplicht houdt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het weigeren van patiënten door te weinig budget van zorgverzekeraar Achmea (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asks whether health insurer Achmea, which has a duty of care, is responsible for patient access when a Tilburg hospital stops treating its insured patients due to limited volume budgets, and whether budgets were set unfairly and whether a zero-growth stance was agreed. The minister answers that Achmea retains its duty of care with no indications of breach, that volume caps were agreed by contract with the hospital, and that the zero-growth stance for 2012 was an independent choice by insurers.
I have no indications that Achmea is not fulfilling its duty of care.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat Achmea de zorgplicht niet nakomt.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over medische selectie door zorgverzekeraars

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about medical selection by health insurers for supplementary insurance, including whether it breaches equal treatment under Article 1 of the Constitution. The minister answered that insurers must accept everyone for basic insurance, that medical selection is permitted for supplementary insurance under EU rules, and that most supplementary policies still apply no selection; she rejected claims of discrimination and of profit-driven harm.
The acceptance policy for a supplementary insurance falls within the insurer's own powers, of which I have no insight.
Het acceptatiebeleid van een aanvullende verzekering behoort namelijk tot de eigen bevoegdheden van de verzekeraar waar ik geen inzicht in heb.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van pakketbezuinigingen voor reumapatiënten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how cuts to physiotherapy coverage affect rheumatism patients, whether mobility is essential for them, and whether the government's constitutional duty for public health is met. The minister replied that long-term physiotherapy for several chronic conditions is not proven effective, that short-term proven treatments remain available at patients' own cost or via supplementary insurance, and that the coverage criteria follow the Zorgverzekeringswet and the Grondwet's health duty.
The CVZ examined whether long-term physiotherapy for certain conditions meets the statutory standard of science and practice and the package principle of necessity.

Het CVZ heeft onderzoek gedaan naar de vraag of langdurige fysio- en oefentherapie voor bepaalde aandoeningen voldoet aan het wettelijk criterium stand van de wetenschap en praktijk en het pakketprincipe noodzakelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat 30 000 Franse vrouwen van siliconen in borsten afmoeten (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that 30,000 French women must have PIP silicone breast implants removed, and about Dutch exposure, complaint registration, recall reach, reimbursement and the approval role of regulators. The minister answered that the number of Dutch recipients is unknown, that no cancer cases have been reported to the inspectorate, that recall reach is incomplete due to bankruptcies, and that removal is reimbursed only in limited cases, with the notified body TÜV Rheinland responsible for approval.
There is no central registration in which the institutions keep track of this. Institutions are also not obliged to do so.
Er is geen centrale registratie waarin de instellingen dit bijhouden. Instellingen zijn hiertoe ook niet verplicht.

An MP asked the health minister whether hospitals using PIP breast implants should bear removal costs, whether the 2001 IGZ advice was ignored, and what measures will prevent unsafe implants. The minister said the 2001 negative advice concerned different hydrogel implants, that hospitals could rely on the CE mark, and that the PIP case is fraud which existing regimes cannot fully prevent, with lessons to be drawn at EU level.
Naturally, it is being examined (particularly by the EU committee) what lessons can be drawn from the course of events surrounding PIP.
Vanzelfsprekend wordt (met name door de EU-cie) gekeken welke lessen uit de gang van zaken rondom PIP kunnen worden getrokken.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) was asked to assess how a merger of two mental health care institutions affects care quality, and what its verdict was. The minister replied only that the answers would be delayed because of the holiday period and promised to send them as soon as possible.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er niet naar de zorgen en signalen van familie van de patiën

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether family members of schizophrenia patients have nowhere to report concerns, asking for counts of reports to police, municipalities, housing corporations and care providers, and a study into how these are handled. The response is only a postponement notice stating that the answers will follow in the week of 23 January, with no substantive answers yet.
The reason for the delay is that obtaining and processing the information needed for the answer takes more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat het verkrijgen en verwerken van de informatie ten behoeve van de beantwoording meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over maximumtarieven in de tandheelkundige zorg (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

An MP from the PvdA asked the health minister whether insurers setting maximum dental reimbursement rates effectively determine dentists' prices instead of the NZa, whether this means prices are not free, whether costs will rise under free pricing, and whether the government will shift those costs onto insured people via higher premiums and reduced basic care. The minister replied only with a notice that the answers would be delayed because more time was needed, with no substantive answer yet.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over levensgevaarlijke therapieën voor huilbaby's (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about therapists who fold or deeply bend babies, with possibly fatal consequences, asking how many such practitioners exist, how the IGZ responds to signals, whether regular practitioners must disclose non-medical treatments, and what role the state should play in protecting parents. The reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed and will follow as soon as possible.
Regrettably, the questions from MP Arib (PvdA) on life-threatening therapies for crying babies cannot be answered within the usual period.
Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Arib (PvdA) over levensgevaarlijke therapieën voor huilbaby's ( 2011Z26810 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aangekondigde fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

The PVV MP Gerbrands asks the minister whether she knows of the announced merger of two mental health institutions, how she will prevent further mergers before stricter merger rules take effect, whether the merging parties and the NZa should carry out merger impact and merger tests, and how she will halt pending mergers until patient and staff participation is arranged. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed due to the Christmas recess and will follow as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the necessary coordination, given the Christmas recess, cannot be completed within the original answering period.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de benodigde afstemming, gelet op het kerstreces, niet binnen de oorspronkelijke beantwoordingstermijn kan worden gerealiseerd.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen Emergis en de Parnassia Bavo Groep (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about the proposed merger of Emergis and Parnassia Bavo Groep, including its effects on care continuity, advice from the NMa, NZa and works councils, whether the merger would be halted under a motion and planned tighter merger rules, WNT pay coverage and jobs. The minister's reply only announced that the answers would be delayed because of the Christmas recess and would follow as soon as possible, without answering any question.
The questions from MP Leijten (SP) about the merger between Emergis and Parnassia Bavo Groep cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

5 Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Leijten (SP) over de fusie tussen Emergis en de Parnassia Bavo Groep ( 2011Z27211 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over selectieve zorginkoop door verzekeraars (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a CBB interim ruling on selective insurer purchasing of specialist medicines, its relation to CVZ views and NZa approval of policy terms, cost effects, and DBC tariffs, totalling ten questions. The minister's reply only announces that answers will be delayed and sent later.
The questions from MP Van der Veen on selective insurer purchasing cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.
Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Van der Veen (PvdA) over selectieve zorginkoop door verzekeraars ( 2011Z27431 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verzet van de bevolking tegen de bezuinigingen op het ziekenhuis de Sionsberg in Dokkum (ingezonden 14

SP MPs asked the health minister why the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum faces closure of several departments, whether financial motives play a role, and what the government will do to keep a full hospital in northeast Friesland. The minister answered that the IGZ found the hospital too small to meet minimum volume norms, that finances also played a role, that a 2012 availability payment will match 2011 subject to an adequate plan, and that the government takes no initiative to preserve a full hospital since other hospitals can serve the region.
The IGZ will keep closely monitoring the Sionsberg to see whether the plans are responsibly developed and implemented.
De IGZ blijft de Sionsberg intensief volgen om te zien of de plannen verantwoord worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de wijze waarop Nederland zich aan internationale afspraken houdt inzake preventie (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

MP Arib (PvdA) asks the health minister how the Netherlands implements its international prevention commitments, including the UN declaration on chronic disease, the FCTC tobacco treaty and EU recommendations, and how it will fund prevention and tackle the tobacco lobby. The minister only sends a notice that the answers will be delayed because more information must be gathered, with no substantive answers yet.
The reason for the delay is that it takes more time to gather the necessary information.
De reden van het uitstel is dat het meer tijd kost de benodigde informatie te verzamelen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an extra ambulance post on Walcheren remains unsecured despite earlier commitments and a parliamentary motion. The minister said she asked the NZa in spring 2011 to expand the regional ambulance budget retroactively, but the NZa still lacks correct data from the regional service and insurers, and promised a decision within weeks.
The assessment of this request is for the NZa.
De beoordeling van dit verzoek is aan de NZa.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over psychedelische truffels (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asked the Health and Justice ministers why psychedelic truffles, which are not on the Opium Act lists, are replacing banned magic mushrooms, whether bans can be enforced, and why truffles are sold in souvenir shops. The minister said displacement was anticipated, the ban on mushrooms reduced incidents, education should accompany bans, and no regulated sales measures are planned.
Placing hallucinogenic substances on one of the Opium Act lists only makes sense if there is a certain degree of persistent use and demonstrable health and societal harm.

Het plaatsen van hallucinogene middelen op een van de lijsten van de Opiumwet heeft alleen zin als er sprake is van een zekere mate van bestendig gebruik en er sprake is van aantoonbare gezondheidsschade en schade voor de samenleving.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verplicht logo alcohol en zwangerschap op fles» (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about a proposed mandatory warning logo on alcohol bottles for pregnancy, including how many women drink while pregnant, how pregnant women are informed, and whether EU rules allow such a logo. The minister only announced that the answers would be delayed because they require further coordination and would follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Uitslag (CDA) on the report about a mandatory alcohol and pregnancy logo on bottles cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Uitslag (CDA) over het bericht «Verplicht logo alcohol en zwangerschap op fles» ( 2011Z26378 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezond, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er in 2011 meer dan 1 miljoen ADHD-voorschriften zijn (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary whether children are being labelled with ADHD or PDD-NOS too quickly, whether ADHD medication is wrongly prescribed to children aged 10 to 12, whether families are financially burdened, and whether doctors' diagnostic criteria should be investigated. The answer is only a postponement notice: the reply will take more time and will be sent as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that answering takes more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de beantwoording meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over falend toezicht door de IGZ (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether she is shocked by repeated failures of care and inspection by the IGZ, following reports about a baby at the UMCG, and whether she will reconsider their earlier call for independent investigation of the IGZ, possibly by the Safety Board. The minister's notice states that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because further consultation is needed, and promises answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that further consultation is needed and this requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat er nader overleg nodig is en dit meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verminderen van het aantal bedden in de GGZ en sluiting herstellingsoord (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

Ms Leijten (SP) asks the minister about GGZ mental health provider Mondriaan's plan to cut 142 beds in Limburg and the closure of the Pro Persona recovery home, including bed cuts, waiting lists, crisis beds, job losses, and insurer Menzis's role. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because they require more time, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that answering the questions requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de beantwoording van de vragen meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over reclames voor maagoperaties (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on gastric bypass surgery, the removal of dietary advice from the insurance package, aggressive clinic advertising, commercial pressure and whether the IGZ and NZa should investigate. The minister defends the policy as a stepped-care approach, rejects a separate IGZ or NZa investigation, and says the rise in operations has several causes without accepting commercial pressure as the driver.
I am of the view that quality can be safeguarded in this way without starting a separate IGZ investigation for every procedure.
Ik ben van mening dat kwaliteit aldus geborgd kan worden zonder voor elke verrichting een separaat onderzoek van de IGZ te starten.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hoogoplopende conflict tussen de minister en de huisartsen naar aanleiding van een uitzending van het televisieprogramma Bu

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about the conflict with GPs over chronic care, budget overruns in integrated chronic care and the 2011 GP tariff cut, and whether insurers and specialists share responsibility. The minister answered that she regrets GPs refusing certain patients, defended the tariff measure, and promised talks with insurers, GPs and specialists on substitution and chronic care.
It is not possible to specify which amounts can be attributed to overruns in chronic care delivered by medical specialists.
Het is niet mogelijk te specificeren welke bedragen toe te wijzen zijn aan (overschrijdingen in) de ketenzorg geleverd door medisch specialisten.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht van de IGZ dat eenzame opsluiting in een isoleercel wel mag als er een camera hangt (ingezonden 12 december 201

An MP asks the health minister about the IGZ's position that isolation with camera surveillance may still be allowed, questioning whether cameras can substitute for human contact and treatment. The minister responds that the IGZ's standard is separation-free care unless individually unavoidable, that a camera cannot replace personal contact and is only an aid, and that GGZ Nederland and the sector are to reduce separations.
A camera does not replace personal contact with the patient.
Een camera vervangt het persoonlijk contact met de patiënt niet.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een brief naar aanleiding van een noodoproep in verband met de dengue-epidemie op Bonaire (ingezonden 9 dece

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister how much funding goes to strengthening public health on Bonaire and to dengue control, what RIVM, GGD and CAREC contribute and their purpose, how their expertise is turned into local prevention policy, and how preventive costs compare to residents' incomes. The minister's reply only announces that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because consultation with those involved takes more time, and promises them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that consultation with those involved requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat afstemming met betrokkenen meer tijd vergt.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het samenvoegen van ziekenhuizen in Drenthe met het oog op een toekomstige fusie (ingezonden 2 december 201

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether merging hospitals in Drenthe ahead of a possible merger with Refaja is desirable, how withdrawing investment squares with small-scale care, and how the government will act given the moratorium motion on care mergers. Minister Schippers answered that the NMa and NZa had cleared the earlier merger, that the scenario study is an internal matter for the care group, that supervisors will monitor outcomes, and that she will press parties to follow the forthcoming stricter merger rules.
For now there is no concrete prospect of a merger between Zorggroep Leveste Middenveld and the Refaja hospital in Stadskanaal.
Vooralsnog is geen concreet uitzicht op een fusie tussen de Zorggroep Leveste Middenveld en het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorgverzekeraars die met cadeautjes en kortingen verzekerden proberen te lokken (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how she views insurers luring policyholders with gifts and discounts, whether this is desirable, and whether the government will check insurers' promotion spending and premium effects. The minister replies that insurers' marketing strategy is their own responsibility, that she sees no need to investigate spending or intervene, and that the NZa supervises insurer information provision under the Wmg.
The strategy of health insurers to attract more policyholders is a matter each insurer must determine for itself and lies outside my responsibility.
De strategie van zorgverzekeraars om meer verzekerden te krijgen, is een zaak die iedere zorgverzekeraar voor zich moet vaststellen en ligt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over toenemend gebruik van de waterpijp met tabak (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about rising hookah smoking with tobacco among young people, the ease of underage access, the health risks and the lack of information. The minister answers that youth monitoring shows an increase only tentatively, that age checks online are being examined with the justice ministry, and that information and school programmes already address hookah use.
I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of this inventory.
Ik zal u binnenkort nader informeren over de uitkomsten van deze inventarisatie.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat verscheidene gemeenten de preventieve seksuele gezondheidszorg van jongeren staken (ingezonden 2 december 2011)

MP Dijkstra asked the health minister whether the GGD Midden Nederland was ending sexual health prevention for youth in 25 municipalities due to budget cuts, and about the wider impact. The minister denied the specific claim, said municipal health tasks are legally anchored and that municipalities set their own priorities, and promised further talks with municipalities.
No, for the explanation of this answer I refer to the answer to question 1 from Member Arib.
Nee, voor de toelichting op dit antwoord verwijs ik naar het antwoord op vraag 1 van het lid Arib
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gelden voor pgo’s die meerdere ziekten vertegenwoordigen (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the government's plan to cut patient and disability organisation (pgo) funding from 43 to 25 million euro, and a new per-condition subsidy system, will hurt organisations covering multiple rare diseases and encourage splitting into smaller bodies. The minister acknowledges some organisations will be hit harder, defends the rule of at most one subsidised organisation per condition, and explains safeguards against splitting, while stating that organisations like VKS can still qualify for subsidy, especially if they cooperate.
I realise that some patient and disability organisations will be hit harder by this new system than they would have been by a generic cut.
Ik realiseer me dat sommige patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties door deze nieuwe systematiek zwaarder getroffen worden, dan bij een generieke korting het geval zou zijn geweest.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stoppen van seksuele voorlichting op scholen (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the health minister how the government will ensure municipalities can carry out their legal duty to combat sexually transmitted infections after GGD reports of ending school sex education due to cuts, and whether municipal prevention money should be earmarked. The minister replies that the national government has no plans to cut sex education, that municipalities are responsible for their own budgets within the law, and that earmarking does not fit decentralisation.
I assume that municipalities carry out their statutory tasks, as laid down in the Public Health Act.
Ik ga er vanuit dat gemeenten hun wettelijke taken, zoals vastgelegd in de Wet publieke gezondheid, uitvoeren.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bezuinigingsplan van de GGD Midden Nederland en het staken van seksuele voorlichting

An MP asks the health and education ministers about GGD Midden Nederland's plan to cut sexual health education in 500 schools, STI partner tracing and TB/infectious disease control, and whether reduced services will raise STI rates and weaken girls' resilience. Minister Schippers answers that the GGD has withdrawn the cuts, that municipalities must carry out their statutory tasks with IGZ overseeing care quality, and that the government relies on personal responsibility while maintaining prevention policy and monitoring.
For me, it is paramount that municipalities and GGDs carry out all statutory tasks adequately and at a sufficient level.
Voor mij staat voorop dat gemeenten en GGD-en alle wettelijke taken adequaat en op voldoende niveau uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht voornemens is een eicelbank te openen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister to react to reports that UMC Utrecht plans an egg bank, questioning whether it stays within Dutch law, whether a roughly 1000 euro payment amounts to commercial egg donation, the age limit of 50, financing and equal access, timing relative to a forthcoming policy note, and the role of national versus European rules. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed due to consultation with external parties.
The questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) about the report that UMC Utrecht plans to open an egg bank cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

1 Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gerven (SP) over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht voornemens is een eicelbank te openen ( 2011Z24771 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontwikkelingen bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep's plans to close ward A1 in Delfzijl, move intensive care and cardiac monitoring to Winschoten, reduce surgical wards, and whether the minister can answer on adequate funding and insurer roles. The minister's reply is only a notice that answers will be delayed pending further information.
The questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) about developments at the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gerven (SP) over de ontwikkelingen bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep ( 2011Z24960 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Snijder-Hazelhoff (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inwerkingtreding van Verordening (EU) nr 284/2011 door een wijziging van het Ware

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the entry into force of EU Regulation 284/2011 via an amendment to the Warenwetbesluit, including fees charged by the nVWA for import controls, the maximum turnaround time for test results, and the risk of trade standstill. The item is a ministerial notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because further coordination is needed, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the answer requires further coordination.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de beantwoording verdere afstemming behoeft.
