Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over spoedzorg in Dokkum (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

CDA MPs De Rouwe and Smilde asked the health minister for her reaction to reports that the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum is closing departments, why emergency care is disappearing, how acute care within 45 minutes and obstetric care including home births will be guaranteed, and how residents of the region and islands will keep access to quality care. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because further information is needed, with answers to follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MPs De Rouwe (CDA) and Smilde (CDA) on emergency care in Dokkum cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.
Mededeling De vragen van de Kamerleden De Rouwe (CDA) en Smilde (CDA) over spoedzorg in Dokkum ( 2011Z25263 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de «big business» in hoortoestellen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about big business in hearing aids: the share of expensive high-end devices sold, large gaps between purchase and sale prices, transparency, possible cartel formation, and the slow removal of reimbursement limits. The minister only replies that answers cannot be given within the usual term because of the need to consult other parties, promising them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is the need to consult with other parties.
De reden van het uitstel is de noodzaak van afstemming met andere partijen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een te ontwikkelen multidisciplinaire richtlijn dwang en drang in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why she frames a multidisciplinary guideline on coercion in mental health care as something to enforce, though the sector is willing to develop it, and why it is excluded from usual ZonMw funding. The minister replies that the sector must develop the guideline, that no government funding for guidelines has existed since 2008/2010, and that she will discuss the matter with parties and explore options without VWS funding.
In this conversation with the parties I want to once again outline the importance of the MDR coercion.
Ik wil in dit gesprek met partijen nogmaals het belang van de MDR dwang schetsen.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijgeven van een medisch dossier in een strafrechtelijk onderzoek (ingezonden 25 novemb

An MP asks whether the Public Prosecution Service may obtain the medical file of a deceased psychiatric patient for a criminal investigation into his treaters, and how medical confidentiality applies after death. The ministers answer that a feitenonderzoek is underway, that medical confidentiality is not absolute and can be breached in exceptional circumstances under strict conditions, and that a study on medical confidentiality is planned for 2012.
Medical confidentiality is however not absolute. Very exceptional circumstances may arise in which the right of non-disclosure must yield to a higher interest, such as the discovery of truth.

Het medisch beroepsgeheim is echter niet absoluut. Er kunnen zich zeer uitzonderlijke omstandigheden voordoen waarbij het verschoningsrecht dient te wijken voor een hoger belang, zoals waarheidsvinding.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over stopzetten richtlijn drang en dwang Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 29 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why the multidisciplinary guideline to reduce coercion and restraint in mental health care has stalled since 2008 despite commitments, and why the government leaves its development to the sector. The minister agrees coercion should be a last resort and that the guideline is important, says the sector bears responsibility since government funding ended in 2008, and promises to talk with parties at administrative level, while admitting she cannot yet enforce guideline development.
I cannot yet enforce the development of guidelines.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Van Klaveren, Graus en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Europees Kampioenschap Voetbal in Polen en Oekraïne in 2012 (ingezonden 31 oktober 201

MPs from the PVV asked the health and sports minister about safety of Dutch supporters in stadiums at Euro 2012 in Poland and Ukraine, anti-trafficking measures, and stopping dog killings in Ukraine, including whether KNVB and ING sponsors could press UEFA. The minister replied that security is the responsibility of UEFA and host states, that Dutch police and embassies cooperate with local authorities, and that Ukraine has introduced measures against dog killings, so no further action is needed.
Responsibility for guaranteeing the safety of Orange supporters in the stadiums lies with UEFA.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het waarborgen van de veiligheid van de Oranjesupporters in de stadions ligt bij UEFA.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Psychose schrikbarend vaak gemist in Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister why many psychosis patients are missed or misdiagnosed in mental health care, whether diagnosis and outcome monitoring are adequate, and how psychosis detection and reporting of undertreatment are ensured. The minister replies that professionals are responsible for diagnosis, sees no reason for further investigation, points to existing guidelines, inspection oversight and ROM initiatives, and notes that a reporting duty exists only for calamities.

There is a reporting duty for calamities in care, but it is not possible to reliably determine in how many cases a patient with a psychotic disorder suffered physical and/or mental harm due to undertreatment or incorrect treatment.
Er is een meldplicht voor calamiteiten in de zorg, maar het is het niet mogelijk op een betrouwbare wijze te achterhalen in hoeveel gevallen sprake was van een patiënt met een psychotische stoornis

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen onvoldoende betrouwbaar zijn (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether hospital mortality figures (HSMR) give a distorted picture, whether insurers may unfairly blacklist hospitals, and whether government should take responsibility for hospital planning instead of insurers. The minister said the technical findings are accepted but HSMR publication is not blocked, insurers are expected to communicate carefully, government will not return to central planning, and the Swedish model is instructive but not directly transferable.
I am convinced that health insurers will not terminate contracts with hospitals solely on the basis of the corrected mortality figures.
Tegen die achtergrond ben ik ervan overtuigd dat zorgverzekeraars niet louter op basis van de gecorrigeerde sterftecijfers contracten met ziekenhuizen zullen beëindigen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zelfmoorden onder Hindoestaanse, Turkse en Marokkaanse meisjes (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about suicide among Hindustani, Turkish and Moroccan girls and whether mental health services are accessible to them. The minister cites regional Rotterdam and The Hague data showing elevated attempted suicide among Turkish and Hindustani girls, says no national figures exist, and rejects the claim that mental health care is inaccessible to these groups, relying on a 2011 dissertation.
I see no added value in having further research carried out into the exact size of these groups.
Ik zie geen toegevoegde waarde om verder onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de exacte omvang van deze groepen.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Ministerie niet blij met donorapp» (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

Rep. Klijnsma asks whether the minister is developing a mobile-phone donor-registration app like the one described in a news report, and whether the initiators' expertise should be used. The minister says a government app linked to the Donor Register via DigiD is being developed, since separate apps or paper cards risk unfindable donor wishes, and that expertise lies mainly with the Donor Register itself.
In addition, the Donor Register is indeed working on a mobile application for those who wish to use it.
In aanvulling daarop wordt door het Donorregister inderdaad gewerkt aan een mobiele applicatie, voor diegenen die daar gebruik van willen maken.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de veiligheid tijdens de Olympische Spelen in 2012 in Londen (ingezonden 25

The MPs asked whether the government shares US concerns about security at the 2012 London Olympics, how contact with responsible bodies is maintained, and whether the Netherlands would send its own security staff with the Dutch team. The minister answered that the UK is responsible, a Dutch liaison is stationed in London, Dutch security is considered adequate, and no Dutch security personnel will be sent unless the UK requests support.
The Netherlands has stationed a liaison from the KLPD and the Royal Marechaussee in London for this purpose.
Nederland heeft daarvoor een liaison van de KLPD en de Koninklijke Marechaussee in Londen gestationeerd.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de betrokkenheid van het CJIB en een deurwaarder bij het incasseren van de bestuursrechtelijke zor

An SP MP asked why health insurance premium arrears from March 2011 may be collected via the CJIB and a bailiff at escalating costs, instead of direct deduction by the CVZ, and whether the 30% surcharge should be lowered. The minister explains the collection sequence, reports case numbers and cost ceilings, and rejects lowering the surcharge while promising periodic income checks and use of the care allowance for payment.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aanpak van onderzoeksfraude in patiëntgebonden onderzoek, naar aanleiding van een opinieartikel over de affaire-Poldermans i

An MP (Dijkstra, D66) asked the health minister nine questions about combating research fraud in patient-related medical research after a newspaper op-ed on the Poldermans affair, covering patient harm assessment, extra quality checks, oversight by a registration authority like the FDA, and open data. The minister's reply only announced that the answers would be delayed pending consultation with the Inspectorate for Health Care and the education ministry, without substantive answers yet.
The reason for the delay is the need to consult with the Inspectorate for Health Care and the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
De reden van het uitstel is de noodzaak van overleg met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verplichting dat tandartsen een factuur van tandtechniek moeten tonen (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

MP Kuiken asked the health minister why the NZa did not adopt her directive requiring dentists to show a technician invoice to patients, and instead only requires it on request, and whether the minister will force dentists to show it. Minister Schippers replied that she left the technical implementation to the NZa, that the NZa's operationalisation stays within her intent after consulting providers, insurers and the Consumentenbond, and that she will not change the rule.
I did not inform the House because there is no conflict between the NZa's interpretation and the intent of the condition I set.
Ik heb de Kamer niet geïnformeerd omdat geen sprake is van strijdigheid tussen de interpretatie van de NZa en de intentie van de door mij gestelde randvoorwaarde.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een rechtszaak van het RIVM tegen een kritische huisarts (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked why RIVM sued a critical GP over claims that the director of its infectious disease centre has conflicts of interest with vaccine manufacturers, and whether this chills public debate. Minister Schippers answered that the director has no close ties with pharma firms, that the lawsuit is a principled bodemprocedure seeking a judicial ruling rather than financial harm, and that the matter must be settled by the court so the scientific debate can continue.
Since on two occasions there has been no willingness to rectify, the court will be asked to rule in the public interest involved.
Nu tot twee keer toe geen bereidheid tot rectificatie is getoond zal ten bate van het publieke belang dat daarmee gemoeid is, de rechter om een oordeel gevraagd worden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de door het RIVM aangespannen bodemprocedure tegen de huisarts H. Van der L. (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister about RIVM's civil lawsuit against a GP who publicly criticised the flu vaccination programme, the costs and proportionality of that lawsuit, alleged conflicts of interest of Prof. Coutinho, and the status of a transparency register for pharma ties. The minister defends the lawsuit as proportionate given the GP's public authority, denies Coutinho's involvement in vaccine-maker-funded projects, and promises the register by Q1 2013 with details to follow by summer 2012.
Mr Van der L. holds a social position that gives his statements such authority in public opinion that a legal procedure to obtain a ruling is, in my view, proportionate to that.

De heer Van der L. vervult een maatschappelijke positie die maakt dat aan zijn uitspraken een zodanig gezag in de publieke opinie wordt toegekend, dat een procedure ten behoeve van een uitspraak voor recht daarmee naar mijn mening in verhouding staat.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het RIVM een huisarts voor de rechter daagt (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

A PVV MP asked the health minister whether she agrees with RIVM suing a GP who publicly questioned flu vaccination and the integrity of RIVM's director, and about the institute's conflicts of interest with industry. The minister defended RIVM's action, said openness on industry ties is important, and maintained that vaccination is effective.
Full openness about relationships with the (pharmaceutical) industry is of the utmost importance to me, both for advisers we work with and for civil servants of my ministry (including RIVM).
Volledige openheid over relaties met de (farmaceutische) industrie vind ik van het grootste belang, zowel voor adviseurs waarmee wij werken als voor ambtenaren van mijn ministerie (inclusief RIVM).
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over artsen die 1 miljard Euro extra declareren (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

The MP asks the health minister about physicians allegedly inflating declarations by about one billion euros between 2006 and 2008, including double billing, upcoding of DBC treatments and the incentive structure of the DBC system. The minister disputes the 'sjoemelen' framing, states the billion is an extrapolated, uncontrolled figure, points to verifier controls, the DOT reform, the new physician budget model, and says it is impossible to quantify any unnecessary premium paid.
The 1 billion euro is a cumulative and extrapolated amount for 2006 to 2008 on which the usual checks by the insurer concerned had not yet taken place.
De 1 miljard Euro betreft een cumulatief en een geëxtrapoleerd bedrag tussen 2006 en 2008 waar nog niet de gebruikelijke controles door de onderzochte verzekeraar over hadden plaatsgevonden.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Jeugd koopt nog steeds makkelijk alcohol» (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

CDA MP Uitslag asked the health minister about a report that minors still easily buy alcohol, whether ID checks guarantee no sales, and how partners such as the supermarket and hospitality sectors are being pushed to enforce age limits. The minister pointed to the working group on alcohol and youth, the planned Drank- en Horecawet amendments (including closing supermarket alcohol departments after three violations in 12 months), and stressed parental responsibility.
In the proposal to amend the Drank- en Horecawet, for example, a provision has been included under which it will soon be prohibited for young people under 16 to have alcohol on them.
In het voorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet is bijvoorbeeld een bepaling opgenomen op grond waarvan het straks verboden is dat jongeren onder de 16 alcohol aanwezig hebben.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stijging van de kosten voor de tandarts (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about sharply rising dental insurance premiums and treatment tariffs following the liberalisation of dental prices, and whether the free-pricing experiment will be stopped. The minister answers that the experiment is still to start, asks dental bodies and insurers to show restraint, and says the NZa will monitor it and the experiment will be ended early if access, quality or affordability are endangered.
I have given the Netherlands Competition and Consumer Authority... rather, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) an instruction to accompany and monitor the free-pricing experiment.
Ik heb aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) een aanwijzing gegeven om het experiment met de vrije prijzen te begeleiden en te monitoren.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Argos-reportage over het (dis-)functioneren van trombosediensten (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about an Argos report on gaps in anticoagulant (thrombosis) care, including deaths linked to anticoagulant use, quality differences between thrombosis services, follow-up on a 2008/2010 IGZ report, and whether funding and purchasing should reward quality. The minister acknowledged 28 reported deaths of anticoagulant users, said there are no large quality differences, listed improvement initiatives with an IGZ follow-up study planned for late 2012, and explained that insurers already purchase this care with some room for quality-based tariffs.
The IGZ will carry out a study at the end of 2012 into the extent to which the agreements have been realised.
De IGZ zal eind 2012 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mate waarin de afspraken zijn gerealiseerd.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de acute geldnood van ziekenhuizen in 2012 (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports of acute cash shortages at hospitals in 2012, whether a national advance-payment scheme is needed, and whether hospitals should cut external staff hiring. The minister replies that insurers and hospitals can agree advance payments locally, expects them to follow the agreements made, and declines to say hospitals must reduce external hires since that is their own judgement.
In my view, insurers and hospitals are fully capable of reaching advance-payment arrangements through local consultation.
Verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen zijn mijns inziens uitstekend in staat om in lokaal overleg tot afspraken over de bevoorschotting te komen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brancheanalyse gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the PwC sector analysis showing hospitals' debts to insurers and risks of payment problems in 2012 from the new billing system and insurers withdrawing advance payments. The minister said advance payments are a matter between insurers and hospitals, pointed to a liquidity grouper due mid-2012 and a request to NZa and CVZ on advance payments of transition amounts, and gave no new debt figures.
VWS does not have more recent figures available on this point.
VWS heeft op dit punt geen recentere cijfers beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen twee Tilburgse ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

The MP asks whether the government will require a merger impact assessment and a fusion test by NZa and IGZ for the planned merger of two Tilburg hospitals, and how it will stop the merger absent a moratorium. The minister answers that the assessment and NZa fusion test will be legislated for 2013, that current law gives no power to block the merger, and that she will urge the hospitals to act in line with the new rules.
Based on this debate, we are currently translating those intentions into legislation, which will also anchor the obligation to draw up a merger impact assessment.
Mede op basis van dit debat vertalen wij die voornemens op dit moment in wetgeving, waarmee ook de verplichting tot het opstellen van een fusie-effectrapportage wordt verankerd.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over alcoholmisbruik door jongeren (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about youth alcohol abuse, including the proposal to raise the drinking age to 18, cuts to prevention funding, and enforcement of alcohol sales rules now that municipalities say they lack funds. The minister answered that she sees youth drinking as a problem, will prioritise youth prevention within remaining funds, has stopped mass campaigns, and maintains that adequate structural funding was provided to municipalities for enforcement.
I also focus on legal measures: the Drink and Catering Act proposes several measures to curb alcohol use by young people.
Ik zet overigens ook in op wettelijke maatregelen: in de Drank- en Horecawet worden verschillende maatregelen voorgesteld om alcoholgebruik door jongeren tegen te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Kinderen krijgen eerste drank vooral thuis» (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

A CDA MP asks the health minister about reports that children get their first alcohol mainly at home, including 10-year-olds admitted to hospital drunk, and asks about parental responsibility and existing programmes. The minister agrees the situation is worrying, says sellers' associations have pledged more effort, promises a letter in early 2012 and a follow-up study on age-limit compliance, but gives no firm measures on parents.
Early 2012 I will, in consultation with the Minister of Security and Justice, send a letter to the House of Representatives on this subject.
Begin 2012 zal ik in overleg met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie een brief aan de Tweede Kamer sturen over dit onderwerp.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het schrappen van 300 voltijdbanen door het Amphia Ziekenhuis in Breda en Oosterhout (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about Amphia hospital's plan to cut 300 full-time jobs linked to market pressures, and whether this threatens care quality and staffing. The minister responded that the hospital is being proactive, that the required efficiency cut is mild (3.3% per year), and that care quality oversight is well organised, without addressing staffing levels in substance.
I nowhere read that cuts are made only or mainly to personnel.
Ik lees nergens dat er alleen of hoofdzakelijk op personeel wordt bezuinigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijkheden tot het verlagen van het aantal dierproeven 1 december 2011 (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how to reduce animal testing, citing criticism that animal tests have limited predictive value and that the risk-assessment framework is outdated. The minister acknowledges limited predictive value, points to the Actieplan Dierproeven en Alternatieven 2011-2021 and ZonMw programmes, and says no test-garden pilots have yet been realised and animal experiments remain necessary for now.
Animal experiments are for the time being still considered necessary to answer complex, socially relevant questions in this area.
Dierproeven worden vooralsnog noodzakelijk geacht om complexe maatschappelijk relevante vragen op dit gebied te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ontslaggolf en bezuinigingen in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary about job losses and cuts in mental health care (GGZ), including the planned introduction of co-payments and possible deterrence of patients. The minister answers that cuts are unavoidable, leaves job cuts to institutions, reports a reduced co-payment with exceptions and a monitor, and says alternatives will be explored for 2013.
I am setting up a monitor that will measure the effects of the co-payment on avoidance of care.
Ik zet een monitor uit die de effecten van eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding zal meten.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de grote ontslaggolf in de Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the consequences of mass layoffs in mental health care (GGZ), including effects on waiting lists, quality of care, regional supply and coercion. The minister says cuts need not reduce supply because insurers keep their duty of care and providers can become more efficient, while giving no data by region and committing to no concrete new action.
There is no breakdown of waiting list data by type of care or by region, only by type of client (elderly, youth and adults).
Er is geen uitsplitsing naar typen zorg of verschillende regio’s bij wachtlijstgegevens, wel naar type cliënten (ouderen, jeugd en volwassenen).
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het doden van zwerfdieren in Oekraïne (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Health minister whether she knows of mass killings of stray dogs and cats in Ukraine ahead of Euro 2012, and whether she will raise it with Ukraine, protest officially, or discuss it with foreign colleagues. The minister answers that Ukraine has taken measures after UEFA pressure, that the choice of method is for Ukrainian authorities though killings should be humane per OIE guidelines, and that no protest or diplomatic action is planned.
The Ukrainian government has meanwhile, partly at UEFA's urging, taken measures to end the killing and mistreatment of stray dogs.
Door de Oekraïense regering zijn inmiddels, mede op aandringen van UEFA, maatregelen genomen om een eind te maken aan het afmaken en de mishandeling van zwerfhonden.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de EFSA (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

MPs asked the minister about alleged conflicts of interest among EFSA panel members advising on aspartame, including industry payments, and whether EFSA should re-examine aspartame after new studies and threatened legal action against a watchdog NGO. The minister mostly referred to a letter from another state secretary and to EU timelines, and said the NGO matter is for the parties involved to decide.
I gladly refer to the recent letter from the state secretary of I&M to your House of 9 November.
Ik verwijs graag naar de recente brief van de staatssecretaris van I&M aan uw Kamer van 9 november jl.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de banden van de minister met de tabaksindustrie en falende rookpreventie (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about ties between her ministry and the tobacco industry, the value of official visits to tobacco firms, possible ministerial conflicts of interest, and whether tobacco-control policy is failing. The minister answered that contacts with industry are technical and occasional, that no ministerial-level meeting occurred, that civil servants' conflict-of-interest rules suffice, and that the disputed mortality estimate is unsubstantiated.
At ministerial level, no meeting with the tobacco industry has taken place since the cabinet took office.
Op ministerieel niveau heeft geen gesprek met de tabaksindustrie plaatsgevonden sinds het aantreden van het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over hulp bij zelfdoding aan huis (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP from the Labour party asked the health minister how she views ambulant teams and a clinic helping people with a death wish to die at home, including dementia and psychiatric patients, and whether she had consulted the initiators. The minister said the physician-patient relationship should remain the main channel, that complex cases need extra expertise, and that she met the NVVE in January without concrete outcomes.
In my view, it is most desirable that a request for end of life and the process of examining this request take place within the existing doctor-patient relationship.
Het is mijns inziens het meest wenselijk dat een verzoek om levensbeëindiging en het proces om dit verzoek te onderzoeken, plaatsvindt binnen de bestaande arts-patiëntrelatie.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the threatened closure of the acute obstetrics unit in Meppel, whether the 45-minute access norm would be breached, and how the unit would be kept open. The minister replied that closure was not currently planned, that a regional hospital vision was pending, that the 45-minute norm would be upheld, and that the IGZ would report on staffing norms in early 2012.
I maintain the 45-minute norm without compromise.
Ik houd onverkort vast aan de 45-minutennorm.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the threatened closure of acute obstetric care in Meppel, including whether the hospital was asked not to close, the lack of clarity, midwives' exclusion from regional planning, and the inspectorate's study. The minister answers that the hospital was asked not to close until regional quality and accessibility norms are secured, that she will ask parties to re-engage midwives, and that the inspectorate's findings will be sent in early 2012.
However, I attach great importance to seeking a chain-wide approach (also) regarding midwifery care.
Ik hecht er echter groot belang aan dat (ook) ten aanzien van verloskundige zorg wordt gezocht naar een ketenbrede aanpak.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onoorbare praktijken van de IVF-kliniek Geertgen (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about allegations of improper practices at IVF clinic Geertgen, including anonymous donation and whether the Inspectorate can act. The minister replies that the clinic appears to comply with donor-data rules, the Inspectorate has no signs of misconduct, the clinic's permit application was refused and is under appeal in court, and the minister will consider whether the 'fair reciprocity' donor system fits Dutch law but sees no reason for measures now.
However, there is currently an appeal case because I rejected the licence application of the Geertgen clinic.
Wel is het zo dat er op het moment een beroepszaak loopt, omdat ik de vergunningaanvraag van de Geertgen-kliniek heb afgewezen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Patiënten terug op straat» (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister how she responds to reports that around a thousand psychiatric patients in Rotterdam will end up on the street due to the introduction of a personal contribution and budget cuts in mental health care, and how risks of care avoidance, coercion and nuisance are addressed. Minister Schippers rejects the claim that the measures will cause these effects, points to exemptions for outreach care, forced admissions and crisis treatment, and promises to monitor effects on care avoidance and report to the House.
The cabinet will monitor the effects of introducing a personal contribution on care avoidance.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van het invoeren van een eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding gaan monitoren.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an additional ambulance post on the Kop van Walcheren has still not been secured, despite a February 2011 commitment and a parliamentary motion, and when it will be provided retroactively. The minister's reply is only a postponement notice: the answers cannot be given within the usual period because additional data must be requested.
The reason for the delay is that I want to request further data that are necessary to answer these questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik nadere gegevens wil opvragen die voor het beantwoorden van deze vragen noodzakelijk zijn.
Vragen van het lid van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bemiddelingssites waar zich sperma- en eiceldonoren aanbieden (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about online sites where sperm and egg donors offer themselves to people wanting children, including whether they operate within the law, whether providers must vet participants, and whether the Inspectorate or others should supervise them. The minister replies that such brokering is not prohibited but donation must be free under the Embryo Act, that websites have no legal duty to vet parties, that the Inspectorate only supervises once medical care or reserved acts are involved, and that a policy position will follow early next year.
Websites or providers of websites are not obliged to investigate whether people wanting children or the donors act in good faith.
Websites of providers van websites zijn niet verplicht te onderzoeken of mensen met een kinderwens dan wel de donoren te goeder trouw zijn.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over misleidende voorlichting door SOS-arts (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the SOS-arts organisation misleadingly presents itself as a provider of GP care, whether the NZa's 'care on call' policy rule allows basic doctors to deliver such care, and what this means for GP posts and access to care. The minister answers that the website wording is incorrect and has been agreed to be changed, that the NZa will monitor access and conduct a sector scan in 2012, and that quality requirements are enforced by the inspectorate.
I therefore note that the announcement on the SOS-arts website is not correct.
Ik constateer derhalve dat de aankondiging op de Website van SOS-arts niet correct is.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Medicijnkastjes ouderen jaarlijks doorgelicht» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that elderly people's medicine cabinets are checked yearly, including whether elderly patients are wrongly prescribed medicines and whether GPs check medication use often enough. The minister said better monitoring is positive, cited national hospital-admission research and a forthcoming polypharmacy guideline, and said yearly comprehensive medication review is advisable while rejecting extra funding for GPs.
I do not have such specific research results at national level.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke specifieke onderzoeksresultaten op landelijk niveau.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nut van de griepprik (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether doubts about the usefulness of the flu vaccine, the evidence base, the expert and industry ties, costs, and the need for new research are justified. The minister defended the Health Council's advice to keep offering flu vaccination to risk groups, citing RCT evidence for some groups and referring to the Council's briefing for the rest, and declined to commission new research.
The declarations of interest of experts involved in flu vaccination are public.
De belangenverklaringen van betrokken deskundigen bij de griepvaccinatie zijn openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toezicht op het bestuur van Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg GG

An MP asks the government about alleged misconduct at GGZ WNB, including unjustified bonuses, a circus for the anniversary and bank loans, and the oversight role of the supervisory board, plus the appointment procedures for supervisory and management boards and whether this reflects quality-of-care differences. The state secretary answers that the supervisory board has taken action and the matter is its own responsibility, that the IGZ monitors quality, and that the institution itself bears financial consequences, declining to judge the board's diligence.
It is impossible for us to assess whether the former supervisory board of GGZ-WNB made the required utmost effort.
Het is voor ons onmogelijk te beoordelen of de toenmalige raad van toezicht van GGZ-WNB de gevraagde uiterste inspanning geleverd heeft.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen onvoldoende betrouwbaar zijn (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that hospital mortality figures are unreliable, whether insurers may unfairly blacklist hospitals, and whether government should take responsibility for hospital planning and quality measurement. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that answers will follow later because consultation with stakeholders takes more time.
The questions from MPs Leijten and Van Gerven (both SP) on the report that hospital mortality figures are insufficiently reliable cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van de Kamerleden Leijten en Van Gerven (beide SP) over het bericht dat sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen onvoldoende betrouwbaar zijn ( 2011Z22005 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de exorbitante vergoedingen aan toezichthouders bij de KNVB (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether KNVB supervisory board members receive excessive fees, including a fixed fee for meetings and free trips, and whether these exceed pay at other supervisory bodies. The minister answers that VWS has no formal role because the KNVB is autonomous and not part of the public or semi-public sector, so she cannot intervene in the board's fees, though the annual report is published.
The KNVB is therefore autonomous in setting the fees of employees and supervisory board members.
De KNVB is dus autonoom in het vaststellen van vergoedingen van medewerkers en toezichthouders.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de praktijken van privékliniek Geertgen uit Elsendorp (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the private clinic Geertgen, which offers faster egg-donation-linked fertility treatment, may pressure patients, profits financially, violates the Embryo Act or is supervised adequately. The minister answers that she will return with a broader analysis in early 2012, that the IGZ has addressed missing external quality checks, and that the clinic's practices are not in breach of the WBMV, while declining to inquire into the reasons for ending a hospital partnership.
I will provide the House with a broader analysis and my position on this in the first quarter of 2012.
Ik zal de Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2012 een bredere analyse schetsen en mijn standpunt hierover doen toekomen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verkrijgbaarheid van levensgevaarlijke abortuspillen via internet (ingezonden 29 septem

An SGP MP asked the health and justice ministers whether abortion pills sold online are dangerous, which countries host the sites, and what the IGZ can do against foreign sellers. The minister answered that the IGZ's jurisdiction is limited to Dutch entities, that Dutch law prohibits online prescribing without a prior doctor-patient contact but lacks a sanction yet, and that a warning was posted on a government website.
The IGZ can, where needed, contact counterpart organisations in other countries with a request to take action there.
De IGZ kan in voorkomende gevallen contact opnemen met collega-organisaties met het verzoek om in het betreffende land actie te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de abortuspil (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP from the VVD asks the health minister whether she is aware that Women on Waves disputes the claim that internet-ordered abortion pills are unsafe, and asks for the scientific basis of her position and for research into home medical abortion. The minister answers that unsupervised use carries risks, that existing research already shows home use can be safe, and that she sees no need for further study, while pointing to the Wet afbreking zwangerschap and IGZ supervision.
I see no need for research into the advantages and disadvantages of medical abortion used at home, because extensive research has already been done on this.
Ik zie geen noodzaak voor een onderzoek naar de voor- en nadelen van medicamenteuze abortus bij gebruik in de thuissituatie, omdat hier al uitgebreid onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Psychose schrikbarend vaak gemist in Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how it is possible that psychoses are often missed in mental health care, with 63% of patients showing psychotic symptoms untreated for two years, and asks about diagnosis, training, routine outcome monitoring, reporting of undertreatment to the inspectorate, and results-based financing. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because further investigation is needed, and answers will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Leijten (SP) on psychosis frequently missed in mental health care cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Leijten (SP) over Psychose schrikbarend vaak gemist in Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ ( 2011Z21797 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verkopen van alcohol door tankstations (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP asks whether petrol stations may again sell alcohol, why such sales were banned, and what sanctions and enforcement capacity exist. The government replies that the sale violates the Drank- en Horecawet, that the ban rests on road-safety grounds that still apply, that fines (900 euro, escalating) and criminal prosecution are available, and that the nVWA's capacity is sufficient.
If petrol stations start selling alcoholic drinks, action will be taken against it.
Indien tankstations alcoholhoudende drank gaan verkopen, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toekomst van apen en andere proefdieren in verband met de reorganisatie bij MSD-Organon (ingezonden 5 okto

An MP asked the minister about the fate of primates and other laboratory animals remaining at MSD-Organon after its research closure, including whether a rehoming to sanctuaries can be guaranteed. The minister said animal numbers are only reported to the nVWA and not published per company, that welfare rules apply, that the destination of animals is the license holder's responsibility, and that the nVWA will be asked to monitor the case.
No data traceable to individual license holders are made public.
Er worden geen naar individuele vergunninghouders herleidbare gegevens openbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de nieuwe voorlichtingscampagne van Sense «hun eerste keer» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the Sense campaign 'hun eerste keer' and whether its framing of average first-sex age (16.4) is appropriate for the 15-16 year-old target group. The minister replies that the campaign aims at sexual assertiveness for not-yet-sexually-active youth, that 'seks' covers more than intercourse, that the average is not presented as a norm, and that the campaign will not be adapted.
The message that the average age at which young people in the Netherlands have intercourse is 16.4 years merely provides factual information based on large-scale research among young people.

Met het bericht dat de gemiddelde leeftijd waarop jongeren in Nederland geslachtsgemeenschap hebben 16,4 jaar is, wordt slechts feitelijke informatie verschaft die is gebaseerd op grootschalig onderzoek onder jongeren.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over berichten dat melk lang niet goed is voor e

MPs Thieme asked the ministers about reports that Wageningen University altered a press release on milk research, its ties to the dairy industry, and whether the Voedingscentrum should warn consumers about high dairy intake. The government answered that the press release was adjusted but no investigation is warranted, that industry partnerships do not compromise independence, and that it sees no reason to intervene with the Voedingscentrum.
There is no reason to request an internal investigation, see also answer 4.
Er is geen aanleiding om een intern onderzoek te vragen, zie ook antwoord 4.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over belemmering door zorgverzekeraars van de toegang tot logopedie (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

MP Leijten asks the minister whether insurers making logopedie screenings conditional on expected demand amounts to risk selection and abuse of market power, and what the minister will do about it. The minister says direct access to logopedie is intended, insurers may still impose procedural conditions, the Zvw rules out rationing by expected demand, and abuse of market power is for the NZa to assess.
Should it nevertheless occur that an insurer denies an insured person care on improper grounds, it is not for me to intervene.
Mocht het toch voorkomen dat een zorgverzekeraar een verzekerde op oneigenlijke gronden (vergoeding van) zorg ontzegt dan is het niet aan mij om in te grijpen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het familiebeleid in de GGZ dat vaak niet op orde blijkt te zijn (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister why family policy in mental health institutions is often inadequate, whether families can get effective responses when a patient deteriorates, and whether relatives should be able to view a deceased patient's file after suicide. The minister acknowledged the importance of family policy, pointed to existing channels and the IGZ complaints route, said 35 institutions (about 30 percent) have a family confidant, and announced a study of medical confidentiality with a planned legal regulation of relatives' file access.
I intend to explicitly regulate the latter in the Client Rights in Healthcare Act (article 23).
Ik ben voornemens dit laatste expliciet te regelen in de Wet cliëntenrechten zorg (artikel 23).

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bereiken van het subsidieplafond van projectsubsidies uit hoofde van het «Beleidskader Sport en Be

Two Green Left MPs asked the health minister whether the subsidy ceiling for the 'private interventions' sport-in-neighbourhoods scheme had been reached in 2011 and why the website still referred to applications. The minister confirmed the ceiling was reached, said 117 applications were received with 12 granted and 105 rejected, and declined to raise the budget, pointing to a new programme for 2012-2016.
No, I do not intend to increase the budget.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan het budget te verhogen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ruimte in het Budgettair Kader Zorg BKZ (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks whether the 2012 budget for pharmaceutical care outside hospitals falls by 68.4 million euro after moving TNF-alpha inhibitors to the hospital budget and delisting heartburn drugs, and whether this creates room of about 530 million euro, and whether the freed-up room will be used to reverse measures affecting insured persons. The minister confirms the figures, says the room is already fully used within the 2012 budget, rejects a 7% room for pharmacist pay, and says windfalls may be used to cover shortfalls under budget discipline rules.
However, this does not mean that a room of about 530 million euro is expected on this file.
Dit betekent echter niet dat er een ruimte wordt verwacht van ongeveer € 530 mln. op dit dossier.
Vragen van het lid van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bemiddelingssites waar zich sperma- en eiceldonoren aanbieden (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about websites where sperm and egg donors offer themselves to prospective parents, covering their legal basis, toezicht by the IGZ, verification of donors, and whether such sites should be banned. The document is only a holding notice: the minister says the answers cannot be given on time because they require consultation with the IGZ and external organisations, and promises to send them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the answer requires consultation with the Health Care Inspectorate and external organisations.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de beantwoording afstemming behoeft met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en externe organisaties.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ontslaggolf en bezuinigingen in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the dismissal wave and budget cuts in mental health care (GGZ), including job losses at Parnassia Bavo Groep, the effects of a proposed personal contribution (eigen bijdrage) on patients, and executive salaries above the Balkenende norm. The minister's reply is only an announcement that the answers will be delayed pending further information from parties, with no substantive answers yet.
The reason for the delay is that further information must be requested from parties in order to answer the questions carefully.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen nadere informatie bij partijen opgevraagd moet worden.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de banden van de minister met de tabaksindustrie en falende rookpreventie (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about alleged ties between her ministry and the tobacco industry, including a visit to Imperial Tobacco, contacts with lobbyists, official conflicts of interest, party sponsorship, and a study claiming 600 deaths from ending smoking-cessation drug coverage. The minister replied only that the answers would be delayed because consultation with other departments takes longer than expected.
The questions from MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Leijten (SP) on the minister's ties with the tobacco industry and failing smoking prevention cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

3 en 4 Mededeling De vragen van de Kamerleden Van Gerven (SP) en Leijten (SP) over de banden van de minister met de tabaksindustrie en falende rookpreventie ( 2011Z21195 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de grote ontslaggolf in de Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the consequences of mass layoffs in mental health care (GGZ), including waiting lists, care quality, regional provision and the government's oversight of the duty of care of insurers. The minister only sends a holding notice that answers will come later because further information must be requested from parties.
The reason for the delay is that further information must be requested from parties for a careful answer to the questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen nadere informatie bij partijen opgevraagd moet worden.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financien en aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over introductie van tweedeling in de ouderenzorg d

MP Leijten asks whether the Menzis/AEGON care-savings product, which lets people save for extra care in old age, creates an undesirable two-tier system in elderly care and undermines the solidarity of the AWBZ. The minister replies that marketing is the insurers' own responsibility, that the AWBZ remains equal for all regardless of means, and that the savings product does not change collective arrangements, while answering the factual questions on deposit guarantees and the risks of the product.
The market positioning strategy is the insurer's own responsibility.
De marktpositioneringsstrategie behoort tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de verzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het te snel ter sprake brengen van orgaandonatie (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MP Klijnsma asks the health minister about reports that doctors raise organ donation with families before brain death is confirmed, and how Dutch practice compares with Spain and other countries. Minister Schippers answers that families must be informed about the purpose of brain-death tests, that raising donation early sometimes loses donation chances, and that staff training and the organisation of donation in hospitals will be improved, with a letter promised later this year.
I will inform you later this year about how I intend to improve the organisation of organ donation in Dutch hospitals.
Ik informeer u later dit jaar over de manier waarop ik de organisatie van orgaandonatie in de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen wil verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het matige enthousiasme onder Amsterdammers over de Olympische Ambitie (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about weak public support in Amsterdam for an Olympic bid for 2028, the expected costs of preparing a bid, and sport promotion as part of the Olympic ambition. The minister declined to judge the poll results for now, gave only a partial cost figure (2 million euro reserved from 2012, larger commitments not before 2016), and agreed that sport and exercise promotion matters, pointing to a forthcoming policy framework.
A complete overview of the costs the government will incur in the coming years cannot be given to you now.
Een volledig overzicht van de te maken kosten die de overheid de komende jaren gaat maken kan ik u nu niet geven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over GGZ-instellingen die de familie van een patiënt buitenspel zetten (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MP Leijten asks the state secretary about mental health institutions that exclude patients' families, citing an enquiry showing inadequate family policy and unequal information access. The minister acknowledges the problem, supports family involvement, notes a legal right to information for some relatives, and announces a planned obligation in care plans regarding family involvement.
I am considering including in the Compulsory Mental Healthcare Act a requirement to record agreements on possible family involvement in care plans.

Verder overweeg ik om in het kader van de aanbieding van de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag en de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte GGZ een verplichting op te nemen om in zorgplannen afspraken vast te leggen over eventuele familiebetrokkenheid.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat tankstations vanaf november alcohol gaan verkopen (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP asked whether the government would enforce the ban on alcohol sales at petrol stations after industry plans to resume sales, including threats to restock and sell spirits. The minister said the plan violates the Drank- en Horecawet, committed to enforcement by the nVWA with escalating fines and possible criminal prosecution, and declined to commit to closing stations.
This intention is in violation of Article 22, first paragraph, under a, of the Drink and Catering Act.
Dit voornemen is in strijd met artikel 22, eerste lid, onder a, van de Drank- en Horecawet.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van vijf tankstation-houders om bier en wijn te gaan verkope

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the health minister about five petrol station owners planning to sell beer and wine despite the Drank- en Horecawet ban, and about enforcement by the nVWA and mystery-shop results on underage alcohol sales. The minister answered that the plan breaches the law and enforcement will follow, gave 2008-2011 enforcement figures, said the Inspector-General will act where needed, and noted the national mystery-shop results were already sent to parliament.
If petrol station owners start selling beer and wine, action will be taken against it.
Indien tankstationhouders bier en wijn gaan verkopen, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over minimale afstanden tussen woningen en i

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers whether they would set minimum distances between intensive livestock farms and homes after the GGD advised such norms, and whether they would legislate these and a health assessment requirement. The minister replied that she will take a position only after the Health Council's advice, due in Q3 2012, and did not commit to legislation.

I want and can only assess this advice after the Health Council has issued the advice requested by me, on behalf of the state secretaries of I&M and EL&I, on an assessment framework for micro-organisms and endotoxins from livestock farming.

Ik wil en kan dit advies pas beoordelen nadat de Gezondheidsraad het door mij, mede namens de staatssecretarissen van I&M en EL&I, gevraagde advies over een beoordelingskader voor micro-organismen en endotoxinen afkomstig uit veehouderijen heeft uitgebracht.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de EFSA (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the health minister about alleged conflicts of interest among EFSA panel members advising on aspartame, including undisclosed industry ties and calls for new safety research. The minister's reply, in this document, is only a holding notice saying the answers will be delivered later because more time is needed to consult experts.
The questions from MPs Thieme and Ouwehand on possible conflicts of interest at EFSA cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

Nader antwoord De vragen van de Kamerleden Thieme (PvdD) en Ouwehand (PvdD) over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de EFSA ( 2011Z20657 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onduidelijkheid rond inkomens van huisartsen en onderzoek van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) (ingezonden 14 oktober 20

An SP MP asks the health minister whether an independent institute should join the NZa in determining GP incomes, whether the LHV should be involved in the study design, and how a 9% GP funding cut in 2012 (and a 132 million euro saving) can be justified and implemented without harming access and quality. The minister rejects a parallel study, says the NZa consults the LHV as standard, states the cut is based on overspending rather than average GP income (now revised to 112 million), and commits only to asking the NZa for a feasibility review of the payment system.
I see no compelling reason to postpone this measure by a year, especially since the cut is not based on the discussion about GP income.
Ik zie geen dwingende reden om deze maatregel met een jaar uit te stellen, temeer omdat de korting niet is gebaseerd op de discussie over het inkomen van de huisarts
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toelaten van buitenlandse artsen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the BIG-register entry of a British-qualified paediatrician, whether recent rule changes exclude such doctors on nationality grounds, and about the shortage of paediatricians. The minister replies that the shortened procedure was dropped because EU law no longer allowed it for non-EEA diploma holders, that the decision concerns the diploma origin rather than nationality, and that assessment procedures should be client-friendly and as short as possible.
Recognition of professional qualifications is not about the nationality of the doctor but about the origin of the medical diploma.
Bij de erkenning van de beroepskwalificaties gaat het niet om de nationaliteit van de arts, maar om de herkomst van het artsdiploma.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bloeddonatie door homoseksuelen (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the UK's move to allow gay men to donate blood and whether the Dutch exclusion policy should change. The minister answers that Sanquin will study whether the UK arguments apply in the Netherlands, that safety of recipients is the key concern, and that the policy will be reviewed after that research and the forthcoming Council of Europe resolution.
I have asked Sanquin to conduct research on this and to report on it as soon as possible.
Ik heb Sanquin gevraagd daarnaar onderzoek te doen en zo spoedig mogelijk daarover te rapporteren.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantrekken van Poolse werknemers in de zorg (ingezonden 9 septem

Two SP MPs asked the health and social affairs ministers about recruiting Polish care workers who live in the homes of the people they care for, working around the clock, with questions on labour conditions, BIG registration, training equivalence, exploitation risks and the WHO code. The government answered that employers are primarily responsible for staffing and housing, that EU labour rules and the Waga apply, that the Labour Inspectorate will pilot checks in care, and that the Polish workers in this case mostly do domestic and support work not requiring BIG registration.

In the autumn the Labour Inspectorate will start a pilot in the care sector checking compliance with the Foreign Nationals Employment Act and the Minimum Wage Act, including checks on intermediary agencies.

In het najaar start de Arbeidsinspectie een pilot in de zorgsector naar naleving van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen en de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag, waarbij ook bemiddelingsbureaus gecontroleerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het uitsluiten van homo’s voor bloeddonatie ingaat tegen Europese rege

An MP asked the ministers whether EU rules require the Netherlands to quickly stop lifetime exclusion of gay men from blood donation and to wait for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister agreed that sexual risk behaviour, not sexual orientation, should be the criterion, but would not yet change the rules, saying changes depend on safety assessment, the Council of Europe resolution and talks with Sanquin.

As I indicated in answers to recent parliamentary questions from MP Arib on blood donation by homosexuals, the rules on blood donation by MSM can be amended if it is shown that the safety of blood product recipients is guaranteed.

Zoals ik in antwoorden op recente Kamervragen van het Kamerlid Arib over bloeddonatie door homoseksuelen heb aangegeven, kunnen de regels rondom bloeddonatie van MSM worden aangepast, als blijkt dat de veiligheid van ontvangers van bloedproducten gewaarborgd is.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie aanmerken van de tran

Deputy Dijkstra (D66) asked ministers whether the Netherlands agrees with the WHO's ICD-10 classification of transgender identity as a disorder and whether it would lobby for a different classification. The ministers said they support transgender emancipation, will facilitate an expert meeting to draft a text proposal for the WHO, but see no role for the Dutch government to argue the scientific debate itself, noting classification is separate from reimbursement decisions.
At this moment I see no role for the Dutch government to put its own arguments into the scientists' debate.
Op dit moment zie ik geen rol voor de Nederlandse overheid om zich met eigen argumenten in het debat van de wetenschappers te begeven.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over eigen bijdrage e-mental health (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the 50 euro copayment for internet-based mental health treatment deters patients and slows e-mental health adoption, despite its promise for cost control. The minister defends the copayment as reasonable and as a useful threshold against dropout, promises to remove regulatory barriers and to inform parliament by letter on e-health.
On my plans to accelerate the implementation of e-health, I will separately inform the House of Representatives this year in a letter on e-health and ICT in care.
Over mijn voornemens om de implementatie van e-health te versnellen, zal ik de Tweede Kamer dit jaar nog apart informeren in een brief over e-health en ICT in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het doden van zwerfdieren in Oekraïne (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether she knows of mass killings of stray dogs and cats in Ukraine before Euro 2012, whether she will contact the Ukrainian ambassador, how she judges the methods used, whether she will lodge an official protest, and whether she will raise the matter with foreign colleagues. The minister replies only that the answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and promises to send them as soon as possible.
cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period
kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de opnamestops in Nederlandse ziekenhui

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the health minister and the agriculture state secretary about hospital admission stops caused by livestock-associated MRSA, including the Weert and Twente cases and whether hospitals have special admission protocols. The minister answered that the strains involved were mostly not livestock-associated, that existing WIP guidelines apply, that the government will review them after recent outbreaks, and gave cost estimates for screening and isolation.
For data on the number of infections in specific hospitals, I refer you to the public information department of the hospital concerned.
Voor gegevens over het aantal besmettingen in specifieke ziekenhuizen verwijs ik u naar de afdeling voorlichting van het betreffende ziekenhuis.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Indiase operatieassistenten en risico’s voor patiënten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether she would send the Inspectorate's findings on risks from Indian operating-theatre staff and whether hospitals would stop recruiting from India given the Fonds Ziekenhuisopleidingen. The minister agreed to send the Inspectorate's findings with her response in spring 2012 and said recruitment from India would be much less needed as training intake rises, while noting temporary recruitment is acceptable if it meets quality standards.
I am willing to do so. I expect to be able to send the Inspectorate's findings to the House of Representatives in spring 2012, including a response from me.
Ik ben daartoe bereid. De bevindingen van de Inspectie verwacht ik in het voorjaar van 2012 naar de Tweede Kamer te kunnen sturen, inclusief een reactie van mijn kant.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bezuiniging in de huisartsenzorg (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

Dijkstra (D66) asks the health minister whether, given budget cuts, GPs will stop necessary investments needed to implement integrated primary care, and whether the financial policy still serves better and cheaper primary care. Minister Schippers answers that overspending in GP and multidisciplinary care is being recovered, that investment room exists, that GPs can agree investments with insurers, and that costs are shared across patients, providers and insurers.
I have invited the Dutch GPs' association to discuss this, and I hope they are willing to do so.
Ik heb de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging uitgenodigd om hierover in gesprek te gaan en ik hoop dat zij hiertoe bereid is.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toekomst van apen en andere proefdieren in verband met de reorganisatie bij MSD-Organon (ingezonden 5 okto

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the number and welfare of laboratory animals, including about 80 monkeys, remaining at MSD-Organon after its research activities closed, and whether the company is obliged to rehome them in sanctuaries under the new EU directive. The minister replies only that answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and promises them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that interdepartmental consultation is needed and this takes more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat er interdepartementale afstemming nodig is en dit meer tijd vraagt.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financien en aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over introductie van tweedeling in de ouderenzorg d

An SP MP asks ministers whether insurers Menzis and AEGON's new 'zorgsparen' product, letting people save for luxury elderly care, creates an undesirable two-tier system and undermines the solidarity of the AWBZ, asking 13 questions in total. The government's answer is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because coordination with the Ministry of Finance is needed, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that coordination must take place between my department and the Ministry of Finance.
De reden van het uitstel is dat er afstemming plaats moet vinden tussen mijn departement en het ministerie van Financiën.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte korting op de bijzondere bijstand van chroni

SP MPs Leijten and Karabulut ask ministers about a court ruling that Amsterdam wrongly reduced special assistance (bijzondere bijstand) for chronically ill and disabled people, asking how many municipalities and people are affected, when the government knew, how Amsterdam ignored a 2009 letter, how people will be compensated, and whether municipalities should be obliged to grant categorical assistance. The government replies only with a notice that the questions touch the SZW minister's field, so the answers are postponed and handed over to that minister.
The reason for the delay is that the questions mainly concern the policy field of my colleague, the minister of SZW.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de gestelde vragen met name het beleidsterrein van mijn collega, de minister van SZW, raken.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de verloskundige zorg ongelijk verdeeld is in Nederland (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the minister about reports that midwifery care is unevenly distributed across the Netherlands, the norm of 105 births per midwife, the absence of a capacity forecast since 2005, and a 4 million euro cut. Minister Schippers answers that no shortage or access problem is known, the distribution follows midwives' own settlement choices, the cut targets overruns above the already-adjusted norm, and she will ask the College Perinatale Zorg to analyse the findings.
Nevertheless, I will ask the College Perinatale Zorg to analyse the findings further and report to me on them.
Niettemin zal ik het College Perinatale Zorg vragen om de bevindingen nader te analyseren en mij hierover te rapporteren.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat patiënten donderdag moeten aankloppen bij de huisartsenpost (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether patients forced to use out-of-hours GP posts during a GP strike would be charged the higher out-of-hours rate, and whether this was acceptable amid spending cuts. The minister answered that regional agreements meant the daytime GP rate applied, that extra costs were settled with GPs or their associations, and that no extra cost falls on premium payers.
In regions where no agreements were made, the services are billed through the patient's own GP to the insurer.
In de regio’s waar hierover geen afspraken zijn gemaakt, worden de verrichtingen via de eigen huisarts bij de verzekeraar in rekening gebracht.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het te snel ter sprake brengen van orgaandonatie (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how she views claims that doctors raise organ donation with relatives too early, before brain death is established, and asks about Dutch donation rates compared with other countries, Spain in particular. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that answers will be delayed because consultation with stakeholders is needed.
The questions from MP Klijnsma (PvdA) on raising organ donation too early cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Klijnsma (PvdA) over het te snel ter sprake brengen van orgaandonatie ( 2011Z20055 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how the threatened closure of acute obstetrics at Meppel hospital will be prevented, whether the 45-minute accessibility norm will be kept, and whether the minister will investigate risks in other regions such as Almelo. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers will be delayed because further information must be obtained from parties.
The questions from MP Kooiman (SP) on the threatened closure of acute obstetrics in Meppel cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
