Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Kooiman (SP) over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Meppel ( 2011Z20387 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asks the Minister of Health about plans to close acute midwifery care in Meppel by end 2012, including whether the hospital was asked in March 2011 not to close it, whether a WTZi licence condition should require it stay open, and the status of the IGZ investigation into concentration plans. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because further information must be obtained from parties.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Groot artsentekort in verpleeghuis» (ingezonden

The MP asks whether a shortage of 180 elderly-care specialists is lowering care quality, whether the specialty is unpopular with medical students and what the minister will do, and why specialists earn about half of GP pay. The minister acknowledges the shortage, cites funding, training-place and alternative-staffing measures and says salary comparisons with GPs are misleading because specialists are employed while GPs are self-employed.
I share the concern. Various parties have therefore taken and are taking various measures to reduce the shortages.
Ik deel de bezorgdheid. Er zijn en worden door diverse partijen daarom verschillende maatregelen genomen om de tekorten te verminderen.
Vragen van het lid Lodders (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een tekort aan verpleeghuisartsen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of geriatric physicians (specialists in elderly care), its causes and possible government roles. The minister confirmed the training figures, attributed the shortage to low awareness and image problems, and pointed to existing funding and alternative staffing measures, with ongoing talks with the field.
VWS is currently in talks with stakeholders on a broad approach to further promote (lateral) entry into the training and supports initiatives for alternative solutions through task reallocation.

VWS is op dit moment in gesprek met veldpartijen voor een brede aanpak om de (zij)instroom in de opleiding verder te bevorderen en ondersteunt initiatieven voor alternatieve oplossingen via taakherschikking.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de oproep van artsen tegen jongensbesnijdenis (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the KNMG's call against male circumcision, whether it takes a political stance, and whether a legal ban would violate religious freedom. The minister answered that the KNMG may take a position, that a ban would restrict religious freedom and lacks justification for boys since properly performed circumcision has no lasting harm, and that the KNMG does not advocate a ban.
A ban would restrict the freedom to practise religion.
Een verbod zou de vrijheid van godsdienstuitoefening beperken.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het van start gaan van SOS Arts (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the NZa's approval of the SOS Arts on-call doctor initiative, its claimed huisarts role, the risk of a two-tier system, and the supervision of the service. The minister defended innovation and new entrants, argued on-call care is not covered by the basic insurance, and said the IGZ will supervise quality.
I am of the view that more innovative initiatives, which may contribute to improving the quality, accessibility and efficiency of care and offer patients more choice, should be given a chance.

Ik ben van mening dat meer innovatieve initiatieven, die mogelijk kunnen bijdragen aan het bevorderen van de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en doelmatigheid van de zorg en patiënten meer keuzemogelijkheden bieden, een kans moeten krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Steeds meer weekendrijders zonder alcohol de weg op» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether mass-media campaigns such as the drink-driving (BOB) campaign and anti-smoking efforts are effective, and why the cabinet is ending lifestyle campaigns while keeping them for road safety. The minister replies that road safety is primarily the transport minister's responsibility, that mass campaigns are poorly targeted and hard to evaluate, and that the government will shift to targeted information via schools, websites and health professionals.
Apart from the question of effectiveness, this cabinet does not consider mass media campaigns the right way to influence the personal lifestyle choices of adult people.
Los van het vraagstuk van de effectiviteit, acht dit kabinet massamediale campagnes niet de juiste manier om de persoonlijke leefstijlkeuzes van volwassen mensen te beïnvloeden.

Vragen namens de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorgverzekering op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 28 september 2011

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister about the health insurance system on the BES islands, including whether private insurers were ordered to cancel policies, whether insured people were informed, whether the new scheme is less favourable and cannot be supplemented, and whether the ID card is recognised abroad for medical care. The minister replied that insurers were not ordered to cancel, that transitional rules let broader private coverage continue and allow supplementary insurance, and that access to specialist care abroad is arranged through contracts and agreements with neighbouring facilities.
The reasonableness and fairness of such a cancellation is a matter for the judge to assess.
De redelijkheid en billijkheid van een dergelijke opzegging staat ter beoordeling aan de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over hoge tandartskosten (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about high dental costs, including the expected price rises after dental prices were liberalised on 1 January 2012, the lack of patient information on technical material costs, and price differences from implant materials. The minister said the NZa will monitor prices during the experiment, sees no need for extra measures beyond the existing quote obligation, and points to insurance policy terms for reimbursement information.
During the experiment with free price setting, the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa) will closely monitor price developments in dental care and report to me.
Tijdens het experiment met de vrije prijsvorming zal de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de prijsontwikkeling in de mondzorg gedegen monitoren en mij daarover rapporteren.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de invoering van het medisch kerndossier in de regio Rijnmond (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister about a medical summary record (medisch kerndossier) pilot in the Rijnmond region, its relation to the national EPD/LSP, whether the privacy regulator CBP reviewed it, whether it is adequately secured, and the DigiD login risk after the DigiNotar affair. The minister answers that the project is a standardisation initiative separate from the national infrastructure, that the CBP did not review it, that security assessment is for the IGZ and CBP, that DigiD is considered safe again, and that the questions could not be answered before the scheduled debate.
The medical summary record has not been reviewed by the CBP.
Het medisch kerndossier is niet getoetst door het CBP.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verkrijgbaarheid van levensgevaarlijke abortuspillen via internet (ingezonden 29 septem

An SGP MP asks the health and justice ministers whether abortion pills sold via internet sites are available, in which countries those sites are registered, whether the Inspectorate can act against foreign-based sellers, and what steps will be taken to stop sales and warn users. The government's answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because further consultation with the IGZ and the Ministry of Security and Justice is needed.
The reason for the delay is that further consultation with the IGZ and the Ministry of Security and Justice is required.
De reden van het uitstel is dat nader overleg met de IGZ en het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie nodig is.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over berichten dat melk lang niet goed is voor e

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers whether Wageningen University distorted research on milk and commercial ties with the dairy industry, whether dairy consumption is linked to cancer and heart disease risks, and whether the university and the Voedingscentrum should be held to account and an internal investigation launched. The answer is a notice from the minister of Security and Justice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because consultation with other parties is needed, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Thieme (PvdD) about reports that milk is far from good for everyone cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.
Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Thieme (PvdD) over berichten dat melk lang niet goed is voor elk ( 2011Z18932 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de abortuspil (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the minister's claim that the abortion pill bought online is unsafe without medical supervision has a scientific basis, given that Women on Waves disputes it and cites research showing home use is safe, and whether the minister will examine the pros and cons of home medical abortion. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers are delayed pending consultation with IGZ and the Ministry of Security and Justice, with no substantive answer yet.
The reason for the delay is that further consultation with IGZ and the Ministry of Security and Justice is needed.
De reden van het uitstel is dat nader overleg met IGZ en het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie nodig is.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voetbalclubs die kleuters scouten en willen opleiden (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about football clubs scouting and wanting to train very young children (under 7), and whether KNVB rules should change. The minister said the KNVB and she believe children should stay in their familiar environment, that the KNVB is still deliberating and she awaits its outcome, and that clubs and parents bear primary responsibility for supervision.
I want to await the outcomes of that discussion and deliberation within the KNVB.
Ik wil de uitkomsten van die discussie en beraad binnen de KNVB afwachten.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat normaal gedrag in het nieuwe psychologenhandboek als ziek wordt benoemd (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the revised DSM manual, which lowers diagnostic thresholds and adds conditions, will increase medicalisation of normal behaviour in the Netherlands and inflate reimbursed treatments, and whether DSM influence and diagnosing-and-treating conflicts of interest can be curbed. The minister replies that the DSM is a professional classification the government does not steer, that the basic health insurance package is being reviewed with the CVZ, that ICF experiments are under way at the CIZ, and that a quality institute will be set up to tighten indication and oversight.
I will remain very critical of possible consequences for the insured package and its 'appropriate use'.
Maar ik zal zeer kritisch blijven kijken naar mogelijke gevolgen voor het verzekerd pakket en het «gepast gebruik» daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ESBL-producerende bacteriën (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

MP Thieme asks the health minister whether ESBL bacteria spread from intensive livestock farming into hospitals via food, whether hospitals should be restricted to certified ESBL/MRSA-free food, whether antibiotic use in farming should be curbed or taxed, and whether farm and human antibiotic use should be separated. The minister answers that the Health Council sees probable transmission from animals but no evidence that hospital food causes infections, rejects certification and a levy, and points to the planned halving of farm antibiotic use and the Health Council advice follow-up.
It cannot be ruled out that ESBL-producing bacteria found on raw meat or vegetables may spread further through the food chain.
Het is niet uitgesloten dat ESBL-producerende bacteriën die kunnen voorkomen op rauw vlees of groenten zich via de voedselketen verder kunnen verspreiden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mens-op-mens besmettingen met MRSA (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether MRSA and ESBL bacteria are transmitted person-to-person in the Netherlands, whether this is a worrying situation, and whether further research and restrictions on shared antibiotics will be pursued. The minister confirmed person-to-person transmission, called the situation worrying, pointed to existing monitoring and guidelines, and promised a further letter to parliament on reducing livestock antibiotic use.
I share the view of the Statens Serum Instituut that the transmission of resistant bacteria between animals and humans and between humans is worrying.
Ik deel de mening van het Statens Serum Instituut dat de overdracht van resistente bacteriën tussen dieren en mensen en tussen mensen onderling zorgwekkend is.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de diensten van SOS Arts mogen beginnen (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the NZa rule allowing 'zorg op afroep' (on-call care at home) to be delivered by any BIG-registered doctor, not only registered GPs, and about the quality standards and oversight. The minister answered that the rule is not restricted to GPs, that quality is governed by verantwoorde zorg norms supervised by the IGZ, and that care quality must be guaranteed.
The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) supervises this.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) houdt hier toezicht op.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over borgbaarheid maatschappelijk vastgoed (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

CDA MPs Van Bochove and Smilde asked the health minister about whether housing general practitioners and therapists in care hubs can be guaranteed by the WSW (Dutch social housing guarantee fund), and asked how long talks with BZK on this have lasted. The minister replied only with a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the normal deadline due to unfinished interdepartmental coordination and that BZK will answer.
The reason for the delay is the interdepartmental coordination that is not yet fully completed.
De reden van het uitstel is de nog niet geheel afgeronde interdepartementale afstemming.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie aanmerken van de tran

MP Dijkstra (D66) asks three ministers how the government views the WHO's ICD-10 classification of transgender identity as a disorder, and whether it will lobby for a different classification that keeps medical treatment funded. The minister's reply only announces that answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental and stakeholder consultation.
The questions from MP Dijkstra (D66) on the WHO's classification of transgender identity as a disorder cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Dijkstra (D66) over Het door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie aanmerken van de transgenderidentiteit als stoornis kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de praktijken van privékliniek Geertgen uit Elsendorp (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about private clinic Geertgen, which allegedly pushes fertility patients toward egg donation by offering heavier IVF treatment in place of simpler insemination, possibly to bypass waiting lists, and asks about financial gain, legality under the Embryo Act, staff qualifications, cooperation with a hospital, and inspectorate views. The minister replies only that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because consultation with the Inspectorate and professional groups is needed, and promises them as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) about the practices of private clinic Geertgen from Elsendorp cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gerven (SP) over de praktijken van privékliniek Geertgen uit Elsendorp kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zwangerschapsafbrekingen op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 19 augustus 20

The MP asks whether the Dutch abortion law (Wet afbreking zwangerschap) will really take effect on the BES islands on 10 October 2011, how preparations are made, how many doctors have permits, and whether doctors risk fines. The minister confirms the law takes effect on 10 October but legal abortion is only possible once a licensed clinic or practice exists, none does yet, and it is up to private initiative rather than the state to set up such services; a study and further information are promised by 10 October.
Currently there is no care provider on the BES that has the required licence as of 10 October 2011.
Momenteel is er geen zorgaanbieder op de BES die per 10 oktober 2011 over de vereiste vergunning beschikt.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een neuroloog in Twente (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's use of disciplinary complaints, including why it sometimes handles cases itself, why disciplinary courts do not always suspend practitioners pending appeal, and how it balances interests in deciding whether to file complaints. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate uses a range of enforcement tools case by case, explained the Leerdam psychotherapist case, and said a note on disciplinary law and the BIG register would follow this autumn.
In addition, the IGZ can also file a disciplinary complaint when the general interest – read patient care – requires it.
Daarnaast kan de IGZ ook een tuchtklacht indienen wanneer het algemeen belang – lees de patiëntenzorg – dit vordert.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bloeddonatie door homoseksuelen (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the UK's reported move to accept gay men as blood donors, and British arguments that the lifetime ban is no longer justified, should prompt Sanquin to revise its policy. The government sent only an interim notice that the answers would be delayed until late October, to be coordinated with the education and culture minister.
The questions from MPs Arib (PvdA) and Dijkstra (D66) on excluding gay men from blood donation cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual timeframe.
De vragen van de Kamerleden Arib (PvDA) en Dijkstra (D66) over het uitsluiten van homo's voor bloeddonatie kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het uitsluiten van homo’s voor bloeddonatie ingaat tegen Europese rege

An MP asks the ministers whether the lifetime ban on blood donation by gay men conflicts with EU rules, which require donor selection based on sexual risk behaviour rather than sexual orientation, and asks for quick adjustment and talks with Sanquin. The government reply is a postponement notice saying the answers will follow by end of October because they must be coordinated with another minister.
The reason for the delay is that more time turns out to be needed to coordinate the answers with the Minister of Education, Culture and Science.
De reden van uitstel is dat er meer tijd nodig blijkt te zijn om de antwoorden af te stemmen met de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van schijncontracten aan jonge

MPs Van Dekken and Spekman asked whether football clubs placing young players on payroll as fictitious occupations such as crane operator, via a temp agency, is acceptable and how contracts could better reflect players' real positions. The minister replied that Vitesse denies misregistration, that the temp-agency construction is not contrary to KNVB rules or law, and that regulating it is mainly the sector's responsibility, to be clarified in consultation with KNVB and player organisations.
I consider this mainly a responsibility of the sector itself, i.e. the KNVB and the clubs.
Ik vind dit vooral een verantwoordelijkheid van de sector zelf, i.c. de KNVB en de clubs.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht over de brief van Verzekeringscommissies van de samenwerkende CAM-artsenverenigingen aan Zorgverzekeraars Ne

An MP asked the minister whether insurers wrongly exclude CAM doctors from first-line care and refuse to reimburse lab and X-ray tests they order, and whether this hinders patient choice and the KNMG conduct rule. The minister answered that CAM care is not covered by the Zvw because it lacks evidence of effectiveness, that patients remain free to choose their doctor, and that reimbursement refusal does not hinder doctors from practising under the KNMG rule.

Because CAM provided by a CAM doctor does not belong to the medical care that general practitioners ordinarily provide, CAM doctors' care does not fall under the insured benefits of the Zvw and cannot be reimbursed through the Zvw.

Omdat CAM verleend door een CAM-arts niet behoort tot de geneeskundige zorg zoals huisartsen die plegen te bieden, valt de zorg van CAM-artsen niet onder de verzekerde prestaties van de Zvw en kan deze zorg niet via de Zvw worden vergoed.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over patiëntregistraties als voorwaarde voor zorgcontractering (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether patient registries should be made a binding condition for contracting hospital care with expensive drugs, and questioned the NZa's role and timeline. The minister said NZa must first study whether mandatory transparency is necessary and feasible, that voluntary initiatives are also possible, and that she disagrees prestatiebekostiging depends on such a link.
I expect that the NZa needs several months to carry out research into these questions and to consult field parties.
Ik verwacht dat de NZa enkele maanden nodig heeft om onderzoek naar deze vragen te verrichten en om veldpartijen te consulteren.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aanwezigheid van salmonella in vlees (in

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the EU salmonella ban in poultry meat will be strictly enforced, whether campylobacter will also be banned, and who will pay for a collective fund and independent research on pathogens in meat. The minister replied that enforcement is delegated to the Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren with audits by the nVWA, campylobacter is not banned due to lack of EU support, the fund is privately financed by the sector, and safety is a shared responsibility of the supply chain.
Compliance checks are carried out under co-regulation by the Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren (PPE), and the nVWA supervises them through audits.
De controle op de naleving wordt in medebewind uitgevoerd door het Productschap Pluimvee en Eieren (PPE). De nVWA houdt hier toezicht op door middel van audits.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kinderen van ouders met psychische en verslavingsproblemen (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether preventive care for children of parents with mental health or addiction problems is available everywhere and whether it is being cut, and about support for children of detained parents. The minister answers that an inventory shows no structural change in reach, that funding uncertainty exists without known effect, that municipalities will be responsible after decentralisation, and that a child-check process via police and youth care bureaus operates in all municipalities.
Whether all children in every municipality receive KOPP/KVO help, I do not know.
Of alle kinderen in elke gemeente KOPP/KVO-hulp krijgen, weet ik niet.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat niet alle slachterijen de verplichte BSE-t

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about reports that some slaughterhouses did not carry out mandatory BSE tests, asking about the risk, sanctions, recall and improved oversight. The minister answered that the risk is negligible since untested cattle were born after 2001, that four firms were suspended and one faces criminal investigation, that a proportionate recall was done, and referred to letters on strengthened supervision.
Because the BSE tests were not carried out, 4 companies have been suspended.
Vanwege de niet uitgevoerde BSE-testen zijn 4 bedrijven geschorst.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gezamenlijke nulgrensafspraak tussen zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asks whether the joint zero-growth agreement among health insurers, communicated by Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, is contrary to competition law and whether the NMa should investigate, and whether insurers should reduce unnecessary care rather than simply buying less. The minister answers that the letter is an interpretation of the macro agreement, not a binding per-hospital zero-growth rule, that no NMa investigation is warranted, and that volume limits and smart purchasing can go together.
I see no reason to ask the NMa to conduct an investigation.
Ik zie geen reden om de NMa te vragen een onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medische fouten doordat artsen niet goed kunnen omgaan met medische technologie (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

Mulder (VVD) asked the minister about medical errors caused by doctors' poor handling of medical technology, citing a newspaper report, and asked about the status of an earlier action plan and whether it needs updating. Minister Schippers said progress would be reported to parliament this autumn, pointed to an expert group report, and promised a further response on the related monitoring study.
On the progress of implementing that action plan, I will inform the House this autumn.
Over de voortgang van de uitvoering van genoemd plan van aanpak zal ik de Kamer nog dit najaar informeren.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 23 september 2011

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of mental health care budget cuts, including job losses and loss of treatment for about 1,000 patients at Bouman GGZ in Rotterdam, and asked what would be done to protect vulnerable patients and continue treatment trajectories. The minister said she would study the effects of a co-payment on vulnerable groups, expected treatment will not be stopped without valid reason, and pointed to cost reductions from integrated care models while stating the sector must still be financially sustainable.
I will conduct research into the possible effects of a co-payment on the care demand of vulnerable groups.
Ik zal onderzoek doen naar de mogelijke effecten van een eigen bijdrage op de zorgvraag van kwetsbare groepen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantrekken van Poolse werknemers in de zorg (ingezonden 9 septem

SP MPs Leijten and Ulenbelt asked ministers about recruiting Polish care workers who live with and are on call 24/7 for the patients they care for, raising concerns about exploitation, working conditions, cao and BIG registration, training comparability, language barriers, and WHO recruitment code compliance. The minister's response only announces that answers will be delayed because coordination with the Social Affairs ministry is needed, with no substantive answers given yet.
The questions from MPs Leijten (SP) and Ulenbelt (SP) on recruiting Polish employees in care cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.
De vragen van de Kamerleden Leijten (SP) en Ulenbelt (SP) over het aantrekken van Poolse werknemers in de zorg kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de daling van het aantal rokers sinds de introductie van de stoppen-met-roken-vergoeding (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011).

Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister whether the falling smoking rate since the 2011 stop-smoking reimbursement reflects that policy, and whether removing reimbursement for stop-smoking programmes would reverse gains; the minister answered that causation is not yet certain, that counselling remains reimbursed while medication costs are dropped, and that anti-smoking policy continues.
That cannot yet be said with certainty.
Dat is nog niet met zekerheid te zeggen.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Erasmus Medisch Centrum (EMC) Rotterdam patiënten weigert onder narcose te brengen bij een endoscopi

An MP asked the health minister whether Erasmus MC Rotterdam refuses to put patients under general anaesthesia for endoscopy because of budget cuts, and what she would do about it. The minister said the ministry does not comment on individual cases, described that sedation is usually light, and said the hospital is selective with adult general anaesthesia but offers it when light sedation is insufficient.
The Ministry of VWS does not make statements about individual cases.
Het ministerie van VWS doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.

Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er steeds meer mensen zijn die hun zorgpremie niet kunnen betalen (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of reports that more people cannot pay their health insurance premiums, how many are affected, whether stricter debt enforcement is linked, and how arrears can be prevented. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the number of affected people in the state premium regime is known but overall arrears figures are not, and promised to intensify preventive measures and inform parliament in autumn.
How many people have a payment arrear of less than six months with their health insurer, or how many people ask their insurer for a payment arrangement, is not known to me.

Hoe groot het aantal mensen is met een betalingsachterstand van minder dan zes maanden bij hun zorgverzekeraar of hoeveel mensen hun zorgverzekeraar vragen om een betalingsregeling is mij niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitgestelde behandelingen door hoge tandartskosten (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

MP Kuiken asks the health minister about reports that high dental costs and thin insurance cause people to postpone crowns, bridges and implants, and about the effects, price setting and government role. The minister says patients are primarily responsible for dental care and can insure themselves, that lab material prices fall outside the Wmg and are set by the dental technology industry, and that the government kept the free youth dental package.
I am not aware to what extent people postpone dental treatments because of high tariffs.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre mensen tandheelkundige behandelingen vanwege hoge tarieven uitstellen.
Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stijgend aantal wanbetalers voor de zorgpremie (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

The MPs ask about the rising number of health premium defaulters (over 300,000 in the enforced collection regime), causes, income groups, whether debt relief works, and cumulative effects of 2012 health measures. The state secretary replies that CVZ does not make payment arrangements, defaulters rose 10.8% to 307,312, a 2008 study was inconclusive, preventive measures will be intensified, and an overview of income effects is in the budget annex.
Statistics Netherlands will provide further data in November 2011 on the income distribution of defaulters as of 31 December 2010.
Het CBS zal in november 2011 nadere gegevens verstrekken over de verdeling van het inkomen bij wanbetalers per 31 december 2010.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van zelfdodingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister why suicides rose for a third year, whether barriers to mental health care such as the new co-payments should be lifted, and whether the suicide reporting procedure should be restored. The minister acknowledged the 2010 rise, declined to investigate its causes and to lower financial barriers further, promised to study the effects of co-payments, and refused to reverse the eased reporting procedure.
At the General Consultation of 30 June I promised that I would examine the possible effects of the co-payment on avoidance of care.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 30 juni jl. heb ik toegezegd dat ik de eventuele effecten van de eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding zal onderzoeken.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de diamanten afvloeiingsregeling voor een adviseur van ziekenhuis de Tjongerschans in Heerenveen (ingezonde

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible 1 to 1.3 million euro severance arrangement for an adviser at hospital Tjongerschans, a prior 350,000 euro golden handshake, board accountability, supervision, a statutory route to reverse such deals, and a planned merger with MCL. The minister said the arrangement far exceeds the 75,000 euro cap, that the supervisory board decides, that the hospital must cover legal costs itself, that stricter supervision criteria do not cover board pay, and that the government favours the pay-norm legislation; the merger is for the NMa and NZa to assess.
The authority to decide on that lies with the Supervisory Board.
De bevoegdheid om daar een besluit over nemen, ligt bij de Raad van Toezicht.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de eigen bijdrage in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) voor mensen met dementie (ingezonde

MP Leijten asked the minister and state secretary whether the proposed co-payment in mental health care (GGZ) would deter dementia patients and elderly people from care, and why it was imposed without exemptions. Minister Schippers answered that the co-payment is capped at 200 euro per year to address rising GGZ costs, that an exemption by diagnosis or income was judged impractical for 2012, and that alternative measures for 2013 will be explored.
I have chosen a co-payment of at most 200 euro per patient per calendar year.
Ik heb gekozen voor een eigen bijdrage van maximaal € 200 per patiënt per kalenderjaar.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending van Kassa over de schadelijke effecten van 3D (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

MP Voortman asked the health minister about health risks of watching 3D images after a Kassa broadcast, whether independent Dutch research is needed, whether Dutch experts should be tasked with it, and what role NICAM/Kijkwijzer could play in consumer information. The minister acknowledged the reported nausea and dizziness, opposed additional Dutch research, offered to raise the issue at EU level, and said producers and the self-regulating industry body bear primary responsibility for consumer information.
As indicated in the previous answer, I am not in favour of separate additional research in the Netherlands.
Ik ben, zoals in het vorige antwoord aangegeven, geen voorstander van eigenstandig aanvullend onderzoek in Nederland.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een frauderende psychiater een doorstart wil maken (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how a psychiatrist suspected of large-scale PGB fraud could keep practising, and what the IGZ, OM and others can do. The minister explained that the IGZ found no grounds for restricting the first psychiatrist after an inspection, while the second was ordered to stop practising after refusing supervision, and that the OM's powers under Wet BIG art. 96 did not apply.
The IGZ cannot anticipate a criminal conviction, since the principle of the rule of law is that a person is innocent until convicted.
De IGZ kan niet vooruitlopen op een strafrechtelijke veroordeling, immers het principe van de rechtsstaat is dat iemand onschuldig is tot het moment dat hij is veroordeeld.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de doorstart van het elektronisch patiëntendossier (EPD) (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a proposed relaunch of the national electronic patient record (LSP/EPD), including whether patient consent is required and how the estimated ten million euro annual cost would be financed through higher provider tariffs passed on to patients. The minister answers that the proposal was received and assessed, that providers are responsible for their own information systems funded from regular budgets, that consent is generally required under the WGBO unless exceptions apply, and that the Senate motion prevents government funding.
I am not aware of which precise agreements have been made between care providers and health insurers about the financing.
Het is mij niet bekend welke precieze afspraken er zijn gemaakt tussen zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars over de bekostiging.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het college bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) en patiëntendossiers (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a CBP opinion holding that exchange of patient data by a care providers' association requires explicit patient consent, and whether current local and national patient record exchanges are lawful. The minister answered that consent depends on the concrete setup, that existing WGBO and Wbp rules apply, that supervision lies with the CBP and IGZ, and that legal analysis and possible law changes are being pursued.
It is therefore for the College to halt violations of the Wbp by applying administrative enforcement or imposing an order subject to penalty.
Het is derhalve aan het College om een halt toe te roepen aan schendingen van de Wbp door de toepassing van bestuursdwang of het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het niet openbaar maken van meetlocaties van onderzoek naa

An SP MP asks the health and agriculture ministers why the measurement locations of the IRAS study on health risks of intensive livestock farming are not made public, whether this is legally impossible, and whether residents have a right to know about high endotoxin levels. The minister answers that postcodes of some locations are released, that the locations of farm-based measurement points remain confidential under agreements with owners and cannot be disclosed, that no legal means exist to compel disclosure, and that the follow-up study design is being prepared and will be sent to the Chamber after assignment.
These measurement locations of the IRAS study I cannot make public because I do not have them at my disposal.
Deze meetlocaties van het IRAS-onderzoek kan ik niet openbaar maken omdat ik daarover niet beschik.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) om topsalarissen te matigen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether Medisch Spectrum Twente's intention to align top executive pay with the sector pay code is meaningful, whether existing high contracts can be reopened, whether company cars and high salaries are justified, and whether she will intervene in other hospitals' governance. The minister replied that the code and pay norm apply to new contracts only, that existing contracts are hard to change, that company car decisions belong to institutions, and that intervening in hospital boards would not respect private responsibility, while noting the forthcoming pay norm law.

I have examined what role I can play in the appointment of boards and concluded that intervening in the governance of a care institution does not do justice to the private responsibility of the parties in care.

Ik ben nagegaan welke rol ik kan spelen bij de benoeming van besturen en ben tot de conclusie gekomen dat ingrijpen in het bestuur van een zorginstelling geen recht doet aan de private verantwoordelijkheid van de partijen in de zorg.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onderhandelingen over de ziekenhuiskosten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether insurers' letter to hospitals (ZN's campaign) undermines the 2.5% growth hoyer agreement, and how hospital care quality, waiting lists and hospital core tasks are safeguarded. Minister Schippers answered that the letter was not addressed to her, that it is not in conflict with the agreement, that hospitals must manage their finances, and that the agreement guarantees waiting-time norms and care access.
The letter from ZN is not addressed to me but to the Dutch Hospital Association, so it is primarily for those organisations to respond to it.
De brief van ZN is niet aan mij gericht maar aan de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van zelfdodingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

An SP member asks the health minister how she will respond to the rise in suicides for the third year running, including whether causes will be investigated, whether co-payments in mental health care should be scrapped, whether prevention should be funded, and whether the 2011 loosening of the suicide reporting procedure should be reversed. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because gathering the information takes more time.
The reason for the delay is that obtaining and processing the information needed for the answers takes more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat het verkrijgen en verwerken van de informatie ten behoeve van de beantwoording meer tijd vergt.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Landelijke Vereniging van Bloed- en Plasmadonoren (LVB), (aspirant)donoren zal adviseren om

SP MPs asked the health minister how she would respond to a report that the blood donor association LVB would advise donors to stop giving blood over Sanquin board salaries, and whether she would ask board members to cut their pay. The minister called the advice irresponsible, said she has no legal instruments to intervene in existing board contracts, and refused to ask board members to give up salary, while noting new appointees will be paid under the BBZ and WNT norms.
I have no (legal) instruments at my disposal to intervene in existing contracts.
Ik heb geen (juridische) instrumenten tot mijn beschikking om in reeds bestaande contracten in te grijpen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Algemene Zaken over de voorlichtingscampagne met betrekking tot seksuele veiligheid (

An MP asked ministers whether a government sexual-safety campaign broadcast by day complied with Kijkwijzer age norms and whether it could backfire on young children. The minister said the spots now air only after 20:00, that government campaigns will be classified by Kijkwijzer going forward, and that such mass campaigns will no longer be funded from 2012.
Recently we instructed that these spots be broadcast only after 20:00 hours.
Onlangs hebben we opdracht gegeven deze spotjes alleen nog na 20:00 uur uit te zenden.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het laten liggen van kostenbesparingen in de Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (GGZ) door het kabinet (ingezonden 22 augustus 201

An MP asks the health minister whether she knows that 10-15% cost savings in mental health care are available but unused, and presses for a vision on mental health and savings based on quality, plus questions on co-payments, inefficiencies, protocols and consultations with sector bodies. The minister acknowledges the savings, defends the cuts as necessary and her co-payment policy, says she has asked the NZa for advice, and promises updates on agreements in early next year and inclusion of protocol questions in the agenda with the sector.
I will include this question in the policy agenda I am going to draw up with the field parties.
Ik zal deze vraag betrekken bij de bestuurlijke agenda die ik ga opstellen met de veldpartijen.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de directeur van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis per direct zijn functie neerlegt en een vertrekbonus krijgt van 2,5 t

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether the Maasstad Hospital director who resigned with a 2.5 million euro severance should be prosecuted, and what action will be taken to reverse it. The minister refers to earlier answers, acknowledges the severance was too high, notes the government has no instrument to intervene in existing contracts, and points to a pending bill capping executive pay and severance at 75,000 euro for new contracts.
Neither I nor fellow cabinet members have an instrument to intervene in existing employment conditions.
Noch ik, noch collega-bewindslieden hebben een instrument om te kunnen ingrijpen in bestaande arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderschatte aantal Q-koortspatiënten (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about underestimated Q-fever infections, deaths, chronic cases, and whether government response and goat/sheep-farm rules should change. The minister answers that infections exceed notified cases as usual for infectious diseases, that vaccination is the main long-term measure, and that no compulsory liability insurance or public warnings are planned.
The number of infection cases is higher than the number of reported cases, but not higher than expected.
Het aantal besmettingsgevallen is hoger dan het aantal gemelde gevallen, maar niet hoger dan verwacht.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ESBL-producerende bacteriën (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the health minister about reports that ESBL-producing bacteria from intensive poultry farming reach hospitals via the food chain, and about possible measures such as certified-free food in hospitals, a ban on intensive poultry in hospitals, antibiotic reduction, a levy on farming, and a clearer separation of veterinary and human antibiotics. The minister's reply is only an announcement that the answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and will follow as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the interdepartmental consultation requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de interdepartementale afstemming meer tijd behoeft.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mens-op-mens besmettingen met MRSA (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the health minister about reports of human-to-human MRSA transmission linked to livestock, including CC398 cases in the Netherlands, and whether the government will act on the SSI's concern. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Thieme (PvdD) on human-to-human MRSA infections cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Thieme (PvdD) over mens-op-mens besmettingen met MRSA kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een ggz-instelling die overweegt het personeel om een loonoffer te vragen (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether she approves of mental health institution Mondriaan considering asking staff to give up 5 to 10% of their salary, and questions budget cuts, cao compliance and the rights of mental health patients. The minister replies that the idea was preliminary, was not pursued, that cuts stay within the coalition agreement, that cao terms are for employers and unions to negotiate, and that she will monitor effects of care avoidance and inform the House in October.
I promised the House during the GGz committee meeting of 30 June that I will monitor the effects of care avoidance caused by the introduction of the co-payment.
Ik heb de Kamer tijdens het AO GGz van 30 juni jl. toegezegd dat ik de effecten van zorgmijding door introductie van de eigen bijdrage ga monitoren.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over artsen die maanden moeten wachten op een oordeel over uitvoering van euthanasie (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the minister why physicians wait about three and a half months for the euthanasia review committees' verdicts and whether the committees have enough funding to rule on time. The minister confirms an average of 103 days in the first half of 2011, describes extra staffing and funding and pilot efficiency measures, and says the statutory six-week term (with one six-week extension) should be met by 2012 without lengthening it.
I consider it undesirable to extend this term.
Ik acht het onwenselijk om deze termijn te verlengen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een fout in de rekeningen van verzekeraars (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a calculation error by the NZa affecting the 2007 high-cost compensation for insurers, its effects on 2007 settlements and 2010-2012 budgets, and accountability between the NZa and CVZ. The minister confirmed the error, said its financial effects are not yet known and will take months to resolve, and committed to reviewing controls with the NZa, CVZ and insurers.
The error was made at the NZa.
De fout is gemaakt bij de NZa.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het overschatten van besparingen door meer marktwerking (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the planned 2015 savings from more market competition in health insurance are overstated, given that DNB's proposed higher solvency requirement (9% to 11%) will raise capital buffers and possibly premiums. The minister answers that the capital increase is about EUR 720 million, that premium effects are expected to be limited because insurers already exceed the requirement, and that the structural savings of EUR 330 million are based on CPB calculations.
These amounts are based on calculations such as those the CPB made in the note 'Analysis of economic effects financial framework'.
Deze bedragen zijn gebaseerd op berekeningen zoals het CPB heeft gemaakt in de notitie «Analyse economische effecten financieel kader».
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over foute compensatie bij de ex-post risicoverevening (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Deputy Van der Veen asks the health minister how an error in the 2007 high-cost compensation (HKC) within the ex-post risk equalisation went unnoticed for so long, what the financial effects are for insurers, and whether a correct recalculation can be presented before 2012 premiums are set. Minister Schippers explains that wrong 2007 settlement percentages for academic hospitals were caused by using 2006 data, that the error only affects 2007, and that insurers have been given provisional corrected percentages, with a full recalculation taking longer than four weeks.
Following the error mentioned, additional agreements have already been made on an audit of the data.
Naar aanleiding van de genoemde fout zijn er al aanvullende afspraken gemaakt over een audit op de gegevens.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zwangerschapsafbrekingen op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 19 augustus 20

An MP asked ministers whether the abortion law would apply on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba from 10 October 2011, what preparations had been made, how many doctors had permits, and whether doctors risked fines. The government's reply only announced that answers would be delayed due to interdepartmental coordination and promised to send them as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Van Gent (GL) about abortions on the BES islands cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gent (GL) over zwangerschapsafbrekingen op de BES-eilanden kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de overname van ziekenhuis ’t Lange Land (LZZ) (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

Two MPs (SP) asked the health minister about the planned takeover of 't Lange Land hospital in Zoetermeer, its effects on accessibility and emergency care, job losses, the risk of hospital bankruptcies, and the transfer of the Csz sanitation college to the NZa. The minister answered that hospital reorganisation is a matter for the hospital board, that accessibility norms are met, that the government will not rescue failing providers, and that the Csz tasks will move to the NZa.
I have no objection to a hospital seeking solutions to address its financial problems and realise a care offer more geared to the future.
Ik heb er niets op tegen dat een ziekenhuis op zoek gaat naar oplossingen om zo de financiële problemen het hoofd te bieden en een meer op de toekomst toegespitst zorgaanbod te realiseren.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de privacyschending van medische persoonsgegevens door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven asked the minister whether insurers should be able to view medical records without patient consent, whether records are sent by post and who may review them, and what the NZa and privacy regulator CBP have found about compliance. The minister defended the regulated framework (developed with CBP advice), said postal transfer has adequate safeguards, stated that consent is not required, and described detailed checks as a last-resort, proportionality-tested step under medical adviser responsibility.
Inspection of medical records can therefore only take place as a last resort, if its proportionality can be justified.
Inzage in medische dossiers kan dus uitsluitend plaatsvinden als uiterste middel, indien de proportionaliteit daarvan kan worden gemotiveerd.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het anoniem melden van misstanden door zorgpersoneel aan de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ing

MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister about the underreporting of patient-safety incidents by hospital staff and whether anonymous complaints should be investigated individually by the IGZ inspectorate. The minister acknowledged underreporting, pointed to existing hospital reporting systems and the whistleblower scheme, and said the IGZ investigates anonymous reports only when serious risk is suspected, otherwise using them to detect structural problems.
In all other cases, anonymous reports are primarily used to identify patterns pointing to structural shortcomings in healthcare.
In alle andere gevallen worden anonieme meldingen primair gebruikt om patronen te herkennen die wijzen op structurele tekortkomingen in de zorg.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding in het ziektekostenpakket van lapatinib bij de behandeling van patiënten met gemetastaseerde

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health why lapatinib is not reimbursed for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer after trastuzumab failure, and whether this reflects cost, inconsistency, or class medicine. The Minister answered that reimbursement was refused on lack of demonstrated therapeutic added value and lack of proven survival benefit, not price, and declined to link the decision to pricing or private insurance.
No, this description is not correct. The reimbursement application for lapatinib was not rejected because it would be too expensive.
Nee, deze weergave is niet correct. De betreffende vergoedingsaanvraag van lapatinib was niet afgewezen omdat het te duur zou zijn.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Zorgpersoneel op dievenpad» (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a report that care staff steal from elderly clients, including whether staff theft should lead to immediate dismissal, fines like shoplifters receive, and whether a certificate of good conduct is enough to keep such staff out of care. The minister said he had no figures on staff theft, that theft from clients is unacceptable, that employers can dismiss under existing law, and that the certificate of good conduct requirement is anchored in a pending bill.
The report is known to me.
Vragen van het lid Bruins Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een neuroloog in Twente (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the health minister why the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) refers so few cases to the disciplinary tribunal, why it does not seek suspension pending appeal after a first conviction (such as a Leerdam psychotherapist case), how it weighs interests, and what action will strengthen its disciplinary role. The minister replies that the answers will be delayed because they require careful alignment with the IGZ, and promises to send them as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Bruins Slot (CDA) about a neurologist in Twente cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Bruins Slot (CDA) over een neuroloog in Twente kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden De Liefde en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de subsidiëring van gescheiden zwemmen (ingezon

VVD MPs asked the ministers why the Amsterdam swim club De Waterlelie received subsidy for gender-segregated swimming under the KNZB's Swim2Gether project, and whether such integration-hindering activities would be ended. The government acknowledged that segregated swimming with state subsidy sends an unintegrative message, said the subsidies had already ended, and listed the other sports organisations that had received similar funding.
By offering segregated swimming with government support, a message is sent that it is accepted in the Netherlands that men and women should not come into contact with each other while swimming.

Door gescheiden zwemmen aan te bieden met overheidssteun wordt een boodschap afgegeven dat het in Nederland geaccepteerd is dat mannen en vrouwen tijdens het zwemmen niet met elkaar in contact horen te komen.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de korting op het huisartsenbudget na overschrijding bij de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MP Kuiken asks the minister how the €70 million overrun on integrated primary care in 2010 was calculated, whether the €35 million clawback via the GP tariffs is fair and delays integrated care, and why GP budgets are cut while hospital and specialist overruns are largely spared. The minister defends the calculation from CVZ data, argues GPs account for most of the integrated care spending, says the clawback is necessary given fiscal pressure, and promises to show integrated primary care as a separate budget line from the 2012 budget.
However, integrated primary care will from now on no longer be presented as part of the GP framework.
Wel zal voortaan de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg niet als onderdeel van het huisartsenkader worden weergegeven.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een hoogleraar patiëntveiligheid/anesthesioloog opstapt bij het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a patient-safety professor and anaesthesiologist was leaving Maasstad hospital, whether the board refused expert help during a multi-resistant bacteria outbreak, and whether the board should be removed. The minister said the departure is a personal choice, that the hospital uses RIVM and UMCU expert support under IGZ-linked supervision, that the IGZ will examine the hospital's response, and that dismissing a hospital board is a matter for the supervisory board and the Ondernemingskamer, not the government.

As I indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, the hospital has been placed under intensified supervision and further IGZ investigation will have to establish whether there was 'inadequate response' or 'irresponsible conduct'.

Antwoord 4 en 5 Zoals ik in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen (de datum 25 juli 2011, 2011Z11786 ) heb laten weten, is het ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en zal nader onderzoek van de IGZ moeten uitwijzen of en in hoeverre er sprake is geweest van «niet adequaat reageren» of «onverantwoord handelen».

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen en de lessen van de Klebsiëlla-infectie in het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about liability for patient harm, the director's pay and severance, the Raad van Toezicht's conduct, and the Inspectie's timing and actions in the Maasstad hospital Klebsiella outbreak. Minister Schippers answered that courts decide liability, that the director's income was overstated but his bonus was smaller than reported, that the Inspectie was informed late and then took escalating measures including verscherpt toezicht, and that a severance cap is in a pending bill.
The IGZ is investigating the substantive and administrative handling of this crisis and will publish an interim report in October.
De IGZ doet onderzoek naar de inhoudelijke en bestuurlijke aanpak van deze crisis en komt in oktober met een tussentijds rapport.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de besmetting in het Maasstad ziekenhuis mogelijk al dateert uit 2008 en dat groot alarm al veel eerder nodig

An MP asks the health minister whether a hospital infection outbreak at Maasstad hospital may date back to 2008, whether the board should resign, why the Inspectorate was unaware, and whether other hospitals should isolate former patients. The minister answers that the original source cannot be determined, the board director has resigned, the hospital is under heightened inspection, reporting duties rest on the hospital board, and the research team recommended isolation only for suspected cases.
The IGZ investigation must establish whether something fundamentally went wrong at the Maasstad hospital.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ moet uitwijzen of er iets fundamenteel is mis gegaan in het Maasstad ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de riante ontslagvergoeding voor de directeur van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views the €235,898 severance payment to the Maasstad Hospital director after his resignation, whether such pay after clear mismanagement is improper, and whether she will use her influence to reverse it. The minister said the 2004 contract's one-year severance was not unusual then, that the Raad van Toezicht weighs the full career, that government has no instrument to intervene in existing contracts, and pointed to a pending bill capping executive pay and severance at €75,000 for new contracts.
Neither I nor fellow ministers have an instrument to intervene in existing employment conditions.
Noch ik, noch collega-bewindslieden hebben een instrument om te kunnen ingrijpen in bestaande arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding van de mammaprint vanuit de zorgverzekering (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the CVZ's finding that MammaPrint does not meet the standard of science and practice should be revisited, why some insurers reimburse it, and whether it should be added to the basic package. The minister replied that MammaPrint lacks proven clinical utility, insurers may reimburse it from supplementary funds, and she opposes temporarily adding it to the basic insurance package.
I adopt the CVZ's judgment and agree with them that, given the information currently available, MammaPrint does not belong in the insured package.
Ik neem het oordeel van CVZ over en ben met hen van mening dat de Mammaprint gelet op de thans beschikbare informatie nu niet in het verzekerde pakket thuishoort.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het aantreden van de heer W. als interim-directeur bij het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether appointing a former supervisory board member with a controversial past as interim hospital director is acceptable, given the Klebsiella scandal and gold handshakes, and whether the Inspectorate should intervene or a medical intervention team should be created. The minister replies that the appointment is the supervisory board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate is already doing enhanced supervision, that salary details are not known to her and will appear in the 2011 annual report, and that external removal of boards is not appropriate given private responsibility.
Having a failing board set aside, at my request, by an external intervention team does not do justice to the private responsibility of the parties in healthcare.
Falend bestuur opzij zetten, op verzoek van mij, door een extern interventieteam doet geen recht aan de private verantwoordelijkheid van de partijen in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nieuwe interim-bestuurder van het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011)

An MP asked the minister whether the appointment of an interim hospital director at Maasstad ziekenhuis was a mistake that should be reversed, how trust can be restored, and whether she would place the board under supervision. The minister replied that the appointment is for the supervisory board and works councils, that the IGZ is already conducting intensified supervision, and that she sees no need for an additional instrument such as administrative supervision of the board.
I therefore do not see the need for administrative supervision as an additional instrument.
Ik zie dan ook niet de noodzaak voor bestuurlijke ondertoezichtstelling als extra instrument.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over landelijke regels voor de aanpak van uitbraken van antibioticaresistente bacteriën (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether national rules and a reporting duty should be imposed on hospitals where antibiotic-resistant bacteria are found, and whether such outbreaks warrant a stronger prevention and enforcement policy. The minister acknowledged the concern, said she is considering an extra support structure coordinated by the RIVM and will inform parliament soon, but stated a statutory reporting duty is not an aim in itself and pointed to existing professional guidelines enforced by the Inspectorate.
I will inform you about this as soon as possible.
Ik zal u hier zo spoedig mogelijk over informeren.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het budget voor de uitvoering van de Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten (Wtcg) wordt gehalve

An MP asked the health minister whether the budget for the Wtcg compensation scheme for chronically ill and disabled people would be halved, what the purchasing-power effects would be, and whether the scheme would be kept after tax deduction limits were cut. The minister declined to answer the budget questions before Prinsjesdag and only acknowledged the background.
The Cabinet wants to keep to the agreement to announce the budget measures on Prinsjesdag.
Het Kabinet wil zich houden aan de afspraak om met Prinsjesdag de begrotingsmaatregelen bekend te maken.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van schijncontracten aan jonge

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and social affairs ministers about football clubs registering young players under fake job titles such as crane operator to bind them cheaply, asking whether this is unacceptable and what can be done. The minister only announced that answers would be delayed due to interdepartmental coordination and promised to send them as soon as possible.

The questions from MPs Van Dekken and Spekman (both PvdA) on offering fake contracts to young football talents by major football clubs (submitted 18 August 2011) cannot, regrettably, be answered within the usual time limit.

De vragen van de Kamerleden Van Dekken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) over het aanbieden van schijncontracten aan jonge voetbaltalenten door grote voetbalclubs (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat topsalarissen in de zorg gewoon worden doorbetaald. (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the health minister how she responds to reports that the executive pay code for healthcare directors (BBZ) is failing, given that most top salaries exceed the norm, and whether she will enforce it and include it in the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister replied that the code applies only to new contracts and disputed the reported non-compliance, promised to analyse the 2010 figures and speak with the sector bodies, and noted that the pay-cap law would make the code binding.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de beloning van de Raad van Bestuur van bloedbank Sanquin vorig jaar opnieuw fors is toegenome

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the rise in Sanquin board pay, with individual salaries up to 258,000 euros above the Balkenende norm, what she will do about it, whether it could harm donor willingness, and how she will ensure compliance with the BBZ care pay code. The minister explained the increase by a 2010 board change and indexation, said the two sitting board members' contracts still exceed the BBZ norms, pointed to a pending normeringswet covering Sanquin, and rejected a donor boycott as irresponsible.
The salary of the two sitting Sanquin board members is still under their earlier contracts, and that exceeds the BBZ norms, so in that respect it is too high.
Het salaris van de twee zittende bestuurders van Sanquin is nog steeds volgens hun eerder gesloten contract. En dat ligt boven de normen van de BBZ en in dat opzicht is het te hoog.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het lage rendement van de opleiding tot profvoetballer (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and sport minister about the low success rate of youth football academies, the age at which children are recruited, effects on schooling, addiction among former players, and whether clubs and the KNVB bear responsibility for supporting dropouts. The minister answered that the KNVB's quality mark and protocols provide aftercare, that academies start at age 11, that no data exist on schooling or addiction outcomes, and that clubs and the KNVB already recognise their responsibility, so no specific agreements are needed.
Against this background I see no reason to make specific agreements with the KNVB in this area.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond dan ook geen aanleiding om op dit terrein specifieke afspraken te gaan maken met de KNVB.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stranden van de ketenzorg (ingezonden augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how to respond to reports that contracting of chronic care (ketenzorg) by care groups is stalling with insurers, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledges problems with COPD and VRM contracting, says she regards integrated care as important, will decide on ending the transitional dual-funding period after a 2012 evaluation, and notes no current cost data are available.
Based in part on that evaluation, I will decide whether or not to end the transitional situation.
Mede op basis van die evaluatie zal ik een besluit nemen over het al dan niet eindigen van de overgangssituatie.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het aanstellen van een interim-bestuurder in het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether a supervisory board member of Maasstad hospital becoming interim director, and the resulting governance and trust concerns, were acceptable under the sector governance code. The minister answered that the board and councils are responsible, the code is self-regulating and not enforceable by government, and the hospital must explain any deviation, while the IGZ already supervises the hospital.
It is not for me to intervene in individual hospitals in a possible governance crisis.
Het is niet aan mij om bij individuele ziekenhuizen in te grijpen bij een mogelijke bestuurscrisis.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de besmetting in het Maasstad ziekenhuis mogelijk al dateert uit 2008 en dat groot alarm al veel eerder nodig

An MP asked the health minister whether a hospital infection at Maasstad hospital may date back to 2008, whether the board should resign, why the health inspectorate was unaware of infections since 2008, and whether it supports advice to isolate patients.
