The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that the answers will be delayed because obtaining the right data and consulting parties takes more time.

The questions from MP Gerbrands (PVV) about the report that the Maasstad hospital infection may date back to 2008 and that a major alarm was needed much earlier cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Gerbrands (PVV) over het bericht dat de besmetting in het Maasstad ziekenhuis mogelijk al dateert uit 2008 en dat groot alarm al veel eerder nodig was geweest kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat normaal gedrag in het nieuwe psychologenhandboek als ziek wordt benoemd (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the revised DSM lowers diagnostic thresholds and may medicalise normal behaviour, whether this will increase reimbursable treatments, whether CIZ should keep using ICF, whether DSM influence can be reduced, and whether diagnosing bodies that also prescribe treatment create a conflict of interest. The minister replies only that the answers will be delayed because background information must be gathered from mental health professional associations.
The questions from MP Wolbert (PvdA) about the report that normal behaviour is labelled as illness in the new psychology handbook cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Wolbert (PVDA) over het bericht dat normaal gedrag in het nieuwe psychologenhandboek als ziek wordt benoemd kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over euthanasie (ingezonden 4 juli 2011).

MP Klijnsma asked the health minister about variation among doctors in handling euthanasia requests, including dementia cases, the refusal of a request by patient B., an estimated 40% of serious requests allegedly not taken seriously, and whether a legal referral duty should be introduced. The minister answered that doctors' knowledge of the Euthanasia Act is insufficient, that the KNMG is working on improvements and dialogue with the NVVE is planned, that no complaints desk will be set up, and that non-granted requests and referrals will be included in the ongoing evaluation of the Act, while arguing a statutory referral duty is not the real solution.
I do not intend to set up a complaints desk, but I will consult with the KNMG and the NVVE to discuss this issue.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een meldpunt in te stellen, wel zal ik in overleg gaan met de KNMG en de NVVE om deze problematiek te bespreken.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handel in jonge spelers (ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether clubs sign contracts with footballers under 16, whether this is lawful and protects young players, and whether the government will press for stricter rules on child trade in football. The minister replied that such contracts are legally permissible with parental co-signature, that the KNVB has tightened supervision, and that the government sees the problem as one for the parties involved rather than for national government.
Responsibility for this does not lie with the national government.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt niet bij de rijksoverheid.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis zwangere vrouwen commerciële pretecho’s aanbiedt (ingezonden 8 augustus 2011).

MP Kooiman asked the health minister whether a hospital offering commercial non-medical 'pretecho' scans to pregnant women is acceptable, how much revenue it earns, whether patients are steered toward them, and whether such commercial activity erodes hospital authority. The minister found no objection provided no public money funds the service and the distinction from medical scans is clear, reported about EUR 15,000 a year going to general funds, denied active recruitment, and saw no reason to act.
I therefore see no reason whatsoever to take action against this.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele aanleiding hiertegen op te treden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het functioneren van maatschappen in ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether hospital boards lack tools to steer medical partnerships (maatschappen), whether poor cooperation harms safety and finances, whether a specific orthopaedic case shows weak grip on specialists, and whether employing specialists would strengthen quality control. The minister replied that hospital boards bear final responsibility and have adequate tools (quality system, contractual rights, the coming Wcz), that IGZ supervises risks, and that employment status is not linked to quality, so she sees no reason to mandate employment.
A good board member can therefore be expected to know what is happening within the organisation so that timely intervention and appropriate measures are possible.
Van een goed bestuurder mag dan ook verwacht worden dat deze weet wat er binnen de organisatie gebeurt zodat er tijdig kan worden ingegrepen en passende maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de opnamestops in Nederlandse ziekenhui

An MP asks the health and agriculture ministers about hospital admission stops caused by livestock-associated MRSA in Twente, Weert and Arnhem, including whether protocols exist for patients working in livestock farming and whether hospitals should be required to employ more hygienists. The document is only a holding notice saying the answers will be delayed and sent as soon as possible.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Unieke Zorgverlener Identificatie (UZI)-pas voor het grijpen ligt (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a report that UZI professional cards were easily accessible and whether their use remains safe, and what sanctions apply for non-compliance. The minister answered that the card meets strict security standards, that pharmacies and users are responsible for proper use, and that the Inspectorate can enforce compliance through orders, penalties and disciplinary action.
This study gives no reason to doubt the security of the card itself.
Dit onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om aan de veiligheid van de pas zelf te twijfelen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de enquête van het RIVM over prenatale screening op Downsyndroom en de 20-weken echo (ingezonden

An MP asks the minister why a RIVM survey on prenatal Down syndrome screening and the 20-week scan asks respondents about religion, and why midwives must put such questions when their profession does not. The minister replies that the survey measures whether pregnant women make an informed choice, that religion is one element of their values, that answers are anonymous and questions may be skipped, and that the survey was drawn up with the professional groups.
For the record, the results are processed anonymously and the survey clearly offers the option of not answering certain questions.
Voor de goede orde vermeld ik dat de resultaten anoniem worden verwerkt en in de enquête duidelijk de mogelijkheid wordt geboden om bepaalde vragen niet te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over prestatielijsten van een zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister whether insurer Zilveren Kruis/Achmea published cardiology quality lists without verifying facts with hospitals, and how this will be prevented. Minister Schippers answers that the lists are based on NVVC-verified norms, distinguishes hospitals meeting criteria from those not yet verified, and sees no problem with differing insurer criteria if transparent.
As far as my information goes, Zilveren Kruis therefore bases its judgment on verified facts.
Voor zover mijn informatie reikt baseert Zilveren Kruis haar oordeel dus op gecontroleerde feiten.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over euthanasie (ingezonden 4 juli 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about wide variation among doctors in assessing and granting euthanasia requests, including low willingness to assist in early dementia, a patient's death after a hospital refused euthanasia, and whether a legal referral duty for objecting doctors is warranted. The minister's reply only announces a delay in answering because of coordination with researchers and the KNMG.
The questions from MP Klijnsma (PvdA) on euthanasia cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Klijnsma (PvdA) over euthanasie ( 2011Z15066 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verstrengeling van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) met private partijen (ingezonden 12 juli 201

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's creation of Zeeland Care, its funding via plastic surgery revenue, and outsourcing of dialysis to a partly privately financed entity are desirable, legal, and risk wasting insured care funds on private profit. The minister said the hospital may choose its legal form and financing within existing rules, that private financing is not prohibited, and that insurers must watch for unnecessary care.
I am not aware of the extent to which the various shareholders participate in Zeeland Care.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de mate waarin de verschillende aandeelhouders participeren in Zeeland Care.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fabrikanten die sigaretten steeds verslavender maken (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that cigarette manufacturers make cigarettes more addictive through thousands of additives, and whether additives should be banned, labelled, independently studied, or costs recovered from industry. The minister rejected each demand, saying there is no specific evidence of increased addictive ingredients, the RIVM already monitors ingredients, and the Health Insurance Act rests on solidarity.
I see no reason for additional independent research into the use of additives and their consequences for smokers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot een aanvullend onafhankelijk onderzoek naar het gebruik van additieven en de gevolgen daarvan voor rokers.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toevoegingen aan sigaretten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether tobacco firms are adding substances to make cigarettes more addictive, and why the Netherlands, unlike France and the US, has no ban on such additives. The minister said there is no reason to think additive use has increased, pointed to RIVM information and an ingredient-reporting scheme, and declined to regulate additives because it does not fit her tobacco policy and evidence is insufficient.
I do not intend to further regulate the composition of tobacco products, because this does not fit the tobacco discouragement policy I have in mind.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de samenstelling van tabaksproducten verder te reguleren, omdat dit niet past in het tabaksontmoedigingsbeleid dat ik voor ogen heb.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat patiënten verkeerd worden voorgelicht door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether insurer Achmea acted carelessly by misinforming patients about prostate surgery, whether other insurers' referrals should be checked, and what measures will bring quality indicators for prostate operations. The minister said insurers give advice rather than referrals, Achmea found only two misleading messages out of 54 and changed its procedure, no review of other insurers is planned, and quality indicators will be mandatory in 2012.
Based partly on the answer to question 3, I see no reason to have the accuracy of information provided by health insurers investigated.
Mede op basis van het antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik geen reden om de juistheid van de informatieverstrekking door zorgverzekeraars te (laten) onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hoge perinatale sterfte in Den Haag (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MP Arib asks the health minister about high perinatal mortality among Creole women and in deprived Hague neighbourhoods, and why a two-year pilot is needed before targeted policy. Minister Schippers responds that a 62-municipality analysis produced twelve pilot sites run by ErasmusMC, that she rejects ethnicity-specific measures, and that early midwife visits are the mother's own responsibility.
I find it a worrying fact that infant mortality is so high especially among the lower educated.
Ik vind het een verontrustend gegeven dat de babysterfte vooral bij laagopgeleiden zo hoog is.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vorming van één ambulancedienst in Amsterdam (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about conflicts and stalled negotiations over merging Amsterdam's ambulance services, including the absence of a social plan with unions and whether the minister would step in by creating a regional ambulance facility. The minister replied that negotiations are the responsibility of the parties involved, that the municipal council has reopened talks, and that she sees no reason to intervene at this stage.
As said, I have no role in the negotiations and therefore can give you no more information than what is already public.
Als gezegd heb ik geen rol in de onderhandelingen en ik kan u hierover derhalve niet meer informatie geven dan wat reeds openbaar is.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er een explosieve groei is van te bouwen verloskamers in ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the health minister about reports of a surge in new delivery rooms, closures of maternity wards such as in Oss and Amsterdam-Noord, travel times and referrals during childbirth, and pain relief options. The minister says there is no evidence of a building surge, insists on the 45-minute ambulance access norm, reports no concrete closure plans for Amsterdam-Noord and that referrals in Utrecht are rare, and promises further data and advice on pain relief.
I have no insight into the number of delivery rooms currently being added.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal verloskamers dat op dit moment wordt bijgebouwd.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Nederlands Kinderoncologisch Centrum (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a dispute between the Dutch paediatric oncology physicians' initiative (NKOC) and the university medical centres (NFU) over concentrating childhood cancer care in one centre, including the NFU's revised advisory report, UMCG letters to parents, and whether boards of directors blocked physicians. The minister says the parties are negotiating, declines to judge the NFU's internal process, and sees no reason to intervene now, while noting intervention could follow if patient safety or parents are endangered.
I currently have no reason to intervene.
Ik heb thans geen reden tot ingrijpen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderzoek van de IGZ naar de verloskundige zorg tijdens avond-nacht en weekenduren (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the IGZ inspectorate's investigation into obstetric care during evenings, nights and weekends, including whether the report will be sent to parliament and whether an overview of complaints on obstetric care can be provided. The minister says the report is finished and will be sent to parliament in mid-September 2011, but a full overview of complaints cannot be provided due to privacy and because the registration system serves inspection purposes, offering aggregated findings instead.
Sending the Chamber an overview of all reports the IGZ has received about obstetric care is not possible.
Het aan de Kamer zenden van een overzicht van alle meldingen die de IGZ heeft ontvangen over verloskundige zorg is niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden De Liefde en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de subsidiëring van gescheiden zwemmen (ingezon

Two VVD MPs ask the Health and Interior ministers whether subsidies to swimming club De Waterlelie for gender-segregated swimming (via the KNZB Swim2Gether project) are acceptable, whether such subsidies conflict with the coalition agreement, and whether other organisations receive similar funding. The government response is only a postponement notice: the answers will be delayed because interdepartmental consultation and talks with sports federations take time.
The questions from MPs De Liefde and Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) on subsidising gender-segregated swimming (submitted 22 July 2011) cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van de Leden De Liefde en Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) over de subsidiëring van gescheiden zwemmen (ingezonden 22 juli 2011) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het succes van de pilot masterplan orgaandonatie Regio Noord-Nederland (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the results of the North Netherlands organ donation pilot, including the number of donation procedures in early 2011 and the rise in family consent rates, and whether the pilot should be rolled out nationally. The minister views the early signals as hopeful but will draw conclusions only after the evaluation, expected late 2011, and promises a plan of action by letter this summer.
I consider these hopeful signals, but I will only draw conclusions about the effect of this pilot once the evaluation has been completed.
Ik vind dat hoopgevende signalen, maar conclusies over het effect van deze pilot trek ik pas als de evaluatie daarvan is afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Maasstad ziekenhuis heeft gefaald bij de aanpak van een gevaarlijke bacterie (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Maasstad hospital failed to tackle a dangerous antibiotic-resistant bacterium, infecting 34 patients, and whether the board acted irresponsibly. The minister says about 70 patients carry the bacterium, the inspectorate is investigating the outbreak and timeline, and the hospital has been placed under heightened supervision with a coordinating microbiologist, with further steps to follow after the inspection's findings.
To this end, the IGZ placed Maasstad Hospital under heightened supervision on 20 July 2011 and imposed additional requirements on the hospital.
Daartoe heeft de IGZ d.d. 20 juli 2011 het Maasstad Ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en extra eisen aan het ziekenhuis gesteld
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een resistente bacterie in het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae outbreak at Maasstad Hospital, including patient numbers, timing of reporting to the GGD, earlier ESBL outbreaks, and public risk. The minister answers that the outbreak is a local matter, RIVM findings are expected in September, the Inspectorate has placed the hospital under intensified supervision, and the public faces little risk.
As soon as I have this information, I will send it to the House.
Zodra ik hierover beschik zal ik deze naar de Kamer zenden.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Maasstad Ziekenhuis zich niet aan de infectierichtlijnen heeft gehouden (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that Maasstad Hospital breached infection guidelines, whether this would be investigated, what consequences the hospital board would face, how compliance is monitored, and whether 21 infected patients died from the Klebsiella bacterium. The minister answered that the Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating, has placed the hospital under heightened supervision and required a hygiene coordinator, may consider an admissions stop if the situation worsens, and that the cause of death of the patients is still under investigation by an external commission.
On 20 July 2011 the IGZ placed Maasstad Hospital under heightened supervision.
Op 20 juli 2011 heeft de IGZ het Maasstad Ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over concentratie van verloskundige zorg (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

The MP asks whether maternity care in Amsterdam is being concentrated and whether the Boven IJ hospital maternity ward will close, and how the inspectorate will test concentration plans against new norms. The minister answers that the hospital has no concrete plans to close the ward, that hospitals must submit plans of action to the IGZ within three months, that a norms implementation plan is due in January 2012, and that the minister can impose obligations on hospitals to keep acute care open if access norms are at risk.
Based on the WTZi (art. 3.1), I can attach to the institution's existing licence the requirement that it provide the necessary care.
Ik kan op basis van de WTZi (art 3.1) aan de bestaande toelating van de instelling het voorschrift verbinden dat die instelling de noodzakelijke zorg aanbiedt.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over eetstoornissen (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MP Uitslag (CDA) asks the health minister about eating disorders: awareness of an action plan for care chains, involving parents in treatment, an extra school doctor contact moment, and better coordination across the care chain. The minister agrees parents suffer and should be involved, describes the JGZ flexibility plan and a new JGZ guideline, and says coordination can improve but is primarily the field's responsibility.
The field itself is responsible for implementing this guideline and therefore for further improving this cooperation.
Het veld is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van deze richtlijn en dus voor het verder verbeteren van deze samenwerking.

Vragen van de leden Arib (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over nazorg van misbruik in de Rooms-katholiek

MPs Arib, Gesthuizen and Dibi asked the health and justice ministers whether aftercare for victims of sexual abuse in the Catholic Church is sufficient and whether the state should support victim gatherings and urgently provide aftercare before the Samson and Deetman inquiries report. The minister answered that existing arrangements with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and regular mental health care are adequate, that no extra measures are needed now, and that the state has no role in organising victim meetings.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to provide extra assistance and prefer to first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om in extra hulpverlening te voorzien en geef er de voorkeur aan nu eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af te wachten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nachtsluiting van de spoedeisende hulp in Zevenaar (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the planned night-time closure of the emergency department at Rijnstate hospital in Zevenaar, its effect on 45-minute access, and whether the government would intervene. The minister said access norms remain met, pointed to the inspectorate's enforcement powers, and refused to intervene to keep the department open at night.
I am not willing to intervene and ensure that the emergency department remains open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Ik ben niet bereid in te grijpen en te bewerkstelligen dat de SEH 7 x 24 uur per dag openblijft.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er vorig jaar door ziekenhuizen voor 4 miljoen aan exitpremies is uitgegeven (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports that hospitals spent 4 million euros on severance payments for executives, asking whether this is acceptable during cuts, whether hospitals are complying with the executive pay code, and about transparency. The minister replied that the code is largely complied with, that the pay norm act applies only to new contracts, that non-compliant hospitals will be asked for explanation, and that existing transparency rules work well.
If that explanation is insufficient, I will ask the relevant Supervisory Board to take action.
Wanneer die uitleg onvoldoende is, zal ik de desbetreffende Raad van Toezicht vragen om actie te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «De gouden handdruk regeert» (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Voortman asked the health minister about reports that hospitals still pay large severance payments to departing executives despite cuts, including payments above the one-year salary norm of the 2009 code, and whether the Wet Normering Topinkomens could apply to existing contracts. The minister replied by referring to her answers to near-identical questions from MP Gerbrands, without restating substance here.
For convenience, I refer to my answers to that set of questions.
Eenvoudigheidshalve verwijs ik naar mijn antwoorden op die set vragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het intrekken van een kritisch rapport door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ingezonden 8 juli 2

SP MPs asked the minister about the Inspectorate for Health Care's withdrawal of a critical report on a UMCG paediatric anaesthesia case, the lengthy investigation, the parents' lack of apology, and whether pressure was applied or a disciplinary case should follow. The minister answered that the withdrawal was for procedural reasons, that the Inspectorate-General has commissioned an independent review and the Ombudsman is also examining the matter, and that the inspectorate admits the investigation took too long.
The IGZ withdrew the report out of caution, because the conclusions in the first report were insufficiently supported by the facts.
De IGZ heeft uit zorgvuldigheidsoverwegingen het rapport ingetrokken, omdat de conclusies in het eerste rapport onvoldoende door de feiten werden gedragen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Nederlands Kinderoncologisch Centrum (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister eleven questions about a dispute between university medical centres (via the NFU) and the initiators of a national paediatric oncology centre over concentrating childhood cancer care, including the NFU's revision of an internal report and the refusal of boards to let paediatric oncologists cooperate. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be sent later because further information must first be obtained.
For a careful answer to the questions, it is necessary to request further information.
Voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen is het opvragen van nadere informatie noodzakelijk.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de prestatielijst van ziekenhuizen bij de behandeling van blaaskanker door zorgverzekeraar CZ (ingezonden 7

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether insurer CZ's published ranking of hospitals for bladder cancer surgery, which excludes some hospitals from contracts, is a marketing tool, and whether it is reliable and consistent with the IGZ's role. The Minister replied that insurers may set quality and volume criteria when contracting care, that volume (at least 10 operations per year) matters for quality, that the IGZ cannot judge hospital-level outcomes for this rare procedure, and that she sees no reason to stop insurers publishing such lists.
Care providers are primarily themselves responsible for determining what responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat verantwoorde zorg is.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de «sloopchirurg» gewoon zijn gang kan gaan (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why the Inspectorate for Health Care has not referred about 300 complaints against a surgeon to the disciplinary tribunal and why he remains on the register, and what action will prevent him ever operating again. The minister answers that the surgeon has not worked since April 2010 under an agreement with the Inspectorate, that investigations by the hospital and the Inspectorate are ongoing, and that disciplinary or criminal referral will follow if disfunctioning is confirmed.
If during or after completion of these investigations it becomes established that the orthopaedic surgeon has been underperforming, the IGZ will take appropriate measures.
Als tijdens of na afronding van deze onderzoeken het voor de IGZ vast komt te staan dat er sprake is van disfunctioneren van de betrokken orthopeed, dan zal de IGZ passende maatregelen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de plannen van zorgverzekeraar De Friesland (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about insurer De Friesland's reported plans to reorganise hospital care in Friesland, including closing some maternity and emergency units, and whether competition there remains adequate. The minister declined to judge the unconfirmed plans, stressed the insurer's duty of care and emergency-access norms, and pointed to the competition authority NMa's finding that competition in Friesland remains sufficient.
However, I cannot give a judgement on the concrete plans or intentions of health insurer De Friesland based on the interview.
Ik kan op basis van het interview echter geen oordeel geven over de concrete plannen of voornemens van zorgverzekeraar De Friesland.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over positief leefstijlbeleid (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MP Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister whether citizens should still be encouraged via civil society organisations to make healthy choices, given the end of STIVORO's subsidy and a 65% cut to smoking prevention, and how this fits the WHO FCTC. Minister Schippers answered that the subsidy ends in 2013 to bundle tobacco prevention with other addiction expertise, that core tobacco measures remain, and that policy choices stay national.
The Cabinet attaches importance to decisions ultimately being taken at national political level in consultation with parliament.
Het Kabinet hecht eraan dat op nationaal politiek niveau uiteindelijk in overleg met het parlement besluiten worden genomen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onrechtmatig gebruik van de wanbetalerregeling en absolute minima met een betalingsachterstand (ingezon

MPs Van der Veen and Spekman asked whether health insurer Zorg en Zekerheid wrongly reports policyholders as defaulters to the CVZ, whether incassokosten and the 130% bestuursrechtelijke premie push people below the social minimum, and related questions on appeals, the beslagvrije voet and refunds. Minister Schippers denied wrongful reporting, explained the statutory collection and protection framework, and said the CVZ is working to speed refunds and embed insurer verification in its process.
The problem is addressed because in appropriate cases a refund can be carried out manually when a citizen requests it.
Het pijnpunt wordt weggenomen omdat in voorkomende gevallen een terugbetaling «handmatig» kan worden uitgevoerd wanneer een burger daarom verzoekt.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over radioactief besmette containers (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the government about radioactively contaminated containers from Japan after Fukushima, whether the number found is too high, whether the disaster is worse than stated, and whether sea-based container checks should be extended. The state secretary answers that 15 of 38 containers exceeded limits and were cleaned, that the sea checks were stopped because no contamination was measured there, and that port checks and EU food sampling continue.
The decision to stop these measurements was reached in good consultation between the government bodies involved and the business sector.
Het besluit om deze metingen te stoppen, is in goed overleg tussen de betrokken overheidsinstanties en het bedrijfsleven tot stand gekomen.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorg voor kankerpatiënten (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether Dutch cancer patients are denied experimental treatments such as Nexavar for GIST that are available in the US, and whether patients are given up too early. The minister answered that the treatment is not yet proven, that research is the manufacturer's and doctors' task, that Dutch cancer care is of high quality, and that the Inspectorate could look into possible undertreatment.
It seems right to me that those involved consult with the Health Care Inspectorate, so that the IGZ can assess whether patients are actually undertreated.
Het lijkt mij goed dat betrokkenen met de Inspectie van de Gezondheidszorg in overleg gaan, zodat de IGZ kan beoordelen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van onderbehandeling van patiënten.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over doorverwijzing bij darmkanker en darmkankerscreening (ingezonden 8 april 2011)

MP Voortman asks the health minister about the NFK report that patients with colorectal liver metastases are under-referred for surgery, the need for research and a bowel cancer screening programme, and a public toilet priority card for bowel patients. The minister says more research is needed, expects a screening programme to start in 2013 after a feasibility assessment, and leaves the toilet card initiative to patient organisations.
I share the view that bowel cancer screening can prevent a great deal of suffering.
Ik deel de mening dat screening op darmkanker veel leed kan voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Mulder (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «De dokter bewijst meestal niet waarom» (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

MP Mulder asked the health minister about a newspaper article proposing that doubtful medical treatments be systematically studied and that such research be funded by savings from those treatments. The minister supports effectiveness research, points to existing ZonMw programmes, and commits to inventorying treatments doubted by the profession and having them studied with funds freed by stopping them.

After this inventory I will have these treatments examined for their effectiveness, with the research funded by the money freed up by not carrying out the treatments about which there are strong doubts regarding effectiveness.

Na deze inventarisatie zal ik deze behandelingen laten onderzoeken op hun effectiviteit waarbij het onderzoek wordt bekostigd met het geld dat vrijkomt door de behandeling, waarover sterke twijfels zijn over de effectiviteit, niet uit te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het opvragen van gegevens over derden bij GGZ Friesland (ingezonden 14 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a GGZ Friesland webpage that suggested relatives could phone a hotline to find out whether a person was in mental health treatment, and whether such practice is lawful. The minister answered that the passage was an error, has been removed, that disclosure without consent breaches medical confidentiality and the civil code, and that the Inspectorate can act within its supervisory remit.

Making statements by a treating professional about whether persons are in treatment is incompatible with medical confidentiality and the provisions on the medical treatment agreement in the Civil Code.

Het doen van mededelingen door een behandelaar over het in behandeling hebben van personen verdraagt zich niet met het medisch beroepsgeheim en de bepalingen inzake de geneeskundige behandelingsovereenkomst uit het Burgerlijk Wetboek.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de vertrokken top van het Medisch Centrum Alkmaar (MCA) vorig jaar ruim een miljoen euro incasseerde (ingezond

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the departed top management of Medisch Centrum Alkmaar received over one million euros, and whether this is acceptable and within the norms of the planned executive pay law. The minister says the Wet normering topinkomens will apply only to new contracts, notes the hospital's positive 2010 result, and says she currently lacks instruments to intervene in care-sector salaries, urging Parliament to pass the bill quickly.
I therefore called on the House in that question hour to ensure that the current bill on top incomes can take effect on 1 January 2012.
Ik heb de Kamer daarom in dat vragenuurtje opgeroepen om ervoor te zorgen dat het huidige wetsvoorstel over de topinkomens per 1 januari 2012 in werking kan treden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verkoop van een ziekenhuisafdeling aan een private investeringsmaatschappij (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether Orbis Medical Centre plans to sell its eye department to a private investment firm, and whether profit-oriented ownership and private clinics in hospitals are desirable, given quality and access concerns raised by experts. The minister says no sale is planned, only a possible 50-50 joint venture under discussion, announces a bill to allow regulated profit distribution with conditions, and says the Health Care Inspectorate will check quality.
I consider it desirable that over time and under the right conditions more private capital providers will invest in medical specialist care.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat op termijn en onder de juiste voorwaarden meer privaatkapitaalverschaffers zullen investeren in de medisch specialistische zorg.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de invloed van leefstijlinterventies op het terugdringen van babysterfte (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about high referral rates of Antillean women to gynaecologists, low awareness of pregnancy risks and folic acid, and the slow rollout of the Rotterdam perinatal mortality plan. The minister answered that awareness work is being pursued through pilots, research and the College Perinatale Zorg, without a national folic acid campaign.
I indeed consider the Perinatal Mortality Action Plan (Ready for a Child) a good example of a solid approach to reducing infant mortality.
Ik vind het Aanvalsplan Perinatale Sterfte ( Klaar voor een Kind ) inderdaad een goed voorbeeld van een gedegen aanpak om de babysterfte terug te dringen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aangekondigde opnamestop door de GGZ (ingezonden 20 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister for her reaction to a mental health sector announcement of an admissions stop and whether she would oppose it. The minister said the growth in mental health care must be curbed, patients should not suffer, providers must ensure emergency care, and she asked the Inspectorate (IGZ) to stay alert and act on any abuses.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert during the action period where continuity of emergency care and care is concerned.
Ik heb de IGZ gevraagd in de actieperiode extra alert te zijn daar waar het continuïteit van de spoedzorg en zorg betreft.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Maasstad ziekenhuis heeft gefaald bij de aanpak van een gevaarlijke bacterie (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Maasstad hospital failed to respond adequately to a Klebsiella pneumoniae outbreak that infected 34 patients, asking whether more patients may be affected, the outbreak date, the reporting obligation and sanctions, and whether the hospital board should be held responsible. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers will be delayed because gathering data and consulting field parties takes longer, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Gerbrands (PVV) about the report that Maasstad hospital failed to address a dangerous bacterium cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) over het bericht dat het Maasstad ziekenhuis heeft gefaald bij de aanpak van een gevaarlijke bacterie kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een resistente bacterie in het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae outbreak at Maasstad Hospital in Rotterdam, including infection numbers, the timing of notifications to the GGD, treatment options, and public health risks. The minister's reply only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because obtaining accurate data and consulting field parties takes more time.
The reason for the delay is that obtaining the correct data and consulting with field parties takes more time.
De reden van uitstel is dat het achterhalen van de juiste gegevens en het overleg met veldpartijen meer tijd kost.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bezuinigingen op PGO’s (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about planned cuts of 18 million euros to patient and elderly organisations, their representative role, and whether they should be funded from health premiums to keep them independent. The minister confirms the cuts, says elderly organisations will no longer receive subsidy, and rejects premium financing as undesirable while committing to a new funding framework and more patient-organisation influence.
I agree that patient and disability organisations have an important task in influencing parties to improve care, support and social participation.
Ik deel dat patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties een belangrijke taak hebben in het beïnvloeden van partijen om zorg, ondersteuning en maatschappelijke participatie te verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending «Sluimerend bewustzijn» van KRO Brandpunt (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a KRO Brandpunt broadcast on coma patients, including claims of misdiagnosis, a Liège consciousness test, and insurance coverage of tests and therapy. The minister rejected the misdiagnosis claim, said further information is needed before the CVZ can judge the test, and pointed to research funding as the route to improving coma care.
Further research must show the ways in which the outcome for coma patients can be improved.
Nader onderzoek moet de wegen aantonen waarlangs de uitkomst voor comapatiënten verbeterd kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de herbenoeming van FIFA-baas Blatter en het WK-bid (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister, among many questions, about FIFA corruption, the KNVB's vote for Blatter, the tax exemption and cost estimates for the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid, and the 'Bierbabes' prosecution issue. The minister answers that the KNVB's vote is its own responsibility, that the cost estimates were communicated with uncertainty margins, that the tax-law change needed parliamentary approval, and that the bid evaluation will follow after summer.
It was also one of the reasons the Netherlands made a constitutional reservation on the guarantees given to FIFA, because the necessary legislative changes would have required parliamentary approval.

Het is ook één van de redenen geweest dat Nederland een constitutioneel voorbehoud heeft gemaakt bij de afgegeven garanties aan de FIFA, omdat voor de daartoe noodzakelijke wetswijzigingen parlementaire goedkeuring verkregen had moeten worden.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ondeugdelijke kostenramingen WK 2018 en verkeerd informeren van de Kamer (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Dijkstra and Van Dekken asked the health minister why the Chamber was told the 2018 World Cup would cost at most 300 million euros in fiscal guarantees and police costs of 200 million, when officials had estimated more, and about a planned evaluation. The minister denied the reporting, said estimates were uncertain and communicated with caveats, and promised an evaluation report in September.
The Chamber has consistently been informed of the insights the cabinet had, noting the uncertainties inherent in estimates.
Er is consequent aan de Kamer meegedeeld over welke inzichten het kabinet beschikte onder vermelding van de onzekerheden die nu eenmaal inherent zijn aan schattingen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat tolken bij artsenbezoek niet meer worden vergoed (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

MP Arib asked the health minister whether scrapping reimbursement for interpreters in healthcare would create barriers for non-Dutch speakers, conflict with patient information and consent rights under the WGBO, and violate field norms. The minister replied that patients are responsible for arranging interpreters, that access to care is not impeded, that the measure does not affect self-determination, and that patients may use an interpreter from their own network or hire a professional at their own cost.
This measure has no consequences for the right of self-determination.
Deze maatregel heeft geen gevolgen voor het zelfbeschikkingsrecht.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Blatter en de FIFA (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MP De Mos asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether FIFA should investigate president Blatter over World Cup awards and a one-million-dollar payment to Concacaf, and whether Blatter should resign. The minister replied that FIFA is an autonomous private body whose members must reform it, that the Netherlands has raised transparent governance in EU sport councils, and that the Dutch World Cup bid support of 4.5 million euro will be accounted for to parliament.
Because FIFA is an autonomous and private membership organisation, I can and will not interfere in its internal affairs.
Omdat de FIFA een autonome en private ledenorganisatie is kan en wil ik mij niet met de interne gang van zaken bemoeien.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de EHEC-bacterie en antibiotica (ingezonden

An MP asks the health and agriculture ministers whether the EHEC outbreak strain is resistant to most antibiotics, whether livestock manure and surface water carrying ESBL bacteria can be used on crops, and whether a ban on manure containing ESBLs is planned. The government confirms the outbreak strain is multiresistant, promises a manure overview and a Health Council advice, but declines to commit to bans pending further research.
There are no standards for ESBL-producing bacteria in surface water.
Er zijn geen normen voor ESBL-producerende bacteriën in oppervlaktewater.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Menzis huisartsenpraktijken opkoopt (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether Menzis' purchase of GP practices via Zorgpunt, which is not temporary, should be stopped before the ban on vertical integration of insurers and providers is in force. The minister says a ban with a temporary exception is being prepared, Zorgpunt is a lasting business, the current rules still allow it, and a bill is aimed for the end of the year.
I aim to have the bill ready for submission to the House of Representatives by the end of this year.
Ik streef ernaar het wetsvoorstel aan het eind van dit jaar gereed te hebben voor aanbieding aan de Tweede Kamer.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat «bizar weinig» specialisten aan functioneringsgesprekken deelnemen (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how to respond to reports that very few medical specialists take part in performance appraisal talks and whether all specialists in all hospitals can be required to participate. The minister says the IFMS evaluation is voluntary and peer-based, that it cannot be made mandatory, and that the matter may be addressed in the model admission agreement and by the hospital board.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de halvering van de spoedeisende hulp in het ziekenhuis te Delfzijl (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about the OZG hospital group's decision to halve emergency department capacity and scale back evening and weekend surgery at its Delfzijl site, and about the consequences for intensive care, the 45-minute access norm and the hospital's finances. The minister replies that the ED capacity is unchanged, that surgery stops after 17.00 hours at Delfzijl with patients referred to Winschoten, that access stays within 45 minutes, and that the availability supplement decision and the Gezondheidsraad advice are still pending.
I cannot give an answer to this question at this time. Whether or not the availability supplement is granted, and its amount, depends on a number of criteria.
Op deze vraag kan ik op dit moment geen antwoord geven. Het wel of niet toekennen van de beschikbaarheidstoeslag en de hoogte is afhankelijk van een aantal criteria.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen een zorgconsulent voor allochtonen moeten aanstellen (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister whether she agrees that hospitals appointing allochtone care consultants sends the wrong integration signal and urges her to advise against it. The minister replies that hospitals decide for themselves, that patients generally struggle with medical terminology, and that learning Dutch is the responsibility of newcomers, but she does not commit to any action toward the hospitals or the foundation.
It is up to the hospitals themselves whether or not they want to use it.
Het is aan de ziekenhuizen zelf of zij hier al dan niet gebruik van willen maken.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de praktijken van een aantal artsen en instituten die nog steeds HCG afslankkuren propageren en mogelijk verkopen (ingezonden

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister why doctors and clinics still advertise and possibly sell HCG weight-loss kits despite the ban, what the Inspectorate has done, and whether enforcement is adequate. The minister confirms the practices, reports that the Inspectorate found advertising violations at six providers with fines being prepared and seven still under investigation, rejects off-label justification, and says enforcement is in progress with prioritised capacity.
The Inspectorate assessed the websites of all providers for possible violations of the advertising provisions of the Medicines Act.
De Inspectie heeft de websites van alle aanbieders beoordeeld op mogelijke overtreding van de reclamebepalingen in de Geneesmiddelenwet.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het levenslang schorsen door de KNVB van een scheidsrechter. (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the KNVB lifelong-suspended a referee for criticising a disciplinary committee ruling, and whether this violates his freedom of expression. The minister answered that the referee was not suspended for life or struck off, but that the KNVB decided not to deploy him in KNVB matches this season, which it considers a matter for the football association's own disciplinary system.
A well-functioning disciplinary system is the responsibility of a sports federation.
Een goed functionerend tuchtrechtsysteem is de verantwoordelijkheid van een sportbond.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht twee topklinische afdelingen te sluiten (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether she approved the Maastricht academic hospital's decision to close two top-clinical departments (immunology and sarcoidosis), who will treat affected patients, and whether the inspectorate and insurers were involved. The minister answers that the hospital board is responsible, continuity of care is guaranteed through agreements with Utrecht and Nijmegen, the inspectorate is informed and monitoring, and she declines to reverse the decision or launch a new cost-benefit analysis.
Responsibility for providing good quality of care lies with the hospital's Board of Directors.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het bieden van goede kwaliteit van zorg ligt bij de Raad van Bestuur van het ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Te lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg» (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about long waiting lists for transgender care at VUmc and whether these cause serious harm, and asked what measures would be taken. The minister explained the causes given by VUmc (shortage of expertise, rising demand, complex multidisciplinary care), said she lacks enough information on the consequences, declined to make promises beyond her system responsibility, and committed to consult VUmc and Transvisie on a sustainable future model.
I will, from my system responsibility, cooperate on a sustainable future transgender care in the Netherlands
Ik zal vanuit mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid meewerken aan een toekomstbestendige transgenderzorg in Nederland
Vragen van de leden Arib en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over toegenomen gebitsverwaarlozing onder peuters en kleuters (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Arib and Kuiken asked the health minister about rising tooth decay among toddlers and young children, including reports of 700 children in the Utrecht region under anaesthesia for dental treatment, and whether cuts by municipal health services contributed. The minister called it a worrying trend, stressed parents' primary responsibility, pointed to existing coverage, new dental guidelines and prevention codes, said no waiting-list figures are held, saw no evidence that GGD cuts played a role, and promised further inventories and first results of a study.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Waarom kennen vrouwen een van hun grootste risicofactoren voor borstkanker niet?» (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MP Voortman asks the minister why women are not told that dense breast tissue is a major breast cancer risk factor, whether about 800 cancers are missed yearly, and whether breast density measurement should be added to the national screening programme. The minister says the missed-cancer figure is based on mainly American data and needs further research, that no alternative test exists yet so women are not informed of the risk, and that density assessment in screening is being studied.
As long as there is no scientific evidence, we unfortunately cannot offer women another or additional test.
Zolang er geen wetenschappelijk bewijs is, kunnen we vrouwen helaas geen andere of aanvullende test bieden.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het levenslang schorsen door de KNVB van een scheidsrechter. (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the KNVB's lifetime suspension of a referee for criticizing a disciplinary committee ruling is disproportionate and conflicts with the free-speech rights and anti-violence programme it participates in. The minister replies only that answers will be delayed because consultation with the KNVB is needed.
The reason for the delay is that consultation with the KNVB is needed regarding the answers to the questions, and this takes the necessary time.
De reden van uitstel is dat er afstemming met de KNVB nodig is omtrent de beantwoording van de vragen en dit de nodige tijd kost.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over discriminatie van ouderen met hartproblemen (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister about professors' claims that older people with heart problems are excluded from research and treatment, and whether this is acceptable, its causes, and criteria for withholding treatment. The minister rejects the claim that older patients are wrongly denied treatment, notes older people are underrepresented in trials for valid reasons, and says decisions on forgoing treatment are made by patient, family and doctor based on quality of life.
I do not share the view that older people are wrongly excluded from treatment.
Ik deel de mening niet dat ouderen ten onrechte uitgesloten worden van behandeling.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over betere uitleg van de overheid over rookvrije horeca (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the government should have explained the 2008 smoke-free hospitality rule better, and whether it should now launch a public campaign on secondhand smoke harm, and why the WHO's four recommendations were not fully adopted. The minister replied that the 2008 communication was extensive and humorous in tone, that the country largely follows WHO advice, and that she does not favour a new generic mass campaign.
I do not share that view.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de slechte telefonische bereikbaarheid van huisartsen (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Health Minister about poor phone reachability of GPs, citing NIVEL research and IGZ norms, and whether past measures were adequate. The minister confirms the norms, admits earlier measures were insufficient given a 2010 IGZ finding that one in four practices missed the 30-second emergency norm, and says the IGZ will enforce the norms.
These measures have so far proven insufficient, as recently shown by the IGZ investigation into telephone accessibility in 2010.
Deze maatregelen zijn (nog) niet afdoende gebleken, zoals recent is gebleken uit het IGZ onderzoek naar de telefonische bereikbaarheid in 2010.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van gameverslaving onder jongeren (ingezonden mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that 12,000 young people are addicted to online gaming and rising, and about prevention, treatment access and European experience. The minister answered that the figure does not show a rise, prevention is integrated and aimed at resilience, treatment methods appear effective, and little is known about European experience.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen te bezuinigen op de eerstelijns GGZ (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

MP Leijten asks the health minister about planned savings on first-line mental health care, including higher co-payments and fewer insured sessions, and the risk of patients dropping out or shifting to specialist care. The minister says savings options are under review in the spring budget process, declines to confirm the specific figures, argues efficiency via e-health and better triage can avoid barriers, and promises an NZa implementation review by end 2011.
I cannot yet make a statement on this at this time.
Hierover kan ik op dit moment nog geen uitspraak doen.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medische dossiers op mobiele telefoons (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether patient-portal systems like Medlook, which offer medical records on the internet and mobile phones as an alternative to the EPD, comply with the WGBO and Wbp, how their security and patient information are overseen, and whether the privacy regulator reassessed Medlook after 2001. The minister answered that Wbp applies given identifiability, the CBP supervises compliance, providers must meet current security standards, and the CBP has not reassessed Medlook since 2001, leaving that to the CBP.
The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises compliance with the Wbp, and supervision of Medlook's compliance falls under that.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wbp, daar valt het toezicht op de naleving door Medlook onder.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het ziekenhuis Bernhoven in Oss de afdeling klinische verloskunde gaat sluiten (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about Bernhoven hospital's plan to close its obstetrics unit in Oss and concentrate births in Veghel due to a shortage of specialised nurses, and whether this threatens access and quality of care. The minister answered that concentration is acceptable because quality and the 45-minute access norm are not at risk, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while committing to a joint implementation plan from the NVZ and NVOG by January 2012.
Since the ambulance response time norm in this region is not endangered by this, the accessibility of acute obstetric care is not at stake.
Aangezien de norm aanrijtijden van de ambulance in deze regio hierdoor niet in gevaar komen, komt de bereikbaarheid van de acute verloskundige zorg niet in het geding.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de helft van de spoedeisende hulpen in Nederland dicht zouden kunnen (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MP Van der Veen asked the health minister whether the 45-minute ambulance norm could close half of Dutch emergency departments, whether insurers may decide which EDs stay open without breaching competition law, and who holds democratic legitimacy over such decisions. Minister Schippers answered that the 45-minute norm is achievable nationally except in peripheral areas, that insurers hold the purchasing role under conditions of quality and accessibility, that NMa would not normally intervene, and that a basic-ED advice and a basic-care note would follow.
Of course I will inform you about this.
Ik zal u uiteraard hierover informeren.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stroomstoring bij het ziekenhuis in Hengelo van de Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a one-hour power outage at ZGT hospital in Hengelo that forced manual ventilation of intensive care patients, asking about harm, cause, management responsibility and inspectorate oversight. The minister answered that emergency procedures worked, no lives were endangered, the cause was a short circuit in a supply cable, and the Inspectorate has commissioned TNO research into emergency power in hospitals.

The IGZ, following reports and notifications of emergency power problems at several hospitals in recent years, had already commissioned TNO Zorg en Bouw before this incident to research emergency power provisions in hospitals in 2011.

De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van berichten en meldingen van problemen bij noodstroom die de afgelopen jaren in een aantal ziekenhuizen zijn opgetreden, TNO Zorg en Bouw al voor dit incident de opdracht gegeven om in 2011 een onderzoek te doen naar noodstroomvoorzieningen in ziekenhuizen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stroomstoring en de veiligheid in de ziekenhuizen van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about a power outage at a Twente hospital group that disabled emergency power, Dutch hospital emergency-power standards, fire-safety enforcement and dwangsommen imposed by two municipalities, and follow-up to a 2006 fatal operating-room fire. The minister answered that standards were addressed in an earlier reply, that municipalities are enforcing fire rules with a year-end deadline, and that the IGZ judged the hospital's post-fire measures adequate in 2009, while declining to commit to a further check beyond a ministry meeting with the board.
At the time the IGZ concluded that the measures were sufficient and continued its inspection work in the usual national manner.
De IGZ heeft destijds geconcludeerd dat de maatregelen voldoende waren en haar inspectie werkzaamheden op de gebruikelijke landelijke wijze voortgezet.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het naast zich neerleggen van een gerechtelijke uitspraak door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa complied with a court ruling requiring it to re-justify its requirement that diagnosis information appear on psychiatrists' and psychotherapists' invoices, and whether it may keep that requirement. The minister answers that the court (CBb) is the authority to judge the new NZa decision, that the NZa has provided a fuller justification, that the matter is pending before the court, and that she will follow the case.
As I explained in my answer to question 3, the NZa has re-motivated the secondary decision extensively. Whether that is sufficient is not for me but for the CBb to judge.
Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heeft de NZa de secundaire BoB opnieuw en uitgebreid gemotiveerd. Het oordeel of dat afdoende is, is niet aan mij maar aan het CBb.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitspraken van de bestuursvoorzitter van de ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Uitslag asked the health minister whether the government can require a hospital to keep a maternity department open, and whether a hospital concentrating obstetric care breaches earlier parliamentary motions. The minister answered that the WTZi allows binding hospital admission conditions and, as a last resort, enforcement, but that no closure decision has been taken and the government will not impose keeping the department open where the 45-minute access norm is not at risk.
However, I will not impose on a hospital the obligation to keep a department open if the 45-minute access norm for acute care in the region is not at risk.
Ik zal een ziekenhuis echter niet opleggen om een afdeling open te houden als de bereikbaarheidsnorm voor acute zorg van 45 minuten voor de regio niet in het gedrang komt.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Assenaar in actie voor hulphond» van RTV Drenthe. (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the assistance dog would be dropped from the basic insurance package in 2012, whether insurers are unduly withholding payments to dog trainers, and whether assistance dogs belong in the package. The minister said there is no plan to drop them, pointed to a planned CVZ cost-effectiveness review, said insurers follow protocols and have a duty of care, and recognised the dogs' value under current eligibility criteria.
I currently see no reason to remove the assistance dog from the package.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de hulphond uit het pakket te schrappen.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

CDA MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about young people turning 18 who must pay health insurance premiums immediately but may wait up to three months for student finance, and about support for vulnerable youth leaving youth care. The government replied that the timing mismatch is a general consequence of financial independence, that parents remain liable and child benefit covers the gap, that it sees no need for special measures, and that it will continue youth information campaigns.
I do not consider it desirable, nor necessary, to take specific measures for this group of young people.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk en ook niet nodig om voor deze groep jongeren specifieke maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman van Meppelen-Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de tijgermug (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why the import ban on Lucky Bamboo plants carrying Asian tiger mosquitoes was lifted and whether this risks establishment of the mosquito in the Netherlands, and whether this ignores a motion. The minister replies that the rule was converted into a permanent regulation with clarified wording, that treatment of imports and enforcement make establishment risk adequately reduced, and that the motion is not ignored.
The policy was and is aimed at preventing the establishment of tiger mosquitoes in the Netherlands.
Het beleid was en is erop gericht om vestiging van tijgermuggen in Nederland te voorkomen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het schrappen van regels om de import van de A

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the health and agriculture ministers whether they will scrap the temporary rules on Lucky Bamboo imports that guard against the Asian tiger mosquito, and whether they will instead strengthen enforcement. The minister replies that the rules were revised into a permanent decree, that there has never been an import ban, and that the new food and consumer authority will enforce them while expert advice on eradication is awaited.
That is why I have, among other things, set requirements on the marketing of Lucky Bamboo.
Daarom heb ik onder andere voorschriften gesteld aan de verhandeling van Lucky Bamboo.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bestaan van een private kliniek voor plastische chirurgie binnen de muren van ziekenhuis Bernhoven (ingezonden 3 mei 2011)

An MP asked the health minister whether it is permissible for a hospital to host a private cosmetic surgery clinic staffed by its own doctors, how common such arrangements are, and whether discounted promotions and a university hospital's specialist clinic are acceptable. The minister answered that hospitals may set up such clinics, that doctors are paid per procedure under contracts, that she sees no need for investigation but wants clear responsibilities, and that the promotion and AMC arrangement are permissible subject to quality norms and NMa notification.
I have had the hospital inform me about the structure between the clinic and the hospital.
Ik heb mij door het ziekenhuis laten informeren over de constructie tussen de kliniek en het ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dure kankermedicijnen oneerlijk verdeeld zijn (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

The MP asks whether expensive cancer drugs reach the patients who need them, whether this amounts to 'postcode medicine', and what the government will do about regional and hospital differences. The minister answers that access is not a problem since the 2006 measures and research, rejects the term 'postcode medicine' as tied to financial motives, and points to planned reforms from 2012 on financing and registries.
I am therefore not convinced that the current financing of expensive medicines causes the differences between hospitals.
Ik ben daarom niet overtuigd dat de huidige financiering van dure geneesmiddelen voor de verschillen tussen ziekenhuizen zorgt.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een middel tegen levensbedreigende acute leukemie nauwelijks verkrijgbaar is (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how the leukemia drug cytarabine became scarce, what would prevent patient harm, and what measures would prevent recurrence. The minister explained a supply disruption at the US manufacturer Hospira, described the Inspectorate's coordination with the Erasmus MC pharmacy and suppliers, and promised to consult pharmaceutical industry bodies on earlier information about such problems.
I will consult with the pharmaceutical industry associations and ask to receive adequate and timely information about these and similar problems at an earlier stage.
Ik zal met de koepels van farmaceutische bedrijven in overleg treden waarbij ik zal vragen op een eerder tijdstip adequate en tijdige informatie te krijgen over deze en vergelijkbare problemen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de barrières die chronisch zieken voelen bij een overstap naar een andere zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister about a NIVEL study showing chronically ill people face more barriers to switching health insurers, and questioned switching rates, price-versus-quality balance, insurer advertising and insurer marketing spending. Minister Schippers answered each question, stating that insurers' acceptance duty applies, that the Zvw is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a good price-quality balance, and that marketing budgets are for insurers to decide.
I do not know how many chronically ill people are refused supplementary insurance.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel chronisch zieken worden geweigerd voor een aanvullende verzekering.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hogere babysterfte in drie Amsterdamse stadsdelen (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Arib asked the health minister about higher infant mortality in three Amsterdam districts despite low rates elsewhere in the city, and which risk factors apply and whether targeted local policy is planned. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the risk factors are already covered by existing national policy, and announced a two-year local pilot in six municipalities financed by the ministry.
I agree that infant mortality must also be tackled at local level, with a specific approach per district or municipality.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat babysterfte ook op lokaal niveau moet worden aangepakt, met een specifieke aanpak per stadsdeel of gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekortschietende hulp aan psychiatrische patiënten (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister about psychiatric patients not receiving help despite family requests, and about the role of police versus GGZ crisis services and a planned police-GGZ covenant. The minister answered that existing services (huisarts, FACT teams, bemoeizorg, crisis service) suffice, declined a single central reporting point, and promised a revised covenant by January 2012.
No figures are known to me on requests for help from family or close relations concerning psychiatric patients.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend van hulpvragen van familie of naastbetrokkenen omtrent psychiatrische patiënten.

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Zoon was een tijdbom, er moet een p

CDA MPs asked the health and justice ministers about a newspaper report on parents who cannot get help for a psychologically troubled adult child, including how families can raise alarm signals and whether a central reporting point is needed. Minister Schippers answered that no figures exist on unmet voluntary care demand, pointed to existing family support, the Bopz framework and the new compulsory mental health law, and rejected a central reporting point.
I am not in favour of setting up a reporting point.
Ik ben niet voor het opzetten van een meldpunt.
