CDA MPs asked the minister how a neurologist removed from the Dutch BIG register could still work abroad via an agency, whether EU rules allow this, how loopholes can be closed, and what the inspectorate did. The minister answered that EU law leaves recognition of restrictions to the receiving state, that the register removal was voluntary so no disciplinary measure applied, and that the minister will raise a European list of restricted health professionals in Brussels.

I am certainly planning to raise again, on behalf of the Netherlands, at the upcoming visit to Brussels on 23 March 2011, whether a European list of health care professionals subject to a professional restriction measure can be created.

Ik ben zeker van plan om tijdens het aanstaande bezoek in Brussel op 23 maart 2011 wederom namens Nederland aan de orde te stellen of er een Europese lijst kan komen van beroepsbeoefenaren in de gezondheidszorg, aan wie een beroepsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over risico’s door uitzendkrachten op ambulances (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs ask the health minister about risks from temporary agency staff and unqualified nurses driving ambulances, including route knowledge, response times, and whether the Inspectorate has examined the response-time norm. The minister replies only with a procedural notice that answers will be delayed because consultations with the Inspectorate are ongoing.
The reason for the delay is that I am currently still in consultation with the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) on this matter.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik momenteel nog in overleg ben met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) hieromtrent.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitzendkrachten op de ambulance (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether budget cuts in ambulance care have increased use of temporary agency staff who may not know their areas, and asked about the numbers, recruitment, quality control, the role of the Health Inspectorate and whether the minister will act. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers are delayed because consultations with the Inspectorate are ongoing, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that I am currently still in consultation with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) on this matter.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik momenteel nog met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) in overleg ben hieromtrent.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er sprake is van corruptie en hoge kosten bij zorgverzekeraar Agis in Marokko (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether reports of corruption, bribery and excessive costs at the Dutch-insured health insurer Agis in Morocco are accurate, whether the investigation findings should be made public, and whether wrongly spent Dutch premium money will be recovered. The minister replied only that answers are delayed pending further investigation and promised them by end of April.
The reason for the delay is that further investigation is needed before I can answer your questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat er nader onderzoek nodig is alvorens ik uw vragen kan beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zogenaamde studiereis naar Zwitserland (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how the study trip with care executives to Switzerland came about, whether it fits cost-cutting goals, who paid, how participants were selected, which firms organised it, and what other trips occurred. The minister defends the trip as knowledge-gathering, says participants paid their own travel, explains the tender and selection, and lists past and planned foreign trips, though it could not answer by the deadline.
Naming the organisations that were rejected is commercially sensitive information.
Het noemen van de organisaties die zijn afgewezen is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vanuit de AWBZ bekostigde luxe studiereis

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Economic Affairs why AWBZ funds and ministry money paid for a luxury study trip for care executives, whether the ministry initiated it, and why it was not cancelled. The minister replied that the trip was a benchmarking visit, that participants paid their own travel costs with organisations deciding co-payment, that VWS paid organisational costs, and that the trip was too far advanced to cancel, while promising more frugality in future.
It is up to the care institutions whether and to what extent the participant pays for the trip themselves.
Het is aan de zorginstellingen of en in welke mate de deelnemer zelf meebetaalt aan de reis.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de acceptatie van homo’s in de sportwereld (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asks the ministers of Health and Education about the government's response to a newspaper report on acceptance of gay people in football and about continuing funding for the 'Gelijkspelen' sports alliance, and whether it will develop anti-homophobia policy in sport. The government reply only announces that the answers will be delayed because the questions were also addressed to another ministry and require interdepartmental consultation.
The answers will be given as soon as possible.
De beantwoording zal zo spoedig mogelijk plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de totstandkoming van één centrum voor kinderoncologische zorg (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about delay and disagreement over establishing a single national paediatric oncology centre, including the selection of the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek hospital in Amsterdam and the UMCs' opposition. The minister answered that the process lies under the NKOC cooperative, that the selection followed published criteria and an independent committee, and that the parties now appear to be converging, while declining to say how the institutional arrangement should be shaped.
For the avoidance of doubt, I note that this is a procedure fully under the responsibility of the board of the Nationaal Kinderoncologisch Centrum (NKOC) cooperative.
Voor alle duidelijkheid merk ik op dat het om een procedure gaat die geheel onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de coöperatie Nationaal Kinderoncologisch Centrum (NKOC) valt.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over online alcoholhulp (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the health minister whether online alcohol help is effective for boys, why it is not effective for girls, and whether the minister will include the findings in the alcohol prevention policy paper and encourage insurers to offer online help. The minister confirms the study, suggests the boy-girl gap relates to heavier drinking among boys, plans to improve and re-evaluate the website, and says a structural solution for insurer reimbursement is being sought.
Following the study results, this website will be improved.
Naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het onderzoek zal deze website worden verbeterd.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekortschietende controle op de hulpmiddelenindustrie en wachtlijsten bij scoliosepatiënten (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether oversight of prostheses and implants is inadequate, whether surgeon-industry contracts should be banned, and why scoliosis patients face long waiting times. The minister replied that the existing EU-based market-approval system and IGZ supervision are sufficient, that a voluntary industry code is due by January 2012, and that financing reform (DOT, expanded B-segment) is intended to address the scoliosis backlog.
I will inform the House as soon as possible about the results of the NOV's investigation.
Ik zal de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de resultaten van het onderzoek van de NOV informeren.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zoutbeperking in voedsel om grote gezondheidswinst te boeken (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the large health gains from salt reduction in food, questioning the figures cited, why the government does not pursue a salt policy, and whether pansalt should be introduced as in Finland. The minister says the figures are misquoted, that industry salt reduction efforts are ongoing, and that she has no plans to introduce pansalt or commission research on it.
No, I do not have that intention. How producers and suppliers such as hospitality and catering reduce the salt content of their products I leave to them.
Nee, dat voornemen heb ik niet. Hoe producenten en aanbieders zoals horeca en catering het zoutgehalte in hun producten reduceren, laat ik aan hen zelf over.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problemen bij de beheerder van elektronische patiëntendossiers (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

The MP asks the minister about the bankruptcy of ICT firm InfoTechnology, which manages 1.5 to 2 million electronic patient records, covering continuity, data loss, privacy, tax authority knowledge, and certification. The minister answers that continuity is adequately safeguarded, that contractual arrangements are the healthcare providers' responsibility, that no guarantees against bankruptcy are possible, and that Nictiz is studying contractual continuity requirements.
As said, this is the responsibility of the healthcare provider itself.
Zoals gezegd is dit de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder zelf.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over misleidende informatie in het bezwaarformulier Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD) (ingezonden 2 maart 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the EPD objection form misleadingly states that deleting data cannot be undone, when objections can be withdrawn, and asked for that sentence to be removed. The minister acknowledged the sentence, explained that deletion is irreversible while the objection itself can be withdrawn but previously sent data must be re-sent by providers, and declined to remove the sentence while promising an extra FAQ on the website.
As indicated in answers 3 to 5, the information included in the explanation on the objection form and on the website www.infoEPD.nl is correct.
Zoals in de antwoorden 3 t/m 5 aangegeven klopt de informatie zoals opgenomen in de toelichting op het bezwaarformulier en op de website www.infoEPD.nl.
Vragen van de leden van Veldhoven en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de besmetting van nVWA-medewerkers met Q- koorts (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about nVWA staff infected with Q-fever during culling operations, including infection rates, protective measures, aftercare and risks to other workers. The minister replied that the answers would be delayed because consultation with other departments and services takes more time, and promised to send them as soon as possible.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de reclames van de zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

SP MP Leijten asked the health minister about insurer advertising (Zekur, Promovendum, VGZ, Independer), covering acceptance duty, risk equalisation, discounts for higher-educated groups and the reliability of comparison sites. The minister's reply corrected an earlier answer: Independer no longer owns the health centres (transferred to Arts en Zorg) and has said it holds no other provider interests, and it has agreed to remove outdated website information.
Independer has agreed to (have) the outdated information removed from its websites.
Independer heeft toegezegd de verouderde informatie van de websites te (laten) verwijderen.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat tien van de veertien maaltijden in het Hagaziekenhuis in Den Haag halal zijn (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a hospital reportedly offering mostly halal meals, questioning whether halal food aids recovery and whether patients understand it, and asking what would be done to stop 'islamisation'. The minister said the hospital's claim was incorrect (nine of fourteen or thirty-two meals are halal), that halal meals can be healthy and are provided for religious reasons like other dietary requirements, and saw no reason to intervene.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zogenaamde studiereis naar Zwitserland (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP from the SP asks the health minister, in 17 questions, how a study trip to Switzerland with care executives came about, who selected and paid for participants, what deals were discussed, and whether further trips will be cancelled. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within a week because more time is needed.
The reason for the delay is that answering the questions requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de beantwoording van de vragen meer tijd vergt.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vanuit de AWBZ bekostigde luxe studiereis

An MP asks the health and economics ministers whether AWBZ funds (100,000 euro) and ministry money (44,744 euro) paid for a luxury study trip for care board members, why it was not cancelled, and whether more such trips are planned. The minister's reply only notes that the answers will take longer than a week and promises them as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Agema (PVV) about a luxury study trip for care board members funded from the AWBZ cannot, to my regret, be answered within a week.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Agema (PVV) over een vanuit de AWBZ bekostigde luxe studiereis voor zorgbestuurders kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen een week worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Mulder en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uiteenlopende eisen voor drogistenexamens en over het feit dat het Drogisterijcollege geen toezicht houdt op he

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about differing exam and quality requirements for drogist diplomas and the lack of supervision by the Drogisterijcollege over how the exam is administered online, including identity checks. The minister replied that the ministry has no say over training and exams under self-regulation, that she will push for a minimum standard and a policy framework for examining bodies, and that exam bodies must ensure identity verification and publish lists of certified graduates.
I will strongly urge that this consultation now proceeds promptly.
Ik zal er met klem op aandringen dat dit overleg nu voortvarend tot stand komt.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het KNMG-concept standpunt over de rol van de arts bij het zelfgekozen levenseinde (ingezonden 5

An MP asked the health minister about a KNMG draft position suggesting a medically classifiable condition is not an absolute requirement for assessing unbearable suffering under the euthanasia law, contrary to the Supreme Court's reading, and whether this causes confusion among doctors. The minister answered that the draft is a discussion for the KNMG, declined substantive comment, and said the current system of regional review committees provides sufficient safeguards, pending the final KNMG position.
The current system offers sufficient guarantees for compliance with the legal assessment criteria.
Het huidige systeem biedt voldoende waarborgen voor het naleven van de wettelijke toetsingscriteria.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vergroten van de Lotto-inkomsten voor de sport (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether it is desirable for sports clubs to promote Lotto gambling to raise revenue for sport, whether sports dependence on gambling money is acceptable, and what is done about illegal online sports betting. The minister answers that involving sports clubs is not objectionable, that gambling revenue funding sport is permitted under EU case law, that the basic sports infrastructure is adequately secured, and that the new gambling authority and a forthcoming policy vision will address illegal online betting.
The bill amending the Gambling Act to establish the gambling authority is currently under consideration by the House of Representatives.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen in verband met de instelling van de kansspelautoriteit is thans in behandeling bij de Tweede Kamer.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de afwikkeling van de brand in Moerdijk (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister why measurement results for the 10 km zone around the Moerdijk chemical fire were still unclear more than two weeks later, when they would be released, how organic farmers would know when they can resume, whether rules on livestock, crops and irrigation would follow, and why the emergency fund had not been set up. The minister answered that results became available after three weeks due to scientifically sound measurement, that no additional rules were considered necessary, and that the emergency fund had not been established, referring to separate letters on compensation.
I see no reason to set additional rules.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende regels te stellen.
Vagen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toegenomen gebruik van de populaire drug GHB (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about rising GHB use, monitoring, prevention, treatment capacity, GBL access and drug-driving detection. The minister answered that monitoring and prevention are adequate, that GBL cannot be banned for industrial reasons, and that a treatment protocol project and a Wegenverkeerswet amendment on drug driving are being prepared.
No information is available on the number of traffic deaths and injuries directly resulting from GHB use.
Over het aantal verkeersdoden en -gewonden die het direct gevolg is van het gebruik van GHB, is geen informatie voorhanden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over doorverwijzing naar het buitenland voor geslachtsselectie (ingezonden 1 februari 2011).

An SGP MP asked the health minister about a Dutch national's involvement in sex selection via a Belgian clinic, IGZ investigation, the legality of such referral in Belgium, Dutch law on counselling, and possible criminal or disciplinary action. The minister's reply is only a postponement notice citing interdepartmental and international consultation, with answers promised later.
The reason for the delay is that interdepartmental and international coordination requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de interdepartementale en internationale afstemming meer tijd vraagt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over genderselectie (ingezonden 1 februari 2011).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks the ministers of Health and of Justice about a businessman who allegedly refers Dutch clients for gender selection to a clinic in Antwerp, whether these activities are criminal in the Netherlands and Belgium, and what the IGZ and prosecutors will do. The answer is only a holding notice saying the questions cannot be answered within the usual period due to interdepartmental and international coordination, with answers promised as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that interdepartmental and international coordination requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de interdepartementale en internationale afstemming meer tijd vraagt.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dierziekten zich via bloedtransfusies kunnen verspreiden (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether zoonoses such as Q fever and hepatitis E spread through blood transfusions, what it costs to prevent this, and whether routine testing of donors is warranted. The minister states that donors are screened and blood tested under EU rules, that Sanquin takes necessary measures, that the Health Council has been asked to advise on testing, and that she will inform parliament if policy changes.
I will inform you if the Council's advice leads to a change in my policy.
Ik zal u informeren als het advies van de Raad leidt tot verandering van mijn beleid.

Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vrijgeven van de voetbal makelaarsmarkt en de gevolgen die dit heeft voor jonge talenten (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the liberalisation of the football agent market by FIFA endangers young players under 16, and whether current rules protect them and whether new measures are planned. The minister replied that the KNVB agent rules already bar agents from acting for under-16s, that enforcement relies on complaints, and that no new legal or other measures are planned because the matter is largely for self-regulation and the public authorities act only on crimes, tax evasion, labour law or free movement breaches.
In view of the above, I am not considering introducing any new legal or other measures.
Gelet op het bovenstaande overweeg ik geen nieuwe wettelijke of andere maatregelen in te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de misstanden in de voetbalspelersmakelaarswereld (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about alleged abuses in football agent transfers, including suspected club kickbacks, youth transfers resembling child trafficking, and whether EU-level rules are needed. The minister replies that transfer fees are not kickbacks, the KNVB has an integrity unit investigating two agents, Dutch law applies, and the Commission favours self-regulation with a conference planned for late 2011.
The KNVB does not have access to the international figures on youth transfers.
De KNVB heeft niet de beschikking over de internationale cijfers inzake jeugdtransfers.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bestrijdingsmiddelen in pangavis (ingezonden 23 decemb

An MP asked ministers about pesticide residues (chlorpyrifos, trifluralin) found in Vietnamese pangasius, EU import controls, and EU residue limits for fish. The government answered that residues found pose no health risk, import controls exist, and it will raise the issue with Vietnamese authorities.
However, State Secretary Bleker of EL&I will raise the presence of trifluralin and chlorpyrifos residues in pangasius fillet with the Vietnamese authorities.
Wel zal staatssecretaris Bleker van EL&I de aanwezigheid van residuen van trifluralin en chloorpyrifos in pangasiusfilet aankaarten bij de Vietnamese autoriteiten

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de website van de regionale toetsingscommissie euthanasie (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister why the regional euthanasia review committees' website has not been updated with anonymised rulings since 2008 and how this will be fixed. The minister acknowledged the importance of publishing the rulings, attributed the delay to heavy workload and said staffing is being expanded and the website redesigned so rulings return from spring 2011.
Together this will lead to the anonymised rulings of the committees being placed back on the website from spring 2011.
Dit zal er gezamenlijk toe leiden dat de geanonimiseerde oordelen van de commissies vanaf het voorjaar van 2011 weer op de website zullen worden geplaatst.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over onnodige dierproeven voor toxicologisch onderzoek (ingezon

An MP asked whether multi-generation rodent reproduction toxicity studies could be dropped because the second generation adds no new knowledge, whether the OECD proposed replacing them, how many animals are used and under REACH, and the status of an inventory of obstacles to alternatives. The minister largely agreed the second generation could be dropped and favours the extended one-generation study, but said the OECD does not dictate EU policy and that the EU has not yet decided, and gave the RIVM study timing.
The Netherlands is of the view that these second-generation studies could be abolished.
Nederland is echter van mening dat deze studies naar de tweede generatie zouden kunnen worden afgeschaft.
Vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over personele gevolgen bij de invoering van de Wet ambulancezorg (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about staffing, collective agreement coverage, liability and response-time effects of introducing care ambulances (zorgambulances) and helper ambulances in The Hague. The minister answered that differentiated transport is acceptable, that the provider is responsible for staffing and liability, that the CAO question is being handled by sector parties, and that response-time impacts are not known.
I am not aware of any reports that preparedness is negatively affected by this.
Mij zijn geen berichten bekend dat de paraatheid hierdoor negatief wordt beïnvloed.
Vragen van het lid De Liefde (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Hufters op het veld harder straffen» (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health and sport minister whether she agrees with the conclusions of a Kennispraktijk report on sportsmanship on sports fields, whether she will send a substantive reaction, inform sports federations about uniform penalties for violence, and whether she agrees that harsher sanctions promote sportsmanship. The minister announces that answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental coordination but will come as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that interdepartmental coordination is needed to answer the questions properly, and this takes the necessary time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat er interdepartementale afstemming nodig is om de vragen goed te kunnen beantwoorden en dit de nodige tijd kost.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Zorg Groep Twente om de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te verplaatsen naar Hengel

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about Zorg Groep Twente's plan to move clinical maternity care from Almelo to Hengelo, including quality, travel times, the relation to hospital budget cuts and consolidation policy. The minister answered that no location decision has been made, that the plan is quality-driven rather than budget-driven, that the 45-minute access norm is not endangered, and that the Inspectorate will oversee a plan of action due in 2011.
With a possible concentration of clinical obstetric care in Hengelo, the 45-minute accessibility norm for acute care is not endangered.
Met een eventuele concentratie van de klinische verloskundige zorg in Hengelo komt de bereikbaarheidsnorm van 45 minuten voor acute zorg niet in gevaar.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag, Omtzigt en Smilde (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voornemens tot overheveling van de kraamafdeling van het ziekenhuis in Almelo naar Hengelo (ingezonde

CDA MPs asked the health minister about ZGT's plan to move the obstetric ward from Almelo to Hengelo, covering access, safety, capacity, home-birth rates, and the insurers' view. The minister answered that no final decision has been taken, that concentration is possible for quality reasons, that Hengelo's current capacity is insufficient, and that the IGZ can intervene if care quality is at risk.
Through the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) I am authorised and willing to intervene if the quality of care is at stake.
Via de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) ben ik bevoegd en bereid in te grijpen als de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rol van marktsturing in het besluit de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te schrappen (ingezonden 1

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether market considerations drove ZGT hospital's plan to concentrate clinical maternity care in Hengelo, and whether accessibility should weigh more heavily. The minister said concentration should not be pursued for its own sake, that hospitals must meet quality standards, and that a feasibility study with regional consultation is underway.
I am not in favour of concentration for the sake of concentration.
Ik ben geen voorstander van concentratie om de concentratie.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over babysterfte en de afstand tot een ziekenhuis (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a study linking travel times over 20 minutes to higher neonatal mortality, the Stuurgroep recommendations, concentration of obstetric care, and the College Perinatale Zorg. The minister acknowledged a possible link, said timely referral can mitigate risk, outlined planned hospital action plans and IGZ oversight, and described the College's start-up.
The IGZ will send a letter to hospitals after 1 April 2011 on what it expects of them and how it will test and enforce.
De IGZ gaat na 1 april 2011 een brief aan de ziekenhuizen sturen over wat zij van de ziekenhuizen verwachten en hoe zij gaan toetsen en handhaven.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mogelijke sluiting van de afdeling verloskunde van het Diaconessenhuis te Meppel (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the possible closure of the obstetrics department at the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel, the reasons, shortages of gynaecologists, the impact on ambulance response times, and a study on infant mortality linked to travel distance. The minister replied that the hospital reports no closure is planned, that the IGZ will require hospital action plans on acute obstetric care, and that the regional acute care body must find solutions for any access gaps.
I am not a proponent of concentration for its own sake.
Ik ben geen voorstander van concentratie om de concentratie.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht over euthanasie bij baby's die niet gemeld wordt (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

MPs Arib and Klijnsma ask the health minister whether euthanasia of babies is under-reported because doctors disagree on unbearable and hopeless suffering, and how many cases are reported, and whether a uniform guideline or palliative sedation priority is needed. The minister answers that the reporting commission cites several causes for under-reporting, that doctors must decide individually, and that the medical profession itself should build consensus and lead on guidelines.
Ultimately it remains up to the individual doctor to assess, within his professional framework, the unbearableness and hopelessness of a newborn's suffering.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan de individuele arts om met zijn professionele beoordelingskader de ondraaglijkheid enuitzichtloosheid van het lijden van een pasgeborene te beoordelen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een medisch letselschadefonds (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister how victims of medical injury can obtain redress, the duration of claims, average payouts, and whether a no-fault compensation fund should be studied. The minister points to the Wcz complaints bill, a deelgeschilprocedure, legal aid rules, and refuses to examine a no-fault system, keeping the existing fault-based liability regime.
I see no reason to start new initiatives in this area.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit gebied nieuwe initiatieven te starten.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het ADR-systeem (Actief Donorregistratiesysteem) leidt tot meer orgaandonaties (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister how she reacts to research finding that an opt-out donor registration system (ADR) increases post-mortem organ donation, whether she shares those conclusions, how she weighs the reported negative effect on living donation, and what drives the rise in living donors and what measures could raise it further. The minister answers that the evidence is too mixed to justify the infringement on self-determination an ADR would bring, attributes the rise in living donors to improved information, hospital capacity and medical advances, and rejects active government promotion of living donation as undesirable.
I consider the uncertainties about the effects of a system change too great to proceed with a system change.
Ik vind de onzekerheden over de effecten van een systeemwijziging te groot om tot een systeemwijziging over te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdovingen door tandartsen (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

MP Kuiken asked the health minister about a TV report showing patients were often not informed of anaesthetic side effects by dentists and that medical histories were not reliably taken, and asked about data, WGBO compliance, drug choice and inspection. The minister agreed this is worrying, pointed to inspection of anamnesis, promised to explore mandatory signage in waiting rooms on dentists' qualifications, and said inspection capacity is being expanded.
After consultation with the Inspector-General, I have decided to expand the inspectorate's capacity for this care domain.
Heb ik na overleg met de Inspecteur-Generaal besloten de capaciteit bij de inspectie voor dit zorgdomein uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over internetapotheken (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether online pharmacies and Pfizer's ilivi website, which route repeat prescriptions online, breach the Medicines Act (art. 67) and whether the law should be tightened. The minister answers that the ilivi site refers patients to their own doctor and a legal pharmacy, that the Thuisapotheek may be accepted if it complies with the rules, and that a 2011 policy agenda on counterfeit medicines and an awareness campaign are planned.
If it turns out that any pharmacy does not comply with the legal rules, I will take measures.
Indien blijkt dat welke apotheek dan ook zich niet aan de wettelijke regels houdt, zal ik maatregelen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Bruins-Slot (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mediazuil in de isoleercel (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether TV in isolation cells in mental health care prolongs seclusion, whether it creates unwanted stimuli, how it relates to earlier sanitation problems, and whether the free-of-charge arrangement with a manufacturer is normal. The minister says the effect on seclusion duration is unknown but will be evaluated, that TV is a quality instrument to reduce deprivation and boredom, and that purchasing terms are the institution's own responsibility.
At present it is not known whether the media column affects the length of stay in seclusion.
Vooralsnog is niet bekend of de mediazuil gevolgen heeft voor de duur van het verblijf in de separeer.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de strenge regels die gesteld worden aan bezoekers van voetbalwedstrijden (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the minister about strict rules for football visitors, including a mandatory car-combi ticket in Heerenveen, reports that stadium bans are being overturned by courts, and a new anti-hooliganism approach. The minister answered that the transport measure is a local mayoral decision based on prior incidents, that the KNVB reported only seven court losses in two seasons on stadium bans, and that a Veiligheid en Justitie policy framework and a sports action plan are in preparation.
The Ministry of Security and Justice is working with representatives from the national football and safety steering group on a renewed policy framework titled Football and Safety.
Het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie werkt samen met de vertegenwoordigers uit de landelijke regiegroep voetbal en veiligheid aan een vernieuwd beleids-kader, getiteld Voetbal en Veiligheid.

Only metadata is provided for this answer to MPs Bruins Slot and Verburg on cooperation between companies, entrepreneurs and top athletes; the body of the questions and answers is not included. The content of the answer therefore cannot be assessed beyond its title and publication details.
Answer to questions from Bruins Slot and Verburg on cooperation between companies, entrepreneurs and top athletes
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Verburg over samenwerking tussen bedrijven, ondernemers en topsporters
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Nederlanders Belgische organen wegkapen (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about reports that Dutch patients receive Belgian organ transplants, including how many, why, whether Belgian patients wait longer, and whether Dutch rules should change. The minister answered that 28 Dutch-resident patients received transplants in Belgium in 2010, that the choice reflects EU cross-border care and proximity, and that the national foundation NTS and Eurotransplant allocate organs without nationality data; she declined to commit to new talks, pointing to earlier answers on the ADR system.
Eurotransplant does not register nationality, but it does register which country donors and recipients come from.
Eurotransplant registreert geen nationaliteit, maar registreert uit welk land donoren en ontvangers afkomstig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan orgaandonoren (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of organ donors, Belgian versus Dutch donor rates, improving donation conversations with relatives, the role of hospital donation officials under the Organ Donation Act, and physician training. The minister said donor rates are about 13 per million in the Netherlands, that hospital protocols and officials are largely in place but need better training, and that the government will review a successful NTS project and report in its progress letter.
As indicated in the progress letter, I will examine together with the NTS whether and how the successful approach from the project can be broadly implemented.
Zoals aangegeven in de stand van zakenbrief zal ik samen met de NTS bekijken of en hoe de succesvolle aanpak uit het project breed kan worden geïmplementeerd.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Health about how Dutch support for EU initiatives on nanoparticle traceability and labelling should be read, and what other EU countries are doing on a reporting obligation. The minister answered that the Netherlands favours a uniform EU approach, describing a Belgian-presidency discussion without conclusions and a draft labelling provision in the food information regulation, and noted that France alone has a national registration requirement, whose compatibility with EU law remains uncertain.
The Netherlands is in favour of a uniform European approach to the traceability of nanoparticles in products.
Nederland is een voorstander van een uniforme Europese aanpak ten aanzien van traceerbaarheid van nanodeeltjes in producten.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over «onafhankelijke» vergelijkingssites voor zorgverzekeringen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister whether comparison site Independer gives preferential treatment to insurers paying commission, whether it discloses its funders, and how reliable information on health insurance comparison sites can be promoted, including via the NZa. The minister replied that Independer's conduct is supervised by the AFM, that the term 'independent' is not defined in law but will be reconsidered, that the NZa oversees insurers' information and has rated comparison sites since 2007, and that the market should otherwise be left to decide.
No, I leave this to the market.
Nee, dit laat ik over aan de markt.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een substantieel deel van de ziekenhuisbestuurders in 2009 meer verdiende dan de Balkenendenorm en het door de

An MP asks the health minister about reports that many hospital executives earned more in 2009 than the Balkenende norm and the sector's own maximum income. The minister says the sector code only applies to new contracts, that the Balkenende norm is unsuitable for the sector, and that the pay-cap legislation is with parliament and the motion will be handled during its debate.
The motion can be taken up during the debate on the bill.
De motie zal bij de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel aan de orde kunnen komen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over preventie via de site gezondheidsrisicotest.nl (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about the gezondheidsrisicotest.nl preventive self-test, its scientific validity, the EUR 19.95 fee, its legality under the WBO, and the Prescan total-body scan. The minister said the Gezondheidsraad found the test unsuitable for the general population, that the test falls outside the WBO licensing rules and the IGZ agrees, and that research funding can be requested from ZonMw while refusing basic-package coverage until effectiveness is shown.
The risk test is therefore not subject to a licence requirement under the WBO. The IGZ supports this position.
De risicotest is dus niet vergunningplichtig conform de WBO. De IGZ steunt dit standpunt.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de chaos bij de spermabank (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about chaos at sperm banks frustrating children's searches for their donors, including lost donor records and how donor data are now administered. The minister answered that pre-2004 records were partly destroyed and cannot be recovered, that the foundation SDKB manages post-2004 records satisfactorily, and that only 11 of 74 pre-2004 requests could be honoured.
Unfortunately it is not possible to recover these destroyed data.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om deze vernietigde gegevens alsnog te achterhalen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het KNMG-concept standpunt over de rol van de arts bij het zelfgekozen levenseinde (ingezonden 5

An MP asked the health minister about the KNMG draft position on the doctor's role in assisted dying, including whether it conflicts with the medical-classification requirement for unbearable suffering set by the Supreme Court and whether it confuses doctors. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed because consultation with the Justice ministry is not complete, and promises them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that further consultation with the Ministry of Security and Justice on answering the questions has not yet been able to take place.
De reden van het uitstel is dat nadere afstemming met het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie over de beantwoording van de vragen nog niet heeft kunnen plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vergroten van de Lotto-inkomsten voor de sport (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the state lottery's push to involve sports clubs in growing lottery revenue is desirable and lawful, and whether sport's dependence on gambling money is acceptable, including questions on illegal online sports betting and betting on in-match events. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers are delayed because much of the matter falls under the justice state secretary and interdepartmental consultation takes time.
a significant part of the questions falls under the responsibility of the state secretary of Security and Justice
een belangrijk gedeelte van de vragen behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken. Landbouw en Innovatie over innovatie en nieuwe medische behandelingen (ing

An MP asks the ministers of Health and Economic Affairs about delays in drug approval in the Netherlands, why companies conduct clinical trials abroad, and how to speed access to innovative treatments for rare diseases. The government has only sent an interim notice stating that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because gathering the information takes more time.
I will send you the answers to the parliamentary questions as soon as possible.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk de antwoorden op de kamervragen doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de reclames van de zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurer advertising (Zekur, Promovendum, VGZ, Independer), including whether ads are misleading, acceptance duty, risk equalisation and independence claims. The minister answered that insurers may shape their own marketing within legal limits, that the NZa and AFM supervise information provision, and declined to refer the Zekur ad to the Advertising Code Commission.
It is up to insurers to decide whether and how much money they spend on advertising.
Het is aan verzekeraars om te bepalen of en hoeveel geld ze aan reclame besteden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dierziekten zich via bloedtransfusies kunnen verspreiden (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that zoonoses such as Q fever and hepatitis E can spread via blood transfusions, asking about prevalence, costs for blood banks, the health risk, and whether donors are tested for zoonoses. The minister's reply is only a holding notice: the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline due to the need to consult involved organisations, and they will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Thieme (PvdD) about the report that animal diseases can spread via blood transfusions (submitted 17 December 2010) cannot, regrettably, be answered within the usual deadline.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Thieme (PvdD) over het bericht dat dierziekten zich via bloedtransfusies kunnen verspreiden (ingezonden 17 december 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van tegemoetkoming en ziektekosten door het Centraal Administratie Kantoor (CAK) (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

An MP asked why the CAK delayed paying out Wtcg tegemoetkomingen and eigen risico compensation, and whether telephone access was adequate. The minister explained the delay came from missing bank account numbers requiring 700,000 response cards, that about 130,000 payments were still outstanding in mid-January, and that the CAK expanded phone capacity and will scale up front-office staffing in peak periods.
The CAK has taken various actions to guarantee telephone accessibility.
Het CAK heeft verschillende acties ondernomen om de telefonische bereikbaarheid te garanderen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over onnodige dierproeven voor toxicologisch onderzoek (ingezon

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers whether multi-generation animal toxicity studies can be abandoned, citing the OECD proposal for a replacement method, and asks about the number of such studies and the government's position in the EU. The minister only acknowledges receipt and announces that the answers will be delayed by consultation with third parties, without substantive answers.
The reason for the delay is that the necessary consultation with third parties requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de benodigde afstemming met derden meer tijd vraagt.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over babysterfte (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

Dijkstra (D66) asks the health minister why the promised reimbursement of the preconception (kinderwens) consult for all pregnant women was withdrawn, on what criteria pilots will be judged, and why the government departs from an advisory group's target of 200 fewer avoidable infant deaths within five years. Minister Schippers answers that prevention will focus on risk groups, pilots will assess the consult's added value, and she declines to set numerical targets, while citing a near-halving of infant mortality in ten years.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, I primarily want to focus on risk groups in the information provided about pregnancy and birth.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven wil ik mij bij de voorlichting rondom zwangerschap en geboorte primair richten op risicogroepen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van Penthotal bij euthanasie (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether Penthotal, used in euthanasia, should be reimbursed under the basic insurance package and whether it should be added to the drug reimbursement system. The minister apologised for the delay, said the drug should be treated as part of the insured euthanasia care, and planned to add it to the GVS after asking the CVZ for advice, expected in early 2011.
Because this drug is medically regarded as a generally accepted part of the euthanasia treatment, its use should be classed as part of the insured entitlement.

Omdat dit geneesmiddel in medische zin als een algemeen aanvaard onderdeel van de euthanasiebehandeling wordt gezien, dient deze toepassing ervan aangemerkt te worden als onderdeel van de verzekerde aanspraak.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toegenomen geneesmiddelengebruik onder kinderen en jongeren (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister about rising prescription medicine use among children and young people, its guidelines, medical training, and industry responsibility for paediatric research. The minister called the rise partly positive, said the Inspectorate may be asked to investigate diagnosis, left guidelines to professional groups, noted paediatric drug research programmes, and committed to set up a ZonMw programme.
I am considering asking the Health Care Inspectorate to carry out targeted research in this area.
Ik overweeg om de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg te vragen op dit terrein gericht onderzoek te gaan doen.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebruik van Ritalin (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about a study showing non-prescribed Ritalin use, claimed addiction rates, the risks of easy prescribing, and whether stricter criteria or an investigation will follow. The minister acknowledges the study but says its sample cannot support the 15% addiction claim, states the CBG judges the risk-benefit balance positive with monitoring underway, and commits to asking the profession about prescribing behaviour with the IGZ and to an investigation if warranted.
I will, in consultation with the Health Care Inspectorate, ask the professional group about prescribing behaviour and have an investigation carried out if there is reason to do so.
Ik zal in overleg met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg de beroepsgroep vragen naar het voorschrijfgedrag en indien hiertoe aanleiding bestaat een onderzoek laten doen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister for measurable, verifiable targets behind the government's plan to freeze the group eligible for the health care allowance (zorgtoeslag). The minister answered that only the budgetary targets in the coalition agreement's financial annex apply, that eligibility figures for 2011 can only be established later, and that accountability will follow the regular cycle.
There is no target in the coalition agreement regarding the number of health care allowance users.
Er staat geen doel in het regeerakkoord ten aanzien van het aantal zorgtoeslaggebruikers.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet intends to expand market competition in curative care, and for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, milestones and accountability arrangements for that goal. The minister confirmed a package of measures (wider free pricing, uniform product definitions, abolishing functional funding, profit distribution under conditions, the Wet Marktordening Gezondheidszorg) and promised letters in early 2011, with half-yearly progress reports to parliament.
I aim to address, in early 2011 letters, the goals, instruments and means regarding the cabinet agenda on market forces in curative care and performance-based funding.
Ik streef er naar om begin 2011 in genoemde brieven in te gaan op de doelen, instrumenten en middelen met betrekking tot de kabinetsagenda rondom marktwerking in de cure en prestatiebekostiging.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

Six opposition MPs asked ministers for measurable, checkable targets for abolishing the numerus fixus in medicine, including student numbers, interim goals and accountability. The government confirmed the coalition agreement's five-year abolition plan but deferred the concrete indicators, targets and instruments to a later response to the advisory council's report.
The response to the RVZ advice will further address the elaboration of the coalition agreement.
In de reactie op het advies van de RVZ zal nader worden ingegaan op de uitwerking van het regeerakkoord.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabine

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet will move conditions with low disease burden out of the basic health insurance package, and asked for measurable, accountable targets, definitions, baselines, interim goals and accountability arrangements. The minister confirmed removal from the basic package to save 1.3 billion euros from 2015, said the government does not decide what supplementary insurers cover, and promised a plan of action in early 2012 while giving no interim targets and only general accountability through the regular cycle.
Not at this moment. The low-disease-burden approach requires further elaboration.
Op dit moment niet. De benadering via het lage-ziektelastcriterium vereist nadere uitwerking.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitspraken van de FIFA-voorzitter, de heer Blatter, met betrekking tot homoseksuelen in Qatar (ingez

An MP asked ministers whether they would confront FIFA over FIFA president Blatter's remarks that gay people in Qatar should abstain from sex, and whether Qatar should protect all players and fans regardless of sexual orientation during the World Cup. The government condemned the remarks, said Blatter apologised and that it saw no need to confront him further, while Dutch efforts to get Qatar to decriminalise homosexuality continue, and answered yes on the protection question.
I believe he has distanced himself sufficiently from his statement.
Ik vind dat hij daarmee voldoende afstand heeft genomen van zijn uitspraak.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitspraken van FIFA-baas Blatter over homo’s in Qatar (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

The PVV MP De Mos asks the health minister whether she knows of FIFA president Blatter's remarks that gay people in Qatar should abstain from sex, whether she agrees this harms gay rights, and whether she will ask Blatter or the KNVB for clarification. The minister confirms awareness of the report and refers to earlier answers given to MP Dijkstra, without restating substance.
See my answer to question 2 from MP Dijkstra.
Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Dijkstra.
Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over 1 miljard kosten voor lobbyen in de zorg (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Van der Veen and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about a study claiming over one billion euros of public money is spent on lobbying in healthcare, and whether toezichthouders are outmatched in information by intermediary organisations. The minister replied that the study mapped information flows rather than lobbying spend, that about 60% of the money goes to supervisory and government agencies, and that she sees no reason to assume patient interests are harmed.
The study aimed to establish which information flows exist between the various organisations active in healthcare that do not themselves deliver direct patient care.
Het onderzoek had ten doel vast te stellen welke informatiestromen er bestaan tussen de diverse organisaties die wel in de zorg actief zijn, maar zich niet bezig houden met directe patiëntenzorg.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een zwarte lijst van rookhoreca (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that smoking persists in about half of cafés and discos, the inspection capacity and fines issued, and why no bar has been prosecuted, requesting a directive for automatic criminal proceedings after repeated fines. The minister says enforcement will be intensified through administrative fines, reports the inspection figures, and declines criminal prosecution as too resource-intensive.
The nVWA will intensively enforce the smoking ban in hospitality where the smoking ban continues to apply.
De nVWA zal het rookverbod in de horeca waar het rookverbod blijft gelden intensief handhaven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de DBC-financiering in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

MP Leijten asks the minister why the NZa regulation ignores the Van Gerven motion on DBC financing for independent mental health providers, and about privacy risks from diagnosis data being sent to insurers and reversibly pseudonymised in the DIS. The minister says the decentralised insurer commitment fits the motion, that the NZa must issue a new decision after the CBb ruling, and that the DIS data are pseudonymised with limited access.

In this decision the NZa must, on the instruction of the CBb, either demonstrate the necessity that diagnosis information reaches insurers via persons not bound by medical confidentiality, or limit the circle of persons receiving it to protect medical personal data.
In dit besluit moet de NZa in opdracht van het CBb hetzij de noodzaak aantonen dat de diagnose-informatie bij verzekeraars onder ogen komt van personen voor wie geen medisch beroepsgeheim geldt
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitvoeren van onnodige operaties door artsen (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about large variation in treatment between doctors, whether it reflects care quality, its causes, how to reduce it, and whether hospital financing rewards unnecessary operations. The minister said variation is partly legitimate but unwanted when unexplained, placed primary responsibility on providers, pointed to transparency programmes, a planned quality institute and a move to DOT financing, and declined to institutionalise benchmarking herself.
I see an important role here for health insurers but also for the doctors and hospital organisations themselves.
Ik zie hier een belangrijke rol voor de zorgverzekeraars maar ook voor de medici en ziekenhuisorganisaties zelf.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de opvang van apen die als proefdier zijn gebruikt door de Universiteit Utrecht (inge

An MP asks ministers whether the University of Utrecht's decision to end monkey experiments is known, what will happen to the five remaining monkeys (including euthanasia as an option), whether animal shelter AAP will take them, and what the government plans for care of research animals. The minister confirms the facts, says AAP is willing to take the monkeys subject to expert approval the university is responsible for, and points to the upcoming EU directive implementation with the decision on post-experiment fate left to the veterinarian.
The board has indicated that it wishes to place the animals with the AAP foundation.
Het bestuur heeft aangegeven de dieren te willen onderbrengen bij de stichting AAP.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een onderzoeksjournalist die medische gegevens van een voetballer van AZ heeft verkregen (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

Voortman asked the minister about a journalist obtaining a footballer's medical data from a hospital employee, and what safeguards exist for EPD leaks, the human factor, hacker testing, patient access, objection numbers and access logs. Minister Schippers answered at length, describing sanctions, technical protections, pending access improvements and planned patient notifications, without addressing the specific leak beyond noting it was local hospital data.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de significante stijging van het aantal HIV-infecties bij homoseksuele mannen in Nederland (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the health minister how she would respond to a 2010 monitoring report showing HIV infections among gay men in the Netherlands at a level above the 1980s peak, and whether she would commit to targeted prevention campaigns, outreach at STI clinics and immediate treatment of those testing positive. The minister's reply is only a holding notice saying the answers will be provided as soon as possible because consultation with several parties is needed.
The questions from MP Dijkstra (D66) on the significant rise in HIV infections among gay men in the Netherlands (submitted 26 November 2010) cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Dijkstra (D66) over de significante stijging van het aantal hiv-infecties bij homoseksuele mannen in Nederland (ingezonden 26 november 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bestrijdingsmiddelen in pangavis (ingezonden 23 decemb

An MP asks ministers whether pesticides banned for consumer products in the EU (chlorpyrifos, trifluralin) can be present in imported pangasius, how the EU checks Vietnamese exporters, whether EU residue standards should be accelerated, how detected levels compare to existing norms, and the status of a motion on ASC-certified pangasius. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed and provided as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that we need more time for internal and external consultation to answer the questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat wij meer tijd nodig hebben voor in- en extern overleg voor de beantwoording van de vragen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het initiatief van het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMCG) om een besloten vennootschap (bv) voor

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether the UMCG setting up a BV for non-insured aesthetic plastic surgery is appropriate for an academic hospital, and whether it worsens waiting lists. The minister replied that the hospital decides its own service mix, the BV only separates administration and finances, staff salaries are unchanged, and the Treek waiting-time norms are aspirational, with no new action promised.
It is up to the UMCG itself to determine which types of treatment it offers and in which organisational form these treatments take place.
Het is aan het UMCG zelf om te bepalen welk type behandelingen ze aanbiedt en in welke organisatievorm deze behandeling plaatsheeft.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ritalin als partydrug (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Ritalin is increasingly used as a party drug and obtained illegally online, citing an IVO study. The minister answers that the study sample was non-random and not representative, that prevalence is unclear, that the minister sees no reason for further research, and that Ritalin is mainly obtained through friends, so only monitoring and existing information instruments will be used.
Although it concerns me that Ritalin is used improperly, the outcomes of the above-mentioned studies are for me no reason for further research.
Hoewel het mij zorgen baart dat Ritalin oneigenlijk wordt gebruikt vormen de uitkomsten van bovenvermelde onderzoeken voor mij geen aanleiding tot nader onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de alcoholpoli's in Eindhoven en Veldhoven moeten sluiten (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether alcohol clinics in Eindhoven and Veldhoven must close and how insurer CZ funds care for young people admitted with alcohol coma, and whether the clinics will stay open until effectiveness results are known. The minister said talks between parties are ongoing, that CZ does not intend to stop funding, that the pilot has ended with results published, and that a multidisciplinary implementation track will follow.
The parties are still in discussion with each other. I therefore cannot answer this question.
Partijen zijn nog met elkaar in gesprek. Ik kan deze vraag dus niet beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dreigende sluiting van de kinderalcoholpoli in Eindhoven (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

MP Bouwmeester asks the health minister about the threatened closure of the Eindhoven child alcohol clinic, whether structural funding will be provided, and the government's youth alcohol policy. The minister says regional coverage is not set by the ministry, that short-term subsidy was granted with structural financing to be explored within premium-funded care, and that alcohol prevention will be addressed in forthcoming legislation and policy notes.
Structural financing from the VWS budget is not on the table, because budget money is never used to finance care costs.
Structurele financiering uit het VWS-budget is niet aan de orde, omdat uit begrotingsgeld nimmer zorgkosten worden gefinancierd.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het patiëntenonderzoek van de (Nederlandse Patiënten Consumenten Federatie (NPCF) (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether she shares alarm at an NPCF patient survey finding that two-thirds of patients reported communication failures and inadequate aftercare after medical errors, and what she will do about it. The minister says she is shocked, will discuss with the sector how to improve communication and patient-centred care under the VMS safety programme, and points to progress made and new instruments such as the GOMA code.
Yes, within the VMS safety programme I will discuss with the relevant field parties how they take their responsibility.
Ja, ik zal in het kader van het VMS veiligheidsprogramma met de betrokken veldpartijen bespreken hoe zij hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Rijnland Ziekenhuis de operatiekamers uit Alphen aan den Rijn wil wegbezuinigen (ingezonden 26 november 20

An SP MP asks the health minister whether Rijnland Hospital will close operating theatres in Alphen aan den Rijn and how this relates to imposed budget cuts. The minister answers that the hospital has its own reasons (costly temporary staff), that access within 45 minutes is not endangered, and that the 549 million cut was reduced to 314 million.
I have no opinion on the internal business operations of a hospital.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de interne bedrijfsvoering van een ziekenhuis.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het ADR-systeem (Actief Donorregistratiesysteem) leidt tot meer orgaandonaties (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a study claiming the Dutch active donor registration system (ADR) increases post-mortem organ donation, and whether this affects living donors. The minister only announces a delay, promising answers later without addressing any question on substance.
The questions from MP Dijkstra (D66) about the report that the ADR system leads to more organ donations cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Dijkstra (D66) over het bericht dat het ADR-systeem (Actief Donorregistratiesysteem leidt tot meer orgaandonaties kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Health about how the Dutch position opposing a national reporting obligation for nanoparticles, while supporting European Commission initiatives, should be understood, and which other EU states are taking initiatives on such a reporting duty. The government's reply is only a notice that the answers are delayed because of interdepartmental coordination and will follow as soon as possible.
The questions of MP Gesthuizen (SP) on nanoparticles in food cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Gesthuizen (SP) over nano-deeltjes in voedingsmiddelen kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over plannen van een zorgondernemer om obligaties uit te geven (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a care entrepreneur issuing bonds to attract private capital, whether this anticipates unfinished cabinet plans on private capital and profit distribution in care, and how this fits the minister's statement that care is not a market. The minister replies that bonds carry interest and repayment rights but no profit distribution or control, so the plans do not anticipate cabinet policy, while signalling that profit distribution for medical specialist care will be allowed with conditions.
It is up to care providers themselves to make choices about how they want to finance investments.
Het is aan zorgaanbieders zelf om keuzes te maken in de wijze waarop zij investeringen willen financieren.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een grote groep jongens die jarenlang niets doet, stopt met studeren, en de hele dag doorbrengt met drinken, blowen en game

An MP asks the health minister about a large group of young men who drop out of study and spend their days drinking, using cannabis and gaming, including questions on parental guidance and youth substance prevention. The minister says such behaviour is not acceptable, points to school dropout and student support measures and existing prevention programmes, and promises a national health policy note in 2011 without committing to new specific measures.
It is not normal for young people to stop studying or working and spend the whole day drinking, smoking weed and gaming.
Het is niet normaal als jongeren stoppen met studeren of werken en de hele dag doorbrengen met drinken, blowen en gamen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de integrale bekostiging van zorg aan chronisch zieken (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

Two MPs asked the health minister about a Utrecht court ruling in the Meditta versus Achmea dispute on integrated funding of chronic-care programmes, its effect on care chains, and the financing uncertainty facing care groups. The minister said the ruling does not change policy, that the transitional rules allow separate-service billing, and that evaluation results are expected early next year.
I hope the ruling provides the necessary clarity so that care providers and insurers can reach agreement on funding integrated care in the near future.
Ik hoop dat het vonnis de nodige duidelijkheid geeft op basis waarvan zorgaanbieders en verzekeraars in de nabije toekomst tot overeenstemming kunnen komen over de bekostiging van integrale zorg.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een mogelijke ziekenhuisfusie in Oost-Groningen (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister for her view on a proposed merger of Refaja hospital and the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep, whether evaluations of past hospital mergers exist, whether a temporary merger moratorium will be declared, and whether a merger would preserve care provision. The minister said the merger is a matter for the hospitals and insurers, noted the Delfzijl emergency department is needed for 45-minute access, said no evaluation exists, pointed to a stricter merger policy with a care-specific merger test, and offered to propose more small-scale care in March 2011.
No, I do not have an evaluation of hospital mergers of recent years and I do not intend to conduct further research into this.
Nee, ik beschik niet over een evaluatie van ziekenhuisfusies van de afgelopen jaren en ben niet voornemens om hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over te veel fysiotherapie voor kinderen (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether too many children are referred to physiotherapy, whether referral figures and guidelines exist, and whether parents' expectations and GP/youth-health roles are addressed. The minister answered that no specific referral figures exist, that guidelines are primarily the profession's task, and that youth health care should inform parents about normal development.
Specific figures on child physiotherapy in (academic) hospitals and referrals to them are not available.
Specifieke cijfers over kinderfysiotherapie in (academische) ziekenhuizen en de verwijzing daarnaar, zijn niet voor handen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gesponsorde pandemie van de Mexicaanse griep (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about claims that the WHO changed the pandemic definition to justify vaccine purchases, about pharmaceutical-industry ties of Gezondheidsraad members, and whether influenza vaccine efficacy should be studied. The minister defends the vaccine purchase as a risk-based decision, says the Gezondheidsraad's conflict-of-interest procedures are sound, and refuses a new study of vaccine efficacy.
