I do think it is important that full transparency is practised in this regard.
Ik vind het wel belangrijk dat hierbij volledige transparantie betracht wordt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de griepvaccinatie (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister for her view on a Zembla broadcast questioning flu vaccine effectiveness, whether double-blind trials are feasible, whether a new trial will be commissioned, and about Health Council conflicts of interest and death registration. The minister disagreed with the broadcast, argued double-blind trials with mortality outcomes are impractical, refused a new trial citing existing studies, and defended current evaluation and communication practices.
No. It is and was known that the current flu vaccine does not fully protect.
Nee. Het is en was bekend dat het huidige griepvaccin niet volledig beschermt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ICT-perikelen van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AZM) (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about cost overruns in the AZM hospital's ICT renewal, its high-earning board, the dismissal of the ICT head, and whether financial pressures threaten care quality and academic functions. The minister repeatedly declined to judge individual hospital spending, pointing to the supervisory board, annual report, works council and insurers as the correcting mechanisms, while promising a future salary-cap law.
It would go too far to set specific rules from The Hague for these kinds of situations.
Het zou te ver gaan om vanuit Den Haag specifieke regels te bepalen over dit soort situaties.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de 66 miljoen euro extra aan ICT-uitgaven in het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AZM) (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Maastricht academic hospital's ICT overspending (66 million euro extra, possibly 132 million by 2013) amounts to mismanagement and whether the minister will act or investigate, including links to planned cuts. The minister declines to judge individual hospital management decisions, states the hospital disputes any overspend, and points to the supervisory board, works council and insurers as the correcting mechanisms.
It would go too far to set specific rules from The Hague for this kind of situation.
Het zou te ver gaan om vanuit Den Haag specifieke regels te bepalen over dit soort situaties.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende ontmanteling van de afdeling immunologie (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister whether the Maastricht academic hospital (AZM) plans to shed clinical immunology and interstitial lung disease, whether patients will have to travel to Groningen, and whether finances are the reason. The minister replies that no decision has been taken, that only two highly specialised conditions with few patients are under review on quality grounds, that the AZM will consult the minister and the NFU before deciding, and that the outstanding motion on financing academic centres is still being implemented.
There is not yet a decision.
Er is nog geen sprake van een besluit.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onderzoek naar vermeende wantoestanden bij een abortuskliniek (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister about reports of mismanagement and possible care quality risks at The Hague abortion clinic PreTerm Rutgers, including oversight of finances and governance. The minister replied that the clinic has applied for suspension of payments, the new board estimates a deficit of about 1.4 million euro, the Inspectorate found that other clinics can absorb its procedures, and therefore no steps will be taken to prevent bankruptcy.
The Ministry of VWS asked the Health Inspectorate (IGz) for advice on the continuity of abortion care in the The Hague region.
VWS heeft de Inspectie voor de Volksgezondheid (IGz) advies gevraagd inzake de continuïteit van de abortushulpverlening in de regio Den Haag

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toegenomen geneesmiddelengebruik onder kinderen en jongeren (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about rising medicine use among children and young people, its cost, guidelines, doctor training, and pharmaceutical industry responsibility for research. The answer received is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because broader coordination is needed.
The questions from MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken (PvdA) on increased medicine use among children and young people cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

De vragen van de Kamerleden Van der Veen en Kuiken (PvdA) over het toegenomen geneesmiddelengebruik onder kinderen en jongeren kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «blowende tiener eerder psychotisch» (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers how they respond to research linking early cannabis use to psychotic symptoms, and whether they will improve prevention, reconsider budget cuts, regulate coffeeshop quality, or allow regulated cultivation experiments. The minister acknowledges the link, promises strengthened school prevention materials, denies known cuts to addiction care, and rejects quality controls and regulated cultivation as incompatible with the current policy and international treaties.
Nevertheless, the guidance that the Healthy School and Substances programme provides on this will be strengthened.
Niettemin zullen de handvatten die het programma De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen hiervoor geeft, worden versterkt.
Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het mogelijk afschaffen van de Wtcg (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

Two MPs asked the health minister whether she is considering abolishing the Wtcg allowance for chronically ill and disabled people, and what replacement would follow. The minister said the scheme needs improvement and will be evaluated after the 2011 payment round, that abolition would only happen with a replacement, and that a new tax deduction for chronic illness costs is not appropriate since the existing fiscal scheme already covers such costs.
I intend to evaluate the scheme after the 2011 payment round.
Ik ben voornemens om de regeling na de uitkeringsronde van 2011 te evalueren.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het initiatief van het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMCG) om een besloten vennootschap (bv) voor

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether the UMCG's plan to set up a private limited company for cosmetic plastic surgery is appropriate for an academic hospital, and how it would avoid draining capacity and lengthening waiting lists for regular care. The minister's reply only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because consultation with several parties is needed, and promises answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that a careful answer to the questions requires consultation with various parties.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen afstemming met diverse partijen noodzakelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medicatieveiligheid, agressie van patiënten en werkdruk van verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about medication safety, aggression against nurses and nursing workload, citing a consumer survey. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to ongoing IGZ research on night and weekend care, reports a fund for training and sector initiatives, but commits to no change in oversight or rules.
As soon as the research results are available, I will inform you.
Zo gauw de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn informeer ik u.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het rapport «De Weet wat je eet Gifmeter Bestrijdin

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the nVWA's 2009 pesticide residue findings on fruit and vegetables, including the risk-based inspection approach, Dutch produce exceeding limits more than imports, and whether the EU limits should follow WHO hazard classifications. The government defended the risk-based approach, said the nVWA audit found no shortcomings, rejected a ban on WHO-classified substances, and noted that the results are published online.
The nVWA's supervision is risk-based, meaning it mainly samples and inspects where exceedances can be expected.
Het toezicht van nVWA is op risico gebaseerd. Dat komt er op neer dat de nVWA vooral daar bemonstert en controleert waar overschrijdingen kunnen worden verwacht.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Meer kids in alcoholcoma» (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MP Van der Staaij asks the health minister how the government will reverse the rising number of under-16s admitted to hospital with alcohol intoxication, and why a third bought alcohol from shops or bars despite the legal age limit. The minister says she will inform parliament soon on the Drank- en Horecawet bill and the prevention policy, and points to transferring age-limit enforcement to municipalities as the main remedy.
I intend to inform your House shortly about the progress of the bill amending the Drink and Catering Act, which contains various measures to tackle alcohol misuse by children and young people.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer op korte termijn te informeren over de voortgang van het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Holland-Belgiumbid voor het Wereld Kampioenschap (WK) 2018 (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about documents released under the Wob on the Holland-Belgium World Cup 2018 bid, why they surfaced late, the bid budget and public versus sponsor funding, and the tax exemption cost. The minister answers that the documents were released under the Wob, that further appeals are pending, that the budget will be settled and sent to parliament in spring, and that cost estimates depend on assumptions.
I am of the view that the subsidy applications are indirectly related to the cabinet decision but do not substantively concern the decision-making itself.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de subsidieaanvragen weliswaar indirect verband houden met het kabinetsbesluit, maar niet inhoudelijk betrekking hebben op de besluitvorming als zodanig.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verschil tussen ziekenhuisomzet en economische groei (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a Gupta report showing hospital revenue growing far faster than GDP, the resulting gap of about 2.5 billion euros, alleged double payments to hospitals, hospital profits, market shares, and whether performance improvement should precede cuts to care use. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the spending framework was not lowered for the crisis, disputed the 300 million euro double-payment figure while admitting some imperfect clean-up, provided profit information via public annual reports, gave partial market data, and promised a cabinet position in February 2011.
Regarding the clean-up of the 2009 B-segment tranche, I had Vektis carry out an indicative investigation.
Over de schoning van de tranche 2009 B-segment heb ik Vektis een indicatief onderzoek laten doen.
Vragen van de leden Straus, Venrooy-van Ark , Mulder en Van der Burg (allen VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorg voor autisten (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

Four VVD MPs asked the health minister about the quality of care for people with autism, including misdiagnosis, separation and long admissions, and whether the government can pressure institutions. The minister acknowledged specialist knowledge is scarce, pointed to good practices and early-detection initiatives, said she cannot directly pressure institutions but the IGZ can investigate complaints, and agreed diagnosis must improve.
I cannot directly exert pressure on institutions to improve care for autistic people. If there are complaints about care, the IGZ can launch an investigation on that basis.
Ik kan niet direct druk uitoefenen op de instellingen om de zorg voor autisten te verbeteren. Als er klachten zijn met betrekking tot de zorg dan kan de IGZ op basis hiervan een onderzoek instellen.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over berichten dat de zorg voor autisten ver onder de maat is (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about reports that care for autistic people is far below standard, including overuse of isolation and separation and misplacement on chronic-care wards. The minister acknowledged the concerns, disputed the 150-separations figure, pointed to a culture change and a knowledge-building initiative, and declined to guarantee that clinicians' autism knowledge would reach the desired level within six months.
I have no insight into the figures on this.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de cijfers hierover.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraar UVIT (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether insurer UVIT's preferential purchasing policy for biological and biosimilar drugs (epo, somatropin, filgrastim) is lawful, safe for patients, and transparent given its undisclosed (onder couvert) tendering. Minister Schippers answered that such policy is permitted, that biosimilars are equivalent in efficacy and safety, that off-label and substitution rules are for doctors and pharmacists, and that she sees no need to end the couvert system, while the question-by-question replies remain largely substantive and reassuring.
Ending the preferential policy under couvert would undo its favourable effects for patients and for competition between health insurers.
Het beëindigen van het preferentiebeleid onder couvert zou de gunstige effecten daarvan voor de patiënten en de concurrentieverhoudingen tussen zorgverzekeraars te niet doen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de totstandkoming van één centrum voor kinderoncologische zorg (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asks the health minister how the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek hospital was chosen as the single children's oncology centre, whether the procedure was transparent, why the UMCs disagree, and what action will be taken. The minister announces that the answers will be delayed because she wishes to obtain further information first.
The questions from MP Van der Veen (PvdA) on the establishment of a single children's oncology care centre cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Van der Veen (PvdA) over de totstandkoming van één centrum voor kinderoncologische zorg kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers whether powdered foods on the Dutch market contain manufactured nanoparticles, whether their health, nature and environmental effects are known, what safety requirements, notification duty, and enforcement apply, and whether a precautionary ban is planned. The government answered that nanosilica (part of E551 silica) occurs in some foods, that its effects are still under study, that it opposes a national notification duty but supports EU labelling, and that it sees no grounds for a ban.
The Netherlands is particularly in favour of labelling nanomaterials in foodstuffs.
Nederland is met name voorstander van het etiketteren van nanomaterialen in voedingsmiddelen.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat volgende maand de eerste allochtonenkliniek opent in A

PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a new clinic in Amsterdam aimed at Turkish-origin patients, which they called discrimination and Islamisation, and whether Agis and oversight bodies would investigate overtreatment. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, said the clinic is open to all, noted Agis's own finding of overtreatment in Turkish clinics, and stated that monitoring is the insurer's task rather than the Inspectorate's.
No, it is the task of the health insurers that conclude care contracts with the clinic to ensure that care is provided efficiently, in line with applicable professional standards.
Nee, het is de taak van de zorgverzekeraars die zorgcontracten afsluiten met de kliniek om er op toe te zien dat de zorg doelmatig – conform geldende professionele standaarden – wordt verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet voldoen aan aanvullende eisen van de FIFA (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether the government had rejected additional FIFA demands for the 2018 World Cup bid, why parliament was not informed earlier, and whether other rejected demands exist. The minister replied that FIFA set no demands beyond the government guarantees, only additional questions which were answered in a letter to parliament, and that no other demands exist.
FIFA has not set demands that go beyond the guarantees provided by the government.
De FIFA heeft geen eisen gesteld die aanvullend zijn op de door de overheid verstrekte garanties

Vragen van het Lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gespreksverslagen en afspraken tussen de beoogde speelsteden en het minister

An SP MP asked the health and interior ministers about meeting minutes and agreements with prospective World Cup host cities, including whether cost-sharing talks were deferred and whether the Dutch state gave FIFA guarantees such as VAT refunds. The minister answered that some documents were withheld under the Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur, that cost issues would be revisited after the bid decision, that no renegotiation or new guarantees would be given, and that no state aid was apparent.
A number of documents were not released on the basis of articles 10 and 11 of the Government Information (Public Access) Act.
Er is een aantal documenten niet vrijgegeven op basis van de artikelen 10 en 11 van de Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bestaan van een wachtlijst voor klinische opnamen van het Landelijk GGZ-centrum De Riethorst

An MP asks the minister about a waiting list for inpatient beds at De Riethorst for deaf and hard-of-hearing patients, and why it arose despite approved expansion. The minister confirms the waiting list, attributes it to delayed realisation of 10 approved beds by Pro Persona (partly because the insurer will not contract in advance), and says the institution is deciding how to proceed.
Pro Persona must implement the plan to realise the approved places.
Pro Persona dient uitvoering te geven aan het plan om de goedgekeurde plaatsen te realiseren.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kwaliteitsnormen voor borstkankerzorg (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether multiple competing quality-norm lists for breast cancer care (from CZ, the patient association and specialists) are desirable, which norms patients should follow, whether CZ acted carefully in contracting hospitals, and whether scientific norms should be the sole standard. The minister answered that quality norms are the responsibility of providers and professional groups, that insurers may set contracting criteria, that patients choose providers, and that CZ's list was revised after hospital checks, though it may have caused confusion.
Care providers are primarily responsible themselves for determining what good and responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat goede en verantwoorde zorg is.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de betrokkenheid van het ministerie bij de benoeming van Professor Vierhout tot directeur van de ziekenhuiz

SP MPs asked the health minister whether her ministry, former minister Klink and a Zeeland deputy were involved in the appointment of Professor Vierhout as chair of the Admiraal de Ruyter hospital board, and about the cost of his advice and the Walcheren hospital. The minister denied any ministerial involvement, called the appointment a matter for the hospital itself, and promised a letter on Zeeland hospital care in early December 2010.
There has been no involvement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport in the appointment of Professor Vierhout as chair of the Board of Directors of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital (ADRZ).

Er is geen sprake geweest van betrokkenheid van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport bij de benoeming van professor Vierhout tot voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ).

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het dreigement van de NMa aan samenwerkende thuiszorgorganisaties (ingezonden 2

Parliamentary questions from MP Leijten (SP) ask how the government views the competition authority NMa's threatened fines against home-care organisations for market-sharing, price agreements and rigged tenders, and how this fits with the NZa's tariff and contracting role. The ministers reply that the fines follow clear breaches of the Competition Act, that the NMa is exclusively competent for cartel supervision, that fines flow to the state treasury, and that the sector's rejection of the settlement scheme explains the renewed enforcement.

This, however, should not be understood as a threat, and is not experienced as such, as shown by the contacts the NMa has already had with several home-care organisations about scheduling talks with supervisory boards.

Dit is evenwel niet op te vatten als een dreigement en wordt ook niet als zodanig ervaren blijkens de contacten die de NMa reeds met verscheidene thuiszorgorganisaties heeft gehad rondom het inplannen van gesprekken met raden van toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over alcoholreclame rondom jeugdsport (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether alcohol advertising near youth sports fields, which the 25% minors criterion does not adequately prevent, is acceptable, and whether a ban should be added to the advertising code. The minister replied that the industry should follow its self-regulatory code, saw no evidence of violations, reported that the Reclame Code Commissie had recently ruled against billboards at one club and that they were removed, and rejected statutory measures.
My preference is for self-regulation. Statutory measures are not on the table.
Mijn voorkeur gaat uit naar zelfregulering. Wettelijke maatregelen zijn niet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het rapport «De Weet wat je eet Gifmeter Bestrijdin

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary and the health minister about pesticide residues in fruit and vegetables found in the nVWA 2009 control data, including health risks for young children, enforcement practices around MRL exceedances, imported versus domestic produce, banning substances classified as very hazardous by the WHO, and whether publishing the data should be done by NGOs or the nVWA. The minister's reply is only a postponement notice stating that the answers will follow as soon as possible because more internal and external consultation is needed.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een onderzoek naar de relatie tussen abortussen en prenatale screening bij Downsyndroom (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

The SGP MP asks the health minister about a Stichting Downsyndroom survey suggesting about 90 percent of pregnancies are terminated after a positive prenatal Down syndrome screen, and whether objective information is adequate and what steps have been taken. The minister says the survey is limited, prenatal screening aims to enable informed choices, existing information provision and counselling are sufficient, and no new measures are planned beyond continued attention.
The central body for prenatal screening is having studies done on whether pregnant women indeed make a well-informed choice.
Het centraal orgaan voor prenatale screening laat onderzoeken of zwangeren inderdaad een goed geïnformeerde keuze maken.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het experiment met de SOS-arts dat per 1 januari 2011 van start gaat (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the SOS-arts home-visit experiment starting in 2011 with fees above the regulated GP maximum, questioning its legality, the doctors' qualifications, and whether it creates a two-tier system. The minister answered that the NZa authorised the small-scale experiment under its innovation policy, that qualified GPs work under IGZ quality oversight, and that data will be collected to evaluate price and quality.
I want to ask the NZa to also collect data on this during the experiment, so that once the experimental phase has ended a sound judgement can be made about the price/quality ratio.

Ik wil de NZa vragen om ook tijdens het experiment gegevens hierover te verzamelen, zodat wanneer de experimenteerfase is afgelopen er een gedegen uitspraak kan worden gedaan over de prijs/kwaliteit verhouding.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman van Meppelen-Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Tilburgse raad akkoord met subsidie aan Willem II» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister how a Tilburg council subsidy to football club Willem II relates to a platform of municipalities with professional football clubs, EU state aid rules, and municipal social support obligations under the Wmo. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous and responsible for state aid compliance, that no state aid notification was made, and that the Wmo spending is a local responsibility the minister does not intend to enter.
I consider this a local responsibility in which I do not want and cannot intervene.
Ik vind dit een lokale verantwoordelijkheid waarin ik niet wil en kan treden.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de fusie tussen het Vlietland Ziekenhuis en zorgverzekeraar DSW toch doorgaat (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister how she will prevent the contested merger between Vlietland Hospital and insurer DSW, which the parties say needs no approval from the competition authority, and whether a 2009 motion banning such mergers is being implemented. The minister says the NMa must review any merger requiring transfer of control, that cooperation without a merger falls under cartel supervision, that the coalition agreement announces a ban on insurer-provider mergers, and that a bill will follow as soon as possible.

As long as there is no additional legal instrument, I point out, following my answer to question 2, that the merger between Vlietland Hospital and DSW, if control is transferred, requires a permit from the NMa.

Zolang er geen aanvullend wettelijk instrumentarium is, wijs ik in het verlengde van het antwoord op vraag 2 erop dat de fusie tussen het Vlietland Ziekenhuis en DSW – indien sprake is van het overdragen van zeggenschap – een vergunning van de NMa behoeft.
Vragen van het lid Venrooy-van Ark (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten (Wtcg) (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports of confusion over Wtcg payments, including whether the eligibility criteria for the chronic illness and disability allowance reach the right people and whether the 2010 implementation warrants re-evaluation. The minister confirms awareness, explains the original criteria and the 2009 Taskforce revisions that were largely adopted, and says she will inventory options and report to the Chamber in February 2011.
In February 2011 I will inform the Chamber, in the fourth Wtcg progress report, about the course of the current payment round and Wtcg-relevant policy developments.
In februari 2011 zal ik – in de vierde Wtcg-voortgangsrapportage – de Kamer informeren over het verloop van de huidige uitkeringsronde en Wtcg-relevante beleidsontwikkelingen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over nanodeeltjes in voedingsmiddelen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers whether nanoparticles are added to powdered foods sold in the Netherlands, whether their health, nature and environmental effects are unknown, what requirements and notification duty apply, how supervision works, and whether they will ban such additions as a precaution. The answer is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline due to interdepartmental coordination, with answers to follow as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that interdepartmental coordination requires more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de interdepartementale afstemming meer tijd vergt.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat bierbrouwer met borden langs sportvelden eigen reclamecode

Two SP MPs asked the health and youth ministers whether beer advertising boards along sports fields at a Utrecht club breach the alcohol advertising code, given that a quarter of those present were minors, and whether the government will tighten oversight and make the 25% rule statutory. Minister Schippers answered that the matter is for the Reclame Code Commissie and self-regulation, that she sees no formal role for the ministry, and that she is not willing to convert the code into law.
This concerns self-regulation, in which the Minister of VWS has no formal role.
Het betreft hier zelfregulering, waarbij de minister van VWS geen formele rol heeft.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat doorschenken aan dronken gasten in horecagelegenheden vaak voorkomt en onbestraft blijft (ingezonden

MP Voordewind asks the health minister about a study showing that bartenders often serve already-drunk patrons without penalty, and asks whether enforcement of the ban (art. 252 Sr) is adequate, whether capacity exists, and whether licences should be revoked after repeated violations. The minister answers that police enforce the ban, the nVWA lacks capacity, sanctions are for the Public Prosecution Service and municipalities, and a wider national study and new public information are not planned.
Soon I will inform your House about the progress of the bill amending the Drink and Catering Act.
Binnenkort zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de in Den Haag voorgestelde allochtonenstop voor het amateurvoetbal (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Van Dekken and Arib asked the health minister about a proposed temporary ban on ethnic minority (allochtone) members in Hague amateur football, asking whether it is discriminatory, its effect on youth participation, and what action the government will take on violence in clubs. The minister replied that the plan had been withdrawn, that the problem affects members of all backgrounds, that the government funds anti-violence and refereeing programmes, and that she will decide on further steps after reviewing their results.
The plan for a temporary ban on allochtone members in Hague amateur football, due partly to membership fee arrears, has now been withdrawn.
Het plan voor een tijdelijke allochtonenstop binnen het Haagse amateurvoetbal in verband met ondermeer contributieachterstanden is inmiddels ingetrokken.
Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verschil tussen ziekenhuisomzet en economische groei (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about the gap between hospital revenue growth and GDP, the cost drivers, a reported double payment of 300 million euros, hospital profits and market shares, and a plan for performance improvement. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because the hospital data analysis takes more time.
The reason for the delay is that answering requires more time for the analysis of hospital data on costs and market share.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor de beantwoording de analyse van ziekenhuisdata over de kosten en het marktaandeel meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verkoop van geneesmiddelen via internet (ingezonden 25 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about poor over-the-counter medicine advice in drugstores and pharmacies, whether internet sales of OTC and prescription medicines like tramadol should be restricted, and about inspection and enforcement. The minister acknowledges weak advice, says the cash-register check is not mandatory, sees no need for a study of drugstore websites, and says the inspectorate acts where it can, including border checks.
Sale of prescription medicines other than through internet sites meeting the applicable requirements is, unlike the sale of AV and UAD medicines, in my view a major risk to public health.

7 Antwoord 8 Verkoop van UR geneesmiddelen anders dan via internetsites die aan de hiervoor geldende eisen 8 voldoen, acht ik, in tegenstelling tot de verkoop van AV en UAD middelen, een groot risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Vragen van het lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vermeende corruptie bij de FIFA (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary of health, welfare and sport about alleged corruption in the FIFA bidding committee for the 2018 and 2022 World Cups, including whether Dutch-Belgian bid contacts were approached improperly and whether the government still trusts the Dutch bid. The minister confirms awareness of the reports, says no improper proposals were received during the delegation's visit, expects FIFA to resolve the matter, and declines to draw conclusions or contact FIFA before the December 2010 vote.
I assume that FIFA will get to the bottom of this matter and ensure that the elections for awarding the 2018 and 2022 World Cups are conducted with integrity.
Ik ga er van uit dat de FIFA deze zaak tot op de bodem uitzoekt en er voor zorgt dat de verkiezingen voor de toewijzing van het WK 2018 en 2022 integer verlopen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet voldoen aan aanvullende eisen van de FIFA (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether the government rejected additional FIFA demands for the Dutch World Cup bid, why parliament was not informed earlier, and whether other demands were rejected. The state secretary replies only that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because of coordination with other ministries, and promises them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is coordination with other departments.
De reden van het uitstel is afstemming met andere departementen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet voldoen aan aanvullende eisen van de FIFA (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether the government had rejected additional FIFA demands for the 2018/2022 World Cup bid, why parliament was not informed earlier, and whether other rejected demands exist. The minister replied that the questions could not be answered within the usual deadline due to consultation with other departments, and promised answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is consultation with other departments.
De reden van het uitstel is afstemming met andere departementen.

Vragen van het Lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gespreksverslagen en afspraken tussen de beoogde speelsteden en het minister

Opposition MPs (Leijten, SP, and Van Dekken, PvdA) ask ministers about meeting reports and agreements with prospective host cities on the World Cup bid, cost-sharing with the national government, possible state aid and FIFA conditions, and advertising law. The government only sends a notice that the answers will be delayed because other departments must be consulted and promises to answer as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is consultation with other departments.
De reden van het uitstel is afstemming met andere departementen.

Vragen van het Lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gespreksverslagen en afspraken tussen de beoogde speelsteden en het minister

An SP MP asks ministers about minutes and agreements with prospective host cities for the 2018 World Cup bid, including cost-sharing, cost estimates, FIFA's additional demands, possible state aid and anti-counterfeiting law. The answer is only an interim notice: the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because of consultation with other departments, and answers will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MPs Leijten (SP) and Van Dekken (PvdA) cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van de Kamerleden Leijten (SP) ... kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake de intensive care zorg in Vlissingen (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

The MP asks the minister about reports that Vlissingen will lose its intensive care unit, whether the hospital board's plans comply with a parliamentary motion to keep a small full-service hospital on Walcheren, and about the promised RIVM ambulance response-time study. The minister confirms awareness, says the proposed IC facility is not a level 1 unit, states a preference for a small full hospital on Walcheren with a business case demanded from ADRZ, and promises the ambulance analysis within two weeks.
I will send you the outcomes of this analysis within two weeks.
Ik zal u de uitkomsten van deze analyse binnen twee weken doen toekomen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de negatieve effecten van Indiaas OK-personeel (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about burdens on surgeons, language and cultural problems, costs and quality of care linked to Indian operating-theatre assistants recruited by Dutch hospitals, and whether recruitment should be banned as neocolonial. The minister replied that hospitals do not see major problems, that extra training is time rather than money, that hospitals follow the mandatory collective agreement, that quality is the boards' responsibility overseen by the IGZ, and that she sees no reason for a ban, relying on the WHO code and a planned training fund.
I see no reason to prohibit the recruitment of Indian operating-theatre assistants.
Ik zie geen reden om het werven van Indiase ok-assistenten te verbieden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over slechte voorbereiding van stagiairs in de verpleging en verzorging (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

MP Leijten asks the minister about a NIVEL survey finding that a third of care workers consider trainees poorly prepared, and about pressure on trainees to work as full staff amid shortages, plus the future of the Stagefonds and ZZP funding for supervision. The minister acknowledges the knowledge gap, states trainees are not fully qualified but may carry responsibilities suited to their level, and commits to continuing the Stagefonds pending an evaluation.
My aim is to continue the Stagefonds. An evaluation of the Stagefonds is currently underway.
Mijn streven is continuering van het Stagefonds. Op dit moment loopt een evaluatie van het Stagefonds.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voorkruipzorg in het Groene Hart Ziekenhuis in Gouda (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about priority-access arrangements (voorkruipzorg) at Groene Hart Ziekenhuis via Groene Hart Extra Zorg, including possible breaches of the Wmg, equal access under international human rights treaties, and ratification of the VRMB. The minister denied that the hospital had started business-club arrangements, said the plans were not yet submitted to the NZa, argued the arrangements are not discriminatory or in breach of the Wmg, and said the VRMB bill is nearly ready but awaits policy on minors' research.
The approval bill can therefore only be sent to the Council of State once the position on the Doek Committee's advice is ready.
Het goedkeuringswetsvoorstel zal dan ook pas aan de Raad van State gezonden kunnen worden, nadat het standpunt op het advies van de Commissie Doek gereed is.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onvoldoende kraamzorg (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

Labour MP Arib asks the health minister about a Kassa survey of 600 mothers reporting too few hours of postnatal care, multiple and inexperienced caregivers, and inconsistent information, and asks about the Inspectorate's role and staffing shortages. The minister says the survey's representativeness is unclear, that all mothers received the minimum necessary care, that the Inspectorate works on risk-based and thematic supervision, and that a final report on the staffing problem is expected in early 2011.
I would add that all women received the minimum necessary care.
Daar wil ik wel aan toevoegen dat álle vrouwen de minimaal noodzakelijke zorg hebben ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over toekomstige faillissementen van voetbalclubs (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

MP Van Dekken asked the health and sport minister about bankruptcies of professional football clubs, their effects on youth academies and grassroots sport, the impact of public broadcasting cuts, and what central government could do. The minister answered that clubs must manage responsibly, that youth training effects are expected to be limited, that broadcasting cuts would not affect clubs before 2013, and that central government has no role in securing youth sport.
The KNVB and the affiliated (amateur) clubs are well able to continue providing the football offering for young people.
De KNVB en de aangesloten (amateur)verenigingen zijn goed in staat voor het voetbalaanbod voor jongeren zorg te blijven dragen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sponsoring patiëntenorganisaties (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether the International Alliance of Patients Organisations (IAPO), which receives funding from pharmaceutical industry bodies, should have a platform in Dutch medicines regulation, and how conflicts of interest are prevented. Minister Schippers answered that IAPO is not formally represented in CBG consultations, that its industry funding is acknowledged, and that existing safeguards (subsidy rules, CGR rules, transparency) sufficiently limit the risk, though absolute guarantees cannot be given.
Absolute guarantees against conflicts of interest cannot be given, but the above safeguards, in my view, limit the risk to a satisfactory degree.
Absolute garanties tegen het optreden van belangenverstrengeling zijn niet te geven, maar bovengenoemde waarborgen perken het risico daarvan naar mijn mening in bevredigende mate in.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het experiment met de SOS-arts dat per 1 januari 2011 van start gaat (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about a private SOS-doctor home-visit experiment starting 1 January 2011 with fees of 30 and 25 euros, asking whether it is permissible, how it fits with their earlier position against co-payments for GP care, who qualified the doctors, who approved it, and whether it creates a two-tier system. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed because information from several parties is needed, promising them as soon as possible.
More time is needed to answer the questions because information from several parties is required.
Voor het beantwoorden van de vragen is meer tijd nodig omdat informatie nodig is van meerdere partijen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boelsma-Hoekstra over bedreigingen en intimidatie van bestuurders

The MP asks the Minister of the Interior about threats and intimidation of local officials, notably over asylum reception plans in Venlo, including whether local officials feel abandoned by The Hague and how the government will prevent escalation. The minister acknowledges the seriousness of intimidation, cites the 2024 Monitor showing 45% of local officials faced aggression, says a 3 million euro fund for safer council meetings is in local hands and that existing measures are insufficient, leaving further investment to a future cabinet.
These figures cannot be broken down by province based on the Monitor.
Deze cijfers zijn op basis van de Monitor niet uit te splitsen per provincie.
